That's how I originally stumbled on it. But as soon as I had finished my first cup from the sampler, I went and ordered two boxes.Order this coffee, you won't be sorry.
I really didn't like the taste.  A very bland flavor.  Timothys is much better.

When I was researching buying a brewer, I noticed that some reviewers said that they couldn't get strong coffee out of their K-Cups, which concerned me because I love strong coffee.  So, I bought all the "bold" K-Cups I can find.  Problem is- my hubby likes it more medium bodied.  Here's a beautiful answer- the Sumatra blend is bold and well rounded and gives that "ummm" reaction and I make it on the middle setting to make it strong.  The hubby makes it on the large setting to make it a true medium (and I even like it as a medium).  One set of two boxes combined with the tea and flavors we have usually lasts around two to three months.  We went through all two boxes worth one month.  It keeps you coming back for a second cup.

This coffee won't blow you away with its mild flavors, but it will not dissappoint either.  It is very pleasant but not very strong.  I think buyers who like medium coffee will gravitate towards Coffee People's Doughnut Shop before this product due to its more interesting flavor.

I really like bold full flavored coffee without bitterness or too much acidity.  I wouldn't call myself a coffee aficionado but I do know what I like.  I own two French presses, an Aeropress, several drip machines, and a moka pot.  All are great but I love the ease of using my Keurig. After purchasing it last year I have probably tried 20 or 25 different k-cups.  For a while I really liked the Donut Shop by Coffee People.  But I grew tired of it.  It's great when it's hot but not so much when it cools off a bit.  Some of the other full bodied cups tend to be very bitter.  The Black Tiger, Jet Fuel, Wake Up Call, Newman's Extra Bold, etc. all can be good but not great.  I had pretty much decided that given the convenience of the Keurig machine I would have to sacrifice a bit on taste.  Then I stumbled on Diedrich's Sumatra and I'm hooked.  This is the one you want to buy in bulk and keep in the pantry.  It's a very good Sumatra blend that is great hot or even just slightly warm.  It's never bitter and very smooth.  It has that classic chocolate Sumatra flavor.  For me this is the only k-cup I've found to be consistent time after time.  I'm on my fourth box already.
The Diedrich K-Cups (Sumatra) were a great value, shipping was prompt and the coffee is delicious.  If you haven't tried Sumatra coffee...don't waste another moment...get some!!!
One of the coffee mess' favorites. Can't go wrong with this one. Rich, bold and dark - full of excellent flavor.

I love Sumatra, but this one did not impress.  It was pale and bitter.  I had to load it with sugar to get any good taste out of it, but too much cream to cut the bitter and it got washed out. Never again with this brand!

We have shopped around for best K-cup prices and find Amazon offers great pricing and great selection for all our k-cup coffee needs.  I am able to get a discount with another company but even with this discount it does not come close to the savings you will find here with Amazon.  We use a variety of k-cups in different strengths.  We love them all!

I have had my Keurig coffee maker for almost two years now and have used various flavors of the K-cups.  A friend turned me on to this Diedrich Sumatra flavor and I am hooked.  I can only purchase it at Amazon (even Keurig does not have it) and have done so ever since.  It is rich and smooth.  Even though it is pricey (other boxes of 18 are about $10.00), it is well worth it!  Hope you will continue to carry it.As for the delivery, typically Amazon, it came in two days!  Wonderful!Thank you.

I've been generally happy with the k-cup selections I've made over the years, and this is no exception. It's flavorful and balanced... what you would expect from a Sumatra. No, it's not like going to your favorite coffee shop, but it's very good for this level of coffee making. Would buy again.
The Keurig cups arrived quickly and were well packaged. I love this coffee...it's may favorite.

column9: Pretty bland for a Sumatra coffee, but good
column10: Generally Sumatra to me means bold.  This is more of medium body type of coffee. I am actually drinking it right now. I have been drinking it for 1 week and wanted to finally comment.  I know how strong a coffee will be because I know how much cream I usually put in plus the taste.This is a mild sumatra flavor. There is no bitterness or bad aftertaste.  I'm giving it 3 stars because it's good, not great(4 stars) and not outstanding(5 stars).  It is a great morning coffee.I picked it because I was looking for a Sumatra coffee in the keurig cup format.  If anyone knows a really good Sumatra or Sumatra type please let me know.

column9: Not as good as other Sumatras
column10: Normally Sumatra is my favorite bean. Peets sumatra can't be beat, and that's the bar I judge all others. Starbucks is ok, Trader Joe's has a very nice Sumatra, but this Sumatra just doesn't do it for me. It's flat. weak. no body. At first I thought it was because it was in K cup form, but that's not the case. I brewed Peet's in my k cup filter that came with the machine, and it was a beautiful cup of coffee.I would skip it and try something better.
I've tried several kinds of k-cups, this is the best.  and subscribe and save works well.  an
do not buy if you like a strong cup of 'joe'..my wife enjoyed it, so, it is suitable for those who do not desire strong/bold cup of coffee.
Diedrich's Sumatra coffee is a another good reason why this is gaining such popularity. A medium blend that sits well at any time of the day. Smooth as silk and no aftertaste. One of my favorites.

This is a very good coffee. Just as it should be, it tastes smooth and goes down easy. I brew it on the large setting (our Keurig only has 2 cup settings: small & large) and it comes out fine. Not too overpowering for that first cup of coffee in the morning. I was worried it would be too weak, but not so: I signed up for the subscription plan to have this delivered each month. I may change (or add) a different blend in the future, but this one is keeping us happy for now!

column9: Great taste when brewed as a smaller cup
column10: Sumatra is one of my favorite beans.  This is a medium.  For me to get a good full flavored taste from this pod I find that I have to brew at the smallest or medium size.  A large cup lacks the richness and brightness in taste.

column9: ok, but not bold enough for me
column10: This coffee was ok, but it didn't have enough 'kick' for me. I think I was trying to equate this Sumatra blend to Starbuck's Sumatra. The Starbucks version is much more hearty than this oneTo be fair, this Smatra blend is billed as a 'medium' strength and it is that.

I have now tried so many varieties of K-cups and I must say that I will always return to the Sumatra...not too strong and not weak.  I also appreciate being able to get this regularly through the subscription program.  Thank you Amazon!!!!
First time I've used this coffee, and there is nothing distasteful about it. I just find it to be a little mild (anemic?) for my taste.
We really enjoy this coffee as an everyday coffee in the morning or at night.  It has a nice flavor.

column9: Not all pasta is the same
column10: I first discovered this pasta at Whole Foods and was attracted by all the unusual shapes they make.I bought some and found out how delicious it was. You may think pasta cannot be so different from each other,but when you taste this you will be spoiled forever after. Since the local store no longer carries BenedettoCavalieri, and I just had to have it I now order from Amazon and the product always arrives in perfect condition,fresh and unbroken. If you love to cook and enjoy Italian food you must try it once and see what I mean.

As a previous reviewer said, one box makes a lot of falafel. It tastes great leftover though. Mine kept well in the refrigerator for a week; I sealed it in some run-of-the-mill tupperware. The mix is mildly spiced, but I think it will appeal to most palates.A minor warning: I managed to fill my kitchen with smoke while making a batch using the broiling directions listed on the box. The instructions tell you to brush both sides of a falafel patty with olive oil and then broil them. This is all well and good, except olive oil has a very low smoke point. The falafel baked just fine for me, and it still tasted great. I made the rest of the batch using vegetable oil with no discernible difference in taste or texture. My broiler doesn't have "high" and "low" settings, so perhaps baking at a lower temperature would solve this problem.Really tasty - will definitely make again.

I tried to make a big batch of this and it was a complete failure. I've made Casbah brand falafel for years and NEVER had a problem.  I followed the instructions properly, but when the "balls" were put into the hot oil, they completely fell apart.  The "beach sand" comparison made by another reviewer was bang on.  I tried to salvage the mix I had made up by making little patties and frying them in a skillet, but they fared no better.  Made a good faith effort, and got inedible results.  I'd love to know how anyone else followed their instructions and got them to hold together.  I bought a bulk amount and have lost my money.  I'm SO going back to Casbah.
best falafel in a box out there.  just add water and fry 'em up.

This stuff is SO SO SO good and one box makes a ton of falafel.  It's probably my favorite Fantastic Foods mix (I love their vegetarian mixes and have tried them all).  And to top it all off, it's really good for you: it's not calorie dense and has a lot of fiber and protein.  Yum!!!
Very easy too make, just don't let the oil get too hot.  Great when reheated in toaster oven the next day as well.  Made a lot.

I love this mix for when you want a quick falafel. It is not better than a homemade one, but when you don't have the time or ingredients around, this is a great substitute! I even have friends that like these more than homemade. The mix is hard to find in my small town, so Amazon saved me with their grocery delivery.

I've had these a number of times and my most recent attempt was an utter and complete failure. The amount of water recommended wasn't enough to hold my falafel balls together and they came out dry. I suspect this is why they fell apart in the oil. Also half an inch of oil in the pan is really insufficient if you want to make normal sized falafel balls. Even at one inch in diameter you would have to flip them over to cook both sides of the ball. This also results in a partially cooked interior.Taste wise these are rather unspectacular. Any half decent restaurant falafel will be better than these. But then again what do you expect for something that comes in a powder form.I say try making your own from scratch. It's not easy to find a perfect mixture that won't disintegrate, but when they are good they are divine.In the meantime I'll continue looking for another prepackaged falafel option.

I bought this when I could not find the Manishevitz brand (which I think is the tastiest). I made it as per package directions-it fried well and stayed together, but it was dry and tasteless in a pita, even with hoummous on top. Beach sand is the closest description used in these reviews and that is how I would describe the taste and texture.
This thing tastes more like beach sand, than falafel. Whoever gave it a positive review probably never tried real falfel.

These are really difficult to eat during a run but eating them about half an hour before a race gives you a great boost of energy for the race.  I've set a couple of PR's since I added these to my pre-race routine!

These beans are for use with intensive exercise to replace electrolytes lost from sweat.  There is no caffeine to wake you up...  I really like these much easier to eat while running than other chews I have tried the perfect size.  Good flavor-a little extra sweet,but tasty!

column9: This item does not work... but tastes ok...
column10: This product does not work... I have bought 5 of each... I ate one packet because I wanted to get a little bit of energy, because I was staying up late, but I ended up sleeping 20 minutes later... Now, I cant sleep without it!!!As for the taste, all in all, they all taste ok. I recommend the orange flavour... and I really dislike the fruit punch...

I love the combination of the iced tea and lemonade.  Everyone who tried it at my house asked me what exactly this was because they wanted to buy it too. I make it directly over a full glass of ice, using the smallest setting.  The ice will melt a little, and if I have left-over room in the top of the glass after brewing, I top it off with either some more ice or more water.  It has just the right amount of sweetness. It's a little sweet without being overly sweet.  My daughter-in-law drinks it either hot or iced. We were horrified when we tried to buy it at our local kitchen store, when we were informed that it is seasonal, and they no longer have it in stock! So, Amazon to the rescue!

Wow, I've never not liked one of the coffees or teas that are made for the Keuring...at least until now.Weak and flavorless and is the best I can say about this. You get neither a good tea taste nor a lemonade taste. You do seem to get a bit of a bitter after-taste though. This may be due to how much the ice cubes melt during production. Frankly it is easier and less expensive to have a gallon of a good brand pre-made combination drink on hand.Brewed on 8 ounce setting as per manufacturers recommendation and it still made an extremely weak glass of tea.  Approximately 68 cents a glass.*SAMPLE PROVIDED BY THE MANUFACTURER*

I have been enjoying single malt scotch since back in the '70's. For a long time the selection available here in the States was quite limited. My normal choice of glass was a brandy snifter. The recent explosion of available brands of single malt caused me to branch out and try a couple other varities with mixed results. After reading the descriptions of some varities online, I found I just wasn't sensitive enough to discover the aromas and tastes they were experiencing. I was just about to settle back with my old favorite, (Can I name brands here?), Glenfiddich, when I discovered the availability of specialized tasting glasses while searching online.I never thought the shape of a glass could make so much difference! These specialized glasses have opened new doors, or should I say new bottles, to the single malt scotch world for me. Is it the curve of the rim? I don't know. I can't say that I am smelling and tasting all of what the 'experts' claim is there, but they do make a difference. If you have any interest in exploring single malt scotches these specialized glasses are a must have.And I may be bordering on sacrilege, but I've tried a little rum in them and they seem to work for that spirit also.

I bought these as a gift for my a friend of my husband. His favorite drink is single malt scotch (he usually drinks McCallum.) My husband and he often have a glass together at the end of the day and we thought the glasses would be better than the coffee mugs they sometimes use!I wasn't sure why this glass was specific to whiskey or scotch. I did look for information about the Riedel types and shapes. According to the manufacturer, the company did research with the help of master distillers in Scotland. This resulted the design of a glass that is an elongated thistle shape on a truncated stem.  The design incorporates a small, slightly out-turned lip which directs the spirit onto the tip of the tongue, where sweetness is perceived, and serves to emphasize the elegant creaminess of top quality single malt whiskey.There are two lines of this glass, the Sommelier and the Vinum. The Riedel Sommeliers Series Single Malt Whiskey Glass is also available here at Amazon. The Sommelier items are more expensive as the upper part is blown into a mold and the the stem and base are hand-crafted.The Vinum is machine made and more reasonably priced. The Vinum looks very lovely and is very nice and thin, there are no seams on the bowl, stem or base. (The Reidel name is etched on the bottom of the base.) It is made of over 24% lead crystal. The glass is 4 1/2 inches tall. There are 2 glasses per box, they are hand wash only. The box is sturdy and was in perfect condition when they arrived (I worried about this a little bit with such thin glasses.)My husband feels the glasses indeed improve the taste of the scotch, but he isn't sure why. He also said it also makes you appreciate the whiskey more and pay attention to it when you are drinking with the special glasses. They made a beautiful gift with a bottle of his favorite drink. You won't be disappointed in these.

I received these as a gift, absolutely unexpected.  I am greatly pleased with the glasses.  The long glass allows for aromatics to be released by the heat of one's hand and reach the nose in a sequence of small discoveries.  The shaped lip does the same for the liquid as it crosses the lips and expands into the mouth.These really do increase the pleasure of fine single malts.

column9: OK, but not as good as Glencarin Whisky Glasses
column10: These are extremely well made but whisky seems to taste much better in the Glencarin glasses. I have 8 of the Riedel Vinum Single Malt Glasses and about 30 of the Glencarin whisky glasses.  I have used these at about 10 different tastings and with the except of one person (and then only with one bourbon) every preferred the Glencarin glasses.As an experiment, I had people put the same whisky from the same bottle in a Riedel Vinum Single Malt Glass and a Glencarin whisky glass.  The difference was amazing:  The Glencarin whisky glass seemed to make the whisky smoother and more flavorful.At my tastings I will put both glasses out for people to use and they will wash and reuse their Glencarin whisky glasses before they will pick up a clean Riedel Vinum Single Malt Glasses.  That speaks to the effect.Just to be clear these are very well made and do improve the tastes of the whisky put in them, but the Glencarin whisky glasses do a much better job AND they are cheaper!I still have 6 unopened Riedel Vinum Single Malt Glasses....not sure what I will do with them.My recommendation, use these:Glencarin Crystal Whiskey Glass, Set of 4

On a recent stay at the Westin Kierland Resort in Scottsdale, I took part in a single malt scotch tasting sponsored by their Food and Beverage Department.  The beverage director used glasses of this shape and size, and talked about how the shape of the glass can enhance the single malt experience.  I was initially skeptical, but as soon as the tasting began I was convinced, and started looking to purchase a few for myself as soon as I returned home.  I only rarely drink single malt scotch (too expensive) but I've found my enjoyment of those rare moments increased by 100% as a result of these glasses.  They are pricey, but a wonderful way to help you enjoy your favorite single malt scotch, and I recommend them highly. Plus Amazon's prices were the best I could find when I purchased them.

My wife and I love these glasses. We have a large selection of Riedel products and these Single Malt glasses are of the same quality. I briefly considered the 'Sommelier' edition of the same glasses and while I'm sure they are fantastic I do not find that the Vinum series is lacking anything.As long as your buying scotch at $50+/bottle why not drink it out of a nice glass?

If you are a single-malt scotch drinker and you are not using a single-malt whisky glass to enjoy it with, you may as well be pouring it down the drain. It really makes that much of a difference. Sure, brandy glasses come close, but a good single-malt glass and just the right amount of water will completely change how and what you taste.With scotch whisky prices going up and up, spending $40 to greatly enhance your enjoyment of your $70 scotch is a no brainer.

column9: From a skeptic - the glass really matters
column10: After attending a wine tasting where different Riedel glasses were demonstrated, I had some friends do a head to head comparison using these glasses versus the typical barware you might have for Scotch.Each was able to recognize a distinct difference and improvement to the experience using these glasses.From what I can infer, the out-turned rim causes the spirits to mostly pass over the edges of the tongue, instead of on the center, making the alcohol burn more mellow, so you can detect more of the flavors in the Scotch or other liquor.  These taste buds are not as susceptible to the burn which the middle tongue taste buds accentuate.  The bowl height and shape also allows the scents to concentrate for you to appreciate, if you like.I find many strong liquors taste much better in this glass, and don't need to be watered down to fully appreciate their complexity. Old fashioneds, shot glasses, etc. concentrate the drink right where you get the biggest reaction to the burn, so you miss out on the subtlety.So if you get the glasses, please do a head-to-head comparison, and prove it to yourself.  Pour some of you favorite liquor into this glass and have a taste, then pour it from this glass to one of the glasses you've always used. Taste again, then pour it back into this glass and try it again.  Prepare to be amazed by the result...

column9: Makes a huge difference over regular glasses
column10: If you enjoy a good scotch, this will only elevate your tastings.  This really lets you take in all the nuances of your scotch, and it does what it says it does.  A wonderful product to do scotch tastings.

If you spend the money on the Scotch, why not spend a little extra on a glass? It is actually just like a good Scotch, I wouldn't really break it out at a party but after a long day at work or a nice quiet evening it is perfect.

Although single malt whisky taste great out of the Riedel glasses and the liquor hits the right part of the tongue the glasses are extremely thin and too light.They are very easy to break, lost one within the first week of use and second a couple weeks later.I bought Villeroy@Boch single malt glasses and they are more sturdy, well balanced and have a more masculine shape.

These really are wonderful. I discovered them when a waiter at Gary Danko brought me a taster of Hendricks Gin in one a few years back. I immediately set out in search of the glass.  Obviously, these are for drinking neat rather than on the rocks. (I tend to add a half of a small ice cube - chills it a wee bit - allows that extra bit of aroma to mingle with the liquid - works for me.)Do they enhance the flavor of scotch over other shapes of glasses? I have no idea. It's probably more marketing than anything else.  I still dig 'em anyway.Just a small note: I bought these to replace a few of mine that had been broken over time. These are slightly larger than those I bought the first time around. Not by much, but noticeable. Base is slightly differently shaped. No biggie, really. Just sos you knows.

We enjoyed these so much that we bought a set for my brother-in-law, who is a dedicated whiskey drinker.The size of the glass might surprise some people (about 4 1/2 inches tall and 2 1/2 inches across), but that's to capture the aromas - they aren't intended to be filled all the way up.If you like good whiskey, and drink it neat - you'll probably love these glasses.

These glasses are wonderful for tasting and Scotch - that given, they are equally good for sipping any other whiskey or for that matter any other spirit that is good enough to be drunk 'neat'. This applies to cognac, armagnac, aged rums, top end tequila such as Cabo Wabo and any number of spirits. With these glasses you will be able to easily distinguish not only the good from the bad, but to taste the individual flavors that make the difference Evan Williams single barrel and Wild Turkey  single barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbons.
I wasn't sure I believed my restaurant-owner/sommelier/friend when he recommended these, but they do make a difference in how you experience single malt scotches--especially the higher end products.

column9: Nicely made but not terribly effective
column10: One of the more enjoyable (and important) aspects of the single malt experience is the nose. Whereas with wine, the nose can be complimentary or conflicting to its taste, scotch whisky tends to be mainly complimentary. Further, as a distilled spirit often of considerable ABV, the myriad components making up a fine whisky's nose can be identified and analyzed with great depth and accuracy provided it is presented in a suitable glass.In my opinion, sloping sides to concentrate aromas from the whisky is essential and for some reason, Riedel saw fit to omit this critical feature from this glass. From the looks of it, it hasn't gone unnoticed and they've received quite a bit of flak over it. Even they admitted that they had made a mistake. One feature that is not a mistake, however, is the curved rim. This serves to deliver the spirit to the middle of the tongue rather than the tip and will let you appreciate a wider array of flavors from your whisky but the taste is only half of the story.I'm a huge fan of the traditional Glencairn glass and taste my whisky (and many other spirits) from it. They have the sloping sides but no curved rim, which isn't a deal-breaker since you can just pour the whisky deeper into your mouth. Some stemmed copitas have it but they're also much more delicate. One glass that has a lot going for it is the Ravenscroft single malt tumbler. It has a Glencairn-type shape AND the curved rim and features no stem of any kind. Perhaps the only thing that could be perceived as a downside is its 12 oz. capacity to the Glencairn's 6 oz. I find the Glencairn to be the perfect size for a dram.If you have the extra clams, you could certainly add these to your glassware collection as an experiment but if you're looking to have the best and most durable, spend your hard-earned quid on some Glencairns.
One of my 2 favorite single malt glasses. Always a hard decision between using the Ridel or the Johnson wisky tots. Great merchant eith rapid delivery.

I didn't expect a glass to make much difference in the flavour of the Single Malt Scotches I drank, but this glass Definitely surprised me. Even an unexperienced Scotch drinker noticed a significant difference when tasting the same Scotch, from the same bottle, in two differently shaped glasses - a Riedel Vinum glass vs. a straight sided glass! They are a pleasure to use, but the thinness of the glass concerns me each time that I wash them They feel extremely delicate.

I bought a set of these for my boyfriend to use at the cigar lounge, and he tells me weekly how much he loves them.  He says the single malt tastes so much better out of these, and they are durable enough to survive the lounge week after week.  I may end up buying another set for him to use at home or for colleague gifts.

Chips!  I bought this set as a gift for my husband last Christmas.  He used them about once a month.  We hand washed and treated with great care, yet both glasses developed chips on the rim after 11 months of very light use.  They are beautiful glasses, and we were planning on getting more this Christmas but since they seemed to need greater care than we could provide, and too expensive to last such a short time, we are now using and expanding our set of the excellent and well priced Glen Cairn whiskey glasses.

These glasses definitely bring out the best in a whiskey.  I was surprised how the flared lip seemed to make a good whiskey even smoother.  If you like Bourbon get these glasses.  Others have commented that they think the Glencairn glass is better.  I would qualify that with maybe.  The Glencairn does focus the nose a bit better than the Reidel however the Reidel's shape allows you to put your nose deeper into the glass while sipping and gives a smoother sip.  If you are trying to extract the last nuance of a whiskey, the Glencairn is the glass.  For overall sipping experience, the Reidel.  These glasses are beautifly made and have a very graceful shape.

column9: Same ones I got in the store
column10: Not the high end crystal or anything but they make for a nice glass to serve scotch/tequila in without breaking the bank.

column9: Single malt glasses - a real splurge but so worth it!
column10: These glasses are beautiful and, if you are a single malt affeciando, worth the splurge.  Scotch has never tasted so good!As usual with products purchased from Amazon, they arrived on time and in perfect condition.

Bought four of these glasses for my husband for Christmas.  He loves his scotch and needed a good glass for it.He is absolutely thrilled with the choice I made and recognized the fact I bought one of the best Scotch glasses that isbeing made.  It was promptly shipped and was very well packed.  I would now like to get some of the wine glasses

column9: Superb quality and does make a difference
column10: I purchased these with skepticism. Obviously being Riedel the quality is there and it shows. But, I was unsure if the drinking experience using this glass would be any different than say a double old fashioned. The answer is, it is. I hardly use my Waterford double old fashioned glasses anyone because the bourbon/whiskey I drink is so much more enjoyable out of these glasses. I purchased two sets of 2 and they are worth every bit of what I paid for them. Highly recommended for the person who loves a neat bourbon/whiskey.

I was very doubtful when I bought these glasses but after trying them I am convinced they make a difference in taste and probably more so than, say, different shaped wine glasses.  I found familiar scotches revealing unknown flavors and aromas.
These glasses bring out the complexity of your favorite Scotch. I can highly recommend these to any scotch drinker out there.

column9: a great gift for the scotch drinker
column10: We ordered this pair Riedel glasses for my fatgher in law. He loved them! They are the perfect size and very classy .

Nothing wrong with a whiskey glass for sipping, but no better way to class up the experience than a pair of these glasses.  After trying them out for a few weeks I even sent a set to my father.Easy to handle and clean, these are great sipping glasses for (Irish) whiskey. The short stem is a handy hold point without feeling unbalanced - the wide mouth on this makes for a nice drinking experience.
Nice elegant little scotch glasses.  I'd like something with a heavier more solid base myself, but these are OK for the price.

The glassware arrived safely but the package arrived two days after it was promised. All I can suspect is that they forgot about the order since it arrived by Fedex instead of the postal service per my order. It was part of my fathers birthday gift and I was disappointed that this didnt arrive one time as indicated by the "latest" deliver by date.

I grew up in Manchester, NH. My grandmother was from Quebec, and my mother and father were both of French Canadian descent.  As a result, we were all raised on Habitant Pea Soup.  It wasn't until I was an adult did I discover that pea soup was any OTHER color than yellow! We used to eat it with a little salt in the soup, and slices of white bread (unbuttered). Just as an aside, Habitant used to have a factory in Manchester right on the shores of the Amoskeag River down in the millyards where this soup was made at least as recently as the early 70s. I know, because I had a job in a nearby textile mill, and you could smell the soup cooking constantly. What a fantastic fragrance. Why they closed it, I don't know. I wish I could purchase it here in Pennsylvania!

Used to buy this excellent soup in larger cans when I lived in Albany, NY.  It is probably my all-time favorite.  BIG drawback here is that I pay as much for shipping as I do for the product.  I see there are recipes available -- and, as soon as I get my kitchen remodeled, I am going to do some experimenting.  Sure wish it was available here in the Illinois Valley -- which would save me the trouble.

Habitant Split Pea soup is really delicious.  As a child growing up in Chicago, I enjoyed it on meatless Fridays.  It must have been readily available then.  With a crisp hard roll, it made a really satisfying meal.  Now I have to order it online, but it is worth it.  Yummm.  This time I shared with my best friend, who loves yellow split pea soup, too.
My husband and I both had this growing up.  It used to be carried in the grocery store in large cans.  It tastes exactly the way it used to and still has the one dark pea in it.  Wonderfullllllll!
Soup arrived on schedule and was so well packaged, I don't think an earthquake would have damaged the soup.  Very pleased with purchase.

column9: Habitant pea soup, the best there is
column10: This is the absolute best pea soup ever made. I was brought up in New England where Habitant pea soup is readily available but now live in Texas where no one has ever heard of it. I buy it on line from Amazon by the case and always have some on hand. Buy some, you will love it too.
I had this soup a couple of years ago while living in Florida and then my daughter found it here.  It was delivered in a timely manner and tastes just like I remember it...delicious!

When my soup arrived I was very disappointed that several of the cans were dented. After contacting customer service, they actually shipped me out 6 new cans. They could not have been more courteous or helpful. So I'm a happy camper and delighted to have this soup back in my life. THANK YOU Hometown Favorites for doing business the good old fashioned American way!

I have loved this soup for over 60 years, and the can I bought yesterday was terrific the same as always.  I have to admit that I did recently get one can that was very thin with not much evidence of peas.  However the flavor was the same.  I have found this type of situation to be true with many packaged products.  I suspect that even though production is automated there is still the chance for an occasional anomaly.
Grew up with this soup & just can't by it in Florida. Then thought about checking Amazon, & there it was. This is not my first purchase & won't be my last. Thank you for carrying my favorite soup!

This is fantastic pea soup!But we already knew that since my wife is from canada.  The shipping cost is really expensive--if a grocery store here in the states sold it/could order it I'd definitely go that way. As it  is though she's worth it!Merry Christmas!

column9: The last word in pea soup
column10: I always make a point to hunt some of this down when I travel to New England and put in a supply. A former boss, from Whitehall, New York, was raised with this soup and was so attached to it that I could always get on his good side by bringing some back with me for him. Thick, tasty, and satisfying, it is the perfect thing to chase away the winter doldrums. It is yellow, unlike the normal green split pea, but don't let the color put you off. Your taste buds will thank you. If you like split pea soup, this is not to be missed.
Any soup from the Habitant label is excellent.  The french make the best soup

I have loved Habitant Pea soup my whole life. When I moved to Philadelphia from Michigan in May I couldn't find it anywhere in the city--thereby increasing my desire for my "former" favorite.  Was delighted to find a way to order it through Amazon.When the box arrived I was struck by how light it was.  When I opened the first can I realized that there were no longer peas in this soup.  It used to be at least half liquid and half the most delectable peas.  You'll laugh at this, but I really feel betrayed.  Surely peas can't be that expensive that you have to eliminate them from your formerly fabulous product.  I would have given this a zero star rating, but I thought you'd think I might have forgotten to rate.Feel a little guilty donating this to the food drive at church.Sincerely,Pat Daniels

If you like unusual soups, this product is for you.  Only grown in North Western Canada, this Habitant Pea Soup is excellent.  You can make it even better by adding: 1 can of "butter Beans", plus a healthy shake of two spices: Sage and cumin.

These seeds are great! This price is much cheaper than my local co-op, and shipping is free! Would recommend to anyone trying to transition from a "junk food" based diet to a healthier way to snack! While these are not super low-fat, they are nutritious, raw, vegan, and full of proteins and flavor! Much better than potato chips for munching on in front of the T.V..and they do not taste like "health food"! Excellent product.. and hey, don't panic, they're organic!
These are the best seeds I've ever tasted.  Full of flavor.  It's hard to stop eating them!!!

I found these at my local organic store and I can't get enough of them.These sunflower seeds are tastier than any other seeds I've tried. They are cruchy and fresh and delicious. The best part is that there's no need to peel them as they are sprouted.Makes a great, healthy snack!
These are sprouted. You get more nutrition out of them when they are sprouted. They are crunchy, yummy and it's a perfect snack for my toddlers.

I've started buying Go Raw products. I'm not vegan or vegetarian but I don't eat most commercially processed foods because they're no longer natural. However Go Raw produces what I consider properly processed foods and for that I'm very grateful. I'm not fond of the two types of chips I've bought but I love, and will continue buying, their seeds. I use the Go Raw seeds for traveling, hiking, and work since I won't eat in restaurants or eat what most grocery stores carry. I follow a Weston A. Price (WAPF) diet and it's great to find properly soaked and sprouted seeds (to combat the enzyme inhibitors and make the nutrients available) that have been dehydrated at a low temperature -- the enzymes are still viable and yet the seeds are crispy and lightly salted with sea salt. I've offered them to co-workers who aren't picky about commercially produced foods like I am and they, too, find them more delicious than the seeds they can get at a regular supermarket.
Very filling for a lunch of these seeds and raisins.  Gets me through to supper and keeps me sharp on the job by not over-eating at lunch.
I want to be healthy, but not enough to sacrifice taste, so these sprouted sunflower seeds are SUPER!  I highly recommend them.  They are one of my new favorite foods!
These are so fantastic they are addicting!Absolutely the most flavor-loaded sunflower seeds I have ever tasted! Bonus feature of being really nutritious.

first i purchase raw pumpkin and sunflower seeds bulk. i rinse them well, soak 'em in diluted food grade H2O2, then dehydrate them.  we add some of GO RAW's sunflower seeds (and GO RAW's pumpkin seeds)to those prepared seeds.  yum!

column9: My search for perfect sunflower seeds is over ....
column10: ... and this is it! I like sunflower seeds and have tried more than a dozen of combination of roasted vs raw and salted vs unsalted on different brands in the commercial market. These are by far my favorite.What's good about them? They are sprouted and then dried under 105 degrees Farenheit. (Go Raw = not roasted.) Therefore, not a trace of stale oil smell as you open the package. They are lightly salted using Celtic sea salt and the taste is really great. Also, this company (Go Raw) seems to have very good quality control. I have tried 9(!) packages in the past months and have been consistently impressed.Furthermore, they are certified USDA organic, so presumably better for the environment and better for you and your family. It is also reported that sprouted and raw seeds are "far more nutritious" than the oil-roasted seeds. So there is really nothing not to like.These sunflower seeds are good for salad toppings, which I use most of the time, but they can serve as snacks as well.Note however that they do taste different from the usual roasted sunflower seeds. So if roasted seeds are your thing, you might want to try the smaller packages from your local markets or Go Raw Organic Cltc Sea Salt Sunflower Seeds (2x16 OZ) before getting this pack of 3 x 1-pound bag.Allergy information: These are certified wheat, gluten, nut free and are vegan.Highly recommended for anyone who likes sunflower seeds, but especially for the salad eaters.

These sprouted sunflower seeds seem fresh. I have not tasted any bad ones. But it was just too salty for me. The customers for such a product are most likely very health minded. I wonder why they add salt to it. Most organic nuts and seeds I had before are without added salt. Is it because this is sprouted? I will need to check to see if other sprouted products also have salt added.I don't mind a dash of salt. But again it is too much to my taste.
These sunflower seeds are delicious, easily some of the best I've tasted. Would have rated them a 5, but as others, I also wish they were not salted even though I didn't find them to be too salty.

column9: Good for snacking, great for baking!
column10: First, I love the fact that Go Raw processes their products in nut free/gluten free facilities and says so prominently right on the bag. That makes a big difference and was THE reason I chose this product. Thanks Go Raw and Amazon!The sunflower seeds are delicious right out of the bag. They taste fresh and not overprocessed. They are kind of salty and they are very high in fat naturally. The taste is pretty addictive, so I avoid snacking on them right out of the bag.I use them for baking in recipes that call for nuts. I soak them in a bowl with warm water for a few minutes, rinse twice, and I have a great unpredictable but yummy alternative that really tastes great in everything from blueberry muffins to whole wheat bread.If you're cooking for someone who has nut allergies or for a school event where nuts are generally prohibited, these fresh tasty sunflower seeds provide extra flavor and crunch in favorite recipes. (Just be sure to rinse first!)

After learning about the importance of eating your seeds, nuts and legumes sprouted, I began looking for alternatives and found that Go Raw makes them and Amazon offers them at an affordable price. The Go Raw Sunflower seeds have all the good points you should look for: 1.they are organic, 2.they are raw, 3.they are sprouted, 4.they don't haves any unnecessary ingredients added, except sea salt, which makes them gluten, wheat and soy free, 5.and they taste delicious, which makes my 7 year old son want to eat them as a snack. The company is family owned and they source the seeds from local growers.

These sprouted sunflower seeds are roasted below 105 degrees which means they retain all the nutrients as if they were raw.  They are lightly salted and delicious.  We eat them as a snack and sprinkle them on salads....very very healthy.

I rated this a 1 just because I didn't care for the taste at all.  I have never purchased any raw seeds before and this might just be what it's supposed to taste like but it has a weird aftertaste and I can't get rid of these bags now :(  No one wants to take them off of my hands....

these things are soo fudgey! I could eat them every day for the rest of my life. Right after I write this review I am going to buy ten more boxes. These things are pieces of heaven in a bag. The only thing I hate is they are a tease! Theres only three little brownie bites in each bag!! NOT FAIR lol
These are pretty good, but i'm very sure that I can bake much better one's myself for a lot cheaper. $18 is a lot of money these small little things.
My grandson loves these brownie bites and I can no longer find them in the store. Thanks for offering them online. You are a lifesaver.

Have loved this tea for some time. What surprises me, unpleasantly, is the price through Amazon. I can get this for $10 directly from Republic of Tea, and for $9 through other sites. To pay more than list price through Amazon is unacceptable.

I first discovered this tea at Panera. When I couldn't find it in my usual haunts I resorted to Amazon which, of course, had a source. It doesn't get bitter as many green teas can and has just a nuance of a smooth honey flavor.  Everyone I've treated to this tea loves it as well.
This tea is so soothing. It tasts so delicious! When I sip it, I feel like I am in heaven!
This is delicious tea. It's just sweet enough to make a great iced tea. I drink a cup every day at least and make pitchers in the summer.
I make Christmas (Norwegian) bread year round and this the only place I can find these out of season.

column9: These are the best I have EVER bought!
column10: I know, candied cherries, aren't they all the same?! NO WAY!Our family has a LONG standing tradition, we make a fruit cake for Christmas!NO! It is not that nasty type of fruit cake you get in the tins or even in the package in the stores. This is a moist and delicious 5 pound fruit and nut cake that we fight over and BARELY share with our most loved friends!Being a military spouse, we are limited to where and what we can shop while living overseas. Trust me, the local merchants LOVE their candied fruit MORE than we love our cake! Let me tell you about that some time! $20 for 6 ounces, and I needed 2 pounds of fruit, can you say, AMAZON?! And here I am, telling you about the BEST candied cherries I have EVER had!The shop that these were ordered from is my favorite feature about this purchase! Feels like hometown America, when you are far from home, its nice to know you can find and order something from home! I have to say, my cake was the best we have ever had.... maybe it had something to do with the deployment we were gearing up for, but I say, its the cherries and the hometown of America they came from that made them SO good and took my cake over the top!THANKS! We have been back to order and will keep coming back, even when we have a choice of places to shop! Won't that be nice!
I ordered this for a recipe and they arrived fresh and worked perfectly for my recipe. These tasted great and they last a long time in the refrigerato.

column9: Red Cherries that turned out to be green.
column10: I ordered red cheeries for cookies. received green cheeries that I could not use.  Will not want to order from this company again.
Not too over powering. Lots of powder and not too salty. Comes with pieces of dried veggies and very small beef pieces but adding more beef is not a problem. lol

Roland Kosher anchovies in olive oil from Spain are a great buy of a really high quality fish product. The reviewer who said they are high in Sodium apparently hasn't used processed anchovies before- these are no more saltier then other canned anchovies in oil and much less then anchovies packed in salt. I highly recommend this product to anyone using anchovies for cooling, in salads, making dressings, etc. If you are concerned about sodium to the point where you cannot use a product naturally high inn sodium and additionally processed with salt, learn about that product before making comments that are derogatory and untrue in nature.
These Anchovies are terrible. They are mushy. More like a paste than a filet. We threw the 2nd can away, had them too long to return them to Amazon.

column9: It's not Inner Beauty, but it's great
column10: I purchased this sauce, wishing that East Coast grill still made Inner Beauty.  This is a close second, with mustard and cumin balancing the scotch bonnet pepper flavor.  It's hot, but not excessively so.  A great condiment for burgers, meats, even vegetables.

column9: Add some tropical fire to your next curry or even a burger
column10: I often  make different curry dishes for my family, from lamb Vindaloo to chicken Korma, they are always favorites around my house.  The only problem is that some like it really hot and spicy while others prefer it medium or mild.  It's hard to please everyone and just adding hot sauce at the end isn't the same since the peppers and spices don't get a chance to become a part of dish as it does when it simmers for a long while.  With Rasta Fire and a little extra work everyone gets what they want.I often separate my curry dishes before I add the meat (for my son the vegetarian), now I just separate some more for those that like it hot.  I love hot sauce and have a dozen bottles open in the fridge at any one time.  I gave this sauce a chance several years ago based on the ingredient list.  The tropical fruits such as orange, pineapple and papaya and the spices that includes curry, tumeric, cumin allspice and annato really appealed to me.  I would rate the heat as 6 or 7 out of 10, just hot enough to hold it's own in a stew but not so hot that the flavor is over-powered by the heat.  The combination of heat, tropical spices and fruit make for a sweet and savory sauce.  Here are a few things that I've used it in (or on):*  Indian Dishes*  Thai Dishes*  Bar-b-Qued Ribs*  Deviled Eggs*  Chicken Wings*  Burgers*  As a topping for cream cheese or goat cheese appetizers*  As a marinade (with orange or pineapple juice)I really like this sauce and always have a bottle on hand.  If you think that all Habanero sauces are so hot that they hurt, you might want to give this a try. It's really surprising how complex the taste is.

This is by far one of my most favorite hot sauces out there (next to my Mother-In-Laws hers is amazing).  The flavor of this sauce has always been just the right mix of sweet and hot that I have known out there.  I found this sauce about 15 years ago and to this day I have not found much that can compare out there on the market when it comes to a very nice flavorful sweat session, thanks Rasta Fire for the kick and great taste!!!!

column9: "Inner Beaty Real Hot Sauce" replacement found!
column10: Been missing Inner Beauty for a long time, and on occasion have looked for a replacement.Found it - this stuff is pretty much the same. It's hard to remember exactly what something tasted like that hasn't been around for years, but I think they pretty much nailed it.If you loved Inner Beauty, you'll probably love this stuff too.

column9: Not the real thing, but still pretty good.
column10: I am sorry, but this is not authentic Dutch licorice. The original Dutch Licorice, known in Holland as 'Drop', is made with Arabic Gum. However, Gustaf's is made with Wheat Starch instead, probably because it is much cheaper. That does affect the taste, as Wheat starch has a more sticky pasty texture, where Arabic Gum has a firmer and  smoother texture.Nevertheless, this is by far the best 'Drop' I have found so far that is readily available in the USA for a decent price. Importing the real stuff can get quite expensive. So, I will be buying this again.
These are delcious. They have a good strong-ish (compared to what you can get in the US), slightly salty taste. I can easily eat a whole tub of these.

This is a great licorice treat for big licorice fans.  The drops are soft and much saltier than I was expecting but nevertheless, I could not stop eating them by the handful.  Not for the feint of heart or non-licorice fans.
These are great but I had originally ordered the coins and love those best....our whole family does.
Last time I had licorice like this is when I visited Holland and got hooked on it.

Ships as an oblong box with 6 plastic canisters inside. Reasonably easy to open and tight sealing. There is a good number of small pieces, shaped like gumdrops but much firmer in texture. Let them melt in your mouth or release a it's flavor with your first bite. Not too gooey, and not overly intense flavor--just good solid taste.Made with real licorice root so consider possible effect if you have high blood pressure.  [...]

column9: My father, who is dutch, loves these
column10: My father loves these and he is a true Dutchman.  They are so good he won't share.  He likes that they arent too hard, so it's easy to chew.

If you are a fan of licorice then this candy is for you but only for those of you that really love this taste. If you are only a moderate fan of licorice then you may want to pass on this.Because this is an intense licorice ride. It's a great chew and a punch of flavor.

I am Dutch and love the Dutch licorice. Grew up on the stuff. I am just considering whether to buy more more. We just finished 12 7-ounce containers already and my husband who loves them as well told me NOT to get anymore because we will finish them in record time and want even more. What have they done to us to import this delicious treat. I love the coins and drops the best. Very good flavor.
with an old timey licorice flavor. just a few satisfies that sweet craving without doing too much damage to your calorie counting!

column9: For people that loves White Asparagus!
column10: Guilty as charged. I do and have loved white asparagus since babyhood. Instead of white milk on occasions I was fed blended soft white asparagus at room temperature. By my own decree (I was very assertive back then) and later I learned the many gourmet possibilities that exist with this much understated edible. Most people being familiar with the green variety, which is not bad for I do love all things asparagus, that offers different ways of consuming. From raw to steamed to sauces to grill, the possibilities are not limited to either or.Back in the old world the chinese population had a gift for chinese foods. A lot different than the ones here in US, somewhat a cultural blending with south american cuisine influence, they had the famous and much loved chicken rolled in asparagus. Really a highlight every time of the dinner.This one gets a 4 and that is good enough for now for even though it is much appreciated it is not eaten with a lot of frequency or the bathrooms wouldn't be able to take for they do reveal themselves in that most basic of human function, the famous #1. Kind of a strong reminder of what one had for dinner.Enough said and 4 well deserved stars for Roland White Asparagus peeled Spears, 27.8-Ounce Can (Pack of 3).
These are a little expensive but are nice to have with a special meal and taste wonderful. In the past with canned white asparagus I have found other brands tough, but not these.
Gluten Free Folks!  You will love these.  I buy them by the case.  They are a staple for me.  I do like rice cakes; but I like these much more.

Ordered my box of coffee pouches in January 2008 and product was delivered promptly. Unfortunately the best-before date was 18 December last year!. I've heard other reviewers had similar problem. That's a bit shabby of Amazon. I didn't much care for the taste of the coffee either and will end up giving it away. I'm sure Amazon would let me return it for a refund but for a box of coffee, I just haven't got the time to waste. Bad Amazon... maybe perishable foods is not a great idea for an "eTaler". I've had good experience with Amazon on hard goods to date.

When I lived on the border of England and Wales, I had a roommate from Copenhagen Denmark, and he got some of this in his Christmas goodie basket from his Mom. At first it is a shock to the system, and I was the only American in the house that didn't spit it out. Soon I was bugging him to get his Mom to send more. It is a testament to the impression that it made that 25 years later I checked Amazon to see if I could get it here.Before I got home my wife and kids had gotten into the box and tried it. They didn't try a second piece. I however after the initial shock of the first piece, remembered why I liked it. And although this case will probably last me a long time, I do rather enjoy the flavor. But be warned the flavor is HEAVY on the salt and very light on the sweet. But it is a treat that you can enjoy without emptying the whole container in a sitting and wonder where it went. So... if you are adventurous, or if you remember the taste from your European adventures, try this exotic treat.

I love licorice and thought I would try this stuff out. I wondered how a double-salt licorice could have 0 mg of sodium. Well, the answer is, the saltiness is the ammonium chloride. There is no sodium chloride (table salt) in this licorice. I'm not sure that ammonium chloride is any better for you than plain old salt, but since it is 'sodium free' it appears on the surface to be a healthy choice. Bottom line: This stuff is salty. A very close friend of mine is Dutch. He's not the typical, "I'm Dutch because my grandparents came from Holland." He is the real deal. He is not even remotely interested in visits to Amsterdam, like most people are. I told him I had some Dubbel Zout (Dutch for double-salt) and he was over to see me instantly. He loved it. Where most people immediately spat it out or nearly choked on it, he was crazy about it. I think that says a lot about its authenticity. Now, as to the saltiness, if that's not your thing, I suggest not buying six tubs at first (though the price is great), but rather pick up a single tub from an import market. If you have tried the double-salt and think that all of the dutch licorice is like that, then you need to try Gustaf's Licorice Coins (which my friend refers to as single-salt). They are outstanding as well. Both the double-salt and single-salt are interesting and authentic Dutch confections and I highly recommend them both.

Its sad that most of the bad reviews are from people who don't realize what they are purchasing.  This is Double Salt Licorice, and its a very salty tasting candy (if you can call it candy).  Since its salted with salmiak, it has no sodium (but ammonium chloride).Anyways, when I was a kid I used to love to get rock salt and let it dissolve on my tongue and thought it was way better than regular candy, so as an adult, I have finally found what I consider to be the perfect treat, highly recommended to those people who love salt.  This stuff is pretty much perfect, I've tried many different types of Salt Licorice and along with the amazing Tyrkisk Peber, this stuff is the best (note: I prefer the harder candies not the chewy ones).  If you're expecting traditional US licorice (which mostly I don't like) then don't waste your time or money.

First of all, I'm a licorice fiend - and not the so-called licorice typically sold in the US.  I grew up in Sweden with the real deal - I even bought ultra-bitter licorice sticks from the pharmacy, back when they sold that.My favorites range from Malaco to Fazer - with ammonium chloride filled licorice candy like Turkish Pepper at the top.Bassett's is the substitute of choice in the US - not much available here.With that said, here's what I thought about Gustaf's - and I bought a whole case.  It's too flat, it hits a very narrow band of licorice flavor - something missing to make it bloom.Great chewability, lots of licorice flavor, but no depth - if that makes sense to you.  Most other licorice versions that I like hit a much broader range.It's worth a try, but I suggest that you make this a small portion of a mixed plate of various licorice types.
Excellent product. I bought this for my boyfriend who is Dutch and loves this kind of candy. It's hard to find in stores and this was as good as he remembered as a kid in Holland. Will buy again!

column9: Know what you're buying! This is DOUBLE SALT Licorice!
column10: Sad when people order something they don't know and then give it a bad review!  Double salt (tastes exactly as it is described) is an acquired taste!  You work your way up to it- you don't start at it.So in all fairness those bad reviews should be ignored.  I am Dutch living in the USA and although there are some better DZ (Dubbel Zout) licorice - Gustaf's are running a very close second.If you are a double salt fan - you will like these - great price - great product.

This is a good price for this amount of quality licorice.  This is the traditional Dutch concoction containing a strong salt taste and smell.Not for everyone, the taste of this product is less sweet but more long lasting than the licorice candies we are used to eating in America.  If you know you like this strongly flavored licorice this is a bargain.

Double salt licorice is a very scary flavor for the uninitiated. People don't like it the first time, then start to crave it if they stay with the taste. If one doesn't like this licorice, it's great to serve to unwanted guests.

column9: You have to be Dutch in order to like it
column10: And Dutch I am,the double salty "Dropjes" is like taking a sip of the North sea,there was enough in the shipment for me to hide some in every crook&cranny in my house,car and in a special box to keep in my pocket at all times.Try it,you might like it.

These DZ licorice buttons are what are known in Northern Europe as Salmiak pastilles. Salmiak, or sal ammoniac (ammonium chloride salt) used to be prescribed as a expectorant for head colds. Sal ammoniac is also used as soldering flux to clean metal. The sugar was used to cover the very strong, corrosive taste. Those who've acquired a taste for them crave them.  All others spit them out within ten seconds. I use them as a diet aid, as two or three will put you off food for hours. Keep them in their resealable tubs as they attract water from the air.

column9: Contains Ammonium Chloride - It's not your typical licorice
column10: This licorice contains Ammonium Chloride. Personally I got to like it after a few weeks of testing, but it's definitely an acquired taste (ammonium chloride!). Don't buy this licorice thinking it's regular salty black licorice (by some cats or coins if you're looking for that).

column9: Love it or hate it, these are unique
column10: If you've never tasted salty licorice, don't buy this bulk pack. It's not the same as sweet black licorice at all, and I don't blame the folks giving it one star. You absolutely need to find a $.50 roll of salmaki first, or you might wind up throwing the whole shipment out, because these are a very acquired taste. But I love them, a few at a time, and they were just what I'd been looking for ever since a friend introduced me. Best of all, they're vegan-friendly, with no glycerin at all.The first taste that hits your tongue feels like a salt lick; once you've melted off the outer layer the taste and texture mellows out quite a bit. They're hard but not especially gummy; they dissolve easily in the mouth. After a couple you get quite used to the taste and it's no longer a shock, more of a savory that gets you to munch some more, but it does leave the palate quite cleansed for a while. I haven't yet found a red wine or liquor these don't clash violently with, but a very acidic white works pretty well.The only trouble is that there are so many; I've had the 6-pack for a month and I'm not even half way through the first tin! I can't in good conscience palm them off on friends and family!

column4: Lingering Lethal Poisonous Lene of Death
column10: This is the real deal. It's what you get when you buy it in the stores in the Netherlands. It's just the perfect double salted taste I craved for. It is excellent!As so many have said, this is acquired taste. I grew up with salty licorice, and this is just short of giving me the burn I so want. If you haven't tried it, be prepared to throw is all away, or give it as gifts to people you don't like. But if you have an ounce of adventure in you, try this! It will burn and sting (in my opinion, not enough). Once you get over that, it has a sweetness to it. After a while the burn will become pleasant, as will the taste. And it is sweet!The recommended serving size seems high to me, though (5 servings per tub). Once I've eaten myself sick, I guess a tub can last a few weeks.
This is the best tasting licorice ever made. Combine it with some sweet licorice like cats. {two cats and one double salt and chew.} Heavenly.

If you're looking for something sweet, keep looking.  This item bills itself as "double-salt" and it definitely lives up to its self-description.  Go to your refrigerator and take a spoon full of baking soda, now let it melt in your mouth while sniffing a box of Good and Plenty.  You've now experienced the essence of the flavor provided by these double-salt licorice pieces without spending the $15.  If this is what you're looking for, I highly recommend this product.  I gave it 4 stars, because it is what is says it is.  It's just not what I was looking for.

When they say salty, they are not kidding.  Ok, so its not overpoweringly salty and there is the faintest amount of sugar in it, but I wouldn't consider this to be candy and you have to search for the sugar and if you don't focus on it you will lose it.  I wish I hadn't gotten a whole order of this, and that there was a way to get a sample first.  I ordered it because its so hard to find Tyrkisk Peber.  If you want a licorice to the extreme but still be reminiscent of candy, I recommend checking that out instead.

Don't buy this if you're American and you think you like salty things.Don't buy this if you love licorice, but have never tried Dutch double salt licorice.Buy this if you want the saltiness of the Dead Sea packed into a tiny drop of something vaguely resembling licorice.

I acquired the taste of this licorice the first time I tried it. I say acquired because at first I didn't like it, but a chunk of it got jammed in a molar and was for a while irretrievable. By the end of that struggle, I actually liked it. I liked it enough to buy this pack of six tubs.It's an awful lot. So I offered to share it with a few friends, hoping they would like it but warning them they might not. I told them I liked it, and I proved it by popping one into my mouth.My friends hated it. But as a joke, they pretended to like it whenever I offered it to someone else. We would all have a good laugh as the curiosity on their faces fade into confusion, then disgust. Most people spat it out and asked me, "And you actually like that stuff?"The people who refused to play along with the joke made it even funnier. I always warned people that the taste was very different and they might not like it. When else someone chimed in and said they didn't like it, that just intrigued people more.So to sum up my experience, given the amount of licorice, this item is fairly priced. Given to friends, the reactions are priceless.

OK, here is the truth.  I rated 5 stars because it is EXACTLY what it says it is.  However, I will not buy these again due to how strong the salt flavor is.A little background....I was raised in a low sodium family.  I do not put salt on anything, including eggs.  So, if you like black licorice....and you put so much salt on your food it would look like a Twilight vampire if you placed it under a light due to the light hitting the salt crystals, you will probably like these.The best analogy I can come up with is if you put a spoonful of salt in your mouth, and a small black jelly bean, you would have the salt to licorice ratio.What I like:The salty aftertaste lasts a long time.  It reminds me of a long drive home from the beach where you taste the ocean in your mouth.The saltiness keeps me from gobbling down the entire tub....which I would do if it were regular licoriceWhat I dislike:The saltiness is a little bit more than my tongue is accustomed to.I still have 5 more tubs to open and finish :/Conclusion:The product is exactly what it claims to be.  If you grew up with a lot of salt, these will provide you with your salt fix.  (Even though there is 0 sodium)  If you grew up with minimal salt, you may want to try the regular salted kind instead of the double salt.

column4: this(ladies and germs), is my pen name .Prett...
column10: I wanted to try some Salmiack so I bought a bag of the fish , a bag of the cats, "Katjes-Kinder" is printed on the red packaging they came in and these double salt disks.The double salt is strong....STRONG... but it IS delicious though eating more than two or three back to back may not be the best course of action .They are A little too soft however and for that reason im going to see if I can find Double Salt Salmiack with the 'toughness' of the cats. I dig licorice and I will be a regular user of these Dutch varieties from now on
Can't be compared with anything else. You either love it or hate it! I happen to really enjoy the taste.Give it a try!

When I grew up as a kid my grandparents would always bring DZ licorice with them when they would visit us from Rotterdam. Eventhough I like this licorice it is not the same as I remember when i was a kid. My dad told me the old DZ licorice was made from salt from the North Sea and this item does not have real salt. I guess they are trying save money or trying to be more healthy by using fake salt.

used to get these from my grandma as a kid around christmas time but the little dutch store where i live closed down and i havent had these in years then i found them online and ordered them and was not disappointing love this candy

This is my husband's favorite brand of salty Dutch licorice.  Bought him a case of it for his birthday, and boy, did he flip out!  Now he's set for at least a few months.  I like knowing that this brand is always delicious, and always just what he likes.  Not too soft, not too salty, not sweet.  It's grand.
Sadly most people I tried to share it with did not love it. Amazing how salty they are, a wonderful contrast to the dark black licorice flavor.

I don't like regular licorice, but this is very tasty and very addicting.  I guess the salty flavor balances out the slightly sweet licorice flavor, which makes these pretty good.  Highly recommended for people who don't care for the overpowering taste of black licorice.

I grew up with Salt Licorice and love it, especially the Double Salts. It is definitely an acquired taste though. I wouldn't recommend starting with a double salt and start with a button, farm animals, or cats. I have had friends try it several time in my life and not one liked it with their first try, however if they stick with it and try it a few times it grows on them to a point where they like it a great deal. Now whenever I have some they all want some of my stash.

column9: If you've grown up with salty licorice, this might be what you're looking for!
column10: This stuff is awesome! I grew up overseas where I was able to choose from tons of different varietys of salty licorice made with ammonium chloride and only the saltiest stuff was good enough for me. These totally live up to the double salt name and the ammonium chloride (salmiak) gives this candy the right flavor. However, if you haven't sampled several varietys of salty licorice with ammonium chloride and liked it, I'm pretty sure you find this suff disgusting. I'd say, don't buy it unless you know that you like strong salty licorice typically sold in the Scandinavian countries, Netherlands and Germany.

column9: Great. . . where did the bears come from?
column10: I love this stuff, but my batch came with a few bear shaped pieces that were not salty licorice.  At least two of the 7 oz. packages contained at least two of these "bears".  I'm just curious if this is normal. Other than this, if you like salty licorice, this is very yummy stuff.

So the story goes like this.  I'm working at the office one day several years ago when a co-worker pulls out a tub of Gustaf's and tells me to try a licorice coin.  Now, I hate licorice.  Always have.  But I decided to humor him.  Within 5 seconds that candy was out of my mouth and into the nearest trash can.  He assured me that his initial response to the candy was similar, but that several weeks later he began to crave their curious flavor.It took a bit longer for me to come around, but it's true.  There is definitely something about this candy that I love.  It's not your traditional candy.  There's nothing "sweet" about it.  It's like a salt-lick for humans, tapping into that part of our primal instinct that craves a salty flavor every now and then.The initial insertion of the candy is a shock, like a weird chemical burn on your tongue that you want absolutely no part of!  Wait it out.  Suck on one of the coins for a while.  Put it in between your teeth and squeeze out the salty, licorice flavor.  It's different than regular licorice, whose flavor is only really apparent towards then end of the candy when you've sucked all the saltiness from it.Take your time with a piece and give it a shot. It's an acquired taste; like coffee or beer, and it's definitely not for everyone.  And it's not one of those candies that you just want to keep in a jar on your desk year round.  But occasionally - say, once every 12 - 16 months - you'll want to pick up a tub and go through it.  That's the way it is for me, at least, and I wouldn't have it any other way!
First purchase I got were okay and I enjoyed them.  But the second batch were just too salty to eat, I ended up throwing them out. When they say super salty... they mean it..all salt no licorice.

column9: Not as I remember Dutch licorice
column10: Nothing as I remember Dutch licorice...not salty taste, just ammonium chloride, nor salt crystals on licorice.  Certainly wish I'd just ordered just one container!  Not wonderful licorice taste w/tang, just chemical residue in mouth. This product ought to be offered by the container so folks aren't stuck with five unopened packages.

The fourth ingredient in this candy is ammonium chloride. Too bad I didn't read the label before ingesting this product.  It has been several hours since I ate my first and LAST two pieces of this candy and I still have the sensation and smell of ammonia in my nose.  A spicy dinner and a Neti Pot nasal wash did not remove it.This is one of the worst things I have ever had in my mouth (or up my nose...) and I am heartily glad I bought a single carton at a local store before buying a CRATE at amazon.com.I'm a salty licorice lover.  This licorice is very salty, hardly sweet (that's what I expected) but packs an unpleasant and lasting ammonia wallop that I found intolerable.

OH my gosh.  Don't call it salted when there's no salt in it.  The "salt" comes from ammonium chloride.  Eat more than one, and the fumes-- the fumes fill your nose and mouth and you breathe ammonia.  Totally gross.I'm giving these away to the kids for Halloween.

This is the worse salty licorice I have ever tasted.  My friend is European and turned me on to Salty Licorice and the store we bought from could not get it in stock..  I went into Amazon which i love and always go by the opiions.  I bought this and with shipping was expensive. It tastes like amonia....  I have never tasted anything so bad..  I did get one down....  My European friend spit hers out...  all containers went in the garbage...  I guess $[...] worth with shipping..
Excellent service from seller and good price.However,I obviously failed to read "double salt"in the description. Not to my taste.My fault entirely not the manufacturer.

i like black licorice. i like salty licorice. but this double salt is way too much. all you can taste is the salt. and it burns your mouth. i had my order delivered to work and had about 15 people here sample it as well, and not one person liked it. take this as a warning.

To sum this product up with one word it would be SALTY, but its not like the salty taste that I am use to the ammonium cloride in the product give it an ammonia flavor.  I have had the taste of the one piece that I ate in my mouth for several hours now, even after drinking some pop and going to lunch its still there.Please advise, even if you are adventurous DO NOT TRY!!! Only try this if you are use to ammonium cloride, if you are not, it will be one of the worst tasting things you will ever run accross.

Always a fan of Licorice.... This one was quite differnt!! Taste like chemical such as Colorox!!! I thought that it was damaged but the 2nd set was just as bad!!!! Thank you Amazon for replacing the first pack but had to toss the 2nd one as well :) Paid $24.00 for nothing. Thanks

This product tasted more like bleach than licorice.  I actually LIKE salt licorice, but this brand was just ugh.  It has a definite stong bleachy undertaste. Don't buy it unless you have tasted it first!

I don't understand how anyone can eat or enjoy these.  So if you are on the fence, stay away.I put one on my tongue and it burned.  I can still taste the horrid bitterness and my eyes water at the memory.I love salted licorice in general but this stuff is disgusting.
GROSS!  My workplace uses this as punishment when you lose a bet.  Unless you're one with an "acquired" taste do not try it, believe me.  Extremely salty.

I prefer soft licorice. I do NOT prefer salt licorice.  At least not licorice this salty.  And I agree there seems to be this note of bleach in the bouquet (if licorice can be said to have a bouquet).  Give me the sweet stuff anytime!  This stuff? Not so much.
I did not get what I ordered in this case. I got licorice but it was not the salt type I ordered.
Without overpowering the taste, Ahmad tea has perfected the art of adding flavor to teas.  You can get a hint of those fruits with every sip but you are still drinking a quality black tea.
This tea is as fragrant as it tastes.Ahmad Tea Peach & Passion Fruit Black Tea, Tea Bags, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)

A lot of the reviews/testimonials I see claim how great this product is for dieting because you'll "never need sugar again." That's certainly not what this product is for, as its effectiveness is questionable and its price is prohibitive (not to mention that simply eating lots of raw lemons/limes would tear apart your teeth/stomach...). These Miracle Berry tablets ARE, however, a fun novelty item to have at a gathering of a few friends. I had seen them on the tv show "US of Tara" and they piqued my interest, and so I ordered some as a surprise for my roommate's birthday. Anyone interested in weird food or fun dinner parties would like trying this item at least once.While fun was had by all, there are problems: While they certainly work as advertised, the effect isn't mind-blowing. Lemons and limes taste sweet and can be eaten without the "pucker-face", but many of the other foods that you can find recommended to try online are not as drastically changed. Which is the other problem: There aren't that many different foods that are great to eat with the tablets. Lemons and limes are best. We tried goat cheese, mustard, hot sauce, pickled veggies, aspirin (which is weird), and a Guinness, but they don't necessarily taste BETTER, just DIFFERENT... Also, while 1/2 tablets seem to work fine, we all had to take an extra 1/2 to make it work better (and the person who said they taste like vomit must have gotten a bad batch; they taste like mild candies...).So all in all, we had about 20 minutes of fun (there were 4 of us; more people might equal more time spent?) before tiring of eating weird-tasting foods, and we still have more than half the package of tablets left that we'll probably give to some friends that have recently asked us about them.The real trick seems to be surrounding yourself with fun people, because otherwise there isn't much magic to the proceedings. It was worth the one-time trial, though, if only to have had the experience. Enjoy.

column9: It worked better for some than others
