column10: This was a fun night. I got together a bunch of friends and we tried a bunch of different foods.  Some of the people had a much stronger reaction to it, but I didn't get too much from it.  Sour patch kids felt like they should have been sour, but they weren't at all.  Guinness did not taste like chocolate milk or a milk shake to anyone attending.  I think that is a myth put forward to sell more Guinness.  It was interesting for a night.  They didn't last very long though.  We each went through two tablets just to make it through the many foods we had.

Grapefruit tastes like it's covered in sugar!Lemons tasted like lemonade!Schnauzberries tasted like Shnauzberries!put the tablet in your mouth, rub it on your tongue until it goes away. Taste sour stuff! You'll LOLs i swear!

the berries are more than a good time during a party or get together. Set out a few different sour or bitter items, lemons, limes, grapefruit, grapes etc... Then top if off with some beers or wine for extra fun. In my experience avoid most hard liquors, they tend to take away the effect of the berries more quickly and do not taste exceptionally well with the berry effect. Using liquors in mixed drinks like a jack and coke or even a fruity martini is a good time. Overall great experience. Don't get carried away eating too many sour foods, especially if you're not used to them. They may taste like the sweetest thing you've ever had but will still have the same effect on your stomach, not always a fun experience after.  ENJOY!!!

column9: Wow! It really does work! Do NOT try vinegar though!
column10: These are hella expensive, but they really do work. Lime tastes absolutely amazing and lots of other sour items taste amazing. However, normal stuff still tastes like normal stuff but orange juice was amazing! Finally, do NOT try vinegar, it still tastes like vinegar, little difference.

The miracle berry tablets work just as described, they make anything that tastes sour taste sweet instead. Lemons and Limes taste like they are coated in sugar. Etc. The problem I had was that the effects of the tablets were short lived and somewhat disappointing. After about ten minutes the effect from a whole tablet fades. 30minutes to 2 hours is probably the effect you get from the real fruit, but these tablets are weak. Other than that, a real amazing treat.

column9: This stuff is amazing.  Some people are less/more effected by it but for me it has been outstanding.
column10: This stuff is amazing.  Some people are less/more effected by it but for me it has been outstanding.  The effect lasts about an hour and really changes/expands the flavor of almost anything you eat.  I love eating grapefruit with this!  It works well on things you normally like too.  Do you like strawberries?  You will love them with this.  How about eating a lime straight?  Most of us would say no but with one of these it is like candy.  I bought a box and a few weeks later I bought four more to share with my friends.

the box in the picture is not the box that came nor do i think that they are the same brand. the new brand was effective but not nearly as effective as the tablets shown in the picture, overall i am disappointed with this purchase.

Lemons are the best with this product, they taste like a sweetened lemonade...Limes taste like limeade...and Snozzberries taste like snozzade...wait...These are great for little tasting parties like we had...everyone was curious what different things would taste like and we had tasted many things in the fridge from pickles, lemons, limes, cheese, and sriracha. Little on the expensive side but still fun to try.Knocked off one star because it's not amazing, but it definiately is interesting and pretty much everything just tastes sweeter.

i had been excited to try these, and immediately broke them out with my 3 roommates when i got them in the mail.out of the 4 of us, 3 of us experienced a significant taste difference while 1 only experienced minor taste differences after letting a tablet dissolve on the tongue.we bought a lot of citrus fruits, and grapefruit was by far our favorite. it was amazing, and i don't even normally like grapefruit at all. it tasted like it was full of sugar syrup, but not in an overpowering way.lemons were our 2nd favorite, also amazing. they tasted like a lemon shake-up... or lemons dipped in sugar. one roommate compared it to a lemon drop, but i think that's not giving it justice!limes were also great! one roommate dug the lime juice out of the fridge and kept drinking it like limeade.we took cautious sips of apple cider vinegar which also tasted... good! it was weird since it still SMELLED like vinegar, but it tasted like sweet apple juice with a slight bit of twang to it.we tried goat cheese like we'd read about, which indeed tasted like slightly sweet cream cheese. interesting, but i'd skip the cost of goat cheese to just buy more lemons and grapefruits.lastly we bought guinness, which was interesting... not like a "chocolate milkshake" as we'd heard but definitely sweet, with hints of chocolate and beer. one roommate disliked the sweet flavor of the guinness. i still like regular guinness better!we were enjoying it but the effects started to wear off... just a few minutes later. a couple other friends have since tried it as well, with the same results; things start to taste normal again before the 5 minute mark. we were really disappointed; we wanted to eat more citrus!all in all it was a fun experience, but not really worth it considering how quickly it wore off.

As other posters have said it does change things but not quite the miracle it claims to be.  The lemon was different, the pickles were sweeter and the wine vinegar was the most distinctive.  Then too each persons experience is probably going to be their own.  Worth a try if only to know what others may be talking about.

column9: The effect is barely perceptible and definitely not worth trying more than once
column10: My girlfriend loves grapefruit, but I absolutely hate the stuff.  For her, it starts and ends very sweet, for me (and most people in the world) it starts sweet and ends bitter.  After we tried the Miracle Berry Fruit Tabletstablet, there was a small difference for both of us.  For me, the bitterness subsided a small amount-- not even enough to worth mentioning.  For her, the grapefruit tasted like one of the "sweetest" ones she'd ever had.However, the real treat for both of us came with the lemons and limes.  Both of which tasted noticeably better.  However, the effect of a single tablet wore off completely within 5 minutes.  To be honest, I hoped each tablet would last closer to an hour, but as is, you're paying quite a bit per minute for these things (we paid ~$20 for ten tablets w/ shipping).Would I try it again?  After the tablets we have left are finished, I think not.  I already enjoy gala apples, bananas, watermelon, oranges, and strawberries without this tablet-- I can live a perfectly happy life without ever eating grapefruit, lemons or limes DIRECTLY (lemon and lime are fine in foods).If you're dead-set on trying these tablets, try it with some of your friends and don't expect too much.

column9: Does nothing, don't waste your money.
column10: Purchased two packs to use for a gimmick tasting game at a party, but everyone was disappointed in the pills not working as advertised on ThinkGeek and other sites.Everyone agreed that the pills themselves had a sweet flavor, but didn't alter the taste of anything we tried after the pills had dissolved on our tongues. Didn't ruin the party or anything, just a little aggravating given how expensive they are.Will not be buying again, you shouldn't waste your money on them either.

I bought this based on the reviews and I gotta tell you that I was extremely disappointed in the results of this product based on the reviews.  We did not notice little if any change in the taste of things.  I bought "Extremely Sour Candies" from an other vendor to this these with and noticed nothing sweet abou them.  I order 3 packs to give to all my family.  I was so excited to finally get them and the candy.  It was the biggest let down I have experienced in a long time.  So much so that I have ordered from Amazon quite a bit over the years and this is the first review I have written.  The product was that bad.  It left a coating of this candy taste nn my mouth.  The taste turned putrid after about an hour and I had to brush my tongue to get rid of the taste.  This product is not at all what it was advertised to be.  Just a poor gimmick.

This item is rather interesting.  Have it with some lemons, beer, grape fruit, etc.  It makes things that are bitter very sweet, as you're probably well aware of by the time you read this.  It works, I never doubted it, I just doubted how effective it would be, and it's very effective.  It wears out after an hour or 2, so if you don't like it, it wont be like a bad trip, it goes away relatively fast, but not too fast for those who are enjoying it.

If you're skeptical at all and think this might be a scam, don't worry.  They definitely work.  I'd recommend rounding up a group of friends, grabbing some assorted citrus fruit (limes are the best!), and trying it out together.  When you first bite into the fruit you usually taste the sourness for a half second, but then it disappears and gives way to the sweetness.  Just remember that even though you can't taste it, you're still consuming a large amount of citric acid.  My tongue and mouth are usually sore afterward.
We tried so many different foods with this. The sour foods were surprisingly super sweet. It also made blueberries taste like Foghorn Leghorn, I say, I say!

I've tried other cheaper brands, but I keep returning to this product and will probably never stray again.  There are 10 tablets in each box and you hold one tablet onto your tongue and let it dissolve.  For the next 30 or so minutes, everything that is normally sour or tart will be sweet.  I've tried this on all sorts of tart fruit and it makes them taste very sweet (some too sweet).  For the price, I wish they'd include more tablets in the box, but they are effective and a much better quality than their competition.
I bought this product, and received it promptly in the mail.  'Twas a great buy indeed!  They made all the sour things taste great!
I gave these magic tablets a try. They worked if you are eating something really sour, like lemons, limes or pickles.  They don't make anything else taste sweet.I don't think I will buy these again.

The Miracle Fruit Tablets are amazing!  They really do make sour things taste incredibly sweet.  I tried straight lemon juice and it tasted like the sweetest lemonade I could have ever drank.  I highly recommend these little tablets to people trying to cut sugar from their diets.

After buying these I tried them and they worked just as described.  My friend and I tried a few sour things (such as lemons) and some spicy things (a jalapeno).  After that I just put them on a shelf and left them there for a while... at this point I have no use for them lol.

I have to admit, I was a sceptical at first.  I had picked up some citrus sour fruits to try, as well as an assortment of other things I'd read about that are supposed to be affected by this little miraculous fruit tablet.  After allowing the tab to dissolve on my tongue I immediately tried some lemon and lo and behold it tasted like a super sweet candy.  Grapefruit tasted sugared, limes were like a lighter version of the lemons.  Lemon and lime combo tasted like a sweet Sprite(tm). I had read that Guiness was supposed to taste like chocolate shake but alas this was false.  No chocolate flavor at all, the berries just removed some of the bitterness.  Tobasco(tm) was pretty tasty though. In summation, these tablets are awesome when it comes to citrus, not so much with everything else, but that's just my opinion..
These work great, You can take one of these then eat a raw lemon and it really does taste just like lemonade. Hot sauce tasting good, no.....  It was nasty but these things are fun to play with.
They are kind of cool to eat once, but they taste gross and leave a gross taste in your mouth.  Great seller though, got'em fast!
step 1: let tablet dissolve on your licker.step 2: eat something sour.step 3: freak out and eat more&more&more&more 'til your mouth burns the next day.too much fun and better yet, NO SUGAR NECESSARY!

column9: Finally and answer for my sweet tooth!
column10: Now I finally have a cure for my terrible sweet tooth!!! I get real bad at night grabbing everything sweet I can.Not after trying the Miracle Berry today. I'll be gorging on strawberries and oranges and raspberries. Oh my goodness, so heavenly!!!I only dissolved a 1/2 a pill slowly on my tongue and it worked just fine. This is just about the most fun thing I get got. I am sure they will help my diet. The lemons were just like lemonade. Very good. Kinda gotta watch it on those as they could be bad for tooth enamel.These aren't going to a party...these are mine, mine, all mine mmmuuuuuaaaaahhhaaahhhaaaaaa!!!

I would have to agree wholeheartedly with the other one star reviews. This tiny little packet was way over priced and the vendor charged way too much for shipping. They charged $5.98 for shipping an item that they probably could have sent with a single first class postage stamp affixed.I agree with those individuals who said these tablets taste funny and are definitely not sweet.  After dissolving the tablet, the quarter slice of lemon that I bit into was only slightly sweet... MY son said it tasted like lemonade. It did sort of taste like lemonade - more sour than sweet.  After that the effect pretty much was unnoticeable. I tried it again tonight with some raspberries and sour cherries. I tasted no difference, other than that of the strange lingering after-taste that the tablet leaves behind.Another person mentioned having tasted tea after dissolving a tablet on the tongue. Like that person, I did notice a difference but did not really care for the taste. More like an artificial sweetener than like sugar. My son and I were very disappointed with this purchase.

I had read about this dramatically changing your test buds so I went on a shopping spree to try all the things other people had mentioned. I am not sure if there is another brand of this product out there that works better, but I found the effect anti-climatic. Basically some sour candies were not sour, and I ate a whole lemon and it tasted like sugar. Everything else people mentioned (like hot sauce, stout beers, etc.) I experienced no difference.

I bought this thinking I would be able to eat spicy foods like no problem.  These things take about 20 minutes to kick in and then it just makes stuff taste sweet WHERE THE TABLET TOUCHES YOUR TONGUE.  If you miss a spot on your tongue then you will still taste it in that spot. DISLIKE A LOT!!!
Two of my friends and I tried these tablets with some pickles - none of us could detect any difference in the taste. Total waste of money.

These do not work. I tried one, waited, then tried another and ate some different foods. They still weren't working so I took 2 more for a total of 4. Still didn't work. It was annoying. Don't buy them. Thank you for your time.

Her's my problem with people like the previous reviewer. I don't need your novice, pseudo medical opinion for a product you have not tried. You are as bad as the people that review a recipe after they change 6 ingredients and then say it was just okay. They didn't review the recipe at hand! I digress... The company has been making this stuff for over 30 years and have not seen any issues or side effects. In fact, dogs and cats seem to love it and they seem happier with better coats. From the Avoderm website:"SAFETYYou can feel quite confident in AvoDerm® pet products safety and nutritional value. In the over 30 years since Breeder's Choice first introduced this product line, millions of dogs and cats worldwide have consumed AvoDerm® with no negative reactions from avocado oil or meal.AvoDerm® pet products use only carefully selected suppliers of avocado meal and avocado oil. Years of problem-free consumption of these products indicate that AvoDerm products are not only safe for dogs and cats, but also provide vital nutrients for them.Concern has been expressed by the ASPCA about the consumption of the leaves, fruit, bark, and stems from the avocado tree, with the exception of the avocado fruit which is used for the oil and meal; none of these parts are factors in any of the AvoDerm® pet products formulations and we have no indication that avocado oil and meal as used in AvoDerm® are toxic, poisonous, harmful or bad for your dogs or cats diet.Dr. Art Craigmill, UC Davis, Professor and Extension Specialist in Environmental Toxicology has said that his studies and other research in the United States and Australia have shown that the problem of toxicity is in the leaves and the pit of the Guatemalan variety; the avocado meat of the fruit and oils have not been shown to be toxic. AvoDerm pet products do not utilize any Guatemalan variety avocados, nor do we use any leaves or pits of any variety of avocados for our avocado meal and oil.The avocado meal and oil used in the AvoDerm pet products comes from the meat of the fruit and does not contain leaves, bark, skin or pit of the fruit. The oil is extracted from ripened fruit in which the meat pulp has been separated from the skin and the pit. Through a mechanical separation process the oil is extracted and filtered and placed into sealed containers. The pulp of the fruit is dried, ground, and screened before being placed into its final packaging and than shipped to our facility."BOTTOM LINE:Do your own research, research the company or the claims about the ingredients or try it for yourself. My dog (Yorkshire Terrier) seems to love this food. He gets excited and waits by his bowl when he knows it is almost time to eat. He does this even for just the dry food alone! Other dry foods that I have tried before would require me to mix in some wet food after a while to make it more appealing. Not Avoderm - he is still always excited to eat it. He also gets a spoonful of the wet food in the afternoon as a snack and he goes even more bonkers for that stuff. I am happy with it - I will be trying the grooming products next.

By dogs, Gus (Glen Imaal Terrier Mix) and Tootsie (tiny teacup Poodle) both loved the food.  I will have to feed it to them for a few more months to see if it REALLY changes their energy level, etc.  I have noticed their bowel movements are smaller, which I understand is a good sign for dog food that is full of nutrients and not fillers.  Anyway, I loved it and am getting more.

column9: Chihuahaua does very well on this food
column10: My chihuahua puppy did so well on this food, but then I could not find it anymore. I tried a new food, but she had diarrhea and bloody mucous. Finally I put her on the Avoderm Small Breed Adult food as the formulation is a lot like the small breed puppy version, except with a little less protein. My puppy is 8 months old now so I figured it was okay. Now she is thriving again -- nicely formed stool, very silky coat that is luxurious to touch, and lots and lots of cheerful energy. I am not kidding. I hate paying a premium price and having to go way out of my way to buy Avoderm, but my dog does so well on it that I am going to keep her on it. How much can a 3 pound dog eat, anyway.

column9: dog food for my Bischon Frise
column10: Since Joy, our Bischon Frise, started eating this food, her fur is no longer oily.  She smells much better.The pieces are very small and easy for her to eat.

My small Cavalier King Charles Spaniel (81/2 months old & only 8 lbs.) loves this food!  Anything else, she turns her nose up at (she's picky, too!).  But she gobbles this up like crazy.  Its a great formula and the avocado meal and oil in it has given her a most beautiful and soft, silky coat (the grandkids say she feels like a bunny!).  She also has a bit of a sensitive stomach and vomits whenever she has any food with beef in it, or rawhides, bully sticks, etc.  With this formula, no disgestive problems at all.  My only complaint is that Avoderm only makes it in a 3.5 lb bag instead of larger, more economical sizes.  I've sent them an e-mail to ask about manufacturing larger bags.  Otherwise, this has been really great for my "baby".

column9: The only thing my picky dogs will eat!
column10: I have had a really difficult time getting my dogs to eat dog food:  one had to be on a special homemade diet for 6 months, after which no kibble would make the grade.  Fortunately, this one worked, although I do take extra measures for my incredibly picky dogs, including crushing it, adding warm water, heating it in the microwave, and mixing it with ground beef.  Avoderm is a healthy food that I trust, and the other reviewer with concerns about avocados need not worry:  it's the stems and leaves of the avocado that are a problem for dogs, not the meat of the fruit itself.  I will keep buying as long as they make it.

I have to buy this dog food for my Dashound because of allergies to food. This is the only dry dog food I have been able to find that will not cause him to break out with bumps. Beside he loves it. I will continue to buy this as long as I can find it.He has had no adverse reactions since being on the this food. It is better than the stuff the vet was selling me for allergy's.
My dog loves this food.  Avoderm makes several different types of food, but i found the chicken and turkey to be the best.

column9: FINALLY, ANOTHER OPTION FOR SMALL OLDER DOGS WITH TEETH PROBLEMS
column10: I have have 10 toy poodles and all are over 8 years old and have lost some teeth.  I have searched and searched for a very tiny kibble which, when water is added, will not take an hour to soften up for them.  All others I have tried are so hard  and larger than I like, except bil-jac.  I have been giving them bil-jac for years mixed with canned dog food.  Bil-jac is the only one I had found that the kibbles are small and easy to crumble for them even dry.  To add water to it, however, makes it more gooey.  I wanted to try something new for them but had just about given up.  I tried this brand of canned dog food and that was a hit so thought I'd give this dry a try.  Well, it works just great and they love it.  I use a  Cuisinart  k-cup type coffee maker that also is used in our household for hot water.  I just put the dog food in a bowl add the hot water and it is soft enough in less than 10 minutes.  It is not as gooey as bil jac when wet. The kibble is triangle shaped about 3/8 of an inch on all sides. VERY TINY, which is what I needed. I would recommend this food to anyone with small dogs, older dogs of any size who have gum and teeth problems and have  trouble chewing or are missing teeth and can't chew at all. I am so happy I discovered this food!  P.S.  It's a very healthy food for them too.  As long as the price is reasonable, like now, 15.00 for 7 lbs, and can be bought with Prime 2 day shipping free, I will continue to buy it on a regular basis.UPDATE 3/21/12 - Oh rats!  I went to re-order and price went up to 16.98 plus 5.73 for shipping.  Disappointed, but found another seller who offers prime shipping on this item, thank goodness. Regular USPS does not deliver directly to our house, in the mountains, and we have to go pick it up.  I am not always able to do that due to health restraints, so Prime shipping is very important to us as it offers UPS delivery to our door. This seller always did an amazing job getting our order to us quickly with the prime shipping and I was very happy with them. I regret having to change, but is necessary.

My whole family loves them.

column9: Popcorn lovers -- you really should try this

column9: 19 Grams of sugar!!! Wash it down with a coke why don't you

This was the second flavor I tried -- the first was the Cherry Pistachio, which was even worse and gave me a stomach ache for the rest of the day.I thought the ingredients sounded promising: WHOLE GRAIN ROLLED OATS, MULTI GRAIN BLEND (WHOLE GRAIN ROLLED OATS, ROLLED BARLEY, WHOLE GRAIN ROLLED RYE), DRIED SWEETENED APPLES (APPLES, SUGAR), DRIED SWEETENED CRANBERRIES (CRANBERRIES, SUGAR), WALNUTS COATED WITH ROSEMARY EXTRACT, BROWN SUGAR, DEHYDRATED APPLES (APPLES, SUGAR, FRUCTOSE, CINNAMON, MALIC ACID, SODIUM SULFITE FOR COLOR RETENTION), WHOLE GRAIN ROLLED WHEAT, SALT, CINNAMON, NATURAL FLAVOR.Part of the problem, for me, was that they're just too sweet. But part of the problem was also that they had a "weird" aftertaste. Kind of metallic and "off." I don't know how else to describe it. Something that doesn't taste like oatmeal or fruit or nuts. Maybe it's from the "natural flavors"?Of course, individual experiences will vary from mine. But I think I'll stick with the old-fashioned way. It's a lot cheaper and healthier to just make regular oatmeal and add your own "flavors" -- fruit, nuts, maple syrup, whatever -- and it won't leave a bunch of little cartons to recycle or go in the landfill.

column9: petroleum derived FD&C Blue 1 = extreme GI distress :-(
column10: Over the years my parents would send me to school and I was just fine until usually either lunch or a snack time with the school or a well-meaning room parent providing grape or fruity colored sugary drinks... or bright colorful candies.. or maybe mom splurged on those bright colorful cereals for breakfast. YUM!  Every kids dream, right?Well each  time I consumed some of these brightly colored cereals or pastries or drinks or candies, over the next few hours I would develop at least mild stomach pain. The deeper the color or the more I consumed, the worse the experience. Eventually it ended with me locked in the bathroom, doubled over in pain, for hours on end, as perplexed school officials called my parents to come get me, as I was AGAIN being sent home from school.  I was soo embarrassed. Pity the few subs who refused me a hall pass - I remember vomiting at my desk more than a few times to the stunned sub who hadn't realized how seriously I had GI issues. If I say I need a hall pass, I meant I *needed* a pass.Growing up as a teenager, dad remarried and my stepmother didn't buy much colorful "kids" drinks n such anymore. Wow, what a change, I even managed a year of perfect attendance! Me?! The kid who averaged 20+ days out sick from school had perfect attendance! My grades improved! I felt better....Then as a young adult, I was trying to kick the soda bucket and went back to the colorful sugary drinks of my youth. The abdominal pain and diarrhea was unreal. I began missing some college classes and my grades slipped. I was having some difficulty at work with a male boss who did not understand, he even implied I was lazy. Really? I was going to college full-time while working in a factory with forced overtime and tutoring on the side. It wasn't my fault I had a sensitive stomach.......until one day I was at home with one of the really bad episodes, doubled over in pain with diarrhea again and it suddenly hit upon me. GRAPE KOOL-AID.  I had consumed a whole pitcher of GRAPE KOOL-AID that day before getting ready for work (2nd shift). I read through the label... RED 40 and BLUE 1 stuck out...  so I stooped drinking grape Kool-Aid and went back to Pepsi for awhile. Symptoms stabilized... until one day when I had a tuna lunchable. A small attack convinced me to read labels- there was BLUE 1 again.I was 25 years old when I made the "BLUE 1 DISCOVERY". I am now in my 40s. I have since learned to avoid lotions, mouthwash, dish soap, GRAPE KOOL-AID and even "white marshmallows".  Since learning to avoid BLUE 1 including GRAPE KOOL-AID my life has significantly improved.I discovered very serious and relevant information about BLUE 1 from the FDA website... the term "BLUE 1" and "causally linked to fatalities" was significant enough for me that I wrote to the medical doctor who issued the press release; we shared a number of interesting email exchanges.I  have learned some "natural" brands of "children's cereals" are made with elderberry juice for coloring. I wish KOOL-AID would change to natural colors! (If using colors at all...) Oh and I kicked the soda bucket, too. I learned what fresh squeezed lemons mixed in a glass of water with d-ribose could do for both taste AND for energy. I feel so much better!

This formula has been a real lifesaver for my son. He had a difficult time digesting every formula we tried from NeoSure to Lactose Free to Soy. Unlike the other reviews, I believe the Enflora has helped. On the can, it recommends not warming the product because it inhibits the enflora to work. I believe this to be true. In order to save money, if my son didn't drink a bottle I made because I thought he was hungry and he wasn't, I would save and warm later. It seemed as though whenever I would warm, he would scream with pain until he either gassed or pooped. Pretty much what he did with all the other formulas he was on. We use room temperature water when mixing and it seems to be the key. I would recommend giving this formula a try. It's expensive, but if it helps your baby, it's worth it. Sign-up with Enfamil online and they'll send you coupons. Good luck. I understand how difficult it is dealing with a baby in pain.

column9: Relief began with the first bottle!
column10: After nearly 4 months of changing my diet, stopping my medications (not a great idea), fighting with my baby to nurse, dealing with a screaming baby every time I finally got her to eat, constipation and mucousy stools, putting her on Zantac and then Miralax, and then, finally having her refuse to eat at all; my pediatrician had me trial her on Nutramigen. The first bottle showed an amazing turn around!!! After the office visit I was out and didn't have any bottles so I did one last nursing which she fought the whole way through. The next feeding I gave her a bottle of Nutramigen and she calmly drank, finished the whole thing and burped easily. No struggling, no crying, no pain! Just a calm, happy, baby, finally! Admittedly it's taken a few weeks to get past her mucousy stools, constipation and she still needs the Zantac but I am so happy this formula exists.Another good thing is that it doesn't smell like normal formula. Not being used to formula, this was a relief for me.Cons: it's not cheap and it's quite hard to find coupons or cheap prices. Most annoyingly is that it's very difficult to find multi-can packs with the 19.8 oz cans. It's mostly just the 12.6 oz cans. It works out cheaper than buying the larger cans since they aren't coming in discounted packs but it just seems so wasteful to have all these little cans to throw out.Typically this formula causes an increase in frequency and runniness of stools. For us that's a good thing since she also has a bad problem with constipation (actually managed to have a BF baby that was constipated tho it's not 'supposed' to happen). She still doesn't stool daily yet but after 3 weeks she's up to every other or every 2 days (from over a week between). The stool smells aweful, though!If your baby has a milk protein allergy, this is an excellent choice!

column9: Painfully expensive, but a must have if you need it. Use "SUBSCRIBE AND SAVE" for a better deal.
column10: Nutramigen worked a miracle for my youngest child. She is one happy, stinking girl. No doubt it stinks, and it is painfully expensive, but there is nothing to compare if you really need it. I'm just glad it exists. If you use it, you probably already know its value, and you are just trying to get the best price. It also helps you quantify how much you are actually using. In our case, it was nearly double what I originally thought, which made the savings much more significant. column9: Made all the difference in the world
column10: From the time my son was 30 hours old, we knew something wasn't right. He began having all sorts of problems that only got worse for the 3 months that I exclusively breastfed him. He had acid reflux, stomach cramping, explosive and painful gas that hit 2 hours after he ate, foamy stools, green stools, light colored stools, fussiness at the breast, hives, eczema, rashes, diarrhea and mucus in his stools, and the final straw was blood in his stools. Not just a little, but more blood than poop. We saw several doctors and I tried several exclusion diets, the final one consisted of me only being able to eat chicken, pears, rice and potatoes. We had this poor child that was in almost constant discomfort or pain. It was gut-wrenching to watch. Our son's pediatrician, who is also a major advocate for breastfeeding, finally suggested Nutramigen. All his symptoms pretty much disappeared! He occasionally has reflux (especially if we have him on too fast of a bottle nipple) and some gas due to constipation from the formula. But we now have a child that is happy that laughs and plays. For the first 3 months, he needed constant attention, cried if he wasn't being held, and was up a lot at night. He now can lay by himself and play. He is a completely different child. We finally saw a pediatric GI and nutrition specialist who said it is food allergies to something, and that Nutramigen is the best bet until we can figure out what he is allergic to. It has broken my heart not to nurse him because I believe it is what is best for him, but I can't argue with the results we have seen since putting him on this formula. I hate the cost, but it is worth every cent. And I use the $5 coupons whenever I buy it which helps a lot. And the specialist said that if I give him probiotics (found at local health food stores), they will mimic most benefits of breastmilk. One last thing, I tried to get it covered by my insurance but was unsuccessful. But, if you have any luck at all, it will probably be with the prescription side of your insurance, not the medical part. Some will cover it if your pediatrician's office call them with all the child's clinical data and why it's a necessity. Good luck!

column9: More expensive for less formula, gave my baby very painful gas
column10: My daughter has been on Nutramigen Lipil for about 5 months now for her acid reflux.  It has really helped with her spitting up and digesting the food quicker.  Since the stores in our area decided to discontinue carrying this type of formula and started stocking the Nutramigen with Enflora, I've had to switch over to using that instead.For one thing, it is much more expensive.  It's a 12.6 oz can instead of a 16 oz. can.  The scoop inside is much larger so you are using more formula per bottle.  They say the reason for the scoop being larger is that the formula is less dense.  In any case, it is still costing you more money (as if it wasn't expensive enough already.)In our case, our daughter is now suffering very painful gas pains, especially in the middle of the night, since we've started using this new type of formula.  She is also pooping much more frequently during the day. Before she would go about once a day, now it's about 4 times a day.I've called Enfamil to see how I could obtain the original formula and they looked up their past orders to see who in my area has ordered it recently.  All the names they gave me were stores I am familiar with and have personally checked to see if they stocked it, which they do not.  Fortunately, I found a case of it here on Amazon for much cheaper then they (Enfamil) or any grocery store could ever offer.I'm not sure why they felt it necessary to add Enflora to this formula if for no other reason than to make even more money.I strongly recommend that if you are going to start your child on Nutramigen, to get the formula that does NOT contain Enflora.  Check with your pediatrician first to see if they have any free samples they can give you.  I am eagerly awaiting my case of Nutramigen Lipil so that I can once again enjoy a full night of sleep without waking up to my baby crying out in pain.

At about three weeks old my breastfeed son started to get fussy.  At first we thought it was just typical colic but it got worst everyday for the next week.  He was crying/screaming longer and would not calm down for hours.  It didn't seem like normal fussing.  Our doctor told us to try the Nutramigen and it really made a difference.  Since I still wanted to breastfeed, the doctor suggested I go on a dairy and wheat free diet for several weeks and then try him on breastmilk again.  My son is now 12 weeks olds and we have tried to give him breastmilk several times since starting him of the formula.  Each time we had the same result.  He would scream and kick.  He got constipated and had bad gas and wouldn't sleep much for a few days until the breastmilk was completely out of his system.  I don't know what I would do if this product was not available.  He is a happy, smiling, adorable infant when he is drinking this.  Totally worth the price!

I have 7 week old twin girls, and one of my girls begining at 3 weeks of age began to have uncontrolable crying especially towards the evening hours from 10-2am sometimes. Her crying wasn't a normal fussy cry it was an 'I'm in pain' cry. It was incredibly hard and frustrating not being able to do anything except push through 3-4 hours of crying while trying to care for her sister. I switched to Similac Sensitive thinking it was gas, it helped only SLIGHTLY. I was desperate so I delt with the slight help I could get, but the crying conitnued. It was frustrating looking for help online only to be told it's colic and "nothing can be done". I called my peds office which I also worked at and asked to see one of the doctors whome all I trust personally after another terrible night of her painful crying.I explained the situation and the doctor said it was a possible milk protien allergy and her little body just couldn't break down the cow's milk properly and was causing upset stomach and pain. It made sense as I was a vegan and didn't drink cow's milk myself it may have effected her.He gave me some Enfamil Nutramigen and said to try it out for a few days to see if there was any difference.That night Friday I gave her a bottle and she did still fuss through the night, the next night after only giving her Nutramigen she cried but MUCH less. After that Saturday night she never cried her horrific cry again and the crying seemed to cease all together in the evening.It's only been two weeks, but it's been such a life saver. Not just for her having no more pain and being able to sleep now with complete comfort and getting her rest, but for my sanity!! I'm finally getting some rest myself and feel peace knowing she isn't in pain and she is happy.I believe this product is wonderful and would suggest anyone at least give it a shot. Not one formula works for all babies, this may not be the perfect one for some babies but it's obvious that it is for many with the milk protien condition or 'colic'.The price is high but a happy healthy baby's price is worth much more.I pray you all can have a happy healthy baby!

column9: Peace of Mind for Parents & Baby
column10: The first week after our son was born, he was a perfect baby.  At the two week mark, he was diagnosed with a milk protein allergy, acid reflux, and colic, not to mention he wanted to be held constantly.  After giving up dairy and soy in order to breastfeed but having issues with my supply and other awful things no mother should ever have to go through that shall remain nameless, I finally caved and gave my son some of this formula which my pediatrician had given me a free sample of "just in case."  I had major guilt in even thinking about giving this to him since every breastfeeding book you read makes formula seem like the worst thing you can give your child.  I got over that in a heartbeat when I saw how quickly this formula satisfied my son.  He was like a completely different baby.  He is now a 100% formula baby and couldn't be happier.  I never used the previous "model" formula as this is our first child.  What I can say is there is no price too high to pay for the health and happiness of our son, and this formula has made us a happy family once again.

column9: Caviar Taste is worth the Price
column10: Since I had my daughter, she has been through 5 different formulas before finally being able to tolerate Nutramigen.  Yes, it's expensive but so much worth the price. When your child has acid reflux, milk and soy food allergies to the point where blood and intestinal tissue is found in their stools (as mine did), the price is insignificant. Even with trying the Similac brand, Alimentum, it didn't work and she didn't like this formula.

This product is a miracle. Our little boy was so incredibly unhappy until we found this product. Although expensive, as most parents would agree, anything is worth your babies happiness and health. I would say that any mom/dad who is experiencing more crying, gas, fussiness than normal should purchase this product. We went through so many formulas before finding this one. Just go right to the best, forget the rest.

column9: Only formula which gave baby a good nights sleep
column10: We tried 4 different Enfamil formulas which worked ok for a few days and then baby would cry and cry and scream and would be up most of the night.  The baby is 5 months now and my daughter tried switching between the soy, gassless, regular formula and the baby would still scream and scream and in a painful state.  This formula is more expensive but it is worth a peaceful night for both mom and baby.  Baby does still spit up some but is in a better spirit with this formula.  Yes it is expensive but there is a reason why it is more expensive.  We did try another brand of the hypoallergenic and also had good results with it and it was also expensive.

I agree 100% with the other reviews on this product. Do not buy the Nutramigen with Enflora. It is a rip off and it makes my daughter's colic come back. I heard that they were going to stop making the old formulation and if that is true I don't know what Im going to do!

column9: The only formula for our little princess
column10: This formula has been a lifesaver for us. Our daughter is so much happier now that her tummy feels better. Amazon has the best price I've found.

My son has been on nutramigen since he was about 20 days old. He was unable to digest breast milk (lactose issue). After trying 4 different formulas recommended by my doctor (none of which worked), my husband and I decided to give this a try. It started working within 3 days. My son's belly distention went away, he was able to keep the formula down and have normal BM's. My son is now 10 months, happy, healthy, and still loving his nutramigen. Our doctor recommended starting to mix in other formulas (with lactose) once he reached 9 months, we tried very slowly to re-introduce them and his digestive problems started back up immediately.  So, it is nutramigen all the way for us!!!

This formula smells HORRIBLE. We have tried giving it to our daughter, because she seems to be lactose intolerant. We're on WIC in our state, and this formula is the only lactose free, non soy based formula covered. She got Baby's Only Lactose Free formula, which she loved. However, it's not covered on WIC. We have tried to move her over to Nutramigen, but she blankly refuses to drink it. If nothing else, what little she did drink, didn't upset her stomach like regular Enfamil, hence the 2 stars rather than 1.

Our newborn was around 2 months old and was having some stomach issues after feeding. We tried Similac advance, Similac sensitive and Gerber good start but nothing worked to ease his digestive problems.The nest step was to try something like Lipil or Alimentum and after some recommendations we went with this stuff. He would drink it without any problems but after about 4 days the problems started. Initially his bowel movements became a little watery. This gradually turned into him having some liquidous discharge in every diaper and an inflamed area around his butt. We kept him on it for about 3 more days but with the inflamed area getting worse we took him off of it. Once off his stool returned to normal and the rash or inflamed area cleared up.I cannot recommend this formula at all, especially after reading numerous other bad reviews on the internet.

I received 6 cans in a pack and used four of them without a problem.  When i opened the top of the last two cans, there was loose powder and i then discovered the cans had been busted.  i had to throw them away as they had been spoiled.  since i had already used the other 4 cans in the pack, i could not return the damaged cans.  frustrating, since this formula is so expensive.  my advice is to check all the cans in the pack before completely opening the first can to use.
This worked well for my baby who is sensitive to cow's milk. It is expensive but this is the least expensive way I have found to purchase the product.

This stuff is great.  Our second child was about 6 weeks old and began to have colic-like crying fits in the evening.  She had gas, constipation, was very unhappy.  Our pediatrician said to place her on this immediately, he suspected a cow's milk protein sensitivity.  He was right.  Within a day no more upset baby.  Her disposition changed right away.  It's expensive but worth every penny and the best for their health so it's a win-win.  I cannot recommend this product enough!

Our baby has reflux and a protein allergy, and despite being on Zantac, then Prevacid, along with being switched from breastmilk to Similac Alimentum, she kept getting worse.  We got desperate the day she refused to take in any fluids, and we bought a can of Enfamil's Nutramigen (with Enflora).  We weren't expecting much, and we certainly weren't expecting her to suck it down happily and hungrily!  We've stopped fighting with her to take the bottle - what a relief that mealtimes aren't a battle anymore and she's not fussy all day from hunger.  We thought the Alimentum and Nutramigen were the same, but obviously they aren't because our picky little eater won't touch the Alimentum but loves the Nutramigen.  We couldn't be happier with this formula!  So what if her stools smell horrid - she's ten times happier since we switched her, and she just keeps getting better.

Our son was born with Hirchsprungs disease and had two surgeries to correct the bad section of his colon, because of the surgeries and initial colostomy bag he didn't /doest know how to poop on his own consistently...he had the initial surgery a few days after birth and the second to reverse the colostomy, remove the bad section of his colon and reconnect everything at 3 months. His peditrician gave us a sample of the nutramigen and it worked but because it went so fast we couldnt see if it was coincidence or his own efforts...so we went back to the regular enfamil...granted we had to dialate him and irrigate him when he didnt poop so we really wanted something to work...well we finally took a chance and bought a case of nutramigen and man oh man i think hes making up for lost time...when he does poop which has been often this past week it does seem to be painful or uncomfortable but i think it because he tries to hold it in instead of releasing it as we all do. I say this because when he sleeps he passes gas freely and without problems but when hes awake its a fight...yeah this is expensive stuff but if i never have to irrigate or dialate him it works the cost of the smell (sometimes...lol) and the extra diapers then so be it...good luck

My 4.5 month old has horrible acid reflux. after multiple trips to the doctor, multiple reflux medicines, I went to a specialist. she recommended this formula and alimentum.  I started with this one.  gave my baby horrible watery stools that were painful.  I agree with the other reviewers, I really think it's the Enflora (probiotic) in here, as I had tried a rice cereal that had probiotic in it and it caused the same issue in him.  I think some babies cannot tolerate the probiotic.  I am now onto trying the alimentum and hoping that does the trick.

My baby has horrible colic. He would scream for hours after eating and it was hard. The dr. Put him on this formula and from the first feeding he's done a complete turn around. I don't think it tastes very good because he was fussy about eating it at first, but now he's ok with it. I'm so glad amazon has subscribe and save for it also because it's so expensive. So that 15% really helps, especially when you just miss out on qualifying for any other help.Just wanted to add. My daycare doesn't mix the formula for you, you have to bring the bottles premade in and put them in the fridge and they'll warm them up. I was noticing at daycare he would get really fussy again, but at home he was perfectly fine. We don't premake bottles at home, we make them as he gets hungry with room temperature water. We have to put gas drops in his daycare bottles, which defeats the purpose of this formula. It even says on the can it'll reduce the effectiveness of the enflora, and we figured out that if you warm it up it breaks the enflora down and makes your baby gassy. Don't warm this formula up. If you're going to warm it up get the concentrated or premade stuff because it doesn't have the enflora in it.
I've used this formula for both of my kids. With the subscribe and save I get the best price out there!

This formula isn't cheap, but as with most things, you get what you pay for!  Our son's doctor recommended this as we were having GI issues and immediately, this did the trick.  Our son was constantly constipated and we tried EVERYTHING but nothing else worked...
My newborn was really fussy at first & constipated. But she did not have colic; we then switched to Nutramigen and ever since she's been a perfect baby!

We use this due to our daughter's dairy protein intolerance. We haven't had any problems with it, and Amazon shipping has been very quick so we've never run out of food for her. Wish it smelled better...

column9: Made a huge difference in my baby's quality of life.
column10: My son was having a very difficult time with vomiting and gut pain. He also had a rash on his face. We tried Enfamil Nutramigen Lipil with Enflora to see if it would help him. After his first bottle, he fell asleep peacefully for the first time in weeks. After three days of using this product, the rash on his face was nearly gone. After nearly a month of using this product, we are very pleased with our "new", happy baby. I wish we had started using this formula earlier.I also wish that amazon.com had it available as a Subscribe and Save product. It is quite expensive and I would like to be able to save a little money!

column9: Seems to cause more spit ups
column10: Our pediatrician recommended switching formula to Nutramigen because switching to Soy did not seem to help my son's atopic eczema. Compared to standard Enfamil Lipil or Similac Soy it seems to cause more spit ups even though the claim is that Nutramigen is supposed to help with spit ups. Currently the only thing that is working for my son is Aquaphor moisturizing cream regardless of the formula. On the plus side, my son has not rejected this (or any of Enfamil Lipil or Similac Soy) formula outright. I'll update this posting if the pediatrician has a different observation.

Our baby was diagnosed with a milk allergy and this helped, period.  People that complain of the smell, or taste are being silly applying adult tastes and standards to this product.  Its like the dog treats that look and smell like Oreos, silly product that's not thinking of the true customer, the dog, or in this case the baby.  All the sour candies, Spaghettios and such taste terrible to me today, too.Anyway, it does what w needed it to.  We haven't had any gagging, but our baby isn't a picky eater, either.  He's eaten anything and everything we've placed in his mouth with vigor, 4-5 different formula types, each sometimes mixed with gas drops, breast milk, and sometimes formula and breast milk mixed.  Warm or cold straight out of the refrigerator, he doesn't care.  So if some babies object to this, all I can say is ours didn't, but he hasn't objected to anything, yet.He did go within one feeding from screaming colicky discomfort back to the happy baby we had a few weeks back while Mom lets the cow milk proteins leave her system.  That's what we really needed, and it worked.  We still supplement the cow milk free breast milk with the Nutramagin, and its working fine.My obly reason for 4 instead of 5 stars is the price.  Its ridiculous.  Solely formula feeding would cost well over $300 a month, and that's insane.

My 7-month old son was recently diagnosed (through blood tests) with a milk allergy. He's had bad cradle cap and eczema on his face since he was about two months old. After trying MANY other formulas (Enfamil, Good Start Gentle Plus, Good Start Soy, Similac Advance, Baby's Only Soy), the doctor finally suggested going hypoallergenic. So we tried Nutramigen... he seemed okay for the first couple of minutes, then he pulled the bottle out of his mouth and gagged. I tried again... and again, he drank for a minute or two, then gagged again. Then he refused to drink any more. After reading up on hypo formulas I was expecting a bad smell, but I didn't think it'd be bad enough to make my son want to hurl!My son never had any problems drinking all of the other formulas; this is the only one that actually made him gag. Maybe if I had started it earlier when his tastebuds were more immature, I would've had more success. I'm hesitant to give him the Alimentum because of the high sugar content. I guess my son will just have to continue suffering with rashes until I can find a formula that works for him. :(

My daughter was having trouble keeping her formula down.  We started with Similac Advanced, then Soy, then Gerber Good Start Gentle and no matter what all she did was puke it back up.  The doctor recommended this formula and gave me some samples to try.  Within at least 3 days I noticed she wasn't spitting up pretty much at all.  A little right after she ate but nothing compared to what she used to.  She can now get through the day in the same outfit she started in and I don't have to wash burp clothes everyday.  This formula has been a lifesaver.

I've bought formula from Amazon and they've always been shipped, sealed in plastic and bubble wrapped to make sure the formula doesn't bust. This company sent us the formula in a poor mans fashion (not individually wrapped or bubble wrapped) in a box that was had one sheet of crinkled paper. Five cans were damaged, including one that was busted open. The company sent us a new case, but didn't listen to us about packaging the formula. This time they used two sheets of packing paper.... one can was dented but nothing was punctured this time. I will say for the price you can't pass it, but be warned about having cans being damaged. Unless they change their packing system.
The item was received early and was as expected.  The price is the best that i can find and subscribing saves the hassle of having to go to the store regularly.

column9: Amazing Turnaround after switching to Nutrimigen
column10: For the first 6 months my child suffered from massive spit-up. A huge amount after every bottle. We tried both the Similac and Enfamil anti-spit up formula, and it only helped the tiniest bit. We even had him on reflux medication, but that still only had a very minor effect. And this whole time he was cranky, and a poor sleeper, but all our children were poor sleepers, so we didn't think of it as a problem (Except for us of course). He was well over 50th percentile in weight, so the doctor was never worried. But we finally pushed the doctor, saying it just wasn't acceptable for him to be this bad, and she recommended Nutrimigen. Within a week, his spit-up reduced 75%. He was a MUCH happier baby all the time, and while he still got up at night, he didn't fight going back to sleep after eating like before. When we added rice cereal to thicken it up, his spitting up nearly stopped. He goes longer between feedings as well. To go from where we were to where we are now with my son is worth any cost. And this is the downfall, as Enfamil seems to be very well aware of this. Nutrimigen is very expensive, and most of the coupons that are available to be printed cannot be used to discount this. But if you have tried everything else and you find yourself in a similar situation, give this formula a try.
Our 9.5 month old absolutely refused to consume any of this formula.  He has not been picky in the past with other formulas.
the last reviewer was spot on... i was going to write just about the same thing

column9: Wish I didn't have to buy this stuff...
column10: I have to buy this formula because my son is allergic to cow's milk and possibly soy.  He started out on Enfamil so his doctor wants him to stay with the brand.This stuff is EXPENSIVE and it STINKS!  I honestly cannot wait until he doesn't need it anymore.He also has colic and this does nothing to help colic like it says on the can.I only gave it 2 stars because my son needs it due to allergies.
I guess it's okay if your baby can tolerate the awful smell and taste of it. My wifed gagged when she tried a sip of it.

I stuck with the original reciepe until this last Christmas.  I added the chocolate rum cake and the pineapple rum cake as presents.  I didn't get to taste the pineapple cake but my mom and brother who got to taste both strongly agreed that the pineapple was super moist and had more of a rum flavor than the original and the chocolate cakes.  Needless to say, they have place their orders for this year's Christmas.
We have been ordering these rum cakes for years, as gifts and for ourselves.  They are always moist and delicious.

I had bought Tortuga cakes in the past. I first had it on Air Jamaica and ever since then I've been hooked, they're always so moist and delicious. This is my first time buying from Amazon and I was a little disappointed because it was a little on the dry side. Maybe I just received a bad batch, or Tortuga changed and skimped on there rum.Tortuga Caribbean Rum Cake, Pineapple, 33-Ounce Box
These cakes are moist and flavorful. Not too heavy with pineapple flavor, but very nice with coffee most anytime of the day.
Good cake.  It's worth every penny.  It's actually cheaper than directly from tortuga itself.  It is very moist and still moist after a month opened.
I received my cake fresh and moist and delicious.  I think I will try the banana flavor next. 33 oz is a substantial size and will feed 8 adults easy.  I loved it.

This is the second time we have ordered the Tortoga rum cakes. This one was pineapple. It is so moist & delicious, & not over powering in sweetness. Had it for Easter & everyone loved it. Had tried several others they make & they are all wonderful. A wonderful dessert for any holiday & gathering. A real "keeper" Makes a wonderful gift too!!

column9: Tortuga Caribbean Rum Cake, Pineapple, 33-ounce box
column10: Super moist, great taste, worth the cost. Used as Christmas dinner dessert and was big hit.  Can stay in original wrapping for months and still fresh.  Gave as holiday gift to parents in their 80's and they loved the taste, ease of use and serving.

column9: Wow! How Great is this? Purchased on Amazon, too!
column10: Women's Bean Project Golden Cornbread Mix I accidentally bought 2 packages of this mix. Yes,the price + shipping was steep. But, I made homemade tomato-beef soup and then made a batch of cornbread to go with it. This is the best cornbread we have ever had. We are westerners but lived in the central south for 7.5 years, so we have eaten good cornbread. Nothing we've had before touches the tender sweetness and fine grain of this product. I don't know where the women get their cornmeal from but I noticed the product comes from Colorado--definitely in the west! Also, it feels good to know that buying this mix helps out women who are trying to better the quality of their lives.

My wife and I are Southerners and love cornbread.  We have had lots of bad luck trying to find a mix that matches "made from scratch."  This cornbread mix, a bit pricey, is superb.  If you like "real" cornbread, you will love this.  (Try it with a small can of diced peppers.)
These are so yummy!!!!  And I'm not a cornbread novice being from the south.  All of the women's bean project items are wonderful!

Wow was this one ever a surprise!  But, these Fancy Feast varieties have surprised me quite a bit over the past couple of months.  I've drug home more different varieties lately of these guys and this one, well, get out of the way for the stampede!  One actually ran into my leg, smacked it so hard that you could hear it upstairs! Now that's something!  Anyway, these foods are full of protein, vitamins and minerals and if you are particularly trying to rescue a cat, these do a fabulous job of getting them back to a full coat, full energy, and overall good health.  Highly recommend!
Can't go wrong with Fancy Feast Canned Cat Food.  It's what my cat's prefer and what they get......a variety.  From Amazon...free shipping subscription - a great deal!
good food and your cat will love it. however, if you go to PetCo it is way cheaper!

My older cat just stopped eating the dry kibble food a few months ago. She used to get Fancy Feast as a treat only, but now it is all she will eat. A lot of canned cat food smells repulsive! Fancy Feast actually looks & smells decent. The cat knows which cabinet I keep her food in & she sprints to the kitchen when she hears it open.
My kitty loves this food and especially this flavor.  So I get it for him from Amazon.  Continue making this wonderful cat food.

This is one of the flavors that our cat prefers.  Our cat, probably like yours, too, has very evident preferences in her food.  Ours likes Fancy Feast, but only the grilled-style in the seafood-type flavors.  Other brands and other flavors, even Fancy Feast, get ignored by our cat.The shipment of cat food (we bought about $75 worth) arrived quickly and well packaged, part of it in plastic-wrapped cardboard flats of 24 cans, and part of the shipment in 24 can boxes.  The cat food's freshness dates were well out into next year, and the cans were clean and in perfect, undamaged condition.The Amazon price is approximately the same as the price at our local big-box stores, but with Amazon's free shipping (and maybe no sales tax, depending on your state's tax laws), you can't beat the convenience of having cat food delivered directly to your door.

column9: Fancy Feast from Amazon is best
column10: My little kitty cats, well maybe I shouldn't say little as my Maine Koon weighs 25 pounds, but my sweet little spoiled darlings will only eat Fancy Feast and in particular, salmon and shrimp grilled.  Sometimes they will eat other Fancy Feast but this one is their all time favorite.  And believe me, they know how to get what they want.  The auto delivery is wonderful from Amazon because I don't have to go shopping and lug cat food home.  Great.  Sharon Dalrymple

After being a butter fanatic most of my life, health concerns nixed butter in my diet, at least to the extent I craved. Then I created my own butter substitute,with the healthy olive oil base and butter flavoring. Then one day when searching for my regular butter flavoring I found Watkins (it had a different taste than my previous strickly bland butter taste) and found Watkins imitation butter to be  absolutely delicious in cakes, and on top of pancakes, waffles, etc., it is even better. I have been butter free for over two years. Love it!

Adds an excellent authentic flavor especially in baked goods.  Does not leave a weird after taste.  I have to admit, it's the "secret ingredient" in my banana bread, and the reason no one else can come close to the taste of my killer bread.  The price  for this size of product is good.

column9: Watkin's 8 oz. Imitation Butter Extract available @ Amazon
column10: I just love the fact that I can order Watkins Products from Amazon, at a very reasonable Price. column9: A quick cookie that tastes like a pro made it
column10: I am a trained baker and have made every kind of bakery product.  But, living in a climate with torrid summers, I am less inclined to spend a great deal of time in a hot kitchen so I look for shortcuts.  Krusteaz products are good quality and easy to use, cutting down prep time so you can bake during hot weather, without too much time sweltering.  I tweak all the Krusteaz mixes.  To this one I add a drop or two of butter pecan flavoring and the chocolate chips suggested on the box.  Make sure you line your baking pan and do not overbake these cookies, if you want them to be chewy.  Keep them in a tightly sealed container, separated with wax or deli paper. If you do not keep out the air, these cookies will stale more quickly than scratch cookies.  Otherwise, no one will know the difference.

column9: Great cookie mix; hard to find locally
column10: This cookie mix had been in our local grocery store, then disappeared without notice (as many of our addictions are wont to do!)  We found it on Amazon and ordered it promptly.  It came in perfect condition, in a timely manner--and we were back with our cookie fix in no time.  Add chocolate chips as directed on the box and your friends will think you're super clever, and may even ask for the recipe!  There's no need to spill the beans about it being a mix (they don't need to know all your secrets)...Note: deception is not encouraged.

This is a great soup! Just like homemade from scratch! With the limits I now have it is handy to have on hand for days when I do not feel up to cooking a lot but need to eat healthy! I am hoping to keep these on hand!

column9: DELICIOUS AND SWEET FOR GOOD ENERGY BOOSTERS!!!
column10: THESE ARE PROBABLY THE BEST SUGAR RUSH SNACKS. I LIKE TO EAT THIS SO THAT I GET JUICED UP WHEN I NEEDED IN CLASS. THIS KEEPS YOUR BRAIN IN FOCUS IN CLASS DURING THOSE EARLY 7AM MORNINGS IN HIGH SCHOOL. column9: Does not dry overnight; thick gel hard to apply evenly
column10: Wilton's Black Sparkle Gel icing looks and tastes good, but the thick gel is difficult to apply evenly. After putting the cookies in the oven for 10 minutes at 200 deg. F, and cooling them, the icing was less wet, but still tacky and not ready for bagging.) I would not recommend this for decorating cookies; after 2 to 3 days for drying, your baked goods will have lost much of their freshness.

I won't say this is the best coffee in the world; because I have yet to try them all and everyone's tastes differ. There really is something in that Volcanic soil on the Big Island.A word of caution though.  Drink this at your own risk.  It is very hard to go back to "normal" coffee after tasting this nectar of the gods.  Enjoy!

Now they say that the diamond collection is a special treat, but once you have a really good coffee it is so hard to go back to something that is below it. Word to the wise: don't stock up on this coffee; while it does last quite some time even with the most careless keeping, the coffee is best when kept in an airtight container and ground fresh for every cup.  The longer you keep coffee around, the more flavor it loses.

column10: First, you will note that I have given Blue Buffalo's "Health Bars with Bacon, Egg and Cheese Treats for Dogs" a five star rating - but that really wasn't my idea - rather that is the rating given to them by the Three Muske-Terriers: a male Westie, a male Cesky and, the Empress-of-All-She-Surveys, a female Scotty. If a treat passes the "Asta test," you know its got to be tasty - and these treats get five barks from Asta. But they are not just tasty, they're also good for your furry buddy, in moderation of course....Blue Buffalo's treats do NOT include wheat, corn or soy, (many dogs, including Her Highness, are allergic to these grains). Instead the ingredients include oatmeal, ground barley, ground whole oats, rye and flaxseed, along with chicken meal, bacon, dried eggs, cheese and carrots. They break in half easily, if you want to reduce the portion size.As for price, Blue Buffalo treats are in the same price range as treats made by other high-end and premium dog food manufacturers. They are not cheap, but I think their quality is worth the cost - and your dog probably will think so too.

column9: Not the greatest but not horrible either
column10: I bought this cat food because of the wonderful low price and I enjoy the adorable cat on the commercials. My cats did eat this food, in fact they really enjoyed it. However, after reading the ingredients and doing some research, this isn't the best food. These particular flavors are MUCH better than most Friskies wet foods. The canned Firskies verities are just terrible. The first few ingredients in these pouches are (which indicates the most prevalent ingredients) water sufficient for processing, ocean whitefish, chicken, and wheat gluten. At least there is real ocean white fish and chicken in it. Wheat gluten is pretty nasty stuff but at least there aren't by-products in these like there are in all the canned frisks. By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! Cats need to eat real, identifiable, pure, meat, and although some of that can be found in this food, I am still weary of the Friskies name due to the terribly low quality canned and dry products. If you are going to go with Friskies, these pouches are the way to go. When purchasing a cat (or dog) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you can identify and would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets all natural foods such as Natural Balance, Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness. All of those brands contain real, whole meats that I myself would eat, with no added fillers or low quality "foods".

I mostly feed her dry cat food, but sometimes she'll want something a bit "meatier" and will refuse the dry stuff and demand meat instead.  But trying to find suitable brand that my cat likes, and doesn't make her vomit, has been difficult.Since I started feeding my cat the Friskies seafood variety in pouches, my cat has become more and more insistent about wanting to be fed them!  She goes crazy when she seems me getting her Friskies pouches out of the cupboard, and shoves her head into her food bowl before I can even finish emptying the packet!I've been feeding these pouches to my cat for about a month now, and they have not upset her sensitive digestion. column9: Yes, great ingredients. But some Diamond Pet Foods are RECALLED
column10: This is not a true review about this products features per say.....but I feel that everyone needs to know that this company has recalled their products and it is going on right now.To begin with, I want to say that I know that unfortunately there are plenty of human products that get recalled too and that is the most important thing. And yes, I know that every time we go eat out or buy any type of store bought food.... that it is a gamble too.But, my family considers our dogs as part of the family and this is very important too.I loved this company's Grain Free dog food.I loved that the first ingredient is actually the real meat.My baby girl loved the food, by the same maker, named "Taste Of The Wild" in Bison mainly.I searched relentlessly for a reasonable priced food that has no by-products, dyes and are grain free.Which my lil' white Maltese needed for her horrible allergies and out of control tear stains.But,I am saddened now because Diamond Dog Food has now been RECALLED for "SALMONELLA CONTAMINATION"This company makes various products that have been recalled.Such as:Diamond Naturals, Wellness, Natural Balance, Taste of The Wild, Apex, Chicken Soup Soul, Canidae, Country Value, 4Health, Natural Balance, Kirkland Signature, Natural Balance, Premium Edge, Professional and Solid Gold.I am saddened that we actually spend more money on these "better than store" dog food and they keep getting recalled!So many families have unfortunately lost their fur babies babies and have spent thousands of dollars on Vet bills....when all we are trying to do is buying the "better" which are higher priced, dog food ingredients.I am pretty thankful that I had signed up online,for emails about the latest dog food recalls last week.My hubby and I was devastated to see that Diamond Dog Foods, Taste Of The Wild was on the list now.I am sickened by these companies being so careless. When the reason we buy their higher priced food is cuz they are suppose to be healthier!I just wanted to write this and try to stop another baby from getting sick or even worse dying.

Illy espresso beans are my favorite of all the widely available commercially produced roasted espresso beans. This is the standard medium roast that Illy produces and it is a bit less aggressive and milder tasting than the dark roasts of Lavazza (the other major Italian brand that some people favor).When properly ground, tamped, and brewed Illy espresso has a delightful aroma and flavor, unmatched by any of the other brands.Granted, Illy is quite pricey, and I do not use it all the time for this reason. However, you get what you pay for. Usually, I buy my espresso from a small roasting house in the Midwest that produces a decent medium roast substitute that I do not mind using most of the time. But Illy definitely produces a higher quality bean.One way to judge the quality of roasted espresso beans even before you taste the coffee that they will produce is to look at the evenness of color and size of the beans. The reason is that beans of a uniform size tend to roast more evenly than beans of varying sizes. Moreover, even when the beans are of a uniform size, it is important that they be roasted in small batches and churned during the the entire roasting process to ensure that they all get roasted to the same point. This is why most high quality coffee is roasted in small batches in a rotating drum that roasts all the beans to the exact same point. Moreover, since the moisture content of the beans varies a bit from batch to batch, quality control in the roasting process is extremely important. And it is here that Illy is unmatched. Just do a simple visual comparison of the color and consisteny of Illy beans when compared to any of the other widely available brands and you can easily see why Illy is the best.

column9: Terrific Arabica beans for full flavor Espresso/Cappucino

Arabica coffee beans of the highest order, treated with the utmost respect, delivering the finest taste.Today, with the third Illy generation leading the family business nothing has changed.Arabica beans have less than 1,5% caffeine. Since they grow mainly in the mountain climate they are sensitive and more difficult to grow/harvest but they are the only ones that can guarantee outstanding flavor and taste.That is what you get when you open the can. And once again after grinding them: a moment of aaah when you inhale the wonderful scent of the freshly ground coffee beans.Please forget about the price and don't compare this with any of the mixed blends. They give me headaches. 100% Arabica are the only beans I drink and love. You want flavor, get Illy. It's one of the best.Enjoy! (f.e. together with Neuhaus chocolate or Sapori Amaretti)

Superb balance. Great lingering sweetness, not at all harsh, moderate brightness. Essentially everything that I search for in an espresso. The bean aroma is very sweet with hints of hazelnut shells. The roast is lighter than most of the Lavazza blends (although it was darker that the Tierra I tried) and much lighter than the beans you would find used in a popular America coffee franchise. In my opinion, this is what really lets this coffee shine, complementing the deep caramels with its restrained brightness and giving way to fruity notes.One very important note: do not simply seal this coffee in the can with the lid after you use it. The can is not airtight, and my first can was stale overnight. I thought that my barista skills were steadily declining, but when I opened the second can the difference in flavor and aroma were astounding. Place it immediately into an airtight container and use within a week. Too bad that this coffee is so expensive, or I would be pulling shots with it all the time. If you've never tried it, splurge a little. It will be memorable.

Yeah, it's expensive but it's soooo worth it...You do have to know how to grind and brew espresso to get it just right, if you don't know how to brew or if you are going to add milk to your coffee there is absolutely no reason to spend this much on Illy beans.Lavazza beans are a great (and cheaper) alternative.

column9: My fave of the Campbell "light" soups
column10: This is a very nice soup for those watching calories and wanting a scosh less salt than is usual for Campbell's soups. It's a tomato-based soup with a light dose of rice, black beans, and chicken. It's not thick or chunky. I'd call it a medium-density soup. Enough broth to slurp for those who like a not-stewish soup. Not super hot or spicy, but flavorful all the same.I find that it's very nice on its own, but I prefer it with more black beans (I just add canned ones) and chopped tomato and a sprinkle of low-fat cheddar cheese. That really makes it into a nice light meal, satisfying and flavorful.But I think if you like tomato-based soups and a Mexican vibe, this will agree with your taste buds. I consider it a pantry staple for lunch now.I do find the regular cans of this tastes slightly better. Maybe heating it in the can transfers some of the metal taste. Not sure. But if you can find the regular cans, I'd go that route.One cup has 130 calories, 3 grams of fiber, 8 grams of protein, 20 grams of carbohydrates, 2.5 grams of fat ( 1 gram of those is of saturated fat.) It also has 480mg of sodium, and 800 of potassium. I add the low-fat (or fat free) cheese for both flavor and to up the protein to balance the carbs.I hope Campbell's keeps making these. Nice quickie soup.Mir
