I quickly ordered 2 lbs, along with the Stainless Steel Induction Stovetop Popcorn Popper and we've been poppin' up a storm ever since! It took some practice (watch their videos) -- but we quickly mastered homemade Kettle Corn and now laugh every time we pass the grocery store brands. There's simply no comparison. JustPoppin's customer service and support is terrific, too. We've been ordering from them for over a year now and enjoy trying all their new varieties, flavorings and popping techniques!

This stuff is great, I was able to make all sorts of flavored popcorn over the holidays (The mushroom shape works best for flavored popcorn).I do recommend using coconut oil for the popping, it gives it that taste we all love.I appreciated that the product came in a reseal-able bag.I also shopped around on the internet for this product and was glad Amazon had a partner who sells it. I was much more comfortable that I was going to get a high quality and FRESH product. And I did.

Finally I am able to make the same, if not better, popcorn than the one I religiously buy at the Farmer's Market every Saturday.The kernels arrived in a resealable bag, which is very convenient.  The popcorn is fluffy and delicious; not to mention the fact that I was very successful on popping the kernels using a hot air popper machine and a stove top popper.I am VERY happy with my purchase!!

Pops big, tastes great, but the hulls are huge! (Expensive)  I Feel like a dog with peanut butter on my tongue trying to get rid of the hulls that suction cupped to the back of my tongue.  Wanted to try mushroom popcorn, because it looks so tasty, but will stick with standard popcorn from now on.

This product was extremely disappointing!  No way did it look anything like the picture and it was full of hulls.  The last time I was at a Farmers Market and purchased kettle corn, I asked them what kind of popcorn they used to get such big kernels.  I was told mushroom popcorn, so I was so excited to find this product at Amazon.  I followed the directions for popping and the kernels were no different from the corn I buy at the supermarket at a fraction of the cost!

column9: I had to say something about it...
column10: A friend of mine gave me a small bag of this quality corn for my birthday and it is AMAZING! He knew I am a avid fan of popcorn and am always searching for something new. He did mention the hulls and said "So long as you chew it and NOT try to inhale it, it would be good" and good it was. I only stove top so it was great to see the corn pop up so big, just a handful and it filled up a 24qt bowl (Cause you can't eat good popcorn in a small bowl). Lightly seasoned to taste with salted butter and seasoning salt, Perfect! So I only wrote cause of the knuckleheads that bad mouthed something that I thoroughly enjoyed. Buy a small sample and see for yourself and don't let others keep you from the good stuff...
I am a popcorn lover and this popcorn was amazing.  It pops up great, really tasty, and quite a conversation piece.
The kernels pop up HUGE. They are really "meaty"  The only drawback is the prominent hulls. (notice the picture has the popcorn carefully turned to conceal this.).

Bought this popcorn because it looked good. It is sooooo good. When you put it in your mouth you feel like your mouth is full. It is a pleasure to chew and a little of this popcorn is better than a whole bowl of regular popcorn. My family is sold on mushroom popcorn.

column9: Just as described as long as you follow the instructions.
column10: I bought a 3lb bag and had it sent to my parents.  They raved that it came out great so I bought a 5lb bag myself.  I have tried it once so far.  I popped 1/4 cup with 1 1/2 tbs of butter flavored canola oil in the 6 qt Lindy's popper.  I followed the instructions that states that you should only toss in a few kernels at the beginning while the oil heats up.  When those three pop, dump in the rest since the oil will be at optimum temperature.  I did so and started to crank away.  All the kernels popped in about 10 seconds since it was a small batch.  Came out fine, but a little chewier than expected because since the kernels were fuller than regular butterfly popcorn.  It did get a little crispier when more steam was allowed to escape.  Flavor was fine with a light bit of popcorn salt.

As claimed in ads this corn is for added flavoring such as caramel. If purchased for popping and eating 'as-is' you'll discover wonderfully huge corn puffs with NO TASTE. The ads are correct, buy to flavor or not I'm not intentionally criticizing this corn, the mistake I made was assuming it would taste as great as it looks, without caramel.

column9: Best popcorn I've made so far
column10: It really does make "mushroom" popcorn. It's  more expensive than regular popcorn but It's well-worth a try, whether you are an aficionado or not. I tried it with the Barleans organic coconut oil and it was delicious! It comes with instruction too, which is nice.

I was so pleased with the texture, flavor, and large, mushroom size of the popped corn.  Even better, the small amount of oil and popcorn salt I normally use adhered to this popcorn much better than to normal popcorn... gives me better flavor with lower calories and fat.

column9: THE necessary ingredient for home made kettle corn
column10: Some things are just harder to make at home.  My mom, who was a marvelous cook, never could get home-made pickles right.  If you want to make kettle corn (you know, like the stuff you buy at the county fair) you really, really need this as an ingredient.  I'm still not 100% of the way to making awesome kettle corn at home (it's merely very good) but I'd be nowhere without this mushroom popcorn.
The popcorn tastes great and is easy to cook in a hot air popper. The hulls are very hard and there are a lot of them. I actually have to pick off the hulls before I eat it, because they cut my gums.
Purchased this to make Poppy Cock - which it was wonderful for, but have found that husband and I love it for eating popcorn as well.  Has more chew.
While they do pop up big and fluffy, they are LOADED with hulls.  I got so many wedged between my teeth that I couldn't finish and had to go floss!  Disappointed with an expensive popcorn.

Try as I may this popcorn could not live up the my expectations.I have a hot air popper that makes large fluffy POP SECRET.Followed there instructions on heating the popper for 5 mins.Did not pop complete, and they were on the small side and hard not fluffy.It's back to POP SECRET.

column9: A real Gold - Gold not Yellow!
column10: This Wilton pearlized gold sugar looks like very pretty real gold. I was a little worried that in person this sugar would look like a yellow, mustardy gold.  It doesn't.  I used it to sprinkle on whipped cream so the color was important to me.  I also used it to rim some champagne glasses before adding Champagne, St. Germaine, A touch of ginger-ale and a smidge of fresh lemon juice.  The drink was of course delicious on it's own, but the gold sugar really took it to another level and made it beautiful and a topic of conversation. Surprisingly, a little goes a long way, so while this was a little expensive with the shipping cost, I'll find many uses for it.

column9: Useless if you plan to give as a gift!
column10: ...at least if you purchase from this seller (OTCMaster).  The tea box arrived completely crushed and looking a million years old.  Disgusting.  Now I have to come up with something else to fill out the gift basket I'm putting together.  A waste of time and money + a huge disappointment; I will NEVER, NEVER, NEVER order from this seller again!
This soup is delicious, healthy, and perfect to bring to work when you're on the go. The bulk packaging was ideal and less expensive than buying each one individually.
I love Italian wedding and Campbell's own regular kind...but this one really traded in good taste (or any flavor) for calories. Eww.

I ordered this for my daughter to take for lunch, as this was her favorite...however, Campbell's has changed the pasta to ditalini (not as pictured)and something else seems different, too.  Donated the case to the food pantry.
I am very pleased with this purchase. I have made tea everyday since it arrived. I will order again when I need more.

column9: Arrived slower than expected, more tea than expected
column10: Although I was initially upset with how slowly the order processed, I was impressed that one order gets you 200 bags of tea rather than the anticipated 100. A (slow) steal!

I live in the Caribbean where ice tea is an all-year-round refreshment! Yama Moto Yama Ice Green Tea is delicious and easy to prepare. I love it with a slice of lime and lots of ice, or in a mango smoothie!!!! Also a very quick delivery each time I ordered this product.
Awesome seller; fast delivery; item as promised.  It came just in time.  I was going through chai withdrawal.
I love this Mocha Chai Latte.  It is sweet and thick and still has the chai flavors without being bitter.  Very delicious!  It is  my favorite!
This is a really good hot beverage - no trans fats!  I haven't tried it iced but would assume it would also be good that way
To put it very simple, this product was worth every dollar and I was very satisfied. I have used (2) cans already and I'm working on the 3rd. Will definitely order again. DELICIOUS!

"Childhood's Calling," or so the slogan goes for Rice Crispies. But I do indeed associate Malt-O-Meal with childhood. I bought this product because I wanted a quick hot breakfast, and unfortuantely, many stores in the DC metro area do not seem to carry this hot cereal. Thankfully, Amazon does. I love the wheaty taste of the cereal, and I tend to add milk and sugar to give it a nice smooth and sweet flavor. Delicious. If you enjoy hot cereals, like oatmeal or Cream of Wheat, I highly recommend that you try Malt-O-Meal. And if you have children, I'd recommend sharing this with them as well. It could provide some warm fond memories at the breakfast table.

column9: Mayo, the way it was meant taste.
column10: Ever wonder why the French enjoy dipping their fries in mayo? Simply put, because mayonnaise in France is more flavorful than its American counterparts.Amora Mayonnaise de Dijon is unctuous and flavorful, great for sandwiches, salads, meats, and of course, dipping your fries. Bland American mayonnaise simply cannot compete.

We drink this every weekend iced at our local farmers market. Slowly I became addicted an had to buy it myself. It ices well with very low acidity and brews just as good hot. Goes down smooth and pleases everyone. Normally I drink coffee very bold but this is a pleasant break from the harshness I am used to, but still packed with flavor! I wil be buying more for sure.

I really enjoyed this product.  I had tasted authentic chinotto while on vacation in Italy, and wanted to enjoy it here in America after I returned.  An Italian friend living in the States told me about the San Pellegrino product, and I ordered a case, since I already enjoyed their bottled water.  I was very happy with it.  It is not identical to the brand I drank in Savona, but just as good (think Coke versus Pepsi).  My family members loved it, too, and it got used up much faster than I would have liked.  It's certainly not cheap, but it's easily worth it, if you love the taste of chinotto.For those who haven't tasted it, chinotto is a citrus drink which is so dark, thick, and balsamic, that it actually tastes somewhat like Coke or Dr. Pepper.  Very nice stuff.  I also have some chinotto fragrance that I bought in Savona, and it has that same rich, wonderful smell.  The bottles are small by American standards, but the product is very nice, and really should be sipped, not chugged.  This stuff probably makes excellent and very novel mixed drinks, too.

column9: Nothing says you love your family like artificially flavoring their baked goods
column10: A giant bottle of murky liquid that tastes (kinda) like vanilla and lemon and possibly other unspecified flavors. What could possibly go wrong? You may want to consider using vanilla and lemons instead.
love this product, everone who has my frosting says it's the best.  you won't go wrong getting this.remember alittle goes along way.

This is a very tasty soup mix and helped me create a soup that my family loved!  The spices add an interesting and flavorful mix to this soup, and do not overpower the finished product.  I highly recommend this mix to anyone who loves pea soup and likes the flavor of a homemade soup.  Plus, the purchase of this product supports the work of the Women's Bean Project, which helps women break the cycle of unemployment and poverty, and you can't beat that!  Give this tasty soup a try, you will like it!

column9: Easiest, Best Tasting Split Pea Soup
column10: The Women's Bean Project Spicy Split Pea Soup is one of those comfort foods that you hated and turned your nose up as a child;  then one day you decided to taste it again --and WOW - you wonder what made you dislike it as a child.  Although it is not the most attractive looking soup, it is certainly one of the tastiest!  All of the bean project soups are easy to prepare and the best part is that they come with the most perfect seasonings!  This soup just makes you feel cozy and satisfied - it is spicy but not so much that you have to chase it with water - just enough to override the blandness of the pea.
This is the best pea soup mix.  The spice balance is just right.

I love the soups from the Women's Bean Project.  They are actually priced better on Amazon.com then on their own web page, so it is easier to order here.  Also, the money goes to a worthy cause:  Teaching women skills (e.g. computer, office) so that they can support themselves and their families.  The soups come fairly complete with a spice package.  Usually you will only require a can of tomatoes, but I like to add celery, carrots, cubed ham, hot sauce, whatever!  The cornbread they sell is also delicious, very moist and sweet.

This is a very smooth coffee!I usually use a french press, 4 scoops for 2 cups @ 4 minutes.The flavor is smooth, and like the other reviewer said a little on the light side, which can make it very crisp, as I've experienced, in a drip-type coffee maker. (this is a very good thing!)It has some subtle earthy-tones to it as well, and leave a pleasant flavor in your mouth for minutes after drinking.Like all coffee- the way you make it will bring out different flavor profiles, and temperature as well. Higher temperature will bring out more acidity and crispness, lower temperature brings out more 'bold' and 'smooth'. That's 175-190 degrees f.Both ends of the spectrum, and all in between, are good, with this particular variety. You can't say that with all of them.I would recommend this brand to others- fair trade and organic at a pretty decent price.

This is the fourth coffee i have purchased from paramount. I will only get organic and fair trade because i care about where my coffee comes from, how its grown and the people who grow it. The flavor of this coffee is something i feel that an everyday coffee drinker can enjoy. It is on the lighter side, not any true distinct flavors. Just an all around crisp cup o joe. I will be buying this again. I would recommend to other.
The online description says ground coffee, once it arrives the packaging says ground coffee, but they are whole bean.  Don't order if you don't have a grinder.

The product arrived quickly and in great condition.  I like the ingredients are just apples...no vitamin C, Ascorbic acid...just apples.  These are convenient snacks on the go.  My two year old can drink the applesauce from the pouch like using a straw.  We've experienced no messes, no problems.  Have also added it to cups of flax milk and coconut milk to help satisfy hunger.

column9: Crystal Light Pineapple Orange in packets
column10: Tastes good, but must use more than indicated to get the same full taste as the tubs in the canisters that they don't make or sell any more.

I've always loved coffee cordials, but they are fairly difficult to find anywhere--stores usually have chocolate-covered coffee beans, but NOT coffee cordials, which have a clear, coffee-flavored liquid in the center of the dark chocolate shell. When I found Amazon.com had them, I bought a 5-lb bag for Christmas! They did not last long! They were so yummy! I'll be ordering again for sure.
A perfect balance of Cherry sweetness, Dark Chocolate and Coffee bean. I wish that I could find a creamer for my coffee that made it taste like this!

Koppers Coffee Cordials are nearly the perfect chocolate confection. If a buyer wants candies that will make his widdle toes curl, go to the Koppers site where there are unbelievable varieties of liquid center in a hard sugar shell, covered with the richest, silkiest dark chocolate in the world. Mmmmm. The price is high, though, so I jumped at Amazon's "bargain" price. What I got, however, weren't really cordials since most had dried out and the liquid had turned to sugar. Even dried out they're delicious, but they're NOT DIVINE~
This review is late in getting here, but not due to the product. I bought 2 of these at one time, and they make great crackers!!  Thank you!!

It's always hard to stick to rating the product itself when you see something you really think should be pointed out. My cat loves these treats every bit as much as he loves Greenies. Maybe even a little more.Here's the reason for my one-star-rating-to-attract-attention-to-this-listing:The price I'm seeing for these treats in this particular listing is absolutely ridiculous. I can get a 3.0 oz bag at Walmart or Target for $1.50 or $1.60. This seller doesn't even come close.
Excellent treat for cats. My cat wakes up just by the noise of the plastic bag. Very useful when I'm looking for him, I just have to shake the Whiskas Temptations bag.

column9: Tried these on three different cats, they ALL love it!!!
column10: I think all cats love Catnip Temptations.  Bought these at a super market and felt so bad when I went back and the didn't have anymore.  Gladly I found Catnip Temptations on Amazon and so are the cats.P.S. If you have the time, you can teach your cats trick using Catnip Temptations.

The Blissful Catnip Temptations treats are wonderful and the only ones my cat will eat. They are off petstore shelves and grocery stores in a matter of hours, and that's why I came to Amazon.com to order. Just be careful who you order from! The company I eventually used priced the treats reasonably at $1.72 per package; the other company (NYCPETSUPPLY), which is the first listed, was/is selling them for a whopping $4.99 per package (a ripoff of monumental preportions, if not downright criminal), and if you're lucky you can find them in some pet and grocery stores for $1.68. My cat loves them so much I have to hide them in order to get her to eat something else.

I was shocked to see this.  Maybe I've misunderstood what they are selling here, but I don't think so.  Locally I can buy a box like this that has 36 1.5 oz bags for $7.80.  I gave this 3 stars because the product is great, but the price is extremely high ($22.97 at posting).

Just so you all know these are $7.50 at Wal-Mart so I recommend you don't buy these. But yet on the other hand this could also look like a good deal because if you buy these out of a vending machine they could cost as much as $1.00 a pouch which would equal $36.00 for all of these. So you are basically getting these half off if you use vending machines a lot. But if you get these at Wal-Mart it's like getting 2 big cases which is (72) pouches for the current price of "one" box on here which is ($16.94). Just be smart while shopping on here and compare prices in the store before you buy online. Happy shopping.

While I was waiting for this box... I bought one BAG of Cheez-It at the corner store yesterday at the price of $.89 cents. So you can guess how delighted I was to receive my box of 36 just now. This was the fastest delivery from Amazon I have ever received for an item. Great Job! Thank you for the great price. I like to eat some Cheez-It while reading on my Kindle at night. It's my relax time.

I have now sent two of these out to my deployed Hubby, and he and his buddies made quick work of them. They arrived in perfect condition, which is great considering the distance traveled. They very much enjoyed the little taste of home!

column9: Yummy, Cheez-It's always a hit with little ones
column10: Good purchase for a kindergarten class of 18 kids. Worked out for 2 days worth of snack. Bags are a bit large for little 5 year old's though...hope it didn't ruin their lunch. :)
These are the cheez-its you (hopefully) know and love. They seem to be a pretty good deal, everything was as listed and tasted great!

We purchase the 2 oz Ready-to-feed and keep them in the car and in the diaper bag for quick feeds.  Because it is sealed I don't have to worry about refrigeration and mixing or messes. At 4months adjusted he eats no more than 4 ounces so having 2 of these on hand at all times is more than enough.  Side Note: The ready-to-feed form does stain a little worse than the powder form.

column9: Perfect for when out and about
column10: We tried the formula powder and formula dispenser when we were out of the house but with twins that became a hassle. It's worth the extra money to us just to be able to pop these little bottles open and pour it into a bottle.

My husband and I decided to purchase the on the go bottles due to our son not going through a large bottle of the ready to eat formula in the 72 hour time frame. However we keep at least two of these bottles packed in our diaper bags at all times. Great for road trips!

column9: Perfect for on the go feedings
column10: While expensive compared to powdered formula, these bottles do offer easy feedings on the go. Sometimes it is just much easier to crack one of these open instead of mix water and formula when I am out. They keep easily in a diaper bag, purse, etc. Price is comparable to local stores. As another review mentioned, the consistency of the liquid is thicker and stains more than powdered formula.

Man, I love skittles and I hate have to keep going to the store to buy some.  This a great deal on a bulk bag of skittles at discount prices.They take forever to go bad too, so once you open a bag you have more than a month to eat it!

I was actually looking for some cool but unique favors to put in my soon to be 5 year old son's loot bags for his Superhero Birthday party in school. I actually came across the Pez dispensers first, but then through just looking around, stumbled on these cute Klik dispensers, which were cheaper and to be honest, I think they totally look better than the Pez dispensers! Now I know there are hardcore Pez collectors out there, but these are 4 and 5 year old little kids, and they don't care about all that.My only gripe, and its really slight is that pictured are Spiderman, Iron Man, and Wolverine. What I got was Spiderman, Iron Man, and Captain America. This was all fine, but 12 come in each box; I ordered two. Both have 6 Spiderman, 4 Captain America and 2 Iron Man. Shouldn't it be four of each? However, because I can read and I inspect carefully before purchasing, I realize that a side note says product may not be as pictured, and you may not get the same number of each character in each box.

These are better and cheaper than pez dispensers.  Used them for birthday treat bags.  Designs are very nice and colorful.  I would say half are Spiderman, then rest were Capt America and iron man.  Truly a great find!!!

The definition of truffle - and to anyone who purchases truffles - is a soft candy made of a chocolate mixture.  NOT SO with this - these are like malted milk balls with some strange taste that doesn't taste like hazelnut.  If I had know they weren't really truffles I would have never purchase them.  These are NOT returnable so it was a waste of money... Beware!

These are not what I would call truffles. They're more "crunchy" than anything because of this toffee-like shell that is around them and they don't have much of a chocolate or hazelnut flavor at all. They're ok, but definitely not what I was expecting from a "hazelnut truffle".

column9: MIGHT HAVE BEEN GOOD TWO YEARS AGO!
column10: I READ THE GLOWING REVIEWS, BUT I DID NOT CHECK THE DATES.THESE COOKIES ARE YEARS OLD AND TASTE THAT WAY . PERHAPS THEY WOULD BE BETTER IF YOU SOAKED THEM IN MILK;HOWEVER, I DOUBT THAT CAN REVIVE THEM. LIKE EATING CARDBOARD WITH A HINT OF STALE SPICE. WHAT A WASTE OF MONEY. THE TIN IS FOR HOLIDAY 2010, THAT MEANS THEY CAN BE UP TO THREE YEARS OLD.

OMG, I bought one of these on sale after Christmas here on Amazon. It is HUGE!!! The cookies never end and what a variety! My Grandson will use the tin to store toys after the cookies are all gone. I can see how getting one every year would make a fantastic Holiday tradition.

Every year for Christmas our Grandparents from Germany sent a tin from Germany. The arrival signaled the holiday season had officially begun. This holiday season for sentimental reason I purchased this tin and have placed it as shrine on the sideboard in my DR Christmas display. Can't wait for my family to gather this Sunday! There were a few favorites that are no longerin the tin, and since the cost was only slightly higher I can see that adjustments were made in product to avoid drastic increase in price. I was soo happy to find a perpetual calendar that will be a treasured keepsake that will take a prominent place on my wall. I am giddy to be adding the keepsake chest to the ones that were given from my childhood. This year cements the restart of a traditionas I want to be able to hand these chests down to my children - the one thing prominent in all my siblings homes are our Schmidt Festive Chests. Do Not let the price turn you away the quality and quantity of the goodies enjoyed this holiday are only paled by the memory of the chest. I display my prominently all year long, and guess what? I have a tree full of very delicate ornaments which I never worry about being broken because-yes, you guessed it-I pack ornaments in one, my porcelain Nativity in another, and have started an antique santa collection which is lookinfor a yearround home-so problem solved.BUY THIS YOU WILL NOT BE SORRY!!!

column9: Fantastic products with German quality and delicious to the last crumb!
column10: First- it weighs more like 9.84lbs, NOT 98.4 pounds! Why that description remains posted is questionable. Second- The case is beautiful and will be a keepsake for many. Inside the case are many varieties of product that are delicious with orange and spice flavors like no other. The gingerbread recipes are very different from American types-the bread is moist and flavorful without any overpowering strange flavors. You could eat any of these as a snack before or after breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner, late-night, whenever. This is the second time receiving this large container from friends of ours and I can't brag enough about them to friends and family. I hope this review helps....they are excellent.

There was a reason Bob Hope had Montgomery Inn Ribs shipped in from Cincinnati for special occasions.  I remember him endorsing the sauce as it appeared on Kroger's shelves.  The one staple that I always have and I have my daughter pack it in her bag when she visits or I purchase it online, just like my Skyline.  A true winner.

I am a former Cincinnatian, so some of my love of this BBQ sauce is based a bit on nostalgia (like the Skyline Chili!).  Even so, I do believe this is the best BBQ sauce I've had and I frequently order it for myself and friends.

I was interested in trying out the Stride gum---it's really great.  The flavor changes from one fruit to another.  I like Stride because the flavor does not fade a way quickly---it lasts and lasts.  I recommend it highly.I ordered it through Amazon and it was shipped to me in a short time-- which pleased me.

I bought this gum at a local 7-11, but I wanted to review it for the flavor for anyone who is interested in the mystery.  It's a fruity flavor like a lime zest sort-of.  It's definitely a mix of things, but I would categorize it as a fruit flavor.  It reminds me of the old Fruit Stripe zebra gum.It's good, not great, but a solid fruity gum.Flavor does not last as long as the mint flavors.

This is an interestingly tasteful gum. It has just enough sweetness to keep you coming back to it, without being overpowering. It is very flavorful and keeps its taste and chew-ability far beyond other gums, even other Stride flavors. I went so far as to order two more packs of twelve, as the shipper sent a notice this flavor was being discontinued altogether. If you are looking for a long-lasting, tasteful gum, you won't go wrong with Stride Mega Mystery!!
This is the BEST gum I have ever chewed. It does not stick to my dental work, which is a big plus for me, and it has great, lasting taste!!
Everyone in the family love this mystery flavor. Just wish the flavor would last a little longer. Keep ordering it so everyone has its own pack.
The mystery flavor is gummy worms which I like but it just doesn't work in chewing gum form. Also the flavor only lasts about 2 minutes.

This is without a doubt the best 70% chocolate I have ever tasted. Way above the so-called top brands, such as Valrhona, E. Guittard, Michel Cluizel, etc. The texture is smooth and creamy, and the taste is full of complexity - rich, but not overbearing. It has a nice espresso finish, but no bitterness, just a perfect blend. I not only eat this chocolate out of hand, but I also bake with it, and use it to make chocolate ice cream. You could not ask for better results. To summarize, this is a very unique, complex chocolate with a nice round taste, and tons of depth. Highly recommended.

For dark chocolate lovers, this is an amazing chocolate bar.  The flavor of the cocoa is very complex, reminiscent of coffee, cherries, almonds.  The label claims it is made from fairly-traded cocoa.  I highly recommend giving it a try.

I ordered a large variety of dark chocolates from 65%-80% all different chocolate brands- as a treat for myself and just to see which was best.  This was BY FAR the tastiest, richest, most flavorful bar.  Dark chocolate lover's dream!!  Now, alas, I am addicted!!!

This is simply exquisite chocolate - better than Vahlrona and better than any other I have had the pleasure of tasting. Single origin chocolate is definitely a different, better breed and anything in this line - all unique and all very distinctive, flavorful and positively gorgeous - are good choices. Also, remember that any recipe that calls for 70% could use even the 65% Santander too - Get into the 55% Santander and it's more of a semi-sweet use, but let me tell you, it's the most muscular semi I've ever tasted. These are all wonderful eating or cooking chocolates - truly the earmark of a good chocolate product. If you cannot stomach eating it, but it taste "adequate" in recipes, pass it by.This is truly amazing chocolate.

column9: Best Dark Chocolate Bar I've Found
column10: I've tried every dark chocolate bar I can find and this is definitely my favorite.  My wife's too.  It is so much better than the other options that we were willing to travel an extra 20 miles to shop at the grocery store that carried them.  Alas, it is now only available online...

column9: Totally unlike any other high-end chocolate
column10: I've purchased every available 70+% chocolate the past two weeks, and the Santander 70% stands head and shoulders above the rest.  Most of the others are good or very good, but the differences are subtle.  One bite of the Santander and you'll go "Wow! - it has an impossible-to-describe complex flavor totally unlike any of the others.  I'm kind of surprised it's not better known.

Unlike a lot of exported goods from Colombia, Santander is actually SOLD in Colombia. I lived there for a year and it was on my grocery list every week. It is sooooooo good, so much better than any dark chocolate I have had in the US or Europe. It's got a rich, smooth texture and a complex but very satisfying flavor. I love it. I'm home again now and have to order it because I can't find anything else that compares (including Askinosie, which is from my college town). I also sampled chocolate while traveling in Ecuador, and I don't think the flavor of their beans compares to Colombia's.Enjoy!

Purely by chance, this was the first taste I had of single-origin chocolate, and of Colombian chocolate.This chocolate is so good, I am surprised Colombia bothers with coffee or cocaine. ;-)Though this is a strongly flavored dark chocolate, it is NOT bitter, just RICH with a 'roasted' taste that is unique. I immediately recognized a familiar flavor from some exotic European chocolates I'd tried before, but never could define. Here it was, an entire bar of it...I have used this as the primary chocolate in baking a complex chocolate torte, and the character (melted gently) remained in the baked result. For a practiced dessert expert this will become a secret ingredient you treasure.But enjoy it just for the amazing character it has - I happily give it 5 stars - it can not be improved upon.

column9: Yes. It's Good--So Go Ahead and Spend $15 On It!
column10: After reading the reviews, I went right to my local store and bought a bar, for the same price.  Very good!  Really--it's darn good chocolate.  Now, am I missing something, or are we expected to spend $12 on shipping for it?  If you're willing to, please contact me right away, since I have a lot of stuff I'd like to sell you.
I have tried many brands of dark chocolate in my foreign and domestic travels and Santander is the absolute best there is bar none!

Ah, our best friends in the world - the Brits - have given us some nice gifts of late:  great Brit Beat rock music (The British Invasion),  Masterpiece Theatre, Emma Peel, Monty Python, fish and chips, shepherd's pie,  my old Triumph Spitfire I had back in High School, and now Bisto sauce granules. These chip shop curry granules are fantastic sprinkled on all kinds of things for a flavorful extra zing. My personal favorites are on mashed potatoes, french fries (er, I mean chips), chicken and fish, shrimp, rice, and noodles. I'll bet there are lots of foods I haven't tried it on yet that it does well on. Gives a little bit of curry bite without going through the procedure of preparing real curry. I tip my bowler hat to you blokes. Well done!

column9: Bisto Chip Shop Curry Sauce Granules
column10: When I visited South Africa I became acquainted with Bisto products.  I have used them ever since when I can get them!  They sure are helpful in 'sprucing up' recipes.  Recommend these sauces.
I missed this gravy and finally discovered at Amazon. Easy to make and full of flavour. The best curry gravy you can buy. Goes good with chips, fish and many other things.

Being Asian, I can tell you this is NOT jasmine rice and I LOVE jasmine rice. A long grain, but it is definitely a NOT true jasmine rice which has a very noticeable and delicious aroma both in its uncooked form as well as cooked. Disappointed to say the least.

This is some of the best tasting jasmine rice i have found. It cooks just as the directions indicate and turns out like the rice you would get at a restaurant, even without a rice cooker. Great flavor and wonderful smell. If you cook it longer than it says it starts to turn a bit sticky but nothing like sticky rice.

I'm allergic to acesulfate, which is found in pretty much all checkout-line gums available. This is the first gum I've been able to chew in over a year that hasn't given me cold sores, because it doesn't have acesulfate. It also doesn't have aspartame, which is awesome.

column9: As a soon to be dental hygienist, this product is terrific!
column10: This gum contains xylitol as one of its main ingredients. I am currently in dental hygiene school and thus have recently learned the benefits of xylitol. The reason this is so good is that it is a natural sweetener that tricks bacteria into thinking it's regular sugar. When bacteria ingest it they have no way to digest it, which results in death of the bacteria and therefore lowers your risk for cavities when used daily.Now for anyone who has TMJ issues (if you don't have TMJ, then you don't have to bother reading this one paragraph) it is recommended that you not chew gum at all. I myself am one of these people. Whenever I chew gum my jaw ends up hurting for days. However, I spoke with the dentist at my college about this issue and he actually recommends to continue chewing xyliotol gum but to only chew for 5 minutes maximum, particularity after sugary snacks only. For myself, this seems to work. If I eat something high in sugar and chew Spry gum for only 5 minutes afterward, it'll help get the xyliotol in my mouth to fight off cavity causing bacteria but won't be long enough to cause me pain in my jaw.Overall, if you're one who gets cavities often, try Spry gum!

Xylitol, besides being an innocuous non sugar substitute (in contrast with some other sugar substitutes), also has the benefit of being an anti-cavity anti-bacterial, although how strong I don't know.  In addition, the cinnamonflavor is delicious, and while the sweetness doesn't last, the hint of cinnamon flavor does. Altogether, a very worthwhile product.

column9: Great for both Dental & Budget Heath!
column10: I first made this product a recurring purchase about 9 months ago, after realizing the benefit of frequent gum-chewing. (I took to chewing several times per day - typically after meals when tooth-brushing isn't practical).Went from buying cinnamon Altoids gum at Trader Joe's, to buying this Spry brand from xlear.com, then switched my buying to Amazon.com, when I saw the potential cost savings.What can I say? Useful product at a good price from a reliable retailer - all at a lower cost than ever. Can't ask for more than that!My only "word of caution" would be: if you're single & don't share your gum a lot or if you just don't chew so often, you may find the product hardening over time; something that can't be helped, of course. Solutions? Chew more gum, be more generous, or buy a smaller tub. (c:

I love the gum.  The flavor and consistency is good.  Unfortunately, I found out after chewing the gum that I'm allergic to cinnamon oil.  After I chew it, my tongue and cheeks get sores on them.  I'm so sad.

I'm a huge fan of natural cinnamon gum, and have attracted many coworkers to it from this large container sitting on my desk. This gum lasts rather long before disintegrating, and retains a hint of cinnamon after losing its initial sweetness fades. The texture is consistently stiff, and gives a nice jaw workout should one chew constantly (I like to suck on it and chew intermittently). I recommend buying a pack from a local health food store for six bits to sample before committing to a large pack. Other flavors have been good as well.

column9: Best All Natural Gum Around IMO
column10: I have tried a few other all natural gums before this one, but this gum is the best value in my opinion. There is no downside to it and it is the most affordable all natural gum I have found. There are 4 qualities I look for when purchasing gum: 1 - it tastes good; 2 - the taste lasts an adequate time; 3 - it uses all natural ingredients; 4 - it is a good value for the money. This gum meets all of these criteria. I just wish I found it sooner.

I love this gum, it has a nice kick of cinnamon to it.I have been buying spry for many years and love their gum.It is true that this gum actually prevents cavities.We have been using it for over 5 years /The taste lasts.This has nothing to do with the gum, but you have to be careful with xylitol, it does something with your sugar levels.  If you are trying to loose weight, there is something that it does.Otherwise this is really good for everything.Great product overall.  Spry is a really good company, they don't add anything to their products, that is not needed.

column9: Great when you don't want sugar!
column10: I was on a low carb diet and this gum was perfect!  Great flavor, did not last that long but there are enough pieces that it wasn't an issue.

column4: Jeffrey D. Leach "Brother of the 3rd Wheel"
column10: I'm very pleased with my Spry Sugar Free Cinnamon Gum purchase, the price is good, the product arrived undamaged in a timely manner. This is an excellent replacement for the Altoids Sugar Free Cinnamon Chewing Gum which is no longer available.

I got this and the Peelu to try out.  I ended up throwing the Peelu away because it has a strange metallic aftertaste.  Spry is great and tastes just like regular cinnamon gum, but the best part is that it stays soft with perfect gum texture even if you drink water.

column9: I never buy any other gum anymore
column10: The flavor lasts but it's not too spicy. I like that it's sugar free and doesn't have those crazy 'penylalanine..' (can't pronounce or spell) chemical additives nearly every gum on the market contains (and with a health warning). I buy a big canister of this gum to refill my travel-size cylinder and it lasts me for several months and stays fresh.

I prefer to chew gum than pop a mint throughout the day.  After a meal, after coffee, after a smoke (when I smoked) this was a go to for getting the after taste out of my mouth without brushing my teeth.  I used to purchase this from a local store but found that with my prime membership shipping and the cost ends up cheaper to buy here.  The gum is cinnamon flavors but not overpowering. I will be purchasing again.

This wasn't my favorite flavor at first of this brand, but after a while I liked it fine though I found something in it caused headaches very quickly.  Also apperently the sweetner is something to avoid if you have any sort of health issues, I bet its still better then sugar but no longer use :(

column9: Love Spry, love cinnamon, can't tolerate this gum
column10: First, I love Spry gum...high % of xylitol per serving, no gross/weird ingredients, great flavor. The flavor may fade a little faster than some conventional chewing gums, but it's better than consuming the carcinogenic, disgusting artificial ingredients they use. Also, this is an amazing value for Spry gum...previously I was ordering the 100 pc. tubs from a popular online herb store; that worked out to about $1.10 more per 100 pieces. At local health food stores, a 100 piece tub is even more expensive at about $7-7.5 each before tax! This is a good value anyway, as I have seen tubs of conventional chewing gum cost more than this per 100 pcs. The only thing is, I can not tolerate the cinnamon flavor for some reason! I can eat cinnamon no problem in other foods, but this gum triggers canker sores for me. I keep forgetting that and order it now and then because I like cinnamon gum, but it's really a bad idea for me :(

Spry tastes great and actually helps clean teeth between brushings. The flavor doesn't last as long as the candy-sweet gums we chewed as children, but this one isn't as much for fun and blowing bubbles as it is for hygiene and freshening breath.

Love the gum, it tastes good, last a long time, it is cheap (per piece), and supposedly won't damage your teeth.Not much left to be desired, only complaint would be chewing the same flavor gets old after awhile and the amount of gum in one container will last most people over a year.

column9: Outstanding with one small negative (being fixed)
column10: I purchased this product fully aware of the fact that the company uses titanium dioxide in its manufacture.  There seem to be different opinions, but from what I could tell there does not seem to be any significant problem with the tiny amount of titanium dioxide in the product, so I purchased it.  I spoke with the company first, and was informed that they are working on the same product without that ingredient, but they didn't have a firm roll-out date.Taste is great, it lasts, and it's sugarless without the (reported) harmful effects of Splenda, Aspartame, saccharin, etc.  We've done our own research and would not consider any of those, whereas the benefits of Xylitol appear to be great and without any harmful consequences.  We love it!It's just nice to know I have a pleasant chewing gum that is also not contributing to tooth decay or gum disease (and may even be helping to prevent both, according to some reports).This is worth just a hair shy of 5 stars, and that's a rating we rarely give unless a product is "over the top" great.  This is close.Note: Try finding ANY chewing gum in local grocery or drug stores that don't have Splenda or Aspartame in them - good luck!  Buy this instead, with its far lower price than at local "health food" stores where they charge much higher prices, and generally only carry small quantities.
Gum is healthy and tastes great in the first minute; after that, there is no taste.  For the price, I would prefer gum with more long-lasting flavor.

I have been chewing this gum for a long time and buying it through my local health food store.  It is not cheap but worth it.  The prices through amazon.com are the best I have ever found.  Cheaper than you can buy through the company that makes the gum in Orem Utah.Please make sure that you are not charged shipping like Amazon advertises.

This is great gum.  It contains NO aspartame, which is hard to find nowdays!  It is only sweetened with xylitol and it tastes great.  And this is the best price I can find.  It is much more expensive at the health food store.
A healthy choice for gum, great flavor.  Customer service was excellent - fast and courteous.
I like this gum very much. It keeps the flavor for a while.And the best part, it is sugarless w/o an after taste.

This gum has a terrific taste. It does not have that overwhelming cinnamon taste that burns your mouth. It has a pleasant, sweet, cinnamon flavor.  The Xylitol is considered a safe alternative sweetener and is also actually good for your teeth. Great to freshen your breath, quench your thirst or divert you from that bowl of potato chips! It really does help me stay on track with my healthy eating!  I highly recommend it.

I bought the Lemon-flavored mints before and was quite pleased. Decided to try this gum and was looking forward to a similar experience (read somewhere that cinnamon is good for your breath). You live and learn. I've found out that I am one of the few (or many?) people who have an allergic reaction to cinnamon. It was fine at first but after about a week of using the gum (three to four pieces daily), I developed tiny sores on my tongue and much bigger ones on the insides of my cheeks. Stopped taking the gum and it cleared up in about a week. Tried two pieces after it had mostly gone, and had a mild reaction within hours. Very disappointed, but it's not the product's fault really. Should've tried a smaller jar first, and probably should have googled "cinnamon allergy," due diligence is so important when parting with cash. Will have to give away the rest now.

I was initially delighted with this gum for I thought I'd found something I couldchew without the attendant gas and GI upset.It wasn't too long though before I noteced that I really sort of craved the gum and itsort of turned into an addiction I'd say.The craving, and chewing continued until a sensation of intraoral ulcers developed which took about a week to resolve. I'm off the gum now but still crave it.Interesting.Probably just me.

The Xylitol is AWESOME & has NUMEROUS health benefits (i.e., benefiting diabetes, heart disease, stroke, osteoporosis, cancer, bone/joint disorders, dental diseases, bad breath, hormone levels) but the TITANIUM DIOXIDE is TOXIC.Don't take my word for it.  If you have a PC research it yourself.

This tea is truly delicious -- one of my Mom's favorites for years (she's 94).  It's very hard to find in stores but well worth the online search.  We drink only hot tea, but I understand from friends that this kind of tea is also an excellent cold drink for those who like iced tea.  I rate it a winner!

column9: Stupendous because it's not filled with sugar
column10: The reason I like the european version of Ovaltine is because the first ingredient IS NOT sugar. A tasty treat to which you can add more sugar if you like.
taste awful. it has that weird after taste i cant describe, what a waste of money. the Philippine version is way better.

The Ovaltine in France is different and has a better flavor than what is sold in the US. We found this, which is indeed the European style, as advertised. It is just fine to replace what our child missed after we moved back, but the cost of shipping makes it impractical to order routinely.
I ordered this for my sister who lives in the US and was missing the European Ovaltine as she found the US version too sweet. I haven't tasted it myself but she seems pleased.

This drink mix tastes ok, just a little bland. It tastes like this to me probably because I am an American and I consume 12-15 lbs. of sugar a week!!  It's certainly not as sweet as the Ovaltine here in Walmart.

These clams from China are very sandy and I don't care for the taste either.  Don't get me wrong -- I like clams and I have had excellent canned smoked clams from another brand in the past.  Honestly, I was expecting more flavor and less sand.  I could go on but why?

column9: An old favorite and I'll give some ideas for it
column10: Back in the day, I used to just eat these right out of the tin.  I've always loved clams in any form.  Same is true for smoked foods.  You can't beat the combination of flavors.  But let me toss a couple ideas at you:1) Get the big scoop sized Fritos, add a blob of cream cheese and one of the clams.  Repeat until you fill a tray.  Easy hors'dourves!2) Big sushi rolls.  Add strips of cream cheese, the clams and some chopped green onion.  Yum!
I have not been able to find smoked baby clams in the supermarkets nearby.So I was excited to get these when I found them here.I was not disappointed, the clams are tiny and very delicious.

column9: Thank you for the smoky goodness!!!
column10: My local grocery stores had stopped stocking smoked baby clams some years ago, I suspect this is because my mum and must be the only ones that would buy them. When I was little my mum would crack open a can of smoked baby clams and we would share the can as no one else in the house would eat them. I was happy to have them to share with my mum as I get a tummy ache eating an entire can myself. As I got older the size of the clams in the cans got larger as well. So large that I would not concider them baby or even small clams. Maybe this is why the grocery stores stopped stocking them, they got too large for the can :)As for this product this is one of the best smoked baby clams I have ever eaten. The clams are quite petite, as the name "baby" would denote. And the smoke flavor is not overpowering. Just right. I would agree with a previous review that there was a large amount of oil, but this is of minor consequence as there is a major feast in each can.

column9: Feast on your friends from the sea!
column10: These clams are really good, but are sitting a little too much oil.  I usually pour out a little oil before my feast.

column9: A Star For Every Baby Clam (if I only could)
column10: Move over oyster - the smoked baby is the new pearl.  Now the signature mark of the outdoorsman - or woman - of impeccable taste in transportable haute cuisine, legend has it that most of the peaks in the Santa Catalina range, AZ have a can or two of these beautiful Bivalvia stashed away for those in the know.  This, the most recent version, is clad in raw umber wrappings and flaunts a convenient pull-tab lid, traits that effectively redefine the remote dining experience both in terms of aesthetics and kinesthesia.  Anchored by a questionable yet delightful consistency that always keeps one guessing about the nature of the next squish, SBCs (with an assist from the steadfast Wheat Thin) just may replace the role of the venerable potato chip within our lifetime.  Crown Prince has surely secured its fame by producing such a fine, fine, seafood product as this.  From wind-blown mountaintops to surf-swept beaches around the globe, I find these little canned clams to simply be the cat's meow.

Sorry PETA, but I love 'em!  After draining on a couple of paper towels, I've used them as a homemade pizza topping, in tortilla wraps (with other items), and stirred into a can of New England clam chowder to give it a smoky taste. Some brands have a bitter aftertaste, this one doesn't.
The product "Smoked Baby Clams" was full of sand and not edible.  Obviously I won't buy again.Crown Prince Smoked Baby Clams in Oil;3.75-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)

column9: Excellent for Light Lunch. Nice Smoke Flavor.
column10: I've been on a campaign to increase the seafood part of my diet and I've stocked up on a lot of canned seafood items, one of which is Crown Prince Baby Clams (smoked, in oil). I enjoy things like this for a light lunch. Just today I opened a can of the baby clams and had them with Wisecrackers (with Roasted Garlic and Rosemary). They were excellent. Nice lunch. The taste was good with the light smoke flavor. I'd prefer the smoked oysters, but that's just a matter of personal taste. The only difficulty was keeping the cats at a distance.Gary Peterson

column9: GREAT CANDY BARS FROM MY CHILDHOOD!!
column10: I really love these candy bars. Wispa bars were my favorite as a child and then they stopped making them in the US. I was so thrilled that I was still able to order them. Talk about a "Blast from the past"! They look and taste the same as I remembered. They taste great and I will definitely buy again in the future.
I am going to be using this product for the candy buffet at my wedding in September. The transaction was easy and fast. Thank you!

I sent a case of Duke's Mayonnaise to my daughter who recently moved to Long Island and, horror of horrors, couldn't find Duke's Mayonnaise.  Please understand that both of my offspring know that there is only one mayonnaise and that's tart and flavorful Duke's.  My only concern was that it may not be fresh but I called my daughter and she said it was just the way it should be, with all the flavor, tang and smoothness that she's grown to love.

I never thought I would be crazy about MAYONNAISE!  I bought this because it doesn't have added sugar.  Strangely enough, it has a spectacular sweetness!  I have tried other no-sugar-added mayos that are available locally, but they all taste horrible.  This one is so worth ordering!

i tried this mayo once while visiting friends. have been wondering often where and how to get it again, i live in north east-i should have thought of amazon right off the bat! product arrived as promised, right on time, great price, great condition, and we are very happy.
This mayo tastes wonderful. You will not notice the difference. Perfect for those watching carbs. I buy it a case at a time (4 jars).
I must say I love this mayo. And the price was very good. Great for sandwiches, salads, or my famous caesar dressing. Smooth, creamy, everything mayonnaise should be.
Super product! Very poor packaging! Four large plastic jars rolling around in a cardboard box. Had they been glass, they never would have made the shipping intact!

I am not from the South, but found Dukes while searching for a sugar free mayo.  This is the best, my whole family loves it!  It has become a staple in our low carb living.  If you are looking for a good mayo you must try Dukes!

I was always a Miracle Whip girl - but when I started looking for no sugar options a friend recommended Duke's.  This is simply the best stuff I've ever had.  I use it to make all my homemade dressings and sauces now and my kids keep stealing the bottles!

I ordered this item because some acquaintances on a cooking forum were raving about Dukes Mayo being far superior to Best Foods/Hellman's Mayonnaise.  I can't get Duke's here in California, so I ordered four 48oz. jars!!  This is a tasteless excuse for mayonnaise!!  The flavor is just plain flat.  I'll be sticking to Best Foods Mayonnaise from now on.  Wish I could send back the other three jars for a refund.

Keebler Toast and Peanut Butter and Jelly Flavored Sandwich Crackers Made with Real Peanut Butter and Jelly Flavored Twelve 1.8 Ounce packsEveryone who ate them at the party stated how fresh the crackers were and the taste was great.

The Jell-O No-Bake Oreo Dessert tastes excellent. It's very easy to make and tastes better than the Oreo Ice cream pies that you get pre-made in the grocery store. All you have to do is mix the ingredients together and put it in your fridge or freezer. It tastes good cold or frozen. It was a huge hit at my last dinner party. I served it for dessert and everyone loved it. Everyone, young and old, raved over it and asked for seconds. I thought that the pie would be too crunchy because the box contains a lot of crushed Oreos but it wasn't. The pie has just enough crunchiness to not overpower the smooth, creamy and rich flavor of the pie. It's not overly sweet and sugary tasting which I like. The only thing I would recommend is that you put this in an 8 to 9 inch round pie plate or something similar in shape so that the pie comes out looking better, if presentation matters to you. Plus, that's what the recipe called for anyway. I neglected to check that out in the store when I bought the mix. I didn't have a round pie plate so I used a 9-inch square Pyrex dish so the pie didn't look as good as the picture but thank goodness it still tasted awesome.

column9: Fabulous New Product from Peeled Snacks
column10: We have been fans of the PEELED SNACKS product line for years now. We love their line of organic dried fruits. We really appreciate having a snack that not only is delicious but is organic and has no added sugar. Kind of nice that the taste is really high but the calories are really low. Now we have discovered that PEELED SNACKS has a new product: Apple Crunch. Wow! We are in love again! Apple taste with a really fun crunch. Not only a fantastic healthy and delicious snack but really fun to eat! If you take your peeled snacks to the movies, as we do, be sure to chew your apple clusters with your lips closed or everybody in the theater will be looking at you! Maybe you should take a few extra packages to share. Thank you PEELED SNACKS for giving us not only tasty and healthy snacks but clusters that are just fun, fun, fun to eat! We are a senior citizen couple and take great care to eat healthy. We appreciate that the entire PEELED SNACKS line lets us snack while having fun and not having to worry about sugar and our waistlines. We can't wait to see what the folks at PEELED SNACKS have in line for us next. Until then, we have a lot to enjoy!
I used to live in Wyoming.  After I moved I could no longer get this delicious product.  I would recommend this peanut butter to anyone.

column4: Tommie "An expert is a former drip under pres...
column10: This would get five stars except for the price. It has a flavor reminiscent of the salad dressing I used to buy from an Asian restaurant--a little sweet and gingery (though I don't think ginger is an ingredient). This is my favorite of all the dressings Foods Alive makes. It's best used straight out of the fridge. Otherwise, it thins out too much and doesn't stick to the salad as well. It ends up in a puddle in the bottom of the dish.
I love this stuff on my salad.  I generally prefer Balsamic Vinegar dressings, so I mix it 50/50 or so with Balsamic and it's wonderful - and 1 bottle lasts twice as long.

I love the variety in this package except the dark orange pieces (I don't what fruit they are).  They're very bitter, and I usually pick them out of the bag.  I wish there were more coconut pieces though, since they're my favorite.

Product arrived within a week.  I had settled for another brand since I couldn't find this one in our local stores.  I was thrilled to taste it again and enjoy the great variety of fruits included.  Very satisfied with my purchase.

Mariani's Tropical Medley of dried fruits is a delicious mix.  My kids and I absolutely love it.  There are all kinds of different colors, flavors,and textures here, as the medley includes pineapple, apricots, papaya, raisins, golden raisins, apples, and coconut.  I would have given this product five stars, but it does have added sugar and yellow dye number 6.  Still, it's a great snack and a far better choice for a sweet craving than candy!

I have used Tropical Medley for years in Orange-Glazed Tropical Fruit Scones. A Pillsbury Bake-Off Recipe by Fran Neavoli 1966. Other fruit mixes just do not work as well.Thank you Fran, wherever you may be.

column9: Quite possibly the best candy you will ever taste!
column10: Enstrem's Toffee is absolutely the best candy I have ever eaten.  When I was a kid living in Grand Junction, Colorado (the home also of Enstrem's) my parents used to get a box of this every year at Christmas.  Needless to say the box would not last very long.  This is thick, rich, and buttery toffee at its finest.  Whole almonds inside this delicious toffee make for the excellent crunch and the crushed almonds and milk chocolate on the top is beyond yummy!  After you eat this awesomeness, there is the crushed almonds, bits of the toffee and chocolate, at the bottom of the box.  You literally have to shake the box of these delicious crumbs in your mouth!  Enstrems has become world famous not only for their toffee but for their chocolate, hard candy, and so much other delicious candy.  They have shops in Colorado from Grand Junciton to Colorado Springs.  It is now easy to order Enstrem's off the internet and their website is outstanding!  I order at least a pound of this delicious toffee every Christmas and have to be careful not to order it every month of the year!  But, I just torture myself and wait to Christmas to order this.  I can't recommend this delicious candy enough!  5 stars and more!!  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED DELICIOUSNESS!

column9: You will eat the whole box.
column10: I love this toffee and buy it for friends during the holidays. It is the best toffee, buttery, crunchy sweet goodness. ok, I'm about to order some more. Their peppermint bark is delicious too.

column9: Eat this and you will find God
column10: I remember about 30+ years ago my brother in law (then my sister's boyfriend) came home from a trip with his folks. He brought over a 3 lb box of this funny looking, broken up bits of chocolate-covered something, dusted in powdered sugar and crushed almonds. I grabbed a small piece and popped it in my mouth. At that point and time I heard the sound of singing angels, cherubs buzzed around my head and I was transported to a large golden gate that opened before me. Behind it was a beautiful old man with a long white beard who stood there with his arms folded and a smirk on his face."Well," he said, "whudja think?""Decadent," I said.He laughed, "yeah, I know."
About half this box of toffee had such a burnt flavor it had to be thrown out.  Very disappointing.  I cannot recommend this product.

column4: Bill Your 'Free Form FM Print DJ "bill nicholas"
column10: This is one of the heaviest of the Starbucks Coffees. Sumatra is big, spicy, strong and bold.Most East Asian and African coffees have more body than those from South America and  Europe. With a big flavor and lots of spice, Sumatra is definitely a sit and sip, not a gulp and run.Leave it to me to make this mistake: 99% of my reviews are music. When I went into Starbucks in 2002, my first year on a regular basis, I kept getting funny looks, and it took me a long time to find out why.I kept asking for a cup of "Sinatra."

Well, all I can say is that the coffee was fresh.  Other than that...Awful, just plain awful.  I'd rather drink $2 a pound grocery store coffee.Kenya AA is smooth, rich, with an intoxicating odor and a wonderful aftertaste.  This coffee is the exact opposite.  Harsh, no body, with a bitter edge and lingering bitter aftertaste that I can still taste a half hour later.  Completely lacking the winey, fruity highlights Kenya AA is known for.I tried it black, and with cream and sugar.  Unpalatable either way.If you like eating charcoal briquettes, then you might like this coffee...

column9: Best Coffee on the Whole Planet!
column10: I don't usually like flavored coffee, but saw this brand on television a while back.  Searched and found it on amazon and decided to give it a try.  It was so amazingly rich, flavorful and just plain delicious that this is our second order.  Best coffee on the planet here, and I can't wait to try their other flavors.  Would definitely recommend this product.

column9: Please understand what it means to go grain free.....
column10: This product is a good product and really good health wise for your cats. If you are looking at this product you are probably interested in feeding your cats something better. I just wanted to address some of the negative reviews of this food - many of them by people who don't understand that all cat food is not the same. I took the time to switch my 8 year old street rescue Louie to grain-free food (tried many brands before I arrived at BFF), and here are some of my observations.CostAll grain free foods costs more for the same reason that grass-fed antibiotic free, free range chicken costs more per lb than a chicken nugget. It's better for your cat! Anyone who has a cat that's on a farm - ever see it eating some of the corn or wheat that spills off of the truck? Never! That is because cats don't eat grains. In cheap cat foods these grains are used as fillers to round out the portions and are not of any nutritional value to the cat. When I went grain free my cat ate much, much less - thereby negating the price difference. I even tested it a couple of times - my 13 lb cat can eat 2 - 3 ounce cans of Fancy Feast in one sitting - but cannot eat a 3.3 ounce can of BFF in one sitting.Another point on cost. If you are the type to take your cat to the vet and take care of it when it is sick, then you save so much money and trouble with foods like this it is crazy. When you hear people talk about diabetic cats, food allergies and all the other assorted sicknesses our animals are getting - most of them come from food. Diabetic cats - did they continuously raid the cookie jar? All the money you think you will save (but are not actually saving) will go to the health care of your pet in later years. Its the same way McDonalds and Denny's don't have to absorb the cost of all the diabetics they helped create - the taxpayers pay for it through Medicare and higher insurance costs 30 or so years down the line (and sooner with all the young diabetics we are creating).SmellMost grain free cat foods smell. EVO stank up the house horribly and I had to move the cat bowl from the kitchen. Minus all the fillers and grains - you are getting an all natural product that is better for your cat because nutrition of the cat is put first.TasteCat's are notoriously finicky. Most cat foods that have grains and other filler ingredients have to add heavy syrupy mixes to get the cats to eat them. They take corn, wheat, soy, barley and gods know what else, add some vitamins and then add a extremely strong tasty syrupy mix to get the cat to swallow it all. So cats fed this for a period of time get used to it the same way babies get used to sugars in their formula. Then, when you want to give the baby vegetables with no sugar added guess what? Baby rejects them - they want the sugar! Same happens with cats fed with cheap filler foods.PoopWhen switching to grain free a cats habits and consistency may change. Their digestive system is learning how to digest what it was actually made for. Same thing happens to humans - look up the "Whole 30" and see what I mean.Switching to Grain FreeIts a process more involved than opening the can and plopping it down. Took me months. Google can help you do it but don't expect to just give this to your cat and have her dive right in thanking you for it. That may happen, but more likely than not you have to mix old and new foods until they are used to it.BFF, EVO, Taste of the Wild.... they are all good brands that will improve the health of your cat. I settled on BFF as my wet food because he loves it. I used to give him EVO wet food and he would eat it but he hated it. I still feed him EVO dry food because he likes it. I tried many brands and did not give up on grain-free food because I cared about my cat. I understood as a street cat for years he was used to eating whatever he could and it all was the cheapest, unhealthiest stuff available given to him by well meaning people. He has improved in every way (coat, activity level, temperament, litter habits, etc..) and now is a healthy and happy cat.

column9: Great grain free, high fiber, high moisture food!
column10: My slightly aging cat has had horrible colitis in the last two years, and was defecating on the floor and my bed. The best solution I found was to switch to a grain free food, and offer more wet food than dry, so he will have more moisture in his bowels. I switched to Natural Care LDT, and it solved his problem...for about six months. After finding another steaming pile in my bed recently, and a few under my desk, I decided to try BFF, as my local pet store  just started carrying it. He is a picky feline, but he sucked the Tuna and pumpkin flavor down like a Hoover. One week later, happy cat, no more poop in my bed, which means happy girl. Great ingredients, and picky cat loves it!Note: yes he saw the vet. The change in diet was the vets idea.

My kitty is not a picky cat to eat so generally I can't tell what he really likes.This one, of course my kitty loves it.For me, it doesn't gross me out with the smell. In fact, it smells like human food.Also, my kitty doesn't leave a bit on his dish when I pour this can.I check the ingredients whenever I buy something for my cat, and BFF generally offers pretty good ingredients with decent price. I highly recommend this cat food!

column9: Tuna, Taurine, My Cat Loves It
column10: Thank You. I am very pleased. Quality cat food. Good for male cats, high water content.Some other brands on Amazon are made abroad then distributed by US. company. The b.f.f product readsmade in Massachusetts. Glad there is Taurine in it. First ingredient tuna, then water for processing,also included: Potato Starch. The Potato Starch may not be for all cats. I am not vetrinarian. I have always fed my cat dry and wet from Premium companies. This was my first time finding a brand for him on amazon. For the price and convenience, I am ordering again... but mostly because my cat loves it. Thank You.

Very good quality cat food.  Made at a human food factory with human grade ingredients.  The tuna used is the red meat from the skipjack tuna fish.  They get a variety so this is just part of their diet as I do not want to feed them tuna based foods as their primary source of protein.  Healthy and cats love this.  I try to use this brand, Tiki Cat, Weurva and then for dry food Orijen cat food.  My Himalayan cats are on a no grain, no gluten/filler diet.  This wet food in combination with the dry has led to great coats, no hair balls, good energy and solid not too stinky poo :)

column9: OMG, it was like TT "totally tasty" - (in the cat's own words)
column10: IDK where my BFF mom found this delicious snack, but I have to say TY!  Best Feline Friend is dose of rich, ambrosial comfort food.  Mini chunks of tender tuna punctuate the smooth tasty sauce.  Costing just over $10 per 12 pack, Best Feline Friend is a reasonable value.  At that price, this delectable entrée is likely to become a staple of my diet.  I heart <3 BFF!ttfnSteve the cat

I initially thought this was a generic brand of food and of poor quality, due to the label design.  However, it's a Weruva product and is exactly the quality of food I normally purchase (Tiki Cat, Merrick, Natural Balance, Wellness).  There's no grains or byproducts.  My kitties love this and are incredibly picky eaters.  I'm going to try the other flavors now, especially at such a great price!!!

column9: Great for our discriminating feline friends
column10: Our cats love this food. One of them is elderly  and doesn't normally eat enough---but she pays attention when we open one of these cans. She is doing very well on it. Our kitten, though, is now spoiled rotten and doesn't want anything else! They both like it better than canned tuna, which is saying a lot. They also really like the "tuna so cool" flavor. The one flavor they weren't crazy about was the tuna and vegetables, big surprise.

I just tried my two four footed food critics on BFF's Tuna & Veggies Valentine and it made a big hit with both of them. It's always a risk trying a new food on my two finicky cats, but I hoped they would like this one because they love parent company Weruva's Tuna & Vegetables Weruva Mediterranean Harvest Cat Food, 5.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 24). BFF's tuna & veggies is a bit different from Weruva's - it has red tuna instead of white and a slightly thicker consistency, though both are stew like and have visible chunks of veggies. And both have an ingredient list that meets my standards - no by products. My twosome snarfed up every last bit of tuna and veggies valentine that I gave them and they asked me for more - but they will have to wait until tonight for that!

One of my kitties has ear allergies, so after much research I decided to put them on a grain free diet. I purchased a number of different types of can food from the pet store. They rejected a majority of it and refused to eat it. They went nuts over this canned food, so I am now a huge fan. My pet store does not keep much in stock, so I was thrilled to find it on amazon!

I've recently switched my cats to all grain free food. (if you still feed your cats (or dogs!) with grain filled food, especially if you have had a problem with bladder or kidney stones, I implore you to look at the reviews and research of grain free food.) That being said, my ragdoll usually only eats dry food and my shorthair usually eats the wet food. Amazon delivered this to my doorstep today and I opened a can and fed it right away to see if they liked it. After taking a shower I came back out and it was ALL gone, and my ragdoll was finishing up what little was left. The cat food box says on the front that it was made in a human food facility, but I don't know much about cat food that isn't made in a human food facility. I still appreciate the fact that they are trying to say it is higher quality. I will probably be buying this brand from now on, I just wish Amazon Prime members got it in two days like usual, but it is shipped from pet food direct so :(.
My cat loves this! You are able to see the pieces of chicken & tuna! It is very fresh and I was tempted to take a bite, though I didn't of course. :)

My four discriminating cats rejected every other brand of cat food that was placed in their bowls, but still love BFF.  Amazon's very low price is GREAT and the food is delivered to my door.  Who could ask for more?  All five of us are happy.
but not as good a weruva -- much more chunky and the cats do not seem to like as much.  All and all a solid back up for the back of the cupboard.

I recently adopted a kitten just under a year old. At first we thought there was something wrong with her, she wouldn't do normal crazy kitten things. After reading about cat nutrition, I discovered what I had fed to my cats as a kid was completely backwards, as is most 'cat food' even today. I read about BFF and decided to let her try some. Now my cat doesn't rest all day, but is playful and as crazy as a kitten should be. Also of note, there is much more urine in her litter box each day, which is a good sign of how much water is in the food. She's also volunteering her presence more now, not just when she is hungry. I had to take a star off, not because of the product, but since Amazon doesn't let me order more than 2 packs per flavor. I'd give it 6 stars if I could 'subscribe' as you can with other types of food on Amazon.Also, I would recommend the 3oz cans if you have only one cat. You will have to feed him/her more throughout the day, but it can dry out if they don't finish it, which defeats some of the purpose besides being unappetizing to the cat.

Awwww another winner from Weruva, i really like the brand and they made the BFF line with us in mind. It's a little cheaper than the actual Weruva brand cause its seafood based. Their seafood has the lowest mercury levels but still this isnt recomended for everyday use on your kitties, you're supposed to switch it around. I only give it to my babies 1 or 2-ice a week that's it. You should hear them begging when the can is popped open ha ha ha.

If your cat has GI or stomach problems, be SURE to read the ingredients on the label as several of the BFF flavors contain Carrageenan which is not at all healthy for your cat (or people for that matter).  It causes GI problems and heartburn -- the very last thing a kitty needs.  It does NOT appear that Carrageenan is listed in the Amazon description, but if one checks the BFF website, you can find complete product ingredients.In particular, this BFF has the Carrageenan listed towards the top of the ingredient list, so more highly concentrated.My cat needs grain-free food for her IBD and I purchased a few cans of this BFF locally.  The "Carrageenan" on the label got me to sleuthing and discovered some food makers (pet and human) use this as a filler.[...]Just a heads up for folks ..!

This is not very expensive compare to other brands, grain-free, my 3-year old cat goes crazy over it! It looks like canned  tuna with chicken gravy. Just started feeding him his second car, let's see if it'll improve my cat's health

My cat is somewhat choosy about her food, and she likes this. There are little meat-ball like pieces in here that she leaves behind if I don't smash them a bit with a fork before serving, but that's not a big deal. Satisfied.

My 14 year old kitty's mouth does not work so well anymore, and she has trouble eating most of the grain free wet foods, which tend to be too chunky or solid. This awesome wet food is full of jelly and broth as well as meat, and it's PERFECT for an old kitty's mouth. She has not eaten a full helping of cat food in YEARS, but the very first can of this stuff I set out for her was GONE almost instantly. She is usually constantly screaming for treats, but after having a full 3 ounce can of this, she is happy and scream free. I have never seen her take to a wet food so instantly and so completely. Yes, it smells like tuna...because it's made from tuna? It's pungent but she frickin' LOVES it. How nice to see my poor old girl eat every last bit of something. I am just so grateful I found this food! Will be ordering it on a regular basis. Thanks, BFF!

I don't feed fish to Hanx too often, but this has become a go to occasional treat for him! He loves this stuff and devours it in a flash! I trust Weruva as a brand and so far like b.f.f. a lot, so does Hanx.

Wow... ALL the cats scarfed it down! Even the ones that don't eat canned food! A couple of the ferals that rarely comes out for me willing came out and was talking and that's just from what they scented!
