I am so disapointed that I am actually going to take this product back to the grocery store and get my money back - something that I NEVER do.

column9: ANGRY AT VERY MISLEADING NUTRITIONAL LABELLING
column10: The package presented, online, or on the shelves at the market, appear about the size of a large cup of soup. If you got a smaller portion in a restaurant, you would complain LOUDLY.However the misleading nutritional info says the "serving size" is 1 cup. PEOPLE, GET WITH THE PROGRAM! 1 CUP BARELY COVERS THE BOTTOM OF THE SOUP DISH YOU USE AT HOME!!!!  TRY IT FOR YOURSELF WITH 1 CUP OF WATER, AND SEE IF THAT WOULD MAKE YOU THINK IT WAS  "normal serving."So, if the REAL LIFE FOR REAL PEOPLE serving size is 1 of their containers =2 cups(=16 oz vs a can of Coke@12oz), then the real sodium is a whopping 960 Mg, 40% of the suggested Daily Value (printed on its own can), and FAR, FAR, FAR FROM A "HEALTHY CHOICE"...And that's assumiung you have nothing else with the soup; not bread, not anything at all.I don't usually get so worked up over little things, but this is NOT a little thing, if you, like so many of us, are watching your salt consumption, just as a matter of general health.THE MANUFACTURES REALIZE THOSE AT ALL CONCIOUS THEIR SALT, WOULD BUY LESS OF THEIR PRODUCT, AND HENCE IN TINY, TINY, TINY PRINT, SMALLER THAN MY MICROSOFT WORD CAN EVEN REPRODUCE, AND"COINCIDENTALLY "ON THE BUMPY, CURVED PORTION OF THE CONTAINER, (MAKING IT EVEN LESS LIKELY TO BE READ), THEY LIST THE FACT THAT THE CONTAINER IS 2 "SERVINGS", AND ALLOW US TO HAPPILY POISON OURSELVES OVERDOSING WITH SALT, WHILE EVEN BE SO CYNICAL AND SLEAZY AS TO LABEL THEIR PRODUCT AS HEALTHY. YES, HEALTHY IN THE SAME WAY AS A HOT FUDGE SUNDAY AND FRIED ONION RINGS WOULD BE.GOD HELP US ALL IF YOU, LIKE I, MAKE THE MISTAKE*** OF EATING 2 CANS FOR DINNER WITH SOME SALAD TWICE A WEEK, THINKING WE ARE EATING HEALTHIER AND LOWER CALORIE FOOD, ONLY TO LEARN YOU HAVE BEEN POISIONING YOURSELF  (AND YOUR KIDS?) BY OVERDOSING ON SALT (ASSUMING YOU EAT ANYTHING ELSE DURING YOUR DAY!), SINCE 2 CANS, ABOUT THE SIZE OF A "REAL" HEARTY SERVING OF SOUP, IS 80% OF THE RECOMMENDED MAXIMUM SALT INTAKE- JUST BY ITSELF.I AM NOT SUGGESTING THESE ARE THE ONLY PEOPLE TO CREATE SUCH MISLEADING ADVERTISING, BUT NEITHER ARE THEY EXEMPT FROM RESPONSIBLE LABELLING.BTW, THE PROBABILITY IS 99.99999% THAT THEY USE PRECISELYT THE SAME MISLEADING PRACTICES ON THERI OTHER "HEALTHY CHOICE" PRODUCTS. CAVEAT EMPTOR, AND GOD BLESS THE FDA, FOR "PROTECTING US" FROM SUCH DECEPTIONS.***I only learned of this by reading other reviews which alerted me to the deception. I am an MBA from a top university with 30 years work experience, and do not think os myself as either inatentive or uncomprehending. This labelling, you can be sure, has been tested through many consumer test panels-they know exactly what they are doing.
Just absolutely heavenly. I had my doubts about it - I mean how good can this stuff be if it is just mixed with water and ice?  But, it really is fantastic. . . and addictive.

column9: The best chocolate drink you'll ever have, period.
column10: I live in New York so I have had the liberty of actually visiting Serendipity--famously known for their desserts, ice cream, and frrroozen hot chocolate. Residents and tourists alike are willing to wait TWO HOURS just to sit-down and get their hands on this. I am NOT a 'dessert' guy nor do I care for a 'frrrozen hot chocolate', but I have to say this is delicious.I purchased two of these gifts and they were received with much delight.==PROS==- consistent and tastes the same as if you were to go in-store- easy to make and followable directions- includes the actual cup they use so you can have a serendipity in the comfort of your house==CONS==- pricey but in the end--it's worth it.

I had heard about this product from Oprah and Racheal Ray...then I was reading about it in magazines, so I had to try it being the chocolate lover that I am.  It took me awhile to order it because it's kind of spendy, but after I made it....IT WAS WELL WORTH IT!!!  This is the best tasting chocolate drink I have ever had!  The only reason I gave it 4 out of 5 stars was because it took a little longer than I thought to recieve it, but well worth the wait!

column9: A Chocoholic's DREAM DRINK!!!! Buy me! Buy me! Buy me!
column10: You may not have personally visited Serendioity in N.Y City.... me either.... :-(  but I have wonderful news....this is the next best thing! Follow the directrions and you will not be disappointed, double blend it real well... And SHARE.. oh my word, one packet can be consumed by a single person but you will fill kinda bad after the high of the drink. I packet is 5 servings....  YUMMY!!!!

I received this as a Christmas gift, from Santa in my stocking!!!  I didn't make it cold in the blender, although I'm sure it's delicious that way too.  I heated milk on the stove and added the mix that way and it's the BEST hot chocolate I've ever had!!!....this is coming from a total choco-holic!  It has a note of melted marshmallows in it and is super creamy!!  Maybe I'll try some cold in the summer.  Not your run of the mill chocolate mix.

My daughter, my good friend and I visited NYC this past summer and my friend convinced us to go to Serendipity3.  We are so glad she did.  Two of us had the frozen hot chocolate (decadently delicious) and I broke tradition and went with the Trader Wic #1. A pineapple coconut frozen concoction equally decadently delicious. In fact it was so good we made a point of stopping by again for the wonderful desserts before we left for home. I was smart though, on my way out I bought the canister of frozen hot chocolate and have converted the rest of our family to frozen hot chocolate lovers.  So glad I can buy this online although shipping is pretty pricey it is well worth it.  Wish they would sell the Trader Wic #1 online too.

column9: Pretty Darn Close to the Real Deal
column10: I recently had the Serendipity's Frrrozen Hot Chocolate at their Vegas location and was in heaven! Although it was $9, it still was worth every last sip of it! I wanted to share the yummy goodness with my friend right here at home so I decided to give it a try.Not bad at all! It was rich and chocolatey just like the real one. I even ate the powder by itself and thought it was delicious. I made some homemade whipped cream and shaved some dark chocolate on top of it for that extra special touch.Will be buying again!!

column9: Wonderfully chocolatey - just like the original!
column10: On a recent trip to NYC, I stopped by Serendipity 3 and couldn't help but try their signature frozen hot chocolate.  It was so creamy and decadent with such rich choclate flavor.  I picked up a few packets of mix before I left (same packs that are sold on here... they also sell this canister mix at the store).  I made one for the first time at home this past weekend and it was so deliciously chocolatey and tasted surprisingly similar to the hot chocolate I got in the restaurant.  This does not have a malt choclate flavor, it's definitely like a frozen version of a rich hot chocolate.  I think it's fabulous and would definitely buy it again!  You can also add a jigger of vodka or kaluha for a bit of added punch.  :)  Enjoy!

All you need in addition to the Serendipity3 Powder is milk and ice cubes.  With those 3 ingredients, you could be a STAR!!!  The finished product is the most outstanding Frozen Hot Chocolate in the world.  This is not an exaggeration.  Makes for the perfect finishing touch for any kind of dinner.40 years ago I became addicted to Serendipity3's Frozen Chocolate from the restaurant of the same name, and it's only since discovering that you can purchase the powder that I have found that I can duplicate this wonderful dessert. Hurray for Amazon for finding and marketing this fabulous product.

column9: THe word Serendipty fits what I found on Amazon
column10: WHat a delight to find that Serendipity is selling their Frozen Hot Chocolate and their wonderful serving bowl on line.  It brings me back to when I was 18, almost 50 years ago when I went to Serendipity with my boyfriend. I had this fabulous float and have had it whenever I could get to Serendipity. In New York and then in Westpot Ct. where they were there for a short time.  Now living in the midwest, I was thrilled to see I could get the whole package and bring back fond memories as I open the box and make myself that delight that only Serendipity makes.

I live now in the midwest, however when lived in Connecticut and N.Y. I went to Serendipity whenever I could.  This mix brings back fond memories and the best frozen hot choclate ever.  Happy they are selling it in the large size. Now I can have it whenever I want it.

column9: BY FAR THE BEST CHOCOLATE DRINK EVER
column10: I purchased it after seeing it featured on Food Network and the narrator stated it is comprised of 17 different chocolates from all over the world, I had to try it being a true chocoholic. I received it and what a great surprise, I normally do solid chocolate (from 70% cacoa to milk chocolate) not powder because it often lacks true taste, but this drink surpassed my expectations, it is sweet but you can taste the blend with dark chocolate.  I let my sons try it they love it too. The second can is on the way and it now has a permanent place in my pantry. VIVA FRRROZEN HOT CHOCOLATE!!!

I saw this product on Paula Deen's show and it looked good so I ordered it on Amazon right away and forgot all about it. It was delivered this afternoon and I decided to try it. I have to say, I wasn't expecting much at all (how many times have we seen something on TV, ordered it and wished we hadn't?) but this totally blew me away!! It's super easy to make and has a deep rich chocolate taste. If you've had the Haagen Daz amazon reserve ice-cream this tastes similar to that but has a longer lasting chocolate flavor in your mouth. It's a little pricey so I may save it for "special occassions" when I need a little chocolately comfort.

This was a gift for my brother and sister-in-law and they said it was positively EVIL...which in my family is the highest praise a dessert can attain.  We will probably give as a gift to someone next Christmas as well.

Oh my...this is just a little piece of heaven here on earth.  I've been to Serendipty in New York and what a wonderland.  I had the Frozen Hot Chocolate at Serendipty 111 and bought some to take home.  It just doesn't get any better than this!  It is good in the winter or summer.  This is a must! If you can't get to Sernedipity to get the Frozen Hot Chocolate in person please, buy it on Amazon!
This stuff is awesome!  If you can't be in New York to drink it, get some to have at home with tons of whipped cream and lots of chocolate sprinkles!!!  It's amazing!
The drink was tasty, but this is just expensive hot chocolate mix. Overpriced for what it is.

column9: Wasn't at all what I thought I was ordering
column10: Returning for refund, because the text says "...As Seen on Oprah! Gift Box Includes: -The beautiful 20 oz dessert glass from the Serendipity restaurant-Two 6 oz packets of Frrrozen Hot Chocolate Mix (each packet makes 30 oz - delectable drink for two!)-A Serendipity spoon -Two straws (in case you choose to share!) Everything you need to recreate the restaurant's #1 all time favorite world famous dessert drink at home."I thought this was all inside the canister, but it's not. It's a canister of mix, but includes no gift items.Frustrated, because usually Amazon product descriptions are very accurate!

I lived in NYC for 25 years and worked close to the Serendipity store.  The frozen hot chocolate is something we do not see or experience if not in NY.Now I live in Toledo Ohio and miss the flavors of NYC!!  Thank you Serendipity for allowing  me to experience this culinary delight once again!!
Awesome and delicious as expected! The container makes it easier to store and use for next time with no hassle or mess. We love this stuff!

If you have never tried this product you are missing out!  The first time I ordered this drink was at Serendipity in NYC. I was skeptical when I saw the instant mix at the store.  It is worth it!  Very flavorful and filling, my teenager now have their friends hooked on it too.
I guess I have seent this many times on tv and etc .. i think its overhyped fro what it was and we are all underimpressed.
We love this special frozen hot chocolate! Very easy to fix and its like having a soda fountain at home!

column9: Don't know what all the hype is about
column10: I received the Serendipity Frozen Hot Chocolate Mix today -  I was anxcious to try it after reading all the reviews.  I followed the directions and I have to say -  I was not impressed.  It tasted like chocolate milk.  Maybe it tastes better at Serendipity in NYC.  I won't be ordering this again.  But at least I can say I tried it.  :(
It was like a chocolate frappe,,,rich and choclolaty,,,,the only thing I wish was, there was a glass with it to serve it in.
Taste very similar to a high quality fudgesicle; this mix very easy to use. I was very happy with the product.
The Frozen Hot Chocolate was very good, easy to make, and very refreshing.  I highly recommend this to all chocolate lovers - would be excellent in the summer!
Wonderful, rich, decadent......a must to serve to your friends, or just to enjoy by yourself....YUM!!
Tried this after seeing it on Oprah as a must try....with fresh whipped creme it is wonderfully decadent!
Have bought this item a few times before and have always been very satisfied with the quality. Great taste, very unique product. Excellant service.

I've seen this product mentioned on various talk shows, so I was intrigued to try it.  It is absolutely delicious--it reminds me of drinking a blended fudgcicle, but much richer with better quality chocolate and not quite as sweet.  I just ordered two more cans to have it on hand for this summer.  I'm looking forward to sitting on my deck on hot summer evenings and enjoying an icy cold glass of frozen hot chocolate!
sent to a family who had enjoyed the frozen hot chocolate at serendipity in NYC, and they loved it.

For some reason my husband ordered a TON of this stuff for me for Christmas.  We live in Chicago & it's cold so I didn't try it right away.  I was craving something sweet so I finally made some tonight.  It tastes like icy chocolate, & it's a bit chalky.  To be honest it reminds me of the old powdered slimfast.  I've got a whole canister and 5 packets of this stuff & I don't know what I'm going to do with it.

This is an excellent product, easy to make and true to the shop's most popular item.  I find it very difficult to get true chocolate flavor from almost any manufactured item, it always seems to be missing that deep flavor. I was pleasantly surprised with Serendipity, they nailed it.  The cost is a little high but I don't think you could do any better price-wise at home buying all the different kinds of chocolates used.  The best way to describe the flavor is  deep cocoa .  It's rich and dark, like hot chocolate.  It tastes nothing at all like a milkshake although it's is cold.  The canister is a nice improvement over the pouches, you get to customize the flavor a little easier.  Because of the cost, it's a once in a while treat for us and it is a favorite.  Buy with confidence, it's a delicious product.

When I got it in the mail, my first endeavor was to cover up the horrible pictures on the can.  Then my intuition said, "Put four walnut halves in the blender with the chocolate mix, the milk and ice cubes."  The blender completely pulverized the walnuts and the only thing I crunched on was tiny bits of ice. The walnuts added the most wonderful depth of flavor to this already remarkable product.

If you were to imagine drinking hot chocolate in an ice storm, that might be close to the experience of smooth chocolaty bliss merging with ice crystals slipping through a straw and melting onto your tongue.Ingredients: Sugar, non-fat dry milk, dextrose and cocoas processed with alkali. The blend of cocoa powders is especially rich and smooth.This is a super fast dessert to make because all you do is put milk (even nonfat milk works) in a blender, add the packet of cocoa and then blend with a few cups of ice.Within seconds of sharing this with my husband, we both knew we had been drinking this beverage too fast. Brain freeze! You can drink this much faster than a milkshake. You have been warned. It is tempting and delicious, but may need to be sipped more slowly...or not.Optional toppings include whipped cream and of course chocolate shavings. Sipping this while wearing Opium perfume is a fun experience. It seems to enhance the experience and add new levels to the chocolate perfection. Oh I think I feel a sugar rush coming on...My favorite way to drink this:1. Turn on heating blanket when the weather turns cold.2. Climb into bed wearing something silky.3. Sip away while reading poetry.So delicious!~The Rebecca Review
So overpriced for what it is. The taste is odd and flat...not at all like what good chocolate should taste.

column9: Serenditpity 3 Frrrozen Hot Chocolate Mix Canister
column10: This product was advertised on Oprah as being something to try before you die, which is why I tried it. I was expecting it to be really good, and I was disappointed in it.  Maybe it would be better at the location in New York.  It is very rich and it is good, I just wouldn't describe it as something to try before you die.

This drink is pretty yummy! But I dont think i will spend the Money for it again! Just wanted to find out what the hoopla was about! I think I rather go to starbucks for my Frappachino for the $..and I dont have to makeit myself!

I saw this product on some TV shows and was excited to try it. I ordered 2 canisters and the price was over $30. When I made it, exactly according to the directions, for my family, no one really cared for it. They would've rather had milkshakes. It didn't taste much different than making it with hot chocolate from our local grocery store. It was a disappointment.

I like the taste of this product.  Using different types of milk and how your ice cubes and water are may alter the taste just slightly.  Topping your drink with whipped cream is a great pair.  I thought the price of this one canister was a bit costly, especialy when you add in taxes and the cost of shipment.  It is a great drink for a special occasion.  It may also be healthier for you than a chocolate milk shake.  There is a recipie for this on [...] from Serendipity that sells this product for the budget friendly consumer.  Taste will vary though.  Serendipity adds their own mixture of hand grounded chocolates.  If you go to their restaraunt, you may yet get a better tasting experience.  I will order this a few other times, but will mainly rely on the recipie on [...].  Oprah votes this as one of her favorite things to eat and drink.

column9: Do not order form Cosmetic Solutions!
column10: While the product is fantastic i do not recommend ordering from Cosmetic Solutions.  The product i received did not match the product description. They made it sound like it was sooooo good on oprah.  It was adverage at best
Sorry, I can't tell the difference from other chocolates and the frozen one taste just like cold pudding.  But maybe that's what everyone likes, not me.

Obviously Not in stock and this COMPANY doesnt care about sales.  No attempt to send it to me.  I will Find it elsewhere I guess. This was for the cannister.
I found them to be alittle on the hard side. but I loved the cranberries

I found this stuff while going to Estes Park last summer. Unlike other energy drinks that hop you up and crash on you sooner rather than later, this one lasts long without the jittery feeling and doesn't give you that huge crash an hour or so later. It made the drive back from Colorado much easier. The only problem that I have with it is that it is limited to where it is sold. But be warned...this stuff is potent so don't drink it in mass quantity like other drinks.
If you need to stay awake this will do it. I can't drink one every day but when I do drink one I am wide awake and alert. Maybe also a little jumpy. Doesn't seem to have a crash at the end.

column9: Best I have had so far!!! THIS IS THE ONE!!!! GET IT NOW!!!
column10: BE CAREFUL WITH THIS ONE!!!! I bought this at seven eleven in the shot first. The shot is great. Then I tried this, and this is great BUT FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS!!!!! I just drank one now and have no Idea what to do with myself. I am WIRED!!!! I drank the whole can, and should not have. My heart is skipping beats, for real. That is not good but I may have heart problems and will be getting checked. I followed the instructions on the shot yesterday and drank half at about Noon (Which I should have on the can today) and and about 5 hours later while I was still WIRED I drank the other half and It lasted until about 4 am...No joke. I did not have any heart effects doing it that way. This is my new energy drink unless one better comes out. I drink mine on an empty stomach to get the full effect and get it fast. If you do this, I can almost guarantee it will work! It is not as expensive as others, it is not easy to find on the internet neither! I will be stocking up on this, and I mean stocking up. I will be comparing the price on the net to seven elevens (Which ebay is asking $130 for a case of shots, and I can get the same amount at seven eleven for $95) and buy a case or two of the cans or the shots. This stuff is no joke, and I would compare the effects to the old 1990's Yellow Jacket Ephedra pills without the bad "Come Down". SPIKE, I got to hand it to you! YOU ARE #1. Man I am on CLOUD 9. I almost want the effects to stop, but then again I don't. Half can would be advised, and the other a few hours later. This seems to be better than the shot, but I don't know yet how long this will last yet. Will  try and update.UPDATE: 12/29/2009: I bought 4 more cans today and two shots at seven eleven, and my wife had one today along with myself. I noticed my results were fair but not extreme, but I drank only half a can. My fife got the Lime I think and said it was like drinking kitchen cleaner and it had no effects with her. She was up all night the night before, so she was beat, but she said she got nothing. You at least have to drink it on an empty stomach, and try and stick with original. The shots seem to be better. It kind of seems like you certain cans are more potent than others. They may have been made at different companies, there for the mixes may be slightly off. My dad works for a company that makes Arizona Tea and sometime their batches get mixed up and they are made in the same building. It is just if quality control got to it in time before it went to stores. I have a few more, so I will keep you posted. I still say it is worth a try! At least 3 cans on 3 different days to see if maybe the first can may not have had less ingredients that what is supposed to be in it normally.

After about 20 minutes there's decent wake-up call.  By the time 30 minutes rolls around the jitters start.  An hour in and you feel a bit scared at how tense and jittery you are.  It was nothing off-the-wall like having to run in circles or not being able to string a sentence together.  Sure, this drink gives a lot of "energy", but what good is it if you're too busy shaking to put it to use?  That's why I give it 3 stars...it's too much.  The drink has a really nasty aftertaste that takes about 5 minutes to kick in.  While drinking though it's sickly sweet and average drinkability.  I felt the effects for about 12 hours or so.  It was more "awakeness" boosting and there was no noticeable increase in concentration.  The energy levels became tolerable around the 6 hour mark, which means it'd probably be better just to drink a Monster or other ordinary energy drink.Overall, only drink this if you're either dog tired and just need to be awake but not mentally present or if you have an extremely high energy drink tolerance.  This one just feels like they wanted to make a product that you can brag about "surviving" rather than one that actually helps you stay functional after an exhausting work week.

OH MY GOD!!! This is THE energy drink!!! Amazing stuff. This gives you the kick you need.No other energy drink tastes so good and has that energy kick.It lasts for about 8-12 hours.The cherry taste is amazing (better than Red Bull, Monster, Rockstar ect), didn't drink one, that is so good, yet.But read the warning labels at the beginning!Your hands will shake, they will feel cold and warm. But it is a good feeling in my opinion.Your heart will also beat like a boss, hehehe.My favourite energy drink.Buy, buy, buy!

Energy drinks like Red Bull and Monster only keep me from sleeping.  They don't provide me with any "energy".I have been nearly asleep with my eyes fluttering and struggling to stay open, and within 10 minutes of drinking this I feel wide awake.  I strongly recommend following the directions of half a can at a time to test tolerance.  They can make you edgy, nervous, shaky etc without proper adjustment.Zero sugar, zero calories.  Lots of B Vitamins ( 33,333%DV ).  Be sure to hydrate properly if consuming these frequently or before exercise.

My husband purchased these drinks because he works a night shift. He was not to pleased with them. Didn't think they worked any better then the other drinks that are out there. He will not purchase them again.

column9: A lot like a British digestive..
column10: These crackers are quite good, as other have noted they are thicker and have a more crumbly texture than the traditional Carr's crackers. If you have ever had a British digestive cracker, these are quite similar. Both slightly sweet, thick, whole grains, crumbly.When I bought these I was expecting the traditional thing flaky Carr's cracker. If you plan to serve these at a party, make sure to consider what you are serving them with. You may have to adjust the cheese/spreads/etc that you plan to accompany the cracker given its different taste, texture and structure.

column9: It's a Cookie...No It's a Cracker.....Who cares they're Great!
column10: These crackers are quite delicious but really very sweet for a cracker. They're more like a whole wheat cookie than a cracker. They are thick for a cracker and have the consistency of shortbread. Here's a recipe for the greatest peanut butter sandwich cookie ever made:Two Carrs Whole wheat crackers......one teaspoon peanut butter.  Go NUTS!
So full of WHOLE wheat that it leaves a few hulls in your teeth after eating.  A little sweetness in the cracker makes it fine for sweet as well as savory toppings.  Even good eaten plain as a snack.

Really can't say enough about how much I love these.  Came across them sort of by accident many years ago.  They are really different and probably not what folks expect when they first try them.  I love to eat them by themselves, but they are even better with a good creamy stilton.  Also, realy good with nutella. YUM!

column9: One of my favorite new finds
column10: I tried this with a cream-cheese appetizer I made recently and was really pleased. They are a little bit thicker than most snack crackers but the taste is not heavy at all. They remained firm even though the dish had a sauce and the crackers were partially in the sauce.Very nice taste, heaty but not heavy, without getting in the way of what was on it. And whole wheat as well. Recommended.

column9: It's a cracker, a biscuit and a cookie all in one
column10: I recently purchase a mixed pack of Carr's crackers on sale. The whole wheat was the one that disappeared first. It's slighty sweet yet has a salty taste, too. The texture is biscuit-like with whole grain goodness. This is a cracker that is all purpose and would be a good cookie substitute. I also think that children would like them.

column9: An Absolute Delight - Even the Kids Love Them...
column10: My wife recently purchased some of these Carrs Whole Wheat Crackers at the store.  I enjoyed them so much I added them to my Amazon wish list for Christmas and received a case of them.  I was very surprised at how well they were received by my children.  It is a pleasant thing indeed when you can have something that is healthy and enjoyable for the whole family to eat. The only problem I have now is that the children enjoy them so much, there aren't many left for me when I arrive home at night.
I happen to like these crackers very much. But, of course, food is a matter of taste. <har! har!> Your mileage may vary. Carrs Whole Wheat Crackers, 7-Ounce Units (Pack of 12)

marvelously tangy wheat taste ,slightly sweet and more of a cookie than a cracker,i am wondering where have they been hiding this treat(or have they).They are clearly the best thing of the Carrs family.Low in sodium and saturated fat ,3gr of sugar(not bad since most lesser cookies have more than 10g,) all palm  oil and no harmful oils of the fractionated kind, these are simply the best and the exp date was nov 08.They won't last out the month.(12 boxes subscribe & save.)

These crackers are good with so many things - hard or soft cheese, peanut butter etc. and they are great alone. More of a buscuit really than other crackers. They are not greasy and they don't have that whole wheat - whole cardboard feel either.
These crackers are slightly sweet and are my absolute favorite.  They're hard to find in our area so this case price can't be beat!

As a diabetic I'm always on the lookout for a healthy snack.  These are by far the best wheat crackers I've ever tasted!  More like a cookie, actually, and quite satisfying to my sweet tooth with only 5 grams carbs per cracker. I have one for a bedtime snack topped with a little peanut butter or cream cheese, or just by themselves any time!
This is a great snack cracker. Has  a cookie texture rather than a cracker bite. Four with hummas is lunch for me. Should be available all the time if you are vegitarian or vegan.

I received my package in the mail opened up the box and started eating the crackers. I said to myself "wow these crackers taste pretty good" then I looked at the box. 3 Grams of Sugar in just 2 crackers?Why bother with a whole grain cracker if it's got that much sugar in it?I know most people don't care (so I won't bad mouth them too much) but I've got to keep my sugar intake down. That's the only reason why I gave them a 3 instead of a 5.

So far from Amazon for smoothie mixes, I have purchased this, the Zola acai product, and Big Train Fruit Tea Smoothie Blast Wild Berry.  The Zola was my favorite product, I order it multiple times, but alas it is discontinued by them now.  Big Train is not bad.  This one ... it has a different consistency and taste than the other two, more like a sweet, thin syrup, than any kind of actual fruit product, compared to the other two.  Kind of like the difference between fruit punch and "nectar" for juices.  This makes a sweeter, but less "real fruity & not artificial tasting" smoothie.  That may appeal to some, but it doesn't to me, so my rating reflect my personal opinion.  But conversely I have upped the review by adding one star to reflect that this mix was cheaper (per volume) than the other mixes I've tried, so my expectations should maybe be lower.

This is the best smoothie I have ever had. Its funny I dont really like smoothies at all, but i tried this at a book store once and I can't stop going and buying them now. I totally recommend this item.

column9: Best Pau D'Arco for Healing Tea
column10: After much research on the healing properties of Pau D'Arco (Lapacho or Taheebo) I finally found one that is from Argentina, which is considered to be the most effective Lapacho Tea out there.  I am trusting that this brand is true to its claim that it is Argentinian Lapacho. I highly recommend this to keep in your "natural medicine cabinet."
Good price, product works as advertised and is better than most postal scales.  Can weigh my food as well up to 55 lbs.  LOL
This tea is just soooo yummy! I don't know what i would do with out it!  I could not find it any where so i came on here and there it was.  Thanks!

I LOVE COCONUT AND MANGO, AND THIS TEA IS GREAT. I GAVE MY FRIENDS SOME TO TRY AND THEY ALSO THOUGHT IT WAS GREAT. I MAKE SUN TEA WITH IT AND WILL SOON BE ORDERING SOME MORE FOR MYSELF AND MY FRIENDS. TRY IT, AND SEE WHAT I MEAN.

Enjoyed making those cookies with my two girls - 3 and 7 yo. They enjoyed cracking egg and mixing it. Then watching it to shape up and get ready. Easy to make, fast to prepare and really tasty. Also makes a good project for kids when they have friends over.

column9: Really great cookie from a mix.
column10: This mix is super easy and only requires 1 egg and one stick of butter. The box says that it makes 3 dozen, but these would be small cookies. It actually makes 2 dozen normal size cookies.I made this mix by the box instructions and then added a bit of ginger and nutmeg, half cup of quick cook oats, quarter cup of unsweetened applesauce and a quarter cup sour cream. This helped cut down on the sweetness of the cookie (as I feel most mixes are too sweet). Adding these ingredients produced a soft, chewy, somewhat cake like cookie.These cookies were not quite up to the same standard as some of the wonderful bakeries in NY, but definitely good enough for gift giving or a household gathering (far better than some of the mixes that cove in a pouch with a red spoon logo).
They taste fine, but they are hard.  I bought them for a tiramisu recipe, which requires the soft type.  So beware.

column9: For me, these are PERFECT for Tiramisu!!
column10: In contrast to the other review I saw for these Lady Fingers, I found them to be ideal for Tiramisu. My recipe calls for the Lady Fingers to be dipped into an espresso/Marsala mixture. If the Lady Fingers are too spongy, they soak up tons of the liquid, and have no real texture in the final product (not to mention overwhelming it with the coffee/liquor flavor).Crisper Lady Finger are ideal, and make it much easier to control how much liquid is absorbed. I'll be buying these again!

I use a packet every week mixed in 16 oz  nonfat sour cream (nothing else added) and take it to work with baby carrots and other cut up veggies.  Low cal snacking!  Great to munch on while playing Ghost Recon on X-Box Live! (KILLAH MOM)

received product promptly on time and in good order. i need a bunch of sour cream to put this order in order.a bag of dorito's are in additional order. watching tv with a bag of chips and plenty of dip is a good thing.

column9: Tastes great, but has toxic MSG in it!
column10: Had to quit buying this once I discovered it contained MSG (Monosodium Glutamate). So sad. Loved this dip, why do they have to make it so bad for you?

column9: The only healthy cinnamon to have.
column10: Recieved quickly. The one pound bag is huge....came in compressed air tight foil bag. Just recently read about how this was the medicinal one to use, "The amazing healing properties of Manoka honey and cinnamon".[...]<This is where infor came from. I've had miraculous results with the manuka honey, hope adding this cinnamon adds to it. I got the Manuka honey from Amazon 20%... 15% works just as well from Whole Foods or Amazon. I bought capsules a while back...read the back label & they were the cheaper Cassia cinnamon. You don't want Chinese or Saigon or Cassia...only use Ceylon. One bag of these cinnamon sticks could be shared with a few friends...such a large quantity. I like to grind fresh, or you can get the powdered.

The cinnamon sticks were received quickly and were of high quality. The flavor and smell are both great. Note that this is 'true cinnamon' and not the less expensive cassia, which is more commonly available. The quills of true cinnamon are like tightly-rolled parchment and crumble easily, unlike the much harder cassia.

This product was not what we though it was going to be. the Cinnamon Sticks were going to be used for chewing on as a means of releaving stress. This is a coping skill used in Reh. The inside of the Cinnamon sticks just crumbeled once place into you mouth. We didnt know there was a differnce in Cinnamon Sticks. We now know to watch out.

Totally disappointed in buying this product from Amazon. It was OLD, STALE and completely TASTELESS.  It turned out it was a few days from it's expiration date. Please note my complaint has nothing to do with Folger's Hazelnut Decaf coffee, which I drink regularly: what I find disappointing is that Amazon would dare to sell a product in such deplorable condition. Even my tiny local grocery store would have removed it from their shelves months ago... if they carried it.From this experience I've decided to stick to buying only books from Amazon.

column4: Robert D. Cochell "bucks in the truck"
column10: Decaf has come a long way from the days of "Sanka".  The taste is identical to caffinated coffee.  I am intolerant to caffeine as is my wife and this coffee tastes great; it has the correct amount of "Hazelnut" flavor without being overpowering.  We serve it to friends and relatives, they think it is Starbuck's at $[...]+/pound.  I bought all this vendor had, keeping the unused in the freezer it will remain fresh for over a year.

Great tasting coffee. Hard to find decaf hazelnut coffee, found this at Amazon, taste great, at a reasonable price. Tried more expenive decaf hazelnut coffee and was disappointed with the taste, didn't even taste like hazelnut, this is a full bodied hazelnut coffee

column9: It's like decaf sex in a can!
column10: 3 words delicious, delicious, delicious! No funky bitter after taste you get with some decaf coffees. Plus on here it is almost $2 cheaper a can than at my local Shoprite.

This is not only our favorite coffee, but the price you can get it for CANNOT be beat! Not only that, but you can arrange to have it automatically deliveres every 1..2..3 months, or whatever time frame you want. OR... just buy it once, and savor every sip! :-)

By buying this case of Hazelnut Decaffe coffee here, we were able to save about about four dollar per container (shipped free), plus our Walmart does not carry this particular flavor. It was a win-win for us....
Good price. Perfect taste and smell.I will come back for more.I have both decaf and regular. Regular in the morning and afternoon. Decaf at night. Sometimes I think I am in haven...
We tried to purchase this product at all of the local stores but could not find it. We then tried amazon.com and were able to purchase 6 cans. We're so glad to have found it!

This was a great deal.  In my area I found that it was difficult to find decaf in the flavors such as hazelnut.  So, not only was it a great deal, but it was also an item that I could not get in grocery stores in my area.  Would truly recommend this product.

I've been looking for a way to fuel my coffee addiction without affecting my ability to fall asleep. This gets the job done. It's the cheapest on Amazon per ounce of its kind. But really, that doesn't matter as much as how it tastes, and it tastes delicious!

My dogs absolutely love feeding time!!! This is the only food that I have found that has been healthy and has helped them maintain their weight. Being an Amazon.com Prime member, I don't have to waste money on gas to go to the specialty dog food store to get the product.

column9: So good, my dogs eat it twice.
column10: My mini dachshunds were quite a bit out of their weight range.  Some of the more expensive brands gave them tummy troubles.  This stuff has been easy on the stomach, they still have a lot of energy, and they are maintaining their weight.  They don't walk around acting like they are hungry all the time either... except, as mentioned before, they like the food so much that they always eat it twice.

my mini doxie was already used to this when I adopted him and I saw no reason to change.  Having purchased same at local feed store, schlepped it home and dragged it into the garage, I located the same food on Amazon CHEAPER with no tax and no shipping :)  Now all I have to do is pull it through the front door into the food cupboard and we are in business.  Why on earth go anywhere else????
This is the second time I order this product.  My dog loves it.....since she is a heavy dog (english bulldog).  This food keeps her on a healthy diet.  Love it.

I just received my 30-lb. bag of Lite Lamb and Rice Formula and can't believe that "powdered cellulose" is one of the top ingredients of this so-called "natural" dry food.  This food is supposed to be formulated for dogs, not termites.  I'm now stuck with a worthless (in my opinion) bag of food and the bill for it.  This was my first experience buying Diamond food.  It will be my last.  I'm sticking with Wellness and the other truly natural brands.  Shame on you, Diamond.

Rainbow Coconut Bar 24 Bars This candy was HORRIBLE!!!! I bought this thinking it would be like some I bought at Walgreens recently and boy was I surprised! The ones I got at Walgreens were so soft and chewy, lightly coated with sugar and just delicious. These things I got from here were such a disappointment. Hard as bricks, coated with hard, dry sugar and actually tasted like sawdust. I took two bites and that was all I could stand. When the box came, there was a cold pack inside a plastic bag with the candy. Maybe to add moisture in the hopes it would soften them up? I don't know what I'm going to do with the other 23 I have left. Anybody got any ideas on how to soften them up? Maybe I'll feed them to the squirrels. One thing I will say on the positive side, my order got here in record time! Two days! Wow, if the candy had only been as good as the service.

column9: Gourmet Health Food for Your Furry Family Member
column10: This product is one of the best we could find for our AKC Standard Schnauzer.  Stella and Chewy's has a great line of freeze-dried raw food for both cats and dogs that provide balanced meals in flavors pets finding appealing and tasty.  DogFood Advisor rates Stella and Chewy products 5 star.  Our now 8month old came home at 11 weeks and as she grew became a very picky eater.  We tried everything - checking first, of course, for independent ratings on nutrition and wholesomeness.  She is almost fully grown now, and a trim but athletic 40 lbs.  She gets a steady diet of Darford dry kibble (also rates 5 stars in independent review) mixed about half and half with any of the Stella and Chewy patties broken into pieces.  Duck-duck-goose-goose is by far her favorite choice, but she also gets surf and turf (salmon and beef), beef, lamb and chicken rotated in for variety.We're confident that we've got her on a healthy - if gourmet - diet that will sustain her weight, energy and coat for a long time to come.Five stars for Stella and Chewy's delicious, nutritious, freeze-dried raw foods.  This vendor has very competitive pricing with no tax or shipping fees for the 16oz 6-pack.  It's the lowest price per ounce.Thank you Gulf Coast Pet Supplies and Amazon Market!

My first impression of this roast was that it was bitter.  But the aftertaste was so compelling, it drew me to drink more.  And more.  And after about half a cup, I realized that the bitterness that I was tasting was nothing more than the flavor of fresh hazelnuts.I received a free sample of this by ordering through a third party website, and my reaction is that it is just so fresh.  I'm ordinarily not a fan of vanilla or hazelnut, so I made sure that this was one of the first I tried to get it out of the way.  But there is a high likelihood that I might order more.  I norally don't like my coffee bitter, but this bitterness was absolutely delicious.  And as I noted, the aftertaste left my mouth feeling almost refreshed.  And speaking of refreshed, I just can't get over how fresh this tasted.  I didn't think that flavor from a pod could be this good.After drinking a pod of a different flavor, I found that the bitterness wasn't from the hazelnut.  It is the coffee itself.  So while the aroma and aftertaste are quite good, I had to dock a star for the bitterness.

I have been trying to find a replacement for my Senseo Hazelnut Vanilla pods, since they are no longer available. The flavor of the Reunion Island pods is good, but the coffee itself is a little too weak. I will keep looking.
when your brewing this coffee,it fills your kitchen up with the fantastic smell of vanilla hazelnut and coffee. So lovely and yummy!!
This is the only hazelnut coffee that combines vanilla that I have found.  Great with just one splenda dot for sweetener.  Brew and enjoy!

I've been buying these "bones" for my two small/medium size pups for a while now and they go banana's for them! Neither has ever had a problem with them and I like that they last a little longer than regular dog treats. I had been trying to find a natural alternative to greenies. With these, I break a medium bone in half each get's one half and it last's them about 15 minutes, pretty decent for a natural chew bone. They are pricey, but I think worth it!

My friend Denna adopted her Sheltie from us at Sheltie Rescue of Utah.  I was over her house the other day. I had brought some of Z-Chews to share with her boy, Duke.  She immediately told me that Duke doesn't like any chewies and she's tried a whole bunch.  He just leaves them laying around.  I said...well...I've got them here, it's a premium product with outstanding ingredients, so let's just see what happens when we offer him one.  You know the end of this story...Duke at first sniffed suspiciously but then ate the Zuke's Z-Chew.  Denna stood there like she was in shock.  So, we found a chewie treat that Duke likes and it's really good for him too.  Yeah!  I'm really sorry that someone else's dog threw up the pieces.  If that happened soon after eating the Z-chew then there was no time for anything to get digested.  Everybody's stomach is different...human or canine.

column9: These are being taken off the market
column10: My little Lhasa loved these, but she threw up big balls of starch.  Apparently, this is such a common problem, Zuke's is soon taking this line off the market and releasing a new replacement product in the next few months.  Small dogs don't have the digestive track needed to process these.  They will be switching from the existing potato formula to a more digestible Tapioca line.I need to hand it to Zuke's though. I told them about the product, and they rushed to send me samples and refund my money.

column9: My buddy loved it until he threw it all back up...
column10: my havanese absolutely loved this, but he spent the night throwing it back up. if you have an excited chewer who shallows chunks of it whole, this may not be a good treat for them.
about halfway through the bag, my dog tired of this flavor, unlike Greenies, which she has never lost interest in.

column9: My dog threw up seven times after eating this.
column10: Wish I'd read the bad reviews before feeding this to my poor pup. She is a 4-year old, 25-lb. mutt and threw up a grand total of seven (7!) times after consuming one of these. Needless to say, we are not happy with the product. Will try to contact the company...I'm disappointed that I was able to buy these even after another reviewer said they'd be off the market a few months from OVER A YEAR AGO.
I have 3 dogs and one of them on a strict diet allergy wise? so he loves this treats and has no reaction to it!
My dog, Comet loves these treats, and dances on his hind legs when they come out. Reorder ahead of time as you just can't buy these in any pet store.

column9: My Dog Loves Zukes Cranberry Bones!
column10: Full disclosure: I haven't chewed on these bones myself--this review is based on what I perceive is my dog's opinion. ;-)Zukes cranberry bones are my dog's favorite bones, paws down. She seems like the other flavors, but the cranberry ones are the ones that literally make her drool as I had them to her. I love that they take quite a bit of time for her to chew (a couple hours), they don't stain the carpet and that they make her breath fresh and her teeth clean. She's a 45-50 pound Australian Shepherd and the small size is perfect for her. I've bought the medium for her in the past, which she loves, but it's really probably too many empty calories for her size, so I switched to the small. column9: My dog loves Zuke's Z-Ridge Bones.

When he gets dry dog biscuits he will hide them, then go back later and eat them.  He does the same with these.  I don't know if that means he really loves them, or if he just feels kind of "meh" about them. That right there makes me want to stick with the Greenies.I do think they work for breath freshness though.  Every once and awhile I'll give him one of these if he's getting a case of halitosis.  The only problem is that he keeps hiding it for half a day before he'll eat it.  I also use these if the little guy keeps bugging me. However, if your dog is swallowing chunks without chewing properly, they'll vomit anything.  All in all, my dogs go nuts for these, in all flavors, and my neighbor's picky pitbull loves them too!

column9: Please amazon, NEVER STOP SELLING WHEAT GLUTEN! Wheat meat rocks!
column10: I am soooo glad they have amazon in the age of gluten free mania. People who dont even have celiac disease are avoiding gluten and making this awesome meat substitute ingredient scarce! It is healthier for my body and the environment- and thanks to amazon I can make wheat meat! yay! PLEASE dont stop selling this! These boxes are just right, they are an affordable starter pack for making your own wheat meat. You can add about a cup of water and your own seasonings per package and you knead it into a very very dense ball.It is great when it is really dense. You can twist it and make it into more of an oval. Boil for approx 2 hours, cool. Once it sets you can get an idea of what you are working with, it is a lot like many other meat substitutes. So cool. (UPDATE: I tried adding TVP, dont do it! Hah ha... Herbs are one thing, but your TVP will fall out, its a mess. Unless you want it to -which it is actually kinda cool because it makes the wheat meat hold sauces easilly... If that is what you want, little holes from falen TVP -go right ahead. Its a cooking tactic I suppose!)----I am so excited! Try adding marinades in the place of water. However much you use it should be dense (very) yet still pliable. After a test run on the first box you will be able to see how you would like your own texture. It does take about 1.5 to 2 hours to cook, so batch cooking is a must. After it is completely cooked you can refrigerate and it seems even better after it has been cold. It browns very fast after it has been refrigerated. Re-cooking in various forms is so fun! Stir frys, anything. Buying more gluten, may end up with this brand again because it is so afforadable.

If you make bread at home, you've noticed that some loaves don't hold their shape very well.  Vital Wheat Gluten solves that problem. This product does not alter the flavor of the bread in any way.  I make bread every day, and am much happier with my results wince I've begun using gluten powder in it.

Suggest to use a bit more gluten to the flour when you make the dough. The ratio I use is: 1/2 cup of gluten per 3-cup of all-purpose or whole-wheat flour. An increasement of 1/8 cup of water to the dry ingredients is recommended.

I'm a big fan of oatmeal; Quaker oatmeal, in fact. I like most of their stuff, and have never had any bad experiences with any of it.When I saw the Oatmeal to Go bars, I thought that they looked like a quick, easy, and healthy snack.....which they may be, if you can get past the horrible taste and texture. I've since been trying to give these things away to my co-workers, but everyone takes one bite, and then gies me a funny look and then a "no thanks".

column4: Carlos De La Fuente "Carlos de la Fuente"
column10: I love the napkin even for drying my hand because im paralyzed on my left side  its soft  & not rough on skin but please no more reviews. I have to many emails. Thank you and may God bless you

sublime. a more perfect oatmeal cookie, i cannot imagine. utterly delicious. and wheat-free! i'm a fan for life!  (p.s. it's important to know that these are soft and chewy, and i love my oatmeal cookies like that... if you want hard and crunchy, look elsewhere)

column9: Best oatmeal cookies I've ever eaten!
column10: I love WOW cookies and feel they are better than their 'wheat' counterparts by far. I have really never been a fan of oatmeal cookies until I tried these...all I can say is they are better than any I have ever made or eaten and that includes my mom's which are really good. One of the reasons I've never really liked oatmeal cookies is because most have raisins in them, which I do not like, but these have soft cranberries instead. The taste and texture is fantastic and you would NEVER know they were not made with wheat flour. Another soft and delicious cookie from WOW! Gotta love the name which stands for With Out Wheat.
Some of the best oatmeal cookies I've ever tasted.Great service.Sammy Rusk

I got these for my sister, who is Gluten Free. She really liked the cookies, said she had eaten them all before she made it on the drive home. I personally liked the Ginger Cookies better from WOW Baking but these were good too
Other than sticking together, these are the best gluten free cookies I've ever had! Trust me, I've tried most of them.

I love these cookies.  They are soft and chewy and so yummy.  You would never know they did not have wheat or gluten. I have to hide them from my husband if I want any.  I would have rated it 5 stars but with shipping it came to $15.99 for the one box of cookies.  That is an expensive treat.  I'll think twice before ordering again because of the shipping fee.

column9: A MUST BUY FOR EVERY PARENT!
column10: I love this new line of pastas from Barilla! Veggie puree mixed into the pasta in kid friendly shapes? This is a dream come true for parents of picky eaters. My 7 year old has autism and food sensory issues, so getting him to eat veggies is very challenging for us. I saw this pasta in the grocery store and figured "What the heck. If my boys didn't like it, it would be good for pasta salad for me and my husband." Well we tried it and both my boys loved it! My 7 year old actually asked for seconds, which NEVER happens! It is a great way to sneak in a few extra veggies into a child's diet! I will definitely be making this my pasta of choice!

Very disappointing. It initially seemed like a good and healthier alternative to rawhide. I am extremely unhappy that this item is made in China!  I NEVER give my pets anything made in China.  There is much information out there about pets becoming ill and dying from products made in China.

Our dog Callie loves these bones and she's VERY picky about flavours(only chicken). It's nice to give her something to "chew" on for awhile. They last a long time and are not smelly or greasy.  The price is reasonable and come in quantity options.

I ordered what I thought was five "4" packs of Smartbones medium size. What arrived was five "single" packs of the Smartbones medium size. The price for a four pack was a little more than half the local store price for the same items.... But for a single bone it works out to more than double the cost. I don't know if the problem is with the web/computer system or if the packer simply grabbed the wrong items. As I couldn't find a way to contact Amazon my only choice was to return the items. I'm afraid to reorder as I can't be certain the same mistake will not reoccur. Too bad as the price would be good and my dog loves the product.

I got these for my chihuahuas and all three of them love them! They seem to be easier to chew than rawhide, and I'm not as afraid of them choking! I wish they had more flavors- but I'm sure they will in time!

column9: Love that they are not Rawhide
column10: this product is great my dogs are so sensitive to eating of rawhide but these are great no choking or getting sick
Bought a small SmartBones chicken dog chew for our mini dachshund this afternoon from the pet store and just discovered that this product is made in China!!  NO THANKS!
My bishon/shitzu puppy loves these. They don't last as long as a rawhide more like a treat. The mini size are perfect for her!
Love this product and so do dogs! It is a big hit with all breeds and owners alike. Try it out!

My pup loves it!! The minute I open my amazon package he smelled the bones! He instantly sat and waited patiently for me to open the pack of Smartbones.I am so glad I finally found a better alternative to rawhide. I feel more ease at heart leaving the house with this treat in his paws.The only reason I am giving it four stars it's because my pup was able to finish quite quickly. Otherwise I am very happy with this product and it actually smells yummy. The smell reminds me of sweet milk.
SmartBones, Mini (Chicken flavor) is a great alternative to rawhide bones. I recommend this product for all dogs. My dog JJ loves this treat!

I recently moved to a region where it is hard to find a lot of items to which I had become accustomed in the mid-Atlantic.  San Marzano tomatoes are nowhere to be found.  I ordered these because they were attractively priced and seemed authentic.  They did not disappoint.  They are equally good in pasta sauce as they are on pizza. The cans are small, which is also a plus since sometimes I've found I cannot use all of the tomatoes in the much larger cans.  Do not overanalyze this purchase-- if you are looking for flavorful, low acid tomatoes that don't taste like tin, buy these.

column9: Good flavor but not as plump
column10: These cherry tomatoes have a nice flavor although they sort of "deflate" if you cook them for more than a minute.Even out of the can, if you pop one in your mouth, it feels hollow. Hard to describe. I added these tomatoes to a pasta primavera I made the other night and had to remove them from the heat after just a minute because half of them had already started to collapse.I shared this order with a friend so now I'm left with 11 cans and I think I'll use most of them in pizzas or to make quick sauces. And if that works out then I'll keep the Subscribe and Save on this item, otherwise I'll have to cancel.I can't recommend this product because, in my opinion, the tomatoes should be firmer and not collapse like these do.Also, these cherry tomatoes are not peeled.Prompt delivery, but six of the cans arrived dented.

great product. tasty and very saucy. unfortunately, this product is not always available and I can buy this product only on line because I can't find in the store!! The shipment is expensive but I don't care because these tomato cans are great!!

I have purchased Mangia Carmelina brand before and I am very happy with them. Great taste and work great in soups and stews.This latest version of canned cherry tomatoes is wonderful.Same juicy tomatoey flavour but with a nice twist. Use in tomato sauces or stews when you want the tomato but not all broken up.I would not use this is your finished item will be pureed, you will lose the red jewels that make this so nice.

This is an excellent, excellent product and an exceptional value! Comparable small, canned tomatoes available on strore shelves here in New England are vastly more expensive and not near as good. Tender, sweet-the perfect addition to your own tomato sauce..great with pasta.

I began using this tea years ago and used it for my husband, who is diabetic, when he had pneumonia.  What it did was nothing short of a miracle in clearing up his congestion.  I try to always keep it on hand in the house.

column9: Tasty Energizing Tea without the Caffeine!
column10: I bought this tea based on a recommendation an online nutritionist who said it was an excellent tea to promote optimal health and longevity. I have been suffering from adrenal gland fatigue and therefore am not supposed to drink caffeinated beverages. I've substituted this tea for my morning chai and it makes me feel great. It contains gynostemma (http://www.gynostemma.org/) an herb that contains more healthy saponins than any other available. This tea is consumed throughout China and is believed to be responsible, in part, for the longevity of those who drink it. While I can't speak to that, I certainly can say that I feel good when I drink it. And I sleep very soundly even if I drink it in the afternoon. The taste is quite nice, naturally sweet, so you don't need to add any sweetener, which is nice.

This tea is the first cup I have in the morning.  Follow the directions with almost boiling water and a 5 minute steep.  I have not been successful using a bag more than once, however. A little stevia intensifies the flavor.  I always order an extra box so I never run out, a problem since I am often giving some to friends.

column9: Good tea from a good company!
column10: I really do enjoy this tea. It is very relaxing and stress relieving and does not take too long to take effect. It really is a very calming tea...although it can also be stimulating, it is dual directional...gives a small mood boost as well... The taste is both sweet and bitter because of the goji extract...The taste is somewhat flat, but pleasant.

I love this tea which was recommended by my acupuncturist.  Its medicinal properties are as explained in the description on amazon.  This seller is awesome and I will definitely keep ordering as long as the price stays steady.  I have one to three cups a day.  Especially nice right before I go to bed.
I really wanted to love this tea, but every time I gear up to try it again I can't choke it down.  To me the tea has a weird chemical taste that I can't ignore!

column9: The best of all the Combos
column10: We are big fans of the Combos, so when I saw the Pepperoni Pizza ones here on Amazon, I had to buy them. They are by far the favorite within our household. Combos in general are an excellent option for those who are tired of chips or crackers-they are packed with flavor, and don't give your fingers the "Cheetos" residue, plus you can eat them without wearing chip/cracker crumbs within the process.Unfortunately, it cannot be found locally for us, so Amazon is our only option. (Love Amazon, they just seem to be out of stock on the Pepperoni Pizza ones more often than in stock, in all sizing options.) If they are in stock (or if you can find them locally), you should try them, they are well worth it!!
Best snack in the world love em!! Shipped fast and now I'm stOcked uP for college. By far the pepperoni pizza cracker ones are the tastiest.
This specific Combos bag is very hard to find in my area, so it was definitely worth it to get a box of twelve. They're one of the best snacks I've ever had in my life.
If you use a lot of this product, as my wife does in gravies and soups, this is an economical way to buy. Plus, it is delivered to your doorstep!

It is the Swanson we all know and love. While it is 100% Natural, they aren't claiming free range/antibiotic free chicken. But, it is the Swanson we all know and love. The broth is great for any recipe. I now use it in place of water when cooking rice or other pasta/starch dishes that can use a flavor boost. Buying it on the subscribe and save program makes it an even better deal, you don't have to pay for shipping, and you always have broth on hand - so dinner can be made quickly with a stand-by recipe. I always make sure to have some in my pantry.

column9: Great product, great price, fast delivery.
column10: Title says it all. Very satisfied and I will order more. Very convenient pop-top cans, easy pouring, tastes like home-made.

column9: Tastes great, but it DOES contain MSG
column10: I use chicken broth in many dishes - rice, casseroles, stuffing, soups, noodle dishes - so I like to keep a case of it in my pantry.  We like Swanson chicken broth because it contains natural ingredients, and the flavor is surprisingly rich for being 99% fat free. The cans open easily with a pull top, and the 14 oz. can is the perfect size for many recipes.However, this broth does contain a form of MSG - Autolyzed Yeast Extract.  If you do a little research on the Internet, you'll find that many foods that claim to be MSG-free actually have it hidden within other ingredients.  Go to TruthInLabeling dot org to read the many names for MSG.  I'm giving a product I really like three stars because of this deceptive practice.I ordered this broth using the Subscribe & Save option, which saved me 15% off the purchase price, and included free shipping.  If I find a broth or stock that truly is free of MSG, I will update this review to share the name of it.
I love Swanson Chicken broth.  It is a quality product and I can trust the brand.  I use it in my soups and even to substitute water when I cook rice to give it a little more flavor.

I have tried several brands of potato pancake mixes and none have the outstanding favor as Streit's.  I'm having trouble finding stores that carry this product. ( Wal-mart supercenters, Krogers, Walts, etc.)

Our family LOVES these.  We've tried several brands and this is by far the favorite.  Over the last year, they are getting harder and harder to find.  If you can get them - try them!!!  I'm going to start ordering them by the case!  Both my kids get to pick their dinner on their birthday night and both of them request these potato pancakes every year.  I need to be stocked.
I followed the directions to a T and the consistency was much too thick to fry as a pancake.  I ended up putting in more water and the end result was the most awful latkes I ever had.

If you're a fan of craft rootbeer, like Virgil's, this might be a little too simple for your palate but I like this a lot.  It's sweetened with cane sugar and not over-carbonated; it goes down smooth and, for a drink with so much cream, it's actually refreshing.  Not a fan of their natural cola, but I think they got it right here.
Love good tasting Root Beer. This is too Sweet. Tried to get the grand kids to drink it and even they say its to sweet papa. 46g of sugar.
Great product.  Great Value.  Free shipping. No HIGH FRUCTOSE CORN SYRUP.  Who could ask for anything more?  Oh yes:  TASTE.  It tastes wonderful!

This is a great price for a case of 6. These are the best crackers and they do not have a "low fat" taste at all. This crackers are great for people who want cheese crackers but are watching their weight! 'Luv em!!T.O.

After discovering PG tips on Amazon, I was on the hunt for all my favourite home comforts (not great for the diet, but heh, you only live once and I wouldnt otherwise get them until I head home for a trip).  So for great price and convenience, this is one of my favourite sweet (candy) - combination of chocolate and honeycomb sweetness, light yet mourishly delicious.  I am not kidding.  If you have a sweet tooth, for once in your life - try it and see that I am not kidding.

column9: Great Candy Usually But Not From this Seller
column10: I sure wish this was sold in the USA, but I haven't found it yet.  It's a delicious candy, but unfortunately my candy was discolored and old.  I never heard back about trying to get a refund or exchange, so I guess I'm out of luck.  I did order it during the month of June, but it's typically not that hot in June here, so I thought I was safe to order it then.  I doubt that I'll order from this vendor again since I never heard back from them.  I suppose ordering during Winter would be the way to go, but the climate in CA is never predictable, so it's a difficult thing to predict when it might be safe to order/ship.  From the looks of the discolored chocolate and the partially good and partially bad inner part of the candy, I am not sure what happened ... only that I'm out the money, and I had to throw away a lot of the product.  The low rating is due to the poor condition the candy arrived in (stale insides, discolored chocolate) and due to the poor customer service (or perhaps I should say NO customer service).  Otherwise, IF in good condition, this candy rates a 5.  Buy it somewhere else that will give you support and definitely buy cooler times of the year (as another reviewer wrote).  I was so disheartened by the lack of support that I forgot to write a review.  Sorry if my tardiness caused another buyer to suffer the same fate as I.

Great chocolate flavor with a delicate lightness.  Eating one of these bars is like eating a slightly crunchy honeycomb-like cloud encased in chocolate that melts in your mouth.  The box of 24 bars was carefully packed and arrived in perfect condition.

My British husband introduced me to this candy bar since they're not readily available in the United States, but they are now one of my favorites. When I saw they were available on Amazon, I was so excited and they were really inexpensive. However, when they box arrived, the bars had completely melted since it wasn't delivered until the end of the day on a very hot June day in Texas. They had ice gel packs included in the packaging but that was no match for a hot Texas summer. I think whoever shipped it should have specified that this package could not be left on a delivery truck all day in the sun.
......but a close second and much cheaper.  it seems that the Violet Crumble might have had a floral flavor....this one doesn't, but if you like HONEY COMB, you will like this candy bar

I tried this product for mainly breath freshening and it worked very well. I have a 2 year old lab/pit mix and she loves them and makes her breath instantly better. I tried many other products, but this seemed to work best.

These are great!  I ordered them for my son, who is allergic to wheat, food colorings, dairy, (and a long list of other things) in order to replace regular laces being used at his school for a special snack.  I was only hoping for something passable, but these are really good.  I hesitated though, because the ingredients weren't on the listing.  Amazon, people with allergies need to read the ingredient lists before ordering!(from the package)"Ingredients:organic corn syrup, organic rice flour, organic rice starch, organic concentrated fruit juice: strawberry (3%), apple, elderberry, organic flavour: strawberry.  Store cool and dry.  This product is made with gluten free ingredients and equipment is thoroughly cleaned to avoid cross-contamination."

My 5-year-old daughter is allergic to every artificial food color so it is difficult to find treats that are tasty and dye-free. This licorice has an excellent natural strawberry flavor. The pieces are a smaller size, which is nice for a child's portion. My only negative is that the texture is a little harder than what you've come to expect with your non-organic full-of-dye licorice, but I found myself gladly chewing a little longer for the wonderful flavor. Besides, it's not a bad thing to have to take a little longer to eat a piece of candy! I'm back to try the raspberry next.

I just received my package today and I couldn't wait to try this. These Strawberry laces are the BEST! They remind me of my childhood, before they started adding all the high fructose this and that to products. Best of all, I can actually for the first time in my life eat a piece of licorice and not be sick! I know some gluten free items don't meet up to the expectations and taste of the "regular" stuff. TRY THESE!! They will be on your shopping list all the time and anyone who is on a gluten free diet will LOVE to be sent this treat! Make sure you have enough for yourself as you won't want to be without it.

My 2 1/2 son who is allergic to wheat loves these laces!  They are not as good as regular ones, but pretty good for a wheat-free alternative.  Licorice is one of the few types of candy we ever let our son eat so we were very disappointed to find out it contained wheat ingredients.  Thank goodness for Candy Tree.

The Candy Tree strawberry laces are delicious. They come fresh as though just packaged. Amazon's price using the auto ship is the lowest, yet at the same time these are a pricey treat.  I really like strawberry licorice, and since I'm allergic to wheat there are few options, so thank goodness for this product.  These laces are a healthier alternative made with fruit juices, and they are yummy!  This link is for the full price, but if you look at the product there is also an auto ship price that is lower.Candy Tree Organic Strawberry Laces, 2.6-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)

I can't believe these things have such great reviews! I was hoping these would be good because I had organic jelly beans and they are delicious. However, these tasted like wax/plastic. There was barely any flavor. No thank you.

We recently discovered my daughter has food alergies. Since before Halloween, I've been trolling the internet looking for candy that she can eat. She loves chocolate but it's not enough variety. When I saw these I got very excited because she's wanted to try twizzlers but can't. Fortunately, I tried them first. There is a very faint taste of strawberry-like flavor but what little flavor I was able to crush out of these things was not worth the work my jaws had to put in to get it. Even as I write this, having tossed the package away 20 minutes ago, I have a rather nasty after-taste even Lifebouy might not get out. Nice story on the packaging about how the company came about but the story is far more satisfying than the product. No thank you.

I find these are a great alternative to the licorice laces we are all used to. The taste and texture seemed very similar to me. In fact, I like them better because of the lack of the artificial aftertaste. Would definitely buy again.
This red licorice arrived all individuality packed , so it was very fresh , takes a lot of chewing -mild red flavor  . . . not twizzlers.

Hard, tough, pasty aftertaste. Like gnawing on a rubber hose but with a less pleasant flavor. Somewhere in the back of that just woke up in the morning and scraped it off your teeth taste there was a lingering strawberryish flavor. An unripe and turned slightly bad strawberryish flavor with not a hint of sweetness. These were awful. So bad I couldn't swallow the bite I took. It was such a disappointment since I was really excited to get these after Runningrabbit stopped making the good stuff. If I fed these to my kids they would report me to CPS. I want to pull them out of the package and whip the CEO with them as punishment. If I'd never had candy in my life these would still taste terrible! Did I mention they aren't good.? Seriously, if you are looking for something that tastes anything like a red vine or any type of licorice this isn't it.

column9: They swallow them so fast!!  They are in love!
column10: Our cats are "crazy in love" with this treat!  They eat them so fast we are looking to buy larger quantities since some local retailers don't carry that much inventory.  Our male cat practically "swallow" them since we don't hear a crunch.  We have noticed Whiter teeth too!  What can I say, they are in love and it's now been added to the grocery list.

column9: Cats LOVE Them but Buy the Cheaper 6.5oz (7 Pack) at $0.43 oz.
column10: My cats love these Whiskas crunch treats but buying 2 or 3 pouches a week is expensive in local grocery stores AND buying them this way on Amazon. .Instead, buy these on Amazon in the cheaper 6.5oz (7 Pack) at $0.43 oz.  You have to subscribe for a delivery every 2 months but at $0.43 an ounce I am in.If you cats like Friskies Party Mix CHICKEN BEEF SALMON (Grill Mix) buy them in the  6oz pouch x 7 Packs in a "subscribed purchase) at $0.46 an ounce.  Again,you have to subscribe to Amazon for a delivery a month (or every 2 months or you pick delivery time) BUT shipping is free and the $0.42 an oz for these beats even the commissary price.

column9: I never knew I even liked Creme Brulee!
column10: I've had Creme Brulee in restaurants before and always thought it was a take or leave it dessert. Tonight, I had some of the Dean Jacob's Creme Brulee at a friend's house and am now addicted! This is a must have because it saves time and energy for just a few dollars! I would have never known this was from a mix!

My Husband and I are Creme Brulee fanatics anywhere we go thatis our dessert.  So naturally when we received the Dean Jacobs Creme Brulee Kit we started getting all the different mixes to go with.  Well... we made the pumpkin mix one night last fall... and our hearts melted! It was so delicious! Now I'm having trouble finding it anywhere.  My husband and I have raved about this mix all year so now family is requesting that we bring this for dessert for Thanksgiving.  BUt now we can't find it... I'm heartbroken and hoping to find it somewhere soon!  If you get a chance to try this... DO! You won't be sorry I promise!!!!

column9: Don't be afraid of the name!!
column10: With names like Treacle, and Spotted Dick-the sponge pudding industry is usually overlooked when it comes to dessert. These are delicious, and incredibly easy to make.  I always suggest the stove top method.  They come out like individual size cakes that are moist and sweet, and not foreign tasting like they sound.  I am addicted!!!

This is a sweet I order every time I see it on menus in the UK - but the canned version is just not the real deal- the topping is runny rather than gooey and the cake is too loaded with strange chewy bits of fruit- if you want to try it I have a couple of cans (ordered in my enthusiasm of finding it online) that I can sell you cheap...not good

This tastes like a really low quality cake. It's mushy and overly sweet, and contains bits of nasty raisins (which granted I never really like even when good). I'm not really sure whether this is popular, and I don't mean to offend the people that have made this product, but I would not even eat this for free -- unless I was starving. I'm sure other people like this very much, and there's probably a good reason for that, but for me this was just yuck.
If you're on a low-carb diet, this is probably for you. It bakes nicely in a bread machine, but there isn't a lot of rise to it. It tastes great toasted and I like using it for grilled sandwiches.

I am so totally satisfied by Hodgson Mill products & I probably have purchased > 100 loaves at this point.  I used some as a present to my brother with good results, too.Never have I seen "old" smelling mix nor have I ever had a yeast failure.  Their taste & texture is wonderful. Never have I had a "slicing failure" where you can't get a slice to hold together long enough to lay it down. The different types lend themselves well to adding ingredients such as Chopped Nuts or Sesame Seeds or Millet Seed or - - use your own imagination.  Coming in nice units of 6 loaves makes pantry storage easy, and once opened, the carton yields 6 boxes with "Best By" dates easily accessible on each so rotating your shelf stock is almost "goof-proofed".Next time you walk a grocery store, note the prices there! Here again, I think you really can't beat the quality with a really fair price that Hodgson provides.  It seems to me that they have expended great effort to have the best product they can produce & the best shipping available for their customers.Buy with great confidence based on my experiences with them during the last 2-3 years.  I hope this helps decision making.
