I see that there are presently 30 reviews for this Hodgson Mill Barley Bread Mix, so why, you may ask, do we need another?Glad you asked. I ordered this bread for a few reasons:1) To save a few bucks over store bought2) To always have on hand in pantry3) To enjoy the aroma of fresh baked bread in my homeWhen it was time to bake this bread, I proofed the yeast & it bubbled up.  Just what you want to see. I kneaded the dough for the time stated, & covered it as instructed. When I checked it after 1 1/2 hrs., it had not risen at all, yet I had done all the right things. So I punched it down, fitted it flat onto a quarter size sheet pan, sprinkled it w/rosemary, garlic, black pepper & extra virgin olive oil.It turned out a delicious flatbread, but what went wrong?I called Hodgson Mill, turns out my house temp. of 64 degrees is good for the heat bill but not for bread. The rep was great, told me to preheat oven to 200 deg. for 2 min. then turn off oven. Let dough rise in oven.Great bread mix, fast delivery by Amazon, fair price & great customer service. I am sold.Just ordered more. You should too.  Enjoy your bread.
The bread is tasty and easy to make in the bread machine. I like the rye, 9 garin and honey wheat varieties much better though.

Made this bread using Guiness in place of the water (wisk the guiness to take out the carbonation).  Wow!  Great flavor - makes an awesome salami sandwich.  Haven't found a person who hasn't loved it yet.  We've tried multiple Hodson Mill bread mixes (white, honey wheat, 9 grain, caraway rye) & loved them all!
Love to make this bread in our bread machine.  This with soup makes for a good meal when the weather is cold.  Very tasty bread - don't be scared by the Barley in the title.

This is a great tasting Bread Mix, for those who want to eat more healthy. It is easy to prepare, that my 12 year old helps me bake it.Kids eat it ,too! Eat it fresh from the breadmaker or eat it later. I use it also, to compliment my dinners. Definately recommend!

I currently subscribe to the Hodgson caraway Rye which I absolutely love, but thought I would try the barley. I could not wait for it to cool out of the bread maker and tried a slice. It is absolutely delicious, even without butter!! It is hearty, without being heavy. Very flavorful, slightly nutty. Also, for those interested, Hodgson is the ONLY brand certified by a GM agency not to contain ANY GM products. I personally don't want to consume anything with genetically implanted poisonous chemicals.  Well, I love this product and can't wait to try other varieties..

This was our first experience with Barley bread and we rate it above overage.  It does have a distinctive yet acceptable taste. It does not taste like barley! It loses it's soft, freshness within a few days, but meets our desire for a heavier bread, particularly for sopping up graveys or dipping in soup.  We like it and will continue to order it when we're not looking for a boring "sandwich" bread.

I have been using Hodgson's MIll bread mixes in my breadmaker for years.  I like to add various seeds and grains as well.I just figured out how to make thin buns (great for portion control) using these mixes:I use the dough only setting on the breadmaker, which does everything but bake it.Then I punch down the dough, form into kind of a round, then cut into 16 pieces (first in half, then half those pieces, and so on.)Then roll each piece into a flat disc about 4 inches wide, and let them rise again for 30 minutes under a clean dishcloth on the baking sheet.Bake for 10-15 minutes at 350' and you got 'em.I don't grease the sheet because I use a silicone pan liner.  I also roll the dough on the same liner so there is no need for flour.

This bread is substantial in texture, hearty and very tasty.  It has a mild and rather nutty flavor, not a "dark" flavor like whole wheat bread.  It is so good you don't really need butter (though butter does go great with it).  I make it in my Panasonic bread machine, at the 1½ lb, light crust setting, and it always comes out perfect.

column9: Love, love, love this bread mix!
column10: Homemade bread is awesome if you love the taste of fresh bread and want to save money. I own a bread machine which quickly paid for itself, but even making it by hand is well worth it. I was making bread from scratch but for some reason I get better results from bread mixes such as this one. At less than $2 for a loaf, it's very inexpensive, especially with Amazon's subscribe & save deal. I like foods with short ingredients lists, so you know exactly what's going into your food and your body, without a lot of chemicals and preservatives. This bread has a lot of fiber, iron, and vitamin C. It says on the package to use 2 Tbsp. of butter, margarine, or vegetable oil for a 1 1/2 lb. loaf, but instead of that I use 3 Tbsp. of olive oil and it turns out better. I might never buy bread from the store again.

I am the director of nurses at a Long Term Care facility and we cook a loaf of this bread in a bread machine everyday.  It's comforting, home-like aroma fills the place as well as stimulates the appetites of the residents;  many of whom don't care if they eat or not.  We slice it up in small pieces and pass it out.  They love it.  Has a wonderful taste and texture. Almost every loaf turns out perfect.  If you like good, wholesome bread, you will love this brand.  The same goes for the Cheese & Herb bread by the same company. Absolutely Great.  A real "Bread Winner".(:o)
If you like Barley Bread this is a great choice.  Doesn't rise up like a lighter loaf - stays about 1 lb size but it is full of flavor.

When I initially ordered this bread mix, I meant to specify a different mix and didn't realize my mistake until it arrived.  I was disappointed UNTIL I finally made the first loaf...and found the bread to be delicious!  I shared the warm loaf with weekend guests and it drew rave reviews!  So glad I made that "mistake"!
The stores near us are limited on their bread machine bread mixes. Thought we would take a chance on these. Really good bread, really good price.
I like all the Hodgson Mill bread mixes. They are very reliable in producing a good loaf of bread. I use the bread machine to mix them, then bake them in the oven. Good bread at reasonable prices.

Freshly baked bread is one of my favorite things, and Hodgson Mill makes it so easy -- and inexpensive -- to have on a regular basis.  Barley bread sounded odd to me, but I'm so glad I tried it.  It has the rich, satisfying taste you associate with whole grain breads, but is a little lighter than their 9 grain bread mix in both color and taste.Grocery store bread is expensive, and cannot begin to compare with the taste and nutritional value of Hodgson Mill breads, so not only am I enjoying myself, I am saving money.  How often does that happen?

Again, Hodgson Mills.  Never disappoints.  Next time, I'm baking it in oven just to see if it's as good as when I used the bread maker.  This is a pure product so, I'm sure I will be happy with the result.

never having barley bread before I thought I'd give it a try since it got great reviews. the reviews were right this is very good bread I love it. my first loaf didn't rise very well, but that was my fault I didn't have the water at the right temp so the yeast didn't do its job. my second loaf turned out great, it had a nice crust not hard it had a nice color and it had a very nice texture, not heavy like some breads and had a great flavor. I will definitely be buying this bread mix again.

I have always used Hodgson Mill Barley Bread Mix since I got my bread machine years ago.  My local stores stopped stocking the Barley bread mix so I turned to the internet for my product.  Completely satisfied with any of the Hodgson Mill products that I use.

This mix, like all of Hodgson Mills Bread Mixes is so easy to make and it is really great for sandwiches  because it is moist. It has wonderful flavor and is so easy to do in the bread machine for a healthy and tasty bread.

column9: Makes a perfect loaf of barley bread
column10: I got a new bread machine and this was the first bread I made in it.  I used the dough cycle, rolled the dough into three long logs, breaded the dough, put it on a cookie sheet and baked it in the oven.  It was so delicious!  I can't believe how easy it was to use this bread mix. The steps on the box work perfectly.
I love dark, dense bread - and this fits the bill for me.  It's certainlybetter than the squishy, tasteless bread from the grocery.

We make fresh bread in an automatic bread machine at least once weekly and these mixes are very good. I purchased several different mixes. Not every one is my favorite, but that is to be expected. The supplied yeast is fresh and active. The price on amazon was much lower then even the manufacturers own website store...so combined with the supersaver shipping it was a nice deal. Highly recommended.

column9: Loved it! The best bread mix I have tried so far!
column10: This was the best bread mix for bread machines! Love the flavor and the texture...it was exactly what I was looking for!
I have been using Hodgson mixes with my new Zo bread maker. They all come out perfect and are very tasty.
Have used this brand and barley bread mix many times and always enjoy it particularly toasted.  Recently gave my sister a box to try.

This is my first experience with Hodgson bread mix, and I am totally satisfied with the product.  Some reviews stated problems with the yeast packets being outdated, but that was not my experience.  The yeast performed as it should.  The bread makes a dense loaf and is very good.  I will order again.

I've been baking the barley bread mix for a couple years now & never get tired of it. It stays fresh for 4-5 days in my bread wrapper & tastes especially good with a slathering of Nutella spread on it! I prefer to mix it in my stand mixer & then bake in the oven where I can make several loaves at once.
Hodgson Mill Barley Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Units (Pack of 6)works really well my bread maker and would definitely recommended .

This is some of the best bread, I have had.  Barley was new, to me, and I find myself using it for sandwiches, a whole lot.Highly, recommend.  Just remember to refrigerate the mix, if it will not be quickly used.

column9: "Barley" new bread type for me - glad I tried it!
column10: I was a bit leery as don't think I've ever had "barley" bread before.  But was very pleased with how it turned out.  I used bread machine on dough cycle and then transferred in to loaf pan for final rising before baking in oven.  Turned out yummy, with a softer kind of crust.  Worked great for sandwiches, but also toasted up nicely.  I'll buy it again.

I alternate between Barley, Whole Wheat and Rye. Sometimes I do the European cheese variation. I use a bread machine with a timer so I wake up to fresh bread almost every day. These bread mixes are great and the price is right!
This bread is wonderful.  Always makes up exactly as it says it's going to and the taste is divine.  I've used it for hamburger buns and pizza crust also and it's great.
I enjoy the smell of fresh bread baking and using this mix in my bread machine gives me that plus a delicious loaf of nutritious bread.

column9: Love it!  Love the taste, easy to make in bread maker
column10: Love it!  Love the taste, easy to make in bread maker!  Will be a favorite of mine from now on.

column9: easy, reliable bread - not sure if there's any barley in it, tho.
column10: howdy y'all,i've made this twice now and it's come out well - and tasty. i was expecting it to be more like what one gets when addng barley to soup ... earthier, i guess. i can't tell if there is any barley in it, tho. it DOES taste different from the other breads i've made, just not what i think of as "barley". still, it's a nice bit of variety.made it with vegetable oil and olive oil. the 2nd is slightly tastier.rated a THREE cuz there's nothing that stands out for or against.take care,lee

column9: Bread baked perfectly with barley mix
column10: Like other hodgson bread mix. I tried this one in zojirushi bread machine and it came out perfectly baked like a regular bread shape. ( not in the shape that is displayed on the packet,). Agree with the distinct flavor and hoping it is healthy as stated.

column9: Great tasting bread, and easy to make.
column10: I don't cook much, but I have a breadmaker and this stuff makes super-great tasting bread quickly and easily and the cost is low.  Highly recommend the stuff.
Like it,but it was not impressive in any way,will stick with the 9 grain bread we also use from the same company.
This is the good stuff, far better than the sprays. My cats are all over this and it is a nice sized bag so it is lasting quite awhile. Make your kitties happy. It is one of the joys in life.

column9: The best catnip in the world!!!!
column10: If you want happy cats buy this catnip.  I tried so many other brands from my local pet store and this is by far the one they run to.  I only have to bring out the bag and all three of my cats come running.  The cost of shipping might be a bit high for this small bag; but buy it anyway.  I sprinkle it on the scratching post and my cats trim their nails and get a treat at the same time. So if your want your cats to achieve Nirvana give them this all organic fresh catnip.
II have been trying to find somegood catnip for my furgirlsbut this catnip did nothing!I will try something elsa!
The chocolate was on the stale side...dry and some were discolored a little.  Thew them out.

I am what you could say a coffee drinker. I have been drinking coffee since I was 15 years of age, when I had my moms permission to drink it at the time. I am 53 now. We are a family of coffee drinkers. I have been going to Panera's  about a year now. I have come to love their dark roast coffee. I too was a Starbucks fan and drank a lot of their coffee. I then tasted Seattle's best and preferred drinking their coffee for years. But now I prefer the Panera's dark roast coffee over both. It has a more full flavor and smooth at the same time. It does not make me feel that I have to much caffeine in me . But some people like the caffeine hyper feeling. Do not get me wrong. I still drink Starbucks coffee, but I do it for the convenience. Everywhere I go there is a Starbucks around. If their was a Panera near by I would choose Panera though. Just my humble opinion.

I use this product very often, as I try to eat mostly vegetarian. This is great to use as the liquid for cooking rice, pasta and all kinds of vegetable soups. So convenient to order a case and have it delivered to my home.

Same thing as above - my grocery store stopped carrying vegetable broth so I looked online. I use vegetable broth A LOT, so this is a really good value. I have ordered a few times and will continue to do so. BUT, usually more than half of the cans are dented. The broth is still good, though ...

wow, my local grocery stores discontinued this product and the only thing I coud get was beef and chicken broth.  I decided to look this up online and amazon came up as a carrier.  I am very pleased with my order and shipping was free,  It was only pennies more than what I had previously paid at the store.  cool deal thanks amazon and thanks swanson.

I use this product in place of city water when cooking almost anything that requires water. It enhances the taste and is definitely healthier.I recently cancelled this product because of the excessive sodium in product, and because the latest shippment had 90% of the cans damaged.

I just spent 60 minutes cutting, chopping, sauteeing etc to make giant pot of butternut squash soup, not to mention the time spent meal planning for the week and shopping. I decided to read the label for the swanson organic vegetable broth AFTER I poured it in to my soup pot.  I was curious what vegetables were used to make the broth, but never in a million years would I have expected to see wheat listed as an ingredient in vegetable broth.  I can't eat gluten. I am very disappointed that I did all this work and can't eat it my soup ;-(

My pet chihuahua was starting to get a lot more finicky with her dry food. I had given her mostly Wellness chicken flavor but there were times where she just didn't want to eat. I gave royal canin a try and the first time she lapped it all up right away. She has continued to eat all her morsels every meal since. When I mentioned the type of food I was giving her to our vet the vet was very pleased and said it's a healthy food. I couldn't be more pleased with this food.

column9: My dog loves it and is very healthy!
column10: My chihuahua will eat just about anything, but this food does a great job keeping him healthy.  He is energetic, has a beautiful coat, and loves the food.  Unlike other dog foods that smell disgusting and are greasy, which seems to cause dogs to be smelly and greasy, this food is dry and and actually smells appetizing - not that I would eat it!  It's just that my dog's coat is always pleasant to pet, and he really doesn't get stinky!  Love this food for my chihuahua!

We had hoped that by purchasing this dog food our finicky chihuahua would dive right in and eat it, but she only does with coaxing and then it isn't but a few bits at a time.  The ingredients are top-notch but our dog isn't that interested in it, darn!

column9: The best food for your dog
column10: I have been feeding my Chihuahua this absolutely royal food for 9 years new.  If you look at the ingredient list you'll know this is ABSOLUTELY THE BEST FOOD you can give your dog.  Costs more, but is worth every penny.  My vet said he's feeding his dog Royal Canin!

Our Chihuahua was raised on Royal Canin Medi Cal as a puppy but after switching to the adolescent, her coat started drying out and she was scratching a lot more.  I thought it might be the food so switched over to the breed specific Royal Canin Chihuahua and it made a huge difference!  She would barely touch the adolescent food but she loves the RCC28.  After only going through one 2lb bag, her coat is already back and the itching has stopped.  Well worth it.  The other option to try was the Hills Science Diet for small dogs (a lot cheaper) but I know RCC28 works so will stick with it.  The only annoying thing is that it's made in Canada, I'm Canadian but buying it is cheaper in the USA.  Go figure.

I grew up eating meat and switched to vegetarian about 10 years ago.  My cravings for a nice smoked sausage still remains.  I found these Primal Spirit Meatless Sticks on Amazon and took my chances.  Usually a vegetarian product trying to imitate meat falls far short when it comes to texture.  These have the texture of a Slim Jim and have a nice spice to them.  Since ordering them, I have also ordered several other of the Primal Spirit products.  These are, by far, my favorites.  They scratch that itch for us one-time meat eaters.

I adoped a (now 6) year old who used to eat a lot of meat and jerky. I have gotten him to try a variety of faux jerky,  and this is the only one he'll eat. He really loves them. (I'm not a jerky fan, so I can't review them myself.)

I eat at least one of these each day, sometimes for breakfast, sometimes for lunch. Imagine taking all of the best parts of one of those slim-jim type snacks, but then removing the grease, the gristle, the animal products, the chemicals and the aftertaste. You would be left with these.I prefer these smoked sticks to the Pepperoni, they have a nicer taste to me, but both are excellent. The size, 1.5 ounce is perfect as well, not too big, not too small.

column9: Not quite what I hoped for.
column10: I have bought and enjoyed the other Primal products, so I thought that I would give these a whirl. Overall flavor is not bad, I just find these dry and kind of blah. They do not have the intense flavor of the Primal jerkies. I suppose the other thought is that perhaps different lots or batches of these products are better than others, who knows what the quality control in Taiwan is comprised of? These items are very difficult to open without a knife or scissors, so don't plan on opening away from home. Overall they seem a bit too dry, they actually break apart as you try to remove them from the package. Pros: Another Veggie option for us. Cons: Hard to open, only okay flavor and a bit on the dry side.

These Primal Spirit Meatless Sticks are vegetarian and delicious.  They have a sweet pepperoni favor (I haven't tried the smoked favor yet).  They are almost a foot long and ½ inch across.  Contrary to what some reviewers are saying, the sticks I got are moist and soft, not dry and chalky.  Perhaps I was just lucky.  They taste and have a texture just like their meat counterparts.  That proves vegetarians can eat well and show compassion to hapless animals at the same time.

I love the primal strips jerky, and when I saw these I thought even if they didn't taste anything like pepperoni they would still be good.  I was wrong.  The flavor profile is off, the texture so dry you need glasses and glasses of water just to eat half of one strip. I even tried eatig one after the gym and then it was only palatable, not good.  Since we bought a box, we're going to save the rest for hikes and back-packing. But I wouldn't advise gettig unless u like the texture of tree bark.

These are awful. I'm a big fan of other Primal Spirit products, but these are almost impossible to swallow they're so chalky and dry.  We'll use these for dog treats, as my pooch seems to think they're yummy...

The ONLY con is that the individual packets are difficult to open.I can't comprehend the criticism on price as these are nearly a FOOTlong and quite filling. I have not eaten meat in decades...yet I thinkthey have done a reasonable job in taste as well.  Maybe I am not as pickyas other consumers...yet I find little here not to like.  I willbe getting these again.  I have PRIME (a great investment I believe)so no shipping cost is involved and the large pack breaks down to$1.45 each. I also received my order in two days!I intend to try the smoked flavor as well.Bon appetit.

I really liked this product; it was a tad spicy and had fantastic texture (although it is a bit dry). However, it certainly is NOT worth any of the prices asked. Unfortunately, due to this product being a specialty, it makes it difficult to obtain through other means. Overall, great product, disappointing pricing for what you get.

I am a pescatarian, so, I was hoping that these would be good. Unfortunately, they taste like cardboard. Do not buy the smoked jerky (that is what I got). I now wished I had ordered the pepperoni flavor.

These would be great if it weren't for the awful taste and texture. :PThe texture lacks any sort of stringy interior or snappy exterior that would make these similar to a Slim Jim. Instead, the texture just has this kind of grainy, mushy-yet-firm thing going on. I could forgive that with no problems if it weren't for the downright awful taste. The closest thing I can think of to compare it to would be cardboard with lots of black pepper in it. I'd rather eat plain tofu than these sticks. I don't know how Primal Spirit managed to mess these up so bad when their other stuff is so good. I highly recommend getting Primal Spirit Meatless Jerky instead of Primal Spirit Meatless Flavor Sticks. They are two completely different products.

This is amazing. I have been a vegetarian for 6 years and the cravings were unberrible. I tried a few but these are what reminded me the most and to me tasted exactly like I remember a slim jim tasted. I ate the two I bought to taste and now eneded up buy the whole 24 pack. I liked the regular smoked flavor more than the pepperonnie. AWESOME a must have for vegetarian who liked slim jim or jerky

column9: Good texture, a bit on the sweet side
column10: This is a reasonable meat substitute, good texture and overall tasty, but a bit on the sweet side if you're looking for something really like pepperoni.

I ran across this item yesterday at University Herbs in Philly and gave it a try...it was great!  it is so nice to have a meatless diet and be able to enjoy a variety of items...much has changed since I started this journey.

I received a few of Primal Foods products at Christmas, and I couldn't believe how good these are. I've had meat eaters try them and got rave reviews. They're actually better than the real meat sticks, these aren't greasy. I bought 1 box of 24 already, back to buy more!

These are absolutely awful. I like Stonewall's Jerkee, and Tofurky Jerky, and even normal Primal Sticks aren't bad... so I thought these would be right up my alley. They taste terrible and have an awful texture. It's like eating spiced crumbly rubber -- I couldn't get a whole one down but even if I could, I wouldn't feel safe eating it because it feels like it would take forever to be digested. I'm embarrassed that my desire for vegan jerky was so gluttonous that I spent so much on things that ended up so terrible!

I bought these based on the good reviews of others and was disappointed.  They are way over seasoned which I find the case with many veg sausage or jerky products.  The texture was not bad though they break easily.  Since I used to eat meat (about eight years or so ago) I know what a meat stick would normally taste like.  This is not it.  It may be the slight sweet taste throwing it off, I'm not sure.  Now I have another 23 sticks left to figure it out I guess.

to make them really good.. add some extras.. cherry tomatos...mushrooms...  start another skewer and you will really get something special out of the starter ka bob.  you can add just about anything. slices of apples and pears.  they thaw out on the counter in about 2 or 3 hours. great over uncle bens 90 second rice packets.
This salt is so unbelieveably amazing. Who would have thought there could be such a difference in SALT. I'm hooked on this stuff.

Same as the lemon peel. It's very powdery. Not much of fragrant smell and taste. It looks old like sitting in a full sun and color faded away like years on the cabinet. I rather pay more to buy spices at Penzey Spices for the quality. You pay for the quality and expensive shipping. Takes too long for the delivery. I can always drive down to Penzey Spice store and get fresh, good quality spice. If too lazy, order online.

I didn't care for chocolate that much, that is until a friend gave me a piece of a ferrara milk chocolate bar.  Now I'm a ferrara chocolate lover.  Amazon has the best price for a box of 12 3.52 oz. bars, I'm very happy!

column9: Once you have tried it you will be done using other sauces.
column10: Simply put, J Wilbur sauces are the BEST around.  "Please note my review on the Spicy Hickory."  If I HAD to make a choice between their two signature sauces I would lean a bit more towards the Spicy Hickory but only because I LOVE a little kick.  If you are not a fan of spice then this product is for you.  I will NEVER use another line of sauces again.  BUY THIS PRODUCT.  The people that you feed will thank you.

I ordered this sauce here at Amazon and was very pleased when it arrived.  There was a nice smoky flavor and just the right amount of sweetness. I used the sauce on ribs and pulled pork.  I would have rated it 5 stars if it were a little less expensive, $7.99 is pretty steep.  Hopefully it will show up on my local grocers shelf soon.

My family gave rave reviews to the Hickory Smoke BBQ sauce. We grilled a few strip steaks and onions, and drizzled it over both. Since I leave for college again in a week, they jealously asked if I was taking the jar with me or not.

This, as well as with the Spicy Hickory sauce, is absolutely the best ever barbecue sauce.  J Wilbur also makes a Bloody Mary Mix that is the hit of the party; plus it is great brushed lightly on meat and fish!
This is the best BBQ sauce i have ever used nothing else comes close. If your looking for something new then try this !

column9: J. Wilbur Hickory Smoke BBQ Sauce
column10: I use BBQ Sauce very sparingly, that said, the little that I apply to my finished BBQ product as a final "glaze" must be outstanding.  In my opinion, this sauce has a great consistency, not too watery where it sticks quite nicely to the meat.  Unfortunately, they added (liquid smoke essence) to the ingredients.  If one is using a wood fired- charcoal smoker/grill, why would anyone want to add more smoke flavoring?  I guess if your take on BBQ is par-cooking the meat ahead of time, and using a Gas Grill as your "Pit", perhaps this product would work fine.  My personal favorite BBQ Sauce of late, is Refus Teagues.  Hope Amazon eventually starts to carry it.

column9: Not A Natural or Organic Item
column10: I was searching for a natural or organic BBQ sauce, and this brand popped up.  I was really disappointed to see that one of the main ingredients was High Fructose Corn Syrup.  I am a 3rd year medical student, and HFCS is something I try to avoid as it really is quite bad for one's health.At any rate, my complaint is largely with the fact that the sauce appeared as organic, when it is absolutely not.  As far as the taste, I thought it was good, but not necessarily $8.00 good.  I would not order it again.
I can't say whether the sauce was good or not, because when I received the jar it was open and had spilled out into the package.
SeaBear Wood Box with Smoked Keta Salmon was excellent. It was given as a gift and the recipient love it!
This is so awesome.  Baked some cake pops and it is very useful to make details on cakes and cup cakes.  Love it!

I make this cake for all the winter holidays.  I bake this in a jelly roll pan.  Roll it up to cool.  Unroll and sprinkle with powdered sugar and then I mix the frosting with a tub of cool whip.  Spread the frosting all over and roll it up.  Top this off a lttle more frosting, caramel and almonds.  Everyone asks for this cake, it has become a favorite at our home or on the road. Not to sweet, has a very fresh and light taste.  10 stars******

column9: My Cats Love It - Highly Recommended
column10: My healthy elderly cats have only eaten Purina Cat Chow for their whole lives and is the only dry food they willingly eat. It is very convenient to have Amazon deliver it to my front porch and the price is competitive with the "Subscribe and Save" option.Highly Recommended!CFH

Cheaper than in my local store, delivered to my door.  It has already saved me that emergency trip to the store when I realize I left something off the weekly grocery list.  You cannot beat the convenience, especially with products you use every day.

I have two cats that just love this cat food they can not get enough of it. Their coats shine and their litter box likes it too! When they go no foul odors. My supermarket sells one 3.5 lb bag for $6.99 plus tax and I have to carry it home. Here with this amazon deal it comes out with tax about four dollars a bag. I love the fact that I won't run out. My cats and I thank you amazon your the purrrrfectsupplier of all the things we love and you come right to our front door!
My daughter's cat loves it! And I love that I can get it shipped to the door and pay a resonable price for it! At my house we are starting to do more and more subcribe and save items
It's normally almost $9.00 per bag for my cat's favorite crunchies, three bags for this? Definately worth the savings when you get the free shipping :)

We have two cats, both neutered males that are totally indoor cats. One is a large black and white longhair we call "The Fuzz." He's six. The other is a medium-sized. solid medium-gray shorthair who resembles a Russian Blue. We call him Boris and he's five. It's difficult to satisfy their needs for food. The Fuzz is somewhat fussy and always seems to be hungry, although he's the proper weight. Boris will eat anything and is a specialist at licking plates clean. He's thin and slinky. However, Boris has a condition wherein he develops urinary tract crystals and has to be fed an expensive prescription cat food to remain healthy. It works, I might add. As such, they have to be fed separately.We've settled in on Purina Cat Chow (Indoor Formula) for The Fuzz. He seems to like it better than any of the others and it's easy to find and it's cheap. His health has been perfect. We're very satisfied with it, as is The Fuzz. Boris is satisfied with his prescription diet. Unfortunately, The Fuzz likes it too and it's five times as expensive as his regular food so we have to keep them separated during the feeding times twice a day. What a pain. It seems ironic that the one who is fussy gets along on the cheap food and the one who will eat anything placed before him needs expensive prescription food. Go figure. Such is life with cats.Gary Peterson
My wife is very satisfied with this product and will order it again. She is from the south and this product is just like home made for her.  It takes her back to her child hood.

Cabbage, peppers, and onions. Those are the proper ingredients and that's all this stuff has.I'm a Chow Chow freak. I've tried them all and except for a few brands made in the state of Tennessee,this is the best I've ever had. A mild tangy flavor, the right crunch, and the perfect amount of sugar givesthis chow a nice sweet finish. Great on beans, blackeyed peas, hot dogs, burgers, fried green tomatoes..use your imagination.Try this on pork chops, northern beans, and smoked sausage. Yeah, that all goes in the same pot.....withthe entire jar of Chow Chow. Amazing!

Let me save you the trouble - this mix has nothing to do with the soda brands printed on its cover. Most beans just taste like liquorice, while the rest taste like a bland version of some citrus fruit.I was really happy with the Sour and Cocktail mixes, so I was looking forward for a similar experience with this Soda Pop mix, but sadly, that was not the case here.If you like bland flavors, and have good imagination, then definitely go for this mix. You will not be disappointed!
Love this product, it tastes great, no caleries, and very easy to make. Only problem is I can find it locally so I will continue to buy it online.

I love the smooth taste of this green tea mix the hint of honey just blows me away! I drink about 2 liters a day but I'm thinking of cutting down on it especially in the evening as it contains 17mg of caffeine per 8oz serving and when you drink as much of it as I do it can affect your sleep!
If your wondering, don't! Best tea out there. You can't go wrong. Not kid sugary sweet, but not flat either, just right!

This is a great tea! Im not a tea person, but this one I drink like water! Very good taste, no calories, 100% vitamin C...perfect for my diet! And is green tea! I bought it at walmart and I paied less than 5 dollars. I will keep buying it for sure!

I've made many waffle recipes from scratch, and I've tried a bunch of mixes. This is the only mix that literally tastes home-made, to the point that I basically don't make homemade waffles anymore. It's totally simple to make (just mix + water + egg + oil). Unfortunately it's hard to find in grocery stores, so it's great to see it on Amazon. Cooking tip: undercook it a little to keep the waffle light & fluffy. When the waffle gets crispy it's not quite as good (but still very good).I have also tried Krusteaz pancake mix, which is easier to find in stores. It isn't as good, and doesn't work well for waffles.

I tried this mix when I bought my  Belgian waffle maker in hopes of creating the taste of the light crisp Belgian waffles that I had eaten when I stayed at a hotel. This mix was easy to make however it seemed a bit thick. The final product had very little flavor and was dry. I would not recommend this product to friends.
This is the best hard mint candy in the world.  Expensive, though.  I can't find it in stores.  Anyone know where I can get it off-line?

I watched The cooking odyssey a few weeks back, which featured a simple dessert with sour cherry preserves and Greek Yogurt. The preserve is really good. It ay be too sweet for some, but I thing the sweetness goes well with the yogurt. I have found my new favorite dessert. And the seller was great - quick shipping and fast delivery...
High quality sour cherries in syrup tastes just the way it does in Greece.  Best on Greek yogurt or with pork chops!

I am delighted to find these cherries can be ordered from Amazon! I have loved them for severalyears and could only find them in two Persian markets in Los Angeles. I've had relativeswho carried them back to New York and San Francisco because they like them so much.Now they can be shipped to their homes. Hurray!I have tried several other brands of cherries and always been disappointed.I eat these in my plain yogurt every single day. They rock!

Like most people, I was a bit reluctant to order a product online which wasn't a brand name with which I was familiar.  But I had seen a few good reviews for these preserves so I took a chance. They pegged the needle on my expectations meter. I'm extremely pleased with the product and the supplier.
I love Vissino, and this product doesn't disappoint that love at all. Happily, the company also ships really quickly, and securely wraps all of the products in the parcel.  100% recommended!

column9: This is not Irish Breakfast Tea
column10: I have been drinking really good Irish Breakfast tea for the past ten years and when my provider was backordered, I decided to give this tea a try since Irish Breakfast has to be Irish Breakfast right? Found out that this is not true with this tea. The tea comes well packaged and is very much a whole leaf tea but when I took a smell I smelled something that suggested it was tea. I immediately became worried and made a cup the next morning and soon discovered how bad the tea was. The tea has the orange color of Irish Breakfast but there is scarcely any aroma or flavor. The tea was very weak and it doesn't get any better by adding more leaves. I liked the idea of a subscription for tea but this one loses my vote.

I have several of the Coffee Bean Direct bulk loose teas. They are all good. The standouts for me are this one- the Irish Breakfast, and the Jasmine. I also have the English Breakfast, which is good, but I slightly prefer this Irish Breakfast tea. It is a great stout, complex tea, with enough kick to make coffee unnecessary.Many people add milk to Irish Breakfast. I prefer it "solo"- no milk and certainly no sugar. If not drastically over-steeped, it remains smooth and full flavored.The quality/price ratio of this tea is outstanding.
I was disapointed in this tea.  I could have made a better cup from the remains in my leaf blower.  My advice is to buy a more expensive brand. You get what you pay for.

If you like your tea stong with a great taste. Irish Breakfast tea is for you. Price is cheap for two pounds of tea. I have bought tea where I paid the same amount for 3 oz. Try it you will like it. Freddyb Mack

column9: This was a 'good' Irish Breakfast Tea
column10: 2 pounds is a lot of tea. I split the package with my daughter.  I make my loose tea in my BonJour Zen Glass Teapot!!!  I like strong tea, and this tea works for me.I'm still experimenting on tea's, so I'm no professional.  I like the taste.  I use light milk and sugar. That's the way my Irish grandmother, Catherine, taught me to drink it.

My shih tzu mix has extremely bad allergies to certain foods, fish, venison, and a prescription food he should be taking that has corn in it.  This food has really worked well after trying so many different combinations, without grains, with grains, on and on.  Even rabbit and buffalo. He's also allergic to mother earth although fish is his worst.  He loves the Duck and Potato Pinnacle food and I add some things to it for his prescription food alternative and it works fine.  He is down to 1/4 pill 2x a day of Temeril-p.  I've tried to take him off of T-p and tried benadryl, claritin, zyrtec, Hydroxizine and another newer pill I can't remember but it costs a fortune and is really supposed to work great, did not work on Joey. The nice thing is that it doesn't cost as much as many other foods we've tried.

I absolutely love this tea. I have tried many other spice tea blends but could not find one I enjoyed. They either had too much clove or were lemon based. This one is perfect. The clove is mild and in perfect balance with the cinnamon and the orange gives it a lovely aroma and a nice sweetness. When I want a little extra spice, I use one of their honey cinnamon straws. It is even good with milk added which you can't really do with lemon blends.

My first taste of Taza chocolate was their chili-flavored candy - don't laugh, it works! That impessed me so much that I had to try more in their product line. This vanilla-infused offering meets the high standard set by my initial Taza experience.With only three ingredients (organic sugar, cacao bean, and vanilla), the flavors come through crisply and well-defined. They open up in layers, starting with the bittersweet darkness of the chocolate itself. The vanilla note follows, pronounced without overwhelming. The finish includes a fruity tartness, possibly with traces of citrus. That last flavor helps remind that chocolate is a flavor from nature, and that natural flavors have complexities that reveal themselves differently to different parts of the palate.It didn't surprise me this time: the sandy texture of the stone-ground cacao bean. Don't looks for Godiva silkiness here - the texture calls to mind the ancient Aztec preparation of this wonderful flavor. If you can learn to like that, Taza could easily become your favorite chocolate.-- wiredweird

I am so glad I got two of these. The product is expensive for chocolate, but the quality is amazing. It tastes soooo good... I'm not sure what else to say! I'm having a difficult time not eating it all in one night. I can taste the bitterness of dark chocolate, but there's definately vanilla in it. And not fake vanilla; you can really tell all of the ingredients are 100% real.Also the seller provided large bubble wrap (I love bubble wrap), and a free tin of caffenated mints. It's a small object, but a huge gesture. I will definately be purchasing this chocolate again, and definately from this seller.

I'm a little reluctant to rate this at three stars although what I salvaged tasted pretty good.  Since the picture of the product here on Amazon, and what I received are two different things, I believe three stars might be fair for misrepresenting it.I expected to receive a box of small individually wrapped disks.  What I got was one large 2.7 oz disk saying it contained two disks.  If there were two disks, they had merged during multiple melt downs.  The product had been melted a number of times (some before they were shipped to me I believe) and had re-solidified since the wrapping was buried deep inside the chocolate.  The outside of one of the wrappings had a white oily substance on it (?).I might suggest not ordering these during hot summer months unless you Overnight it - then you still run a risk.  I Overnighted them although UPS misrouted the package on a Friday and I didn't get it until the following Monday.A UPS miscue may have exacerbated the melt downs although packaging chocolate in a single box wrapped in a "ready to ship" plastic bag may not have been the best during summer months.Amazon refunded the shipping (it was late) and the price of the chocolate since it was, among other things, also firmly attached to that "ready to ship" plastic bag and a disaster.  They have always been good about this kind of thing and I've been using them for items hard to come by locally, since the beginning.Packaging type management could use some training.  There is also the possibility that the product I recieved was stored and handled incorrectly.  It was within it's "use by" date.I think these are good chocolate, although after being beat to mush, I'm not sure.  At least these do not contain a forced GMO Soy product.

column9: My favorite energy drink bar none
column10: This stuff is straight up delicious. It has no syrupy feel or taste like most energy drinks. It tastes largely of lemonade with strong hints of black tea. Perfect start to the day, I usually drink one about an hour into my work shift. Very low calorie but full of taste.As of writing all the Amazon sellers are asking absurd prices. Try to find this at a local convenience store. The main brand of gas station around me sells it 2/$3.50

column9: Great "Half and Half" Tea with a Kick
column10: I never liked energy drinks before tasting Monster Rehab.  When I finally got around to trying Rehab at the suggestion of friends, I was pleasantly surprised.  Unlike the green label "regular" Monster drink, Rehab is very light.  It does not have a syrup-like feeling going down and it only has 20 calories per can compared to about 200 in the regular drink.  The flavor is mostly lemonade with a hint of tea (much like the "Half and Half" teas on the market).  Unlike most drinks sweetened with sucralose there was no chemical aftertaste.  The energy rush from the drink took about 10-20 minutes to set in and lasted about 2.5 hours.  Although most of the people I know use Rehab as a coffee replacer in the mornings (lemonade with the effects of coffee is a great way to start the day), I drink this every weekend so I can stay up late with my family.As much as I like this drink, I wouldn't buy it from Amazon at the price they are listing.  Once a month Rehab goes on sale in grocery stores and you can get a can for $1.50-$1.99 vs. $2.30 being charged by Amazon.  Wait for the sales then stock up.
I'm hoping that the label showing "2 pack" means that there are actually 48 cans for this price.  Otherwise I can do better buying them individually at the corner store.

column9: The only energy drink that tastes good
column10: Most energy drinks I have to choke down.  This is the only one I've ever tasted that actually takes good.  In fact it tastes quite good.The taste is like a weak lemonade.  I personally can't pick up the tea taste, which I don't mind, as I am not crazy about tea.I don't notice any particular energy boost.  But I believe it has about 170 mg of caffeine, so it ought to have not quite the kick of a no-doze pill.Seriously, this I'd actually drink for the taste.
It dosnt get much better than this, it taste just like an arnold palmer. I highly recommend this to everyone.
You can do better buying these drinks at the store. This is a terrible deal. They are 2.39 at gas stations.
Holy Crap!This stuff is so good words can not describe.Just brew up like coffee or mix 50/50 with your coffee.Its best to get a resuable filter for this.

This is absolutely the BEST bread I have ever eaten! It's extremely dense and heavy and has the most wonderful flavor of any bread I've ever had. It makes GREAT toast. You can slice it as thick or thin as you want. I have to watch that I don't eat it all in a couple of days. Keep it in the refrigerator and it will last at least a week. I will definitely be buying this bread again.

The bread was outstanding.  The bread came pre-sliced.  It is authentic hardo bread like you would get from" Yard" or from New York.  My family enjoyed it.  Be mindful of the shipping and handling charge.

Moroccan Pomegranate Red is a nice break from hibiscus rosehip flavored fruit teas.  The bouquet is wonderfully fruity. After steeping you have a ruby brew that tastes great.  The flavor of pomegranate is very authentic without the bitter taste of pomegranate seed.  Rooibos provides a healthful and mild base for the fruit flavor without any sourness or ashiness.  Altogether a satisfying tea.Celestial Seasonings gets extra points for their packaging: they utilize 100% natural recycled paperboard in their boxes and they don't package each tea bag individually. Instead they use a system of a waxed paper bag inside the box that stays shut when you fold it. It keeps the bags fresh and utilizes less packaging than individually wrapping each bag. The art they use on each box is beautiful as are the quotes and information they put on every surface.Quote from the box:"One that would have the fruit must climb the tree." Thomas Fuller
Although the front of the package describes this as "rooibos", this tea contains hibiscus, which completely overwhelms the rooibos.  Ewww.  I really DO NOT like hibiscus teas.

This particular package came with just enough packaging. I hate it when the items are in a huge box with just one little thing in them, but this package was perfect. The tea itself was just what I expected since I have had it before and already knew how it would taste.
not available in the stores where I shop yet, I appreciate you have it as I discovered it in the Celestial Seasonings store in Boulder. Thanks again for your prompt delivery and service!

I started drink this tea a while ago and I have to say, I really love the flavor.  They have other blends I've tried, but this particular one is the best so far for me.  I don't drink a LOT of tea, but I find that when I'm having allergy and sinus problems, a hot cup of this tea really brings me some relief.  I drink other teas for that reason too, but so far this has proven to be my favorite.  There was some minor panic when I ran out 4 weeks ago and had to go to 4 different stores before I was able to find it in stock.I'm glad to see I can get it here on Amazon.com in case I can't locate it locally!

I buy many of the flavors offered by Celestial Seasonings and Moroccan Pomegranate Red is one of my favorites. African Red Tea is also very good for you. I especially like that there is no string and no tag. Saves a lot of paper and the tea bags are not indiviually wrapped which I like because I make pots of tea and with the indiviually wrapped teas I spend way too much time unwrapping each tea bag. Waste of time and a very large waste of paper.
I put 8 teabags in a 2 gallon glass container filled with water and leave in the refridgerator overnight.

Very benificial tea the pomegranate red tea and also very tasty.It is caffiene free so you can enjoy it anytime.Once you've had a cup you'll find yourself going back for another.Also great with REAL LOCAL HONEY.
I use fruit flavored teas to make ice tea and even when I mixed 4 of these bags with 4 regular tea bags, it still seemd too strong/fake tasting/smelling for me.

Amazon has pleasantly broadened my awareness again. Mementa is a premium tea brand with teas from Ceylon (Sri Lanka). My tea experiments usually via a restaurant or snagging something from "interesting" local stores. I saw this, did some research and purchased. These aren't the tripods sachets bags but tagless teabags for the teapot. They're great for the microwave when grabbing a quick cup on-the-go IF you're into that sort of thing (lol).This pleasant English Breakfast tea is a welcome addition to my caffeine collection. At a BUCK per box of 20 bags it is a WINNER!
We use this in homeschooling as an ingredient to make goo and slime. It's an awesome experiment! We can make our goo stretch & bounce back like rubber.

Still waiting on the rum back order but tried both butterscotch and caramel with skim milk/protein powder smoothies. Half a capful is about right, too much will ruin it. Adding an apple banana with the caramel gave the smoothie a bananas foster flavor. Maple is next with frozen blueberries. I have a hunch the pancakes I gave up for lower glycemic choices won't be missed. Using these extracts is an delish tool to increase satisfaction when making healthier food a permanent lifestyle.

column9: Perfect portion control on a favorite snack
column10: These chips are tasty and very fresh and pair perfectly with a whole grain pita sandwich to add crunch to my mid-day meal.  I know that extra packaging is less than desirable because of landfill concerns and I usually never buy single-servings of anything, but I make the exception with these Baked Lays Potato Chips. These are the perfect amount of chips to go along with my sprout-laden lunch so that I am not tempted to dive into a bigger bag.  I find that things like these chips have been key in my new eating habits that have let me lose 30 pounds in 8 months without problems.

I like the subtle taste of Baked Lay's Potato Chips.  They are thinner and easier on the bite.  They are also more fragile that you see more crumbs inside a bag, no wonder they put more air in it as an added cushion.Compared to the original Lay's, the baked chips has 3% fat compared to more 5 times of the original with 16%.  Also, it does not contain trans fat while the original has 6% of guilt on it.  The baked Lay's has tad more sodium though.  Honestly, nothing taste better than actual slices of fried potatoes,  But it is great to have a choice if you are conscious about your health.

column9: So nice to have healthy portion control snacks at home.
column10: These are a great value I got them at a sale price but even this current price is good as these size bags at our local "SUB" shoppes are $1 each.These taste great have only 130 calories, 2 gm of fat and NO trans fat. Even 2 gm protein. They are very salty which I need as I have a condition that requires I eat salt and drink water to keep blood pressure up.They came in good condition and a long outdate. Three months. At one per day that will be no problem. It's great to have a healthy good crunchy snack ready when you are watching what you eat. Nice to grab a bag and leave in the car so you don't get tempted to go thru the drive thru.

Get em on sale...what can I say? For those concerned with calories and fat consumption..these hit the spot. You can always get a bag at your local market if you want to sample first. I give these 2 thumbs up...

I loved baked chips and it's hard to find large quantities of the BBQ flavor so I'm very glad Amazon offers these to purchase on line.  They come fresh with a long time expiration date so you don't have to worry about eating them all really fast!  Great!

Since I have become wheat-free, Baked Lays has been my go-to snack (pretzel withdrawal needs a 12-step program, for sure). Keeping me relegated to a single portion is a huge deal, since I can munch my way through the large bags in two days. These are handy for travel, too. Cannot in all good conscience give 5 stars; who are we kidding? There is no nutrition here...only a lack of seriously high-fat chips (even popcorn can claim fiber) Enjoy it for what it is!

My son loves Baked Lays for his school lunch, and I couldn't find single serve bags anywhere... and I know they have them... so thankfully Amazon to the rescue.  For around .50 cents a bag - I am happy!! Son is happy! They arrived FAST, with a long expiration date and none were crushed or anything!

I like these chips. I am trying to cut back and 130 calories per bag is not bad. Also, the sale price is really good. I normally pay .75 cents per bag at school and I saved .39 cents by buying in bulk.

I have a weakness for crunchy snacks, so chips were forbidden at our house in my efforts to lose weight. These are just the right size - I can satisfy my cravings without blowing a day of calories. I keep the box in a hard-to-get-to spot in my house so they aren't too handy. My family is grateful they can have chips again. The product arrived quickly and in good condition. We live fifty miles from anywhere so the convenience of mail delivery is worth it for us.

I haven't seen these in sale at the local supermarket in a while, while browsing Amazon's warehouse deals I saw these. $[...] for 64 bags not bad at all. I ordered on 1/10/11 and it came two days later, the expiration date for all of them is March 8th. Not too shabby considering these will be consumed by two growing boys lol. I mainly bought them for my brother, since he buys crisps at school anyways and a little bag like this will cost $.75-$1.00 pending whether he buys at school or at a petrol station.The only compliant I have is that the box arrived smashed up a bit on one side, but I just had a bag of crisps from that side and it seems perfectly fine and whole. There also isn't anything that protects the bags of crisps. As soon as you open the box all you'll see is the bags of chips and your Amazon receipt.While I think this is a great deal, you should be aware of the short shelf life, it's a good deal because they need to unload expiring products. So if you live by yourself, your probably better off buying from the supermarkets. If you have a ton of kids, or just really enjoy in indulging in DELICIOUS BBQ CRISPS these are for you!!!If you would like to buy these crisps you MUST click on "See more buying choices". Or else you'll be buying these crisps for $[...].. PLUS $6.95 shipping!!!!

if you like the taste you gonna pick it, especially when it's on sale; come in manufacturer package, easily control your daily serving, i did not figure out it's 60 or 64 packs yet. But sure it's worth it.

Great product. The small individual packages make it easy to take chips to work daily to have with my lunch.  Being able to buy them in a large quantity also makes life easier. Thanks for selling them.

Have been using these chilies for many years, and watching the price go up and up at my local grocery stores. (that is the ones that carried them) Was delighted to see that they were available through Amazon. The Hatch chilies have fit the bill for all my cooking needs: the right taste, right heat, fire roasting, and available for just a couple of clicks...win win in my book. And on top of it all, the best price I could find anywhere.
YUM!  These are so wonderful! I just wish they came in a bigger bag size.  I feel silly buying 10 bags at a time.

These candy beads are just as described/expected. The color is a tad bit off in the picture as they are actually one or two shades ligther than pictured. I used these on some cupcakes and they were very pretty and worked out great. I don't personally like the taste of them, simply because they are hard and... well... just don't taste good. but doesn't mean that you won't like the taste :)

This were so tasty that I couldn't stop eating them! I ended up finishing the bottle before I had a chance to make the cake I was going to decorate with them. The color is a very lovely lavender with a shiny luster, and they are flavored (which is more than I can say for Wilton's pearls which kind of taste nasty). I originally bought this item on sale, but now that I'll be buying more, my only complaint is the price. I wish it were a bit lower.

These are cucumbers marinated in evil! Satan himself couldn't stand these pickles!I just ate three of these. It is true: these are not for the faint of heart. Don't get me wrong, I love jalapeños, but if you think jalapeños are spicey, just move along. These pickles, while not as hot as a straight naga jolokia pepper, are hot in the extreme!

These pickles had barely any heat kick to them at all.  On the list of ingrediants, ghost chile was far down.  Even my 7 year old daughter ate these with no problems.  If you are looking for something spicy, I do not recommend these as they are way far diluted.

column9: Not bad but not quite there
column10: These pickles are spicy but to truly enjoy the ghost cili pepper you need to get burned. Unfortunately these pickles are diluted with the flavors of other chilies (habanero, jalapeño, serrano, etc.) so it's difficult to enjoy the ghost chili's flavor itself. They come sliced and in a thick salsa like sauce. Not a bad flavor but not quite what I was looking for, which would be a more spicy, simple pickled flavor.

column9: Simple the best bacon I have ever had.
column10: We pick up this bacon every time on our way to our cabin in Northern Wisconsin. It is amazing! Get the Lettuce and Tomato ready and have a BLT!
This maybe a little pricey, but its some of the best bacon I have bad. Hands down.I just bought 10 lbs more of it.

I love these potato chips.  I've been eating Season's potato chips for years.  When I buy the unsalted ones, I add a little salt on my own.  They're cooked with peanut oil, which doesn't leave the slight aftertaste that many oils other than this and canola oil do, in my experience. These chips have a great mouth 'feel',light and crisp, not too hard or crunchy.  I highly recommend giving them a try.

What a find.  For those persons who need no (or low at best) salt and low fat food it is hard to find snack foods that actually taste good.  These chips really do!!  I love them and even for those who can eat anything without remorse these chips will still taste good.  Highly recommended.

column9: Michael Season's Ripple chips are a hit with wife!
column10: We first discovered and bought Michael Season's at Fred Meyer because they are reduced fat and salt, and the taste and consistency are great. But FM stocks only Thin and Crispy and my wife wanted a sturdier version to use with dips. After getting product descriptions from the Michael Season's web site we discovered that they also make reduced fat and sodium Ripple chips. Found that Amazon had them in stock, ordered and received them promptly with free shipping. My wife says that she likes the taste as much as the Thin and Crispy and that the Ripple also stand up to using with thick dips.Also we found that Michael Season's are almost entirely whole chips, whether ordered online or bought from a store, unlike Frito-Lay. After I watched a Frito-Lay sales and stock person literally crush each bag of F-L chips apparently so that he could get more bags into the allotted space I could understand why. Michael Season's is a winner for several reasons. And with Amazon, the price per bag is lower than if bought locally.
These are great - very light and crispy, and not greasy. I love the fact that they're unsalted, which is almost impossible to find.

I have tried the unsalted thin and crispy. They are excellent.We have also tried the chesse poofs and cheese curls which are glutten free.For themto be gluten free and taste so good. Our kids love the taste.Espcially now that they are on a special glutten fre diet.... those cheese puffs have become there favorite.Excellent  food choice.

These are the BEST chips ever!  I hate chips that are ruined by mass quantities of salt.  These chips actually taste like...wait for it...POTATO!  The only thing wrong with them is that they are so good I can't stop eating them!  Light, crisp, not greasy, and tasty.  Could it get any better?

column9: These Chips Taste Like The Potato They Came From!
column10: As many have said, it is very difficult to find a chip that isn't loaded with salt and so much grease you need an entire roll of paper towels to clean up with after just a few bites. You can actually taste the potato these chips were cut from and because of the intense potato taste, you don't miss the salt.
Not greasy, not salty, not dry (like baked chips), and the best part..don't have to eat the whole bag to feel satisfied.  I'm sold!

We truly enjoy these chips, and were delighted to find them on sale at Amazon! We experienced a great savings over the healthier, food choices aisle price, of our grocery. They are not greasy, or overly salted, but absolutely delicious! A great, heart healthier option, that still has great potato chip taste! Also holds up fantastic with dips! :)
I tried, and love these chips. My local store carries them at over 4 dollars each.  I save over 15 dollars on every case.  I'm trying the salt free next!

I only knew of one company that made no sodium chips and they stopped making them. Yeah, to see them back and surprisingly, they fill me up better than regular salty chips and keep blood pressure low. Health and taste rarely combine, and for once it has.
I was dissapointed this potato chips, tast ok, not very crunchy and all broked tiny pieces.

These are the best chips ever!  They are unsalted and being on a low sodium diet critical in allowing my husband and I to eat chips.  They are all natural and low fat which is a great extra bonus.  Additionally they have the BEST flavor...you really taste the potato flavor and not the salt!  I would choose these chips over ANY chip on the market today, salted or not!! These chips as well as ANY unsalted chips are very hard to find in the stores so THANK YOU Amazon for selling them.

column9: Amazon Michael Season's Thin & Crispy Unsalted Potato Chips - Sad news
column10: The taste was very good on this product but I bought the 12 pkg plan and the bags each were anywhere from 1/3 to 1/2 crumbs or small pieces you would only use on top of a casserole.  No dipping or presentation wise nothing.However since I need unsalted chips they were worth a try and I need to cancel future orders of this one and stay with the Michael Season's kettle ones which of course were more durable and they too taste the same as the others.Amazon please note to cancel automatic shipping on this product but keep the one for the Kettle chips - thanks

The chips tasted stale and were so broken up from poor packaging that I could only eat a few from each bag. The bags were crammed into a box that was lightweight, and thus, the problem. I will not be ordering them again.

I bought the Ripple lightly salted chips. I find that the chips are very good as other reviewers have said. I like that that they are lightly salted and it is still enough of a salted taste. The chips were not broken (any more than when you get them in a store) or crushed. They are packaged quite well for shipping. This is February and the expiration date on them is 6 months from now (Aug.). 12-8 0z. pkgs. to a box is a lot of chips but for those who don't know it, the chips can be refrigerated for quite a while, even past the expiration date, and still be as fresh and crispy as if just bought. I put extra crackers and cereal in the fridge too with the same results. I have a fridge in the garage so I can do this. I do recommend these chips.

12 Bags, with a six month expiration date; packaged well to avoid your typical delivery process of testing the packaging.Chips are as advertised: thin, crispy, & unsalted, but surprisingly flavorable; difficult to stop eating them. There is a fair share of breakage, & a few over-cooked pieces per bag, but no higher than any other chip-seller I've seen.

Michael Season's Thin & Crispy Unsalted Potato Chip, 8-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)Michael Season's Unsalted Potato Chips are the best in the market. I was buying them at my local grocery store, but for $3.69 a bag, it was very expensive.  Buying these in bulk for a much lower price makes sense especially if you have at least a bag a week.  I've tried a few others and none compare.

Particularly fine product at a competitive price.  Should be carried by major chains for the significant percentage of the population whose doctors recommend reduced sodium intake.  They're losing business when they think there's no market.  I'm sure I am not the only one who has walked past the stores' snack isles for years for lack of an unsalted selection, but I can't buy from an "empty wagon."

I have ordered many boxes of these and have been very happy with them until now.  For some reason the shipment was returned as undeliverable.  Same address as always.  One try at delivering it and they sent it back.  I'll get a refund.  Great.  I want my chips.  Moronic driver?

column9: Concord Roasted Potato Bacon & Chive, 18 Box of 1.25oz
column10: My son gave me a few packages a while back...he lives in NC...I couldn't find them in any store around or close to where I live...I could only find them on Amazon...The taste is unreal....only a TBS of the mix to a TBS of olive oil mix it up add potatos...stir...bake 20 minutes....goes great with just about everything
This is the only Honey Mustard dressing that we like. Taste and low calorie make it the best.  I can't find it in stores so I order it.
I love the Swiss White Chocolate and have been having a really hard time finding it.  I hope Amazon keeps selling it.
I got a box of assorted skittles and starburst.  the picture showed a mixture of starburst, skittles, m&ms, and 3 musketeers.

Frist off i order it took 4days to come and it came with everything that was in the Picture m$m candies, snickers, skittles, starbust, 3 musketeers. all these candy came so im keep ordering more when i can.

column9: For almond maniacs (or mai tais) only
column10: I keep six or seven flavors of these Torani syrups on hand, right next to my beloved Jura-Capresso F9.  I've had to go elsewhere to purchase a "starter" bottle that's made of glass for each flavor, as these bottles on Amazon are plastic and pour spouts (like those in bottles of liquor at bars)fall right out of their necks.  I use these as refills for the glass bottles.  The flavor of this syrup is very strong, so unless you think you might like a cloyingly sweet amaretto in your coffee, you might want to steer clear.  However, if you like mai tais, this is  very good orgeat to use.  It's one of the cleanest flavored ones I have had.

In my experience, all of the Torani syrups (the ones with honest-to-goodness sugar, anyway) are very high quality and have very intense flavors.  While I do occasionally put the orgeat syrup in steamed milk or coffee, I mostly use it to make almond sodas.  A dollop of this, a splash of lemon juice, and seltzer.  Yum!  The lemon cuts the sweetness of the syrup and provides what I think is the perfect balance.Shipping was fast, and the price can't be beat.

column9: Awesome taste for Mauresque and with just water

column9: Quality dog food, but he still can't have it...
column10: For about three months we were feeding this formula and the Senior formula to our 18-year-old Gilligan, mainly because he has a very long list of health issues that we try to sidestep like landmines and I strongly believe the prescription foods sold at the vet office are nothing but crap.  I have researched and studied dog foods for several years now and although I believe Canidae is one of better foods out there, Gilligan began having seizures just weeks after he begun eating it and we now home cook his meals.  Gilligan has not had seizures in his lifetime, so we were baffled when all of a sudden he developed a pattern of having a seizure about 3-4 hours after his meal.  His vet said that the pattern made sense to her, because ammonium levels are highest in the blood about 3-4 hours after eating and if the liver doesn't process the protein efficiently, it can definitely cause seizures in the brain.  The day I stopped feeding him the canned food was the last day he had a seizure, and that was about two months ago.  His vet nor I cannot figure out the connection, but my only guess is that it might have something to do with the quality of the meat they use (better than most other brands but still not what humans might consider consumable.)  I must also mention that during this timeframe, Gilligan developed a sinus infection that ultimately we had to have cultured to figure out what it was, and it turns out it was e-coli and the staphococcus bacteria that was up his nose.  Gilligan doesn't have any eyes so when he eats he gets food all over the place (including up his nose), and he was on antibiotics to clear up the infection.  The antibiotics didn't have any effect at all until we stopped feeding him the food (he was on them for about four weeks while eating the food, and about six weeks on his homemade diet.)  Amazingly, the sinus infection began clearing up exponentially after we stopped the canned diet.  He hasn't had any seizures or sinus issues with his home cooked meals, so we won't be going back to Canidae food in the future.  However, for a dog that doesn't have the amount of health issues that Gil has, I still believe the listed ingredients are acceptable and nutritious.  I am extremely critical and picky about the ingredients that go into our dogs' food and I don't find anything on the Lamb or the Senior formulas that severely throws up a red flag except for maybe psyllium husk, which can be hard on the colon for some dogs with sensitive intestinal issues.

My dog has severe allergies, and I'm always looking for superior dog food to try on her.  I ordered Canidae Lamb and Rice canned formula; she really loves it, and she's quite picky.  It arrived quickly, and I'm very pleased, with both the service and the dog food.
