Used this last night and we had great tasting spaghetti.  Packaging was good and it came in a reasonable time.  Good job.

I was very happy to see that I could order just the blueberry tea like the tin that came with my iced tea maker, it's the first blueberry tea I've tried and I love it. I ordered the 4 pack tins and I will for sure order it again!!

Teenee Beanee Jelly beans are the one and only jelly beans to eat. The flavor selection is the greatest of all the beans available and the best place to buy them seems to be Amazon. None of the stores in my area of NJ have them available.

My husband is a jelly bean fanatic (and not the gourmet kind).  We have had a hard time lately finding regular jelly beans just at the store it seems these gourmet are more popular.We bought a few kinds on amazon, most were ok, but these he just LOVES!  They are so fruity and good.  We finally found a kind he really enjoys and can indulge in :)  I really like the resealable bags too

column9: Teenee Beanee Americana Medley Gourmet Jelly Beans
column10: These are the best jelly beans around. The flavors burst in your mouth, no strange flavors, just fruity tasting deliciousness. Our family loves them!

These are the best jelly beans but they're so hard to find. I'm glad I thought to look here. Only 1 problem. I ordered a case of Americana Medley and one of the packages had another flavor mix (Island Breeze)in the Americana bag. Weird.

I received my case (12 bags) and every bag was as solid as a rock. I opened 2 bags immediately and some of the beans did separate but most did not. I now have sticky feeling beans in with jelly bean clumps. They do taste okay (not great) and certainly not at all what I had hoped after reading two glowing reviews. Next time I'm going for the lifesaver jelly beans, maybe I'll have better luck!
Nuts are good for you so why not this. Its pricey though in comparison. I dont use for cooking where I still like EVO but this is very nice for drizzling on fresh salads.A healthy choice.

I am an Belizean-American and we love all things Marie Sharp's.  The flavor stands alone.  I usually get the value pack of sauces as I can't find them in the local stores. I wanted to specifically comment on the orange pulp because of the citrus ingredient/flavor the sauce is great on seafood.  Hope you enjoy it!

column9: Wonderful both as a sauce and as a powerful marinade
column10: I love hot sauces and have at least 20 open bottles in my fridge at any one time.  Finding a sauce with burn is not difficult.  Finding one with a both a pleasant burn and a tropical flavor is tough.  This orange flavored sauce from Belize accomplishes this with style.Made from yellow habaneros, orange pulp, onions, key lime juice, vinegar, garlic and salt Marie Sharp's Orange hot sauce is a perfect marinade for white meats such as chicken breasts, pork tenderloin, and turkey breasts as well as for seafood such as shrimp and talipia.  I have also used it as a basting sauce but I prefer it as a marinade.  I sometime add some simple syrup which gives it a sweetness and provides a nice caramelization when the meat is grilled.  I wish that it had a little less vinegar but I imagine that it is needed as a preservative.  Other than that I like it very much.

column9: The right amount of hot and flavor
column10: I like it!  The habanero makes it hot, but this sauce is not about straight burn.  The orange pulp and the natural fruitiness of the habanero gives this sauce an excellent flavor.  It is a great accompaniment to home-grilled jerk chicken.

Stash Chamomile Herbal Tea is tea bags with dried, crushed chamomile flowers.Honestly, as far as I'm concerned, chamomile is chamomile.  I suppose that when you use loose flowers you get sediment in the cup and I have seen this happen with some brands of chamomile tea bags, these don't do that.I have also had organic chamomile (this isn't) but I can't taste the difference.Each bag is individually packaged and that is either good or bad depending on how and where you use it and if you are concerned about excessive packaging.If you like chamomile tea, this is a good choice.

Love getting my pet food this way! Our 8 dogs love Pedigree and I love getting it delivered to my door. Per can, it costs a bit more, but when I consider cost of gas, as well as load it into my cart, unload at checkout, load back into the cart, load into car, unload at home...makes me tired just to write about it...home delivery is a fantastic bargain!

My dogs are very picky. This is the first canned dog food, except for expensive Little Caesar, that they'll eat. Still, they hold out for table food as long as they can! My worry is that Pedigree has only 6-7% protein. Recommendation is 27-28%. Notably, the can does not say "nutritionally complete"!
My dog loved this brand and flavor.  However, beware of AMZN's packing/handling because I've received dented cans which broke seal making several of the cans in the package go bad.

Pedigree chicken and rice is good product.  My dogs love it.  I wanted Pedigree Weight Management Chicken and Rice but it was recalled and I don't know when Pedigree will start to release again.  My dogs don't know the difference of Pedigreen Chicken and Rice regular or weight management.  I can also use Pedigree Health Weight Chicken and Rice but it comes from Peto and that costs over $18 in shipping whereas Amazon if over $25 does not charge shipping Love that.

column9: Pedigree Traditional Ground Dinner Chicken & Rice Food for Dogs, 13.2-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
column10: Great food for my older dog and my dog with digestion problems. The chicken and rice is the best I've found. Other wet dog foods that are beef/liver/lamb or anything dark colored or artificially colored upsets their stomachs. My dogs love this!

My dogs like this flavor of Pedigree canned food a lot.  It's a very good deal with Amazon's subscribe and save program.  Much cheaper than Walmart or Kmart.  However sometimes the cans are dented.  I don't know whether this is Amazon, UPS, or the manufacturer.  I've gotten dented cans in 12 or 24 packs in local stores so it could be anyone tossing them around.
Great product, convenient and cost efficient.  Good quality.  Will order this product again.  Fast on delivery. Dogs love it and have no issues with it.

I had previously purchased this Pedigree chicken dog food for my finicky 1-year-old german shepherd and she loved it.  When my shipment arrived from Amazon I immediately opened a can from the end of the plastic-encased 24-pack and presented it to my dog.  She sniffed it and refused it, so I left it out for her. She kept begging for food, but I would each time point out that she had food in her dish.  She finally ate it, reluctantly, the next evening and then was up all night vomiting. The next day we smelled a dead animal odor that we couldn't locate. Sugar (the dog) sniffed it out for us at the top of the cabinet and we discovered that at least one of the Pedigree cans had burst open and was full of squirming white worms and rotting, oozing liquid that permeated the entire package. I felt so guilty for making Sugar eat something that made her sick, and threw away the entire package. Now I'm afraid to buy the brand again.

column4: Warren Cook "I don't need no stink in' badges"
column10: Plan on feeding this outside unless you live in a place that can be hosed out.

I was a bit concerned as the jerky had an odd odor not present in canine caviar products I had bought before, but they looked fine and my dog enjoyed them, so maybe it was just because they had been packed in an airtight package for shipping.  This product is WAY too expensive, but my dog really enjoys it.

This Villa Manodori Artigianale Olive oil was given to me by a dinner guest. I had no idea how special it would be! It has a clean but very nutty flavor. So delicious I could be tempted to just have a taste with nothing else. It made both plain pasta and simple bread taste like  gourmet food. I highly recommend it for uses where you will be able to taste the oil - not so much for generic cooking due to the cost.

When I bought bubble gum cigarettes I wish someone had left a review. I ordered a lot of candy cigarettes which those are just sticks of sugar. These are the ones I remembered buying from the ice cream truck when I was child. I bought these for my nephews birthday as party favors and they were a great success. The kids couldn't believe if you blow in them they blow smoke out the other end. The gum really does taste good too. If you remember these cigarettes I highly recommend them, if you don't remember them you should try them to.
at my office all the smokers get a 10 minute smoking break. I handed out candy cigarettes to all the non-smokers and now we get a break too

column9: Just like I remembered them as a kid!
column10: I used to play with and chew these gum cigarettes as a kid (I grew up in the 80's). These are exactly like the ones we had then. You can blow the powdered sugar (or what we pretended was smoke as kids) out of them a few times, before peeling them and chewing the gum. Glad I could find these and share the tradition with my kid. I told her these were the only "cigarettes" I'd ever approve of...lol

Awesome to get ahold of these novelty cigarettes. They reminded me of getting these for Halloween when I was a little kid. Plenty of packs to share with friends. Perfect for those of us who are nostalgic about candy.
My son loved them. I will be buying him some more. All the neighborhood kids are ordering themselves some too.Thanks again

column9: Great gum! Just like i remember!
column10: One word: Amazing! These gum cigarettes are chewy and delicious not to mention super fun to "smoke" :P I don't get how people say that If you had these when you were a kid you would grow up a smoker. I used to get these all the time from the ice cream truck when i was 7 or 8 years old and my mom would buy me them when I was 3. I grew up "smoking" these all the time and have not smoked a cigarette or any drug for that matter. I think it all depends how you were raised. Almost, everyone in my family has or still smokes, I was raised around smokers and still don't smoke. I don't see why people smoke but that's out of topic lol These gum cigarettes are great fun! They have a "poof" of smoke and come in different flavors as well. The pink gum flavor is a little hard at first but then gets soft after a couple of chews. Definitely, recommended item [:

The world's bubble gum cigarettes were frowned upon, but later enjoyed by my family. They were kind of hard at first, but quickly became softer.The bubble gum however was a little flavorless and had a nasty flavor at the end...

Okay, so they aren't politically correct!  I personally believe you can't go through childhood without a pack of bubble gum cigarettes.  It is a given. These came super fast, were a great price, and exactly as I remembered.  It is hard (as one reviewer mentioned) to find these particular cigarettes.  They puff a bit of smoke one time, and then you chew them.  I bought these for the grandkids, gave a few out to kids I knew on Halloween.  We had a ball!  I grew up in the 50's, and I don't smoke.  I wouldn't let the kids run around school or the mall puffing on these, but they are fun and a good chew as well!  Funny, because none of my kids smoke either, so my grand kids like the gum factor of these more than the cigarette factor. My 6 year old grand daughter didn't even know what they were, LOL.

column9: Excellent back in the day candy that kids love
column10: I gave this old but good candy to some neighborhood kids and they loved it. I am glad it is one of my favorites.

column10: Who doesn't love Brachs Butterscotch hard candy? I grew up on these things. They are the only butterscotch discs I know of that get their flavor from REAL BUTTER, not the artificial flavors and colors found in competitor products. You really can taste the difference!It's sad that these are so difficult to find. I guess nowadays, stores are more interested in how much profit they can make rather than providing a quality, American product. These candies are worthy of being on the top-shelf everywhere candy is sold. Everyone at my home and office loves them.I'm so glad I found them here on Amazon. I plan to buy more in the future. You'd think a bag of candy that is almost 7 lbs would last a while, but at the rate my family and fellow employees are loving them, I may have to order more much sooner than I thought!These are a bit more expensive than other butterscotch discs. But, it is sooo worth getting the REAL deal!Update:20110902 - My boss was heartbroken when he walked into my office to check the candy dish and found I was out of these. I immediately got on and ordered more. Now, it will ship with Prime. It is less expensive and will be here in 2 days! Go Amazon! Oh by the way, these are no longer made in the USA. On this bulk bag, it says, "Product of Argentina." They are still quite delicious but I knocked 1 star off for that.
I can't find these in the stores anylonger and you can tell the difference between Brach's and the other brands. There is no comparison in quality.

I've wanted to buy the Brach's Butterscotch disc's candy for the longest time.  I had a hard time finding them, until I check Amazon.  This is 100% Brach's brand Butterscotch disc.  They are fresh and taste perfect.  I would buy them again.

I love Brachs butterscotch & they are so hard to find so when I found them in my local albertsons I was ecstatic. Well that was short lived because the original Brachs butterscotch that has the yellow wrapper with blue writing no longer exists!! The new version sucks!! The taste is different as well as the texture and I hate them! Ill never understand why companies feel the need to change products that are not broken. I'm very upset bc the original was amazing and anyone who loved them will notice the horrible change in the new version. Bad move Brachs!!

I got addicted to a butterscotch candy at my dollar store and Werther's when I could afford it.  My dollar store ran out and WM ran out of Werther's.  So, I went online and I liked the ingredients and reviews of this candy.  I love it!  It certainly tastes better than the dollar store candy and I prefer it over Werther's.When I received my order, I thought it would last forever, but I now will be placing my second order!  The first sensation, for me, was tasting the real butter.  It is a smooth, great tasting butterscotch candy that lasts a long time, if you just let it melt in your mouth.  In fact, I wouldn't risk a crown trying to bite into it!  If you are a cruncher, wait until it is about half way melted and then take a large drink of ice water.  Then, you can crunch away without dental damage!It is rare to find a product that uses real ingredients.  I haven't tried all of the other butterscotch candies here as I'm afraid of buying something that doesn't taste as good as this one!
I looked all over locally for this but no one seemed to have it. I didn't like the all artificial they had locally. Better ingredients, better candy !! I was not dissapointed when I received it.
I have tried and tried to no avail to find Brach's Butterscotch in Bakersfield.  I am not the only one.  So, I order it here in bulk to keep my graving in check!

column9: THANK YOU! THANK YOU! THANK YOU!!
column10: OMG...I am in heaven! It has been so long since I have had these WONDERFUL treats. I looked but could only find sugar free. I have loved these since I was a little girl and NO other so called butterscotch would do, so I went without until now!!! :-) Thank so much!

These are awesome and delicious.  Excellent price for so many (a really big bag) pieces.  The taste is buttery and not too sweet.  The candy is HARD and  not soft or sticky like some butterscotch pieces that are out there.

Brach's Butterscotch Hard Candy is the Very Best Butterscotch. People have bought me other kinds when they couldn't find the Brach's brand- there is no comparison; Brach's is definitely the Best. I'm having a hard time finding the Brach's Butterscotch hard candy in Central Michigan. Many stores are carrying their store brand of butterscotch which I won't buy. You only have one life and mine is going to have Brach's Butterscotch Hard Candy in it even if I have to go on-line to find it. I Love to put two pieces in my mouth at once  and bounce them back and forth in my mouth- what a flavor rush!

I LOVE these tarts. I'm been eating a mostly raw foods diet for a little over a month and once in a while I want a treat that I don't have to make from scratch. I actually bought one of these tarts before I went raw vegan, I was still eating eggs, meat the typical SAD diet and I thought it was one of the best desserts I've ever had! Even my mom thinks these tarts are delicious!!! I really can't even describe Hail Merry tarts and do them justice other than to say there's gourmet deliciousness in every bite! I hope they come out with other flavors, I don't do caffeine anymore so I can't eat the chocolate tarts anymore (they are outstanding too) so it'd be nice to have another flavor or two to choose from. Maybe a strawberry tart or peach! YUMMY!... LOVE YOU MAKERS OF HAIL MERRY PRODUCTS!!!

column9: Not RAINBOW - does not match photos whatsoever
column10: I ordered this for a rainbow-themed party. When it arrived, it was not rainbow at all but red and hot pink swirl.

This is the most decadent dark chocolate drink you will have. Just pure chocolate, no milky syrupy sweet drinking chocolate this. If you love dark chocolate that is more like the European drinking chocolate - you will love this! Every sip is just heavenly smooth and rich!Just half a cup made up following the instructions on the container will hit the spot on a cold winter day. I used fat free milk and it still was delicious.

I have had other Vitale products but this one is one of their best. I have a preference for Venezuelan chocolate and this really hit the spot.This is not for your casual Hot Chocolate drinker. This stuff is a little expensive but worth every penny. I need to find larger containers!

The gummy bears were delicious and the company packaged them very well.  I had them shipped to a VERY hot location; the company provided cooling packs so that the chocolate didn't melt.  I wish other companies would do the same.
I recently returned from Easter Europe where Elder Flower drinks are very common.  This syrup has nothing to do with Elder Flower.  It is an artificially flavored sugar syrup. Yuck..

column4: Juanita A. Floyd "Life is too short to read b...
column10: This syrup is to die for and an absolute must for making a Garden of England cocktail.  Absolutely divine. I only wish it was Amazon Prime, because the shipping costs as much as the syrup.
I had never used or tasted elderflower syrup before, but Monin made a great product. The syrup is deliciously floral and sweet and great with rhubarb and sparkling wine.

column9: Good but tastes more likes sugar than elderflower
column10: This isn't the light, flowery drink that I think of Elderflower water as. There was another brand in a dark green bottle that was really good but when I went to order this for my wedding reception, that one was not available. It's still good. But not amazing like the other one.
Pretty Good.Low salt and low fat.Flavor is a little weak,add a little pepper to make it just rightThe Health Valley line of soups is pretty impresive, this is no exception
My parents may not have salt and this soup has excellent flavor - you don't miss the salt.

This is a great base soup. I love putting salt-free crushed tomato in it, then put some parmesean cheese on top.  Then sometimes I slice red peppers and put it in the soup. Or add a packet of Equal to make it a little sweeter and some left over vegetables. It's really perfect if you are on a budget since it sells most places for 3.00. You just to have bulk it up and it's a great dinner.

column9: Very bland.  For the price won't buy again
column10: I'm not on a low sodium diet, but learning to eat better so limiting my sodium intake.  I was actually eying this product for awhile before ordering it because I personally love potatoes.  No salt?  Great.  All organic?  Wonderful!  $2 a can?  Kinda pricy.  But wanted a healthy soup to add to my brown rice.After putting it in the microwave for 3 minutes, which is what I always do with soups, it came out looking like mush and tasted like it also. I have 11 more cans to go through though so bought some hot sauce, going to try chili powder and pepper.  As for the looks, I don't mind so much if it fills me up and healthy for me.The lack of flavor and having to find things to add to it makes it not worth the cost for me.  The killer is, out of the 12 pack, a single can wasn't dented.  The packaging was fine so I doubt they were damaged when shipped.  I also ordered the chicken noodle soup from the same brand, but I haven't tried that yet.  Same problem with the denting.Would I recommend?  Nope.  I'll never order again unless the price drops to $1-$1.50 a can.  Even then, anticipate being creative to make it work for you.  I have 11 more cans to go through.  Personally I'll just stick with steamed veggies on my rice instead of this product.

Well I purchased this item to give away at trade shows my company attend. While I was expecting a bucket of 3 different flavors. I received a bucket of the original flavor. As I chatted with a rep from amazon.com, he basically told me that your out of luck.
Says a variety of flavors, which is what I was expecting, instead I got 275 pieces of all regular.  NOT AS STATED!!!

While Bazooka lasts longer than arch-rival Dubble Bubble, the flavor of their assorted bubble gum product is astonishingly awful.  It screams "artificial" with every chomp.  All I can taste with Bazooka is "sweet" and "artificial."  I wish Dubble Bubble lasted longer or that there were another serious bubble gum contender but, in any event, I won't be purchasing this Bazooka product again.

For those who have read the previous reviews let me clarify exactly,my package arrived very quickly. Contained was the assorted fruit gum just as described. Serious good value for the money, a ton of gum. Three different flavors, tropical, strawberry, and original. I'm not sure what all the negative reviews are about, because I got exactly what I ordered and the gum is delicious. People are too funny talking about taste wearing off quickly. Any gum you can buy loses taste a while after you chew it.. Especially if its fruity gum. The gum seems to last a long time to me and my family flavor wise.Regardless, dontt let the others fool you.. I got exactly what was described, very quickly I might add.. And I'm very happy with ny purchase.

I ordered this even though so many folks said it was not assorted.  Mine is.  3 flavors.  My daughter loves it.  I don't like the gum at all...but I am an adult and she is 5 so it makes sense.  I had no problems and am very happy with the purchase.

column9: Too expensive, but my grandchild wanted it.
column10: I would not have spent this much on bubblegum if it had not been for the fact that my grandchild had to have Bazooka.  I guess that how you catch us.

Just recieved my tub today and I recieved the variety pack (strawberry, tropical, original). The seal around the lid was intact, and once you opened up the tub all 275 pieces were in a plastic wrapping in addition to the individual wrapping & comic for each piece.Fully sized pieces and an expiration date of November 19th, '13.

Got this bucket as a Christmas gift, which was wonderful.  Everybody in my family (and company) loved it!Three flavors were original (great), strawberry (kids liked it), and tropical (tasted like it was a mango flavor).

This turned out to be excellent filling for a pinata.  It was just as I remember it as a kid- individually wrapped, generic bubble-gummy flavors, loses flavor fairly fast, but blow very good bubbles!!

My dogs love these treats and so do I.  They are small enough to give as training treats and are swallowed quickly.  If a few are a bit big they are easy to break into smaller pieces without crumbling to dust.  They aren't too smelly, and they aren't at all greasy on my hands.  They contain no additives!  The perfect treat for dogs with allergies!The company is great to deal with.We give this product four paws up!

column9: pups love it, easy to handle, not too much smell
column10: Bought these in July 2012. I included two pics, so you can see the bag and the size of the dehydrated tripe nuggets. Tripe is a highly nutritious treat, so our girls just get two of these pieces as their evening snack. They love them! There is 5 ounces of dehydrated product in this bag, it says "product of USA" on the bag, and I like the size of the nuggets. There is a little smell, as there should be - it's TRIPE! but it's not overwhelming. We will buy these again. I feel that they are a quality treat.

When I bought this tripe... I expected the package to look exactly like the picture. Instead, I had a smaller bag of tripe that was not quite the same. Regardless, my dog loves it. Just not quite what I expected...

column9: sort of like southern greens but with a little umph!
column10: This is a delicious meal.  Well, I eat it as a meal.  It, of course can be eaten as a side dish. It has two types of greens and a bit of a "bite!"  You might want to put some sour cream or plain yogurt on the side. :)  I will always buy this as I'm too inept and lazy to prepare the recipe myself. lol

Jyoti Natural Foods Delhi Saag, Spinach and Mustart Greens, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)Tastes a good deal like spicy creamed spinach. Also good mixed in meat loaf, provides both nutrition and moisture. Will keep buying. Sale price made this a tremendous bargain.

TLDR: Its so good that its almost addictive. Stay away or get addicted for life.So I am a sucker for Saag. Its my favorite food in the universe (yes for me, it even beats medium cooked steak). Unfortunately in Seattle I have had a lot of trouble finding it. Its available very rarely in some seasons.I stumbled upon these on amazon and ordered 12 cans that arrived in two days. Here is how I made it1.) Heated oil2.) Fried pieces of garlic, ginger and chopped green pepper.3.) Added red chilli pepper4.) Added one can and let it cook for 5 minutes.And the result is nothing short of phenomenal. The taste was so amazing that I had tears of joy. I cannot stop thinking about it and cannot stop eating. I am hooked!All I need to do is to figure out how to order enough to last me for a lifetime.

You may well wonder why I gave this only 3 stars when I love it so.  I could eat the whole can all by myself.  I would also love it on some kid of pasta - or how about ravioli?  It would be perfect over rice.  Or over chicken thighs.  It has a perfect blend of mild Indian spices.It has a fatal flaw that makes me limit my intake:  It is way too salty.  This is not just my imagination.  The whole can would have over 2,000 mg of sodium.  Because of that I ration my intake.If the manufacturer reads this, perhaps they can cut back on the salt by about 40%  I imagine it would be just as good.Also, I don't know if this is a storage problem or not, but the cans look as if they either are old or have been stored in a damp place.
Yummy, couldn't-be-easier, vegan Indian food.  I put some croutons on top for a little crunch.

Most of my family truly delights in eating JYOTi saag. It's a delicious and satisfying part of a meal. I'd feel better, however, about feeding JYOTi saag to my family if I had reason to believe that the cans don't leach BPA into the saag.

column9: Tasty but for this price, I should learn to make it myself
column10: I love this product, been buying it in my local store for a couple of years. It's becoming harder to find, but I'm not sure I'm ready to pay this much for it, in bulk no less.My prep for this dish: bone-in chicken thighs & half a large onion, cooked in a pressure cooker until really soft. Pull the meat off the bones and add to the sauce with onion pieces and use a touch of the cooking water to thin it to the right consistency. Add a few tbsp. of sour cream, or yogurt, whatever you have, and a dose of garam masala or your favorite curry powder, simmer, eat on Naan.The flavor right out of the can is good but a little acidic to my taste. I like rounding it out with all the extras. Be careful adding spicy, I feel like the heat level is inconsistent from can to can - sometimes it's really pretty spicy to begin with, and I regret the touch of cayenne I added.

This product is a good base for shrimp or chicken saag.  I sauté the shrimp or chicken in olive oil with some chopped hot peppers, a little salt and some garlic powder.  Then I add the saag, heat  it up for several minutes, and pour it over some Tilda Basmati Rice.  Forget about it.

Every single can of Jyoti Natural Foods Delhi Saag, Spinach and Mustard Greens was dented. At first I thought it was just because they were poorly packed, but I realize that Amazon sent me a box of pre-dented cans, since the interior box was not sealed as most bulk orders from Jyoti are, and other items in my shipment were not damaged. Amazon, this is the way you lose customers!

The actual quality of QBubbles boba tea mix is pretty good.  You just mix with water, add the tapioca pearls and ice if you want, and end up with a flavorful drink.  Be warned that the main ingredients in QBubble's boba mixes are sugar, tea mix, powdered dairy creamer (which probably means trans fats), and flavoring (whatever that may entail)- overall not the ingredients that indicate a healthy drink.The Lavender flavor itself is interesting. To me, it tastes similar, but not the same, as Earl Gray tea with cream.  If you don't like Earl Gray, I would suggest avoiding Lavendaer Boba tea.

More than 10 years ago, while in Europe, I happened upon the oil variety of vanilla extract and have never gone back without wailing to the alcohol or water-based vanilla essence variety. The difference is like day to night. One capsule is enough for two batches of baking (about 2 pds of batter each batch). *The* vanilla essence, for me; and what a joy to be able to buy these in the US.

column9: Perfect to grab on the way to brunch so you don't have to eat high fructose corn syrup.
column10: I bought this item because about half the week I eat out for breakfast and half the week I eat at home.  When I eat out I HATE the idea of consuming high fructose corn syrup mixed in with a little bit of fruit or fruit flavor.  Everything about breakfast at my favorite restaurants is perfect except the jam.  I usually go to Corner Bakery if I have to be at Northwestern in Chicago extra Early-- Or grab breakfast at Nookies in boystown in Chicago (another favorite place of mine to eat).  Only thing bad about breakfast at these and most all other places is CHEAP sad fructose syrup jam.NOW with this Bonne Maman small jars of jam- made with fresh raspberries and real cane sugar I can FULLY enjoy my breakfasts out.  Just throw one in your coat pocket or bag and go.  These are small and east to carry and a pleasure to put on your toast and eat while you are eating out.  And they taste great! Why compromise your taste?  You have a good jam at home and a sucky one at the restaurant???  Why?  This is your solution.  Worked for me...  I'm about to order my second box.  LOVE THEM!

The Jawlipops were a hit with my boyfriend and although the size is three twice the size of a quarter, they brought a smile to his face; he stated that they taste better than the original "big mouth suckers". Thanks Amazon for making his birthday a special one!!

The only thing I wish this seller would do is even out the colors some. 2 orange 2 yellow 2 red.. those are the beat colors and they are stingy with them. You do not get to pick out your  colors, nor are they even. I am disappointed  with so many white & blue pops. Why not even out the colors.I wish the colors are evened out. I would  give you 5 stars tgen.You can buy em for half the price at jawlipops.com. 100 count for 167.00 if you want that many.  I eventually will buy from the manufactures website. They are so nice on the phone.I dont mind people making a buck though.The shipper is super fast using fed ex an they aren't broken. That is great!! Good seller all around. You make your order and they get here super fast!!  Again, 5 stars if you would combine more colors. The kids hate so many white out of 25.

Growing up, I would go to my parents to Wyoming to visit grandparents. My grandmother would make chokecherry jelly, and we thought it was wonderful -- I've been looking for chokecherry jelly ever since.Unfortunately, this wasn't it. The consistency is almost to jelled to be able to spread, and the wonderful tartness of the berries is way overshadowed by the sugar.I guess I'll have to keep looking.

column9: good, but not strong enough flavor
column10: My Mom made tons of this stuff when I was a kid. My Depression raised parents were into free food. Hers had more intense flavor. This brand didn't quite come up to my expectation. It's tasty and fruity though and I didn't have to spend hours picking the cherries.

I first tasted Wild Huckleberry Apple Butter when a friend in Montana sent a small jar to me. I fell in love.I've always liked apple butter, but the mixture of huckleberries and apples took the place of plain apple butter.As a diabetic, I can't have many sweets, and those I use need to be nutritious. Wild Huckleberry Apple Butter fills the bill.

Bought this product to use on my bagels and toast in the morning.  Overall it is a good product, but the taste of clove is too strong for my liking.  If you do not love the taste of clove, you may not care to have too much of this in one sitting.

When my husband requested some chokecherry jelly, I couldn't find it locally, so I looked on Amazon.com.  I found this wonderful jelly, and my husband absolutely loves it!  I'll definitely buy it again.

When I was a child in Montana, my family would go out chokecherry picking -- not an easy thing to do, as I remember.  My mother would make jams and jellies out of these wonderful berries.  I was thrilled to find this product online and even more excited to find that it tastes exactly like my mother's jelly did!  I've introduced this to many of my friends, most of whom have NEVER heard of the chokecherry, and they, too, absolutely love it.

column9: Choke cherry jam is a definite winner!!
column10: I am a chef who is American and lives in England...I was asked to create a gourmet burger that represented the Mid West..particularly a North Dakota burger...I made a burger topped with homemade style German Russian potato salad, topped with Schnitzel, topped with your Wild CC Jam..It was a perfect accompaniment..The only thing I had a problem with is that you do not send internationally I did have to have it sent to my mothers in R.I. and it did make it more expensive but the jam itself was wonderful...Thank you!AnnieAnnies Burger Shack[...]Heres a pic![...]

I purchased Chokecherry jelly at Amazon.com.Your Chokecherry jelly has the same taste that my mother'sChokecherry jelly had.When all of her ten children ran around a farm in centralMinnesota, we were hungry when we came into the house forsomething to eat. My mother baked her own bread twice a weekfor her huge family.  Us children would lather the Chokecherryjelly on thick slices of Mom's homemade bread.Reliving childhood memories through the sense of taste iswonderful.I would like to see this jelly in a larger jar.Please keep selling this Chokecherry Jelly I will be buyingmore.Let me know if Chokecherry Jelly is ever on sale.Sincerely, Inez Lintz
I loved Chokecherry Jelly that my Mom used to make.  This is just like it.  Yes it is sweet but that is the way I like it.
Love Wild Chokecherry jelly!!  Glad I could find it as almost impossible in the midwest.  Fell in love with it when I lived in Utah.
Product just as I had hoped: great tangy flavor.  Very prompt shipping.  Thanks so much.

It certainly didin't taste a thing like the chokecherry jelly I had growing up in N.Dak.  No tanginess.  I don't thingk there was any real chokecherry juice used. I was very disappointed as I got one for me and one for a Christmas gift for my brother.

I popped some last night and I love this popcorn. If you like large poofy kernels then this is not for you, but I like small kernel popcorns too, and this one was light and a little crunchy and had good flavor. I think the selling point of this type is that the hulls shatter when it pops ("hullless"), so that you don't get the big painful pieces of hard popcorn hull in your teeth like with larger varieties. I think the popcorn kernels have to be small to be hullless.If you have an air popper and find that small kernel popcorns fly out of it, you could try a different cooking method - I just pop mine in a saucepan on the stove (with a little bit of vegetable oil, and a lid to keep it from flying out), there are also air poppers that don't let the popcorn fly out, or I've seen a microwave bowl that's like air popping but with the microwave as a heat source (but no added oil or anything, like air popping), or some people even just use a paper bag in the microwave (I think with this method they use a little oil too). There are many ways to cook popcorn, and instructions are pretty easy to find on the internet if you need them.

This popcorn has hulls, which I don't care for. It's not labeled as hulless, so it's not deceptive. I just thought for the price it would be - my bad. I only use the whilry pop popper, so this review is relevant to that method only. It produces somewhat light, crispy popcorn of fairly large size with a real popcorn taste. I did think it would pop larger though. It's good for the coated popcorns I like to make. It's not the best I've tasted though. Fireworks makes some delicious, hulless varieties that have spoiled me, I'm afraid. The company ships fairly fast, and the shipping cost is what I'd expect it to be. I'm ruined by Amazon Prime though, so to pay any shipping at all is a drawback; that being said, for this quality popcorn plus the S&H cost, I won't buy it again - simple as that - and for no other reason than that.

column9: Not good with an air popper.
column10: This popcorn is not good with an air popper, because the kernels are too light.
I liked it. I can't say I loved it, as it turns out I prefer bigger kernels and this one is small. But it's a tasty one, especially if you prefer smaller kernels.

My wife says that I can cook two things - omelettes and popcorn...with popcorn being my best. We have always used popcorn from the grocery store but the Amish Country Lady Finger Popcorn is so far superior to the store bought. The flavor was so good you did not have to use butter and it was a delight to eat, both in taste and texture. The husk of the corn seemed to disappear and left almost nothing that you had to dig out from between you teeth. I give this product FIVE STARS. I look forward to trying the other style of popcorn they offer.

I've tried a wide variety of popcorns, and generally find the quality of this brand to be excellent.  The Lady Finger popcorn is by far my favorite of all the brands and varieties of popcorn I've tried.  It's tender, flavorful, and a bit sweet; highly recommended.

I am unable to buy "hulless" popcorn in my area. This is the first time since my young days that I have enjoyed this type of popcorn. I would recommend that everyone give it a try, as they will really enjoy eating it with no kernels stuck between the teeth. Tasty, too.

Even "no hull" popcorn has hulls.  It has to so it can contain the moisture in the kernel and cause the popcorn to POP.  "No hull" popcorn has a hull that shatters when the popcorn pops so the hull isn't as noticeable.  There's no guarantee that every hull will shatter into "invisible" pieces.  So ALL popcorn varieties have a hull.  With some varieties you just don't notice it as much.

When I bought this popcorn, it was because Amazon recommended it or at least showed it with the air popper. As other reviewers have said, this popcorn does not work in the air popper. It hasn't got enough weight  to stay in the popper long enough to pop. That same quality - lightness - is actually what makes it good popcorn otherwise. I recommend it for stove top popping in a deep saucepan with a lid.

I was interested with the fact that this popcorn is supposed to pop with less hull. However, I read that the popcorn also pops smaller as a consequence. I wasn't quite sure what to expect when I placed the order, but I figured I'd give it a try.The kernels pop to about the size of a penny on average, which is smaller than what I'm used to. However, I wind up just eating handfuls of it anyway. The hulls are in fact definitely less pervasive, which is a huge plus. Hulls and old maids are a huge turn me off for me from regular popcorn.I use an elecrtic oil based popper. There are always some unpopped or barely popped kernels. However, this is the first type of kernel I've tried with this popper, so I'm not sure which is at fault. Even still, some old maids are to be expected with any popcorn. Most of it pops fine.
Husband makes this in a whirleypop popper with bacon grease.......have mercy! You will love it--promise!!!

column9: Great, but not for an air popper for sure
column10: This popcorn is excellent. My husband and I love the taste and we don't mind eating several pieces at a time to make up for the tiny size. I rarely have any hulls when eating this, but when I do, they don't get stuck in my teeth. However, I could see why these would never work for an air popper. They are far too light and would never stay in the chamber long enough to pop. If you have a stovetop or electric popper (like I have) this is definitely worth a try.
This popcorn is great for young kids and infants because of it's petite size.  It does pop well in our air popper...if I tilt the popper back a bit to keep the kernels in as they pop.

I love Lady Finger popcorn.  It has so much flavor. It's a million times better than microwave popcorn and a thousand times better than the popcorn in the super-market.Warning....Once you have the good stuff, you'll never want to eat regular popcorn again.

When I was a child, my grandmother got some popcorn sent to her straight from the fields in Missouri.  It was white and SO tasty it didn't need butter or salt.  I've been on a search to find more ever since.This isn't it.The kernels are quite small but, worst of all, only about 40% of them pop.  That's a lot of "old maids" and makes this tuff pricey indeed.I contacted the seller with the issue; they told me to pop it at a lower microwave setting -- didn't help.I gave it 2 stars only because what did pop was OK-tasting.Keep looking...

column9: great corn... especially for small corn lovers
column10: small kernels lead to small popcorn... wonderful flavor... i like to use this when i make kettle korn...1/4 cup sugar, 1/4 cup oil, 1/2 cup kernels into a popper... AWESOME!
We have always loved this popcorn but couldn't find it...now, we have not only discovered it again, but we have found the PERFECT place to get it....shipped on time and was fresh and delicious!!!
taste great but if your using an air popper not so great the little seeds will fall out before popping.
This is good popcorn, but it is very small so you need to make twice as much as you normally would.

I ordered this because Amazon recommended it to go along with the Redenbacker popcorn popper I got from them. Hey, only a few of these actually pop! Most of these small, unpopped kernels get thrown out of the popper. What an absolute waste of money!

I ordered Snappy white popcorn, mushroom popcorn and this bag of Lady Finger popcorn all from Amazon.  So far I've reviewed the Snappy white (wonderful).  I tried this Lady Finger corn today.  I measured the oil, popcorn and Flavorcol so that my sloppy technique of eye-balling the amounts wouldn't mess it up.  It popped quickly in my Whirly-Pop popper and the kernels were a nice, appealing yellow color.  As stated in their description, these are tiny, tiny kernels that produce tiny, tiny popcorn.  They were fairly tender and tasty but a bit chewy.  They are supposed to be "hullless."  I'm not sure I agree with that but it is true that the hulls don't pop off and land in the bottom of the bowl.  The hulls stick to the kernels which is what makes them sort of chewy.  I will use these up but I probably won't buy more.  Kids may like the tiny kernels more than I did. I found them messy to eat because I kept dropping them.  My dog loved the ones I dropped!  I also had only about a dozen unpopped kernels.

Amish Country Lady Finger popcorn is not hull free but we had to search to find any!  This product arrived quickly and well packaged.  It is crisp with a mild flavor everyone seemed to enjoy. Anyone with dentures will appreciate this product, I should think.

column9: Probably the worst of the Amish popcorn types
column10: The kernels are very small, much smaller than movie theater popcorn. There are also a lot more unpopped kernels and because the popcorn is so small, it tastes like I'm eating larger hulls because the ratio of kernel to hull is closer. This is the worst of the three Amish flavors I tried, with Baby White as the clear winner. Skip this and go straight to Baby White.

I love this popcorn!  We use this corn in a traditional oil popper with the really "bad for u" coconut oil. I tried Orville reddenbacher after this just b/c it's cheaper, but never again. My husband doesn't like the small pieces of popcorn, but frankly, I say, just use a spoon!
This is another Wabash Valley popcorn that pops up small, but is absolutely delicious!! Very few kernels are left unpopped in my Whirly Pop. I will buy this one again for sure!
Love this! Much healthier and only popcorn I feel good about feeding my toddler. It is very small and delicate so can burn if not careful cooking on stove top.

Although this popcorn was advertised with the Presto Poplite hot air corn popper it is too small and too light to work with this machine. It is even stated in the instructions that came with machine as not recommended type to use. Made good duck feed though.

column9: Stale - Hull O' Plenty - Unflavorful - I'm Out the Money :(
column10: I cannot believe the vendor had the nerve to sell this nasty, bottom-of-the-barrel popcorn to anyone.  Not even fit for a pig's slop.
Disappointed in this popcorn, too many kernels did not pop, in the future I will not be purchasing this popcorn from Amazon.

I blame Amazon.com not Ammish country for recommendig this otherwise good popcorn when I bought a hot air popper.  the instructions with the popper said don't use small kernel light popcorn.  they were right.  it all just flew out of the popper before it had a chance to pop
This is supposed to be tender popcorn and it is anything but that and the seller will not respond to my emails requesting a refund.  I am very sorry I ordered this product.
IF YOU LIKE YOUR POPCORN SMALL AND CRUNCHY, THIS IS FOR YOU.  I DON'T.
THESE CORN KERNELS ARE VERY VERY SMALL AND WHEN POPPED WILL RESULT IN SMALL POPPED CORN WHICH IS NOT GOOD FOR CHILDREN AND WILL NOT POP IN A HOT AIR POPPER

Very sweet and delicious - rich and decedent - never new fig could be so wonderful!I had to make a second matcha because I drank it so darned fast! My family was laughing at me when I began to make the second latte! They have seen me down matcha before but never quite as fast as this one!Its sweet but not cloying whatsoever, tastes like something one picked fresh from the tree or ummm garden? Do figs grow on trees? I need to look that up! I have had fig only in a few forms before - jams, canned which were whole figs, and in puddings, but I am positive this is the best tasting fig ever for me!I think this may become one I keep as a permanent selection in my stash. I am not sure I would say it is better than macadamia nut or butterscotch but its up there with them maybe number 3 or 4 in my favorites. I have been drinking so many new ones as I collect them that I need to go back and try some of my first matcha again.I have also been sending out a ton of samples but its getting to that point I can't share as much anymore because my stash is beginning to thin lol.I'm at the place of deciding my favorites and keeping only those in stock. This will be one of those.So I was surprised as I really did not expect to love this one quite so much, actually I thought I would probably not favor it but alas I do. Go fig!

column9: Exactly what I was looking for
column10: This is a very glutenous rice also known as sticky or sweet rice (it is not sweet but used to make sweet treats).  I got addicted to this in Japan and found it in Hawaii but not in the grocery stores near my house.The best way to cook this rice is to soak it in water for at least a few hours (sometimes over night) and then steam it for 30 minutes.  I make a large bunch this way and then when I want a serving I just resteam it for about 5 minutes.  It's so delicous especially topped with some madras lentils.

I got a serious mochi addiction after a trip to japan, so my husband bought me a mochi maker so that I could enjoy it back in the US, too.  I tried the hand-made mochi at a festival there, as well as the store bought, and have to say that my little pounding machine and this rice make mochi comparable to the hand-made.  I've ventured into making my own flavours, including a delicious chocolate mochi, as well as plain that I wrap in nori and eat with soy sauce.  This mochi produces sticky, stretchy, firm mochi that toasts up perfectly.  Delicious!
Be carefull once you have them you will be hooked. Started out with a one pound bag now up to a three pound bag. CAUTION

column9: Do NOT order a 3 pound bag of these...
column10: So...  A co-worker of mine mentioned how delicious "those little random glazed morsels" were inside the giant tub of assorted Poker Mix we kept in the office.  But what the hell were they?  A quick internet search led us to these wholesale honey roasted sesame chips.  We thought, what the hell...  instead of diggin through useless pretzels and bland azz rice puffs in hopes of scoring one of these gems in your handful of snackage, lets order JUST the good stuff.  Scratch that.  Let's order a sh!tload of the good stuff -- make it a 3 lbs bag.I placed the order, anxiously awaiting each day's FedEx shipment in hopes it would arrive. Much hype had built up around the ensuing delivery and as fate would have it the package arrived on a day when I was one of the few folks in the office.  This presented a perfect opportunity for me to commandeer the package and place it stategically on my desk within arms reach for constant munching -- with noone else around to get in the way and ruin my snackin rhythm.  And so I ate...  and ate some more...  and a couple more after that.  Fast-forward to the end of the day...  I've completely OD's on these god-awful things.  A terrible aftertaste lingers well into the night, along with some serious heartburn.DAY TWO...  I can't even look at these things.  Everyone else in the office is pretty excited about them though.  "Oooooh, these are pretty good -- what are they?"  "Yummy..."  "It's like a tongue kissing an angel..."WEEK 3...  Everyone in the cubicles surrounding my immediate area has had it with these godd@mn things.  I've finally managed to pawn the remainder off onto our Director of Network Operations, who graciously accepted my "gift" and carried them over to his side of the office.  Sure -- I feel bad passing the hot potato off to him, but at this point it was us or them.  I'm basically a hero, the way I see it...  I saved lives over here.AND SO, THE MORAL BEING...  Yeah, they're ok in small doses.  But at the end of the day they're best left as the amusing but rarely seen supporting character in some marginal sitcom.  IE, sesame chips are well placed as a rarely occuring morsel in some party mix, but NOT as the featured star of a snack extravaganza.  And whatever you do...  DO NOT GET THE GIANT 3 POUND BAG!!!
I fully intended to take some to work with me and share them with my friend, but they were so addictive I ended up eating them all myself at home!
These chips are so good!  I think I've eaten a pound in 3 days.  I have to agree, they are addictive.

They did great on Science Diet but I wanted to feed them a food that food experts rated as a 4 or 5 star. I also needed a food without any beef or beef by-products or beef flavor added. This product is excellent. My husband and I recently stopped in a restaurant in Fredericksburg, VA and I was served this type couscous with a salmon dish. I absolutely loved it! package was delivered quickly and product was great.  I have since found this item at a grocery nearby in the Kosher section, but the bulk option is nice if you cook for large groups or want to share with friends.

column9: My bassett hound LOVES his food now...
column10: Canidae has definetly proven to be a tasty, balanced source of food for my dog.Initially i had started my new pup on IAMS because of its popularity - but after reading the ingredient list and hearing the the IAMS corporation had just been sold (therefore not keeping the quality of their product) I decided I needed to provide my hound with a heathier source of nutrition.I volunteer at the local Human Society Shelter and a friend of mine there suggested that I try "Canidae". At first I was hesitant because of the cost - but when i read the nutrition facts and saw REAL, all natural ingredients, i felt confident enough that the price was worth it.Before i started feeding my bassett Canidae he would only eat once a day (placing a full bowl of food down for him in the early morning on my way to work...he would wait until late at night to eat AFTER I had my dinner and slowly munch on a couple bits here and there). The first morning i put Canidae in his dish (at 5:30am) he scarfed the entire bowl down in a matter of minutes!!!!! It was such a relief to know that my dog was actually enjoying his food.Now i feed him once in the morning and once at night and he eats every bit as soon as I put it down everytime. Occasionally I will cook up some frozen vegetables with an egg and mix it in his food for a little variety, but I havent had to do that in a while.If you love your dog and care about his/her nutrition, I suggest giving Canidae a try.

column9: Good price for a highly rated dog food
column10: I feed three large dogs and one small dog with this dog food.  I've used it about three months. I decided to change when I did some internet research showing my old brand was considered to have inferior ingredients.  I have to say that I have seen good reviews on the ingredients of this dog food, but I cannot say I notice anything in particular about my dogs since changing other than they seem to enjoy it more and seem to be satisfied with less of it.  Perhaps one dog who has skin problems is better, but I can't swear the dog food is the cause.  So, relying almost entirely on internet proclamation of quality, I give this a hearty recommendation.  And, the price is competitive to lesser rated dog foods.  And it comes directly to your door.

Both of my large breed dogs love Canidae.  I actually have to limit how much they can eat or they will make themselves sick by eating so much!  The ingredients are wonderful and actually contains stuff I would eat myself.  I would recommend this food for any animal lover.

column9: great dog food at the lowest cost
column10: I bought the chicken meal and rice formula because I suspected my 8 year old Lab mix might have a food allergy related to corn or soy. Well, she does not. However I did learn a lot about dog food in the process. According to [...]  Canidae rates four stars whereas as everything on the shelf at my local Wal-Mart rates only one star. I was considering Blue Buffalo and other brands but they were $15 or higher in cost.  I saved money buying Canidae and received dog food with the highest quality ingredients! I highly recommend it. I strongly advise you to visit their website.

column9: Great choice for the active young dog!
column10: I'm the owner of a year and a half old beagle boy.  He's the love of my life and when I got him from our local rescue they emphasized how important a proper diet of a premium dog food is.  I'm not one to be sucked into the belief that if it costs more, it's better.  That said, in terms of dog food, it's important to find a food made of fresh ingredients with no corn byproducts.My little guy eats a bowl of this per day and he has cured the constipation problem he was having before we switched foods.  He seems to really like the taste and to make it a little easier on his teeth, I add water to it to soften it.  That seems to do the trick since the kibbles are decent sized and might be a bit much for a smaller dog to take on.What's also nice about this is ordering through Amazon Prime and getting the heavy bag shipped for free to my door with two-day shipping.  This is by far the most reasonable price I've come across for a top-brand dog food.  Try a smaller bag to see if your pup takes to it and go from there.

I ordered this after reading a ton of awesome reviews and in hopes that it may hope with my dog, Kitty, a 65 pound, 2 year-old pit bull's recent issues with her skin. It turns out that her problem was in fact due to corn and other fillers used in lesser quality dog foods (in this case, Purina One). Overall, this product alone made it completely worth the cost to subscribe to Amazon Prime for the extremely fast and cheap shipping, so for less money (as Kitty now requires less food, since she's more full from eating less of the higher quality food and we make sure to only feed her what the vet recommends,) I no longer have to drive to the store and pick up a 40 pound bag of dog food and load it into the back of one of my GTIs. So far, Kitty's been gaining weight and muscle at a pretty decent rate, in my opinion. (Over the past 2 months, she's gone from approximately 59 pounds to 67.5 pounds currently, and is quite fit and happy.) All this, is of course in addition to daily exercise, walks, et cetera, but her temperament lately has also been much better. On the lesser quality dog chow, she used to mope around the house every few days, but lately, she's been very happy, energetic and outgoing. She seems to be much less easily stressed out, which is great for her, as she tend to be a bit anxious, although an absolute sweetheart.Bottom Line: I could not recommend this or any other Canidae Dog Food product highly enough. Canidae Grain Free ALS Salmon formula is one of the foods I rotate for my two keeshonden girls. They love the taste and they have no digestive problems with it at all. Canidae grain free food is rated very highly by all the dog food rating sources I have found. Do your dogs a favor and try some.

The orders are here within a week to 10 days of ordering.

column9: Great food for a great price

If you're feeding your dog trash like Science Diet or Eukanuba, switch over to this and you won't be disappointed.  Worth every penny.

We haven't had any issues with it what so ever.

column9: Cost effective & so far a good alternative
column10: We have a 52lb Basset/Beagle/who knows. For the past few years Boing has eaten a grain free + low gluten dehydrated food. My dog has had diarhea problems with all sorts of dog foods in the past.  We switched him to this a couple months ago and he is doing great.  This food was recommended by our pet store and I agree that it is not only healthy, but gentle on my dogs touchy stomach.

glad I got this, searched the web for the best food for a dog with stomach problems, loose stools, what I got at the vets didn't help, after reading many reviews I got this and I love it becaseu I feed less, they poop less, more money up front but less cost in the longer, also I get it delivered, what could be better, couldnt say anough good stuff, love you canidae

column9: Great Food for high energy dog with digestive problems!
column10: At 40 per cent high quality protein, this is great food for a young, healthy, very active dog. It's hard to find food with that much protein. We've been through the wringer for 3 years with our German Shepherd's food needs. He was diagnosed at 1 year old with IBD (inflammatory bowel disease) and even though he is on medication, we have to be careful because anything less than top quality food will give him terrible diarrhea (no matter how slowly and carefully we transition him from one food to another). Even some top quality foods will do it.Since we put him on Canidae Pure Sea he's had consistently firm stool for the first time in his 3 years of life. His coat has gotten more soft and glossy, his breath is good (for a dog), he's put on and kept on some much-needed weight. We are so happy! He's also a picky eater, but he loves the Canidae and never turns his nose up at it.A couple of notes for any dog-savvy readers: we ruled out EPI and protein sensitivities early on. He's on Tylan and Immodium for the IBD, and most likely will be for life. The vet said that no matter WHAT we do, he will likely be subject to bouts of diarrea. That's why the Canidae seems so miraculous.

I am feeding her this currently while mixing it with the Innova (which is very expensive and hard to find) that her breeder is feeding her. I love that the price is slightly less than other premium, holistic foods and I can get it shipped to me on Prime 2 day shipping.  It's also for all life stages, so I like that if this continues to work for her, I won't need to switch to a different food as she gets older.The ingredients in the food are great, and I especially like that there are pro-biotics. Great service and good product.

Take care if choosing this food as they recently released a new formula that has more grains and has resulted in the superpoops for my dog that I have been feeding canidae for 2 years.

Within four weeks on the new flavor he developed a set of distressing systems including soft, mucus covered stools, horrible gas,low energy, staggering walk, excessive drooling, licking and constant neck extending (difficulty swallowing).  A vet visit confirmed these as diet related.  We put him on a chicken/rice diet and his symptoms stopped after just two days. column9: Healthy salmon dog food without fishy odor.
column10: This product is made from the best ingredients.  My dog was allergic to chicken-based dog foods so my vet suggested salmon.  This is a quality salmon dog food without a strong fishy odor.
