This has given my young dog persistent loose stools. My older dog also had problems with loose stools on the adult formula, which was immediately rectified by a change to Innova. See the large number of serious complaints on the web about the new formulation before buying.

column9: My dog lost too much weight on this food.
column10: I have a two and a half year old female Boxer that has allergies to most commercial dog foods, so I keep her on a diet free of wheat, soy, and animal by-products.  Canidae seemed to fit the criteria and was available at my local pet store (whereas, the brand I was feeding, Evo, had to be ordered), so I wanted to try it.  I've been feeding my dog three and a half cups of Canidae dry dog food daily (divided between two feedings) for about five weeks, and she has lost a significant amount of weight on this diet.  She is a very active dog that has always been lean, but she is now too skinny. I will be switching back to Evo and would not recommend Canidae.

I purchased Canidae Dry Dog Food, Chicken Meal and Rice Formula for my two Cocker Spaniels (Cavalier King Charles and American breed).  After about two weeks, the problems began.  Diarrhea, some vomiting and general malaise.  Further feeding resulted in more problems.  We had fed them Blue Buffalo and Eukanuba in the past but had never experienced these kind of problems. We returned to Eukahuba and both pets have returned to normal. I'm unsure what ingredients caused the problem but I will never use this product again and recommend caution before feeding your dog this food!Canidae Dry Dog Food, Chicken Meal and Rice Formula, 30-Pound Bag

I <3 Jd's bacon salt and this is basically popcorn with baconsalt on it so it tastes good! I don't think I would buy it again because I can just make popcorn and add JD's bacon salt in the amount that I like.. I thought the bag I had was not bacony enough but it was good!

I bought these for my husband last Christmas, mainly as a gag gift. True to name, they tasted like bacon. Which, doesn't make a very good popcorn flavor to me. Plus after I popped a bag, my house smelt like butt for days.Me and my husband thought they tasted horrible. My daughter could eat a whole bag, on the other hand.

Wasn't going to try the popcorn, it was suppose to be a gift. Although when it arrived the box was stuffed into smaller box.  Saying that, the box was to messed up to give as a gift. After popping the popcorn it was not what I expected it to be. It did not taste like bacon. I give it a three because of how it was sent to me mainly. Although it didn't taste like bacon it still wasn't a bad tasting popcorn.
This popcorn is the worst popcorn i've ever had.  It smells horrible!!  It also made me a bit queezy afterwards.  I would not reccomend this

This popcorn is very yummy but I'm saddened that there are only 3 bags in the box! Luckily, we've had this a bit and have only ate 2 bags so far, but we'll definitely be sad when we finish the last one! A great alternative to the tradition butter popcorn during a movie.

Other than for novelty purposes, I really cannot recommend this product.  There is a strong odor of smoked bacon that emanates from the popcorn, but it is has a strong artificial plastic odor to it.  The flavor of bacon really seems to be overwhelmed by a taste of smokiness.  I would think it is more accurate to say smoked popcorn than bacon popcorn. At first I thought it might just be me, but when I shared them with my friends, they took an initial handful for the novelty, and then stopped. The more I tried it, the worse it tasted to the point where the smell was just nauseating.  But I do admit that people get a kick out of receiving it as a gift.

column9: The bacon flavor just doesn't quite pop.
column10: The theory, "Everything tastes better with bacon," sounds good, but does it ring true? J & D's put the theory to the test, and with their Bacon Pop product, they almost hit the mark. Bacon-flavored popcorn is a fantastic idea, but the bacon flavor in Bacon Pop just doesn't quite pop. It isn't bad by any stretch of the imagination, but the flavor is just a bit too subtle. It smells great when popped, but the taste leaves you wanting more. Fortunately, J & D's provides bacon lovers with other options, and we'll explore one of those soon.

Not bad of a popcorn, but it feels like it's kind of missing something. The flavor doesn't taste strong enough. Maybe not enough bacon taste, or not enough butter, or not enough salt. Any of the 3..It was still not a bad popcorn.. But if i seen this in the store, and seen jolly time homemade style popcorn sitting next to each other, i'm takin the jolly time homemade style.. Or any theater butter popcorn.
This happens to be my son's favorite flavor jar.  I always have it on hand for him.  I often mix it with rice or he'll want more than 1 jar!

column9: great for a complete veggie with rice combo
column10: My daughter loved this combo and it was very convenient to use when I was in a restaurant or visiting with friends.  She  still eats Earths Best foods at 15 months!
I wasn't sure about this combination at first but my little boy LOVES this mix. And I love how healthy it is for him

My baby loves the flavor of Peas and Brown Rice. Gobbles them up. I started giving this to him around 7 months and the consistency was fine. Now that he is 9 months he would like a thicker consistency, so I just add some rice cereal to the jar. I also like that it has 3 grams of protein per jar. Purchased by the subscribe and save is the best price I have found - online or the grocery store. And so convenient!

My baby LOVES this stuff! I don't like peas, but I tried this once and it was not bad. I add cereal to make it thicker (my baby likes a paste-like consistency, always has), otherwise it is more like a medium-thick puree in consistency. I would absolutely recommend this product.

column9: Great Option for Organic Baby Food
column10: I generally love Earth's Best brand and my 6 month old likes most of the varieties we have offered him so far. The peas and brown rice flavor is one of his favorites. I admit I have found better prices occasionally at the store, but Amazon subscriptions makes purchasing so easy and I don't have to deal with a million baby food jars in my shopping car and having them spill out of the bags all over my car on the way home. Free two-day shipping for Amazon Moms makes the deal even better. Great quality product that baby loves and the convenience of free automatic delivery. What could be better?

column9: Yummy, organic and delivered - can't beat that!
column10: Son loves this baby food and we love that it is organic and delivered to our door at a great price.
My six month old loves peas and brown rice.  Each jar contains 3 grams of protein  which works out to be 22% of the daily value.

column9: Great price for quality baby food.
column10: We love Earth's Best Baby Food. Great quality food and taste for very low price. I like the taste of the food and found myself stealing couple fruit jars from cupboard for desert.

I can't recommend this spice highly enough. Its smoky depth works perfectly with lamb, chicken, and pork, and in combination with garlic works wonders with prawns. It isn't too spicy (which makes it ideal for family meals with heterogeneous spiciness preferences) and has a lovely color too. Two thumbs up! La Tienda's service is excellent as well, and they have a line of delicious-looking Spanish foods that make me wish that I could afford 100-dollar-a-pound ham from wild pigs fed exclusively with hazelnuts. Mmmm. Ham.

I cook with parika a great deal and have always used the Hungarian extraction.There is no comparison...this paprika is full of flavor- comes in three strenegths ( I have tried them all and they are GREAT).Can be used with any meat and is great in a fritata!

column9: You'll never go back to regular paprika
column10: When I purchased La Chinata Bittersweet Smoked Paprika, I had high expectations, based on the reviews I've read on Amazon and elsewhere. After having a chance to try it, I can honestly say it's met those expectations. In fact, it's wonderful. It's flavorful with that hint of smoke and adds a whole new level to your dishes. Not to mention, it has versatility. We've added it to our chili recipe, to chicken dishes, and have even been inspired to experiment with spanish cuisine. In comparison to any paprika you could buy at the store, it's night and day. I don't think I'll ever be able to settle for the grocery store bland red power again. I highly recommend this!

column9: Add a little savor to almost anything
column10: A tasty addition to almost any meal. The smoky flavor comes across well, but the sweet paprika also adds nice flavor. Especially good on vegetables.

column9: Still easy, but better for you...
column10: I don't actually eat the macaroni and cheese in our house.  The kids do.  In an effort to improve the quality of life for all, I've been gradually switching us over to natural, organic, and whole grain products.  Macaroni and cheese finally got my attention.  We've tried other brands, but the kids really say this is the best and is far better than the Kraft.  What else can I say?  I don't feel as guilty, they still get what they want.  Life is good.

I have a son who is very particular about his food. There are never any complaints about Annie's Classic Mac&Cheese!! I also have a 13 yr old nephew who wont touch anything other than "thee" national brand, except for when it comes to Annie's Classic M&C. He loves it and even asks for it when he visits. I really like the fact that it does NOT call for butter. Just combine milk with the provided cheese packet and that's it!! This has been a real winner in our home and we make sure to always have some on hand by purchasing it in bulk on autoship!

This mac and cheese is a great product, all organic and real food used in it's making...the cheese sauce is to be made separately by mixing the powder with milk or cream while the mac cooks, so it is a bit different from the standard dry-box mac and cheese. This may seem tougher by one step than you are used to, but it is really just a matter of dumping the powder in with the liquid and stirring. This allows the cheese sauce to be made quickly, no cheese lumps, and no added butter or margerine...tastes great!

column9: Love That It's Organic Without Artificial Ingredients
column10: For a boxed mac and cheese, this is pretty healthy. It doesn't taste quite as cheesy as Kraft's mac & cheese, but it's still good. To up the cheese flavor I don't add the milk to it, just the butter and the cheese powder. I usually leave a bit of the pasta water in it so that there will be enough liquid to make it creamy. My children love it and I don't feel too bad about letting them eat once in a while because it is organic and doesn't contain artificial ingredients or preservatives.

This is the best powdered cheese macaroni I've found. I always add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter to it. I used to buy it at WalMart but they stopped carrying it and it's $3/box at my local grocery store so this is a pretty good deal on Amazon.

My son loves Mac and Cheese, but I certainly didn't want him eating all of the artificial ingredients in some other major brands.  We buy many of Annie's products, and I always make sure to have plenty of these on hand.  I don't have to worry about the chemicals, and it's really good!  It's the closest thing to Kraft Mac and Cheese that I've ever had.  The sauce is a bit watery, but I actually like it better that way.  There's no way I'd ever buy anything else now, and usually the subscribe and save is a better deal than the grocery store.

This macaroni is very good. We usually buy Kraft or Great Value brand of Mac and Cheese. Our friends told us about this so we decided to try it. It is organic pasta and cheese basically. We did notice that it was a lot healthier for you than other brands. I would say it doesn't contain as much content as Kraft does though. It has way few calories and fat. Also, the cheese flavor isn't very strong. You can taste way more noodle than cheese, so sometimes we add just a tablespoon of melted cheese, and if we get the Annie's White Cheddar Pasta, a little organic parmesan cheese sprinkled on top will sure make a difference! Overall, very good product. Will continue to buy.

column9: Fair take on an alternative to Kraft box Mac n cheese
column10: Made the 3rd box of this for dinner and for the second time the macaroni cooked unevenly.  It didn't destroy the meal but it was noticeable.  My wife likes pasta al dente, so when half of them are perfect and the other are over done(at least over to my wife), it either means something is wrong with the cook, or something is wrong with the product.  My wife cooked the first mix matched product and I cooked the the other.  Both of us lived on Mac and cheese in college so we really great at mac and cheese box top instructions.  Again the difference is not huge enough to prevent another purchase.  It just is enough to prevent the preparation of a perfect al dente.  The product flavor was nice and had almost a savory undertone. I recommend this product.  It's decently different in a good way.

column9: What a deal for my family!
column10: Eating food that doesn't have nasty or un-nameable ingredients can be expensive.  my daughter loves mac n' cheese to finding this on Amazon was great!  I like the price and of course I really love Annie's products.
great product, kids love it and it's healthier than the kraft mac and cheese, so unless  you are going to make it from scratch, this is the best!

column9: Good, easy, and with identifiable ingredients!
column10: Mac and cheese is a popular quick meal with my children, so I like to have some around the house just in case. We've generally gone for the big name brand stuff, or one of the local grocery store brands (which is just as tasty as the big name brand stuff). However, I feel a bit bad about it given the somewhat unidentifiable ingredients on those boxes, so I decided to give this a try, having enjoyed some other Annie's products we've tried. Made the way I tend to always make box macaroni and cheese, it's just as good as the other stuff. (Made by the directions on the box it's not quite as good.) I generally go for 1 tablespoon of butter per box, and enough milk to make a proper sauce, mixed with the cheese mix and noodles at the same time. The only difference my kids noticed were the shape of the noodles, as I prefer to buy the spiral noodle mac and cheese in the other brands. Is it the healthiest thing out there, even in this box? No, but at least this helps me feel a bit better about the occasional box mac and cheese meals the kids get. Ultimately, the only thing that would make this better would be a version with spiral noodles, in my opinion. I'd definitely recommend it, and I'd recommend that you make it in whatever fashion you're used to making other box mac and cheeses for the best results.

column9: Very good and easy to make
column10: I really like this mac and cheese. It's easy to make and much better for you than the leading national brand. I love that it's organic and doesn't have artificial flavors or colors. I will definitely buy this again soon.

Of the three types of Annie's I have tried, these are by far the best. I get two meals per box and add a can of tuna with it. As mentioned by another satisfied customer, add the cheese to the milk first and then add the noodles.
Our family loves these.  Adding in some organic milk and butter makes these taste even better.  And my kids love it as well.  Go for it.

This macaroni and cheese is very good.  Lately I have not been able to eat my favorite foods, since nothing seems appealing to me, and  thinking about eating anything makes me depressed. I picked up a box of annie's which I have tried in the past, and it it hit the spot. I can eat my whole serving. The flavor of the cheese is very subtle and natural tasting, and doesn't make me feel sick after eating it like other mac and cheese. I think it's because it's all natural, since I usually never eat processed foods, but this is the exception! Thank you Annie's!

I am a big fan of macaroni and cheese and I also enjoy organic food. I love Annie's Classic because it has a more rich and cheesy taste than Kraft or other brands. This is the only macaroni and cheese that I will eat!It's relatively healthy and not so fattening as many other brands.

column9: Not as good as other Annie's products
column10: Perhaps it's just me but the noodles in the Homegrown Classic Mac & Cheese seems to have a unique flavor - I can't put my finger on it but the closest thing I can think of is a slight cinnamon or even saffron flavor.  I tasted the cheese sauce separately and it had a good, mild cheese flavor.  My 5 year old liked it but did not ask for a second helping like he does with other Annie's products.We just switched from Annie's Gluten-Free Mac & Cheese (which was wonderful for being GF!) but I did not care for the flavor of Annie's Homegrown Classic.  I'm going to go back to Annie's Gluten-Free version even though we're not on a GF diet anymore.

I used to buy these in bulk and finally great tired of finding dried glue caked on the elbows in the box.  I've had the same problem with the shells from Annie's.  I contacted the company about this problem 3 times before receiving a brief reply informing me that I had nothing to be worried about and that the glue caked to the pasta in the box was not toxic.  Forgive me if I don't take anyone's word on that, and why would I want to eat glue anyway when I'm paying extra for a healthy alternative.  No thanks.  I buy Back To Nature mac & cheese products now and will remain with these as they have the added benefit of employing vegetarian friendly enzymes in their cheese culture, as opposed to Annie's which does not uses animal enzymes.

column9: Gluten-free macaroni has wheat in it
column10: This macaroni and cheese product was advertised on line as Gluten-freeMain ingredient is wheat. Couldn't get Amazon online to Complain about it.Ended up throwing all 12 boxes out in the trash. Didn't have room on the shelves for a product that would poison me.

This well packaged package of beef jerky tastes relative bland and is relatively tough and chewy, I rate it below average in all categories as it is a sub-par product even when compared to commonly marketed brands such as Jack Links. I definitely will not be buying this again, very disappointed.

column9: It is a  pleasure to do business with this company.
column10: Choo Choo R Snacks, Inc.Every time I order products from this company through Amazon:- They arrive sooner than promised, and- Are exactly what they described.What more could you want?It is a  pleasure to do business with this company.Gunner  October, 2010

We have purchased several different types of jerky from this company and we have been satisfied customers every time. The flavor variety is awesome and the flavor of each product itself is worth every penny you pay for it. This company stands behind its product as well as customer satisfaction. I haven't had the pleasure of dealing with a company like this in years. You won't be disappointed.

I don't know if I've ever hated a product more...I bought this because I wanted to see what all the fuss was about with the new coconut water fad. OMG. This stuff tastes like grass. It isn't sweet at all, it's bitter and...tastes and smells like wet hay. I gave it away to someone who claims they like it. My advice is to buy one single bottle at your local store. If you like it (and God bless you if you do) then go on Amazon and buy a case of it, because more than likely, it will be a much better deal than your local store. Love Amazon, hate the product. (shudder)

I call them this because I can't seem to keep the gumball machine full.  Gumballs are getting harder and harder to find.  The kids love these, they say they taste great.  They are sized to fit any gumball machine, and the package size would be great for small machines. I have them set up on Subscribe and Save, so I'm definately buying them again.

column9: Fresh quality assorted melt in your mouth gumballs
column10: These are great. Convenient sized packs. Arrived fresh and nicely assorted. No bad flavors, no aftertaste. Will definitely order again when I need a quick gumball fix.

These gumballs have an awesome flavor, similar to Juicy Fruit, however it lasts about five minutes and then it's gone. They were fresh and soft. The image shows a 6 ounce package but they are 4.5 ounce bags. Overall, not a bad product but I will not be a repeat customer with the flavor not lasting long enough. Also, if you are watching calories beware, a serving is one gum ball at a whopping 126 calories!
This item is reasonably priced, good flavor  but about 30%% of the gumbslls had rock hard shells. Mybe it's wad just that one bag I opened. I would still buy these again.
The crab arrived in two days, just in time for Mother's Day.  It was frozen solid.  Mom loved it...good job.

These cherries are fantastic! I think they were one of the only ones I found that did not have added sugar - super important to me.  They are tart, chewy, and moist.  Perfect.  I used them as mere, but delicious snacks and also in raw food desserts (Carob-Cherry Raw Brownie).  Highly recommend. :)

column9: Great Chocolate but cheaper at Target
column10: Target regularly sells the 14.1 ounce Toblerone bars for less than $6 each.  Beside the lower cost you don't have to buy 4 bars at a time.

Whats better then a Toblerone bar? How about a huge,14.1 ounce Toberone bar! Please Sir,I want some more.Creamy chocolate,crunchy almonds and chewy nougat. Sounds too good to be true,no? Its true and in gigantic form with these Toberone bars.Give them as gifts too. They make the perfect gift for the person who has everything all the way to your coworker who just broke up with her boyfriend.
excellent chocolate. Arrived on time. very pleased with purchase.Toblerone is a world class chocolate& I shortly will be ordering more.

These are much, much larger than the Toblerone's I get at Target or local stores.  I prefer the larger size and just break off a piece and eat that piece--I eat less at a time this way compared to buying the smaller one.  This is the exact same taste as you get in the smaller one.  I love it and feel that the chocolate is very good quality.  It seems to me that these larger ones have more honey and almond nougat than the smaller ones but maybe it is only because it is larger chunks so you can taste it better.  I prefer that to the smaller ones where the nougat is there but not as noticeable as it is in these.I have ordered these a couple of times--the most recent time temperatures were over 80 degrees and i was concerned it would be delivered and be melted.  It was not, it came in perfect condition.  However, I'm not sure I would risk it in the dead of summer and 100 degree temps.Enjoy

Toblerone Swiss Milk Chocolate with Honey and Almond Nougat, 14.1-Ounce Bars (Pack of 4)My favorite milk chocolate triangular bar!!! Never mind the small ones .... only the LARGEST size for this gal !!! Yummy!!

column4: Beverly J. Scott "Author and avid reader"
column10: Toblerone is the best chocolate I have ever eaten. The bits of almond and honey add a unique texture to the product and I am so impressed with the flavor of this chocolate that I am giving bars of TOBLERONE away as Christmas gifts. This Swiss milk chocolate is fabulous and they also have bars of White Chocolate and Dark Chocolate that are as delicous as the Swiss Milk Chocolate. TOBLERONE is the chocolate lovers bit of earthly heaven, definitly food for Angels.

column9: recieved items with a short expiry date
column10: I ordered different Toblerone Chocolates in large quantities and amazon shipped me most with like a 4-5 months expiry dates. If I had known then I would have ordered limited quantities.

column9: Good, but not as good as the duty-free bars found at the Paris airport (CDG)
column10: A friend of mine recently gave me a 400 gram bar as a gift that he had bought duty-free at the Paris airport (CDG), and I was hoping that by buying this chocolate I would get the same experience. Unfortunately, the chocolates simply didn't match. The one from Paris was much better. That's not to say this chocolate wasn't good, but it simply didn't have the same gourmet taste and feel.
I have bought these cookies at a local market near me and they are excellent. They are crunchy and delicious and the vegan tastes as good as the regular. Good to know they're now available online

column9: Unbeatably fresh, heavenly treats; amazing customer service.
column10: Please keep your eye out for the soon-to-arrive Marge's Bakery website ordering, as you cannot possibly go on in life without trying their Rosewater Snowball cookies. I've developed a cult-like obsession with these cookies simply because they are the most delicate, pure, aromatic, creamy, light, nutty crisp but smooth cookies to ever touch my lips. Sounds insane, but the most accurate comparison I could make to emphasize my fervor here is one's love for a perfect French macaron. Now did that make a little more sense? Further, if one of your favorite macaron flavors is rose, then you would DIE for this cookie, not because they resemble each other but because the lust simply goes hand-in-hand.I understand this particular Amazon item is featuring OTHER Marge's Bakery cookie varieties, but since the Rosewater Snowballs are so impossible to find, hopefully at least the cookie name will appear in an online search to give a glimmer of hope to other shoppers out there in my similar situation. My order was fulfilled by directly contacting the company, and the sweetest person (Jeanette) emailed me directly to tell my that my very own batch was being baked Monday and shipped out Tuesday. You can't get any more genuine than that--regardless of what this company sells, their degree of customer service is of the highest quality. An exquisite company...please don't short change yourself. If I were Oprah, I'd send MB to the moon by raving about them every single day to anyone that will listen (and taste).

These cookies are slightly soft-baked, and although I'm a vegetarian of over 10 years and can't stand meat, have been more than tempted to try these due to their delicious smell!  They have a wonderful herbally scent to them, and my dogs absolutely love them!  These cookies are easy to break and 100% grain free.  One of my dogs developed a problem with ALL grains, as well as poultry, and while "grain-free" doesn't include rye, oatmeal, etc., these are things that cause him to itch horribly,  so finds like these are wonderful!  As for the complaint below on the price (no comment about quality!), these are absolutely top notch, and are also devoid of dairy, something which I only give my dogs if they have diarrhea (which makes them quite constipated).  Overall, I'm quite happy with this find, and recommend it (and the beef tripe version) to picky dogs or dogs with specific food allergies!
The first day we got them was the first day they were gone like the wind....down the hatch and into the tummy

My dog and my sister's dog both go crazy for these treats! I love that the bison meat they use in here is liver, organ meat is very good for dogs, as is the rosemary and brewer's yeast.It was very hard to find a treat that didn't have anything in it that would bother my dog, these are grain-free and don't contain anything else he is allergic to (like poultry or tomato etc).Most other treats have too many ingredients, which leads to allergy issues, I love the limited ingredients in these.Very much well worth the price! I will continue to buy these as they are my dogs favorite, and so far are lasting pretty good, (giving about 1-2/day).

column9: My dog liked these but the price is not competitive
column10: I was feeding "Taste of the Wild" dog food to my new puppy because I wanted to make sure he got the most nutritious food. I bought a number of dog treats like these along the same line, and of course dogs will eat anything, however the cost is about double what I normally pay for such as Wellness WellBar Yogurt, Apples and Bananas Dog Treats, 20-Ounce Pouch. So I would not buy these again unless you have money to burn :)

Being from Pennsylvania, I grew up with these.  They are the best Irish Potato candy that you can buy.  These are the coconut fondant type.  Not many people realize that there are two basic types of this candy.  This kind, fondant, and one actually made from potatos.  Around St. Patrick's day, the stores are full of Oh Ryan's.As I have gotten older, I have started to make my own Irish Potatos, and homemade are always a little better than store bought.  I guess because there is that element of love that you can't buy.  But if you are not kitchen inclined, or if you have no idea what they should taste and look like, you can not go wrong buying Oh Ryan's.In cast you weren't aware, these candies have become a tradition at St. Patrick's day in order to remember the struggle of those who went through and those who died during the Irish Potato Famine of the 19th century.  Make sure that you talk to your kids about the Potato Famine and its impact on the Irish people and how it changed the United States.

column9: If you like cinnamon you will love this
column10: I purchased these to try something new. I like them but expected them to be softer. These are hard. I'm sure they are meant to be seeing as how they are supposed to be "potatoes". I'm glad I bought them but in the future I will only purchase as a novelty candy. I think these would be good with coffee...
My mother used to buy me a box of these every year for St. Patrick's Day. A wonderful, creamy confection. They came quickly and the quality is better than I remembered.
I bought these for my son's class.  The kids really enjoyed them.  It was something different that they never tried before.  A happy customer in Honolulu, Hawaii.

(Horrible title, I know)I just received my package of two boxes of these little potato-y sweets. These were suppose to be for a little St. Patty's Day potluck at work, but unfortunately the party was cancelled due to not many people wanting to contribute. However I'll still bring one box to work.The first thing I noticed upon opening the package was the smell. That wonderful cinnamon smell that makes me instantly think of Christmas. Second was the size, which surprised me a little. They were smaller than I thought they were, slightly smaller than a golf ball. When I opened a box the potato sweets felt a bit hard when I gently squeezed them, but they gave very easily when I bit down.The flavor.... It reminded me of a mix between a macaroon and a snickerdoodle. It was WONDERFULLY sweet (but not too sweet), soft, and with a light crunchiness from the coconut.I DEFINITELY recommend Oh Ryan's Irish Potatoes, and not just for St. Patty's Day. Get them anytime of the year! They're 100% worth it.

My daughter loves just about any flavor of the mashups by Revolution Foods. She hadn't tried the Beetbox Berry flavor before I ordered online (and 4 boxes at that). She gobbled it down in seconds! And this flavor seemed to be cheaper than the others. There are other brands of fruit puree's that my daughter will not eat, but anything by Revolution Foods she eats quickly, and sucks out every last drop!

I stumbled upon these at Target and picked up a box for my kids.  They absolutely loved them.  Realizing I could get a healthy dose of fruit and veggies into them when we're out and about intrigued me.  I came to Amazon and with Subscribe and Save, they were around $1 each.  TOTALLY WORTH IT.  We have bought several cases in various flavors since and my kids and their playmates just love them.  I'll continue to order them all for as long as they eat them.  I tried them too and they are delicious!

My 3 y.o. loves these. He considers them a treat, in fact. I love that he can get fruits and veggies on the go without any mess (I would never give him beets without a bib and without being strapped into a highchair)I also use these smoothies during winter months when strawberries are out of season.

column9: Great way to sneak in a veggie.
column10: I love these.  Not because I have eaten them but because my kids will eat them.  I get tired of the daily battle over veggies.  My preschoolers do fine with eating fruits and vegetables most of the time but it is nice to have something on hand for one of those times that you need to get dinner together fast or you are on the go and you want them to have both a fruit and veggie.  These fit perfectly into that scenario.  My boys will finish the entire pouch every time it is given to them.  Often they will want to have it first.  I like the fact that is appears to be a fruit smoothie but there is a vegetable in there.  Personally I love beets, but my kids have not acquired my love for beets so they eat the Beetbox berry without knowing what a beet is.  I also buy them on subscribe and save and sometimes find myself getting an extra shipment.  That tells you how much we like these.  We also like the Carroty Chop and Fruit Berry.  We have tried a few other versions of other brands - one with a Fairy Tale rabbit on it - they hated that one - but these by far are the most popular.

This flavor is super sweet. I usually have to ad it to a smoothie or mix it with another flavor for my toddler to eat it. It tasted like strawberry jelly. I was also disappointed with the lack of vitamins.

This prodcut was a hit from the first try! We have tried a number of way to get our little ones to eat fruits and veggies.  Mashup's Beetbox Berry reminds them of fruit juice, so its a good way to get their daily servings.  I recommand this prodcut.  A must try!

I really like the Mash Ups. I have tried other flavors and they are all equally tasty. I love foods that I can feel good about my kids eating and these are one of them. I love the fact that I'm sneaking in veggies that my kids wouldn't normally eat (beets) but they don't taste them!

We got one of these in a birthday party bag-of-treats and ever since have been buying these in bulk via Amazon.  In the stores like BabiesRUs they cost over $1 per pouch but on Amazon you can order 24 at a time and get around 70 cents per pouch.  I wish they sold them in higher quantities because they only are 4 per box which is a waste of packing materials - but at any rate it is worth it for the quality and nutrition of the snack.  We even have a song: "I'm a little fruit drink, short and stout, here is my pouch and here is my spout, when you get real thirsty hear me shout, put me in your mouth and suck me out!" and our 2 year old guzzles them.  Highly recommended!

My 19-month old daughter absolutely loves these and they are so convenient and an easy snack on the go or during a busy day. I would like to hug the person that first thought of these fruit/veggie pouches! It's a great way to get my toddler to eat vegetables (which she normally refuses, unless if they are peas!) and she loves fruit, so it is perfect!

column9: Healthy, no-mess snack for on the go
column10: We were recently introduced to these snack bags and as a mom of 3 active toddlers on the move - I love them.  I went to Target and bought singles of all different flavors/brands and tried them all to see what everyone liked.  The kids told me which ones they liked, and then I picked these for the mix of fruit AND veggies (as opposed to the just straight up fruit).  They are quick and healthy options for the kids when we are on the go.  I keep some in the car and in my purse for when hunger strikes.  As I said, I especially like these because they are made with vegetable puree in addition to the fruit.  With 3 toddlers, it can be hard to get them to eat their veggies - so I like that they at least get a little veggies in their snack.I rated 4 instead of 5 stars because they are on the expensive side, though Amazon still has one of the best prices I could find. We use subscribe & save, and eat them only a couple times a week for snack.

column9: I did not think babe would like these as much as he does
column10: I won't give my son anything I won't eat so I tried a bit of this.  You can definitely taste the beets and some fruit.  I thought my smarty son would turn up his nose, but he likes it.  So much so, he finishes a pack in about 8 seconds.  It's a great on-the-go snack for my little one.  I only wish they made more flavors with veggies.
My 3 year old eats beets!! I don't even eat beets.  Introduce these flavors to them early and you'll be sure to have a healthy eater.

column9: Great way to sneak fruit and veggies
column10: I purchase these through subscribe and save. My kids love them. They are a great way to incorporate fruit and veggies into their diet. They are also portable and great to throw in lunch boxes or picnic coolers. I love having them delivered to my door and not having to worry about running out.

I made my now 2.5 year old son's first baby foods, but quickly found that homemade purees weren't exactly easy to take out and about - they had to be kept refrigerated or frozen, then warmed to a comfortable temperature, then spooned into baby's mouth, or handed over to a toddler who enjoys tipping over bowls and banging messy spoons. Definitely more difficult than I wanted when trying to feed my little one on the go. I needed an easier option, and found it in these Mashups pouches. No utensils needed. No refrigeration needed (though they're great chilled, or even partly frozen, during the summer months). They even encourage independence in babies who can hold the pouches themselves for self-feeding. And of course, they're jam-packed with fruit and veggies and nothing else. Awesome! From a mom's point of view, how can you go wrong with a snack that's organic, natural, and so easy to bring on-the-go?I keep a stash of them in my diaper bag for when we're on-the-go, and I've been known to grab one for myself from time to time! But they're not just mom-approved. My son really enjoys these, too. He's been eating them since his baby days, and continues to love slurping them as snacks. I keep a bunch of them in a "snack basket" (along with cookies, crackers, and other goodies) - my little guy knows he can take something from there anytime he wants a snack. He brings me a pouch to open more often than he grabs cookies! His current favorite flavor is the Beetbox Berry "red ones!" but he enjoys all the Mashups flavors.Best of all, I get them here at Amazon with the Subscribe & Save discount - the price here can't be beat.

3 of my 4 children play sports, and I'm always on the hunt for healthy, portable snacks.  I always carry a box of these in my car and at least one in my purse for those moments when the children are hungry for a little snack.  They're absolutely delicious (I've tried them myself!), and they're so easy to carry around.  I can't tell you how many parents have inquired about where I buy them because they're so much healthier than candy, and other sugary snacks.

At this point, my family and I have cycled through all the PopCorners flavors. The Butter flavor was the last we tried. For those unfamiliar, PopCorners are sort of a popped corn chip- they are an interesting combination of a Frito with a rice cake, but absolutely flat and crispy. However, the texture and the flavor makes them seem incredibly indulgent. They are really delicious, not your typical dry, crumbly, cut-the-roof-of-your-mouth with sharp corners healthy chips.The butter flavor is good. I don't personally think it tastes like popcorn, but my husband and daughter do. Maybe popcorn that was, like, roasted over a fire. But, wow are these salty! I'm all about saltiness but I have to admit, I wonder if these aren't a tad *too* salty. However, I would still choose them over the other snack we have in the pantry- Pirate's Booty, whole grain chips, cheddar rice cakes, pretzels, etc.I like the butter, and will happily munch my way through the pack of 40 snack bags we purchased throughout the next month, but my favorite PopCorner flavor is hands down SeaSalt.

My husband has diverticulosis and had to give up popcorn - we tried this, we LOVE it!!  So far we've tried the Butter and Kettle flavors... Butter's the best!  Has the same great flavor as movie popcorn :)

The Medora Snacks Popcorners Popped Corn Chips, Butter taste just like popcorn. The chips are a great combination of the crunchy chip and popped corn. They have a hint of butter and salt, but they are not greasy nor too salty. I also enjoyed the Medora Snacks Popcorners Popped Corn Chips with Sea Salt, 1.1-Ounce Packages (Pack of 40), especially with salsa.

column9: My husband is addicted to these!!
column10: GReat snacks, just the right sized package.  Good crunch, not too salty.  All in all a very good product.  They sell the HUGE bags of these at costco sometimes, but then you eat too many at a time.

column9: Medora Snacks Popcorners Popped Corn Chips, Butter, 1.1
column10: Medora Snacks Popcorners Popped Corn Chips, Butter, 1.1 BagsWay to much Salt ruined the flavor. Will not buy again. Zero stars.Nutrition Facts:140 Calories a bag.Total fat 3.5g.Saturated fat zero.Trans fat zero.Cholesterol zero.Sodium 310g a bag.Total carbohydrates 23g.Dietary fiber less than 1 gram.Sugar 1g.Protein 2g.

We could no longer find these chips at our local grocery store,so having them arrive at our door was sure was tempting. Shipment took longer than expected,about two weeks. When they finally arrived all of the different flavors were stale.  We have been working our way thru the box tossing them in our bags for lunches.  Too bad the cats aren't interesting in helping us out.

column9: Became one of my favorite sncak
column10: I tried on Jetblue airline and liked it.What do you know amazon has it.I liked it better when I realized there are many flavors available.

Medora Popcorners are so delish. I bought it in the butter flavor and couldn't be happier. It has a crispy chip like crunch while satisfying both your popcorn and chip craving packed in with butter and saltiness. This is my new go to snack. Calorie serving per bag isn't too bad either @ 140 cals per 1.1 oz. LOVE!

I ordered these not knowing what truly to expect.  They taste like buttered popcorn but a bit saltier than I like at this time.  (Watch my sodium intake to some degree).  If you like salty buttered popcorn you are going to like these.  The price is very good.  I plan on trying one of the other flavors.Medora Snacks Popcorners Popped Corn Chips, Butter, 1.1-Ounce Packages (Pack of 40)

These popped chips from Pop Corners are amazing!  The butter flavor is mouth watering and is a great snack for the gluten free diet.  My kids love these chips as do I.  Would highly recommend this product.
These are great chips for those looking for low-fat products.  If you like Popcorn, then you should like these.  They taste so much like popcorn that it even satisfies my popcorn craving.

column9: Yummy and "ALMOST" like buttered popcorn at the movies
column10: I LOVE the very unhealthy buttered popcorn the theaters sell.  I rarely go to the movies but will go inside and order the large tub with extra butter --- yum. So when I saw this product and read the reviews, I thought I should at least give it a try.  Well it came today.  I opened the first little package and it smelled like buttered popcorn.  I tasted it and it had that flavor.  Of course it isnt dripping with the fake butter that theaters use, but these are very good.  I also like the crunchiness -------- hmmm break them up and use for a coating or topping on a casserole.  Anyway I have now ordered the white cheddar and the kettle.  I will make a review on the other two as soon as I get them.
Amazon is the greatest market place on earth - these chips are absolutely amazing! Plenty of popcorn crunch in a potato chip - what more could you ask for!
great treat. just bought these for my girlfriend. much cheaper than the popcorners website.  cant beat this price. recommended over potato chips all day

column9: Yummy, but Salty and Lots of Whey !
column10: I love the taste and the gentle crunch of Popcorners, but the Butter flavor has lots of whey, salt and other ingredients that over do the really lovely taste of the "chip."  I'm one of those people who don't do well with Whey and if you are too, consider the sea salt version which is my favorite.  They are less salty, and contain only corn, oil and sea salt, no extra additives.What I do love completely, is the size of this little bag. It's perfect for a snack, great for a car trip, and just the right amount. And the cost is just over $.40 per bag for a healthy yummy snack.If Whey's not an issue for you, you will probably enjoy the taste of the Buttered version as it is very close to the taste of movie theater buttered popcorn.
Very tasty product...and low fat and natural. I have tried most of their flavors and like them all. Will buy again.
I first ate these on a Jetblue flight and I was hooked. I was thrilled to see them here on Amazon. I bought them for my wedding gift bags. Cute size and super yummy. I had to eat one. Opps. :D

This is the perfect snack for people who need gluten free on the run snacks, however, the sodium is 330 per serving, making it too high in salt for me.  The sad part is they dont need that much salt, the product woluld be great with half that amount.  I ended up feeding mine to the squirrels.

I cannot eat popcorn. I was looking for a suitable substitute. I thought these might do the trick after reading the reviews. Had to throw them away. Other people may like them but for me they taste pretty much like stale cardboard. Worst snack I have ever tasted.

I ordered a few of these treats for my small dogs, and they love them. I will order more of these yummy treats. They help freshen breath and are a nice green color. The item is as described, and your dog will love these. I usually get these at, Petsmart. However, I saw them on Amazon and decided to order them online instead. I am happy with this purchase, and so are my dogs.
I am a bit confused by this product.  It is advertized as a single piece, yet the price is $35, something you would expect from a box of 100.  Why? Am I misreading something?

My white American wife thinks this furikake (dry Japanese condiment) is delicious, my two Chinese girls enjoy the rice seasoning, and of course the Japanese in me finds this stuff to be da' bomb. Although the product is actually produced in China, we would never had known had we not read the label. The ingredients include sesame seed, horse radish, shaved bonito (a relative of the tuna), Japanese mustard plant, sugar, chopped seaweed, soy sauce, salt, and cooking rice wine. Despite the horse radish and Japanese mustard plant ingredients, it is not spicy. It actually has a slightly sweet fish flavor that I recommend sprinkling on your rice and rice balls.

column9: Awesome Gum, I seen better prices!!!
column10: For example, Walmart sells this gum 45 pieces (15 pieces * 3 pack) for $1.75; therefore, if you do the math, 300 pieces would cost you around $11.67 =)P.S. This is my favorite gum!!!
This is my favorite gum. It has a great taste and keeps your breath fresh for a whole hour. I love this stuff! Plus it is sugar free.

column9: This is the only gum I buy
column10: This is the only gum I buy.  Great fresh taste to make your breath nice and it last a long time.  I've been buying this gum for at least 10 years now.

Don't know when it started but I have become an avid gum chewer and although I've tried other brands, Extra is definitely the best. You can chew for hours and hours and it never dissolves like the other brands. I buy in bulk from Amazon because it's the best deal that I have found and although the other flavors are great, nothing beats polar ice and it leaves your breath smelling great and your mouth just feels cleaner. Definitely BuY!!!
This gum is very strong, minty, and tastes great!  It's sugar free and I think it is dentist reccomended too...
This is Way cheaper than buying it in a store and I buy 2 of these every time I order and then I live off of it for a couple months.  This is a great deal and saves me a lot of money!

column9: This gum is great, I'm addicted.
column10: I'm a dentist and I recommend this product!Not only is the flavor great and long lasting but chewing sugar-free gum such as Extra Polar Ice can have a positive effect on your teeth especially after meals.  It works by stimulating salivary flow which has a cleansing effect by washing away food debri and plaque acids that can cause cavities.Enough of the techno-babble, I've been chewing this flavor of extra for close to 10 years and recommend it to anyone.
The gum was fresh. It was delivered on time. It was a little cheaper buying it here then it is in the stores. Very satisfied.

column9: One of the top two brands of Decaf K-Cups
column10: If you like your coffee a little stronger than mid-strength, this one is for you!  You would never know this is decaf coffee.  I'm a very fussy coffee drinker - too weak = bla;  too strong = bitter and undrinkable.Tully's coffee as a rule is a little stronger then the GM brand, overall. Typically 'House' blends don't mean a whole lot to me, but this one is exceptional.  Not bitter, not watery, wonderful aroma. The only other decaf brand I would ever recommend is Emeril's. All the other brands are too weak for me.My husband can only drink decaf and we tried every, single brand when we were switching from ground coffee to the K-cup.  This is the only one he liked - and he doesn't like strong coffee and I don't like weak coffee - WE BOTH LOVE THIS ONE!  (finally we agree on something)Enjoy!

I bought Tully's Decaf House Blend Coffee K-Cups in bulk, originally on E-Bay, because of a really good deal. I hadn't tried it before, and was worried that I had made a big mistake, buying it. I was supprised after my first cup, at it's strength, and full bodied flavor. It is now my most favorite k-cup coffee. I was never into "Decaf" before, and I feel that this coffee will make, both Decaf and Regular coffee drinkers alike, very happy. Don't hessitate to try this blend, you will not be sorry.

I am a very fussy coffee drinker and this is, without any doubt at all, the best of the decafs available.  You feel like you've had a 'real' cup of coffee.......not too weak, not too strong, but with a rich look and taste.  No one, on a dare, could ever tell that this isn't regular coffee or 'high-test' as I like to call it.  For the record, I've tried many different brands and Tully in general is always very good.
This is the best decaf I have tasted in K-cups. Perfect cup of coffee, you would have to read the package to know it was decaf, full rich flavor, no bitterness.

This is by far my favorite evening cup, you would have to be a very discerning drinker to even know its decaf. Tully's coffees are always superior quality and this is no exception, full-bodied but not overpowering like most french roast decafs.

It is difficult to find a good tasting decaf coffee. Often it's due to lack of selection and or attempt to please too many tastes. I tend to go for a strong yet "un-smoky" cup of coffee. Not too many decafs fit that bill. While this could be even a bit stronger for me it has the most body and flavor balance I've found in decaf yet...in traditional or K-Cup varieties.

column9: Best decaf I've found so far
column10: I switched to decaf for health reasons.  I love coffee so the switch was difficult for me.  I have to say that this decaf is pretty good.  I've tried other brands (donut shop decaf, etc.) and they aren't as good.  This tastes almost like regular coffee.

column9: The Best Cup of Decaf Coffee
column10: I only drink decaf coffee, and having tried at least 12 other brands, this is one of my three favorites!  It's got a bold flavor, without being bitter, and it doesn't get lost when I add flavored creamer. Some of my 'regular only' friends couldn't tell that it was decaf.

I purchased Tully's Decaffeniated House Blend 24-count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers.  They open up around the top seal when brewing and the coffee grounds get into the coffee and also make a mess inside the machine.  Unless you want to strain your coffee and clean your entire machine after each use do not purchase this product.

Although the flavor of the coffee is good, the K-cup is not properly sealed.  The cover seal breaks when brewing, resulting in coffee grounds in the brewed coffee and coffee coffee grounds in the Keurig brewer.  This necessitates a thorough cleaning of the brewer each time a new K-cup is used.  I ordered and received two boxes of Tullys House Blend.  I have not opened the second box because of the inferior seal on the K-cup.

column9: K-Cup foil not sealed and hot coffee spurts out all over
column10: We purchased two 24-count packages of Tully's House Decaf. Obviously something went wrong in manufacturing of these K-Cups.  After we began the brew cycle, very hot coffee came out over the top of the K-Cup and the compartment in many directions and only a portion of it went into our mug below.  Thinking it was only a problem with that one, we tried another.  When it happened again, we investigated more closely.  The foil seal over the top of the K-Cup is not complete.  Very hot water under pressure inside the K-Cup was forced up and out, along with coffee grounds, and sprayed quite a distance from the machine. Our Keurig is in the bedroom - what a mess!
The coffee package leeks out all over machine wial brewing.Not a good manufacturing job.the coffee is good, what ever gets into your cup.
Really smooth and mild. Great for the older folks that come to visit that do not want a "rough" cup of coffee.

This is a great deal on a great coffee. This blend is just right for a morning beverage, the taste will give you a jolt but caffeine won't. Well worth the price and with fast deliver. Hard to find a better deal on k-cups.
i was looking for an affordable k cup decaf for when i want coffee without the caffeine. this one is very tasty.  just like their regular coffee.  plus affordable when ordering through amazon.  [...]

I had to switch to decaf several years ago due to an ulcer. We recently purchased a Cuisinart kcup brewer. I had been having quite a time finding a great tasting decaf kcup. I ordered a sample pack from another site and it contained one of the Tully's. It was sooo good, I can't begin to tell you how excited I was!I hopped online in search of the best price for the quantity on these kcups! I found it here.This coffee reminds me of a warm, nutty toasty regular cup of joe that I used to get at a local restaurant!

I drink decaf when I drink coffee at night and I've settled on this as the best I've tasted. Most of the others were OK and I don't expect a decaf coffee to taste was good as a regular coffee. But, for my taste buds this works.BTW, Tully's Kona is my top regular coffee.

These K-cups come unsealed around the edges during use, and as a result cause coffee and grounds to spew everywhere. Because of this, I tend to get a cupful of grounds which is not drinkable, thus I can't comment on the taste/strength of the coffee.

column9: Pods explode making a huge mess!
column10: Many of these exploded making a huge mess with grounds spewing in and out of the cup and onto the counter.After the first one I thought maybe there was one bad one.  I have seen it before with Green Mountain brand but rarely,  Maybe one out of 10 boxes.After the third one exploded I tossed the remainder in the trash.

I bought this item because it was significantly discounted.  Since I received it I have had several of the K-cups break when punctured during dispensing.  This is a very big pain to have to clean up.  I am wondering how I can get my money back because I am not willing to use the 20 cups I have left.

I have yet to have one cup of this coffee brew properly.  Always leaves grounds in the cup an about have of the time the thing blocks the coffer maker and blows grounds all over the coffee maker and counter.  This is the only brand I have had this problem with and threw away about 40 K cups rather than clean the mess.

We buy a lot of K-cups for our Keurig, typically going through about 4-6 a day. We often buy various ones to satisfy different tastes.This is the only brand that we have purchased that has given us problems. Not only have the k-cups exploded, leaving grounds all over the machine both inside and out, but every single k-cup in the two 24-count packages has done this. At first, we thought we just received a bad batch in one of the two packages that was a part of the order, but when the k-cups in both of the packages did this for k-cup after k-cup (there wasn't a single one that did not explode and leave coffee ground in the coffee mug, machine, or outside of the machine), we knew it wasn't a fluke.Since there is no return on food...buyer beware.

About 40% of the tops of the KCups explode and come off in the coffee maker, ruining the cup of coffee and leaving grounds everywhere.  POOR quality control!!  For the few that work, the coffee is great.In complete fairness, when notified, Amazon quickly replaced the order with outstanding customer service.

column9: Good tasting coffee, poor quality k-cups
column10: I just want to chime in with the other reviewers who noted the poor quality of these k-cups. Half of the k-cups I purchased explode in my coffee machine because the foil over the top of the cup is not sealed properly. Not only is it disappointing and a waste of money, it's a real pain to clean your machine after an explosion of coffee grounds. This is unfortunate because I think Tully's has the best quality coffee, particularly decaf, you can find out there in k-cups right now. I heard Starbucks is going to get in the k-cup business at some point. Hopefully sooner than later.

Coffee rich and strong no problem. However about half broke open during the brewing process,getting grounds in my coffee and all over.  Obviously a defect in top cup seal packaging. Eventually I cut off the bottom of the cup and it relived the pressure so as to not blow seal.

I've had several of these pods "explode" while brewing.  The tops are flat instead of having that nice "poof-dome" top.  Normally love the Tully's House De-caf.  I will not order from this seller again.

I need to drink more decaffeinated coffee. Thus, I tried this product out for my Keurig coffee maker. And I have thoroughly enjoyed the experiment! Some of the K-cup blends that I have tried are terrific, some are okay, and some don't have much taste. This product is closer to the good end of that continuum than to the bad end.It is labeled "extra bold." Perhaps not quite so. Still, it does have a rich taste and is a delightful way to begin the day.So, I am a satisfied customer and intend to keep drinking this particualr brand.

column9: One of the Best decaf K-Cups around!!
column10: I love to have a cup of coffee at night but I'm always leery of how caffeine might affect me.  Tully's Decaf House Blend is perfect!!  During the day I drink Newman's Own Organic Special Blend and in the evening I have a cup of Tully's.  While they don't taste exactly alike (Tully's is a little weaker, I'd say) it's still a great alternative.  It's so hard to find a good decaf and I'm thrilled that I finally found one!!  It's fairly strong and bold but not skunky or overpowering in it's flavor.  I highly recommend it!!

I really dont like Decaff coffee but I gotta say.. this one was REALLY GOOD!! it surprised me.. Maybe its just me, but some decaff brands have a watered down taste.. Not the case here.. Tullys decaff house blend has a nice Robust flavor, no acidic after taste at all..I felt like I was drinking regular coffee. As a matter of fact, Im gonna have a cup right now. Cheers!!

column9: Tully's House Blend k-cup Decaf coffee
column10: We like this for our decaf coffee. It is smooth, good flavor, no bitterness, no acidic taste.

I was recently told that I need to consume products that have less caffeine; so I have one to two caffeinated products earlier in the day and decaf products for the remainder of the day.  The product is very good.
I bought this coffee on the strength of the reviews and they were dead on.  Excellent coffee!
This is a great decaf K-cup.  It has a nice coffee taste which many decafs do not have.  I mix a Tully's decaf and a Tully's French Roast for a great cup of coffee in the morning.
This is the best tasting coffee. You will like it even if you enjoy regular coffee.

I am under strict medical orders to avoid all caffeine and I have been searching for a great decaf for the past few months. I went out on a limb and tried this based on the feedback so far and I am VERY happy with that decision. This really tastes like regular coffee! I even gave a cup to my husband without telling him what it was and he couldn't believe it when I told him that it was decaf. Amazon has the best price around too.

column9: I'd give them 5 stars if they didn't open while brewing
column10: This is very good coffee, but nearly every one of these k-cups ends up opening at the top around the rim while brewing and leaves coffee grounds in the machine and also in my coffee cups. My wife and I have been through several boxes of these and it has been the same with every order. We haven't had this problem with any other brand of k-cups. We won't be ordering any more of these until we see from the reviews that this is no longer a problem.

column9: Wish I had reviews - having problems with this
column10: Tase is good, not as bold as I prefer. But I love strong coffee.  But the reason I cannot give 5 stars is THREE times now I have had a brewing problem that I have not had with other brands.  TWO TIMES, the coffee went all over the brewing part and not a straight shot into the cup.  Today, I noticed several grains in my cup, so rathr than waste a cup, I strained it through a filter and enjoyed my cup.  I have bought Tully's before, but nt from this seller. Wonder why the problems so many of us are reporting?

column9: You would NEVER know this is Decaf!
column10: This coffee is absolutely wonderful if you like a strong full-bodied coffee that has no bitterness whatsoever and nothing but a wonderful deep coffee flavor. I was very pleasantly surprised the first time I ordered this amazing coffee and I have been buying it ever since. I have never been disappointed. It is truly bold and flavorful and when i serve it to friends they don't have a clue that it is decaf and most can't believe it until I show them the container!
Although the price was great on the decaffeinated Keurig K-Cups, about 50% of them were not properly sealed and caused coffee explosions as they brewed.

I ordered these k cups by mistake, I meant to order the Tully's decaf French Roast, which I love.  This coffee is even better!  I usually don't care for house roasts, I was even really disappointed when I opened the Amazon box and realized my mistake.  I decided to try it instead of sending it back and I'm glad I did!  I like a darker and richer cup of coffee, and this one is nice and dark and very smooth.  It's not watery like many decaf coffees and it doesn't taste like the donut shoppe type coffees that I really dislike that decaf coffee always seems to taste like.  It also makes an excellent iced coffee on the smallest setting on the Keurig B70 Platinum.  I sometimes make iced coffee on the 5-1/4 cup setting and it still comes out pretty strong.  It's really the perfect decaf coffee.  Even better than at the coffee house!  You will not be disappointed!

This is one of the better decaf brews I have found for the Keurig.  I found others to be bland and leave somewhat of an aftertaste.  One I tried (San Francisco) had very poor packaging with cloth bottom so the coffee would go stale.I highly recommend this (I'll sure order it again).
I just bought Tully's from Bed and Bath Beyond and have not had any trouble with the cups. Brewing fine each time.

Our negative rating is not about the coffee, but rather the k-cups construction.  The top was  not securely attached to the plastic cup and every cup had hot coffee spurting all over that section of our kitchen.  Of course after the first two mishaps, we just held an oversized cup up close to the bottom of the dispenser.  I hope they enhance their quality control and fix this problem because it was not just one cup.  It was every one in box.

column9: Bad k cups on Tullys Coffee
column10: We have purchase Tullys Coffee Decaffeniated KCups from Amazon for over a year and this is the first time we have had this problem. column9: So much better than the store brands; great value too
column10: I purchased this product out of curiosity -- to see if it would work differently (or as well) in my homemade yogurt than the instant powdered milk. And oh, yes, there's a big, big difference -- in taste and consistency (in the liquid milk *and* the yogurt). Based on the cost of instant dry milk around here (GA), it's quite a bit less expensive too -- you use less of it to make a quart than with instant.While I've heard that this form of milk is harder to mix, I didn't find it that much different from reconstituting the instant version, except that I needed to use warm water instead of cold. I did have a first trial that gave, ahem, unexpected results. ((YMMV, of course -- but if you end up needing to use a whisk, and plan to use the milk for yogurt, you might get an interesting "bubble effect" texture in the finished product. :))On my next experiment, also with warm water (just under 120 degrees), a few rounds of patient (slow) spoon-stirring was all it seemed to take -- I just waited a minute in between stirings. In each case, adding the nearly-room-temperature starter-yogurt made the temperature just right for the yogurt-maker. (If you use warm water and plan to use the milk for drinking, you'll want to refrigerate until chilled -- in other words, plan ahead.)So again, the mixing process is a little different, but not that much different -- and the results are very much worth the little bit of extra care. To me, the chilled liquid tastes as good as regular milk from the store -- I didn't think I'd ever say that about powdered milk!Just a couple of downsides to mention, though they're minor:- I wish there were mixing directions on the package -- how much powder to use to how much water. But I eventually found ballpark directions on the Internet. I used about a cup of powder and a bit over 3 cups of water to make a quart of yogurt, but it turned out so thick, I'll probably try a little less next time.- While the product packaging doesn't say this, I suspect this form of milk is the kind without the added Vitamins A & D that most store milks have. I get plenty of these vitamins from other sources, so it's not a deal breaker for me. It might be for you.

Even though I just did a review for Barry Farm, which is a highly reputable supplier, for their INSTANT non-fat dry milk powder... I ACTUALLY prefer the NON-instant dry milk powder.One reviewer sought for their ingredient list. I pointed out that the ingredient list IS actually (the label) on the package; the product is simply dry milk powder (whether instant, as in that case, or non-instant in this one).I added: The fact these powders taste sweet may also be a very good indication they products are FRESH. Since any dry milk only has a 6-month shelf life, you seldom want to purchase large quantities. Only buy quantities you will use within 6 months. Whereas, any classic off-taste people dislike about powdered milk is when the dry milk is old.Another reviewer stated she makes superior YOGURT with non-instant powdered milk, which I do too.(Tips & Techniques...)For any who wish for information how to reconstitute this product.Combining 2 1/2 Tbsp NON-instant powder with 1 cup water = 1 cup milk (should be correct).The easiest way to blend, is with an immersion blender. Amazon offers one by Cuisinart, at an affordable price see Cuisinart CSB-77 Smart Stick Hand Blender with Whisk and Chopper Attachments.I wish to add that I also make Better Baking Buttermilk (aka: BBB) with non-instant powdered milk, to make much better breads! For more cooking tips and techniques, simply do a search for my name Sharon Anne, i.e. cooking and sharonanne.

I wondered when Amazon might get around to offering this product. I've loved eating these basic fried and dehydrated noodles for decades, and will be glad to order them by the case. These simple noodles are great with tons of Tabasco--quick and satisfying.The instructions are plain silly, though. My family has always prepared these noodles this way: 1. boil water in a pot, 2. add in the soup base, 3. add in the noodles, and then cook them together till the noodles are soft enough to eat (I like them slightly undercooked). Cooking the noodles in the soup base makes them taste better. Do not overcook, and do not let noodles sit in soup for too long while eating (e.g., longer than half an hour), or noodles will become too soft and fat.Then I pull the noodles out first and douse them with hot sauce--so the hot sauce will cling to the noodles as well as the soup--and then pour in the soup. That vinegary Tabasco taste mixed with the salty noodles and soup is very good. The noodles are also good with an egg--cracked into the pot after the soup base, and cooked together with the noodles.

The Sapporo noodles are more expensive than the ones you find at the local supermarket, but they are also a notch above the cheaper brands. The noodles do not bloat up and get mushy when boiled. As a consequence, the cooked noodles have a pleasant Al dente bite. The spice pack is pretty delicious, and I frequently boil some frozen dumplings from Trader Joe's when I make these noodles. The price offered on Amazon is really awesome. My local supermarket is selling these for $1 per pack.To be healthy:(a) throw away the spice pack. These noodle spice packs, any brand, are high in sodium, fats, MSG.(b) boil noodles and throw away the water. These noodles, any brand, are coated with a waxy substance to protect their freshness. They will come out when you boil it- so pour away the water. The noodles will taste better too.

These don't stay in stock too long so buy them when they are available.  I waited for a year before Amazon started stocking these.  They are 25% cheaper than the local supermarket.Great quality and not your typical Ramen noodle.  Once you have these, you'll never go back to the 10 for a $1 Ramen noodles (unless you are in college).

And of course none of these instant noodles tastes anywhere near as good as the ramen in a half decent Japanese restaurant.
Great classic ramen....but go find a Korean Grocery near you (they are every where)In a Korean Grocery you can get one box for $10.

column9: Not just for the dorm, anymore.
column10: Love this brand and flavor of ramen. The upper tier, of this sort of food. I only ding it one star, because I have yet to see it available for Subscribe and Save. Anyways, still a better deal than I can get in the Brick & Mortar stores. So, there's that, I suppose . . .

These are the best ramen noodles you can buy. They are FANTASTIC. I could almost eat them every day. I have been eating them for over 20 years so for me they are totally comfort food. My favorite thing to add to them is an egg. Just crack in an egg while the noodles are cooking. It is also fun to add any leftover meat you have in the fridge, just slice it up and put it on top.

The soup base is too weak and naive. Yea, Japanese ramen is good but what I mean by that is the real ramen you can get in Japan.As to instant ramens, Korean ones are much better.

Well, first got this from grocery at a premium price. Ordered from amazon and saved some cash. Just as tasty and definitely worth it. This product was one of the contributing factors that led to getting a prime membership.

Great item for a quick meal which is extremely affordable. As dry soups go, this is by far the most flavorful and filling. Add your favorite meat,seafood...AMAZING!!! Most stores no longer sell it, Im so glad AMAZON does!!!!
GREAT ramen! Make sure you have a big soup bowl because these noodles are way bigger then most and won't fit into a small bowl. Add some beef or veg to knock it up another notch.

i usually buy this when amazon has it on sale.  cheaper than my local grocery store and walmart quit selling it too

I love ramen noodles, from boyhood to my late twenties.  I love adding veggies to the mix and makes for an easy lunch or quick and dirty dinner.  Try throwing a couple hot dogs in as well, you won't regret it. :P

These are very good.  They taste much better than the grocery store variety.  They are so good, by daughter requested that I order more.  One time I ate a whole block of noodles without cooking them.  They were quite tasty...most likely due to the high salt content.
Great noodles. Just like the ones in the store. Got mine from Amazon.com as seller.

column9: The soup base is key to this ramen!
column10: I prepare this ramen like most of you except I drain the 2 cups of water the noodles are boiling in. I prepare another pot that heats up the soup separately and after draining the noodles (because the water gets starchy and the soup has a cloudy look to it) I pour the soup over the noodles with bean sprouts, chinese red pork (char siu)or left over beef steak or spam cut up into bits that will fit on my chinese soup spoon. Bits of spam is one of my favorite meats to eat with because its saltiness gives the soup base another dynamic flavor along with Tobasco Sauce. When eaten with chinese red pork there's another tasty dimension and leftover steak (usually NY or rib eye) makes for a hefty beefy brothy change. Sprinkle fresh cut green onions and I don't know how you can go to a Pho' shop. When I use the chinese red pork I keep it out of the soup till it is joined with the noodles otherwise your broth turns a not so appetizing red. Snap peas, bean sprout, cabbage and any of your other crunchy vegetables will make this dish fit for a King.  One improvement I wish Sapporo Ichiban would make is: add about 10-20% more noodles. 2 packages is a bit more than my bowl or my stomach can take but I find myself running out of noodles and the meat, vegetables and broth populate the bottom of the bowl.  I've been having this for breakfast every day during a work week for the past 3 years I believe and wonder when I'll break this culinary habit. I've alternated my meats and vegetables around this Ichiban dish which probably has me thinking that I'm getting a variety making my obsession last this long. I guess the change to french toast and bacon on the weekends has helped.  Of course, you know that in Hawaii it is called Saimin. After a high school game, dance or event we would head over to the Saimin House in Kalihi and along with Teriyaki sticks would wolf down a large bowl. Of course now its a Pho' shop that we eat noodles at huh? Sorry it isn't the same.

These do taste better than the cheap brands like Maruchuan, and you get a slightly larger (3.5oz block), but these are WAY more expensive.  I've seen them in local Wal-Marts for a slightly lower price.  Overall they do have a good flavor, not too salty or mushy.

These to Me Are Simply the Best,With cabbage..without..With louisiana hot sauce,crushed red pepper,Green onions,soy sauce,not all at once just one at a time ..cause i like to mix it up a bit.The taste is out of this world!been eating this brand since i can remember.Amazon Rocks for selling these by the box,Versus a dollar or more per package at the local grocery or asian markets here in new mexico.I thinks i have struck me some Ramen Gold!!!

Have been enjoying these noodles for years. The Thai, Korean and Vietnamese versions are but pale comparisions.  Nooodles are best when water is brought to a high rolling boil, the noodles dumped in, the sauce pan covered and allowed to steep for about 1 1/2 minutes.  Then pour contents into a bowl where you have already dumped in the flavor envelope. Stir, let stand for about a half minute and then enjoy without adding anything else.John Hyatt
Sapporo Ichiban is the benchmark of ramen noodles.  I learned about this product in Japan in the 60's and have been eating it ever since.

column9: The best basic ramen noodle out there
column10: Nearly every day for my work lunch, I eat 1/3 of a ramen noodle packet, embellished with some leftover grilled meat and tons of vegetables from home. I was excited to see this available on Amazon.  I used the bag and was happy with the product.  I am not sure I would buy it again only becaue I am not that much of a bread maker.

column9: A reliable brand for gluten-free flours
column10: Authentic Foods is a reliable brand for gluten-free flours and starches, including this potato starch.  I generally use this with other flours in recipes, but it also works on its own as a coating for fried chicken, onion rings and similar foods . . . although potato starch by itself tends to give a bit of a white cast to fried foods.

This is one of the best k-cup coffees I have tried. Rich smooth flavor. I love it. For those that say "it is not a K-kup" are off base. This is the second box that I ordered. My husband and I love it.  It is rich and bold. Being it was so good, we went ahead and tried the decafe as well.Much to our surprise, it was just as good. You can't beat the price for either one of them. I would recommend it to anyone!Pat C.

this coffee is excellent and the price can't be beat the cup looks different from most kcups but it works perfect and is really good coffee.I have it on auto shipments and that makes it even a better buy. Try it you'll love the taste and value

column9: Simply The Best "K Cup" Cup Around
column10: I'm a serious coffee drinker. I like it strong, rich and interesting. My wife prefers a good but milder variety. We've tried many, many K-Cup varieties and found several one or the other of us enjoys, but until now none that pleases us both. Ready in minutes. At a fair price. Doesn't that beat all? :)
This is the best coffee we have ever had - made for the keurig brewers. The flavor is very full bodied with NO bitterness.
I am not a coffee drinker but my wife says it's some of the best coffee she has tasted. She also likes the more compact size and the fact that they are more biodegradable.
I know organic has a different taste, but this is bad. Couldn't get even one cup down. I won't buy again.

The least expensive KCups I've found, and very good coffee! I was skeptical about auto-ship, but since I can modify my order as needed, it turns out to be a no-brainer for me. I HIGHLY recommend this product.

I have subscribe to these to get that extra discount which makes them a not bad price compared to others one cups. As most others have pointed out this is not a true K-cup as the base in not plastic.
