Under $200.We always carry Xyloburst chewing gum as well as one other flavor of Xylitol chewing gum everywhere with us now. Xyloburst has more Xylitol in it and it really tastes GREAT!Worth every penny spent on it! A great buy!

column9: Has artificial flavor and titanium dioxide (NOT listed in ad)
column10: I inadvertently purchased this product instead of Spry brand (my sister - unfamiliar with unhealthy additives - had purchased XyloBurst and the name must've stuck in my brain when I went to reorder my usual Spry and I got the two confused).It's very irritating when these items sold on Amazon do NOT contain the product label listing the ingredients.  This forces quality/health-concious individuals to waste valuable time locating this information on the web.  (I've learned that if it's not listed in their ad to just keep on moving because every product I've ever had to FIND the information myself ended up being something I would NOT buy.  Quality manufacturers proudly 'boast' their ingredients.  Some do that as well as proudly list the 'unsavory' ingredients NOT in their product.)Other than having ARTIFICIAL flavors and TITANIUM DIOXIDE, it DOES have Xylitol and a robust cinnamon "flavor" but I'll be sticking with the Spry brand.

I love a balsamic reduction, but find it too time consuming to make very often. For everyone who may be like I was a couple of years ago, this is balsamic vinegar that has been simmered until much of it evaporates, making it very thick. It is this thickness that makes it stick to everything, not just run off like regular balsamic. I have used it in pasta salads, caprese salad, and tonight I made bruschetta that I could not sit still to eat. I have never written a review for Amazon in the many years I've shopped here, but felt I must speak up about this product.It will be a staple in my kitchen for as long as it is made. Hopefully it is never discontinued!

Absolute rip off - I was NOT sent the item as stated and pictured.  I was sent the Creme Latte; which you can purchase at your local supermarket for $6.50.I did not want the Maxwell House Creme Latte; I wanted the original Maxwell House Latte.They are now arguing via email with me; even though my order quite clearly states the product shown for sale here.Be warned - do not buy!

column9: Why can't I find this cereal in the grocery store anymore?
column10: I'm not a fan of regular Kix but cannot get enough of Honey Kix. It has just the right amount of sweetness and honey flavor for a health conscious adult. As an added bonus the cereal stays crunchy from beginning to end without being difficult to chew.
Our kids love it.  They even munch on handfuls of it after school.  It's lots better than the regular Kix bland taste that was around when I was a kid.

I tried this cereal because I heard it wasn't that bad for diabetics.Hubby is diabetic so I gave it a go. Unfortunately, I didn't realize it had inulin as one of the sweeteners. Though inulin is a natural sweetener derived from the chicory root, I'm not crazy about it in excess quantities. Why do food companies over do it with every new sweetener?! Hubby wasn't thrilled with the honey flavor and I like regular Kix much better. The chickens didn't voice their opinion but it stayed in the food dish for a couple of days before they understood there would be nothing else if they didn't clear their plate.

column9: The best dry pasta you can get.
column10: From reading ingredients from typical pastas, one would probably think they are all the same. However, they can be dramatically different from each other. This one is the best I have ever had, which does not turn to mush as some cheap pastas do, and also is extremely consistent in its cooking time. With De Cecco, one does not need to test the pasta before the allotted time; one simply follows the directions for cooking time and it is perfect every time. I have never been able to do that with any other brand I have tried, and I have tried countless brands of pasta. The flavor is also better than other pastas, without being overpowering or drawing attention to itself. It is what pasta should be.It costs more than some other pastas, but it is worth much more than other pastas. This pasta absolutely deserves the highest possible rating, and compared with it, the best of any other brand, even brands that cost more, deserve no more than 3 stars. It is that much better than anything else you can find.The fusilli is my favorite shape, but all of the shapes are the same quality, and which shape one should use depends upon what one is making and one's personal preference.There is no reason to ever buy any other brand; they are all a disappointment after De Cecco.

We love De Cecco pasta, but our local grocery chain charges a preventative amount for it. We can get it for a reasonable price through Amazon, and get a bunch of it at once. No downside. So far, we haven't found a comparable pasta, especially for the price, and we eat a ton of the stuff. Perfect bite, perfect taste... if I had a gripe, I'd say that you have to cook it for one minute less than the recommended al dente time in order to get it properly al dente, but once you know that, you're golden.

Love De Cecco pasta. Decided to order it from Amazon because the price is much better than the local grocery store. However, the boxes of pasta arrived crushed, with pasta leaking out. The outer Amazon box is just fine. That tells me the boxes of pasta were already damaged before they were shipped. Very disappointed.

column9: Misleading: There is no tea in this
column10: so..it's caffeine-free, because there is no tea in the "tea" bags. Ingredients listed are:-Lemongrass-Black Pepper-Ginger-Cardamom-Cinnamon-Marigold-ClovesI'm actually pretty furious. Company is deceptive. The package instructions to add milk is ridiculous. It brews green, not like black tea.

column9: Price increased by nearly 300% in a matter of 2-3 of months
column10: I enjoyed this rice when I bought it for $5.31 for this 5-pound bag in Nov 2011 but not enough to pay nearly 300% more in just a matter of 2-3 months later now in Feb 2012. Hence, I will be looking for different rice.
I am very happy with this purchase.  The price and quality of this rice is great. I love the bag it comes in.  I would definitely purchase this rice again.

I am a recently diagnosed Gluten senistive person.  I went to my local grocery store and bought a number of gluten free products.  Hodgson Mill cookie mix was on sale at a very nic price.  Went home and whipped up a batch of peanut butter cookies.  Ummm lasted all of an hour and there is only two of us!  Very addictive but it is nice they include 5 different directions for different cookies you can make with this mix.  The box makes quite a few.  Even my dogs were begging for them!  Went back to the store and bought every box they had.  Highly recommend!

column9: Taste just like classic chocolate chip cookies! Modified a little.
column10: I bought this mix for my daughter's Cookie Monster party. What's a Cookie Monster party without chocolate chip cookies? She has recently had to become gluten-free because of allergies, and this was the first box of cookie mix I tried. There is no reason to try another! They were delicious and tasted just like classic chocolate chip cookies. I did modify it a tad, based on another review, by adding an extra egg and melting the butter partially before mixing. I don't know if it made a difference. Several parents at the party were asking me, "Are you sure these are gluten free?" So pleased to have a cookie mix for her(that can be made into several varieties of cookies) that tastes this good.

I cook a lot, so to get foods to be the best they can be, I often have to tweak them a bit.  Cooking gluten-free for baked goods is a hassle, so these mixes come in handy.  This one in particular, I have had great success with.  The recipe calls for vegetable shortening, which I refuse to use.  So, melt the butter, as directed, and then add in some Canola oil, which I understand is also naturally gluten-free (same amount as the shortening would have been).  I also add one more egg to the mix, to keep the moisture and to keep it together better.  Result:  perfect cookies.  Not too dry, not crumbly, excellent.  The taste of this particular product is also very nice.  I don't bother squishing them down.  My family likes the "mountain" effect of spooned dough.  The entire cookies seems to cook very well in the appointed 15 minutes. I usually wait until there is a little brownish ring around the base, then they are usually all the way done.

column9: These gf cookies are TOO good!
column10: I was diagnosed gluten intolerant in the mid to late 80's & these are some of the best GF cookies I've made from a mix.  I did the peanut butter & a few chocolate chips and oh wow...are they good!!  They only lasted a few days & it's just me!  Although I usually share my baked stuff with my neighbor...have made them 3 times & I haven't been able to give part with a single cookie!  :o)

I bought this mix a few nights ago. Since its SIGNIFICANTLY cheaper than most of the other brands out there I figured it was worth a shot... I thought it was REALLY tasty. Ive read several, VERY mixed reviews on this product and cant quite figure what the issue may be. I did notice that the box I bought reads "new and improved" where the box in this picture simply reads "new".... maybe they made a change to the mix??? .... I say its worth a shot. I liked it a lot and will use this as my go-to/easy/fast mix from now on.

I made the peanut butter version.  The taste was fine but VERY dry and crumbly. When I saw how dry the first batch was, I doubled the butter---I'm new to baking GF and don't really understand the flours and chemistry, nor do I know why GF baked goods are usually SO dry but adding butter didn't solve it, it just made it more buttery tasting.

it is difficult to find good odor neutralizing non-clumping kitty litter this is the best for the price and since amazon ships it to your front door you dont have to schlep the bags home from the grocery store (if you can find a store that carries it).... this is great for people with webbed pawed kitties
I had not seen this item before in the stores, and did not know it is not a clumping litter. Be sure that is what you want before ordering.

My kids love this juice.  However it's not such a great value in the big bottle.  We buy the small sippy bottles version which are the best and leak proof bottles you'll ever find.  No other sippy cup comes close.  They are very convenient and reusable.  Perfect for the little hands.  The large bottle is fine, but I just buy cheaper organic juice in a local store and water it down myself for the refills (toddlers should not drink straight juice which is bad for their teeth, etc.)
This is really bad tasting juice!  I cannot detect any banana OR carrot flavor.  It taste like dirty dish water.  In addition, it has an off-putting odor.  My recommendation is to skip this one. ##

This is a really wonderful juice for your baby or toddler, for convenience it is premixed with water & ready to go out of the bottle. Our daughter loves this juice & while we have tried other organic juices she hasn't enjoyed any as much as First Juice!

column4: N. A. Walther "as Einstein stated:  Those who...
column10: No where does the amazon lisitng, yes it says purified water on the ingredient list but nowehere does it tell you that all it is is watered down juice!... as soon as i opend the box and saw the words 49% juice I was shocked...see the pretty picture?  can u see the words 49% juice?  no cause it is on the back.No wehre in the product lsitng on amazon did it meantion that or i would never have bought it.wht spend 21 dollars on 96 ounces of tap water and 96 ounces of organic juice?For SHAME!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I was looking for a chicken/duck dog treat that isnt made in China (most of the popular ones state that they are on their packaging). This one, with its dual French/English labeling and Free Range title, appeared to be a North American free-range organic-type natural product. Especially given the price. But it is NOT, it is also made in China. Upon closer inspection it says this product has no ADDED hormones, antibiotics, preservatives... but it doesnt say the product is FREE OF these additives. I feel duped, and I am returning.  I can get the same China-quality for half the price without being taken for a ride.

column9: #1 treat for a very finicky dog!
column10: When offered a smorgasbord of snacks and treats, Rudy (springer spaniel) always chooses free range chews first!
My little Cavalier King Charles is a very picky eater, but these are his absolute favorites!

Dogs know which treats they like best.  These are my dog's very favorite so I refer to them by saying, "I'll give you a million dollars."  Now that he knows this phrase, it gets him moving when he's reluctant to get in the car, or helps change his mind about an agility obstacle that makes him nervous.  I also use these as high-value treats for classical conditioning; I give these out when my dog is meeting a new person, or when I'm talking to a neighbor in the backyard, to create positive associations so he's less likely to bark.  Of course he also loves getting these just as a treat.  A bag of these treats can be stretched by cutting each one into about 3 pieces to use for training (big enough to still be chewy instead of swallowed whole), but I leave some whole for regular treats.  A whole one is big enough that my dog will carry it away to eat, and he will guard it from another dog, so be aware of that if your dog is a resource guarder.I highly recommend trying these.  Don't be fooled by the tear notch above the zipper; when I open the bag this way the zipper ends up getting ripped.  Cut the bag open above the zipper to make sure you can reseal it.  The thick plastic keeps the treats fresh.

My dog goes crazy over these treats!  They are like doggie crack!  If you want to really reward your dog and show them love you'll be happy with the Free Range Treats.  I cannot purchase these in any of my local stores so I'm very happy there are available on Amazon!

These Chicken and Sweet Potato dog treats are the all time favorite in our home...not for me but for my dogs.  I was so happy to see them at such a great price, but when I received them I found that all 5 bags (2 priced at regular price) all had expired dates on them and they were not soft but very hard.  They all expired last year.  I realize they're dogs, and I realize the body parts they lick can't be any worse than some expired dog treats, but knowing that most dog treats, including these, come from China, and with the pet food issues that we have had, I just think that the expiration dates should be noted on the item description, and let the buyer beware. Otherwise, bar none my dogs love these treats, I shouldn't make that public than they will really go up in price and be even more difficult to find!
I dont mind paying a little extra because my dog loves these and I like that it only has two ingredients. Its well worth the investment...
Thank goodness these are back in stock!  They are the only treats my dog gets excited about and...they're  healthy!

column9: Chicken w/sweet Potato is the best!
column10: I have purchased this product several times.  I cut each piece in half for the perfect size.  It's a special treat every morning for my litle 8 pound dog.  I've tried other brands but always come back to this one. Sealing  the package each time will maintain it's fresh smell and moisture content; insuring a long shelf life.

These were a wonderful find!  While looking for chicken or duck breast strips I ran across these and they are FANTASTIC!!!  And to top it off, when I read the ingredients list there were only 2 items listed...sweet potato and chicken!  How great was that???
our dog thinks sweet potato chicen wraps were invented for him. he loves them and waits not very patiently for them every night.

column9: This is the secret of REAL theater flavor
column10: I've done a lot of research and I've tried a lot of products.  This is it.  I have a friend that owns a movie theater and he told me this is what is used.  There are slight variations in theaters across the nation but this is the product used.  He said they do not use real butter because it melts down the popcorn when it is hot.  Real butter also tastes funny, yes, it's true.  He said the theater tried it for a month and customers would come back complaining that the butter tasted funny and get a refund.  The topping is the way to go.Trade secret number #2:  Flavorcol.  You won't get that salty seasoned flavor from this topping alone.  Nor from a combination of this topping and salt.  Flavorcol is a salt seasoning that is put in the mix while popping.  Get it use it.Oh yeah, there's a 3rd secret too: Use red coconut oil.  It's similar to what McDonald's uses.  Pay attention to how similar the smell of the nuggets frying and popcorn is.  That smell in the movie theater is actually the coconut oil frying.Never said it was healthy.

First off, I'm not one to leave reviews. Only if a product is extremely good or extremely bad. And as long as I've been an Amazon customer -- going on a decade or so now? -- this is my first review of a product.I'd like to consider myself a bit of a popcorn connoisseur. I love popcorn, but I'm extremely picky. It's either too stale tasting, not salty enough, too salty, not enough butter, too buttery -- you get the idea.Well, as the title suggests, three li'l words describe this butter to a T. It is unbelievably, incredibly, stupendously fantastic! This, combined with some Great Northern Popcorn make, in this lone popcorn fanatic's perception at least, sheer perfection.I've had some great movie theater popcorn in my day, and this emulates, if not actually TRUMPS, the best I've had. All the way down to the tickly aftertaste senstation you get in the back of your throat. It's dangerously addicting. If you like movie theater popcorn, this is quite simply THE one to buy.

column9: If Movie Theatre Butter is What You're Looking For, This is all You Need.
column10: This Butter Flavored Popcorn Topping is perfect if you're looking to make popcorn that tastes like what you get at the movie theatre.  It is a very large bottle, however, so you better like popcorn a lot if you're thinking about purchasing this product.

column9: I like Mor Gold topping much more than this one.
column10: I don't like the after-taste of the "Butter Flavored Popcorn Topping".....I prefer "Mor Gold" Premium Butter Topping it has a far superior taste and "Mor Gold" is also more creamy and more theater like buttery taste than "Butter Flavored Popcorn Topping".If you haven't tried Mor Gold - then you really can't say...I've tried them all and Mor Gold taste is just like in the movie theaters...I too use to work in a movie theater and I know that butter popcorn taste like the back of my hand, I love it and Mor Gold has it hands down....Also if you can find the Coconut oil in the 1/4 lb. sticks, this also helps make it more like the movies But it's not really necessary, Mor Gold will do the job well all by itself....The salt is really just up to you....I tried the "fine grain popcorn salt" but I think regular house salt from your pantry is just as good or even better...Try It & Enjoy!

I am a popcorn addict and what's more, a buttered popcorn addict, so with this product I was able to skip the line at the movie theater all together!! The only problem I have with this is that it congeals and is not good unless it is thoroughly warmed. To make it work, I put the amount I want to use in a small container (like a salsa bowl) and heat it in the microwave for about a minute. Pour it on, shake the popcorn to mix, and voila, perfect popcorn!! Yum!!

Im not sure about the other products out there but this stuff will make you believe your at the theater...the only problem is with the application..there are no instructions and its really thick so i have found the only way is to pour some into a small container (i used an old mustard squirt container) then spread cooked popcorn all level in the maker then apply some liberally on top then mix it all together...after doing that twice the popcorn is perfect the only problem is that itmakes the popcorn maker ALLOT messier then if you applied it somewhere else...good luck
this is the best popcorn topping we have found. It is 99.9% as good as the movie theater, the only thing missing is the big screene, this is great stuff you got to try it.
Good stuff, just watch you don't put too much on or it is just oily.  Add to popcorn salt to it and you are set.  Wonderful stuff, better than the movie theatre!

I RESEARCHED A HANDFULL OF DIFFERANT TOPPINGS. THIS ACTUALLY TASTES LIKE MOVIE THEATHER TOPPING-GREAT WARMED SLIGHTLY---WARNING.....THIS IS A HUGE CONTAINER AND WILL LAST THE AVERAGE HOME OWNER WHO MAKES A BATCH A WEEK 3-4 YEARS AT LEAST!!!
I use this all the time and has a great buttery taste. It is a gallon jug, so you might want to get a pump. I poured some into an empty Orval Redenbachers bottle to make it easier to use.

I bought this product as part of my quest to find a really buttery topping for microwave popcorn. This is the third brand of oil that I have purchased and I think I will keep looking.What one gets is a thick, creamy emulsion with a faint buttery taste. I found pronounced creamy overtones in a raw tasting. It will slightly separate on standing so, even though the label does not say so, "Shake Well Before Using."As expected, adding this oil to freshly popped popcorn produces an oily, semi-creamy, and very slightly buttery finished product. Adding plain popping salt completes the process for a very likeable popcorn.This product is not in the same class a movie-theater style popcorn, but would easily satisfy someone looking for an alternative flavor profile. The creamy texture of the oil gives the finished popcorn a nice, silky mouth-feel.

column9: good if u like chemically altered tasting butter
column10: At first I actually liked this seasoning and thought it was the real deal just like at the movie theaters boy was I deceived after a while I started tasting this horrible chemically synthetic butter taste and doesn't matter how much oil u put on the popcorn you will taste it no matter what kinda a shame cause the seasoning was done really well but the chemical taste makes it a very bad product.

column9: You haven't got a home theater without this product and a real popcorn machine!
column10: For years my husband loved the movie theater pop corn we grew up with, but hated that it cost us, as a family, $35.00 to have it at the theater, without the cost of the movie added with it.  I finally researched and picked up a Funtime 8oz tabletop machine with funtime popcorn kits. I cannot tho stress how much this BUTTERY, butter flavored popcorn topping has really finished the whole process for enjoying TRUE Movie theater tasting pop corn.  The texture and taste of the popcorn with this on it is EXACTLY as the theaters.  You have found the correct topping, if the eaxct, true movie butter flavor is what you are looking for.  I heat mine up in a coffee mug in the microwave, and spoon dribble it over a half filled box of popcorn, and then fill it full, topping it off with more drizzled.  Thank you for selling this product!!

A perfect match to go with my favorite snack....popcorn!  Yum!  My grandchildren love to come to my house & watch movies, knowing that they will always have scrumptious buttered popcorn.  It tastes just like the movie popcorn, but when you have it at home, you always get it topped just right! And it was shipped super fast!  So you never have to be without. Love it!

I have finally found the pot of gold when it comes to real theatre butter flavor. After purchasing a couple of different brands and finding only disappointment, we tried wabash valley farms buttery topping and I believe this is the ultimate. Not knowing exactly what size container this was I ordered two of them only to find out in reading other reviews that it was a gallon bottle. I sent an email to wabash valley farms and an attentive employee was able to catch my order and change to only one gallon. We are going thru this stuff like piranhas and may have been better to keep both gallons. Try this product .... It's the best!!!

column9: Closest thing to theater popcorn I have come across so far.
column10: After a long bit of research we finally decided on this product to try and produce theater liek popcorn. This product by far has come the closest yet. We poured a little into a squeeze bottle and then while the popcorn is popping, put the bottle in hot water. By the time the popcorn is done, the butter flavor stuff is warm and very tastey. We squirt a little on the popcorn, add some special popcorn, flavored salt and voila, theater popcorn.  It's great.

Super Yummy as good or better than any Theater Butter topping! The first jug was damaged so the seller is supposed to refund the purchase price. We have an 8oz popcorn machine and I cannot even imagine not having this topping now it is very buttery and tastes great I keep it in a squeeze bottle in the popcorn machine so the warming light will keep it nice and warm. If you want great butter taste for me this was it I have my working jug of topping and a backup jug it's that good!

It's thick and taste just like real movie theater popcorn butter.It's not salted, the popcorn salt is perfect for this butter topping. My only concern is that there is no expiration date on the container. I need to know how long is the shelf life of the unused portion.I am disapppointed that there is no customer service number on the container for any consumer questions.

Close your eyes and you'll swear you're in the theater with this topping on your popcorn.  Real "theater popcorn taste".  But plan on lots of popcorn as it comes in a gallon container so you'll have lots of topping.

I love the taste of this. I used it to pop my corn in. It made the popcorn all buttery. I have to deduct a star because when it gets cool it leaves that film that crisco-like shortenings do on the roof of your mouth. I hate that. And it has trans-fats.
It is as close to theatre topping as it could be.  Good taste, good flavor A+ in my book or should I say on my popcorn.

Ordered this product as a supplement to my concession operation.  On receipt, I put it on some popcorn I'd made for friends as a test run.  Of the six people who tried it (myself included), four thought the popcorn tasted oily and that it actually detracted from the taste of the popcorn.  The topping was put on in incremental amounts.  Of the six testers, no one thought it made the popcorn better.  Four thought it negatively affected the popcorn and the other two were neutral.  I will most likely not be purchasing this product in the future.

This butter like topping is very good.  I did read some reviews before purchasing which did sway in my decision to buy this topping for my home popcorn.  Most of the reviews were positive, some negative but the positive outweighed the negative, therefore, I decided to buy some.  Some reviewers said it tastes just like at the movies and some said it does not, but more said it did than not.  In my opinion this topping is not an exact match in taste as the butter topping they use in the theaters, or at least in my area.  I live in the suburbs of Los Angeles and go to the movies in various locations in Southern California.  It is possible that the other reviewers who say this taste just like at the theater visit theaters that do use this or one just like it.  I go to the movies at either Edwards Cinema (Regal) or AMC theaters.  This topping is good but not an exact match.  Someone mentioned Mor Gold is creamier and just like the theater.  I found that Wabash Butter Flavored Topping actually is creamy too, at least compared to that at the theaters that I go to the movies.  The butter topping at the theaters that I visit is very thin and very liquidy actually, which makes this stuff seem to be creamy and thick.  I think people are accustomed to "movie butter" topping and anything less or different is not acceptable.  For awhile I was melting real butter and putting in on the popcorn but honestly, even if real butter is higher quality and the real thing, I can't get used to butter on my popcorn and went on the quest of this synthetic like topping that is used at movie theaters.  Although this is not an exact match am I happy with this product?  Yes I am, is the answer.  This topping actually does taste like butter but not exactly. If it was exactly like butter taste I'd not use it any longer but it is not just like butter but has some taste properties.  It falls somewhere between real butter taste and that synthetic stuff from the movie theater that I like so much.  Heck I might use this on corn on the cob and see how it is.  I have no complaints about this stuff at all and a little goes a long way.  I just purchased this recently, came the other day and I tried it out on some popcorn.  Tasted good.  So this will last me a long time. When it's all said and done I might try some of that O'Dell brand, I heard good things about it.  So bottom line is I rather get an exact taste copy as the kind I am used to at the theater but I can say this is very good stuff.  Would I buy it again? Yes I would but I'd compare O'Dell brand first and after comparing the two I'd go for the one I like best.  I think that Amazon actually carries O'Dell also so you might want to look into it.

Product is pretty good, makes for great popcorn but does not taste like theater popcorn butter,it is similar. Product arrived in yellow jug with no FDA nutritonal information, no instructions for storing. Contacted Wabash Farms thru Amazon asking for information, they have not responded.Can not recommend a product that you have no idea what is in it.

An excellent product that is exactly the same as used in most theaters to flavor their popcorn.  Economically priced, this canola oil based flavoring adds a smooth, rich flavor to a bucket of homemade popcorn.  The canola oil offers many health advantages over that great tasting wad of real butter, and has the same wonderful flavor.

We use this for our home theater, every loves this topping. It has a little bit of a weird smell but adds a hint of buttery taste to the popcorn. It's much better than some of the other brands I've tried. Get this one if you want a real theater type of butter on your popcorn.

column9: Exactly what I was looking for...
column10: I love popcorn at the local movieplexes (extra butter, please.)  When I get below the "butter layer," I'm always a little sad, but am usually pretty engaged in the movie, and don't care as much.  If you know what I'm talking about, then I can cut to the chase.  Barring health concerns (I've no idea how bad this is calorie-wise or fats-wise, really), THIS is the stuff you want!!I wanted to imitate the movie theater experience at home, so I bought a popcorn popper on a whim at a discount web retailer. At a friend's behest, I bought a jar of orange-ish coconut oil (turns yellow as it spreads out, and looks really cool on a metal spoon). That gave me the movie theater SMELL, and an important component of the overall flavor.One of the reviewers here recommends coconut oil, this stuff, and Flavacol, and for folks that want butter flavor without the oil, Flavacol is fantastic, but it really didn't get me to the movie theater experience on its own.  I'm keeping the box I bought, anyway, in case someone doesn't want this "butter" stuff.  I have no idea how unhealthy it really is.This topping really made all of the difference in the world, in terms of getting the movieplex experience.  I bought a separate squirter from Amazon (you can probably find it in the list of things people also bought when they bought this.)  It fit perfectly and really simplified the "butter" application.  You could probably put this on microwave popcorn and get really close to the theater experience.This topping is not really butter, obviously.  Folks who buy it thinking otherwise will hopefully learn to read titles and labels more closely.I love this stuff. Can't recommend it enough.

Butter flavor taste real, like in the movies.  I've tried others and they were not even close in taste.  I gave it 4 stars only because movie theater is still better, but this is as close to the real thing as it gets.
Tastes and smells like the movies, but even better.  My son who doesn't like popcorn likes it now with this on it. I will buy this again.

The "butter flavored" popcorn topping is ok. Is it worth the 14g fat/tablespoon?  Probably not....  It really doesn't have much flavor to it.  If you don't have salt in mass quantities, the popcorn is going to taste oily and bland.  I would recommend using just coconut oil.

I purchased this based on the rave reviews. I am thinking that either I got a bad batch or a lot of people just love the taste of flavorless oil. I am not a picky person. If this even remotely had a good flavor I would have been fine with it. But everyone who tried it agreed that it made the popcorn taste worse and not better and added almost no flavor at all. I wish I could have tasted the product before I purchased it. So, I guess I am out about $25.
Along with the popcorn salt and the popcorn oil, adding this Butter Flavored Popcorn Topping makes for a theater feast!
If you want the real thing and maybe even better then try this topping out to see for yourself.

The product itself is great - we love the stuff around here.  That's why it gets any stars at all.The biggest problem I have with this is the $10 shipping.  Add that to the product price, and $23.99 takes this off my "worth it" list.
The flavoring is just ok. Bland, no salt added and really has no flavor considering how fattening it is. Will try another brand next time.

This topping tastes identical to the topping that the movie theatres use.  A little goes a long way....  Also,  the gallon container which it was shipped in may get damaged but it was still usuable and the seal was unbroken.
My whole family is addicted to this product! Gives popcorn that movie butter flavor!! So good my family prefers this to real butter. Makes you look forward to movie night!!!
I was not sure about the butter, but I love it and so do my customers!

column9: JUST LIKE THE MOVIES!!! SOOOOO GOOD!!
column10: I've never tasted anything like it other than the movie theater! It is the absolute best! I hope they sell some more because I am ready to buy! Awesome product!

This product contains partially hydrogenated soy bean oil.  Partially hydrogenated vegtable oils are trans fats.  Trans fats are artifical fats that health professionals agree are unhealthy and should be vigorously avoided.  Trans fats are not normally found in the human diet to any appreciable degree. The lable states that 2 grams of trans fat are present in each serving.  I would never eat this.  Unfortunately the container was opened before we figured out it was such an unhealthy product.  Now it is in the trash.For your healths sake, please don't eat this.
Tastes too much like regular oil for me. I'm still looking for one that tastes like butter.
THIS IS PARTIALLY HYDROGENATED OIL. I'd give this product minus stars if I could. You be the judge.

column9: Great Flavor but Bottle Top Hassle
column10: I used it in a Moqueca which is a Brazilian Fish Stew, and it was very delicious. The problem I had was with the bottle top. The recipe called for 1/4 c of the oil. Unfortunately, I was unable to remove the plastic top which does not unscrew.  It just has a flip top cap with a single hole in it and ended up just shaking it by drops into the measuring cup which was messy and a hassle.
I had never heard of Dende Oil before I read a recipe for Braziliam Fish Stew.  I had to make it authentic so ordered it from here!! So glad I did as it made the dish!!! It's really awesome!

column9: Herbal Alternative to Caffeinated Beverages, A Different Rooibos
column10: *****Sweet African Green Rooibos Herbal Teasan is a delectable Numi tea.This tea is certified organic and kosher and contains only green rooibos and honeybush. It is from South Africa, made from the same plant as Rooibos (Red Tea), but it is not sun-dried, and it has more anti-oxidants than green tea. It is also rich in phytoestrogens. It has a light, smooth, eathy-woody taste.The price is perfect, a big savings over single boxes. If you like Numi herbal teas, get it---you won't be sorry. If you just want a tasty, high-quality rooibos tea, this one does not disappoint.*****

I was literally not prepared for the exquisite and lively flavors that this brew offered as it instantly became my favorite Rooibos tea. This organic Rooibos makes the perfect daily cup of tea that can be enjoyed in any quantity. African herbal tea is rich in many essential natural elements as it is not allowed to oxidize making the flavor more fruity and literally weightless. This tastes like a cross between soft black and green tea, a gorgeous pumpkin color when brewed and since it's caffeine free I can drink myself silly before bedtime and it has not kept me up yet. The subtle richness of soft pulpy mellow woods is silky with a pleasant sparkling green aftertaste which I find myself craving all the time.So far every flavor of Numi I have tired proved to be a winner and a cup of high quality in both flavor and taste is always guaranteed and only a short boil of water away. After a hectic day this is the best calming and tranquil beverage that is not only delicious but also so healthy!- Kasia S.

column9: Herbal Alternative to Caffeinated Beverages, A Different Rooibos
column10: *****Sweet African Green Rooibos Herbal Teasan is a delectable Numi tea.This tea is certified organic and kosher and contains only green rooibos and honeybush. It is from South Africa, made from the same plant as Rooibos (Red Tea), but it is not sun-dried, and it has more anti-oxidants than green tea. It is also rich in phytoestrogens. It has a light, smooth, eathy-woody taste.If you like Numi herbal teas, get it---you won't be sorry. If you just want a tasty, high-quality rooibos tea, this one does not disappoint.*****

I love this tea.  I've researched the health benefits and it's one of the healthiest things you can drink... Google it.  I like that it's caffeine free, and with a little honey, it's a treat any time of day. I'll be buying more when I run out.

This is, by far, my favorite high-antioxidant decaf tea. The flavor is subtle but perfect. You can steep forever and the tea does not become bitter. It's delicious. Since getting this tea, I have not even considered trying another flavor of decaf.

I can't get enough of this tea.  It fills my go-mug every morning on the way to work, and warms me in those early winter meetings.This is a great alternative for people who can't drink camellia-based tea (green, black, white, conventional or decaf) or want a caffeine-free alternative.  It lacks the sharp bite of oxidized rooibos, but still has its fruity tones.  It's not so exotic that you'd get sick of it quickly; it's not so unremarkable that you don't care if you finish your mug.  It's just right.

I actually buy these from my local grocery store for 48 cents for every little bag. They are super yummy. This is my favorite flavor but I also like the Ranch one. A great alternative for pretzels with my deli meat sandwich for lunch.

I'm one of those people that drinks a lot of tea. Expensive and inexpensive.This is a less expensive every day tea.  It's not fancy, but it is above average.Strong flavored that will stand up to milk and sugar if you like. Think Irishbreakfast commercial blends and you have an idea of the typical flavor.If you're a tea drinker, think a Anhui Province medium grade Chuen Cha.Overall a great bang for your buck if you are a tea drinker who isn't afraidof loose leaf preparations. The packaging concerns are pretty groundless. If you'redrinking loose leaf tea, odds are you have a few jars or air tight tea containers.The packaging itself is good, eco-friendly, seals well but you might want to put half(or more) into a air tight container then use the stuff left in the bag first.This way you will avoid any flavor degradation when at the bottom of the bagfrom oxidation over time, if you don't use this tea daily or regular like.It is not a first flush premier estate tea. It is splendid tasting and a great value.Eco-friendly and organic are just valuable perks to the world conscious.

This is an organic certified tea. It is rich and smooth and fullbodied, with no bitterness or 'spoiled hay' flavor that some teas unfortunately have. It stands up fine with milk and a bit of sugar. One of my new favorites, which I will buy again. I recommended it completely.
This is the best Keemun tea I have tasted for some time it is nearly as good as Taylors of Harrogate Keemun tea.

column9: Not what I was hoping for
column10: I found this tea very bland when brewed normally (1 tsp per 8oz boiling water for 5 mins). When I tried adding more tea, the flavor was distinctly "barn-like". Sort of like moldy hay. I am very disappointed in this tea overall and will not order it again.It is a shame because the price was nice! But you get what you pay for I suppose, and I will stick to ordering higher-quality teas from other vendors.

I have been drinking Keemun Congou tea for more than 20 years. My first taste of Keemun was from Harrod's and the bright red color and the fabulous bouquet of Keemun made me a fan for life. In my opinion, the taste should be slightly astringent but sweet on your tongue. I love to open my jar of tea in the morning and inhale the slightly smoky, winey aroma of my tea much like coffee drinkers enjoy the smell of a newly opened can of coffee. Keemun really is the Bordeaux of tea.Then the inevitable finally occurred the company I normally buy my Keemun tea from (Special Teas) went out of business, selling out to Teavana and Teavana has chosen not to carry the Keemun I prefer. Alas I found myself looking for a tea to replace the now unavailable Special Tea's Keemun, so I bought two pounds of the Davidson's Keemun because the price was right. Unfortunately this tea is nothing like the Keemun I love and look forward to every morning. The Davidson Keemun smells green and unfermented, almost like a green tea or perhaps slightly fermented like an oolong. The brew does not have that slight smokiness to it and is not sweet on my tongue.I tried brewing it with more tea but that tasted like I had just used more green straw (someone equated it to being barny) and was not at all pleasing even to my husband who is less particular. In the end I am wondering what to do with the enormous amount of tea I have left and have to give this product a thumbs down.

column9: Wish I'd read the reviews first.
column10: Well, what they said.  Been drinking Keemun for years and love it, but this is just bland, and now I've got a pound of it.  Find something else.

Junk tea.  20% is twigs and chunks of leaves that aren't even rolled.  First one I ordered came in a zip top bag and was OK.  Not a great Keemun (my daily drink), but okay for my morning thermos on the ride in to work.  It came in a plastic coated paper bag with a zip top.  I ran out and decided to order some more.  The second batch (unfortunately I ordered 3...big mistake) came in plastic lined paper roll-down bags like shown in the image.  And it is junk.  I can't even drink it.  It has no flavor.  Forget the fact that there is almost none of the signature Keemun flavor.  There is almost no flavor at all!  If you want to convince somebody that loose leaf tea is worse than Lipton tea bags, this is the stuff to get.
Davidson's bulk Keemun tea can't be beat! Great taste and good price -- especially for organic tea. Packaging is simple and recyclable.

First, I'd like do a math for the potential buyers. 13 dollars for 16 Oz means 77 Chinese Yuan for 500g.  In Beijing, capital of China, this is the price for a low or middle-low level Keemun Congou (Qi Men Hong Cha).  So don't expect a super high quality.As one previous reviewer said, there are too many twigs and other dirty branches.  But if you know the produce process, you will accept it considering the low price ......Anyway, the smell is good and the same as what I bought in China.Overall, I'd like to say this is a good everyday use red tea.

I love Davidson's tea in general, but I won't be purchasing this again. This black tea doesn't have much body and has a rather unpleasant earthy taste (perhaps that is a correct characteristic of Keemon Congou?). It is much more drinkable with the addition of fresh mint or a fruit tea so I have been using it that way.

I'd previously tried Davidson's Earl Grey tea and was pretty happy with it, so I decided to order a different variety.  In retrospect, I think the Earl Grey only works because it's so heavy on the Bergamot.  That hides the fact that the tea itself doesn't have much flavor.  The Keemun has nothing to hide behind, and tastes like nothing much.  Too bad!  What to do with a pound of mediocre tea?
My daughter and I are really enjoying this tea.  It has that great Keemun flavor without the exorbitant price of our local tea shop.  Highly recommended!

I'm really disappointed in this tea.  It's got really, really strong tobacco and earthy (read: barnyard) flavors.  I've decided to use it as a filler with some other bulk tea I have . . . its the only way I can use this tea.I will not purchase this tea again, nor will I suggest it to anyone I like.  I'd rather shell out the few extra bucks for a better tasting keemun and drink it less often, than drink this stuff daily.  Insert "Sad Trombone" sound effect here.

This is a very good tea, in my opinion. I am no tea aficionado but I was a big tea drinker in my days. The flavor is nice and not overwhelming and there is a subtle aftertaste which I like a lot. I recommend this tea for a quiet Friday summer afternoon in a back yard watching the sun go down.

Since our mornings are very busy it is not unusually for me to leave the tea steeping too long or for me to have to reheat my cup at least twice. Somehow this tea still comes out tasting good.  It has a smokey flavor that is enhanced by just a bit of milk.  But is also very good plain or sweetened and chilled.  This is my households favorite tea.
Really enjoyed this tea.  Packaging is not really resealable.  But very flavorful tea and worth the money for a bulk buy.

Could not find the Crystal Lite decaf iced tea in grocery stores.  Had a wild thought about possibly finding it on line and was surprised to find that it was available on line.  Feels a little weird to order this online.  Product arrived in timely fashion, and is as fresh as if I just brought it home from the grocery store.  I anticipate that the next product I will seek on line is Crystal Lite's fruit punch.

column9: we add pure lemon juice to our decaffeinated iced tea.
column10: we enjoy the decaffeinated iced tea all year round and add some pure lemon juice to each pitcher full....it adds some zip. It is very hard to find in stores, I was able to get it in the summer, but now that it is winter....I can't locate it anywhere.

We drink this stuff like crazy and we'd be out all the time. So I bought a case on Amazon. Problem solved. Also, the decaf is nice. The regular can keep you UP! You forget how much caffeine is in the regular. Also, Safeway generic is nasty.
I made my mom very happy when I brought this to her. It isn't to easy to find inthe stores around here anymore.

This is the best Instant diet decaf Iced tea I have tasted.I ordered this item because it was getting harder to find in the stores. There is no after taste and just sweet enough. It also only takes 15 seconds to mix up 2 quarts!The price is the same as the supermarket, however. No bargains.

column9: Good taste at a great price
column10: Each tube contains 6 tubs, and each tub makes 2 quarts, so each tube makes 12 quarts, or 3 gallons, and costs $27.65 / 6, or $4.61. So this comes out to $1.54 per gallon.Lipton makes a similar tea mix, in measure-it-yourself jars:Lipton Diet Decaf Instant Tea Mix, Lemon 3-Ounce (Pack of 6)The little pre-measured tubs make Crystal Light more convenient than the equivalent Lipton jars, and CL is slightly cheaper than the $1.57 / gallon for Lipton. However, I personally like the Lipton flavor more; it tastes more like "real" tea.

Unless it is a great sale in a grocery store... this was a great buy!!  More important to me, I specifically wanted this flavor and "Decaffeinated".  I have been having a hard time finding this in the stores.
My grocery store can't seem to keep this stocked. I got tired of waiting. Now I have free delivery every month. One more item off the shopping list.

These pancakes are delicious and easy to make! They are great gift ideas, too. I have seen them used as teacher gifts, stocking stuffers, holiday gifts for the boss/in-laws and much more. So much more original than the tired candle or gift certificate and you can pair them with other items too (a cute bottle of syrup, etc). Highly recommend.

column9: Ritter Sport Nugat : one of the best
column10: I am a big chocolate lover, and must say German chocolate is generally the best, especially if you consider the price-quality ratio .. Ritter Sport's Nugat (not to be confused with Nougat) has a wonderful hazelnut-cacao (sort of Nutella-type) taste, melding on your tongue, and is not too sweet (I find US or UK chocolates really too sweet); it goes perfectly with black tea or coffee ..
I love chocolate...and I simply have not tasted better chocolate then the dark blue bar of Rittersport.  It's absolutely mouth watering.

column9: Nice supplement for on dry kibble
column10: Feed dogs bones and raw food diet but also give kibble. A sprinkling of this on top of the kibble is popular with our dogs. Expensive, so I only use a small amount.

column9: Best Homeopathic Dog Food Out There!
column10: I had to write a review for this wonderful brand of dog food when I saw that no one gave it the credit it so richly deserves. Natures Variety Instinct is completely grain free and made from 95% meat and 5% assorted oils (like olive oil and fish oil), vegetables, fruits, and vitamins/minerals. I was a loyal follower of Canadie dog food for years until they decided to change their formula and increase their amounts of grains being used. Then the reports came in stating that so many dogs were getting sick over it. I was at a loss until I came across this line of dog food from a small manufacturing group. The reviews I read online were phenomenal and I decided to try it. I have a baby long-haired Chihuahua that absolutely loves this food. It doesnt give her an upset stomach, nor does it make her stools runny. She only has to eat a very small amount because its so nutrient packed. Her coat looks lustrous and her eyes sparkle. I decided to use the chicken meal formula because it offered a higher protein intake compared to the other instinct dry food options., but all of them offer the same fat intake and omega-3&6. It may not have the fancy commercials and the marketing campaign of more well known dog foods like Purina, but it more then makes up for it by making a product of exceptional quality.

column9: The best food you can give your dog
column10: I struggled with my Rhodesian Ridgeback Mix Muriel and the allergies and sensitive stomach that she inherited.  We tried other premium brands such as Wellness, Canidae, Inova and even made our food until we found Nature's Variety.  It was actually recommended to us by a vet who specializes in dogs with allergies.Since we started feeding this fantastic food 4 years ago Muriel no longer gets hives, upset stomach or ear infections.  Her coat is glossy and she is as energetic as a puppy even though she's almost 9 years old.  We also feed Nature's Variety to our 2 cats and our other dog Gilbert (English Fox Hound Mix).  They love the chicken instinct but we rotate through the other flavors available and add Nature's Variety Canned and Raw frozen food (Available in a variety of flavors: Rabbit, Salmon, Duck, Beef, Lamb, Bison and Venison).I'm Lucky enough to know the owners of some of Muriel's Litter Mates and am Happy to say that I have made converts of some of them. Their dogs no longer need allergy shots or suffer from hives and upset stomach. As for the ones I haven't converted, I'm still working on them.But don't think this food is just for dogs with problems, this food has changed the health and lifestyle of all our pets.A word of caution this is a very nutrient packed food, no fillers. So you feed about 1/2 as much as you would of many other dry dog food.  See the Nature's Variety Feeding Chart at [...] to figure out how much food your dog or cat needs.

Our puppy had never had a solid poop in his life. He was tested for parasites, etc and came out negative. When we switched to grain free, the results were almost immediate, plus his coat got nicer looking too.

column9: One thumbs up, one thumbs down
column10: I purchased this food 1)for the ingredients and 2)for the convenience of Amazon.com delivery. With 2 small dogs, 13.2 lb. was the best size bag. Our older dog, with no digestive issues, just loves this food, gobbles it up, and she is a picky eater. She has no problems digesting the food. Our second dog has had digestive and allergy issues and had problems with the food. He loved the taste, but the result was loose watery stools, and we had to stop feeding immediately. Perhaps it was too rich for his system - we have since put him on a vegetarian diet with great success.

column9: Instinct Grain Free Chicken Meal Dry Dog Food
column10: I have an 8 year old 8 lb toy fox terrier. With other dog foods he gains weight and eats a lot more at a time than he does with this Instinct dog food. I researched dog foods and tried to find ones that were the best and this is one of them.  I feed him and he eats the right amount of this daily and maintains a more healthy weight.  This dog food doesn't have a strong "dog food smell". It will take some time for him eat this size bag but the bag shelf life is good for this brand and it has a good tight bag sealer on it.  I put enough for a week in another container so I don't have to open this large bag very often.  I also have this on a quarterly automatic purchase with amazon and will save even more by buying the larger bag.  A 4.4 lb bag averages $16 or $17 and the 13.2 lb bag averages $32.53 but if you do the automatic plan, it is $30.90.  The information on the front of the bag under Chicken Meal Formula "says it all".
My dog has sensitive skin, I switched his food to Instinct. I am already noticing that his skin is less red and itchy. I am pleased with the results of changing his food to Instinct.

My dogs used to eat this and it did wonders for their coat.  BUT they were regurgitating it so i stopped.  I thought I would give it another shot but even with a gradual transition, my dogs never got used to it nor stopped having loose stools.I notice it is a much smaller kibble than the older formula AND smells absolutely horrible now, like s--t, no joke.Nature's Variety is usually tops when it comes to ingredients and manufacturing guidelines but can't tell you what happened here.

column9: Looks good on paper but my dog never stopped being sick.
column10: We used Nature's Variety (non Instinct formula) for a while, but when we moved to our current location, the closest we could find was Natural Balance, so we had to switch.  When NB put out their grain free Alpha Dog, I tried that out and was amazed at how my normally very smelly Boston Terrier suddenly didn't seem to have any gas at all.  This got me searching for reviews, where I discovered the NV's Instinct line was rated much higher than NB's Alpha dog.  When I discovered the Amazon subscriptions, and how inexpensive that makes it(relative to what I pay at the pet store for organic pet food), I decided to give NV another try.  For the first week, I mixed the last of the old food with the new to get him used to it.  He had diarrhea and the worst gas EVER for days.  Now it's been a week on just the NV food and the sickness has not stopped.  I though maybe he was suffering from seasonal allergies and that's why he seemed so blahhh lately.  Last night I put it all together and realized it's the food.  I really wish I could get a refund, but at least I stopped the subscription in time not to get another.
The bag I got did not look like the bag pictured. The food was stale and my dog got sick. Will not be buying dog food from here again.

column9: World's Best! Nectar of the Gods!
column10: Life without Duke's is hardly worth livin'. When I lived out in Los Angeles, my parents use ta' send me care packages from the blessed South, which always included Mrs. Duke's savory prescription. It is by far the best they is! I placed it in a movie that I was shooting in LA last year and when it arrived on set (much of the crew was from the South) it was welcomed as either an old friend or vessels of ambrosia. In short, I highly recomend Duke's, even to our friends from the colder side of the Mason-Dixon (as all of us in God's country are well familiar with it). It is great on a sandwich with peanut butter and bannana. Bon appetite!

Duke's contains no sugar. It is loaded with flavor. If you've never tried it, you're missing out on one of the bestthings in a jar. Duke's on a tomato sandwich or BLT is divine and it makes awesome tuna, chicken and potato salad!

This is the ultimate treat for my dogs...they simply cannot resist them! I like finding treats that are made in the USA and this one in particular has ingredients that are great for my large breed dog's joints. I would suggest this treat over and over!

column9: Kodi has a new favorite treat!
column10: Trying something new is always risky with our picky Shiba Inu, Kodi! He has turned his nose up at many treats... but the Lamb Trachey Chewz were an immediate hit!Kodi is small, just under 20lbs, so the large size treat should last him awhile (which makes us both happy)... "100% humane sourced from sustainable family farms" makes me especially happy and guarantees a return purchase, for sure!Thank you Later Dog for letting me know about this pawesome product :)

We've got 4 dogs big and small and they took no time to snatch these out of our hands (the package even!) and gobble them up. They were crunchy and clearly delicious, didn't leave a mess and best of all these treats are grain free, gluten free and low carb. Didn't even think of stuffing them with something - will have to try that with the next batch! The dogs LOVED them and we had one left which we left on the counter...but it didn't take our Dublin long to sniff that out and bark for it!!!!

My mixed terrier is very particular about her treats. If she doesn't like it, she'll take it, then drop it. If she likes it (rare), she'll take it and eat it right on the spot. If she loves it (very rare), she'll take it, hide it, and then act paranoid that you saw her hide it. So then she'll go get it and re-hide it multiple times until she's satisfied that you're not spying on her with a secret wish to devour  it the moment she blinks. Then she'll sneak it out once most of the family has gone to sleep so she can savor it in peace. So I can't really tell you where today's Lamb Trachey Chewz treat went, but I can be certain she loves it! Thanks to Clear Conscience Pet for producing a healthy, greatly desired treat!

column9: Lick Your Chops Seafood & Brown Rice Dinner for Cats
column10: The ingredients are wholesome, and are without by-products, but my four cats do not really like this catfood.  It is a shame because the price is reasonable, and I like the quality, but my cats and I don't argue over 'taste.'
I really like the flavor of this curry. I have purchased it a couple times. Very fresh!
The aroma, taste, quality and excellence will drive you to the kitchen to start preparing your favorite recepies !Stay Safe,F. Wade McReynoldsCarmichael, CA

column9: Good stuff, but a little messy to use.
column10: This is a mild but nicely balanced curry. The price is great, and if you buy lots of curry, the shipping stays the same. The only cons are that the containers have no shaker top, and they are filled so that lots of curry becomes lodged in the threads of the lid so that when you open one, curry gets all over everything. They should improve this, but I can't complain much, since the price is so good, and the quality is very nice.
Fantastic! Spices are fresh and full of flavor. Arrived intact and on time. One goof in shipment was corrected immediately. I will be buying from them again. Thanks!

I made a seafood curry dish with this and it turned out really nice.  The one thing that I like is that there's no added salt.  This is important if you want to make a bold curry dish but balance the salt evenly.  I was hesitant buying this as I was thinking curry had to be in some exotic packaging to be good but I'm glad I picked it up. We've purchased curry from specialty shops and in my opinion this one holds its own really well.
I love making curry chicken and this curry powder is great . I still add my other jerk seasonings to pop the taste out, but this is a great seasoning.

My daughter make the best Jamaican food I've ever tasted. Even after 40+ trips to the island, no one can cook "Jamaica-stylee" like her. My son-in-law is from Jamaica, and he loves his wife's cooking; his eyes light up when the plate is put down in front of him. This is the best curry powder we've ever bought.CURRY POWDER FRESHLY PACKED IN LARGE JARS, spices, herbs, seasonings
This curry powder is cheap but with good quality. It is not very strong. What I like most is that it is not salty. I can add salt separately as I wish.

column9: Very nice curry powder at a very reasonable price.
column10: This curry is very good and much better than the curry you find in most super markets and about 1/4-1/5 the price!.Also have had good experience with the quick delivery of this curry powder and their customer service .Best value I have seen for curry powder on Amazon too btw.

column9: Great for the daily cocktail hour...
column10: I ordered this cheese for my Mom who was on vacation in Florida. It arrived on time. This swiss cheese is huge and tasty. She has had several cocktail parties since and all loved it. I will be ordering from this company again. Well done.

column9: Great for the daily cocktail hour...
column10: I ordered this cheese for my Mom who was on vacation in Florida. It arrived on time. This swiss cheese is huge and tasty. She has had several cocktail parties since and all loved it. I will be ordering from this company again. Well done.

column9: In search of a good pizza sauce.....
column10: We were looking for a nutritious and flavorful sauce for our homemade pizzas and stumbled onto this one. Glad we did. All healthy ingrediants and a pleasant flavor. After trying it, I then ordered a whole case. We tried several others and while healthy, the flavor didn't touch this product. Very pleased to have found it.

My husband and I have made homemade pasta sauce from Roma tomatoes we grow in our garden for the last 30 years. Last summer, due to weather conditions and blight on the plants, we didn't have enough tomatoes to make large batches of sauce.  I am Italian-American and have fairly high standards for pasta sauce.  I read online reviews and tried a few jarred sauces, only to be disappointed.  Since I frequently shop on Amazon, I searched for a pasta sauce with good reviews, and found this Eden sauce.  The ingredients were impressive and the price was very reasonable, so I decided to give it a try.  The flavor is very close to my homemade sauce, but the consistency is thicker, which makes it ideal for pizza.  I am very pleased with the quality and taste of this sauce.

This sauce is great for a base pasta sauce.  Many flavors can be added onto these already pure ingredients.  I buy this one for piece of mind, the flavor on its own is pretty good too.  A good company, plenty of other canned products they make are tasty also.

I started buying Muir Glen Pizza Sauce to make homemade pizza and absolutely loved it. On a repurchase, I accidentally ordered the Eden Pizza/Pasta Sauce and loved that as well for pizza. One day my husband wanted spaghetti but I was out of my usual base sauce, Classico. I always use a base and then add my own ingredients such as ground meat, garlic, diced tomatoes, herbs, etc. I took a chance and used the Eden Pizza/Pasta Sauce for my base and my husband loved it. This is a paraphrase but substantially what he said. "I know you have been making spaghetti sauce for me for thirty years and this can't possibly be the best, but it sure tastes like it." I had been concerned that it would taste more like pizza than spaghetti but it did not. I can't speak to how this sauce would taste over pasta without the amendments I made, but as a base it works beautifully. Being in Nairobi Kenya and having little access to organic canned foods, this fit my needs--great shipping and wonderful product
Am very happy to be able to buy such a good product online having it delivered right to my door.  This will be an item I continue to buy as needed.

column9: I've used 9 cans and its been growing on me.

column4: Donna's Reviews "I Love Shopping on Amazon!"
column10: Eden Organic Pizza Pasta Sauce, Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) I like to make my own pizza and based on the other reviews bought a case of this..Glad I did very happy! Taste great...

Okay so my family and I moved about 25 miles away from our fave pizza place which left me on a quest to find good sauce and this is definitely the one, single best canned pizza sauce. In my honest opinion second only to Don Pepino's which is also a good sauce but seems a tad more commercial(more like the stuff in the cheesy pizza spots, not sooo much authentic and not organic like this one). It is a thick sauce but not as thick as some other organic sauces I have tried (which seem kind of like marinara sauce with a pizza sauce label on it, lol). The teabags are so full of flavor, I have to take the teabag out of my cup halfway through finishing it, because there is so much flavor in it! Works out well, I use each teabag for two (2) cups of tea. So, it's almost like you're receiving twice as much in your box!
We drink alot of green tea mixed with our homemade ginger tea.  This was the best priced organic green tea from all sources we tried.  Very happy with the tea.

I bought this tea for the health benefits, and although I am not the biggest fan of tea, I knew that this tea was extremely overbearing and is very hard to drink. This team smelled like perfume, as well as tasted like it. It left my mouth smelling like I drank a bottle of perfume and it just wasn't pleasant at all. I can usually handle things that taste bad, but this was an exception. If you can get over the strong taste, however, I'm sure you'll be fine.

I am a tea drinker so why not drink a tea that is good for you.  This tea is mild and slightly fragrant.  I am concerned however that this tea came in newer individual packets that look newer then the tea bag itself. I also thought that this tea was a little over priced, since I am able to go to an Asian market and get green tea cheaper.
I have been looking for a good, organic tea but I just did not like the taste of this one.  It feels like it leaves a film in your mouth.

I have purchased this "Organic Green Tea" locally and have to say its very good.  Its smooth and light... similar to other organic based green tea's I have tried. The price is more than fare... and would recommend.

This is the worst green tea I have ever had. Don't be fooled by the pristine picture on the packaging. This tea is made in China--I doubt where this tea is grown looks anything like the picture. I try not to buy food products from China considering how polluted it is. This may be "organic" but the water and air in China is toxic so it doesnt really matter. The taste is all off and it leaves a sour/bitter taste in your mouth. The tea bags are made of a cheap brown material. Overall this product is bad.

I am so impressed with the Funky Monkey line of products.  They are great for kids and the taste is awesome!  I highly recommend this product.

great snack.  You can find these at whole foods or other natural food stores, but for twice the price! better to buy online if you buy these on a regular basis since while these are tasty, they're not worth 2.39 in the checkout line!

LOVE THIS PRODUCTBUT....These are .85 cents a pack at Publix and people think they are getting a good deal on here.GO TO PUBLIX PEOPLE -

column9: I wish I had found this earlier
column10: I discovered Beet Juice when I went to Whole Foods in search of a natural source of Iron. column9: Best Guac mix ever, but use less than directions
column10: I live this guacamole mix and being organic is an extra bonus!!  I use about 1/2 of what the directions say.  It is very tasty!!
Great dip mix! The recipe calls for like 2 avocados but you can stretch it to 4-5 if you have a big group. It makes it less "peppy," but still better than the rest...

I've tried McCormick's (too bland) and Lawry's (the runner-up) and a few other brands that I can no longer remember, but this is by far the best guacamole seasoning mix I've used. It's surprisingly peppery (a sweet red smoked pepper flavor) and has a good onion taste, too. Our local Whole Foods stopped carrying this product for some reason, so I had to order online.  It is the best guacamole mix I have ever used.

column9: Great Brown Rice Cereal - try with Stevia powder or honey
column10: I eat this cereal with raw milk and sprinkle powdered Stevia on it.  It is delicious and a filling snack or treat.  I sometimes mix in the 'regular' (non-cocoa) Erewhon cereal and if I get really daring I put a little honey on it too.  'It's all good!'

This is an incredible product.  First, Erewhon is a highly respected company for bringing quality ingredients to our grocery shelves.  For those of us who can't eat wheat or prefer not to, this is the cereal brand of choice.  Brown Rice with just simple, natural ingredients.  I love them all, but this Cocoa Crispy one is my favorite for the whole family.  My nieces, 5 and 6 love this cereal so much that I send them boxes every month.  My college aged kids love it because it fills them up and it is highly nutritious for the beginning or even end of the night snack.  With all the junk they can eat in the cafeterias, this cereal really is a welcome food!  I love it for my chocolate fix.  This with almond milk is the perfect snack!  Great company, great tasting food!

column9: Yummy and Good for you Chocolate Brown Rice Cereal
column10: My family is on a Dye free, Preservative free, Gluten free, Soy free and Lactose free diet!  But you would never know in our household because of the great products we eat like this cereal!  If you or your child loves chocolate in the morning, then this cereal is for you.  If you like to make treats with rice cereal, then this cereal is a great choice.  I love it and so does my 4 year son!
This cereal tastes great, is not loaded with sugar, and is gluten free. The kids don't even know they are eating something "good" for them, lol! Highly recommend.

I recently went on a gluten free diet.  Where this hurts the most so far is breakfast.  There is barely any flavor to this cereal.I picked up mine from Whole Foods, not Amazon.I'd rather it was fortified by vitamins and even though I'm sure it would taste worse, at least it would have taste and do me some good.  It really isn't filling.  The barely darkened milk doesn't taste chocolate, though does lose some of the good taste of the only thing with taste - the milk.  I don't know if it is the rice flavor, or the general lack of flavor, but there is a hint of staleness, I think.  Could I add sugar?  Sure, and then I'd taste the sugar or sugar substitute, but that doesn't make it more healthy.To be fair, it isn't bitter, or too salty, or too sweet, or sour, so there isn't anything there to offend.  If you are eating it fast enough, it won't be mush.  If it has stopped making noise, you are in danger of mushiness.  It makes some truly good snap crackle and pop noises.  I suppose the cereal is bad enough to encourage you to eat some fresh fruit to have a good taste in your mouth and remember to take a daily vitamin (I can only take those every other day).It is cheaper than granola.  When I can afford it, I'm totally getting outrageous gluten free granola.  I also have envirokids to try next.

Yup, in this case it holds true.  I didn't find them to taste any better, in fact I really liked the berry taste less, but regardless it's not a great tastes no matter how you look at it.  But what I really found lacking was the boost.  While it does give you that initial energy boost, it's not as fast or as great as that you get from the 5 Hour drink, and it does NOT last anywhere near 5 hours!  I have to drink 2 in the time I'd drink 1 5 Hour, and still find myself dragging.  I work the graveyard shift, so alertness is sometimes something I have to trick my body into...it really aint gonna happen w/ thisRed Rain Energy Shot.  In my opinion, it was a waste of my money.

These are great. So far I've tried 5 hour energy (extra strength and regular) as well as 6 hour power.  5 hour energy is great but too expensive.  I saved a few bucks with 6 hour power but it did not work.  I'm very happy with Red Rain and I'm excited to pay only $11 a case with subscribe and save.  The flavor isn't great compared to 5 hour energy but I don't care since I take these down FAST. If I bought these to enjoy the flavor, I'd buy a big can of one of those sugary energy drinks.

Red Rain berry flavor tastes great and gives you the energy and focus to get through the day. You can drink the 2oz all-at-once or sip on it throughout the day. The directions say to use or discard within 3 days after opening. Refrigeration is not required. It also contains a 2000mg energy blend which consists of Glucuronolactone, Malic Acid, Caffeine, Choline Chloride, N-Acetyle L-Tyrosine. The amount of caffeine it says is comparable to a cup of the leading brand of coffee. At the current price of $12.00 for a 12-pack, or $10.20 with Amazon's Subscribe and Save, it's much cheaper than the other leading energy shot product.

I recently purchased this product without the subscribe and save deal, and man, was I wrong! I will definitely be purchasing Red Rain on a subscription basis. This product tastes much LESS bitter than the leading brand, but tastes better. It is almost sweet, but verrry light on the palate. I quite enjoyed sipping it. I ordered the extra strength because it is cheaper and has more bang-for-your-buck. I generally will drink half a bottle at once and judge where I am over the next half hour. If I need the extra boost, I will go for sipping the latter half of the bottle over the next half hour until my energy is right where I want it, then save the rest for later. Brilliant! when you can buy an extra-strength shot at LESS THAN HALF the original strength leading shot price! I believe this product may be the "hidden gem" of energy drinks. It is hard enough to find a cheaper energy drink that even matches the higher-priced, but tasty, competitor(s), yet this one supercedes them all! I have tried 5-hour Energy ($$), Energy 2000 Berry Flavor (taste? energy?), Monster shots (ok), 6-hour power (ok), and above all, Red Rain Extra Strength Berry (the best!)The search is over!!

I started using 5 Hour Energy about 10 years ago while a long haul truck driver. Then, I would buy them from ebay in the 100's in order to get the best price.But since 5 hour has been doing its media blitz over the last few years it has increased in price to the point that Im just not willing to pay. Guess they have to pay for that advertizing somehow...I just happened to see this product on the shelf of a Walmart & I decided at the price, it was worth a shot. ( pun intended...)Red Rain works for me just as well as 5 Hour. The size,taste & packaging is similar but it comes in a 12-pack for less than a 5 hour 6-pack. As long as Red Rain keeps up the quality & keeps down the price Ill keep using it.

column9: GREAT product for a LOW price!

And I think it is one of the best investments I made during the test prep period.The taste is not bad, it's actually kind of good.After drinking the product, I felt really energetic. And I personally think the effects are no less than other brands.  Especially with this product is the lowest priced energy drink on Amazon, you cannot ask for more.Overall, I really recommend this product too all of you that needs an energy boost everyday.

column9: A powerful kick, but not without some side effects
column10: I drink energy shots on a daily basis. I struggle with chronic fatigue and without an energy shot in the morning I'm falling a sleep at my desk by noon. Anyway, I've tried them all: the balanced Red Bull Energy Shot (one of my favorites), NOS Energy Shot (delicious, but hard to find), 5 Hour Energy (too expensive), Rockstar Shots (taste awful)... I bought this because the price was so amazing. Let me tell you that this is one of the strongest energy shots I have tried. It's a really, really powerful kick. However, it did give me a pretty severe case of the jitters and some nausea (which went away quickly). I think I'm adjusting to them, though.Like I said, I've tried dozens of energy shots on the market. I can honestly say this one is one of the strongest.

column9: Not going to win any prizes
column10: I ordered this because the price is much better than 5HE but I'm rather disappointed.  I take 1/2 a bottle of 5HE and it gets me going all day long including making me much more energetic for my morning run.  I expected this to be at least comparable considering it's "Extra Strength" but it's not.  I tried 1/2 a bottle and it doesn't work nearly as well as 5HE.  I've actually had to consume the entire bottle to get close to the same effects of 1/2 of 5HE.  I guess in this case you do get what you pay for...not much.  Considering I'm taking twice what I took with the other brand I'm not saving any money since I'll go through the product much faster.  If you're used to 5HE and it works for you stick to it. I am giving this 3 stars because it has partial effects and the taste is mild.

column9: 1/2 as good as regular strength name brand

column9: I am a HUGE fan of 5 Hour Energy - Extra Strength. And I still am. But I was urged to try this product, and it WORKS! A+!!!
column10: As the title states, I am a big fan of 5 Hour Energy - Extra Strength. (5-Hour Energy Extra Strength Berry 12 bttls I use them because I'm terminally ill, and I'm sometimes so weak that I start to fall asleep even when my upset stomach is still in full swing.
