In addition, more broken tea leaves were found deeper in the can.I then poured out the entire can of white tea leaves to examine.  I was surprised to see how much impurities were buried in the tea leaves.To be honest, I have not seen that much impurities in a whole leaf tea of any kind (white, green, or black). To me, the tea farm did not do a good job in handling the tea leaves.  I would strongly question the claim of USDA Organic rating of this tea.If you never tried white teas before, please do not assume that the yellowish flowers and chips are part of the white tea.  They are not since this tea is Silver Needle.I had to remove all the impurities by hand-picking all the whole tea leaves and discarding the broken ones and the yellow flowers and chips.  I still question how this tea could be so badly handled by the tea farmer or the tea exporter/importer.I am sure there are better white teas out there. The benefits of BSM are numerous.Ive only been taking for about 5 days but have noticed increased energy(and mood).The most striking benefit is that it nearly eliminated my cramping during my period.Normally I would have to take 1000-2000 mg of tylenol to make it through the day.Its certainly worth a try if you have heavy periods,cysts or fibroids.Very good stuff.I take mine in hot tea and you can barely taste it.

This molasses has a wonderful flavor (if you like molasses), and it's nice to know it's organic and unsulphured.(For a nice caffeine-free hot beverage, try a teaspoon or two of this molasses in hot water with additional sweetener, a few drops of vanilla, and creamer of your choice. And you can make your own brown sugar by mixing a teaspoon into a half cup of white sugar.)The only reason I'm not giving this product five stars is because, as other reviewers have mentioned, the packaging doesn't hold up well in shipping. One of our orders had to be returned because it leaked out of the package and into the courier's truck. Another order leaked but at least stayed within the Amazon box.Since it's molasses, I'm going to guess that such leaks occur more often in hot summer months. It's still a great product, so winter might be a good time to stock up!
Good quality blackstrap molasses. Great flavor whether used as a topping or in cooking. A bit strong as a beverage sweetener, however. It is an acquired taste. Great price!
great tasting molasses I like this product a lot but the packaging was very poor,the bottles leaking. please improve your shipping & handling.

These 3 bottles came wrapped in a/1 plastic bag.  The bottles leaked at the lid into the plastic bag and into the box.  Luckily the only items messed up were the bottles of molasses.  I was not allowed to return them because they were food.  Just to let everyone know the packaging was poor.  They should have been wrapped separately in bubble wrap.I know the product is good. That is why I can rate it.  I can't give it 5 stars because we didn't use this particular product. We have purchased it in the past at Whole Foods and will purchase it there in the future.  My husband uses it to make his barbeque sauce.

column9: Love the molasses but not the packaging
column10: I received my first shipment of this molasses yesterday.  My UPS driver brought it to my door.  He had opened the bottom of the box and said he needed to set it down where it wouldn't leak on anything.  It had alaready leaked on some of his cargo!We went to the sink and set it down there.  Molasses was all over the inside of the box and dripping out one corner!He suggested I beg or PLEAD with Amazon to make sure tape or something of tht sort would be placed around the lid of the replacement shipment.Sorry, that didn't happen.  The replacement came today and two of the lids were loose, with less leakage though, since today's shipment was overnight....less time to leak.  And also, the UPS driver had opened the box when he loaded his truck and had tightened the offending lids!I truly love the molasses.I have three loaves of molasses oatmeal bread rising in the kitchen right now.  They are smelling wonderful.I am just hoping the leakage problem will be solved before my next shipment is due in six months.I'd love to see this wonderful product keep coming!

The flavor of the molasses is exactly what you'd expect sweet with a hint bitter and an earthy aftertaste.  I've used it in several recipes with great success.  If I'd purchased this item at the grocery store it would get a 4-5 star rating; however the packaging is not designed to be shipped.  When I received the bottles one of them had opened in transit and leaked over everything.  If you order this through Amazon make sure you open the box over a sink to minimize the area you'll have to clean.

One tbsp of Wholesome organic molasses offers me 20% iron, 18% calcium which is more in compare to milk for every calorie, 15% potassium, 11% magnesium, and 10% copper. With 50 calories and 11gr sugar, I only use one tbsp a day in my green tea daily as well as when I am in need of fast energy, without any additives, right exactly before any sports like weight lifting, mountain biking, surfing, etc. if I have no access to banana or grapefruit. Potassium stops cramps and this is my life saver.. This is a necessity just like I consume honey, Bragg's apple cider, organic flax-sesame seeds, etc. as super food. Once opened, I place some in a smaller tightly sealed container and keep it in refrigerator, refill as needed, but consume it within 6 months. I am into sports, diet and nutrition and blackstrap molasses' nutritional value varies depending on the quality of the sugar cane or beets from which it was extracted. For that reason organic and brand is extremely important to me. Honey looses its medicinal value when added to tea but since molasses is a by product which was heated during the production, further heat does not impact the nutritional value. With all that said, you will still need to get used to the taste since the taste is somewhere around bitter, beet juice and changes the taste of the tea. Bravo.
Great buy! need plenty for my Whole wheat Bread I make weekly this was the way to go the price was perfect and I am very happy with the size they last a long time.
i use this instead of sugar as sweetener. Its super nutritious and once you get used to the taste its awesome. Has a strong raw taste.

This is the stuff from which the smoothest rum would be made!  The quality is unparalleled.  I take a spoonful/day in vinegar, or add a spoonful in protein drinks, or add to my defatted peanut flour and polenta desert.  Wholesome Sweeteners is an ORGANIC/FAIR TRADE,quality product which I have on subscription. One could not find a better molasses anywhere at any price.

I love molasses very much. This is a fair trade organic molasses that's very dark, not very sweet and has all that complicated molasses flavor. I use it in bread fairly regularly, in cookies less often and occasionally on cold winter nights in my coffee. The flavor is fantastic and doesn't bake out so it works very well in spelt or whole wheat flour breads.Very recommended!

Every 18 weeks or so I order another shipment of Wholesome Sweeteners' Organic Black-Strap Molasses.  That's about how long it takes me to use up the previous shipment of 6 bottles.  I order that many to qualify for free shipping - - that's what makes it a really good buy.  I really haven't had problems with the shipping.  Once in a while there's a bottle which is slighly leaking, but a little hot water with a sponge deals with it.  I religiously use the Molasses in everything from tea to coffee to baking.  I recommend it.

column9: Quick Response from Molasses Company -- Recommend Highly -- Reneg on Previous Review

I have one tablespoon every morning in hot water.  Being pregnant, it's part of my daily medicine because it has iron and other nutrients.  The taste took a week or so to get used to, but now it's quite pleasant.  I'm literally preparing water for a cup right now!  I highly recommend this product.

I love the price I got this for, and love the quality of the product. Will order again from this seller.

I have used this tea now for about 3 months.  I enjoy 3 cups a day.  I have used various green tea bags and different brands of loose green tea.  This Sencha is mild and steeps to green not brown green tea.  I make it in a French coffee press.  I put 1 tablespoon of tea in the press and pour in 8 ounces of filtered water that I have heated in the microwave for 1 minute 20 seconds.  I stir the tea for about 2 seconds and press.  I pour the hot tea into a cup in which I have finely grated frozen ginger root.  I do not need a sweetener.  But it is good with honey, agave nectar or brown rice syrup.  I can make 3 cups of tea before needing to empty out the used tea and use fresh loose tea. The used tea produces a less green tea (more amber in color) but it is still good.
For the cost of this product there are much better senchas out there.  This steeps to brown, not green like they claim.  Low quality tea.
The price was right on this product, so I tried it.Taste is just OK for Sencha.  I won't be buying more.

When I first wrote this review, for some reason Amazon did not have it available:  This price now is excellent, I began drinking this years ago as a macrobiotic practitioner, which I still use much of the time.  This is the best green tea I have found and I have tried many. You only steep if for a coupe of minutes.  The review saying it brews brown is somehow in error this is an excellent tea.  sorry for the earlier error about the price. updated 8 July 2012.  ronI have used this tea for years, usually buying from health food stores, I was pleased to find it being sold by Amazon. Delicious sprouts in 5 days or so, just like fresh radishes. Great way to add variety and more nutrition to your salads and great on sandwiches. Almost every seed sprouted. Good price and quality.

column9: Very fresh Radish sprout at home
column10: I made 2 times. First,  you Need be able to change water twice/a day. 3 times is better if you can. Use correct amount of seed  is very important. if you use too much seed, sprout rise higher than the rid and won't  close.If the rid is an half inch taller, I could make bigger sprout but nothing is perfect. we enjoy them this tangy taste radish sprout in salad and sandwiched much more now. It goes well with Sashimi and Sushi roll.As well as  broiled fish and tofu-steak.

I was a little trepidous ordering seeds online; these seeds are really good. I have been growing sprouts for years and these were not only easy to grow but taste terrific...nice bit of "spice" in our salads and sandwiches.

This is a wonderfully grassy, fresh-tasting oil.  It is worth EVERY penny;  I use it anywhere that I want the fresh flavor of the oil to shine through -- fresh lemon vinegrette, homemade hummus, as a dipping oil for fresh bread, etc.  It works fine for cooking or sauteeing but to be honest, it's best used in items that aren't cooked so that the flavor can really sing.

Very flavorful oil, makes a huge difference when drizzled over vegetables, or in a vinaigrette. Unfortunately the bottle isn't very good - the cork doesn't seal well, and the little "spout" on the bottle is prone to dripping. There was even some leakage during shipping - just a drop, but there shouldn't be any.

column9: Just like when I was a kid!
column10: This candy is the best!  I remember going to the store as a kid and buying these and pretending it was a communion wafer with my friends.  I'm so glad to share this with my children.  It is an edible wafer with little nonpereil beads inside.  They are not too sweet.  Everyone who tries them seems to love them.  You cannot eat just one!

column9: They remind me of the neighborhood candy store
column10: After eating a handful of these and remembering what it was like to be eight years old, I read the ingredients list on the box:- Yummy sugary things- Weird styrofoamy stuff that melts in your mouth- Memories of a simpler timeNot only are they tasty and addictive and packed with nostalgia, but it's a lot of fun to feed satellite wafers to people who have never seen them before.  They start out completely unconvinced that the weird styrofoamy stuff is edible, and they want to rip it open to get to the stuff inside.  After a few rounds of convincing, the braver ones go for it.You can now easily tell the cool kids from the fuddy duddies-- the cool ones take another, and the boring ones scrunch up their faces in that way that your mother always warned you about.  Walk away from them, secretly hoping their faces will freeze that way.  The face-scrunchers mean more satellite wafers for you.  Yay!

column9: The most delicious candy ever made
column10: I love these candies. Im waiting for my order now. I used to order on ebay, but shipping was way too much, so found them on amazon, thank god. I eaisly go through the two boxes in a few days, by myself!! The absolute best!!!!!
These have become my favorite candy! I don't know what it is about them, but I love them! 2 of us easily go through 2 boxes of these in less than a week!

These candys were a favorite of mine growing up and you can not find them in any stores anymore. I found them online and I was so happy. They are a wafer like candy with little candies inside, they are delicious.

I remember these as a kid and like other reviewers, they reminded of communion wafers.  I purchased a box for my sister who is a teacher.  She handed them out to her students, who said they tasted like ice cream cones.  I subscribe to these - 4 boxes a month.  I can finish off a box in 2 days.  Love them!

You might be worried that a candy says edible on the front, you might be thinking why they would need to put that there. But, this really is a great candy, not too sweet, they DO NOT taste like styrofoam, as the one review says. The best way to describe them is a communion wafer with tiny candy beads, called "sugar pearls", inside of them, they are not too hard or too soft. My dad would bring these home from work when my sister and I were kids, and we both loved them. Although I did not buy mine from Amazon, I would recommend doing so, these really are great! There's about a gram of sugar per wafer, and almost no fat so if you're diet conscience these are still for you.
These are so good and such a great bargain.  I plan to purchase more because I already ate both boxes!!

My daughter first got a little bag of these at Dylan's candy store in NY.  She loved them and they are low in sugar compared to most candies.  I bought this big box of wafers and we packaged them up in gift bags for her 8 year old classmates.  They loved them too as they were unique and had never seen them before.  The wafer is nostalgic of a communion wafer and filled with little colored sprinkles.  If you've never tried them before, I would start with a much smaller package than this big box.

I ordered these for a gift to find they were stale-so I emailed Amazon and they were very forgiving and prompt at returning my money because the candy was out of stock. The previous time I ordered these they were great! Would order again!

I remember eating these as a kid in the 80's and absolutely loved them, I too like another reviewer mentioned used to pretend that these were communion wafers lol to me thats the best part, the candy beads are yummy too but the wafer is what's classic, I have found these for sale at candy stores/old general stores but they were usually quite expensive and you eat the whole pack in a few minutes, so I searched ebay and the prices were high their too so I check Amazon and wa-la I find a great price for a 2 pack box of 240pcs per box, I got my package yesterday from Amazon and literally just started tearing into them, they're that good, if you never had them before you have to try them !!

column9: These are a favorite from the past

I do wish they were a bit cheaper but this is the best deal I've found anywhere.  Since they are imported it makes sense that they cost a little more then some other types of candy.  Love these!

I used to buy these candies at Disney land in California as a kid so this is a real treat to be able to get them again. They are one of my favorites as they bring back so many memories and I just love the taste and uniqueness of the product.  Amazon has the best price around!

These corn starch ufo's are truly unsatisfying. I find it hard to believe that anyone could be an ardent follower. They simply don't taste good.

I had never heard of these but saw all the good reviews & thought all these people can't be wrong. Man, was I Wrong, these things were horrible. I bought 2 boxes & couldn't give them away so I just threw them away. They taste like styro-foam, I'll never make that mistake again.

I prefer non-flavored, semi-strong brews that I can add flavored creamer to when desired.  This coffee has been the best I've tried yet, if you are looking for a semi-dark, yet not bitter coffee to start off your morning.  It makes our kitchen smell like a coffee house each morning.I have only found 1-3 types of non-flavored K-cups that I would buy again and this one is probably atop my list.
I was trying to find a decent colombian coffee and stumbled upon this gem.  And with Prime, shipping is freeeeee. Awesome.  Great flavor, smooth, not too bitter.
Had been looking for a Columbian coffee for the Keurig. This is a great morning coffee and makes a pretty tasty iced coffee for those warm afternoon.  Good price for 24 count box.

I have a pretty serious coffee habit.  I drink 3 or 4 cups in the morning and a couple more through the day.  I enjoy flavourful grinds, with nutty characteristics, but not too strong.  While I can and have drunk Italian style espresso, for my daily coffee I prefer something that doesn't have a chance of making me jumpy or give me a headache.  This Caribou Columbian is perfect.
not as impressed as I had hoped. the standard blend is still my favorite. the is wroth buying but there is better out there. to each there own.
I drink one cup of coffee in the AM so I really want a good one......not too strong....not too weak. This is perfect!

I received a Keurig B-70 for Christmas a couple years ago and with it got the Caribou Colombian k-cups.  I used to go to Caribou at least once or twice a week to get my coffee and then just have Folgers the rest of the time.  When I made my first cup of coffee with the Caribou Colombian I told my boyfriend and son that I would never have to go to caribou coffee house/shop again.  This is the best of all caribou coffee.  It's smooth and delicious.  If you like mocha or dont like coffee black it is also delicious with sugar and cream or milk.  I make mine with a dash of chocolate milk and 2 heaping tablespoons of Swiss miss hot cocoa for a 14 to 15 oz cup.  Very good!  I have not had any other kind of coffee since.  This is the perfect coffee!
This is my husbands favorite morning coffee blend. Not too bold, just the perfect jumpp start to the day !
My Mom and sister love this coffee.  I purchased it, just for the heck of it.  And received big thank you's after they tried it.  My sister is a coffee snob, so high marks for Caribou.
The quality of these cups were awful.  Several of them broke open in my keurig brewer and leaked grounds into my coffee. This has not happened with any other brand of k cups.
I expect a more robust flavor from a Colombian coffee. The Caribou K cup has an OK flavor; it's just weak.

I'm pretty easy to please when it comes to coffee, I like my cup a little strong but usually go for medium styles as the bold and extra bold blends upset my stomach. Columbia is typically my favorite type of coffee and I was very pleased with this offering from Caribou Coffee. I've had their original "blend" on multiple occasions as its one of my favorites in k-cups. I'm not really sure how my coffee tastes stack up against other peoples but if you like a good middle of the road cup of coffee I highly recommend this.
Very happy with this Caribou K-cup.  It's exactly what its supposed to be...with just right amount of coffee flavor and aroma.  (I like smooth light-to-medium coffee with no acid taste)
I am a Green Mountain Dark Magic fanatic, so this coffee fell a little short for me. It has good flavor, but is just not strong enough for me.
I've only tried the Caribou in the k-cups - and love it.  It is consistently good - not bitter - will purchase again

I am a fan of of Fresh Produce line and have been known to buy things in California and put in my luggage-like these croutons. Apparently not impossible to find in MA but difficult, particularly not owning a car (common in Cambridge) and using public transport or Zipcar.I really like these croutons on top of chili and in Tex-Mex salads. What I like about them is that they add crunch but are not aggressively seasoned like most croutons.Someone was pretty darn clever when they came up with this idea. I was tickled to find them on Amazon.

Caper berries are delicious.  I first had them in a tasty salad at the Galaxy Grill in Manhattan.  This particular brand of caper berries is okay but there is too much of a frequency of biting into a berry that is too mature so you wind up with a mouth of seeds which is not pleasant.

I have given a Roland Wild Caper Berry to ten of my close family and friends, and guess what? They LOVED them! Each and every person wants to buy a case or share in purchasing a case--they all know what a great food feels like, tastes like, and excites like!These little berries can be placed in Oyster Shooters, like my favorite restaurant in Port Angeles, Michael's, utilizes the berries, or the berries can be tossed in a killer Pasta Putanesca; they really can become any cooks close friend.

I originally purchased the 5-bin carousel directly from Tassimo, and I wanted another one because I routinely use about 10 different types of T-Discs.  For some reason, Tassimo stopped offering their carousel except to their "European cafe collection" customers.  The only other carousel I could find was this one, the Nifty Home Products carousel.  It is a little smaller, 4 bins instead of 5, and does not have the holder for the cleaning disc like the Tassimo holder.  I didn't think I would like it as well.  As it turns out, I like it just as well if not better.  It is an attractive carousel, and it spins better than the Tassimo carousel.  Although its capacity is slightly less, it is not bad.  It can hold full stacks of 4 different T-discs, or, if you don't mind taking T-discs out of both the bottom and the top of each bin, it can hold half-stacks of 8 different T-discs.  And the price on Amazon is great.  I definitely recommend this carousel.

column9: This is half the price it's selling for in a kitchen store; it's made very well
column10: I debated getting one of these in a gourmet kitchen store but declined because I thought the price tag was too steep at fifty bucks. However, I just received one as an early birthday present to go with my new Tassimo coffee maker and, in doing my review, find it's far cheaper as of the time of my review here.This is made very well...heavy shiny metal but it flows very easily. So much so that you could spin it fast and keep it twirling. I only say that, not because you'd need to do that, but so you can visualize that there is no tipping or hard pushing when selecting your coffee, tea, or cocoa.We had the self-dispenser boxes on our conter but, let's face it, it's not so attractive to do that and I like to keep a clean and organized countertop.  This is ideal if you have guests or if you like switching up your drinking choices. While it has 4 slots for drinks, you can actually have 8 different selections because you can pull from both the bottom and the top of the dispenser so we fill the dispenser slots with 2 different choices so we have 8 choices total. If you entertain or have frequent guests as we do, you can have some lighter coffees and heavier ones, tea, cocoa, espresso, etc and each guest can pick their choice to make their brew. But we like this for our choice variations equally.  I love green tea for the health benefits and taste, I like Nabob Columbian coffee for a smaller cup that's smooth, and Starbucks for a large cup, we like to keep the Milka hot chocolate on hand for a low cal decadent treat, etc. With an easy turn you can make your choice and it takes up very little room on the counter while matching our stainless appliances so it seems to fit well without looking unsightly.I usually list negatives in my reviews to give a balanced picture but I really don't have any for this one. It's a good size and works well.  Happy I got it.Note: This is similar to the cream dispensers or jelly dispensers you might see at a breakfast restaurant if that helps visualize it. This is for the Tassimo brand coffees.
The carousel is a very convenient way to store T-disc coffees and teas. Everything can be seen and reached easily. We use one for 'high test' coffees and the other one for our de-caf, chocolate ones.

This thing is almost a necessity if you have a Tassimo machine. It will hold at least 40 (10 per column) of the small T-discs. If you have a specialty drink that takes 2 discs (1 small T-disc and 1 large T-disc), it can accomodate those too. I normally alternate the small and the large in the same column and that works out to 4 small and 4 large discs per column. I haven't tried a column with all large discs, but I suspect it would hold about 6-7 of those in one column. If you like a variety of drinks to be available at your house, I suggest picking up 2 of these. You'll be glad you did! Well worth the price!

Basically, this should seem dumb and unnecessary, but the t-disks are little buggers to keep organized. So, it's rather nice to have, and it makes me feel like I live in an Italian B&B. I refill every other day or so from coffee collection in freezer.
Very handy, my only regret (that I knew going into the purchase) is that it does not hold more T-discs.

This is a very nifty carousel for my Tassimo t-discs.  Everything fits very nicely and the product is of excellent quality.  The heft is nice, carousel turns without sticking, and it is clear that this is not a cheaply made item.  Thank you!
this is awesome if you have one of these coffee pots it really helps keep everything in order if everyone in your house drinks different kinds of coffee
This is the best way to store your T-Discs. I have been using it for about a year and it works great. It holds two packages (32 T-discs) easily and rotates freely. Good product.
I purchased this carousel as a gift for my mother.  It's well made, works perfectly and she loves it.  What else can you ask for?

The Carousel is easy to fill and easy getting the T Discs' out. Takes up very little space and the stainless steel is easy to clean and looks sleek on the counter.  It is affordable and ordering and receiving it was easy as is everything from Amazon.

Want to store more Tassimo T-Discs in less space? Get rid of those pesky boxes?Than buy one (or a pair) of these carousels to keep your coffee corralled.The units (Yep, I bought two) are very stable, and each of the four columns of the unit easily holds 10 regular- or 6 jumbo-sized T-Discs (creamers, Gevalia "Starbucks clones"). We use one carousel for our coffees, the other for our espressos and cremas.Just ensure that you have sufficient "spinning room" so they don't catch each other or something else in your cabinet. This is MUCH more compact than stacking 8 boxes in the cabinet.Get one (or two) for your kitchen -- you'll be glad you did!
Tassimo t-disc storage medium.  Well made although capacity is small.  You will more than likely need several of these if you beverage choices vary.

Nifty Home Products Coffee T Disc Carousel is very close to the real thing from Tassimo but only for a fraction of the price.  I am thinking about buying a second one since I am stocking up on more varieties of my T-Discs.
This carousel is perfect; it fits on the counter right next to my coffee maker. The t-discs fit precisely. I'd recommend this product to others.
WHAT A GREAT LITTLE CAROUSEL. LOOKS GREAT ON THE COUNTER. IT TAKES UP HARDLY ANY ROOM AND KEEPS ALL MY T-DISCS IN ONE TIDY LITTLE PLACE. I ABSOLUTELY LOVE IT!
put a different variety of coffees etc in this doodad and take your pick when you feel the urge. what else can i say... it is "nifty"... lol.....

column9: Great T-Disc Organizer! Check It Out!
column10: The Nifty Home Products Coffee T-Disc Carousel is a Great Organizer & convenient way to store all Brands of Coffee, Tea & Cappuccino T-disc's, made for the Tassimo coffee maker.Highlights on Why it gets a 5-Star Rating:* Chrome finish, with inverted U-shaped center pick'-up handle', and it spins quite easily.* Takes all T-Disc sizes, the discs are EZ to Load into the vertical bins, and it's also very easy to take discs from the top or the bottom of the holder.* Has 4 separate bins which allows for 2 main different Sizes of T-Discs.* Perfect holder for 30 to 40 T-Dics, with a small kitchen footprint and can Snug the wall, if need to.* A Great Gift for someone that has a Tassimo Coffee/Cappuccino maker!Just works perfectly!

column9: Nifty, functional T disc storage that has held up well over 6 months.
column10: I bought this as a gift for a co-worker who is kind enough to brew me cups of coffee in moments of desperation (or even 'just because').  I gave it to her about 6 months ago and she has it set up in her office and keeps it well stocked (I help with that part too...she really does help me out with keeping my blood-caffeine titers level).  This is definitely a well utilized product for her.I waited for the review to make sure that it has held up well, and it has.  High marks on functionality and usefulness--it is always stocked and keeps her from having to dig around looking for the 'right' t-disc, and it looks good.  Also, over 6 months, no concerns with durability, so both in terms of usefulness and product quality, this is a great item.Highly recommended--either for yourself, or as a gift if you have a person who gives you the Tassimo hook-up.JTG

I have looked all over for a way to organize my t-discs.  This works perfectly.  It is just the right size to tuck into a corner.  It will hold a little more than 2 complete packages.  I have in mine right now a set of Gevalia Signature Coffee and their Iced Coffee and it fits perfectly.  I love it.  It turns with ease.  Cleans well.  Classic design.  It is a lot better than leaving the boxes out which just creates a huge mess.  I would buy this all over again.

This little doo-hickey converted us from a Tassimo T-Disc enjoying household, to a Tassimo T-Disc loving household!  It has a classic chrome look that will appeal to the aesthetic of most home kitchen barista environs.  You'll love filling it up, using them up, and filling it up again.  Guaranteed to increase your consumption of T-Discs (is that a good thing?  I think so).  The four sections mean there is room for four varieties of T-Discs.  The bottom of each section offers space for simple removal and dispatch of both smaller (espresso) and larger (creamers) T-Discs.

Both sizes fit easily in the bins and it is very easy to take discs from the top or the bottom.  It spins very easily and looks much more organized then a bunch of boxes sitting out on the counter.  I highly recommend it and am thinking about purchasing a second one as we try and like more of the different drinks!

This product is a must have!  I love how it holds all the T-disks in one spot and theyre all nicely organized.  Much better than having a bunch of boxes all over my coffee bar!  Easy access to most frequently used disks!  The finish is elegant and it spins smoothly!Only complaint is that I wish it held more.  I may need another one!

column9: Perfect holder that uses little space
column10: This carousel does the intended job perfectly, holding up to 40 T-Discs unless you are a Starbucks House Melange Maison glutton for punishment. The material appears to be stainless steel, and is quite substantial in spite of the carousel's compact footprint. It rotates easily and is very stable. T-Discs are dispensed, as usual, from the bottom and slide right out.  The only thing I might want is more racks to place a greater variety, and so that I could add milk discs for latte products.All in all, a great value.

column9: Nice way to organize your T discs
column10: I bought this carrousel cause I wanted to display my discs for easy access for anyone coming to the machine, I must say I'm pleased with the purchase, although I'd like to place more than 4 types of discs, it's fine for the price. You may consider buying two of them.

I like this item a lot even though there aren't too many choices available for storing and displaying T-discs.  I think the only thing that might be nicer is if it held more T-discs.I tried to survive without buying one of these but the boxes of T-discs were just too cumbersome and annoying on the counter or the stove.
Great product for storing t-discs!  We have this on our refreshment center in our hair salon.  It looks good, plus it organizes and displays the t-discs conveniently.  Would recommend.
Spins well, holds enough of our open cartons of coffee disks to make it worth it's while, looks nice enough to display.

column9: Works as advertised. Could hold more.
column10: It's great for what it is. It'd be nice if it came in other colors and/or if it held a few more discs. Looks good on the bar! Recommended until something less expensive comes along.

I wanted to purchase a second Tassimo/Gevalia brand carousel that has five sections, but I couldn't find it anywhere.  I decided to buy two of these instead and put the original Tassimo/Gevalia one in the cupboard for my extra t-discs.  I'm happy I did.  The carousels are of good quality and do the job nicely.  I'm pleased with them and wouldn't hesitate to buy another one if needed.
Execellent addition to the Tassimo coffee maker - handily displays large number of T-disc coffee selections, is attractive, and doesn't take up too much space.
Love it!  Holds all my coffee and hot chocolate.  The padded bottom keeps it from slipping; it turns smoothly and holds four different kinds of coffee.  Very convenient.

If you have the Tassimo system, you will not be complete without this carousel.  It will take up counter space just as the machine itself, but impact is minimal.  It is sturdy, although it may not be soid metal? I now the carousel is metal, the base may have a painted plastic surroungd over the turning mechanism.  The neat thing is that with the 4 stalls it can store 8 different varieties, because you can pull from both the bottom and the top.  So, the latte expresso and milk can fit in one stall.My friends love the experience of coming to my counter and conveniently grabbing a bup of something, anything.  If you buy a lot of varieties this is one way to keep the popular ones out and ready.  If you only buy 2 packages at a time, I think it is still worthwhile, because it only holds up to 40 discs which is about 2-3 packages.The price is cheap here, 14.99.  It is 19.99 in the stores (BBB).  the cost of the Tassimo went up in February'09 to 169.00 from 139.00, so if the savings is still here, it helps with the sting.

I was very frustrated with all of the half full boxes of coffee on the counter before buying this product.  Now with the Disc Carousel my coffee is organized, easy to access and it looks great on my counter.
If you have a Tassimo, I recommend this.  It looks great and is convenient.  The metal is a shiny silver and it spins for your convenience to store T-discs.
This is a good idea and inexpensive, too.  We love our Tassimo machine and find this carousel to be very handy!

column9: stylish, easy to use and well made
column10: This item is designed for Tassimo and holds up to four separate varieties of T-discs stacked in columns.  Simply spin it to the one you want and pull it out from the bottom.It's polished chrome, well made and very stylish.

I was very pleased with the Carousel.  It is nice to have the Tassimo disc handy.  I used to keep the discs in boxes and shuffle through looking for the ones I wanted.  Now they are in plain sight and handy.
This is perfect for a tassimo beverage maker. It's created for t-discs. Don't purchase this product if you own a teurig or something different

A must to have with every TASSIMO  :)Well organizes my T-Discs. Although you have only 4 lanes and you should pull the discs from the exit side at the bottom (for 4 types/flavours of discs), I use it for 8 types of discs which in each line I use 2 types of discs and pull either from the bottom or remove the one from the top.I love it and it's realy great.Thanks
This dispenser allows you to throw away the boxes and keep your Tassimo coffee discs handy.

column9: If you have a tassimo you have to get this
column10: very stylish.  so much better than having boxes laying around the machine. if you have a tassimo this is a great purchase.
This coffee disc stand is great. I used to keep all the t-disc boxes out on the counter or window sill, or just hidden away. Now I can get to all my coffees easily, and they look really stylish, too!
When taking discs out of the handy dispenser box, you discover...Hey this aint so handy! The carousel solves the problem and is the cheapest I found on the net. Thanks Amazon!

column9: Excellent source of energy between meals
column10: Along with a supply of Cliff bars and Larabars, I keep a few packets of Amazing Grass in my bag for use as a meal replacement or in between meals.  This item tastes best when added to cold water and one packet of Stevia (or to taste).  It doesn't have an after taste or chalky taste like some others that I tried.

I tried this out to replace my Shakeology chocolate shakes. Same concept (veggies, fruit, protein in a shake) but Shakeology tastes much better. I'm sticking with Amazing grass because of its quality of ingredients(Vegan, not processed...kosher...the real deal) and great price.Tastes a bit bitter and gritty but definitely palatable. I use to mix Shakeology with banana and Peanut butter but I'm not sure if Amazing grass will mix as well. Shakeology included milk product which I think gave it a better mixing advantage. Overall, I will make it through this box! Who knows...maybe it will grow on me more!

column9: Amazing Shake That Lives up to its Name!
column10: This shake is exactly what I was looking for and needed. I am sensitive to Gluten so it had to be Gluten Free, which it is. It also had to have protein from plants, which it does. It also had to taste good, which it does. This shake has it all! I am so happy with it, I get it each month on an auto-ship. It gives me energy and also helps to regulate my body in many ways (the most important way!). I got my 20 year old son hooked on it so I sent it out to college on a monthly shipment and he was so happy to have a consistent form of protein that kept him healthy while everyone else was getting the flu. I couldn't be happier with this product (unless it drops in price, but I do think it's fairly priced compared to the crap out there).

I had very low expectations about this product because I rarely like the taste of these types of shakes.  But I purchased it because (a) it had no fake ingredients or Stevia (which I'm allergic to) and (b) I wanted to get into the habit of having a healthy breakfast shake or inbetween meals shake to get back on track.I tried the first one this morning for breakfast with some vanilla hemp milk and ice.  I was surprised because it was tasty!  Yes, it's a big grainy and if you're expecting a smooth chocolate milk type experience, you'll be disappointed.  But it actually reminded me of Tiger's Milk, a nutritional shake my dad used to make for me as a kid.  Kinda of malty tasting but in a good way.So not only was it more pleasant tasting than I expected, it's the first time I have been able to drink a shake for breakfast at 6:00 and not feel like I need a snack right when I get to work at 8:00.  In fact it's 10:00 and I'm just now starting to feel peckish.  Not too bad!

Quick breakdown of the Pros and Cons:Pros- Vegan and Gluten Free (both things I was looking for)- Tastes great- No upset stomach, keeping everything "moving," if you know what I mean...Cons- Not enough to constitute a "meal replacement" (only 110 calories per packet)- ExpensiveI've been drinking Amazon Meal every morning for breakfast for the last two weeks. I mix it up with unsweetened vanilla almond milk (my Original 28oz Blender Bottle Black blends it up wonderfully, but this may not be necessary) and it tastes out-of-this-world. Seriously, I'm usually craving a second one. It has hard gritty/grainy stuff in the powder that gets stuck in your teeth, but otherwise I don't mind the grittiness. My biggest complaint is that this is more of a complement or supplement to a meal, rather than a meal replacement in itself. Lastly, this stuff is *really* expensive; I've looked around on Amazon and found the packets to be the best deal of them all (you would expect the large containers to be... but no). I would definitely recommend this product.

I got this product because I love healthy chocolate drink, and it quick and easy breakfast for me.  I love the taste.  As long as you completely stir or shake it up you won't taste any grassy taste.  I put vanilla almond milk in my drink, and I shake it with the amazing meal cup that I brought at a health store.  I don't put anything extra, I found that adding more milk to it makes it taste even better.  I go by the texture of it when it looks light chocolate milk.  I found it better to use milk than water; it's better to shake than stir, you can stir after you shake it up; put milk in first than packet, that way you probably don't have to stir the leftovers at the bottom.  It's also better to use a cup that has a lid with it.  If you don't like the taste you can always add sugar or just put in blender to add more ingredients.  It is way cheaper to get this on Amazon than places like whole foods.  I feel better in the morning, I been drinking this for two weeks.  My nails grow quicker too.  I like this packet because I can take it anywhere with me, if I need a healthy drink.  Sometimes I get to lazy to make my own chocolate shake so this save me so time.
Amazing Grass choc drink powder and meals are very good tasting and really do the job for losing weight and getting the nutrients that you need.  I highly recommend this product.

I love Amazing Meals and buying it on Amazon is convenient and more cost effective.  The chocolate tastes real good mixed with chocolate Almond Milk.  I have been hooked on this product for a year now!  It has curbed my need to snack thru-out the day.
Yuck. Really, the initial taste isn't bad, but overall I couldn't take more than one sip. I tried mixing it with everything, but the health benefits just aren't worth gagging over.

I am a regular tea drinker and love good Assam and Darjeeling tea. I was very disappointed when I prepared this Serendipi Assam tea shipped by Amazon. Its taste is extremely bland, dissimilar to the good Assam teas I know. I cannot recommend this product.

This is good quality black tea.  It's organic and biodynamic, meaning it has been grown using natural and environmentally-conscious methods.  This assam is malty and brews to a lovely liquor, making great breakfast tea with cream and sugar.  All in all, a fine representation of the variety.  Store it in a tin or mason jar after opening to preserve freshness.

column9: Don't buy this unless you love Splenda
column10: My wife bought two cans of this "no sugar added" pie filling thinking it would contain, you know, cherries without added sweetener.  I baked the filling into a pie without noticing the teeny "Splenda" symbol down along the bottom edge of the label (see product photo).  To our disappointment we discovered the artificial sweetener on our first bite of pie.  To our tastes, the pie was inedible and we threw it out. Personally, I'd have preferred an actual "no sugar added" filling but even sugar would be better for you than an artificial sweetener.Since Comstock obviously needs to do a better job of labeling it's products, I went to leave them feedback on their website.  Unfortunately, they wanted every bit of my personal contact information (Email, phone and address) in order to do them a favor and provide feedback on their product. Hopefully they get this message.

This may not have sugar, but it tastes very strongly of SUCRALOSE, the chlorocarbon substitute marketed as Splenda.If you can tolerate Splenda, then you might like this.I cannot, and only upon tasting, and spitting out a mouthful of delicious crust and absolutely terrible filling, did I read the ingredients, having stopped at NO SUGAR ADDED.Big MISTAKE. This tastes plain horrible, to me.BUYER BEWARE!

I used this too bake for a diabetic and he loved it.  I used cinnamon and ginger over the apples - you might try that if your taste buds are that sensitive to Splenda.  Highly recommend.  Some apple pie spice would work too.

Must have overlooked the fine print. Thought it was syrup derived from the Walnut tree.  It was just corn syrup with roasted walnuts.  Big difference.  Am still looking for a syrup derived exclusively from the Black Walnut tree.  My understanding is that it is the best of all syrups.

column9: My cats LOVE these and demand them.
column10: I am very pleased with these treats and keep them stocked at all times because my cats demand them! They come and sit next to my chair, waiting for them daily, it's too funny. No other treats give this response from them, and they usually don't like other kinds.

These are the only treats my cats will eat.  They actually beg for them like dogs.  Shake the bag and no matter were they are they will come running.  We have been feeding them these treat for ever, cats always get a good bill of health.  Good and healthy, cat's love them.

Although this product is a little pricey... It is SO WORTH IT! Prepare to fall in love! First tried it on toast... ummm! Then followed a dollop on ice cream... yummy!  My husband stopped me before I indulged beyond the point of no return, AKA not saving him any! I bought these to have on hand for the holidays...looks like I'll need to re-order! This Granite Bay Farms duo of Pecan Pumpkin Butter and Old Fashioned Apple Butter is almost too good to share - but I will! Do not hesitate to indulge in a special treat for yourself!

I ordered the 10 oz crab cakes.  Usually you expect a shell or so, but not in EVERY bite.  The 'lump' was not all lump meat either.  These were a great disappointment. The flavor is fine, but I would never order these again.  I have found G&M crab cakes to be true lump and much better than these.
I built a house out of these. It was great, until it rained. Then some of the house disappeared. Good thing there was plenty of shell in these or I wouldn't have a house anymore.
me and my girlfriend throw these at cars and it makes us horny, doing this from a helicopter! is a lot of fun

column9: The new recipe Lindt 70% cocoa recipe is bland.
column10: I have been buying Lindt 70% Cocoa bars for over a decade.  It was the best dark chocolate for the price.  However, the new recipe, as of Fall 2010, lacks the full rich flavor of the original recipe.  It is now bland and too sweet and definitely not work the price any longer.  I bought one bar of the new recipe and won't be buying any more.  I will probably start buying Green & Black's 70% Cocoa bar instead, unless I can find another better 70% cocoa chocolate that costs less than $3 or $4 per bar.

As another reviewer has noted, Lindt has changed their previously great recipe as of Autumn 2010, and this chocolate now has the texture and taste of bottom-shelf waxy, cheap American dark chocolate.  Not even mediocre American dark chocolate, but BAD American dark chocolate.  It reminded me of the candy you got behind the windows of an Advent Calendar when you were a kid.This is unfortunate, and apparently, this new recipe has been incorporated into all of their dark chocolate with the possible exception of the 85% version.Avoid this, as this is now one of the worst chocolate bars on the market at any cost.UPDATE:As of 11/10/2010, I've started to see the regular recipe bars re-appear on shelves.  Hopefully this isn't just old stock, but instead a sign that Lindt got the hint and has reverted to the excellent old recipe.

Other reviewers have already said that the Lindt-70% new recipe is terrible. I would like to add, that after reading the labels carefully, one can clearly see that the new Lindt is manufactured by an American company in New Hampshire, while the old one was manufactured in France and then distributed by that American company. What's pity! -- another great product has been ruined. The change of the recipe and of the production place must be related to the dollar weakness relative to the euro.

column9: Who let the marketing director into the test kitchen?
column10: Who let the marketing director screw with the recipe?  This had to be related to cost savings.  Please give me back my chocolate.

I have been a regular consumer of Lindt Excellence 70% cocoa Dark Chocolate bar for years and have recommended it to many people, not only for the wonderful taste and texture, but b/c of the purity of this product (only four ingredients, including natural bourbon vanilla beans that gave it a most delicious flavor). My most recent purchase ... their "new recipe," as stated on the label, was quite a shock to my taste buds. By adding soy lecithin to the recipe, they are now producing a bar that is not only tasteless but has a waxy texture that I find disgusting. I can only conclude that the soy has replaced some of the more costly ingredients, thereby becoming cheaper for Lindt to produce. Apparently, this has happened only since Lindt started producing the bar in the U.S. and the original formula is still in use in France and Canada but they will not ship it to the U.S. I am extremely disappointed in Lindt for this change and will never buy this product again, unless they go back to the original recipe. What a shame that lovers of dark chocolate have lost the opportunity to enjoy this formerly great product. And let me add that you didn't have to be a connoisseur of dark chocolate to know just how great this product was...all it took was one bite!

As of autumn 2010, Lindt has changed the recipe for their "Excellence 70%" dark chocolate. The new recipe is very different--much more sweet and bland. It does not have the delightful intensity of the original recipe, which was my regular chocolate for years. The original recipe was exceptional, but the new one is just another ordinary chocolate. I'd skip it.

column9: The new formula is a disaster
column10: I have been addicted to Lindt 70% chocolate bars for a long time.  It was fine European style chocolate with all natural ingredients and the best value for the money around.  However, the last time I purchased one it was labeled "NEW FORMULA" and it was absolutely terrible.  It was mealy and oily like cheap chocolate and much too sweet.  I think they have adapted their recipe to appeal more to the American market, but if I want cheap chocolate I can pay 50 cents at any grocery store around.  I get Lindt so I can experience fine chocolate.  Skip this one.  If you are a die hard dark chocolate fan, get the 85% bar (which as of December 2010 they haven't screwed up yet), but eat it with a cup of your favorite hot beverage to help it melt since the 85% does not melt well without the extra heat.  I am currently on the search for a replacement for my old recipe Lindt bars and wondering why they couldn't learn from history not to mess with a winning product.  (I mean did anyone like New Coke?)  Lindt, if you are reading this GO BACK TO THE OLD FORMULA AT ONCE!!!!!
I do not like the new recipe at all. They messed with a good thing. There is plenty of chocolate that tastes like the "new" recipe already. Bland and waxy. You just lost a long time customer Lindt.

column9: The new recipe is bland plastic-y junk chocolate
column10: I enjoyed Lindt Excellence 70% as a lunch treat for over ten years. It was a real favorite of mine, and I trusted a company like Lindt to not mess with a 165-year tradition. I was wrong. Lindt seems to be pursuing Hershey (or worse) now, instead of keeping a proud tradition alive. (The recipe has, by the way, only changed for the US market.)Lindt is still calling this Excellence 70% Cocoa (although the tag at the bottom does say "Smooth Dark" instead of "Intense Dark"). But it is a (literally) pale reflection of the original recipe, and an insult to the Lindt tradition. At least when Coca Cola screwed up, it had changed the name to New Coke so it could easily bring back Classic Coke. Lindt is now stuck, by drastically changing the recipe but not changing the name. Those who liked the old recipe have abandoned them with this change, and are not likely to trust them again, and those who like the new recipe will react the same if they change it back. I think this one will be studied in biz schools as a "how not to do it" case.

column9: Why did you change a GREAT thing?!
column10: As many of the other reviewers have pointed out the new recipe is terrible! I love chocolate, but have always been picky on what actually deserves to be called chocolate. This new 70% bar should not be considered chocolate and Lindt should be embarrassed for selling it with their name attached. I bought three bars of the original before the stock was replaced with the dreaded new recipe. Too bad chocolate doesn't keep well, I would have bought a box! If you like dark, coco tasting chocolate and are not fond of greasy tasteless bars that call themselves chocolate...don't waste your money on the new recipe. I hope Lindt gets the message and brings back the ORIGINAL recipe!

column9: Lindt just lost a 20+ year customer; BRING BACK LINDT CLASSIC!
column10: The flavor is now bland and boring (think Hershey Kiss), and the "new and improved" smooth texture reminds me of plasticizers.I spent probably hundreds of dollars on Lindt 70% chocolate bars over the years, but as soon as I tasted the new version, I will never by another Lindt product of any kind until they bring back the old one. Looking at all the other reviews, Lindt has made an identical mistake to Coke of releasing a new version and discontinuing the old one.I wouldn't be surprised if its cheaper to make (soy emulsifier wasn't on the original ingredient list and it tastes like they are using inferior coca), but this bar is an insult to the intelligence of every person who's tried the original.

This used to be one of my favorite chocolate bars before they ruined it with soy lecithin.  I've been reading the other reviews and I'm really happy to see so many people saying the same thing.  My wife sent an e-mail to Lindt and they wrote back saying they had done extensive market research and had gotten positive feedback on the new recipe.  I have a very hard time believing that.I have found some good alternatives but they more expensive.  Michel Cluizel 72% Noir de Cacao is very good but not as easy to find and about twice as expensive as the Lindt bar.  I hope Lindt will come to their senses and change it back.

column9: Avoid the "new recipe" at all costs!
column10: I have to agree with the majority here.  The new 70% bar, made in N.H., is just a Hershey bar in a fancy package.  Don't even bother.  In fact, once I tried it, I returned the 8 I bought on sale locally and exchanged them for the 85% bar.  The 85% is still made in France with the "old recipe" and has no soy lecithin.  Comments about the 70% bar being "greasy" and "plastic" are correct.  But let's be frank... no serious chocolate connoisseur would consider any Lindt bar worthy.  If you're serious about chocolate, look towards Michel Cluizel, Valrhona, Bonnat and others.

A few weeks ago, I sent a complaint to Lindt via their web site and did receive a very nice email  response.  It mirrored pretty much what the web site says about the overwhelming positive response.Here's the funny part:  I was in a Lindt store last week and complained about the recipe change.  The sales person said that they've been receiving numerous complaints from previously-happy 70% customers.  And yes, the reason for the change in taste is that the bar is being manufactured in the US now, with a soya emulsifier and less cocoa butter.As I mentioned in my email to Lindt...  I hope they don't have the same PR disaster Coca-Cola had when they "improved" their recipe.

column4: Michael Bock "The definition of insanity is d...
column10: I've read all the reviews of this product and I feel I must add my name to the chorus of negative reviews on the new recipe.  I can't express how disappointed I was with the new recipe.  I started eating dark chocolate about 12 years ago.  I started with sharffen berger which is quite good chocolate.  I tried various brands.  I wanted the healthy dark but wasn't interested in eating 85% because I wanted to balance flavor with health.  That is where the old recipe of this 70% bar was perfect at.  It tasted better than the Sharffen berger to me and every other bar I had tried.  Now they take this wonderful bar and ruin it for poorly thought out reasons.  I still had a bar of the old when the new came out and I did a blind taste test in my family of four.  All thought the old was better than the new.  So Lindt's marketing machine is doing itself a great disservice by continuing to perpetuate the lie that most people actually like the new recipe.  Note that in my grocery store I can still find the 1.2 oz bars as of August 2011 that are labeled Intense dark.  These bars are still made in france and have no soy products in them (although they say it may contain "traces" of soy beans but all chocolate products say that due to the factory environment in which they are made).For me at least money is no object for this purchase and I'm not rich.  Just trying to prioritize good food over other things in my life.  I would gladly pay the higher price if the exchange rate was the issue or if the ingredients were the issue.  The bottom line is the new recipe is horrible.  Don't purchase if you like chocolate.  If you like wax just buy a candle and eat that.

column9: The good news is that I'm losing weight and saving money...
column10: I used to eat way too many of these things, but their new recipe has made it easy to kick the habit.  Kind of waxy and tasteless.  Maybe this is more to the liking of the average palate and they're going after the Snickers crowd.  Can't blame 'em but, as of now, I'm on the long, sad search for a replacement...

column9: Have been enjoying this chocolate for over 20 years, but now...
column10: I remember the first time I tried a Lindt 70% bar, when I visited France as a child.  My parents bought several to bring back to the States, and they were cherished and eaten slowly.  I've enjoyed them as a special treat ever since.Sadly, that era has ended.  The "new recipe" is a shadow of the former Lindt chocolate.  It tastes like pretty much any other standard dark chocolate bar -- none of the crisp, vibrant, complexity it used to have.I guess all good things eventually come to an end...too bad.

column9: From perfection to 100% mediocrity: what were they thinking?!
column10: This used to be about the greatest thing you could buy for less than $50. Really. What other product could you purchase and credibly say, "this is the best in the world"? Lindt 70 actually became difficult to find at the grocery stores I go to because the secret was clearly out. Now there's plenty, so Lindt screwed up the bottom line as well as on purist grounds. And for those of us with soy allergies, the change is of course a disaster, as it's practically impossible to locate chocolate or any other dessert without some form of soy. I'll spare the reader a review of the new recipe. Why bother? It tastes like every other mediocre or worse dark bar out there: waxy, non-descript, and let's face it, a little too "American," like American cheese is "American."What should we do? A great gourmet store in Ellsworth, Maine (Rooster Brother)has the right idea. I hear the owner took one bite of the new recipe and sent the entire shipment back to Lindt. Perhaps other suppliers will take up the cause. Meanwhile, here's hoping that somebody at Lindt actually cares enough about quality and distinction to put the good old stuff back into production.P.S. Amazon should change the image associated w/this to reflect the New Recipe packaging, lest people think we're dissing the old stuff.

column9: Another Blunder in the Name of Marketing
column10: I could not believe the first time I bit into the new recipe (and did not notice the "new recipe" on the packaging) - what a shock! Lindt, by far, had the best dark chocolate on the market in their 70% bar - I try all dark chocolate I can find and have been buying Lindt for several years now (Green and Black's 70% now is my preference). Someone in Marketing should be removed - they even lied when I asked about responses, the first person answering the phone said it had been overwhelmingly negative, Marketing was my next stop where they said it was positive. I only hope someone wakes up at Lindt....
I posted Lindt a letter at their site and then saw that all these reviews voice my sentiments exactly.  The new bar is pitiful.  Bring back the perfect chocolate bar.

Lindt 70% was easily the best dark chocolate on the market. We tried the new recipe ...once. That was it. I emailed customer service and they said their marketing showed that the new stuff would sell better. And they sent me a coupon for more Lindt.They lost a customer.

For years this was my go-to bar providing quality, character, value, availability.  Don't misunderstand, I'm not suggesting that it was ever something more than it was but the bottom line is that whether you are a chocolate snob or a casual chocolate lover, you knew that this was simply excellent chocolate for the price.  Nearly boutique chocolate level flavor that you could pick up for half the price.But to my shock the new recipe is simply garbage. Mundane, flat, lacking any punch. What the !@#% was Lindt thinking?  I, along with many others, will have to seek a new replacement for a serviceable bar that the Lindt 70% so faithfully provided for years.  Lindt, shame on you.  You lost a good percentage of your loyal base...and all for what? Sadly nothing, because its not as if this new formula will appeal to a 'broader audience'--it will not.

column9: Imitation of a BAD dark chocolate
column10: "New Recipe" turns out to be an imitation of a bad dark chocolate. When I opened the package, I was not struck with the aroma of good bittersweet chocolate. When a piece hit my tongue, it conjured up memories of awful aftertastes of many bad milk and some dark chocolate. The nasty aftertaste never actually materialized. Still, Lindt should be worried.So I looked at the ingredients. First on the list is chocolate, some unknown, pre-made chocolate. Shouldn't the first ingredient be cocoa powder or cocoa something? Lindt started making chocolate in China some time ago. Are they churning out this "New Recipe" with "Made-In-China" chocolate, sugar, cocoa butter and so on? By the way, the 85% cocoa bar's ingredient list also starts with chocolate, followed by cocoa powder, sugar... At least it contains enough cocoa powder to fool me for a while. I suppose it could be worse: Lindt could have substituted partially hydrogenated junk for cocoa butter.I just bought Trader Joe's Swiss 72% cocoa Dark Chocolate for $1.99. It smells and tastes right for me. Its color is just a shade lighter than Lindt 70%. Ingredients: cocoa mass, sugar, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, Madagascar vanilla. I can see myself sticking with this one until something better shows up or returns.

column9: I'd give it 0 stars if possible
column10: It's really too bad there isn't an option to give 0 stars, or even better in a case like this, negative stars.  I almost never do reviews on products, but I, like so many loyal and long term addicts of the 70% bar am shocked at what Lindt has done.  The new recipe is basically the same thing as those terrible Ghirardelli squares of waxy tasteless "chocolate".  The original 70% was amazing.  It had a great texture, just enough sweet to balance things out, and there was no mistaking the cocoa.  It was also always a bit of a surprise every time I would eat it.  Sometimes it had hints of citrus, sometimes it was a bit nutty.  Maybe that was the vanilla, but whatever it was, there is nothing about the new recipe that even comes close to anything I used to enjoy about the 70% bar.  Now I have to try and find a replacement for what used to be the perfect chocolate experience.  Thanks for nothing Lindt.
Echoing the reviews of lots of "former" customers,  this new recipe is just awful.They need to .......  well, everyone else here has already said it.Read THEIR reviews.  Thanks.

column9: Might as well buy a Milky Way
column10: After buying 5 bars, I and my family do not like the new recipe!I called Lindt to inquire about the new recipe and was told that the old recipe is gone, taste testing shows a preference for the new recipe.  I am not sure who did the tasting but it was not a chocolate lover.Another fine item is history!

I finally, FINALLY found a dark chocolate that I love... Only to have it swept off the shelves and replaced with a disgusting 'new recipe' that reminded me of chocolate I bought on sale at a dollar store once. One of the other reviewers said 'waxy and tasteless' and that about sums it up. Plus, I find it insulting that they would trumpet NEW RECIPE!! on the box, and expect the consumer to assume that it was improved, as opposed to ruined.Lindt-- Charge more, I don't care, but don't sacrifice the quality of your products. Americans are SICK TO DEATH of soy products in EVERYTHING.

Here's the email I wrote to the Lindt company after my first taste of the "new" version:Hello,I have loved your 70% Excellence bar since I first discovered it 3 years ago. The slight tang of fruity notes was very unique and simply delightful. Also - knowing that only the highest quality chocolate is made with enough cocoa butter to preclude the need for soy lecithin, I was impressed that your 70% Excellence bar was soy-free. Like many other Americans, I typically avoid soy for health reasons.However, your new version of the 70% Excellence bar is entirely a disappointment. Its bland flavor is not disagreeable but it certainly lacks the character of your previous recipe. And I see that the quality of ingredients has also been sacrificed - the 70% bar now contains soy lecithin. This chocolate no longer stands out from any other chocolate available on store shelves.I will now be buying my chocolate from a different company. But if at some future time you decide to resume your previous version of the 70% Excellence bar, I will be pleased to buy from Lindt again.

This was my favorite chocolate bar for years.  It was so bold and flavorful.  Then, I tasted the "new" recipe.  It is waxy and flavorless.  I didn't even finish the bar.  That never happens at my house!  Do they really think we won't notice?  Well, now I am searching for another good chocolate bar.
The new recipe is horrible!Don't buy it, force them to bring the old ones back!And yes, Amazon - change the picture to reflect the change.

I had been a huge fan of this until they changed to the 'new recipe'. I don't buy it anymore, its very sweet, and way worse than the original recipe, which I thought was one of the best quality dark chocolates available.

I used to looooove this stuff until they changed the recipe. Now it is waxy and kind of tastes like Hershey's. And it also tastes less like chocolate. Skip this chocolate and buy something else. Not worth the money.

I just tried a sample of it in a bag of Lindt truffles.  The sample was about the 1 inch by 1 inch, and although I LOVE chocolate (especially dark!) I wouldn't have wanted to eat any more of that stuff.  It is, indeed, awful.  Completely bland and very waxy: the taste and texture are BOTH horrible.  I find it impossible to believe that a whole company that produces chocolate for a living could imagine that this is a good product, so all I can assume is that they, too, must know that it really sucks.  How can they sleep at night knowing that they are producing such horribly pathetic chocolate?  Thank goodness I didn't pay anything for this woefully sub-par sample!!

column9: New recipe for Lindt 70% is terrible!
column10: I had one bite and spit it out - the worst chocolate I ever had!  One of the worst tasting foods I ever had!  Just NOT good!

I have to agree with most of the other reviews, except I don't find it bad enough to give it only one star ...I've tasted many chocolates that are worse. The new recipe (made in U.S.A.) Lindt 70% has lost all the qualities that makes the original great. The new version is overly sweet and creamy, with noticeably less cocoa flavor ...hard to differentiate it from most cheap chocolates.But the original made in France version (still available in Canada as of early 2012) is one of the best easy-to-find 70% chocolates. It has a stronger and more complex cocoa flavor, with nice hints of bitterness, smokyness, and vanilla. And a nice dry texture - not the yucky, slippery sweetness and creamyness of the new 'improved' recipe.

You get what you pay for with chocolate.  I buy Lindt chocolate to serve to guests occasionally, but it's a really poor cheap chocolate.  On a scale of 1-10 (10 being the best) Lindt would rate in the 2-3 range. If you really want a GREAT chocolate that has the full flavor and fine chocolate nuances, you'd have to spend three or four times as much.  I would recommend Amano Artisan Chocolate, for example.  Truly excellent.  Just a warning, however: once you taste a high-end chocolate like Amano, you will never like Lindt again.  In fact, you might just spit it out.

This chocolate gets my dollar vote as the best there is for the money.  I love the degree of sweetness and health benefit of the darker varieties.  It appears the reviews on this candy were contrived since I've never seen such low ratings on any Amazon product, especially one that should be near the top of the pile. Y'all need to try it again...or do you work for Mars?

Maybe this chocolate bar doesn't really need a review, but..I highly recommend this bar. It has a delicious dark chocolatetaste, hardly any bitterness with enough sugar too satisfybut doesn't overpower the chocolate and also one of the lowestprice premium chocolate bars. It was just a little over 2.00at Wal-mart

column9: Great on Large Orders (for cheaper shipping)
column10: These Peanut Butter chips are fantastic. We use them in all sorts of cookies and candy making too. To melt them (which not using as chips), use a double boiler and they melt like magic.These babies go great with the carob (chocolate alternative) chips:http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B0001CXUE0?tag=a52-20&ie=UTF8As well as the yogurt coating (both sold by Barry Farm):http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B0001AVTE0?tag=a52-20&ie=UTF8Do note: the more you order from Barry Farm, the better the shipping (compared to all items), but larger orders can take a little longer to ship. Don't fret though, you'll get it!

I wanted something hot. Let me tell you these are by far the most spicy chile I've had. I put them on everything from pizza to chicken. I warn you not to eat these if you're not someone who eats hot foods. Also DO NOT GIVE THIS TO SOMEONE AS A JOKE!!! These are to hot to be a joke.

These pepper are awesome!  My family and I are aways making the hottest sauces we can to make us sweat, and now that I have the ghost chile, I WIN! definitely  makes you sweat but with good chipotle style flavor very good and addicting...

These are not the famous ghost chilis that send you screaming in pain, they are a smoked chili of mild heat. I was unhappy with them because I wanted fire and got a fizzle. I will say they add a smokey element to what you are adding it to but not much heat. If you want a little extra flavor they work but if you want heat keep looking. I have a bunch of hot sauces way hotter and a bottle of 1,000,000 scoville unit capcacin extract that made everyone that tried it totally light up in pain. Now that's what a ghost chili is supposed to do.

column9: Just a normal hot pepper and nothing more or less
column10: From reading some other reviews about these sorts of dried peppers I was prepared for them to be something special, but they are not.They are fine, but they are not specially hot nor do they have any special flavor.Luckily for me, most of the time I can get fresh habaneros. I got these as a back up.I normally have 3-5 fresh habaneros in a meal and in comparison I figure that one of these is maybe in hotness about the same as 2 small to medium sized fresh habaneros.I noticed no special flavor at all with these peppers.I ground them up to flakes before I used them, and some of the bigger flakes made them stand out a bit, but I want my hotness spread throughout the meal so I always chop fresh habaneros or grind or chop up dried hot peppers.I am sure if you chewed up a fistful of them you would get a fierce blast, but you could get that from a fistful of fresh habaneros as well. It seems they are maybe 2x as hot as a decent habanero.As a good back up dried pepper to have when you don't have access to fresh hot peppers, these are fine.Don't be fooled into thinking they are some kind of miracle pepper, however.

The order kind of took a while to get delivered. Ocnce I opened the bag of ghost chile pepper you could smell it right away, it really smells hot. I took one tiny little bite of it and it was hot. I eat alot of chile. I wouldn't recommned this if you dont eat chile.Me and my nephew ate a pepper each, it was hot but, not as hot as in youtube videos. the burning only lasted a little while. It was a good price for $8 plus shipping,I was going to get another order but, the price went up.

These chiles are hotter than hell!!!  There were a lot of peppers in the 4oz. bag, around 80-90 probably more, so I shared them with Chilehead friends.  I made a salsa that choked everyone in the house and that was only from the cooking process.  We hadn't even tasted the salsa yet! I'm about to place a second order but I think I may order the 1lb bag.  These are awesome if you're a true Chilehead.
The chilies are great.  We were very happy with the speed we received our items.  We will definately order from you again.  Thanks for such a great product.

A while ago, a friend sent me a small package of ghost chilies. On a lark, I added some to homemade BBQ sauce and it was a hit. I ordered these ghost chilies when I ran out.They're hot. Even dried out, exercise caution when handling. Usually I don't use gloves; but one night I made a big batch with lots of chilies. After about fifteen minutes of handling ghost chilies, my hands started burning. Even using milk, water, and bleach - my hands burned for about 6 hours.Besides the heat, they add a nice subtle flavor. As long as you're careful, these are really great chilies.

Very good product.  Has a much more appealing taste than regular table sugar, which by the way, is bleached.  Should not eat any bleached foods.  If it says enriched, which is commonly found on white bread, leave it alone.
Almost taste like black tea. Very nice tea, but what is better than other tea is that this Pu-erh tea doesn't upset your stomach like black or green tea does to me.  I am glad to have found this tea.
Did not come in a sealed package, but in a small ziploc bag. Will not use it...Also, shipping was way expensive in comparison with the value of the product.

column9: Just what I expected...wish the shipping cost were lower
column10: The citric acid was just what I expected for my bath bombs but I cannot order more as the shipping cost are just too high.

After reading the other reviews on this product I was a bit weary of purchasing, but everything met or exceeded me expectations.  The price was as low as I could find for 4oz of citric acid.  I paid for standard shipping which was a typical price for the size of the package, not overpriced as others have stated, it said it may take up to two weeks to arrive.  But, to my surprise, it arrived two business days later, (faster than the unrelated item I purchased off Amazon the same day, that I paid two day shipping for).  It arrived in a heat sealed bag, and is also resealable to keep it dry.  The quality of the citric acid is as good as any other I've received.  I use it to make frozen sour pops for my kids, and they came out as good as always. I am very pleased with my purchase and would definitely use this seller in the future.

column9: Citric Acid, 4 oz didn't pass the taste test.
column10: I bought this item as a replacement for the more.expensive "Fruit Fresh" which I use in emulcified juices I make myself.With s/h it wasn't cheaper and didn't do a better job of preserving the juices for storage in the frig. And it had a much more bitter after taste than "Fruit Fresh" I still have most of the bottle leftSo I don't think I'll buy this again.

It came in a good quality, resealable bag which was heat sealed at the top to prevent tampering. Shipping is reasonable if you are purchasing other items from Barry Farms. I've purchased many items from Barry Farms, and this is as good of a quality as anything else I've tried.
This works so good when canning and can not beat the price compared to in the stores. I love getting stuff from barry farms can not beat there prices either
Received package on time the product was in nice clear packaging the label affixed to the product was a bit worn looking ~ however do not expect that to influence product.
I use this stuff occaisonally on candy because I am A spicy/sour loving guy. try coating your favorite candy with it. it is Painfully and deliciousy sour !

column4: Bushido Bryan "Fear is the mind Killer, so Fa...
column9: works perfectly to clean our Panasonic boiling pot
column10: It was very easy to clean our Panasonic boiling pot.  We just put this in, hit clean and it was cleaned.  So simple and clean.  Why aren't more products this easy to use?
I bought this citric acid for my daughter to make her own sour pixie sticks . The  citric acid has a very sour taste. it was cheap and was shipped fast

I use citric acid for my hair. I've started shampooing my hair with Borax disolved in water. A citric acid rinse is necessary to remove all the traces of Borax. In addition, it has been an excellent addition to my henna. I add it to distilled water prior to mixing it with my preffered brand of henna. It makes a smoother yet sticky paste which adheres to my hair much better than just plain water and henna powder. So far, I'm loving the additiion of citric acid to my hair care regimen.
The product is exactly what I wanted, the price was acceptable and I received it in the time stated. I thought the shipping charge was a little too much.
The essential ingredient for making Daquiri Ice- a now discontinued ice cream flavor at Baskin and Robbins.
