This is a very tasty soup indeed, and it makes a LOT- at least 6-8 hearty meals, made according to the directions, and more if one added corn or another vegetable to it (corn or lightly cooked onions would be good; it could also handle something like roasted poblano peppers).I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 due to the expense. This is not at all a complete kit for this soup! You will need to add a pound of hot sausage, a whole chicken breast (boned and skinned), a large can of diced tomatoes, and 6 cups of chicken stock, in addition to whatever extra veg you might like.Still, once you've done this- it's delicious.Note that it's also not fast, at least in elapsed time. After soaking the chickpeas overnight, they simmer for 2 hours; then you saute the meats, add the rest of the stuff, and cook an additional 1.5-2 hours. This cooking time is hands-off, but it does require planning ahead.The result, though is really good. Definitely homemade-tasting; the seasonings are excellent; and the ease of making is wonderful.I used hot italian sausage since that's what I had, but I think the recommended chorizo would be even better. One could probably also skip the chicken and add some rice for a complete protein with the chickpeas.This- and many of their other kits- are gluten free- something that makes them attractive to me. While I'm not GF myself, many of my friends and family are, and these would make a nice casual dinner for them!And hey- even with what it costs- it's cheaper than fast food or a restaurant! and much more tasty.I do like these soup kits. I';ve tried several now, and they've all been yummy- though this is the best one so far.

Great taste and crunch, but I feel these have too much sugar (even if Kashi calls it dehydrated cane juice...that is sugar).  I guess I am just used to eating less sweat cereal, but my first bite of the cereal made me pick up the box again and see what was in it.  Organic and all that too, for what it is worth.  Kellogg's Unfrosted Mini Wheats have no added sugar (1g of sugar in a 59g serving) whereas the Kashi has 7g of sugar in a 54g serving.

I absolutely detest shredded wheat type cereals. My husband however, enjoys those types of cereals. He decided to try out the Kashi Autumn Wheat, and I have to admit, after years of calling shredded wheat or granola type foods, horse food, I had to take it back for this one. I find I eat this mostly as my night snack. It is very very crunchy and contains a slightly sweet taste that's very pleasing to the palette.If you've been avoiding the fiber craze because of the taste of most of those products, give this one a try - you'll be pleasantly surprised.

This cereal reminds me of honey nut cheerios, because of how lightly sweetened it is.  No frosting, no syrupy after taste. I love that! It's also a nice crisp, easy to chew biscuit, unlike some of the other frosted "mini wheats" out there.  I'm impressed and in love!

column9: Best shredded wheat squares on the market
column10: This is my favorite cereal - indeed, the only cereal I eat. It makes other shredded wheat cereals look and taste pathetic. It's expensive to buy it locally and to be able to buy it for under three dollars a box means I can eat it guilt-free.
This creal is sooo good.  Sweet but not too sweet and still very healthy for you.

column9: Healthy Organic Shredded Wheat Cereal at great price $
column10: Tried Kashi Autumn Wheat as an alternitive to the brand name cereal because this is labeled as Non-GMO/Organic.  I was pleasantly surprised that I prefer the Kashi brand so much better!  Not only is it healthier for me it also tastes better.  You get 50 grams of fiber where the recommended daily amount of fiber is 48 grams!  Also, no sodium.  I don't mind the little bit of sugar as I used to add Agave sweetener to the other brand, and don't have to now.The Amazon price is better than my local Safeway where the price is $4.29 per box.  With the current Amazon advertised price for 4 boxes works out to $3.28 per box.  With PRIME I get free shipping to boot!  Good thing too as my husband just discovered that he likes it so we're going through it twice as fast. :)

I love this cereal. Since I pretty much exclusively eat cereal for breakfast, I wanted to have a modestly healthier alternative to the sugar party that is Frosted Mini Wheats, and other similar cereals. This is not too sweet, nor too bland. And it's great with soy milk.One thing I've noticed, is that the last few "Wheats" in the box are usually pulverized, so you'll probably end up with a loss of about the equivalent of 10 or so units because they were crushed to bits. This is probably a side effect of shipping them.As always, check the expiration date!! I haven't had a spoiled box yet, but you can never be too careful!

column9: Pretty good, and definitely not too sweet
column10: I am just dumbfounded by all the people saying this cereal is too sweet. The only way you can think this is too sweet is if ANY amount of sweetness is too much for you. I'm not sure if the amount of sugar was lessened at some point, but as it is now, it's really not that sweet. It has 7g of sugar, and while I wouldn't call that unsweetened, it is a pretty modest amount. It's nowhere near as sweet as Mini Wheats, for example.All in all, good cereal! I would buy it again.

column9: The Best!....if you're a cold cereal person.
column10: My family is very fond of the Autumn Wheat cereal and I think it truly is a great tasting one.I gave this product four stars instead of five because, as a Clinical Herbalism student with a focus on diet & nutrition, I don't recommend boxed cereals at all.So the bottom line is: If you must eat boxed cereals, this is an excellent choice!
Product is delicious and delivery was quick. The only issue I have is that the cereal gets crushed sometimes in transit, but not enough to hurt anything.
I am trying to diet with Special K and having a sweetened Wheat adds to my journey

column9: Pricey w/o a special, but very tasty.
column10: Tastes like "light" Frosted Mini-Wheats, but has a lower sugar content.  We usually just eat plain shredded wheat, so my children thought this was dessert.

This Autumn Wheat variant of Kashi cereal is as addictive as Kashi Golean Crunch.Ideally, you would have a cup of this with organic milk for breakfast. But when I get the munchies any time of the day, instead of reaching for nachos or candy, I grab this and just consume it dry -- one wheat square at a time.Since it's ORGANIC and WHOLE GRAIN and NATURALLY SWEETENED with cane juice, I feel so guiltless that it's not uncommon for me to go through half the bag before I admit to being a bad, bad girl. But really, it's that good.The reason for four instead of five stars is that deep down I know that plain old oatmeal without addictive properties is still more healthful.

I've been saving quite a bit by ordering this through Amazon Subscribe & Save, but thought everyone should know that Kashi has started making the box smaller--16.3 oz instead of 17.5. I noticed this for the first time with my most recent shipment and wanted to make other shoppers aware. I'm sure the boxes you will find in the grocery store will soon all be the smaller size. Not Amazon's doing, but they should update the product description to reflect the new size.

column9: Frosted Mini Wheats but nutritious, and filled with nothing but natural ingredients
column10: I first bought this delicious cereal at Trader Joes because it had a Recycle Bank code on it, though even if it wasn't for that, I'd still be eating this cereal. Amazing nutrition, including more fiber than a lot of TV Dinners have, a taste quite similar to Frosted Mini Wheats, and one of the most natural cereals on the market. Even better, is that while the majority of cereals have GMOs(Genetically Modified Organisms) this one doesn't.

I didn't expect this cereal to be sweet.  It has the same chew as shredded wheat but is pleasantly sweet - almost too sweet but not quite.  I counted the number of "biscuits" I put in my bowl and there were 35, so I ended up with probably 8 grams of protein, not counting the milk, and lots of fiber.  I was really happy to find another cereal for about 200 calories for a reasonably-sized bowl that I could enjoy in the mornings.

So as cereals go, this is one of my favorite.  I'm usually a weetabix person or just plain oatmeal but i'm been eating this stuff recently.  I mean it does have 7g of sugar, but 5g of protein and 6g of fiber sounds pretty balanced to me.  At 190 calories it's perfect for my morning breakfast before running or going to the gym.  I mean if you need it sweeter, just add honey or maple syrup.But if you want a little more flavor than weetabix and are too lazy to put the toppings on weetabix, get this stuff.  You won't get diabetes eating this and it's good.  It's a big box too.  And if it really means anything to you it's organic...To those that say it's too sweet.... do you eat cardboard for breakfast?  Come on, you guys must not eat anything sweet at all.But most of all it's cheaper on amazon

Really great taste and good for you but the cereal breaks up easily and there is lots of very shredded and broken up cereal.  Still good but a bit like oatmeal after you add milk.  No sugar needed, another plus for this item.

Kashi cereals have become a pantry staple in the past couple of years, and Autumn Wheat is one of my newest additions. It tastes great, and has a good texture - not so dense that it won't soften in milk, but not so fluffy that it dissolves. The pieces are bite-sized, so they'd make a good crunchy, dry snack too.The fact that it's all organic and sweetened with natural cane sugar is a great bonus. It provides 6 grams of fiber and 5 grams of protein - all with only 7 grams of sugar - a little less than 2 teaspoons. That's about as sweet as I like my cereal, so I think it's perfect. (I prefer my cereals plain and not very sugary.) If you like more sweetness, I'd recommend the Cinnamon Harvest flavor of this cereal.
I love the fact that this cereal is made with organic wheat.  It's as good as any wheat biscuit cereal I've ever tasted, except for the Kashi Cinnamon Harvest.
This product is nutritional & tasty. Simialar to Life but not as sweet.

Length:: 1:17 MinsFinding healthy foods that actually taste good is a quest of mine.I love the taste of Kashi's Autumn Wheat cereal.Knowing that it is a natural product and is healthy is fine but he added benefit of tasting good is even better.I highly recommend this for anyone, especially those who are health conscious !

This is a great tasting cereal. Love shredded wheats and this one actually has flavor. My only complaint is that it is a bit too sweet so wish Kashi would cut back here. If you require more sweetness you can add as needed.
This high fiber cereal pleases kids and adults alike.  It does not get soggy in milk and is equally good crumbled over yogurt and fruit.

I've always loved shredded wheat cereals, but this one to me is better!  It is not too sweet, but lightly sweet, and seems heavier than other brands of shredded wheat.  I love this in the morning as it usually holds me for a while before lunch.

column9: Yummy, Yummy, Kashi in my tummy!
column10: I love it... my family loves it.  And, go figure, it's actually healthier than some of those OTHER cereals!  This is the perfect breakfast food, and we like to snack on it at night, instead of potato chips or popcorn. I just pour some in a dish, and we have some movie-night munchies!

column9: my favorite and my 4 year old's favorite!
column10: Kashi Autumn Wheat is a cereal that manages to bridge the generation gap!  My 4 year old and I both love it.  It's sweet enough for her, and not too sweet for me.  The small sized "biscuits" are just right for a spoonful, as opposed to the giant sized offerings from other companies.  The ingredients are listed as organic whole grain wheat, organic evaporated cane juice, and natural flavor.  THAT'S ALL! I like to know what we're eating, and this cereal makes that easy.

This is one of my favorite cereals that I always try to have on hand.  It is very lightly sweetened throughout (not frosted), has a great taste and good fiber content of 6g per serving.  I tend to avoid any sweetened cereals but I like the light amount of sweetness in this cereal.  I prefer this version over the Kashi Cinnamon Harvest, which was still excellent but a little too "cinnamony" for me.This Kashi cereal is organic and is a great option compared to the standard brands for shredded wheat and frosted mini wheat cereals.  It tastes better than plain shredded wheat.  It is a healthier option with 7 g sugars compared to 12 g sugars in frosted mini wheats and those contain ingredients I am trying to avoid like high fructose corn syrup and gelatin.

column9: Best organic shredded wheat squares with touch of cinnamon.
column10: Best organic shredded wheat squares. Love the little tough of cinnamon. So good no need to add sweetner. Just add a little organic milk or soy or rice milk. Our family loves these, this is out new staple ceral.
I LOVE this cereal ~ it is healthy and tastes great which is a combination I find hard to find.  With the subscribe and save price, it is definitely cheaper than the grocery store.  Well worth it!!

This was our first time trying these.  They are wonderful!  The shape, size and crunchy like Mini Wheats with the flavor of Life cereal.  They have just the right sweetness with a hint of cinnamon.  My daughter absolutely loved them too.  We will be buying them again.

I love Kashi products and this is one of my favorites of their cereals.I like to mix a couple of their brands for a high-fiber, low fat breakfast. I can eat at 7 a.m. and be fine untill 1 p.m. I have it almost everyday. Especially good with sliced, fresh strawberries.
This has a wonderful crunchy taste and  just enough sweetness.  Great choice for morning.

I have always been a big fan of MiniWheats, but one of my medical providers pointed out that foods that contain tyramine often trigger migraines. They suggested switching to an organic diet, and Autumn Wheat was the cereal I chose. It was so much better than MiniWheats that I have never even missed my old stand-by. I am not sure it has helped reduce the migraines at all, but it has certainly left me with a happy palate.That said, the Amazon price for the product is, like most of their other grocery prices, grossly exorbitant. You can find it at nearly any grocery store for much less.

Of course, your taste may be different. I'm accustomed to non-sweetened breakfast cereals. I found this to be much, much too sweet for me to enjoy. I've managed to eat a few bowls, but this cereal will never be my first choice for breakfast.

This cereal is too sweet for me. They call common cane sugar as "evaporated cane juice", as if that makes it any healthier. I like Kashi's approach of limiting food additives and chemicals in their products, but that doesn't mean they should compensate the bland taste with pure sugar... It just doesn't taste good.
Great cereal.  I mix into it some soy milk powder, Cinnamon, and a mixture of cocoa powder and water.

This is probably the best loose leaf masala chai  I have tasted in the US (outside of an authentic Asian restaurant). I dont often write reviews, but if you've ever had real masala chai (and not the syrup stuff they sell in Starbucks et. al. coffe shops) you'll love this stuff ... inexpensive, high quality ... beats Teaism hands down ... I just ordered more, and I'll keep ordering more ... if you're British/European, and you're looking for a nice black tea ... this is the one xxx!
Arrived fast.  In good shape, nothing open.  Was outstanding price and these are so helpful in my stop smoking campaign.  Love them.

Say what you will about Mint Mentos but they are a mouth kicker. The moment I log one in, the flavor is a force of nature. I like them a lot and probably they deserve a little higher score but for now I am giving it 4 solid and well deserved stars, which by the way, makes them above average as a product. I was thinking how nice it would be to have the same mints on a sugar free concept, like splenda perhaps, and imagine, if only for a second if they would add something that is good for the teeth, like some chewing gum company does, something that kills bacteria. I thing I would go nutty for that to happen for I like the whole thing about these mints excepting the fact that I wonder how much are they taxing my soon to be examined by a dentist, faithful teeth.  I done them both ways. One where I just chew happily until they disappear completely and after the initial burst of mint on the outer layer there is still pockets of the flavor all the way till they are gone, if not as strong as when you begin. The other, and the more persistent of my methods, is pop them in the chambers and bite as soon as possible and wipe them out that way. That is why I was thinking how much safer it would be to do that, even if it was not completely true, with the vague knowledge that they might be good for your teeth in the long run. I do not think I would be able to stop myself then, from eating them in larger quantities.I open a package and at the most it will last for two days but chances are that in one day the deed will be done. They are so easy to eat and they do bring that extra minty flavor. I read somewhere that Mentos is developing a sugar free version and I was tempted to call the company, hopefully talk to a higher up under the excuse that I have a million dollar idea I would like to give them for free and that idea would be: How about adding Xylitol to the sugar free mint mentos and advertise it like a healthy alternative to damaging candy, besides a fine bad breath deterrent, which by the way it is already. Come On! I would sell, break out of the pack and make the mints the ultimate healthy sweet!Do forgive my outburst, I am probably a little too demanding sometimes, but like the song goes: wouldnt it be nice (Beach Boys?) I can not stop liking these Mentos. I have tried their whole line up and these keep reigning supreme. So much in fact that I purchased the Mentos Mint Candy, 6-Roll Packages (Pack of 12) right after I had purchased the lesser priced one that delivers 30 rolls. Well this one delivers 72? Yes, that is exactly what I am talking about. Put your money where your mouth is specially if it is a minty sensation mouth kicker. 4 Happy Stars going on 4.5, right about now!
I just love these mints. Being able to buy them cheaper than I can get them locally was just great. They are quite fresh and I don't have to worry about running out when I have a craving for them.
Probably the best deal on the internet.  Even with shipping, these mints cost up to one half the retail price.
Good, healthy cereal. Good ingredients, fiber, easy to pour and eat, not too sweet. Arrived fresh. I eat it combined with other cereals, flax seed, soy protein powder.
This is great cereal, with just a hint of sweetness.  I love all the grains that you get.
We like this cereal, it's light and dilicious, looks like we are going to finish all the package too fast...

5 star for the product, but 1 star for the sneaky price increase means 2.5 stars. I subscribe and get it regularly, but noticed how thin the packages appeared the last shipment, but the price was the same as previous deliveries so I assumed I got the same as before. It turned out that the size of the package was reduced from 305g to 264 gram, 10% less for the same price. I don't mind paying more for a good  product, but not in this way.
It is the most expensive puffed cereal that I know of.  Its very good and no sodium just very expensive.

We discovered this cereal a few years ago at Trader Joe's.  We love it as an "amendment" to granola or Great Grains cereals.  Put simply, a mixture of the two is better than either one alone.  Since we can't ever count on our local grocers to have Kashi Honey puffed Seven Grain Whole Grains & Sesame on hand when we run out, this Amazon subscription is a brilliant idea, and the price is competitive.  Thank you, Amazon!
This is a great cereal for those looking for something beyond Sugar Crisp.  Even has some fiber in it

Progresso Vegetable Classics Hearty Black Bean Soup is a real find - in more ways than one!  A favorite  of mine, I think Progresso Vegetable Classics Hearty Black Bean Soup is the best commercially produced, mass-marketed soup available.  It is a rich, hearty soup that is perfect for that cold winter evening meal.  The bacon-flavored base is more like a gravy and does not overpower the black bean taste.  The base is not thin and runny as are the broths on other canned soups.  The black beans are plentiful and are not cooked to a mushy consistency, but neither are they undercooked.  I like to serve Progresso Vegetable Classics Hearty Black Bean Soup with a dollop of sour cream or a sprinkling of cheese; sometimes I add some cracked pepper and minced onion.However, Progresso Vegetable Classics Hearty Black Bean Soup is very difficult to find.  The primary grocery chain in Texas stopped carrying this variety of Progresso soup several years ago.  Shipping costs kept me from having out-of-state friends send me cases of Progresso Vegetable Classics Hearty Black Bean Soup.  Unfortunately, this is not a grocery product that Amazon stocks or offers on the subscribe-and-save program, so I had to seek another source.  A careful internet search helped me find an online retailer who offered free shipping with a $39 order and an additional 15% off as a new customer.  As a result, my cost per can below $2. If you cannot obtain this soup locally, be sure to do an internet search for Progresso Vegetable Classics Hearty Black Bean Soup before you buy.  Prices vary widely.
This is my families favorite black bean soup.  Since I cannot buy this soup in Southern California I have purchased it on line from Amazon.

Finally found the amazing and utterly delicious Progresso Hearty Black Bean Soup! Stores back home and where I live now stopped carrying it, even though it is the best soup that Progresso makes. The soup is incredibly good and my mom will be so happy to get a case of this. Too bad the shipping is so expensive, though. It's almost as much as the soup!
I buy this brand consistently and have no problems. My two toddlers love every flavor I buy. I love it because I can let them eat two in a row without concern. The size and amount are just right.

column9: Subscribe and Save and it's a better deal then most stores!
column10: If you can catch Mashups at a good price on S&S it tends to be a better deal and less hassle then say, buying them at a Babies R US or grocery store that happens to carry them.  It's hard to get tots and kids to eat veggies sometimes, and what with squeeze packs being such a rage lately this Mashups flavor falls into a must have at our house.  My 19 month old will eat this, it's portable, it a smoothie so babies and teething tots can handle it.  USDA organic.

column9: Great on the go snack for my son
column10: My veggie picky son claps when he sees the pouch.  We throw these in the diaper bags when we are out and about so he gets a good-for-him snack.  I don't give my son anything I wouldn't eat so I tried a taste of this.  The first thing I noticed was that it tastes like apples.  Whatever gets my picky boy to eat veggies is fine by me.

column9: Healthy quick snack for baby and kids
column10: I like this product because it combines vegetables and fruit.  Both my 1 year old and 3 year old love the taste and I like that I can throw them in my purse.

This is the perfect size for a toddler to have for a snack or as part of a meal.  My son is always on the go and these are great portable snacks.  He can carry it around and feed it to himself with very little mess.  It's also nice to keep in the car or diaper bag since they have a long shelf life and don't have to be refrigerated.  I like that they have 1g of fiber and are low in sugar.  They are mostly apple puree (that is the first ingredient), with a few other fruits and veggies mixed in. I think having more veggies and less apple would have earned it 5 stars for me.  These would be great for an older baby as well (9-12 months range).

column9: Another tetra-packed apple sauce product (that kids love!)
column10: Lets be honest, I don't care about it being organic. Buy these things with subscribe and save through Amazon Mom (I am a dad, where is Amazon Dad, Amazon?). Anywho, all I care is that they don't pump these full of extra sugar/sweeteners which is not necessary since this stuff has naturally high levels of sugar anyway. I do like that it has veggies in it and carrot puree is on the ingredient list rather than just veggie juice. My daughter can down several packets in a row if I let her (18 months old). She loves this stuff regardless of the brand so we try to mix in the variety of ingredients where we can.

We love these for a quick snack on the go or when the little guy is being picky he can at least get a fruit/veggie serving in.  I gave this 4 stars because of the serving size, could use another ounce or two in that area.

column9: Loved by Toddler and easy for travel
column10: I love that these are not entirely fruit based.  There are veggies inside as well.  These are easy to travel, make no mess, and as long as your child doesn't squeeze out too much product you will be fine.  I wish they had a variety pack of flavors!

Harney & Sons Organic Passion Plum is an excellent way to ease out of caffeine addiction.  Although it won't keep you awake like caffeine, it prevents the headaches that most people encounter with quiting. Be sure to preheat the cup to maximize the ginseng, steep at least five minutes, and above all, enjoy!

I'm a big fan of all the Fire & Flavor rubs, but this one is my go-to rub.  I put it on everything....from chicken on the grill to a light sprinkle over steamed vegetables.  It adds a really light distinctive flavor that perks up any dish.  I buy lots of the Fire and Flavor tins and create gift bags for Christmas and birthday gifts, and this rub is always in them.

Paid 10.00 for this item, and another 10.00 for shipping... should have know it wasn't going to be good after paying 20.00 for a jar of cashew butter! But when I got it.. WOW!! This stuff tasted terrible!!! I really thought it was bad, or tainted! So I had 3 others taste it, and with the same results! Immediately it went into the garbage! Maybe their other items taste ok, but the Cashew Butter, was just gross tasting! I recently went to Aruba and at a grocery store there purchased a jar of cashew butter, and it was fantastic!! Soooo I thought hmmm, why not buy some more on line... WHAT A MISTAKE! I should have just burned the 20.00!! Stay away from the cashew butter from this seller!!! YUCK!! No, DOUBLE YUCK!!

I love chai tea and this is definitely reminiscent of that. It's got a wonderful aroma and tastes good hot or cold. I'm definitely buying it again. It also reminds me of special home-made tea I had at a NYC Indian restaurant which was fabulous. Excellent tea. Well worth the price!

I discovered these on a recent trip to England.  Some of the higher end Guest-Houses used them and I was hooked, though I never thought to actually go looking for them while I was there.  They're delicatly sweet, one lump (occasionally two, since they're all brilliantly different sizes) is quite enough with a cup of tea and I prefer the brown sugar to the white.They're also (for some reason) an odd little conversation piece!
great product.  high quality and lower price than similar sugar cubes.  i love the irregularity of size and shape, too --- makes customizing my tea much easier.  plus they just look better.

These lovely irregular brown sugar cubes are the perfect sweetner for a strong cup of espresso. They're impossible to find outside of major metropolitan areas, but having them delivered to your door is easy.

I became somewhat addicted to Mango Madness at work. There was a coffee shop at my office that sold the delicious smoothie for $5.50 to $6.50 depending on the size. I'd get a smoothie at least twice a week. Luckily, one of the staff members told me which brand they used before the coffee shop moved.After searching the Internet I discovered the smoothie mix on Amazon and it happened to be a special item for that month. I ended up purchasing the Mango Madness, Peach Pizzazz, and Pineapple Coconut smoothie mixes and got $20 discount. The products are great and well worth the price even without the $20 discount. I spent more than the regular price in a month  just on smoothies from the coffee shop.The smoothies made with this mix have a bright mango flavor, and you can vary the amount of smoothie mix to change the sweetness. Best of all there's no high fructose corn syrup and it's loaded with vitamin C.  If you're like me and have smoothies often from a smoothie or coffee shop then the product pays for itself after using the first bottle which makes the two pack a great deal.

The product is delicious, definitely.I bought this package to replace the previous order which arrived with one of the two bottles leaking and therefore not usable.  Inquiry about exchanging was not returned.  Its a great product, and now I know a bottle may arrive open and its my problem to absorb the cost.  I've ordered many bottles and only one has arrived open, maybe 2% failure, I wish my fail rate was so low!

I have tried a lot of liquid smoothie mixes, and I always came back to this brand! Now it's the ONLY one I'll buy!Besides being an excellent product, it's cheaper than buying it on any other site, even it's OWN site!Plus Amazon gives you the FREE shipping & handling!I've tried ALL their flavors...but I'm kind of partial to the Mango Madness flavor ;-)An excellent product...especially IF you love the mango taste (as I do) ;-)

A number of years ago, I worked at a coffee shop that used these smoothie mixes, as many coffee shops do. I have to say they are amazing if made right and I got many compliments from my customers. Therefore, I was very excited to see them offered on Amazon.I found the ideal "recipe" to be 6 oz. of smoothie mix, 6 oz. of water, and 16 oz. of ice. And the biggest secret I learned is that making the smoothie with 6 oz. of orange juice in place of the water makes the smoothie 100 times better.

column9: Sickly sweet syrup; misrepresented ingredients/nutritional info
column10: I took a risk and ordered the mango flavor, hoping that some of the reviews would be wrong and this product would be as described - that is, a relatively healthy smoothie mix.  Alas, that was not the case.This smoothie mix is basically sugar syrup with maybe (I'm still dubious on this one) a little bit of fruit mixed in.  The mango mix is BRIGHT orange and SICKLY sweet.  They WAY overdid it on the sugar.  I couldn't even finish the first smoothie I made because it was way too sweet.Also, as another reviewer noted (not sure which flavor was being reviewed then), the ingredients for the mango product are also not as listed in the nutritional info on the product page.  I think part of the problem is that the product picture (and probably also nutritional info) are actually for a different product, the MANGO GUAVA flavor.  I ordered and received the MANGO MADNESS product, with no guava listed in the ingredients.  But my main beef is the type and relative amount of sugar was misrepresented.Here are the ingredients and nutritional info from the product page:Ingredients: MANGO PUREE, BEET SUGAR, TEA INFUSION (FILTERED WATER, GREEN TEA), NATURAL MANGO AND GUAVA FLAVORS, VEGETABLE GUM, CITRIC ACID, ASCORBIC ACID (VITAMIN C) YELLOW 6, SODIUM BENZOATE (TO PRESERVE FRESHNESS).Calories 110Total Carbohydrate 28g (9%)Sugars 27gAnd here is the info from the actual product label:Ingredients: Sugar, water, mango puree concentrate, malic acid, ascorbic acid (vitamin C), natural flavors, green tea powder, potassium sorbate (preservative), sodium benzoate (preservative), cellulose gum, yellow #5, and yellow #6Calories 140Total carbohydrate 36gSugars 35gAlso note that the nutritional info directly above is for 1/4 cup of smoothie base.  Of course, the directions on the side of the bottle instruct you to add 4oz of smoothie base to generate a 16oz serving.  So, you're really getting 54g of sugar in each smoothie.Wish I had received the product that was promised, it sounded like a great product. Instead, I'll be trying to return this if I can.  Very disappointed in this purchase.
I received the Mango Smoothie product only to find out the product had expired.  However, DAB was very prompt in sending a FedEx form for return of the product and refunded the amount paid.

I was looking for something different to put in my daughter's thermos for summer camp when my wife mentioned these. I haven't had Hawaiian Punch in a long time, so it sounded good. Being sugar free was a good thing because kids already get too much sugar anyway. As soon as it arrived we all tried it and liked it very much. I bought some regular (non-sugar free) a few days ago and now that I have had that I can taste the difference, but only slightly. If you haven't had Hawaiian Punch in a long time or if your kid has never had it, they won't even know the difference with this one.

I didn't order from Amazon, but picked up in the grocery store.  Not a bad product, I just wish there was a sugared version of the mix.  "Health nuts" aren't the only people who desire convenience...  Not sure why this pops up in electronics or with an iPhone case picture...

****Tazo Assorted Black and Green Teas and Herbal Infusions includes one or two of each:AWAKE:  plain ordinary black tea, a little bitterCALM:  nice chamomile teaCHAI BLACK TEA:  an okay chai black tea with caffeineCHINA GREEN TIPS:  great green tea experience, Tazo's best, no "natural flavorings"DECAFFEINATED CHAI: an okay chai black tea without caffeineEARL GREY BLACK TEA:  a disappointing perfumy, intense, black tea experienceLOTUS:  decaf green tea with lotus flower, one of my favorite Tazo'sPASSION HERBAL INFUSION:  hibiscus-y, intense, caffeine-free, and luxuriousWILD SWEET ORANGE:  orange herbal tea, some complex overtones perhapsZEN:  mild, relaxed green teaTheir ingredients include: black tea, green tea, hibiscus flowers, chamomile flowers, lemongrass, citric acid, natural flavors, spearmint leaves, blackberry leaves, cinnamon, rooibos, ginger root, rose hips, orange peel, rose petals, licorice root, safflower, black pepper, lemon verbena leaves, cardamom, cloves, peppermint leaves, chicory, sarsaparilla root, lemon balm leaf, star anise, and red poppy flowers.Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea. In general I'm not a big fan of tea with flavorings added, preferring the subtleness and authentic taste of the real thing.Overall, the green teas seem good. The herbal infusions are fine. The black teas tend to turn bitter if you don't brew them very briefly...even then they have bitter overtones. Tazo's assortment, and Tazo teas in general, are fine---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings---but not anywhere near as good as Numi, or Aspen, or other super premium teas made with only "real" ingredients and minus all of the flavorings. I'm more used to these high quality teas, which Tazo attempts to be, but disappoints...so overall Tazo Assorted gets a 3.5 to a 4. For this review, I'm rounding up, since so many people seem to enjoy these teas, and I'm in the clear minority. If your tea experience so far is drinking commercial teas of a lower quality, no doubt Tazo's teas will appeal to you, as they are a great improvement. They have a lot of variety and many interesting tea experiences. If you don't enjoy Tazo's teas, though, know that there are many, many teas made with all real ingredients, teas that cost only a fraction more, that may be just the thing you were looking for.****

column9: Excellent Assortment to Learn what you will enjoy
column10: The following recommendation is based on having enjoyed over 100 tea varieties in the last 2+ years.An inexpensive way to enjoy several varieties. Try it.

My first Tazo experience included a box of interesting items from a friend and packets of Tazo Green Ginger tea, delicious with orange blossom honey.This box of Assorted Teas contains:Awake - English breakfast style tea, strong enoughto handle the addition of milk.Calm - ChamomileChina Green TipsEarl Grey - PerfumedTazo Chai - SpicyPassion - hibiscus flowers and orange for a calming blendDecaffeinated Tazo ChaiWild Sweet Orange - really delicious when blended with Lotus and poured over iceLotusZen - Nice alternative to black tea and has a lemon verbena,spearmint and lemongrass twist.The ingredients include: Black tea, green tea, hibiscus flowers, chamomile flowers, lemongrass, spearmint leaves, blackberry leaves, cinnamon, Rooibos, Gingerroot, rose hips, orange peel, rose petals, licorice root, safflowers, black pepper, lemon verbena leaves, cardamom, cloves, peppermint leaves, chicory, sarsaparilla root, lemon balm leaf, star anise and red poppy flowers.I use 16 ounces of water and two tea bags for each experience. When you drink these teas you can transcend reality for moments at a time and that is all the truth I need about these teas. Some of these teas even evoke a sense of wonder.Once you taste these teas, you will want to try them all and forever be on a search for new Tazo teas. Fortunately they have enough tea blends to entertain you for years.~The Rebecca Review
Granddaughter in military and extremely fond of purple Skittles.  She was extremely happy with gift.  Would purchase this again as a Christmas gift.

column9: Great with a few extra ingredients added.
column10: I am a huge fan of organic foods and have experimented for years on how to get my children to eat things that are better for them. That said, this pasta is as good as any other on the market, but you can make it wonderful just by adding two simple ingredients. After I take the pasta out of the pan to drain it, I add about a tablespoon of light margarine (any soft butter-type spread will work) and about 3 tablespoons of fat free sour cream (you may also use plain yogurt). I whisk the cheese powder into this mixture and then add the pasta back to the mix. My kids finish an entire box EVERY time. Try it!

My kids have always preferred Kraft Mac & Cheese. *I* did not prefer it's ingredients but I relented because they liked it. I took a chance and ordered this mac & cheese hoping they would like it. I have purchased other organics (like Annie's) which they hated so I wasn't holding out much hope. I made it in place of the Kraft for dinner one night and there wasn't even a comment made about the switch! They ate it up and wanted seconds! This is now a staple in my pantry and I feel better about serving mac & cheese twice a month or so since it's ingredients are organic. If your kids like Kraft but don't like Annie's, I encourage you to try Back to Nature

column9: Great way to feed kids lots of veggies
column10: I like Back to Nature's mac and cheese a lot, my toddler do too. I do add my ingredients as well.Here's what I do:I cook pasta as directed, but on top of the pot with pasta I set a steamer basket with variety of frozen veggies, like mix of squash, cauliflower, green beans, carrots, corn, clove of garlic and either butternut squash or a winter pumpkin. By the time pasta is ready, veggies are nice and warm too. Then I cream all the veggies with some milk, cream and the cheese powder from the pouch. We never do anything low fat in our house, but if you do, you can use whatever you usually do. I add this sauce to the drained pasta, put it back on the burner just to warm it up again and add a good amount of a frozen carrot/sweet peas mixture. My kids finish their plates and ask for more. It's really good and you can never tell how much veggies are in there.

Excellent product. I was weary to try it because the kids love Kraft over others we have tried. The kids approve! This is my new go to mac-n-cheese. I can also feel good I am giving my kids a healthy organic product with no weird ingredients.

It very hard these days to do the right thing for my family and the envorment when you are on a budget. So items like this that teast good and have a great price are a really wonderfull find. I will buy again and again.
A good example that the taste of organic food is better!

column9: Good, quick mac and cheese option
column10: We purchased this mac and cheese because it was reviewed as the best in category from a magazine we receive. It is definitely better than many other organic boxed mac and cheese options out there. We purchased it online because it is currently not available at our local supermarket. While it was good, it saves a bit of money for us to catch a sale on the Annie's organic at our local store. I would buy this again, but it is not so good to make it the only organic boxed mac and cheese option in our pantry.

My husband and I are transitioning into organic.  This is our first try at substituting Velveeta Mac N Cheese - and what a success!  It takes more like Kraft, or like I say, how Granny used to make it (probably due to the butter).  If you follow the directions on the box you will have one delicious batch of Mac N Cheese, that is creamy and so tasty.  Bon appetit!
Bought this for a 6 yr old with a sore mouth (having dental work done).  She loved these and I felt good because she wasn't getting any chemicals or preservatives.

I love these, but sometimes the cheese doesn't mix in as easy as the less healthy versions. When it doesn't mix well, the cheese powder has kind of a funky, spicy flavor. Other than that, good product.

... jarred and vacuum-packed chestnuts may be close enough to the real thing to deceive your palate. The real thing is increasingly problematical in the USA, available only part of the year at best, often of poor quality, sometimes of such terrible quality that you'll give up on chestnuts forever. And of course, even if you can get good chestnuts, they are hard work to prepare in sufficient quantity for many recipes. This offering, by the way, is shockingly expensive; the same or similar imported jarred chestnuts are sold in my local markets in SF for half this price or less.One of my cage-mates in the amazoo requested this recipe:Equal quantities of roasted chestnuts and fresh Brussels sprouts.Roast and peel the chestnuts (or use these pale substitutes from the jar).Steam the sprouts, but somewhat less than completely.Braise the chestnuts and sprouts together in an ample amount of unsalted butter, with just a hint of garlic (not powder of course!), until the sprouts take a bit of brown color.Serve hot.Very well matched with a puree of potatoes and celery root, and roasted duck.

I used chestnuts from a jar or can for the Thanksgiving stuffing every year because I don't have the time to roast and peel. Other brands leave a lot of the hard black membranes on the nuts, so I still had to pick through them. Not this brand...they were very clean, fresh and made preparation that much easier.

I, myself, think chestnuts taste like dust and am not sure just what the allure is.  I ordered these for my mom, who has been a chestnut lover for a good portion of her 84 years on this planet, and she liked them very much, so I guess they must be okay.  Last year I purchased a different brand and these measured up.  So for you chestnut afficionados, it's a thumbs up.

We ordered two jars of these cooked and peeled chestnuts.  The vacuum was opened on one bottle and we tossed it out.  The seal on the second jar was OK but the chestnuts were mealy.  We tossed it out.I think we should get our charges refunded.

Roasted Chestnuts are a tradition with my family on Christmas day but this purchase of chestnuts was very disappointing due to the lack of flavor of the chestnuts themselves...no flavor even with using my chestnut roaster. The texture was perfect as well as the color but lacked taste in the mouth. Thank you.

Standard purchase this time of year - two large jars of roasted chestnuts.  My husband makes the traditional English chestnut stuffing for Christmas dinner.The best ones are the ones Wms. Sonoma sells but they sell out FAST.  I first bought these in 2009 and they were pretty good.  So just to make things easy I bought these again the next year and the quality was just not there;they were not at all fresh.So depending on the seller, it is hit or miss.  Best bet, buy early, and buy from the best.

We have ordered these chestnuts many many times over quite a few years and they have always been fabulous.  They are especially good in turkey stuffing, and also prepared with Brussele sprouts. We recommend them highly.

My wife prepares a special dish of brussels sprouts and chestnuts in a casserole for Thanksgiving. Our local markets did not have the chestnuts this year so it was good to find these available on-line. They are fresh and tasty although certainly pricey compared to the usual local cost. Still, they arrived in time for our feast and the guests were well pleased.
Absolutely delicious chestnuts.  My Dad has tried other brands and these are his favorites by far.  Mine too!  Thanks!
This beats roasting, and peeling.  Tastes just as good as t'ere plucked from the tree.With brussel sprouts, it will please the pickiest at the Thanksgiving tableIt has nothing to do with puzzles
Served with brussel sprouts in a cream sauce at Thanksgiving.  Received rave reviews from my guests.

column9: Great Taste and Nutrition in One Cereal
column10: Have you tried those healthful cereals that taste like tree bark or cardboard, knowing that you were doing your body good, but still dreaming of giving your taste buds a treat?  Kashi Heart to Heart cereal will surprise your taste buds with a wonderful toasted oat cereal in adorable shapes of hearts and "o's."  With just enough honey-filled crunch and oodles of nutritional value, you won't even realize you are eating a cereal that's so good for you.Providing high fiber, antioxidants and botanicals like grape seed extract and beta carotene, 100% daily value of Vitamin E, folic acid, Vitamins B6 and B12, this cereal is chock full of healthful ingredients.  And to boot, it's low in fat and sodium.  What more can you ask for?Ingredients listed: Whole Oat Flour, Oat Bran, Evaporated Cane Juice, Yellow Corn Meal, Corn Flour, Kashi Seven Whole Grains and Sesame Flour ( Whole: Oats, Long Grain Brown Rice, Rye, Hard Red Winter Wheat, Triticale, Buckwheat, Barley, Sesame Seeds), Oat Fiber, Wheat Germ, Honey, Salt, Sodium Bicarbonate, Natural Honey Flavor, Decaffeinated Green Tea Extract, Alpha Tocopherol, Ascorbic Acid, ActiVin Grape Seed Extract, Tomato Extract, Pyridoxine Hydrochloride, Ferrous Fumarate, Zinc Oxide, Tuermeric, Beta Carotene, Folic Acid, Vitamin B12Kashi Heart to Heart cereal has been a delicious and nutritious mainstay of our breakfast regimen for several years, and will remain so for years to come.- Victoria Austin

column9: Highly Addictive Cereal Is Fortunately Healthy As Well As Tasty
column10: As a serial cereal eater, I have had my bouts of addiction throughout my life from Apple Jacks and Count Chocula during my early childhood through an extensive adolescence with Sugar-Frosted Flakes, a short-lived health-oriented period with Bran Flakes and of course, my self-deceptive dieting tactics using Special K. My latest has been Kashi's Heart to Heart, which I find flavorful and filling. There is a slightly sweet taste which has something to do with the light honey glaze on the Cheerio-looking rings, though the most pervasive flavor is a toasted oat. I don't find a need for sugar, but I do like to pile up blueberries if I have them in the fridge.I have to admit that I have used it as a dinner replacement on really lazy evenings. The best part is that the low-fat, low-sodium cereal is heart-friendly (thus the name) with one gram of soluble fiber per serving. The box claims 11 servings of 3/4 cup each, which for a cereal lover, is a stretch. I've been lucky to eke out eight bowls since I tend to overflow the bowl. Still, the calorie count is reasonable at 110 of which only 15 come from fat. For a price that is on par with local retailers, Amazon delivers the cereal in cases of six boxes, which I think is a reasonable medium-term amount.

column9: Heart to Heart Cereal- The Best Cereal Ive EVER Tasted!
column10: Heart to Heart really is the best cereal Ive ever tasted. A couple of months ago my mom and I were shopping at Rite Aid buying toilet trees and then I came across this cereal, Heart to Heart. I looked at the back and found out that its low in calories. I had been trying to find a cereal that tasted delicious but is also low in calories and hadnt found one until I came across Heart to Heart Cereal. It also lowers cholestrol and it also lowers blood pressure. It doesnt have a bland taste like lots of low calorie cereals do; it has a honey flavor to it which is wonderful :) I eat Heart to Heart every morning, Ive lost a lot of weight (maybe because I start my day off eating Heart to Heart Cereal), and I totally recommend this cereal to anyone. You will LOVE it!

I have been eating this cereal every morning for breakfast for a few years now. It is just "heavy" enough to be satisfying until a mid-morning snack. I tried granola, but it's too "heavy" for me. I like a lighter breakfast, but need more than fruit. So this cereal is perfect. It has a mildly sweet nutty flavor and stays crunchy until the end. Reasonably priced with healthy ingredients...it's great!

This is the first oat-based cereal that I have enjoyed.  I like it straight from the box, with 2% milk, or occasionally with orange juice.  When I travel and may not be able to find it, I pour it into quart-sized zip-lock bags and take some with me.  It's also good as a snack when flying.  I've compared the label to those on other Kashi cereals, as well as the run-of-the-mill stuff, and this is better.

column9: Read the Ingredients before Believing the Health Claims
column10: Sure, the first ingredient on this cereal is whole grain oats. That's good. But the second ingredient is sugar, and there's more nutritionally-devoid corn in this cereal than Kashi's signature 7-whole-grain blend. Also note that this corn is not GMO-free. I'm not saying this cereal is bad for you (although there is debate over the health effects of GMOs), it just contains more empty calories than you think.Side note: Kashi is owned by Kelloggs. It's not some small company devoted to creating wholistic, nutritious foods; it's a corporation that is interested in taking as full advantage of cheap, subsidized corn as it can without deterring health-conscious consumers.

Been eating this stuff for a few years nearly every morning.  I like it with Silk Vanilla Mile which adds a dash more sweetness.  My toddler daughter likes it too.  Has a lot of fiber for a cold cereal.  Will continue to buy.
I like the cereal a lot, but the current price here is outrageous--almost $7/box. I just ordered this cereal from Walmart's site at $3.38/box.

I love this cereal, esp. with a lightly sweetened soymilk. But Hannaford Supemarket and Target sells this for less $, and this week I bought boxes of this and other Kashi cereal for $2.50 a piece on sale at Target.

I have to admit that I bought this at the local Safeway when it was on sale and I was on a health kick and I fully expected it to taste like the cardboard box it was packaged in.  The first bowl was a 50/50 blend with Honey Bunches of Oats b/c I thought I'd have to mask the horrible taste. How did it taste?  Well, the second bowl didn't need any Honey Bunches of anything. This stuff is so totally yummy with a slight sweetness and good crunch. This is the only cereal I've eaten where i start to feel full before i hit the bottom of the bowl. A cold breakfast that's tasty, convenient and filling?  It's a breakfast miracle!

I had always cringed at the Kashi brand simply because I just "knew" it would taste terrible like most of the other good-for-you foods. Then we received a small sample packet. My 5-year-old and I tried it. I was great! Nice crunch but not too hard. Terrific flavor with a hint of sweetness. We gobbled it right down and I had to promise my daughter that I would go out and buy more the next day. We end up eating it dry as a snack as much as a wet cereal. Another great point is the fact that there are no artificial colors in it, as my daughter is allergic to every artificial color and it is difficult to find satisfying treats. I highly recommend this cereal!

The cereal tastes the same as it always has, which is quite good especially when combined with fresh berries, but they have reduced the amount in the box from 12.4 ounces to 12 ounces. The product description says 12.4 ounces while the order details says 12 ounces per box. Stop giving us less and less cereal in the box. I would like a box to have more than just a few servings in it, please.  I judge cost based on cost per ounce, not on cost per box.

column9: Great Cereal - Do Your Homework on Cost
column10: I'm a big fan of Kashi Heart to Heart.  Sure, it's not a cereal most kids will like, but I find it's great for someone who is working to eat healthy as an adult.  It may not be as good for you as oatmeal and fresh fruit, but it has to be better for you that a bacon, egg, and cheese biscuit.I have a bowl of this cereal, or Kashi Heart to Heart Blueberry Flake and Cluster Oat Cereal, with Whole Foods 365 Unsweetened Almond Milk every day for breakfast.  If you must have a sweeter cereal, you can use the 365 Vanilla Almond Milk.Regarding value from the sellers on Amazon.com, I'm concerned by the e-mail Amazon sent me on 1/13/12 advertising a 6 pack of this cereal on "sale" for $42.79 ($7.13/box) from Bangalla Organic.  In June of 2011, I purchased a 6 pack from Amazon with Subscribe & Save for $17.91.  Really!  A single box sells for roughly $3.50 at Publix and Target.On a positive value note, Amazon has the Blueberry cereal right now for $15.84 / 6 pack with Subscribe & Save.  That's a great price.The bottom line is that this is a good cereal.  Just don't assume the advertised price on Amazon is good.  Do your homework.

This cereal has it all. It tastes great; each serving is loaded with fiber (5g) and protein (4g), but is very low in sugar (4g), sodium (85mg) and fat (1.5g); and will easily fill you up at breakfast time if you eat it in a bowl of milk with fresh fruit (I usually cut up an apple, a banana, and add some blueberries or strawberries).Shop for price. I buy a 43 oz. box at my local Costco for just under nine dollars.

This is 10 times better than Honey-nut Cheerios!I love this cereal, I eat it for breakfast and even as a snack in the evenings sometimes. I finally quit buying Honey-nut cheerios for my kids and now they have started to eat this; it's so much healthier.I would highly recommend this to anyone who is considering trying it.

column9: Yeah it might look like dog food but it AINT dog food! It's GREAT food!
column10: Yep! I got hooked on Kashi. The first time I tried it I thought it was nasty. Hard, expensive, you name it, I thought it. However, I've been needing a food item to include in my daily diet to fill the sweet crunchy void so I gave Kashi another try. Lo! A free full size Kashi bar in the mail- the one with chocolate chips and it was excellent! And not made of excess garbage chemicals and unecessary sugars and fats that clog up your heart and brain. I went to the Kashi website and printed their coupons, bought some Heart to Heart cereal and- didn't like it. I thought "dog food, boring, etc., etc. But I ate it.I began to appreciate the quality of the product, the subtle not-too-sweet crispness of the cereal and now I eat it dry more often not. If you don't like one Kashi product, try others, you're bound to find something you'll enjoy. Kashi products are excellent products that are clean, healthful, and more apt to do your body good than many of the other sugary over processed products on the market now days.

column9: Great choice for an on the wagon sugar junkie
column10: No sugar needs to be added, slightly sweet, mild nutty flavor makes this one great tasting choice.Want to make it even better? I use soy milk, the sweetness of the soy compliments this cereal. Satisfies even the most hardcore sugar addict and makes this a double wammy of healthy goodness.This is a ceareal that will satisfy your 4 year old and your 40 year old at the same time.I tried a number of the "cardbord" cereals on the market, VERY happy i found thisMost healthy choices i found would taste better if you ate the box it came in (with some sugar added of course)This is one of the few healthy cereals i have found that would have the flavor ruined by adding sugar to it

Kashi Heart to Heart Honey Toasted Oat Cereal could be described as Kashi's take on Cheerios.  However oats and shape are about all that they have in common.  The taste of the Kashi cereal is quite different, and one might even say that it is an acquired taste.  I'll admit it is not a flavor that I try to seek out in any other foods, but it is one that I find pleasing enough after having eaten it for years.  I will say that it tastes a lot better than regular Cheerios which taste like Styrofoam.  In addition to taste, Heart to Heart wins over Cheerios on ingredients too.  While Cheerios list "modified corn starch" as an ingredient, Kashi using nothing modified.  Kashi also uses evaporated can juice which I prefer over sugar.  Heart to Heart also has a couple of additional ingredients that claim to promote heart health:  grape seed extract and green and white tea extracts.  The USDA has not substantiated these claims yet so take that for what it's worth.  Overall, Kashi's Heart to Heart is the winner for me over Cheerios based on both taste and ingredients.

column9: Good source of fiber, protein and great with milk.  I love Kashi!
column10: I really enjoy this cereal right out of the box as a healthier snack or with milk.  It is one of those cereals that passes the milk test with flying colors and will not wilt.  Expect a great, crunchy and nutritious cereal and snack.  It is filling and not overly sweetened.  Other people in my house thinks that the cereal borders on the bland side ... if you are accustomed to Lucky Charms, these definitely will.  But if you are trying to ease your palette into a healthier cereal that is not loaded with sugars, you will like this.I tend to lean towards Kashi products even though they can be more expensive.  I like the company philosophy and the ingredients.  Not a lot of empty stuff in their products.This is a great cereal to ease into as you move away from the surgary stuff.  I used to keep a box in my drawer at work to hold me throughout some of those long corporate days.  It works!5 Stars.

We love this cereal,it is a regular part of our breakfast routine - just add berries! However, if I watch local sales (Rite-Aid, Target, Walgreens) I can get this cereal for about $2.00 a box - which comes out to $12.00 for the six boxes as opposed to Amazon's $26.00. A huge difference for my budget!

Somehow picked up this cereal from Costco at random a while back and have gotten glued to it ever since! I hate really sweet cereals and this one has just the right amount of sweetness to it and I love the crunchy feel it gives. I keep trying other cereals especially the Post Selects (which my husband loves) but I cant help keep coming back to Kashi Heart and Healthy !

I have been eating the Kashi Heart to Heart Honey Toasted Oat Cereal for a few years now.  I first began eating it after being diagnosed with an Underactive Thyroid.  I especially like this cereal for the B-Vitamin content and its great taste.  Anyone suffering from Underactive Thyroid or Hypothyroidism usually have issues with energy and that's why this cereal is so helpful and nutritious.  I am currently attending college part-time online and eat this cereal whenever I need some extra energy or mental alertness.  When I'm not eating this specific Kashi cereal, I am usually eating the Kashi Go Lean, and others that I alternate with.  This cereal has a nice texture and a light honey flavor.  I particularly like that it's not real sweet tasting since there are so many cereals out there that contain just too much sugar.  I highly recommend this cereal as well as Kashi's other cereals.  You just know you are doing something positive for your body, mind, and spirit.  As always, Amazon's delivery and convenience is just great.  Amazon also offers very competive pricing since you save quite a bit by ordering this cereal in a bulk amount.  Great product and great service!!

I got a coupon for a free box and so I decided to try this (usually pretty expensive) cereal. The taste and mouth-feel are definitely better than most high-fiber rivals, but I have a really hard time getting over its appearance! I know that sounds silly, but I just cannot whet my appetite for a cereal that looks so much like dog food. If I ever got another coupon, and it took the price under $2, I would probably buy it again. If not, I will stick with cheaper, more attractive cereals.
Tasted Good! Would buy again as it tasted better than expected, though not as sweet. The product is healthy as well so more reason to buy it.
This is a great oat cereal if you enjoy crunchy. The honey gives it a pleasant but not overpoweringly sweet taste. It is not organic, which is why I only give it 4 stars.

Healthy is NOT equal to tasty. This cereal confirms that. I had a hard time finishing it. I will stick to Honey Nut Cheerios! If people like it I am sure they will stick with it. Kashi brand is great and I do take their other cereals, this one was not for our family.

I share an apartment with two other college-aged guys.  Kashi is really expensive in the grocery stores nearby, so we get monthly subscribe-and-save deliveries of the following:Kashi GOLEAN Cereal, 14.1-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! Cereal, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! Cereal, Honey Almond Flax, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)Kashi GOLEAN Crisp! Toasted Berry Crumble, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)Kashi Heart To Heart Honey Toasted Oat Cereal, 12.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)We save quite a bit of money this way, and we always have a stock available.  I eat it for breakfast every morning and often for a snack as well - it really is tasty and filling, has lots of healthy protein and fiber, and doesn't leave you feeling sugar-shocked like kid's cereals overloaded with high fructose corn syrup and cane sugar.  I rotate between the five cereals listed above to keep things interesting.Kashi Heart-To-Heart is my choice when I'm not feeling quite up to the heavier multigrain GoLean cereals.  It's extra-tasty with dried, fresh, or frozen fruit, but I usually enjoy it plain with vanilla soymilk.  It's not quite as filling as the GoLean cereals, so I usually eat this one as a snack instead of breakfast.

I buy this item on Auto Ship.  In my last order I found that the inner package of the cereal was not properly sealed.  One of the corners was open about 4 inches.  I called Kashi and gave them all the identifying information on the box.  They sent me a coupon for replacement of that box.  Good Customer Service buys loyalty.  This is why I stay with Amazon for all my needs, whatever they are.

column9: Great Tasting Cereal That Causes a Lot of Gas!
column10: This is probably the best tasting cereal I've ever had when I eat it dry.  I love the crispy crunch and the sweet honey taste.  I don't see where people think this looks like dog food.  I've seen other cereal on the market that has comparable looks.WARNING!  This cereal causes your body to become a profuse gas factory!  Don't eat this cereal if you are going to be around other people within three to four hours of eating.  You'll find yourself talking on line "toot".

column9: Very disapointed! too short expiration date!
column10: I used to order different cereal from amazon, but I've never had cereal with just TWO MONTH expiration date left. I got 6 pack of cereals. Unless i have a huge family, it is hard to eat 6 packs for 2 months. I got it this week. Expiration date of all six boxes were Oct, 2011. I can't believe they sent old product. I don't think they would eat or buy something may expire soon. Bad business manner!!

I have been buying Kashi for awhile, try to eat cereal good for you.  The boxes came alittle banged up but a good price .  Helps me not have to carry as much home.  Helps to keep numerous boxes at the house.

At the time of writing the Amazon.com cost for this is $3.34 a box (or $20.09 for six boxes). As another reviewer noted, you can usually find this for around $2.50 at a Kroger's. I haven't seen it at sale prices in other grocers, but $3.34 per box is comparable to most of the prices I've seen when it wasn't on sale.My husband is picky with his cereals and he didn't have any complaints about the smell or flavor of this one. I enjoy this cereal, I think it is more flavorful than the brand name Cherrios, and I like that it is high in fiber. It isn't SWEETER than Cherrios, mind, but it does contain more flavors. If you like sweet cereals (puffs, loops, frosted etc.) this may taste more like grains than you could be used to.I recommend trying these out, keep in mind though that they don't really taste like Cherrios.

column9: Great taste and not overly sweet
column10: Love the taste as I don't want a mouthful of sugar first thing in the morning. These are way better than the salty bland old Cheerios I used to eat. This cereal did not leave me feeling full as long as the Go Lean Crunch variety does, but it is much easier to chew. My main concern with many Kashi products is the high fiber content and how many times I will have to excuse myself... well I'm happy to report that this gives me about 1/5 as much flatulence as the Go Lean Crunch, and Go Lean Crunch is known for some serious flatulence. if you work in an office you are safe with this variety. As with all Kashi products my body just seems to work better when I eat this stuff. It also helps keep things regular in the ol' digestive system. I would give it 5 stars but I like a little bit of nutty taste in my cereals and when pouring it out of the bag I was reminded of processed pet food. The Go Lean crunch has me spoiled I suppose but it makes me poot way too much so for now heart to heart is my top pick.

my order arrived in good condition. the cereal was fresh and it smelled good to me. the freshness date was well into the future. they tasted delicious as i was snacking on them right out of the box. the list of ingredients is wholesome and healthy for my situation. i'm looking for a sale on them so i can stock up soon. very little salt and very little of any sweetness just wholesome good grains and stuff in there for a healthy snack. i hope many others will try this wonderful product.

Basically, I can't live without a morning bowl of this stuff. I don't know what it's made out of, but I eat it everyday. I tried honeynut cheerios again recently and there is no comparison. I hope they never stop making this cereal, cause I don't know what I do.

column9: Great Cereal... a bit pricey at Amazon
column10: This is a great cereal (the warm cinnamon is even better).  But it's priced pretty high here at Amazon.  What amount to $4.60/box.  I can pick this up locally for as little as $3.29/box.

column9: Good once you get used to it...
column10: I couldn't get over the initial thought that these had the consistency and texture of dog food. Yep, that's right! But after I got over that, it tasted good. It's hearty w/ a hint of honey. My kid enjoys eating it too once they soak in milk for a bit b/c they're on the hard side.

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column10: I have to admit, I don't normally eat cereal for a normal meal. However, I'm trying to replace my bad snacks with good ones & cereal is one of those things that I do like to snack on. So yesterday when I was at the store, I decided to give this cereal a try. After all, my mom & several of my friends adore Kashi.Here's the pros & cons:PROS:Tastes good, is healthy for me & has lots of fiber. There's a lot of nutrients in this & it is far better for me than if I were to eat sugary cereal or other bad snacks.CONS:The Kashi brand is expensive & forgive me... but this looks like something you'd feed to a dog or cat. Like another reviewer said, it looks like kibble.If you can get past the lackluster appearance, this really is a great cereal for everyday munching & for breakfast.

What's not to love about Kashi's Heart to Heart?  Its actually GOOD for you, slightly sweet, so even kids love it, similar to Honey Nut Cheerios.  I love this cereal and feel good giving it to my kids.  They don't bounce off the wall afterward, either. (moms know what I'm talking about).

My kids have eaten honey nut cheerios for years but my mom suggested mixing them with regular cheerios to reduce sugar intake, when I saw this cereal I thought it was a great solution as it has much less sugar, more fiber and has a great honey flavor, not as sweet as honey nut cheerios but sweet enough, my kids loved them right away and didn't seem to notice they have so much less sugar, plus they like the heart shape and the name, girlie girls that they are, ages 4 & 8. I signed up for the recurring order thru amazon which is less expensive than the grocery store and we go through a lot of it especially on the weekends.

Kashi's Heart to Heart is, by far, my favorite cold cereal.  The crunch and the fact that it stays crunchy in soy milk makes it perfect.  The honey flavor is very mild and the cereal has an almost maple taste to it.  And the cereal is made with whole grains.  How perfect is that?!One week, I ran out of the Heart to Heart and grabbed a box of Cheerios at Target.  It was such a disappointment.  It didn't stay crunchy and the flavor was just flat.  I  was grateful when my next Subscribe & Save shipment arrived.While the cereal is mighty tasty with milk, it also makes an excellent snack to eat out of hand.Update: This cereal is no longer available on Subscribe & Save.

This cereal is the best, and I love it!  It is similar to another popular oat cereal, but it has no aftertaste as some do.  It is a clean, nutty taste, and I mix it with fat-free yogurt and fruit and it is delicious.  Also, having it shipped on a regular basis makes the Amazon cost the best deal.

Love the convenience and price, but would like to see two improvements:- larger boxes (less packaging - especially get rid of the plastic shrink wrap that holds the boxes together)- organic ingredients

This is excellent cereal!  It is very tasty and does not need sugar added.  It has just the right amount sweetness (in my opinion, that is). Read the nutional label and you will find that it is suitable for most people's dietary priorities.  I try to keep my sodium intake below 1500 mg per day and it is difficult to find a cereal that helps me meet that goal, but this one does.Amazon has a great price on this product and I buy twelve boxes at a time!

column9: Less sugar than most brands and quality ingedients
column10: This cereal far outweighs the most common circular cereal on the market shelves for quality ingredients. It's tasty without the sugary sweet coating found in the other brands of cereal.Great for the little ones in the house to take as a portable snack instead of high fat, trans-fat filled and sugary things that conntribute to later obesity and tooth decay.

Perfect breakfast cereal and/or snack - great taste and good nutritional stats. I usually mix it with a high-protein cereal in the mornings and have a baggie on hand as an afternoon snack. I do try to watch my portions, and it can be a bit addictive...

column9: Good dry but not as cereal
column10: This cereal has a good taste but I expected it to be more like honey nut cheerios-crunchy in milk.  It wasn't, it's a lot softer and gets soggy in milk.  I ate it as a dry snack.  I like the nutrional content but for cereal, I am sticking with honey nut cheerios.

If you are looking for a great tasting way to get some added nutrition, I strongly suggest you try this cereal.  It has a nice texture, slightly crunchier than cheerios, and tasty enough that you don't need sugar.  With whole grain fiber, tea extract, grapeseed extract, and lycopene as well as vitamins, I don't think any other cereal cangive as much in each bowl. This is a staple in our house, I highly recommend it.

Getting the automatic deliveries of this great tasting and healthy cereal makes my life easier. My husband can actually fix himself a bowl when he wants a snack!He knows it's healthy and will sometimes have a bowl full before he goes to bed...just in case he's too late in the morning for breakfast.
Delicious cereal that is lightly sweet.  It reminds me of Lucky Charms, without all the sugar and no marshmallows.  Or a lightly sweet box of Cheerios.

This cereal taste good and is really healthy . . . although you can also buy it from other regular stores at a lower or equal cost.  Without the free shipping, it comes expensive if you buy it online.

column9: Great big taste and super health benefits!
column10: Kashi Heart to Heart Honey Toasted Oat Cereal delivers big taste and crunch for comparitively few calories. It's one of the best cereals out there, delivering the kind of health benefits you'd expect from Cheerios or oatmeal. In addition to that, it delivers the antioxidant equivalent of eating almost a pound of grapes!The flavor is so good that you'll enjoy it as a crunchy snack right out of the box but it's great with fat-free milk. It's got enough sweetness to satisfy your cravings, without being overwhelming. It's perfect for adults dealing with (or preventing) health issues, but it's so delicious that kids will love it, too!Order it from Amazon and there's no shipping charges!

column9: Great Product.  Priced a Bit High.
column10: Great cereal that we can highly recommend.  However, do shop around for a better price.  We're able to purchase locally for under $3/box at several grocery stores.

All Kashi cereals omit the preservative BHT, which some studies show to be carcinogenic. They use vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) to preserve freshness. Kashi Heart to Heart Honey Toasted Oat cereal tastes great to both the adults as well as the young children in this family.

Tastes like a much milder version of honey nut Cheerios with a bigger crunch. And how can you say no to eating little hearts each morning?! Definitely a staple in my cabinet. Good dry or with milk. My kids like it too.

I don't know why, though it's probably the fiber, but most Kashi products don't raise my blood sugar, when normally that high of a concentration of carbs would.  I've been eating it everyday for a long time, and am not sick of it yet.  I thought the texture would be too dense for my toddler, but she loves it to.  Yay Kashi.

Tastes great! and more importantly, eating this regularly really reduces cholestrol.The details on this cereal reads much better than any other good tasting cereal I have seen.This cereal has less fat etc even compared to the other Kashys heart to heart cereal (with blueberries).

I have been eating continuously for over a year now and love it! I love the taste and I know what all of the ingredients are. Do yourself a favor and look at the ingredients of other "healthy" cereals from other brands like Kellogg's and General Mills. You will find out that there is a lot of junk in them or ingredients which you don't know what they are let alone be able to pronounce...imagine how your body reacts to it. This cereal has very low sodium too.
I love this cereal. It is healthy and really tasty which is such a rare combination to find! My 2 year old loves this cereal too. She keeps saying - give me 2 hearts or give me 2 circles :-)

column9: Is there a great tasting natural cereal? YES!
column10: Kashi's got a winner with their Heart to Heart Honey Toasted Oat Cereal.  Low calorie, great taste with no artificial ingredients.  Thank you Kashi!
This cereal has it all, great nutrition and great taste! It's perfectly sweetened (not overly sweet) and a more nutritious option for children as well as adults.

This cereal is a daily part of my diet.  It tastes delicious and I love that it is low fat, low calorie and has low sugar! All the added antioxidants are great too.  I give the ingredient list an A+.  The only down side is the price here at Amazon.  I can get this same cereal at Wal-mart for $2.50 a box which is only $15 for 6.
very good. not like other "good 4 u" foods of the past. this taste great & even he kids enjoy it.

My kids (ages 8 and 10) love these with milk and without. I like them,  though they can get a bit monotonous, but I am not a big cereal/carb lover. They are a much healthier and tasty alternative to cheerios.

great cereal.  my 18 month old daughter likes these everyday for breakfast or as a trail mix with raisins, cherries and/or m&m's .  its a shame that they don't sell them in a smaller quantity though, 6 boxes takes up an awful lot of storage space.

Kashi makes some of the tastiest, healthy cereals and their Heart to Heart is no exception.  Their O's are crispier & crunchier than the leading "O" cereal and have more of a lightly sweetened graham cracker taste. They stay nice and crunchy in milk/soy milk and also mix up great with nuts & raisins for a trail mix treat.I like to eat them with plain Silk soy milk which adds just a bit more sweetness.I love this stuff!
Great deal from Amazon, the entire family loves this cereal.  The kids really like the heart shapes.  Also great since it only has 5g sugar per serving, good fiber and protein levels too.

column9: Good Cereal and Good for You
column10: Great price for 6 boxes, better than a grocery store (but not quite as good as Costco -- not that mine staocks it).I like Kashi Heart-to-Heart.  It tastes almost like Honey Nut Cheerios, but the texture is a bit strange.  To get used to it, I recommend mixing it with Honey Nut Cheerios.

column9: Healthy, but not tasty in the least
column10: I have to admit that I do have a bit of a sweet tooth, but it's not an abnormal one.  I bought this cereal knowing it is healthy because I am trying to lose a few (read that as 10) pounds and be healthy about it so my husband and I can try to get pregnant (I'm over 35, so higher risk).  It has great nutritional value and I decided to try it instead of my "usual" Grape Nuts.  (Figured it would save my teeth.) :-)It is not, not, not tasty.  It is very bland (which is OK, I guess) and mildly sweetened, but it tasts like I've decided to eat one of my dog's biscuits with a little honey.  It's fully edible, but it is not something I have to worry about anyone else eating because it isn't good.  It really doesn't taste good.
