I read these other reviews that say it tastes great and wonder, "what do these people usually eat?!"  I would MUCH rather have my Grape Nuts or Shredded Wheat or some other granola/bran cereal.  I'll finish my box, but I will NOT be buying another.Healthy?  VERYTasty? NO WAYSorry.

Read the ingredients on most cereal boxes then read the Kashi boxes. What a difference. You may never eat a "regular" cereal again. Kashi cereals taste better, eat better, and make a true cereal lover happy.

Something about the texture of this cereal... once it's in the milk, it quickly becomes so soggy and mushy that it feels and looks like cat food. it is also very lacking in taste- it's VERY slightly sweetened and lacks the toasted aroma of other "honey toasted' cereal.  Granted, this product is probably a lot healthier.  I wish I liked it since I bought the Costco pack... and I usually LOVE other the other Kashi products (go lean crunch, energy bars), but unfortunately this cereal is not one of their best.

After looking all over town for a good price on this, we finally found it in the natural section at Kroger on sale for $2.50. I cannot believe I paid that much for this junk! First off, it has absolutely no flavor and the texture/consistency/thickness reminds me of dog food kibble. I know its supposed to be a low sugar cereal, but it also has no flavor! It tastes like cardboard and I have to sprinkle sugar on top of it to tolerate it. I will never, ever make the mistake of buying this stuff again!

column9: no longer good. well, it's really bad.
column10: I ordered one last month due to very high ratings and some old memories of mine that this cereal was healthy and tasted reasonably good.  Once I received the boxes, the first one had a very stale smell and taste. so does the second, the third, the fourth, the fifth.  the sixth one?  I haven't decided what to do, but i am sure the birds in my backyard would love them and would be able to handle the stale taste better than me.:-)  well, unless they also have a sensitive stomach like I do.:(
At how many people like this cereal.  Its dog food.  Looks and smells like it.  And it tastes bland.  I fed it to my dog and she loved it.  Maybe that's whose rating this cereal: pets.

Love the McCormick series of marinades. Often have a hard time finding them in our local stores, especially outside of grilling season. We like to grill all year long. Signed up for S&S, which was great for the discount and the convenience of resupply every few months.

column9: High quality yummy treat for dogs!
column10: My puppy loves these treats! She's allergic to wheat and gluten so it's hard to find treats for her (and ones that she likes). She has naturally dry skin and these definitely help! The omega 3 & 6 fatty acids provide what she needs to keep her coat healthy and shiny. It's great-- they don't contain any wheat, soybean, glutens, bad preservatives, or by-products. Not to mention that the salmon and sweet potatoes in it are known to be easily digestible. She gets so excited when I bring out the bag. Worth the money! Highly recommended!

I am downgrading from a 5 star to a 1 star because they are made in CHINA. Treats from China have been associated with kidney and liver failure and rare cancers in dogs. Another series of dog deaths from treats from China has been released. There is no oversight. These treats may be OK but I will not take any chances. I am really irritated with Amazon and the vendor for not disclosing the source of the product. They say in the online description, "read the label carefully". In very small print the country of origin is disclosed. I do not knowingly feed my dogs anything from China.These are great treat. My dogs love them and they are no artificial stabilizers or fillers. However, at most other on line pet websites they are half the price. Usually Amazon is competitive in pricing but not on this line of products.

column9: My dogs love these, but they are extremely overpriced on Amazon.com
column10: The product itself is great, thus my 5 stars. My dogs love these and I think it's helping their dry skin, but ... WOW @ the price! I had no idea the 6-oz. size is the same package I buy at PetsMart for $4.99 - HALF the cost I paid here - and for 3 bags at that! :((((( I had run out, so I didn't have a package to check the size. I thought I'd add these to my Amazon order for convenience, and *assumed* the 6-oz. bag must be considerably larger than the ones I get at PetsMart, given that the price was TWICE - very odd for Amazon, so I never suspected the packages are the same size! People - definitely get these from PetsMart, or check PetsMart or Petco online even - this is WAY OVERPRICED! If I could have rated the price itself, it would have gotten ZERO STARS ~

My dog (14 year old toy poodle) hates just about every food for dogs.  This is the only treat I've ever found that she never refuses!  The treats are a bit pricey but, for once, they won't go to waste. I do limit the number she eats in a day, as specified on the bag.

My dogs absolutely love these treats - we get them in salmon, duck and chicken.  There is nothing they won't do to get one!  If they are ignoring me outside, all I have to do is shake the bag and they come running...licking their chops on the way!More importantly, the omega is great for their skin and coat - one of my dogs has issues with dry skin/flaking.  As long as I give these to her on a regular basis - her skin is flake free and her coat is absolutely beautiful!It's a win win - my dogs love them and they are good for them!  What more can you ask for from a treat?

These two-millimeter long treats don't have the pronounced smell of the tuna treats. Like the other Omega treats these are easy to break in half, but are small enough for many dogs to eat in one piece. The shih tzu pair, with their dainty snouts, prefer to have their duck treats torn or cut in two. Since the first ingredient in these Duck treats is duck liver, the girls are becoming treat snobs and act as if they are actually dining on Foie gras. I don't have the heart to tell them anything different.Often the Omega Duck treats are mixed in with several other snacks on the breakfast plates. Always the duck treats are the first to disappear. It's funny to watch Piper push aside the other treats so that she can pick out the pieces of Omega treats. I have some reservations about the treat's country of origin, but the girls love these things and their lip smacking comments have all been positive.

column9: Smelly, but they make my doggies very happy
column10: First of all, they stink.  Imagine fish lying around in the sun for a couple of hours.  Yeah, they're that smelly.But that, as it turns out, is why my dogs love them so much.  These treats are so special, in fact, that they're only given out when we want to get our girls into their crates, like at bedtime, or if we're going out or something.  They even know the bag...all I have to do it get it out of the cabinet and they're running off into their crates, waiting happily for their treats.I had read the review from the person who wrote that a fishbone had been found in one.  What I do is bend/break them down the middle before handing them out so I can feel if there's something sharp inside.So the bottom line here is...if my dogs love them, then I love them.  :)

column9: My dogs favorite and nutritious treat!
column10: Not only is this treat good for my dog, but it is great for her coat!  She loves them.  She normally does not do tricks, but will sit, give her paw and do anything you say for those treats.

column9: Dog likes it but I don't.

Yuck.  I'm gonna give the chickens ones a try, but the salmon is going back.
our siberian husky loves these!!! they are a special nighttime treat and she goes crazy when you say it's time for your salmon!!
these treats read like they are excellent, but my little dog won't touch them, and so far, neither will any of the neighbor dogs.  too bad.
I have some incredibly picky dogs and they love these treats.  The pieces are nice and small.  I reccommend this to even the most finicky of dogs.  My dogs have had no digestive issues with them.

These treats come in Salmon and Duck....my dogs LOVE both. They go crazy when they even see the bag.... Perfect size for a training treat. These treats stay moist...I have the Bear Treats also, they are good too, but more of a dried salmon "meal" consistency.

Jablum Jamaican coffee is Jamaica itself, especially the Sandals Resort at Ocho Rios. If you ever make it to Jamaica, be sure to buy plenty of Jablum in the airport's Duty Free stores . . . it is far less expensive, but not necessarily fresher. Also, make sure that the bean quality is #1 (not a problem with Jarblum products, but a concern with other Jamaican "blends" offered in stores and on the Internet). Thank heaven for the Blue Mountains (the "blum" in Jablum)!

column4: B. Valentine "I am out to prove I have nothin...
column10: I was not expecting this coffee to actually be shipped from Jamaica, so I was pleasantly surprised to find a FedEx International package at my door.  One cannot argue that it didn't come from Jamaica! I assumed it would be shipped via a distributor in the US.  I guess that just proves what they say about assuming...The coffee is real smooth and enjoyable.  Unlike other "Jamaica grown" products I tried during my youth - this one you can proudly admit you really did inhale the sweet aroma!It comes packed in a burlap bag with the sealed coffee bag inside, just like the picture.  It arrived fresh.As with any of these boutique coffees, you pay a premium - like the Hawaiian Kona coffees - so it's really a matter of taste and the depth of your pocketbook if you think they are worth the price.

I was not satisfied AT FIRST with this product.  After posting a less than glowing review, I was immediately contacted by the seller (distributor).  They graciously sent a new "fresher" bag of coffee.  This is much closer to what I remember.  Try with sweetened condensed milk as suggested, it is served that way in Jamaica.  Now if I only had some coco bread to go with it.Thank you for the prompt, courteous service.

This is the best coffee I have ever had ... and I may not be a coffee expert, but I consider myself picky!  This is extremely smooth and flavorful.  I wish the price were lower & we had to sign for our package that came directly from Jamaica (hey, it is real!), but it is so worth the splurge!

Since my first trip to Jamaica, I fell in love with the coffee.  The delivery date was right on and we had Blue Mountain coffee on Christmas morning!  For a treat, try drinking it with sweetened condensed milk!

column9: I don't even like coffee, but I LOVE this!
column10: I don't even like coffee, but this is in a class by itself!There is no bitter aftertaste, and with the slightest sprinkle of chocolate creamer, it is going quickly to become my drink of choice!  I can't imagine how good it will taste with a shot of liquor in it!I just wish we had more! (But we will soon...thanks Amazon!)No matter what Jamaican coffee you buy, make sure it is certified Blue Mountain Jamaican coffee, like this one is! :)

I'm a big Juan Valdez colombian fan. This Jamaican stuff doesn't have the kick that I love from coffee. It's sorta flat. Especially for something I spent $75 for two lbs. Goin Back To Colombian (twang twang)

When in Jamaica I drink JBM coffee and have come to develope a fine appreciation for the bean. What I opened this morning was not what I had expected. To be clear, I was greatly dissapointed. I found bits of husk from the bean, which doesn't make coffee, and is considered filler. The flavor left something to be desired as well, it tasted like folgers coffee without all the acid. I was hoping to leave a great review of this product, but honesty forbids it.

Believe it or not, I bought this at a yard sale for 50 cents.  The packaging was perfect and looked exactly like the photo.  It doesn't expire for another 6 months.  I can only figure the seller received the coffee as a gift and had no idea the cost.  I LOVE coffee and figured this would be very good but was so disappointed.  I wanted to see how much it would have cost me had I not bought it at a yard sale and almost fell over when I saw the going price on Amazon!!!!!!  There is NO way on this Earth I would pay the ridiculous amount here, but I will say I like the coffee more now that I know what a great deal I got!  :-)  I decided to try it again this morning and am using the sweetened condensed milk as mentioned by another reviewer (about 3 over-flowing teaspoons per cup - I like sweet coffee).  I also used less coffee since last time I felt it was too strong.  I still cannot pay the going price for this and figure most people on here buy it as a splurge thinking it is neat to drink Jamaican coffee.  I too like to experiment with foodstuffs from other places, but not at this price... Needless to say unless I find another at a yard sale, I'll never drink this coffee again once my 16 ounces is gone... except if I take a trip to Jamaica mon.  :-)

I bought this coffee after watching a documentary on Jamaican Blue Mountain coffee, thinking it would taste exceptional compared to regular coffee.  This was a gift for my boyfriend for Christmas.  We brewed it in the drip coffee maker and also tried it in the French press and neither one of us were impressed.  At this point, our preferred coffee is Dunkin' Donuts Original Blend...it's much cheaper and more readily available.

A co-worker of mine went to Jamaica for vacation in Feb. and bought me a 1lb. bag of the ground.  It's expiration date was March.  I brewed it as soon as I got home.  To me it tasted like cheap coffee that had been left out in the open air for a week.  I wonder if it was due to the expiration date, or does this coffee really taste like this.  If so, I will never buy again.  From all the hype, I was expecting much more.

Domino makes a fine sugar.  I like it.  I frequently buy it in the 5 and 10 pound bags at the store.  But when I saw these canisters I thought I'd buy some for 'backup' -- because I hate running out of 'the necessities' like sugar, flour, salt....In any case, I was unpleasantly surprised to find that the first canister I opened, after only two months, showed signs that the sugar had come in contact with moisture.  I took note of the lumps but didn't decide to write this review until after I opened a second container, only two weeks later, and it also showed signs that even with their transparent seals in place, that the containers were NOT air proof. The sugar was entirely usable, and that's not my complaint, but don't you also find it odd that this was the case for these coffee-canister-like containers.  As far as that goes, I don't remember having the sugar in the paper bags do this until after an extremely long period of time has passed.  Like a year.SUMMARY:::Good sugar, but if you are planning on hording, don't count on this sugar remaining moisture free for years.Pam T~mom/baker of sugary goodness

I am really glad that I purchased Domino sugar from Amazon.  I have always liked Domino sugar but, when I compared the price with local stores I realized that I was getting,in my opinion the best sugar there is at an unbelievable value.  I highly encourage anyone who bakes a lot of sweets or enjoys sweet tea or coffee to get Domino sugar.

The seller sent the cat stockings right away.  I bought three of them.  They ended up being different colors from what was pictured, but the cat absolutely loves them. It's hilarious to listen to the bell clanging around.  I know that sound means the cat is tossing it around.  The last one we had was the cat's favorite toy and overdue for replacement.

This tea is delicious....I had it at a restauraunt instead of having wine and I was pleased with my decision. The tea was minty but I liked it because I could taste a hint of chocolate. The flavors blend so well I found no need to use extra sweetners to enhance the taste.

Though it smells very chocolatey-minty in the tin, I feel like the peppermint overpowers the chocolate once you actually brew it.  However, it's still nice, especially if you love peppermint.  I agree that it makes a good after-dinner tea.
My dog happily eats this. She's been eating Merrick brand treats and canned food since she was a pup (she's now five years) and she's always loved it.

My German Shepherds get a can of this mixed with their dry food every morning and they love it. They will no longer eat cheaper canned foods. I have never tried it myself, but if these two spoiled brats like it, it must be good. It also has a pop top, which is very convenient when two large dogs are drooling with anticipation.
This dog food has a strange, bad odor to it. My dogs won't eat it. Other dogs must like it becuase Merrick is a very successful company, but I won't be buying this again.

I've never tried another lemon oil, so I don't know how this compares to other products.  I chose this one based purely on price/quantity.I used this for my brother's wedding cake and it had fantastic flavor!  It was even better than another recipe I tried using about a dozen fresh lemons. (We did a side-by-side taste test.)  Their guests raved over the cake and I plan to continue using this lemon oil in my baked goods.

column9: So Much Better than Lemon flavorings from the grocery store
column10: When my next door neighbor moved she left a bottle (about 3 tbs. in it) so I tried using it in a couple recipes that called for lemon oil.  Also discovered that adding 1/2 tsp. of lemon oil to a Betty Crocker Vanilla Pound Cake mix, and substituting two Tbs. of fresh lemon juice for some of the water makes the best lemon pound cake ever.  Mix a couple Tbs. of lemon juice, fresh lemon zest and enough powdered sugar for a glaze and you've completed the cake.The bottle will last forever, so I share with my daughter.  You just can't compare it to lemon flavorings - it's far better.

I first started using Boyajian oils at one of my baking jobs.  These are amazing and add such great flavor to our baked goods - especially cheesecakes!  Be careful not to use too much, as it can add a sort of fake flavor.  But used in the right amounts these are great!

This lemon oil is expensive for the amount you get, but it is well worth it. When I first opened the bottle, I couldn't stop just inhaling the wonderful aroma. It doesn't take much to add a wonderful lemon flavor to baked goods. I made lemon shortbread cookies and they were reallly good. The taste is like mixing lemon zest with lemon juice, but there is much less work to this.I will definitely order more when this is gone.

column9: Finally, a reason to keep the Keurig!
column10: I have had my Keurig for ten days now.  Since I was waiting for my Amazon-ordered Green Mountain Dark Magic Decaf to arrive via Fed Ex, I was using the free variety sampler pack that came with the machine.  I was certain that the whole Keurig thing was hype.  The coffee was weak.  The coffee was fruity-winy, just what I dislike in my coffee mug.  I had even tried the hot chocolate and thought it was about the same as Swiss Miss in an envelope:  crappy-tasting and limpid.  Last night, things started to look up:  I had a Celestial Seasonings Mandarin Spice herbal tea, and that was verrrry good.  And today, my Dark Magic arrived.  Just had two cups.  It's dark.  It's rich.  It's bold.  It's smooth.  It accepts my half-and-half and stands up to it.  It's a heckuva cup of coffee.  Maybe I'll keep the Keurig after all.

This is an acceptable coffee offering from the folks at Green Mountain. Rich without bitterness or burnt flavors, the strength and balance of this brew should satisfy most palates. If Sumatra is not available, this will suffice.

column9: Great for those who like their coffee strong and dark
column10: After we received our Keurig I tried numerous decaf coffees(that's all I can drink).  This was my definite favorite.  I make the most concentrated brew, and some cream and yumm.  It's a great alternative to my Starbuck's (short double decaf americano).

column9: You can have your coffee and decaf too!
column10: I love the flavor of good strong coffee but I am limited to the amount of caffeine I can have. This decaf is perfect and serves both of my criteria.

This is the best decaff coffee that I have found in K-cups.  Actually I like a 50:50 mixture of caff and decaff coffee so I blend the Dark Magic caff and the Dark Magic decaff in a 20 ounce mug.  This is a much better option than buying the Green Mountain Half Caff which has a really poor taste.

Recently my cardiologist forced me to give up my beloved coffee with caffeine. I have always been a coffee addict drinking up to 7 cups a day of Green Mountains darkest, richest blends. Sometimes for added oomph I would add a shot of espresso. So imagine my chagrin when forced to give up my beloved coffee? You may ask yourselves why was I giving up coffee? Why wasn't I switching to decaf? Well, lets say that what I remember from the past was that decaf coffee wasn't delicious. It was rather nasty to my taste buds. Sanka Instant and Postum...blech.Since I had been drinking Green Mountain Dark Magic WITH caffeine, I decided to try it in the decaf form. And WOW. What a difference from those weak wanna be coffees that taste like warm water that a brown crayon was dipped in and called coffee.Testing Dark Magic against the French Roast decaf...well thank god Dark Magic is even better since the French Roast Green Mountain will no longer be available.  At least according to Keurig when I asked them. I had previously thought that the French Roast was the best and that the Dark Magic rated a distant third, but I have a feeling that I had gotten a bad batch since what I have been drinking is excellent.It is surprisingly rich, full flavored, non-acidic and with none of the aftertaste that some coffees can have. I don't think for one minute that I would be able to tell the difference if I was to be served this in a blind taste test.Well this just goes to show that sometimes the past and how we remember things can come back to bite us on our you know whats. I would have been truly suffering had I not found this product!

I've been looking for a good Decaf k-cup since purchasing my Keurig coffeemaker about a year ago.  Found at last!  Green Mountain Extra Bold Dark Magic Decaf is wonderful!  It delivers full, rich, bold flavor, even at the second biggest cup size setting.  Now when I cap my caffeine intake for the day, I don't feel like I'm settling for for "less than" coffee.  With this great taste and aroma, you'd never guess this is a decaf. If you like strong, dark roast coffee, but want to limit your caffeine, this is the k-cup for you!

column9: Best K-cup coffee for everyday enjoyment.
column10: The Dark Magic was highly recommended by others, and I tried it. It is really good coffee, in both decaf and regular. It is my K-cup of choice for a great cuppa joe on a break from a busy day.On special occasions I like the flavored stuff, but when you want a good, honest cup- this is it for me.

column9: A way for a coffee drinker to enjoy decaf
column10: I'm a coffee drinking fiend, but the caffeine ups and downs were really starting to wear on me.  I've been hesitant switching to decaf coffee becuase I thought I had to give-up the bold taste that I enjoy so much.  Green Mountain's Extra Bold decaf was the answer. My sister in law likes to mix it with flavored coffee for strength (as the Green Mountain flavors tend to be on the light side), I like it on its own. An impressive decaf.

column10: Great great decaf.  Made the Keurig worth it.  Until then all coffees tasted like water.  Very smooth not at all bitter just full of flavor.

column9: Precooked was not the way to go...
column10: I really wanted to love this item. I have ordered from Burgers before. Their precooked smoked turkey is excellent. But I did not enjoy this prime rib. Why? I bought the 4-5 lb roast for Christmas dinner. I let it thaw in the refrigerator for 4 days and then set it on the counter for two hours to bring it up to room temperature so it would reheat evenly. I followed the instructions that came with the roast, preheated the oven and let it cook for about an hour at 350 degrees. As I was busy preparing the rest of the meal I felt confident the prime rib would turn out fine since it was already cooked. As I was finishing up the rest of the cooking in that last dash of chaos to get everything out on time I finally checked the temperature of the meat and was shocked to find it was only 80 degrees in the center!I know for a fact the entire prime rib was thawed so there is no way it was still cold in the middle before I put it in the oven. I didn't panic. Since my guests were waiting and everything else was finished I had to get this meat up to temperature quickly (to at least warm) in the center without ruining the perfect red color of medium rare. Unfortunately that meant putting this beautiful and EXPENSIVE piece of meat in the microwave. I had to run it on high for 1 minute intervals, constantly opening and closing the door until I got the center to 110 or so - at least so my guests thought it was warmed through. Because of how big the roast was, that process took about 10 extra minutes. Obviously it is impossible to cook a prime rib evenly in the microwave so I ended up with overcooked ends, well done second and third slices and a slightly pink center.As for the taste...what were they thinking? I tasted like it was injected with highly concentrated au jus. Each bite was too salty for my taste and there was a heavy flavor of beef broth and rosemary. I wanted to taste the beef, not the seasonings. It reminded me a little of carved roast beef you get in a cheaper chain buffet restaurant or cafeteria like Golden Corral.Are there any positives? Yes, I can't say I hated it outright. The meat itself was tender as a prime rib should be and the flavor while a bit overpowering, was edible. In fact, my in-laws said they liked it a lot (but maybe they were just being nice). Also, it was much bigger than I thought - that's a good thing. It easily fed 6 people and there was enough left for another 5 or 6 more slices.But for the $115 I paid I probably could have had the same results from my grocery store meat case. Sorry Burgers. I like your products but you blew it on this one. I won't be buying a precooked prime rib from you again.

column9: A gourmet fruit spread that adults will appreciate. Mostly fruit. Not too sweet.
column10: The ingredients:Black CherriesConcentrated grape juiceFruit pectinLemon juiceNothing else. No preservatives or other chemicals.These are sumptuously delicious. It tastes as good as home made. Once you've tried this fruit spread, you'll find all others to be just sugary.  I don't think younger children will be able to discern the difference between this and common jellies or jams.I bought this on-line only because it's becoming more difficult to find locally.  A year ago I found them on sale for about $2 and bought as many as I could find.  When I do find them in stores, they're now nearly $4.50 for 10 ounces.

I have purchased and consumed many different teas. I have always boughtorganic teas from around the world. Free trade teas. By chance I purchased a box for work.  It is the BEST tea I have ever consumed!!!!!This will be the only tea I purchase from now on. You must try it,,,very smooth, delicious.

column9: Great Green Tea, and CHEAP too!
column10: What can I say?  It's green tea, it's organic, it comes from my good friend Paul and his daughter and it's a very good green tea, much better than Lipton or most stuff in my supermarket.  And the price is GREAT!  If you drink green tea, buy it!

column9: Organic Green Tea for an excellent price!!
column10: When I first purchased this, I thought I was buying 100 tea bags for the $20 something dollars it cost.  This being because when I have bought organic green tea at the store, I remember paying $4-5 for 16 tea bags (why I rarely bought organic green tea).When the package arrived, and there were FIVE boxes, totaling 500 tea bags, I couldn't believe it!!  This is such a great deal!  The flavor is wonderful and the value and quality is to be expected of Newman's Own.
This is my favorite green tea and now I have a whole lot of it!  For some reason, it doesn't taste as bitter as other green teas I've tried.

Very good flavor organic green tea, at an amazing price when purchased in bulk. The tea I was purchasing at the large discount chain store was costing me three times as much a month. And the flavor of this tea is better.
This is a very mellow full bodied green tea! For the price, it is the best that I have found.

column9: Great Tea at a Great Price
column10: Perhaps this tea does not please the discriminating tea pallet, but it pleases mine! I love that it has a bit more flavor than other green teas. It is not smoky or dirty tasting, just a bit more robust than your average green tea. The price, for an organic product, is rather inexpensive, but the quality is very high. My husband and I drink it every morning, and we love it!
The best deal on organic green tea i've found. the taste isn't too bitter like some green's and you don't have to drink all the pesticides

I've tried many different green teas, and this is one of the better ones, considering the inexpensive price.  I've tried brands that have more hype and cost more but usually ended up with a bitter muck passed off as green tea.  I have and will continue to recommend this to anyone looking for a tasty inexpensive cup of green tea.
The best green tea around at a super super price.  I will always buy my tea from Newmans Own on Amazon.
I couldn't find my favorite, jasmine green tea, at this price. But tasty, organic tea at this price can't be beat! I add my own flavor adjuncts. :)

Newman's Own Organic Green Tea is delicious and perfect for those who choose organic products! Just a note for those of you who heat your water up in a microwave- you cannot put these tea bags in the water while microwaving as the bags have tiny metal staples in them.

This green tea is the worst I have purchased. I don't understand the good reviews. This has a smoke taste. It is not smooth or light at all. Lipton original green tea tastes better than this. This does not taste organic. At first I thought it was Lipton in a different package, but that would be insulting Lipton. Don't waste your money on this product, I have 5 boxes that will be tossed out.Best Green teas I have had:1. Bigelow Organic2. Celestial Seasonings Organic3. Lipton Organic

I give this 4 stars for the taste (solid) and 6 stars for the organicity and price(are you kidding me?)..I have a suggestion for preparation..I empty out about 6 bags into a 4 cup measure cup and microwave while stirring once for around 5 min on high..then I strain (and microwave) whenever needed..the tea this way is a bit different..first, it's REALLY green, got to think that more of the good stuff (catechins, polyphenols,etc) are in there..second, the taste is more well-rounded(think robust and "warm")..
I am very pleased with this product. The tea is excellant and the price very competitive.

OK, you pay for what you get, but in this case you get quite a bargain.  I've compared this green tea to some of the other major brands. Honestly, it's the same taste as the others and you get 500 bags!  This will last me for the rest of the year because I drink green tea once a day. I sometimes like to make my tea English style and mix the tea drop of skim milk or almond milk and a dab of honey. Gets rid of the bitter taste of which all green tea has.  Pick this one up. It's good.
Newman's own royal green tea is the best tea for the absolutely best price and each bag is individually wrapped.  It's good for your health and helps to lose weight too.

column9: Surprisingly good, if you brew it right
column10: A surprisingly good green tea.  I usually drink loose leaf green tea, but when I need the convenience of a teabag this stuff is tasty -- and a steal.Different green teas required quite different soaking conditions.  For this tea:1. You've got to make sure the water is cool enough.  I pour boiled water into one mug, let it sit for a few moments to cool a bit, then pour the water into a second mug, and then put the tea bag in.2. Don't soak it for more than 2 minutes.  It becomes noticeably bitter if you do.

I am a coffee drinker and have been one for many many years.  For the past couple of years I've been trying to shift to drinking tea.  Mainly because it's supposed to boot metabolism and has antioxidants.  That been said, this tea is pretty good.  It's a very mild tea compared to the Pu-erh teas which I think are stronger.  So if your looking for a very mild tea this one is worth checking out.  Keep in mind that you will be buying 500 tea bags at this price.
Wonderful to find a mild tasting green tea that is also organic AND at such a fabulous price.Signed up for subscribe and save.

column9: Best green tea I've ever tasted
column10: After my redelivery date for another green tea brand (Lipton) was coming up I was informed by Amazon that it was not in stock and wouldn't be for my delivery date, so I looked for some other option. So I saw this and on Subscribe And Save it was cheaper, but it had great reviews, so I decided to try it. All I can say is WOW! The other brand of GREEN TEA tasted more like just regular tea, and even looked like regular tea (by regular I mean the popular cheap orange peoke tea you get in restaurants and such) but this is actually GREEN, the flavor is nice and light, not bitter.I didn't really care that it was organic, I don't fall for that hype, but I believe the tea plant is very hardy so it doesn't take much to make it organic (as compared to other plants).At the current price ($25.24 Subscribe & Save) it works out to 5.1¢ per bag, which is a heck of a deal, throw in some ice and it's a great way to beat the summer heat!Needless to say, I'm not going back to the other brand after this!

column9: Newman's Own Organics Royal Tea, Organic Green Tea
column10: This is very good tea at a good price and in a quantity that allows me to purchase only every couple of months.  Highly recommend this item.
I got this tea for the health benefits.  Add a little Splenda and it is delicious.  I intend to have it cold for the summer.  Great buy!
I love strong tasting tea and these has no taste. I feel like I'm just drinking hot water. I would not recommend it.

column9: WORSE TEA EVER WITH OIL FLOATING ON TOP!!!
column10: FIRST OF ALL, IF YOU ARE ABOUT TO BUY THIS TEA BECAUSE IT IS CHEAP AND ORGANIC, YOU SHOULD RETHINK AFTER READING MY REVIEW, BUY IT IF YOU ARE HERE BECAUSE YOU LIKE THE SMOKE TASTE AND THE OIL FLOATING ON THE TOP FROM THIS TEA PRODUCT; IGNORE MY COMMENT AND BUY THIS.This is actually my first review on product that I have purchased, because it is a shock to me seeing all these great reviews about it when it is the worse tea I have ever had! I agree with the 1 star reviews for the most part, and if I could give it a 0 star I would.I know this tea is cheaper than most of the other organic teas, and being that it is organic, one would expect some high quality tea. BUT THIS TEA IS HORRIBLE. Like many others, I like the idea of it being organic, and to decrease in the amount of chemicals and shit I put into my body. However, yesterday when I made my first cup of tea with this tea bag, there were oil residue floating on the top, and the tea taste like smoke!Today, I told myself, why not give it another try? It might be my cup's problem yesterday. Ah ha! same thing happened, the oil slowly emerge to the top again! And I know it for a fact because I always stare into my cup when I am drinking something. I even conducted several experience with the tea bags by using different temperature water (I guess it is a wise way to use up rest of the tea bags, since I refuse to drink this tea any longer). I was hoping to find something different, but every cup had the same kind of oil residue floating. It is disgusting!Now I am still stuck with many tea bags left, and I don't even know if this cxrxaxp is good for me though it's organic. I will never buy this product ever! I wasted around $5 with tax, but I got to warn you all about this tea. I guess it's worth it? now I wished I would have listen to the other reviewers, hopefully someone will take my words to consideration before purchasing.I saw one of the 1 star reviewer being questioned in comment section, and I don't really care if I get questioned because this tea does taste bad and I am mad about this purchase. Again, this IS my FIRST REVIEW, if you don't think it's reliable that's your own problem and you can go ahead and purchase this tea. Anyways, TAKE IT or LEAVE IT. This is what I observe, and this is my opinion and conclusion.

I guess that I'm spoiled for good tea, as we have a local tea/coffee merchant (the Spice Merchant!) that sells great loose leaf tea, but this stuff is awful. It has a bitter, dirty taste no matter what temperature of water you're using. I strongly recommend that you avoid this crap at all costs! I'd rather have no tea at all than drink this.
The previous reviewers must not have ever tried Salada or Lipton Green Teas because this doesn't even come close to their quality and taste.  Price is cheap and that's what you get.

Not a very good tasting tea. Leaves an aftertaste in the mouth.Here are some of the instruction on the box:"That 1 tea bag shall be used for each 6 oz. of royal water.""That the royal water be brought to a boil & let cool no less than 5 but no more than 7 minutes.""That the royal water be poured carefully over the royal tea bag.""The royal steeping time be no less than 1 but no more than 2 minutes."Huh?!? What's with the "royal" nonsense? Is there a special water filter I need to purchase in order to have "royal" water? Perhaps that is why there is an aftertaste-I don't use or have access to "royal" water.It also says on the box:"Somewhere in Pa's mind, he harbors a long standing belief that he comes from nobility." Signed by "His Perilous princess, NELL."This stuff is pure nonsense-makes no sense to me at all. Maybe they need to spend more time on the tea than on someone who is dilusional?
Excellent product that we tried while traveling overseas but had difficulty locating in the U.S. Great product received in an extremely prompt manner from the seller.
I very much like the taste of nescafe gold, though I think it is pricier than other types of nescafe ...

column9: I think quality of product has slipped over my last two orders
column10: My shipment does NOT contain the same product as was shipped in my last order of the 3.5 ounce jars! Its darker, bitter, more oily & hurts my stomach.  It was immediately noticeable upon opening the jar.  The aroma was not the same and you could see right away the crystals were dark brown... not the usual honey color.  Additionally, one of the jar lids was broken in shipment.  THE SELLER WAS TERRIFIC ABOUT THE RETURN - very nice... and I would buy from them again.  I ordered the small size jars f rom the same seller as I did a few months ago... same problem.  This product has changed.

column9: Great taste, gentle on the stomach
column10: I love Nescafe Gold because it's a light roast, plus they extract the tannins from it in the processing so overall you get less bitterness and it doesn't irritate the stomach like regular coffee does. I have stomach problems and other coffees really irritate my stomach, including Nescafe Original. I have found that Gold doesn't bother my stomach at all when dissolved in a mugful of hot milk. I can even drink it without breakfast in the morning! So yeah, nice flavor and a very mild-tasting, stomach-friendly coffee, if that's what you want. Too bad it's hard to find in the US and you have to order and pay shipping... But it's all over Europe (where I grew up) and I miss it, so I order it through Amazon.P.S. The seller was very nice in sending me 2 jars for the price of 1 with a nice note, because it was around Christmastime :-)

I love this coffee and usually have my mom ship it to me from overseas. I like to make it with nestle Nido powdered milk and a little sugar. It's more like desert. I also think it has more caffeine than other coffee and seems to get me moving once I drink it in the morning. Ill be ordering it from here next time even though it is a little pricey, but to me it's worth it, yummy!
I'm so happy I can finally enjoy my Nescafe in the morning, couldn't find this product in US.It is just the best taste!

Based on reviews for this coffee and others that said the Nestles brand instant coffee made for the European market were far better than instants made for the U.S. market I purchased a jar of this expensive coffee.  Result: to me it tasted like ordinary instant coffee.  NO BETTER.  I wasted a lot of money on this stuff.  Mine was labelled in a foreign language, but I recognized the word "Ankora" (Turkey) on the label.  My advice is don't waste your money.

These may be the best pretzels I've ever had. They're tasty AND healthy (bonus: They're organic). Good alone or with salsa, guacamole or a non-fat dips. Or add some apple or pear slices, a dollop of yogurt or some fresh veggies for a quick and healthy at-home or on the go snack.I first came across them in a desperate attempt to wean myself from baked white cheddar chips. Looking for something crunchy yet non-fattening wasn't easy. You get 15 pretzel sticks at only 130 calories and no saturated or trans fats. Works for me!Best of all, there's 4% dietary fiber in a serving. (About 8 servings to an 8-ounce bags, so we're talking about a week's worth of healthy snacks.)The honey wheat flavor is great and best of all, it's a satisfying snack, too.If you buy in bulk, be sure to hide away those other bags and count out portions. Otherwise, it's way too easy to overeat these pretzels.

We love these pretzels!! They have a unique taste--not like a regular pretzel. The multigrains combine to form a distinct taste with hints of rye, poppy seed and molasses. They are not as salty as regular pretzels. And they have 3 grams of fiber per serving. I have reordered several times since I cannot find them locally. They always arrive promptly in perfect condition.

I started buying these pretzels in the grocery store and then when I went to buy them again I couldn't find them anywhere so I decided to go online and whala Amazon had them, for alot less money too, although theyhave gone up about $3.00 since the last time I ordered them 6 monthsago.  Our whole family including my kids 9 and 5 love these pretzels!!The favor is wonderful and you actually get 3 grams of fiber per sevingand they are pretty low in calories 120, low in fat 2grams, and we lovethe slight sweet with the slighty salted flavor.  I can't rave enoughabout these pretzels, and to boot they don't have partially hydroginatedoils or high fructose corn syrup, no artificial colors/flavors or preservatives for which they wouldn't be in my houseif they did :)
This product gets a mixed review in our house.  Some of us love them because they combine sweet and salty; others think they are too sweet.  They could be a bit saltier, and we'd all like that!

The pretzel sticks are "starchy" tasting (just like all other pretzels), but with just a little bit of sweetness to make them delectable. They're not salty at all, which is good--I personally don't want the extra sodium. Every once in a while eating these you get a punch from the taste of sesame seeds which make these pretzel sticks that much better.

column9: If you like the bread....you'll love these!
column10: These pretzle sticks are fantastic. They have a very deep robust pumpernickle flavor and color with just a hint of onion. Make an inside-out ham sandwich by wrapping a thin slice of baked ham and a slice of swiss cheese around one of the sticks.

column9: It's not too good to be true
column10: They are the greatest low-fat, organic snack that I have ever tasted!!!! It taste just like pumpernickel bread from the holidays and I love it! It only haves 1.5 grams of fat for  14 pretzels which is a hearty snack. I can not say enough great things about this snack.

The problem with most pretzels is that they are white-flour bombs.  Lots of carbohydrate and not much else (other than a ton of salt).  Consequently, I have been looking for a good whole-grain pretzel.  These are pretty good.  The multiple grains add a variety and depth of flavor not found in plain pretzels, and you sure don't miss the extra salt.  Although they have a crunch, they are not so hard that my wife won't eat them.  They have only three flaws.  First, they are slightly sweet.  Although it is a subtle sweetness (which I suppose some folks like), I could do without it.  Second, white flour remains the number one ingredient, notwithstanding the multiplicity of whole grains.  Third, although they are low fat, they are not fat-free.  I am not sure why the bakers find it necessary to add oil to a pretzel.  Despite these shortcomings, these are a good--and healthier--alternative to standard prtezels, and much, much healthier than most other salty snacks.

I ordered these expecting them to be like other honey wheat pretzels but they are not.  There is something about the flavor that is not thrilling me but now I have a whole case.  I think I might just donate the rest of the bags.

I was ordering these pretzels from Amazon and they are wonderful.  Couldn't find them in the stores any longer so Amazon was my savior.  Unfortunately, Amazon doesn't carry them any longer either.  But it was great while it lasted!  Wonderful product.

BEWARE of the warehouse deals - many of the products are near end of shelf life and often there is no way to ask about that, so you end up with a case of food items that you might have hoped would last a few months that require being consumed in a month or less.The case I ordered was near its shelf life expiration and the product is moderately tasty.
We use the auto ship for these.  I've tried other brands, Trader Joe's, Fresh and Easy, bulk from Sprouts; but the hubby says these are the best.

column9: My favorite snack...and now it's history
column10: Why did Snyder's drop this product? Was I the only one who loved this snack? I really hate it when I find something this great and then it gets dropped from production.
The Hanover Pumpernickle & Onion Pretzels are the best. Use to find in the Grocery store but now only over the internes. Love these treats, YUM!!!!!!!!!!!!

These are my favorite pretzels.  I like the whole-wheat flavor and rough grain texture.  They are also a good size for snacking.  I can never find these in the store so I buy them online.  I have bought several cases and had one off-flavor/stale bag.
Excellent pretzel!  Can't find locally so I order in bulk - and they don't last long.  My daughter even asked for a box (12 bags) for her birthday.  Go figure!

Wonderful pretzels! I purchased these last summer in New Hampshire which started an addiction that has been hard to fulfill because I can't find these pretzels in Missouri. Hence my online purchase. A really good pretzel that's not overly sweet, and packed with flavor.

These pretzels are light and very tasty, plus they are not as salty as other snacks.  The fact that they are a healthier alternative to most other pretzels or chips and, I believe, they taste better, is a very rare combination.

column9: Good tasting Organic Pretzel sticks by SNYDER"S
column10: This was a great tasting organic snack food, buying it through Amazon in bulk, it costs less, stays fresh and delivered to my door. It is priced a lot better than in the stores, if you can even find it in a store! It is a good product that myself and husband enjoy. If you like pretzels want organic and are looking for a slightly salty/sweet taste, then this is one you will enjoy too! This is an edit of my review as my last shippment of this product was not very good... the pretzels in this latest shipment have an odd taste to them...sad as they were so good tasting in prior shipments...I also see that you can not get this organic Pretzel anymore as it show as unavailable, this maybe is due to the problem I am having, perhaps someone else found this odd taste that wasn't there before soI'd change my rating on this product now after the problem w/ this shippment I hope they fix the problem.

I'm making some healthier lifestyle choices.  I ordered these pretzels because they were multigrain and I want to add more fiber to my diet.  I love them, but the real proof of the pudding is that my husband loves them too.  He typically complains about other whole wheat products I buy. As a matter of fact he eats them more than I do. Great product, I put them on automatic shipment.

These are so yummy. My son likes the Oat Bran, hubby likes the Honey Wheat and I love the Pumpernickel & Onion. It makes me happy to find an incredible ingredient list for something so yummy. Amazon has the best price if you want to buy in bulk.

column9: These little beauties are killer, no onion breath afterward
column10: Snyder did it all right. (you used to be able to get these in the big pretzel size in my grocery store, but they are no longer available where I live) The pumpernickel is delish, the onion is very faint, but distinguishible, and the salt is just enough to get you all excited, but not too much to overpower the pumpernickel. The sticks are a fun shape to munch, and if you have company that likes to dip things these are a good size for that (no double dipping). Sticks are about 3 inches long.

column9: an acquired taste, then it's good
column10: it's not your typical pretzel. I don't eat much pumpernickel, so it took me half a bag to get used to. after that, I liked it. I don't like that it comes in a pack of 12; these are regular sized packs. I was hoping for snack size packs. Anyway, the best thing about this is that it is good fer ya and has a different flavor; it's always good to play with the palette a little. world peace!

I've been doing the weight watchers program for about 6 months now and  have lost over 40 pounds.  Every morning I have good old fashioned peanut butter and jam with this great product.  Love it!!!I keep ordering it over and over.  Its so nice to have peanut butter again without all the fat and calories.This is good stuff.Just a note, it does have to be refrigerated after opening.

column9: BEST LOW CAL. PEANUT BUTTER ON THE PLANET!
column10: Who ever the person is that said this stuff tastes like nail polish must have just swallowed a bottle of it then taken a bite of the peanut butter because there is not other reason that I can think of for them to make that assessment.This stuff is fabulous!  If your looking for chunky, this is not for you.  It has a nice sweet flavor, which makes it extra nice if your out of jelly or jam because it can work nicely on it's own.  :)  It's also very smooth and soft and extremely spreadable.  I have been very into PB&J lately and am just flying through my jars.I live by this stuff and recomend that everyone give it a try but PLEASE realize that it's okay if you don't love it.  You must remember that it's not your old school basic Jif.  It's low cal and just different, but that doesn't make it bad.  Oh, it's so good and I can't wait to have my PB&J tomorrow....maybe I'll have one for dinner, my mouth is watering for it right now.  :)

So, I snagged a jar of this at my local Whole Foods, because it had been recommended to me as supplying full peanut butter satisfaction with a fraction of the fat and calories.  Well.  I didn't read the ingredient and nutritional info till I got home.  It has stuff in it like "Grain syrup".  What's that?  Tapioca syrup?  Vegetable glycerin, and dehydrated cane juice (more sugar).  So maybe it's because I've been eating sugar-free peanut butter for a while, but this stuff is REALLY sweet.  Like tooth-achingly, diabetic shock-inducing sweet.  It also has a nasty chemical undertaste, and a LOT of salt.  13 g carbs, 4 g protein, 2 g fat. 190 mg sodium. 100 calories.In the same conversation where so-called "Better'n Peanut Butter" was recommended to me, another person recommended PB2, Powdered Peanut Butter - 85% Less Fat and Calories - 16 Oz, which is a mixture of defatted peanut flour, sugar and salt.  Three ingredients, in that order.  Granted, it comes in powder form, so you have to reconstitute it, 2 TBSP peanut powder to 1 TBSP water.  Mix it up for a couple seconds, and it tastes like peanut butter.  No discernible sweetness or excessive salinity. No chemical undertaste.  5 g carbs, 5 g protein, 1.5g fat,94 mg sodium, 45 calories.  It's a wee bit more trouble cuz you have to mix it as needed.  But it's also delicious, unlike "Better'n Peanut Butter".  Oh, and available at Amazon at roughly the same price, considering that when a pound of PB2 is reconstituted with water, it makes about two pounds of tasty peanut butter.

Oh my goodness. I went in to Trader Joes looking for PB2, but ended up coming out with this. I was really worried by some of the reviews saying it was either too sweet or too salty, as the added sugar in "reduced fat" peanut butters always leave me gagging. Turns out this stuff is AMAZING! I even like it better than my old peanut butter, because I can really taste the peanuts in this (don't worry, it's not overpowering). It reduces the calories of my daily sandwich by 45 calories, which is really cool too! The only reason this is 4 stars and not 5 is because of the price. Even off of Amazon, it's kinda pricey at about $4.00 for about 2 cups (AKA 16oz or lb) of peanut butter.

column9: Better'n no peanut butter at all!
column10: For some, dietary fat is not about losing weight or whether one kind of fat is better than another. As far as MY body is concerned, fat is fat is fat is fat, whether it's solid vegetable shortening, wild salmon, or avocados. One level tablespoon of ordinary peanut butter contains between two-thirds and three-quarters of the fat I can safely eat in a day or I get very, very sick, so it's either go without entirely (waaah!) or try the alternative products. This is what my dietician recommends for very-low-fat diets; she had samples of a few different products and I preferred this. No, this isn't better tasting than real freshly-roasted peanuts ground with just a bit of salt and nothing else, which is my peanut butter baseline. I'll admit that right up front. Some reviewers have said it is very sweet but I don't agree; to my palate, it's much LESS sweet than the mainstream Jif/Skippy type. You do have to get used to the texture, which is a little "sandy" and very firm when refrigerated - stirring the living daylights out of it in the jar with the handle of a wooden spoon loosens it up and makes it more spreadable, although it will still tear up the puffy white bread like W*nder. It does "melt" really well onto hot toast (or pasta for peanut noodles, yum yum). I wouldn't eat it straight off a spoon the way some people do with regular peanut butter; OK but not great for "ants on a log" (celery with peanut butter and raisins) or spreading on apple slices (it tends to slide off), but for other PB uses - including the good ole PB&J - it's been a lifesaver.

After finally finding a peanut butter with reasonable nutritionals, I must say that I love this product.  For breakfast, I eat it on English muffins with a little strawberry jam and I put a tablespoon in my Weight Watchers chocolate smoothie. (Tastes like a chocolate/pb milkshake.)  I have not experimented with it for baking yet, but I plan to try that over the holidays.

I give it 3 stars cuz it's good to snack on.  Snacking the better'n peanut butter with veggies and bread is not bad at all if you're a peanut butter person.  This butter can be use in a good diet plan if you eat it sparingly.Now, I DO NOT recommend this for protein shakes.  I lift weights and run 6 times a week and drink 3 protein shakes a day.  You cannot taste the better'n peanut butter in a blended shake.  I thought I could replace Skippy's reduced peanut butter, but I am back on it.

I read about this product and decided to try it.  I paid a visit to my local Whole Foods market & bought a jar for less than $6.  I was quite excited to find one of my favourite 'trigger' foods for half the calories, fat & sugar.  I started to buy 3 jars but thought I should try it first.  I rushed the jar home and tasted it on a spoon.  Nice peanut taste but it is VERY sweet!  Shocking considering the low grams of sugar.  I could never eat it with honey or jam.  I thought about cutting it with natural peanut butter but that would defeat the purpose of having a low calorie option.  I eat it spread on Wasa multi-grain Crisp Bread.  Very nice.  It relieves my peanut butter craving quite nicely.  I'll be buying the other 2 jars later this week!
Positively scrumptious. It is a thousand times yummier than peanut butter. Keep it in the fridge so it's cold and mix it with yogurt. I am addicited.

column9: Not bad, but not peanut butter.
column10: I would actually rate this a 3 1/2.  Taste like Bit o' Honey or Mary Jane candy.  Stickier than peanut butter.  I use it on a toasted English muffin.  It is good for this purpose b/c the warmth of the toasted muffin makes this spreadable.  It is not really spreadable enough to use for sandwiches.  I will buy again, but wouldn't buy in bulk.

I recently went on Weight Watchers and was missing peanut butter.  Then I picked some of this stuff up (at Trader Joe's) and was changed for life.  Its consistency is so good--creamier than peanut butter.  My friend with me said it tasted like the peanut butter in a Reese's.  I would never guess that one Tbsp is just one Weight Watcher's point.  It's sweet and creamy and hits the spot on a sandwich, apple slices, celery sticks, or my favorite:  a spoon.

I was so excited to hear of this product, being a big fan of peanut butter. I was sorely disappointed. It has a grainy texture and slimy taste in the mouth. Since it wouldn't work on sandwiches, I figured I'd use it in peanut butter cookies, but no. The dough was sticky and unmanageable; the cookies spread out into a chewy mess. Cannot recommend it.

I researched this for a long time before I actually bought it. At first I admit I wasn't impressed but it wasn't bad. After going through a jar of it, I'm addicted. I don't even like the bad for you peanut butter any more. This tastes so much better. column9: Amazing - HEALTHY - Try it on vegetables, too!
column10: Amazing - HEALTHY - Try it on vegetables, too!I just had green beans (a tasteless, slightly bitter vegetable that is not great plain) plus a pile of rice,  plus GOBS of this delicious peanut butter on corn tortillas! It's still too expensive, but for me, it's worth $3-4 a jar. Great on bananas and with vegetarian bacon!

I've been eating this brand for the last 3 years and love it. I was eating the powdered kind but this not only tastes better but is so much easier to use. I didn't have to give up any more Plus Points on my Weight Watchers plan but it still has a awesome peanut butter taste. The only difference between this and "regular" peanut butter is that this stuff is stickier. I use on everything including using it baked goods.

column9: Great Substitute for the Real Thing
column10: It's not often that low calorie, low fat substitutes are as enjoyable as the real thing.  This product hits the mark.  The peanut taste is there and so is the creamy mouth feel of peanut butter.  At just 100 calories for the two tablespoons serving, it's almost half of what you would eat when having your favorite brand.  Eating 85% less fat is great, too, and it's cholesterol free. It's even low sodium.  Since I'm a crunchy peanut butter lover, I sometimes add a few peanuts to my sandwich and enjoy Better 'n Peanut Butter just as much as if I were eating my formerly-favorite brand.  What's more, it's a guilt-free pleasure.I'm giving a jar to my son to make his sinfully delicious peanut butter pie.  I think the taste and texture will be as satisfying but, with far less fat and calories.  I definitely will re-order when the four jars are devoured--er, gone.

column9: Not peanut butter, but pretty darn close!
column10: I am hooked on this product...thank G*d they have this at Trader Joe's for $3.99/jar (although it's only the low sodium regular flavor version).Although you have to refrigerate this (otherwise it gets moldy after a few weeks) and it's a little bit less "firm" than regular peanut butter at room temperature, this is the closest thing I've ever had to regular peanut butter that's low fat (2G vs.16G). The taste isn't perfect, but it's good enough to satisfy the peanut butter craving and not feel guilty about all the fat. And when you mix it with jelly, bananas or whatever, it's almost identical to the original.

I'm thinking in a smoothie the taste and texture of this would be okay.  For me, a sandwich of this is unbearable.  Using half of the amount of low fat peanut butter on my sandwiches is preferable to this.  Don't buy this product in bulk until you try it out.

column9: One of my favorite snacks! Great for people with nut allergies.
column10: Wasabi peas are essentially roasted green peas with a light coating of mild wasabi (Japanese horseradish) on them. I have been using Sportea now for only 6 months or so.  I have been buying in bulk to save on cost and have noticed that my 2 quarts/day 5 or more times a week really do make me feel better, sort of.  It is not like caffeine or sugar as it does not make you hyped up only to crash later.  It is more like a smooth constant boost.  It does not come on strong so I did not notice it at first.  However I can tell the difference now, as can my wife, when I drink a bottle of it and when I do not.  When I do I have more stamina and energy, not in great amounts, just enough to be noticeable.But what I really like is that it is not soda, it is not plain water and it does not have caffeine, sugar or high fructose corn syrup in it.  No taurine or other engergy drink additives, just good satisfying cold tasty tea.The taste is widely variable.  If you find that you do not like it try to leave it "steeping" for a differnt amount of time.  I have found that I like it best between 6-9 hours in the fridge.  That is another thing do not steep if not in the fridge, it will taste bad look funny if you do.  Steeping longer than 10 hours also makes it bitter and mellows out some of the better flavors, so if you don't like your tea bitter and tasteless do not leave the tea bag in more than 10 hours.  Any less than 4 hours and the flavor is barely even there at all.  4-5 hours and there is a stronger flavor but weak color and weak overall flavor, meaning that some of the flavor has leached out but not all of it.  Between 6 and 8 hours seems like the sweet spot, sometimes I do it overnight and it goes for 9 hours and it is still OK, but I pull the bag out as soon as I can when I get up.I have taken this hiking, camping, climbing, kayaking, etc.  As long as it is prepared right and the bag is removed it will keep its flavor as long as it does not get too warm, so I have found that it works best to use it within the first day out if you plan to use it outdoors.  Then again maybe you prefer it warm, it is a whole different taste.I also do not encourage you to use hot water on the cold bags, it always seems to taste aweful when I make it hot.  I have not tried the hot bags, as they are smaller they may mellow the bad taste of this tea when hot.  I don't know, but I suggest not using the big bag for hot tea.Thats about all I can say for this.  I would be happy if it also included some of the grean tea properties of staving off hunger, but sadly to say this has had no effect on my appetite.  It does howover seem to relax me, probably more of a comfort thing at this point though.  It also really does quench my thirst better than other drinks for better or worse.  I cannot comment on it nutritious value except that it does have good stuff in it and as far as I can tell no bad stuff.

We just recently added a corgi to our family, and I started researching different types of wet and dry foods for our pup. After trying different raw diets, we eventually settled on the Weruva brand of dog food. Our local pet store recommended it to us, and the girl working actually opened up a can and started eating it! It's processed in Thailand, and before that scares anybody, you have to realize that the food processing laws in Thailand are MUCH more strict than in America (read it up online!). They are not allowed to process by-product in their pet food, or use filler product. Weruva definitely does not have any of that--you can actually eat the dog food and it'll taste just like dinner.Our boy has a sensitive stomach and he's a very picky eater. The first night we got him the regular Chicken with Gravy he ate that whole can up. He loved it, and when we tried feeding him anything different he refused. Then we ordered him the Kobe Master flavor and it quickly became one of his favorites. I'd definitely recommend this brand, especially coming from a very concerned dog owner.
