There was a powdery texture to the cookie instead of the smooth surface.  It's a subtle difference but the 'Milano' experience is very specific.  At these prices, they better be perfect.  These cookies weren't.I know Pepperidge Farm products; my parents lived in Norwalk, CT near their factory.  I have shopped at the company store.  What's amazing is that their products are perfectly good at the expiration date or even one year later.  However, in the case of the product above, they were not good right out of the factory and thus they were discounted.

All of the flavors I've tried are great; but my favorite are the mint.I was concerned re the shipping issue based on other reviews.  When they arrived, the cookies were packed so tightly into a box filled with canned goods that the outer carton was pushed out of shape right on top of where the cookies were - which carton was pretty battered on that location, as one might expect from an incorrectly packed carton.  Amazon, what is up with your packaging logic?  It's so weird what you do when packing things....Anyway, I figured the whole batch of cookies would be crushed.  To my amazement, only 3 of the cookies were broken (out of a pack of 4 bags).  I think that was a fluke really.  Anyway, otherwise they were fresh etc.  The only other odd thing was that these seemed to be different cookies than what I was used to.  They seemed to be thinner.  I've noticed since moving from the West Coast to the East Coast that a lot of products seem different here in various ways, so I figured it was either that, or maybe I was imagining it; but I don't think so.  Anyway - I actually preferred the thinner ones, as the overall flavor balances were better and the texture was more appealing.So while my shipping story was a success, I can't claim that the product was really properly packaged, and I wouldn't therefore want to leave a review claiming that.

A tasty treat for those who remember what these were like when they used to sell them in the stores, now I can't find this one, but they have the double chocolate, mint, and other random flavors that I don't find quite as appealing.Note that this is a pack of four, but still expensive for such - probably designed to extract the emotional value from people like me. Considering the other kinds can be had for far cheaper at Target... I can do without these for a while again, especially as most of us don't eat through these fast enough to get through four packs by the due date.

This review is regarding the cookie, not the price set by this seller. The cookie.... is fantastic. What a perfect little treat. Three cookies are only 180 calories. Since I am trying to watch my weight, I eat one - only 60 calories!! It's perfect for those times you NEED something sugary or chocolately. You can eat one of these and not blow your entire day dieting.Yum. Yum.

These cookies hardly need a review. They are so amazingly delicious. The perfect amount of rich chocolate between the cookies. Pepperidge farm sure did it right with these cookies. Stick to the classic ones, though. I've tried a few other variations and they aren't nearly as good.

The cookies were delicious, chrisp and whole. I can only say they did not last long.  Pepperidge Farm Mint Milano is the only cookie I realy enjoy and would eat a lot off.  The others, even in Peppridge Farm I would only eat one or two.  But I have found that the Mint Milano is hard to get.  Pepperidge Farm should try selling in Canada and Jamaica,  West Indies.  I actually live in Jamaica, W.I. and can not get Mint Milano there so I either ask friends to buy it for me or buy it on line.  Would recommend this cookie for all those people that like a lite combination of mint and chocolate.
These have minty chocolate in them, but it's not too minty, wich is good.  They're a lot like the Thin Mint Girl Scout cookies in reguard to flavor, but the texture is lighter and crisper.

I LOVE raspberry, and Pepperidge Farms, so I thought this would be a "no brainer".  However, when I received them they were already a week past the freshness date, and they were very dry.  I don't think I will order again.

column4: Doreen B. Bishop "Doreen Bishop cat parent"
column10: By the time I buy a few four packs and get amazons free shipping to my door it is a better deal than my local store.Its a wonderful crispie cookie that holds up well in shipping Try it for yourselves  :)

Our household loves this fig vinegar; its rich fruity and sweet taste makes a great finishing touch on a variety of dishes and it adds a nice complexity when used in place of ordinary vinegar. I am delighted to find that Amazon offers it as it can be tricky to find.  Try it drizzled on Parmiggiano Reggiano.

column9: Great for soup or a quick snack
column10: I like adding these to my soup or chili, or just for a quick snack.  Cheaper than the regular (yellow cheddar) flavor and just as good to me.  A bit milder taste.  Always fresh in the individual pouches and easier to control portions. A decent value at 22 cents per ounce (current pricing).  May sometimes be cheaper locally, but very convenient via amazon.

column9: Great flavor, could be slightly fresher
column10: I bought it for about $11. It's such an affordable price. The per oz price is even competitive with the larger boxes (of non-snack size bags) cheez-its at grocery stores!The white cheddar is my favorite flavor; I think it's sharper than the original cheddar one.My only complaint about this order is that it seems very slightly less fresh than it should be. I had just bought 13.7 oz boxes of the white cheddar and the original at the grocery store shortly before this order arrived. So in comparison, the snack-size bags that I ordered seem slightly less crunchy than the ones I got from the grocery store. But I think if I didn't have the other boxes to compare it to, I wouldn't have even noticed. So I would still recommend this product!

column4: Angel_Boy "Treat the people around you the wa...
column10: When i ordered these they were $12 for a box of 36 bags- so that's like 3 bags for $1_ i like to snack- and tend to eat too much if eating from a large bag or box- so i like to get these portion controlled snacks when the price is right. I would prefer a parmesan or swiss over this flavor- the white cheddar is kinda bland compared to the other flavors- it lacks the zest of a sharper of more flavorful cheese.I would not buy this flavor again- but to each their own.

Last night I have tried out the Bucatini for the first time from Faella - WOW, they were so great!I had Latini Bucatini before, and yes, those were outstanding as well, compared to Delvedere or De Cecco (which you can simply forget, they don't play in the same league...).I made my own (vegetarian) version of a sauce all' amatriciana, using Morningstar Farm's Bacon strips, cut in slices and fried in butter with a fist-sized white onion (cut) and fresh garlic (not minced out of a jar!), rounded up with a good San Marzano tomatoe passata. And what should I say - we were blown away!The sauce is great, and the wonderful Bucatini made the dish perfect. They had just the right consistence, the right thickness, the right taste, the right everything - I fully recommend this Pasta!Can't wait to try the other varieties as well.Oh, and the price is even below the Latini price, imagine!

column9: Please Sir, I want some more.
column10: It is really hard to find a good gluten free bread that doesn't taste like cardboard. My search came to an end. I can finally enjoy sandwiches, french bread or hot chocolate and toast!

Better than any other bread PLUS it is gluten and egg free. Delicious right out of the bag, no toasting needed. After years of dry tasteless (and toasted) gluten free bread, this really is heavenly. Now I must go order some more!!
These candies are great! They're light and refreshing without being too sweet. Candies that are too sweet always leave me feeling thirsty. I highly recommend them.

Pro Plan is an excellent brand, so when we adopted a new puppy, Pro Plan was a natural choice as far as feeding is concerned. My girl loves the chicken and rice puppy food, and our veterinarian says that she is healthy as can be. In fact, our veterinarian sells Pro Plan, though it is more economical to purchase on Amazon.
i dont think this worked well with my puppy, I hated the looks of those chicken chunks , they looked like fried nuggets

column9: The best flax milk on the market
column10: I've tasted other brands of flax milk but this brand is the best by far...and it is creamy. Other brands are not really creamy and have a slight after taste...a little too nutty I guess. I can't wait to order this through Amazon...I hope the shipping is reasonable.

I love Earthborn Hollistic. After Taste of the Wild got recalled and I realized they were from Diamond Foods I immediately made the switch. My dog loves it. He is a Pit- Mix and is prone to food allergies. He loves it and we have even switched our cats as well. I shop around and find that Amazon prices are the best. Will continue to buy again.

column9: schar products are really good overall
column10: My 14 yr old son has celiac and finding products a kid likes is difficult.  He likes all the schar products.  I have also found using a corn based spaghetti pasta does better than an all brown rice spagetti.  He says it is "most real".  I rinse it after cooking (all gf pastas do better for somereason if you rinse them after cooking/straining).  With all gf pasta there is a fine line between "al dente-not cooked-and overcooking"  , but I found schar has more time to forgive!

I've tried many GF noodles.  I was a fan of Tinkyada until I tried this Schar's product.  Everyone in the family (gluten free and not gluten free) found Schar's to taste most like 'real' spaghetti noodles.  The color is like an egg noodle, but the taste is like regular noodles.  I also like that it takes less time to cook than Tinkyada.

column9: Simply the best GF spaghetti out there
column10: This is the best gluten-free spaghetti I've found. Previously we had to make two pots of pasta -- one for the 1/2 of the house that is gluten-intolerant and another for the "normal" folks. Everyone loves this pasta, so now we make ONE pot and everyone's happy.

column9: prefer other forms of Schar gluten free pasta
column10: If you just love spaghetti, and have to have it, cook these noodles in AMPLE water and stir frequently, and all will be well.  Their taste and texture is quite nice as long as they are not over-cooked.  However, if you cook them like wheat pasta, you'll end up with a clumpy, unevenly cooked mess.I prefer the penne and fusilli, for which preparation is really a no-brainer.I cook all of them for the minimum time given on the packet instructions and rinse briefly with cool water.(Guests have not noticed that these are gluten free pastas.)

I've been gf for about 6 years and Schar is by far the best gf products I've ever had.  The only negative thing about this pasta is the price.  For our family of 7 we need two packages of spaghetti to feed all of us.A word of advice about cooking this - I've had trouble with it sticking together in large clumps so I now break them in half first and then fan them into the pot.If you were a pasta lover before going gf, you will find this worth the price!!

column9: A delightful change after 3 years of spaghetti squash
column10: After my husband [who is a diabetic as well] was diagnosed as gluten intolerant in 2007 I set out on a quest to find someway to eat spaghetti that had some semblance of real spaghetti and still keep his carb count under control.  I discovered spaghetti squash which was a fascinating, if not terribly tasty choice.  Just this past year I gratefully learned about Schar gluten free spaghetti and once we tried it we never looked back.  Although the carb count went out the window, the taste, visual and oral senses took over and we've been thoroughly enjoying the Schar spaghetti since that time.  I can not tell the difference between 'regular' spaghetti and the Schar pasta.  The spaghetti is great buttered but covered in the tastiness of spaghetti sauce, plus my additions, the Schar spaghetti is wonderful.  My husband thinks he has hit the jackpot as he LOVES spaghetti.As far as the carb count goes we have the Schar on special occasions and do not over load his system with the carbs.  It keeps his spirits high to have something special once in a while.BTW- It takes 11 minutes to cook the spaghetti.

My Mom was just diagnosed and had to give up gluten. I went on line because she loves pasta so much- to find something else she could use. I read the reviews and decided to try this product. I bought it and sent it to her. I called her to be on the watch for it in the mail. When she got it, she tried it right away and told me how much she really liked it! She recomends this product to anyone who needs to be on a gluten free diet!

column9: it is the best gluten free Spaghetti ever
column10: it is the best gluten free Spaghetti everi try 3 kinds of Spaghetti in 2 yearsthe best taste & consistency is for schar Spaghettibut it is very expensive for Spaghetti pasta

This product is awesome.  My kids have not found any difference between regular noodles transition to these noodles.  Their are no funny tastes.  Though with any gluten free noodle the cooking process the water gets thick like.  The noodles cook in under 10 minutes.  We've been very pleased with them and eat them at least every other week!

With over a decade of experience with gluten-free food, I think I've tried every gluten-free noodle on the market. Many turn to paste in the pot or are otherwise inedible.Schar noodles are by far the best we've tried.These spaghetti noodles are as good as the real thing.One caveat, though: Boil the noodles very gently. Even then, you won't end up with many long strands. They do tend to break up. Eating them while twirling probably won't work out for you.But you will like the taste.

I am surprised by the negative reviews.  This is a great product.As one of the negative reviewers said, you definitely need to use LOTS of water and you cannot make more than one package at a time and it does require stirring.  But like other pastas you must stir it a lot when first placing the pasta in boiling water.  All pastas develop a sticky coating initially and will clump together if not stirred A LOT!!  After the sticky coating is dispersed by the water it does not require any more stirring than regular spaghetti.  Wish I had known this 25 years ago.

This product cannot be cooked more than 1 package at a time, and even then you will need to watch and stir it lot (be prepared for a workout).  The consistency is like rice not pasta. So the water becomes milky and if you don't cook it correctly (which is difficult if you really want it al dente), it can be very chewy.  The taste does not lend itself to authenticity.  I wish I had not bought it and am stuck with the other packages :(
The "pasta" had a decent texture when eaten quickly, but lost texture quickly if the dish sat or was reheated.  Overall good flavoe and I would buy it again.
Loved the texture and flavor of this spagghetti!  Would recommend to anyone, even if not gluten intolerant!

column9: A gift for the glutenly challenged
column10: I really have no choice I have Celiac disease and have to eat gluten free.  I do have vast experience with rice, corn, and even chick pea pasta.  Schar is by far the best I have tasted.  It like all non-wheat pastas has a narrow window for aldente cooking but when you hit it there is really very little to distinguish it from a good quality wheat pasta.
This is the best pasta I have found, My whole family loves it.  I use all oF Schar's corn pasts for all my Italian recipes.

column9: By far the best GF spaghetti in my 6-year-old's opinion
column10: We love this corn spaghetti.  Schar has a bunch of great GF products out there.  Make sure you boil in plenty of water and stir frequently and you'll have some great spaghetti.  I add a little oil to the water during boiling and quite a bit of salt and the spaghetti is great every time.  My 6-year-old GF son loves this spaghetti.  The whole family eats it even though only half of us need GF foods.  It doesn't taste like wheat spaghetti...it tastes like corn spaghetti, but we like the taste!

You have to get your timing exactly right to make these taste llike regular pasta.  Play around with the suggested eleven minutes.  That being said, I like them.  I would not eat them all the time, but these are a great gluten free substitute when you get the pasta "itch."

column9: By far the absolute best gluten free pasta!!!
column10: Tried most and this is by far the best tasting, best texture, gluten free pasta I've tried to date. This is so great, (takes extra time to cook as most gluten free pasta does), that even my family and friends who don't eat gluten free are switching to this because it is so great and has the benefits of gluten free while truly satisfying the pasta crave.

column9: Best gluten free pasta I have found!
column10: I first bought this at Walmart in Mesa, AZ. Came home to Cali and could not find it here. When I found it on Amazon, I was really happy. This pasta tastes just like regular pasta. The one thing that I notice about all gluten free pasta is that they do not reheat well. This one does if it is in a sauce like for lasagna. If you have the noodles cooked and need to reheat for a recipe, just drop them in boiling, salted water with a little oil for 2-3 minutes and it is great!

column9: We love this pasta AND it's non-GMO
column10: I have tried many brands of GF pasta and this one is the only one I've found that tastes just like normal spaghetti with normal pasta texture. I do not understand the negative reviews. While it is made from corn it does NOT taste like corn (or even remotely smell like corn). The really awesome thing besides the taste is that Schar DOES NOT use genetically modified corn...which almost all corn products here in the US now are. Even my husband who has no need to eat GF loves this pasta. I didn't even know about this product until I went in a local health food store and asked the clerk which GF pasta they sell the most of (they sell approx. 5 or 6 different brands) and she said: "hands down we sell more Schar than any other" she said it was the one brand they constantly run out of. It says on the package that it's Europe's #1 selling pasta and I can see why.

column9: only gf spaghetti my non-gf hubby will eat
column10: he'll actually ask for it!  we can only get the schar spaghetti at one store near us and it's so expensive.  much more worthwhile to stock up!
It's nice having a new option that's gluten free! Tastes great! Ordering in bulk is easy and works out great. Wasn't able to fing this selection anywhere else.

I have not bought Schar gluten-free pasta again.  It was ok, but I wasn't too impressed with the predominantly corn-flavored (and colored) pasta.  Also, it did not hold up too well when reheating a meal.  There are better products out there.

For those of you out there that are new to gluten free foods...such as myself, the pasta experience will be quite disappointing.  Maybe it was just this particular brand...I don't know. Don't get me wrong...I love pasta and I consume it quite regularly. So when I suddenly switched to this new gluten free diet because you hear how much healthier it is, I thought I'll give it a try.First off, expect to cook the spaghetti longer then regular wheat pastas. The water will start to look thick and cakey. I suppose that's normal too. As you cook beware of the odor which I can't describe. The noodles will be very sticky so I advise putting in olive oil in the water but that didn't do the trick as well as I thought either. The noodles do have a heavier consistancy but as for the taste...it was just ok. It made me quite bloated after eating it. Wonder what that was about. Would I eat this again? No.
We've tried many brands of gluten free pasta, and this is the best we've tried!  When our family uses this pasta we don't cook seperate gluten free/regular pasta.  It's worth it!
All Schar foods have made me sick... There is something in them that gives me the "Gluten Ache" even though they claim to be gluten free... Be careful when using these products!!!!!

I'm the account holders wife....I bought this based on the good reviews.  I was disappointed. I made a batch of it and it was so bad I wouldn't even feed it to the livestock and they usually get all our scraps. The consistancy of the noodles was horrible and I followed the instructions and I even rinsed it.  I have made lots of spaghetti over the years and this one was the worst.  I'm going back to rice flour spaghetti.
I LOVE THIS PRODUCT!!!! I noticed right away that i slept more soundly and it helped my hubby as well... Im so grateful that i found this product.
Bought these to try some new recipies, but have found they are quite tasty straight out of the can, chopped up in my salad!
I was very disappointed in these artichoke hearts.  There were at least two VERY tough leaves on each quartered piece -- way too much waste, especially for this price.  Won't be buying these again.

There's nothing Plain Jane about the performance of this product. The aroma and flavor are heavenly, mouth-wateringly vanilla-y as soon as I open the bottle. It's a good value. As another reviewer said, you need only 1/4 teaspoon of powder for every 1 teaspoon of liquid extract called for in a recipe. Or, if you're like me and always add more vanilla than the recipe calls for, use as much as a 1/2 teaspoon per teaspoon, and your baked goods will taste decadent!One thing I especially appreciate is the strong vanilla flavor without the alcohol of liquid extracts, which allows me to use the powder in uncooked creations, like smoothies, fruit salad, and as an unexpected accent in salad dressings.

If you're looking for a powder substitute for pure vanilla extract, look no further!  The first ingredient is natural vanilla bean extractives, then evaporated cane juice, silica, and cellulose.  It has a wonderfully rich smell and taste that will enhance your baked goods.  Just substitute 1/4 tsp powder for each tsp of vanilla extract.  Very glad to have found this!

Husband wanted some vanilla powder to sprinkle on his morning lattes. Searched many stores and couldn't find a local supplier. Once again Amazon was a great source.He likes the flavor and the shaker works well. I like the size of the container (since it wasn't ordered to cook with we had no use for a large container or pound of bulk powder).In response to unhappy reviewer - nowhere does this product claim to be "pure" i.e. 100% vanilla. Two accurate descriptions mention the cane juice and the silica. Yes, cane juice is a form of sugar and therefore the source of the sweetness. Silica is a mineral commonly used as a flow agent for powders. (It is also an ingredient in many other items including glass, fiber optics, cosmetics, and supplements.) It is misleading to insinuate that silica=sand=glass.This is a good product and it is exactly what it claims to be, "a vanilla powder that adds sweetness and enhances flavor." Glad we found it.

Very tasty, worked perfectly in a cookie recipe and two different muffin batches.  It didnt even occur to me at first that I needed a vanilla extract substitute, but when it did, I'm glad I found this.  Will definitely buy again.
all vanilla powders are not the same, thought i could get away with it, but never will get this again, disappointing taste and a bit grainy too
Authentic Foods Vanilla PowderSilica is sand (typically made into glass) and "cane juice" I assume is "sugar cane juice" which is of course sugar.

I do like Sobe Lifewater.  If you aren't a fan, then new flavors probably won't matter to you.I am not sure how long this one has been out, but do know that it is fairly new.We finally found it in a grocery store here, and Hubby grabbed a couple of them.I am SO glad that he did!This one is very tasty!  I am one of those who also has to smell everything before eatingor drinking it, and this one smells good too.  Then add the great eye-pleasing color on thebottle, and well, it's a new favorite flavor.It's hard to describe the flavor. Obviously, they have kiwi and cherimoya, which is a spinyfruit with a creamy white inside. It tastes very fresh and fruity, with a slight pear aftertaste.I definitely recommend this one - pretty AND tasty!

column9: Very Good Meat Snack - Highly Recommended
column10: Jack Link's "X-Stick Original" snack sticks are very good tasting and far less greasy than other "meat sticks" (like Slim Jim). These are great snacks for diabetics (like me) since they have a negligible amount of Net Carbs.The Amazon "Product Features" incorrectly lists these as 160 Calories each, and neither the box or individual packaging list the Nutrition Facts, so I visited the Jack Links web site and found the following:Serving Size: .5 Oz (1 stick)Calories: 60 (45 from Fat)Total Fat: 5g (2g Saturated Fat)Cholesterol: 15mgSodium: 220mgTotal Carbohydrates: 0gProtein: 3gThese do contain MSG, which can cause "gastric distress" in some people (like my dad).Overall, these are great as a snacks between meals and they are so much better than the competition.Highly Recommended!CFH

These are along the line of Slim Jims but have a milder, less spicy, taste. The X-Sticks also have a much better texture than Slim Jims, these things actually look like they are made of real meat, NOT the 'mystery meat - goat hair/cardboard' texture of the modern Slim Jim.The X-Stick is 'not exactly' a health food snack. They have a fair amount of fat, a little over 5 grams (each stick, in this package, is 14 grams total mass). Sodium content is about 224 mg and, about 3.2 grams of protein and only 64 calories (about 47 calories from fat) per stick.What the X-Stick is, is a very satisfying snack. I sometimes have to miss a meal, due to my work. One or two of these take the hunger away and puts some energy back into me. I do try to limit my fat intake but do not feel guilty about snacking on these once in a while.Enjoy.Ken

These are so much better than Slim Jim's they don't have that weird fur texture when you bite it; and as far as biting goes you can actually bite these without fighting with it. They taste good, but have that typical meat stick flavor. These are also MUCH easier to open than a Slim Jim. Packed well, arrived quickly and fresh.

This review is for the 0.5 ounce X-Sticks box of 50.First I will comment on the taste.  The X-Sticks have a mild and pleasing flavor to them.  They taste similar to Slim Jims, just without the chemical spiciness and odd plastic texture of Slim Jims.  In a taste test, the X-Sticks would win without a problem.Next is the price.  The price for the box of 50 0.5 ounce X-Sticks tend to fluctuate on Amazon but it's still worth it, provided the price stays below $20 a box.  When you combine this with the Subscribe and Save discount, you can save even more!  The price of the same type of Slim Jims is almost $10 higher, so once again, the X-Sticks win.So my final thoughts are if you're looking for a meat snack that isn't going to repeat on you an hour later, these are the way to go.  Although they can't claim to be "All natural", they have more natural ingredients than the Slim Jim.  These also are composed of beef and pork (yum), whereas a Slim Jim is composed of beef and mechanically separated chicken...  (Eww).  Anyway, I was very happy with this purchase and I highly recommend them for you.

I can't really compare these to other similar products (Slim Jim,etc.), as I had never had jerky-type snacks before I got these.  I decided to take a long road trip (4500 miles round trip), and I have a tendency to get drowsy if I don't get enough protein.  I decided to carry these plus some string cheese in the car to tide me over between meal stops.I really like these.  The flavor is good, the texture is fine, and the "damage" from a diet standpoint is minimal (these are 60 cal apiece, based on the Jack Links site).  They're not too salty, either.  Having them on the trip from Bellingham, WA to St. Louis, MO and back was a huge help.  One or two of these provided just the right amount of tasty protein.  The size and packaging is handy, too, and easy to open when driving.I now keep them on hand for when I need a little pick-me-up.

column9: Best of all the beef sticks I have tried
column10: My son and I love these beef sticks! I purchased these and slim jims at the same time and was amazed how much better taste and tecture they have over slim jims. Infact I'm tempted to throw my slim jims in the trash! Perfect for your 72-hour kit.

This stuff is great for snacking, has a long shelf life, and convenient to pack for travel.  The taste and texture is awesome.  Buying on-line saves money and time.  I keep a box in my office and another at home.  It is a great way to enjoy group discussions and family time.  Eric D., Wanamingo, MN

column9: Easy snack sticks on the cheap
column10: I am a meat lover and this makes a perfect snack for the road.  Inexpensive.  Can't say the taste is outstanding but is certainly not yucky.  Will get another box when this one runs out.
After eating these you'll Never want another Slim JimThese are Awesome.

So these sticks taste ok, I mean, it's jerky, how do you mess that up? My issue is with the expiration date, which was a little less than one month from when I got my box. How am I supposed to eat 50 of these things in 25 some-odd days? That's just cheap trying to offload these so close to the expiration date. Never buying these again.

This was my second purchase. Watching carbs, I look for snacks that are high protein with low or no sugars. Tiring of nuts all the time I tired these a couple months ago. Very surprised, they taste good with a bit of spice kick. Recalling that most convenience store sticks were dry or greasy or blah tasting, it was nice to snack on these. They are not the long sticks but a nice size at about 6 inches. Wrapped individually and easy to open. Great item to grab when looking for a quick munch.

column9: Just okay -- not nearly a Slim Jim
column10: While certainly edible, I don't think Jack Links brings a realistic competitor here with their version of the Slim Jim.  Honestly, there are some bites I take which remind me of dog food.  I know we are talking about meat sticks here and not fine dining, but the texture of these is just not right, almost too granular.  I know Slim Jims have that greasy taste but these guys have a bit of it too and I have to admit I kind of enjoy it.  Overall, in my opinion, Slim Jims are much much better than these guys, but to each his/her own!
Just letting ya know that I bought a pack of these before..they were perfectly fine..this time? no. They were moldy, so I just threw them out, what a waste of money!!
The first time I got these, everything was great. The second time, however, the sticks tasted a bit off... then I notice the 3-months-expired date on them.
My husband has tried many links is his day and these stand out.  Would compare these to Fat Freddies.
I first bought these at my part-time work at Advance Auto and since I could buy them cheaper this way, I did it.Good flavor and a bit of a bite.

The product is exactly what we had been purchasing in the store.  I love the box to store them becuase they would fall behind things in the cabinet and now they are always easy to find.  The price was better than in the store.
my son has type 1 diabetes and needs to eat low carb snacks.  he loves the jack links small beef jerky.  we take them with us everywhere.
After eating these you'll Never want another Slim JimThese are Awesome.

column9: I'll never Have another slim Jim again
column10: This jerky is the greatest jerky ever it taste so good it comes with 50 links for only 15 bucks!!!! i bought this last month and i just finished them i'm buying more right now!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Have purchased this product several times and we are pleased. It is a good value for the money compared with the retail stores.
Better than thought theyd be  A+++++++.  Excellent choice for a great snack at work.  never got close to getting sick of them and will buy again.
Product is tastey but I would like some cheese to go along with it since the beef sticks alone don't taste as good after awhile.

column9: A bit on the greasy side, but the kids love them
column10: Some fairly improved ingredients vs a typical 'slim jim', at least its not made with jowls and pink slime.  The taste is good, salty, smoky, a bit on the greasy side.  If you've had the x-sticks, this is just small pieces of that in a bag, four times the weight of the stick.  In other words, excellent for sharing or a snack at school where eating a whole stick might be a problem.I also dump a package into a ziploc and can snack on it a piece at a time to boost my protein and fat intake a bit.A pack of 12 lasted my 7 year old and his friends about a week, which is way faster than most other meat snacks I've put on the snack counter.But even the 7-10 year olds say its a bit greasy, as they devour another package.

this will be the third time i bought this an enjoy it every time much better then slim jims  their tender an full of flavor i often want a snack at random times but don't want eat a lot or a full meal this ties me over an is worth the price

My kids love these beef sticks...... so this year I purchased these and stuffed lots of them in their Christmas stockings.  These were a much better replacement to all the Christmas candy they usually get.  Great item and great price!!!
Realy liked the taste, price and quality. Only downgrade would be that about 20% of the easy peel opening packages are not serrated and need to be cut with scissors. Only defect
I have ordered this item several times and am very pleased with it. Will order again. It is one of my favorite jack link products.

Having never had the X-Links before, I bought them based off some customer reviews I read here. Maybe I should have read more, but these are most comparable to a Slim Jim. While they are much better, they still fall into the same category, and I was looking for something a little more "real" tasting. These have a much better taste than Slim Jim does, although there is still a substantial "artificial" taste. Highly recommended as a Slim Jim upgrade, but don't buy these if you're looking for a more natural tasting product.
Very pleased with these. They had both a good taste and texture. The price was right for what you get. I would highly recommend.

column9: Very good, but not really EXTREME
column10: I like these sticks better than Slim Jims because they are less greasy and have a meatier flavor.  However, they could benefit from some more spice.  That's my only suggestion.
I love these sticks i have purchased 2 boxes from amazon and I have bought many from local stores. These are the best tasting sticks i have ever had just wish i could get them by the case yum yum.

The product is the same as what we had been purchasing in the store. I like keeping the box to store them becuase I dont lose track of where they are in the cabinet and now they are always easy to find. The price was better than in the store.

Very good snack sticks.  It does not feel greasy like Slim Jims and is easy to chew.  The size is perfect for a snack so I don't eat too many all at once.  I prefer it to be a little bit spicier though but they don't come in this size and price.  This is good if you have a craving for protein and should help hold off the hunger between meals.

I just bought my second box of Jack's Links because I'm sold on these!  I purchased a box of small Slim Jim's for my son's lunch box and for throwing snacks in my bag for the long afternoons of driving kids around to activiities and someone ALWAYS asking if I have something to eat!!  The Slim Jims were just ok, but after time got really hard, even in their individually packaged cases.  So I bought the Jack Link's X Stick and immediately my 10 year old son said they were WAY better than Slim Jims.  The 0.5 oz size is a little bigger than the small Slim Jims, yet not too big so that I'm filling my kid with even more fat and junk.  This is just the right size for a "snack" and the price is great.  At Amazon today I bought a box of 50 on sale for $17, which is about .35 cents a stick.  Don't hesitate to buy these if you are like me and need a variety of on-the-go, non-refrigerated snacks or lunch box fillers!!  Great product!
I'm not a beef stick/beef jerky eater.  These were bought for my son's school snack, however I have eaten a few and really like the beef flavor.

Sounded like a great product - pepperoni with an extra kick of flavor. But when I first bit into it, it tasted bland and strange - I was expecting something like the Slim Jim Pepperoni sticks, which are soft and flavorful. Another thing I dislike, is that neither the box nor the product itself contains any nutrition information - you have to mail them to get the info, it says. 29 sticks to go..

This is much better than a slim jim. These are softer and have a good snap when you take a bite. The seasoning is not out of control like in a Slim Jim and the color is naturally brighter. Packing is good, much better than a Slim Jim, Jack Links have peel-able  packaging while with Slim Jims you have you to find a nice cut edge and wrestle with it.

column9: Jack Link's X-Stick, Pepperoni extra 1.25 oz X-Sticks
column10: Shipment is always on time. This is one of Jack Links best products. Just the right amount of spice and texture.

This will be the shortest review I've ever written, because it's based soley personal taste when it comes to beef sticks.I didn't like the X Sticks. I wouldn't even put them in the same universe as Jack Link's Beef Stick, Original, 0.92-Ounce Sticks (Pack of 72) or any of the beef sticks that Jack Links makes based on the 'Original' formula/base. I dig all of their flavored stuff, spicy stuff, etc, as long as it's based on the original beef stick variety.The X Sticks taste... like potted beef, wrapped into a beef stick? I don't know, It's odd. I'm still going to eat all 50 of them or whatever; they're not awful. Just "okay"; and in my world of seriously loving beef jerky and beef sticks, being just "okay" is a crime...

Very much enjoyed the product under review; however, one slight problem.  The extended length of the X-stick over the shorter length market -size.  Prefer the shorter length.  Also, I have purchased the 7.2 oz.size in my local market.  This is also a good product.  I might be interested in buying these in quantity fron Amazon if offered.  Thank you for the opportunity to comment.

Guess people have different. They taste like Slim Jims with all the flavor and texture boiled out of them. Bologna sticks shaped like Slim Jims. Anyone want a box of 49?update: After some time I tried another. Not inedible. The more I ate, the better they tasted. I think I still prefer Slim Jims. A little more work to eat; spicier, with a little snap to the skin. But I'm raising my rating to 3 stars from 1.I couldn't find any nutrition information which I thought was required for food products made in the US. I don't really want to know what the put in these things anyway
These things are by far the best beef sticks among those that are commonly available.

Good stuff if you want a Slim Jim type of replacement that is of better quality.  Does not have that waxy taste that Slim Jim tends to offer.  If you want real beef jerky I'd pass on this.  In fact, I assumed they would be more like the regular bagged Jack Links (myfault) just in stick form.  This has that mixed spiciness that you cant really find in any of their regular flavors but did remind me of Slim Jim.  Tastes like a hot dog in a way which is good and they tend to do the job as far as giving me a boost.  I give it 3 stars but I am going right back to the regular bagged stuff which so wayyyyy better.

This is by far,the best beef stick on the market.I have been a fan of Slimjims for years and this beats them and all the rest,HANDS DOWN!With today's frantic pace in living on this planet,when fast food restaurants are not an option,Jack Links is a quality snack on the go.Taste,texture,and convienience in small packages is the way of the future.

column9: Great Deal for a Tasty Snack
column10: These were only .19 each after getting 40% off with Amazon's snack sale, which is incredibly cheap.My hubby likes them in his lunches and I like giving him anything that isn't loaded with sugar or starches.I recently had a Slim Jim after about 20 years without trying them and it was awful. I like the flavor of Jack's Links ten times as much.Easy to get into the package, too, just peel it back.
These snack sticks are all individually wrapped and are very good! They taste a lot better than slim jims, plus my dog likes to lick the wrapper if i accidentally leave one on the floor overnight!

These are way better than Slim Jims for a fraction of the price. I order these through subscribe and save for even more savings. The flavor is outstanding. Love the portability. Makes a great protein snack any time of day. Even the picky eaters in the family love these. Also love these come from my home state.

column9: Good jerky for a quick snack
column10: I had tried one of the Jack Links snack pack, the kind that come with cheese, pretzel and meat, so after trying that, and loving it, I knew Id most likely enjoy this.  I took a bite from the first stick, and it wasn't too good, I guess it naturally tastes better with cheese IMO, but after eating the second and then third, they started to grow on me.  These things are perfect for that late snack and its convenient and does the trick for a hungry tummy.  They have a chewy consistency, but when you take a bite each time, you can hear a small snap from when you bite I also like the design, you just remove a piece of cardboard from the bottom and it becomes a dispenser, which is a little nice idea. I ended up liking these so much, I am going to subscribe to receive these once a month.  Price is great and if you do that, you get a nice little discount (15% off).  I definitely recommend this.
I bought these because I like meat snacks and Slim Jims are just way to greasy. I can't wait to purchase the next box.

I buy these by the box for my husband as his "stash" snack at work...he is always happy to receive them. Thanks for making a consistenly quality product. They ship ridiculously fast and we've never had a problem with our orders.
My whole family loves these and usually fights over the last package.  Great for on the road, quick protein fix.  Kids really enjoy them.
Better than Slim Jims.  Kids love them as a snack.  Not too salty, either.  Will buy again.

column9: Individual Jack Links best for sharing
column10: Have to admit I've never had Jack Links X-Stick (or any other Jack Links product) and have NO idea what they taste like.  I bought these because I know a Marine in Afghanistan loves them and so do his buddies.This particular item is perfect for military CARE packages: each unit is individually wrapped so nothing goes stale or gets sand in it after the box is opened.The small-size box is great for people without a lot of storage or 'personal' space.  The single-servings are ideal for sharing (without wiping yourself out of goodies) and fit into cammy pockets without taking up a lot of room or adding to the weight you're carrying.They make a welcome change from MRE's or when you need a quick energy boost (the convoy can't always stop for lunch).Even if you don't know if your 'fighter' likes them, I guarantee they'll be appreciated - remember when the kids traded lunches in school?  They may be older but trading goodies within the unit is a time-honored tradition, too!

I ordered this on April 29, 2011, and received it on May 2, 2011. The product expired in March. I am only giving this one star because that is the lowest rating that I can give. If it weren't for the one star minimum, I would give it 0 stars.

This stuff is great for snacking, has a long shelf life, and convenient to pack for travel.  The taste and texture is awesome.  Buying on-line saves money and time.  I keep a box in my office and another at home.  It is a great way to enjoy group discussions and family time.  Eric D., Wanamingo, MN

A quick, filling snack or not fattening beef stick, callit what you like...it is good! Most lunches for me is thisbeef stick and a cheese stick. That is usually all I havetime for. It is easy to carry and stays fresh.
Great snack, taste good and is a good value. Convenient package and just the right size for a snack.

column9: If you love beef jerky, you'll love this!
column10: I gave this as a Christmas present to my older, single brother.  He ate them all in less than a week!  I'd highly recommend buying this for someone!  I might even buy some for myself!  If you like beef jerky or Slim Jims, you'll definitely like Jack Links X-Sticks!

Edible, but not great. I picked these up because Amazon had stopped carrying Pemmican beef jerky (which hadn't been the same since the company was sold anyway) and I was looking for something to snack on. I like Slim-Jims ok when they're good (but quality control is a major issue with Slim-Jims, as for every good one you get, you're likely to get one that tastes rancid or worse).Obviously, these aren't like beef jerky, they're closer to Slim-Jims. The consistency seems to be much better than Slim-Jims and the price is pretty good. The flavor isn't as good as a good Slim-Jim, but is much better than a bad one, so it kind of evens out.I was hoping these would be closer to the "Matador" line of snack sticks that Jack Link's makes. For whatever reason, despite carrying many Jack Link's products at present, Amazon doesn't seem to have the Matador line.
EASIER TO CHEW, MILDER FLAVOR . I THINK LESS EXPENSIVE. MY KIT LIKES THEM TOO.

column9: Very tasty, not greasy, and tender.
column10: Having just bought both these X-Sticks and some Slim Jims Nacho Flavor, I like the X-Sticks better. They are less greasy, more tender, and don't have the tough casing that Slim Jims sticks have.

The taste is very similar to Slim Jim's, but tenderer and with less excess liquid.  Each piece is about 1/2 inch long and a little over a 1/4 inch in diameter.  The package is not resealable, a small gripe since they aren't too big anyway.

This stuff is great for snacking, has a long shelf life, and convenient to pack for travel.  The taste and texture is awesome.  Buying on-line saves money and time.  I keep a box in my office and another at home.  It is a great way to enjoy group discussions and family time.  Eric D., Wanamingo, MN
These sticks are good to carry with you in your breifcase for when you want a snack, but are watching out for carbs.
This 50 pack was only a 42 pack in my order. When I noticed pack was only half full upon opening, I counted and box WAS short.
My order was exactly as it should be, I got what I ordered in a short delivery time.

column9: 2 for1 is the way to go
column10: 2 for 1 Jack Link Snacks are easy to distribute, store, and get good visibility.

column9: If you like Slim Jim you won't like this
column10: I purchased this because I had cravings for Slim Jims and read a review claiming that these were similar to Slim Jim. Well, I just received it and after one bite I realized these were NOTHING like Slim Jim. They taste like plain old boring beef sticks with jazzier packaging. Slim Jim is an institution and this is a pizz poor imitation, if in fact that's what they were going for. These might be healthier but nothing comes close to the distinctive taste of SJ. So if you want SJ, snap in to a SJ!!!!!!!!

This vegan chocolate is really tasty, and it has small pieces of peaches in the bar. I've never tried peaches with chocolate, but the peaches blend in nicely. I am not vegan, but I enjoyed the chocolate bar anyway.

i developed celiac disease at the age of 62 after being a wheat glutton for my entire life. This is the first wheat substitute that has taste and texture, not only is it acceptable to me, but i would now prefer it to wheat pasta. The only diff. cook at full boil for the suggested 6 min., turn off heat, then let it sit in the hot water an additional 5 min. to absorb. Drain, but not rinse, and you have a very tasty, glutton free dish. i like it.

column9: Hands down, best pasta out there!
column10: Undoubtedly, the best tasting gluten-free pasta out there. It doesn't break, isn't mushy, and tastes just like regular pasta. You can serve this to guests and no one would know it's gluten free, trust me!!

column9: The BEST Gluten Free Pasta I've tasted
column10: I have tried DeBoles, and Tinyada among others. None hold up as well in water as Sam Mill Pasta D'oro. It is 100% corn pasta, and when I picked it up in the beginning I worried it would taste like a taco shell. It doesn't. It has a great flavor, and does not break down and get slimy in boiled water. It doesn't stick together. It also is great in casseroles as well with just sauce on top. Since my store is always low on supply, I subscribed to have Amazon ship this to me every 2 months. Give it a try!

I've tried many types of pasta for my gluten-free diet.  This is the only spaghetti I've found that tastes and feels like "normal" pasta.  Even my non-celiac family members are satisfied with this pasta -- which means I don't have to fix two pots of spaghetti anymore!

Our local store stopped carrying this item so we ordered in bulk via Amazon.  The price is right and the taste is great.  My wife is the one who needs gluten-free, but I don't mind being gluten-free as long as this is the brand we use.  All others are mushy and tasteless.

This sauce is delicious, if a little sweet, but that is marsala.  I had intentions of laboring over the stove all night simmering down a home cooked marsala sauce but after trying this, I won't ever be doing that.

I cannot give this Marsala Sauce by Rothschild's enough praise.  It is so tasty you could eat it like a soup!  This is simply the best sauce we have ever had.  We gift it, eat it, microwave for dip, eggs, burgers, pasta, don't get me started on caramelized onions and steak, obsess about it, etc.  You will not be sorry.  I know this seems like oversell, but...Man OH Man...It's the stuff!!  I hope they don't stop making it.  It would break my heart.

I've been eating Jing Jing Jahe for the past 15 years, even taking some with me when traveling in Indonesia, where it is manufactured.  When you first put a candy in your mouth, you might wonder where the ginger heat is, but don't worry.  After a few minutes your mouth will be enveloped with the most wonderful ginger taste you'll ever experience.  This chewy candy is not for those who do not like "hot" foods, but for ginger affecionados, it's a wonderful treat.

I've been buying this candy for a few years now, since I found it on a shelf at an Asian supermarket.I love the chewiness and then the slow warming of the ginger in your mouth.  It's not 'hot' but some people don't like the spicy warm it creates.However, I cannot believe this price of the candy on here!  If your neighborhood has ANY sort of Asian market, check there first.  I just picked up 6 bags (5oz each) for $1.59 each.Granted, I don't have a 'local' market, so when I get the chance to go to one, I stock up :-)  It doesn't take long for me to go through my stash.

I was introduced to these candies by my grandchildrens' Chinese language tutor. Are they chewy? They are pull-your-fillings-out chewy! Are they delicious enough that I don't care about the dentist bill? As SP would say, "you betcha!" If you like ginger, and you like spicy, I would choose these things over just about any candy out there (ok, if you need chocolate, you need chocolate, but I'm just sayin'). And since ginger is great for digestion, they also give me a great excuse to chow down on them after dinner. Try these babies. If you like them, chances are you won't have to share them. My experience has been that people either really truly love them or absolutely can't stand them. Enjoy!
The best after meal digestives EVER!I can't keep these in my home since I munch on them all the time!DELISH!
One of the healthier candies I eat and it's great to get them in bulk.  Really are a great snack at 2:30 when lunch is starting to wear you down.

I love the flavor of ginger and this candy captures that flavor perfectly with just the right amount of heat (for those unaware, ginger is a naturally hot spice).  I also love the texture of this candy.  I have to pace myself or I will find that I have eaten half a bag in a day.
A yummy way to get the ginger which helps settle my stomach. I also eat them to help manage motion sickness in cars, buses, and boats, and it helps with vertigo.
Love these ginger candies I just can't get enough of them.  Not all ginger candy is the same...  Ting Ting Jehe is the best in my opinion.
If you like ginger, this is a candy for you, in addition to it being benefical for your digestive track. Has a wonderful ginger flavor.
This candy is just great. The texture is soft and chewy. The flavor is great with that ginger taste and then the bite that it offers after you starting eating it.
An Asian co-worker gave me one of these. This candy is awesome. And, apparently, somewhat good for you! I bought 10 bags, and I pass them out to students. Most awesome candy ever...
great tasting candy with a bite. If you like ginger then you will enjoy this candy. very soft and chewy. One of the best that i've tasted and a good price.
I love ginger chews. I received them very quickly and the price was good. I would highly recommend this product and the seller.

while this candy has no "bad" ingredients, it is a "candy" Not candied ginger, not crystallized ginger. I usually make my own but was trying to save time, energy and money. Now I have spent the money I would have spent on raw ginger to buy this. Very disappointing
I remember trying one as a child.. SPICY! I spat it out instantly because the ginger flavor is so overwhelmingly strong. People seem to love it though, but it doesn't suit my palate.

column4: John Kosofsky "the man with no plan!"
column10: I'm a famous TV cook and talk show host. I didn't become a butterball by just eating salad. I put this on EVERYTHING: steaks, fries, ice cream, my husband John, Corn Flakes, in my coffee and especially my breakfast Scotch. Delich...
Arrived chalky and white. Tried to return them, but amazon.com did not allow. BOO. These are going in the trash, what a waste of money.

column9: A Faint Hint of Orange Blossom
column10: I used to order Dolfin orange blossom chocolates but they always seem out of stock or they would send me a totally different product by mistake. Finally I have found these delicious Newman's Own Organic chocolates. They have a hint of orange blossom instead of candied orange rind. The chocolate itself is superior to anything I've ever tasted. Such a pure flavor and not sour like some dark chocolates can be. Everything in this bar is organic and you can really taste the difference!~The Rebecca Review
This popcorn is really good when made in one of those old-fashioned looking, theatre style popcorn makers.  Great purchase.
This is a LOT of money.  I can purchase this same thing from Dunkin Donuts storefor $11.99. I do not know who came up with this price but it is totally over priced.The coffe is great!

This kcup was pretty tasty once you get past the weird smell while brewing.  It was described as a bit "funky" by some coworkers.  I tried it out anyway and was impressed.  It's very smooth and has a nice pumpkin flavor.  It gets better as it cools.  The clove flavor is only slighty noticeable which is a very good thing.  The flavor was pretty close to pumpkin pie.  This would mix really well with a good french vanilla kcup and some cinnamon.  The flavor is light years better than the Green Mountain pumpkin spice kcup. It took me a year to get through that box.  I threw out the last few.
I normally prefer Starbucks pumpkin lattes to Dunkin donuts' but these kcups are amazing!  Won't have to make my daily Starbucks visit!

Sooooooo delicious!!!  This coffee is so good that it's almost orgasmic!  I have tried a lot of coffees and none have ever beat out DD's Original Blend...NONE.  And now I can buy it in K-cup style; it is a little pricey, but you can best believe I will scour the web for a better deal.  This stuff beats Starebuck's Sunrise Morning Blend--hands down!!!
This is the ultimate in flavored coffee. Excellent body. Enjoy it while you can. But purchase at a Dunkin Donuts if at all possible since buying elsewhere is artificially high.

column9: The only coffee I will buy for my coffee pot
column10: This coffee does not have a bite like other brands and is the best tasting coffee I have found in my travels.  I can only get it here now since all the stores I did get it have quit handling it.  Their loss of my business.  Stores complain about losing business to the net, they should carry the products we like.

column9: Beats retail and makes you happy
column10: While in college, you just need that extra push when studying or in lecture. These puppies have kept me through long exams and extensive readings. Would originally buy each bag individually at a local store, but figured buying in bulk would be cheaper. It definitely is, and I fill a mug with each bag to grab from my desk and for sharing. If you're a "Jollies" fan...this item is for you. You get 12 of those bags. and each contains enough "Jollies" (Original flavors, regular sugar, nothing fancy, just perfect) to fill a cereal bowl.

column9: Not Original, but it gets the job done. . .
column10: These are probably the greatest hard candy known to man. Which is why they have lasted years on the market without any scrutiny. They are especially great if you have an oral fixation. Just don't chew on them or your teeth will hurt. My only grip is, like many other, that I know the truth. that is that the mix you get now is not the original Jolly Rancher mix. My favorite flavor 'Lemon' was discontinued and replaced with Blue Raspberry, and there is no where on the market where you can get a lemon Jolly Rancher anymore. I figured with numerous complaints and high demand Hershey would step up and reinstate the Lemon Jolly Rancher its place among the original bag. This however is not the case and us Lemon fans have to make do with Watermelon the next best thing to the sour yellow gold. Other than that these get the job done and are a good product.
A great treat for kids. I have trouble getting rid of the apple and grape ones, though.
I use Jolly Ranchers hard candy for business and personal; have for many years. It's a favorite for all of us.
Found out, package not good for trick or treaters.  Too bad. We found something to do with it. Yum.

column9: Love it. all my family love it, delicious!
column10: Love it. all my family love it, delicious!My daughter love it, my wife love it, I love it, all my family love it.Just one word, Delicious, you must try it.

I bought a different flavor at a health food store, $7 for 4oz...I was going to order a case through my local co op, $24 for 6 packages 4oz each.  Then I went to Costco. I hope I can make it back to Costco and they still have them.

Excellent on both counts! I will purchase again, my 3 dogs really enjoyed them..plus they are safe. Dogs are happy, I am happy!

column9: My Cat always asks for MORE...

This is the best salsa ever!  I recently moved and none of the stores in my area carries it, so now I have to order it from Amazon.  My family is addicted - the other salsas just don't cut it.

Arriba Fire Roasted Mexican Salsa is outstanding. It has a peppery, smoky, roasted tomato flavor and is excellent for dipping chips, cooking, or as a toping. It does not have a lot of chucky tomatoes or peppers in it, which I prefer, but has a nice, even consistency. It is an excellent salsa - in fact it's one of the best I've tried. I prefer the hot variety, as I love spiciness, but they are all good.

I purchased this item to combine with a warm cozy throw to give to a friend for Christmas.  I thought the two together made a "warm comfort" gift for some cold, winter evening.  I actually got an unexpected bonus.  I didn't read the description carefully and thought I was purchasing 1 package with 2 cups and servings, but it is actually two full packages of 2 cups each.  So I was able to give the 2nd package to another friend.  The item looked to me to be a fun, easy thing to fix on short notice.

I ordered this and the 'Tender' steak pie on a whim after a watching a "Are You Being Served?" marathon one day. I've long been an Anglophile, and unlike some critics of Brit cuisine, I love the honest, stick to your bones quality of the food, particularly what could be termed standard pub and market fair. A good meat pie is hard to find state-side, but I've never encountered a tinned pie before so had no idea what to expect. Well consider me impressed. The tin itself was rather argumentive (more than a little muscle was needed for the can opener to do it's job), and once the lid was off the the sight that greated me was somewhat troubling - a pasty doughy disk with streaks of meat grease smeared over it. Undaunted, I resolved to follow the instructions and placed the tin on a foil lined metal tray in a preheated oven for roughly 25 minutes. The result was nothing short of miraculous. The pie came out with a puffy, flaky crust and smelling of rich, beefy gravy. The foil lining was a good call on my part - some of the gravy and a bit of grease had come out of the tin while baking, but the amount was small and the tin was hardly "messy". I left the pie undisturbed to cool for about 15 minutes, and when I finally dug in the result was a rapturous taste treat. Forkfull after forkfull of rich, meaty pie and minced veg swimming in a savory gravy made it's way into my mouth until I found myself taking a spoon to scrape up the last bits of meat, crust, and gravy clinging to the tin.Full? Yes. Satisfied? Very. Will I order again? I already have.

column9: The choice of fundraiser BBQs everywhere!
column10: Cornell Chicken marinade was developed more than 50 years ago at Cornell University to help chicken producers in NY State sell more chicken. The logic seemed to be that making chicken taste more delicious would entice people to eat more of them. Seems like a great idea to me. The professor who developed the recipe approached the task with scientific precision - the instructions he produced include measurements for marinating just a few up through several hundred chickens as well as plans to build your own BBQ pit. Pretty incredible.This is the recipe used by fire departments, political organizations, and schools throughout Central New York for their fundraisers. I didn't know it was called Cornell Chicken until after I graduated from Cornell, but when I saw the label and tried it out at home I knew I'd identified the familiar taste from many, many BBQs growing up. The bottled marinade is available at local grocery stores throughout Central New York, which is where I've bought most of mine.The base is primarily vinegar, oil, poultry seasoning, egg, salt, and pepper. I generally clean up some boneless chicken breasts, place them in a ziplock bag, then pour in enough marinade to fully coat the mean. I generally put it back in the refrigerator for at least a few hours, though I've done as little as an hour on the counter or as much as 24 hours in the refrigerator. The intensity of the flavor varies with time, naturally, but I have not found 24 hours to be over seasoned. If I've marinaded for less time I generally baste the chicken with a little more marinade while its grilling.I love the subtle flavor and the extra bit of moisture retained in the chicken. While its similar to just marinating chicken in Italian dressing, I think the flavor from this sauce is far better.

At any rate the breeder had them on Pedigree puppy food when we purchased her and though their is nothing wrong with the brand I wanted something better for her due to her early weaning. Our 2-year-old Labradoodle is fed "Castor & Pollux" which really improved her coat and stamina etc. when we switched from another brand so I bought Puppy food in the same brand. However our Vet told us that she was unfamiliar with the brand, and that she wouldn't feed it to her. Instead she recommended "Purina One Smart Blend Puppy Formula". I of course ordered a bag and stated mixing it with the Pedigree to switch Joy over slowly so as not to upset her digestive system. She has now had Diarrhea for 4 days, her stool sample shows no abnormalities and after taking her to the vet she is being treated with medicine. On reading the list of ingredients on the bag of Purina I saw it contained something called "ANIMAL DIGEST". I thought "what in the world could that be?" On searching the Internet low and behold I discovered this web site.[...]which the following came from"Since the pet food recalls I'd like to believe we've all grown a little more aware of what we're feeding our beloved pets. In this blog I'd like to call your attention to an ingredient that is so common in many lower quality foods and dog treats. Animal Digest is often included in many commercial treats and bottom of the barrel dog foods. Be prepared to be grossed out when I explain to you what this product really is! According to AAFCO (The term AAFCO stands for the Association of American Feed Control Officials; they provide regulatory guidelines for the manufacturing of pet foods) standards, Animal Digest is"Animal Digest - material which results from chemical and/or enzymatic hydrolysis of clean and un-decomposed animal tissue. The animal tissues used shall be exclusive of hair, horns, teeth, hooves and feathers, except in such trace amounts as might occur unavoidably in good factory practice and shall be suitable for animal feed."Yuck!Another expert has described Animal Digest as "a cooked-down broth which can be made from unspecified parts of unspecified animals." The animals can be collected from almost any source. There is no control set in place over quality or contamination. Any kind of animal can be included: "4-D animals" (dead, diseased, disabled, or dying before slaughter), goats, pigs, sheep, horses, rats, euthanized at animal shelters, restaurant and supermarket waste, road kill, etc.That is about as gross as it gets.Please read your bags carefully and choose treats with ingredients that you can pronounce and understand."After reading this I tossed the Purina in the trash and opened the bag of Castor & Pollux. Once again an intelligent, Professional, trained person just accepted the word of an authoritative institution i.e. the "AAFCO" as FACT and has no doubt along with untold numbers of others in her profession recommended it to her clients to put in their pets bodies.This is perhaps the microcosm to the macrocosm that is today's America. We-the-People have just taken the word of all our institutions and so called leaders unquestioningly. Look where it has gotten us! I may not be able to change that unfortunate fact of human nature but I can change Joy's nutritional intake and have despite the increased cost. Sometimes you do get what you pay for. I highly recommend Amazon.com but do your dogs a favor and buy the Castor & Pollux for them or some other quality brand instead of one containing "Animal Digest"

For many years now, we have been able to enjoy real Italian prosciutto in the United States, but its close relative, salame, has been denied to us. For those of us who know about such things, American-made salame has been far, far off the mark, and barely worth eating. Now, while no real Italian products can yet be imported, three brands have filled the gap. Fra Mani, from the Napa Valley, is a good approximation, though unduly expensive, and Volpi from Saint Louis strikes close to the mark at a fair price. The real success story, however is Columbus of San Francisco, whose Artisan Collection is a joy. Salame, referred to in Italy by the broader term "salumeria", is a large family of superb dry-cured sausages, ranging from the tiny Cacciatorino (hunter's sausage) with its spicy and gamey taste, to Finocchiona, the Tuscan salame subtly flavored with fennel, to Soppressata, a coarse-grained delight from central Italy, and finally Felino, the incomparable Lombard specialty named for its town of origin. All these are now made by Columbus, and match the quality of their Italian counterparts. Try any one of them, and the illusion of false salame will be forever banished! Better still, fill a large platter with iced cantaloupe wedges, drape them with tissue-thin slicess of real prosciutto from Parma, and decorate the edges with medium-thick slices of one or more of the salami I have mentioned, and your friends and family will know true gourmet bliss!

I have always favoured glass over plastic -- or metal -- especially as regards dishes and enclosures for food products.  When I chanced upon BIONATURAE TOMATO PASTE in glass jars, here on Amazon, I thought .... "Hmmm...this might be something I'd like.... Glass jars, 7 ounces of tomato paste in each, (rather than the 6 ounces that's the usual capacity for small, metal cans of tomato paste)....organic....I might like this!" The fact that they spelt their brand name "BIONATURAE" made it seem good as well -- I've always been a fan of delightfully old-fashined "ae" spellings of words.  So, I bought some!WHAT'S INSIDE....AND OUTSIDE..  It's very convenient to be able to resear the glass jar, and this is mentioned on the label! It's organic, all right -- and from Italy, as well!  And, (at least as far as the stereotype goes), Italians should know tomato paste, right?Yes, they do. But, being from Italy, this is a slightly different type of tomato paste than that which I am used to buying and eating in the USA.  Although the label says it contains "tomatos", and nothing else, I found the consistancy of the Bionaturae tomato sauce SLIGHTLY more watery than the soft-frosting-like consistanc I usually find in American tomato pastes.  This very-slightly more watery consistency does have advantages, though: it's easier to take out of the can...er, glass jar...and easier to mix with milk or water, or with whatever else you want to mix it.I use tomato paste as a hopefully-inexpensive way to make my own tomato soup, and tomato sauce -- and sometimes, (thought not very often), as a snack, all by itself!  So, before I made either tomato sauce or tomato soup, I tasted a teaspoon or so, right from the jar, to judge the flavour.  Again, there was a difference from American tomoato pastes: it was slightly less sweet.  (I guess they use a different type of tomato, for "sugar" is NOT an ingredient in this, or any other tomato paste I have bought.)  So, all by itself, being less sweet, it makes a far less satisfying snack.  However, I realize not many people use tomato paste as a snack, so -- except for the very small part of the tomato-paste buying population, such as myself, who do like to snack on tomato paste -- this isn't too impotant a factor.However, I was pleasantly surprised and delighted when I added ht water and milk to approximately half the jar (3 1/ 2 ounces), of this new tomato paste, added just three Splenda packets, warmed it up, and made myself about 20 ounces of tomato soup.  It tasted far more like the Campbell's tomato soup I used to drink, than tomato soup made with other brands of tomato paste I have bought -- but without any additives, preservatives, or chemicals, of course!  (I drank my nice warm tomato soup near bedtime, as I've read -- in The Green Pharamacy Guide to Foods, also available here on Amazon -- is a great way to get yourself to sleep on sleepless nights!)It was the same when I used Bionaturae Tomato Paste as a base for my home-made tomato sauce, to use over pasta!  It had, somehow, a more "tomato-sauce-like" flavour than the tomato sauce I have made with other tomato pastes.  Plus, of course -- in making both the tomato soup, and tomato sauce -- the slighly more liquid consistency of this particular tomato paste made it easier to mix with milk and water.  Less milk and water for the tomato sauce, more milk and water for the tomato soup.So, in the end, this "extra-ounce, in a glass jar" organic tomato paste is not half-bad.  I don't recommend it for those (few( others who, like me, may like to have a small can -- or glass jar -- of tomato paste as a a occasional snack.  For cooking, however, it seems an ideal little concentrate.  And concentrates -- which allow one to add one's own dilutantes, (usually water, milk, and/or seasonings), are usually a great way to save some money, not to mention eliminating chemical or other unwanted, extraneious ingredients!  It's called BIONATURAE for good reasons!  : ),

column9: Far and a way the "Best Buy" in truffle oil
column10: "Full strength" truffle oils (as opposed to olive oils that claim to have truffle flavor but are much weaker) often cost $6-$10 per ounce, so you'd better hope you're getting a far superior product to this one to pay several times as much.  For the most part, you aren't.No matter what they call it (truffle flavor, truffle essence, natural flavors related to the truffle) all "truffle oils" - every single one of them - use fake flavoring, specifically 2,4-dithiapentane.  This is the main flavor compound found in truffles, similar to how vanillin is the main component of vanilla beans but can be made artificially.  A few oils do contain tiny amounts of real truffles, but it's just for show; a "pure" truffle oil would require hundreds of dollars worth of white truffle just to make a few ounces of flavored oil.If all truffle oils rely on the same compound that can be made relatively cheaply and consistently, how do the "better" truffle oils justify the higher price?  First, they package them in fancy looking tiny bottles.  Second, they use Italian olive oil as the base oil.  The goal is to suggest (falsely) that the truffle flavor comes from real Italian truffles.So while it's true that some truffle oils taste better than others, this is mostly (perhaps entirely) due to the quality of the oil used.  La Tourangelle uses organic safflower oil, which is nearly flavorless.  On its own, it does tastes more "chemically" than olive-oil based oils.  If it took a lot of truffle oil to flavor a dish, this might be a serious weakness.  But in reality it takes just a few drops to flavor a dish, so you're usually going to add additional fat anyway.  You can put your savings towards the premium oil of your choice.  Besides, in some dishes (eggs or mushrooms cooked in butter), you might not want olive oil flavor anyway.One caution/tip: like wine, "truffle essence" oxidizes and changes flavor.  So unless you plan to use the whole bottle within a month or two, it's best to keep the air out.  I filled several glass "airline size" whiskey bottles with the oil and use one at a time.  I also keep the bottles in the refrigerator, as heat and light speed up oxidation.
