I honestly have to say if you have trouble sleeping you should give Neuro Sleep a try!

column9: You don't need no stinkin' SLEEPing Pill...you need some NEURO SLEEP!!!
column10: Who would've thought this would work? Yet it does, time and time again! Couldn't believe it the first time I tried it, so purchased a case via Amazon's Subscribe & Save for $25.50 (delivered to my door). Best price I've found to date. Have recommended to friends and all have praised the benefits of this drink...

column9: Tasty and gives a good night's sleep
column10: Product works well except after drinking a full bottle I invariably have to get up during the night to use the bathroom :-)

I was at the local gas station really late last night (well, actually really early this morning) and decided to pick one of these up. I was tired but could not get settled to sleep. I got home, popped it open, drank it and in 30 minutes I was OUT. This is totally rare for me because I don't sleep well and I sleep very lightly. I slept like a rock after drinking this and I will most definently be picking up more. The taste wasn't amazing but it wasn't aweful either, reminded me of diluted Tang but when I was drinking it, I couldn't get enough of it.

column9: Helped me sleep, until it made my heart race
column10: This is a product I doubt I'd normally have tried, but a hotel we were staying at provided complementary bottles of it in the room. My son had opened and tasted it the first night; I didn't want it to go to waste, so I drank the bottle. And I slept very well that night, falling asleep within half an hour of drinking the Neuro Sleep and getting a solid eight or so hours sleep. Since it worked, I tried again the next night and that worked well, too. I then used it for a third night and woke up with my heart racing at about four in the morning and it took two or three hours to get back to sleep.I have a history of leg cramps. In the past, a friend had recommended I take a magnesium supplement to fend off the cramps and it had worked. But a few days after starting with the magnesium regimin, I started noticing that my heart would periodically start racing. It took me a couple of weeks - getting more and more concerned about a possible heart condition - before I connected it to the magnesium. I stopped taking the magnesium and within a few days the racing heart effect had disappeared. In the morning after my third night with Neuro Sleep, I looked into the ingredients and, sure enough, Neuro Sleep contains magnesium, to prevent muscle cramps.I won't take Neuro Sleep again, because I'm apparently sensitive to the magnesium in it. If you don't have a bad reaction to magnesium, though, this product may be for you. As for me, I may start mixing a homebrew cocktail of Melatonin and 5HTP, the other active ingredients, because I really did sleep well after drinking this.

So I'm the biggest skeptic, I bought this stuff thinking it probably wouldn't do much to be... boy was I wrong. 15 minutes after downing the bottle, I was knocked out. This stuff game me some pretty weird dreams, and I woke up the next morning feeling a little too relaxed. Still feeling the effects 12 hours later, good thing I have my coffee.

I was very skeptical of this product, but I purchased it since the Neuro representatives were so friendly. As per their warning, I did not try it until I got home that evening.I sat down at the computer and started chatting with a few out-of-state friends and my husband, who was also out-of-state. I opened the bottle and started absently sipping, as I would the ever-present glass of water on my desk. Nobody was curious about what I was drinking (through virtue of Google's Hangout) until I said, "Whoa...I need to stop drinking this." I was halfway through the bottle, and my head was feeling heavy. Upon inquiry, I showed my friends the bottle and they looked it up. Being the geeks we are, they recited the ingredients and laughed, "Of course this is going to make you sleepy!"  I retaliated, "I didn't read the label because this stuff NEVER works!"Well, it does work.  And I didn't experience the groggy hang-over I get from Tylenol PM. If they'd sell in glass bottles, this line would be perfect.

This product gets 4 stars because it ZONKED me to sleep. However, I have been having issues with sleeping only a few hours at a time. I know most of sleep is psychological and I'm trying to figure that out. So it didn't help with keeping me asleep like some of the other people claimed it did to them, but WOW it kicks in at about 15 min after consumption and it hits you like a ton of bricks. I am weaning off of a lot of sleeping medication so I was looking for something natural. This product can give you that- 'i'm ready for bed' feeling that I don't get too easily!

I am a big fan of the entire Nuero line of drinks.. The sleep KNOCKS me out.. and it tastes great.. many times I do not even have to drink the whole bottle before i feel the effects.. better then ambian!

Like everyone on here I always have a hard time sleeping. Maybe 2-4 hours a night. I hate sleeping pills and have tried everything natural. The first time I tried this I was soothed into peaceful sleep. I had really awesome dreams too. Slept 8 hours. The 2 most important things about this drink1. I actually slept through the entire night (which never happens)2. I didn't feel groggy at all in the morning.I use it once or twice a week now. The store near my house just had them on sale for $1.99 a bottle! Good deal for a good night's sleep.You should seriously consider trying this if you have trouble with sleeping.

column9: It doesn't seem like it should work.... but it does.
column10: I was skeptical of this when I came across it at FreshDirect.  I mean . . . it's a drink.  I've tried prescription sleep pills (which make me groggy the next day), melatonin (which doesn't always work) and OTC medications (which don't always work).  After reading the reviews on here, I figured I would give it a try.  Well, after a few months, it is now the only thing that reliably puts me to sleep and makes me refreshed the next day.  I suppose the ingredients just work with my body chemistry in a way that other supplements and drugs just don't.After having several sleepless nights when I ran out, I finally bought a monthly delivery subscription.  I might not trust homeopathy and holistic medicine as a whole, but you can't argue with results.

So much better than pills or tea.  This has a natural Melatonin hormone.  I was skeptical, but I tired one for an evening and it worked great.  So much in fact I bought a case.  If you are looking for a good night sleep this is worth a shot or a bottle rather.  After drinking the tasty liquid you will feel a bit sleepy - just lay down and then Wham!  See you in the AM.  No groggy hang-over feeling and some pretty nice dreams too.  Give it a try - I highly recommend it.

column9: It does work to help you sleep, but...
column10: No doubt about it - this stuff puts you to sleep very quickly, however it caused me to have a pounding headache. I noticed the headache about 10-15 minutes after drinking it. I didn't particularly mind at first since I was half asleep anyway (which was a big feat in and of itself). This product also doesn't last the entire night, so I woke up 4 hours later and the headache was worse. Nothing would ease it. It was a strange headache - like a sore, pounding feeling would best describe it. I put a warm compress on my head, took my Ambien and was off in la-la land for the rest of the night. In the morning, the headache was still there, but not as bad. It was gone by noon.I tried it 2 nights later to see if it was a coincidence and the same thing happened. So, for me, Neuro Sleep isn't worth it. It could possibly be a contender if it kept me asleep for at least 8 hours, but it doesn't. Looks like I need to find something else to help me get off Ambien.(Also, the taste is not particularly great either!)

This has been a wonderful product. My grandmother has bad insomnia we tried several prescription sleep aids that did not work. This drink has her sleeping regularly with no drowsiness in the morning. Great product!!

column9: Trouble Sleeping? Neuro Sleep is the answer.
column10: I first tried the Neuro drinks from a local gas station. Bliss was the first one I tried, and it was amazing how well it actually worked (but that's for another review); so, based on that knowledge, I was more than happy to try Neuro Sleep.I've always had trouble getting to sleep. I will go to bed and lie awake for over half an hour every night. Not necessarily enough to be considered an insomniac, but certainly annoying. I'd always tried to find a fix. Tylenol PM, warm milk, etc. Nothing ever got me to sleep any quicker. Until now.Neuro Sleep is something you drink about 20 or 30 minutes before bedtime. It tastes great (has kind of an orange-y taste to it), and isn't carbonated so it goes down quick if you want it to or are thirsty. Within a few minutes, you begin to feel a little drowsy. By about 20 minutes, you're ready for bed (assuming, of course, this is a normal bedtime; if you drink it in the middle of the day, I don't expect it would put you to sleep like this). It lets me get to sleep right when I want to.All my friends always tell me the Neuro drinks are just placebo effect kinds of things, and they're not really doing anything. Well, I did some research, and Neuro Sleep is armed with 3mg of melatonin, which is a chemical naturally produced by the (normal) body to help put you to sleep. So this one, at least, really does work.I recommend trying it out from a gas station before laying down the money for a case, but hey, I eventually caved in and got myself a case, so maybe you will too.

Haven't slept for 6 months due to bursitis and back. Tried this once, and it worked. The problem was the next day I was so tired I felt faint. It doesn't say how much melatonin is in it...and that can be risky as it can ruin your body and make it ineffective on its own production of that. I would suggest half a bottle. Serving size should say 2 not 1. I think they don't have the formula right yet.....need to make it only last 8-9 hours....not 20, and should post the level of ingredients. Aren't they liable if they don't? What are the long term effects? I've heard magnesium can cause heart racing.  ??  Has this been tested wisely by FDA?? I hope this is a safe product. I will try it for a week and then decide. I hope I am not risking my health...the site picture of the developers makes me worry....they look kinda creepy and not very professional. Also have heard reports of headaches from this. I just got one at 7PM, and I took this at 11:30PM last night. Still very tired as if I was drugged. Feel faint. Seems dangerous to me...but will try more out of desperation. Half a bottle this time. I am 325Lbs and wonder how this would affect a petit person! There also should be warning labels about taking this with medications, etc....  I have been taking anti inflamitory medicine Dyclofenac. This can make you a bit dizzy. It doesn't for me....but maybe this Combo is what caused the drugged feeling. I see groggy complaints from others though! You should not feel groggy the next day but refreshed instead. The affect of this lasts too long!!! Many feel groggy the next day. This product has great potential...but they need to organize it better with proper Info. and the formula---This could be dangerous to some. I can see lawsuits coming. It feels like when you take 3 Benedryl. Too powerful for shelf product. Bottle should state 2 servings, not 1! I paid $2 at Vons and would not pay more---too pricey if you have to use it all the time. I suggest putting it at $1.59 ea.---you will make more profit due to volume.

Since they have changed the bottle packaging, I swear they have changed the formula.  I've been drinking the Neuro Sleep for more than a year.  The last few months I've ordered from Amazon through the subscribe and save insteaed of getting it at my local gas station.  I use to get sleepy within 15 mins of drinking a bottle, even half.  Now I can drink a whole bottle of this one and it does near nothing.  I am very disappointed.  The new packaging is a plastic cover for the entire bottle, it use to be imprinted on the bottle.  I get it if its to save money, I just wished it was the same product!

column9: Knocked me out and left me aching
column10: I was curious so I bought one at the store and waited for a night where I had nothing to do and could sleep as late as I wanted.  Nyquil knocks me out, I need 6-8 hours of free time to sleep with it so I didn't want to take my chances with this.  45 minutes after I finished the bottle I felt loopy and needed to sleep.  4 hours later I woke up with a massive head ache.  It knocked me out big time, but now I have a bad head ache.  I may keep a bottle in the fridge for a long night, but there's no way I would drink this on a regular basis, my head hurts way too much now.

Bought this for my wife. She tried half a bottle to start, still had trouble falling asleep and woke up in the middle of the night sweat with her heart racing and very uncomfortable. Product is NOT returnable. If you try this and you don't like it or have problems you are out of luck.

Holy crap, I bought this as just an experiment to see if it even did anything. It tastes a little strange, like it was watered down, but about an 30 min to an hour after I was starting to feel the drowsiness and nearly fell asleep like 3 times. I didn't even drink the whole bottle, I'm saving it for a little before bed xD seriously, this just works

I've been using Dream Water but they seemed to have discontinued their 8oz bottles. The 2.5oz size just doesn't do it for me. I pay $2.48 for 2.5oz of Dream Water. Neuro, at $30.00 for a 12 pack of 14.5oz bottles is just $2.50 each, but I get "580%"! more product for two extra cents. That would mean Neuro is only 43 cents per 2.5oz compared to Dream Water's $2.48. This is a no brainer price wise. If it works as good as the reviewers say then it's a homerun!I will update after I receive my order.Update: Found some at various stores and it works as advertised...Homerun!
Product did not work as advertised.  Don't waste your money.  Plus drinking a 14.5 oz of bottle to try to get to sleep is not good.

I literally drank this 15 mins ago and i can assure you it works. Legit. For about a month i have not been able to go to sleep right away. I would just lay in bed and stare into darkness while my dog looks super comfy sleeping next to me! I am about to go to bed now because i am totallly relaxed and ready for my bed to take me away :)

column9: Tastes Great - Not Sure How Effective
column10: I ordered this on recommendation from a friend; it tastes good and goes down easily. I'm not sure if i notice much of an effect when i drink this - it actually has made me a little groggy and slow moving in the mornings. I probably wont try again; if you can find a store that sells singles in your area i suggest picking one up and seeing if it works for your situation.

column4: Writer of Books - Mage - Mom to Two "Writer, ...
column9: Insomniac here. This is good for non-major sleep issues for sure.
column10: I am very (VERY, VERY) familiar with all sorts of sleep meds and other items. Just as a background, I've had severe insomnia since I was a child. I have used OTC things (Melatonin, Diphenhyrdamine, Unisom, Magnesium, calcium, Valerian, chamomile, etc) and several scripts (Ambien, Trazadone etc) and I'll be honest, wine :)  I feel the wine works the best but is the most expensive. I get off/on again results with the OTC items, especially Valeran and Melatonin combined.So, last night I skipped the OTC stuff and drank this Neruosleep drink. First, the taste was not pleasant, it was like a vitamin drink..a strong one. I had no issues drinking it at all, but it's not like 'mmm, this tastes yum.." After about 20 minutes, I had that groggy feeling that sooo many get sooo easily, all their lives. I LIVE for that groggy feeling and spend a lot of money chasing it!Ultimately I was awake most of the night, but the groggy feeling lasted about an hour. I think at this price point, this would be a good once-in-a-while grab, kind of the nemesis for Red Bull :D  For hardcore insomniacs like myself, it's meh.I hope this helps!

column9: Beware if you are prone to heartburn
column10: This has citric acid in it and it is carbonated - a recipe for heartburn.  If you have acid reflux or are prone to heartburn - this will only serve to keep you up at night with bad heartburn.  It definitely makes you sleepy - so if you don't have issues with acid reflux, give it a try.  But if you do have heartburn issues, try Dream Water Snoozeberry , Sleep & Relaxation Shots 6x2.5 Oz Shots instead.

I have a really hard time going to sleep at night (5 or 6 am) and I almost never wake up in the middle of the night.I bought this and started drinking it. The taste was good. Nothing amazing but I didn't mind it at all. Had about two sips (like 1/8 of the bottle) and stopped cause I had to stay awake for my class (7pm). During the entire class I felt really drowsy. strange considering I didn't drink much of it. I was also eating sweetarts, so when I started to get a headache I thought it was cause of to much sugar. After class I got home, drank the rest of the bottle and crashed before midnight. which is very rare for me, so I was happy and continued to ignore my headache. I slept for about 5 hours before I woke up with an even worse headache. I've had headaches like this before when I was younger but this one was slightly different. Like, I can't really explain it. My stomach wasn't to happy either. felt like i had to puke. I took some naproxen sodium (all i could find) and went back so sleep for another 4 hours. I woke up feeling totally fine.

Picked this up at a CVS ($2.79) because I needed to wake up early in the morning for a meeting, which meant going to sleep earlier than usual. I'm a very small girl, so I drank half the bottle. It was a pleasant citrus flavor, and I started feeling the effects after 8 minutes. After 20 minutes, I was in bed because my body was starting to feel limp (which I guess is what people mean by "relaxed" in all these reviews).That was the extent of it though. My mind was still racing, worrying about meetings, deadlines, work, an upcoming interview, etc. All the while, I couldn't roll over because my body was limp and it felt like too much effort to move. I still ended up lying in bed awake for a couple of hours (which is standard for me).Waking up was a terrible experience. I felt groggy and could barely get myself going. That could have been a combination of the lingering affects of the melatonin and the lack of sleep from lying awake at night. Not sure if this is something I would invest more money in.

I bought a 12 pack of the Neuro Sleep based on reading reviews of the product.  Silly me...should have walked away.  This products has a pleasant taste but doesn't do diddly squat for helping me get to sleep.  This was an utter and complete waste of 30 some dollars for the 12 pack.

I was really excited to try this. Saw it at a gas station and picked it up along with the neuro bliss.It didn't taste like butthole to me like it did to another reviewer, however, it didn't do the job.I took the drink around 11pm and I did feel something soon after. I was drowsy and relaxed, almost like I drank some wine or smoked.I was happy that I was feeling this way because I figured that this meant I'd be going to bed pretty soon. I got in bed, and immediately, it all went away.I ended up being awake till 430am.Disappointed. At least it didn't taste like ass tho.

I ordered 30 of the sleep. I have insominia. This drink doesnt do anything special. If you have no trouble sleeping, I can see a good sleep. I drank about 1 1/2 of these and it made me sleep for about 4 hours till i woke up. Pills have this same effect on me, and there cheaper. The ingredient is melatonin that makes you relax and sleep. You can find melatonin pills online for cheap. drink taste like butthole BTW...

column4: Another Dispatch from the Tree House
column9: Great Hard to Find Low Salt & Low Fat Chip
column10: Usually, if you see a low salt chip, the manufacturer amps up the fat content. Conversely, a low fat chip is usually overloaded with even more salt than the manufacturer's regular product version. With only 2g fat and 26 mg sodium per serving, the Guiltless Gourmet Unsalted Yellow Corn Tortilla Chips offer a rare combination of both low salt & low fat. Plus, they are very tasty when used for dipping.

Our dog has destroyed nearly every other toy we have given her. So far, this Dino bone and the kong are the only two that have lasted.I would recommend this toy for anyone who has a dog who is a heavy chewer.

It has been 2-3 years since we last bought these apple chips.  Our recollection was of a nice crisp apple slice with the crunch of a potato chip.  The cinnamon sugar had a slightly sweet taste.So when our box full of these apple chips arrived we all grabbed a bag expecting a great treat!How disappointing... 2 months later they are still setting in the pantry.The chips are still crispy.  Other than that, the taste is bland and you have to eat around that hull which surrounds the seeds when the apple is still an apple.  Now that the hull is dried and sliced, it is very easy for the smaller kids to choke on, so we don't dare to even give this to the toddlers.On the good side...  these are very expensive and we will save alot of money by not buying any more!

column9: Nueske's Smokehouse Bacon.... Seriously good stuff
column10: If you are a bacon head, here is your bait:  Nueske's cherrywood or applewood smoked bacon.  Pricey?  Yes.  Worth it?  Well. we sure think so.  This is NOT your typical grocery store off the shelf stuff whether peppered, thick cut or what have you.. This is custom made bacon and it is different than the grocery store fare.  Share it or savor it for yourself...  I think it needs to be shared personally, but I am not everyone.  Enjoy it and keep a bit on hand for those special times when just regular stuff won't quite do.

This is a fantastic product.  I even use it for regular wheat bread.  Everything pops right out.  I used to have so much trouble with my pumpkin bread sticking using the regular Spectrum canola oil spray.  I found this by chance locally one day and it was really expensive but so worth the money.  Then I couldn't find it anymore. I once again turned to Amazon and there it was.  It was through a third party vendor.  I NEVER use a third party with Amazon.  I like dealing directly with Amazon and whenever I read complaints  it is usually complaints about third party vendors.  Well, I was so desperate for this baking spray with flour that I was willing to purchase it from coloradobargains.  Even with the shipping fee it was still  less than what I paid before and more importantly I could actually find it.  I was very happy to get six cans.  I expect by the end of Christmas baking I'll need more and I definitely will purchase from this company again.  The price was great, the shipping quick, the product fantastic.  If you bake, this is the product for you.While this is not organic, according to Spectrum's website they don't use GMO products even in their non-organic line.

I specifically aked if this product was made in America. My guess is because the American Flag is displayed on the the back I was told yes. This product is made in China. It gave my dogs diarrhea. It seems that each piece of chicken has a different consistency. I have used "Happy Hips" Chicken in the past and will do so again in the future. I give CHICKLES 1/2 Star.

column9: Dark Oolong with a lot of flavor & color
column10: This is a dark Oolong. It has a lot of flavor with it's own light fragrance. I make my tea with three level table spoons per 9oz. teapot. I don't let it soak too long; so there is a plenty of flavor over and over as I make additional infusions. I used hot water and the resulting tea was not bitter; but smooth. This is a good buy for the price. The leaves are not curled or rolled; but flat.
I had high hopes for this but unfortunately it wasn't that good.  Not a good flavor for a oolong.  Leaves were barklike and I actually had trouble getting them to soak up the water.
I'm re-ordering another pound of this tea.  It has a very light, generic Oolong flavor and is excellent either hot or cold.  It's become my favorite tea--and what a great price!!
Turkey will never be the same..it will be better! Very moist and flavorful! Works with chicken too!
Yumm! I had never brined a turkey before and it turned out great. Very moist and flavorful. The instructions were clear and easy to follow. Two thumbs up.
Used it for whole chickens on my Big Green Egg. Will never use anything different. Very moist and flavorful birds.

Purchased a 3 pack of this brine mix.  Followed the directions to the "T" and the turkey came out almost too salty to eat.  I do not recommend this product, however their bags are great for brining and well worth it.  We don't cook turkey very often and its usually for a special holiday occassion and I just won't risk ruining another feast by trying this stuff again.

column9: Won't cook a turkey without this!
column10: I had never made a turkey before and I certainly knew nothing about brining so when I found this product 4 years ago and decided to give it a shot. This brining mix (combined with cooking the turkey upside down so that it's self basting) ended up being the absolute best turkey that any of my family and friends had ever tasted! I have now used it 5 times with the same results. The breast meat is so moist and full of herb flavor, you'll be blown away! It's a simple process to make the brining mix, prep the turkey and get it in the fridge the day before you plan on cooking it. The instructions say that you can take it out of the brining mix and leave it in the fridge for up to 24 hrs before you cook it but I wouldn't recomment that. The one time I tried that it wasn't as good as before. I don't know why, but that was the only thing I changed so I wouldn't do it again. Time it so that when you remove it from the brine, it's going in the oven within an hour or two. Enjoy!!!
This brine is over the top!  I mixed up 1/4 of a box and brined chicken thighs for about 3 hours and cooked them on a Green Egg.  Best chicken my wife and I ever had......

I bought this on clearance from a big box store while out shopping in another town on Saturday 1/28/12.  On Sunday, my BF overcooked my turkey on the grill!!!! Urgghhh-- but this brine saved it.  Although the turkey was welllldone, the brine helped it retain its tenderness.  I drove 1 and 1/2 hours back to that town and bought five more boxes.  It has a long shelf life: 2016.

THE Brine it self is great ,BUT  what you do not find out & there is NO way TO KNOW THAT it is NOT inside this product  after you open the package, you find out, is that you need a LARGE Brine BAG to soak the whole thing in for the 24- 48 hours before baking, so then you get this2 days before Christmas day & now it is to late to order a Brine bag to use with this, & NO place in this add to order did it say it was no included?? IT would BE so helpfull to know ahead of time that this is not all you will need to do the brine ,  I know IT also will not come with a turkey, BUT you would think for the price it would have a bag, BUT the truth of this is , THAT it is still great Brine  JUST hard to use IF you do not know what you will need,  Thank YOU for ASKING< A GRANDMA THAT FOUND another way TO SOAK THIS BIRD,when you do not have a BAG!!!!
I first tried this brine in 2010 when we fried a turkey for Thanksgiving.  It was the best turkey.  The flavor and moistness of the turkey was spectacular.  I highly recomment this product.

Once I found Turkey Perfect Herb Brine Mix, I will never make another turkey any other way.  This is hands down the BEST Turkey every.  Now I have to make a bigger bird every year because there is never enough leftovers.  Buying a mix that is ready to go is not only the easiest way to do it, it is also the least expensive because buying individual herbs are expensive.

column9: If you want a perfectly seasoned Turkey for Thanksgiving or Christmas!
column10: I was shocked how flavorful the Turkey came out, my family was happy, the neighbors I invited were really happy.It's up to you to cook the turkey properly, but this will get you started on the right foot with seaonsing the turkey.I cooked a 17lb. turkey in the oven, marinated the turkey over night in a cooler with some ice on top of the brine bag.You must be careful with the remaining brine, it will definately clog your sink up if you dump it in there.But if you follow the directions to the letter, you will be alright and have a wonderful turkey.

I'm not crazy about the flavor combination, but the food is decent and healthy even though it has too much salt. Pinto beans, brown rice, and spices. Per can: 420 calories, total fat 3.5g, trans fat 0g, sodium 910mg (38% RDA), total carbs 77g, fiber 10g, protein 14g, (<1g sugar per serving with 3.5 servings per can).

I never before found a can that combines brown rice, per say, and beans. You heat it up and add some tasty choice of Beef, Fowl, Seafood or Veggies and you have a standard meal ready to be consumed. I have come to appreciate Eden Organic. Yes, I admit that I usually add a little more salt, pepper and herbs but in the end they do taste very good. I initially was looking for the beans alone but when I read the label and since I only use brown rice now a days, we gave this combination a shot and for us, it paid off! I can cook all manners of legumes, beans, etc but hey, if a nice organic company wants to do it for a while for an acceptable price, why not? For sure 4 Stars or even higher, they are reliable fare but for a couple of weird reasons we ended up with 6 cases of different kinds so we are still figuring how are we going to consume so much since most of the times we are only 2 people. That is the beauty of canned food, I guess, that it does keep longer and well. 4 Stars!

column9: excellent food staple for students away from home
column10: While searching for some healthy and tasty food for my son who is in the 10th grade far from home, I came across Eden's selections of legumes and grains.  No longer does my son have to get sick eating cafeteria food laden with sugar, fat, salt, and white flour which makes him ill.  He's feeling great and enjoys the taste of this particular selection: Spanish Rice & Beans.  It is tasty, wholesome, kosher, filling, and shelf stable.  I sooo appreciate AMAZON's subscription arrangement that not only delivers this food when my son needs it, but at such an excellent price! Thank You! G-d Bless you!

You can't go wrong with most of the Eden rice and beans. I like to add my own seasonings like extra cayenne and garlic and it makes these taste delicious while providing a good amount of sustenance of complex proteins. Many canned goods these days contain health damaging BPA which should be avoided if possible. I wish more companies were as responsible and authentic as Eden Organic. Customer for life here.

column9: I love it, but I still add to it...
column10: I've tried several Eden Rice and Bean varities, with the Spanish Rice&Beans being my favorite. Next, in no particular order are the Mexican, the Caribbean, the Curried, the Cajun and the Black Bean & Quinoa Chili.While they're all very good as is, I like to tinker and add ingredients, usually 7 or 8 oz. of black beans, an equivalent quantity of diced tomatoes, and a tablespoon of bacon bits. Sometimes I add a tablespoon of diced garlic, a few drops of "A Taste of Thai" hot sauce, sometimes some picante sauce, as the mood takes me...

column9: yummy spicy, somewhat sweet and tasty ramen noodles.
column10: The BBQ Chicken Mi Goreng flavor packs on the heat...and just right for those who like their food on the intense side. It has lots of packets of flavor including a spicy chili oil and soy sauce and some msg-powdered seasoning and hot chili powder and even dehydrated fried onions as garnish.It is subtly sweet and the spicy-heat just hits you in every bite and the flavors all merge into deliciousness. This is a flavor unlike any asian bistro cooking, and yet, it's so-oooooooooooo so, so good.I must admit that I have often wanted to find other flavors that were just as tasty and spicy and have only found 1 that is nearly as tasty but it's not a similar sweet-n-hot-savory, it's got heat but it's very different. (see my other ramen noodle review)

column9: Taste ok. No effect.  A lot of fake reviewers on this product.
column10: Got absolutely nothing from it.  It did taste decent, not worth $2.50 for the bottle, but at least it didn't taste like crap AND do nothing.This comment will probably get pushed down quickly; It looks like whoever is selling this product does the thing where whenever a somewhat negative review appears, they quickly create some accounts and give this a 5 star rating and vote helpful for all of the other previous fake 5-star comments.  The way you can usually tell is go threw and click the link that says "see all my reviews" by the 5 star comments; on many of them you will see this is the only product they have ever rated.  That's pretty fishy.

I was somewhat in the dumps today because I am on a diet and I was feeling deprived, so I JUST NOW decided to try this drink on a whim and I finished my whole bottle. I looked up on Amazon to see if there were reviews for this product and other folks were saying that it was ineffective. And initally I was going to say the same thing, but right before I was clicking on 1 star to review the product, this "warm & fuzzy" feeling came over me, definitely not BLISSFULL, but warm and fuzzy. So I say this crap works. It takes a few seconds to kick in, but it did.(and I bet people are already thinking to themselves "yea yea, you probably work for the company") but I don't...I can't prove it...but I don't.I will probably be purchasing another bottle of this stuff in the near future.

column9: Don't believe everything you read, but read this anyway.
column10: I'm a miserable jerk, and have no manners, temperance,or patience.  I have a crap job installing heavy equipment in filthy cardboard box factories.  I work everyday for months at a time and travel all over the country.  I thoroughly hate my job.  It's hard and dirty.  At the end of the day I'm usually going nuts about wanting to leave.Anyway, one day I'm on break, smoking a cigarette and having a complaint filled temper tantrum when I decide to go into the store and get a drink.  I see this stuff, and I figure what can it hurt.  If nothing else it will get this cigarette taste out my mouth.  So I buy it and chug it and get back to work.  It wasn't 10 minutes later, I was calm as falling snow.  I don't complain about wanting to leave early.  I don't yell at people.  I don't even want to sucker-punch my coworkers, and they deserve it.  I bought one for every guy on the crew the next day, and we all swear by them now.It's not like a drug, so don't expect your mind to get blown, and different things work differently for different people.  It could have just been a placebo effect, but I'm genuinely happier as a result of this product, so I suggest it.And if you're fat like my boss, you need to drink 2 to get the same effect.

I like this product, really I do.  Yes, I do notice that it acts like a little "pick me up" when I drink it.  Nothing drastic, but it's there and the feeling is pleasant.  Having said that, the price is just too much.  It's a drink, not medicine and I can probably find similar ingredients in a supplement for less money.  Drop the price, guys, and you will get more buyers!

I'm sure that NeuroBliss won't work for everyone because people have different body chemistries.  I suffer with anxiety and depression, but I hate being on prescription medication.  So I'm always on the hunt for healthier alternatives.  I discovered the Neuro products through a friend and decided to try them.  For me, NeuroBliss is a miracle.  If I'm having a bad emotional day, even just a few sips of this product and I'm immediately calmer.  Is it the placebo effect?  Who knows.  For the moment though, this product works for me.  Yes, it's a bit pricey which is why I only use it when I have a desperate need.  My only complaint is that it contains sucralose, which I'm not a fan of.  But the benefits I get from the product overrules the sucralose issue.  Not being a fan of carbonated drinks, I like that it's "lightly carbonated."  The taste is a light citrus flavor - very similar to Fresca.  If you're curious about this product, I would recommend purchasing 1 bottle as a test before buying a case of it.

column9: Yummy drink, helps me prevent migraines & low in sugar.
column10: This drink is pleasant, perhaps due to the fizzy slightly sweet taste. It doesn't have that high sugar content other drinks have. What's more, it's helped me whenever I feel a migraine headache coming in. Now I order it by the case because it isn't cheap at the stores, nor is easy to find. I have read some of the reviews here where people claim it doesn't work for them. I understand everyone is different. I'm just lucky that it works for me and it does the job.

I bought this in a Long Island gas station was amazed by the taste for only 35 calories! I then had to buy some online to see maybe one bottle day would effect my mood. I had one everyday for about two weeks and although tasty and low calorie, I did not see any effect on my mood. If it were cheaper, I would buy it just to drink daily whether or not it made me 'blissful' but at about 2.50 a bottle, it's just not worth it.

I indulge in a lot of caffeine and came across this one day in the store.  Skeptical, the bottle was cool so I tried it really not looking for much.  It taste suprisingly good and its smooth.  It gives you a relaxed feeling as if nothing can get you down and it gives a low-mild euphoria feeling without feeling tired.  I know what euphoris feels like from taking other things in life...but this being healthy is a good alternative and after trying one bottle I tried two 2day and Im relaxed and actually felt like posting on here because I feel really good and positive about things right now after consuming 2 bottles.  Not a waste of money..probably will be very popular soon....this works..5hr power works and I am very picky abt what I take to relax and get or get goin...hope my review helps....

I work swing shift at work- And have one of these around 10pm ( two hours before I get off ) They make me chipper and improve my mood!! And I love the taste, kinda like seven up ... I call this my happy drink and will continue to drink :)

I found NeuroBliss in a gas station.  I was already in an okay mood, but, I thought this might give me a boost.  The flavor is a bit like mineral water and grapefruit.  Fresca light I call it.  It is better very cold.  I drank the entire bottle and about ten minutes later I really did feel better.  I am already on an antidepressant so I am always trying anything I can to stay in a good mood.  I don't think it is mind over matter.  I really was in a better mood. I was laughing and singing and cutting up with my husband. We had a very good day all day.  I am so glad to find these here since it is a very long drive from where I live to purchase them. I will definitely buy the Neurobliss and will be trying some of the other drinks, too.

column9: You go from -_- to :D. Euphoria in a bottle. HOWEVER...
column10: I tried Neruo Bliss on a whim and I am really, really impressed. It's a great, probably healthy alternative to soda and it really does work like it says.The situation: I'm almost 17, 6'4", football player build but skeletal, as I get absolutely no exercise. Relatively healthy diet. I bought Bliss with my lunch at an upscale-ish convenience store (Wawa, if you happen to recognize the name). It was a relatively "gloomy" day, overcast and it felt like it was going to rain. I took my lunch to an Atlanta Bread Company store to eat.Bliss had a refreshing citrus-y taste. It quenched my thirst, and I had some rather dry food with me. I felt it kick in almost immediately. Bliss provides a warm, fuzzy euphoric feeling, kind of like when your favorite song comes on the radio. There was definitely a spring in my step for the next hour or so. I felt cheerful, happy with the world, ect. Interestingly, I found a used Nintendo DS for exactly the same price that I had earned babysitting the previous weekend while "high", so maybe Bliss is lucky or something.The "high" is a focused lightheartedness. You want to jump up and punch the air if something good happens, listen to loud sing-along music, ect. I had a spirited and amusing conversation with a Gamestop employee about my lack of rewards cards. It's caffeine-free, too, which is awesome given that I'm unfortunately a caffeine addict. The euphoric sensation kind of wears off after the first hour, but you still feel energetic and rather cheerful. I even went to the orthodontist and walked out with a small grin. It was potent enough that I could tell it was not a placebo.HOWEVER, there are a few cons to this drink. First of all, it's quite obviously been sweetened with artificial sweeteners. This might not bother everyone, but I'm an actor/singer and I try to avoid those because they aren't good for your throat/voice. Second, it is rather pricey. Third, I may or may not have crashed afterwards. I'm not entirely sure. If I did crash, it was a minor crash, not like after an energy drink. Plus, the "high" lasted much longer than most energy drinks.This is a great drink and I'm definitely a Neuro fan. I'm going to try Sonic this afternoon for an acting class; in the meantime I have also reviewed Passion.

It tasted good, mostly because there is only a little bit of sugar (9g in whole bottle).  Those supplements do have a very nice subtle effect, although maybe a misnomer to call it 'Bliss'.  Maybe mini-bliss, or warm clarity, or something.I've started to drink it after a workout and it's a nice way to replenish sugars and get some liquid.  Also, can't complain about that warm fuzzy feeling, even if it isn't 'Bliss'.  Kind of like having a cup of tea in the evening and relaxing.  Some of the supplements are found in tea, too.It's too pricey to be an everyday drink.  If it were around $1-$1.50 a bottle I would make it a habit to drink one every day.  I'm tempted to drop it a star again for that, but this is really better than three stars.  Maybe if they pay less money for *fancy* advertising and *fancy* bottles the price would be more reasonable.

column10: I like the Neuro Drinks, but when I first tried Bliss, I appreciated the taste. However, after consuming Bliss on a regular basis, I felt that the taste wasn't as good as I remembered. Also, the 'happy' side effects are now minimal, but that's just me.A better Neuro Drink is Sonic.

I love this stuff! I first descovered it at a local QFC and bought it because the bottle was cool.I know it works because I get comments on my performance at work when I drink Bliss.The price on here is steep, since I can usually find it for around $1.50 or less elsewhere but to get this quantity I think it might be worth it.I may even try the multi pack soon!

Ok, so not sure why the person is griping that there are fake reviews but I have to say this is true to claim. My dog passed away on May 13th,2011 (she was like my daughter) and I was severely depressed to say the least. I wasnt sleeping at all and was just miserable. The following weekend  I decided to help my friend with a project she had undertaken....bad idea since I wasnt sleeping I was extra grumpy so my usual patient and calm demenor was non-existent. So I came across this Neuro Bliss in some far out store and it caught my eye. Can I say instant mood changer! It relaxed me and it was like I drank the stress away! I highly recommend it. Just even as a pickme up. and its yummy :-)

column9: No, Bliss Can't Be Found in a Bottle, but Vitamin B Can.
column10: To be honest, I committed a heinous act I originally swore I never would: I bought this product because the presentation (bottle shape, color, font) was visually appealing and I liked that it stated the drink contains only 35 calories (you'd have to drink five of these to equal the caloric content of a Dr. Pepper!).It has a sort of grapefruit-like taste, although subtle, which I like. More important, however, is the fact that this drink, in the end, is a nutritional supplement. Being a petite, small-framed woman, I don't take in 2000 calories a day--but if I did, one bottle of Neuro Bliss would provide me with 200% of my daily Vitamin B6 and 100% of my Vitamin B12. For those of you who aren't familiar, Vitamin B is HUGE for mood regulation; many people with depression and anxiety have critically low levels of B in their systems. Again, compared to soda, this drink can and will give you a natural, healthy boost for the day.I strongly recommend this product to anyone dissatisfied with watery or faux-chocolate-tasting nutritional supplements, or otherwise looking to replace soda in their daily diets. It's a little more expensive, but your body will thank you.

I would have never thought!! This stuff really works. I would have never thought. I bought 1 bottle from the gas station and have been hooked since.Im assuming it wont work on everyone, but for me it boosed my mood. I acually feel happier. Give it a try before you buy a whole case.
This stuff is amazing. It actually works. I suffer from depression and two of these a day keeps my doctor happy. He actually recommended it. I think everyone should try it!
Didn't make me happier, and I didn't like the taste either...Actually, none of their drinks worked (I bought all  of them).If you want bliss, try iboga, like 20-50mg per morning on your tongue.

I can't say if the supplement part works or not, but according to my wife who is very into the supplement components it's got the proper components that she thinks works. I personally like the taste. It's a bit of a light pina colada flavor to me.

column9: Didn't know exactly what to expect, turned out better.
column10: The first reason why I had even purchased this drink was because of a friend, of a friend, I saw their post on a blog telling people how this drink was "so good and refreshing," that I, myself, wanted to give it a try. They say that you'll never know if something is good or not, till you try for yourself.Amazon took awhile to ship and it was delivered on a day I didn't expect it to, so that worked out nicely. Packing of the drinks was questionable, but I've bought things from Amazon before so that was no real big deal to me. So that was 1 Star.When I first took a sip, I noticed a difference it had from many other "energy" drinks I've had before. Lightly carbonated, is a big understatement to me. It felt more like a juice that would always be cold, because the way it has been carbonated made it feel that way. So I don't really consider it to be an energy drink at all. 2 Stars there, tasted better than expected and for 12 bottles, it is a bit pricey but to me, not a big deal considering if this is what I'm paying for, then I'll stop with those other cruddy drinks for these.The last star, over the period of maybe 2 weeks I had finished all 12 bottles and gave some to my younger siblings to try. None of them told me of anything described on the label to have happened to them, but they loved the taste of it. In my opinion, Bliss has the best taste so far and I have tried Sonic as well, and I wouldn't recommend that one. Maybe after the first few days or so, I did notice feeling calmer, energy-wise I did feel like I had more energy to do things that I wanted to around the house and at school. But not by a lot.Reason for not giving that last star. The drink is good, better than I had expected to be, and the price of $2.50 per drink isn't so bad at all. This is considering that most energy drinks now cost in the range of $1.25 to $2.25. So for a little extra, you get something better and isn't hidden in a can where you can't see what is actually in there, plus tastes great.Recently I've just purchased Neuro Sun and Neuro Sleep, so I'll probably end up writing reviews for both of those as well.All in all, Neuro Bliss, in my opinion, definitely is worth the money. But don't go into buying this drink expecting too much out of it, that way when you do try it, it'll end up being better than you what you could have expected it to be. Maybe it'll even surprise you.

Though I, like many, aren't happy with the price, it does work. I've been drinking the bliss and sonic versions of nuero for the past week and it has done quite a bit to boost my creativity, help my overall mood, and cut through the clutter to find manageable tasks that can be conquered. It very well may be the placebo effect but then again the effects are going to be subtle unlike energy drinks which kick you in the face and leave you jittery and wired. Its vitamins, nutrients, amino acids and such, it's not going to wash over you like warm wave of happiness, but it will subtly and pleasantly leave you feeling good (and with the sonic; productive).  And no I have no affiliation with nuero and heard about this from a friend who bought it locally.
I love this drink! It arrived quickly and as described. I would recommend this product to others. Overall great buying experience.

I tried Neuro Bliss just a year ago as a joke, a gift from my son.  And I discovered something remarkable.I have chronic pain that limits my play each day.  If I use my prescribed pain killers I turn into a dumb lump.  But, taken with Neuro Bliss, my medication gives me 4 hours of significant pain relief AND significant mental focus!  (I'm 62 and have never before experienced mental focus!}.I am not saying it is a miracle cure.  The effects are soft and subtle.............  exactly what I need.  If it is a placebo, don't tell me.I have my magic potion shipped to my door and look forward to those four hours each day when I can be myself.Thank you.merle
Im an impulse shopper the packaging caught my eye. It tastes like a lite fresca and i love all the b vitamins and the chammomile.

I'm sure this is person by person, but for me, this product does work.  On a very stressful day at work, I feel much less overwhelmed if I drink one.As one other reviewer said, though, it's not like taking a drug- the effect is subtle, but for me it is noticeable.I'd say the effect is about the same as taking 2-3 B Vitamins, which I also find helpful during stressful times.Tastes good.  A little pricey, but I wait for them to go on sale at Safeway and stock up.

Honestly, I really enjoy this product.  B6 and B12 are great for boosting the mood, so I have read, and chamomile has always worked extremely well for me as a sleep aid/anxiety reducer.  I'm not sure about the other ingredients.  I suffer from fairly severe anxiety, and this drink definitely helps to take it down a notch and put me in a calmer, more contented mood.  I tend to drink 2 or 3 a week, though I'd love to drink it daily.  Of course, I suppose this could be placebo, I can't prove that it's not, but it seems to work pretty well for me.  Also, from researching the ingredients and from experience, it does not mess with my SSRI, which one needs to be careful about when taking supplements. And I happen to like the light, slightly citrus taste.I give this four stars because every so often when I have this it makes me feel a little out of it for maybe a half hour.

column9: This is not my idea of "happiness"
column10: After lunch, I drank about 1/3rd of the bottle (the flavor is pretty good) and stopped when I started feeling like my world was closing in on me. I started getting a headache and felt really drugged.  Not a good thing when trying to work...typing was something I had to really concentrate on.  I'm finally coming back to normal after about 45 minutes but the headache still lingers.  Unless I'm sitting on the couch with nothing to do but eat, I won't be drinking it again!

The first neuro drink i had was neuro gasm, right before my sister and I went into our local state park for the trails. It was like everything was in ultra-color, happy, joyful, and  it was the first time in awhile that I did not have to take one break while walking the trails. I drank neuro bliss while helping my friend with their course work and throughout the session I was calm, really happy, and considerate.

I used to be on anti-anxiety medication but recently decided to get off of them.  I started drinking Bliss after it was recommended to me by a friend.  It works wonders with concentration and stress.  I have Bliss every morning and can easily tackle a stressful day of work and work more efficiently as well. This is much safer than taking a prescription pill (or even an over the counter one) and tastes great too.

I downed a bottle of this in about two minutes, and man was I glad that I tried this at home. It gave me a feeling within minutes like I was in the Twilight Zone or some horrible nightmare. Like the walls were moving farther and farther away. This only lasted for about ten minutes then I actually started to feel stoned. It was like I smoked some illegal green herb and did a few shots of espresso on top of it. It was very nice for about an hour. Then the terrible part happened, the crash! It felt like I had a few glasses of wine and then took a short nap like a mild hangover. If you want to try it, try it at home! I am not messing with this stuff again.
I bought the variety pack and this is the best out of the four. It makes me as calm as a Hindi cow for hours :)It also tastes great, like grapefruit without being tart.

I was very skeptical of this product, but I purchased it since the Neuro representatives were so friendly.  I was en route to my college graduation when I picked this up, and sipped it until I got to the site.  I was surprised by how relaxed I was because I expected to be a ball of nerves through the ceremony.  After my experience with the other drinks, I do believe that the Bliss helped me.
I read the info and compared to similar drink & decided to try it. I like it although I can't really tell if itdoes what it says.Jerry

column9: Bliss can't be sold in a bottle
column10: The tag line on the back of the bottle sold me-- it was something like, "what's wrong with wanting to feel happy?" I was feeling blue, and thought maybe trying something new would make me feel better, even if the drink didn't.I drank about a 1/4 of the bottle. It tasted pretty good ! But then five minutes later got a BAD headache. I wound up going to bed early,  woke up the next day and STILL had the headache.... and it stayed with me almost all day!!  I NEVER get headaches!I never use energy drinks, so maybe I'm sensitive to it,  but it didn't seem to me that this was even advertised as an energy drink-- it's just vitamins, right?  But I'm definitely not trying Neuro drinks again-- I'll stick to my usual vitamin supplement. Time is too precious to risk being crippled by a headache!

Do not waste your money on this drink. It doesn't taste very good and it doesn't have any effect. I had previously tried neurosleep with success so I thought I would give this drink a try. It is definitely not worth it.

column9: Now you can purchase Bliss. In a bottle. For $2.79 or less!
column10: NEURO Bliss - once again...tastes great, less-filling and I'll be darned if I don't feel better after drinking one!!!This is the best-tasting NEURO drink as well, IMHO.Also recommended and field-tested: Neuro Sonic & Neuro Sleep!PS - Subscribe & Save (how can you beat $25.50/case delivered to your door?)!!!
Info provided doesn't disclose that this is spiced apple syrup.  I wish someone in the US would make just plain apple syrup.  I have to get it from Canada
A bit too spicy for my taste. Will have to tone it down with catsup, or something, so the sauce can be used more often.

column9: My son eats the hole box!
column10: I just wish that once, someone would leave me a taste of these. Every time I purchase these my son eats the whole box. He loves fruity pebbles! Obviously they are an excellent product. And they are gluten free.
These nuts are very good, yet a bit mild. I keep these in the freezer and they last a long time. Try using these with your favorite Pesto sauce, you'll be very pleased.

column9: Great complement to seafood and fish flavors
column10: If your cat is like mine, they'll really like one flavor a lot, and will eat it for a while. And, then, for whatever reason, they'll want a change. This duck and green pea is always a hit with my shorthair. It is a lot different from the other flavors, and he never ever grows tired of it. This is a smooth creamy cat food, with a lot of moisture in it -- highly recommended for adult male cats prone to urinary problems. Those males often don't drink enough water, so this food helps by adding some water to their diet.

This stuff smells just fine and my cat loves it.  We get it for him ever since he had his UTI.  Even though its wet food we add some water to it and he does not seem to mind in the least. He goes to pee regularly and never had upset stomach.They ship it very fast too.

NOT a CD.I received two trial sizes of these THE GOODLIFE RECIPE catnip delights and decided to see if any of my cats would eat it. Well, they DEVOURED the first pack and then the second pack!
