column9: I love this better than steel cut oats due to the full-body texture
column10: I've been eating cooked oats all my life and have tried rolled, instant and steel-cut oats (McCann's, Quaker, Silver Palate, Bob's Red Mill, and Country Choice).  I fell in love with the McCann's steel-cut oats for the last 12 years. Well, last week I read a book that mentioned groats which I've never heard of before.Oat groats are the harvested oats in its pre-processed form before they have been steel cut.  To me each oat looks like the size of a fat grain of rice.  However, they have a  nuttier flavor because they are the full kernel and are as good for you nutritionally as steel-cut (if not slightly better)  and also lower on the glycemic index since they are unprocessed.These oats are my new love and once I finish the several pounds of steel-cut still in my possession, I will buy groats instead.  The only drawback to groats is that they take longer to cook.  I always steam one serving of Oatmeal in my Oster 5711 Mechanical Food Steamer, White.  For the steel-cut oats, I use ¼ cup of oats to ¼ cup of water and steam for 17 minutes.  For the groats, I use the same measurements but have to steam them for 22 minutes (5 minutes longer).  Since I can set it and forget it in my electric steamer every morning while I'm getting ready for work, the extra 5 minutes do not matter to me.  If I were cooking  them on the stove in water that would be different because then I would have to attend to them and the cooking time would probably be around 30 minutes.  (NOTE - When using this type steamer I remove the drip tray or the oats will take longer to cook.  The drip tray is not needed when I am using the rice bowl or another bowl inside the steamer bowl.)In summary, groats are lower on the glycemic index and have a more robust / nuttier / meaty texture due to the larger size pieces.  The only negative is the cooking time.  This is definitely my new morning oatmeal and I doubt I'll purchase steel-cut oats again.  It's also delicious with ground flax seed, fresh fruit, and skim milk.  I gave a bag of these oat groats to the same friend who turned me on to McCann's steel cut oats.  He has now become a convert as well and loves the full-body texture.Don't get me wrong, McCann's, Quaker, and Bob's Red Mill steel-cut oats are delicious and nutty and are five-star products (except for Country Choice) as well; it's just that these groats take the taste and texture further along the taste stratosphere making it a five-star-plus product to me.
Super tasty with avocado! Keeps me full for miles & miles! Way better than processed oats! Can't live without this super food!

I'd never tried groats but I love Bob's 10-grain hot cereal.  These cooked up perfectly in my rice cooker in 20 minutes (I was worried about the 50 minute stovetop cook time on the package) and were quite good - the flavor seemed closer to cracked wheat than oats, but tasty.  Nice chewy texture without being tough.

This worked great to find out if we liked fresh oats rolled with our Schnitzer grain flaker.  The kids love it and eat it almost daily.  The price on the oats are rather high.  I get 25 lb bags from a local natural food dealer that are organic and kosher for around 90 cents per lb.  This is why i say that the cost is high.  However if your'e not a bulk user... then this could fit the bill for you.

column9: Oats make for Healthy Horses and Healthy Men
column10: So I bought these being a bit uncertain.  I have liked thick rolled oats for the last year - eating them almost daily. The thick rolled oats are great but the glycemic index is a bit high.  I was looking for healthier options, and learned about these Whole Groats - They are essentially the oat before it gets rolled.  It still undergoes a bit of steam (heat) processing but not anything as severe as quick oats.These oats are amazing.  The taste is full and the texture is not mushy like rolled oats.  I could eat these day and night.  I have found that cooking them in my "rice cooker" also an Amazon purchase...works great.  It has a built in timer.  I put these oats in at night, with water.  And in the morning the rice cooker kicks in around 6:15 and by 7am my oats are perfect.I dont even eat these oats with sugar anymore,  a few blueberries or banana on top....delicious.  The taste is awesome!

I fell in love with Stash chocolate mint tea two years ago.  I am thrilled to be able to buy it now in an economical and environmentally friendly way.  This is used for my private use and I've felt uncomfortable with all the many boxes I've gone through in order to have my six bag a day tea fix.  If you are a tea junkie and care about our landfill situation then go for broke and purchase this way and save yourself a couple of hundred bucks.

I have tried many OOlong teas and this is by far the best.  It has a wonderfully light coconut, mango flavor.  The two flavors blend well together, neither one overpowering the other.  I will definitely buy again.
really nice tea, and smells wonderful. I enjoy it with a teaspoon of "sugar in the raw."  Stores well as is wrapped in foil. I usually buy the box of 100 teabags since it is an excellent value

column9: A ginormous box of 1,000 tea bags
column10: Stash Chamomile Herbal Tea is tea bags with dried, crushed chamomile flowers.Honestly, as far as I'm concerned, chamomile is chamomile. I suppose that when you use loose flowers you get sediment in the cup and I have seen this happen with some brands of chamomile tea bags, these don't do that.I have also had organic chamomile (this isn't) but I can't taste the difference.Each bag is individually packaged and that is either good or bad depending on how and where you use it and if you are concerned about excessive packaging.If you really, truly like chamomile tea, or own a restaurant, this ginormous box of 1,000 single-serving tea bags is a good choice.
Fast shipping. Smells good when you open the tea bag - tastes like watered down coffee with a faint mint aftertaste. Not recommended.

I have a daughter with a peanut allergy, so we're constantly on the lookout for products that she can enjoy.  Sun Cups are fantastic! What a great idea, to produce an alternative to that old standby of the peanut-butter filled chocolate cup. This product is far superior in flavor and quality to any similar product I've tried, with or without nuts etc. This is a gourmet product that stands on its own - not just an "alternative". The chocolate (especially the dark chocolate) is really as good as any gourmet chocolate I've had, including Belgian and French chocolates - in combination with the sunflower seed filling, it's just amazing. To boot, you can feel good about the socially responsible and sensitive way they're sourced and manufactured. Can't wait to see what they come up with next!

column9: Wow!!  Sun Cups are dangerously addictive!
column10: We live a gluten-free household and as those of you in similar situations know this is a challenge as gluten is hidden in too many products it does not strictly need to be in!Sun Cups is at the opposite end of the scale: Sun Cups not only are gluten free, but they taste incredible!!  All our "Normal" friends have declared that they are 100% better tasting that Reese's.Add the nut-free and organic and Sun Cups is the definitive proof that gluten & nut intolerances can be managed with joy!Long live the Sun Cup.  Try it and you will never go back!

This product is seriously addictive. I love the taste - the beautiful combination of sweet and salty. The chocolate is outrageously good. Combined with the fact that it is kosher, gluten free and organic and that so many people are allergic to peanuts, this is the way to go. I've had their dark chocolate sun cup and it is equally fantastic. Other peanut butter cups just cannot compare.

I haven't had one of my favorite candies in about 10 years all because I developed a peanut allergy.  Today, I was buying my fruits and veggies and saw this by the cash register.  I got so excited because it was produced in a facility free of gluten and nuts.  My first bite was strange since it was sunflower seeds and not my beloved peanut cups, but I took a few more bites and ate the two in the pack quickly and wanted to buy another, but they are 1.99 each.  The 20 in a package is a better price, but I'd probably eat 2 packages in a sitting.  Finally, I can eat my favorite sweet/salty candy again!

column9: These are awesome!  Taste almost just like Reese's
column10: My daughter is severely allergic to peanuts.  We found out when she was 8 months old.  Since then (she's 2 and a half now) I've not eaten anything with peanuts or treenuts.  I used to eat Reese's all the time...they were my favorite candy.  These sunbutter cups taste almost identical to reese's.  I don't agree with the others who gave it 2 and 3 stars because I think they're crazy cause these things are awesome!

Having a nut allergy, I was so excited when a friend of mine told me about these products.I went to Whole Foods to try them first before I bought a whole case. Needless to say, I bought a whole case.I am so excited about them! They are so good, and they come in a home compostable package too. I give them two thumbs up!

As someone with nut allergy, I was so excited to try these!  I bought three from the local health food store after finding them on Amazon.  I didn't want to commit to a whole case before trying them.Although the package was sealed, the chocolate in each was hard and looked like it had fat bloom.  It didn't taste like real milk chocolate (the ingredients list it as a mixture of milk and white chocolates, which explains the taste).  The filling was very dry and not creamy at all.  My husband said it wasn't like Reese's cups.They were fun to try, but the quality was lacking quite a bit in my opinion.  I'd rather dip a chocolate bar in Sunbutter than buy these again. Maybe it was just a bad batch, but I was quite disappointed, especially considering the price.

A wonderful alternative for those with peanut allergy, but great even if you're not allergic.  Another reviewer noted that she had some that were dry in the center; I'm not sure if storage conditions affect them, but I have ordered many cases and have come across a couple that were drier than others inside.  However, I still love them, all the other cases have been great quality; my whole family likes them, not just my peanut-allergic son.

As a former Reese's Peanut Butter Cup Lover, I was reluctant to try something different.  What a surprise!  I have to say that I am smitten.  How something so healthy that is kosher, gluten free, peanut free and organic can taste so good. I have recommended this product to several of my friends whose children and/or grandchildren are allergic to peanuts, and the results are amazing. The children are enjoying a treat that they only could watch their friends enjoy before. Bravo to a great product!

Sun Cups are absolutely wonderful, the fact that they are organic, kosher and peanut free is a bonus.  I have always been a fan of sunflower seeds, combining them with one of my favorite food groups (chocolate) is a winning conbination. I highly recommend them to anyone who has a sweet tooth you will not be disappointed!

I had my doubts about Sun Cups until I tasted them when we visited Boulder.  Wow! Not only do they use very high quality chocolate, the sun butter filling is terrific--not too sweet--with just the right balance of flavors that had me on the first bite.  This is a great new product--and our grand kids are crazy for them.

I was so excited to order and receive these sun cups. When I opened the package, I found the chocolate looked like it had a white film all over and it was dry and not creamy at all. Since there were so many good reviews, I am wondering if I have received a bad batch. Any one have any thoughts?

I don't have any food restrictions,and still choose the milk chocolate Sun Cups as my treat of choice!  They have such a balanced, clean taste that allows me to really appreciate the high end chocolate, nutty flavor and hint of sea salt.  Delicious!

column9: Nut Free Chocolate Butter Cups that rival the best chocolate confections!
column10: I'm not gluten free and I'm not nut free but I am completely addicted to Sun Cups, the equivalent of a chocolate peanut butter cup but made with sunflower seed butter.If you appreciate fine confections, you will love these...I consider the price a bargain as the quality of the chocolate and the creamy just-salty-enough center really does rival the best "nut butter patties" from candy stores like See's and are MUCH better than any other packaged nut butter cups I've had from health food stores.The milk chocolate complements the sunflower butter very well. The dark chocolate is good, but I definitely seek out the milk.

column9: It's tough to choose between Del Monte's canned diced tomatoes and Muir Glen's
column10: (1)The price is much better on Del Monte's canned diced tomatoes ($13.26 for 12 cans) than on Muir Glen's canned diced tomatoes ($18.70 for 12 cans).  (2)Muir Glen's canned diced tomatoes are certified organic.  Del Monte's are not organic.  (3)As of June, 2012, Muir Glen still uses cans that have a white plastic inner lining containing Bisphenol A (BPA) for their canned diced tomatoes (but not for their canned tomato sauce).  Del Monte's inner can lining is shiny, metallic brass.  Thus, Del Monte's cans are better.  (4)The taste of Del Monte's canned diced tomatoes is good but not quite as good as the taste of Muir Glen's canned diced tomatoes.  Why?  (a)Because Muir Glen adds tomato sauce, which is thicker, while Del Monte adds tomato puree, which is thinner, to their canned diced tomatoes.  (b)Because the skin of the tomato fruit and the tough part of the tomato fruit which connects to the stem is somewhat more noticeable on the Del Monte canned diced tomatoes than on the Muir Glen canned diced tomatoes.  (5)Del Monte adds high fructose corn syrup to their canned diced tomatoes, making it too high in calories.  Muir Glen relies on the natural sugars already contained in the tomato fruit, making their canned diced tomatoes very low in calories.

In my house we go through a box of Wheat Thins at least once a week, so I decided to try ordering in bulk from Amazon.  I will never buy Wheat Thins in a store again!  These are the FRESHEST Wheat Thins I have ever had.  They are awesome.  They are even cheaper than what I have seen in grocery stores.  Thanks Amazon!!

We order these by the case to sent to a friend of ours some distance off.  We thought the price was appropriate.  However, I picked up a box for myself at Publix and found that the store price for 6 boxes was less than I paid to Amazon.

second time ordering this cracker online for for my son. he loves wheat thins! a bad review was recently written by mistake, problems with my computer. please remove bad review, wheat thins are delicious and they were received in perfect condition. thanks,theresa strati

Wheat thins are great and crunchy and delicious with Hummus. This pack is a little too much of just one flavor and made our family a little sick of them. For some reason we've barely finished one box in four months and still have four sitting there.

Wheat Thins is a nice snack for the right person. They can be eaten by themselves, or eaten with stuff on top - cheese, hummus, salami/sausage, vegetable spread, etc. The cracker itself is fairly small, so you can't put as much stuff on it as you would say, a Triscuit, but it is still a great snack, and healthy, with fairly low fat and a decent amount of fiber.

Wheat Thins definitely aren't the most exciting cracker in the world but they are consistently snackable. Great for an afternoon snack when you don't want something overly sweet. Crisp, salty and delicious!

column9: Good value until changed from 6 to 4 pack.
column10: This is a convenient way to purchase. I had on the subscribe and save since last year, Wheat Thins 100% Whole Grain Crackers, 10-Ounce Units (Pack of 6) *notice it still shows 6 Pack* for 6 pack at 19.80 w/15% discount. Last order arrived as a 4 pack. No explanation. Price did not decrease. Increase of 33% with no warning to subscribers. I know Amazon is not hurting so what's the reason for the apparent gouging of us consumers? This at a 4 pack a terrible value
just like from the store!I don't really have much to say. they came in good condition and it's hard to put down a box.

I use to love these things, tasted so great and went great with any kind of dip.  I just ate some the other day and they tasted terrible.  They had a horrible aftertaste and tasted artificial to begin with.  What has happened to these crackers?  Is it just that my tastes have changed or has the product gotten crappy?  I just know that I am not going to purchase these crackers again, yuck!!!

column9: 5 stars for the taste, -4 for the price
column10: I am pretty sure that you can buy the 10-ounce box at Walmart for $2.00, $2.18 max.  Save yourself ~$6 by just making a trip down the road.

I've been eating Familia since I was in college in the late 60's (it was just the red box then). The taste and quality have never declined. The "no added sugar" version is even better than the original. The price Amazon offers with a subscription is awesome. Mix 1/2 cup Familia with 3/4 cup nonfat plain yogurt, take your shower, and come back to a wonderful breakfast.

1/4 cup muesli plus 1/2 to 2/3 cup any flavor Kefir and 1 T. Salba, stir and let sit for 30 or more min, and eat with 1/4 to 1/2 cup fresh fruit mixed in; breakfast at its best. Digestive problems solved after all these years, but it took a few months on this regimen. Have faith and stick with it. You'll be soooooooo glad you did.

column4: Kay Bone "people's movement for the eliminati...
column9: Great product, good value, prompt service
column10: I was looking for the wonderful familia Swiss Muesli I enjoyed as a child.  It is not available in most grocery stores and I do not live near a health food source.  The 32-ounce boxes of no-sugar-added Swiss Muesli are chock full of good grains and raisins and are priced 1/3 less than in the big health food chains.  When my supply runs out I will order this again.

Tastes great when cooked with organic fat free milk, be generous with milk. I eat mostly in the evening, not in the morning, instead of eating some junk food. When you are hungry and have nothing to eat, prepare this in two minutes and enjoy. Amazon price is really competitive, it's $3-$4 less per box, depending on whether you buy 6 pack or 12 pack.

column9: Best cereal I have ever eaten- best for digestion
column10: This cereal has made a big difference to me.  I used to have a sensitive system, but this cereal has made life a lot easier.  I eat pretty carefully, but with this cereal, I can eat unpredictably (as we all sometimes do) and still feel great. It is a natural regulator.  The uncooked oat flakes make the difference and the fruit in it sweetens it.
This cereal tastes great and it is also very healthy. I would not consider it a low calorie food but I still feel healthy having it in the morning. Simply the best Muesli I have had.

We have been eating Muesli for over 30 years and this product, the no sugar added, is the best and closest to what we first enjoyed in Europe 30 years ago.The 32 oz box/6 pack is a much better price than in any store around and the free shipping and delivery to your door makes a great deal!  In the cold winter months I warm mine in the microwave for 60 seconds after adding the milk. So glad to find it on Amazon!
Great price on a great product.  It is so hard to find a delicious breakfast cereal with no added sugar.

column9: GREAT FIND IN SEA OF SUGAR LADEN CEREAL
column10: Even though its not very tasty its loaded with good stufflittle less fruit than I expectedhave recommended to friends & family

column9: One Star Short of Bob's Red Mill
column10: Bob's Red Mill Old Country Style wins in the following ways:1) $2.50/lb vs Swiss Familia's $3.67/lb2) Flax seeds ingredient3) Bob still own's Bob's4) Bob's employees' can become part-owners as well5) 200 employees in OregonSwiss Familia wins in the following ways:1) More oats than wheats2) interesting flake made of good ingredients3) wheat germ4) hazelnuts! instead of sunflower seedsOverall, I rate Bob's a Four.The best though is what I can do at a simple store like Sunflower market, Trader Joes, or Whole Foods: buy my own ingredients and make a super cereals -- that is 5-star!

We are long time fans of muesli.  We have a long history with Familia and were disappointed when it left our local store shelves.  It has come back, but at inflated prices.  So we are grateful that it is available through Amazon.  By the way, if you like this muesli, try the Red Mill brand as well.  It is different but also excellent.

Absolutely can't get enough of this stuff!! I grew up eating Swiss Style Muesli in England & was so happy to find this on Amazon, at the subscription rate.  It costs far too much in the stores for the tiny box!I could eat this every day...sometimes have it for breakfast & again as an evening snack!  It's especially good with unsweetened vanilla almond milk...and with it being sugar free, I don't worry that I'm overdosing on junk the way I would eating most cereals!

I first had Familia when visiting Switzerland in 1977. That's where we ate it the traditional way, soaked in milk with grated apples. In 1985 I found it again at a friend's house, and have been eating it daily since then. I just love it....sometimes I have it as a snack in the afternoon, too. Familia (no sugar) is the only breakfast food I've found that gives me a burst of energy that lasts throughout the morning. This was recently corroborated by an article I read a couple of weeks ago that said that muesli was the best breakfast food because the carbohydrates are so complex (raw oatmeal was a factor) that they break down very slowly, giving you a long energy burn. I don't eat sugar, and find that there are enough natural sugars in Familia to make it a treat for me. It sounds crazy that I've been eating it every day since 1985, but it's true, and I will continue to do so as long as they make it. Finding this at Amazon on the subscribe and save program has made it much more affordable for us -- please keep carrying it! Thank you Amazon!

As my subject says, Familia Swiss Muesli is my favorite cereal.  I like it with various fresh and/or dried fruits (so, ah, not quite the "original" recipe on the box, which I have never tried).  BTW, an amazon.com subscription is a very convenient, low cost way to purchase it.

As a frequent visitor to Switzerland, I have enjoyed many fine Swiss foods, including several brands of Muesli. I am particularly fond of Migros brand 'Farmer Croc,' but it is unavailable in the US. Familia is a tried and true high-quality brand I have known for many years. Food in Switzerland - with notable exceptions like yogurt - is generally 50 - 100% more costly than in the US, which fact prompts this review. Purchased as a 6-pack of 32 oz. packages, Familia is very competitive on price with many lower-quality US breakfast cereals. It is, at the same time, much more nutritious. Hint: prepare it with some pureed apple, fruit, a few tbsps. of yogurt, and milk and/or cream - cream turns it into a fabulous dessert. Sweeten to taste if you wish. Prepared fresh, it is chewy. If you prefer soft cereal, prepare it in advance and eat after an hour or so. It keeps well in the refrigerator. As the dollar has just hit new lows against the Swiss franc, you can expect a price hike of up to 20% in the near future.Addendum: I was wrong about the price increase. It went up by 30% in 8 months since a dollar now buys only 83 Swiss cents.

column9: Don't miss the sugar one bit, super price too!
column10: Thank you, Amazon, for bringing this item back in the Subscribe & Save program.  I can't find it for a better price anywhere.  My son and I love this cereal as it's a lot less sweet than the "original" in the red box.  Very satisfying with plenty of milk.  The dried fruit flakes add just enough sweetness as it is.  My favorite cereal.

Excellent food - just a nice natural mix of grain, nuts, and fruit.  One of my staples. I mix it with another naturally sweetened Kashi cereal (Honey Puffs).  Arrived as advertised - no problems. Good price.

Amazon is the only place we have been able to find this "No Sugar Added" version of Familia. It is not available in any of our local grocery stores, so we were so pleased to find it here. The vendor is prompt and we have had no issues with their service.

column9: Grew up on it and I love it
column10: I love this Swiss Muesli.  I can eat it straight out of the box but I would agree that it's most like what you'd get in Europe.  That said, I don't think it's for everyone.  If you grew up on super sweet Americanized cereals, you likely won't like this.  It's extremely filling and very hearty.  Keeps you full.

I  have been eating Familia since the 1960's, and it remains my favorite cereal of all time.  Mix with milk or yogurt, add fresh fruit, and you will have a delicious breakfast that is really, really good for you!  I once took a two-week business trip to the Philippines.  When I got on the plane to go home, and they brought out a small box of Familia as a breakfast choice, I started crying -- that's how good it is!  I hope they never stop making this stuff!

I have been eating this cereal for more than 30 years.  It was always very difficult to find, difficult to get the stores to order it for me and expensive.  With Amazon, I have the wonderful, fresh product I want and ordering is effortless.
Excellent cereal.  Dense, stick to your ribs.  Oats & Nuts.  No added sugar or junk.  Difficult to find in stores in some locales.

column9: Just the thing I was looking for
column10: For two years in the US, I've been looking for muesli at reasonable price in all food aisles, never to find one until now. This muesli is delicious to eat (Even without yogurt or milk) and healthy so I can stock up for those long nights at work.Now, if only Familia can bring my two favourite flavours - Erdbeer n Jogurt chips (Strawberry and yogurt chips) and Schokolade chips - chocolate chips - I can die a happy man :D.There is some truth to the reviews that muesli is flaky due to long shelf life- but I'm far too happy just getting this at a reasonable price to complain much.(0.16c/oz is better than any healthy cereals I can find here)Perhaps one thing they can improve on with the package is ensuring the box can be closed again once it's open.

Beaware that the price has gone up on the "no sugar added" version from $36. to $49. for 6 32 oz boxes and no free shipping vesus $36 and free shipping still on the "sugar added" version.  Why?  Demand.  This equal to local stores which I will now buy from.

column9: Love the Cereal; Hate the Packaging
column10: Everything you could ever want in a "just add milk" type breakfast: delicious, nutritious, satisfying, mixes great with just about any fruit or with yogurt . . .The packaging, well . . . a) difficult to open the inner foil bag, b) difficult to close up the foil bag after pouring out the cereal, and c) simply impossible to pour the cereal into a bowl without having a bunch of it spill on to the table and back into the outer box.  Needs a fix in this dep't.

good taste, wholesome ingredients...however, this cereal so hard to eat. even after i let to soack in milk for a long time, i could not eat it.It's much better cooked, as a hot cereal, but i don't have time or desire to deal with it.It's been sitting on my shelf for weeks... and then i had a great idea - use it to make muffins! (i added some spelt flour, baking powder, egg, banana, applesauce and soy creamer). These came out to be the best muffins i ever had. my kids ate it up - and i didn't even add any sugar!now i'm ordering more to use as my muffin mix :)

I loved the ingredients of it. But I didn't like the taste of it (and no it is not because it doesn't have sugar). But I will try to experiment with using berries, more honey, more raisins etc. It is a great wholesome cereal.

my first bowls were a terrible disappointment. tons of powder, made the cereal soggy and felt like eating wet sawdust.  flavor was ok, but consistency was terrible. I figured maybe the first box was a fluke, maybe I just got the bottom of the barrel in the first box and the rest would be different. wrong. on my second box now and struggling to get through it because of the sawdust-like consistency. i usually go through a box of cereal a week, but i have not enjoyed this cereal enough to want to eat it.  it will be a few months before I go through the rest of my 6 pack. i canceled my product subscription before Amazon sends me another 6 pack.  i have four and a half boxes to go, and yes i intend to eat what's left, maybe as punishment for wanting to save a few bucks and trying this new muesli cereal (new to me).
there is so much powdery material in this cereal it turns it all into mush.  i cant give it away.

I've been buying this cereal for $35, and my 3 year old daughter even loves it. I went to order another 6 boxes and the price had jumped 25% to $44! Sorry, but that's too much for me. I've switched to another, inferior product.

With disparity between the Dollar and the Euro, the price of this cereal has been rising where a lot of groceries have simply dropped it.  I was glad to find it on Amazon; actually it was pointed out to me via an e-mail to Switzerland.I have been eating this cereal for over 20 years on a daily basis.  They have changed the formulation over the years a little [more oats initially]but it still the closest to true Swiss Muesli since I was introduced to it in the 1950's.Only one local store comes close in price but they do not always have it.***They ran out of this on Amazon and through one of their vendor it is now $72 per carton with shipping!  That's $12 a carton!  You can get it typically for under $9 in the store.  I tried a carton of the Original (Orange) formula.  Still the old price.  But it is very sweet.***

This muesli has the consistency of sawdust. If you're like me you'll pour a bowl, then realize you've got 5.9 boxes of worthless sawdust left. If I owned a gerbil and lined his cage with this Muesli he would starve before eating it. Unless you've tried this particular brand before and find it appealing, save your money and find a better reviewed variety.
Worst quality, All I got is powder in packets, Even thought I was not able to find how to returns. I had to throw all packs. Very disappointed will never suggest this product to anyone.

THIS HAS GOT TO BE ONE OF THE WORST CEREALS OF MY LIFE IT IS SO DENSE YOU CAN BARELY SWALLOW IT. TOO MANY CALORIES IN SUCH A SMALL AMOUNT OF CEREAL.  THEIR OTHER CEREALS ARE ALOT BETTER EVEN IF THEY HAVE A LITTLE BIT OF SUGAR.

I like this product, but the prices is too high in the grocery store, so I get these at costco for 14.99 for a case of 12. I don't particularly like the orange one, and at costco the case is a variety pack. I was looking for a single flavor case. The price here is too high. not much less than what you pay for a single in the grocery store.

This tea is very tasty and wonderful for a sore throat. It gently coats the throat. You can drink it hot, or make up a full water bottle full to sip all day long when you can sit and sip hot tea. I use to send my kids to school with a water bottle and 3 bags in it, they loved taking it with them and help them through thier day when not feeling well. I enjoy this tea even when I am not ill too. Ive not bought in bulk like this ad shows. I do not know this seller, I just know the product is very good.

I'm no roasted wasabi pea connoisseur, but these are very tasty to me. Just be careful not to eat too many at one time. A friend of mine ate a bunch at once, and then she started tearing up, then everyone thought she was upset about something, but she wasn't. It was just the wasabi peas. On the other hand, if you want people to think you are sad about something, say, the death of your mother-in-law, you could eat a handful of wasabi peas and start crying and everyone will think you cared about her a lot even though you really didn't like her at all.
Good buy.  I love wasabi and wasabi these coated peas are very good.  Sometimes the peas are a bit hard -- maybe not dried /roasted quite right.
Bitter and not what I thought it was going to taste like. Wish I had not bought 2 of them. I'll try it on a baked ham, but never on any bread.

Okay so I work at a Family Dollar in St. Louis && we just got these in. Well for awhile I had been looking for the Snickers for my mom (just because) && now it's at my job for 10$ along with the Reese's. ! It's so freaking good && you can't go wrong with it what so ever . !
It is indeed, as my daughter would say, GI-NORMOUS! And it made my lady fair, Maid Mary, very happy (even though she'll probably only have a bite and share the rest).

column9: Great Gift for the person with the sweet tooth!
column10: I got this as a gift for my husband. It is one pound and it is great for the Snickers lover in your life!!

After having pup on Taste of the Wild and Solid Gold Barking at the Moon, did some research to find another premium grain-free food but at a lower price and found this.  Excellent stuff.My year and a half old chihuahua has been on it for a few months now and couldn't be doing any better.  Both he and our two cats (who are on Purina but steal the Epigen, which they seem to prefer, out of the dog's bowl) seem to love it. And pellet size is just right for them all, very small.Just purchased a second bag and will continue purchasing this. Very happy with the product and it's price!

This is the first grain free food all 4 cats like.  AND it is starch free to boot!  Looking forward to having them try the fish and the venison. My cat with EGC is 90% clear of issues and has stopped chewing on his fur/skin. We are all SO happy!

My cat loves it!  I think I have him convinced that these are treats and not actually 'food'.The pellets are a quite small.  So if you use treat-balls (as I do) try to get one with a smaller or adjustable opening.
kitty says she likes it. it also prevents her from becoming a fatty since it's starch and grain free. why do cats need starch and grains? they don't.

With an enormous range of essential ingredients, including krill oil, a super-antioxidant rarely found in other pet foods, this product is ostensibly ideal for both cats and dogs. THE PROBLEM is that it contains so many NON-ORGANIC ingredients, including corn protein. Newer studies just released point to a greatly increased risk of tumors in animals that are fed corn, simply because ALL of the corn grown in the USA has been genetically modified (courtesy of one very large multi-national corporation whose name is familiar around the world.) You can't escape it. So until Wysong decides to produce an all-organic version of their Epigen WITHOUT any GMO ingredients, we won't be buying it anymore.
My 3 big dogs and my cats love this food.  And, I like the ingredients that it contains.All my pets always like all Wysong products.  They have a sort of variety with good ingredients.
i was amazed at how quickly my order arrived. also, i was pleased that the product was packaged in small easily managed bags. both cats and dogs like this food.
i like them but not the best i tasted,nice box good for the office table

Wow comes in a six pack of 4 oz containers at about 1/2 of the local price...We use LOTs of Black Pepper so this is right up our alley....  Service was fast and arrived ahead of estimated delivery time by a couple of days....
This is OK, but it is not better than that.  The flavor is nothing special. If you are using it in some dip (caviar/egg sort of thing) you will probably be OK.  Frankly, you can find better deals.

There is nothing better than travelling and having that first breakfast on the road! Cook this up in your kitchen, close your eyes, take a bite and remember that vacation when the day started off with a delicious breakfast!  It did it for me and i bet it does it for you! Enjoy!

We are learning that sea salt is better for us because of the reduced sodium content. This brand of sea salt has 400mg per 1/4 teaspoon which is even less than some other sea salts.  I find that the saltiness in Roland seems more intense than regular table salt, so am able to use even less of it and still have all of the flavor enhancement.

It's hard to review salt but I will try. Yes, this is sea salt from Italy and sea salt you know is very good for you in moderations. The quality of this brand goes outside the box. Food salted with sea salt taste so much better than regular rock salt that has been used here for years. Just look what rock salt can do to the highways and your driveway after a snow storm.  Got the picture. Stay healhty, Retired Early

The product description did not include the fact that this salt also contains magnesium carbonate.  Despite that, it seems "moist".  The crystals don't make hard lumps but they also don't flow freely like some other brands of sea salt that I've had in the past.  It is difficult to use this salt in a salt shaker.This is the only Roland product I've purchased that has been less than satisfactory. I do not believe I would order it again.

It's oregano and it's ground.....what else do you need to know?  It tastes great when I put it in the water to boil my artichokes.  I ordered this on Amazon because I couldn't find the finely ground stuff at my local grocers.  No regrets....will order more when this one is gone.

column9: Wonderful fun making homemade candies for Christmas!
column10: This chocolate is so easy to work with for making homemade molded chocolates.  We have used it for years for our traditional chocolate making at Christmas.  It melts easily in the microwave, and it molds beautifully.  The molded chocolates have a nice shine and a crisp bite.  I was very disappointed when I could not find it locally, so hurray for Amazon.  And this price is great. Direct from Ghirardelli's, it's $10 a box!!For a great chocolate treat, mix some rice krispies in some of the chocolate and fill a nice-sized mold halfway.  Lay a small piece of caramel apple wrap in the mold and then fill the remainder with plain chocolate.  Voila!  a home-made $100,000 bar.  These are our favorites.

This soup is pretty good, it doesn't have many "noodles" in it at all, they are tiny, and look more like parmesan cheese shavings than noodles, it is mostly broth and flavorings. Its pretty good, but I would highly recommend the Chicken Cheese Enchilada soup in the same line instead.
I don't know what it tastes like. I just know that that this item came up on a gluten free search but it is not gluten free. It contains semolina and semolina is wheat.

OK, I wrote a damning review of the Dilmah Green Sencha tea, which I described as tasteless and weak and no relation in any way to Japanese Sencha, so here is a cheaper tea that at LEAST has a minimal taste of something and a subtle flavorful after taste in the back of the throat. It is also, to me, fairly stimulating so there is definitely a fair amount of caffein or caffeine like substance in it. But still not sencha as we know Japanese Sensha.

column9: No arguing with your healthcare people
column10: What a blessing it is to have these natural products to help with things that not just any ole herb can handle.A very fine grind, to make it easy to use, steeping quickly in warm water or alcohol and filling quick and easily.

After years of thinking these weren't made anymore my wife saw a program on TV that mentioned Squirrel Nut Zippers.  Well, needless to say, I immediately went to our friends Amazon and did a search and found these delights once more.  Made sure that I order two tubs of 240 pieces each (can never have enough backup of a favorite).  They're good but seem to have less nut pieces than I remember.  That's why a four rating rather than a five.

I agree with the other reviewers, Necco has totally ruined a childhood favorite.  Squirrel Nut Zippers are now no more than run-of-the-mill caramels.  Also the 240 count are sticking to the wax paper.  I wasn't going to mention that since I need the fiber but I thought you might want to know. BRING BACK THE NUTS.
I ate these as a child and there were a lot more peanuts in them then. I still enjoy them but bet they's sell a lot more if they hadn't cheapened them up.
The squirrel nut zippers are just like I remember them with a new name.  I'll pick up a box for each hunting season.  Good price, fast shipping.

I well remember these Squirrel Nut Zippers in their original form from my childhood. Thought I would try them again since I still have a few of my own teeth remaining. The bits of nuts made a great difference between this candy in the 60's and this castrated recipe today. But it is a light, sweet and chewy caramel even if it has been altered, but it would be more descript to name them Eunuch Caramel Chews and let the customer know.And...who names a band Squirrel Nut Zippers? ? You're screwing up Google searches for my fav treat.

column9: just as I remember but with less peanuts
column10: I bought this item at least three time.  I enjoy the tasty treat but the one compliant I have is that I wish it had more peanuts like yesteryear.  It is still a great candy and it is addictive.  I will most definatly buy more when my five pounder is done.
My order was received promptly and the candy was very fresh and sweet.  The quantity was right on time, enough to share and have on hand,
If you are a Squirrel Nut Zipper fan, you have found the right ones to buy!  I received them within two days of ordering and they were super fresh.
good stuff .... not a lot of peanut in it but it i good and chewy

column9: This is not a miracle health cure!
column10: This is not a miracle health cure!I think some people have unrealistic expectations when it comes to products like this. They expect a sachet of powder  to be the basis of their nutrition regimen.I first experienced EBOOST when flying on Virgin America a while back. This product is available from the in-flight menu. I tried it a couple of times and found it to be a sweet pick-me-up. Did it have a health benefit? Maybe. It can't hurt to get the extra vitamins listed on the packet can it?I take a range of supplements and while EBOOST is not as comprehensive as some others it does contain a decent amount of vitamins.I like the convenient sachets - I keep one or two in my carry bag and then shake it up in a bottle of water when I want a sweet taste. The taste reminds me a bit of Tang I used to have as a kid.I like this product - but please don't think it is the key to good health...

column9: Performance and Flavor--both are equally important
column10: Now matter how effective a sports drink is, if you're riding a bicycle for five or more hours over a hundred mile course, whatever is in your water bottles has to taste good too.  I generally use Gatorade, not because it's the most effective but because it's more effective than just plain water AND it tastes good.  For comparison, the most effective sports drink I've ever used is Accelerade, but I wont put it in my water bottles because I can't stand drinking it hour after hour as I'm cycling up and down mountains over a 100 mile course.  Accelerade isn't bad, I just don't want to drink a gallon of it, all day long, in 90F+ heat.EBOOST has all the qualities I look for in a sports drink--for doing actual sports--which is simply that it's palatable (so I'll actually want to drink it) and effective at maintaining my endurance.Besides that, EBOOST comes in single serving packets which I can put in a jersey pocket and use throughout the ride when I visit water stations at rest stops rather than starting the ride with something I like and then having to drink whatever is available that I can tolerate.Flavor alone makes the difference between consuming enough fluids during an all day effort and energy-zapping dehydration.

column9: Gives The Right Kind of Boost
column10: EBOOST gave me the right kind of boost. It made me feel energized, alert, focused, and ready to get through my day. What it didn't do was make me feel anxious or jittery like many other energy drinks.Full of B vitamins, Vitamin C,and other essential nutrients, EBOOST gives your body what it needs to enhance your immune system and keep you going in a good way.The taste is ok. It tastes a lot like an orange drink with a dash of salt. The salty taste most likely comes from the bicarbonates. But, it's really not that bad at all. Getting the desired effect far outweighs the slight salty taste.A cool glass of EBOOST will clear your mind and make you feel more refreshed than you've felt in a long, long time. Definitely a healthier choice than one of the popular canned energy drinks.

I recently gave up drinking soda and have been searching for a calorie-free alternative.  I'm a big fan of Tea2Go, but like most sweet-tasting mixes it has Splenda in it.  So even though I've replaced my Diet Pepsi addiction with watered down tea, I still feel a little guilty about it.So when EBOOST came along I thought it was a perfect opportunity to inject some vitamins into my diet.  And, let me tell you, EBOOST sure did.  I just didn't expect it to blast those vitamins through my tongue and out the back of my skull.You see, the folks who produce EBOOST believe that more is better.  And therefore, something that's good for you in large quantities is even better.  And while we're at it, why not just multiply the good stuff by a THOUSAND, because hey, how can it hurt, right?I take a daily multivitamin already and even the efficacy of a multivitamin is questioned by the FDA.  The reason being that different minerals are absorbed by the body differently, and often require fat in your diet (usually at the time of consumption) to be absorbed along with the vitamin. In other words, just sucking down a vitamin with water isn't going to do you much good.  And, in case it's not clear that this review is going down the toilet, dumping thousands of milligrams of certain vitamins into your system is going to pass right through you.Don't tell EBOOST that.  EBOOST has 1,000 mg of Vitamin C, which is 1,667% the daily recommended value.  Let me repeat: one thousand six hundred and sixty seven percent of the daily recommended value.  And here I thought I was okay drinking a glass of orange juice in the morning! I drank a full eight ounces of water with EBOOST and I'm surprised my head hasn't exploded already.In fact, the only vitamin that EBOOST doesn't include insanely high amounts of is potassium at just 14% of the daily recommended value, because that would reduce the efficacy of the 2,500 mcg of Vitamin B12.  Do you know how much of the recommended B12 daily value that is?  41,667%.  I read the label twice: FORTY ONE THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED AND SIXTY SEVEN PERCENT of the daily recommended value.A quick search of several health sites explains how ridiculous this amount is. "Vitamin B12 supplements do not appear to improve energy or athletic performance, except in people with a vitamin B12 deficiency."Please folks - if you want to take care of these fragile bodies of ours, drink plenty of water, eat healthy, and exercise. There is no magic formula that will make you healthier except a healthy lifestyle.  There are plenty of other ways to get your vitamins, but EBOOST isn't it.Also, it tastes like metal shavings off a dirty muffler mixed in with an orange rind. But I have only myself to blame -- EBOOST fizzes when you pour it into water.  That's Nature's way of telling you not to drink it.

I'm a big water drinker, and I love using mix-ins for my water. However this simply did not work. Clumpy. Didn't taste good. I struggled to drink it and don't think it's something that I'd be able to recommend. Ugh.

If this tasted good, I think I'd be more supportive of it, but it tastes terrible. I didn't feel a huge energy boost from it, but maybe I just didn't notice it because I generally draw energy from exercising and being active. I think you're better off getting multivitamins from your local drug store.

I took a long time to try EBOOST after I received it, because I was worried it might be bad to take it with a multi-vitamin (I hadn't considered this when I ordered it). But today I was feeling a bit tired, so I thought I'd go ahead and try it. There were no warnings on the package, so I figured it was probably ok.I sound like I'm building up to some kind of terrible reaction, but nothing happened. There was no effect at all, good or bad, because I just couldn't drink the stuff. I tried, but it was so nasty. It's very sweet on the surface, like artificial sweetner. This didn't bother me so much, though. What bothered me was the bitter, flat under-taste it had. It tasted like the lemon-lime laxative doctors force you to chug when they want to clean you out. Really awful. And it didn't go well with the artificial sweetner. It was bad enough to make me shudder.I'm sorry I can't write about how beneficial I found this drink mix. But it can't do me a lot of good if I can't drink it in the first place.

column9: good source of vitamins, but could taste better
column10: Orange-flavored EBOOST is a fairly standard energy/vitamin drink.  It has 50% our the daily recommended value of zinc, 1667% of vitamin C, 100% of B6, 41667% of B12, 75% of niacin, as well as several other vitamins and nutrients, with only 5 calories per serving.  The B12 amount in particular is very high, and I'm not sure how if that is really necessary.It is supposed to be orange-flavored, but it also contains green tea extract, and I didn't think the orange taste was very authentic.  In fact, I found this drink to be overpowering and unpleasantly bitter.  The first time I tried it, I followed the directions and added 1 package to about 8 oz of water.  However, I found this unpalatable and had to dilute it until I had used 4 times as much water as instructed.  Because the vitamin levels are so high, I don't really have a problem diluting it to such a large extent, but other people might prefer something that is drinkable after following the directions.

I didn't get much of any energy boost.  it doesn't taste that great either.  It was very foamy from the carbonation it creates.  A little bit of bitter finish.  I don't think of it much more than a vitamin C pack.

The review title about says it all.  It was fizzy, tasted like an orange drink made popular by important travelers of the 20th century, and didn't disagree with my stomach like orange juice does.  The plus was definitely the taste; I have used another vitamin C loaded product which is almost bitter in comparison.  I don't recall feeling any extra energy, although I felt good each time I took the product.

I recently tried EBOOST for a four day trial period, with what I would consider "mixed results." The product provides a good orange/citrus flavor and I really like that it also provides the essential vitamins of Vitamin C, B6, B12, Zinc, Green Tea Extract to supplement a person's dietary requirements. However, as far as the "energy boost" that is suppose to accompany the use of the product . . . well I am more than a little skeptical. Overall I think it may be a helpful/easy way to supplement your diet, especially if you are not receiving the appropriate and necessary vitamins/minerals, but I am not convinced it will add to a person's vitality or daily energy level.

This product describes itself as a "Daily Health Booster." I'm not so sure about that, but it does have an array of vitamins and minerals, and an insane amount of B12. Since it is billed as a "dietary supplement" they don't have to substantiate any of the "health" claims. Like many "dietary supplements," it is overpriced.I'm not sure what the effervescence is all about. You pour the powder into a glass of water and it foams up, but doesn't seem to add anything to the resulting drink. The powder does dissolve completely, leaving no residue after mixing and drinking.The drink itself tastes like Tang (which is not necessarily a good thing) with a slight artificial sweetener aftertaste (which is definitely not a good thing). I got about the same "boost" from this as I did from drinking Tang, which is to say, "not much."If you need a "health boost" save your money and buy a bottle of multi vitamins. If you need effervescence, take the vitamins with a glass of orange soda.

column9: Tasty with a reasonable energy effect
column10: "Boost" may be the wrong word. When I took this in the middle of a bike ride, I didn't suddenly feel more energetic, but my energy level definitely did not decline. It has roughly the same effect as Gatorade without the sugar. It tastes good and does a reasonably good job of keeping me going when exercising.

I handed out the packets to all ages in our house for their opinions.  My reaction was that it tastes like Tang with a fizz, my 12 year old said it was Tang + fresh, "Can't you taste the green tea at the end?" he asked.  I could and it does leave a pleasant lingering green tea taste.  My thirteen year old liked it equally well.We used smaller juice size glasses and filled with water and ice.  The EBoost fizzed and tasted great.My older son took a packet to college and during lunch drank EBoost instead of soda for a much healthier and still refreshing drink.With only 5 calories and no sugar, you get all the Vitamin C, B6, selenium, chromium you need for a day.  You get 50- 75% of niacin, folate (great for pregnant women), zinc, and 14% potassium.Here's what the packet tells you: EBoost's naural proprietary blend delivers energy that is unyielding, focus that is unclouded, immunity that is derived from vitamins and minerals, and a means of recovery that is not only sugar-free but delivers essential nutrients.  EBoost gives all those who rely on it a healthy comptetive advantage.  At work, at play, at life.Whew!  I don't know about all that but if it is true my son is sure to ace the physics test today!The taste is good enough to make a regular appearance at breakfast.

column9: Beats taking a bunch of pills
column10: I love the EBOOST healthy energy drink mix! It not only tastes great but it's rich in vitamins and minerals to increase energy levels, support the body's immune system, aid in recovery and electrolyte replacement and boost focus and performance. The vitamins and minerals include vitamin C, B6, B12, zink, niacin, folic acid, selenium, copper, chromium, potassium, green tea extract, glucuronolactone and 5-HTP.Getting your vitamins and minerals in a delicious effervescent drink beats taking a bunch of pills. The preparation is easy too. Just add the powder to a glass of water.Best of all EBOOST has only five calories and is sugar-free. There's no harsh crash afterwards.The drink comes in three delicious flavors ACAI POM, orange and pink lemonade. I chose the orange flavor and highly recommend it. Proceeds go to National Breast Cancer Research.

Dissolving Eboost Orange in a glass of water results in a mildly carbonated beverage with a Tang-like taste.  Although it is supposed to be an energy drink, it is not fortified with caffeine beyond what is in the tea extracts it contains, so I would not say that I felt an 'eboost,' but nor did I get the caffeine jitters.  It has amazingly high levels of vitamins C and B, most of which will likely go out in your urine.  However, since it is a powder Eboost is convenient to keep on hand and transport, unlike other sports and energy drinks with the water already added.

column9: Excellent Taste - No Jittery Energy Burst
column10: First, the most important thing in my mind - taste. These orange flavored packets punch a wonderful citrus/orange flavor. Not too tangy, and not tart at all, they convey a perfect orange flavor. While not supplying a huge energy burst, they do make a noticeable difference. What they do NOT do, is give you that jittery feeling a lot of energy drinks do.Each packet contains a powdered flavor that completely dissolves in water. Each packet also contains the following - supplied by the company website :Anhydrous Caffeine  * Increases Energy  * Aids in Focus  * Augments muscle strength  * Raises metabolism by increasing muscle activity.Chromium  * Increases Energy  * Regulates hunger  * Reduces cravings  * Helps protect DNA and RNA  * Important to heart function  * Helps control fat and cholesterol levels in the blood  * Compliments of Suite101.Copper  * Increases Energy  * Aids in Focus  * Augments muscle strength  * Raises metabolism by increasing muscle activity.Glucuronolactone  * Increases Energy  * Aids in Focus  * Augments muscle strength  * Raises metabolism by increasing muscle activity.Potassium  * Increases Energy  * Aids in Focus  * Augments muscle strength  * Raises metabolism by increasing muscle activity.Selenium  * Increases Energy  * Aids in Focus  * Augments muscle strength  * Raises metabolism by increasing muscle activity.Sodium  * Increases Energy  * Aids in Focus  * Augments muscle strength  * Raises metabolism by increasing muscle activity.Vitamin B12  * Increases Energy  * Aids in Focus  * Augments muscle strength  * Raises metabolism by increasing muscle activity.Vitamin B6  * Increases Energy  * Aids in Focus  * Augments muscle strength  * Raises metabolism by increasing muscle activity.Vitamin C  * Increases Energy  * Aids in Focus  * Augments muscle strength  * Raises metabolism by increasing muscle activity.Zinc  * Increases Energy  * Aids in Focus  * Augments muscle strength  * Raises metabolism by increasing muscle activity.And all of the above come in a wonderfully flavored drink mix.

EBOOST:  Daily Health Booster provides the essential vitamins of Vitamin C, B6, B12, Zinc, Green Tea Extract to supplement one's dietary needs for the day.  As the label suggests:  energy, immunity, recovery, and focus are the necessary elements as well as the tangy, natural orange flavor that one packet possesses that is not quite as Crystal light or powdery as Tang but tasty enough to drink with as much as 5 calories.The packet is convenient and easy to mix into a water bottle or a full glass.  However, when dispensing the item into a water bottle, make sure to slowly pour the contents rather than quickly because what may result is an overflow of an orange colored mess that almost looks like a lab activity gone awry.Overall, EBOOST has a desirable taste that is satisfying and healthy.

My cousin-in-law is Thai and she cooked an amazing curry for us.  I had to have the recipe and she said it was really very simple.  Just get the green Mae Ploy curry paste, some Asian basil, and some coconut milk.  A little salt, sugar, chicken, some bamboo shoots and rice were the only other things I would need to make it.  Well, I couldn't believe it was really THAT simple, but it was!  The paste imparts several subtle and delicious flavors to the curry.  Tastes like you slaved for hours.  I never have leftovers when I make this curry.  The paste is so low priced I plan to stock up so I'll always have some on hand.  Plus-- no preservatives, no wierd ingredients.  It's all food stuffs, albiet some of the ingredients I don't recognize... what is a galangal?  Whatever it all is, sure tastes good!

column9: So good and easy to prepare
column10: My husband and I love Thai food,but I'm not that good at cooking Asian dishes. This product was easy to prepare and the flavor was tremendous. It is tastebud hot, so the first time making, be conservative with the measurement of the paste. I would recommend this product.

If you're looking for authentic, Thai curry, this is it.  After you've made the dish a few times, you can tailor it to your liking.  We like it VERY spicy, so we're generous with the portions, and add chili flakes and a little madras curry powder.Buy with confidence, and keep your pantry stocked!

I live in Puerto Rico and cannot find Thai food here, let alone ingredients.I bought this and the red curry paste too. I had never made my own currybefore, but with the help of this, I made restaurant quality curry!  There is quitea bit of product in the container, so it will last if refrigerated.  Watch the shippingcosts from outside vendors. They will not combine shipping in some cases.

Authentic taste, long shelf life in your fridge, easy to use, and the price is right.  How can you go wrong.  When I prepare a curry with this I don't go crazy with a lot of Thai ingredients other than the curry paste.  Just some veggies from the super like bell pepper, scallions, carrots, jalapeno and serrano chilies, and some sliced pork or chicken or beef.  So easy and so delicious.

column4: Jon Atwood "Computer Geek and loving owner of...
column10: Curry has officially become my FAVORITE food over the past year. I can't believe I waited 35 years to try it.We went through all of the grocery store curry pastes and never could find one that had great flavor and spice.Mae Ploy knocks it out of the park! We always have 3 or 4 of these in our fridge & pantry. These make super yummy curry with or without coconut milk (we've recently started using chicken stock instead of coconut milk to cut down on the calories)A definite MUST HAVE for curry loversAdd some Mae Ploy Sweet Chili Sauce, 25-Ounce Bottle (Pack of 2) to your pantry too!

column9: Yes, it's better than the rest
column10: Agree with most posters that this is really the best. I don't know if the price is right, but considering this might be a 4-6 month supply for me, I'm satisfied. Just don't buy the little jar of "Thai Kitchen" green curry, whatever you do. I will be throwing it away now that this Mae Ploy has arrived.
Mae Ploy curry paste is always delicious.  Directions are on the label.  Easy to cook.  Saves a lot of cooking time.

I have both the red and green curry paste.  The green is milder.  I use both of them in variety of dishes and often spice up soups and stews that need a little zing.  It is so convient to have them in the frig.

I have been using this curry paste for 10 plus year. It makes very delicious curry, if time is available I will add some raw ingredients on the list to enhance the flavour of the curry. Very good buy and recommended to everyone. Lisa, [...]
This is real potent.  It doesn't take a lot to make it firey.  This tub should last a long time

column4: Cool Life in AZ "Nuts for Brussels Griffons"
column9: I don't have to beg my son to cook for me anymore....
column10: Everyone who has had the opportunity to eat this loves this - I like this a lot with green and yellow zuccini, carrots and bamboo shoots with thin sliced turkey breast. Living too far from any real good oriental restaurants is no longer such a bummer...just came back to order more... price went up a bit but it's still well worth it.I see some complaints about too salty - I don't think it is salty and I do NOT use any salt when cooking nor do I eat any salty snacks so my taste buds would complain if this was too salty. Too hot? The way we make it, it's at most medium hot while the flavor is excellent (not diluted with coconut milk)...the hot sensation goes away very quickly...we love hot food - almost to a point of burning lips, eyes and nostrils hot but this is medium hot. Maybe it's less hot for us because we use a lot of veggies and eat it with white rice which always turns down the heat.

I thought the flavor was really good, just the right balance of flavor and heat. So much better than the stuff you buy at the grocery store. The only complaint I have is the saltiness, you can definitely taste the 25% of your daily sodium in every serving.

I bought this brand because it was all they had at Ranch 99 near us. I find it spicy (hot) but not enough flavor. I would have rather bought Maesri Thai Green Curry Paste. It is much much more flavorful and spicy.

I've purchased different curries in the grocery store and was never completely happy with the flavor. I read a recipe that recommended this brand and after using it I can see why they recommend this specific brand. Great flavor - I purchased all 3 - Green, Red, and Yellow curry paste and have enjoyed all 3 types.

after FAR too long seeking to mimic the cuisine of the local thai restaurateurs(without seeking help online or simply asking) i discovered mae ploy by accident in some hippy dippy food shop. this paste is all that stands between a bizarre amalgamation of food and authentic thai goodness. buy it add some veggies some coconut milk serve with rice on side. you will not regret it.
I like other styles of Mae Ploy curry paste, but the green just doesn't work for me. Overwhelming garlic, no heat, and very bland. I would not purchase this product again.

Because of Mae Ploy Thai Green Curry Paste, green thai curry has become my signature dish. I am always being asked to make it. Remember that it is very spicy so a little goes a long way. The flavors in this paste are complex and varied and make for a delicious curry. We are living overseas (not in Thailand) so I am happy to see that it is available on Amazon!

Not the best tasting curry paste. It is good, but it still requires alot of work to throw together a good curry. The taste is salty and spicy, not exactly what I look for when it comes to green curry. It takes alot of sugar to even out the flavor and make it edible.

column9: just packaged curry paste quality; nothing to rave about
column10: Many people are unnecessarily intimidated when it comes to making curry paste.  I am always disappointed by the people who are impressed with the taste of curry paste manufactured between 6 months and 18 months ago.  Its not hard to find the fresh ingredients and make it fresh.  It takes me less than 15 minutes to make something that is far superior in taste and nutrition to this product.  This product is widely used in Thai restaurants where the cooks don't want to cook, and don't want to invest the time in training workers who change restaurants every 6 months...they just want to hire untrained laborers who can open cans and scoop pre-made mixes out of containers.  It takes a bit of time and practice to make curry paste, but do it a few and you can master the art of working with the spices.  You will never go back to the cheap, low quality substitutes used in most Thai restaurants and sold in Asian grocery store. If you want the real thing, learn to make it or find a restaurant to support that makes their pastes from scratch.

I was so excited to get this curry paste. The flavor was good if you can get past the heat. Wow, it is hot. My boyfriend goes to Thai resturants and orders Thai hot and then asks for some more hot sauce. He even said it was hot. The next time I make it I'll try adding less paste and additional coconut milk.

Xylichew is the only gum I use. It tastes better than any other gum I've ever had. And then, there is the added benefit of xylitol which is good for teeth.  And these packets are perfect for carrying Xylichew with you on the go!

column9: NO CHIPS FOR ME, THIS IS MY FAVE!
column10: I have sworn off chips and soda for many years now. When I do crave for salty snacks, this is what I get. Garlic and Adobo is my favorite. I live close to an Asian Store and recently found out that Amazon does have better prices for a 3-pack.

I ordered this soup from an online low carb retailer, and I love it. Its the best soup I think I've ever had. It doesn't taste low carb or diet at all. If you like cheese,and you like Mexican, you will love this soup. I've been eating it everyday and I never tire of it. It is smooth, creamy, delicious.

I send the Austin-Cookies & Cracker Variety pack to my son in college. This is perfect for the dorm room and he does not have to keep running to a vending machine. He likes the variety, I like the convenience and know that the product is good and more nourishing that cany bars.
Good selection of single-serve cookies and crackers...handy to have around because there's something to please everyone. Good price and the product shipped quickly...

column9: variety, yummy, and lots lots more!
column10: This box is absolutely a bargain! There are so many different flavors and they are all delicious! You NEED to buy these! They are seriously delicious and addicting! Plus, they are really filling and already in great portions! Just grab-and-go!!! Love love love these!!!
These things are fairly tasty, but really I get them more for their low price than their great flavor. It's nice to have something like this handy when you need to eat on the run or in the car.

column9: The price is right and the crackers are fresh
column10: I am very happy with these crackers and cookies. Why? Because they where shipped right which means no broke cookies,,,they are fresh and taste great and the big excitement is the price. Let me explain that. If you go to the store and pick up and buy one of thes crackers or cookies one at time you will pay between .60 and .75 cents but this product cost .33 cents a piece and you always have some to eat when you want a snack. Great price and great product.

Pretty good stuff, beats running to the vending machine. Alot of variety though i wish there were more cookies to crackers ratio.

this came with only three packs of cookies one of each type in top layer not five each no big deal but I wanted them

Then I can't restock additional cookies (resulting in lost sales) until the crackers are sold.  The product mix in these packages should be closer to 10 vanilla, 10 lemon and 10 chocolate with the balance in the crackers.  I have half full cases of crackers sitting in the store room and the customers are screaming at me because I don't have any cookies on the shelf.  Kellogg's....are you listening?  Time to wake up!

Most of the packets I opened had crushed pieces which spilled cracker dust all over the place. I tried one of each variety in this package and took the rest to work to give away to co-workers.
i always put a pack of these in my lunch box for a snack during the day.....this is an amazing package and the taste just like i remembered
Every last sleeve of crackers was damaged. The majority of them were smashed so badly that they were just dust. Horrible packaging.

Not bad but not great either. My children of course love the cookies but when it comes to the crackers they just tell me they are extremely dry and pasty. This was the ultimate snack pack which was so delicious i had to make myself curb my cravings for these delicious crackers and cookies these are fantastic for late night snack urges.

column9: austin cookies & crackers 45 ct what a deal

Excellent assortment, just the right amount of each, lasts a long time! None of the crackers were broken or crushed like some might expect to happen during shipping. My favorites are the round crackers with peanut butter. Great anytime snack or with a sandwich for lunch or sensible dessert.
I really like the variety. Hence, it is a variety pack. I grew up with this stuff as a kid so it was a good natural buy off of amazon. I would purchase these again once I run out.
