i regularly purchase the glennys ranch flavored soy crisps. they must of changed their baking process. the last 4 cases have lacked flavor, and are not as crisp. they tase the same as regularsoy crisps.

They are Delicious! Great for snack, as crackers or chip.  Great for Gluten & Wheat free replacement.  I couldn't find the sea salt at the store anymore.  Found & bought them on Amazon.  Thanks Amazon!  And thanks Glenny's!Thanks Alvita

column9: The Glenny's "Lightly Salted" Chips Are Great, But the "Sea Salt" Chips Taste Funky
column10: I've been enjoying the Glenny's Lightly Salted chips for several years.  They're great.  They're hard to get in the supermarket, so I buy them by the case from Amazon .  (Sometimes they're hard to get from Amazon, too.)I thought I'd give the Glenny's Sea Salt chips a taste.  Blech.  It has a funky taste.  "Salt is salt," I thought.  I don't know if it's only the taste of the different salt that makes the chip taste funky, or if they make that variety of the chip differently in other ways.I trashed the entire case of the Sea Salt chip, and went back to the Lightly Salted variety."To each, his own taste."

Glenny's soy crisps with olive oil,garlic & feta chese is good tasting!!!But people with hypertention will proberbly have increased numbers...When my wife ate the product her numbers were 188/109...next day with no product her numbers were 139/83...She still loves the product & will order more...

Folks, maybe it's because I'm not use to eating horrendously healthy snacks - but these truly reminded me of cardboard covered in cheap powdered flavorings.  And one thing I learned the hard way - food items are not returnable, even though they are in sealed bags.  So now I'm stuck with 24 bags.  And my daughter, who eats horrendously healthy (soy, tofu, etc), won't even go near them.  She also thinks they resemble cardboard.

Love these soy chips by Glennys! They are guilt-free, taste good and low calorie. I'm losing a few pounds by adding these to my new diet. This bag size is perfect for 3-4 evenings of before bed snacking.

I decided to try these as a protein alternative for my kids' lunches.  I like that they are organic, and the flavor sounded good.  I tried them when they came, and they really do taste great!  They have a light crunch, and they are the perfect size for kid lunches and snacking.  The kids really liked them as well, so I bought them again.

column9: High in protein and tastes great!
column10: I was so shocked to see that there were 7 grams of protein in serving of these chips that were only 80 calories.  This is really impressive, since most protein bars that pack similar amounts of protein are way more calorie rich and packed with a lot more sugar and fat.  I compared these soy chips with the PowerBar ProteinPlus High Protein Bars and here are the stats if you were to eat 3 servings of these chips (to get comparable protein amounts):Glenny's vs Powerbar:21 g protein vs 23 g protein240 cals vs 290 cals0 g sat fat vs 3.5 g sat fat3 g fiber vs 2 g fiber27 g carbs vs 37 g carbsSo the powerbar has 2 more grams of protein, but is 50 more calories and tons more carbs.On top of that the chips taste great and are perfect if you love crunchy, savory, carby stuff but still want to get that protein.  Highly recommended!--Don't worry, I don't work for them, I just did all these calculations because I literally could not believe the protein content in these considering they are also low fat, low carb and low cal as well.  Why doesn't this get any more cred?
the garlic,olive oil and feta taste is wonderful, chips are crisp.  I love them, and they're good for me.

I took a chance and ordered these on one of Amazons deals and WOW I am glad. I love the taste and the fact they are not horrible for you makes it even better. I will defiantly be sharing these and be ordering more. I plan on trying other things from Glennys.

column9: A nice alternative to the usual flavors
column10: These feta, garlic and olive oil chips are a great alternatives to the usual bbq, cheddar, sour cream and onion flavors.
These soy crisps have a genuine barbecue potato chip taste that is a great substitute for the fatty calorie laden chip. I highly recommend them.
These are great little snacking chips with the benefit of Soy.  Best of all, they are gluten free.  Great with tuna salad, jam, peanut butter, or chip dip.
These are yummy.  If you follow weight watcher's, they are a good 2 point snack!

I have long been an avid fan of Glenny's products.  Unfortunately, the two stores in my hometown that carried Clenny's Soy Crisps stopped carrying them.  That's when I turned to Amazon.com, from whom I ended up ordering from six to twelve bags of nearly each flavor.  They arrived at my door so quickly (in only two or three days, despite the prediction of more than a week) that I was completely astonished.  For people who are on Weight Watchers, they can eat twice as many of these crisps than they can other similar products for the same number of points.  The crisps are a delectable alternative to crackers and chips, and in lieu of croutons, I have crumbled them into salads as well.  I have even melted fat free cheese on them.  They are worth the money and the few days' wait.

I looooove these chips. Super tasty. Just got to watch out for how much salt it has, and sometime not every bag gets the same amount of flavor dusting. Seriously though, even with a dud bag or two I like the taste and the protein that I can get from munching!

I have tried many brands of soy chips and these are the best I have found. And they are one of the few brands that come in plain ol salted. I don't do the flavored chips. Their customer service on the home site needs major improvement, but Glenny's still makes the best chips.
These taste really good. I found myself eating a whole bag of them every day. They are very healthy for you and taste so delicious.
These crackers are extremely flavorful and taste great.  They are also gluten free and low fat.  This combination is very hard to find.

Looking for an easy way to incorporate some soy protein in your (and your kids) diet?  Soy Crisps are a fun and easy way, and delicious.  Don't worry, they don't taste weird.  Even my son (who hates everything) likes these.

I try to be healthier with my snack choices, and this isn't horrible. Could be worse, could be better. If you're a "healthy snack food" person, definitely check this out. If you're like me ... skip a soda and grab those Cheetos. :)
Lime Cola is our new favorite Zevia flavor!  Thank you, Zevia, for giving us a soda without all the harmful artificial sweeteners. Amazing variety of flavors that actually taste good!

column9: Weird, but good if you're giving up aspartame
column10: Good choice if you are looking to stop drinking aspartame.This is going to take some getting used to; I'm not going to lie.  I've been drinking diet soft drinks for a very very long time, and I prefer them to the HFCS versions.This stuff is expensive, and, after one try, I do not like it as much as I like the lime-flavored diet name brand cola.  It's not bad.  Just different.  And I think I could get to like it.  The cola has an almost tea-like quality to it, and the sweeteners (stevia and erythritol) are very sweet. The carbonation is on the light side for my taste.  It's drinkable, and it has caffeine, so it's got that going for it.
Zevia is probably the best line of natural sodas available. Lime and Cherry Cola Zevias are among their best, along with Doctor Zevia.
I like all the Zevia flavors.  I'm so glad that I have some many flavor choices to chose from now.  I drink the lime cola when I feel like being in a tropical mood.  Great job Zevia!

I have been doing my own taste-tasting on many of the hazelnut flavored coffee.  I keep coming back to Melitta Hazelnut Creme.  Most of the flavored coffees lose the "coffee" flavor and taste very weak.  This is a nice medium coffee with a great hazelnut touch.  At this point in time, I haven't found a better quality tasting hazelnut.  The price is also reasonable.  I'm on the Subscribe and Save with this product.

I love ALL of the Melitta Coffees!  The flavor of the Hazelnut Coffee is just right and the actual coffee itself is smooth and rich!  Most flavored coffees are very low quality, but not this one.  I've always been happy with coffee in the Melitta family and will continue to enjoy them again and again.

My husband and I are fans of flavored coffee and have tried many types of hazelnut coffee.  This one is plain delicious, especially the first thing in the morning.  It starts with the aroma while it's brewing, transfers to the cup, and then does not disappoint when you taste it.  The flavor strength of this coffee is just right, and there is no artificial cast or aftertaste.  To maximize our coffee experience, we keep the coffee in the freezer once it's been opened and double filter our water.  Price wise, when Amazon runs it for just $4.71 a pound (do the math, and this includes super saver shipping), this coffee is perfect.  I can finally quit searching for the perfect hazelnut coffee.

This is the best Hazelnut coffee on the market, period.  I have tried them all, and hands down this one is head and shoulders above the rest.  So glad I found this on Amazon's subscription service.  Keep it coming!

column9: No question this is not only a good deal, but ship to door is great!
column10: My wife and I have tried many different coffee's over the last several years and thru trial and error have been forced to repeatedly chose an alternative brand of coffee every time our local supermarket no longer carried what we HAD gotten used to (and LIKED). It's seems like it's been about 1-2 times a year in the last 3 years and I was sick of it. After the last 'coffee cycle' I decided to look for a steady source. And now using Amazon subscription service (delivered to my door) no other source is competitive (or reliable). Amazon subscription service is superb, I highly recommend it. Also, about the Melitta coffee!I thought it would be obvious but to be clear, it is superb. We have tried many and love the 'just right' amouint of SLIGHT Hazelnut Creme flavor and love how mild and NOT bitter (unlike so many coffee's) the underlying taste is. It's smooth, not bitter, and wonderful. We use 4 heaping scoops in our Braun 12 cup drip machine per batch. So after 'trying' (and tossing or giving away) many other coffee brands (and several flavors) this was the one we settled on. Many flavored coffee's would be a bitter base coffee with a "too strong" perfume taste. This one is just right and anyone who has come to our house like it (including people who do NOT like flavors generally).

im not a coffee fanatic, but ive got nothin to complain about this product. price lloked great, reviews looked great,so i bought it. Overall i am satisfied. It smells nice, i feel im drinknin quality coffee, and this is gong last me a while. Good buy.

I'm a coffee snob and for many years have always bought flavored beans and ground them myself before each cup I'd brew.  Checking out what Amazon had to offer, I came across the Melitta Hazelnut brand and thought I'd give it a try.  Ground and in a can seemed easier to me.  I was right.  It's finely ground just the way I like it, and the coffee is good.  So why not give my grinder a rest!
We love this hazelnut coffee. It is very finely ground and has a great flavor. We use it in a coffee maker that uses a permanent filter as opposed to disposable filters.

I ordered this coffee for my fiance as I don't drink coffee.  She made it a point to call me while I was at work to tell me how great it was (she leaves before I get up in the morning).  So apparently it's great!

I am very pleased with the rich hazelnut flavor of this brand of coffee.  I used it in my automatic drip coffee maker and it tasted superb!  I believe that the finer grounds is what gives this coffee the fabulous flavor.  I know this brand of coffee is at the top of my list and that I'll be purchasing it again.

I have been drinking Melitta coffee for years. I don't drink it all the time for I like the flavor of different blends.  But when I am in the mood for hazelnut flavored coffee this brew by Melitta is the very best I have ever tried.  And trust me, I have tried many. Not every one of the more expensive blends, but just about everything around Melitta's price range. I think the key to this coffee being so good is its fine grind.  Make that it's very fine grind.  It really looks and feels like a brown powder it is so fine.  But I just happen to believe that one gets the most flavor out of any blend by totally pulverizing the coffee bean and then making sure its stays sealed tight and fresh.  Nobody grinds coffee finer than Melitta in my opinion.  And thus they're flavored coffee is the best for that reason, as well as the fine beans they start with.  Mind you this is only my opinion about the fine grind.  It very well may be that some people don't like the taste of a such a powdery grind and if you are one of them, I would suggest you skip this blend.  On the other hand, if you want what is in my opinion the freshest most flavorful hazelnut that can be found easily, I believe Melitta is your blend.  Even though it is easily found in stores I suggest you pick it up right here on Amazon, and if you really like it, subscribe to their regular delivery.  You will save on sales tax,(in most cases) receive a discount, and, all subscription orders on Amazon ship for free.  An undeniable deal over buying locally.  Highly recommended for your morning, or anytime pleasure....
I start my morning with this coffee each day.  Great taste and great price. I have ordered this coffee several times and will buy again.
We use this in our Keurig coffee machine in the reusable filter.  Comes out great every time, just make sure not to fill past the line.
I really like this coffee, but since the price has increased so dramatically I will not be buying it again from Amazon.com.

I bought this coffee based on all the positive reviews and the significantly cheaper price than my usual brand.  I find this coffee lacking any Hazelnut Creme flavor.  Perhaps the lack of flavor is due to the fine grind?  Needless to say I will not be purchasing this coffee again.

This is my second time purchasing this item from amazon. Considering the price when you subscribe this, I think it is a good deal. The Hazelnut flavor(scent) is not strong, but is mild and does smell nice. It wont make the whole house smell like flovored coffee though, if you are looking for something like that. over all, this is a good quality for its price.

This coffee is excellent! Maybe this is the best flavor of all Melitta's Ground Coffee. Delicious and subtile with hint of light spice this coffee will definitely make your day. I tried to cheat on this flavor and went to French Vanilla and Morning Decadence... But came back to Hazelnut almost instantly. Great Coffee, one of the best!UPDATE: As per now, June 2011... Coffee itself is great, but the price jumped over last months. So now i suppose to pay for $8 more than initially established price. Shame on you, Amazon, you don't follow your our contract!

It just feels like everyday, a great cup of coffee is a simple way to start off your everyday morning just right. While I've had so many different coffee brands like Maxwell Houde & store brands, I don't really feel the simplicity of seeing great flavors in ground in the stores anymore. Melita though does know how to simply make a strong cup of coffee that can simply make your day strong, and that is the case with the taste of their Hazelnut Creme ground coffee. The coffee tastes purely delightful, and stronger than the ones that you'd get at Dunkin' Donuts, or any other store chain. I love the aroma from beginning to end. My only one big gripe with the coffee is that it is harder to open after you open the lid. You'd also have to use the aid of a can opener to get the coffee open afterwards, but it definitely is worth the wait. If you want a zesty and smooth hazelnut taste, than I really suggest you get Melita's Hazelnut Creme coffee.Quality: A-Price: B+Overall: B+
Trouble was, I gambled and lost.  As I recall, there was not a description of the fineness of the grind.It is far too fine, it is dust particulate fine, and so in brewing disappointing in taste.

Dr Lucy's cookies are pretty tasty! And I feel like they can't be bad they are from a dr haha. So far I've tried the chocolate chip and cinnamon ... Choco pretty good I can taste the garbanzo flour a little the other flavors have spices so it's not noticeable with them...I had dental surgery and discovered if I leave the cookies out the get soft and chewy some might call that stale I called it an opportunity.  The seller takes a few weeks to ship but at this price who can complain??! If you need gluten free Lucy's IS one of the tastiest options... A friend said they didn't taste gluten free to her and she had eaten a big old piece of regular cake first(yes I hate her for that and never gaining weight but I digress) buy the cookies of you want a treat you don't have to bake or risk getting sick over.

column9: satisfies the hunger & sweet tooth urge
column10: This cracker / cookie is light - but quite filling.  But the prices on Amazon are way to high.  Try Publix - alot cheaper ($2.99 a package of 6 cookies).

I saw this in my local pet store and wanted to try this out on my three cats, they currently eat Wellness 24-Pack Healthy Indulgence Tuna Recipe Cat Food, 3-Ounce Pouches and I have to smush it up in the pouch because two out of three cats prefer their soft food in smaller bits, all of them prefer the pouch food over Pate Style and all three want Tuna over everything else.In the store I compared the ingredients on the label just to make sure they were comparable. Here are the first 6 ingredients side-by-side:Wellness Tuna (Pouch) - Turkey Broth, Tuna, Turkey, Turkey Liver, Egg Whites, Potato StarchWellness Tuna (Can, Minced) - Tuna, Fish Broth, Water Sufficient for Processing, Salmon, Dried Egg Whites, PeasWhile this seller doesn't specify the size of the product, I'm assuming it's the smaller 3 oz cans, the same I purchased in store (there were no other available sizes). Both the Healthy Indulgence Pouch food and the new Minced Canned Food Tuna Dinners are 3 oz.Here is a side-by-side comparison of the Guaranteed Analysis for each:Pouch - Crude Protein: 9%Can -  Crude Protein: 8%Pouch - Crude Fat: 2.5%Can - Crude Fat: 3%Pouch - Crude Fiber: 1%Can - Crude Fiber: 1%Pouch - Moisture: 82%Can - Moisture: 82%Pouch - Ash: 2.5%Can - Ash: 2.8%Pouch - Magnesium: .025%Can - Magnesium: .035%Pouch - Taurine: .10%Can - Taurine: .05%You can see that while they are the same flavor, not all ingredients are the same.All three of my cats ate this food but I suspect they prefer the pouch food over the canned food due to little bits being left over in their bowls while the pouch food was completely gone and their bowls were licked so clean they shined. I would purchase this again to give them some variety.

I bought this as an alternative to Fancy Feast tuna with gravy because we suspected our cat had a reaction to the wheat gluten in F.F. My cat likes this flavor of Wellness. The pieces are small enough to chew even with his bad teeth. I think my cat wishes it had a little more gravy in it, but otherwise both we and he are happy with it. The packages have arrived in good condition from Amazon.
I am not sure if it is my brewer or the taste of this coffee.  It is a little lackluster

This is the first garlic-infused olive oil I've purchased, so I can't speak to the taste comparison differences, it reminds me of a mild truffle oil; I was under the impression, however, that this was 100% extra-virgin olive oil.  It is pure olive oil AND extra-virgin olive oil mixed. My fault for not reading more carefully.  The "pure" olive oil is listed first on the label denoting that most of the contents is not EVOO.  I do not see Italy as the place of origin as some garlic olive oils are...this one says "bottled by Boyajian, Inc., Canton MA," that's all.  The other thing that makes this a more serious problem for me is that it has a disclaimer on the label that it shares machinery w/peanut oil and wheat.  My toddler granddaughter is very allergic to dairy, eggs, and worst of all--peanuts. B/c of her dairy allergy, I use olive oils freely w/o worry as a suitable cooking substitute for dairy butter. Had I assumed that olive oils were safe for her and not read the label, I might have sent her to the hospital with this oil.  So if you have issues w/these 2 food allergies, beware. I will try another brand of garlic-infused 100% EXTRA-VIRGIN olive oil after this bottle is finished.

I purchased this oil packaged with 4 different Italian spices for dipping bread into.  This oil is excellent.  I tried to make my own with some crushed garlic and olive oil....just not the same.  I had to go back and buy more of this.  I bought it at Le Gourmet and it was on sale 2 12.7oz bottles for $14.  Good deal!
this oil is amazing! i use it to fry pork chops, use it as a dipping sauce for my fried plantains, and sprinkle some in salads and boiled potatoes. i'm gonna get a costco card just to buy this!

Reportedly both garlic and olive oil is supposed to be good for your health. I can't say this bottle of garlic oil will help your health, but it will help your taste buds. I love cooking with this garlic oil and often add it to the pan when browning meats. It's also good eaten as a bread dip.Recommend.
This oil is fabulous. My favorite dishes with it are roasted red potatoes with a drizzle of this and salt and pepper. It is delicious. Same goes for spinach. =)

column9: Better for you without  the salt
column10: A very good and inexpensive treat to enjoy while watching TV or doing just about anything. These nuts have no salt and are easy to eat too many.

For some reason this dip mix is difficult to find in my area so I have to purchase it elsewhere. This is the first time I have purchased Laura Scudder's and so far I have been very pleased with this product. It's very tasty and easy to prepare.

This really is the missing ingredient to all of your attempts at making traditional japanese food!  It may seem odd that fish is used as a "spice", but it really almost is just that.  I tried making steamed japanese vegetable with mirin & soy sauce figuring that Mirin was the missing ingredient.  But it wasn't until I read on one of the packages that hon dashi is required, that I discovered the true missing ingredient!  I bought fresh miso to make miso soup, and it too didn't taste right.  Added a spoon of hon dashi and suddenly I had real Miso Soup!  (actually i found out later you can buy fresh miso for miso soup with the dashi already added)  Hon dashi is great for soup stock for udon or soba too.  Buy some and add a little to whatever doesn't taste quite japanese enough.

After buying some fresh organic miso at a local supermarket the search for dashi stock for miso soup led me here. Having tried it (1/2 tsp stock + 2 tbsp miso + 2 cups water) it was pretty good but I am subtracting one star for the salt and MSG content which is considerable in this product. While this will be good for those in a pinch I think I might opt to try making my own stock with shaved bonito so I can axe out the salt and MSG.
I use this product to make my udon noodle soups and also miso soup. It is a very reputable and popular brand and it is very good.

column9: Good but wish it was available without MSG
column10: It is the missing ingredient in miso soup recipes if yours doesn't call for bonito- this has lots of salt and MSG though.  It doesn't work for me unfortunately.  If you're sensitive to MSG, I like the Miso seasoned with bonito and without MSG, but it can be hard to find.  Alternatively use the bonito shavings and just plain miso without MSG.
Everything was as expected. Product has good quality. There were two containers with the promised amount of product. Package came on time and in good condition.

column4: Christine "If at first you don't succeed, try...
column9: Easy Must Have for Miso Soup
column10: Because I wanted homemade Miso soup TODAY, I ran out to my local Asian grocer to find any kind of dashi bonito soup stock sans the MSG.  Couldn't find it... this brand was the only one they even sell.  I purchased it reluctantly (at a slightly lower cost and no shipping fees, btw - $3.99 for one 2.29 oz bottle) and while I am not happy about the first two ingredients being Salt then MSG, it did make my Miso soup taste very good.  I will definitely keep searching for a dashi benito soup stock without MSG, but until then this is a good substitute.
My Japanese (WIFE) Born in Japan likes or loves the flavor as any Japanese woman born in Japan would like it.

column9: is real dashi supposed to have msg?
column10: I doubt that dashi extract should have MSG and other listed chemicals, no? Personally, I would look for a more genuine solution.

I buy a lot of stuff from Amazon.com and always get great service. I just wish their web site would correctly sort products by price. Trying to find the best price on a given item can be really frustrating on Amazon.com.
Amazing that you can orders these online, but it died within 3 weeks. I took care of it just like they said to. It makes a nice dead Bonzi, but that's not really what I had in mind.

This tree was absolutely nothing as pictured. It has horrible qualities for bonsai, even as a place to start. The best part of my money spent was the unglazed pot I received. The tree was honestly healthy, albeit with a poor root system(very obviously grown from a cutting/air layer). It is just a horribly ugly thing with attempts of wiring that would have been best left off. It is about a foot and a half tall with a trunk diameter less than an inch. I could lop off the top half to start over, but the curve in the trunk is so dramatic there is nothing to do with it afterwards. I am attempting to make something out of it by rooting the branches and making an air layer out of the top half, which might have potential many years from now.Bottom line, don't buy from here, unless you want to pay $40 for a small pot and fire wood. You're better off going to your local department store and buying a juniper with a blind fold on.This would have 1 star but, as I said, the tree was technically in decent shape, as well as the pot. Not reccomended what-so-ever though.
so far so good the packaging was awesome the tree looks healthy. i can only hope that i have better luck than the others that left reviews lol....

When the tree - a gift - arrived, I was thrilled. It is absolutely gorgeous. However, I soon realized that it is a tree that MUST be kept outdoors. The main description on Amazon did NOT say this - I had to read the detailed description. Because there are dozens of bonzais to look at on Amazon, I must have skipped over this. Now, I have a gift for someone who would LOVE to have a bonzai, but who lives in an apartment so cannot keep it outdoors. I'm incredibly disappointed. The problem is not with the quality of the tree, which is wonderful. The problem is with Amazon's description, which has left me in the lurch just a few days before I had to give it as a gift.

column9: Excellent tea, despite the misleading name!
column10: Recently, I've been searching for a good ginger tea. Preferably, something that captures the awesome spiciness and flavor of ginger. After trying the Organic Ginger Aid tea by Traditional Medicinals and being disappointed (see my review on that) I decided to try out this tea instead.  So, how was it?Well, it was good and bad.  It has "Spicy Ginger" in its title, but it's not spicy at all and you can't really taste the ginger.  So in that sense its pretty bad.  However, its still delicious as a tea, and has a very pleasant lemony flavor (probably due to the lemon myrtle).  I don't normally like lemony-tasting teas, but I absolutely loved this one, so that really says something.  Unfortunately, this tea doesn't really satisfy my craving for ginger flavor.  I would recommend it, however, to those who want the health benefits of ginger but hate the taste.  This would be perfect for those sorts of people.I later discovered that you can make an excellent ginger tea by just boiling some fresh ginger root slices in water.  This resulted in excellent spicy ginger tea and was very cheap to make (since ginger roots are pretty inexpensive).  So, I really recommend this method over buying this tea if you just want ginger flavor.  However, I'll still probably buy this tea since I love it's taste so much otherwise.  In fact, if you are just looking for a tasty good tea (and don't care about having ginger flavor) then I recommend you pick this up.  I only wish they'd change the name to something like "Lemon Myrtle Organic Blend" or some such so that it would more accurately describe the taste that buyers are going to get.  Other than that, though, it gets 4/5 stars simply for still being delicious.
Tazo Spicy Ginger is great.  It soothes the body, enhances your digestion, and tastes great.  Those of you who are herbal lovers, this one's for you.
I was trying to find a true ginger tea; the description failed to include stronger tastes...still a pretty good drink but not what I thought I was buying.

I don't even like ginger that much, but I tried this tea at a friend's house and it was delicious.  I highly recommend this decaf tea for those who want to relax with a big cup of tea on a cold evening.

I decided to try Tazo's Spicy Ginger Organic Tea to add some variety to my several-cups-of-tea-per-day habit. Since trying this Spicy Ginger tea, I now drink it 90%+ of the time. If you like ginger as a flavor, and you like a little bit of spicy kick or bite to your tea, you'll probably love this!

This tea is the best herbal blend I have ever tried from any brand. Most herbal teas rely too heavily on the big hitters: licorice, rosehips, chamomile, mint, orange, and other fruits.Somehow this Organic Spicy Ginger is gingery without being so hot and simple that I could have just boiled ginger in water for a few minutes. It has other notes that balance the ginger and leave me feeling nourished, revitalized, and ready to take on the afternoon.It's not always spicy. I've noticed some boxes are spicier than others. I've also noticed that it doesn't get bitter or tart or yucky in any way when left to steep. In fact, to try and milk the spiciness out of it I don't even bother taking bag out of the cup.I gave this tea to a coworker who was feeling a cold coming on and she requested a second bag a few hours later. Before going home for the day she reported feeling much better. She didn't end up with a cold.The only bummer is that I cannot find this tea anymore in stores! Which is why I looked here on Amazon. And it is not available here either. Why Tazo? Why?

column9: Tazo Organic Spicy Ginger Tea - LOVE!
column10: I love this tea.  It's delicate.  I don't care for overbearing spice or overbearing ginger, and this tea cannot be called overbearing in any way.  It is lovely, addictive, and I've not been able to find it at any local brick and mortar stores.  So yummy!
I find ZYM the best product I have come across for an energizing & hydrating sports drink. I use it daily. I highly recommended this product!!! I'm purchasing another box of 12 tubes today!

column9: Don't bother with this fig jam!
column10: I have become obsessed with trying every fig jam and preserves and chutneys I see available.  They are truly wonderful with goat and sheeps milk cheeses.  There are many brands which are simply wonderful - unfortunately this one is not!The flavor is NOT rich and figgy - it tastes diluted and flat.  The consistency has too much gelatin in it so it is NOT smooth and creamy as it should be.I keep my fig preserves in the refrigerator for AGES - and they never, ever go bad - I had one in there for over two years.  This brand however, actually went MOLDY after a couple of months!!  Good riddens to the most disgusting fig jam I've ever had!Now for some recommendations for delicious brands:  Bonne Maman Fig Preserves (France) is widely available and very nice - creamy with a nice fig taste.  The Adriatic Fig Spread (Croatia) is very widely available - it has a rather bright, fruity taste, a bit more tangy - but also nice. L'Epicurien (France) makes a bunch of fig products - some which I haven't tried yet - but the one I have tried is their Fig and Walnuts Confit.  It is pricey for the size (only 4.4 oz) but it DIVINE - really indescribable - very rich and intense - somewhat sweeter than regular fig preserves - worth trying at least once.And finally is the Vergers de Gascogne Fig Jam (France) imported in US exclusively by Williams Sonoma - and as far as I know - only available in their stores - not on their website.  This one is amazing wonderful - a classic - call them and find out how to order.I have another 6 brands in my pantry ready to taste - but too soon to recommend.  But don't waste your money on this one - that is for sure...

We've tried quite a few different varieties and always bring some home from our travels.  This is one olive oil that my wife and I both love.  It's very smooth and is excellent for cooking, for salads, and dipping.
The Halutza Olive Oil that I purchased is the best tasting olive oil that I have ever tried !  It has a very pure flavor and I have included it in all my recipes.  This is an exceptional product.

I bought this as a gift for someone around the holidays. I wanted to find something that is as good as quality as other places but has a reasonable price. I was very happy with my purchase and the recipient was very pleased and happy to receive it. I will be purchasing more of this product in the future. VERY Very Very Very please with purchase and shipping time.

The product is good, the meat and cheese were as good I remember for pass years.  Unfortunately I found the amount of product very small.  There was more packaging then product.  What I mean is that the packaging made it look like you were getting more them there actually was.  I remember is years past you were able to get more for the money and in this case I felt is was a lot less even in today's economy.

However, this last batch seems defective...not in taste but in assembly.  they burst open at the seams and leave coffee grounds behind. This is the first time I purchased through this particular amazon source and was wowed at the cost per cup ... now I know why.
This by far my favorite coffee in a k cup.  Nice medium bold flavor and it reminds me of the coffee you would get at breakfast in a diner.

I purchased a Keurig coffee maker to use at work, and another one for my home.  Not much of a coffee drinker, so individual portions are ideal for those times when a coffee is tempting.  My friends and I prefer the Donut shop coffee by Coffee People, and I see that it is the most popular selection, according to Keurig. I buy the large quantity when I can find it, since it more economical that way.

These lollipop's are definitely are a good value. For the amount in the package and the price, they are great party favors. Just a heads up on the description; 9" include the lollipop and stick, they actual lollipop is about 4-5". I also expected them to be a little thicker. But all in all they are still great for what I need them for and I'm sure the kids will enjoy them.

I received many different flavors and lollie styles from Kendon Candies and there was not one disappointed student in any of the classes they were delivered to. The older students favorites were the mystery flavored and the younger ones loved the twists. It was a carnival atmosphere when they were delivered and the anticipation was overwhelming because they were coming from the oldest candy factory in the USA! They were not disappointed, neither was I.Thank-you Kate!

When the wine shop I typically buy from wasn't able to get this particular type of wine so I ordered it from Amazon. The kit is 'brewing' as I write but i was pleased with the quick delivery. column9: Better than a Mounds bar in a jelly bean
column10: These little gems are delicious. I tried them as part of the 5-flavor variety and this flavor was my favorite.

The tea is good but not great.  The price, however, is unbeatable.  If you are willing to pay more for top quality, get Yamamotoyama's Tokusen Kokyu Sencha (Premium Green Tea).  If you want a great deal, however, get their regular sencha.

If you drink green tea, you know Yama Moto Yama sencha.  Buying it by the six pack is certainly the most economical way to get it, especially combined with the super saver shipping.Delivery was prompt.  Everything went fine with the order.

If you've largely had only pan-fired (Chinese style) green teas, the kind of green tea they sell in American supermarkets, this tea will probably seem surprisingly flavorful.  It will likely strike you as bold, but still possessing of some nuance; it won't seem too sharp and there will be some slight awareness of a vegetable flavor.That was my experience at least, and the reason I think it depended on my drinking history was that I received a very large quantity of high-grade gyuokuro tea as a birthday present.  It took maybe two months for me to finish that stock, and returning to this tea, I found it bitter and unsubtle-tasting.I've readjusted and appreciate this tea again.  I prefer it because I drink liters of tea a day (I'm what the Japanese would deride as a "tea gulper" rather than a "tea drinker" or a "tea sipper") and it's more economical.  It can even taste good, depending on your history.  I'd recommend it to most Americans who want to give steamed (Japanese style) green tea a try, at least as their starting point.  It's somewhat reminiscent of the supermarket green teas actually, except perhaps bolder and slightly more nuanced, and if they think it's an improvement over those teas then they might want to try the more vegetable flavors of higher-grade senchas.

They actually sent me 12 individual packages when the sale price is only $15.00. I am not sure if they made a mistake or I misunderstood something. Anyway, I am very satisfied with the price.The flavor is fine but not excellent. It's similiar with those tea provided by Asian restaurants. I am an Asian. I think it's an average everyday green tea, not impressed and not bad.

column9: You get what you pay for
column10: This is going to fall under the category of "You get what you pay for". It's not a terrible tea, but I do find that I have to be extremely careful with water temp and steeping time or this is bitter beyond anything drinkable. A dissapointment was that instead of nice large leaves, this rather looks like chopped hay. Kind of smells like it, too. If you're looking for a really excellent green tea to enjoy, you'd probably want to skip this. If you're just looking for a cheap tea to drink daily, this may be ok.

This breaks my #1 rule from 'Tea Buying 101', which is "Never buy tea that comes in a see-through bag".  Light oxidizes tea like water oxidizes iron into rust.  Whenever I see a see-through bag, I see "Attention uninformed consumer - check out this great tea we're showing you, even though by showing it we're ruining the product".You can tell if a (sencha at least) tea is oxidized BTW if it comes out amber vs. light green.  I'd bet money you'll never get a green-colored brew out of this.I'm not saying there's no way this could taste good.  But a see-through bag to the informed is like seeing ketchup served with a fine steak.

I am very disappointed in this green tea.  I bought it to use in protein shakes and it creates a grassy aftertaste that is not at all pleasant.  It makes me not want to drink my shakes at all that were previously delicious with other green teas. I don't steep my tea so I cannot comment on it in that sense, but as soon as I opened one of the bags I could smell the difference from every other green tea I have had. There was no sweet aroma like there typically is with sencha green teas, and it almost made me gag. This is not a high quality green tea and I would recommend buying elsewhere.

I'm not vegan or vegetarian, but I don't have an issue eating vegan friendly foods. I picked up the Dr. McDougall's Miso Ramen because it's somewhat low in sodium. I don't know if it's the lack of sodium, or just the product in general, but this really isn't very tasty. Eatable, yes, but I'm not going to order/eat more.

When I worked in a local cafe, we used Torani chocolcate, caramel, and mayan chocolate sauces.  The store didn't last long, but it wasn't because of the sauces!  Our lattes were the most popular things on the menu, and many people ordered the mocha (that we called Dame Holda), which used this sauce.This sauce is sure to impress if you are whipping up espresso drinks for friends, because it is the cafe stuff--just remember to use good-quality espresso beans with it ;)

For Christmas we got a Saeco espresso machine - this is the brand Starbucks sells, and we know Starbucks well, so we purchased the chocolate (and syrups) SBUX uses, Fontana... It wasn't until I tasted that chocolate separate from my drink that i realized i really really did NOT like it. I looked on Amazon and saw the recommendation of Torani and of Hershey's Special Dark. I bought small bottles of both of those at our local grocery store and tested them.Of the three, Torani won. By far. It is the only one that to me mimicked melted chocolate. With a flavor resembling solid chocolates you would want to eat. Fontana has a very strong corn syrup flavor, almost maple syrupy with the chocolate and Hersheys Special Dark, while a definite improvement over regular, didn't wow me either.Torani's ingredient list shows more dutch cocoa and it shows! I gave it 4 stars because its not perfect, but graded on a curve it is...Surprisingly I had avoided this brand because it is available everywhere and i thought too common to be able to match what i could buy at an actual coffee house, if that makes any sense... I am sure we won't buy fontana again.Next is to sample caramel sauces, something tells me fontana might not win there either.Note that this 64oz bottle (at least at current amazon prices) is a few dollars more than the 6-pack of smaller bottles, and less ounces, but we opted for this because of the ease of the pump to control measuring, etc. It uses the same pumps as Torani syrup bottles...

Pros:*  No High Fructose Corn Syrup.  It uses a sweetener you may not have heard of:  sugar*  Taste amazing*  Makes good mochasCons:*  Thick sauce*  No pump works well unless it is kept at room temp, which means you have to use it within a few weeksIn short: 5 stars.  It's about the taste.

I had been using the Torani chocolate mocha sauce for a long time, but when it wasn't available in the smaller bottles for a while at Amazon, I started freaking out as my supply ran low.  I'm very fussy if I don't make my mocha in the morning.  However, I tried the large bottle of chocolate sauce with the pump after finding out that the stuff does not need to be refrigerated.  I'm a convert now.  The taste is great even though the label is different, but I think it is pretty much the same ingredients, although the proportions of the basic ingredients are a bit different.  I'm a convert now, and I'm just about ready to order a couple more bottles.

column9: could almost be considered a marital aid
column10: As a woman, I must have my chocolate, and as an only child, I dont like to share. These were delicious.  We have enjoyed lentils a lot and have had fun buying different kinds.  These were very mild, and looked nice in the soup.
this product is clean and packaged in a tough plastic bag. excellent way to add whole grains to your diet, and help in losing weight naturally.

Out of the 12 cans, four had huge dents in them, which, according to the USDA's Food Safety and Inspection Service, renders them unsafe for consumption: [...]. So basically, I bought this, and 1/3 of my order was unusable.

I was very excited to get some more Silver Needle Tea.  Their price was competitive but no cheap by any means.First complaint was the packaging the tea was packed in plastic bag and shipped with the second outer plastic bag.  Silver needle tea have beautiful fuzzy little delicate buds that should be handled with care, this was not the case.  However their handling was just a preview to the lack of quality, this tea company sells.Review of the Tea.Aroma: The aroma was weak when compared to other Silver needle tea I've had.Appearance: there was lots of impurities. I will post a picture if I can figure out how. There were pieces of stems beyond the bud.  Piece of leaves of the were clearly not baby buds but of mature leaves.  Lots of brown colors there were pieces of leaves that were clearly not beautiful fuzzy little friends.  The buds that were there were more yellow than the delicate green.brew:  there was lots of debris/particulate in the first few brews.  the brew lacked delicate aroma and its color was off darker than I'm used to.  the flavor was more earthy than delicate reminding me of a strong cheap green tea. this tea also lacked exquisite sweat flavors/aromas that I so love about silver needle teas.on a scale of 1 to 10 I would rate this tea and 1.5 or 2.  For comparison I would rate my last batch of Rishi Organic Silver needle tea an 8.5.I am now stuck with 8 ounces of this very disappointing.  If you are a connoisseur of this absolutely wonderful type of tea save yourself disappointment and look elsewhere.

column9: Mint Jelly is hard to find in my town.
column10: I have learned if i cannot find a product in a town of over 300,000, Amazon will be the place to look. Beautifully packaged product, good mint taste, and reasonable price for a jar of mint jelly.

So much better than the bright artificial green mint jellies; this is the perfect compliment for a nice leg of lamb, carved off the bone into juicy slices, pink and delicious. Somehow mint totally brings out the flavor.

Wow, I wondered why I needed ten times as much mint to achieve the same about of flavor.  Then I took a closer look at the label.  I wish I had been more careful before purchasing Watkins.  The name of the product says 'Watkins Pure Mint Extract', but the fine print is much more honest.Read the fine details before you buy.  I wish I had.  After a lot of searching, I came across nowfoods.com.  They have food grade 100% Pure Peppermint oil and Spearmint oil, with NO alcohol.  I'm sure there are others, but this is the first one I found.

For mint enthusiasts that use a lot of mint extract, this is the product for you. It's much cheaper than buying the 1 oz. containers from grocery stores and of the same quality. I recommend using a transfer pipette to use this, though, as it's difficult to pour sometimes.
This kit contains 6 gallons of juice--not a concentrate. It is so easy to make,and it appears to be a great wine. I will need to age it for a year to be sure of the wine,but it sure does look good.
Love the product....  we have bought from this company before and we really enjoy it......  Can't wait to try the other wine kits...

October 25th, 2012This is my 4th wine kit in 60 days and my second which I sourced from Amazon. As wine & beer making have several steps over time I will update this review as I proceed through all the steps. This is a very heavy container.  Getting that bag empty will be the trickiest part of the wine kit I think. I was simply not strong enough to pick up the bag of 'must' from the bucket shipping container. What I did was to dump the contents of the shipping bucket into my plastic food grade fermentation vessel.Because I couldn't lift the bag out of the primary I had to cut a hole in the bag as near to the bottom as possible and lift the bag out of the primary as the bag drained.  This was still a tricky procedure as the 'must' initially just pooled on top of the 23 liter bag of must.  I think next time I try one of these 55 lbs kits I am going to borrow my step-son who works unloading UPS trucks everyday and is strong as a horse to hold the bag of must clear of the 'primary' while I open the bag the proper way and let it drain into the primary.I have at the time of this writing transferred the juice/must to my plastic primary fermentation vessel, added the bentonite, stirred, added the yeast, and stirred again. column9: What My Dog Said To Tell You
column10: What follows is a statement of personal opinion, an opinion formed based on published reports from the FDA and other credible sources, and widely available on the Internet.  I am a (recent) former user of Evanger's pet food products, and have no affiliation with them, or with anyone else in the pet food industry.  I deeply regret having ever fed any animal Evanger's products, especially animals I love and care for.  Of course, you must do your own research and draw your own conclusions about these matters.  Evanger's has made an explanation of their side of things in some of these matters, although I personally found their "reasons"  entirely unconvincing.I would strongly urge you to research this company for yourself.  In particular, read about the FDA's revocation of their permit for failing to process the food properly, and read about the arrest of the owners on charges that they committed millions of dollars worth of utilities fraud by operating their plant for years with the gas and electric meters bypassed.  If, as alleged, they were operating with stolen utility service, what shortcuts would they be willing to take with your pet's health and safety to reduce manufacturing costs?  And in the vein of cutting costs, read about the successful lawsuit by employees for just under half of a million dollars in unpaid overtime wages.I can't post web links here, but my sources include a Chicago Tribune Article dated March 25, 2010, titled "Lincolnwood couple charged in utility theft scheme" and two articles on the FDA web site entitled "FDA Orders Pet Food Maker to Obtain Emergency Operating Permit" and "FDA Suspends Temporary Emergency Permit of Pet Food Maker".  I would also mention the lawsuit against Evanger's by their employees, which Evanger's appears to have lost.  (Source: web site "Truth About Pet Food") The Northern District of Illinois Distric Court, Case: 1:09-cv-00227, filed 9/15/2010, Final Approval Order Francisco Barragan and Liberto DeLaRosa, on behalf of themselves and all other similarly situated persons (Plantiffs) versus Evanger's Dog and Cat Food Co., Inc., Holly N. Sher and Joel Sher (Defendants).  Don't take my word on this, find out for yourself.The picture these events and reports formed in my mind was one of owners who were willing to do anything to make a buck, without regard to the legalities, consequences to their employees, or to their customers.  Maybe you will come to a different conclusion.  Maybe I  am over reacting.  But I want everyone considering their product to learn the facts, read the articles, and make an informed decision.I hope you find this to be useful.  If anyone can point to any error of fact in my review, please let me know, and I will happily correct it, it is my intention to be fair and accurate.

In contrast to the rest of the year, we didn't have to share 'our' box with any of the other kids.  The oldest of my younger sisters favorite cereal was Lucky Charms.  After getting her box, she would sit down with two bowls and sort the cereal from the marshmallows.  She'd dump the cereal back in the box and eat it as you normally would cereal. Win-win!

Finally after all these years I was able to mix up a bowl of my favorite cereal, and its all thanks to these wonderful marshmallows.
