Probably didn't help that they were all dented but still it was a mess no matter how careful I was.

Having lived in Germany and enjoyed Wienerschnitzls with Jager Sauce on I was delighted to find Wienershnitzels in Aldi but not able to obtain the sauce there , so being able to obtain it on-line was a boon but the cost of sending it from the USA was a bit prohibitive but the product itself was excellent .

I have a golden retriever who loves to eat.  On weekends when I am up before my husband, my golden will bring his empty Kong to me at the computer waiting for something to be put in it.  Luckily I have a large box of these; I will put the Kong Ziggie in it and he'll throw it around for awhile then it is gone....he'll wait another but he gets one a day...He loves these and I love that it keeps him busy for awhile first thing in the morning.  Shipping came quick on these, thank you.
this brand is just ok, Lindt is better.  I love the flavor and will get this again, pear brandy is great, I wish we had more of  here in the US.

I lived in southern Germany for 5 years and loved their egg noodles (Spaetzle). This comes the closest to homemade German Spaetzle of any packaged product I have tried. You will save a lot of money buying by the case, will qualify for free shipping, and it has a long shelf life.

Great, Authentic, wonderful.  I like these, almost the same as homemade, and a lot easier. Amazon's price is good if you are willing to buy a large supply.  If you like German Spaetzle, you will not be disappointed with this product.
These are by far the most traditional blackforest noodles I have found.  And the Amazon price of course beats everyone.

This is the easy way to swallow a teaspoon of cinnamon in 30 seconds or less!  Just use this Cinnamon Matcha instead, and whisk it in hot water.  You'll be gulping it up at record speed!  It is so yummy!Yeah, yeah, I know, that's not the idea behind the cinnamon challenge.  But, I assure you - this is much easier to swallow in 30 seconds, and better for you too.  (Yes, cinnamon is good for you, but it is very questionable, indeed, whether or not its healthy for you to swallow a teaspoon of dry, ground cinnamon.)This is really delicious.  The cinnamon is a spicy-sweet kind of cinnamon, reminiscent of Saigon cinnamon.  Very zesty - it enlivens the palate with its warm, exotic spice.  It makes a really nice combination with the sweet, buttery, vegetal notes of the Matcha.

I'm a sucker for cinnamon, so of course I had to try the Cinnamon Matcha. It smells so good. Sooooo good. Not like fake cinnamon hearts (which I adore too), but like real cinnamon. I want to slather this matcha on toast...but that would be weird. This is another matcha that inspires me to bake. Matcha snickerdoodles? Don't mind if I do! I need to start actually trying some of these recipe ideas. Like cinnamon matcha cinnamon toast! Or a cinnamon matcha apple pie! Nom nom nom.At first sip, it was delicious. At second sip, it was delicious. At third sip...well, you get the idea. There is something I don't care for about it, a bit of a tangy aftertaste, but that's not enough to keep me from drinking it! I'm excited to see how it will taste when blended with the vanilla. Ooooh, I should see if they have an apple matcha, that would be yummy mixed with this. Or pear! Oh dear, my list of desired matchas is growing longer and longer...But really, I just want to dump a whole mess of sugar into this and make some cinnamon raisin toast. And bake my little heart out! I think this is a matcha I will end up mixing more than making straight, but that's okay. I am seeing a wide world of possibilities coming from this little beauty. Cinnamon and I were good friends before, but I think is safe to say that this tea has pushed us over the edge into best friend territory. Plays well with others, makes me feel better, and encourages me to eat tasty, tasty sweets! I can see this becoming a staple in my cupboard, sitting right next to my beloved vanilla.

I got this for my dad who is the president of a college around Christmas and they were eating it at parties at their house for months and they said it stayed fresh and delicious the entire time. This is a huge bag of trail mix.

It's a great product, the best tea I ever tasted.I bought for my friends and they loved it very much and asking to get more of that tea. My friend are actually coffe drinkers, now drinking that tes a lot.Really great product.

I ordered this by mistake, and what a happy mistake it has been!  This tea is very sweetly aromatic in a way I find delightful. I have been enjoying a pot with just a teaspoon of sugar which seems to bring the flowery undertones out.  This tea has taken over my morning ritual for the summer, as coffee is too heavy in the heat.

column9: So many Russians could'nt be wrong
column10: This tea is a very big surprise. I have really enjoyed this tea in the evening. It is like desert to a diabetic. It's like cheating. The taste is mild and slightly sweet without adding sugar. Importantly to me is that it does not have a lot of caffene, and I can have it at 8:00 pm when I am reading a novel and allow me to go right to sleep. I will order this product again and again.
I purchased this item as a gift, and the recipient really seemed to like the gift. They have not yet tried the tea, but I am sure they will be pleased.

Now try another great marriage:  Aioli and Mustard!Aioli (basically, garlic mayonnaise with a fancy label) is blended with a brown mustard that expands the versatility of this mild, creamy condiment (OK, I'm not a gourmet).  Not just for fish and pasta anymore - I love it with my Sunday weisswurst.[WVM's Aioli Garlic Mustard Sauce]

column9: Do Not Order from this Seller
column10: This is a good mustard but a horrible seller.  Box arrived with 8 out of 32 mustard molded or unusable.  Who knows how this was stored, but I am throwing away the box.  Amazon appears to take no responsibility for selling faulty merchandise.
I thought these bags would have more candy than they did so, I'm a little disappointed in this bag. However, the delivery was everything you could ask for. I wish there would have been a bag count.
What can I say, it's skittles.  I think for the price you get a lot and it's individually packaged in small bags so my 3 year old feels content when I give her, he little colorful treat.
I do a lot of cooking and have always kept a good supply of Tone's seasonings.  Their product quality is high and consistant.
I used it on my yard... The neighbor's dog quickly taught HIS OLD OWNER a new trick... To walk him elsewhere..  =)I'm happy and yard looks nice!

column9: Fresh and tasty Cayenne Pepper - generous amount and good value
column10: As other reviewers have mentioned, cayenne pepper is also good to deter animals from getting into certain places. It has been good for cats, and smaller dogs, not so much for my curious Labrador who will smell and eat anything.This Tone's Ground Cayenne Pepper is a great for my cooking needs. The cayenne pepper is fresh, tasty, and has good value for the price.
This cayenne pepper is every bit as good as the expensive organic variety, but is many times more efficient to buy!
I have used this product as a deterrent for any dogs to dig up on or around my flower bed, it works and would recomment it to others, great price and well packaged during delivery.
I am a big fan of spicey foods. This Cayenne pepper adds the heat to any dish. Fish, chicken, pork...doesn't matter.

I get these at the store & not on line. I like these almost as much as coco wheats. I like the individual packages I take these to work because they are wraped seperately. Great with water & milk. Better with chocolate milk. So Yummy! Good food!

column9: LOVE this stuff, but DON'T buy online!
column10: Chocolate Cream of Wheat is AMAZING - especially when you make it with lots of water and milk to make it thin and creamy. I just drink it as I drive to school in the morning!However DO NOT BUY from this seller online. It is way overpriced and you only get 3 packets! Try to find it at a grocery store. Many stores don't have it, but when they do, I buy a ton of it to stock up!

column9: Love the taste, recommend the seller.
column10: I love this new taste. jsut need it in the box like the regulars (instead of jsut 3 packets for the regular price, want 12 packets for the same, jsut like the original and other flavors).
This was a gift for my dad. He LOVED it! It was hard for me not to eat them before Christmas. I Had to go and buy some for myself!

Culinary Teas gets customer service. I got my tea earlier than expected--it was fresh w/a v. Floral flavor. The company even sent a sample of another flavor of tea. I've ordered from them again & will continue to do so!

column9: You won't find this texture in a caramel anywhere else!!!
column10: I've tried many salted caramels and only authentic French caramels have this slightly gritty texture that I think comes from the sea salt. Anyhow, I love this caramel!!! It's worth the price especially since it qualifies for free super saver shipping. The honey is noticeable but not overwhelming and gives it a very unique quality. Does anyone else have any other sea salt caramels recommendations?

column9: The only dog food I use
column10: I have had a dog or two of my own for the past 20yrs.  Once we found out that our first dog needed a better diet and that the brands at the grocery store had more fillers, we have only used the eagle pack product since. In the past few years we have even talked our friends and family to use this product. Our local store has been our supplier for years.  This was a very easy purchase and gets delivered to my door.  I will continue to ordering from this source as the price locally has increase many time.
I am very happy with the beans.. I made bean soup and they held together but cooked evenly and were delicious.
Do not buy this product!  Lousy!!!  The inner wrapper will not come off of the product and is so stale that it is disinegrating so it isn't even able to be eaten.

This is a great training treat for my 13 year old cat. I do clicker training with her and am always looking for a treat that she is satisfied with, but doesn't fill her up. These are perfect for that because they break up into little bits easily and Rusty thinks they are fabulous.
My cats are addicted to this stuff!  They actually beg for it.I've purchased cans in area pet stores, but buying it online is much cheaper and more convenient.  My guys are spoiled!!!

column9: My cats go nuts for this treat!
column10: They can be at the opposite end of my home and if I take the lid off the Kitty Kaviar they cannot run fast enough in the hopes of getting some!  My older cat had a medical issue at the beginning of the year and has to eat canned food only with a lot of water added which, even when he is hungry, he is not always willing to eat -- I put a little Kitty Kaviar on it and, wah~la, the bowl is suddenly empty!  Also, this company is great -- got my order quickly and in great condition.

column9: LOVE this whole line of organic food
column10: My daughter is 7 mos old now and has been eating baby food since about 5 mos (cereal & oatmeat at about 4 mos).  I originally planned to make all of her food, but that quickly became very hard to keep up with being that my husband and I both work full time.  I searched and found the Sprout line at Whole foods and tried a couple of the stage one foods.  My daughter LOVED it!  I keep thinking we are going to give her one that she doesn't love as much, but so far, after trying all the stage ones and a couple of the stage two's she loves it all.  I would say this squash and the sweet potatoes are her favorite and more filling to her.  I haven't had any issues with the packaging. I actually feed her right out of the pouches and don't really find it difficult to get it all out,  I make sure that I shape it to the most open position so I can get the spoon in and out and scrape the bottom easily.  Love being able to toss a couple into her bag for trips to grandma's house.

Our baby was ready for a little supplementation to breastfeeding, so we've tried the Sprout line-Stage 1 for a week now, 6 different flavors, & I love it!  Every one of the foods tastes delicious (I would happily eat it myself), & my 4 1/2-month old son has gobbled up every one.  They are a thicker consistency, which I find to be a plus - it's easier for my son to swallow & not spit any out with each bite.  It stays in his mouth well.  I noticed some other reviewers didn't like the packaging, saying it was messy & hard to get the food out.  I haven't had that problem.  The packages tear open smoothly at the top every time, with no splattering.  Then I just squeeze the food out into a bowl, & almost every bit of it comes out.  There isn't waste. I found these at the same price as Earth's Best, which has BPA in the lid, so I'm thrilled to get a perfectly safe packaging & HIGH quality organic food for my baby, & not have it cost more then the other organic foods!

Very thick! My baby got constipated but i gave her prunes, she really likes the meal, she eats the whole thing when she was seven months. It's pricey! I am not going to buy again, but quality and flavor are a GO!
Baby loves the squash inside but I wish the top were ziploc.  I also don't love the bottom crease in which food gets stuck.  Good food, bad packaging.

I started buying these through Amazon's Subscribe and Save Subscription, which is a great deal for quick on-the-go meals, when my twins started eating solids.  Now, at 20 months, they still like it.  On my last order the packaging changed, so it no longer has the attached closure, which was helpful, but I rarely have any food leftover, so it's not a big issue.  I've also used it when baking as a substitute for pumpkin!

This butternut squash taste good!  Love the portability of these pouches.  They are messy to open.  I use scissors to cut below the ziploc line so I don't have to deal with it.  The ziploc is nice though if you are going to have leftovers.  We never do.

My son loves this & I love that I know what it is (it isn't "mystery squash").  I agree with the prior poster about the consistency - it is surprisingly thick.  But we just added some formula to thin it out a bit.I also think the packaging on the Sprouts baby food is annoying.  Eco friendly - great.  But it is very messy trying to get the contents out into a bowl & there is always a fair amount left in there that you can't get out.  It is resealable, which is great so that I can spoon out a little at a time, but with the mess trying to get food out, food gets caught in the zip & I end up having to rinse it.  The quality is enough that I will put up with the annoying packaging, though.

The thicker consistency of the butternut squash makes it a more fulfilling food. However, it took my son a few bites before getting used to it. The package says it's a Stage 1, but I think the consistency makes it a Stage 2 food.

column9: Smells great - strong aftertaste, but not horrible
column10: Gnu Bars is on to something good, but they need to keep on working a little.This one has a really great fragrance when you open the package. Very orangey.Now on to the taste/texture. The texture is the same as all the other Gnu Bars -very moist, very chewy, very good for you. This one is okay, but do consider thiswhen you make your purchase. There is NO ORANGE JUICE or orange product in this bar.I can only guess that the overwhelming orange flavor comes from the "natural flavors"in the ingredients list. The cranberries are good. Overall tasty, but leaves a veryodd orange aftertaste. Definitely not my favorite bar.Ingredient list:Gnu High Fiber Blend (whole rolled oats, organic whole wheat flour, wheat bran, organic kamut, psyllium, flax, millet),chicory root, inulin, fruit juices, rice dextrins, raisins, apples, canola oil, plums, cranberries, rice,natural flavors, wheat protein isolate, baking power.Nutrition Facts:1 bar.Calories - 130Total Fat - 3 gmCholesterol - 0 mgSodium - 35 mgTotal Carb - 32g, Fiber 12g, Sol Fiber 8gProtein - 3 gVit A - 0%Vit C - 0%Calcium - 6%Iron - 9%
Sure, it costs more than it did when it *was* available at my Costco. But it's no longer there, so I'm glad I can find it here for a reasonable price. It's delicious!

After buying this product today at Costco (for less than $7), I had heated some up with milk in the microwave. I found it delicious and much easier to chew than hard granola.  It is so good for us, to eat these ancient grains!  I will probably eat this for a snack, too.  As Martha says, It is a good thing.

I love this cereal & am mad that it's not available.  I orginally got this from Costco but they recently stopped selling it!  It has a great taste & is very filling.  My only objection is that it's a lil' too sweet for my taste.  I just rinse it off with water before adding milk and then it's perfect!

Bottom line, this stuff is delicious and filling, and should keep you going until lunch. But just because it's cereal, don't limit yourself to pouring milk over it. My breakfast this morning was granola, Greek yogurt, and a sliced banana -- a fantastic combination.As others have noted, it's way cheaper at Costco, so get it there if you can.

column9: Great Tasting Organic Cereal!  It Might be Addictive...
column10: As many reviewers have already noted, this is a "Kirkland" brand product from Costco.  The price from many vendors roughly seems to be around twice of what Costco charges in their warehouse store.  I highly recommend getting it from Costco if you can.  If you're not able to for one reason or another, the total price (including shipping) still seems to be reasonable when you consider the amount of "organic" cereal you're getting.If you haven't tried this cereal before, it is a delectable cluster of grains and almonds.  It is my favorite cereal and I have to be extra careful how much I eat.  It is one of my guilty, yet healthy pleasures.  I have to cut myself off at two servings!  There comes a time when you've had too much of a good thing!BOTTOM LINE:  Highly recommended for people who love tasty and healthy cereal and can't get it at Costco!

This cereal is amazing!  It tastes wonderful and keeps me full for quite a while.  I was never eating breakfast in the morning until I tried this and now I cannot wait to have it in the AM.  And the best part is that it keeps me full for hours.  I get it at Costco however because it is more convenient and better priced.  I don't know where others are located, but where I live, I am able to get this at Costco.  If they ever stop selling it there, I would still fork out the money for it online.  It is THAT good:)
this proget it for a thjduce is way overpriced you can it for a third of the price at Costco

I bought these b/c I felt a sinus infection creeping up on me...spring allergies are wreaking havoc once again. I love drinking anise tea so I saw these "Jakemans Throat and Chest" lozenges, anise flavored, and wanted to give them a try. They are deliciously smooth and have helped soothe my sore throat and another great side effect, they have really helped clear my sinus passages too. Great little lozenges, I will keep these in my medicine cabinet for sure.

"Krunchie" might be exaggerating, given the mix of oil and vegetable gum, but I bet someone with lots of paper towels could line something or other to soak up the oil and gums while baking until the wedges are "krunchie".

These plants are holding up great.  I bought two of them two months ago for a really shady spot in my house - across the room from a north facing window. I repotted them into bigger pots when they arrived. Two months later, they've put out new leaves, new shoots, and are doing fantastic. I tend to forget to water them and they are still alive. If I didn't kill them yet, you probably won't either.  Good buy.

The potatos and hot dogs are really good.... In fact they are great and will order again. The steaks and burgers are crap. Steaks are very chewy and dry. The burgers are too.... Id rather eat bubba burgers... They are much better.
I ordered this, again for my brother's Birthday.  He enjoyed it so much last year, I ordered another one for him!  Great tasting food!

column9: Incredible burst of flavor, ecstasy in a jar
column10: I tried this today at a local gourmet purveyor of wild mushrooms, it was in a salt shaker at the cashier.  I've never tasted anything so wonderful, incredible.  So, I bought a jar immediately.  I was on my lunch hour from work and I had stopped and bought a basil, fresh mozzarella and tomato sandwich, would this taste good on it?  Oh my goodness, it certainly did.  A little goes a long way, but this is an incredible condiment to add to your pantry.  I won't be without it if I can manage it.  Don't hesitate, it is worth every single cent of the price.

column9: You'll either love it...or you won't.
column10: I discovered this in a specialty store in Seattle and was immediately smitten.  It's absolutely delicious on egg dishes (try it on a homemade egg and cheese breakfast sandwich!) and turns ordinary buttered popcorn into a culinary masterpiece.  Here's the catch -- my husband *hates* it.  LOATHES it.  The smell alone makes him push his own truffle-salt-free dish away because he can't get the scent out of his nose.  So now I'm reduced to using my precious find when I'm home alone with the dog.  Thankfully he doesn't seem to mind it.

I purchased this product at Dean & Deluca and have been very satistfied with it taste that compares as close to fresh truffles as possible.  The salt holds all the aromas and flavors of the truffle.  The finishing salt just adds that extra something to a dish that you can't describe without having used it before.  I highly recommend this product because it will last and continue to add that something special to anything from poached eggs to bread and butter. Worth the price.

column9: Excellent! Buy it once, and you're hooked!
column10: I have to say, truffle salt will elevate your dishes to new heights. The 3.5oz jar seems small, but it is strong, and a little goes a long ways. great on buttered popcorn like everyone says, but it's even better on lamb or beef. If you're looking to try truffles without breaking the bank, my vote goes to truffle salt.

column9: From the Moment You Open the Jar!
column10: Truffle salt is heaven on earth.  Imagining what to put it on is my favorite thing.  This is the best one I've tried so far.  The size of the jar makes this one easier to grab a pinch out of too as opposed to some others I've seen.  Luckily, I was introduced to this salt by a friend who made me taste it.  AFTER I was already hooked, she told me the price.  There was no way I could question the worth or the necessity at that point...needed truffle salt immediately!

I've been using this truffle salt for about a year now, and I can't say enough good about it. It is, in fact, fabulous! You need only a tiny pinch to add an incredible truffle flavor to what ever you are serving. Try roasting asparagus with a little olive oil and a light sprinkle of this truffle salt. While it seems expensive initially, it takes so little to make a big impact, it really isn't that costly. The truffle scent is so intense, you can smell it through the jar. And if you're a truffle lover, that scent is almost better than French perfume.

Casina Rossa Truffle and Salt - 3.5oz.A friend gave me this gift, and what a wonderful gift it is!!  It is great sprinkled on fresh veggies, salads and so good I'm tempted to sprinkle on my cereal...not really, but it is that good! Anyone who samples this immediately gets a smile on their face and ideas for what they could put it on.
Just got this for xmas and rubbed down our dry aged prime ribroast with it for dinner and it is amazing...I can't stop cracking it open for a littl salty truffel pinch.

Recently celebrated my 40th birthday and my compadres treated me to 3 days of gourmet home-cooking.  We opened a jar of this Truffle & Salt on the first night and were [all three of us] forever hooked.  We put it in everything- Greek Fries, Swiss Raclette Fondue, American Steaks there was no WRONG.  While the flavor IS distinctive, it is in no way over powering.  Used in moderation, it's a perfect compliment for just about any meal.  We even put it on ice cream.  -Don't ask.  For truffle-lovers, this salt might as well be powdered heroin, for first-timers a delightful treat.  Just go for it--  You won't be disappointed!

Start your day off right.  Cook some steel cut oats and amaranth (2:1) in unsweetened almond-flavored soy milk.  When almost finished stir in some dried blueberries.  When finished, sprinkle with truffle salt and pepitas.This is probably the most healthy and addictive breakfast you can eat.  I'm here because I'm almost out of truffle salt and I don't think I could bear to run out.

column9: just a pinch goes a long way
column10: Pretty great deal for a truffle salt that packs a lot of truffle flavor.  Just a tiny pinch goes a long way in terms of flavor, so this salt should last you quite awhile.

For foodies, this is the ultimate.  A little pinch of this miracle ingredient, and your otherwise ordinary dish is transformed.  We use it for things as pedestrian as eggs in the morning to dishes as delectable as sauteed sea scallops.  One jar lasts us about a year.

Wasn't sure what to expect, but the flavor is amazing! A little goes a long way, well worth the cost. I love the flavor of salt & the truffle aroma is intoxicating. Sprinkle a pinch over eggs, roast, veggies... it's liberating. This salt brings out the flavor of foods. My favorite is a few pinches over fried eggs, toast with grape jelly (jelly from concord grapes in my back yard) & a slice of cheese. Comfort food from my childhood. My big fear is that I drop the little jar when it's open!

column9: a good product that overshot the mark
column10: This truffle and salt is impressive in its intensity, but almost to a fault. The mushroomy-garlicky taste and aroma is good in moderation but I found that the salt can act as an obnoxious contaminant in the kitchen, as even fractions of a grain can aromatize an uncleaned countertop or dig itself into your clothes to assert itself later. I store the sealed jar in a firmly-snapped plastic container for security. While the summer truffle content appears to be legit, I suspect that the overpowering aspect is due to an artificial chemical additive that likely covers the vague "truffle flavor" on the label, though I'd like to believe that that is actually a natural extractive of truffle peelings or whatnot.
This stuff is great to make egg dishes special.  It does add a truffle scent but you must cut down on adding other salt.

I have tried many truffle products including a few truffle salts and the Casina Rossa is by far one of the best products I have used.  The truffle to salt ratio is high and the aromatics are very strong and fresh.  Sprinkle this salt on egg's, pasta, sandwich, salads...etc.  You won't be dissapointed buying this product.

This product can be used on anything--other than probably ice cream. I add it to soups, put it on chicken and steak before grilling it, and I even use it on popcorn. This is a must have for any foodie.

This stuff is what it is all about!  The tiniest pinch makes almost everything taste better.  My kids don't like it as it is too strong of a flavor but that means more for me.  It is one of my chef's secret go to seasonings.  Just use 1/4 as much as you think you might need.  People love this stuff, it's like CRACK!  In fact, one of my friends nicknamed a potato dish I make with this "Crack Potatoes"!!! I would give this stuff 6 stars if I could!!!  I use it all the time and this jar lasted me over a year.  Well worth it.

Is it worth it - let me search it...Fennel is muy good. Salt is muy good. Put them together and you get more muy than you would with a Spanish cow. We put it on everything from omelettes to pizza to chicken and fish.Some people think love makes the world go around - I happen to believe it has more to do with the conservation of angular momentum but a distant second would be this salt. It is good and makes other ordinary things into special tasty treats.Me gusta.

If you love the taste and smell of truffles but don't want to spend a lot of money, this is a great solution.  It perfectly enhances a variety of dishes.  It's great for spicing up boring scrambled eggs.  It is wonderful on pastas with wild mushrooms, risotto, poached chicken breasts, etc.  It works well even on grilled thick Italian bread with olive oil.

I've had this salt before and purchased more 'cause I like it. However, when I opened the box I could smell the fragrance of the product. I found the seal on the jar was broken and the lid was loose. This vendor (Kiva Health Brands LLC) obviously has no compunction about selling a food item with the safety seal compromised; there are two other reviews complaining of the same problem and I can't image how the seal would break in-transit. Four stars for the product itself but one star for the handling.Casina Rossa Truffle and Salt by Nicola de Laurentiis - 3.5 oz.
Great smell and taste if you are a truffle lover, fresh and granular, mix with olive oil for bread dipping- delicious.

I was in a store which sold odd ball food items from various countries and came across this truffle salt. I have heard before of the truffles high prices and good tastes, but there was no way I wanted to pay 30 dollars for a 3.5oz container of the stuff. It was gifted to me in the end and I used it sparingly, but the flavor is so awesome you don't really need much. This item is a must for all foods really; especially popcorn! The flavor is special and kinda smokey, a flavor you cant imagine till you try it!
Got strong truffle smell before opening Amazons box - the jar was not closed properly.You Cannot Sell Spices In Non-hermetically sealed jars!!!

Pretty much what i expected. Tasty & aromatic. However will continue to look for a product with like 10% truffle content. This salt contains "truffle essence" aswell which makes me wonder if a good portion of the aroma flavor comes from synthetic chemicals as found in other various mock truffle products. If that is the case, mehh whatever. Overall, I am pleased with the purchase.

The smell of this salt is quite strong, and pungent even it only has 5% truffle in it. I rated 4 stars because I wish it had 10% truffle. I've used this salt to sprinkle over potato gratin, steak , gravy and sauteed mushrooms. Voila!
Ordered this item with the intention of using it for a particular recipe and loved it so much have used it on pasta and roasted vegetables. You won't be disappointed with the purchase.

A dear "Chef" Friend gave this to me as a house warming gift.  I find myself going to the cupboard just to open it and smell the aroma.  My friend said it is great on eggs and fish and vegetables.  That is for sure!  i am sure there are other uses and i hope to find them.  baked potato anyone?  this is a wonderful gift for yourself or another.  highly recommended.  hmmm....so yummy!
A pinch of this truffle and salt mixture transforms any dish into a gastronomic delight! I use it every day. Fortunately, a little goes a very long way.

I had a problem with my first order,but I didn't contact the seller.  Instead, I left bad seller feedback.  The seller (The Frenchy Bee) immediately contacted me and resolved the problem in a very professional manner.  I should have contacted the seller before leaving the feedback.  I learned a lesson.The salt is awesome.  I haven't had the opportunity to use it much.  So far, I have used it in scrambled eggs and I have sprinkled it over pasta.  It really enhances food.  I don't use very much of it, since it is quite fragrant.  The taste is earthy, but subtle when used in moderate amounts.  I look forward to using this salt in many more dishes.

column9: Nice aroma but after 1 year it will disappeared.
column10: I like this salt and purchase it periodically for my egg dishes and omelettes.But be prepared than after 1 year truffle aroma will completely disappeared from well closed jar and you will get just regular sea salt.It happened already 2 times with this salt. I think this is by nature of this product and have no complains, but it is $25/year spice.
You only need a small pinch of this salt to add loads of a unique flavor to your food.Very good!
Heard people talking about putting this on popcorn with some lemon juice....had to try it.  I found this to be delicious on many things.  Will definitely buy again.

The important fact about Casina Rossa Truffle and Salt is the word AND.  It is truffle and salt combined, so when using it, little bits of truffle will season your food instead of just an infused salt flavor. It's great on poultry, meat, and transforms ordinary eggs into something really  gourmet.  Truly delicious!
This truffle salt has quite a bit of truffle flavor.  It is as flavorful or more so than the infused truffle oils I've had.  Just a little sprinkle is enough. This jar will last you a long time.
Really sparks up chicken and/or pork.  I use it in my vegatables.  Highly recommend.

column9: Good but perhaps too distictive flavor
column10: I bought this after having the fortune of a chance encounter with white truffle oil which I found quite tasty. Also I've had black truffles on french dishes in restaurants of which I also was quite fond. So I looked up various truffle options and decided to give this salt a try. The reviews were lauding this product as being the best thing to the fresh truffle itself .. But alas I was disappointed and really kind of frustrated. Maybe it's 'cause I've had the real thing, but no because the truffle oil is still not an issue. The problem is the strong and distinctive quality of this product which doesn't always enhance but rather changes the flavor of foods I've put it on directly. Unfortunately I haven't always found this change for the better. But it has been OK in soups or stews where the flavor is blended in. Maybe I just got a bad batch or something? I don't know if this sort of thing is like wine where storage conditions can damage it? Anyways I give it 3/5 stars.

I picked this truffle salt because of the user reviews.  When I opened the jaw, the aroma was like a brick in the face.  I thought that the flavor was going to be watered down, but couldn't be wrong.I read that it was great on eggs, so I took a pinch and added it to my eggs.  When I took a taste I nearly vomited. I may have added too much, or may be like the husband of another reviewer.  This may be just a flavor that is a love it or hate it.  I REALLY wanted to love this stuff, but it's just vile to my taste buds.I gave it 3 stars because I want others to know that they may be cursed with my genetic taste buds.  I envy those of you that love it!!!!!

When I look at the label it says 5% truffle so 95% salt.  It smells mostly like salt.  It looks mostly white, with specks of dark spots.  So you are basically paying for the salt.  Like someone said I would need at least 10%.I do not like the real thing concentrated but this is not enough.  I would have to add some myself. It tastes OK if you like salt.
The company has great customer service.  There was an error in the original mailing, and the company promptly re-mailed it to me for free.  Also, the product was excellent quality.

Garlic and especially garlic juice can make your dinner a little more exciting. Reese Garlic Juice seems to be a little condensate, so be careful. The best thing you can do is to use a little water and add a little juice until you think the taste is okay.A little secret about garlic. Garlic (fresh, powder or juice) reinforces your immunity system to all kinds of inflammation. If you suffer from psoriasis and you persist in taking every day a teaspoon of garlic juice in say, a bowl of soup, after one or two months the skin disease slowly disappears. If you don't believe it try it any way, what do you have to lose. It worked with me so why not with you?

I make pickled garlic asparagus every year and sell it at my roadside stand.  My garlic asparagus is a big seller and I couldn't make it without this important ingredient.  Hard to find in the store, especially in my small community.  Great find for me.

column9: Has harsh burning taste. Not as good as some other garlic juices.
column10: Tastes like the old McCormick garlic juice which theyquit making because nobody could stand the taste. Thereare some good garlic juices out there though. Just diga little deeper.

Best flea control for my dogs I have ever used. Better than all those expensive topical applications that only work half the time.just put a cap full in their drinking water, every time you give them fresh water and it is that easy.

Buttercrisps, sesame, wheat--such a variety, and Grandma loves them all. We keep an extra package on the top shelf, just to look forward to! They came quickly, and none of them were broken.Keebler Toasted Crackers, Three Assorted Flavors (8-Ounce each), 40-Ounce Box

In my opinion, this is the best pizza sauce!  Moved away from Chicago where we could get it at most any store, now we have to buy it online. tried other brands but nothing compares to Pastorelli!  it's delicioso.  Thank goodness for internet orders!!!!!!!!!!

I bought a case of this on the stellar reviews and should have tried one can as a trial b/4 I did that.  I am not crazy about this pizza sauce.  All I taste on the pizza is this sauce, it overpowers the pizza in its entirety.  It is a darker color too, not a bright red.  It has romano cheese in it, so perhaps it is overpowering the sauce.  I prefer Gia Russa, Cento, and Don Pepino...no cheese in those sauces, so I suspect it is the cheese that I prefer OUT of the sauce.  You can always sprinkle some on the pizza to taste.  I also like that the other three brands are allergen free so I can use it safely for my granddaughter who has nut, egg and dairy allergies.  Don Pepino does not contain citric acid (a preservative) which keeps the tomato taste clean and authentic tasting. I will probably use this sauce on occasion but most probably more as a regular sauce in Bolognese, meatloaf, etc..

...I've been making my own home-made pizza sauce for several years with home grown tomatoes, or top shelf whole tomatoes. Mine tastes very good!  I've tried 'store bought' pizza sauces just to see what's on the shelves... yuck! WAY too sweet!  Then I saw the reviews for Pastorelli's sauce on Amazon and - what the heck - gave it a try. Wow! Terrific pizza sauce!  No preservatives, additives, no sugar (that I could see on the ingredients), nicely spiced and very 'authentic' excellent taste. Give it a try!  (I make my own rare Italian yeast/sour dough 3-day cold rise crust, and store-bought offerings can NEVER replace THAT, thank-you-very-much ;-)  The 8-ounce is good for 2 pizzas... I bought the 15 oz cans, - 1/2 can too much - and used the left-over for pasta sauce. Good that way, too.

column9: Great Pizza Sauce - But Needs Better Price
column10: This is very good pizza sauce - but the price isvery high.  I bought some anyway thinking that thetaste may be extremely superior to such a degree asto justify the price - but it was not so.

column9: Product is fantastic, their shipping really stinks

I'll have to buy a manual can opener in hopes of being able to open the 9 cans that are useless now for any electric opener.Prices here were far better than the only store in my area that carries these, but it's not worth the hassle for the mangled cans I ended up getting.

column9: So far the best pizza sauce
column10: This is better than Contadina as that one tends to be slightly bitter while Pastorelli has a better balance and is slightly sweeter. Another option to try if you like a sweeter sauce is the Prego Sweet Basil spaghetti sauce...face it sauce is sauce the thickness is the same its just labled PIZZA sauce to make ya feel good.

I've hear that home-made sauce is the best, but who has the time? I bought this sauce at target today and I think it's very good... flavorful but not to spicy. These cookies are fabulous.  Simple and sweet.  They are a little on the sweet side, but when everyone else is having cake and pie and you do not, this is a great thing to pull out and reward yourself with.

This makes not only great pancakes, but also delicious muffins and chocolate chip cookies.  My husband prefers these pancakes to non-GF ones.  And no one can tell that the muffins and cookies are GF!  I highly recommend this.

column9: sweet and crisp, like autumn in new england
column10: I'm usually *not* a flavored tea person, and I'm definitely not a "fruit for dessert" person (the idea of candied apples makes me gag a little bit), but I LOVE this tea. I highly recommend it.My brewing recommendation: 1.5 teaspoons to 16 oz of water (or one full Ingenuitea) for no more than 3.5 minutes. Had this for the first time on an Alaskan Cruise.  Ordered some as soon as I got home.  Wonderful scent, great cinnamon flavor.  Good for morning and afternoon tea. Very smooth.
I am into tea and have to say this is the best tea I have ever tasted. I look forward to it every morning. It is so naturally sweet and aromatic. And I never review anything.

I am used to this rice since the days I was living in the middle east. It's a top quality rice, no question. However, the seller is really charging too much for it here in the US. It's very, very, very overpriced compared to back home. I wish the seller would adjust the pricing...
i try thus type of rice when i was in my country ( saudi arabia )i  thought i couldn't find it in USA but fortunately i found it in amazonreally its pretty good .

Small bottles of rose essence I bought at an Indian grocery smell much more like roses than this product does. Product was as described, I guess, although disappointing after such a long wait. Product took over two weeks to arrive and the other items that were ordered on the same day aren't even in the package. I feel let down by the seller and won't use them again.

I use these macadamia nuts in my smoothies, cookies and salads. We love them and appreciate the fact that macadamias are great for us!

If you love to cook with spices you must use Whole Spices! The product is outstanding and the cost is great. Compared to buying in small bottles--you can't compare for price.The Garlic Pepper is our favorite. We go through a bag a month!
Very good product, grew up with cardamon and can't live without it. I use it in baking and add it to my steel cut oats in the morning!

If you are a coffee flavoring lover, you are bound to enjoy Monin French Vanilla.  It's made with cane sugar and a delectable, truly French vanilla flavor.  I love both the Vanilla and French Vanilla syrups and often alternate between the two in order to fully enjoy the subtle difference between them. I ordered these for a bridal shower to make the favors and they turned out great!  The shipment came just in time and I had so many of them that I am thinking of using the rest as the rehearsal dinner bouquet for the bride. this is by far the most delicious lolipop i ever ate! sorry for my english, im from other country, but this lolipop is very tasty, and beautifoul, i bought it for my daughter 2 year old party, and it was amazing, everibody loved it!I will absolutly buy it again!
the product has a great taste and the price was right.this product for those who are not aware,takes the place of sugar and sweeteners that are harmful to your body.try it in coffee and be heathier.

However, this plastic liner makes the packet impossible to open without scissors!  And who travels with scissors?This product could be greatly improved if there was an easy-open slit in the packaging, and would be more environmentally-friendly without the plastic. It really boggles the mind that they would put this into convenient, portable packets, then make it so maddeningly difficult to open the packets. Packaging FAIL.
Great product which is gluten free and not made with corn. Great tasting sweetener that I add to everything including all baked goods instead of sugar.
This stevia tastes great. It shipped quickly and it is priced right. We would buy it again. 100 packs of this stuff goes a long way.

Oh my goodness! This sweetner is the best. I've switched to stevia a few years ago but had only been able to find regular in stores locally. The French vanilla flavor is a treat in my coffee every morning. If you're looking to tweak changes in your eating and drinking habits, this is one to begin with.
I had been looking for a vanilla Stevia powder for months as Whole Foods no longer makes vanilla.  This NOW brand is even better tasting!

column9: I make large pans of jell-o "bites" for snacks
column10: and I can't always find the large boxes and, definitely not in the more "exotic" flavors beyond orange and cherry. This (plus large quantities of Knox gelatine) is the answer. Now I have enough on hand in the basement to make what I want when I want.
This flavor is very hard to find in the store. The price was better than in the store, larger package and flavor I wanted was available.  Will purchase again!

Many coffee brands that advertise their beans as "Kona" are blends, containing only ten percent beans from the highly desirable region, but these Aloha Island Gold beans are pure Kona, all from plants grown on the Big Island in the designated microclimate that produces some of the smoothest coffee beans in the world. While the Aloha brand may not be Hawaii's best, it is certainly one of the more available brands on the mainland.  Store in the freezer to maintain optimal freshness, and grind the beans immediately before brewing.For coffee connoisseurs, two phrases light up their eyes, "Jamaican Blue Mountain" and "Kona."  If you want to give a gift sure to impress a sophisticated coffee drinker, you've found your beans.

column9: One of the best coffees out there
column10: Finally a coffee that is full of wonderful flavor without all of the bitterness and half of the acidity of regular coffee.  I can drink as many cups as I want without worrying about getting a stomach ache!  I will never go back to another coffee and will recommend this to everyone I know.

I absolutely love this coffee! It is extremely rich and smooth and without any of the bitterness that most other coffees have.Don't let the cost of this coffee scare you because you will actually use less of this coffee when you brew so it really ends up costing about the same as any other "regular" coffee. I highly recommend it.

Yes, it's expensive.  Most of the finer things in life are.  Buy it whole bean, get a good burr grinder and a french press.  You will not be dissapointed.  Anyone that has a cup of joe at my house is blown away, even me...every time.

It seems there is never a place where I can buy a good 100% Kona here in the States. At last I found it!  GOLD Estate Kona is the best Kona I have EVER had. I gave some to a co-worker down the hall and heard instant raves; this coming from a coffee gourmet. This brand is excellent.  The reviews were right.The directions in the package are just right.  Follow them and taste the best coffee you've ever had.

Sticker on invoice: "We care about your satisfaction with our products and service. If you have any concerns or questions about your shipment, please call us toll free at..."Who would think that getting coffee could be so difficult?! We had a problem and it had been arranged that the coffee would be exchanged. They sent a Fed Ex label and off it went. After 2 weeks, a call was placed to check status. A few moments later, Anna calls back and goes into some diatribe with my wife not knowing what coffee is.  If the president of the company resolved the issue, why is someone else from the company calling to stir it up?!Another call back to speak with Emma and she apologized for the actions of Anna. The coffee and a "for your trouble" gesture would be sent along that day. They are located cross town about 10 miles away and most shipment are next day...nothing came.A week passed and still nothing. Another call. Emma relays that it should have been taken care of and will call me back next day to confirm. Next day came, went...nothing. We are quite disappointed by this company. They got the $$ and we received empty words.
I gifted my brother and sister-in-law with this for Christmas and they enjoyed it very much. Their visitors smelled the coffee brewing and decided to stay longer. What a bunch of mooches.:-)
My husband loved the coffee and keeps it to brew for special occasions/guests.

We bought this coffee based on all the hype (Food & Wine Magazine, "handcrafted" , "Estate" , etc)  but as serious coffee drinkers, we didn't feel this was worth the high price (especially when shipping is added). It had a pleasant, full bodied taste, but so do a lot of other, more easily available and less expensive coffees.Starbucks for example,  has enough different varieties of coffee where you'll find one blend very similar if not as good (or better) tasting than the much lauded Kona........just our $0.02

Not really, but she gave me this stuff for Christmas and I'm totally hooked. I got a gift card from a co worker and I'm going to blow it all on this coffee.Oh well the kids don't really need private school do they? :)Try it you won't regret it......

When I got to enjoy a cup of Kona on our vacation to Hawaii, I thought I was in Heaven.  The smooth flavor was something to enjoy at any time of day or night.  This Kona brand seemed very strong to me - I even tried not using to much coffee and more water and it still seemed too stong.  I missed the smoothness and flavor of the Kona I remembered in Hawaii.  For that reason, I do not think it's the same Kona I loved so much and would rate this coffee at a 3.
Very good but too early to give final rating until we try other beans

Eating this yogurt is like eating cream cheese.  Sweet and thick and absolutely delicious, the kind of thing where you diligently scrape every last molecule out of the bottom of the cup because you can't bear to let it go to waste.  Although, if you're not a big cream cheese fan, you probably won't like this either.  Very low carb, moderately high in fat, very high in saturated fat.  And, to me, worth every calorie.
Fage how I love thee.A serving of this @ breakfast, with some chia seeds, agave and walnuts, and my tumtum is full and happy for 4 hours. Thank you Fage for a brilliant Greek yogurt.

I love the creamy texture. I use it in place of sour cream on baked potatoes and in recipes.  I blend it with frozen fruit, whey protein and juice in a smoothie and have it for lunch and/or breakfast.  I am always amazed at how good it tastes and how long it stays with  me.The only issue I have is how it was packed for shipment. It was in a box with styrofoam around it and a few ice packs that were totally thawed. It arrived at room temperature to my house with no exterior notification as to what was inside or that it needed to be refrigerated.  I was not home when it arrived and my husband just set the box on the table, where it sat for several more hours til I arrived home. ??All in all I am happy to find a source for this yogurt since I am in rural America and my grocery stores don't carry this brand. I just hope they can find a better way to cold pack it for shipping.

I ordered this basket for a gift. WHen I saw that it was over $50 I thought I would be getting a really nice basket.  I would have done better to go to Starbucks!  It seems like a very cheaply put together basket and very overpriced.  It is too late to exchange but would not get if you are trying to give a nice gift.

The Lucaffe Blucaffe pods are the easiest way to make a decent espresso.  We've had our machine for over 5 years and the Lucaffe brand is about the only brand we buy.

column9: Only the Best Butter in the World - Anchor Butter from New Zealand!
column10: Growing up in Southeast Asia, we had easy access to New Zealand's Anchor butter for everyday consumption. Moving to the States as an adult, I found the butters here tasteless. I thought it was just a change in my tastebuds, but when I was able to get Anchor butter again, I did a simple taste test and realized that the high quality flavour of the NZ butter was real!  I have tried all kinds of butter here - organic and not, even butters imported from France, Ireland, Germany, etc. Nothing - NOTHING - comes close to the fresh taste of New Zealand's Anchor Butter, which has hints of clover and something really special that's hard to describe!  The NZ government has very strict regulations for its cows and all, and these cows graze upon meadow grasses - you can taste it in the butter!So if you're reading this and getting curious - don't waste another second - order yourself some real Anchor Butter. You won't regret it, and you won't look back!

I've always preferred butter to other spreads. I lived in New Zealand almost 7 years. New Zealand butter is the best I've ever had. I've tried others available in gourmet stores, but have never had anything better. After moving back to the U.S., I started buying it in bulk and freezing it. I was really spoiled in New Zealand when it was readily available! When I first got some after being back in the U.S. for several years, my daughter pulled a Paula Deen and ate it strait off a plate. I've seen the happy cows and happy cows = awesome butter. Now if I could just get some New Zealand triple cream brie in the U.S.... New Zealand butter is the most prized commodity in my kitchen.

column9: Worlds greatest butter, great job Kiwis!
column10: Simply the best butter in the world, right now can only get it from Filipino Supermarket in Inland Empire but would love to be able to order it from Amazon by bulk.  Enhances any meal for gourmet chefs.
This is the only butter I use; lucky for me it's available at my local supermarket. If I can't get this, I use the Golden Fern in the tin which I also noticed is available on Amazon.

I've tried a lot of different butter and this is the BEST tasting butter ever!  Customer service is excellent.  The only complaint I have is that I ordered 8 packs of butter and they all expire in less than two months.

Wow!  This is fantastic butter!  So smooth and creamy...I really didn't expect it to be this much better than the rest, but it is...wish it were available in stores around here, but happy to have the option of ordering it here.  Order a lot to save on shipping costs...I got eight pounds of it.

column9: Perfect food for my old cat
column10: I'm porting this over from the "blue" pouch.My cat has "put up" with canned cat food and other pouches for years. Her rejection of all would be evident on my carpets if I didn't have every carpet cleaning device known to man.She only likes the gravy and when she actually eats something solid, it's a great day. When I brought this food home from Petco she ate two pouches down to the bottom of the bowl within a few hours.Since then, I've bought most other Soulistic flavors and she eats them all.I'm sold enough on this product to order it from Amazon because when I go to my Petco they're sold out. A wasted trip is worth the shipping for me.My cat gives it 5 stars.

We have a Bengal cat and she loves all the Solistic brands. She especially loves the pumpkin. We can't keep enough for her. It seems to be very healthy food too as she has not picked up much weight since we got her about a year ago. She is just about the right weight eating this and her coat is very shiny and soft. I'm glad we can get this through Amazon too!

My cats only get wet food as a surprise treat every once in awhile, but they've still managed to develop tastes. They no longer eat pate style wet food, only things in gravies. I usually get them something different to try when I pick a can, just to compare and see, and since it will only be a small part of their diet it won't shock their system to change it up. One of my cats--darling that she is--stuck her face in the middle of a bowl of pumpkin puree when I had my back turned during the making of a pumpkin pie and went crazy for it, so when I saw this pumpkin food I thought I'd give it a try. Both my cats love it, and I love that it's grain free. They like other flavors from this line as well, but still won't eat pates and are iffy about the gelee ones, too.

Soulistic has been the answer to a very finicky cats quest for perfection.  No grain, no fillers, just the stuff cats like best! I was avoiding the ones with the pumpkin for awhile, couldn't imagine that being attractive to Domino - but he likes that the best of all!  I heartily recommend.

column9: My Picky, Picky, PICKY Dog Loves Chewnola
column10: I have small-medium size Schipperke/Chihuahua who's ultra picky with his food and treats.  The first time I bought Chewnola was at a store and it was the only bone-like treat they had.  Despite the dog's pickiness, I bought a pack out of sheer desperation.  He's been crazy about these Chewnola bones since day one.  My dog isn't just picky, he's a hyper-active, major chewer with razor-like teeth in the front who bores easily.  One Chewnola keeps him completely occupied for hours, mopre than any other type of bone I've given him.  One of my cats seems to enjoy the taste and he takes the treat from the dog.  The cat will lick it until it's taken back by the dog (I do have a video of that).  I highly recommend Chewnola to anyone with any type of dog, especially picky ones.  Some 411 - I order these from Amazon because, even with shipping, I save a lot of money on this item - in the store it cost double.

We saw these at the store, and decided to try them for our mini Aussie. She LOVES them! Somehow I went with Garden of Life and it worked out great. Ive also had Nutiva, which a lot of people use and can be found for a bit cheaper. You can buy a gallon tub from the direct website for cheaper. So shop around on Amazon and other sites once youve selected the brand you want.Coconut oil, youve heard all the great things it does. Here are some things that hopefully persuade you more:Ive found that when refrying leftovers, such as chinese food or meatballs, it actually IMPROVES the flavor over the original. With coconut oil, you can avoid microwaving, which does alter the taste and texture, and some say destroys nutrients and adds toxins. Just stir fry with coconut oil and enjoy your delicious leftovers!It may serve as a bit of a replacement for vanilla in baking. The main purpose of vanilla is to add flavor. Unfortunately, the vanilla we had at home had the dreaded CORN SYRUP in it (READ YOUR LABELS). I looked online and it appeared that it could be omitted anyway, but as it turned out, coconut oil appears to provide that underflavor. Add a hint of coconut to your baking!Yes, coconut oil can be much more expensive than regular oil, but you cant and shouldnt cook with olive oil. Almost every other oil is bad (soybean, canola, corn) or just not as good (butter). Think of it as an investment in your future. I know people who arent of strong financial means that would be hard pressed to give up their "coco" as I call it.Enjoy!

I love this stuff! It has a light delicate flavor and makes a wonderful skin oil. I get a lot of compliments on how I smell when I use this as a moisturizer.An added bonus is my kitty absolutely adores it as a treat! when I unscrew the lid he comes running and begs for a little taste.
This is by far the best brand of coconut oil that I have had. It is a great deal as well. Buy this and enjoy the healthy benefits of coconut oil!
I just received my package in the mail & it was shipped so nicely! I love the smell of this product I defintely recommend this product!!!

This is the product you will find on the grocery shelves in the supermarkets in South Africa. column9: No 1 Ladies got me to try it
column10: After reading several books in the No 1 Ladies' Detective Agency series, where they drink many cups of red bush tea each day, I had to try it for myself. I should add that I'm English and black tea with milk is one of my daily necessities. I drink my Rooibos tea the same way. I found the smell a little odd at first - reminiscent of antiseptic (some say vanilla) and wet straw - but I liked the taste immediately. Rooibos tea has all the robust attributes of black tea but without the caffeine, and it is supposed to be very healthy. It's also refreshing. If you like black tea, give it a try!

column9: Rooibos is my choice for iced tea
column10: I'm an iced tea drinker year round, and I go thru tons of the stuff during hot weather.  Rooibos is naturally decaf and has a mild unobtrusive taste.  I find my palate doesn't get tired of the stuff, which is key during those high volume hot days.I've tried a number of brands of Rooibos and Freshpak wins hands down.  Don't even bother with other brands.My iced tea recipe:Boil water for 6 liters of final product with 8 Rooibos tea bags.  During this process I add 1/3 cup Splenda and 1/3 cup real sugar.  After it reaches a boil, I shut it off and let it cool down (tea bags still in the liquid).  After it's cool I add the juice of one healthy lemon.  Pour the contents into 6 plastic liter bottles (used seltzer water bottles in my case) and stick them in the reefer.

column9: Best Kept Secret - The Real Deal with the Rich Flavor!!!
column10: I purchased this tea after I was given a box of Madagascar Red Tea,(a different brand altogether) it was good, but... column9: Unusual, delicate yet flavorful.  I began developing cravings for it!
column10: This is the perfect tea for breakfast or any time of the day. Numi's Yunnan Black tea has a distinctive aroma with a strong apricot top-note fortified by a nice oaky, grassy base. The brewed tea flavor is clean and yet complex, slightly rich. There is a an very slight edge of tannin which perfectly contrasts the subtle woodsy and floral flavors. Excellent with a dash of cream. Unfortunately Numi does not list the amount of caffeine it contains on the box. It appears to have less caffeine than the usual English breakfast from its effect on this taster.Numi gets points for their manufacturing process and packaging. The boxes containing their tea is made from 100% recycled paperboard from 100% post-consumer waste--they assert that by using such packaging materials they save 2,040 trees, reduce landfill by 131,200, and prevent 184,000 greenhouse emissions. Numi uses only 100% natural ingredients without added oils or "natural flavorings".

I'm a big tea drinker.  I grew up in a tea drinking home- my grandmother always seemed to have a pot on the stove.  But all teas are clearly not equal.  And this is one of my least favorite black teas that I've had.  I thought that Chinese Breakfast sounded delicious, but I've noticed strong grassy notes.  At first I thought it was the milk we get.  We drink grass-fed milk for our daughters (Farmer's Creamery) that tastes amazing.  I thought we had gotten a batch of particularly grassy milk- but nope.  The Numi Chinese Breakfast tastes very grassy by itself, and it smells fairly unpleasant.  I'd say like a barnyard.  I don't mind the smell of a barnyard, I just don't want that of my tea.  I've tried most other Numi teas, like the Golden Chai (which is a spiced Assam) and the Honeybush, and they are , admittedly better.  They are about the quality of, say, Tazo.  That's to say they are not much better than regular black tea bags like Lipton or P.G. Tips.  And compared to Two Leaves and a Bud (delicious!) or even Lipton Black Pearl, Numi is not nearly as enjoyable.  That is especially true of the Chinese Breakfast.  I have 36 Chinese breakfast teabags and I will drink it all. I just won't be buying any more after that.

column9: Great find, good as is, very good with just a little work
column10: My wife and I have been very pleased with this purchase. This is a great tasting, truly easy meal. Bring to a boil then simmer 20 minutes. There are a number of different vegetables and a great spice mixture. And not too much salt, but I would not call it low salt.We add a little chicken (pre-cooked after it reaches a boil) and finish it off with cheese and sour cream. Leonard Mountain 3 Amigos Enchilada Stew is my sister's favorite soup---so easy to make and quite tasty.  I met the nutritionist and her husband at an arts festival in Maryland a couple of years ago where they were providing samples of their soup products.  Can't go wrong with this product.  Keep them in my pantry for quick suppers.  Top with sour cream, cheddar cheese, black olives, and whatever you like!

My 12-year-old Husky goes crazy for these - they are healthy, delicious (apparently), and a great training tool.  They are a little pricey, but worth it for the joy in my dog's face.

column9: My dogs tell me these treats are YUMMY
column10: My two Corgis were thoroughly spoiled by my late husband (I spent a year and a half dieting them down a combined total of 25 pounds!)They are accustomed to the finest of fare, and they absolutely love the Wellness brand of treats.

They are hard treats and kind of big so they probably wouldn't be good for tiny dogs. Our miniature schnauzer is about 18 pounds and they are just the right size for her.
My dogs love these treats!  These treats smell so good that I'm tempted to try them.  The box arrived promptly and was well packed.  Thank You!

column9: All My Dogs Have Loved These
column10: I've had three dogs who all love Well Bars. They break easily and can be used as a training treat.

column10: Both of my dogs love these bars.  They smell good too - like apples.  Wellness has a reputation for using quality ingredients, and the ingredient list for these bars is no exception.Eating these bars made one of my dogs itch, though.  He does have some food allergies (corn & wheat), so I didn't detract from the treats' rating.  My best guess is that he reacted to the cane molasses because he's never eaten it before.
Our Golden Doodle loves these treats. Great size for a great price. The large size here on Amazon is the same price as the small size at a local store.

I had to try these treats and are rather impressed with them. I have larger dogs (bullmastiff etc) but they work well for him too. They are square, solid and obviously pretty tasty as all three of my dogs love them. There is a lot in the box and I think for the price, well worth it, being made with good stuff. I recommend to anyone who is the "treat" man or lady.
My dogs love these treats and the price at Amazon was a great value.  There were twice as many as the normal size I buy at less than double the price at my local pet store.
The service was great.  The product is my dogs favorite and it's healthy too.

Both my boxer's favorite treat.  It's healthy, they love it, and it smells good enough for me to try!  (I haven't..yet, for the record).  Wellness continues to impress me with their wholesome products.

Wellness is the brand I go to for dry and wet food for my dog, so I thought I'd try the chicken and cheddar bars.  The second ingredient is cane molasses... I honestly don't know why this is, and it seems odd.  As soon as you open the bag inside the box, you get a whiff of an overwhelming sweetness.  After my dog has one, he's constantly trying to get the caked treat off of his back molars.  It sticks on pretty hard.  I have to help or I have to brush his teeth to get rid of it.  This can't be good for his teeth, and I don't know if he needs the extra sweetness in his diet.  I would recommend Old Mother Hubbard wheat-free treats, such as chicken and apples, before this.  They're also made by Wellness.  Old Mother Hubbard Classic Oven Baked Chick' N' Apples Dog Biscuits Or, Get Naked dog biscuits, which are also very good.  Get Naked Super Antioxidant Biscuits for Dogs, 12-Ounce

My dogs have a sensitive stomach, so I've got to be careful about what I give them. These treats are perfect. They are an optimal size. I give them several throughout the day, so them being small (for a 60 pound dog) is great. I have been using these for years, but just recently started purchasing them online. I haven't really noticed any problems.

Our dog loves these--all the wellness well bars, not just this flavor.  They do seem to be a little hard, great for cleaning teeth but maybe not if your dog has teeth problems.  Nice healthful treats.

My dogs love this flavor and I'm happy they are a healthy treat without all the wheat, etc. thanks for providing this much less expensive buying opportunity or I could probably not afford for my dogs.
These biscuits are real favorites of my small CKC and my GSD. usually they don't like me to change their treats but these were lpve at first sniff and the vendors were quick and very courteous.
My Pit bull puppy would give up her doggy sole for these treats.  I use them all the time.  Highly recommended.
Much bigger box and bang for the buck.  I will purchase again. This is a great treat that the pups enjoy.

column9: Dogs are in love with these treats......!!!!!
column10: As with all of the Wellness products I have ordered so far....these came on the date promised and arrived safely.Both of my dogs were at my feet begging before I had the packaging open...They love them..........K
I hope this product is as healthy for the dog as it seems to be enjoyable.  My 4 year old dachshund loves these!
We have ordered these before and will continue to do so because Bailey loves them and they are good for her.
I like these treats for my dog for two reasons:  1.  They are good for him.  2.  He really likes them.  Surely they have contributed to his healthy teeth.
My dog, of course, adores these - anything with cheese is his favorite.  However, they gave him considerable amounts of gas.  We will, however, try other Wellness treats to see if they work better.
I have been giving these treats to my Weimaraner and Lab for years, and they simply love them! They are extremely healthy, vegetarian treats and they smell good enough to eat!

column9: SMELLS GOOD even I want to eat it
column10: This smells so good . Doesnt' smell like cardboard boxes. Comes in thick plastic bag to prevent puncture and letting the freshness go out.  There's no sealable zipper or anything so I have to use a clothing pin.My dog eats it when she wants to.  I leave it next to her bed she won't touch it sometimes. But sometimes she does eat it up.  She should eat it up fast or else it will become stale.Smells fruity and a hint of gingersnap cookies.  I gave it to another dog and he ate it like there was no tomorrow.  I gave my dog a wellness lamb jerky .. she ate it like crazy. I gave the other dog lamb jerky... he ate it like crazy.My conclusion is that not all dogs like fruity gingersnap cookies. Still have 60% left.Wellness brand is very good but I should stick to a guarantee treat....the lamb or any line meat jerky offered by Wellness.Not sure if I can eat it . lol
My dog loves these crunchy treats and I feel good about giving her them because of the wholesome ingredients. I'm about to order my second box.

I have been giving Wellness treats to my dogs for awhile.  They really like them and I think Wellness puts out a good product.  When I get the box out at night, they run to their crates and wait for their late night snack. No command necessary!

column9: Best of the Wellness Bars, too bad only comes in 20 oz box!
column10: These are the best ones of the Wellness bars because they're completely grain free. My dogs love these. They also contain no artificial preservatives. Highly recommended. However, I wish these came in a 50 oz box like the other flavors. The 20 oz box at 8.99 is the same cost at the pet store (and it is 45 cents per ounce) versus a 50 oz box which is just 30 cents an ounce. The product is fantastic, though. A++++
My dogs love these. They are not grain free, but they have no wheat, corn or soy and no artificial preservatives. Highly recommended. This is a great value at just under thirty cents per ounce. A++++

First Impression: Well the kind folks over at Wellness Pet Food heard about my website and sent me some treats to try! They ended up sending me a big box of their WellBars that have Yogurt, Apples, and Bananas in them. Totally vegetarian, oven baked with lots of vitamins! I'm sure you have read one of my other reviews about Old Mother Hubbard, they make outstanding healthy treats. Turns out that WellNess is owned by Old Mother Hubbard. Who knew? As usual Dad ran me though a barrage of tests to see how much I really wanted the treat. Let's just say I had to work very hard. Those silly "sit ups" that little dogs do, roll over, sit, stay, down, etc, just to have him put the treats in my Everlasting Treat Ball! I made short work of it and devoured my new delicious and healthy treats. The only thing I'm a little disappointed about is I found out that they have WellBites that are soft treats. They even have one that's Lamb and Salmon flavored... Those are two of my favorite things in the world. Now I have to talk Dad into buying them for me...Conclusion: Outstanding healthy dog treats! A must buy for a healthy pup.

We can't change our dog's diet much.  Unfortunately he is highly food motivated and loves to visit our local hardware for treats.  In fact, he keeps a supply at the hardware.  He had never been diagnosed with any food allergies but after buying a large box of commercial treats to keep at the hardware, we started to notice some problems.A local pet store recommended another flavor of these treats.  He liked them but we didn't notice an improvement in his symptoms so I tried these.  After all, apples and yogurt are some of my boy's favorite things!He loves these treats.  Although his symptoms have not cleared up entirely, they did improve.  His friend at the hardware likes to feed him a lot of treats at once so we consider them well tested at this point and we just ordered our third box.  Dogs like 'em and mom approves!

Our dog will not eat the Wellness Wellbar Yogurt, Apples and Bananas Dog Treats; however, we crush two of these up for each daily feeding and mix them with his regular dog food.  For this reason I would not buy these crunchy treats again, although I must say they smell good!We feel the reason for his not eating the crunchy treats is that he is accustomed to the soft Wellness wellbites that we have been giving him for over a year.  He loves these.  Wellness WellBar Yogurt, Apples and Bananas Dog Treats, 50-Ounce Pouch

I ordered this product thinking it would have been soft treats I could use for training and disappointed that they were biscuits. However they seem to be very healthy treats compared to some and the dogs really like them.

tried wellness webb bars, whitefish and sweetpotatoes and with crunchy peanuts and honey.  have three dogs two just push them away, the third who will eat dirt inhaled them.  Rate this products as a 0.
So good make you wanna slap your teacher!! these are good. I like, I like a lot. My hommies like em too. It will take me a month to eat all these chips.

column9: The clam chowder for people who hate clam chowder!
column10: Do you suffer from flavor intolerance? Are you recovering from major surgery? Or maybe you just hate yourself. If so, then this is the clam chowder for you. Imagine a rich, creamy, thick soup with tons of clams. Now, forget that because this junk has nothing to do with clam chowder. The "soup" is flavorless because there's no fat. It's the consistency of fat-free milk. The potatoes taste like nothing. What clams there are are the size of toenail clippings. No amount of salt can give this slop flavor. Avoid at all costs.
for the amount of calories this soup is awesome.  comes in at only 240 cals for the entire can for creamy thick clam chowder!

This olive oil is supposed to be special.  I don't taste anything special.  To me, it tastes slightly better than normal, cheap, off the grocery store shelf olive oil.  I got mine at a local Italian grocery store for the same price as what's listed here.  Not worth it if you ask me.Google Frantoio for olive oil that has a nice taste.
This is my preferred olive oil and I use it for everything - salad dressings, drizzling on roasted vegetables, dipping bread, etc.  My sisters and mother-in-law use it now too!

column9: Incredibly fragrant, but not of chai
column10: While I was very excited to see an herbal chai variety available on Amazon, I was let down by the product itself. After my doctor told me to cut our black tea (something about caffeine), I was anxiously waiting for this product to arrive. As soon as you open the bag, the smell hits you, FLOWERS! And you think, flowers? That can't be right.  It was overwhelming, but I decided that it was concentrated  . . .to make up for the caffeine?But once you brew it, no better. It certainly would work much better at spicing up a room than a beverage. I tried mixing it with other, more simple herbal teas, hoping to tame the flower power. Sadly it didn't work. There just isn't enough cinnamon and cardamon in this mix when compared to the floral notes to make it still be chai. Needs more spice, less flower.

column9: This is my favoirite bedtime drink -Chai with Rooibos and fragrant spices
column10: This is my favoirite bedtime drink - imagine a Chai tea with rooibos and chammomile along with a host a fragrant spices--if you Davidson's Tea Herbal Classic Chai, 25-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)

column9: Tastes more like potpourri than tea
column10: The ingredients on the package are rooibus, chamomile, carob, cinnamon, cloves, chai blend, orange peel and natural flavors. The overwhelming taste and smell of lavender is all there is - cannot taste rooibus, chamomile, or any other spices. Not chai at all.
These were delicious, but not wrapped as well as I think they should be.  They kind of melted out of their wrapping.
They are great ice pops but extremely overpriced.  You can get these at Walmart for like $3.  You can also get them at your local grocers for a reasonable amount of money.

column9: Mahatma Wild Rice / Monica R Abel
column10: I have used this rice for nearly 20 years.  Outstanding product.  I suppose it was my fault not reading the quantity in this order.  Having purchased before and expecting at least 6 packages of rice, I was very frustrated to see only one.  For the price of $6.75 fo one packet.  I would say this was a rip off.  I will never buy from Monica R Abel again.

This is the very best of the long grain wild rices. I've tried many and this one beats them all. It's not an instant rice but well worth the time to cook it (25 minutes). Comes out perfect for me every time. It goes with anything - any kind of meat, fish, or other seafood. We love it with grilled salmon or spicy shrimp. The perfect side dish to replace potatoes. Too bad it's impossible to find in the grocery stores near me.  I have to purchase it on line and usually get a year's supply. Try it!

I have searched every grocery market in a fifteen mile radius and cannot find this mix.  My mom gave me a stellar Chicken Wild Rice Soup recipe and there is no substitute for Mahatma rice!  The microwave directions are easy to follow and produce a non-microwave tasting rice.  Thank you!!!

column9: Great Rice at a Great Price
