Buying by the case made it great, having as much as I want, when I want it, but it can get a bit expensive. But when the time is right I will be buying more to enjoy. If I could scream this out my window, I would scream for everyone to buy Pop corners. It's the greatest invention since the light bulb. Medora Snacks Popcorners Popped Corn Chips with Sea Salt, 5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)

I found these snacks on a jetblue flight and since then they have been my primary snacking chip. They are have pretty much healthy snacks for you because their is nothing bad in them. It is quite amazing and they are even gluten free for people that need good snacks like that.The most important part is they are delicious. I can't quite describe them, but they beat anything else out there. They also solved my old Doritos problem where the chips would slice the roof of my mouth......

If you like popcorn, you will like Pop Corners.  The sea salt is not overbearing.  They really are just like popcorn, but in a little triangle.  My two and a half year old loves them too!  They are a lot better than greasy chips!

I came across these on a dinnerless night while waiting in line at Marshall's. I think i had most the bag gone before i got to a cashier. Now i go to Marshall's specifically to buy these since i havent found them elsewhere. I buy 3 bags at a time and they are only $1.49/bag. I SIMPLY LOVE THESE in all flavors and prefer them to chips. Now that i can buy them by the case, the next line I will be standing in may just be to a rehab. Im addicted!

I tried these once and came to Amazon to order more because they don't sell them where I live.  They're a healthy alternative to chips, with great flavor!  I love that they only have 3 ingredients.  They're similar to rice cakes only thinner, and have achip-like crisp/crunch.  I was surprised to find the size of the bags, assuming they were small bags.  The 5 ounce bag is almost the size of regular chip bags, not individual bags.

column9: Better than movie or microwave popcorn!
column10: I was rather skeptical about the taste claims but I'm really impressed.  I have now placed 3 more orders.  I cannot eat regular popcorn because of the husks, this is better than the real deal, with no husk to worry about.  The butter flavored and sea salt are my favorites.

column9: The only problem is, after the first bite, you cannot stop.
column10: I'm never a fan of popcorn. Hate the chewiness, grease and the sugary flavors. But this bag of Popcorners is no typical popcorn. First of all, I purchased it on line, attracted by the packaging of course (one really eat with the eyes!), which jumps out of the usual bright pink or yellow colors you see when it comes to popcorns. Also thinking it might be just an alternation of "baked chips," already quite popular in the market. Even after I received it, I still thought "The wrapping's really lovely. But I'm just gonna try out a bite...".The only problem was, I couldn't stop after the first bite. Who knew something so simple, with only three ingredients for this flavor, could be this sensational? It's crispy yet thick in the texture. The size of each piece is not too big nor too small. The natural scent of corn is just delightful to the palate. Don't need to lick the fingers....I'm completely amazed and will be venturing into the other flavors. This is one snack food I'd be munching out. Ditch the bags of chips at lunch, try this!
I absolutely Love Popcorners, and the Caramel Flavored are out of this world.  My new favorite snack.  The vendor also made this purchase extra special!

This is just simply a great product-tasty and healthy-a winning combination! plus kosher!! Unfortunately it is so good that I really must limit myself and be cognizant of portion size. HURRAH! I really enjoy this snack!

Like quite a few other reviews, I discovered these on a JetBlue flight. I did try to find them when I landed too. But, it's really not so easy. I did find them when I got home though and have been eating them ever since. The Sea Salt are my favorite by far. I was lucky enough to get that flavor on the flight. If it had been one of the others, I may have never eaten them again. I've tried the Butter (way too salty) and Kettle (too sweet). So, I went back to Sea Salt and stayed there. My favorite thing about them is there are only 3 ingredients all of which you can pronounce.
I love the buttered Popocorners and will be ordering more.  Only wish they weren't as salty as they are.  I'll also be ordering other flavors, too.

I was surprised at how good these were, they are excellent! There are very tasty with real all natural butter flavor. It's like powdered butter, its very buttery. Better to eat this than fattening popcorn for a movie! And the price for the whole box can't be beat. Order them, you won't regret it!

column9: Taste great, but don't be fooled by "low calories"
column10: Popcorner chips taste great, but don't be fooled by the "low calorie" bit.  They are low in fat compared to regular potato chips, but the calories are fairly close.  For example, the calorie count for 1oz of Popcorners is about 120.  The calorie count for 1oz of Kettle Chips is 150.That being said, if you aren't thinking you're eating them for health reasons, they're great and tasty as a snack!  You can buy them at your local Costco too.

Do these taste exactly like hot buttery popcorn? No but it's really close. I love popcorn, popcorn regretfully does not return my feelings.Every time my housemate makes popcorn,which is frequently, the smell makes me nuts. Now I open up a bag of these yummy treats and I'm happy.Medora Snacks Popcorners Popped Corn Chips, Butter, 5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
This is a great snack with the perfect amount of salt. I don't feel guilty eating them because they are relatively healthy.

Regular popcorn makes me cough because of its dryness and its loose kernels. The Kettle Popcorners are a delicious alternative. I don't have a problem with eating the Popcorners, and they aren't as messy as regular popcorn.

column9: Popcorn lovers -- you really should try this
column10: I love popcorn but after trying these, I don't know if I should ever bother popping corn again.  The taste of these is wonderful and I really like the crunchiness of the chip.  Best of all, however, one can have them anytime by simply opening a bag.  While popcorn can be popped, stored and eaten later, good as it is, it is never quite as good as it is freshly-popped.  These taste great however, and I would rank them very close to freshly popped popcorn -- add convenience and crunch and they pull ahead in my eyes.Note that I am really basing my comparison on the Kettlecorn variety so I, perhaps, shouldn't be comparing it to plain popcorn, but I would rate this against regular kettlecorn similarly, and I suspect that the regular popcorn varieties would hold their own.The additional sugar in the Kettlecorn version weighs in at only 3g in a one-ounce serving so despite the great taste, it isn't exactly drenched in sugar.  If you love Kettlecorn or popcorn, you should give PopCorners a try.

column9: Very Tasty And Unavailable In Stores
column10: Awesome invention. I wish it was more available in stores. High quality product from start to finish. What else does this company produce?

column9: Great Snack if you Love Chips and Popcorn
column10: What a Great Snack because I love Chips and Popcorn and with these I get the best of both snacks.

My family loves Popcorners and the kettle variety has become our favorite movie snack. We think it tastes even better than actual kettle corn.  The serving sizes are fairly small so one bag doesn't go far.  At only 100 calories per serving it is a great, healthy snack. These have become a staple in our gluten free household.

Pop Corners are a good tasting snacking chip for those who are going for gultin free or those of us on the Lets Do Lunch diet. They taste as good there competitor (who we will leave unnamed) for abot half the price.

As a suffer of diverticulosis I cannot eat popcorn (the hulls are the problem). POPCORNERS came as if they were an answer to prayers. Now, I can once more enjoy the taste of popcorn--and they do taste like real popcorn!

I LOVE these!  They are addictively good and not that bad for you... just pure ingredients.  I am soooo happy I found these! I pray they never go away! Even my dogs love them and I don't feel bad giving them because they are pure ingredients of corn, oil and salt!  PERFECT!
love this coffee, love how fast you get it to me, love that it comes in a single package together. i will re-order this coffee again and again. thanks for having such a great coffee in decaf :)
Great flavor, however for some odd reason, most of the brewed kcups are spilling grounds into the coffee. I have never had and currently do not have this problem with other kcups. Thus only 3 stars.

column9: Really good DeCaf and the flavors lasted even in big mugs
column10: Keep in mind it does not matter if I like it or not, it will be your own taste buds that settle the matter BUT you can try a small pack and find out.  Maybe like me you will find a keeper.I can only drink DeCaf coffee - I always liked French Vanilla and Hazelnut flavors when I drank regular coffee and searched for one in DeCaf.  I have found it.  These are the best I have found and I am picky.

column9: I love this coffee, but it is very mild.
column10: I have recently switched to decaf most of the time, and love the convenience of K-cups for making a fresh cup. Only a few K-cup coffees taste as strong as I used to brew a pot (Tully's Coffee Decaffeinated French Roast, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2) (extra bold) is the only decaf variety that can make that claim, and can be brewed in 10 oz. size!) and these Green Mountain flavored varieties are on the weak side. I brew them in 6-oz size to get them as strong as possible, and they aren't bad. I don't like sugar in my coffee and love flavored varieties, and these are very nice and elegant tasting. My husband can't abide flavored coffee so the K-cup machine (ours is a SS-780SA Single Serve Brewing System) has solved the problem of freshness, decaf vs. caffeine, and flavor vs. unflavored. He prefers Tully's French Roast Extra Bold Coffee For Keurig K-Cup Brewing Systems 18 K-cups Count.
this coffee has the rich vanilla taste that I love without giving me the jitters.  I love and recommend it!

YUM!  This was a great deal.  I love the fact that I got two flavors in one and am able to switch off each morning, or stick with whichever flavor is my favorite that week.  I only wish the decaf came in more flavors!

It is hard to find flavored K-cup decaf of good quality. This one is above average.  The French Vanilla has a better flavor than the hazelnut (Decaf).  The non-decaf hazelnut has good flavor for some reason.
It's hard to find flavors in Decaf, but this is a great combo and they are both delicious! I love that I can still enjoy my coffee without the caffeine. Great product!

I grew up in the south, and I've been looking for a convenient and authentic tasting sweet tea for some time.  I found it here.  The cane sugar adds the perfect sweetness and makes a delightful, refreshing summer drink.

column9: NOT "SWEET" potato!!! NOT what is shown!
column10: This item is NOT as shown! NO "sweet potatoes" were used in the making of this product!!What is shown on the box is "Sweet Potato Pancakes". "Sweet potato" means sweet potatoes or yams. I believed I was ordering a pancake mix made with SWEET potatoes.What I got is - the box is identical in appearance EXCEPT - it says "SWEETENED Potato Pancakes"!  BIG DIFFERENCE!Absolutely NO "sweet potatoes" were used in the making of this product!I am EXTREMELY disappointed. If I could give it "0" stars I would. Will not order it again!!

column9: Excellent gummy bears but no labeling
column10: These gummy bears are tasty and slightly larger than the standard ones.  I don't know how authentic the pineapple flavor is, but if you're the sort of person who always pulls the clear looking gummy bears out of the bag first, these are the ones for you.One complaint: there is no product information on the bag.  No ingredients list, no nutritional information, nothing.  If you go to the seller's website, the ingredients and nutritional information are listed there. (Ingredients: corn syrup, sugar, gelatin, citric acid, sorbitol, natural & artificial flavors, vegetable oil, carnauba wax, 120 calories in a serving (all from sugar), which is 12 gummy bears.)  The packaging is clearly custom and well made, so I can't think why they wouldn't include something so basic.

column9: Everyone Loves My Gravy - Beef, Turkey, Chicken, Pork
column10: I love to make simple roasts with gravy for mashed potatoes, bread stuffing or Yorkshire Pudding - Gravy Master and a touch of dissolved corn starch in stock are the secret to success with any of your pan drippings. Gravy master is not a thickener, it adds color, clarity and flavor to your gravies.  It is a blend of caramelized vegetables, no meat products.  I think the flavor is superior to Bisto and Kitchen Bouquet and it gives sauces a better natural browned color.  My significant other is working on maintaining a vegetarian diet but loves gravy - I'm going to give this a go with Kitchen Basics Vegetable Stock, mushrooms and carmelized shallots and see if I can come up with a great gravy for him and I bet it will be good. This product wasn't available on the west coast for many years - I used to bring home 4-6 bottles in my suitcase from trips back east.  Now I've been able to find it online and even in stores in California. Sorry to see it is no longer made in Branford, Connecticut - where it was a small family business for years - looks like the product has gained a new manufacturer and distribution though and maintained it's superior quality.
Good flavor, makes gravy a nice brown color, mixes well, tastes good. Only need small amount small bottle lasts along time. good price for 3 pk. will buy again.

Been using Gravy Master for decades! It's too bad I can't find it locally any longer. However, you can still get it on Amazon.com! No meat, so great for vegetarians! ;) I love this stuff! AND, it's all natural!

This adds depth of flavor to sauces, gravies, soups, and stews. It is concentrated so you don't need much, but add it to a slow cooker roast, stew or a roast in the oven, and people wont stop talking about your food. www.chefjosko.com/ShepsPie.html

column9: Far ahead of other, similar products across the board
column10: This is a first class product. It nicely colors gravies which would otherwise be a bit pale, and does this with a natural-looking dark brown coloring. It does not look artificial and does not add an unrealistic, shiny appearance to the gravy. It also has only a very faint aroma, and the slight aroma it has is quite pleasant; some of the other competing products have, in my opinion, a clearly unpleasant odor to them, a major drawback. Lastly, a little bit goes a long way, and one bottle lasts a very long time. Fortunately, the product seems to have a very long shelf-life. The only drawback I'm aware of is that it is hard to find in stores, the competitors, unfortunately, are clearly more popular with the retailers than this high-quality product is.
I ordered three bottles of Grade Jelly and one of the lidswas off laying in the bottom of the box.  You can imagine whata mess it was when it got here.  Jelly was running out of the box.Thanks

Just over a 1 1/2 yrs ago, we discovered my son had a peanut allergy.  My introduction to soynut butter came after that.  I was curious about what the chocolate flavor would be like.  The only place I could find it was here on Amazon.  I took the plunge and am VERY glad I did.  It makes a tasty sandwich with jelly or my favorite is with bananas.  Plain is great too.  I use this as a substitute in recipes that call for peanut butter in them.  My only wish is that Amazon would offer the subscribe option and keep this (all flavors) in stock regularly.  They were out for many months and it was expensive buying it anywhere else.

I bought this at the local supermarket out of curiosity, and it's good!  Not as chocolate-y as frosting (the company's website suggests using it as such), but it's healthier without the extra extra added sugar anyway.It tastes decadent on a sandwich plain, pretty good on a choc-PB sandwich, and substitutes *really* well (original flavor probably would as well) for PB in a cookie recipe I recently tried.
Great product!  I will reorder.  Be aware that it may take a little getting used to--it seems a little greasy.  It is, however, an excellent nutrional product.

My boys have peanut and tree nut allergies, so soy butter is an important protein provider for my little guys. My youngest won't eat meat or touch regular soy butter, but he loves this.Thank you Amazon for carrying it because I am now having trouble finding it in stores!
I'm a convert to soy nut butter in place of peanut butter for a number of years now.  Just discovered the chocolate soynut better by I.M. Healthy and it is yummy especially on graham crackers!

I bought this for my 2 1/2 yr old son who has allergies to Peanuts/treenuts..He absolutely loved it.. As soon as it was delivered I opened up a jar & put a little bit on a spoon for him to see if he'd taste it..After he did he took the spoon from me & kept eating it out of the jar..So a joy to watch him eat it..I highly recommend this product..I cant wait to experiment & try making cookes with it..
I really liked the regular so I thought I would try the Chocolate and it's almost as good as the regular smooth. It's just a little more liquid and you need to stir it.

My youngest daughter was just diagnosed with a peanut allergy. The doctor also said she was reactive to tree nuts, so we are staying away from it all. I tried Sunflower Butter first and found it so disgusting I gave the jar away to someone else. This was my next try since my oldest daughter recently discovered Nutella from a friend. It's not Nutella, but it's not bad either.  It's a mild chocolate taste, and I guess the soy has a very different taste than peanut butter. More grassy or dirt like - I know that sounds gross, but it's not as nutty tasting as peanut butter. It is still smooth and the grassy undertones aren't horrible like I found the sunflower butter to be. I find myself eating it on bread or crackers like peanut butter. After a while it's a pretty good taste, I don't notice it's not peanut butter.

Two of my three children have severe peanut allergies so we tried the chocolate soy nut butter.  They all love it...even my non-peanut allergic child.  They prefer it over regular soy nut butter or sunflower butter.

This product has a fabulous taste, plus you get all the health benefits of soy!  I shouldn't admit this but I love spoonfuls out of the jar.  I haven't tried a fried chocolate banana sandwich yet, but bet it's spectacular as well.

column9: Nothing like chocolate OR soy butter!
column10: Having tried the creamy soy butter (same brand) and loving it, I thought this could be amazing as I am also a chocoholic. Unfortunately, the whole family found it repulsive. It tastes nothing like chocolate! If you want the flavor combination then I recommend the regular soy butter (the crunchy version is also delicious!) and either sprinkle chocolate chips on it (try it! you won't regret it!) or for some serious indulging drizzle with a little left over ganache! Now that's YUM! As for this "chocolate soy butter" concoction, our jar is still sitting in the pantry, uneaten and unloved.

I wasn't sure about getting this product due to price and the fact that I had to buy it by the 6 pack, but my toddler started pre-school and isn't allowed to have Nutella due to school policy.  I finally ordered it and WOW!  We all love it, even my finicky mother!  Great product and I don't see it lasting long in my house!!  Compared to Nutella it is less expensive and I think it tastes much better.  Good texture, taste is great; it isn't too sweet and is not oily or runny.

As a former peanut butter lover, and now a mom of a peanut allergic child, I am constantly looking for peanut butter substitutes.  I.M. Healthy Soy Nut Butter is ok, but their chocolate soy nut butter is awesome!  It is now a staple in our house, along with Trader Joe's Sunflower Seed Butter.
Mix it with my Greek Yogurt, eat it with bananas and apples, sandwiches.  Love to put it on strawberries.  Sometimes just a tablespoon is all I need.

My peanut allergic son loves this stuff.  His sister who is not allergy loves it too.  The same company makes great regular soy nut butter too, but this stuff is really good.  It goes great on apples for a quick snack or side dish.
Love the Chocolate SoyNut Butter, use it in smoothies, sandwiches, with fruit, and put on pancakes or as frosting. Eat a spoonful when I want something sweet.

column9: I really like the IM Heatlhy Chocolate Soy Nut Butter.
column10: This product is a fun and tasty change from regular soy nut butter.  I have trouble keeping out of it.  I always find myself grabbing a spoonful.  I bought it for my peanut allergic son but have been eating more of it than him!

The best jalapeno I've ever had. Sweetness offsets some of the HEAT, but was warmly pleased (pun intended).Ordering more today and if you like jalapenos, you'll love these. Amazon provided excellent service, again.

bought this stuff and made several times as per directions. it stinks badly while brewing and tastes even worse. i read all the awesome reviews on the bell web page, yeah right! this stuff is awful! i see there is a money back guarantee but it is not worth my time, already wasted enough time on the this terrible stuff. $20 down the drain, oh well,live and learn. john hills washougal, wa.
These bars are the best fiber bars out there---lots of fiber, plus they taste great---very satisfying.  They are crunchy and nutty, not dry or "card-board" tasting, like many other bars.

Definitely recommend trying them :)
I love these Oskri bars, they changed the packaging and increased the size of the bar which made it hard to find on the web but great taste, flavor and very healthy.  Great source of fiber....

Great tasting healthy snack.  And when I say great tasting, I mean it, I am very picky about food, so it is not "great tasting" for super health conscious people who only eat bad tasting health bars.  And it's great to know you are getting a ton of fiber which most of us do not get enough of!

There are little pellets of what I guess is rice bound together with something really sticky and sweet that holds the cashews and cranberries.The taste is really good, the cashews are big and tasty. I have been using this product instead of regular salt and it has made a difference in my health and level of wellbeing.

column9: Just the right amount of sour

That way there's more for us! ;)  Like others I was a regular impulse buyer of these while living on the left coast.  Now I live on the right one and convenience stores here just don't stock these diabetes sticks that I <3 so much.Not only did Amazon hook me up and at a great price but these are the freshest Sour Punch Twists I've ever had! column9: Pretty tasty, but smaller than I thought they'd be.

They are pretty sour, but not warheads sour for sure.Also, they are small (maybe 3 inches?)  and almost as thick as a twizzler.The price here on Amazon was right and they're easy to throw a few in my backpack to take along as a snack.

These are by far my favorite candy ever!!!  I loved that it was a pack of 2 and I'm still working on them with my roommate.  The containers make for easy storage and you could reuse them if you wanted.  We hide them in our bad food cabinet because they're so addictive

They taste very fresh and delicious. You also get A LOT. There are so many that I kind of got sick of them. However, that is a good problem to have when it comes to candy if you ask me. Just share them with your friends and family and you will be happy with your purchase.

so glad i found these big containers on amazon, my grandkids and their parents love these i usually get them at the counter of local store near my home for 10 cent a piece so i was very glad to get the whole container and for a good price.

column10: I thought I could finish the two tubs within a few weeks, but, as it turns out, there's A LOT. You don't even realize until you see it. It's definitely a great buy for Sour Punch lovers and super convenient for those who like to take them on the go!

To my pleasant surprise, these adorable, little brown mushrooms were absolutely delicious and even the 'juice' left from the water they are canned in is worth keeping and adding to soups and rice (which is rare since most canned mushrooms I've eaten have water that is totally unpalatable and tastes more like the can than the mushrooms). The mushrooms slice up very nicely and they aren't soggy or overly water-absorbed but they are rather slippery little suckers so be sure you have a very sharp knife.These were actually tasty enough to eat right out of the can, drained at room temperature with a little soy sauce. The texture of these mushrooms is silky smooth (almost buttery) and slightly squishy and the flavor is extra-mushroomy 'umami' goodness.There were a couple dented cans but nothing that ruined the product and these mushrooms were packaged very well.You get 96 ounces [6 pounds] of dry weight shiitake mushrooms at $15.21 with subscribe and save and free shipping which is a fair deal (and no need to rehydrate like dried mushrooms and obviously much more convenient). That rounds to about 63-cents a can.What's in the can:Medium-small to small whole shiitake mushroomsWaterSaltCitric acidI rarely get over-the-moon about something as pedestrian as canned mushrooms but these tender little morsels are well worth the deserved kudos!Side Note:These mushrooms *do* come from China (they are native to China though).
I love the mushrooms and have ordered them in the past, but half the cans come in badly dented.  If only this problem could be fixed, I would keep ordering.
These are awful and slimy.  I you like slimy scum in your mouth you may like these.  Can't return these so don't waste your money. Green Giants are always good.

column9: Shiitake mushrooms are usually sold fresh or dried, not canned
column10: Why aren't shiitake mushrooms canned more often?  If you buy this product, you will know why.  The salt water inside the can doesn't taste that good.  By contrast, the salt water inside cans of both button mushrooms and straw mushrooms is quite delicious and it's difficult to resist the temptation to drink it all down as if it were soup.  Apparently, shiitake mushrooms will make the fluid that they are soaked in taste bad.  But the shiitake mushrooms themselves can be quite delicious to eat.  Yes, up to half of these cans will arrive slightly dented - that's normal when buying canned foods from Amazon.com - but it should still be easy to open all of the cans.  Cans that are severely dented on both the top and bottom cannot be opened but that problem usually occurs only with very large cans and never with small cans like these.  The most delicious way to eat these canned juvenile shiitakes is to: (1)Wipe away any dust from just one side of the can - the side that you plan to open.  (2)Open the can with a can opener.  (3)Drain away all of the brine (salt water) by pressing down hard with the opened lid, just as you would when opening a can of tuna in water.  (4)Eat these small shiitakes as is.  You have now successfully squeezed away the bad taste from these mushrooms.  (5)To make these young mushrooms even more delicious, you can now add Worcestershire Sauce directly into the can but you would be reducing the healthfulness of this treat.  Product of China.
Muy buena calidad de alimento, a un preco muy economico. Tengo Gran danes y les encanta este producto, ademas de rendir muy buen tiempo.

Seriously the 1st ingredient is chicken byproduct, the second ingredient is brewers yeast & it also has beets. I'd rather give my dog cornflakes with chicken stock. It would probably be healthier. The only Intimidating thing about this food is the ingredient list.

column4: William D. Colburn "buys things on amazon far...
column10: I was so happy to find this.  I've wanted to eat ziti for years.  Five stars for being real ziti!But now that I've had it, I'm going back to chopped up pieces of pasta that used to be ziti.  My largest pot is only 40 quarts.  A mere ten gallons of water.  My stove isn't powerful enough to bring that much water to a boil unlidded, but I have to fill it to the absolute brim to get most of the ziti into the water while it's still stiff and dry, so I can't lid it because it would boil over.  I also can't stir the ziti once it's in as I have nothing long enough to reach down to the bottom of the pot without submerging my hand in near boiling water.  I can't carry ten gallons of near boiling water to the sink, and even if I could, there is no possible way I could successfully pour it into a colander.  After the ziti softened and was down in the pot I did try bailing out the pot like it was a boat.  That sounded like a good idea, but bailing water and bailing near boiling water are two entirely different things.  I survived that with only minimal burns, and I got the water down to where I could use my tongs to stir it.  Once the ziti was cooked it was too long to successfully transfer into a bowl without it tearing into smaller pieces.So, in the end, I've eaten some ziti.  It was quite an adventure.  A bit too much adventure, really.  But I'm glad I did it.AG Ferrari packed my ziti amazingly well in lots of spray foam.  I have no idea why, as the pasta is so dry and so thick and so hard that I could probably use the package as a baseball bat.  All in all, this brand of pasta is absolutely amazing for its flavor and texture.

River Street Sweets pralines are so delicious that it is hard to just  eat one! I order pralines for my family and they love it! There pralines are made with the best quality ingredients and the pralines arrive fresh and packed with care. The only thing that I wish changed was the price. If it was not as expensive I would buy more!

For medical reasons, I can not eat gluten.  So, some years ago when I learned this, I thought oatmeal would be off my table for good.  For those who don't know, oats can be cross-contaminated with wheat crops, thereby rending them not gluten-free.  This means anyone who is gluten intolerant can not eat mainstream oatmeal products.  So one day a couple of months ago, I saw this new Glutenfreeda oatmeal at my local family-owned health food grocery.  I bought a package and immediately realized how blessed I was that Glutenfreeda introduced this product.  The flavors in the variety pack are all great.  My favorite is the maple raisin, which is out of this world delicious.  I have dedicated myself to eating a bowl of hot oatmeal every morning.  I prepare it by nuking it for one minute with a half cup water, stir it a bit, then I pour a bit of Alm...d Br..ze vanilla flavored non-dairy almond milk, then a light sprinkling of sugar.  Pure Heaven!  Please, I don't have any connection to this manufacturer, but I know it's difficult for small companies to navigate the rough economic cycles.  I beg you, PLEASE support Glutenfreeda by trying this product!  Try it locally, just buy a box.  Then when you realize how delicious, buy it like I do, by the case from Amazon, with S&S discount, and free shipping!
Delicious...one of few foods I can eat since I have Celiac and many, many food allergies!Thank you for making this product!

Oatmeal is gluten free and we should be able to just grab any brand we like and be okay with it, but having a food allergy is never that simple, knowing that an item that is GF by itself does not mean safe to eat, since oats are exposed to crosscontamination while being processed, so having a brand that is certified GF is great! plus the flavors are delicious, especially the raisin one!
This is a great tasting oatmeal and one that my twins also both enjoy.  It is also a great value through Amazon.

This is great oatmeal considering it is a package item. Tastes great and possibly even better, gluten free. That's very important as I have high sensitivities to gluten and wheat. We've tried all the flavors. They're all good but we do have a couple of favorites.

My mother has celiac disease.  She always loved having oatmeal every morning.  Thanks to this cereal I never have to hear her complain again about how much she misses having wonderful warm oatmeal for breakfast.  Thank You Glutenfreeda!!!!
This Gluten Free oatmeal is delicious as always, but I do think I like the apple cinnamon flavor better.Fast shipping and exceptional pricing. =]
This is wonderful oatmeal, great for me because of my gluten allergy, easy to prepare.

I had ordered Glutenfreeda"s Instant Oatmeal from another company. The Maple Raisin was my favorite flavor. It is easy to microwave and is delicious. I ordered a pkg. of 8 from Amazon and it arrived quickly. The ingredients are healthy and I need gluten free cereal. My husband eats regular oatmeal but said this tasted good. I think readers would enjoy the generous size of a serving. I microwave with water and eat plain. I hope Amazon will set up a replenishment schedule with this product. Please offer more gluten free breads.

I have been gluten-free for over 5 years and dairy and soy-free for 9 months. My daughter has been corn-free for quite some time and gluten and dairy-free for the past 10 months. We were ecstatic when we learned about Glutenfreeda's Oatmeal being safe for both of us. It had been soooo long since I could make a packet of flavored oatmeal in a jiffy. And with my daughter's corn-allergy, it has been even longer for her. We are now in heaven and love all three flavors, but my daughter's favorite is the Maple Raisin. We eat it for breakfast, snacks, whatever. It isn't as sweet as we both like it, but a spoon of demerara organic sugar and we're both ready to enjoy.Anyone who can buy any brand or kind of instant oatmeal off the shelf just can not fathom our excitement, but it is truly a wonderful thing to be able to enjoy instant oatmeal again!!

These packets are very convenient for taking to work or school. I even took a few on vacation.  The taste is a little less sweet than I was expecting based on the amount of carbs, but I top it with a little yogurt and it becomes a treat.  For about .50 a packet I feel it is a good deal.  I'm looking forward to trying the other flavors.
We were pleased with the taste and texture of the product.  If you remember what Quaker Instant Oatmeal tastes like, this is a little better!

Having a gluten-free replacement for Quaker instant oatmeal makes my mornings easier. My kids and I need a quick breakfast so we can get to work and school on time. Cold cereal just doesn't keep you full until lunch. Now we can make a quick breakfast that is healthy and filling. An added plus is that it's dairy-free, too.

The maple raisin instant gluten-free oatmeal tastes great, is processed in a dedicated gluten free facility and the oats are certified gluten free.  Quick & easy, filling, gluten-free, wholesome ingredients, and delicious - highly recommended!

column9: Not bad, and I usually don't like instant oatmal
column10: I'll admit, I was skeptical, because I generally don't like instant oatmeal. But this is pretty good stuff -- decent texture, and not overly sweet. And I appreciate the fact that every single item on the ingredients list is something I recognize and use in home cooking.But the real endorsement comes from picky seven-year-old, who is very difficult to please. "Not bad." Coming from her, that says a lot.

Have a delicious day! Wish I wrote that but it's off the box.So is this "We make glutenfree delicious..it's what we do" and boy did Glutenfreeda do it again.I've been hooked on Glutenfreeda products since they introduced their frozen cookies years ago. I was delighted to see them come out with instant oatmeal and I wasn't disappointed.I was doubly delighted to see the oatmeal offered on Amazon.com. Win,win! When you read the ingredient list you will see why- Off the Maple Raisin with Flax box :certified gluten free oats, raisins, organic maple sugar,brown sugar , flax meal and salt.That's it and yes you read the ingredient list correctly.Real ingredients for my real family.I was very happy to see a very low sodium content and the addition of flax.I always have a packet with me for a quick snack or those "eat at the desk" lunches. My husband who is not on the gluten free diet loves this oatmeal.He says the oats taste fresher. And for my Celiac college student this product has made his life so much easier.He can have a healthy breakfast in his dorm room or at the food court with no worry of cross-contamination.Like me he always has a packet in his backpack for snacks or a quick lunch.Thank you Glutenfreeda!

I HAPPENED UPON THIS OATMEAL, GAVE IT A TRY AND I AM TOTALLY SATISFIED.  THIS COOKS UP QUICKLY IN THE MICROWAVE, I ADD RAISINS, TRUVIA AND I AM GOOD TO GO FOR UP TO 4 HOURS! I love grape tootsie pops and while the price for these is probably [more than buying a variety bag in the store, at least, I am getting what I want and nothing I won't use.

...This jerky tastes just like how my brother described them: sugary bacon. I was really hoping the jerky'd have a savory taste, with a not so overbearing flavor, since I hate other commercial, store-brand jerkies.But, honestly, this doesn't taste good. At all...I'm ashamed I even bought this jerky. Skip this flavor and try the BBQ or Pepper flavor. If original tastes like sugary bacon, I shudder when I think about how the terriyaki might taste like...

This tea is fantastic and offers many, many, MANY health benefits. I only wish it was available with "Subscribe and Save"! Highly recommend looking around online to view the uses for this tea, especially for ridding the belly of H.pylori.Do yourself a favor... order this tea, and Enjoy your health!!

We have tried several times to change what our boys eat but they love the Iams food.  So we buy them what they want and need.  The vet says they are both completely healthy so it must be good to some degree, they do not get any table scraps or any extra food from anywhere else....

I tried several different brands and formulas, but all caused at least one of the two dogs to have severe upset stomach and associated issues.  I finally settled on this product when both dogs reacted well to it and love the taste.  As for the quality of the food, neither dog receives table scraps and less than 1 treat per week, yet the vet consistently gives them high marks for health.I don't know if this is the perfect choice for everyone, but it works out great for my dogs and I.

We've been feeding this to our Great Dane and honestly it hasn't worked out too well.Our dog is just over a year old and at her annual vet visit the vet pointed out that she was developing a yeast infection in her ear.  He told me it was most likely from her food and asked what we feed her.  I told him we feed her IAMS Large Breed food, and he said that it was probably the problem.He said we didn't need to treat it at the level that it was at, but that if she got to where she was shaking her ears a lot, or pawing at them, or if we noticed other symptoms, we would want to try a better diet to see if it fixed it.So, our dog's ears got worse.  She was constantly shaking her ears.  Her skin developed really bad dandruff.  She used to be really obedient, but she became really naughty.  I called the vet's office and we're switching her to a wheat-free corn-free diet now.  Last week we transitioned her over and this week we have already seen a little improvement; she doesn't shake her ears much at all anymore.  We'll watch and see if the dandruff and behavior problems also go away.  I am hopeful that they will.Maybe some dogs can eat this and be fine--our dog LIKES eating IAMS food...but it's just really obvious that it hasn't been good for her.  Until her vet told me, I had no idea that dog foods have so much bad stuff in them.  Dogs are carnivores, so it makes sense that they have problems on a wheat and corn diet.  The vet didn't try to sell us any particular brand of food, he just suggested trying a wheat and corn free brand for a couple months to see how it goes.  We are trying Nutro Natural Choice now.Too bad.  $50-60/bag dog food for a Great Dane is going to add up.

column9: tasting this is like been back home
column10: If you are Italian you just got to have it. If you are not italian and you tasted only "ham" (in italian prosciutto) this is a must in your food education :-)This Item is not cheap but is worth the price and is as Authentitic as it can getShipping was fast and less expensive then other store. I will definetely will buy this item.Suggestion: Make sure to have a good carving knife or a slicer since you need to make sure that the slices are really thin
The chicken is tender and juicy, and it's so convenient.  I was very impressed and I plan on keeping this product on hand at all times.  Their canned turkey is also very good.

I bought this product because of its decent price and relatively healthy nutritional contents. The reviews aren't bad either. When I opened the first pouch, I first noticed that it had a strong smell, and the smell was not of chicken. Being the hungry adventurous eater that I am, I consumed the whole pouch. The texture and appearance are actually not bad for chicken-in-a-bag, and it was satisfying going down. However I couldn't get over how odd the smell was - it smelled exactly like tuna. Also, the meat is cut into little cubes that smush easily so the texture actually tastes pretty similar to tuna as well. I thought I had gone crazy. I had to examine fibers to be sure it wasn't an error at the packaging plant that gave me tuna instead of chicken. When I gave two friends the sniff test with other pouches, they both said they smell tuna. Overall, this is not a huge problem because I like tuna, I may even make a chicken/tuna salad out of it, but I believe someone who hates tuna would find this product intolerable.

column9: Why is it so difficult to find all natural chicken?
column10: I decided to try this as finding all natural chicken seems next to impossible unless you're willing to pay a ridiculous price. Overall, I'm very happy with the product, it is all natural, no unnecessary ingredients, and the taste is what you would expect of canned chicken. I know some people complain that it smells like tuna, but in reality, any canned chicken product you buy, that doesn't have added ingredients, will smell like tuna, that's just how it is.Valley fresh does offer their all natural canned chicken at the grocery store, but it's the improved flavor kind, and they use additional ingredients to make it taste better. While it is more tasty, one of the ingredients they use is potato based, and us health freaks, don't eat potatoes. So I had to try to find their old recipe.The only reason it did not get 5 stars is because of the price. I'm having to have to resort to their better flavor recipe as it is a lot more affordable. I decided that potatoes are better than chicken that is not all natural. I am hoping that valley fresh will eventually allow for both products to be available (better flavor and original), so that I can choose to eat this one more regularly with out worry about price.

column9: easy to use, convenient size, awkward package
column10: howdy y'all,these are easy to use and a convenient size. they are, however, a tad awkward to use since the package doesn't let you easily get to the stuff stuck in the bottom corners. a few times i have had to get out the snips and cut the package down the side to get that last chunk.it is NOT dry - there is some liquid in the package. it is a tad oily since [unlike what my stepdad always claimed] there really is such a thing as chicken fat. We purchased this for backpacking because we could only find tuna and salmon in stores. It travels well and tastes great. The packaging is easy to carry out as well once it's empty. And no strong tuna smell to attract bears! I recommend it. My only wish would be that they move toward free range organic chicken. *That* would make this a perfect product!

column9: Never Thought To Buy Chicken Online
column10: Chicken is my cousin Dendo's favorite, every time he goes to the dentist we have a tradition that we go to the KFC next door. We get him a big ol' bucket of extra crispy, he calls it tucky bucky. Well, somebody burned the KFC down so now we're on our own when it comes to chicken. Fear not, chicken lovers. column10: Compared to cans, the pouches are a lot easier to store, open and dispose of, but I found that the chicken chunks are stringier and tougher compared to what I usually get in cans.

column9: Tastes better than most regular root beers
column10: I hate diet soda, so when I found out I had type 2 diabetes I was pretty depressed, as I drink alot of soda pop. All the diet drinks I was recommended as "you can't tell they are diet" turned out to be advise from people without taste buds. I can tell. Enter Sprecher Low-Cal. I have always thought that Sprecher made the best root beer out there so I gave the low-cal version a try. I'm not going to sit here and lie to you and say it is as good as the regular version, it's not. It is however better than alot of the regular root beers out there. There is no after taste. You could have served it to me and I would not have known it was a diet beverage. One more thing you should know, it is not a zero calorie drink. There is about 30 calories and 8 carbs in a 16oz bottle. You might not want to drink it everyday, but with those low numbers, a dieter or diabetic can surely fit this in as an occasional treat.

column9: Great product, Cat goes crazy and burns some energy

not too hot, good flavor, if you like bannana peppers on sandwitches add this too.will last a long time, a little goes a long way, reccomentd buying 2.

Sandwich stores have no clue about the wonderfulness of this product on their sandwiches.  So I have it delivered via Amazon and we enjoy having hots on all of our sandwiches, hot dogs, and hamburgers.  What a taste treat.

column9: My four year old LOVES these

One that is tasty is even better.These bars are small but they are very tasty and seeing that USA portion sizes are way out of control, I really don't mind the size.These have alot of taste, sweet but not so sweet that you feel like you binged on sugar afterwards. This was a good way to buy these, as they can be difficult to find in stores and my son loves them and goes through them pretty quickly. column9: I am 37 years old and I love these!!! Yummy :)
column10: I saw these in my local Target and was intrigued by themostly healthy ingredient list. column9: Not bad... but not great, either.

It is one of those popcorn poppers that actually uses corn oil and is not a cheap "air" popper.  Anyway, I tried a few different brands of popcorn, and by far, the best is the Orville Redenbacher yellow in the jar. They were cheaper than any other place I've seen them at, and my dog loves them! She starts drawling since she sees me grab the bag!

I found these when I was on vacation in the Bahamas.  They taste like a graham cracker and shortbread cookie combined. Great simple cookie.  I have had trouble finding in the States.  I am glad I found them on Amazon.  I can't wait to order the chocolate flavors.

This is the only thing my mother, who is 95, will eat for breakfast. She has them with her coffee and spreads them with cream cheese. I prefer them plain with hot tea. These cookies are the perfect antidote for an upset stomach or when you just want a good simple GREAT tasting plain cookies.  They have a nice texture and are just about the least offensive thing you could ever put in your mouth.  Substantial & dense, balanced in flavor.  Keep a pack on hand, they can last a long time and always taste fresh.  If you're a chocolate lover, the dark chocolate ones are even better!

I was shocked when I found this biscuit on the shelf at the local Wal-Mart Supercenter the other day! I gleefully bought 4 packs (16 biscuits/pack) at $1.98 each. You might be surprised!It goes without saying Digestive biscuits + tea = heaven!
Not greasy or too sweet, these wafers are perfect for after a meal or for a snack.  Especially enjoyable with a hot cup of tea.

Unfortunately they were shipped without packing protection and several were broken, but I still love them!

column9: One of the best biscuits I've ever eaten.
column10: It's hard to describe these biscuits to someone who's never had this because there is no American counterpart to this type of biscuit. It's a very rough and unprocessed kind of biscuit. If you feel American biscuits are too processed, then these are the opposite. The comparison would be like American biscuits = white flour and Digestive Biscuits = whole wheat, but I'm only talking about the textural quality; they are very crunchy and feels a bit rough in the mouth.Tastewise, they are sweet, but not overly so. They're very wheatey tasting and grainy. If you're a biscuit lover, you should definitely give it a try. They are a very high quality biscuit. They used to be very difficult to buy in the US, but now, thanks to the wonders of the internet, you can buy them anytime you want.
This is a wonderful "cookie" that is very light and not too sweet.  Makes a lovely mid-afternoon or late-night snack.  Great service from the company.
Had these on a trip to Scotland and really liked them. Nice to find a source for them now that we are home.

I love these biscuits a great deal. But they sell for $3.19 and cost $6.99 to ship to you ??? No way as they break very easy and thats TWICE the cost of the initial product. Almost makes going to look in Cost Plus where they sell them for $3.99 a bargain.

This 250g package is really quite a small package, for which I paid over $10 on Amazon.Because it specifies a European weight measure, I was not prepared for how small this package is.I wanted to give this item as a gift, but will now have to add other items to my gift.Substantially overpriced, in my opinion.
McVitties Digestive Biscuits are the best cookie in the whole world. This supplier sent me fresh product, but mostly crumbs.

I really don't know how to describe Kay's Naturals Cookie Bites, Cinnamon, 1-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12).  They are extremely tasty but don't really compare to other foods.  They are somewhat like Cinnamon Toast Crunch, but not as sugary and the texture is all wrong.  They are light and crispy, but not crunchy.I love that these are available in snack pack sizes.  I sometimes go on autopilot when eating so it is really helpful to not have to think about portion control. The temptation to binge on delicious food like this is best avoided.  I just eat what is in the bag because that is a reasonable amount of food.In any case, I think these are fantastic; the nutrition content makes you feel good about what you are putting in your body, and the taste makes you want to put them in your mouth!  This is healthy food that you can eat for the taste, rather than in spite of the taste.

I beg to differ with the previous reviewer. These are delicious!  They are crispy, cinnamon-y and not too sweet. They remind me of cinnamon toast crunch cereal.  1 bag 1.5 ounces is one a half servings. The whole bag is 165 calories and 15 grams of protein.

These little snacks are tasty but ever so mildly sweet.  I don't taste the almond butter in the center.  They taste mostly of cinnamon.  They are light and crunchy and full of fiber and protein.  For me, though, they did not satisfy the "bulk" need in my stomach.  I have used them as cereal in milk, since I am a celiac. These are awesome!!! They taste great, good quality, just enough in 1 bag for a good snack!! A great deal to have them auto shipped to you every month!!

We buy these ALL the time here on Amazon mainly because the price is affordable (SO hard to find when buying gluten free) and they have a great taste. My son loves to eat these and I will continue to buy them as long as they stay affordable. I buy many priducts from this manufacturer and have been very happy with all of them so far. column9: I find them to be tasty

It's difficult finding gluten free snacks that actually taste good, but thesedefinitely do.  Because they are individually wrapped they can go anywhere with you.Convenient and tastes great!

column9: Good snack with decent protein/carb balance
column10: I like these. They strike me more as almond butter mixed into shredded wheat than a "cookie bite". But titles aside, these are sweet enough to satisfy me when I'm looking for something a little indulgent.
