My wife has been using these k-cups for about two years or so, and I've always turned my nose up at her quick cups.  But I've been too snobby.  I tried one the other day - I had my usual ground and pressed large cup in the morning, and was looking for another smaller cup in the early afternoon.  I didn't feel like pulling out the burr grinder, french press, and boiling the water.  So I poppped a cup in when the wife was out in the garden and tried a cup.  Whatta ya know - not so bad at all.  Good flavor - definitely not just "dark water."  It was a good cup of coffee.  Now, of course, it is not the same as the cup I get when I go through what I go through for the near perfect cup I shoot for every early morning.  But for a not-so-bad quick cup, the Keurig system and these k-cups deliver.
Excellent coffee for the non-coffee snobs. It's as good or better than Dunkin Donuts regular.

$125 for 72 K-Kups.  That is absolutely laughable!!  Come on!!  I hope no one falls for this highway robbery.  There are many many online stores that offer K-Kups from Green Mountain (and other companies) for less than 50cents per cup.  Amazon, and their partner in crime here, are trying to charge close to $2 per cup.  Thanks for giving me a good laugh today.
This brand and flavor of K cup coffee is great...expensive but the taste is so good and satisfying!
I support purchase of all Fair Trade coffee and hope that the price is will be more affordable.
I've been ordering these for a long time - they were $17.95 and now all of a sudden $125?????  AMAZON what the heck R U doing????

If you are a serious coffee drinker, this is not the one for you. With the k-cup technology, it's not as though you have to practice making coffee as the work is done for you. Whether on the smallest or middle setting, I can't taste coffee! To me, it's Dark Water. If I could have rated it 0 stars, I would have. I tried but I kept getting the request to rate the coffee. For me, it has 0 stars.

column9: Definately not what I was expecting
column10: I've enjoyed Jamaican Blue Mountain from the Amber Estate for a number of years but as its price climbed to at times over $75/lb. I had to look for an alternative.  The description of Reggie's Roast Panama Blue sounded like it might fill the bill, unfortunately, this was not the case.Top quality Blue Mountain coffees are most often given a light, mild roast which allows their nuances to gently fill your senses with an essence I can only describe as honeyed liquid gold.  Reggie's Roast Panama Blue is said to be a blend of Jamaican Blue Mountain and Panama Boquet coffees.  I suspect it contained very little of any Blue Mountain coffee, much less a "blue" from the top quality estates.  I found the roast to be darker than expected and the result was a somewhat coarse coffee with chocolate over-tones that had none of the light, bright honey notes I had expected.It was worth a try, but this coffee just doesn't do it for me.
Very good coffee w/ a very nice flavor.  Not too bold, not too mild.  I will buy this coffee again.

Archie Loves these..we give him 1/2 per day and he wait for the next one. Helps in his dental care. I don't understand the pricing on Amazon.com ($20-$25) we buy them at Costco for $11 a bag 24 Count 48 oz.

I was disappointed when Costco stopped selling these treats.  Their Kirkland brand of dog treats are horrible.  My dogs love them and I do feel they help whiten and clean their teeth. I have a lab and a German Shepherd and they look forward to them.  I think this is an excellent product and would recommend them to all dog owners.  The best part is they are made in the USA!!!!!  Please keep selling them.

column9: These seem to work well and my dog likes them
column10: Tried these recently and before the first bag was finished my dog's teeth were cleaner and brighter than I was able to get them with brushing and other dental "treats".  My only issue is that they are a bit pricey.  Service from the Vendor was Accurate and very prompt.

My vet often ask's how do I keep my three, eleven year olds, teeth so clean. I'm lucky to tell him all about Checkups. My dogs do not have any plaque on any of their front or back teeth. It's amazing. These easy to chew, tasty treats are just long enough that they have to use their back teeth to chew them. I stick by this product. They get one a day. They love them.
Easy on my dogs' stomachs and they work great on reducing plaque.  However, they are sold at Costco for less than $12.00 for a pack of 24.

column9: Good Product, price was too high
column10: My dogs really love this product. I was purchasing it from a warehouse but they stopped carrying them for a while, so I was thrilled to find them here but the price is much more. The item is still a great product and they arrived very quickly.

column9: Great on his system but no breath improvement...
column10: My basset hound LOVES these - we give him a half a check-up bone each morning when he goes in his crate (and now he goes RUNNING into his crate after walks with his leash still on.) He gobbles them up, and best of all, they don't bother his sensitive tummy like every other dental chew we have tried! Another major plus, is due to the white color, they don't stain our carpeting! The only downside I see to these, is that they don't seem to freshen his breath. Smelling the bones individually, they don't really smell particularly minty or like anything that might freshen the breath either. If your dog has bad breath that stems from poor oral health, these may help. But, if your dog just has dog breath from his food, these aren't going to give you much improvement. That said, it is very hard to find dental chews that don't have harmful ingredients for dogs with sensitive systems, and these work beautifully!

I read great reviews on this product so I decided to give it a go! I gave 1 stick to my 80 lb saint Bernard mix and she threw up about 4 hours later multiple times. She doesn't have a sensitive tummy usually.. This worries me so I will no longer be trying this product out!
Harry can be fussy.  He will not go near the greenies, but loves the dental checkups.  It's a great way to keep his teeth clean and breath fresh.

A friend gave a bag of these to me as a Christmas present for my dog (a German Shepherd), and she loved them so much I had to ask where she got them.  They don't sell them at PetsMart or at any of the grocery stores I shop at, so now I have her pick them up for me at Costco, since I don't have a membership.  I agree 100% with what the other reviewers are saying - the treats work like a charm to keep teeth clean & breath fresh, and the doggie is nuts about them.  But they ARE too pricey on Amazon - I don't understand why they have to be $22-$25 a bag, when Costco sells the same exact product for about $10 per bag.  They do work though, and I use mine as a 'bedtime' treat.  She gets the bone as a reward for going to her bed (the crate) at night, and it's hilarious because no matter where in the house she is, as soon as I say it's time for bed she literally sprints to her crate!  Just because she knows she's getting the bone as a treat.  Wonderful product!

She won't have her teeth cleaned for a few months, so we'll have to see how effective they are on tartar and plaque.  In the meantime, she's enjoying them!

Before I commit to purchasing an item, I do research on the product. Choosing a food brand for my lovable German Shepherd puppy was no exception. It was while I was scouring the internet for reviews on selective dry (kibble) large breed dog food for puppies, I came across several respectable websites that ranked Chicken Soup for the Puppy Lover's Soul at the top of its category. Compared to other brands that rank highly in puppy kibble, like Orijen, Innova and Wellness, Chicken Soup offers quality food at an affordable price. As the kibble is high in meat content and contains quality grains, and my puppy loves it, Chicken Soup for the Puppy Lover's Soul is a brand I recommend.In the instance your puppy dislikes this food or has an allergic reaction to some of the ingredients, be sure to consider the following when deciding on another dog food:1. Always gradually transition to the new food. Over a period of days, balance the quantity of old to new food (75% old/25% new; 50% old/50% new; 25% old/ 75% new). If you do not do this, your puppy will have loose stools and possibly feel sick.2. The main ingredients. There needs to be plenty of meat products, and if there are grains, check to see if they are high quality whole grains. Usually, a good indicator of the quality of a product is the first few ingredients listed. If these are meat, like the chicken, turkey and chicken meal of this product, then this should be a food to consider.3. Try it out for a few weeks. If your puppy does not like it, feels sick, has loose stools or a dull coat, the dog food is not good for your puppy. It doesn't matter if the food is the best food; it is not good for your puppy and you should not continue to feed it.

The roland brand lychee's are great. There is roughly 15+ lychee's per can. Roland Lychees come from thailand. On the back of the can it says you can stir-fry these with cooked rice. I havent tried it yet but will soon. If you are open to fruit from around the world pick these up, you will not be disappointed.

I can't get enough of lychee! I go through at least one can a day at breakfast, and Roland delivers a bulk product here that satisfies my craving. I really wish they were grown more here in the US - fresh lychee from Florida or California is tremendously expensive.

For some reason, I thought they were from Thailand, but I was wrong.  They are from China.  I don't feed my child food products from China.  I don't trust them to not use poisons, because we know they will, if it saves a buck.  I will not order again.

column9: Cafe Bustelo is excellent using a K-Cup insert
column10: I am one of those K-Cup snobs, who loves a hot cup of fresh coffee each and every time I get a cup.  Sorry, brewing 10 cups that sit in the pot for an hour til I want another cup just doesn't cut it for me.  But K-cups can get expensive (running $0.40 - $0.60 per cup depending on the type).  Well, I picked up a packaged of Cafe Bustelo, and used the individual insert K-cup, and OMG!  None of my prepacked K-cups come even close to the flavor and intensity of this coffee.  It's bold but not bitter.  A scoop is fine for making a single cup, and I am guessing I'm going to have about 40 cups per 10 oz package.  Cuts my cost down into the $0.10 range per cup!So if you are a K-cup user, try this brand of coffee.  You will not be disappointed.  BTW: I purchase this locally at Walmart for about $2.80 per 10oz package...

We owned a bed and breakfast for many years and the coffee we used daily was Cafe Bustelo.  The flavor was rubust and not bitter...just good coffee that 95% of our guests thoroughly enjoyed.  Recently, I ordered 8 packs from Amazon, and only 2 of the 8 arrived in their vacuum brick...the others seemed to have not been sealed well.  This had never occurred before.  The coffee in the sealed packs is the delicious flavor that is known, but the unsealed packs has given the coffee a bad flavor...who knows how long the vacuum was broken before arriving at our home.  I will purchase this coffee again...but from the Cuban Market.

If you like strong full bodied coffee then get this! This stuff is like rocket fuel. It tastes very good as well. I use it for making iced coffee and it does well for that purpose. I also use it for brewing hot coffee the traditional way and everyone in the house loves it.Cafe Bustelo Coffee Espresso, 10-Ounce Bricks (Pack of 4)

column9: delicious and good for iced and hot drinks
column10: Smooth taste, lovey aroma, very popular in Hispanic communities, and great to make a variety of drinks, iced or hot. It beats the heck out of the more common Folgers and Maxwell house brands, and with the low price and high quality, you can't beat Cafe Bustelo.The flavor itself is strong but smooth, not as bitter as some, and the smell is sharp and rich. It reminds me of visits to Puerto Rico, where all my great aunts would play cards and drink it every evening.

This is a very good espresso blend at a bargain price.  It does well in a pump espresso machine and since it is a little on the mild side it will probably do well in a drip machine at higher temperature.  However it is a very popular brand so if you shop around you may find it in the small resealable metal cans for only pennies more at your local store.
There is no better coffee than bustelo. It really is amazing. I feel like my  espresso is better than any coffee shop I've ever been to.

....then you should like this blend.  I accidentally stumbled across this brand of coffee while searching for some Italian blend or espresso blend (basically something strong).  I've seen this package in several stores but never purchased it because I thought it was a cheap tasteless blend.  After reading all the reviews, I decided to purchase this Cafe Bustelo because it appeared most customers were pleased with the taste and the price.I can report that I'm very pleased with this blend and I use it in my maka pot too.  I love strong coffee, but not the acidity taste and this is strong but not bitter strong, and of course the price is great.  Also,  I don't have to grind coffee beans to get the consistency as fine as this blend.  I think I will become a Cafe Bustelo purchaser for the foreseen future!

My husband and I LOVE this coffee.  It's strong and soooo smooth!!  I love making the left over coffee into iced coffee.  Beats any Peets or star$$$ I've ever had.  With the exception of their fancy frapps.

I have been a fan of Cafe Bustelo for about 10 years now.  I am actually not a fan of the taste of coffee, so when I drink it, I am looking for one thing- That BOOST! Cafe Bustelo is like Rocket Fuel, this stuff kicks A%#!!!  And when I add some creamer, it actually tastes really good.  I love this stuff, and it's cheap!  You can keep your $12 a bag Starbucks, for less than $4 I have enough fuel to last weeks!  Love it!

I have been purchasing this brand of coffee for approximately 2 years now. I first tried it because I make my own espresso drinks at home and was looking for a good,rich espresso coffee without the ridiculous price. My objective as always was to save money, yet get a good product at the same time. I bought this at the store that I most frequent for $3.45 for a 10oz can. I was pleased with the flavor, and the price. I have used this ever since.I have also used in it my regular coffee maker and it makes a great cup of regular java for those that don't want all the foo foo in their coffee. However lately I have noticed that at the place I shop known for " Always low prices" that they have slowly raised prices, not by much but it got me to thinking I wonder if I can find it for cheaper here on my favorite ( tonque in cheek) website. Well lo and behold, I found at a good price for 4 10oz. bricks of my favorite espresso coffee, with Prime free 2 day shipping. All told I actually saved some extra money for my favorite chocolate to add to my espresso tomorrow morning! Thanks! I will be grabbing it this way for a long time to come. Cafe Bustelo Coffee Espresso, 10-Ounce Bricks (Pack of 4)  Happy coffee everyone!

column4: Shana "That's my opinion- I could be wrong!"
column9: Excellent dark dark roast with small price tag
column10: I just love this coffee. I'm a big fan of a really smooth and very dark roasted coffee. For reference some of my other favorite coffees are made by Unique Roasters in New York. This coffee tastes a lot more expensive than it is. It doesn't taste truly as rich as an Espresso, but, I just have a regular drip coffee maker. Perhaps, that's why, but if you love a good dark roasted coffee with no bitter tastes than you will love this coffee.Usually, I buy this coffee brick and the cans at my local Wal-Mart, so I cannot comment on the unsealed bricks that the other reviewers have mentioned.
One of the best coffees for the price. Package was on time and in perfect condition. I know it is expresso but just make it like regular coffee and enjoy.

column9: coffee is great, they need to work on their shipping
column10: Café Bustelo is a great coffee choice. Be aware that the packing of this product is not very efficient. I had to place four of the coffee bags in ziplock bags because they arrived with mini tears on them that allowed air to get in and coffee to spill.

This coffee is delicious, strong, and very aromatic.  I look foward to my cup of Cafe Bustelo espresso.  I also use it in my drip coffee maker because I hate weak coffee.  mmmmmm, I think I will make a cup right now!

column9: Bustelo has a nice rich flavor
column10: I really like the Bustelo.  I bought it instead of Pilon because the price on Pilon was high that day.  They have very similar flavors, but I think the pilon has a bit more coarse feel & a slight chocolate note that the Bustelo does not have.  The bustelo has more of a rich coffee flavor.I prefer the Pilon, but I would gladly buy either.

I have only used this in my Bialetti stovetop espresso maker so far, but I'm sure it would be fine in any machine.  My next experiment will be using it in my old Senseo machine in the refillable eco-pods, which are great by the way.  I picked this up for a road trip, because I wanted some pre-ground espresso coffee, and didn't want to lug around my burr grinder for the whole beans I normally buy.  I think I might be hooked on this for a while!  Here's a protip - if you have a TJ Maxx or Big Lots nearby, they have great deals on coffee beans.  I picked up bags at half the price found anywhere else, including online stores. If you're a rich coffee snob, and can afford the good stuff at $50/lb, then great for you, but for the rest of us, this coffee is nothing to sneer at.

I will preface this by saying I am a coffee snob. I would not dare, adulterate a cup of java with diary or sugar. Sacrilege!  In any case, Bustelo is a good solid coffee and for the price it is a good bargain. As someone else posted- It is infinitely better than Folgers and Maxwell tripe. On a scale of one to ten, I would rate it a five. Average. But again, for the price, it is hard to beat. For reference, I would rate most of the Starbucks brews in the 6-8 range. Pure Kona and Jamaican Blue Mountain start getting into the 9-10 category.

column9: The only way to buy coffee
column10: Amazon's price for this vacuum packed coffee is better than what I pay in the grocery store.  The coffee itself is great, but the price is even better.

column9: good coffee but crap distributer (Lakwood Candies LLC)
column10: The coffee is good but when it arrives in an opened yellow package that is then retaped shut and then put in the box w coffee spilling out, it is not fit for consumption. Amazon simply put the box with the coffee coming out of it in a larger box and then shipped the damaged goods to me.

No problem, there is a solution and you can still enjoy this great coffee.This is a foundation in south Florida, almost all the Cuban restaurants serveCafe Bustelo, and real Cuban coffee is a treat. I dont have the patience forit but you can find instructional videos on youtube. Anyway, I dont like Expressoeither so what I do, and I'll get slayed for this, is mix this entire packagewith a pack of Chock Full O Nuts regular. Now I have a hearty robust and veryrich tasting coffee that to me tastes the way coffee used to taste 20 years ago.Pilon is another good product, but Bustelo is less expensive and honestly I dontknow how to tell the difference. Dont be afraid to try this with your everydaycoffee, it blends very well.
Smooth and very robust without much acidity!  If you like Espresso, this is a purchase well worth the dollar$!!
This is the only coffee my husband and I will drink. It seems to have more caffeine than your average espresso. Also, it has a great flavor for being such a dark coffee. My dad loves it too
I've been drinking Cafe Bustello since I was a teenager visiting my Italian uncle and his family. It has always been the best- nothing's changed.

My mom has to have her Bustelo cafe just like she used to get in the old neighborhood.  One day, when it seemed like our store was out and she was afraid they wouldn't get anymore, I found this on Amazon and she is very pleased.  We will keep ordering.
I am the "barista" for our office and like to add varying amounts of Bustelo both for the flavor and the caffeine boost.  This was a great deal and delivered right to our door!
Thought I would give this coffee a try and I wasn't disappointed.  Nice flavor - not bitter.  Packaging was fine for me.
This is my wife's brand of choice for decent, not too expensive espresso.  It's hard to find in stores around here, so buying on Amazon is a really nice option, especially with Prime.
This coffee is a great alternative to grinding beans.  Tastes great and is reasonably priced.  COmes in cans or vacuum sealed bags and both keep well.

Cafe Bustelo Coffee Espresso, 10-Ounce Bricks (Pack of 4)I have been a long time customer...begining use while living in the florida keys...since living in oklahoma, colorado, louisiana and texas it has been necessary to order the coffee...sometimes not available where lived or too expensive where lived...we really enjoy the product and after 10 years of usuage, have not found another brand that meets the top quality of cafe bustelo.
exellent coffee,exellent price,and exellent servive! I will tell all my friends about it.If you are on a budget and need your expresso in the morning,buy buy buy

column9: Best electric drip coffeemaker coffee grounds
column10: TASTES REAL GOOD, nice dark roasted flavor.I have to write a few more words to make amazon accept this as a real review, but really I've already said it all with that first sentence.

Born in NYC I was weened on cafe con leche. Mom always used Bustelo.  Moved to Miami where un cafe Cubano became a daily tradition.  Moved to Olathe KS 13 yrs ago and freaked out  when I couldn't find any of my favorite Latin products.  It's better now but the prices are outrageous.  Yesterday I saw  my bustelo going for $6.35 at my local supermarket.  Through Amazon I can get 4 packs of Bustelo for less then $11.  What a bargain!  I have ordered enough to last through 2011.  (I keep my stash in the deep freezer!).  The shipment always arrives as scheduled.  Cafe is 1st rate.  Last month  the Smucker's company purchased Bustelo.  I pray they don't try to mess with the formula.
I love this coffee! It is SOO smooth and dark! mmm...this was a GREAT price too and I love have the extra on hand
This coffee is our daily must have.  It brews an even, strong, non-bitter cup of coffee that is perfect!  I recommend it to everyone and have turned many non-coffee drinkers into lovers.
Good Cuban style espresso.I received a damaged product (3 of 4 packs had lost vacuum)and amazon quickly refunded me.

column9: Best espresso for quick home use
column10: I grew up on this coffee, and find it to be a way better deal than the new espressos. I can't be bothered grinding beans. This coffee stays fresh as I put the bag in the Bustelo sealed can right after opening it, and keep it in the fridge. Richer that more expensive brands, hint-of-chocolate-flavor in the way it's roasted. No other coffee tastes this rich, and it's the best deal, price-wise. Bless Amazon for carrying this brand, as where I now live, it's not available without a long, expensive trip to get it.

Tried it in my friends espresso machine and it tasted horrid. I have a drip coffee machine and again it tasted bad but I put it in my bodum french press and rapture. It doesn't taste as an espresso should but it's a nice dark roast. I personally like STRONG coffee with only a little bit of sugar and this was perfection for my ideal coffee. I bought it at a place that gets items that have been damaged and one of the sealed pouches had opened so  I bought the other three at $1.75. I hope they get it again but if not I now have it on my wishlist on amazon.
Bad tasting coffee, no aroma/baked, very dry, bitter, hard, harsh and unpleasant aftertaste of burnt charcoal. Not suitable for espresso and not creamy at all.

column9: Amazon- great place for buying Cafe Bustelo
column10: So glad to have found that Amazon has Cafe Bustelo bricks. Found it elsewhere online for less moolah but shipping killed the deal. I love Amazon.com for its free shipping for orders over 25.00. And I love Cafe Bustelo. We bought a couple of cans of the expresso and now we just empty the contents of the brick into the tins. We were happy to find that the stuff in the bricks is just as good as the stuff in tins. Love buying in bulk, too, because we don't run out for a while.

column9: Prebrew smells crap post brew tastes crap
column10: What the hell was I thinking? Open can ..it smells foul ..no coffee smell at all ..just foul unrecognizable smell. Next morning opened container.. Still no coffee smell.. vague  fruit smell like that I have smelled in some tobacco's.. Over riding crap smell sends to have dissipated.. Noticed another reviewer mentioned a 'green' quality.. ie picked too early.. I would concur.I had purchased to mix with my premium blend for economy.. dumb dumb dumb lol decided to prepare as per my normal, unmixed. Whole milk to the boil, frappe, auto drip 6 teaspoons espresso grounds to 24 ounces of water. milk frappe in cup, ghost dust with cinnamin, med-light sprinkling of dark brown sugar on foam filled cup, pour 2-3 ounces if expresso straight down the middle.. As I do with premium blend.. Smellless, wow, after cooled to drinkable it's actually drinkable.. Though my stomach tells me the acid content after 3 sips is way to high.. And no coffee aroma our premium taste.. A slight green fruitiness..but not really a coffee taste.. definitely a do not buy brand. Too bad. It sucks

As an experienced Lavazza and Illy coffee consumer I can tell you that this thing tastes like a used cigarette filter.Dark roast, very bitter, quite coarse grind all together make an ugly espresso. very similar to Starbucks and friends(excuse me Seattle but Italian blends are MUCH better)Skip if you can. go with Lavazza Qualita Orro (light),Cafe Espresso (stronger) or Tierra (refined) blends, you won't be disappointed
I picked this up, August 2011, for 11.62.October 2011, the price is 19.49My mom clicks on the same link, the price is 14.83 ??

I rarely review anything with limited time...unless it's either really great or perfectly horrid. Bustelo out of the can is without exception, the very worst coffee I've ever had in my life. I sensed the flavor of dirt off a factory floor with a mild flavor of old dirty cigarettes. This was with filtered water (so no water issues). Maybe I got a bad can, but man, this was rough and acrid stuff. Your mileage may vary...

I have a small collection of finishing salts that I use for different things. This one is my favorite for things like salad and desserts. It's gorgeous with large crystal shapes that are very thin, some are just flakes, but other pieces are like shallow hollow pyramids. The flavor is mild and they have a nice snap which adds a textural interest to chocolates and candies.For more robust flavors, I prefer stronger flavored salts like smoked or Peruvian pink salts.

column4: Gail Volkert "Cat lover, kitchen gadget freak"
column10: This has a great, fresh, finishing salt. I personally prefer Murray River Pink Salt for the more delicate crunch, but I do like this for a change. Try both!

To those who believe salt is simply salt this should change a few minds. I've mainly used it as a finisher for salads and other dishes, however, in a bind had to use it in pickling as well and the results were fantastic.

This is the most flavorful salt you can imagine.  After you cook a nice thick steak and carve it, sprinkle a little of this salt on the cut side to make the meat pop in your mouth!!!  If you've never experimented with finishing salts, then this is a great starting point!
I was very dissappointed with the treat's because there was hardly any treats in the bag which I think was way over priced for the size of the bag. My dogs loved them by the way

I am going to have to purchase more of this product.  My westie, who is very finicky, loves these treats.  My recent rescue (shihtzu) loves them too!!! I am grateful that they are made in the USA.Thank you for a great product.  I will definitely be back!Sabrina
I think that Rice krispy treats is better than Rice Krispies cereal. Eventhough Rice Krispy treats has a high level of sugar it's still better than the cereal.

Flavorganics Organic Peppermint extract is an excellent product & excellent buy.  I have used it when making my chocolate mint chocolate chip cookies & peppermint patties.  The flavor is fresh & crisp without being overpowering. This is not a one time purchase for me.  I really like the product.

Love their tortilla chips, so thought I'd try these.  The reviews for the yellow corn shells were mixed- one liked them, the other seemed like they just got a bad case.  I couldn't find them in my local grocery stores to try just 1 box to see if I liked them before buying a whole case of them.  But, no worries...  They arrived in perfect condition and were delicious!  Much thinner and crunchier when heated than your standard Ortega or Old El Paso fare.  They became very crispy with just a subtle, clean corn flavor when heated (I only heated for 4-5 min at 350).  My hubby doesn't like the "musty" flavor (his description, not mine) that regular store brands have; even if it's way before the "sell by" date, he thinks they taste and smell stale.  These shells don't have that problem, plus I like the fact that they're organic.  I will definitely be buying them again!

I bought these at my local supercenter, assuming they might be fresh, and was shocked when I got home and they were stale.  They're really poorly packaged (just thin shrink wrap around the box; open the box and there's nothing but a tray and the rings) and they don't taste good at all.  The chocolate is flaking off of the rings, which look crystallized.  I wanted these for Hanukkah but they look and taste like they've been sitting around since last Passover.  Skip these and get Joyva.
this product was unacceptable.  The chocolate was all bloomed.  They tasted awful. I had to throw them away.I should have known better than to buy something other than Joyva.

column4: D. White "movie critic but book lover"

Considering how many foods get recalled, shouldn't it say where they are ACTUALLY made? Got at Costco and I'm taking them back. Worth trying once so you can really appreciate Joyva, lol. My son loves Jelly Rings and wouldn't take more than one bite. Lesson learned. Two thumbs down.

RUN away from these. They may LOOK like the Joyva Jelly Rings, but trust me...they are NOTHING like them. My local grocery store carries so many Joyva products, but for some reason they don't carry the Joyva Jelly Rings. They carry these instead. They are so awful! SO WORTH IT!

I should have sent these back. Thay were stale with the chocolate coating on the jelly rings white and looked like they were in storage for a long time. The jelly inside was hard and inedible. Never again do I buy from this company. I was embarassed to serve them and threw out.
My family loves chocolate covered jellies and I ordered these as a gift. The chocolate was waxy and had a musty taste. Not recommended.

column9: Manhattan Dark Chocolate Covered Jelly Rings
column10: This product had a very objectional chemical-like off-flavorto it.  Very disappointing!  I will never buy these again!Manhattan Dark Chocolate Covered Jelly Rings 2 lb Box

When I received the Manhattan Chocolates I was really unhappy with it from the beginning. The box of chocolates had pieces of chocolate that were loose under the plastic wrapping of the box...which had me thinking this wasn't gonna be good. So, as I opened the box it became more and more apparent this really wasn't a good product....you know when chocolate is old it turns light brown or whitish??? Well, that's how ALL of the jelly rings looked. This box was nasty and I would never order from them again...very disappointed

I think that these taste every bit as good as-- and even better than--the Joyva Jelly Rings that I grew up with.  And they are much more affordable.  The chocolate is good and plentiful, as is the jelly.

I fell in love with fresh coconut water while teaching in Vietnam.  This is the closest I have found in the states.  No sugar added.  Just coconut water.  I bought two cases at the Pacific Ocean Market in Denver, but that is 250 miles away.  Price was $24.00 a case.  Interested to see what it will cost on Amazon with shipping.

I have used Bilardo Bros. "Steak Rub" for years. It is by far THE BEST boxed spice rub out there. A word of caution. It is a "pepper" product which carries with it a bit of heat to the palate.That said, if you like Whiskey Peppercorn Steak this is the rub for you! Simply fry your rubbed steak in some olive oil on high heat and sear both sides appropriately. Set aside. Whisk in 1/2 tsp. fresh cracked peppercorns, heavy cream, whiskey of your choice, and maybe a pat of some real butter. Whisk over medium high heat until all is combined, then pour over your resting steaks for a scrumptious, firey delight.Bilardo Brothers spice rubs are convienient, tasty, and an excellent choice for the part-time gourmet chef with a steak fettish. Ummmmm!!!

I use these rubs to make a pastrami like meat. I begin with a corned beef briskette, rub on the bilardo's and smoke for 8-10 hours. The end product is a very peppery, great tasting snack. Amazon had the best price I could find on these, I purchased a dozen boxes, they contain two packages per box. That makes 24 briskettes!!! I strongly recommend these products.
These cookies were ok.  I prefer the plain oreo's. These cookies were pretty pricey too!!Not a very good value, don't spend the extra money.  Just buy the regular oreo's they are better anyway.

This is excellent honey!  And at a remarkably good price.  Be aware that you don't just pour it out of the jar unless you nuke it. My favorite way to eat this is to spread it on a biscuit & sprinkle on some cinnamon.  It tastes just like a cinnamon roll.  I like it better than regular honey.

column9: Happy With My Organic Spring Jasmine Tea
column10: This is a huge amount of tea for a reasonable price.  The smell and flavor is wonderful.  Will buy again but won't need to for a while.  You can easily steep the tea 2-3 more times with good results.
For me, this is by far my favorite jasmine green tea.  It's scented just right and is smooth in taste.

I am a jasmine tea lover.  Might Leaf Organic Spring Jasmine is so reasonably priced!  It has the taste of of a tea that make you believe it is a very expensive, exotic Chinese tea.  A cup in the afternoon is so special.  The foil bag keeps the tea fresh.

This one pound bag is a good value considering the taste and that it is organic.  If you brew it according to the directions, you will have a perfect cup of tea every time.  I will continue to order this tea. It is one of my favorites!

column9: An all natural fruit snack that tastes great and has the crispy consistency of a chip!
column10: This is a great tasting snack that's good for you!Crunchy N Yummy mango has the crispy consistency of a chip.  This snack is wholesome and all natural - just 100% sun ripened and freeze dried mangoes.  The mangoes are certified USDA organic - even the water that is removed from the fruit is returned to the farms!These snacks contain no sulfur dioxide (E220), a food preservative commonly used in dried fruit.  Some individuals may be sensitive to sulfur dioxide especially in large amounts, so it's great that Crunchy N Yummy products contain no preservatives and no artificial whatchamacallits! :))The freeze dried mangoes are great in salads, cereal or as a topping in yogurts or ice cream.  I don't worry about re-sealing the pack to keep the mangoes crunchy - at only 100 calories per 1 ounce serving, I can eat the entire pack!  :))SEE MY PHOTOS IN CUSTOMER IMAGESThe only negative comment I can make is the high price for these single serving snack packs.  I do hope Amazon would offer these Crunchy N Yummy snacks at cheaper prices soon!4 STARS for the high price - 5 STARS for a great tasting crunchy dried fruit snack!RECOMMENDED: Crunchy N Yummy Organic Freeze Dried Fruit Papaya is great for snacking on the go.  At only  55 calories per pack - you can even start another pack without guilt tripping! :))

This is my new favorite snack food for whenever I have a craving for sweets!  There is so much fruit for so little calories.  I love to eat it at night when watching TV and I even bring it to the movies to eat instead of popcorn.  I get all the crunch I love from chips, all the sweetness I love from candy and none of the guilt!  And my kids love it too - win, win, win!

I have tried so many brands of freeze dried fruits, and crunchy y yummy is by far the most delicious one. its is really crunchy and tastes like the real fruit.On top of that, its healthy and super practical to carry around for an anytime snack. I highly recommend!!!

I was very surprised how good this Crunchy n yummy mango was.  This was the first time I had freeze dried fruit since I could remember.  Nice size peices.  Mostly slices with some small tidbits.  No sugar added. Very low in carbs.  High in potassium.  Great snack. Low calorie.  So good I ordered for my mother for Christmas present because she loves mango.  Great to have in winter when grocery stores dont have mangos or they are not good.  Also tried the strawberry good too.

There are only a few pieces of mango that actually resemble a freeze dried mango, the rest of the mango pieces inside are small hard pieces that feel like your chewing on glass and get heavily stuck in your teeth and have almost no flavor, and not to mention lots of sugar. The product is inexpensive enough that you can purchase it on your own and see for yourself, which is what I did. (PS Trader Joe's mangos are the best, but not sure if they're available onlinen, guess I'll go check.)

column9: One of the best snacks ever!
column10: My kids love these and so do my husband and I. They are truly delicious! We tend to eat them straight from the bag, but I've put them in cereal and on salads as well. They're really sweet and full of vitamin C. Yummy!

This product did not meet our expectations.  The pieces were not light and crisp as I expected but were somewhat chewy and odd shaped.  The flavor of the fruit was ok, but I have had other brands of freeze dried mango that are much better.  Overall it was very poor quality and we would not order this brand again.
Ordered the pack of 4 (10 count boxes)and found it to be a good buy. The jammers were very good taste wise and none were bad. Found it to be a good buy and will order them again.
I bought these because I often need a mid-morning snack at work.  I wanted something that I could stick in my purse.  This is compact yet just enough to quench my hunger.  This is the perfect size!
nice compact packages of nuts. everything was fresh and tasty. price was a good deal. very usefulfor group outings. would recommend to anyone
I like snacks in portion control packs. These are great to throw in my lunch bag and keep me from over indulging.

This is a very good water cooler.  Has a place to put a lock so people wont still ice on a hot day.  I purchased for my softball team, to have outside for kids in hot weather and many other things.  You can get it at walmart for 30.  Try there.

Another excellent product from Celestial Seasonings teas.  Just brew a cup and sit down and within 15-20 minutes I am yawning like crazy and must just head to bed. Great for those nights when you're all wound up and just can't seem to relax and get to sleep.

I bought this balsamic vinegar to try it, since I have previously bought the Gold version from the same company (La Piana Gold Quality Aged Balsamic Vinegar PGI) and loved it.  This one does not come anywhere near the quality of the Gold.  It is closer to the pricier balsamics from Trader Joe's (which are around $5 instead of $20) than to a nice balsamic.  The Silver is fairly sour, the sweetness barely comes through.  As for viscosity, it's very thin - if you're looking for the more syrupy kind of balsamic, this is not it.Given the small increase in price, it is completely worth it to go ahead and buy the Gold and not waste your time and money trying the Silver.
I am not an expert in balsamic vinegar, but this one could have been anything. The bottle was not marked in any way, so have no idea if the vinegar is the real thing. I would not order again.

column9: we really love this balsamic vinegar
column10: My husband and I have tried many balsamic vinegars.  We really love this one and keep getting it over and over again.  We do not want syrupy, sugary vinegars, and this is definitely not in that category.  This has a nice balance in flavor, not too sweet, not too tart.  It mixes beautifully with olive oil for salad dressings, or can be used by itself very nicely, and the price is not overly high for the frequent use we give it - several times a week.  I am back here to buy another bottle as it's hard to find locally.  Very tasty.

I have been trying a variety of grain-free foods on my two cats.  They seem much healthier when they're not eating corn cereal.I had never seen Felidae in a local store, so I decided to roll the dice and give it a try.My only concern was an ingredient known as "menhaden" meal, which I had never heard of before.  With some additional research, I learned that menhaden is actually nothing scarier than a type of fish.  Satisfied that the food was edible, I put it in the cat food dish.My cats like to rotate through all types of food for interest and so far have had no problems on Felidae.  They don't seem to prefer it more or less than any other food.I gave it four stars mainly because the smell of Felidae is quite a bit stronger than some other foods.  While this is good for kitties, it can be a chore to fill the bowl for people who don't really care for a fish market smell in the kitchen!
I have three cats, and they lvoe the Salmon Formula food. There coat is softer and shinier, and they eat less of this than the cheap, grocery store cat food.

I'm not sure why some cat food gets a bad review because a cat doesn't eat it. We have 7 here in our rural home, plus some strays that stop by for a meal, and though they can be finicky they all eat pretty much what we put in front of them when they're hungry. They get fed 3 times a day and canned food is the morning meal so perhaps having nothing out from about 6 PM to 6 AM makes this pretty inviting. We have one cat that's about 17 years old and all she can eat is canned food. I can't say how good it is but at less than 45 cents a can (including shipping) it's less than at the local food store that happens to be about 45 miles away... as is the Vet. We feed them dry food (the grain free expensive kind) for the other 2 meals a day so the canned food is also a bargain.We had a cat develop a kidney stone, with urinary problems, and the Vet claims it was from the poor ingredients in some dry cat food. He wanted to put her on a special diet with a Science Diet special blend for Urinary Tract and then onto one of their regular formula kibble for life. That seemed a little useless because we were feeding the cats some decent kibble to begin with like Purina One. We did a search and found that it was true that a lot of filler in most dry cat food was grain and that is hard for cats to process. The diet we found involved a home made cat food of grinding up some rabbit or chicken and adding some vitamins. Tried it and it worked but it was a mess to make, rabbit is not cheap or easy to find and it takes up a lot of freezer space. Back to another search and a viable alternative seemed to be canned cat food, with some limitations, and a grain free kibble. The canned food doesn't have as much fillers and the main ones for us are poultry, fish & meats varieties in pâté or gravy form. That's what the cats are on now and the kidney/urinary problem is gone, their coats are nicer, their urine is less now because they don't have to consume so much water to process the grain feed and they really seem to like what they're eating. We feed them Friskies & 9-lives in the cans and Blue Buffalo Wilderness, Merrick Before Grain, Felidae or Taste of the Wild in dry food. The dry food is getting pricier, the bags are getting smaller and the free shipping deals are disappearing so it's more of a challenge now to get a deal but when we do we buy extra. Can't say enough about how well this new diet seems to be working and any saved trip to a Vet pays for a lot of food.As long as Amazon keeps giving deals on this we'll keep buying it, the cats will keep eating it and that's worth 5 stars... in my opinion. We have Subscribe & Save on some but that'll probably disappear soon since it's heavy to ship and it's recently disappeared on some of the bagged food or the price has gone up significantly. I'm posting this same review to every cat food we purchased rather than editing each to fit the particular brand.
My cat is allergic to chicken.  This is one of the few cat foods that doesn't have it. My cat loves it.

Bought the 108 pack after wife drank this in a variety pack...She LOVES it!!!!!  I tried it and I have to say I do NOT really enjoy coffee anyway and found the breakfast blend to be quite good for coffee.  It has no bite, and a smooth, full coffee flavor.  An Excellent everyday coffee.  PS My wife is a coffe snob and used to be a Dutch Junky, but is FAR happier drinking 2-3 cups of this per day for less than the price of a single "hut cup".

I enjoy a cup of breakfast blend coffee each morning.  It helps me to wake up and face the day with a brighter attitude.  The taste is smooth with no bitter aftertaste.

We have the Kuerig Coffee Maker that uses these pods.  The best thing about this coffee maker and the pods is that you can make a single cup in a minute!  No coffee sitting for hours.  A fresh cup each time.  Of course, the pods are of no use without the coffee maker. Buy both from Amazon.  You can't beat a really fresh cup of coffee!

column10: This is a great deal and the best tasting coffee I have found for the Keurig. I used to like the Caribou, but the taste has changed.  Thanks :) This is my second order.
Best cup of morning coffee; no bitterness and great flavor.  Exceptional price for this amount of single serve.  Highly recommend.

The coffee is very good, it has mild but not weak flavor. Not to strong, but strong enough to wake you in the morning. I would order more but the vendor "PINDR" only sent me 86 cups when I paid for 108 cups.
Received order ahead of time and in good order. Product as advertized and this is a great non bitter coffee. Would recommend to people who enjoy non bitter no additives coffee.
I love the K cups from Green Mountain. The flavor is great and the convenience is nice.Delivery was on time.  My only complaint is that I wish the price would come downa little.
I love Green Mountain's Breakfast Blend, and being able to buy it in this amount ensures that I'm not going to run out anytime soon.
I purchased this product through Amazon I enjoy this breakfast blend from Green Mountain very much. my order came in a timely manner.
I love coffee and this one is great.  Just right for the first cup of the day.  It has a low acid level and is kind to the early morning stomach.

If you love fluffy thick and moist pancakes You will love hungry jack. I have to buy from amazon because we live overseas. No not 1 grocery store I've been to have these pancakes.all you need is some warm syrup and butter and you are in heaven!
This product came prompt and well packaged.  Was beautiful and still is.  This Bonsai is very easy to maintain and care for.  I would definitely recommend this purchase.

Just as described and pictured.  Rainbow jimmies and the little round sprinkles mixed together.  Not an expert on sprinkles....they taste like I expected.  Got them super fast along with some bonus chocolate sprinkles too!  Nice!
These taste great if you like persian desserts. A bit dryer than I was expecting. One cookie has ~ 200 calories, and so they are very rich.

I feed this to my Collie Lady.  She has a very fussy stomach, and you give her almost anything else and she gets the runs.  We had been feeding her Evolve from when we got her from the breeder.  The breeder gave us a small bag with her, but then she started to poop in the house and is was runny and not well formed, we found out that they had changed the formulation of the food and we had been giving her this for almost 5 years.  We did a lot of research and then tried the California Natural Chicken and Rice adult dog food and she was fine and she loved it.  We only give her 6 oz. twice a day and her weight is great and she is very healthy, has great Vet checkups.  I would highly recommend this to anyone, especially those whose dogs have fussy stomachs, the ingredients are all natural and of very high quality, suitable for human consumption.

My dog is allergic to wheat gluten.  Every other food she has tried (including other high-quality brands) resulted in itching, vomiting and/or diarrhea.  I got this food because of the limited ingredients.  She has done very well on it.  She doesn't scratch all the time, she doesn't vomit, etc.  I only took one star off because I would like this food better if it contained probiotics.  I supplement her food with a small amount of fish oil, a small amount of probiotics and a dog supplement called "gas defense" that helps with digestion.  Still, I am sure that even without all these supplements she would do well on this food.  If your dog has food allergies I recommend trying it.  For reference: she is a 60-pound lab and she eats 1-cup of this twice a day.  Also, she could probably stand to lose 2-3 pounds.

column9: Do Not recommend for sensitive stomach
column10: I have a 1 year old Golden retriever who has a sensitive stomach. After trying Iams and Eukanuba Puppy we made the switch to the more quality California Natural Chicken and Rice Puppy formula which was great for him (firm stools and shiny coat). Now that he was ready to switch to adult formula (weighing in at 75 pounds now) I thought it sensible to choose the Adult Chicken and Rice formula by Calif. Nat. However, he has had an awful reaction even after gradually introducing the adult food with puppy food. He is itching a lot, ear infections, and chewing his paws, HORRIBLE gas, and loose stools. I do not recommend for sensitive stomach Golden Retrievers. We are going to try grain free options...

column9: Best for dry, itchy skin! Border collie & Aussie
column10: So far this is the only food that I've found that my Border collie and adopted Australian Shepherd do well on. They used to itch and shed a lot until I switched to this food. It has limited ingredients, less chance of food alergies. I have tried many high cost and probably high quality foods but nothing worked. I have just recently tried Avoderm chicken meal and it seems to be working also, so I might have finally found another food that they can tolerate. I hope so as I would like them to have a little variety.

To cut to the chase, this produces a very good MEDIUM roast style cup of coffee...period. Some folks tend to compare all coffees to one another no matter what the bean is and how it's roasted. I do roast my own green beans (home roaster) when I brew a pot of coffee every morning and use the K-Cups when only a single cup is needed. If you don't like that 'in your face' dark roast, dense, heavy style of coffee in the morning (or any time for that matter) this is definitely the coffee for you. It's not bitter, a bit floral, with a true pure coffee taste. Does it match Dunkin Donuts style coffee in taste? I'd say YES to that when using the middle cup size setting on the Keurig brewer....which I use for folks that take milk in their cup, I use the larger cup setting because I drink my coffee black and like that taste profile. The new packaging is OK (you get 2 extra K-Cups for the $$) as long as you have the room in your kitchen to store the larger single box....as opposed to storing the two 24 cartridge boxes.NOTE: The description of this coffee uses the words "Medium Extra Bold" in it's packaging as opposed to the two 24 boxes version which lead me to think there was now two DIFFERENT varieties of this Donut Shop coffee....so I ordered both (wanted 98/100 anyway) but it turns out that both were the same. Amazon should correct that description  and take out 'Extra Bold' so they match each other.

column9: My Favorite by a Landslide so Far
column10: I must admit that I have gone a little overboard with my k-cup sampling.  So far I must have tried about 50 different blends.  OVerall I must say that the vast majority of them have been pleasant, better than what I used to make in my coffee brewer.  Then I tried the Donut Shop brand.  When I first tried this I was not expecting much, it sounds bland, plain, everyday type of coffee.  Don't get me wrong, I have had some pretty good cups of coffee in donut shops but nothing to write home about.  When I took my first sip, I thought wow, this is amazing.  Smooth, not much of an acid taste, about as close to perfect as I could describe.  My love for this k-cup continued and continues to this day.  Many times you find a k-cup which at first is very good, but after a couple of cups you get a little sick of them; not with this one.  It has been and continues to be my absolute favorite.  I will still search for something better, but I doubt I will find it.  I hope you like -- no strike that -- I hope you love this coffee as much as I do.

I've had my Keurig brewer for 5 months and have tried a lot of brands and the Coffee People Donut Shop regular is among my favorites. Green Mountain Nantucket Blend and Timothy's Italian Blend are also favorites.One reviewer remarked about Subscribe & Save costing less. It's only a dollar and a few pennies cheaper than this packaging and Subscribe and Save does not offer Donut Shop "regular" but instead has "Extra Bold". Also, this packaging gives you 50 k-cups as opposed to 48 (2) 24 count packages in Subscribe & Save.Another reviewer complained about not having the standard boxes to dispense the coffee. I purchased a K-Cup carousel, available on Amazon for $19.95 that holds 26 k-cups; it looks nicer by my Keurig than cardboard boxes.

We purchased a Keurig brewing system early this year, so we've been trying out as many different varieties of coffee as possible. This coffee is -- BAR NONE -- the best of the bunch. It is rich, syrupy and just a bit sweet. My experience, thus far, has been that the K-Cups listed as "extra bold" produce the best cups of coffee, but many of those are only available in dark roasts, while I prefer a medium roast. If you're a fan of a good, old fashioned diner-style cup of coffee (like what you can get if you go to Dunkin Donuts or somewhere like that), then this is the brew for you. We love it and make sure we always have some on hand.
My favorite K-Cup flavor! A mild rather than a strong coffee strength, it really has a flavor reminiscent of a local donut shop or Denny's cup of coffee.Highly recommended!

column9: Great taste - poor packaging wastes k-cups
column10: I love the taste of this coffee.  But apparently they have poor quality control.  These K-cups come too full and they tend to not brew properly.  You can always tell when you got a bad cup, because the grounds are so packed in the cup that the water doesn't come out completely and your cup of coffee will have less liquid than you are used to.  Sure enough, when you go to lift the K-cup out of the Keurig for disposal, you will find it is very heavy compared to others. We also know this is a problem with Coffee People DOnut Shop k-cups only, because my husband drinks a different brand and never has this problem.It doesn't happen all the time, and I have found if I shake the k-cup before putting it in the Keurig, it happens less frequently, but it still happens.I've tried ordering from Coffee People multiple times to see if it was a one time manufacturing glitch, but it appears every time I buy a box of their K-cups I have a problem with 10-15% of them.Fortunately, another brand is offering a donut shop coffee which I tried with this last order and I find it just as pleasing.

My husband and I are crazy about Coffee People k-cups.  A friend gave us a box of the "Donut Shop" cups and they are spectacular.  Very rich and bold, not bitter, but packs a nice punch.  Reminds me of coffee from an old-fashioned percolator.  A good, strong cup of coffee is hard to come by when you are using some of these newer brewing machines, but the Keurig system is definitely the exception and this variety of k-cup is the best we have ever tasted.

column9: A perfect "Anytime" coffee that is sure to please.
column10: I have tried many, many brands and blends in my Keurig coffee maker and this is definetely one of my favorites.  The type of coffe I drink depends on my mood.  Sometimes I want a strong, bold cup like, Newman's Own Extra-bold Special Blend K-cups, 80 Pk for Keurig Brewers and sometimes I want something more mild like, Green Mountain K-Cup Single-Serving Coffee 108-ct.- Nantucket Blend  But ever since I have had my Keurig I have been looking for one of my favorite coffees.  The Dunkin Donut brand.This coffee is superb and very much like the Dunkin Donut brand.  Not bold or bitter.  Not weak or under flavored.  It is smooth and very flavorful.  It is the perfect crowd pleasing blend for any time of day or night.I have shopped all over and you can't beat the variety or the price here on Amazon when you join their club.  A great value.I do wish that Amazon would change the name by removing "Extra Bold".  It is not.  It is, at most, a medium roast.  Even when brewed with the smallest setting of the Keurig I would not concider it bold.  It comes out great on the medium size setting.  Very remanicent of that great cup of Joe you would get in the old days at your favorite diner.

This coffee is exactly what you would get at a coffee shop. Sweet and aromatic, not bitter or too bold. I like the pack of 50 and it comes in one box, so there is no waste of packaging or more trash to throw away. If they only made a box of with 100... We love the K-Cups and get great consistent coffee every day without wasting half a pot. My favs are Timothy's German Chocolate (desert coffee!), Donut Shop (mid Morning) and Emeril's Big Bold Easy (first thing in the morning!).

Both of my dogs absolutely love these treats.  I feel good giving them to them because they are made with all natural ingredients and nothing they don't need.  I would recommend these treats to anyone who loves their dogs!
This tea is really good,my cholesterol went down already,from 289 to 229! I won't stop drinking this tea!it really works!

These crackers are very tasty.  They're not as different from the Original 7-Grain ones as I expected, though.  They have a very similar taste.  But we do enjoy these crackers, and I'd buy them again.

column9: Great product that cats actually love!
column10: If you start reading cat food labels you will discover few that have the quality of ingredients that this one does.  Well, actually you will discover some - probably in a nice pet food store - but good luck getting your cat to eat it!One of my cats used to be pre-diabetic, asthmatic, and overweight.  At that time his diet was exclusively Iams.  My vet, who has done much research on various foods, has a list of cat food she recommends.  Of all the expensive and exclusive brands of food, the Fancy Feast Turkey & Giblets Feast and the Gourmet Chicken Feast really made a difference, and my other more finicky eaters loved it!  The 'problem cat' is no longer asthmatic, has lost weight, and is not pre-diabetic.  Plus, everyone who sees him can't get over what a fantastic shiny coat he has.  Now I buy these two flavors exclusively.  I highly recommend this product.

My cat is 17.5 years old and had been fed canned Science Diet food for years.  She seemed to like it and ate well.  But about a year ago, she just refused to eat any Science Diet flavor I gave her, mainly chicken.  I tried some other 'premium' brands to no avail.  This is the ONLY cat food she will eat now.  She eats three or four small meals each day and can't be fooled.  If it's not Fancy Feast, she absolutely won't eat it.

I too have a problem cat - she was starved before I got her and well, her coat, skin, and overall condition was ridiculous.  This was one of the foods that she went mad for, still does, and well, you should see her now!  She's a chocolate Persian and has the most beautiful long, shiny coat now! Friskies has a great variety of healthy, protein-filled products that both I and my vet credit for bringing her back.  If you rescue cats on a regular basis, although it costs more, it is definitely worth the results.  Besides, it smells like you just cooked it yourself and canned it! Great stuff, highly recommend!

If you have to buy cat food from the grocery store, know that your choices are limited in getting anything that's actually good for your cat. Purina has all but left the cat food buyer in peril with cheap ingredients, some which are downright awful. Having said this, Fancy Feast's Chicken Classic is probably the most available and better made canned foods out there, not to mention it's economical. Luckily, the gross "by-products" are minimal and there are no grains or wheat gluten in this formula.Fancy Feast is on sale all the time at either Target or my grocery store. In my experience, cans of Fancy Feast Chicken Classic from Walmart are more watery than cans I buy at other retailers. When I began buying this food, the differences in the look of the pate and the content from store A and content from WM were unmistakable. It's not that the food was bad, but it was definately more watery. I've been told Purina makes special batches with less meat content for major discounters. Perhaps WM is one of them.The top six ingredients in this the Chicken Classic formula are; chicken, chicken broth, liver, meat by-products, fish, and poultry by-products. This ingredient list beats any other Fancy Feast formula on the shelves so I recommend it. I take one star off my rating because of the two types of gross by-products in the formula.
My cats love this food.  However, I wish they would make it in larger cans.  When you have many cats it is just inconvenient to keep opening cans and cans of food.

Cats love this stuff.  My Fancy Feast cat is now 14 yrs old.  He is beginning to have kidney issues and the vet wanted him exclusively on a prescription diet.  He wasn't having any of the prescription diet (loving his Fancy Feast) so I ended-up mixing it half-n-half.  Perhaps this wasn't an ideal solution, but the good news is he would at least get some prescription food.  It has worked because last blood work showed a better kidney function and vet was pleased.  My cat has always loved his Fancy Feast preferring the "Classic" variety over the grilled or shredded stuff.

column9: My cat no longer needs insulin because of this food
column10: I have diabetic cat. My cat started exhibiting symptoms and I went to my vet who started him on insulin. He progessively got worse, as the insulin doses steadily increased. My super smart, very litter trained cat got completely out of his mind one night and climbed on top of a shoe box and peed. Poor thing didn't know where he was or what was going on.At that, I went to the internet and found yourdiabeticcat.com. I started reading and was so skeptical but out of pure desperation I started doing what the people on the boards there suggested. I started tracking my cat's blood sugar daily at home myself. I took him off of dry food and started feeding him fancy feast classics. His blood sugars eventually started leveling out.I went back to my vet and informed her of my changes with my cat and she was amazed. I asked her to research some concerns I had with the fancy feast. She researched it for me and told me the fancy feast is fine. My cat no longer gets insulin shots. I honestly couldn't believe it myself. He is back to his normal self: smart, energetic, and using his litter.I now buy this food automatically off of amazon in three different flavors for variety. I have two cats and they both love all three classic flavors that I buy. (Turkey, Chicken and Beef) I highly recommend this food for the health of your cat.Also, I have two large male cats and they eat an average of 3 cans a day each. Hopefully that will help you figure out how much you need for your cat. If for some reason, they get full and don't finish a full can in one sitting I have to cover up the left overs. They will not eat them if they have dried out, but they will eat them if I have covered them and allowed them to retain their moisture.

column9: My beautiful Sheba thrives on this and loves it!
column10: Fancy Feast is good cat food but it's tricky for me to get the flavor my cat willalways eat since she is a gorgeous picky female.  This brand also comes in many different textures and the flaky version, as well as any type with gravy, neither of my cats will touch.This particular Chicken Feast flavor is what they call the "classic" which is the usualtexture of cat food and the one both my cats like.  I found it difficult to say the least to pick out the correct texture when in the supermarket as there are so many different flavors and textures available and the cans are jumbled together so I had to fish through them trying to find ones marked "classic", so I prefer getting this by the case here on Amazon.Sheba does have slight allergies to certain cat foods, as do many cats.  They itch and can develop bumps under their chins or in the case of one poor cat I had, terrible bumps and systemic itching all over, with fur loss, if the exact right food isn't given to them. That cat had to get only Hill's hypoallergy formula food from the vet or he would be tortured by itching, bumps and fur loss.Also using only stainless steel bowls for food and water helps tremendously if your cat gets chin bumps. Even plastic dishes get bacteria that can cause itchy bumps under a cat's chin.My cats love this chicken flavor and texture and it doesn't cause any allergy problems in Sheba so far.  She also has no itchy problem with Nutro dry cat food so I can recommend that one if your cat has a problem with itchy skin bumps.  In fact her fur is just incredibly gorgeous and she is a big fit muscular healthy cat, so I can recommend this highly.

Our rescue kitty came with the report of being a finicky eater, but he quickly cleans his plate with any of the Fancy Feast classic pate varieties.  He's maintaining his weight, his coat is beautiful and he's about as frisky as we can hanle!

The best cat food on the market by far, Purina knows how to take car of our pets. The ingredients in the Fancy Feast cat is so far superior than any other cat food. Look at the 1st ingredient listed compared to other brands. Real chicken,beef,turkey and tuna or salmon all other brands start with fillers and meat by products for all of there foods.The price can't be beat,Even cheaper than Walmart @.52a can compared to .$47a from Amazon plus shipped to your house for free.

Lately this all chicken pack costs more on Amazon than the chicken/turkey/beef variety pack.  My cat does best with chicken and sometimes turns her little pink nose up at the beef and turkey.  Is the chicken of higher quality than the beef and turkey and that's why the variety pack costs less?  I withhold one star because FF has by-products in it.  However this classic recipe does not have grains and it is the only cat food my girl will willingly eat day after day.

column9: THE BEST CANNED FOOD ON THE MARKET.
column10: I've been a cat lover for 25+yrs and in that time have tried many different cat foods for the 5 cats that were part of the family.I have done my research on almost all of the canned cat foods on the market and could not find one canned food that had the superior ingredients that's in the Fancy Feast canned foods. check it out yourself and read the first ingredients on 99% of all canned foods and they almost never start out with the flavor on the label.I've seen canned beef flavor and their main ingredient is chicken parts and a form of rice with beef broth. You can't go wrong with any of the Fancy Feast foods made by Purina. Thanks RB
I purchase Fancy Feast Classic Chicken Feast for my cat. Why?  Less fillers, no gravy, just meaty.  He eats it.  It is smelly.
At first my cat loved it, but after a while she tried to burry it.I give her a varity of food not just one flavor.

column9: Ms. Bea loves her FF Classic Chicken Feast
column10: My older kitty, Ms. Bea can only eat soft food now, and she especially likes FF Classic Chicken.  I like the price!

I purchased this for making a typical clam chowder. I will use the rest of the can as a base for clam sauce for pasta.I also use it as a flavor booster in other fish or Oriental dishes rather than fish sauce. I freeze it in ice cube trays to add to a recipe. Like most concentrated juices, it is very salty but the clam flavor is good.I will order again in spite of the large size.

I smoked a large wild-caught sockeye salmon and wanted to make a bisque from the meat I smoked on the bones.  Most recipes I checked used chicken stock as a base.  I chose your clam stock and Bar Harbor lobster stock (50%/50%) instead and it was superb. Thank you!
Technically they are sport peppers, but that's about all that can be said for them.  Bland and tasteless with no heat at all.  A disappointment.

Recently purchased this item in an effort to create a Chicago dog at home.  The peppers met our expectations and we have another jar already on order.  Cheers for Amazon for helping make our " hot dog" adventure fun!

This is a really great Shrimp Scampi Seasoning. It makes making Shrimp Scampi a breeze. My whole family really likes this and I think I will be trying it with Chicken one of these days. I have always used a Scampi seasoning from Market Day, but they discontinued it so I had to find a new one and this one is the one!

I just finished using this paprika on ribs and mac and cheese, it gave both dishes a sweet smoky taste, it was fabulous. I am embarrased to say I had no idea there was such a spice, I am so used to purchasing the standard stuff in the grocery store. Do your food a favor and purchase this paprika.
This is the first time I've been able to get sweet smoked paprika and it is really special.  I use it in making a BBQ dry rub and it gives it that unique taste.

This is really awesome spice.  Smoked Spanish paprika was mentioned at a cooking class that a lady and I took.  So, I went on line to see what I could find.  Not sure how this compares to other products and value.  Although looking around when I purchased this it seemed to have been a good deal and comes in a 4 pack.  However, this tastes great mixed to various foods.  I think we may have used this in the cooking class (a while ago) when we were making a humus.  I've used it in Red Quino and it a nice change of pace.
Great price.  Product smells great and flavors foods really well.  Perks up bland tastes.  Kicks up your cooking a notch.

column9: Amazing Quick Healthy Breakfast, and Vegan!
column10: Original Mix (I prefer this one because there is no added sugars)Taste:In a green smoothie: Changes the texture of the smoothie just a bit, nothing too noticeable or annoying.  Also adds a different flavor to the overall smoothie that helps enhance the taste when combined with the right greens and fruits.With Almond milk: I am not used to eating sugars and processed foods, so this actually tastes pretty great to me. I saw some earlier reviews complaining about taste and I honestly have no problem slowly sipping on this shake as I drive to work in the morning. I have tasted some horrid protein shakes in the past and this one is delicious!Overall Feeling:I feel fantastic after having Amazing Meal in the morning. Completely clear minded and energized for the day. Even without the accompaniment of a multivitamin, this meal powder stands alone in providing a days worth of energy and clear minded thinking.Cons:I found that I needed to get used to the added probiotic that is apart of the meal. I found myself for the first four or five days, starving only 2 hours after drinking one of these shakes. It was like I couldn't get enough food, I had to eat every two to three hours to stop the hunger. I am unsure whether it has to do with the combo of probiotic or the digestive enzyme that is added. Like I said though, after 5 days that feeling of starving all the time went away. It now fulfills me completely.Overall:This is the best meal shake I have come across thus far in my search for the perfect morning/ after workout shake. I have tried many from whole foods and other various health food stores. The fact that I have decided to actually buy another container of Amazing Meal must mean I really like it! I've been taking it for 2 weeks and, this wasn't my initial intention, but have lost 5 pounds. A nice little added bonus :)Highly reccomened if you are looking for a great protein/vitamin/healthy living shake. Oh and did I mention it is Alkaline based? Perfect!x x

I bought 5 individual packages of different types of protein drinks to see which I liked before I committed with a whole container. This was excellent - I mixed it with orange juice and proceeded to play 1 1/2 hours of tennis - singles and not once did I feel hungry. I used a small hand-held frother to make sure it mixed completely so I wouldn't taste any of the unmixed granules. I've since ordered the "whole container"...

Purchased for my wife the vegan. She loves this product and uses for shakes or sprinkles on her hot cereal in the morning. She has me order more as soon as she starts getting low. On the flip side if you are a "meat & taters" person like myself it is an acquired taste as I don't like it much. In a nutshell....Vegans & Veggie lovers = GOOD!!Junk food Junkies = You could use some help

This is a great protein powder and I only use half the recommended portion. I drink it in the morning with  unsweetened almond milk and 1/2 banana in the blender and it keeps me going until mid day, then I drink a glass of water and I'm full all day. Its got a nice chocolate flavor, although I add 1/4 tsp of cocoa powder if I want it stronger. I love this product and the price on Amazon.

I have multiple food allergies, which makes a grab-and-go breakfast...well...not possible. I wanted a meal replacement shake because I tend not to eat during the day (way too complicated) and not eating actually helps me gain weight. I also have some other health issues--like Hashimoto's--directly related to my allergies. Food is an issue for me, and so is energy and feeling well.I'm not vegan, but I prefer vegan foods for their cleanliness. I can't have soy, but many vegan products are soy-free anyway. I also like whole, organic, Non-GMO foods, and while I prefer Raw, I don't mind non-raw foods, either.I tried several vegan, gluten-free, soy-free, dairy-free shake mixes: Garden of Life, Vega, Inca Meal, RAW, etc. This is, by far, the best tasting, best "feeling" shake I've tried.I've tried all the flavors--Chocolate is my fave, then Pomegranate (sp?) Mango and Vanilla Chai, in that order. I mix mine is a shaker cup with a little mixing ball. I use Vanilla almond milk and a little agave syrup (I hate Stevia, it tastes like saccharine to me) and sometimes I throw a little extra hemp protein in, chia seeds, and flaxseed oil. I haven't bothered with a blender yet. One day, I'll put it into a blender with some fruit.Let's be real: this is a whole food shake with fruits, veggies, grasses, and hemp protein. This is not a mass-market, full-of-stuff-I-can't-pronounce homogenized drink. This is real food, synthesized down to a mixable level. Dunkin Donuts it's not. So?Truthfully, the pure, clean, feel-good energy I get from this, plus the cleansing, tonifying, and gut-health benefits are worth chugging down a slightly earthy drink every morning. Mixed with vanilla almond milk & a little agave, I actually savor the flavor--not too sweet (sweet in the morning makes me gag) chocolatey and, well, nutritious-y.Try a sample packet (you can get them at your local HFS, usually) and see which flavor suits you. I don't ever like this mixed in water--its just too thin. I DO use it on oatmeal, or stirred into yogurt. This is an awesome product. I just saved $12 over what I pay at WF, plus Amazon will deliver it to me every 15 days so I'll never run out...heaven!

The other flavors of Amazing Meal sound rather yummy but they contain "Natural Flavors"  this is the only version that does not.  I even went to their website to make sure.  The addition of natural flavors is the only reason why I chose their Original over the others.I find the flavor is somewhat bland & absolutley is grassy!  Lately I've been mixing it with organic coconut water.  The quality of the coconut water affects just how tasty my "meal" turns out.  Sometimes I will add a few drops of organic liquid Stevia.I'm not sure what it is about this product that keeps me coming back for more.  I use Amazon's Subscribe & Save for it!  I'm not nuts about it, yet here I am drinking another glass!It is a quick & convenient way to get something nourishing into my body.  I find it is very refreshing.  I have never used it in a smoothie but when I do, I think it will be out of this world!  I have also mixed this with organic almond milk, organic rice milk & organic coconut milk.  The rice milk tasted the best probably because it was the sweetest.  The coconut milk was so so.  For now, I plan on sticking with the coconut water because I think it is the healthiest option & it tastes good enough for me.Overall this is a great way to get your greens & more in one quick "meal" though snack would be more appropriate as I don't find it filling for long.  Usually I pour a small amount of my liquid of choice into a glass, add a scoop of this (scoop is included), use a fork to stir it really good.  Then I add the rest of my liquid of choice & do lots more stirring.  I leave the fork in the glass & stir as needed because the fiber bits tend to settle on the bottom rather quickly.  Thankfully the amount that settles is substantially less than other mixes I've had.  I had a Organic Hemp protein shake that I flat out thought was disgusting & nearly all of it would settle on the bottom of the glass so fast I couldn't help but waste it! I'm sticking to Amazing Meal from now on.  Lesson learned!If you want to do something healthy & want to avoid all sugars & artificial sweeteners this mix is the way to go!  All Organic & GMO free!  If you are one of those sugar junkies who gets those "fast food" smoothies thinking it's healthy when it's just a sugar bomb you will surely hate this stuff.
