column9: Good Tasting Sugar Free Dip/Topping - Recommended
column10: The Walden Farms Marshmallow Dip was a good find for me, but perhaps calling this "Marshmallow" was a mistake since it only slightly resembles marshmallow by looks and taste. It should be treated as a dessert dip/topping for dieters or diabetics. Being a Type 2 diabetic, I am always looking for low carb sweets that will not impact my blood sugar levels and this Dip/Topping has no impact at all.I like the flavor and use it on other sugar free foods to round out the dish. This works well with sugar free chocolate ice cream and with peanut butter sandwiches.Recommended, if you set your expectations to match the reality that this is not really marshmallow. You might also want to try Chocolate Dip 12 oz.

Despite my concerns over the taste of calorie free food, I tried the chocolate dip and was amazed. Can't be eaten plain but was very good paired with other things (strawberries are great!) So, I decided to give the rest of the line a try. This one was a flop and a waste of four dollars I'm afraid. It has a very strong chemical taste to it, one that stays in your mouth for a while which is a shame because they've gotten the texture down. I don't know  that I would ever buy it again (depends on whether or not I can make something with it, the cheesecake that someone suggested sounds promising) but I will never try to eat it as I would marshmallow fluff. Even on bread with peanut butter it is pretty awful tasting. Unless you're a daring low cal baker and think you can make something of it, steer clear.

This could be the nastiest stuff I've ever tasted.  After paying $4 for the jar, I was excited to try it.  So I took a spoonful and tried some.  BAD IDEA. This has a horrible after taste and is just gross.  I do, however, like the Rasperry Salad Dressing by Walden Farms.
Only resembles Marshmallow cream / fluff slightly in appearance.Tastes gross. Almost flavored like sugar free pancake syrup, but disgusting.

column9: It's not the real thing -- of course! -- but extremely good for what it is
column10: If something sounds too good to be true, it probably is. And cream cheese-ey fruit dips, or marshmallow "fluff" spread, cannot possibly be duplicated without calories.  That is a fact of life.This marshmallow dip should not be compared to either of those foods, both of which are high in calories, sugar, and taste.  This dip should be compared to all the other low-calorie sweets out there that don't have potential to derail a diet.  And in that field, this dip definitely stands out, both in its taste and in the fact that it packs NO nutritional punch.  For me, it's good for a sweet tooth kick during the dog days of a diet.  It leaves a major aspartame after-taste, so if that's something you really hate, then don't get this.  I personally don't mind.I think the seriousness of your diet -- and your sensitivity/repulsion to after-tastes from artificial sweeteners -- will determine whether this is a winner for you or not.  It is obviously a big jar of chemicals.  (Though I'm sure there are plenty of chemicals in other marshmallow dips, too.)  For that reason, I wouldn't make this a daily part of my diet any more than I would any other purely artificial food.  But it sure is great, again, for the dog days of a diet.I got my jar at Kroger, here in Tennessee.  There were several Walden Farms items in the diet/health food area there.
Creamy and marshmallowy. Yummy on fruit like strawberries! It's very sweet. Better than the chocolate.

I was skeptical trying this product as I did buy the old walden chocolate syrup and it tasted like bitter sugar water but for zero calories, I thought I'd give this a whirl. I was not disappointed...for the dieter this is a dream...but you have to be creative! must apply to other foods, graham crackers, rice cakes and fruit!

I was very excited about this product (among others).  The thought of being able to satisfy your sweet-tooth without fat/calories/carbs seemed too good to be true.  Well, it was.  This product tastes like chemicals.  I tried it with different things, such as chocolate pudding or fruit, and nothing helped.  I had to scrape it off because it was so disgusting.  I'd stick with cool whip, only a couple more calories, but it tastes great!  I do however, enjoy the other Walden Farms products (caramel sauce, chocolate sauce, french onion dip).  The honey bbq sauce is my favorite.
I think this is a great product.  I enjoy the chocolate dip, caramel dip and this marshmallow dip with fruit, especially strawberries.

column9: All the goodness every body needs
column10: Cellulose Gel, Lactic Acid, Sucralose, Titanium Dioxide, Salt, Xanthan Gum, and Potassium Sorbate.....yum can't wait to get me some more titanium dioxide in me...how great does that sound!
Pour a little of Miyako - Ponzu Vinegar with Citrus into a glass. Add sparkling water and a twist of lime. You've got a great refreshing drink for hot weather.

It is so hard to find plain Ponzu! Many places have Ponzu Sauce, but very few have plain Ponzu.I was very pleased with this Ponzu- it adds a great citrus-y flavor to recipes. Order several so you're not without.

column9: Fantastic, rich, sweet and sour heaven
column10: I love this tea and still think it's the perfect epitome of that rich red fruit tea. The hibiscus leaves dominate to give it a sour, anti-oxidant packed flavor. It's kind of like a zinger, except it's the best zinger I've ever tasted. I'm a pretty regular tea drinker and agree that loose leaf is the way to go, but sometimes I'll drink a tea that had to be brewed loose leaf and think, why bother? Too much time and effort for a tea that would taste similar brewed in a tea bag. But with a choice few- genmaicha, a delicate white tea, and this one- it's totally worth the effort and I wouldn't do it any other way.  This tea makes the water into a red, juicy but not overly powerful elixir. It wakes up your taste bugs with it's tartness, gives you just enough sweet to satisfy your craving but not give you a sugar spike to make you crave more. Rich, beautiful, fragrant, delicious. The ingredients are fresh, top notch, it's perfectly blended, and quite simply, it's one of my must-have teas.

column9: Superlative comfort tea for the dessert addict
column10: I was in my local tea shop buying my usual Earl Grey/Darjeeling blend when a young couple came in and asked for this by name. The shopkeeper opened the tin and an incredible fragrance -- sweet and seductive -- filled the shop. I bought a quarter pound and am here to report that it's everything the product description claims, and more. I don't know as it would stave off a full-blown chocolate craving, but it certainly will quiet down a run-of-the-mill sweet-tooth.I wonder how the mix might be in a sweet bread -- soaked in a little water and added to the dough. It would probably make the bread pink, but that's not a bad thing for a romantic-smelling tea.

I've traveled the world and am of Greek and Italian origin. This is the best olive oil I've ever tasted and I bought everything my import store carried. I am searching for distributors to buy in bulk. I asked my husband to buy me a crate for my birthday. It makes everything and I mean everything you put it on, out of this world. I use it sparingly now until I can locate more but once you try it, you'll be hooked. Nothing like it in Italy, Greece, or Spain. Sorry guys. This one is amazing. I live in Beverly Hills and have tasted the best these chefs have to offer, and none are as fine as the SULTAN!
Found this in aMiddle Eastern grocery store in Philadelphia.  The flavor is superb. I'm Italian and I know olive oil....this is delicious and adds to every dish I use it in. Best I've ever had.

Bought a 3 liter bottle of this oil at the local Asian market in DC area.  Roughly $20 and I wasn't sure what to expect.  Turns out it is much tastier than some of the more expensive Italian oils I was buying.  I can't recommend Sultan's Cold Press, Extra Virgin oil enough.  If you can find it, get it.  Simple as that.
i love this coffee..its like..freshly brewed percolated coffee...but easier as it is infact instant coffee..a must try for coffee lovers!!! love it!!

I like Bru instant coffee. I am not sure what the effect of the chicory is, but it tastes different from Nescafe, more like South Indian-style filter coffee. There are cheaper places than Amazon to get it though. Be sure to check out a local ethnic Indian grocery store.

For the sake of the coffee bean farmers around the world, try to support those companies who pay a fair wage to the farmer.  Fair trade coffees are usually grown in "bird-friendly", "tree-friendly" and pesticide, chemical-free plantations too.  Check out Higher Grounds for instance...

This is my first time ordering a food item from an online site, and it was great! :DA lot of the other review for this product said they only had a few of the mango flavors but mine had about half and half of mango and strawberry.Also, the shipping was awesome.  Shipped next day and got it the day after. (Compared to August 6-9 that tracking said it'd take vs. arriving on August 3)<3
i love chupa chups, my favorite is the mango yogurt ones and there was only 4 in the entire package so that was disappointing, but just about every flavor is good so its still a good buy.
Newman's Own Organics special blend decaf is so good no one would suspect it could be a decaf.  I am thinking of switching to this blend totally.

Been eating these since I was a child when mom would buy a couple of cans every other month or so.  They were a real treat back then and they're just as good now.  Only diff is I can get them by the case from Amazon and have them delivered to my door.  What else needs to be said?  They're exactly the same as they were thirty years ago and in this day and age, being able to count on something, even something this small, is a good thing to hold onto.  Thanks Armour and thanks Amazon!

I haven't had vienna sausage since childhood, and even then I only had them occasionally, at other people's houses.  These were much less flavorful and much saltier than I remembered.  They aren't bad; they are basically tasteless, much like tofu.  I would suggest to anyone thinking about buying these to see if the company markets a low sodium version.The "pink slime" scare is a bit exaggerated in its details.  Still it's unnerving.  However, I had heard so many times from family friends and associates who are Native American and Chinese doctors etc. about how healthful it is to consume more than just the muscle tissue of animals, that I gave it some thought.  "Pink slime" does not contain every type of animal part.  Notably it will contain some highly beneficial parts we don't normally eat in the U.S., such as tendons and ligaments.  These actually are very healthy items featured in the cuisines of a number of cultures.  Not only am I unlikely to sit down to a nice bowl of Chinese beef tendons (which I don't think I could even chew up), but have you priced these products in the ethnic markets?  Very expensive.  So, if that's the case, and these cheapo little hotdogs offer the same thing, then maybe they warranted my reconsideration.  That was my line of thought, anyway.So - something to consider for those who are suffering from ailments such as arthritis or other bone and joint issues.  Again though - seriously - look for low salt ones if you want to try them.  These are too salty.  For me, since I got a lot of them with the order, I will be able to use them rather like a salty condiment added to dishes such as beans.

column9: Delicious alternative to traditional fried ramen noodles
column10: After being somewhat disappointed with the "Spring vegetable" version of this soup line from Annie Chun's, I was expecting more of the same with this flavor - but boy, was I pleasantly surprised! The soup base is a delicious and savory broth which is not spicy, and the noodles are not fried unlike traditional ramen noodles. They come vacuum sealed and already cooked, and its easy to prepare. It comes with a sauce packet and the noodle packet. The noodles are a perfect consistency in my opinion.This is an excellent alternative to regular ramen, is very low in fat, and the sodium content is still less then many soups and a lot less then many of the prepackaged ramen noodles out there. (41% of your daily sodium, which for any prepackaged soup or meal is very reasonable) This version is not vegetarian unlike the vegetable flavor, and the flavor really shines through. Its a mix of pork, chicken, and oyster stock and its excellent. Dont be scared of the oyster - it has no fishy flavor or scent to it whatsoever. It tastes largely like a soy sauce base and somewhat similar to the Udon soup bowl, but better in my opinion.Adding some scallions, vegetables and some tofu or meat to this soup would make it more filling and very delicious. A dash of chili powder or hot sauce would be nice too.Regarding the price, id say each one is probably not worth more then $1.75 a piece. I saw it on amazon on sale at 80 cents each which was a great deal. Some of the third party sellers really overcharge for this stuff so keep an eye out at your local grocery store, or maybe amazon will keep them in stock at a reasonable price.5/5 stars!Ingredients:NOODLES: WATER, WHEAT FLOUR, TAPIOCA STARCH, SALT, WHEAT GLUTEN, LACTIC ACID, ACETIC ACID, RIBOFLAVIN (VITAMIN B2), SOUP BASE: CONCENTRATED PORK STOCK (PORK STOCK, SALT), NATURALLY BREWED SOY SAUCE (WATER, WHEAT, SOYBEANS, SALT), WATER, CANE SYRUP*, CONCENTRATED CHICKEN STOCK (CHICKEN STOCK, SALT), CORN STARCH, GINGER (GINGER, WATER, CITRIC ACID), SHIITAKE MUSHROOM POWDER (SHIITAKE MUSHROOM, DEXTRIN, SALT, WHEAT FLOUR, YEAST EXTRACT), YEAST EXTRACT, SALT, GINGER*, GARLIC*, ONION*, OYSTER EXTRACT POWDER (OYSTERS, MALTODEXTRIN, SALT, SUGAR, SOY SAUCE [FERMENTED SOYBEANS, WHEAT, SALT]), WHITE PEPPER. *DEHYDRATEDPRODUCT MANUFACTURED IN A FACILITY THAT USES, SOY, MILK, PEANUTS, TREE NUTS, EGGS, FISH AND SHELLFISH. The positive review on this product is either a paid reviewer, or incompetent to share an opinion with living humans. The sodium content per serving of this product is 1000 mg. PURE POISON.
You can not find these chews anywhere in the local stores! Amazon makes ordering them so easy! My dog loves them so thanks!

My dogs love these ! They last very long (mostly 45 minutes to an hour) and afterwards they fall asleep very satisfied.Only minus would be the strong "smell" that fills the room. But hey......if you see your friend al satisfied.....who cares ?

My dog loved this bone. It has a hard chicken flavored rawhide outside and a soft bacon flavored rawhide inside and he couldn't wait to gnaw his way to that bacon. Lasts a while and keeps him occupied. I wish they sold them in bigger packs.

column9: Disappointing (rating should be three stars, not two)
column10: I had high hopes for this as I really like dragonwell tea. Sadly, this did not live up to my expectations. Perhaps it was old (purchaced as part of Amazon's grocery clearance)and had lost its flavor, as the cup it makes is drinkable, but bland and uninteresting, but all three Tao of Tea products I purchaced disappointed me. We drink this all the time, finially we dont have to lug it in from the storeAmazon delivers it to our door step.At about a 1.00 a bottle.. this is not a bad price for the best mineral water in the world !

This is great sparkling water and is very refreshing. Some people say it's too salty. There is a very little amount of sodium in it but I don't notice it at all when I drink it. If anything it enhances the taste compared to regular plain seltzer water.

Good value! And it's free-shipping to my address with my prime membership. I don't know why I have struggled with carrying the heavy box of San Pellegrino from the grocery store to my house when this is free-shipped by Amazon.I like the fresh taste of San Pellegrino and its awesome package design. It's much cooler than Perrier to me. I've tried Voss, Perrier, Wholefood's, and other brands. Considering the price and taste, I think  San Pellegrino is the best.
I bought 2 cases of this product from amazon. It was all flat. Normaly I love Pellegrino. I had to throw most of it away
Just a few words like the title page said. It is not as babble as Perrier. If you like Panna water, made by the same company, you will like Pellegrino too.
I am trying to get away from drinking diet soda so I decided to try sparking water with lemon.  I love the taste of this brand and Amazon has a great price.

i bought it... ran out and bought it again... i have one of those make your own sparkling water thingys and it works but its so much easier just to grab one of these bottles and drink.  i carry water in my boat and car and now ive added these as well.

Now here's the deal. I love coconut. It's my favorite sweet. Candy, cake, cookies, give me coconut and I'm set. I have eaten every kind, brand and variation of coconut macaroon known to man and these Mrs. Crimbles cookies are (other than fresh out of the oven) the best I've ever had. The are very moist, perfectly browned, dense, sweet and fundamentally delicious. Don't waste your time with dry, gummy or artificial tasting "roons", these are the real thing.

These moist and flavorful macaroons are lovely-dense, chewy, sweet but not overpowering. No problems with the packaging on the lot I received. The individual packages are sealed properly, and all six packages were sealed inside a plastic shipping bag and then securely boxed. I have family members who are sensitive to gluten so these gluten-free cookies are especially nice to have on hand for them.

column9: Gluten Free AND yummy? Yes indeed!
column10: Best gluten free "cookie" around. I found these at the local very upscale grocery, and am so glad to see them on Amazon. I love these macaroons. They are better than even the local bakery. And for those with celiac, these should be a staple.

Disappointing! This purchase was a container of six packages of cookies.  One of the packages had not been wrapped/sealed in cellophane at the Crimbles factory.  The cookies were completely uncovered.  They were as hard as rocks, very stale, and had been exposed to who knows what.  Obviously not safe to eat; I had to throw the pack away.
$20 for 6 cookies?  Are they made of silver or the grated wings of angels and teddy bears?  I mean, really, whose arrogant enough to pay $20 for 6 cookies unless you have a serious problem.

column9: Part of my breast cancer fighting diet:
column10: I was diagnosed in July of 2010 with breast cancer and had a nearly baseball sized tumor removed from my left breast on August 4, 2010.  Of course, a vital part of my anti-cancer regimen included discontinuing drinking cow's milk which contains hormones fed the cows to increase their milk production.  I drink some organic goat's milk which doesn't contain those harmful hormones, but I have found that another delicious alternative is this brand of soy milk.  If you want something that tastes like milk, drink goat's milk, because no brand of soy milk I have ever tried tastes like milk.  However, this organic vanilla soy milk sweetened only with evaporated cane juice is really delicious and very satisfying because of its high quality protein content with the complete amino acid profile.  This variety also doesn't contain the oils sometimes added for a richer consistency which this soy milk doesn't need.  It tastes just great without those oils.As far as the packaging and condition upon arrival are concerned, mine has always arrived in perfect condition.  I have never personally had any problem with Amazon's packing and shipping for anything I have ever ordered from them.

I purchased this soy milk to use it in my protein shakes (as a milk substitute)and I have to say this actually tastes pretty good. The best way I can describe the taste is like an instant mix horchata (rice water). In my protein shakes it mixes wonderfully and adds a nice vanilla flavor. Totally worth it.

column9: Clean flavor, incredible price, convenient storing, everyone should buy this...
column10: This is exactly what I wanted and because of the packaging you do not need to refrigerate before you open them.  I do wish that amazon sold unsweetened regular soy milk for this price but alas...they do not.  I am not in anyway disappointed with this product though and while I cannot use it as a dairy substitute when I am cooking, I love it in the morning or for making protein shakes. You will not regret buying this and you can take all year to drink them if you want.

Our family has been consuming Pacific Select Soy Milk for years. We use the Vanilla flavored product in cooking, coffee and cereal. We love the taste. We consume 1 case a month easily and can consume up to 2 cases of Pacific Select Soy Milk in a month. It is a healthy, quality product.

I'm an espresso enthusiast but must watch my intake of saturated fats. This is the exact product used at the famous Blue Bottle coffee bar in San Francisco. I make it at home on prosumer level machines and find that it steams well into microfoam and has the best taste of any I've tried, including Silk Soy Vanilla Lite.

Pacific Natural Foods Select Soy Non-Dairy Beverage is quite good.  I confess that I buy this through Amazon.com mainly to stock up for winter.  I don't have a car and winters can be long, bitter cold and icy which makes walking over a mile to the store to buy more soy milk a bit hazardous.  Being able to buy a 12 package box is not only cheaper than what local stores charge for same size container, but it's great to have my soy milk delivered right to my door.  I am lactose intolerant which is a good thing.  I have seen many research articles showing that Oriental women who for the most part avoid dairy foods and using soy milk and other soy products have very low rates of breast cancer and other types of cancer seen only in women.  I eat soy yogurt, soy whipping cream {just like Redi-Whip}and the soy milk is great for making chai lattes at home instead of paying an extra fee to Starbucks for requesting soy milk.  I do not like soy milk in coffee or tea, but Coffee Mate is lactose free so...  I like being able to store my soy milk in a cabinet since it is time to open a carton of it.

My wife loves her coffee in the morning, and this stuff is vital for it - no other Soymilk will do.  After introducing to other friends, they are the same way.Only lost one star, for being on and off available and making my life more difficult as a search around for the stuff.

This is a light type soymilk. Not too bad. BUT it came with two units damaged with leakage!!! Cannot drink these. Amazon failed in packing!!! Not worth the trouble for returning.UPDATE: Amazon gave me a full refund. Did NOT have to return the item.The soy milk was ok. Not as rich as some brands.

My cats are small, furry gravy-loving demons and this food has no gravy. They sit and stare and proffer silent recriminations with their moist little eyes, begging for answers, but I have none. This food has no gravy, and that will not fly.

We got it for a great price on Amazon here, and the cats are loving being spoiled.  I like the fact that it's more than just meat, but rice and veggies as well.

column9: Friskies knocked one out of the park with product
column10: Friskies hit a solid gold home run with this combination , I've got 4 cats all tended to be picky eaters till we tried this stuff . Now my dog is on a diet the cats are licking the bowls clean , no leftovers for the dog to sneak his late night snack with . Worse part is kitties are telling me loudly when it's dinner time not the other way round .

The photo and description is slightly misleading, I think. column9: Friskies Select Indoor Cat Food Variety Pack (24)
column10: I am pleased with this canned cat food.  It is particularly made for the indoor cat.  Gives you 2 flavors and good size cans.Doesn't have a bad smell like most cat foods do.  Very economical price for the pack.  Delivered to my door and no bother of having to go out to the store and lug the case home and from the car into my apartment.Couldn't be any easier, and I really like that aspect of it.My cat LOVES the taste of the salmon and the chicken and cleans her plate every time I give it to her.I am very satisfied with this product and will continue to purchase it.

Duncan Hines never lets me down! Moist and tasty and easy to make! Some of the Best Brownies Ever!

I have bought Duncan Hines Decadent Double Fudge Brownie Mix countless times.  It is always delicious with a perfect texture.  My boys want me to make these all the time.  I quite frequently bring them to family gatherings, and everyone always comments on how good they are.  I have tried other flavors and other brands, and to me, this is #1.

This candy bar is absolutely amazing!  I have not eaten candy bars in years but when I saw this I had to try it as I adore caramel and chocolate.  I like to cut it into 6 slices and freeze them in a container.  I suck on 1 or 2 in the evening as a splendid treat; lasting longer because it's frozen.  In addition, if your watching your weight you can still indulge.  Each slice is only 1 Weight Watcher point; and well worth it!If I could rate it a 10 I would.  You will not be disappointed; I highly recommend it to all.  Cudos to Milky Way.
Not a big fan of milk chocolate but this is great!  I will buy again.  I have zero (0) will power.
it is good best candy ever i don't have enought candy i like carmal and choclate candy i think you wil like this kind
I found this candy bar while camping and could not find it locally so was delighted to find it online.  I absolutely love this candy bar and wish it was more widely available.  It freezes very well.
My absolutely favorite candy bar!  I am disabled and it's hard to get out. So glad I found this on Amazon!  So convenient. Fast shipping!  Thank you!
Go get some.  Now.  They are wonderful, ambrosia of the gods.  Seriously.  Stop reading this and find some.  You can thank me later.

LOVE Milky Way's caramel, but not overly fond of nougat?  This is your candy bar!  The chocolate is a little too thick, but otherwise I LOVE this stuff!  Hope it stays on the shelves as a permanent item and not disappear...
Received in perfect condition.  Nice and fresh with far away date of expiration.  They will be gone long before the date of expiration.  Fast ship.  Perfect transaction start to finish.  Thank you.

column9: One of the best candy bars ever made!
column10: I live in a small town, so we don't get this candy bar.  Went to Sam's in Salina,Ks. and got a box, while we were there.  Simply Caramel Milky Way is fantastic, best candy bar i've had in years!  Only eat one every few days, or you might get a tad BIG.  Love it!!  Try it chilled.

column9: Soft, chewy caramel with a milky chocolate shell
column10: When I tried these for the first time I was immediately overwhelmed with the soft caramel and the creamy milk chocolate covering! These are so "bad" I wish I hadn't found out how wonderfully good they are. I can take a bite, and savor it for awhile, and then another bite a little later. I try to make one last all day, but on occasion I have opened a second one! Thank you for thinking of us milk chocolate and soft caramel lovers, and doing such a bang up job of putting them together! YUMMERS!

Iorder these for my husband. The first order was great. This time the  chocolate was discolored, like they were old.  I would love to keep ordering but I'm hesitant. I don't want to receive old product.

column9: Milky Way Simply Caramel Bar 1.91 oz.
column10: This candy bar is yummy I belief.  I bought this candy bar at a local drug store chain during their 3 for $2 deal.It has the perfect consistency of milk chocolate and the caramel is real and delicious.  Unlike most candies I've tasted lately, the caramel is perfection.  It is chewy and smooth.I purchased several varieties of Milky Way, French vanilla, simply caramel, and midnight dark.The candy bar is a blend of firm rich caramel and delicious milk chocolate.
