The bar is exactly as pictured.The packing also comes with an expiration date.  I like this because it prevents vendors from selling the product  beyond it product expiration date.

About a year or so ago, Mars test marketed a bitesize Milky Way Caramel ... it was fabulous.  Then they took it off the market.  When this candy bar was announced I jumped at the chance to buy it.  Sadly they changed the product to candy bar size and in the process changed the texture of the caramel and the chocolate coating is way to thick.  Disappointed with the product, will not purchase it again.

My father has always had a thing for Banana Laffy Taffy but not the other flavors...a couple of years ago we couldn't find it anymore except in the mixed packs...not even at our local wearhouse store...so when I found this I decided to give it a shot...it was as fresh as the day it was made...we now have a source for all the Banana goodness my dad could ever want...it made for a great gift from Christmas because for once he could guess what he was getting...If your giving it as a gift be sure to put it in a sealed plastic bag or two before wrapping or the person you are giving it to will be able to tell what it is from the smell.

I used to buy these all the time for my taffy addicted mother at our local 7-11, but they stopped carrying it a while ago.  So it's nice to see this product on amazon, however, compared to the 7-11 price, the price here just seems inflated.  At 7-11 it was 4 ropes for $1 but increased to 3 for $1 later on.  That would put 24 at $6 or 24 at $8.  $12.60 is a little too much.The price for the 96 pack is much better though:  Wonka Laffy Taffy Banana Rope, 0.81-Ounce Packages (Pack of 96)$19.44 for 96 puts it at $.20 per rope, much better than over $.50 per rope with the 24 pack.-2 stars for pricing.

I felt like the information about this product was a little misleading, once it arrived.  Maybe it ships as 5 pounds, but it's just over a pound of product in actuality.  I'm glad it shipped free, because the individual pieces were marked "3/99cents....which makes the $9.49 price slightly MORE than retail.Then when I tried one, it was crunchy, which tells me this is not fresh product.  Still edible?  Absolutely.  Still the Laffy Taffy banana flavor I like?  Absolutely, but I won't be buying this again.  I live in Alaska, and I can buy over-priced candy right here at home.

I purchased this product for my dad who loves these things, but he was immediately displeased. They tasted old and were hard. Since they were marked individually as 3 for 99 cents, I'm assuming that they were put out for sale and what weren't purchased at a physical location were sold here on Amazon. The fact that there were only 21 in a package supposed to contain 24 only adds to that assumption. I will still need to purchase more banana Laffy Taffy to appease the father, but never again from this seller.
I was highly pleased with how fast the shipping was and how fresh the product was! I will definitely buy from once again!

column9: Forget the other flavors... All u need is banannanana!!!
column10: I didn't think I could get just one flavor of Laffy Taffy...I stand corrected, I got my favorite banana and it was fast, easy, didn't need to leave the house and waste gas trying to find it... And since its a food product I got it in like 2 days! So awesome :-) ...........!

Not sure how long these were in the warehouse but they are very stale and not too chewy. Actually I buy this sort of taffy all the time at my local walgreens and it's soft and taste perfect! Banana is a great flavor but the boxes amazon sales I have to question how old they are because this wasn't very fresh at all.

After going through a package of the Laffy Taffy Strawberry I ordered these and they were gone within a week. The flavor is one of the best artificial Banana flavors you will find in any taffy. If you have a sweet tooth and enjoy taffy this product is for you. The seller shipped it rocket fast and the product was very fresh.
I always hate to buy the bag just to get to the banana and also feel that one small one was not enough.  We really enjoyed this candy.

I received the item, looking forward to receiving it the whole week, because I am addicted to banana Laffy Taffy, I quickly ripped open the box and started to eat one, I bit down and it was so hard! Regular laffy taffy is hard, but not this hard, so I give this 4 stars, a little generous.
EXCELLENT PRODUCT BUT TOO EXPENSIVE.WISH THEY COULD PUT IT ON THE "SUBSCRIBE" LIST SO THAT A FREQUENT BUYER COULD RECEIVE A DISCOUNTED PRICE.EXCELLENT PRODUCT, THOUGH.

column9: High quality and taste but a little expensive
column10: During the holidays, I had Nielsen Massey peppermint extract and a store bought brand.  Needless to say, I threw the store brand out.  The flavor quality does not even compare.  I just wish this brand was a little less expensive, so I use it sparingly.

I am not a huge potato chip fan so I was suprised by how much I love with these Lentil Chips!  They are light, healthy and absolutely delicious!  Also nice that they are Gluten Free and can be easily shared with my Gluten Free friends.  My kids also love them!  Favorite is Sea Salt & Cracked Pepper, but also like the Parmesan Garlic.  My father really likes the Cucumber Dill too.  Try them!  You'll love them too.
Great value, subscribe and save is the way to go. Never have to worr about the product being on sale when u start to run out.

I purchased this product to use in an espresso pot de creme recipe and have ended up enjoying glass after glass of delicious iced lattes. They are simple to make and delicious. That said, the product is expensive if you do the math, though it is arguably less expensive than a latte at Starbucks or elsewhere. I like the fact that it is decaf and it is full bodied and full flavored. I highly recommend it. And by the way, the pot de cremes were otherworldly -very rich in coffee flavor despite using a decaf product.

With so many dark roasts, over roasted,varieties available,it was with great anticipation I waited for my coffee delivery of these Organic Colombian beans...I was not disappointed!  The price was right, and the coffee, smooth, mellow, yet full flavored and satisfying. With 15% discount susbscription, it's a fair price for Organic.

This coffee was very stale, it had no expiration or product date.The coffee had no body, no aroma,very harsh tasting.The company refused to replace it or give a refund.We had this same coffee once before and it was verygood. Just must have been a bad batch or old.

This is now our "household coffee" after a very long search. My husband and I are delighted to find this healthy, flavorful coffee. It is top quality down to the last bean and it takes us about a month to go through one bag. Highly recommend the subscription service if you like it as much as we do!
We have this organic coffee on subscribe and save.  It is a reasonable price with free delivery. The coffee has a good flavor and we don't have to worry about running out.

Amazon was excellent again, provided quick delivery. Always pleasure doing business with amazon.  Now coffee, very good coffee plus it organic, If I had to compare this coffee to other organic I tried, this would be the best of the organics coffee.Try it for your self about $8  a pound is very good coffee and usda organic.nuff said.

excellent coffee at a great price; its great to get it delivered to your house every six months.  Its very consistent I've never been disappointed in a bag & will continue to have it set for delivery.
Very smooth, rich flavor - just the way I like it! I bought it twice and will buy again.

I love getting my coffee from Amazon because they have many gourmet varieties that are fair traded.  This coffee is no exception.  It has that "Fresh coffee bean" smell upon opening the bag.  Nice flavor once ground and brewed.  Highly recommended.

This is a good organic Colombian coffee. There are organic coffees I like a little bit more, but this one is a good overall coffee. If you like Colombian you'll appreciate the smooth, not bitter, taste of this one.
Perhaps i was expecting something special, or maybe I just didn't order the right bean.  This coffee is perfectly OK, but no more than that.  I will try a darker beam next time, I think.

column9: OK coffee, roast, but a bit stale!
column10: Too bad. This can be a problem with bulk (2 lbs.) bags, IME. Just a bit soggy/stale, rather than crisp, fresh beans. Disappointing.
I really like strong expresso style coffee's ...  this coffee is very mild.. dont get me wrong it is good coffee if you like it light.

My dogs are crazy about these bones! For treats, nothing makes them happier. This is the only edible dog bone they take awhile to chew. All the others they devour in under 1 minute. They chew at this bone for some time and then I take it away to save for the next day chewing. My theory is they release stress when they chew. I noticed my havanese girl has a lot less nervous tension after chewing on the N-bone. Typically, she licks herself all day and all night long. She has slowed down dramatically on the licking and I think these bones amongst other things have played a part in that. She sinks restfully into my lap after a chewing session where before I could feel her body was tense.

My dogs love these and go crazy for them when ever they see them.  They tend to get a bit territorial with them and do not like to share.  I usually end up catching one dog with all three bones, chewing one and hiding the others and the other two following me around for another bone.I highly recommend Pupper Nutter and Chicken flavors seeing as those tend to go quickly in my home.  They are safe, digestible, and do no splinter like real bones do, however, you should still keep an eye on your pet when they are chewing them.

Sadly, this case (or unsealed bag) of dried mango really is too good to be true. They don't even taste like actual mango and considering that they're an unnatural bright orange color makes us wonder if these are actually mango at all. I'm extremely disappointed with this product...and now we have 11 lbs of gross orange garbage. Maybe we can give it away to our neighbors.Phillippine Brand Naturally Delicious Dried Mangoes Tree Ripened Value Bag 30 Ounces Dried MangoIf you want some REALLY GOOD dried mangoes, go with a dependable brand like Phillipene Dried Mango. They're a bit pricey but you get what you pay for...and they are oh so delicious.

If you like dried manogos, don't buy these because they are not.  they may have started out as mangos but by the time they were mashed, sugared, colored, and shaped they resembled mangos and tasted like sawdust with a lot of sugar and some flavor that vaguely resembled mangos.  After my experience with this company, I will never do business with them again.

These are candied, not what I was expecting. They remind me of the fruits found in a fruitcake, they had a slight chemical taste to me. I attribute this to the food coloring and preservatives. My family did not care for them. They shipped quickly! The company was gracious enough to allow me to return them per their 100% satisfaction guarantee.

This is good quality mango.  I have tried many different kinds of dried mango and this is not the best, but it is the best for the price.  It is not stringy, has good flavor and a lot of sweetener.  I would give it 5 stars if it didn't have artificial coloring.

I wrote a review about these about 2 or 3 months ago and my only complaint was that the mangoes were sticking together but since then I've received 2 more bags and they were great. The mango was fresh and not stuck together as my first order.They come packaged great as well. I am very happy with this company and will come back to only them when purchasing dried fruit.

I love these noodles. They're like Ramon noodles, but way better. I really like how I can make it spicy for me, and not spicy for my daughter, simply using the seasonings that are in the package. I've never used the third packet of seasoning, though, the one that's kind of like jelly. I don't know what that would do.

I like these because they taste great you don't have to boil them forever like some other brands. I simply put them in a boil with boiling water then wait a minute or two. I thought this was great because I was living in a place that didn't have a kitchen so my little portable water boiler was all I had
YEAH SO.. these soups are great, even comes with a spicy powder that you can add to your soup. noodles are delicious. they taste good without the seasoning.

I was in a Hospital gift shop when I first saw a pomegranate Tootsie Pop in a bowl of mixed flavors. After trying one, I returned and pulled all the pomegranate Tootsie Pops from the bowl. This, to me is the best flavor they've made. If you're into the red flavors, you must try the pomegranate.

It's been a long time since such a new and delicious flavor combination has captured my attention, but Pomegranate Tootsie Pops have my tastebuds singing a song of praise.  So out of the ordinary and completely satisfying.  One pop does it all.  Bring them on soon!

These tootsie pops are absolutely the best flavor ever !  They are not too sugary sweet, (like the watermelon ones are) and have a pretty true flavor.  I love them and order them every time they're available !  Yum-yum !

column4: notAyesperson "Always in search of good books"
column10: I would have given 5 stars but only gave 4 due to it's availability.  I don't like it when companies make a good product, but tease the customers with only limited stock.This is a good candy.  I was in a grocery store buying candy in bulk.  I swear in that whole entire bin of tootsie pops there were only like two pomegranate.  I was taken by the color of the wrapper which I wasn't familiar with.  I bought both of them, and they were the best ones.I also like the blueberry ones as well that seem to come out around Halloween. The original flavors are kind of played out, and I'm a little tired of them.

column9: REALLY, REALLY, GOOD-WISH THE COMPANY WOULD CARE ENOUGH ABOUT THEIR CUSTOMERS TO MAKE MORE!!!!!!!!!
column10: These are the best! I wish the company would care enough about their customers to make more of them.  You would think since so many people keep requesting them that they would do something about it.  Actually, when a company doesn't honor the many requests for them to make them again, it really turns me off to keep supporting the company. So, I just won't buy their products any longer. Too bad, but it is the only way to let them know we mean buisness.

I randomly grabed this out of a bag of halloween candy, ate it, and fell in love. I love this pop im hoping that this product becomes available before my birthday. This is THE BEST out of all the flavors, but i cant find it every where

I happened upon these in a gas station and I thought I had grabbed the raspberry kind when I purchased it, and, to my delight, it was pomegranate. This is certainly the best tootsie pop flavour yet! I can't wait until they are back in stock so I can order some. :)

My kids ended up with Pomegranate Tootsie Pops this year when they went trick-or-treating~ We are all wishing that this pack of 30 exclusively pomegranate pops were available, as we ALL thought this was the BEST flavor! (It even edges out the Raspberry, which was our previous favorite~)

column9: The BEST Tootsie Pop EVER MADE!
column10: I went to Sam's club and bought a bag of assorted 5 1/3 lb. Child's Playtime Candy (assorted Tootsie candies the smidgees, pops, and ugh! Dots) I saw the wrapper and we thought they had a printing error with the color overlay. I tried it- it was like awesomeness in pop!. I wanted no other- it was sweet and fruity and not in an artificial way and it didn't taste like medicine (orange & grape) Now I don't know if that flavor is directly pomegranate but I am willing to trade all my chocolate candy, which I LOVE, just to get another pop. If you find it do not share!

I tried Stoats bars at a Scottish themed race a couple of years ago. I love the taste and flavors. They are hard to find so I was really glad that Amazon carried them... that was until they arrived. I opened the plastic wrapped box of 12 to find only 9 bars!! I purchased a box of 12. I did not know that the product I was getting was a previously opened, partially "used" product. I was not willing to return and pay for shipping, but I will not be purchasing this product through Amazon again.

Am thrilled to get these in US!  Discovered these bars in Glasgow and was "addicted" to the fruity oat texture and flavor immediately.  Thought I'd have to order from Stoats direct, but Amazon.com makes makes it more efficient and easy!
This is a top notch product and has met or exceededed my expectations in every way.  No more grocery store 'pork hocks' with zero meat for me!

I ordered these city ham shanks, the large package size, and when they arrived, I was really surprised that theyhad little fat, they are mostly ham that is edible and cooks wonderfully with out a lot of fat grease left.I have used it for beans, cabbage, greens, and am really going to say only this to those of you who read thisreview, you can not beat the quality of the ham shanks, and the price for the large size order, is fantastic. If you like shanks in your greens, beans, give this a try for sure through Amazon.

column9: Review of the product, not Amazon
column10: I have not purchased this from Amazon, though if the delivery is the same as the other experiences I've had in the past decade or so, I'm sure it is fine.I have purchased these in my local grocery store, and they're fantastic.  Each section is individually vacuum-sealed.  They do come with the skin, and some bones, but bones add flavour.  I use mine to make soup, as well as red beans and rice.  Simmer them for a couple of hours, then the meat falls off the bones and shreds.  Not too salty, but very tasty.  In the winter when I do lots of soup making, I'll use a couple of these a week.  I've also used the ham steaks, and they are good as well.
Just tasted like coffee, nothing special. I have never had Kona and thought it would be incredible since Kona is so expensive.

The best thing about this expensive decaf is the shiny, purple packaging.  The flavor is nothing special, certainly not as good as my favorite decafs from Durango Coffee, which cost about half as much.  Save your money.
Great coffee.  The swiss water method is the way to go and is much easier on your body.  I like to add a teaspoon of sugar in the ground coffee before I brew it (cuts the acidity).  Mmmh.

I was looking for a really good special treat coffee - something very dark, but not bitter.  Since I'm limited to decaf only once or twice a week, I want to be sure that what I'm drinking is special.  This really wasn't it.  So far, I've been happiest with Kicking Horse and Starbuck's Sumatra decaf, neither of which, unfortunately, is organic.  My search continues.

I fell in love with Kona coffee while in Hawaii years ago and have only been able to find 10% Kona coffee. For me coffee is a delicacy and I try to keep my caffeine consumption down. I have mixed this 1/2 and 1/2 with regular Kona coffee Hawaii Roasters medium roast Hawaii Roasters 100% Kona Coffee, Medium Roast, Whole Bean, 16-Ounce Bag  and also combined the above with Columbian to get a 50-50 mix (This is expensive coffee)and it is terrific. Not being a coffee connoisseur I don't know how one would describe it, but it has a mellow flavor that is fairly light bodied.I would buy it again.

These are a total joke and upset i took a chance on them. They have a vingar taste to them and they taste fake. I am shocked how poorly they taste. I do not taste artichoke really at all. I only taste vingar really. What a shame and a waste of money. I tried 2 cans and let my mom finish them off. Well i actually made her take them home but she tossed them. Do not even buy even for 6 cans for $5. If you get these for free well it helps you live but you will not enjoy the taste.

I can't stand the pre-packaged jerky that isn't homsemade. So it's been years since I've had real jerky that can satisfy my need. I was getting a craving so I started researching online about making my own but I wanted some NOW. Purchasing jerky online is risky considering you never know what you're really getting. This company got high reviews on Yelp.com so I decide to try them out. And I couldn't wait to open that bag and get a taste. It was so hard to share. I ended up purchasing more online to test out the other flavors and hopefully I'll make a trip to the actually location this summer. Overall a delicious home taste of real jerky.
I didnt tell anyone in my family how good they were, and I ate the whole box in a week, they taste Wonderful, I am here getting more.

After trying a sample of the Almond Trail Mix Bars, I immediately ordered a pack of 12.  They are so moist and delicious, you won't want to eat just one.  They taste nothing like the bland, healthy treats I have tried in the past.  I shared these with my family and the 12 pack was gone in 3 days.  I highly recommend them.
These little bars are a perfect snack. Super healthy, and there is nothing in there that makes me cringe and think I shouldn't be eating it. ALL good stuff. And did I mention they taste great??

column9: Too sweet, almond extract flavor too strong
column10: I had high hopes for the product, but it's too sweet for me and the almond extract flavor is overpowering. I couldn't taste a real almond flavor. I'm willing to try another flavor though.

From a taste standpoint, my son really loved these. I like that they are relatively "clean" in ingredients, but simply contain too much added sweetener. Not only is 17g of sugar very high for a granola bar, my 9-year old daughter and I actually found the taste too sweet and cloying (and not enough almond!)
These bars are great! Our whole family loves these. We use them for lunches, snacks, and always keep one in my purse for emergencies :)

column9: Alright but there are better bars out there
column10: I find the Earnest Bars to be far too sweet, especially this bar that has so many raisins in it.  I can taste the almonds, but the sweetness is overwhelming.  I got them cheap but will not be buying them again.  If you can find them in a store, you may want to consider trying one and see if you like it rather than getting a box of 12.

The good news, these are very tasty and pretty filling for 210 calories. The bad news? For nutritional value they're slightly better for you than the average candy bar.A tasty snack, but don't get the idea that its health food.

I was looking for something to take hiking and i was a little tired of lara bars. I ran across these things and I must say they are amazing. I think it is the strong almond flavor that reminds me of amaretto that I enjoy.

column9: Will finally eat nutrition bars now!
column10: A coworker told me about this product she bought at the health food store.  So I went and bought one and it was LOVE AT FIRST BITE!  These are so good you can't believe it.  Even my mother likes it and she never likes these nutrition type of bars.  Now she will finally snack a little healthier!I never buy anything online in this quantity after only one initial purchase, so that should tell you,,,and I bought QTY 2.  I love the fact that they are easier on your teeth.  They are not hard, they are soft.  The only other type of nutrition bars I liked before were the KIND bars, and these blow KIND BARS away!!  I will use this as a healthy snack.  The only thing bad about these is the sugar.  For diabetics since you should not go over 30 grams of sugar in one serving, this is all you can get, as they are 31grams per bar.

As soon as I smelled the Almond Trail Mix Earnest Eats bar, I thought "Bear claw!" The best part? These bars are WAY healthier than a bear claw could ever be. It has the great flavor and smell of almonds, chewy texture and a few raisins throughout (why it's considered 'trail mix').

All natural and great tasting!  Some food bars can be too hard and dense -- these are not.  Imagine taking oats, mixing them with peanut/almond butter and adding a more flavor.  I enjoy them as a breakfast on the go if I am running short on time.

These are yummy! This particular flavor is definitely for almond lovers, because as another reviewer noted, the almond extract flavor is strong. They are sweet and that may be too much for some, but I found the grains balanced it out. I love them as a filling and very enjoyable snack.
I love these bars.  They are the best snack or quick meal with some fruit or yogurt.  The Oats fill you up along with the almonds butter.  Great taste - not like your typical healthbar.  I am hooked!

I love that the Earnest Eats baked bars are made with natural ingredients and are good for you.  This is the second flavor I've tried so far and it's really tasty.  My favorite one is the peanut butter one with the chocolate chips but this one is also very delicious.  I got these mainly as a breakfast bar but find myself eating these as snacks or treats.  My kids even like these alot and they have become a regular item in our household.

column9: One of the best 'breakfast' bars I have tried
column10: I bought these primarily as a breakfast bar rather than as a snack food, but they can be used as both. These taste wholesome. I do very much enjoy the taste, I have really savored the taste on every bar. There is not cloying sweetness masking everything else and a very wholesome taste.I also really like the texture. In size these are small bars. But they eat larger than their size. They have a good amount of (pleasant) chewiness to them and the overall texture encourages you to eat slowly. Overall very tasty, good nutrition compared to other breakfast/snack bars, recommended.
Best granola bars I have ever had and Amazon had a great price. Can't wait to try the other flavors.

I love these bars! They are an excellent snack and taste great wwith a cup of herbal tea. They have more calories (210) than some of the other choices (such as Oskri Granola bars which have 145 calories). But they are well worth the few extra calories. I highly recommend them!

This bar has a lot of almond flavor, which I love.  I'm trying to stop the candy bar snacking in the afternoon and I feel this is a good replacement. I found the bar to be very moist, fairly sweet, with a soft texture (softer than many other 'chewy' style bars).

The Earnest Eats Almond Trail mix bars are my absolute favorite bar on the market! they are healthy, lots of vitamins and made with almond butter which is pretty unique, I've not seen other bars with almond butter, I think that's what makes them so moist.  I love nuts and trail mix and with these Earnest Eats bars, I get both of them! I'm active and often need a quick snack on the go that is also healthy.  I've tried all the Earnest Eats bars and these are by far my favorite!
This is my favorite of the Earnest Eats collection. It is like eating a cookie without the guilt. Sooooo tasty.

The Almond Trail Mix bars aren't exactly what I expected but they are still pretty tasty.  Extremely dense and chewy, they're definitely a filling snack.  However, it has a lot of calories for such a little package if that's something you care about ... I was hoping for a slightly bigger bar to share with my wife but it's not really large enough to split.  The trail mix flavor is *definitely* the prevalent flavor here instead of almond, which was also a little bit disappointing since I love almonds.Minor quibbles aside, this is a tasty and healthy snack item.  I'd order it again if it went on sale.

These were really good and the family liked them a lot..they had just a bit too much almond flavoring for me, but I'm not crazy about alond extract. All in all they are a hit with the family and I will probably buy them again.
These bars are soft, moist and full of flavor.  They are worth the price and I can't stop eating them.

Perfect for throwing in my purse for "emergency snacking". All natural food, no fake stuff, no guilt. Doesn't taste like vitamins or powders. Decent amount of protein, and holds me over until mealtime. I like the Cran Lemon Zest, too.

like others have said, it's good and worth it if on sale. not good for you, but hopefully not bad either. when you open the plastic pouch you are hit with what seems like almond extract fumes.  they air out.  its a good bar, you have to share them b/c you get a dozen and people like them.

column9: I like the texture, but not the excessive amount of Almond Extract
column10: I placed the order based on the good reviews here. Generally speaking, I like it especially the texture. It contains the right amount of moisture, not to dry, not to moist. However, I do believe it contains too much almond extract. It's too dominant in the smell and in the taste. It's hard to miss once you open the plastic wrap of the bar.
The way name goes Almond Trail. You hardly feel or see any almond in it. Taste is Ok not that great as I see in other reviews. Same hint of chewy sodium you get in other bars...

column9: No longer happy with this product.
column10: Ordered  Earnest  Almond Trail Mix Bars on Oct.16. upon receiving them I find they are no longer the same as when they were {HONEST BARS} They are very dry now and flavorless.Will no longer purchase them. Very unhappy with the quality.

One day my husband came home with this little bottle of spice....Okay, says I...I'll try it.  All I can say is Wow! It has been a couple of years now, and I am STILL not bored with it. It is still my favorite spice to reach for. My favorite combo being a dash of celtic sea salt, and a big shake of Bragg Sprinkles!The grind size is just right...not so fine that it is like tiny "sand". Rather, it's just large enough that you can actually get little tastes of various flavors....rosemary, thyme, sweet basil, a smidge of dill, oregano, etc. Even though it contains about 25 different spices, it doesn't blend away to "anonymous" when it hits your mouth. You're gonna love it!Oh, and we usually have it right on the table, for that last sprinkle on top, right before we eat it. Mmmmmmmmmm.
This goes into almost every soup. My only wish is that is comes in a larger container as I go through it quickly. It really is a great combination of herbs and spices.
This seasoning taste great.....It reminds me of another similar seasoning on the market only alot more flavorful and the extra benefit is it's an organic product. Give it a try.

I bought it because of the health attributes but I will keep buying it because of the taste. Really nice stuff. Great with almost anything and its very colorful so makes you look like a chef when you deliver the mash potatoes with this across the top. Very pleasant and eccentric flavours.

I've been cooking for well over three decades and have tried many different "no salt" seasoning combos. Recently I received a sample of Bragg Organic Sprinkle Seasoning and tried it on chicken I was roasting. It was truly the best seasoning I've ever used, and my husband raved about it, asking me to purchase it. It's not spicy, not sweet, and not one spice in the mixture overpowers the others. I'll be using it in soups, stews, hamburgers....So--here I am, and might purchase the 12-pack. :)

I originally tried this as a free sample. It was really good especially when I would bake my fish. So I had to buy more of it. It lasted me a pretty good while because I didn't use it for everything so as to not get tired of the flavor. I ran out of that so now I ordered it from amazon. It came nicely packaged and in a glass jar instead of the plastic that I had before. I have yet to use this one but it smells good and looks good so I'm expecting what I had before. It has a healthy fresh taste which makes anything more special like from a restaurant or chef.

column9: Wonderful and Versatile Blend of Spices
column10: Bragg Sprinkle Seasoning is great; so tasty, and adds taste and spice to nearly every food. The Shipping & Handling is expensive, but it is worth it, since no stores in this city carry this product anymore, for some inexplicable reason.

I don't have sodium issues but it's better not to create any either! That's why I puchased this product. It seasons well. I use it as a rub also (mixed with a bit of extra virgin olive oil) for my skinless chicken and fish. The bottle is small but packs a bunch in flavor! Great on veggies too!
Excellent seasoning blend! Love it!!! I wish I would have bought two bottles. You can definitely tell it's organic. Braggs' products are great!
I absolutely love this product. It is a staple in my pantry. It blends together very well and adds a flavor distinction to many of our dishes.

You know it is Bragg when it tastes good and is good for you.  This is a tasty seasoning with the right mix of ingredients to make eating more enjoyable.  Sprinkle it on just about anytbing and enjoy.  A really healthy mix with no regrets after the fun.
GREAT COMPANY GOOD SERVICES GREAT PRODUCT WILL BYU ALWAYS ZTHIS FROM HERE MADELINE B OGLE Bragg Organic Sprinkle Seasoning 1.50 Ounces

this is some really awesome food. within two weeks of feeding my dogs mulligan stew they started showing visable signs of being healthier and happier, plus the shedding has stopped almost completely. i like the fact that it's made in america.

the product is good.........the packaging was horrible.....partly open.spiders crawled into the package when I found it on the porch...last thing I need is a spider bite.  Last time I got the pumpkin seed bars they were sealed in plastic.......now not..who knows what I have in there.  The spuralina was packaged in plastic.......A ok

I must say I was excited about this item but was disappointed when I received them.  I thought the 'chips' were going to be thin and crispy but they aren't.  They taste like bananas and I want to like them but I don't.  I thought about trying the chocolate ones but I'm afraid to.

I love tea - all kinds of teas. I don't usually like fruity black teas, though... so ordering this was a risk. But this tea is really pleasant and pairs perfectly with sweetener and cream or milk, if you prefer. I did not really like it black (plain); the flavor was a bit too strong, but milk and sweetener balance it out perfectly. The subtle sweetness and tartness of the plum combined with the warmth of the cinnamon make a very nice flavor. If you like chai, you will probably like this tea.

Picked up a set of 2 at the local home improvement store for ~$11.  The design of this trap seems to count on the animal pushing dirt in front of him and the dirt is what sets off the trap.  In these instances, the gopher will likely be caught behind the neck or shoulders.  I see a lot of holes on our property where the hole is not plugged and plenty of sign that he has been out scampering around.  In these cases, he'll get caught in the hip area with his nose up against where the trigger plate would be set.  This just makes it a little more awkward in emptying the trap.  The cinch type trap looks to be just as effective but much easier to empty.  The cinch trap will cost up to 2-3 times more, though.  I might get one or two cinch traps, but 9/10 will be the 610 type.I have read at least one review where the sweep of the jaws could be an issue, preventing the trap from being seated in small holes and from closing effectively.  This is really easy to work around.  I first thought to shorten the jaws, but decided to just make the hole bigger when setting it.  I learned that gophers are not shy of these traps or your activity around the hole.  In very short order you can excavate the hole to a size that allows the trap to operate freely...and the gopher will come...especially if you notice fresh activity around the hole.Much of the literature on setting traps recommends digging back from the plugged hole to access the main tunnel and then set the traps in pairs so the gopher has to enter a trap from either direction in order to replug the hole.  I have found this is not really necessary.  If the hole I am working was freshly plugged, one trap in the hole works every time.I also noticed that a small plug doesn't necessarily mean a small gopher.  In one instance, I almost passed on setting a trap in what I thought was just going to be wasted effort.  I cleared dirt from a plug the size of a 50 cent piece and it opened up into a tunnel about 2 1/2 inches!  The gopher I got out of that hole was a normal sized gopher!I also read that a 3 degree difference in the gopher's comfort zone in the burrow is enough to cause him to do something about it.  The fact that light appears at a point he previously plugged is also enough for him to quickly come back and see what happened.  One the first day I used these, I set one, then walked about 30 yards away and set another.  I checked the first one on the way back a few minutes later and found it had been tripped and completely covered.  I had to dig it out and found the little bugger had pushed a rock the size of a bird's egg into it!  My first catch was a rock!  A Bill Murray moment flashed through my mind.  That gopher is now history, by the way.I am working with only 2 traps at the moment and secure them with a piece of butcher twine to my tunnel probe or a 12" piece of 1/4 in re-bar.  This size hardware is probably overkill.  You can probably tie the traps to those marking flags on wire type stems available at your local home improvement store, especially if you are setting a lot of traps.  They may not need to be secured at all.  When that gopher's body in in the trap, he isn't really going anywhere.  If he can go anywhere with it, it might be best to let THAT gopher keep it as a souvenir!If you are not having any success at all with these traps, it would be a good idea to re-examine how and where the traps are being set.  I have never used these things before and only bought this set after 4 years of poison pellets simply didn't work.  Look for FRESH activity and don't be shy about providing enough room for these traps to work.  So far, have set these only at holes that have been plugged, but will set the next time where there is fresh sign but no plug.  I don't bait mine and the trigger plate can ALWAYS be seen from above after I set them...easier to check them.  From all the mounds on our 2 acres, am guessing we have at least 40 gophers or more.  These traps will be busy and I'll be keeping score.I give the trap 5 stars for effectiveness and 4 stars for the emptying issue.  From my experience, no need to spend a lot of money....these things work.

I have just recently purchased the Woodstream Corp 0610 gopher trap, and  within 10 minutes of laying the traps i was catching  gophers. This product  is the best i have ever used. The 0610 gopher trap is easy to set and works  with great success. Also, remember to use a wire attached to the trap and  tie it to a steak to prevent gophers from dragging the trap further into  their hole once they are caught. I hope you find this product as easy to  use as i did, Good luck.

Gophers were ruining my yard. Actually my dogs were ruining it chasing the gophers. I'd come home to 3-4ft trenches dug. I tried everything else, gasers, poision, sonic noises, and cat hair. I didn't think I could use the traps because I don't enjoy killing animals. I guess they pushed me to far cause I bought a set and I really enjoy hunting them. It took a couple days. I had some big suckers for living in southern california. They'd push so much dirt they would set off the trap but be far enough back to escape. I kept with it digging out the trap and resetting it. Then BAM, got my first two today. They were still alive and they were pissed. Chompin their teeth as I was pulling them out. Glad I wired the traps, wouldn't want to stick my hand in there. Easiest way to kill them I found is to get a 5gal bucket, fill it with water and throw them in with the trap and all. They sink to the bottom and die pretty quick. Other gophers will eventually use the tunnels and I get them too. Kind of excited for the next one.

column9: Works well and actually is easy to set
column10: Length:: 1:51 MinsI recently bought a pair of these and after seeing how effective they were, bought two more.  There are a number of these reviews that mention the instructions, or lack there of.  Although the traps are actually  very simple to set, you wouldn't know if from the instructions, which are pretty cryptic.  The illustrations are especially tough to follow. I decided to film my own instructions to show you how to do it. I think after watching you will see it is easy to set these traps.  After you purchase some traps, you should find it helpful in learning to set them.

column9: Better then the gopher repelling devices
column10: I purchased a set (two) of these at my local home store for about $11.00.  I purchased a gopher repelling device which advertised that the gopher would be repelled by the beeping noise.  Only when I got home and read the packaging did I learn that the device would not repell the gopher for 2-3 weeks.  My gopher was eating about three plants and herbs a day.  Doing the math and realizing I would have no plants left in 2-3 weeks I purchased these traps.  They were a little tricky to set up but once you figure it out it is easy.  I set the trap where I knew there had been recent gopher activity.  I dug up a mound of dirt and found the tunnels and cleared out the dirt.  When the hole was refilled I knew it was active.  I took out the dirt and placed the traps in the tunnels as the direction indicated.  I checked it an hour later and the gopher was history. Not the easiest to empty but you can use a screwdriver to push down on the device to release the gopher.

column9: Wish I would have tried sooner
column10: I purchased a single Victor 0610 at the same time as a pair of Sweeney 9013. I found the Sweeney very difficult to use, due to wire construction that flexed while being set, and both Sweeney tripped without snagging the critters.I set the Victor in the same tunnel that the first Sweeney had been in, and caught a gopher within 10 minutes. I then replaced the second Sweeney, which had been tripped (but no gopher caught) with the Victor 0610, within twenty minutes another gopher had been snagged. I then placed the Victor in a third tunnel and again snagged a gopher within 20 minutes. The other model has been relegated to the tool shed and I have ordered two more of the Victor 0610.

I have used this trap before.  I was able to eradicate the my vole problem fairly quickly with these traps.  They are great long lasting traps that get the job done.  They do not fair well under a lawnmower though!

I set this trap the day after I received it.  The gopher pushed dirt onto it, but also pushed the trap out of the burrow.  I reset the trap with a nail behind it to keep it in place, and two hours later my gopher problem was solved.

Unlike a certain Utube video that denounces this gopher trap, I find these traps to be very effective. You just have to know how to set them properly!! I have had absolutely no problems with these traps and have been reducing the gopher population in my yard and garden tremendously!!

column9: UPDATE TO "Caught one on the first try!"
column10: OK...so I wrote my review too early.  Since the initial 'capture', I have bagged a couple more of the furry garden  terrorists.  Unfortunately, their relatives continue to excavate in and around my garden.  The problem: the trip mechanism is not sensitive enough (as I suspected and wrote in my initial post).  My catch rate is less than 10%, and I usually find the unsuccessful sets filled with dirt and untripped.  I just ordered 6 Macabee traps and will post a review there after a few days of using them.Initial post: "I have pocket gophers running amuck in and near my vegetable garden.  Tried the smoke bombs without success.  After watching a number of videos on You Tube about trapping gophers, I decided to take a whack at it.  At two different sites, I found new mounds, probed for the main trench, excavated, set traps in each direction, wired the traps to a stake, and replaced the sod.  18 hours later, the first set had caught a gopher BY THE TAIL!  One clunk on the head with a shovel and I was on the board! The other set, I presume, was not placed deep enough in the hole as the gopher simply pushed dirt up into my trap.  The only drawback that I perceive about the product is that the bump plate requires a pretty hard 'bump' to spring the trap.  But, with one gopher in the bag after the first 18 hours, I am willing to keep using!"

I am outside with product open and there is absolutely nothing here to show me how to use this.  Now I must go inside, search online, print or make notes to have something with me as I use this product.  Why not one printed sheet to use at worksite?  No value here--I'm losing half an hour.
I have used this trap for many years and it works great! It never breaks and it ALWAYS catches the gophers in my yard and my neighbors yard.
I bought a bunch of different traps to try them out and find the best one.  This wasn't the best, but I did catch one.  It is a bit safer which was nice.

column9: Trigger is not sensitive.  Waste of money
column10: Mine did not work well at all. As another person said, the gopher can push a set trap out of tunnel and not spring the trap because the trigger is not sensative enough. I recommend Maccabee traps. They cost a little more, but I have had a lot better luck. I don't even waste my time setting the easy set traps. Avoid!
This trap is very poor quality. Lock bar was too weak to engage or set trap. I threw it away because it was useless.

column9: find the instructions online; needle-nose pliers helps; still no luck
column10: Instructions for setting the Victor 0610 gopher trap can be found online, but it would have been helpful to include them with the trap, or a link to the *.pdf file. Instructions say to use 2 traps side-by-side (trigger pans facing one another), laid parallel to the ground in the gopher's horizontal tunnel, on each side of a fresh vertical gopher hole. Leave the tunnel open since the gopher will come back to fill it with soil.  After several failed attempts to set the trap (my thumb on the lever was in the way), the easiest way for me was lying it on a table with the jaw end hanging off the table top. A pair of needle-nose pliers to hold the jaws open helps too.  You don't need to bait the trap, but I am trying a bit of peanut butter. You also use a stake and piece of rope tied to the trap/stake to keep the gopher from dragging the trap along the tunnel.  So far the gopher has sprung the trap several times, but got away.  I rated it as 3, but am waiting to see if I can catch the critter. Leather gloves were also helpful. Update: After a few months we caught no gophers in the traps.  Next we bought gopher repellent in the form of castor oil pellets to form a linear barrier.  Finally, we were able to send the gophers away from our house for now.  For us it was the pellets that worked.
It's called easy set but there were no instructions included. Doing this wrong looks like broken finger's. Instruction's pleaseVictor 0610 Easy Set Gopher Trap

This is a poor excuse for a gopher trap. I have lots of gophers and have used other traps. I recently bought 8 (four sets) of these traps. They are ill designed. The gophers are able to trip them without getting caught and have even managed to push the set trap out of the hole. The problem is the sweep of the pincers is too wide and the mechanism too easily clogged with sand or dirt. Don't bother with these traps.

I ordered the Victor 0610 Easy Set Gopher Trap after exhausting all other methods of trapping and killing a sneaky little gopher.We received the trap before the expected delivery date, so the shipping was very prompt.  I was disappointed after opening the box because there were no instructions included, though.  I searched for instructions online only to come up with hard to see diagrams with small print.  After playing with it for several minutes I was able to figure out how to set the trap.  Our crafty little gopher didn't mound up for several days after receiving the trap so we couldn't use it immediately.  When the shifty little creature finally did mound up my husband cleaned out the hole to make it slightly larger, set the trap and then secured the trap so that the gopher couldn't run off with it.  He decided to cover the mound with a wagon so that light wouldn't enter the hole.  When I went outside to check the trap a few hours later we had trapped the guileful gopher.  The gopher was still alive when we pulled it of the hole but he was quickly eliminated.  This gopher had managed to destroy a large portion of my yard and evaded us for 3 months.I wish I had found the Victor 0610 Easy Set Gopher Trap before I spent more than $50 on the other methods that didn't work.  I highly reccomend this product.

I actually use this trap to catch moles and it works fine.  It is simple to use and set up.  You just have to dig with shovel to find the the tunnel and place it carefully.  I don't bother tying string to it with stake anymore because I look at it as a disposable trap (I just find it too disgusting to dislodge the dead mole from the trap, and I also don't want to bother digging it back out again).  I have used it enough now where I know it works, and I don't feel the need to check it.
The most effective way to get rid of pocket gophers, & I've tried all the other things. Easy to set & use.

You may have to figure out how to set them up right in the holes, it takes a while to get good at catching them. But, I have really put a significant dent the golpher population that is attacking my gardens.
I purchased 4 of these and caught about 20 voles. My lawn finally is hole free! Purchase these in pairs so you can put one facing each direction in the vole run.
...looks like 40 cents worth of cheap wire and a nickel in sheet metal. NO indication of where it was manufactured. Not a clue as to how to set it or deploy it. "Easy Set" my A$$.

column9: waste of money  -- just didn't work at all.
column10: Repeating:  it was just a waste of money.  It didn't work at all...and yes, it was set up according to the directions.  We have yet to trap the first mole....and there are mole tracks all over our yard.

I was underwhelmed by this product. It's not chocolatey enough, the filling is bland, and so the entire finished result is just sort of.... bland. I ate two and threw the rest away on principle that it wasn't delicious enough to waste the calories on it. Don't expect this to taste like a Hostess filled cupcake, because it really doesn't. Children will probably like it for the novelty. Be sure to cool them 20 minutes like it states in the instructions, or they'll burn their little tongues.
My order shipped promptly and arrived in good condition.  The product was as advertised and tasted great.  Will be back for more.

The product was shipped in a plastic bag placed into an express mail envelop. As the envelops are designed for documents packing a bag of nuts results in the envelop being stuffed. There is no protection for the nuts so as the envelop is thrown around in transit and as other packages are thrown on top of the envelop the nuts are crushed resulting in well over 50% of the pecan halves arriving as pecan pieces. Also the bag is loaded with pecan dust from all the breakage in transit. I do not understand why this shipper would ship what is sold as a premium product in packaging that results in delivery of an inferior product. I purchased and paid for Fancy Mammoth Pecan Halves not pecan pieces.

I love pumpkin seeds and they have good nutritional value, but most commercial seeds are covered with more that a day's supply of salt.  I always eat them shells and all so the salt is...BAD.  I've been looking for unsalted pumpkin seeds in stores for years with no luck, so I decided to try these raw seeds.  They arrived very quickly.  The seeds are huge compared to other pumpkin seeds and they taste like they need a little salt (LOL)  Actually, they taste like I just pulled them out of a jack-o-lantern and baked them in the oven without salt...A nostalgic taste.  I like them and feel good about eating them without salt.  Getting my daily supply of fiber.  I will buy them again.  YUM.
The product arrived on time & was as advertised.  Raw. Pumpkin. Seeds.  Thats it.  If you were expecting flavor, you will be disappointed.

I decided to buy the 3lb bag of raw pumpkin seeds because I was craving home-roasted pumpkin seeds! I like to eat them raw as well, and they are delicious either way! The package came on time and I highly recommend them! I will be purchasing from this company again!

column9: Labor intensive to find any flavor
column10: Yes, they are very large, but for me completely inedible straight out of the bag. The shells are like soft cardboard, and there's no taste. It would be nice if the company would include preparation suggestions with the seeds. I've been experimenting with mine and have had partial success in making them palatable. First I soaked them in mineral spring water overnight with sea salt and smoked salt. Then I drained and dehydrated them for 24 hours. They were getting closer to crunchy and even had a bit more pumpkin seed flavor. Next I took 1/4 cup of the dehydrated ones, put them in a skilled with a sprinkle of olive oil and roasted them just to a light brown, then sprinkled on seaweed and brewer's yeast. (Lots of options for seasonings.) They're pretty good that way, but I doubt I will purchase again. Maybe I'll just start buying a fresh pumpkin every time I want to eat the seeds. It would be less trouble and much tastier.

This is indeed a huge seed of pumpkin seeds. They are un-roasted, un-salted, totally nude. Also they're pretty fresh. The bag is thick plastic so you can use it for storage and it won't rip. Nice seeds guys.

column9: Rum me over with a truckload of this fudge :)
column10: This fudge was very good.A friend brought it back from a Cruise.  Lucky her got to taste test I'm sure many other varieties of Tortuga fudge.The fudge has a good consistency.  It's appearance is like a brick of hard chocholate but it has a perfect fudge texture.  It's not too hard nor too soft.  It's the type that flakes if forced.  The flavor - amazing.  I read someone complaining it tasting like cheap rum.  I disagree.  I've drank cheap rum before and that's a taste you can't forget.  The rum flavor is heavenly divine. It's saturated in the stuff which makes it a real treat above the other fudges you may have ever had.  The price is not bad at all - considering where it's imported and all.  Generally with other fudges you are paying for quantity and- not quality.  However in this case you are paying for quality, quantity, and a rum filled experience. mmmmm :) boy it's good.  BUY IT, I'm going to. Too bad it doesn't have a subscribe and save option, ha-ha.  My hips I guess are grateful for that.

Fiendishly good.  Smooth, rich and ridiculously delicious.  Sweet tooth candy.  Not for someone with a drinking problem, as you can smell the rum when you open the wrapping.  We inhaled three boxes of this fudge in a shamefully short time.  Don't buy this product, it's too good, and, unfortunately, reasonably priced.

A strong artificial rum flavor sort of ruined this product for me.  It could be ok for others, but I found it rather off-putting.  Strangely enough, the Tortuga pineapple cake I found delicious, so perhaps it's just the fudge that's overbearing.
I would not recommend this product.  First it is unreturnable, arrived in a timely manner but the Fudge is rock hard.  Worst fudge I have ever purchased.
The best canned beef I have ever tasted. Much better than ground beef! I hope it will soon be available here. Gonna buy a lot of 'em.
This an excellent tea, the same leaves can be used three times and it has helped greatly with my overall well being.

purchase this for a evening dinner guests,they rave about how good they are. Making it a hit with them but i was disappointed as pistachios is my favorite. It is not the company fault it was mine. The Pistachios was salted and i wanted Unsalted but did not looked carefully when i ordered.i wished i could had eaten them as i am on a salt free diet.This won`t stop me from coming back. Thank you........

Usually I send my male friend, age 86, Pisttachios for Christmas. This year I did not as I had been out to his home in Late November and he seemed to have two full cannisters sitting on his counter. Turns out I was not wrong, it is just that he and his pre-Christmas and Christmas guests like Pistacios very well.When I went to visit at New Years, They were gone and he told me they had been eaten. A couple of weeks later, this conversation resounded with me and I ordered these for him, but had no way to denote they were a gift, so just sent them on and forgot about it.Then in about another two weeks, I received a note from my friend. "Cindy, he asked, did you send these. I bet so. They are from Amazon, arriving at my front door uninvited by me, but, well liked."
