The energy bars have more of a "Powerbar" like texture, everything is ground, with some shredded coconut added to some flavors for interest. Little bits of amaranth add some texture too, but they are still more soft and chewy than crunchy. That said, the energy bars taste pretty amazing too, and are a better alternative for strict vegans (sweetened with brown rice syrup and tapioca syrup instead of honey).To note, the Rise Energy Bars are very sweet, and almost dessert-like in my opinion. I enjoyed them most as a mid-day treat, particularly when I hit an afternoon lull before a workout. Plus, they are the perfect size for a sustainable energy snack.I love all of the "superfruit" inspired flavors, which are a fun change from the ordinary. That said, I think the blueberry and coconut is still my favorite - the flavors really stand out and are great together!
The Variety Pack is delicious and I love that they are all Vegan, Gluten Free, and Organic. There are 3 of each flavor in this box, and each one was yummy!
I purchased the bars because they were soy free, I enjoyed the flavor because they are delicious. Great post workout snack for those of us who have allergies to contents in other energy bars.
These bars are great for a snack. They have alot of healthy ingredients and low sugar. The bars have a good flavor from the coconut. It is hard to find bars that don't have soy ingredients as well.

I've tried a bunch of different energy bars and this is my favorite. It's not as heavy as some, is quite satisfying, and is not too sweet. It is also organic, mostly raw (which I think is healthier), and doesn't have a ton of weird non-food ingredients. It's also fairly tidy to eat - I like the kind bars also, but they are very sweet and very messy. Generally I cut it in 1/2 - as I don't think I need all the calories at once, and use it as an in-between meal snack, or to help fill me up if I've only had a smoothie or salad for a meal. I used to be a big fan of the lara bars, but I prefer these. I've bought this flavor and the coconut flavor - and buy both in bulk on on subscribe and save.
Very good. Great in between meal bar. Keeps me from being hungry and has helped me to shed some more weight. Taste great and is easy to carry with me when I am unable to stop and eat a meal.

column9: Haven't noticed a lot more energy, but they taste great!
column10: These have a great mouth feel-juicy, chewy, sweet without being overpoweringly so.  They have super antioxidant ingredients like acai, goji, blueberry and pomegranate that I haven't seen in other bars of this type.  They have only a few ingredients which are all natural.  No artificial sweeteners and they are gluten-free.  Great for an anytime snack or for on the go.
A bit different taste than the other bars out there. Quality ingredients. Will buy again.

I discovered Stretch Island Fruit Leather in the grocery store while looking for an alternative to artificially flavored fruit rolls and was pleasantly surprised. They were sold individually, so I purchased one of each flavor available (strawberry, cherry, and raspberry) to sample. Raspberry and cherry turned out to be my two favorites.The strips are thick (think a thin strip of beef jerky) and if they've been sitting out in high temps, a thin sticky film will develop on them--I learned that the hard way--but if kept in the fridge or cool location, this can be avoided. There is some texture to the strips; I like to suck on them rather than bite and chew because it feels like a little tongue massage, but they are chewy. As for the flavor, it's tangy with a hint of sweetness.It reminds me of the fruit strips I used to make in my dehydrator, except with a bit more thickness and moisture. Basically, if you're searching for something ultra sweet or don't have a fondness for tangy/sour flavors, then this fruit leather may not be for you.

I think these fruit snacks are OK. I have hypoglycemia in which my blood sugar drops if I go without eating for a long time. These are nice snacks 45 calories each with no added sugar. If I feel my blood sugar drop, these snacks do the job! Our daughter likes them too. My wife doesn't like jelly type roll up snacks, she says she doesn't like the stickiness or the texture. I prefer the strawberry over the cherry, but they are both good.
Healthy snack for kids that taste great. 4 stars our of 5 because the price could be better when compared to costco's price in store

column9: SI Fruit Leather Is A Hit
column10: My family loves fruit leather, and I like the way that Stretch Island does business, but the Orchard Cherry has a cherry flavor that is just okay, more like dark cherry pie on its way out and I think it has to do with the other fruit flavors that they use to boost or support the cherry flavor. Even with the slightly different tone to the cherry flavor, it was a hit with my family and my husband ate just as many of them as the kids did! My only wish is that they offered even larger packages (like bulk for fruit leather fiends), so that it lasted longer in our house.

Bought this for my son who is now 15 months and has a full set of 16 teeth.  They were cheaper and larger than the Gerber fruit strips so I figure this would work great.My baby loves them and I feel good knowing it's got no preservatives or sugar.That said, they really are fruit LEATHER.  Extremely chewy so sometimes I feel like it's tug of war helping him bite off pieces.  But I will continue to buy them.Great product!

These little fruit strips are a delicious and portable fruit snack.  They are easy to slip into a purse or bag for a quick snack and are also great for travel.  They are quite chewy so anyone with small children or dental issues should use with care.
Nice to have these organic fruit strips.  My kids love them and they are a healthy snack.  I give them at their lunch for an extra cookie treat.

These are so delicious!  Such an easy snack to throw in my bag to bring to work or on other travels.  They taste good and are a good way to get some healthy fruit!  My fave. flavor is the raspberry, but that just depends on personal preference as all the ones that I have tried are good!
These are delicious and not a bad price per unit of you purchase them with a subscription. I keep these at work and eat them instead of junk from the vending machine.

column9: my favorite brand of fruit leather
column10: stretch island fruit co. is a great brand. it has a true fruit leather consistency; i find that some other brands are more soft like fruit roll-ups which makes them stick to your teeth more. these also taste great, and cherry is my personal favorite :)

column9: I am diabetic and not that big
column10: on fruits mainly because fresh fruit does not keep very well.  It is great that each .5oz package is equivalent to one fruit in the diabetic diet.  I received both cherry and grape.

These Fruit Leather Strips are a delicious treat that my daughter loves!  They can be sticky but I love that they aren't full of corn syrup and sugar!  I saw that another review said there was no flavor. I have to disagree, there is plenty of fruity flavor, just not overly sweet!

We have several kids on restricted diets - no gluten, dairy, soy, corn, etc. This is a quick and easy snack to pack that they love.  This is one of their favorite flavors although they eat them all.  This is the best price out there for this quality fruit leather.
This is the best flavor of all fruit leathers.  It does not have a very recognizable cherry taste, but it is fruity and yummy.

These are really, super yummy - my whole family loves them!  We've tried all of the flavors and loved them all.  They're a little bit pricey, but that's pretty much what you have to pay for real fruit in your fruit snacks.

What a wonderful way to eat dry fruit. It is portioned just right, although I find I want to peel and eat more than one. They are sweet but not too sweet, texture is great as well. I have been eating Stretch Fruit for many years and I know I will continue to do so, as will my kids.

I love to keep a few of these in my purse just in case. They are the perfect portable snack. The box is also designed nicely for easy storage in the pantry.I haven't found a flavor I don't like but my favorites would have to be: Apricot, Raspberry, Cherry, Grape and Apple.
I really enjoy the Harvest Cherry flavor of these fruit snacks.  My kids love them too!

Fruit leather is such a great snack!  I used to love fruit roll-ups until I tried fruit leather, and I won't ever buy them again.  I feel much better knowing that I am eating something with no added sugar.  Plus, 2 fruit leathers are equal to one serving of fruit.  These sell for 65 cents at my local grocery store, but with subscribe and save I can get them for just under 42 cents apiece.  My husband and I both eat them a lot, so it's worth it to me to pay for the big box.

I ordered these through Subscribe & Save so I get them every month.  The price for them in brick-and-mortar stores has gone up, but I'm now getting them from Amazon.com at the same price per candy that I used to pay in a local store.  My kids absolutely LOVE them; they usually polish them off early so I have to order another shipment before the next one is due.  I've tried them myself and they taste wonderful; if you love cherry flavor you won't be disappointed. It's great to have natural "candies" for my kids.
The price great. The only thing that could be better is an assortment.
These snacks are great for on-the-go, and they are low in sugar.  My toddler really enjoys them.  However, they are a little pricey.

These strips are not very generous,kids would want more sugar They taste just o.k. Very adult. I'm sure If you are old like me they might be perfect. I still think each serving should be  bigger that's all

column9: Sour and leaves an after taste
column10: I found these to be a bit too sour and they leave a bad after taste in my mouth.  Also they have a slimy film.  I would not recommend.
I bought these looking for a healthy alternative to the sugary fruit snacks like the fruit roll ups.  They are like leather in texture and have no taste.  Very disappointed.

I bought a big bag of this stuff at my local Costco after doing research on dried fruits with oils....not so good for you after all.  This is great because there are no preservatives at all; just dried apples, cherries and grapes.  Plus it's all organic so how could you go wrong?  A funny statement on the back says may contain pits, core fragments and stems - Hey it's real food!  Haha that gave me a good laugh.  This is how dried fruit is supposed to be!  A note with the apples - at first they seem to have a rubbery texture, but the more you keep chewing them, the sweeter and tastier they get.

Pacific Chai Decaffeinated Vanilla Chai Latte Mix, 10-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 6) : This Chai Tea is excellent - just as good, actually better than Starbucks or Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf made at the store!  I like it hot, but it is excellent iced also.
yummy..what a wonderful drink and good price.  Where I live it's hard to find decaf so this was a real treat.  Thanks

column9: Pacific Vanilla Chai...... so happy to find it here
column10: I got hooked on this chai latte a few years ago; it makes Starbuck's tast like dishwater.  Then my market discontinued it and I couldn't find it anywhere else in my local area.  I did a quick Google search and was so happy to find Amazon carries it; I now have a supply to last me through the winter!

column9: Weak flavor profile, but at least it is decaf
column10: I find the flavor of this chai, when made as directed, to be flat and weak.  When made stronger (using nearly twice as much as the directions call for), the taste does greatly improve.  The flavor also has a bit too much star anise for my personal tastes.  I prefer to have anise take a backseat role in my chai, with more cardamom, cinnamon and clove tastes up front.  Either way it is a very creamy and smooth drink with the bonus of being decaffinated.  I am still searching for a really good decaf chai, unfortunately this one just didn't quite work for me.

The Pacific Chai Vanilla Latte (Decaffeinated) is so good. I like it in the evening as it does not disturb my sleep. It is a great alternative to coffee, hot chocolate or regular tea and the taste is wonderful.
This decaffeinated version of vanilla chai latte is excellent.  It tastes almost exactly like the original, but for those of us who do not or cannot drink caffeine, it is the best alternative!

column9: Hard to find, but worth it!
column10: When you are a chai drinker and been told to cut down the caffeine, this one is perfect to replace the usual caffeinated version.  I love my chai, whole leaf or premixed, and this is a good mild spice blend -- not cloying with cinnamon, or over-spicey with pepper.  Had more pronounced vanilla flavor than similar blends.
This is the best pre-mixed chai I've tried. I first found it in a grocery store but could not find it again, so I looked online.  I ordered a year's supply.

I have been drinking decaffeinated chai for at least 10 years, and I noticed that this last order was not the same as the rest.  The taste was obviously different, and very very grainy.  In the bottom of my cup was all the spices (cinnamon etc) that never dissolved.  Something is definitely wrong!!!!  I probably will not buy any more.  Can you explain what happened???????????  Highly disappointed.

I will not buy this product again.

Everyone I gave them to asked where I had bought it - BIG success. My Mom is 82 and cannot drink ANY caffine. She (as well as me) loved this creamy light flavored vanilla chai. Pacific Chai Decaffeinated Vanilla Chai does NOT contain caffineated black tea. My Mom ad I are set for the winter. And by the way, it is a REAL treat with a dollop of very vanilla Silk (soy milk).

This is the ONLY brand of Chai I'll buy~The regular will keep me awake bigtime, so I use the decafffor after 3 pm.  My favorite is Vanilla, followed by spice.The six pack of containers will last me a winter.

column9: Pacific Chai Decaffeinated Vanilla Chai Latte Mix
column10: I love that there is a decaf Chai Mix that we can have just before bedtime. It is relaxing and warming and we love it.

column4: Christine "If at first you don't succeed, try...
column9: I wouldn't call this Chai, but I like it...
column10: The Decaf Pacific Vanilla Chai is a soothing, mostly nondairy, milk-like drink that you can make hot or iced just by adding water.  I only drink it hot and like it very much though I wouldn't call it real chai... more like warm milk with sugar and spices in it - lol.  The black tea is pretty far down on the list of ingredients so authentic it ain't!  Still, I enjoy the warmth of the drink and find it comforting to sip for some reason so I'll continue purchasing.  It's especially nice to drink in the evenings on a cold day.

The tea is reasonably tasty but not what I would call a great chai tea.  When drinking it, it leaves a hollow feeling of missing something (flavor, not caffeine).  Otherwise the flavor is good, I very much like the decaf side of it and in fact that is why I buy it, because I could not find a decaf chai tea that I liked better.

I was introduced to this years ago by a co-worker. I don't drink coffee, and this was such a different way for tea to be made. I have been drinking it ever since, I absolutely LOVE it and will keep ordering the six pack from Amazon! column9: arrived in tact, am enjoying the chai

I only drink decaff product and was pleased to find this on amazon. now I can have it anytime I want

I find this is the only way to get this product as the stores I have available don't carry it anymore, so the ordering system works well, and I like the price!

column9: Yummy, comforting drink with no caffeine.
column10: This provides a great beverage whether cold or hot any time of day.  I am not a coffee drinker but do like coffee flavor and cannot handle caffeine so this drink is right up my alley.  Calories are low, lots of flavor, easy to prepare..........what's not to like!  Try it.  Looking forward to icing it in the spring.  Linda

I often use it as a substitute (for coffee) breakfast drink, as well as a special treat for myself at times when I feel a need for some nurturing after a busy day.

column10: This Chai is very strongly flavored. It is almost like hot chocolate. I don't know if I really like it. It seems to be that it needs more milk or something to dilute the intense flavor.

column9: Chai Lovers your gana LOVE this!
column10: I wanted something I could have and not affect my sleep, this is perfect.  You just ad water,BUT it is also excelent with milk.  Great way to end my day, without the caff!
ACTUALLY, THESE WERE BETTER THAN I HAD EXPECTED.  CAREFULLY WRAPPED AND FRESH TASTING, WONDERFUL TEXTURE, WOULD HIGHLY RECOMMEND THESE TO EVERYONE.

Scott's cookies are nothing short of spectacular. I enjoyed every single one as did my friends.Would highly recommend to any cookie lover. As i actually purchased this product on Amazon, I feel comfortable giving it 5 stars
Got these for Boyfriend, He loves them.. They are huge cookies ! Totally YUMMY, He loved them so much I just ordered him some more!

I bought this as part of a large order with other spices.  This seasoning is terrible.  The final product comes out chalky with a slight hint of jerky flavor.  Luckily, I ordered other spices that I will need to doctor this stuff up to make it passable.

You get a lot for your money. Has all the good flavor of any you would purchase off the store shelf. The only thing I miss is the bottles do not have a shaker lid. So, I just scoop some out into my hand and then sprinkle onto the food. Yes I would reorder.

These folks really know how to make great food. My older dog, who is a picky eater, was skin and bones before we switched food. Now she is again healthy and happy.Amazingly,changing to K9 Natural cured dry, itchy skin and lackluster fur. Her coat shines and she no longer scratches and chews at herself.She does eat more than the recommended portions, so it is a bit more expensive than expected, but soooo worth the price.As an aside, the amount of waste that comes out in the end is about 1/4 of what it used to be. It also isn't smelly or gross. It makes clean-up way faster and easier. This may not seem like a big deal to some, but keeping the yard clean and odor free is pretty great, and having very little to pick up on walks is really nice!

column9: Sweet, lemony, with a pinch of salt...heaven!
column10: Imagine two Ritz crackers, with a sweet lemony filling. That's what these are. The sprinkle of salt is a lovely counterpoint to the sweetness of the filling. Perfect!
I love TimTams, but I just found these Arnott's Lemon Crisps at CostPlus World Market and they are DELICIOUS!!! I will definitely buy more!

Lets be clear delivery of product was great, product looked good.I thought I loved these lemon crisps, and feeling homesick for Aus I purchased them. The lemony filling delightful but I had forgotten about the outside biscuits being salty.  Oh well.  Still love Arnotts, maybe its time for a Tim Tam instead.

i usually don't buy ground coffee as i like to grind coffee beans, but i was taken in by the totally cool packaging of this product.  the grocery store had it in cans versus the packs advertised here.  the coffee is an excellent roast and not bitter at all.  if you like good coffee, this is as good as any you've had so far.  enjoy a cup!

column9: Healthy treats that help to naturally calm excited dogs
column10: We originally bought this brand due to the claim that it uses "All Natural Cage Free Chickens" as well as the "No Hormones" and "No Antibiotics," etc.  But the items were surprisingly better in quality than the package claimed.  These strips are real strips of dried chicken, not just processed "meats" as some companies may use.  This particular flavor became our household favorite due to the effect it has on our easliy excited black lab, Hayden.At first I thought the ingredients were just light flavoring, since all of the packages seem to contain the exact same looking treats.  But, the smell is very strong.  This flavor contains chamomile and lavender - which claims to calm your dog.  This claim is very true for our dog.  Only after a couple of nights, we noticed a considerable difference in behavior for Hayden.  Our dog usually gets wound up in the evening time and continually wants to play even right before we go to bed.  After giving Hayden six strips, which is the suggested amount for his body size, he became docile and even sleepy before our bed time.I usually don't believe the statements that most products like this claim, but I can say we have noticed a big difference.  Granted the effect is short term and can't be predicted for really young dogs or "unfixed" dogs (for comparison our dog Hayden weighs 85 lbs, is 6 years old, and has been fixed).These are the draw backs though.  1) This is an expensive way to treat large dogs EVERY DAY, so maybe not realistic for everyone.  2) The effects may only last a few hours, so overly exciteable dogs may be able to "battle through" the effects.  3) Flavor is very strong and very odd (lavender?) some pickier dogs could turn their noses up to the smell and flavor of these treats.Just a note - Dogswell Happy Heart Chicken Breast, Flax Seed & Taurine, 3-Count 16-Ounce Bags seems to have the opposite effect on our dog.  This product contains taurine - like Redbull - so maybe that's the reason.  I'd recommend that Happy Heart flavored treats should be avoided late in the evening.

column9: Good treats for a good pooch!
column10: We have a lovable mutt who we believe is part Corgi, part Australian Shepherd.  Needless to say, he loves to herd us around and has energy to spare (especially considering that we live in a 2 bedroom apartment with no yard).Because he's little, we only give him one or two strips on nights where he's particularly rambunctious, grab some chamomile tea for ourselves, and in 20 minutes, we're all ready for bed. :)Brisco loves these treats, and I love that it's a healthy way to lets us all get some good sleep!

I have used these products for several years for my Cairn Terrier. Have always purchased them in health food stores and felt it was a safe product. Never had a problem. However, I recently(June) purchased this item from Amazon and recieved the 6 bags. It took a couple of severe illnesses in my dog for me to connect the mellow mut strips. He initially started vomiting yellow bile and it proceeded to a vomiting/diarrhea progression that lasted for two weeks with much abdominal pain. The first time, I thought he had just injested something outside that had caused inflammation in his abdominal tract. My dog eats an excellent, mostly organic diet...is seven years old and in great health and vitality. After the first bout of this "mystery illness" I didnt give him any treats for a while(because of the dehydrated form) just a very bland diet of rice and chicken/beef working back in to adding veggies etc that would be in his normal diet...he was fine. A few days ago, with the presence of wonderful health in my dog, I opened a bag of the mellow mut strips and gave him one per day for three days. Here we are again, same illness...same symptoms. This time, I made the connection...did some internet research and found numerous pet owners who have experienced the same "toxic" problems with these Dogswell products. I am writing this review to alert other pet owners to a likely contamination problem in these products.

column9: Made my dogs calm and they loved these!
column10: I was surprised that these treats actually calmed my dogs down, especially the four month old puppy, who is hyper. All three dogs loved these treats. For the puppy, I broke the strip into smaller pieces for him, and it worked out well. None of the dogs got sick from the treats. I will buy these again for sure. The ingredients are all natural.

column9: Mellow Mutt for the Anxious Pup
column10: This all-natural product is effective in taking the edge off the anxiety of separation, road trips, or vet visits. Dogs beg for this tasty treat. Who could ask for anything more?

My dog loves these a lot which is good because their healthy for her with. she is very hyper and jumpy with seperation anxiety. i wanted these to hel[p her out calm down a little bit. im not sure if they calm her down at all but she likes them. plus its a great price for 6 bags. These will last me a long time, even giving her 1-2 a day.
i've tried many kinds of treats and this one by far is the only one that won't cause my boston to have upset stomach!  and he loves it!!!!

column9: Dog will do anything for even a scrap of a piece
column10: Dry, clean, easy to pack up for a stroll.  I have a very small dog so I break these into little pieces for treats (and bribes). We have tried all kinds of other treats but these are his favorite and mine and seem to be a healthier and more natural addition to his diet than biscuits or other snacks.

We have used this product before so I was familiar with its results. The dogs, a Corgi and a Mastiff puppy, both love the strips.  I use them for treats, for training and carry them easily in my pocket when we are on the road. The fact that they are all natural is even more appealing.
My dog loves these treats, and I love that they're healthy, and not full of junk stuff. And I don't have to be as careful about rationing them. (Just wish they weren't made in China.)

On behalf of my dog, Fritz, these are really great!  It's really exciting when I hear that bag open!  From the human side, these are very natural, it is a good chewing activity for a short time, and he loves them!

We have been using Mellow Mut for several years for our slightly high-strung dogs. Best product ever for calming your pup that's a little ADD! Dogswell products are consistantly high-quality and well priced.
We bought this to give our dogs treat that would be healthy. They are kinda picky when it comes to treats but, this was a great hit. The bag is resealable to keep it fresh! A must for your dog.

column9: Great treat for all size dogs
column10: We have been buying this product from Amazon.com for some time now. We save money and their delivery service is great. My dog LOVES these things!  They really are nice pieces of chicken and I am thinkingthe chamomile really works at calming the dog.  We will be back!

My dogs love to have one of these at bedtime and since they sleep on the bed these taste so good there are no crumbs and the lavander keeps thier breath from being stinky for those sneaky "good night kisses"
My pug loves these treats. He gets so excited when I open the treat bin. I'm not sure if it makes him mellow... but I like to think they do. Plus they are healthy!
My female Yorkie loves this product.  Can not find in most stores so purchased from you.  Great price and good service.Thank you
My dogs love these treats. We run out of them very quickly.I haven't notice a big difference in their behavior but they sure do love them.

These are, by far, our 5 month old beagle's favorite treat.  We like that they are all natural and they are much cheaper to buy online than in the pet stores.  However, she gets so excited about them that they really don't mellow her out at all - they actually seem to have the opposite effect!  Still, a great product, and they smell good, unlike a lot of other dog treats.  Try putting them into Kong toys for a fun challenge for your dog (and good way to make them last longer!)

Our dogs love these chicken strips, unfortunately I cannot recommend them nor purchase them again. When given in the recommended amount (4 strips for our over 75lbs. dogs) all three dogs developed loose stool. I eliminated other treats in order to isolate the cause and unfortunately it is the mellow mut. I will continue the search for the perfect  calming treat...

column10: These are wonderful packaged jerky treats, with nothing questionable in them as far as I can tell.  I would rather be making my own jerky, but since I don't have the time, tools and space to do so, these are great. My doggy LOVES these jerky treats too!
My hyper terrier loves these treats...we dream that it will make him mellow...fat chance...but a girl can dream can't she?

column9: Do not feed your dog chicken jerky products
column10: My dog got really sick from eating this product.  Vomiting for days and had to take him to emergency room.  There have been 1000s documented cases of illness and death from chicken jerky products.  search for articles on this issue.  I can't believe this has not been recalled.  I'm glad i caught it before he got really sick, but there have been many documented cases of death now.  I don't want to see any more dogs get sick or die from these products.

column9: Great product - my dog is addicted!
column10: The "mellow mut" chicken breast strips are great for my dog - he loves them and they aren't full of artificial junk. Only one drawback: some of the strips are not consistent in size and this creates a problem for a little chihuahua mouth with few teeth; some of the strips are so thick he can't bite through them. I gave my 1 year old healthy dog one of these strips.  Within 12 hours, he began a bout of diarrhea that has now lasted 4 days; vomiting began last night.  We are on our way to the vet this morning -- I hope something can be done.  That chicken strip was the ONLY change in his regular diet, so I am certain that his illness is a result of this product.  I strongly suggest that you do not purchase this item.  It looks like some sort of high-quality, natural product, but I believe that's just marketing.  I have contacted the store at which I purchased the treats as well as the company.  I hope that the product is taken off the market and that no other dogs and owners have to go through the experience we've had with Mellow Mut chicken strips.

The product I ordered was fine; the price, vis-a-vis supermarket, was excellent! Delivery time, great.BUT what I ordered was a 6-units-for-the-price grocery thing. What I got was a single unit, NOT the 6.When I called about this, the mistake was corrected immediately, so that was good. And I got to keep the single unit I received FREE. That was nice.Still, you may have a picking-and-packing problem in the dog-treat division. Any ideas on how to avoid this? The order form doesn't supply any alert mechanism. SO I GUESS THE PICKER JUST HAS TO READ THE ORDER MORE CAREFULLY?
When I received this product (6 bags total) all of the treats were stale! They were hard as a rock - not soft like others I have bought in pet stores.  Very Very disappointed!

column9: MIO Sweet Tea is really good!
column10: My sister and I were out to lunch.  I drink ONLY unsweet tea, and she used to drink ONLY sweet tea. I ordered my unsweet and she ordered WATER.  I was shocked, but kept my mouth shut.  When the water was delivered, she popped open her little MIO sweet tea and squirted a bit in her water.  Then she told me to taste it!! That was it!! I was hooked!!This makes water wonderful! And no calories, and no caffeine, I can drink it all day and night!!I got some that day, and carry it in my purse, I have one at work, and at home by my coffee pot.  This stuff is great!!
"Fabulous!!! Flavorful!! Excellent product!". So much flavor in a little container. Can carry it in your pocket or purse! A little or a lot flavor......

I recently had heart surgery and was put on a blood thinner.  I was told I could no longer drink tea of any kind because it contains vitamin K and it cancels out the blood thinner.  I could form blood clots and experience many life threatening conditions.  I was so happy when I found MIO Sweet Tea.  It tastes very good and I can carry it with me where ever I go.  I hope they never discontinue making it, it has made me so happy.

I buy this for our work and it is only $12.99 per 2 lb bag at Costco and is available and every Costco I have ever been at! I've tried to buy other coffees that could be delivered (instead of me having to go to Costco every week to buy 6 bags)but these coffee fiends insist on the San Francisco Bay Coffee French Roast! Guess I will keep going to Costco.

I love this coffee!  I purchased it on sale at my local supermarket, thinking I'd give it a shot and then go back to my good old 8 o'clock bean.  Now, I'm almost sad I tried it because it makes my old standby pale in comparison.  The supermarket no longer sells the french roast, so I'm looking forward to the day when amazon carries it.  If you want a reliably delicious whole bean coffee, look no further, it's the closest thing to perfection out there for a pretty good price.Great job on your coffee, San Francisco Bay!

column9: One of thee best tasting Coffee's I've ever had...You can believe in me Mr. Bean
column10: Atten: All you Foldgers coffee drinkers out there this coffee is not for you it is way way out of your league..This coffee is best drank black to get the full flavor of this rich tasting coffee, in my opinion cream and sugar will ruin the taste a real coffee contasure is looking for out of a great cup of coffee...This is one of the best tasting coffee's I've ever had...This is definitely a Blue Ribbon First Place Coffee, bottom line a must try..( You will love it )... You can count on this coffee to put a smile on your face..From Mr. Bean

I read the reviews on Amazon about this coffee. I checked to see if COSTCO offered the San Francisco Bay Coffe and they did not. We decided to purchase this coffee brand for we have never tried it. Had some of it this A.M. and it is really good there is no acidic taste or bittnerness. It is a smooth rich aroma filled refreshing cup of coffee. It reminds me of KONA coffee(without the higher price). The package was delivered perfectly and quickly.
This is our favorite coffee.  The whole beans are still oily when you open the bag.  It has a great smell and wonderful taste.  It is not a bad price for the whole beans and the freshness you get.

column9: Can't beat the taste for the price!
column10: Half the price of starbucks/peets coffee and tastes just as good!I drink a ton of coffee,  use a french press and always fresh grind.  I'm always on the lookout for a good coffee that is not expensive (starbucks, etc. are way too high priced). I ran across this coffee at costco one day, and have been buying it ever since (about 2 years).There is some variability month to month (I go through a bag a month) and one month the coffee was not as oily,  and one month it was so oily it cloged my grinder.  The taste has not varied too much, and I have never been dissapointed with the taste for the price.  If I had the money to waste,  Peets Major Dickasons is a bit better than this coffee.This coffee is cheaper at costco, but if you add local sales tax, it's roughly the same as amazon's price.  I have not tried ordering this product from amazon as I buy it from costco near my house.The bag this coffee comes in is very heavy clear plastic and OK for reseal, however I prefer to store it in an air tight plastic container to keep the aroma fresher longer.Aroma on the coffee is very good.
This coffee is rich dark and full bodied. It's flavor is stimulating to the senses and I enjoy every cup. I am an avid coffee drinker and this brand is well worth the price compared to other brands.

I've been using this product for many years as I lived in Santa Cruz, Ca., then moved to the Adirondacks in NY state and have found it to be less (even w/shipping) vs. buying in the store here.  It is just as fresh as when I purchased in Ca.San Francisco Bay Coffee French Roast, Whole Bean, 2 Pound Bags (Pack of 2)

We like this coffee the best of the many we have tried on Amazon. Normally we buy it at Costco but found it here for about the same price, so ordered it and had it delivered to our door by Amazon! Nice full bodied flavor.

I shop at my military commissary and purchased this coffee during Christmas and loved it.  I paid $9.99 for one large bag.  I was wanting to buy more however the commissary ran out therefore I purchased it from Amazon.  I paid more but I did not care because I was looking forward to drinking this amazing coffee.  When it arrived I noticed the beans were darker than I recalled but figured it was my imagination, made a pot and was very disappointed, it did not taste as good as I remembered, still ok but no wow factor.  I  spoke with the manager of the commissary and asked if they could order more and they did.  When I saw it at the commissary I purchased a bag and compared the beans to the ones I purchased off Amazon, the beans WERE darker and had a shine to them, not the same as the bag I purchased from the commissary.  I made a pot and the coffee was excellent.  I don't get it, same company however it was better from the commissary and cost me $9.99 a bag.

column9: Hot diggity this is good coffee.
column10: Purchased at Costco.  I've been trying all sorts of coffee, all sorts of brewing methods, call it a quest. (Dunkin'Donuts brand coffee is so sour to me I need a donut's sweetness to offset!  Life is too short for that sort of thing.  Starbucks is a dang bitter cup...probably best as espresso.  Trader Joe's 100% Kona tastes like it was filtered through a dirt shirt!) Lately I've been using either french press or melitta paper pour-over.  Either way, San Francisco Bay by the Rogers Family Co. is some very, very good coffee.  It is a good french roast, chocolaty, low acidity and sugar/cream seems to mess up the wonderfully subtle flavor dance so I just drink it straight.  I've found very few competitors to this brand, especially in a bulk bag!

Our local Costcos stopped carrying this brand. I went online to try to find some. Ouch! Now $48 for 4 pounds. Guess we will do without. If price is no issue and you want excellent coffee, this is one of the best we have tried. It has a wonderful richness, smooth, non-bitter, all around excellent coffee. If I had to pay $12 a pound for coffee, I guess this is the one I would choose. But for now, I'll keep looking.

I & my husband really like this coffee. Multi-use either with the espresso machine or drip maker depending on the grindyou make. Only thing is the price offered by this vendor is a rip-off. Get it at COSTCO or get your local grocer to carry it. We highly recommend this coffee and it is well worth the effort to obtain it.Amazon isn't able to process my lower price findings.
I've enjoyed these since I was a small child, and lately they are impossible to find locally.  Amazon.com to the rescue!

So happy to finally find these in bags. Been to at least 10 stores, suddenly couldn't find them anywhere. I like that they are individually wrapped; also, the size of the candy is bigger than when you buy it in the roll. Will definitely buy more.

I bought these because I couldn't find them in any of the stores around where I live. My Grandma used to bring me Butter Rum Lifesavers all the time when I was a kid and I have fond memories of sneaking them in my mouth during church on Sunday. :)I enjoyed the product but my goodness, you get enough to feed 60 people! I recommend that you give bags out to your friends and family when you get them!

column9: I buy these for my mother
column10: Butterscotch (butter rum) lifesavers are hard to find in the stores (the individually wrapped ones), so I buy a case of these every so often for my elderly mother.  She likes to put a few in her purse and enjoys eating a few a day.  Because they are individually wrapped as well as sealed in the larger bag, they have a long shelf life.  I wish more stores would carry this flavor so I would not have to pay the shipping costs.  But it is for my mom.  What can I say?  :)
My wides favorite life saver flavor.  Can't find them where we live.  Was the perfect Valentine present
We are unable to find these lifesavers where we live and have purchased these delicious candies from Amazon in the past. They are the best!
This product provides a little taste of sweet without consuming an entire roll of candy.

I love the size of the candy and that it comes individually wrapped.  The flavor of Butter Rum is my absolute favorite. Having it shipped directly to my door is such a convenience. Thanks to Amazon for this service.

This delicious candy is not available in my area.  I was so glad to find I could order them by the case.  Then whenever I need just a small 'lifesaver', I can pop one in!!  I store them in a cool room upstairs and they are always ready to eat, they do not get sticky in the wrappers.
....what more can I say. My wife loves them soo much we buy them in bulk. Great deal though! Who could resist?

This candy is so delicious. I put 2 in my mouth at a time, they are just that good. I buy them by the case and share them with my family and friends. I try to suck on one without biting it, but it's so hard to do. Try it. It's so hard to do. Last time I purchased a case, I gave a co-worker 6-bags of them, and she ate them all in 2 months. My order should be here tomorrow. Can't wait. They are mouth watering, and the size of these are bigger, which makes it even better.
What can I say? Lifesavers Butter Rum is the Best!These are individually rapped, making it easy to carry a few in my pocket.

I forgot how good these tasted! I love butterscotch, but these Butter Rum candies are simply delish. I actually got them since I'm trying to stop smoking, and it helps to curb my cravings while giving my mouth something to do. It also keeps me from having to binge during the insane moment, and even shoves back my already-problematic sweet tooth. Compared to a candy bar, bowl of ice cream, or whatever else, I'll take the 60 calories of these per serving (4 pieces). Heck, one or two does the trick. The price is also great, considering how much a roll can cost on its own at the store compared to how much you get in a box with this purchase.
These are much larger than those in a roll, very fresh and priced right!  Thank you Amazon for having these treats available.
This may be my favorite tea ever! You can purchase at Wegman's but not sure if it's in stock all year long.

Stash Chamomile Herbal Tea is tea bags with dried, crushed chamomile flowers.Honestly, as far as I'm concerned, chamomile is chamomile.  I suppose that when you use loose flowers you get sediment in the cup and I have seen this happen with some brands of chamomile tea bags, these don't do that.I have also had organic chamomile (this isn't) but I can't taste the difference.Each bag is individually packaged and that is either good or bad depending on how and where you use it and if you are concerned about excessive packaging.If you like chamomile tea, this is a good choice.
Warning about these nut bars:  They are addictive!  A co-worker bought a box and now every afternoon I crave the wonderful salty sweetness of these delectable nutbars!  I must have another!!

This was a great deal.  We had priced them in single package and this is much better.The sweetness is overwhelming and the saltiness.  Just the right size.  One drawback --- they melt just like other candy bars.

I just love these nature valley bars. They satisfy both the sweet and salty cravings that one might have. I'm not one for eating much chocolate, but I do like peanut butter. Well, these are actually dipped in the natural butter of the peanut and the flavor is sensational! There also have less calories and fat than a regular candy bar so that is also a plus...
if you like peanuts these are great we use them to make homemade brittle it is awesome keep up the great work and fantastic price

column9: Little Bitz for your Little Ones
column10: I picked up these when the local pet store stopped carrying the thin bone shaped Little Bitz chicken and rawhide chews. The Beefeaters Little Bitz Small Round Chips are circular wafers of rawhide backing with a hard dried meaty topping. I was reluctant about getting these because they are about 1/4 of an inch thick though they don't seem to be more than an inch in diameter, and well I wasn't sure if it would be too big for my teacup's bite. My picky pooch seems to do ok with them though sometimes the cracking sounds she makes scares her but she cant get enough of these. I prefer the similar product by Beefeaters that are thinner less chunky. These are great for smaller breeds. But be warned they give my dog terrible gas. Only recommend these if you really love your fur babies and won't mind the smell.

PURCHASED AT AMAZON VERY BAD PRODUCT! TASTE LIKE VINAGAR WATER.DURKEE BUTTER FLAVORING.I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT TO ANYONE.VERY SORRY I WASTED MY MONEY ON THIS PRODUCT.CAN'T BELEIVE DURKEE PUT THEIR NAME ON THIS PRODUCT.

This is a good product! I bake a lot, and this is a great size for my needs. I received it on time and it was a pleasant transaction all together. The product is an old brand-- I have used for many years! Good experience with over all! Thanks Amazon!

I was looking for a vegan powder to add to smoothies. This looked interesting because the bag says "Add 1/2 - 1 cup water and mix", which seems simple enough. This mix is not good with just water (too thin), use unsweetened soy, almond, or coconut milk. It is too sweet to use with regular sweetened soy milk. I highly recommend the blender bottle, which is sold on Amazon, if you don't have a protein drink shaker. It's easy to add the mix, liquid, and just shake it up and go.This mix is really good in smoothies, to make a breakfast meal replacement before working out or just to start the day. Add water, a little bit of fresh fruit (1/2 mango, banana, or strawberries, work great), optional yogurt (fresh or frozen) and a few ice cubes and blend. It turns into a foamy and delicious tropical smoothie that is high protein, low fat, low sugar (only fructose), with lots of fiber. It's also very filling and will keep you full until lunch.The only downside is that it is expensive. The bag only makes 12 servings. It might be best to alternate this smoothie mix with a cheaper protein mix, if you use it daily.

column9: Best vegan protein shake out there.
column10: I've been hearing mixed reviews about the vega shakes. The WFHO reviews have particularly scared me a bit because I have read that the shakes can be a bit gritty and over powered with stevia. I heard these shakes were different so I decided to give in and try the Vega brand. I was really pleasantly surprised. Initially when I opened the package I saw it was green and smelled a little nutty/bland which didn't scare me but I thought it'd taste like hemp. I blended it with 8 oz of unsweetened almond milk and a few ice cubes. It was really good. Definitely a tropical smoothie. Adding liquid completely transformed it. It wasn't gritty at all. It kind of reminded me of a starburst chew. I wouldn't say this is something I would want on it's own as a go to comfort food, but I could definitely do this for my morning breakfast. Out of all of the vegan/vegetarian/raw food shakes that I have tried (I've tried a lot and have wasted a LOT of money), this is by far the best tasting one. I've heard great things about the vanilla and chocolate mixes also so I'll be trying those next.

I am a vegetarian, but I strive to be as vegan as possible everyday, but thus far that has proved to be way more difficult than just being vegetarian...for me at least.I was really nervous to try this due to the taste some of these shakes can have. Let's face it: They are usually disgusting. Some people can handle it NO PROBLEM. Others struggle with getting it down. Some of the healthiest things to eat or drink or not always the tastiest. LOLLet me just start by saying that this smoothie doesn't even SMELL bad.It holds true to its Tropical Citrus title & it really smells amazing.I mixed 2 tablespoons with 1 cup of Silk Vanilla Almond milk & just used the spoon to mix it up.It was DELICIOUS. I could not believe it.It was a little bit chunky, but very small chunks. I swirled it as I went & even the small chunks I drank didn't taste bad or gritty. Just dissolved in my mouth. I think I will invest in a thermos type thing to shake it in for next time, but it isn't necessary.I will be using this probably once a day, preferably in the morning, just as a drink, not a meal replacement.If you are skeptical, just give it a try! It really is SO delicious. & it is truly a great addition to a healthy diet! PLUS VEGAN! AND 65% RAW!

I like all the Vega smoothie mixes. I do buy all their shakes and their oil. I love healthy food so I do not mind the green, spirallina and suppliment taste that some of these products have. If you can't handle the strong taste of these you may still like all the smoothies because they are mild in the supliment flavor department. I drink mine with water or put some into a fruit and greens smoothie. It is raw, vegan and has all the good for you "extras" that you now wont have to take a pill for. And a good tip is if you find your smoothie too watery... just reduce whatever liquid you used.

I fell in love with this product when I first tried it at a health fair (my daughter drank 6 sample cups). We're not vegan (or even vegetarian), we just like the taste.  I don't find the product gritty and it dissolves pretty quickly in water.  However, it does settle some, so I have to swirl it while I drink, but it's no biggie! We drink the mix straight: we like it with just water and sometimes ice. The flavor is delicious, just a little bit sweet, but not too much.  It's perfect before and/or after a workout, or whenever I need a pick-me-up.

column9: Not too bad, a little gritty
column10: First glance at the ingredients and I wasn't able to find fruit in the ingredients (at least, the fruit displayed on the front of the package). The powder itself is green, and looks more like a vegetable powder than something "tropical" (it doesn't smell tropical either). However, once mixed with water...it tastes like a fruit drink, which is surprising. It's not too off-putting, and is a nice change from the regular vanilla or chocolate protein powder I get in the mornings and post-workout. My only real complaint is that it is a little gritty - no matter how much I shake, there's still a little bit of grit at the bottom of my blender bottle.

Just tried this for the first time. I added 2 tablespoons of lime juice, 1/2 cup water, ice cubes and a squirt of agave for a smoothie. Tastes fantastic. A little on the sweet side, so next time will try without agave. Definitely want to buy this in bulk.

I love this mix. The flavor is very good. It's mixes well in the glass shaker bottle I use.Sometimes I add a little chopped fruit and shake with water. Take the lid off and eat the fruit.So far I have only used water. It tastes mildly tropical and it's sweet enough for me with no after taste. I plan to try with juice or skim milk but am happy with it using just water. Too bad it's so expensive I can only use it for a treat. If the price was better I'd drink more. It does have green flecks in it as I can see them through the glass shaker. Not a problem as it feels good having something healthy to drink and start the day. I do have to say one grandson did not like it but he is used to sweet smoothies from a blender. I love this drink!

column9: Fabulous taste and convenient travel pack.
column10: I love Vega products and use their protein powder daily.For daily, I buy the larger containers but, for travel, I appreciate these convenient, easy to seal packs.

This drink tastes like it should not be as good for you as it is, and by the first glass I was absolutely hooked. I have the tropical tango flavor and I mix it with some frozen mango and black tea. Delicious!!! It gets me through my mornings.
This product is great! It is so easy to make a quick smoothie in the morning, just add water. Or you can always add it to some frozen fruit. I love it. It helps give me energy and fills me up.
I have had two or 3 shakes and it has a mild flavor. I like it compared to other smoothies i have tried. It doesnt have that funny after taste.

column9: There are only 4, not 6....FALSE ADVERTISING! and they are not delicious, just pretty.
column10: There are only 4, not six! If there were 6 and they are not delicious, just pretty,No stars for the false advertising that there are six.Oh, the chocolate is a low quality coating over a stale marshmellow with decorative candy bits on top, on top of that is a dab of white chocolate where there is a small pink jelly bean on top.If there were six I would have let it rest with one starfor taste in comparison to cost. They would be worth fifty cents each, at tops a dollar because they are a decoration, a stale, old candy turned into a decoration for a birthday or something similar, but not the $8 I paid for 6 and only got four...The packaging only fits four...so someone made a big mistake advertising it.

I am a big tea drinker and love loose herbal and organic teas. The Rishi Tea Loose Tea Infuser Basket came in a package of three. Perfect for home and work. I use the baskets several times everyday. I am thoroughly pleased with this product. A must have for serious tea drinkers.

Great iced tea and good hot tea, too! I use 5 bags in 1 quart hot water, let steep until cool, then add another quart of cool water. Makes a great refreshing iced tea - easy to drink and not too strong. Best of all, no caffeine so I don't get that buzz when I drink it in the evening. Only downside is that the price increases every time I buy it...

column9: Make Shaken Ice Tea Lemonade at Home
column10: Starbucks serves Shaken Ice Tea Lemonade made with Tazo Passion Tea and I developed a fondness for the tea but not the four dollar price tag. I figured out how to make it at home and bought the tea in bulk here at amazon for a very good price. For those interested in doing this at home, this is how I did it for a half gallon.Half Gallon Pitcher5 Tazo Passion Tea Bags3/4 Cup SugarJuice of 1 to 2 LemonsBoiling WaterCold WaterPlace 5 Tazo Tea Bags and sugar in half gallon pitcher. Add boiling water and fill pitcher 2/3rds to 3/4ers full. Allow to steep for an hour. Remove tea bags and juice lemons, adding lemon juice to taste in pitcher. Fill pitcher with cold water or ice cubes. Voila - a great refresher all year round.Tazo teas are generally wonderful, but the bright cheery red and fruity, citrus taste of the passion is really wonderful. Enjoy this lovely tea today. Caffeine free and tasty and I am a black tea lover so to rave about an herbal tea means it is truly exceptional.

column9: Pretty darn good hot and great iced!
column10: Tazo Teas is a relative newcomer to the tea market, having been founded in 1994 by Steve Smith. But, what Tazo lacks in history it makes up for in pure inventiveness!Among Tazo's many blends is Passion, a bold and flavorful mixture of hibiscus flowers, other tropical flavors, citric acid, orange peel, licorice root, cinnamon bark, rose hips, lemongrass, and red poppy. Brew it up, and you are rewarded with a bright red infusion, that has a tart and exciting taste.Now, this tea is definitely not for everyone. As you can tell from the ingredients, this tea is strong and decidedly on the tart side. When drunk hot, you probably will want to sweeten it with honey or moderate it with milk, or possibly both. But, when made into an iced tea, Passion really comes into its own - decidedly refreshing and thirst-quenching. Just what you need for a hot summer day!So, overall I would say that this is a pretty darn good hot tea, and a great iced tea. Buy some today!
LOVE Tazo Passion tea. It's hard to find in the stores, and at Starbucks is super expensive. Our shipment came quickly, and was WAY cheaper than in the stores.

Tazo's "Passion" iced tea has definitely turned me into a fan of hibiscus iced tea.  I have been using the Takeya 64 oz iced tea maker with one bag of Passion to make this iced tea and find the tea to be refreshing and healthy.  In my brew there is enough tart and just enough sweet and I've been drinking it almost every day since I got the tea and tea maker.  In fact, I was a bit worried I'd like it too much and get sick of it fast, so I picked up a box of Celestial's "Wild Berry Zinger" (first ingredient is hibiscus) for some variety and was pretty disappointed -- it tastes like a watered-down diet fruit punch drink.  Passion, on the other hand, is almost like the Mexican drink Jamaica (also made from hibiscus), except less sweet of course, and actually tastes like a real tea unlike Celestial's Zinger.How I brew the Passion:-Fill Takeya 64 ounce iced tea maker almost to the top with filtered water.-Add 2-3 tablespoons of lemon juice (or up to one lemon).-Add three tablespoons of Erythritol sweetener.-Add one bag of Passion iced tea to infuser and let cold brew overnight.

This is the best tea and the only tea my husband will drink. He adds lemon to it and it is terrific. I do wish they had it in a gallon concentrated formula where it would last longer for us.Received it quckly as I should. Will definetly order again.
This tea is so good and I have a hard time finding it for a good price. I love to buy it from Amazon and get the whole case and have plenty and at a fair price.

column9: A coffee substitute, and a perfect tea.
column10: This tea is a tea that will wake you up with its bold flavor, put you to sleep with its soothing smell, and make you happy just by drinking it.5 stars for Tazo and the great job it has done in filling the gap that has long been void.
i first tried this at a hotel and i lovvvvvvvvvvvve this tea, w/ a bit of sugar the favor is surpassed by none!
I could drink this all day; I do not even add sugar the natural flavors of the hibiscus flowers and the orange peel soothes me  ...I love this stuff!!!

Since I can't drink caffeine, I had to find something besides my usual coffee for these cold fall mornings. (Not a fan of decaf at all!) Tazo passion tea has completely hit the spot. I get it hot, or cold, with just a couple of packets of splenda, it is perfect either way.

column9: slightly tart bold herbal fantastic tasting iced tea
column10: Normally I hate yucky flowery herbs like hibiscus and rosehips in my tea (such as Celestial Seasonings Tea) but one day while at Starbuck's, I was sweating, heated and tired in hot weather and wanted an iced drink but not coffee and since I'm really a tea drinker, I tried their Tazo iced teas and they tasted SOOOOO good and invigorating with just the purrrrfect balance of just enough herbs but still letting your senses know it was still TEA and the fragrance/taste comes out boldly!! The heated tea is nicely turned immediately, boldly, vividly, red in color. I don't need to add much sweetener even as it's tart but its tartness gives it more taste.The only drawbacks are its high price (compared to other teas which is why I'm always waiting for a sale on them) and having to wait to heat the water and waiting to cool it down in the refrigerator (or quickly in the freezer).  It's true as another reviewer said that it's very strong in taste after just leaving it in hot water for a few seconds so the longer you leave it in, the stronger and bitter or more tart it becomes and you could really be frugal and only need a tea bag for a half gallon to a gallon of water.  Adding ice helps dilute the taste as well as cool the tea down fast and cold, but I like my iced tea strong so i can taste its full flavor, so I try never to add ice.It's a delight as an everyday iced tea as well as a great gift for a friend.

I drink this on the reg. It came quickly, well packaged, and I have enough to make a million passion tea lemonades. Don't leave it in the water too long, or else it will get a slightly bitter taste. The nice thing is that it's strong enough that you can use one bag more than once or make 20 ounces of tea and it is still a strong flavour.

I love this tea, which is why I bought what would otherwise be a ridiculous number of tea bags. Passion tea with a bit of honey or sugar is the perfect blend of tartness from hibiscus and a spot of sweetness. My favorite and much easier than brewing a whole pot of pure hibiscus flowers!

My friend had me try this tea.  I'm usually skeptical about things she wants you to try; however I took her up on this.  I added a little Blue Agave to it and it was the best tasting tea I had in a long time.  It tasted like Kool-Aid. Also, it made me think of eating grape Kool-Aid right out the package.  I definitely would buy Tazo Passion Herbal Infusion Tea, Caffeine Free, 20-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)and would recommend it to others.

I have been TRYING for years to get into drinking tea, as it's cheaper, healthier, and all that good stuff, but I HATE weak drinks, I'm a total Dr. Pepper addict, so I need something that can actually compete with it. I went to my friend's house and she had this and green tea... green tea is NOT my cup of tea (lol) it's just too weak, I I tried this one, and let it brew REALLY strong and put just a tiny bit of sugar, OH! It tasted like Koolaid! Hot Koolaid of course, but you can drink it hot or cold, I can't wait to get it in so I can try it with natural sweeteners like stevia leafs or agave. I'm finally a tea drinker!
This Tazo tea is my favorite herbal tea as it is full bodied and doesn't have that "tea made from weeds growing in my garden" taste.  It is delicious served hot or cold.

column9: One of the best no calorie sweeteners available
column10: I've tried pretty much all the no calorie and low calorie sugar substitutes available. None of them are perfect. Don't expect anything to taste exactly like sugar except sugar because there is nothing that tastes exactly like sugar except for sugar. That is a fact. The human taste buds, especially in certain individuals, are extremely sensitive to the various flavors each sweetener provides. Often sweeteners are compared to sugar, but in reality high calorie sugar substitutes like fructose even taste different from sugar. So please stop comparing other sweeteners to sugar, because only sugar tastes exactly like sugar, and attempting to find a sweetener with a different molecular structure that tastes exactly like sugar is impossible because the human taste buds can sense even the slightest difference in the molecular structure of the sweetener.Now with that said, there are today available many sweeteners each with their own positive and negative attributes. The number one sweetener in the world is sugar, and most people find sugar to be the best tasting sweetener. That's why it's number one. The low calorie alternatives include both natural sweeteners (erythritol, stevia, xylitol, lo han, etc.) and man-made sweeteners (nutrasweet, saccharine, splenda, etc.).This product is a mix of the three natural sweeteners erythritol, isomaltulose, and reb A (a sweetener extracted from stevia), as well as natural flavors to make the taste more like sugar.Erythritol is a great all natural low calorie sweetener on it's own, but it lacks depth, and imparts sort of a watery sweetness unless mixed with other sweeteners. It goes very well with stevia, and is commonly found mixed with stevia based sweeteners, as is the case in this product. The combination greatly enriches the sweetness of each of the two distinct sweeteners.Stevia normally contains stevioside, reb A (rebaudioside A), reb C (rebaudioside C), and dulcoside A. Of these, reb A is the most desirable, sweetest, and lacks the bitterness of the others. Most high quality stevia products contain mostly reb A. Reb A on it's own has a shallow but pleasant sweetness. It's a sharp sweetness and goes very well with other sweeteners that help broaden it's sweetness such as xylitol, erythritol, sugar, lo han, etc. The fact that PureVia only uses reb A from stevia means that it has none of the bitter aftertaste of some of the other popular stevia products available.Isomaltulose is a full calorie sweetener very similar to sugar but like erythritol and reb A it does not promote tooth decay. It's presence helps to give PureVia a richer full bodied sweetness.Ok, so those are the facts, but how does it actually stand up against the other sweeteners available? The taste is excellent. Most of the people I know who've tried it like it a lot. It has a flavor very similar to sugar, but like all other sweeteners out there, it has its own unique flavor. There is no bitter aftertaste or unnatural chemical taste present. It's sweetness is full bodied, not thin or watery. The manufacturers did a fantastic job of mixing the various sweeteners together to produce a rich full bodied sweetness. It has none of the drawbacks of most common stevia products (a thin flavor, bitter aftertaste), none of the drawbacks of erythritol (watery sweetness), and to top it off its all natural. What natural flavors are added are of course a trade secret, and these are partially responsible for PureVia's flavor being very similar to sugar.PureVia is simply one of the best sugar substitutes you can buy. There are a few others that are as good (such as NuStevia and Truvia), but each one has its own unique flavor. Not everyone is going to agree on which one is the best tasting because each person has their own taste preferences.I really like PureVia's individual tube packets better than those of most other products. They are easier to use. They are tubes rather than flat envelopes. This makes it much easier to dispense.One bit of advice, if you're very picky about a full bodied sweetness, no matter which sweetener you prefer, using more than one sweetener nearly always improves the flavor profile. For example, a mix of splenda, nutrasweet, and saccharine will give a more full bodied flavor than each one can alone. The same is true for the natural sweeteners. Sugar and fructose together give a richer taste when combined together. Stevia and lo han give a richer taste when combined together. In general, the more sweeteners you combine, the richer the taste. You can get a sweetness that is better than sugar alone by mixing different sweeteners together. Also keep in mind that natural low calorie sweeteners like stevia and lo han vary dramatically from one brand to another, with the more refined ones generally being the most expensive and best tasting.A combination I often use is saccharine mixed with a stevia based sweetener (such as PureVia, NuStevia, Sun Crystals, etc.). Saccharin was once thought to cause cancer in humans, but this is no longer believed to be true. Recent tests show it to be one of the safest manmade sugar substitutes available (far better for you than Splenda or Nutrasweet) and it is VERY CHEAP. I use a little bit, just enough to give the other sweetener a richer flavor. Saccharine has an off flavor that's unpleasant if too much is added, so I only add it as a booster. The other low calorie sweetener I'll sometimes add is all natural lo han (such as Lo Han Sweet, Sweet Sensation Natural Luo Han Guo Syrup, etc.). Lo han has a very unique taste, almost like brown sugar or honey. It's rather pricey so I'll use just a little bit. It greatly enhances the sweetness of other sweeteners. I avoid using splenda and nutrasweet because they are obviously very unhealthy. Splenda gives me stomach pains, and nutrasweet makes me feel drugged (driving on a nutrasweet drugged brain is dangerous), so I avoid those like the plague.Give this product a try. Only you will know if YOU like it or not. It is one of the best stevia based products you can buy. Because it uses only reb A from stevia, it doesn't have the infamous bitter taste of many other stevia products. Similar stevia based products with the same quality include NuStevia and Truvia. Sun Crystals is another new stevia based product that I like. It's stevia mixed with sugar, but the stevia extract is not pure reb A and therefore it has a slight aftertaste like Sweetleaf has, but I like it nonetheless.People who like stevia in general are likely going to love this product. People who've tried bad quality stevia in the past and were put off by the bitterness of a poor quality stevia product should give this product a shot. It's not truly a stevia product, because it only contains reb A, and none of the other sweeteners and compounds found in stevia that impart a bitter aftertaste. Reb A is a very decent sweetener, much better than the other sweeteners found in stevia. Most stevia products contain a mix of all the sweeteners found in stevia, plus other compounds present, which impart a bitter taste. Reb A is an isolated sweetener which doesn't taste the same as a full stevia extract. Much like how sugar doesn't taste like sugar cane or brown sugar. Pure reb A is more expensive than a common stevia extract, and so expect to pay a little more for it. The flavor of reb A is a lot better than a normal stevia extract, it's sort of like thin tasting sugar. Because PureVia contains two other sweeteners, and natural flavors, the taste is far better than reb A is alone. I really have to hand it to the manufacturers. They did a great job.

I made the change from regular sugar to Splenda some time ago. The saccharin and aspertame based sweetners seemed to have a lot of unanswered questions regarding long-term use. Along came Splenda which seemed to have all the right answers and it tasted much better.Recently a few negative murmurs have arisen regarding Splenda, so I thought what do I do now.A lot of folk had mentioned Stevia in the past & I tried it at that time, but the taste/aftertaste just did not work for me.Just the other day in the store I saw "Pure Via" and another similar rendition of a Stevia based sweetner. Tried the PV and so far can say that it does the job well. No funny aftertaste and still some of  the benefits of Stevia.I'll try the other Stevia based product & let you know.......

I have been highly averse to "sweeteners" ever since I was a kid watching my mom dump equal in her coffee in the 80's. To this day she still uses whatever fake stuff she can get her hands on. I don't like the taste of any of them, splenda, equal, sweet'n'low. ick. For that reason I've only used raw sugar or when I'm low on $$, white processed sugar just because it's not a bag of chemicals, and that's a plus in my book.Lately I've been hearing about the stevia based sweeteners, and figured it might be time to give it a try. Stevia has been a bit controversial, as it was banned in 1991 by the FDA(but isn't anymore) and now is ban in Europe and a few other locations. But the reasons for banning are vague and don't seem completely investigated, just that there was "pressure from the market" to stamp them as unsafe.It was important to me that it be natural, because I go as much organic/natural as possible. I knew I wouldn't be using a boat load of it, so I'm not concerned about the controversy. I compared a couple of the stevia based sweeteners in price at the grocery store and this was the 2nd brand I tried. Not bad at all, but I really liked Truvia a lot better then this one. My main reason was because it required about 1/2 a packet of truvia compared with a packet up to a packet and 1/2 of purevia to get my coffee where I like it(I used to do a tablespoon & 1/2 of sugar). So using less, making it last longer = more for the $ to me.From a picky taster to you though, this is worth giving a try. I'm not noticing a huge taste difference between this and my usual sugar, which is great. No after taste to speak of. I think people should try a couple of the stevia based brands to see which one suits them best, since everyone's taste buds are different.

I recently received a box of Pure Via sweetener to try and review from Viewpoints. I come from a family of dedicated Splenda users, so I was interested in trying the new product. I was initially impressed by the packaging, which gives a fresh, light vibe. My only complaint with the packaging is the state in which my sample was received. When I opened the box, Pure Via poured all over my counter. I inspected the box and all of the packages, but there were no tears or breaks in the packaging. I'm assuming, therefore, that the mess was from the packaging process, and not defective packaging.My parents and I each tried the product with food and solo. According to the package, each pouch is the equivalent of 2 Tbsp of sugar. My dad said he put a whole packet on a bowl of cereal and didn't think it sweetened his cereal very much. I put a packet in my cup of coffee, and I thought it did an alright job of sweetening. Typically I put 2 or 3 packets of Splenda in my coffee (I like really sweet coffee) and my coffee was fine for me with just one packet of Pure Via. Mom tried it in coffee and thought it did an alright job of sweetening.We also tried the sweetener solo. We each put some on our finger and tasted it. The general consensus was that it was sweet, but had a slightly strange taste to it. There isn't much of an aftertaste, which is a perk. My mom used the word "bitter" to describe what she thought the taste was, but I don't think it was strongly bitter. It certainly had a different taste from sugar, although I can't place it. This difference, however, was not as noticeable when the Pure Via was mixed into foods.All in all, I thought it was alright. I don't think my parents will convert over from Splenda, but I wouldn't discount it as an option in the future. It was sweet, and the fact that it's zero calories is a definite perk. I didn't think the flavor was very different from Splenda, and it sweetened my coffee just the way I like it. Like Splenda, it is much sweeter than standard sugar, so less is certainly more. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a sugar substitute!

I'm sure there is some reason this stuff is better than some other artificial sweetners, but I found the taste to be really nasty. It's bitter and leaves a bitter aftertaste. It does dissolve completely, but so what if it tastes terrible? I hav not tried Truvia but probably won't if it's the same basic stuff as this.

Yep, great little convenient packets of Stevia for sweetening.  My recommendation would be to use HALF of a packet at a time.  Using the whole packet in a 16 oz. coffee left a very bitter aftertaste.  Still, Stevia will sweeten your stuff without raising your insulin levels, so it's worth the trade-off.

column9: Not Sweet Unless One uses 3 times the amount
column10: I was happy to see another grocery store option for Stevia that seemed to be price a bit lower. My taste buds do not find it very sweet unless I use a lot more that plain stevia. The label says it measures cup for cup like sugar however I think one would need a 3:1 ratio on the sweetness scale.This was my first and last purchase of Pure Via. It may be my taste buds but I think it is a big rip off. - Dot

I'm trying to replace half of the white granulated sugar I use in my coffee(4 tsp) so I used 1 packet and 2 tsp sugar. It's almost intolerable though I can see how it might be fine compared to other non caloric sweeteners since I find all of them to be very bitter.When I first tried it, I kept adding more packets to make up for the bitterness but it doesn't help - makes it worse.I'm hoping the liquid form tastes better.

column9: It's ok, but a little bitter
column10: My heart becomes irregular when I eat sugar made from sugarcane, even the more refined types like demerara.  I decided to give this a try in my coffee, instead.  It's hard to imagine something being sweet and bitter, but that about sums up Purevia.  Not the best.  You can soften the bitter with a little honey, but I'm moving on.Stevia is probably behind Purevia's bitter taste, as it is a well-known complaint of that sweetener.  I'm going to try the main sweetener in Purevia, which is Erythrinol, a naturally occuring fruit sugar. The famous natural foods Dr., Dr. Weil, highly recommends it, not only for taste, but he believes it's one of the safer sugar substitutes.  Not much in the way of calories, doesn't cause tooth-decay, gastric disturbances are rare from it etc.  Sounds good.  You can buy it on Amazon in pure form, although one company got some bad reviews because they were selling Erythrinol that had a musty taste (the company was something forest).  I ordered mine from Now Foods.  Still waiting.  Good luck.Update:  I got my Erythrinol, and added about 4 spoonfuls to a cup of coffee, since it's only supposed to be 60-70% as sweet as sugar.  Very quickly, my stomach became upset, and it only took like 20 minutes for this sugar to liquify my entire intestinal track.  Not good.  Also, there is a decidely unpleasant effect in the throat that is hard to describe.  If you've ever had hard candy sweetened with xylitol, you may know what I mean...the feeling that you want to cough because of something chemical, or perhaps your eyes water a little etc.  The sweetness was fine, just didn't care for all of the effects.  It probably needs to be mixed with another sweetener, as it is in Purevia.Right now, I'm trying Splenda, and it's not too bad.  See how it sits.

I am not entirely sure what part of the plant PurVia uses, but I thought it the most reasonable explanation for the differences between the tastes (Truvia vs. PurVia).

column9: Excellent Product - Better than others with 5 star reviews

These beans come in a vacuum-sealed package to preserve freshness, and it works extremely well--all the beans that Beanilla sells are moist and plump with a wonderful texture and scent. There are multiple wonderful flavors that you can get from Beanilla, and Madagascar is one of the more deliciously exotic ones.I had never made my own vanilla extract before I ordered from Beanilla. Their customer service is superb, and one of their representatives told me by email how to make vanilla extract when I asked, and he also explained why one might want to make his/her own vanilla extract. When you make your own, you can be 100% sure exactly what has gone into the extract, which is not always the case with some types of vanilla extract that you buy pre-made. It is also cheaper and a lot of fun to make your own.Here is the technique for making vanilla extract spelled out in detail for anyone who has not tried it before, and I have uploaded photos demonstrating these steps:1. Assemble kitchen scissors, good quality vodka, a clean, dark-glass jar (I save all my empty vitamin jars), a funnel, a spoon, something to label the jar, such as a self-sticking label.2. Remove the beans from the package. Cut each bean lengthwise in half. Then cut the beans horizontally into pieces small enough to fit in the jar and easily be covered by vodka.3. Place the bean pieces in the jar.4. Pour 1/2 cup of vodka into the jar per every 3 beans (for 10 beans, it would be a little over 1-1/2 cup). Then tamp down the beans so that all bean parts are covered by the vodka.5. Put the lid on the jar and label the jar with this information: what kind of vanilla bean you used, the date, the amount of vodka you used in ounces (or whatever measure you prefer), and the number of beans you used, then place the jar in a cool, dry place like a kitchen cabinet (I put mine with my spices).6. Every week or so shake the jar.7. After 8 weeks, the vanilla extract is ready to use.
These are top quality beans - moist and supple. The customer service is great, and the shipping is ultra fast. I will definitely order from Beanilla again.
