I used to buy 100% natural fruit roll-ups at a local fruit market down the street from me. They were sold individually for like 65 cents apiece and were AMAZINGLY DELICIOUS. They were nothing like the fruit roll ups for kids you find in the grocery stores today. Those things are gross and have no resemblance whatsoever to a real fruit roll up. I used to literally buy like $50 worth at a time and would just eat one after another after another. In particular the Apricot and Strawberry flavors were just outstanding. Anyways, I went to the market one day and they had gone out of business. That was about 8-9 years ago. I tried finding a different store that carried them and to this day I have been unsuccessful. I tried finding them using the internet but unfortunately I just cant remember the name of the company to save my life. I just remember they were sold individually, were round and actually quite large in diameter, and they came attached to a piece of cellophane.I came across Stretch Island Leathers on Amazon just a few weeks ago and got extremely excited after reading the description as it sounded exactly like a fruit roll up, just presented differently. While a Fruit Roll-up is large and thin, The Fruit leather is small and thick. Anyways I immediately order a box of the strawberry and anxiously awaited its arrival. I received my shipment 2 days later and immediately ripped open the box and dug in. They were exactly what I was looking for and they were just as delicious as I remembered them to be. I would up eating one after another after another, just like I used to do, until I had a fairly large pile of wrappers sitting in front of me. I honestly cant even express how excited I really am. Not only did I find what I was looking for, I found it on Amazon which means I can buy them in large quantities for a very reasonable price. On top of that Amazon offers them on a subscription based service so I don't even have to trouble myself with re-ordering more.The bottom line - Stretch Island Leathers are OUTSTANDING and my hunt is finally over. If you are a big fruit lover than you simply have to give these a try. Of course these are not just for adults, in fact these are absolutely perfect for kids especially if your trying to cut down on the amount of junk food your kids eat. They are all natural and have no added sugar. For those that have dietary restrictions, they are also gluten free and dairy free. I honestly cannot give a higher recommendation!!5 Stars!!!

I initially wanted to make my own fruit leather but in a fit of impatience, purchased this brand. The only other fruit leather I had before this was the Archer's Farm brand (Target) and honestly, I felt like the taste and texture of Stretch Island did not measure up. After the disappointment began to settle in I started doing more research into the ingredients and process involved in making fruit leather and stumbled upon some eye-opening information. Most companies are trying to market their fruit leather as a healthy alternative to the sugar/corn syrup fruit snacks but in reality, there is little difference in the amount of sugar you are eating. When a product like fruit leather is produced commercially, it often contains fruit concentrates (Stretch Island is made almost entirely of concentrates). Knowing nothing about that process I researched it and found how fruit concentrates are made and how the process destroys nutritional value and dietary fiber that would be found in homemade (or a higher quality brand) fruit leather. While this may be a good alternative to someone who is eating a lot of junk food, people who are already health conscious should be aware that this is borderline junk and holds very little of the fruit's original vitamins or dietary fiber but ALL of the natural sugars. Yes, I know, fruits have a lot of sugars...but when I eat something made from fruit I want to eat all the nutritious parts too...not just the sugar left over after heavy processing.

I buy the pack of 30 from amazon, every 2 weeks. The price here is alot cheaper than the local grocery stores.
Great snack for little ones (and grown ups too)! Nothing but real fruit and tastes delicious. They are a quick boost of energy.
These were great.But I prefer softer, more moist, and sweeter.However, it was a nice treat and snack and enjoyable

column9: Not as good as Kettle Valley...
column10: I used to get the Gerber fruit strips for my kids, but they were so expensive for the dinky little strips so I got Kettle Valley.  I really liked the Kettle Valley bc it had actual strawberry seeds which tells me there are actually strawberries in them (as well as one full apple).  I thought I'd try these Island ones because they were cheaper...and I've found they lack quality too.  Instead of being berry colored like the picture mine were brown.  They tasted ok, but they weren't my favorite.  Looking at the label the only benefits it had was 4% of your DV vitamin C.  I'd say they are probably better for kids than the regular sugar packed fruit strips you find in the store, but I don't think they are really worth the advertised 1/2 serving of fruit.

I purchased these as an alternative to the Gerber fruit strips for my toddler.  The kid won't touch most fruit with a ten foot pole, but these he will eat, though not as easily as he eats the Gerber ones.While I appreciate that he does eat these strips, the individual plastic packages are difficult to get open.  If you open them slightly wrong (which happens about 50% of the time), they require scissors to get the plastic the rest of the way off.  These fruit leathers are also extremely sticky, which makes them less than ideal for a snack on the go.Overall, they are an acceptable alternative to the Gerber fruit strips but certainly not ideal.
My kids are very picky and these fruit strips are their favorite treat! Now my babies won't go near a Fruit Roll Up!:)
I love the fruit leather. Definitely will purchase again.Stretch Island Original Fruit Leather, Summer Strawberry, 0.5-Ounce Bars (Pack of 30)

Package arrived in about 10 days and was intact upon recieving it.  There was enough bars to last me about a month and was a great thing to snack on whenever I was away from the chow hall or on the road during convoys.

I had such high hopes based on the reviews.  The product is pretty good, not outstanding.  A quick peek at the ingredients shows the top two ingredients to be pear and apple puree, not strawberry.  I do commend the makers on the fact that all the sugar comes only from the fruit and there is nothing weird or hard to pronounce in the ingredients.  The texture is a bit like leather and the color is brown like leather.  (Maybe we got an old batch like some have complained of here.) We happened to get Target's organic version in a goodie bag from a party.  We preferred it and will be buying those in the future.  However, if your kids are eating fruit roll us...no question, these are better in every way.
I have trouble finding anything like these in the stores so I was happy to find them here!  They taste great and are a very good bargain.
All I have to say is that this has a TINY taste of strawberry and the texture is like if you put a piece of cardboard in your mouth.  Very dissapointed...

These are my favorite fruit leathers. I love this flavor as well as the mango. And they are so much better for you than the fruit roll-ups we ate as kids. They are soft and chewy, not hard like other reviewers have noted. They just received bad products.Until now, I was spending absolutely too much money on these at natural food stores and Albertsons. Unfortunately, our Costco does not sell these. Using Amazon's subscribe and save feature, I am getting them for a much better deal than I otherwise could. These are the perfect proportion for storing in your purse to tide you over when you are hungry and circumstances do not allow you to eat your next meal.For all those of you who are worried about receiving products close to their expiration date or products that are hard or inedible, I have read in other food reviews on Amazon that Amazon will replace the expired or inedible/hard products if you are not satisfied.

My son loves these snacks for lunch or car rides. I used to buy them at the grocery store in the organic section, but it's less expensive and more convenient to order them through Subscribe and Save. I have tried them as well and they are quite yummy.
This is a yummy snack that is organic and good for you.  I am a total sucker for fruit snacks and the fruit leather tastes more like fruit than any other fruit snack I've ever tasted.
I love these way more than the Gerber brand because my son would eat three or four of the smaller ones. These are perfect size for a snack and are just as healthy!

We've been geting Stretch Island fruit leathers for about 10 years and my kids love them and I don't have to feel guilty about letting them have them.  They accept them as genuine treats, not like the "healthy" treats you get from a health food store that taste like it's good for you.
First time trying this brand and I LOVE IT!  Will definitely be getting more!  Looking to try a few other flavors soon.
My teenage kids like these more than I do.  I find them a little boring for some reason, but they love them.

I love this product. I've been ordering it repeatedly for a couple of years. It's a great way to have my non-food-eating child enjoy fruit. It's also a good thing to have in the cupboard for when you're out of fruit and it's time to pack a school lunch.  Thanks for making this stuff!

My three year old was addicted to "fruit snacks" and I have been looking for a more nutritional replacement product. She really likes these fruit strips and I feel much better about the ingredients compared to the ingredients in traditional fruit snacks.
I bought these thinking that I got a really good deal but I think that you can get them cheaper at Costco. The convenience was nice but probably not worth another purchase.

First time trying these - caught them on sale from Amazon so thought I'd give them a try.  I'm always looking for treats that aren't loading with extra sugar & junk to feed my family.  We absolutely love these!  The day the box arrived I quickly ate 2 right away and my 23 month old son gobbled up a whole one by himself as well.  Even the husband likes them.  Can't wait to try more flavors!

My 6 year old loves these "treats" and that makes them a hit for us. This is a smooth, clean fruit leather that is very much like we used to make as kids. It has apple and pear juices added, but the strawberry really steals the show and it doesn't taste like Apple-strawberry at all.

I like the idea of giving my grandson a treat that he thinks is candy and he seems to really enjoy it.It is kind of brown looking and very soft and sticky so I was skeptical, (nothing like fruit roll-ups like I expected) but he ate every bite!The down side is the price..  I bought it when it was on special pricing, with auto ship but it was expensive to re-order so I cancelled auto-ship.  I would not buy on a regular basis just because of price.  It is now available at Costco as well.

We originally found these in the variety pack at costco and have loved them ever sense. They are 100% all natural fruit and have no artificial fillers or additives. Great flavor and I love that they are soft. Great snack for kids too!

I bought these for my daughter to take as a part of her lunch for school, and she loves them! In fact, we all do. They smell fantastic, they have an excellent chewy texture, and they taste great. These things are way better than fruit roll-ups  and are comparable to the organic fruit strips I sometimes buy at our local grocery store. I like that it comes in a package of 30; it's very convenient.

Strawberry is one of our favorite flavors of the fruit bars.  we choose these due to them being sugar-free and with natural ingredients.They are a convenient snack you can take anywhere and everywhere. However, they are a bit sticky so you  might need to wash your hands after.

Tastes great.  Good price.  I eat them after lunch when I'm craving something sweet.  Donuts and pastries mess up your diet, but these are great to get the sugar you crave in a low calorie treat.  I get them through subscribe and save, best way to go.
I love these, my kids love these! Even my most picky eater loves them and they are healthy! Will definitely be getting more! Great for school lunches or snacks on the go!

These are excellent tasting fruit strips.  I have eaten all the different flavors and while they are all good, the strawberry is by far the best.  Regardless of which flavor you buy, these are primarily made of apples and the apple taste is recognizable in each flavor.  They are only 70 calories and do fairly well at filling me up when I need a snack.  The box that the fruit strips come in is convenient for setting on the counter for easy "grab n' go".  The only negative to these is they are very sticky on one side (which is odd), and you need to watch how you unwrap and eat them or you end up with sticky fingers. Therefore, due to the sticky fingers, I have to take away a star.

column9: Bought them and really liked them !
column10: We haven't had this kind of item in our house in a long time, and I bought them for a snack for the family (okay, my husband & son) and tried to choose a flavor that they both would like.  I had them delivered to my office and a few of my coworkers also tried them.Long story short, they were SCRUMPTUOUS !!!

This fruit leather is made from 100% fruit (actually, it does have "natural strawberry flavor") and tastes great! Of the flavors I've tried, strawberry is my favorite with grape taking a close second. They make a great low calorie snack.

I bought these instead of getting more of the Gerber toddler fruit strips, thinking it'd be cheaper as well as more healthy.  Well, it is, and the product tastes great.  Very fruity, but not *sugary*, which is nice.  Think dehydrated fruit without cornsyrup. So, they're not quite as sweet as the Gerber ones, but only by a little bit.  However, it is much more "leathery" than I expected.  I have to cut the strips up for my small toddler to eat it, and it takes her some effort. She's still at an age where she likes to fill her mouth too much.  Also, one side has always been sticky when I remove it from the wrapper.  I have no idea why, but this has been the case for every strip thus far.  So, for travel, I'd say this may not work real well for small toddlers, and definitely wouldn't be good for car interiors.  At home?  It's easy enough to cut up.  At least I know it's all fruit, and American made.Overall, a good, healthy snack that is cheaper than buying the tiny gerber boxes, but beware it's chewiness for real little ones.

column9: Great option for a fruit roll up
column10: If you are looking for a yummy chewy treat I would suggest these summer strawberry treats.  Although these are not as sweet as "fruit roll ups"  these are much more healthy as its pretty much all fruit.  With no artificial flavors or sugars these make a great treat for just about everyone.  If you are trying to feed them to a child who enjoys fruit roll ups it may be a little tricky, however as an adult it was easy to make the switch.
These fruit leathers are not overly sweet.  Tast fruity enough tht you feel like you are eating fruit, not candy.  Feel good about passing them on as a quick snack.  These were tasty and fresh.
These things are really worth spending money for. My mom thinks so. This is a natural snack to die for.
these things are so great. my gf and i always eat them within 3 days of buying them. this is the best flavor of all of them.

I have been eating this stuff on and off for about 15 years.  I have always liked it, I had my husband try it and he liked it a lot too.  This is an easy snack to pack in a lunch.  When I bought it on Amazon, it was on sale and I was able to get it for about 1/3 to 1/2 as much as I generally pay for it when I buy it at the store.

I love these fruit leathers for my kids (and myself as well). I always make sure to keep a few in my purse for those moments in the grocery store or running errands that take too long. It is a great, tasty, healthy snack and my kids love them! During the school year they are a staple in my son's lunchbox. He doesn't like fresh fruit at school becasue of the mess so these are a perfect way to get a full serving of fruit. They are also great for picnics, ball games, or any other place that you need a portable snack!
Love this product. In my opinion, strawberry is the best Stretch Island flavor. Great taste!

I first purchased one of these at Safeway but because they were so expensive didn't buy again. I saw these on sale on amazon and bought a box. Great flavor but sadly my 3 year old granddaughter won't touch them. I swear she can sense things that are good for her! I will only buy more if i can get her to eat them.

I love the Stretch Island fruit Leathers!  I can fool good about giving my children a snack that is 100% fruit without added sugars.  They are great for the afterschool carpool!  They do make the kids fingers sticky so be sure to have them wipe them off when they are finished.

column9: Better than the fake stuff, but the organic version is way better
column10: These are a million times better for kids than Fruit Roll-ups, of course, but nobody should be eating Fruit Roll-ups.  Real fruit is much better for kids and much cheaper.We get these as treats for our kids and they do love them, but they are SMALL and the kids always want a dozen more.Also, strawberries are some of the most heavily doused fruits in terms of pesticides, so I always pay the little extra to get Stretch Island's organic fruit leather instead.  I'm disappointed Amazon doesn't carry those.

it's fruity. it's leathery... but is that really all you expect from your fruit leather? personally i like mine a little less leathery and a little more chewy. The fruit has also been 100% liquified before dehydration, so there is a weird, soylent-green like uniformness to the texture. I will stick to 365 (Whole Foods) brand for now.

Ugh! I really wanted to like these as I love Fruit Roll-Ups, yet wanted something healthy. Well, unfortunately ity wasn't meant to be; these straps are just awful, they have such a bizarre off-putting texture that it makes it possible to enjoy the taste. (Not that the taste is great either.) The name "Leather" is so apropos; this snack is seriously like chewing a belt, although I'm sure some belts have a better taste than these "fruit" bars.

column9: good flavor but not so great texture
column10: I always loved fruit leathers and growing up they were always a part of our snack cupboard (thanks to an aunt that was all about organic and healthy well before it became trendy to do so!) I usually stock up when I am at Trader Joe's but since I haven't made the trip there in months I needed to stock up again. I ordered these when they were on a Goldbox special and decided on the strawberry flavor due to the reviews. I did enjoy the taste of these but took issue with the texture. Too much moisture? or maybe because apples are used as the primary fruit base ? The bars remind me of semi-dried pears- slightly mealy and grainy. The true fruit leathers I am accostomed to have a wonderful chewy and sticky quality complete with the tiny seeds found in and on berries. These were an interesting shade of reddish/beige, and did not live up to the decription of a fruit "leather". Slightly gummy, easy to bite in to and chew- perhaps a Godsend for children or others with dental issues, but missed the mark for what I was looking for. Again- the flavor was nice even though the strawberries are a "flavor" more than the bar itself. Just be aware that if you are accostomed to homemade fruit leathers or similar store bought products that these are not the same.
These aren't our favorite flavor of stretch island snacks, but they are good and have less sugar than the typical fruit snacks. I wish they'd make them a little larger.

column9: Where did the REAL stuff go???
column10: If you like a hint of the past then this stuff is for you. All I can say is what a disappointment...The problem with these, Archer Farms and Kettle Valley are that all Fruit Leathers have become APPLE leathers with a smattering of the desired flavor in puree form. There used to be real pure fruit leathers made from the actual fruit (Apricot, Strawberry, etc) but for some reason they disappeared from the market about 10 years ago (last company I recall was 'Nature ...' something). I guess like everything else these days the emphesis is 'make it on the cheap' and forget the real quality.It's a shame if it's merely a cost decision, there's a bonafide market out there for the real thing even if it's a little more expensive.

I am a die hard Fruit Roll-up fan. So I decided to give these a try since they are all natural. I did NOT like the flavor or texture of this product. It was dry and does not have much flavor. Do not recommend. I am going back to Fruit Roll-ups permanently.

column9: Our twins love this one. With the subscription, the price is fair
column10: Both our twins love this one right from the start but it's not loaded with lentils (see ingredients below).  We introduced it when they were 7 months old and now they're 10 months.  I'm glad they are eating something green because we couldn't get them to eat the one with peas when we tried at 7 months, but we got them to eat the peas later at 9 months.Their favorite vegetable is sweet potato and we've also tried sweet potato with cinnamon. They love all the fruit varieties.I'm glad they love this one because lentils and brown rice form a complete protein, although a view of the ingredients shows that lentils is not one of the prime ingredients.This one also has carrots and I've heard all babies like carrots.  I don't know if they would like it without the carrots.  I haven't seen this one - lentils and brown rice - in our local stores, so I'm glad to get it here. Along with some others, we get this one with the subscription.  Of course, with twins one is forced to buy more in bulk and we're so busy that it's great to get these delivered.The packaging is excellent.  I've ordered an unbelievable number of cases of jars of different types and only had one jar arrive broken.Ingredients per label: Water, organic apples, organic carrots, organic brown rice, organic lentils, organic canola oil.This has 70 calories, 10% protein, 100% vitamin A, 4% vitamin C, 2% calcium and 4% iron.I'm informed that the daily intake percentage is based on an adult.

column9: Dessert to Them.  But is it Nutritional Enough?
column10: My twin 10-month old babies treat this one as dessert.  Their first Earth's Best jar they loved was straight sweet potatoes.  After water, sweet potatoes are the first ingredient in this one, followed by apricot puree.  That's dessert for them right there.  After that comes the chicken and then brown rice flour (not as good as brown rice though).This is a meal that babies around the age of mine are probably almost all going to love instantly.  Almost all babies love sweet potatoes for starters.  Add apricot puree and there's really not much one could do to discourage babies after that.  I recommend this flavor brand.Ingredients per label: Water, organic sweet potatoes, organic apricot puree, mechanically separated organic chicken, organic brown rice flour.The rice flour absorbed the water and gave it a real nice consistency, and the sweet potatoes gave it a nice color.Nutrition per label: 80 calories, 15% protein, 90% vitamin A, 2% vitamin C, 2% calcium and 6% iron.This one had the most vitamin A of all Earth's Best jars I've tried.  I've been informed that the percentage of daily needs met is based on an adult.

column9: Repeated deliveries of broken jars.  Great product though
column10: I liked getting this one for my twin 10-month olds because it has such interesting ingredients, particularly the zucchini and the garbanzo beans.  I like the fact that it's vegetarian yet I believe it has a complete protein since it also has brown rice.  This list of ingredients looks excellent and it's a green color naturally.The babies liked it.  They have liked everything that has carrots.I have the subscription for this one as I really like the ingredients and the fact that I'm giving the babies food that is naturally green.Ingredients per the label: Water, organic corn, organic zucchini, organic green beans, organic brown rice, organic carrots, organic garbanzo beans, organic canola oil.This has 70 calories, 8% protein, 40% vitamin A, 10% vitamin C, 2% calcium and 2% iron.  I've been informed that the percentage of daily needs met is based on an adult.

Baby loved this one, but as he has progressed I had to cut this one out because it is too runny and if I have to move the spoon quickly out of the way of his grabby hands, it is all over! I think they could use a little less water maybe a little more potato to make it more the consistency of the turkey dinner one.

Earth's Best Turkey Vegetable Dinner hits the spot with apples with turkey. You can add cranberries if you want to take it to the next level.  I just can't find non-sweetened and non-dried cranberries even at the better food stores.Apples, carrots and turkey taste good to my 10-month old growing twin girls.  Babies love carrots since they're sweet to their taste, so that made a great addition.  The whole barley flour absorbs the water to give it an acceptable consistency.The ingredients per the label: Water, organic apples, organic carrots, mechanically separated organic turkey, organic whole barley flour.In addition to 12% protein and 50% vitamin A, it has 6% calcium and 4% iron.I'm very pleased my babies like this food and are being introduced to so many foods through Earth's Best.  I've been informed that the percentage of daily needs met is based on an adult.

My little girl can't get enough of this! I like that it is organic and contains fruit, veggies, protein and grains in one tasty meal. I wish it came in larger portions since my 10 month old always wants 2 jars.
Its my daughter's favorite first and foremost.  For me I love that i can get lentils, there aren't many stage 2 or 3 vegetarian choices.

Wow, i am shocked to find clear plastic pieces in the jars. The other posters say they notified Earth's Best about this in August and they are still selling it without checking or recalling!! No more earth's best for my little guy. I am taking my business elsewhere and I am very sad that organic company is selling baby food with plastic and bpa in their jars. They gotta do better than this to get my business.

column9: My baby's favorite 2nd stage food so far and great for constipation!
column10: I like the Earth's Best baby food line because of the organic ingredients. Amazon has great prices (especially if you subscribe) and free delivery to your doorstop, which is convenient when you're a busy mom. My daughter doesn't like a lot of baby foods, but will eat this one. As other reviewers have stated, it's a bit runnier that other EB's stage 2 foods, so I add some oatmeal to it. It's also a bit bland, so I add a dash of cinnamon after heating it up. As an added bonus, it works wonders for her digestive tract! She had problems with constipation for about 2.5 months, sometimes going up to 10 days before we had to give her a suppository, and then I discovered that this food makes her poop every time (I also started giving her a sippy cup of water with meals and during the day to help with the fiber). I rated it 4 instead of 5 stars because the main ingredients are sweet potatoes and apricots rather than sweet potatoes and chicken. I wish there were more chicken in this so there was more protein.

This is my son's favorite dinner! Best of all it seems it has the best combo of protein (21%) , vitamin A (100%) and C (30%). It is runnier than most of their dinners which was a great start for solids with protein in it. Love love love this brand and flavor. I think I purchased 50 jars so far.

I don't know how everyone else got these broken, but when I received them they came wrapped in plastic and in bubble wrap, not a single jar was broken.  My son loves them and the price was great and I had no issues at all.
Would be a quality product if it weren't so thin. Nearly the consistency of soup. It just makes too much of a mess no matter how careful you try to be.

I would love to say that I have the time to make my son's food everyday. Its not the case. Honestly, I do make it most of the time, but some days, you just don't have the time/energy to get it all done. Enter this product. Before I bought this baby food, I read the reviews and all these people were saying that it has fruit in it, its like a dessert, yadda yadda yadda. The truth is, is that yes, it has a bit of fruit in it, but its not sweet at all. The fruit merely brings out the flavors naturally so that you don't have to add anything else. Its a great product to enter proteins into baby's diet. The consistency is smooth enough that if you wanted to add cereal  to it also, baby will not choke on it. I highly recommend.

column9: good for you but not best flavor
column10: We love earth's best organic baby food, but this is not the tastiest one. I've tried it myself and think it is pretty gross. But my daughter still eats it, just not with as much enthusiasm as other flavors. It's got a decent amount of protein, which is important for us as a vegetarian family.
Soft smooth texture - my little one devours this one...it is one of the best meat/veg dinners we have found!
My triplets will not eat this, eventhe one who will eat ANYTHING. The consistency is way too runny as well and does not stay on the spoon.

My baby LOVES sweet potatoes. I can essentially mix any food into sweet potatoes and he will eat them; which in this case could be a good or bad thing depending on what I wanted to mix in there... it was horribly runny, like spooning formula into his mouth. Ick.

column9: Great taste for a picky baby, but very thin compared to others
column10: My daughter was not a big fan of baby food, especially any with proteins, but she did LOVE this one! The flavor is just right, not too sweet or too savory, and doesn't have a strong chicken flavor. Almost like plain sweet potatoes but not as sharp, thus it's a very good first protein to offer, and good for picky eaters. My nephews and my niece also liked this flavor, so it's a pretty safe bet to keep on hand if you don't know a particular baby's preferences.Something I wish I had known was that it is quite a bit runnier than other Stage 2 Earth's Best, especially for having chicken. I added quite a bit of rice cereal to thicken it up after my daughter had gotten tired of the runny texture, and she liked that just fine, but it is an extra step. However the runnier texture makes it workable for younger babies or those with gagging/texture problems.
This is the only food my daughter will eat consistly. She really enjoys it. The packaging is great. Never had any broken (having ordered 4 times).

My son loves the rice and lentil jars.  It's not as liquid in consistency as the peas and brown rice jars.  I have it on order with subscribe and save + amazon mom and it always arrives nicely packaged.
I have twin girls, they both loved the Vegetable Turkey Dinner.  It was one of their favorite baby foods.  Great price.

column9: FOUND SHREDDED PLASTIC IN THE BABY FOOD!!!!
column10: I normally love Earth's Best products (as does my son). However, tonight after I'd given him half the jar I thought I would try some since it was a new flavor and I realized that there were little pieces or soft shredded plastic in it. I was appalled!  As this is my first child and I don't have any experience with this kind of thing, I called poison control. They said he would be ok and once I knew he was fine, I got really angry. I looked it up online and found that Earth's Best has actually known about the plastic for some time but are still selling it. Don't buy Earth's Best! Really disappointing.
My son really enjoys Earth's Best lentil!  He eats the entire jar for dinner and always wants more.  The product shipped very quickly.

column9: Meh.  My daughter eats most everything else... this isn't her thing.
column10: I introduced my daughter to Earth's Best Organic Turkey Vegetable Dinner at 4 months. A bit early, but she's advanced, as she was 6 weeks overdue.  She loved it at first.  But, I bought every other kind and now this is her least favorite.  I've tried some of it as well.  Of all of them, this is also my least favorite.

column9: Not as yummy as Earth's Best's other flavors
column10: We received this in a dinner variety pack and tried it for the first time today. I always try her baby foods to make sure they are the right temperature (I put them in a bowl and microwave for 6-9 seconds) and taste ok. When I tasted this, I made a face because it was so yucky! I added sweet potatoes and a dash of cinnamon. To her credit, my (8 month old) daughter ate some bites, but not nearly as enthusiastically as the other flavors. I like that it has a mixture of organic vegetables in it and beans for protein.
I love the fact that there is turkey being offered. This is my son's 2nd favorite dish. No issues with it and a good balance of nutrients.

column9: Had to toss 9 out of 12 jars
column10: Only three jars came in a form edible to babies.  The rest of them were filled will a clump of spongy mush that would not mix with the water.  It also had a brown color and not the yellowish brown like the jars that had the good mixture.Pretty disappointing and a waste of money.

This is one of my son's favorite baby foods.  It does have a bit of sweetness, but not too sweet.  It's more runny than some of the other flavors, so we use a deeper spoon with this one, or add a little rice cereal to thicken it up.
For whatever reason, our son really likes this flavor. I'm not a fan myself, but I'm not the one eating it. Any time I can get a variety of vegetables into my baby in one sitting, I'm a happy mom.

The Rice and Lentil dinner is our son's absolute favorite. I don't know why but he gobbles this up every time. He enjoys most of the Earth's Best foods and we have only found a couple he doesn't eat (anything with too much apple) which is more a personal taste issue than the brand or particular combination. Some of the varieties tend to be too runny but this one has a great consistency right out of the jar.

My 7-1/2 month old absolutely loves this one...by far, it is her favorite jarred baby food. I like it because the lentils add a bit more protein than your average baby food, and I'm not ready to introduce her to meats yet.I do subscribe & save, which brings the price down to $0.80/jar. That's a fair price - not an amazing deal, but roughly equivalent to sale prices at the grocery store.  The bigger issue is that this particular blend is hard to find - I have to go to Whole Foods. My regular grocery store and Target carry Earth's Best, but not this blend. My daughter likes it so much, though, that I would still buy even if the price were a bit higher than store prices. It's a good one!
I always try the food before I feed it to my daughter and this one is actually pretty good. My daughter LOVES it. She gets all excited when I make it for her

column9: the only jarred baby food my son ate
column10: From 6 month to 12 month, my son barely ate any solid food.  He was so picky.  We tried many different flavor from various brands and this was the only baby food that he'd actually finish the whole jar.  I didn't expect him to like this since it has very green vegetable scent to it, but I guessed it wrong.Now he is 18 month old and he is a pretty healthy eater.  His current favorite seems to be tofu, but he still loves corn, zucchini, brown rice and carrot which are the ingredients of this.  I highly recommend to try this baby food.Also, Earth's Best makes not only the best baby foods but their toddler foods are fabulous as well.  My son doesn't really like any snacks from Gerber brand, but he likes most of the products from Earth's Best.  Their foods taste great(even for us adult) and so good for you too.

column9: A little more watery than other 2nd foods for EB
column10: Little Baby Picky will only eat this sometimes. This one is more watery than the others, so keep that in mind. Reviewing baby food is objective since all children are different, so I hope letting you know the consistency and texture help.

This tastes so good that apparently our cat thinks so too -- he's constantly poking his furry face around every time we pop open one of these. There is absolutely nothing bad to say about these. I know some people have complained about the poor packaging but I believe that must've been fixed b/c I've not had any problems at all -- in fact, they securely bubble wrap these, then place them in an air-cushioned box and it all arrives perfectly every time.
I have 12 month olds and no time to write a great review, but they like all the flavors, the textures are great, and the jars open easily. Great on the go snack.

My son started eating this when he was around 8 months old; he's now 14 months old and it's one of his favorites. Let sit for overnight.  Next day when you are ready to begin cooking, you will pour off the water on fish and get a pot and once again place fish in pot with enough water to cover it and let it cook for ten minutes then pour off boiling water and putting tap water on the fish again.  Use this time to debone the fish and break it into small pieces taste fish to see if it is too salty to taste, if it is soak it in water for half an hour more or boil it for ten more minutes.  Be warned that salted cod fish shrinks when cooked.  If fish is  to your taste then you will need an onion sliced,three plum tomatoes or nine cherry tomatoes sliced drain water from fish, heat skillet  and add some cooking oil and saute onion and tomatoes then add fish and stir every thing together.  Add black pepper and then add a little water so as to make a little sauce.  You can tweak the taste by adding a little garlic to the mix, putting it in at the same time as onion and tomatoes. You can eat this cooked up fish with bread and pita chips or on a bed of steamed white rice.

Ghee is the shortening and frying oil of Indian cooking, butter that has been 'clarified' of its proteins and salts. It looks like and feels like soft lard, semi-liquid at room temperature. In comparison to butter, it scorches at a much higher frying-pan heat; thus instead of flavoring food with the typical French "brown butter" taste, it is relatively neutral but allows the essences of spices and seeds to be accentuated. A typical Indian recipe for lentils, for instance, will call for cooking the lentils in one pan and then lacing them with aromatic spices - fenugreek, cardamon, caraway, etc. - fried quickly in ghee.Chefs in big cities like Minneapolis, Seattle, or Sunnyvale will have ghee available in their neighborhood bazaars, along with rose-petal ice cream and fresh naan, but it's gratifying to find that ghee also is marketed on the internet. After all, so many of the computer geeks who keep America fed, informed, and entertained are immigrants from India.If you plan to substitute for ghee in your down-home Indian chow, DON'T use salted butter, olive oil, or soya oil. Canola oil is probably your best hope. Ghee has other uses that might appeal to Americans, by the way: skin-softening; skin scraping in lieu washing with soap, which is what the ancient Romans did; gun-stock polishing (if the British Raj had known the difference between ghee and tallow, they might have averted the Sepoy Mutiny); and, of particular value to Missourians, as a preservative top-layer for 'confit du vautour' and/or Geierpâté.
Good to find  this supplier of authentic Indian cooking supplies. Will use them again as I cannot usually find these ingredients in Floida stores.

column9: Delicate with a hint of vanilla
column10: To be wholly fair to the product, I feel compelled to disclose that I'm not usually a brewed coffee drinker these days, except for restaurant outings. The aroma of the grounds is pretty significant and I expected a similarly infused flavor in my cup; however, the vanilla came through as little more than a slight nudge. I actually would have preferred a more prevalent vanilla taste had I gone specifically for a vanilla-flavored coffee. But this facet of the blend might represent a positive point for certain other vanilla coffee lovers.Would I personally buy this product? If there were no such thing as Nescafe Clasico Instant Coffee, 7-Ounce Jars (Pack of 3) then I could say with some confidence that I would buy some intermittently. I'm limited for health reasons as to the amount of caffeinated coffee I can drink each day so I'm looking for a *plain old roadside diner coffee* experience most of the time -- for brewed coffee that would be either Yuban Original Ground Coffee, 12-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) or Maxwell House Original Roast (Medium) Ground Coffee, 11.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), and not a gourmet-type brand. If I were choosing a specific *Starbucks* blend for myself, it would be Starbucks Christmas Blend 100% Arabica Whole Bean Coffee (1.56 lb. bag) which I slightly prefer over the one under review here.However, I would not hesitate for a moment to serve the Starbucks Vanilla to either casual visitors or dinner guests, especially since the vanilla flavoring is so subtle. This is a quality product which I think many people will much enjoy.

column9: no matter what I do, it still taste bad
column10: Taste bitter, in a bad way, some coffee taste bitter but smooth, not this one.  A hint of vanilla flavor but no coffee aroma at all.  I tried a few different way to make the coffe and no matter what I do, it just taste bad.

I normally drink organic dark french roast coffee from Trader Joe's, so I wanted to try a vanilla flavored coffe. I liked the slight vanilla flavor this coffee had, but I did notice that it had a much more bitter flavor then my regular coffee, and I don't think that is something I can get used to drinking. I went right back to my organic french roast coffee.

This is an excellent coffee for drinkers like me who don't like an overwhelming vanilla flavor.  Some flavored coffees I have tried miss the mark and the additional flavoring covers up the coffee flavor.  This had just the right light vanilla flavor along with a nice, smooth coffee flavor.  If you are someone who likes a stronger flavor, this product might not be for you.  Personally, I really ejnoyed it and would recommend it.

it is definitely Coffee with Caffeine.. Taste like vanilla mixed with coffee but not as strong as vanilla syrup or anything..I honestly don't like this coffee, which is personal taste.the coffee is well ground, and the smell of it brewing is very nice, but not the taste of it!

column9: Not too bold, strong vanilla aroma
column10: This coffee was not quite as dark roasted as I'm used to for Starbucks, but for me, that was a good thing. Sometimes I feel like I'm drinking from an ashtray on their very dark roast.The vanilla taste (and smell) are more prominent than in many flavored coffees, which again, for me, was a good thing. Though not overwhelming, you definitely could tell this was a vanilla flavored coffee.Nice fresh/consistant flavor through the whole bag.

column9: About as good as bagged Starbucks can be made with a Mr Coffee
column10: We don't have your fancy schmancy coffee makers. We just have the basic, Mr Coffee with a 12-cup carafe. It's really impossible to duplicate the flavor you get at the coffee bars when basic home equipment. That said, this coffee emerged full, rich, strong and most importantly, without that nauseating taste some flavored coffees have. My daughter and I are both coffee lovers and were both pleased.

I drink Starbucks coffee at home each morning.  I like a strong bold cup and therefore usually brew the darker roasts.  I am not a huge fan of flavored creamers but on occaision I will get a vanilla flavored coffee at a bagel shop.  I was excited to see Starbucks new line of flavored coffees because I assumed the quality would be just as good as their regular coffees and that the premium price would provide a genuine good hint of vanilla flavor.  I was deeply dissappointed in the strong artificial vanilla smell and taste when I brewed this coffee.  I couldn't even drink it with my 1/2 & 1/2 in it. It was worse than any gas station flavored coffee or instant vanilla coffee beverage I have tried.  The aftertaste was terrible and I had to throw away the remaining coffee.

I'm a big fan of flavored coffee. Usually you have to buy a drink that has been flavored but they come with tons of sugar. If not sugar the sugar replacement is a bit to nauseating. I love how this brew has the perfect aroma of vanilla that takes over the house in the morning. Will always look for an amazon bargain on this product.

OK...I've never reviewed a coffee product. I stick with book reviews...but I drink a lot of coffee when I'm reading and reviewing books.  So...this one was special.  I made my first pot and upon smelling the coffee, I was hooked. How good is it? I haven't tossed the ground coffee package yet!  It's empty, but it still smells good and reminds me of those morning smiles and good books.  Way to go, Starbucks!
this product tastes great, just like the coffee you expect from your local starbucks.  pricing and packaging are also great.  makes for a wonderful gift.  eNjOy!!!

column9: Starbucks french roast+tsp. vanilla extract= fusions
column10: I gave this a try, as I enjoy flavored coffee from time to time, and I also enjoy the starbucks brand, especially their darker roasts.  In terms of it's roast, this did not disappoint, so for you milder coffee drinkers, this might be a bit bolder in flavor for you.  That said, the dark roast with the added vanilla flavor didn't seem to fuse so well for me.  Instead of both flavors working harmoniously, it was like dropping a dash of vanilla extract to my french roast in the morning.  One flavor, followed by the vanilla aftertaste.  My local store carries this at 11 oz, and a starbucks typical roast at 12 oz for pretty much the same price.  So we're talking an ounce difference price wise.  The fusions coffee comes only ground, so it doesn't work for the french press users, and I just wasn't impressed.  Not horrible, but not worth coming back for more.

column9: It's ok. . . but I like Eight O'Clock better
column10: This coffee is really ok. . . I know what to expect with Starbucks.  I know what I don't like . . and what I do like . . . . But I have to say, especially for the cost, I really like Eight O'Clock better.  If you really want more vanilla flavor, I think you should give it a try.Eight O'Clock Coffee, French Vanilla Ground, 11-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)

Absolutely did not like this flavor at all.  It's sweet without tasting good, and that's really the only way I can describe it.  Add a little sugar to it and it only gets worse.  So far not impressed with the Starbucks flavors.  Have also tried the cinnamon and didn't enjoy it, either.

This coffee smells good when brewing but there is no vanilla scent at all. We thought that would be a bad sign but when we tasted it, the coffee was very good, even served black. The vanilla taste is very subtle. I served this coffee to family and friends and everyone liked it. My daughter said it was very smooth and she liked that the vanilla taste was subtle.

Unpleasant aftertaste, I bought this hoping I would enjoy it. Amazon had a great price. But I find it leaves an unpleasant aftertaste that I can only describe as a "burning" feeling on the top of the back of my tongue. Would not buy again.

I hate flavored coffees for the most part. Not because I dont like a little flavor in my coffee but because most companies use flavored oils and inferior beans and are often very bitter. This caught my eye because the flavors are in their natural form ground with the coffee. I thought I would give it a shot and LOVE it. The coffee alone is a good quality coffee and the suttle vanilla flavor really comes out when you add a small amount of cream and sweetner. It's not my daily coffee but I always look forward to drinking it!
I wanted to try this product and i really liked it. what i liked even better was the price. Great quality and taste!

column9: bought it at a great price
column10: My husband likes the coffee and we bought it at a great price.  (Starbucks is normally pretty expensive coffee.)

I was worried the vanilla flavor would be too overpowering, but I was pleasantly surprised to taste it and it was just a nice subtle vanilla flavor. I like that it's pre-ground as well since I usually have little time in the morning and it's just one less step I have to worry about. I would highly recommend this product if you like your coffee with a hint of flavor!

column9: What A Way to Start a Morning!
column10: This tasty coffee will brighten any morning.  The coffee is a perfect mixture of vanilla and strong bean.  Worth its weight in gold...if only for the smell as it brews.

I am not necessarily a fan of Starbucks coffee, nor of flavored coffees, but I have to say that I found this particular coffee very smooth and the flavor was not the usual overpowering, cloying stuff that you usually get when you get a flavored coffee. I use about 7-8 scoops (note: varies with the size of your scoop, mine is about a tablespoon size when heaping, perhaps a touch more) for a 12 cup pot and get a very nice tasting/smelling pot of coffee. I can see having more of this coffee when the current bag is done. P-)

I'm not a big Starbucks fan...I think their beans taste burned and bitter.  That said, surprisingly, I really like this coffee.  It still has some of the strong, Starbucks coffee flavor that some really like, but it is nicely mellowed with the vanilla flavor.  The vanilla is not crazy strong, but if you don't like flavored coffee, you won't like this.  I found it to be a great morning coffee.  I drink it with half and half and like the smooth, creamy, vanilla taste.

column9: Great coffee even from a non coffee lover
column10: I am not a huge fan of coffee, however, this coffee is excellent.  The aroma while it is brewing is outstanding and it really delivers once you take a drink.  The vanilla flavor is strong, but not overpowering, the coffee has a nice full taste.  I have served this to a few friends and they all loved it as well.Highly recommend if you are looking for a nice flavored coffee!

column9: Smells like vanilla, tastes like vanilla
column10: The best thing about it is the smell - while I do like the smell of regular coffee, the combination of vanilla and coffee smells make it incredibly pleasant.While some flavored coffee can taste fake, or have virtually no taste (other than coffee) this one actually has a nice vanilla and coffee flavors mixed in - and they taste natural to boot.If you like coffee, and enjoy vanilla, you can't go wrong with this coffee.

This coffee was something we approached tentatively, since we do not like strongly flavored coffee.  However, the quality was consistent with Starbucks' other roasts, and the flavor was not too strong.  A soft, morning coffee.  Very nice.

I must say that i'm not a fan of regular Starbucks coffee at the stores.  I'm a coffee lover and must have one every each day.  Anyways, i thought giving this coffee a try.  I must admit, i'm not sure what they mean by "natural fusion", but it sure does taste good. It's nice and smooth with sutble taste of vanilla. I personally like bolder taste of coffee and this coffee seems more bold.

column9: I'm not really a coffee drinker, but it's good
column10: Well, let me start off, I'm not really a coffee drinker. I only drink it when I'm tired. So I thought this would be nice to try since it has a little bit of vanilla flavor in it to make it taste better. So I would have to say it taste pretty good for coffee, but if you're expecting it to take taste like vanilla Frapuccino, you will be disappointed :-) . It has a nice light flavor of vanilla in it to give your coffee a unique taste.

column9: The first flavored coffee we really like! Will buy again.
column10: I ordered this coffee at at good price, not for the name. But both my husband and I were surprised that we really did enjoy the flavor and aroma without noticing a bitter after-taste. We are by no means coffee experts, we just drink our morning cup to get us going. We've tried different brands and don't usually give much care either way, except for flavored coffees which we usually avoid due to bitterness. They always smell so nice, but the taste, yuck. So maybe there is something to the Starbucks brand, it was good coffee, and I'll have to try some other flavors to see if they stand up to our taste testing as well.I should note that we make our coffee using an aero press which helps in taking much of the bitter taste out of coffee and we usually drink our coffee with just skim milk.

column9: Good coffee with a small flavor boost
column10: The Starbucks Natural Fusions Ground Coffee, Vanilla Flavored is a very smooth tasting coffee.  There is a very small hint of vanilla flavor that did NOT have a chemical taste.  However, I would have preferred more of a vanilla flavoring as opposed to the minute amount in this coffee.  All in all, this is a good coffee that is not bitter.  I would recommend it to coffee drinkers but not to those who are looking for a burst of additional flavor.

While I do like Vanilla flavored coffee I really don't like it over powering. In fact I usually blend 1/2 regular with 1/2 flavored. Well much to my surprise I didn't have to blend this at all, in fact I really couldn't taste any vanilla at all. It is a great tasting coffee but I really wanted vanilla. Maybe that's why it was selling so cheaply.

column9: Coffee is fabulous without cream & sugar
column10: I purchased this in hopes that I could drink black coffee to cut the cream & sugar from my diet. It's fabulous!

I like me some Starbucks coffee.When it is on sale or I have a chance to pick it up when out with a friend, it is always a treat.  I was excited when I saw a deal featuring their new Natural Fusions Ground Coffee on Amazon.I placed my order and (because of Prime) got it in two days. The first thing I noticed was the intense vanilla smell. I could smell it through the bag. After opening the coffee and making a bit, I was expecting an almost over-powering vanilla taste, not the case.I could only taste a hint of vanilla in the coffee.  That was OK, but I was hoping for a bit more.  Over-all, it is a good tasting coffee that has a decent boldness. While I prefer non-flavored coffee, I will admit, this coffee tastes pretty good and makes a strong consideration for future purchases. Especially if I can get it on sale.

It has a nice smell when you open the package, but not all that much like coffee. More like Vanilla extract,it really is very lightly flavored compared to regular Starbucks, it could be called Starbucks lite. It has a very pleasent taste but weak. I think if you use a bit more than the usual amount it has a more powerful kick but still not Starbucks par. You can taste a slight Vanilla flavor still not nearly as strong as other flavored coffee I have tried, still very pleasent and tasty though. Not sure I would buy this varity for myself. I like mine a little stronger. If you like a weaker flavored coffee, then you will like this.

I got this for my hubby, who is the real coffee drinker around here.  The smell when it's brewing is so delicious.  It smells sweet and kind of caramel-ish.  The coffee is smooth, and the flavor is subtle but definitely there.  We brew it in a Keurig machine using the filter attachment.  Definitely worth repurchasing.

We enjoyed this coffee and its hint of vanilla taste. It was a decent drink though certainly not the best coffee we have consumed.it is ground fairly finely and has a coffee odor while it is brewing. It really is a satisfying cup of coffee but nothing to make me rush out and buy it!Overall, a decent coffee, worth trying out!

column4: Caonabo Javier Peguero "Long live and prosper"
column9: A taste of starbuck at home
column10: I was amazed to have the richness and aroma of starbucks cofee at home. If you follow the instructions you won't notice any difference from the coffe yu buy at the starbucks shops and this home made brew.Highly recommended for people that don't have the time to wait in line, have harsh climate in their area or, like in my case, that live out of the continental US.I also recommend this coffe for everyone that wants to enjoy life!

Starbucks coffee has a signature taste that my husband describes as "burnt beans".  This SB vanilla blend has the same subtle "burnt" aftertaste, with a hint of vanilla that is just right- not too faint and not too pronounced.  For those who don't usually care for flavored coffees, it might be a nice change.

I thought this was going to be garbage - I feared it would be harsh and watery and have that fake-vanilla flavor you get with these kinds of things.Not at all.  This was a nice mild vanilla flavored coffee.  Starbucks tends to be harsh and watery when brewed at home.  But this wasn't - I was impressed.  Everyone else really liked it too - raved about it, actually.

I thought this coffee would taste a lot better than it did.  Maybe it would taste better with an expensive brewer.  Mine is not the most expensive but far from being the least expensive.  I wouldn't buy this coffee; the Yuban I buy has a lot better taste.

column9: Nice product as flavored coffees go.
column10: First off, I think it's fair I mention that I'm not a big flavored-coffee fan. That said, I did enjoy this product more than I thought I would. I chose it as a change of pace over my usual dark roasted plain coffees. The vanilla flavoring is subtle, natural-tasting, and doesn't leave much of an after taste as many flavored coffees do. It's a lot more affordable on Amazon now, but when I received it, it was way over priced. Starbucks coffee is always over-priced (in my opinion) but this stuff was crazy expensive at first.Definitely recommended if you are a flavored coffee lover, and can get it at a fair price. I just ordered some of the cinnamon variety and can't wait to give it a taste, too.

When you first open the bag, the aroma is fantastic. I love vanilla more than chocolate so I thought this was going to be great, and I drink Starbucks all the time. I found however that the smell was better than the taste. Once I added sugar, it seemed to be better, but I normally don't add sugar in my coffee. It also seemed as though there was an odd aftertaste. The coffee was okay, but I think I'll stick with my regular Breakfast blend.

Yep, They've done it again.  Known for it's consistency, quality and boldness Starbucks company keeps pleasing me (and my taste buds) with every coffee variety.  Although I was a bit reluctant to try this "Flavored" coffee, it is done really well.  I was expecting sweet, but it is just coffee, bold, delightful coffee, infused with vanilla.  It produces a wonderful aroma when you wake up or works well when mixed with a liqueur for a dessert cocktail.

As coffee lovers know, it is sometimes hard to get the same flavor and consistency of brand names at home.  In the case of Starbucks Natural Fusions Ground Coffee this is NOT the case.  The coffee is just as good as what you'd get at their shop (though you do have to make it yourself) with a rich and fragrant vanilla taste. Following the recipe as listed, yields a great cup of coffee (which I have not always found to be the case when I purchase brand name coffee - I often have to "fiddle" with the guidelines to produce something close to what I get at their restaurant/shop).  The bag came very compressed and wrinkled and I was initially worried that this would impact its taste but we've made multiple cups since opening up the bag and each has been delicious and the bag itself does the usual job of keeping the product fresh (though I doubt we'll have it for long as good as it is).  If you like Starbucks and/or vanilla coffee, this is a product for you.

This ground coffee smells wonderful . The bag does keep it is fresh and it has a smell button and the vanilla scent is very nice, but the coffee itself isn't particularly vanilla. I wish the smell carried over to the flavor, but it didn't.

This coffee is just not for me; the vanilla gave the coffee an off-note I just didn't like.I tried.  I really did.  I brewed it a cup at a time, a pot at a time, by drip, Chemex, and French press.  Each and every time, it was a no go for me.For the record, I like my coffee strong and black.  I'm sure that if you add a lot of sugar and cream, this would be just fine.But for coffee purists, pass this one by.

This is a very smooth blend with such a light hint of vanilla that you might miss it if you weren't paying attention. You know its different but you don't know why ... and then it hits you. It's GOOD! Not overpowering like some flavored coffees; this one has just a hint of flavor and I think it makes it better.I brought this into work and shared it with colleagues; it quickly became one of our favorite blends. Not bitter at all, yet not weak at all either. A nice, smooth blend perfect for relaxing mornings as well as at work. I will be ordering more.

I'm not a huge fan of flavored coffees. I prefer to add vanilla syrup to regular (Verona) coffee. However, this was a nice change. The vanilla flavor wasn't overwhelming and it was a true vanilla-not perfumey or artificial. I still had to add a little sugar and a splash of cream to make it to my taste but I enjoyed it. The aroma when it was brewing was terrific.

I've tried lots of flavored coffees, and most taste artificial and eventually wear out their welcome. This one is great. It has just enough vanilla to be flavored, but not too much to overpower. This does brew up quite strong, almost as strong as espresso with one tablespoon coffee to one cup of water. However, it's great for my purposes. I've developed an addiction to adding it to warm milk and brown sugar for a vanilla and brown sugar latte (I froth my milk by shaking it up in a jar and microwaving it).  I bet I can't get it that way at Starbucks, but that's okay because I can make it at home just fine ... and cheaper.

I was really excited to try out this coffee since I thought it was going to be bursting with flavor, but unfortunately, I couldn't taste that it was flavored or at all, much less with vanilla.  Now, don't get me wrong, this is a really good-tasting coffee, but it just doesn't live up to its name, in my opinion.  Also, although one of the ingredients is a sweetener, I really didn't find that the coffee tasted significantly sweetened either.  Overall, it's still a pretty good coffee, but don't buy it expecting much vanilla flavor or sweetness because you will probably be disappointed.

Maybe the title above says it all.  A cup of Folger's is a perfectly fine cup of coffee but it's the Little League compared to Starbucks.  When we stop at a Starbucks' coffee shop, we know that we'll be paying a good deal more for the coffee -- but we're glad (?) to do so.  It's really fine coffee.  And so too with this 11-ounce package of ground coffee -- the price is more than a bit higher than the regular coffees.  And the taste, especially this one with the strong hint of vanilla, is better too.So treat yourself at home.  Buy the packaged ground Starbucks coffee and get that same great taste.

column9: Very good, but not quite great
column10: It's very difficult to review a product that is so strongly contingent upon personal taste. That being said, I rarely drink flavored coffees but do like them once in a while as a change of pace. When I drink these types of coffees, I prefer to flavoring to be light so that it does not overwhelm the natural coffee flavor. This product almost achieves that balance but the vanilla is just a bit too strong for my taste, hence only 4 stars. If you prefer the flavoring to be a little stronger than I do, then you will love this coffee. It's very robust and flavorful and it smells fantastic while brewing.

column4: Agatha Kristy "•The secret of getting a...
column10: I served this coffee to my guests on Thanksgiving and everyone LOVED it! It is not only a good flavor coffee but the accent notes of vanilla are just right. No bitterness to the coffee, light refreshing vanilla flavor all added up to a smooooth cup of coffee!This coffee was good enough to serve to guests, yet feel like an indulgent treat for yourself!

column9: so good i ordered more - subtle vanilla ground coffee
column10: Let me say that I'm a big fan of Starbucks fresh-brewed coffee, so it's a nice treat to have it at home too. From a pure coffee perspective, I really enjoyed the rich, medium-strength taste of this finely-ground coffee. It's not quite your local fresh-brewed, but still very good for my average drip coffee maker.Most flavored coffees just blow you over with aroma and flavor, so I find the subtlety  Starbucks Natural Fusions refreshing. But, if you're really looking for a vanilla-flavored coffee, you might want to look elsewhere - it's that subtle.Of course, the cost is more than your run-of-the-mill coffee in a plastic crate. But for me, the difference in taste and quality is worth it. I've ordered more!

column9: Hit or Miss is up to you
column10: Seems like many either love or hate this coffee. My Dad, GF and I have tried and and we all liked it.I liked the smell of it and didn't find it to be bitter.

column9: Very smooth.  Subtle is the key
column10: The nice thing about vanilla is that it is subtle.  Unlike other flavors often used in coffees (cinnamon, fall spices, etc.) vanilla is not meant to be a strong flavor.  It is truly their to compliment the coffee.  The vanilla flavor is very natural and takes the edge off the coffee.  The smoothness of the coffee does not overpower the vanilla, and the flavors do not seem to be competing for space on your palette.  I would recommend this coffee as an enjoyable break from your everyday blend.

column9: Do you like coffee, or only flavored coffee?
column10: I liked that this flavored coffee wasn't as synthetic tasting/smelling as what most flavored coffees would deliver. You could still taste the Starbucks coffee and I like that, but that's because I like regular coffee. If you're a flavored coffee drinker and you prefer the flavor over the coffee taste, this may not be the one for you.Since I do not typically drink flavored coffee the ingredient list still left me a little uneasy..although "natural"(which really has such a loose, if any, definition when used in labeling food)the ingredients were just things I was not used to seeing listed on a coffee package.They were, in order listed: Ground Coffee, Natural Flavor (with Corn Maltodextrin, Vegetable Glycerin), Ground Vanilla Beans, Indidan Sarsaparilla RootSo, more "natural flavor" than actual vanilla beans. Also, glad I checked before serving this coffee to a close friend of mine who has corn allergies.A plus I discovered while examining the bag, it says if you bring the empty bag in to one of the US Starbucks stores they'll exchange it for a free 12oz coffee (within 30days of the "best Before" date). :)

column9: Smooth pleasant flavor- better than VIA vanilla
column10: Generally I find that flavored coffees always seem to smell better than they taste.  It seems like the special flavor disappears once they are brewed.  And, I have to admit, I threw out the first pot I brewed of the Starbucks Natural Fusions Vanilla because it was too bland.  So when I made the next pot, I added an extra tablespoon of coffee and that made all the difference.  The vanilla scent is very natural and not perfume-y, and the vanilla flavor is nice, but not overpowering.  Add a little milk and sugar and it's a special treat.  I much prefer this to the VIA vanilla packets which, although more convenient, are too strong-flavored and too sweet for me.Bottom line: if you like flavored coffee that is subtle, but well-balanced, this is a good one to purchase.  Just be prepared to add an extra tablespoon or so when you make it.

This is a bit stronger than other vanilla coffees that I enjoy such as New England.  Depending upon your taste, you can enjoy a stronger brew or reduce the amount of coffee you use. I simply use a bit less coffee.  I was skeptical about this coffee as I find Starbucks coffee at the local stores has a burnt taste to it lately and I avoid their coffee in general.  This is a nice rich coffee and there is no hint of burnt coffee flavor.

Subtle vanilla flavor if you don't like your coffee too heavily flavored. My husband, who usually doesn't care for "regular" Starbucks (unlike me) did like this coffee. I actually switched his out (Duncan Donuts) and he noticed it was different but said he really enjoyed it. As for me, I really prefer this to the VIA style with the sugar added, this is much more robust and stands well in an expresso. Nice product, I may give it as a gift for my coffee buddies!

I hope I don't offend but I am not a regular visitor to Starbucks.  It is not because I don't like them but it is because I usually have my coffee at home.  Their product is actually pretty good from the few times I have been to one of their stores.  This product ranks high on my list of prepackaged coffees.  Light as I like it, but very flavorful, it is a nice way to start the day.  Don't shy away from it because it has a "chain restaurant" brand, it is actually pretty good.

column9: Vanilla? or Hazelnut? Good coffee, either way.
column10: I admit, I'm not a huge Starbucks coffee fan (yes, there are those of out there who aren't), but I do enjoy flavored coffees, so looked forward to trying this Natural Fusions Vanilla-Flavored Ground Coffee from Starbucks. I thoroughly enjoyed the coffee, but I do question whether it is actually "vanilla" flavored or hazelnut. It tasted no different from the Hazelnut coffees I buy, and I didn't get a sense of vanilla from it at all. That aside, the coffee was robust and had a natural taste to it. Measurements for my coffee maker were the same as regular coffee, which is a positive since I often have flavored coffees that require extra coffee to get a deep coffee flavor. I did not rate this coffee 5 star because the flavoring was so deep that it actually flavored my thermal carafe, and that flavor stayed for 5 or 6 more pots of "regular" coffee, despite being washed out thoroughly after each use. Overall, I think hazelnut coffee lovers will love this coffee, though vanilla coffee lovers might be surprised at the hazelnut flavor! Good coffee and I will buy more for those nights when a special cup of coffee is just right.

Ok, so I think this is a great coffee for people who like strong coffee. Me, I'm more of a "McDonalds" type coffee drinker because I have found it to be a weak coffee, which is perfect for me. I wanted to try this Starbucks vanilla because I like the smell of vanilla. So I brewed it at home, and drank a bit. Personally, it was too strong for me, though the vanilla flavor was subtle and a nice touch. I added more milk than usual, and that seemed to help.Am I giving up my McDonalds coffee? No, but that's no fault of the Starbucks vanilla. I prefer my coffee less strong, that's just me!

I often will add a teaspoon of sugar-free vanilla syrup to my coffee so I was excited to try this vanilla flavored coffee from Starbucks.  Like most Starbucks coffees this one is very strong and robust, but the hint of vanilla actually helps to cut some of the bitterness.  The vanilla isn't overwhelming and does not leave that unpleasant toothpaste-like aftertaste that some flavored coffees do.  I found that I didn't need to add as much sugar or cream. Overall I was pleasantly surprised and found this more drinkable than Starbucks' traditional or non-flavored blends.

This coffee opens up with a vanilla cookie odor and brews up the same. If you like your coffee to taste like coffee this is probably not for you. If you tend to use vanilla creamer that is what it tastes like but for me to drink it I have to add sugar because the vanilla has a bitter flavor, same as when you use vanilla in cooking.So in the end for me I doubt I would get it again because I don't like adding sweeteners to my coffee, it really is going to be personal choice so maybe go to a Starbuck's and ask them to brew you a cup before buying. One nice touch is you can take the empty bag into a Starbuck's and get a free coffee.

With a lot of flavored coffee I find that the smell is better than the taste and that after a few sips I'm very tired of the flavor.  Not so with this coffee.  The vanilla is perfect.  The coffee isn't like most Starbucks coffees (where it is strong and a bit burnt).  I would recommend this coffee for people who aren't really into flavored coffee but want to take a walk on the wild side of coffees.  Perfect for the holidays as well.

column9: Did Starbucks forget a Key Ingredient?
column10: I was never a coffee drinker in the past. The bitter and often foul flavor of ordinary coffee was not to my liking and, other than the often-needed boost from the caffeine, I could see no reason to indulge in something with such a nasty flavor.My opinion changed with the invention of flavored and higher quality coffees and as a result of this change, coffee is part of my regular drinking routine. Starbucks is one of the pioneers in leading these changes and when I heard about this, Starbucks Natural Fushions ground coffee with vanilla flavor, I was anxious to sample. Starbucks makes this product using natural vanilla which, combined with quality coffee, sounded like a successful culinary marriage.So, how does this coffee measure up? Well, it certainly has a very pleasant aroma that whets the appetite and I doubt anyone would dislike this aspect of the product. The problem is, unfortunately, the taste itself. I was expecting something much more vanilla- like in flavor but the flavor is instead a little harsh, roasty, and contains only a touch of vanilla. How Starbucks managed to produce such an aromatic product that tastes so different, I am not sure.However, this isn't to say the product is bad. I find it decent as a general coffee for everyday consumption. I also like that Starbucks encourages recycling by offering a free cup of coffee if consumers bring the empty bag to a nearby Starbucks location. The coffee is responsibly grown and ethically traded, too, as indicated by the Starbucks Shared Planet symbol. However, the bottom- line is taste and based on the lack of real vanilla flavor, like I was expecting, I can give this product only an average rating overall.

I love Starbucks, but had never tried their ground coffee so I thought I'd give their Vanilla coffee a try. It wasn't quite the same as grabbing a latte at one of their stores, but it was pretty darn good overall. There wasn't as much of a strong vanilla taste as I was expecting, in fact the vanilla was very subtle.It was smooth and rich. Very good coffee and worth the splurge - especially on a cold winters day.

This is a medium roast coffee with a lovely vanilla flavor.  I don't like strong flavors and this one isn't too bad, had the vanilla been a tad lighter I would have gone 5 stars.  However, the coffee does come through and I would buy it again.  My husband who does not like flavored coffees at all (but does love Starbucks)gave it a try and said it wasn't too bad (which is about as good as anything gets from him).  I do recommend it.

column9: a bag of coffee doesn't need 300 reviews....
column10: This one is pretty good and a good deal especially with the Amazon promotion going on right now.  I use it with my Keurig coffee maker and it's so much nicer than some of the expensive k-cups I purchased.  I can taste the vanilla just fine and it's enough vanilla for me.  Not artificial tasting, just a nice hint of flavor, very smooth.  That's how I like my coffee so this is a good buy for me.  A warning to those who are single...this is ground coffee so buying a lot at a time may not be a good idea.  My 2-pack both expire in May 2011 and at only one cup a day, I may not finish it by then.  So I'm storing the extra bag in the freezer.

column9: "Understated" is, in fact, what the vanilla is.  Good description, Starbucks!
column10: From a coffee standpoint, I thought this wasn't bad.  If you drink Starbucks coffee regularly, it'll taste just fine.  (For those with more refined tastes, I imagine this won't go over quite as well.)  It's definitely a step up from the Folger's and Maxwell's provided at my work.That said, where's the vanilla?  I could barely taste it!  When I tried using more coffee to increase the flavor, the resulting brew was too bitter.  Milk and sugar did nothing to enhance the vanilla flavor.

column9: Great coffee underneath vanilla alcohol aftertaste
column10: The title of this review says it all. There is a great depth of flavor and full robust coffee under a somewhat annoying aftertaste of cheap vanilla extract. I brewed it according to package directions, measuring everything exactly. I figured I could adjust and go from there. The coffee itself is deep, dark, and very robust - just the way I like it. I simply cannot stand what many people like, the common watered-down breakfast or house blends - yuk. I do like an occasional flavored coffee if done right. This time, however, Starbucks simply ruined the concept with that hideous alcohol after bite. If I brew with less coffee, I lose the delicious robustness of the star - the coffee. I wish I knew which bean blend they used as a base. I would buy that on it's own. I won't be purchasing this vanilla fusion any time soon. I may try the cinnamon one next.

I anticipated the arrival of this product, but was quite disappointed when I tried it.  Althought a milder version of most of the Starbucks coffees, I couldn't taste a vanilla flavor in it.  There is barely a vanilla scent when you put your nose in the bag.  I wouldn't try another bag.

column9: Good but could be more vanilla-y
column10: The coffee is smooth and very good, but I would expect more vanilla flavor from coffee that is labeled as such. It's a very light vanilla taste that I think should be amped up a little bit more! Regardless, it's still good coffee.

Though I prefer my coffee plain, bold and with cream (My Starbuck's favorites are Pike's Place and Verona.) I was intrigued by Starbucks new offerings...naturally infused flavored coffee.Starbucks vanilla infusion is a flavorful marriage of both decent coffee and fresh vanilla flavor. Not as bold as Pike's but still bold enough to deliver the coffee flavor I need in the morning to jumpstart my day. The vanilla is strong enough that I didn't wonder what the flavor was supposed to be. It is definitely vanilla but without a cloying fake taste. It makes for a perfect companion to dessert or as a mid-afternoon pick-me-up.I think those who love flavored coffees and especially those who want those flavored coffees to be natural should find much to like in the new Starbuck's fusions.
