Dried peaches ordered from nutricity.com via Amazon. Taste was not recognizable as peaches. Smell was vile. An unfortunate waste - at some point in the process they were actually edible peaches, I think. I thought of the local food bank, but then thought better of it. Tossed in the trash.Bulk Dried Fruit, Peaches, Unsulphured, 5 Lbs

I like them for me should be 3.5 stars, though the cashews should be salted more. Can't really taste the cashews and overall has a buttery taste... Others in my family would rate it lower and described it as bland.

These were on sale and I didn't have really high expectations, but they turned out to be great!  Everyone in the family is enjoying them.  I mix them with dried fruits for lunches.  Would purchase again.

column9: for true dark chocolate lovers only
column10: This sure isn't for milk chocolate lovers!  Just one leaf suffices my cravings!!!  (well, for a while anyways)

column9: Easy, delicious ... like a pound cake
column10: This mix has become a cupboard staple for us.  I make birthday cakes with this mix sweetened with Agave nectar that are so good they have my husband talking about me opening up a Gluten Free Bakery!  I have served this cake to cousins, grandma, aunts and uncles and friends from school.  They all raved.  I also use this mix to make muffins - I add an extra teaspoon of baking powder, a little more milk and a mashed up banana and frozen blueberries.  My nephew (who is also gluten intolerant) loved them so much he asked me to make a batch and ship them to him!
Nice and strong with the raw ginger still in it. Superb summer drink on the rocks!!But it's wayy to spendy online...I can get them for 7$/4 bottles in Rapid City, SD.

Just logged onto Amazon searching specifically for Ginger People Ginger Beer, since no local stores carry it. Like the previous reviewers, I've tried many different brands of ginger beer, and this one's my hands-down favorite - sharp, with a clean, strong ginger-y taste and tiny ginger particles that settle to the bottom to give the last swallow a little final punch. In my household, it's the clear winner.

Have to agree with other poster.Although I have enjoyed ginger beers for most of my life, this is the worst one I've encountered.  It has a nice initial "bite", followed by an extremely medicine-y aftertaste leading to an unpleasant finish.I tried more than one to give it a fair trial: with food, by itself, etc.  On the final try, I had just come in from working outdoors on a very hot day, took a big swig and was surprised to discover LARGE PARTICLES in the beverage that seemed to be a cross between tapioca pearls and orange pulp.  (The first three bottles I tried didn't have them.)Needless to say, the rest of the beer went down the sink.

I've been a ginger beer fan for years and have had a number of Jamaican, Bermudian, British and American varieties.  This is, without question, the worst tasting ginger beer EVER!  I really tried to give this a fair shot in case I had gotten a bad bottle or perhaps tried it with the wrong food.  But of the 3-4 times that I tried it, I couldn't even finish a bottle.  Seriously, this makes Reed's seem good by comparison and that stuff is pretty bad too.  If your'e looking for real ginger beer, look elsewhere!Now please excuse me while I go try to get the taste of this swill out of my mouth.

column9: Love the product, but the title is false advertising!  (says the cans are 12 oz, when they're only 8 oz.)
column10: I love this stuff, but it would be nice if the product was as advertised.  I bought it thinking that I was going to get 12oz cans like it shows in the description.  Instead, when I received it, the cans were only 8oz.  Someone needs to fix the error!

My 9yo loves this in her lunchbox..... at that age anytime I can get a veggie and a fruit in her withot a battle is win/win. First time buying grocery item from Amazon. Can't find this flavor at 3 local stores in my area so I'm buying here.... Side note... I'm pretty sure these are 8oz cans not 12oz. I'll repost if I'm wrong.

It does not have added sugar - it comes naturally. But... it's too sweet. Other flavors are not sweet as this one.You'll see that it has much more sugar than the other flavors (again: naturally... but it's still a lot and tastes too sweet).For information: 30g of sugar in one single can!

I love all the V8 Fusion flavors. It's so great to find them in cans. The perfect way to make sure you are getting a serving of fruits and vegetables. Also cheaper to buy them in bulk on Amazon then to buy the packs individually at the grocery store. Always go for the ones with prime shipping though other wise you end up paying double or triple what they are worth.

We ordered the rock candy in purple and in green for a bridal shower.  We used them to accent a themed beverage - - everyone loved it, they looked very nice and it was a hit!  The candy arrived in perfect condition!

column9: Absolutely delicious ... but watch out for the maltitol.
column10: Although the texture and flavor of this product are fantastic, Smucker's Sugar Free Hot Fudge Topping is loaded with maltitol, an ingredient that turns your intestines into a nuclear holocaust. Seriously, my husband has forbidden me from ever eating this again and I had to throw out the last three jars in the pantry. I wish manufacturers of sugar free products would find another sweetener to use. This stuff's deadly.

column9: Great cat food! All natural with wonderful ingrediants!
column10: Love this cat food and so does my cat!  It's all natural and healthy with none of the bad additives that commercial food includes.  I have went from Iams to this and am thrilled I made the change!

column9: Excellent and affordable cat dry food
column10: I have two cats and have fed them Chicken Soup for the Kitten Lover's Soul about one and half years ago while they were still kittens. I adopt them from local shelter. Last year I switch to Chicken Soup for the Cat Lover's Soul since I believe they were adult cat now.I'm picky about what my cats eat. During researching good dry foods for my two cats,EVO was my first pick for my cats, since it's grain free, high protein and low-carb cat food. Unfortunately, both my two kittens did not like EVO dry/wet food at all. I don't remember how many brands I had tried. Then on a local pet supply store, I saw the Chicken Soup for the Kitten Lover's Soul. The name got me interested, but I have trouble to get the nutrient analysis from the package or the internet. So, I wrote an email through their web site. I got their answer back within few days with a detail nutrient and ingredients analysis excel file. I decide to give it a try, and I'm so happy I try it, since my two cats love it too. They love the taste, it's not by-produce meat,and the ash & magnesium levels are low.

This stuff is great.  I tried it after doing a bunch of 'net research, looking to improve my cat's nutrition--he's getting older, and his energy was a little low, and his coat getting a little rough.I switched him from the Iams he's been on all his life.  I mixed the two brands together to switch him over gradually, but noticed within a couple of days that he was picking out the Chicken Soup cat food and leaving the Iams behind.His coat is softer and shinier, he's more chipper, and possibly best of all, he's barfing on my carpet much, much less.  Couldn't be happier.
Amazon lists salmon as the second ingredient. It is not! Would have passed if I had known that! My cat likes it so-so...

Considering the fact that these treats are grain-free, and have high quality ingredients, the price makes sense. You always pay more for better things, right? I love that these treats aren't full of things I cannot pronounce. They also don't have a bunch of things in it that make no sense to feed a dog (like sugar). These treats are also made in the USA, which is important to me. All in all, these are great treats. The dogs love them, and I can give them treats without feeling guilty, or worrying that they will get sick. Try them yourself, your dogs will love you for it.
the dogs love these nutritious treats, but they are very pricey for the size and amount.

I live in a very rural area. There is a store about 15 miles away that sells Alvita teas. The last two times I have been there they have been out of Valerian Root Tea. i find this product very effective in helping me sleep. This seller was inexpensive and responded very quickly to my order. Thank you!

I needed the fun size for a centerpiece I was making.  None of the stores carried them because it was December and they only seem to carry them for Halloween.  Glad I found them on Amazon.  Quick response!  Thanks.

I purchased this package of Milky Ways a few months ago and if I had written my review then I would have given it 4 stars. I paid $17.96 at the time. That came to $4.49 a bag and they are nice large bags. If it wasn't for the length of time it took to ship I would have given it 5 stars. Now it's more than doubled in price and comes to $9.00 a bag. I find that a ridiculous price and a very steep increase in such a short period of time. These bags are large but they are not that large. Do yourself a favor and buy them at Walmart or your grocery store.
These olive pieces are large enough to use in recipes, but are a bit too salty for use in many recipes.

column9: The price to pay for a good product
column10: I moved from California to San Antonio, several years ago and unfortunately the closest place I can get my ponzu sauce is in Houston, so I tried this method, yes, Expensive, but cheaper than making the 200 + miles tour.
The product was nice but not to use as a centerpiece as I wanted without everything coming apart.

This is an excellent product! do not hesitate to try this honey, you will not be sorry. The taste is wonderful and the feel on the tongue is sublime. I love just digging in with a teaspoon and grabbing a nice scoop!

My babies really love these.  The only problem is that they are easily crushed.  Shipping always seems to make about half the biscuits into little pieces.  The dogs like them anyway but it is harder to know if you are giving too much to them.
My dog is crazy about these treats and the service that I received was great!!  The treats arrived early and in top condition.  I would definitely order these treats again and from these people.

If you've never had Japanese Mayonnaise, then you have never lived. Ask any Japanese person, and they will tell ya about it.  Much better than the American version. Comes in a squeeze bottle with a small opening so you can draw perfect little designs of Japanese Mayo goodness.Once you go Kewpie, you never go back

I made spicy mayo at home and it tasted awesome. My only problem with the product is that once you open it the fridge shelf life is only a couple of months. In a small household it is impossible to use it all. The good thing is that it probably has less preservatives...
We decided to try the Kewpie mayonnaise as the base sauce for our favorite sushi recipe. It's perfect adding just a slight tart flavor. Nothing else can match it. Mmmm Mmmm.

I tried this sauce on a whim, when I saw it in Whole Foods Market. It had a local label and I'm all 'gung ho' for trying out products made locally. I wasn't sure what to expect so I tasted a little bit before mixing it with my other ingredients, and was initially surprised that it truly tasted like its name as well as very authentic. But boy was I surprised after I used this with a stuffed shells recipe and really tasted the flavors! The flavoring of the herbs in the sauce were simply robust and just delicious, complimenting my other ingredients extremely well. I vowed never to buy commercial pasta sauces ever again, but this certainly changed my mind. This is very close to making a sauce from scratch, in my opinion. If you're skeptical, I would suggest buying a jar from your local health food store before buying in bulk...you won't regret it!

This was indeed a nice genuine British Christmas pudding and the inclusion of a sixpence to add AFTER microwaving was a nice addition. The price of the pudding itself was fine, but I was miffed by the high shipping charge for a compact 8oz item, hence the reduction of one star. Still, it's only once a year and we enjoyed covering it in brandy, setting it aflame and then gorging ourselves...

I live in Minnesota surrounded by people of Scandinavian descent and bland taste buds.  Since I'm of Hungarian descent, finding a good Hungarian paprika is important to me for making some of my family recipes. My mom used it for years and I did too until I ran out of the spice my mom sent to me.  This is the best paprika!

I had to order this online because my favorite local stores doe not carry this brand. The cheaper Paprika's they carry taste like chili powder. This is the real deal. So far only deviled eggs but I am just waiting for chance at goulashes or Russian Paprikashes.

I won't say that I know the real flavor difference between Hungarian Paprika brands.  What I can say is I purchased my first bottle of Hungarian Paprika from Williams and Sonoma.  While W&S paprika is tasty (IMO), their bottle only has 1.9 oz, while this can has 5 oz., more than twice the amount!  Like I said, I don't know how "authentic" the flavor is but this one was tasty when I made Paprikash.  I would buy this one again.

column9: Sweet taste and ruby red color
column10: Great for Mexican dishes too.The difference between this and the other brands in your grocery store, that the Hungarian kind doesn't have the bitter aftertaste in larger quantities.Hungarian measurement is "put 2-4 TBS in the food (for 4 persons), enough to turn it nice red"Famous for the smooth sweet taste and the ruby red color.

I DID NOT GET A CHANCE TO USE IT. WHEN I RECEIVED IT, SOME OF IT WAS IN THE BAG I WAS NOT SURE IF I SHOULD USE IT SO I SENT IT BACK. I DID NOT WANT TO RATE IT, BUT THE WAY YOU HAVE IT SET UP YOU HAVE TO. I NEVER TASTE IT
sent it back.the top corner of lid was coming off.i dont no who gets the 1 star.i would order again.but found some
Delivery was on time but the postage cost more than the item... Next time I will purchase local or check for another site

How do I delete this item?? it was bad!!! The seal was broken and it look like and it was opened then resealed??? I love the kethcup.. but this.. I have found out it's not put out buy Heiz Dist,USA...:(((( maybe I just got a bad one though???

I ordered 3 bottles of Heinz Yellow Mustard (17oz Upside down).  What I received was 6 bottles of Heinz Spicy Brown Mustard (17oz Upside down).  I have tried to contact the shipper but to date........No response.  I wish I could make these purchases all of the time.......Pay for 3 and receive 6.  Amazon Marketplace really DOES NOT work for me.  I would not suggest using Amazon Marketplace to anyone.

I knew when I ordered these that I was making a mistake, because "large" olives are always the worst.  But I took a chance.These lack flavor, I mean there isn't really even a hint of flavor in them.Further, the texture is unappealing; it's not quite mushy, and not quite mealy, but something between those two.I would not recommend them considering that there are so many wonderful olives available instead.

column9: Great way to start the day!
column10: I have been using the Bigelow Green Tea w/Lemon for about 3 years now and find it to be refreshing and soothing first thing in the morning.  Very easy on the stomach.

column9: Perfect tea after a long day!
column10: I am a tea drinker and I love my tea and this is one of the best packaged teas that I have had.  I like the way Bigelow packages their tea to preserve freshness and this one is no exception.  A perfect blend of green tea and lemon!  Other teas either have too much lemon taste or not enough.  Bigelow's is perfect!

I've always heard about the very many benefits of Green Tea, but only got around to drinking it when I was down with the flu about 5 months ago and had a very sore throat. Unfortunately, the brand I picked up randomly Lipton Green Tea, 100% Natural, Tea Bags, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6) kept leaving a bitter after-taste in my mouth. It was one of those things I had to force myself to drink. So not fun.But then *drumroll* I found Bigelow Green Tea with Lemon! I loved it. It was as refreshing as it was soothing, all this without any unhealthy/artificial additions. Drinking this product frequently throughout the day worked wonders for my sore throat and health-o-meter, and converted me into a die-hard fan. My morning cuppa tea and quiet time is a prized part of my routine now. I heart this product, and oh yea, it's not that expensive either. I just pick up individual 20-ct boxes at Walmart for $2.04 every so often.By the way, here's the lazy person's three-step process of drinking this tea - Boil 1 cup of water in the microwave for about 1-2 minutes. Immediately drop in the teabag and let steep for 3-5 minutes. Enjoy your lovely cup of freshness.

We start our day with a cup of this delightful tea. It is crisp and refreshing-hot or cold.  Unlike some green teas that tend to be overpowering, it has a light, but distinct flavor.  The touch of lemon makes it perfect.  Highly recommend it for those who love green tea, but don't care for the usual musty flavor.
I drink this tea all day long and its really good. Needs no flavoring, but sometimes I do add a little honey and make it into iced tea. That is yummy. Most times I drink it hot.

I have been drinking tea since I was old enough to steal my mother's mug for a sip of orange pekoe, which is close to 30 years ago now.This tea is light, refreshing, and natural-tasting in the best way possible. It kicks the butt of Celestial Seasonings, which I stopped drinking since switching to this brand full-time. I like the distinctive flavor, the healthiness of the green tea, and that if it were a blind taste test I could still tell you which one this one was with a sip, or a smell of the yummy aroma. I hope they always make this tea, because it is worth keeping a case around, knowing it will never go to waste or be forgotten in the back shelf. You will drink every box of this tea and come back for more. I drop two bags in a large mug of hot water, and steep it 3 minutes, no more, no less. Never boil the water, it messes with the flavor. I once brought a mug of this to my trusting husband and he took one nip of it and gave me a serious look, "Damn, this is good tea!" I already knew it was, but it is always nice to hear someone else say it, too.If you buy it on amazon subscription (I also have prime, which is a bonus) you will get a respectable price, which doesn't exceed the store cost. I don't even have to go to the store to get this, and it arrives in a cardboard case I can pop on the shelf. It doesn't stay there long, though, since I adore this tea immensely.

If you're looking for a tasty green tea, you might enjoy this Bigelow green tea with lemon.  I love the flavor of lemon in tea.  This has a light, pleasant lemony flavor which isn't overpowering. The tea is a wonderful afternoon or evening treat.  Green tea alone to me tastes the way hay smells--excuse me, we used to have a horse form and when I drink plain green tea I feel like I'm drinking horses brew.But this tea tastes like lemon and is delightful.  I was never a tea drinker but wanted to add green tea to all the other nutritious foods I'm eating and this is my favorite so far.  I want to try the decaf version of this green tea with lemon, also.Each tea bag comes individually wrapped with a string so the bag is easy for dipping. If you like lemon flavored tea, you should enjoy this version of it.
I first started drinking tea about a month ago. I tried Bigelow's GT w/ Lemon and that's all I'm drinking now on. I did not try their other flavors however their blueberry offering sounds tasty.
Love the ability to order my tea in bulk and online.  Being disabled and transportation challenged, I find this very helpful.  The tea is great and the service exemplary.

column9: Citrus Is Important To Have with Green Tea
column10: I could not find an online source to back this claim up but I did read in a health magazine that adding citrus to your green tea will increase the benefits of drinking such tea. This product is perfect to suit those needs. My wife & I love it too!

Good on its own as it has a nice Lemon taste with it but I mix it with Black Tea and I have found that to make it even better.  Tea packets come in an air sealed in paper foil packs to preserve freshness so these can sit in the cabinet for a bit since when I order I get 6 boxes at a time (takes about 3 months to go through them).  Plus Amazon's price is half of what I pay at my local store.

column9: So far the best tasting green tea!
column10: I like this green tea ,as it does not dry my mouth and does not give me that after taste effect!  What makes it better for me if I add a little bit of instant honey ginger flavor to it.

Order came quickly.  Since Bigelow tea bags are individually wrapped, they last forever, so buying in bulk makes sense here.  I see it for $3.50 a box in the store, so getting it at ~$2 a box is definitely worth it.

I first tried this tea and didn't care for it at all.  I was thinking about throwing out the box.  Then I tried it with artificial sweetener and I was hooked!  (I'm sure sugar would work even better, but I prefer the no calorie sweetener.)It is absolutely delicious.  I usually drink tea without sweetener, but this tea needs a little extra something in my opinion.  It's a great tea and I'm looking forward to enjoying it for a long time!

This is a delectable sweet pepper sauce.  It is a little spicy, and sits wonderfully on the tongue.  My daughter lived in Slovenia, and Ajvar is her favorite food from there.  She brought a bottle home with her when she came back to the U.S., and I agree that is one of my favorite foods, too.  Jadranka is the authentic brand.

column9: I wish I could rate it LOWER
column10: To put it simply, this is the most HORRIBLE cake product on the market. I wanted so badly for it to be great. Being an avid searcher for delicious fat-free or low-fat dessert alternatives, this sounded like the absolute MOTHER LOAD!Normally when you open a cake mix box, you get that delightful cake smell that we are all too familiar with... this is not the case with this product. In fact, the product had an almost chalky smell to it. After mixing it with the water, the mix took on a paste smell and after baking there was still no sign that this was supposed to be a dessert. Now I'm stuck with 5 other packs that I have no clue what I'll do with.If you are hungry for a fat free treat, my suggestion would be to go with "No Pudge Brownies" and SKIP this horrible excuse for a dessert.

I have to keep my intake of fat at a minimum. This cake is just the ticket for me to enjoy a cake without fat. Very easy to fix and bake. I am a Guy and not a genius in the kitchen but even I can fix this cake.

These are some WONDERFUL candies and I am appalled at the prices being charged on Amazon! These candies can be purchased at local stores for around $3.00 a bag. That's $12.00 for 4 bags and sellers are charging almost $40.00 for 4 bags!!! This is taking greed to a new level. Shame on you folks!!

I'd rather eat this canned tuna than any fresh fish that wasn't just pulled out of the water!  It's addictive...  And it makes regular grocery store brands of tuna taste like cat food.  Dry cat food.  This is well worth the price.  Try it tossed, oil and all, with hot pasta, a little lemon and some pepper for a super-quick and tasty meal.

Cento tuna is just the best...it puts regular grocery store brands to shame.  Cento is delicious right on top of salad with nothing more than a squeeze of lemon juice and a few capers...gourmet right out of the can.
This is very tasty, no after taste, and no smell.  It's the best tuna I have tasted.

column9: Remarkably delicious tuna in a handy little can
column10: And the can even has a pull ring! This is a no-brainer busy-day lunch. And the tuna is DELICIOUS!!! I was expecting a lot of olive oil, you know, so much that I'd have to drain it like water-packed tuna and that wasn't the case at all; if anything I'd say the tuna was lightly DRESSED with olive oil. And just the right amount of salt. Incredibly convenient. I never want to be without a stack of this tuna in the pantry. I had no idea such delicious tuna existed.

My husband and I both LOVE this tuna. It's hard to find the small cans in the grocery stores and when you do it's very expensive.  Purchasing the case was a great cost savings and convenient to have it on hand when we want it.  I keep several cans at work and add it to a home made or purchaed salad for a healthy and tasty lunch.  One can is the perfect amount of protein for a single serving.  This Italian style tuna is delicious and has more flavor and better texture than the usual solid white tuna packed in water.  I just drain a little of the oil off and add it to my salad for a quick, healthy and tasty meal.

column9: Fine tuna, deja vu all over again
column10: Funny about the rave reviews here, don't get me wrong the tuna is indeed top-notch, but what amuses me is that this is simply as good as tuna used to be in this country. Starkist, Chicken of the Sea, all the major brands used to have such quality tuna in oil (MAYBE NOT olive but still tasty) as the only choice available. Then came the novelty geared towards dieters, tuna in water, then the oil-based variety was eased out I guess entirely. So now we who like good tuna have to find it from Italy. America in decline--

hard to get tuna in olive oil here..this is delicious .... comes in a size perfect for a pita pocket lunch..add what ever and tastes better than most restaurants!!!(I love nuts on top with abit of celery)I have this tuna on the automatic refill .Cento Solid Packed Tuna in Olive Oil, 3-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
This is a rather dry tuna fish, not at all what you would expect for tuna packed in olive oil. Very light on the olive oil!
This tuna is so much better than any canned tuna I have eaten. It contains just the right amount of olive oil (not swimming in it as other brands I've eaten). Excellent!

This tuna is delicious, and the size is perfect for one person.  Once you try olive oil packed tuna, you will never return to water or vegetable oil packed.  It is great with crusty or soft bread, or try it stuffed in half an avocado!

column9: The only Canned Tuna i eat.
column10: This is the only canned tuna i will eat. packed in olive oil, nothing else comes close.

I eat this tuna at least three times a week. I usually put some kind of chili or hot sauce on it or pepper relish but that is it. It is sooooo delicious. Just moist enough. Just flavorful enough. Delicious!

The product is described as Solid Packed, it is not. The meat is flaked.  I like the tuna flavor, but the added salt is over the top. Way too much salt!  I will not purchase again. A letter to Cento is next.

Thanks to all the previous reviewers -- this is indeed delicious tuna:  delicate flavor, excellent texture, with a hint of olive oil (not heavy and cloying). It is a bit salty, which I enjoy.  I ordered the 3-ounce cans in the 24 pack and find the size perfect for a sandwich or to eat right out of the can...yes, it's that good.To my taste buds,Tonnino Tuna Ventresca in Olive Oil is slightly better -- but only slightly -- not enough to justify the higher price.  Both are much better than supermarket-bought canned tuna.Ordered it from Amazon Prime and, of course, it was delivered promptly and in good condition.  Enjoy!
As tuna with olive oil gets much harder to find locally, I'll be buying more of this product. Not dry with "essence" of olive oil like some others, this makes a great snack.

This tuna is not solid packed as stated on the can, which is a misrepresentation of the product. I plan to file a complaint with the company.  It tastes O.K. but too salty and strong in flavor for me.  This is no more than chunk light mushy tuna.  I do not recommend it to anyone!!!!
This participial tuna comes in a tiny 3 oz can. It is grossly overpriced. You get a better Italian tuna at the Trader Joes, in a bigger can and without skimping on the olive oil.

I was new to this product, but after doing some research ordered a pack of 24.  Our whole family loves it!  The shipment came in perfect condition with a few extra to share with friends and family, and that I did.  I will be a regular ordering this yummy and healthy dessert for my family.

column9: Not a vegetarian, but prefer this jello over regular jello
column10: I ordered a 24 pack and was given extra to share and a nice handwritten note from the company, very nice.I really like the jello. I bought it originally to make homemade gummy candy, but it just did not get to like the store bought - which does not reflect on this product. I just didn't do it right. Anyhow, I make it as the direction on the package says and sometimes I will add a bit of agar agar to make it firmer. I pour it into the candy molds such as frogs, bears, and my kids love it. All the flavors are really good and the texture is nice, clean tasting.While it is a better alternative to the conventional Jello made with animal gelatin, it still does have artificial coloring. But 'organic' colorings usually involve some animal derivative. Will order again.

We ordered, and it was delivered promptly and with 25% more product than we ordered "to share." That was cool.The product itself is just like Jello, and once we got past the fact that green does not mean Lime, we thoroughly enjoyed it. The flavors are a little less intense, but much more "natural" tasting then the fakey Jello. And having a vegetarian in the family (and all of us being grossed out by what is in regular Jello), it is an awesome alternative.Will definitely order again!

column9: Great Tasting Considering This is Vegan!
column10: My daughter has tons of allergies so she is pretty much a Vegan and it's so difficult to find child- friendly vegan products. We were glad to find this and now my daughter is not deprived of all the good sweets. Some vegan products, like the yogurts, ice cream do not taste the same, but surprisingly, this jello tastes pretty good, like regular gelatin jello.

column9: Great Treat, but Not Health Food
column10: Don't make the mistake of thinking there's anything especially healthy about these dried pineapple slices. As far as nutrition goes you might as well buy a candy bar. For my money though, these are great candy. They have a very nice semi hard texture and the intense pineapple flavor coupled with the sugar crust tastes wonderful.

column9: Better than the dry packets and a great 3-way!
column10: This is called Cincinnati Chili because it originated there but is a fine minced ground beef with spices that are different than normal Texas chili; this chili is flavored with cinnamon, cumin, cloves and chocolate.  It's different but a cult favorite in the midwest.  The traditional method of serving is called a 3-way where you pour the chili over cooked spaghetti and cover in finely shredded cheddar cheese.  There is also a 4-way which includes either adding light red kidney beans or chopped white onions.  The 5-way is adding both beans and onions.  Often hot sauce is used along with oyster crackers.  The other favorite is a cheese coney where you take a traditional hot dog and then pour the chili over top adding the shredded cheddar cheese with mustard and/or onions.  You can make this chili from scratch getting a recipe from allrecipes or you can use the dry packet mix 6 Pack Cincinnati Chili but either way is not the same.  You just can't get the ground beef minced enough to resemble the true stuff.This is also a great gift to send to any troop overseas who is from the midwest.  They would instantly know and love your package.  Facebook even has pages committed to this chili.  It's a cult favorite and you will either love it or hate it.

column9: If your desperate for a three way this is the ticket!
column10: Cincinnatians all know the story of Skyine, created by Nicholas Lambrinides, a Greek immigrant.  The recipe is different than the standard chile favored by Americans because it has spices such as cinnamon and cloves.  Of course out of a can, it is not the same as in the restaurant (I still favor the one off Oakley Square when I go back to Cincinnati).  The frozen doesn't ship well so we are left with the canned as our only choice if there is  no franchise nearby.My main problem with the canned chili is it is too watery.  Either cook it down a bit or strain before serving.Here are the typical recipes:Pour chili over a plate of freshly cooked spaghetti.  Add a VERY generous amount of shredded cheddar cheese (mild is favored).  This is a three way.  For a four way, add diced oniions.  Five way?  Red kidney beans.Take a hot dog bun and apply yellow mustard.  Use a good quality beef hot dog.  Pour chili over it, sprinkle some diced onions and add a VERY generous amount of shredded chedda.  This is the cheese coney.Finally my son just likes chili cheese fries, with fries, Skyline and lots of cheddar cheese.Not for the faint of heart, or those with hardening of the arteries, this is a little taste of cincinnati.

As an Ohioan living in Chicago, I often miss the famous Skyline chili.  A friend tipped me off that we could buy it on Amazon!  YAY!  The chili came very quickly, was covered in protective wrap, and was ready to be devoured.  The only thing missing is Skyline's skinny shredded cheese, but it was so nice to have a taste of home.  Thanks, Skyline!

column9: Very excited to have found this on Amazon!
column10: Never been to cincinnati, but love this product.  We had a local store that was carring this in Washington state.  But they stopped. :(  now we can order it on amazon.People are complaining because it's not like normal chili...  It is it's own new type of food.  Don't compair it to regular chili, try it on it's own.  Enjoy.

column9: Great chili but cans have big dents
column10: The chili is great, but either the chili cost less because of the poor can shape or amazon didn't take any kind of care with the cans.
My wife and I love the taste of Skyline Chili. We serve it over spaghetti withlots of onions and cheddar cheese. Just the way they do it in Cincinatti. (where it comes from)We recommend it highly.

Although the Skyline inside the cans seems to be satisfactory, every single can was dented (which was not in the advertisement of this product).  If you are re-selling scratch and dents, you should make that clear in the advertisement for the product.

I got this out of curiosity...I had never even heard of Cincinnati chili except at some American restaurant in Shanghai, and so the next time I was in the US I wanted to try the (semi) real thing.I dig this stuff, but it's not what your normally think of, when you think of chili...the main differences being, it's much thinner, more like a sauce with a lot of beef in it.  There's no tomato sauce.  And it's not hot - the spices are a more subdued mix, the most prominent (to me) being allspice, and then cinnamon.It's too thin to stand on its own, so I have it with hot dogs, and the norm is to put it on spaghetti.  Probably any starchy food would work fine, though.  Trans-fat has been (perhaps correctly) demonized lately, so it's a little weird that each can has a couple grams.  It's not much, but you think they'd get rid of it.Anyway of course canned chili isn't the height of the culinary world, but it's about as good as any other canned chili I've had.

When you can't make it out to your favorite Skyline Chili Restaurant you can always fix it at home in a jiffy with a can of Skyline Original Chili poured over your favorite pasta and covered/smother or what ever you prefer!

This is the second time I have ordered Skyline Chili from Amazon and this is the second time I recieved the product with dents in multiple cans.  The packaging is not at fault it is what happens before it is boxed.  This is ridiculous, if I am paying for dented items it should be in the description.  I asked last time why all the dented cans and got no response. Maybe I should look elsewhere for my chili because no one seems to care here.

This chili lives up to its reputation. For an even better taste, try this with refrigerated linguine instead of spaghetti. Be sure to use enough chili and add finely shredded cheddar cheese. Better than the original 3 way.
This is the original 'REAL DEAL' from Cincinnati, which uses Cocoa, a most unusual flavor.  They advertise 5-ways to eat it.  A great experience to have with friends.  Try all the different ways.
From Columbus, live in Austin Texas now.  I love Skyline (refuse to ever go to a Gold Star) and I find this to be very true to the original.
I love Skyline and am so pleased to be able to purchase it at Amazon. The service is fast and pricing reasonable. I enjoy no other brand!

okay, so i admit that it is weird, both the taste and the consistency BUT i don't eat it straight out of the can.  i add it to my own chili and i make the best chili in the world.....or at least that's what they tell me!i wish amazon would carry it in the 6 packs and offer free shipping.  it's pricey and having to pay shipping...well, i have one can left and after that i'll have to decide if i can live without it.

Not as good as what you get if you go to Skyline but it's great for those of us who are not close to Cincinnati. Used to live there and miss the great chili dishes from Skyline and Gold Star. This helps bring a little Cincinnati to Rhode Island which has nothing like it! I will order again!

column9: A Cincinnati favorite, but an acquired taste
column10: I did not like Skyline Chili the first time I had it. I was introduced to it by a friend who made me a "four-way" (chili, spaghetti, cheese, and beans). I am not a fan of beans. I tried it a second time to make sure the first time wasn't a fluke--this time without the beans and enjoyed it very much so that I am now a fan.It definitely has a unique taste to it, it could be the chocolate. The consistently is not thick like other types of chili, and you put it on top of spaghetti, along with a mountain of cheese which is very weird at first. Give it a couple of chances and you just might like it; I make no guarantees, this is an acquired taste. (TIP: Try it with EXTRA SHARP cheddar shredding for the best kick in flavor.)When I saw this 6-pack on Amazon I ordered it right away! It beats the prices from other sites and you don't have to go all the way to Cincinnati or ask your Cincy friends to get you some. Don't forget to dine in at the Skyline Chili restaurants whenever you're in Cincinnati for the most authentic taste!

I had my first plate of Skyline Chili (5 way) about 40 years ago.  It's absolutely the best of any Cincinnatti style chiles.  Of course there are no Skyline Chili Parlors out in the West, but I'm so happy to know I can order it by email.  Amazon has by far the best price for six packs of the chili... far cheaper than the others.  And, I had my order just 3 days after submitted.  Fantastic!

This is some fantastic stuff right here.  But be forewarned, this is not your normal tex-mex style chili.  This chili is thin, and has ingredients like cinnamon in it.  I know must people that I have told about this chili, upon their first taste, have not known how to think about it.  I normally get "its different".  But after the second and third times, they have all bought their own cans and love it now.The best way to eat this is in the classic three-way style.  Take some spaghetti and place it on a plate. Add the chili on top of the pasta and add a nice helping of shredded sharp cheddar cheese.  Enjoy a four or five way by either adding beans or sliced onions, or both!Top a good natural casing hot dog with the chili, a little mustard and the cheddar cheese and you have one heck of a chili dog.Im getting hungry now after writing this, and I think I am going to go make some Skyline!

Skyline is a famous chili localized mostly to the Cincinnati/Ketuncky area. There are no beans or onion in the chili itself, but they can be added on top.This chili is exactly the way our Dad made it, with a little more water.  The meat is fine and the flavor unique. It is best as a sauce on pasta or a hot dog.Enjoy it.

column9: Great for those who don't have a Skyline nearby.
column10: Great price for the chili compared to ordering it directly from Skyline's site (under $3.00/can from Amazon including shipping).  However, the packaging of the product was horrible and about 1/3 of the cans arrived dented from bouncing around in the much too large box they were shipped in.  I rate the product at five stars, but I have to take away a star due to the packaging.
Was very happy with this purchase. I love Skyline Chili. Lived in Cincy for 7 years. This was WAY cheaper than getting it from the Skyline web site.
I used to eat this Chili all of the time when I lived in Ohio so when I figured out I could order it, I did. This is the best 3-way chili on the market and I recommend it to anyone.
This chili has to be the worst chili I have ever eaten, what a waste of money.  It tasted of cloves or something.

I was born and raised in Cincinnati and I know how Skyline Chili is supposed to taste....what came out of 3 different cans was so sickening tasting that I had to throw it out!!!  I tried 3 different cans to make sure it wasn't just the one can.  It was greasy and just tasted like dog poop!  I will never buy a can again!!!

I read about the taste of Skyline chili on a Tulsa, OK website [..], posted by someone trying to simulate the unique taste of cheese coneys made by the Tulsa, OK-based Coney Islander hot dog restaurant chain.A transplanted Tulsa native that's lived in New York City since 1977, I was suddenly overpowered by the urge to recreate the mythic hot dogs of my teenage youth, so I immediately ordered a case of six 15-ounce cans.Amazon promptly delivered the chili and I eagerly set about sampling it. Unfortunately the chili turned out to be (no disrespect intended to Skyline fans in Cincinnati and elsewhere) inedible--at least to my taste buds--and looking nothing like the product depicted on the can wrapper. The contents consisted of half watery soup, half highly spiced meat, and resembling nothing like the savory, meaty chili described by the website writer. Even after pouring off all the liquid, the remaining chili was so heavily spiced with I believe to be a heavy dose of cloves and perhaps some cinnamon and other ingredients that I stopped eating after a single bite.Still, wanting to believe that I could somehow employ this chili to help mimic the taste of my beloved Coney Islander cheese dogs, I asked my wife to sample the chili, who proclaimed it to be "awful."Much as I hate to step on a product that some people no doubt love, I have to say this is the absolute worst canned chili I've ever eaten. It was so bad I felt slightly nauseated a few minutes after having the single bite, and a faint worry about food poisoning briefly entered my mind.Needless to say, the five other cans were summarily tossed into the garbage. The quest to find the perfect chili for hot dogs continues...

Sorry, but it must be an acquired taste.  It was more like soup than chili...could barely find the meat.  Plus, it tasted like it was loaded with ginger, cinnamon, nutmeg and something else.  Those things have no business being in chili.  It was so overwhelming I literally couldn't taste any other food for 15 minutes after eating it, almost like it ruined my taste buds.
They must be goofy in Ohio. This stuff is terrible. There is no way to doctor this glop to make it taste good. If you want to vandalize something then throw some at a house.

The Coffee Shop pod in this pack is replaced with the Coffee House pod by Green Mountain, even though the Coffee Shop pods are described and pictured.  Customer Service was less than helpful when contacted and sent a response e-mail that lectured me.  Be cautious when shopping this seller.

I was quite surprised with the quality of this product.  I wasn't expecting too much from canned beef, but this is very tasty.  The beef chunks are in a nice, fairly thick gravy and it works well in many dishes including just pouring over rice or mashed potatoes for a simple meal. The texture of the meat is very good--it reminds me of crock pot cooked beef stew.  It's a real time saver and I keep several cans on hand.

column9: Not bad but not quite there
column10: Pros:+Really tasty, especially if you have a little gravy mix on hand to thicken it.+Long shelf life.+Great time saver, goes great on just about anything.Cons:-Amount of beef. They really didn't hold back with the gravy in these. The beef still tastes great, but there isn't much of it.-Quality of the beef. This one's a little biased, as I grew up on Libby's where the beef had a much more solid, wholesome bite to it and that's what I was expecting when I grabbed these.All in all, still a great meal when you're short on time and still want something that tastes good. If they upped the amount of beef in the cans and thickened the gravy a bit I'd love to come back and give this 5 stars.

column9: A quality, versatile, and delicious product--I'm a permanent fan!
column10: I've been looking for more choices that give me at least a partial "made-at-home" taste with minimum work.  Sometimes I come home from work and I am so tired that I don't want to cook much of anything - - but I also want something other than take-out, canned soup, or a frozen dinner.  After seeing the reviews for this product, I ordered it.  I figured that it would be average, but I was willing to take the chance because the price was low and the nutrition information showed this to be a healthy choice.To my pleasant surprise, it is everything the other reviews suggested and more!  I came home, threw a couple of potatoes in the microwave, and emptied the roast beef into a bowl.  I ended up with the beef and gravy over lightly buttered baked potatoes.  It was a hearty and filling meal (enough for two dinners) that tasted like a good crock pot roast.  I've since tried the product in stroganoff and creamed over toast points.  Both were fantasatic!  The meat is hearty, lean, and tender; the gravy is flavorful and rich.  Honestly, I'm amazed that something so good is such a secret - - but then again, any canned beef I've tried before this product has tasted (and smelled!) like dog food.Bottom line: THIS IS A FANTASTIC PRODUCT!  It is delicious, convenient, versatile, and thoroughly enjoyable.  What a blessing!

My opinion: I really like this product alot. I eat it alot. You can make all kinds of variations to it easily. No regrets. Great price. The quality is good. Delivered right to my door. I subscribed to it and am very happy I did.update: the more I eat of this beef product the more I like it. There are so many possible variations with this can of delicious beef product. It's very easy to create a quick meal with this can of beef. I buy it often from amazon.com.

Please think 'out of the box' for this product. I have used it for over 20 years for meat in tacos, burritos, added to BBQ sauce for 'pulled beef' sandwiches and other mostly ethnic dishes. I used to make my own tamales and used this meat for them.  I drain off the gravy most of the time and my doggies love it: if I keep it, I spice it up. We live in an area of the country where we may be out of power for days, and this is a great source of meals cooked on my Coleman stove.  All you need is canned salsa, canned refried beans, this meat, and tortillas.

column4: B. WILLIAMS "B WILLIAMS LOOKING FOR LIGHT"
column10: LIBBY'S ROAST BEEF IS VERY HANDY TO HAVE FOR QUICK "ON-THE-GO-MEALS" OR TO ADD A BIT OF TASTE TO LEFTOVERS. WE REALLY LIKE THE PRODUCT AND USE IT A LOT.  ALSO PERFECT IN STEWS and CHILIS. THE CHUCKS ARE A VERY NICE SIZE, YOU MAY FIND THAT FOR SOME USES YOU'LL BE CUTTING THEM, LIKE FOR PITA BREAD STUFFING. WAS VERY EASY TO GIVE THIS 5 STARS.

Good roast beef from a CAN. I bought this product as a quickie when I did not feel like cooking. I eat smaller meals and I think you could serve three people if you all include 'taters' and a salad! Can be heated in the microwave or on the stove top.

Was amazed when I first tried this. It is very good & I am picky about how beef gravy tastes, but this one passes with flying colors. Just heat & serve over rice, mashed potatoes, or even on toast like an open-faced sandwich. Good value especially on Subscribe & Save program.

This product has very good flavor and seems to work best over rice. I have compared it to other brands with the same sized cans and found that the Libbys brand has more protein. This seems to indicate that Libbys has more beef than gravy. Great item for your pantry as an alternative meat source to chicken and tuna.

My husband makes the best beef tacos and this is what he uses. Fry the corn tortilla, (bend while frying)...add this meat (heated on the stove) some refried beans, pico de gallo, shredded cheese and pig out!!!! They are amazing!He has had to buy the Hormel brand before when they were out of Libby, but he says the Hormel brand has too much gravy and less meat.Also - my daughter (she is 7) loves when we lay out some mini tortilla rounds, add shredded cheese and some of this meat, put in the microwave for 1 minute and Wallah! fast beef nachos.

column4: Jacki Gunter "good movie or book lover"
column10: I use this canned roast beef in beef stroganoff, crock-pot beef and noodles, taquito's, enchilada's, and enchilada pie.  It is great for emergencies when you can't use electricity because it is already cooked - just keep a manual can-opener handy.
I always have tyrouble finding this in grocery store, so I placed on auto ship and never have to worry about locating again. Great flavor and a great price!!!
These cans of roast beef in the store are almost 5$ each, with this online buy I can get them at about 3$ each and I don't pay shipping so its great. My son loves this for tacos.

Just received my first Amazon subscribe and save and had it for dinner, and immedicately went back to the site and ordered an extra shipment.  I just used half a can and microwaved it with a little of the gravy and it was very yummy with a side order of peas.  I imagine it would be great with rice or potatos.  Libby's has a winner, and Amazon makes the order fast and easy
I think that both the Libby brand beef and the Hormel brand beef are very similar in flavor but I found the Hormel to be much tenderer.
Best canned beef that i have ever tried and it is my favorie canned beef for cooking with my fav soup excepts fresh beef.
This is roast beef in chunks with about 1/3 cup beef broth. The beef is gristle and fat free, and perfect for casseroles or a quick dinner over rice.

I had not seen this product on the grocery shelves for many years and was happy to find it on Amazon. It was as delicious as I remembered except that the gravy was very salty. I use very little salt so maybe I notice it more. I served it over potatoes and didn't notice the saltiness.I will not use it over pasta or toast as I used to do.I am going to try it in a pot pie without the gravy as the meat is tender and tasty.I will order this again. I subscribed to this as a replacement for beef stew that Amazon discontinued. The beef stew came with token vegetables, potatoes, lots of gravy and some cubes made of textured beef product. It wasn't too bad when doctored with red wine, spices, extra vegetables, and brown rice.There are no potatoes, or token vegetables here, and the textured beef cubes have been replaced with actual chunks of beef with the Libby roast beef. The chunks are slightly tough, have a pronounced grain, and actually taste something like beef. Having gone through six cans, I have found very little excess fat or gristle.It's pretty easy to whip up a quickie beef stew with this stuff. Frozen veggies, rice or potatoes, a can of diced or stewed tomatoes, some spices and wine, and you have a perfectly serviceable, quickie meal.For those who argue that made from scratch tastes better, you are right. For those who argue that home made is just as easy, well, I have a bridge I can sell you ... ;)

column9: "Subscribe and Save" - Amazon giveth, and Amazon taketh away
column10: This canned roast beef is as would be expected for a canned meat, and was a decent value as offered through Amazon's "subscribe and save" option.Unfortunately, this product, along with Post Cranberry-almond cereal, and several other items to which we have tried to "subscribe", are unceremoniously withdrawn from being available, often after a very short time, never to return.This procedure makes a mockery of the "Subscribe" portion of this Amazon feature. The good news is, I guess, that one does save 15% off the Amazon list price for at least one order.Hopefully, Amazon will be able to get longer term deals with suppliers, or change their in-house policies, to allow the "Subscribe" offer to be real.

That's basically it. If you offer a Cholent kit, you could at least send along a spice packet, without which this is just, well, beans. column9: Not the same stuff sold in the US
column10: This is the oatmeal my father's family regularly sent us from Puerto Rico when I was a child, and boy am I happy to have found a way to buy it myself all these years later. Even if you haven't taken any Spanish language classes you can probably pick out that "avena instantanea" is, in fact, "instant oatmeal," and Quaker is, of course, Quaker. The same brand you see every time you walk down the cereal aisle in your grocery store. Yet this oatmeal is substantively different from the oatmeal you can buy in Illinois. It's smoother somehow, creamier. I've purchased many varieties of American Quaker oatmeal and cooked it in the method that I learned as a girl, but it is not the same. It does not make a bowl of "Puerto Rican oatmeal," as my sister and I came to call it. This, however, does.If you grew up in the Caribbean and have tried to reproduce the oatmeal of your youth, here it is. If you have no idea what I'm talking about but you like oatmeal, give it a shot. I like to cook it with skim milk (and a splash of half and half, as the milk fat makes it creamier), then dump cinnamon and blueberries into it so I can feel all smug about my healthful breakfast. Delicious!

column9: Something Changed, And In A Bad Way
column10: I've been enjoying this product for years.  It was by far my favorite bourbon, and I didn't mind spending $40 on such a small bottle as it was so amazingly good. Tchibo coffee is hands down the best coffee I have ever had.  It is smooth-not bitter and wonderfully aromatic.  Definitely worth its weight in Gold!
This coffee is so good. I'm very picky about my coffee. It has a beautiful smell and flavor. I would recommend this coffee to anyone.

My husband and I used to drink this coffee in Germany and it is the best I've ever tasted. It is a good strong taste but not bitter, like many American coffees are. It is very smooth and you feel like you're drinking liquid gold. It really is amazing. The other thing I love about this coffee is that it is vacume packed like a brick and it's easy to pack and take with us on the truck.

I agree with all the reviewers who found this coffee smoother and less acidic than domestic U.S. brands. It is good coffee, but it is not exceptional coffee. While I consider Tchibo Gold of better quality, I found the flavor similar to regular Folgers coffee. If you think U.S coffee brands generally taste fine and you'd like something similar that is easier on the palate and the stomach, Tchibo is probably a good choice. For a flavor that is different and very outstanding, I'd recommend trying Dallmayr (also available on Amazon).

Tchibo is one of my favorite coffee brands. The wonderful aroma you smell when you open the vaccum sealed package speaks volumes. Tchibo's Gold Selection has a distinct rich but smooth flavor - A perfect choice for that first cup of coffee in the morning. Another plus: The subscription price here at Amazon definitely beats Walmart's price :)
This coffee is ok, but lacks the bold taste of the Tchibo premium coffee.  Although either one tastes less acidic than american coffee brands.
This snack is tasty and good filling. Though falafel is not the best among all other flavors of bisslis. Our kids in love with osem snacks.

I have two little power chewers (under 20 pounds each) who can tear through a regular rawhide roll in a couple of hours. After three days they each could only manage to eat about one fourth of a roll. These rolls are gigantic compared to the regular 10" rolls I have been giving them. I had to cut them in half to make them easier for my dogs to handle. Usually, my dogs strip off large pieces of a rawhide roll but they couldn't do that with these rolls, the hide is too thick (it ranges from about 1/8" to 1/4" thick). Four of these rolls lasted for about a month with two small dogs chewing on them for about two hours every day.

These rawhides are great!It is really hard to find rawhides that are made in America using American cows. It really does matter where they are made because the US has laws against using formaldehyde and other deadly preservatives in products meant for pet consumption.If your pet is a heavy chewer and goes through rawhides like candy, then they could be consuming harmful amounts of poisonous stuff.This article does a great job discussing the topic:[...]These Rawhides are made by Pet Factory in Illinois. They are talked about in the article as being great quality rawhides but they go on to say that the company does not sell directly to the public so they are really hard to find.But here they are!!They are really thick and last a very long time. They are a great value too. Petco makes a "Retriever Roll" for $5 each that are of lesser quality than these Pet Factory ones.I order 10 at a time though and when I first open that box, the smell is pretty gnarly; which is exactly how natural rawhide is supposed to be. Just open the box outside and let them air out a bit before bringing them inside and everything is fine.

As I emailed before all the candy was all broken up and poorly packaged.This was the only time in all my years of buying from Amazon on line I have had a bad product shipped to me. I never was sent a answer back from last email ??????? Bad service!!!!! Gordon cross

column9: Cadbury Holiday Chocolate Candy Coated Mini Eggs, 10 Ounce (Pack of 4)
column10: Who couldn't love Cadbury Mini Eggs?  I get them for our grandson.  My wife and I sneak some ourselves!  Amazon price is better than retail.  They are also hard to find in stores lately, so this makes Amazon an even better choice.

I was told this tea would help with heat (both summer heat and flash heat).  It's great.  I even sweat now, I got damp, but didn't actually sweat, so it's not only helped the heat tolerance and the flashes, but helped the sweating process as well.  It's also the least expensive price I found for Pitta.  The three cans have a lot of tea in them.  I thought 2 oz wouldn't be much, but it's a lot of tea.  Well worth the price.  You can drink it hot or cold with the same results.
This is a great pizza sauce.  It is thick and tasty and freezes well for use later when you don't use the whole can.

I purchased this product because I make a lot of pizzas and the reviewers rave about this sauce. I waffled a bit before I purchased it because 12 cans is a lot to use up if you don't like it. Well, I took the plunge figuring I could hide it in meatloaf or spaghetti sauce if I didn't absolutely love it but I have to admit, I'm impressed. This sauce has deep, rich tomato flavor with not a hint of anything artificial. It's a keeper. I gave it four stars for two reasons. I feel that it's just slightly heavy on the spices and also, it's too thick--concentrated almost like a tomato paste. I add a full can of slightly drained, chopped tomatoes to a half can of the muir glen and pulse them together 12 times in my food processor. The resulting taste and texture is reminds me of good pizzeria pizza sauce and surpasses anything I was making from scratch.  Ican also see using this sauce in my spaghetti sauce and meatloaf with great results.  Highly recommended (Get on autoship to save more money).

This pizza sauce is fantastic.  It is the tastiest canned pizza sauce I have ever used, and I have tried many different brands. In my opinion, this is the difference between good and great homemade pizza. Highly recommended!
I usually make my own pizza sauce, but when I'm in a hurry, Muir Glen's is the best.  It has a fresh tomato flavor, not overpowered by sweetness from the seasonings.

Not too sweet, not too spicy and just the right consistency for pizza. I highly recommend this sauce.How much pizza can you make with one can?If you are making one 16" round pizza you will likely have extra sauce unless you lay it on extra thick. On an 18" round pizza the sauce still covers nicely but you might not have any left over for dipping.I typically make a single 12" diameter pizza and I like to lay the sauce on thick. One can is more than enough for two of these pizzas, which causes a left-over problem. Another reviewer suggests freezing the extra but that requires advanced planning to account for thaw time and I'm a guy so I never plan that far ahead.Some calculations:I figure one ounce of sauce can thickly cover about 15 sq inches of pizza. This is based on my experience with 12" diameter pizzas:... 12" diameter = 113 sq in... 2 pizzas @ 113 sq in each = ~15 sq in per ounce15 ounces @ 15 sq in per ounce means one can is enough sauce for 225 sq in of coverage, or about one 17" diameter round pizza. But who makes 17" round pizzas?If each ounce covers 15 sq in of pizza, one 15oz can will cover ...* one 18" dia round pizza (255 sq in) @ 0.059 ounce / sq in, nicely covered* one 16" dia round pizza (201 sq in) @ 0.075 ounce / sq in, extra thickly covered* two 12" dia round pizzas (226 sq in) @ 0.066 ounce / sq in, thickly covered* one 15"x15" square pizza (225 sq in) @ 0.066 ounce / sq in, thickly covered* one 13"x18" baker's half sheet (234 sq in) @ 0.064 ounce / sq in, thickly covered* two 9"x13" quarter sheet pans (234 sq in) @ 0.064 ounce / sq in, thickly coveredBy "thickly covered" I mean the sauce oozes when you take a bite. If you like to spread the sauce thinly you will have extra for dipping. Bonus!For my twelve inch pizza-making purposes a 7 or 8oz can would be ideal but I'm not going to stop buying the 15 ounce cans. I'll just have to eat more pizza.By the way, if you like pepperoni, I highly recommend Bridgford Pepperoni, Old World, 16-Ounce Sticks (Pack of 3). Good stuff.

column9: Excellent sauce for pizza and more!
column10: I make my own homemade pizza since I follow a gluten free diet.  This sauce has fabulous taste, is just the right thickness for pizza, and perfect for a quick pasta sauce or to add to homemade chili.  Amazon has a great price with the subscription service and free shipping.  Definitely recommend!!!!!

I am a really picky pizza maker.  Since I found the perfect recipe for the crust, I have been testing various toppings.  Since I make almost everything from scratch, I used to make pizza sauce from scratch as well, but that got to be really time consuming.  So, if I'm in a rush, I use this canned sauce because is the best I have found.  It's terrific as a base for marguerita pizza.

I love pizza and love to cook and this sauce is the best out there. I used to make my own but this tastes better. Muir Glen makes amazing tomato products. The fire roasted canned tomato products are amazing as well.

This is a fabulous sauce, and I never want to be without it here at home. We make our own homemade pizzas once a week. It's easier on the budget and comes together quickly after coming home from work. This sauce makes it better than the take-out places. It's the best pizza sauce in the marketplace, and I have tried many from all over the US.

I don't often buy convenience type items.  We like to make our own sauces and other items homemade.  However, after trying this pizza sauce, we've allowed it into our house.  Why?  This sauce has a tremendously good flavor!  Whether it's the tomatoes used or just the right spices, I don't know.  Either way, this has earned a prize position in our very picky pantry!

column9: One of the best healthy pizza sauces on the market
column10: After trying a few different brands of organic, healthy pizza sauce, this one has easily hands down become my favorite.  Not only is it great as a pizza sauce, but I also use it as a pasta sauce for spaghetti and chicken parmesan.  I do not care for spicy anything, and I do not find it too spicy at all.  If you make homemade pizza or eat pasta, I'd encourage you to give this sauce a try.  Not only is it delicious, it is also healthy.
Not the best pizza sauce you can buy but I'm limited on what I can have shipped and this does come in a non-pull top can. After adding cheese and other toppings it's fine.

I just recently got into making homemade pizzas and until I found this sauce on Amazon my pizzas were just ok, fairly bland and nothing special.  I purchased this on faith of reviews and everyone saying how good it was.  I am glad I made the purchase as it is truley delicious!

Not as good as everyone is raving about, although its good, i wont be buying another full case. It is a little on the spicy side, but if you add 8 oz. of tomato sauce you will have a good balance.ive got 6 cans for sale!!

My wife and I make pizzas nearly every Friday instead of ordering.  This makes a terrific pizza base, top a nice homemade crust, add cheese, sausage, mushrooms and pepperoni and bake...and you've got a pizza that puts commercial pizzas to shame.

I used to make my own pizza sauce before I discovered Muir Glen.  This sauce is rich and thick.  It also has a familiar, traditional pizza flavor that my two young boys approve of!  The best part is that it doesn't contain high fructose corn syrup like many other brands do.  If you make a lot of pizza, the case price is a good buy.

family of 6 - 3 boys/3 girls - we go through a lot of pizzas:)  The only thing that would be any better is if I made it myself:)  ...and if it were in a glass jar (metal toxins):  Great sauce- I would absolutley recommend:)

Wow. This can of Pizza sauce is seriously the best sauce our family has ever had! We purchased a pack of 12 and gave out many cans to our friends to try and they were totally impressed also. Not over seasoned and tastes of really ripe tomatoes. Super red color, all natural, organic and totally simple. We love simple food that tastes like it is supposed to. This product tastes like the most lovely tomatoes picked fresh from the garden and freshly pureed but still has texture. Love it! Your homemade pizza will be perfect with this sauce and you won't get any pesticides that create cancer in your pizza to boot! How can you knock that?

This sauce has everything I love.  It's thick, tomatoey, great spices and low calorie.  I started making pizza at home and this sauce is the best.  I also decided to use it with pastas, meatloaf, anything requiring tomato sauce.  If it's too thick for your personal taste, just cut it with a can of Muir Glen diced tomatoes or the fire roasted diced.  Fantastic!  I'm just waiting for Amazon to get it back on subscribe and save.  SO much less expensive.

column9: Y U M M Y......S T U F F...l  CI  : )  - O R G A N I C, .....T O O !
column10: The little chef in my title heralds something very tasty!  And this Muir Glen Organic Pizza Sauce, 15-Ounce Cans, Pack of 12 -- certainly IS tasty!  Made with all organic ingredients, you can eat it without fear of eating anything harmful -- because it's full of safe, organic, ingredients!Use it as a pizza sauce.  Use it as a spaghetti sauce, or wherever tomato sauce or a similar ingredient is called for.  You can even melt cheese, then pour it IN the sauce, mix the two together, and add to a calzone / pirogie crust!  The extra spices make this pizza sauce taste different from regular tomato sauce or tomato paste; they are just the RIGHT spices to make anything you add this sauce to, taste like pizza!At 40 calories per serving, and 7 servings per can, each can contains 240 calories.This makes it a very tasty, quite low-calorie snack, all by itself!If you like pizza, you will like this pizza sauce!
Found it at Safeway and tried it. WOW! Now I'm ordering a case (like I do with Muir Glen Organic Diced Tomatoes, Fire Roasted, 14.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)). Great stuff!

column9: a little chunky...so my kids didn't like it. But I think its good!!
column10: It tasted good to me. Its not as sweet as the 'normal' stuff you buy in the store, since they probably don't add tons of sugar. I think my kids would be OK with the flavor, but there are small pieces of onion, etc in there and as soon as they noticed...they wouldn't eat anymore....I suppose you could puree it...but then you have more stuff to clean later.

column9: dehydrated onion or bits of plastic?
column10: Love the flavor of this pizza sauce, and the price (especially for organic products) and also the convenience of ordering from amazon. For each of those points, it gets a star.The one thing I can't stand about it, though, is the dehydrated "onion" - it's SO tough and dried, I really can't chew it up that well. At least, it takes longer to chew than anything else so I'm occasionally left with what seems like a little bit of plastic to spit out - it's really quite disgusting. I don't think I'll be purchasing any of this pizza sauce ... probably will try to run the remaining cans of sauce through a sieve or something before using.

column9: Ordered and Shipped the Wrong Product....
column10: Ordered this item when it was priced under $20 but was shipped the wrong Muir Glen Item-Plain Tomato Sauce.Tried to return the Plain Tomato Sauce, called Customer Service the same evening of the day the wrong item arrived but was told I could not.Refund issued after a bit of a tiff with Customer Service, then was told Amazon could not ship the right product-the Pizza Sauce.Told to reorder but the new price was increased to over $30 at that time.Glad the price has come back down to under $25 for now and hope folks who now order get the RIGHT product.
I love Muir Glen products in general, so I took a chance on this. Word of caution: it's really spicy. Our kids hated it.
peace iced tea is a tea company that is apparently controlled by the notorious energy drink company, monster; and is a must try beverage. When i say must try, i mean MUST . TRY.

I was pleasantly surprised at the thirst quenching love I felt in consuming this product.  I have had other tea products that left me feeling strange afterwards.  This is a tea I will grab for a certain great drink experience!

column9: As good as the movie, maybe better
column10: [preparing to open the can] In the immortal words of Jean Paul Sartre, 'Au revoir,tea'.Sorry about the poor Caddy Shack reference, but this tea is great.  Tastes good, low on calories, plus one huge 23 ounce can that can satisfy about any thirst.
Limited availability in stores (mostly drug stores and gas stations). The taste blows away the "Arnold Palmer" in a can. Very good - sweet and satisfying!

I LOVED these things as a child & was so happy to see them more available. I have a weird addiction to sweet gum, so these are perfect. Might be weird for someone who hasn't tried them before, they're hard & turn into a very chewy almost stiff gum. Mine never really make it that for though, because I swallow my gum, bad I know!!! good thing I shared these...

I hadn't tried Numi teas prior to this, but I will definitely be purchasing this particular tea in the future.I'm a bit of a tea junkie, and use a dedicated Zarafina tea brewer (Zarafina Tea Maker Suite with Ceramic Tea Pots, Cups, and Serving Tray) for making both loose-leaf and bagged teas, as I find I get a more consistent cup of tea this way - this may or may not be the issue some of the other reviewers were running into with their cups.I've found this tea to be a very pleasant surprise.  I don't typically like "flavored" teas, such as blueberry or strawberry, but this tea caught me off guard.  After pouring the tea, I noticed a very pleasant chocolate scent coming from the cup.  While most flavored teas have a stronger odor and weak taste, the chocolate and vanilla taste in this tea is definitely pronounced without being overbearing or cloying, and really didn't need sweetening.  If you do decide to sweeten it, I would recommend something simple, such as raw sugar or a half packet of Splenda.  Anything more aggressive would probably ruin the taste of this tea; definitely don't use a creamer.The chocolate and vanilla flavor is pretty complex, especially for a bagged tea.  I found it a very pleasant change from my standard English breakfast and white teas.  It's a black tea, but not as aggressive as most black teas are.  My wife is a die-hard coffee drinker, but even she got hooked on this one, and it's become a habit to have a cup of this after dinner.It *would* be nice to have a loose-leaf variety of this tea for the tea elitists like myself, but it's not a dealbreaker for me.  I'm a big fan of this one, and it has me considering other bagged teas for the future.

column9: My favorite tea in the whole world. Period.
column10: Now, I don't presume to say that this is a tea for everyone. I don't quite get it, but obviously, considering the reviews, many people don't like it at all. (I gave t-bags to 2 co-workers, after raving about how wonderful this is, and their lack of comment 6 weeks later tells me that they didn't like it, either.) It's up to you whether you want to risk disliking it, or missing out on something truly amazing. (Rule of thumb: If you like pu-erh, you might as well try it; if not, this might not be your best introduction to it.)When I'm having a horrible day, when things have turned sour and the world seems to be against me, this is my cup of comfort, my security blanket. It soothes me, calms me with its sheer deliciousness. (Give a child a big bar of chocolate, and he'll stop sulking in no time. That's my equivalent.)Now, this tea is amazing, but far from perfect. I wish there were twice as much tea in each bag, for starters; this is a bit weak, and I use big mugs. I wish there was more pu-erh than condiments (chocolate nibs, orange pieces) per bag. I wish that it was good for multiple re-steepings, as most pu-erhs are. A few more t-bags per box would be very nice too, or a lower price tag.In fact, these shortcomings annoy me a bit, and I've been looking for other chocolate teas (pu-erh and non-pu-erh) to substitute it. So far they've all failed. It is next to impossible to find *good* chocolate tea; most are terrible. See: I hate rooibos, so that plus chocolate equals "eeew". I like black tea, but haven't found a good combination yet. Green tea and chocolate sounds gross; I haven't tried it yet. Same for white and oolong. I've only found another brand of chocolate pu-erh (Mighty Leaf) but the flavor wasn't there.But I found a way to make this perfect: I cut a bag open and mix it with regular pu-erh; Rishi Tea Organic Pu-erh Tuo Cha Loose Tea, 5-Ounce Tin (Pack of 2) or a Camel's Breath tuo cha work beautifully. This way I can steep it 3-4 times, and I get the yummy flavor in a much stronger version. Heavenly!!!

Every bag of this tea I've tried so far has been very different from  the other bags. Sort of a Tea roulette. Several cups have been quite weak, even in a six ounce cup, no matter how long I brewed it. One cup was strong but bitter, another had a huge amount of cocoa powder sediment. I tried double bagging one cup which made a strong, bitter cup that tasted more like stale coffee than like either tea or chocolate and one cup was actually pretty good. Only one cup had any discernible spice flavor.  The cocoa seems to be rather poor quality too. On the other hand one of my daughters' just loves it.

A very tasteful tea with just the perfect hint of chocolate.  Good for the sunday afternoon when you need a warm refresher.  I'm more of a dark tea drinker, earl grey is probably my favorite flavor and english breakfast at a close second.  This tea for me is definitely a situational tea.  The hint of chocolate goes perfect with a small serving of ice cream or a nice spring afternoon at the porch.  It isn't the best tea for early mornings, nor is it something you drink at the end of the night.  I would recommend this tea along with your vanilla ice cream as they just seem to compliment each other.  The tea is bold though and of good quality and the flavor is not bitter at all.

I won't call myself a tea expert.  Organic green tea is pretty much all I drink.  I'm known as the "tea expert" in my social circle because I know of the existence of white tea (although I haven't tried it yet).  Onen day, I was in a Natural Foods store, and the attractive package and appealing description of this Numi tea caught my eye.  Since I was on vacation, I splurged and bought the box.  Tried it as soon as I got home.And I've never looked back.  I admit, the first cup wasn't eye-popping.  It had a pleasant taste, but I decided it wasn't worth the $10 I had to spend on the single box (Amazon sure has a nice deal going on).  Except, the next day, I found myself looking forward to having another cup.  It WAS good - such a unique, warm taste.  Over the next few days, I discovered that - in my opinion - it tastes best after brewing for 5+ minutes in WARM water, not boiling.  I just let the faucet run on hot, and fill up the cup with it.  That's probably not the "right" way to brew tea, butI've since had a steady supply of this tea - it's just delicious.  Highly recommended!

column9: Great tea! Tasty, warm, & super delicious!
column10: If you are a tea drinker and like a bit if variety, this is for you.  Indulge in the wonderful and healthy benefits of a rich chocolate without the added fat and calories.This is a rich and satisfying brew. It looks great, it smells great, it tastes great.We enjoy having this on hand for a bit of guilt free indulgence.  It is nice to have at your desk for a pick me up during a work session.  We have served it to guests after dinner and it is always well received. This tea has now been sampled by many in our household and everyone has always really loved it.This is a wonderful and different tea!

Unsweetened, this has a nice mellow, black tea flavor, with a hint of cocoa, orange and spice.  Sweetened with sugar, the flavors intesify somewhat, but when I added a splash of soy milk, it completely dominated the flavor and the subtleness of the cocoa and orange was lost.  Perhaps cow's milk would be better if you prefer milk with your tea.For anyone on a gluten-free diet like myself, Numi's website states that all their teas are gluten free, with no chance of cross contamination.I think I'll go have another cup.
This tea was very tasty. It has bittersweet chocolate notes that are layered upon an excellent base tea. This is great to go along with dessert for people who do not drink coffee.
