Was using peanut butter on bread to hide them, as even the chewables they weren't interested in chewing, and wrestling them to get the pills down just makes it an unpleasant experience.  With Pill Pockets they actually COME for their meds when they hear me open the bag!

column9: It takes away the aggravation in feeding your pet pills
column10: Whoever invented this product is brilliant. Both my dog and cat love the taste. It makes giving them pills easy and fun. Because it's moist I suggest putting in the refrigerator after opening.

Most dogs I've had have no problem taking pills, except for my yorkie, very obstinant.  It is a whole lot easier just to pop her meds in one of these, and we are both happier for it.  These are great.  End of struggles, she doesn't try to hide from me at pill time.  What could be greater.  The price is worth it!

column9: Perfect for Giving Medications to Our Dogs
column10: Every month, we give our three dogs (two Aussies and a Golden/Flat-Coat Retriever mix) pills for flea/tick/worm repellant.  In addition, one of our Aussies needs daily thyroid pills.  We found Pill Pockets is the very best way to do this.  Opening the mouth wide and trying to put the pill waaay in the back of the mouth before clamping the jaws shut and massaging the throat until the poor dog swallows is a bad thing to do to a beloved pet.  It's bad because Pill Pockets make this chore a happy and delicious time for the dog involved.  The Pockets (in the pet store we use) come in chicken or beef flavors, so we alternate flavors every time we buy a new supply.  Everybody is happy, and the dogs get the required meds.

These are 12.99 plus tax at petco. They work wonderfully for giving dogs pills. I like to break them in half, then mold it around a large capsule for my pug. They work better than cheese, banana, wet food or other treats.
If need to give your dog medicine these pill pockets are the best. My dog loves them so there is no running around the house trying to give him his medicine.

My dog doesnt like the flavor of the duck but loves the peanut butter.  I was shocked because she loves duck dog food.  I gave them to my girlfriend and her dog loves them.  My dog is super pickey and somewhat of a treat perfectionist!  She is spoiled I will admit it.

column9: Great for pets that don't like to take pills.
column10: We have used the beef, chicken and the peanut butter Pill Pockets, we tried hot dogs before, but our dog would eat the hot dog and spit out the pills.  We tried the pill poctets and he actually ate the whole thing.  Great product.

It used to be a pain giving my dog two pills twice a day. With pill pockets, I fill several days worth at a time, so medicine time is quick and easy. Now I just grab one, and say "Medicine time", and he comes running.
I love whoever invented these.  My dogs are real stinkers when it comes to taking pills and these work great.  They line up waiting to get one!

We have tried all the various flavors of Pill Pockets for our dogs. One has a twice a day pill she takes and the other once a day. Chicken and Beef work ok most times but the dogs have never not wanted to take their pill when we use this Duck flavor.The consistency is excellent for being able to wrap around a small pill or to break apart and use only half at a time if needed. The smell is just enough to help hide the scent of the pills. The dogs just love it when I open up the pouch and come running to take their pills.

column9: Our cat loves them for his pills
column10: Our cat doesn't like the feline Pill Pockets so much, but he loves these canine beef ones. (Our vet said it was fine to give him doggie PPs.) And, the pieces are big, so I can use only half a Pill Pocket each day for his pills--saves me money. (I take the half Pill Pocket and split it in half, as he takes two pills a day.) Anyone who has ever had to "pill" a cat knows what a relief it is to just give a treat and the pilling is done. Great product.
Excellent product and transaction so glad I was able to find these on amazon. No more fuss about meds with our pup! She gobbles them down!

I had gone to the vet and I got these for my dog and she absolutely loves them! It has no foul smell although it does smell a little weird on your fingers so wash them but thats normal. Its as simple as you take a little bit or the whole treat and stick medicine or a pill inside of it and cover the pill and they will eat it right away!Its vet approved and very safe for dogs to eat so dont be worried but read the ingredients just in case. I love these soooooooo much. Thanks!

column9: Fabulous resource for the reluctant pill taker
column10: This makes giving daily pills a snap. Our dog thinks she is getting a treat all the time when all she is doing is getting her meds.
They work every time to hide a pill.  Great product that works very well. I buy the largest size and pinch off what I need to cover the pill.

column9: These are large, the cat size is smaller and has more
column10: I love these, we have a cat that is impossible to administer pills to, but she goes stark freaking INSANE for these pill pockets. We used the feline size, which has more pockets in it than the dog size. However at one point she had to take a couple of pills at the same time and I could not fit all the pills into the cat-size pocket, so I bought the dog size. All kitty knew was hey, I'm getting a BIGGER treat than normal!If you have a dog that takes micro doses of tablets or just one small tablet, get the cat size and they'll go much farther.I purchased the chicken dog pockets for my cat and she loved them. That seems to be the flavor most of my cats like.

column9: Very affordable and shipping is quick.
column10: I have used pill pockets in the past, and continue to use them. It makes it so easy to administer especially if you have a hard time giving medication to your pet.

My Maltese pup was given a chewable heartworm combo pill to use and the first time I offered it to him, he all but ran away.  Lucky me, I was prepared because I had already purchased these pill pockets.  I carefully slipped the heartworm pill into one and pinched it closed, then gave him the good boy talk.  He took the pill pocket and thoroughly enjoyed eating it, including the insert.  Problem solved.Whoever came up with this idea has my thanks.  These would have saved me a lot of trouble in the past with other dogs.  I just hope Puka doesn't catch on as he gets older.  I'm thinking about giving him a pinch of one every now and then to reinforce it being a treat instead of medicine.  They are very soft and sticky and apparently very tasty.

We have been buying this product for several years but at pet store or vets.This was first time ordered on line and had shipped. Each bag the pockets were wet/slimy upon opening and not sure if that was their original shipment condition or from sitting in my hot Florida mailbox till I get home. Of course the dogs could care less but they broke apart easliy as if all the mushy flexibility had leaked out and made them wet. So in trying to close the end over this giant capsule..., even in the large size, made pieces break off and made this mom a mess. were not expired or anything o/w good shipping and communication.

I have to give my do meds twice a day, and these pockets make it so easy. I prefill  at least a week at a time, and keep them in tuperware. Every morning and evening I say "Time for medicine." , and he comes running.

column9: Warning: using this product may have unintended side effects
column10: This is both a blessing and a curse.  The blessing part is these pill pockets are pretty much perfect.  They take a pill very nicely, cover it, and make it wonderfully desirable for the dog to eat the pills.  "Serve with food because it's so bitter your dog will hate you forever" is not a match for these little suckers.  Little dog loves these, and would happily snarf down the entire packet if she could.  As for the curse... well, you can no longer safely move pill containers anywhere.  With a keen ear and a taste for beef pill pockets, your dog will hear you shift your containers even one nanometer and come running, expecting you to give it a treat.  My Dad has to take pills twice daily... you can see why this is an issue.Sealed air tight for freshness.  Approximately 30 to a bag.  Suitable for small pills.  Tasty, yet functional.  A fantastic delivery system for an otherwise annoying problem.  5 stars.

I have great animals that are usually willing to do whatever I ask of them.  Unfortunately my male dog gets anal gland infections once or twice a year.  I have tried many ways of administering his antibiotics from coating with peanut butter/cream cheese or wrapping in slices of cheese.  All of these methods work for the first few days but over time he decides the treat isn't worth while so I end up forcing the pill down his throat and giving a treat afterwards as a reward for being tolerant.  Eventually he starts refusing his treat and looks at me like I'm abusing him, lol.  So this time I decided to try Greenies pill pockets.  I chose the capsule size since they are supposed to be larger and he needed to take three pills at a time.  I also chose the duck and pea formula to provide a unique flavor.  Each night he watched me place the antibiotics in the pocket and form a nice ball then eagerly took his treat.  They apparently smell very appealing as my female dog also begged for them and we have to store them in a cabinet because the cat tried to help himself by chewing on the bag.  By the end of the first week, all three animals would line up in the kitchen at the end of the night waiting for their treat!  They did leave a strong smelling oily residue on my fingers but washed off quickly and easily with just a little water and friction.  Purchased through Amazon with Prime shipping.  Arrive quickly in perfect condition.

column4: Merrin Folender "Seriously, I know what's good."
column10: I bought these at the vet's office when I needed to give my dogs pills.  They said dogs really love the beef flavor and they were right!  The pills and pill pocket were gone before I knew it!  I still buy the pill pockets as treats even though they don't need medicine because they really love them.  Since they're used to getting them, they won't realize there's a pill in there if/when the time comes that they have to take some medicine.  Highly recommended in beef flavor or peanut butter.
my dog wanted to do this review for you guys. i said sure. dog: "nom nom nom.... medicine!? what medicine???"
My dog loves both Chicken and beef.  Does not even notice her pill inside.  The ones for largrer dogs are too big for her.  I bought both sizes before.  Everything came quickly and was in good shape.
What a great idea!  I have to give my labrador thyroid medicine twice a day for the rest of his life. This makes it a breeze!

column9: Helpful to get pickey eaters to take their medication.
column10: My one doxie won't eat either the chicken or beef flavored pill pockets, but he will eat the "Duck and Pea" flavor; this is also the formula to buy if your dog has allergies.  The product smells quite strong when you first open the pouch; I suspect the peas give it that distinct odor. I don't need to use the entire pocket per pill, so I break a section off of the capsule just large enough to encapsulate the size pill I need to administer, forming the soft, pliable substance around it.  It is most economical to buy the capsule size, so I do so, but they also come in a smaller, pill size shape.I haven't purchased the pill pockets for my cats yet and don't know how they would be received, but this product has helped me give my dogs medication.  Even when the pill is supposedly chewable, and "liver-flavored," my dogs will generally not take their medication willingly unless I disguise it first.  These can make your life with your pet easier. Shop around for the best price as these can be a bit expensive if you have to use them frequently.

column9: Wonderful as always; my dog adores these!
column10: Although these don't have the most pleasant scent, their effectiveness render's my nose's experience immaterial. These Greenies never fail to fulfill their purpose; once thoroughly surrounded by the pill pocket, any pill, capsule, or necessity I'd otherwise have to battle to shove down my dog's throat gets gobbled up. Actually, swallowed without chewing is more accurate. My dog has become increasingly sensitive with age, and she has shown signs of mild to severe allergies, digestive, dermatological and other manifestations. Not once has she experienced any hint of an adverse reaction to these. Without hesitation, I strongly recommend this product and flavor. These are a staple in our house, and I will continue to purchase these pill pockets in the pea and duck formula monthly.

My dog loves these. Totally unaware that she is taking a pill. The pockets are nice and soft, and can be squished around to totally cover the pill. My dog doesn't seem to know the difference of flavors, so I just get the ones that gives me the most for the least dollars and cents. It's only a small price difference, but, hey, it is a difference.

column9: Probably A Good Product, Just Not For Sweet Girl!
column10: When I got these in the mail last Saturday and opened them up, put in a pill that she absolutely hates the smell of, offered it to her and she gulped it down we were thrilled to death!  We have not been able to get this dog to take this particular medication using everything from hot dogs to hamburgers and several kinds of cheese, so when she ate this thing like it was candy my wife and I were both excited.  Then that afternoon for her last dose for the day, same performance.  We thought we had found the answer to our prayers as she has a disease that can't be cured if she doesn't take this medication until it's all gone.  So this was a Godsend!But, the very next morning, before she had anything else to eat, my wife tried to give her a pill using a Pocket and she turned her nose up at it and walked away!!  She tried several times with varying amounts of the pocket cut off to make it smaller for her and easier to gulp down.  Still no go.  So we waited a couple of hours, without feeding her anything at all, tried again, same thing.So I saw a bag of Pockets in Walmart and the only thing they had besides Beef was Duck so I tried that.  Same thing.  Wouldn't even eat one so we're back to looking for something else that might work.  If your dog will eat them they are GREAT!!
My dogs LOVE these ! I have 3 dogs. 58 lbs., 15 lbs., and 10 lbs ! They ALL adore greenies. HOODIES as we call them !!
Giving my dog pills was a nightmare until my vet game me some of these to try. They smell good and my dog loves to take her pills tucked inside a greenie pill pocket. Problem solved : )

Pill pockets are fantastic! My old (13 yrs) dog has to take medication for Congestive Heart Failure and Arthritis daily. It was getting to be a chore to think of things to hide the 4 pills in...until I found pill pockets at my Vet's office. I highly recommend this product and do does "old dog." I found this product much cheaper on Amazon than at my Vet.

column9: Pill Pockets - Great Product - Good Price
column10: My dogs love these. They think they are getting a treat and eat their pills, no problem. This is a good price for a great product. Fast shipping makes it even better.

Pill pockets are ideal for giving drugs to dogs, much easier than squashing pills into a piece of cheese!  Our dog sees daily pill times as a treat now and comes and sits patiently waiting.  We are on our 4th packet of these and will definitely order more whenever we are giving drugs to dogs!

Our puppy (a bernedoodle) loves these duck treats.  We started using them for pills, but now use them to spread inside of kongs and other toys.  She has a sensitive tummy, so these are great for multiple uses.

My pets love these things, and they make giving medicine so easy!  I no longer have to chase my dogs down and hope that they take their medicine.  With these I KNOW the pill is going to get swallowed.My dogs love anything duck flavored.  They went wild over these!

If you've ever tried to get your dog to swallow pills, you know how wonderful these are.  We have four dogs (three Corgis and a mixed breed), and all like them, and these have been successful with them all.Our mixed breed dog was about 13, and her disease was terminal, and we weren't ready to lose her (not that anyone ever is).  We had medicines that would make her comfortable in her final stages, but the problem was getting her to take them...we tried all sorts of things: peanut butter, apple sauce, fruit, meat--all had a certain ability to disguise the taste, but she got wise to them pretty quickly.But the Greenies Pill Pockets ALWAYS worked.  We were able to extend her life, with comfort, for a couple of months longer, and for that I'll always be grateful.A NOTE: The Greenies come in several flavors (chicken, beef, duck & peas), sizes, and also flavors for cats.  If you need to be more economical, you can also "shave" them down by squeezing off a little of them (depending on the strength of the pill they're taking).

We have had a number of cats with medical problems and tried any number of ways to get pills into them.  Pill Pockets are by far the easiest method.Most of our animals have considered Pill Pockets as "treats" and readily eaten them.  Our current feline gets three pockets in the morning and three in the evening, so we go through a lot.One suggestion:  if your smaller pet needs to take many meds, buy the pockets designed for capsuls for dogs.  Product pricing seems to be related to the number of "doses", rather than the weight.  I believe the small package for cats is 1.6 oz and costs only a few $ less than this 6.6 oz package. If you go through the pockets like we do, the savings are substantial.  We simply tear off a piece of the larger pocket and wrap it around the pill.  It takes 15 seconds.Another suggestion is to get a selection of flavors.  Our cat goes through periods where certain flavors are unacceptable, so it is good to alternate and have backups.If you are really desperate, you can always use human meat baby food.  We haven't seen a cat yet that would't take that.Summary:  A much better way to give your pet meds than a pill shooter.

First off, I have found that buying these treats on Amazon is cheaper than purchasing them at PetSmart. I buy the capsule version of the Pill Pockets versus the tablet version because the bags are larger (it holds more ounces) and the cost difference is almost nothing. I then break that one capsule up into many pieces because they are soft & malleable. I am able to get that one bag to last me for many servings. I only use it to wrap up my dog's Prozac pill.  He will gobble it down with no problem. However, if I try to use any larger pill such as a Heartworm pill or Allergy pill in them, he will eat the treat part off & spit out the medicinal pill. For those types of pills, I just crush them up and stir them in some wet food for him.

we tried alot of things to hide pills in.  our dog would maybe fall for it once or twice, but then would spit out the pills and eat the cheese, peanut butter, hot dog, etc. that it was wrapped in.  But then we found pill pockets and he likes them enough to eat them and the pill inside.  the best thing is how easy it is to form them around different pills, and how you can only use pieces of one pill pocket on smaller pills to make them stretch farther.

These pill pockets are the easiest way to get a dog to take its meds.  My dog scarfs them down no problem.  They can be kind of pricey, especially if you have a dog that requires daily medication, as they only come 30 in a pack and retail for $7.99 (cheaper on amazon of course!).  I would definitely recommend them if you have a dog that has trouble taking his pills.
Finally something my german sheps can not get the pills out of !! They even work great @ the Pet Hospital for our patients.

I have been giving my dog all his medication using Pill Pockets. He just loves them. I prefer the smell of Beef over Chicken, but he doesn't care. They definetly were cheaper through Amazom. I will buy these again.

Like most dogs I have met, our dogs HATE getting their meds. These things take the headache out of giving medication to dogs.  The dogs get so excited for these pill pockets, and they are easy to use.  The pockets are very soft, so if you live in a hot and humid place, they will turn into a pile of mush.  However, you can easily just take a piece of mush and wrap it around the pill.  The dogs don't care if it is shaped properly or not.  Our dogs just swallow it hole and sit there waiting for another one.
Great product !  Finally me older dog will take her medicine without me trying to disguise it with some other treat.......

THE PRICE ON THE GREENIES PILL POCKETS WITH THE SHIPPING WAS ABOUT 22% LESS THAN THE PRICE AT PET SUPERMARKET OR PETS MART.  EXCELLENT DELIVERY TIME AS WELL. I WAS HOPING FOR A BETTER SELECTION OF FLAVORS. I CERTAINLY WOULD LOOK TO ORDER THIS AGAIN WHEN NEEDED.
I purchased six bags of the Greenies and were very happy with them.  The price was great and so was the product.  Carol

These smell worse than the regular chicken/beef Greenies pockets. However, I have a dog with a major stomach problem that the vet is narrowing down to a food allergy - to stop her pain I can definately withstand the brief smell. All three of my dogs think they are treats and actually beg for them, so does one of my cats lol.Anyhow the price of these keep skyrocketing in the sotres and at my vet,I am glad to find them on here at a better price considering how often we go through them!!!!!
Forget the peanut butter, cheese or whatever else you are using.  And stop shoving pills down the dog's throat.  These are a lifesaver!  Our cocker spaniel just gobbles it down, no muss, no fuss.
I have used this flavor - pea and duck for quite some time but the last 5 bags I have purchased smells HORRIBLE. I'm very disappointed and hope the manufacturer fixes the problem.

Easy to Grow bulbs is very highly rated by it's many customers on the "Watchdog" ratings.  That's because it provide large sized bulbs at great prices with a large selection.  Appleblossom is a commonly sold Hippeastrum (that's the correct name), but if you've been dissaappointed by "gifts" that have come from the supermarket or big box stores, try this company.  We got 5 huge beautiful blooms from this bulb.  It blooms for about 2 weeks. Oh, and don't buy one of those foolish "gift packages" just use a 7 or 8 inch pot with soiless potting mix (any kind will do).  Let the soil dry out between waterings, and then put it in an out of the way spot in your garden after frost danger is gone.  It will bloom for you next year too.

column9: Raw Organics going back to Paradise
column10: Raw is eating from your Organic garden of fresh grown fruits and vegetables.It is also all the nuts growing from the mountains that surrounds us through out the land from the forest. Although grown from a tiny little seed that the sun and rain helps in growth it is our heavenly father our creator God who truly makes them grow and should be appreciated for his gift of life to us all and for our home the planet we call earth .I used to be a true vegetarian then I went to only eating Poultry and some fish and eggs through out the years.Now I will eat vegetarian soup made with some beef stock but I don't care for the meat itself and no pork.I am still Organic Alternative and Green but I am slowly trying to go back to being that true vegetarian that I used to be however going raw will take a some time because I have a little hard time chewing with my teeth like my friend but after I get my dentures I will be able to adjust into it .Right now I am canning for winter storage.I have dehydrated my whole garden into green super power food that I added to my barley greens. note if you choose to cook get the Fagor Pressure cooker caner That I got it helps make the meals go quicker and is a lot healthier than baking and Broiling or grilling and never fry food.Well I will let you know how the canning turn out and one day I'd like to make home made all fruit yes that's right not jelly or jam.Hi Again so far so good I have canned 4 pint jars of my home made spaghetti sauce with 4 of Chili and 4 vegetarian soups with 2 red cabbages and they sealed and are ready for winter when things get rough as around here it is hard to get organics so when I do I get all that I can like I just got up at the farmers market this late fall and then I either freeze them or can them and even dehydrate them.So I will keep you up to date but I need to try and get some organic fruits and that is hard to get again around here.well catch ya later as I never say goodbye!Just get this wonderful organic fruit nut and seed mix it has no preservatives and is delicious and affordable and if I can get it you can too. Just remember to soak the nuts and seeds because nature puts some  protective coating on it and they need to break down this to be edible and fit for human consumption.

We purchased Activate water while we were travelling recently, by car, to visit family in another state.  I had never heard of it before but gave it a try.  Can you call something with no taste delicious???  We drink filtered water at home, but this water was so pure, we are considering having it delivered directly to our door (it is not available locally).  Highly recommended!

It's actually 60.3% cocoa solids, not 63.3% as advertised.Rich and creamy. Not too sweet and not too bitter. The ingredients* say it all.Certainly among Belgium's finest. Very well done.If I had to do it over, I may try the product with closer to 50% cocoa. Still, 60.3% is certainly tasty and it's probably best to go with the highest content of cocoa one can stand (the higher, the healthier). (I probably would not attempt 70% for anything other than cooking.)*Ingredients: unsweetened chocolate, sugar, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural vanilla flavor. May contain milk.

I was first introduced to this when we were in Jamaica.  Even went up to the mountains to the Pickapeppa factory.Saw how it was packaged.My son was home at the time and he eats this on just about everything.Sometimes it's hard to find.  When I saw this I jumped on it.  He was really delighed, especially when he saw howmuch I had.  Of course he's 30 now, but still uses it all the times.
I got tired of scanning shelves for Pickapeppa & not finding it . They were quick to ship & now I've got a year's supply of yumminesss .

I've been using Pickapeppa for at least 25 years.  My mother-in-law introduced it to me when she would pour it over cream cheese for an appetizer.  My sons have grown up with having it always in the frig. for steaks, chicken, cream cheese or whatever!  It's still not available in all the grocery stores but found it much easier just to buy it by the case.  It never lasts long, though!

Pickapeppa Sauce is the best ever.  We have enjoyed this product for probably 20 years.  It's great poured over cream cheese with Wheat Thins.  It's super with steak and pork.  Also good for dipping veggies.  The sauce is not for the timid.  Not because of hotness, but it is so interesting, full of exotic spice flavor and exciting to eat.  My favorite!!!

I was first introduced to Pickapeppa sauce when a friend of mine started traveling back and forth to Jamaica. I was hooked the first time I tried it. I have had trouble finding the sauce here in the states and was thrilled to find it on this site and in  bulk no less!! The price was as expected and shipment arrived in a decent amount of time.
Hard to find now that I've moved up north, but I have yet to serve at a BBQ without accolades!

Given our difficulty finding this product locally this was a great buy.  One bottle did break in transit, but considering we ordering 4 cases I suppose this isn't too bad.  Quick delivery and great price.  Will likely order again.
It's not steak sauce or pepper sauce. The flavor is unique, a combination of the two plus much more.also the best price i can find.

It's a better version of A1 Steak Sauce that we use on the table when we're eating cold chicken or other things that need a kick. My wife doesn't like spicy things in the least bit- but she likes this sauce. When she tried it and liked it, I was truly amazed. It gets a little pricey when you buy it at the stores, but buying at Buy The Case . Com is the way to fly.

I have gone through many gallons of this over the past 13 years since I discovered it and could hardly imagine a day without it.  It's strong, somewhat spicey/peppery, but really complex thanks to ingredients like mango. If something like A1 or Heinz 57 had no faults of any kind, they might be like Pickapeppa. I haven't served it to anyone who hasn't like it. Great for meats, sauces, basting, even with vegetables.

column4: The Wizard of Rock and Roll "bigbill947"
column10: One of the best sauce condiments in the world , try mixing with a little bit of catsup , to extend or mellow the taste a bit !

column9: Finally a truly dairy free soy free whipped topping
column10: And it is soooo good.  If you like the tub of whipped topping at the grocery store, but have food allergies or just an aversion to nasty ingredients like hydrogenated oils, etc this is the whipped topping for you.  Made from cashews and almonds this whipped topping adds that creamy yumminess without all the dairy or hydrogenated oils to your favorite desserts.  You simply put the box right in the freezer to get super cold, but not frozen.  Put the mixer bowl and beaters in the freezer to chill too.  Then once cold, whip up in your stand mixer for 3-5 minutes and viola, now hide it from the family or it will get gone before you have a chance to use it for its intended purpose.

Even though I make wicked-good homemade cashew creams in my blender, I really wanted to give this a try because my homemade creams are not "whippable." I also liked the white color, which is perfect for showing off vanilla flecks or using as a canvas for natural food colorings.This cream tastes decadent, although it is actually fairly low in sugar. It whips nicely, and it can even make a lovely icing or cream filling for vegan treats because it sets nicely in the fridge.  I have flavored the cream with maple, vanilla, and cinnamon so far (not at the same time!), and I plan to try strawberry or other fruit flavors. Maybe even mint.I also love that it contains sunflower lecithin instead of soy lecithin (which quite often is genetically modified).Leftovers also keep well in the fridge, which is great for those of us with small households.

I am now officially addicted to this. Even though the package indicates that you have to place it in the freezer prior to whipping, I have no problems just keeping it in the refrigerator prior to whipping.The taste is wonderful, not the sickly feeling I got with milk based whipped cream. In fact, prior to this product, I did not like whipped cream. This was called for in a recipe.

column9: Finally . . . a gluten free dairy free whipped topping I love!
column10: I made this as a topping for gluten free dairy free pumpkin pie for Thanksgiving. Incredible! I am so happy to have found it. And it holds up well the next day in the refrigerator. Awesome product!

This stuff is AMAZING!  Anything you use whipped topping for, you can use this.  I keep mine in the freezer and put it in the refrigerator or at room temp for a little while before whipping it up.  I add cream cheese and agave nectar to it to make an excellent cake icing or fruit dip.  I make fruit salads by mixing in fruit of my choice ( i especially like strawberries and blueberries or mandarin oranges), chopped walnuts or pecans, vanilla extract, cottage cheese, a little agave nectar, and a small dash of salt.  This fruity whipped salad is WONDERFUL!
This product allows people with milk allergies to have whipped cream.  You can use it to make the base for ice cream.  It does well as a cream substitute when making cream pies and pumpkin pie.

column9: wouldn't use any other whipped topping
column10: why would anyone use whipped cream from the frozen food section that's made from nothing but sugar when you can use this absolutely wonderful topping made from nuts?
This is very good.  It surpassed my expectations.It whips well, stays firm in refrigerator for quitesome time and tastes good.  Well worth every penny.Irene

I was really excited to learn about this product.It is everything it says it is but for me it is just too sweet...I would suggest a non-sweetened version like mimic creme.  Sweetness is so personal and there are so many choices available, unsweetened would be better for me.But other than that we like it.

column9: great (non dairy) alternative to whipped cream
column10: This is a new product that I could not find in the grocery store.  It's a bit difficult to get out of the box (I ended up tearing/peeling the box off), but once I followed the rest of the directions (chill it for a few hours, chill the beaters) it does whip up and stay whipped.  Taste is somewhere between Cool Whip and dairy cream.  My teenager liked it (usually ultimate test of whether something is "good") and I like it because it is easy to use, does not spoil and is great on berries.  For coffee it will not melt like dairy cream (use regular mimicream for cafe latte), but will sit on top of the beverage, so it's better for hot cocoa, pies, etc.

At last! The best tasting non-dairy whipped topping made of almonds and cashews! I have been enjoying this from Amazon. Easy to prepare and I have been told it tastes better than real cream). Anyone who is lactose intolerant will beam after having dipped their strawberries into Healthy Top.I find the easiest way to empty the container is to cut tabs on the side first, cut accross middle seam, cut down each corner to the bottom, then peel flaps and put "H-Top" into bowl,  be patient as you use your mixer on low to blend; I add any flavorings (vanillaextract or chocolate cocoa). I also add 1/2 cup water to get the right softness to the cream. Wow, you'll be amazed at the freedom for new recipes this product creates.

The product tasted alright, but it wasn't what I expected at all. I thought I'd get a liquid that after spending half an hour in the refrigerator (as directed by the package) would be cold enough to whip into a cream. Instead the consistencly is very viscous and needs to be dug out of the container. It does lighten up a bit when whipped, but not to what I thought I would get. Also,the results are not speadable and doesn't lend itself to acting like a cake topping. I probably wound not reorder this again.

column4: My 2 Cents "A penny for your thoughts"
column10: Bottom line is that this topping tastes great. It doesn't taste like real Whipped Cream but if you like Cool Whip etc., you will like Healthy Top. My only problem is that the description says "Saturated Fat Free" and the label says "Saturated Fat - 12%".I have read that Virgin Cocoanut Oil (which MimicCreme uses) is not harmful like other Saturated Fats but I is think this mislabeling is important. I'm sure some people aren't supposed to have ANY Saturated Fat.I'm new at the dairy, cholestrol, gluten (seems like everything) free.... but NOT new to whole milk whipped cream, butter etc.I don't eat chemicals when I can help it but recently started a holistic diet.  Protein and vegetables. Avoid dairy, wheat, soy, sugar. I even found healthy sweetener (Organic Zero) but just can't find non soy, non dairy cream for my coffee. (This diet allows Decaf made with the swiss water method only because regular decaf is made with a surprisingly narly chemical process).I ordered MimicCreme Coffee Creamers. The delivery guy screwed up so I have not received them yet and won't for a few more days. I will post when I do. Meanwhile, I couldn't stand it so I thought I'd try MimicCreme Healthy Top (because as I said, I used to use whole cream in my coffee). In case you're thinking the same, don't. It's the consistency of Crisco and even with heat, doesn't pour. But after all, it's NOT a creamer. So I whipped it and it's great (especially for a non everything topping).  Trouble is, on a dairy and wheat free diet, I can't find anything to put it on. :(  I just wish this labeling thing was consistent.

I'm a vegan and I bought these hoping to have whipped cream product that taste good and is quick to make. The texture of this product is perfect. For the taste though it's kinda bland and has a weird aftertaste. I make my own vegan whipped cream at home and it's alot better. It's good but the company needs to work on improving the taste or I won't be buying this ever again or recommending it to anyone.

I bought this product based on the positive reviews it has gotten here. My experience was the exact opposite of what others have said. While the texture of Healthy Top is great, I found the taste to be quite frankly pretty awful. I expected a nutty taste, but this is a very distinct, powerfully odd nutty flavor that I could not get rid of no matter what I added to it. My search for a non-dairy whipped topping continues...

column9: Not the same as shown in Amazon item photo
column10: I bought this because I was looking for the "aged 10 years" product shown in the photo. Note that this product is NOT the same as the product shown in the photo. The product I was shipped is simply "aged" but doesn't have any duration. Clearly it's a cheaper product than the one shown. I would look elsewhere for ten year aged balsamic

I don't normally order food over the internet, so I was a little bit worried that I ordered a bulk package and might not like what I got.  However, I am very happy with this product.  The instructions are printed in both English and Japanese, which is helpful.  The soup tastes great and it is only 35-40 calories per serving.  Also, this packages is good for first time miso consumers, as it gives a variety of flavors.

I ordered this sampler pack of instant soups and it was delivered very promptly. (arrived within 2 days)The confusing thing is that I'm not sure what I received in the package. I was expecting some instructions and/or information in English.....  but everything on the packaging is in Japanese.  Unfortunately I live in an area of Pennsylvania where there is no Japanese population.The package contained a total of 22 small packets in eight various sized strips .... two packs(4 strips), three packs(2 strips), and four pack (2 strips).I have no idea what is in the packets or how to prepare them.  I assume that they are various kinds of instant soup.Do I combine them?Is each packet a complete soup mix?Does this represent 22 servings?Your guess is as good as mine.  I am going to try to prepare the soup by adding boiling water to each packet.  I'll update this review after I get a chance to experiment.It's like a Dining Adventure!  Wish me luck!

I would have given this item a 5 star review but due to the price of it I have to give it a 4. The taste of the product is excellent and its very easy to make. I just wish it wasn't over 1 dollar per pack as they go quick! I recommend the SAN-J white miso soup also.
This was a far better bargain than I imagined. I can't believe how much miso soup comes in this sampler pack. I hope they restock it, because it is a great bargain! Thanks, Piermall!

column9: Lemonhead lovers, this is for you!
column10: I wasn't really sure of this tea, Lemon Matcha. I ordered it for my wife in the hopes that it would be her gateway matcha drug, but she really doesn't like matcha, so it will likely be a bust (though she'll be a good sport and try it anyway). But I'm only a citrus fan to a point, that point usually being grapefruit. Mmm, grapefruit.When I first started mixing it, it smelled like a mix between Lemonheads and lemon cleaner. But the sip is pure lemonhead. It tingles down my tongue! It's tasty in its own way, and if you're into Lemonheads and the like, I would definitely recommend this to you. My wife has a coworker who loves lemon, so this matcha might be hers after another cup or two. It has a lemony bite that someone who enjoys lemons and sour candy might love. It's more of a mild vegetal flavor than a stronger matcha, which my wife appreciates in a matcha. The lemony bite can be cut with a touch of sugar, so while I can see that this matcha would be right up the alley of a lemonhead lover, it's just not the tea for me. I am extremely grateful to have tried it, though!
It was a quick turn around and I wasn't without drinking my morning tea for long.  This order will keep me most of the summer.

column9: Delicious, but high in fat and calories
column10: My mom buys these.  They are moist and delicious.  My son and husband's favorite is chocolate chocolate chip.  It's a chocolate muffin with chocolate chips in them, which puts the men in my life in chocolate heaven.I like banana nut.  It's full of banana flavor.  Yep, that's banana all right.  I don't think they could squeeze more banana flavor in it if they tried.  They could use more nuts.  Most of them are sprinkled on top.  Otherwise, I think they are fantastic.Blueberry is very good, also.  It's just not as good as banana nut and chocolate chocolate chip.These muffins make a great snack, but are also full of calories, so I don't eat them except as a treat.ALLERGY INFORMATION:Chocolate chocolate chip muffins contain wheat, soybeans, eggs and milk.Blueberry muffins contain wheat, soybeans and eggs.Banana nut muffins contains wheat, eggs and walnuts.NUTRITIONAL INFORMATION:One serving is 2 ounces.  One muffin is two servings.  I will list the information based on one whole muffin (since that is what I eat at one serving).Banana nut muffin: 440 Calories (200 Calories from fat), 22 g total fat (3 g saturated fat, 0 g trans fat), 50 mg cholesterol, 420 mg sodium, 220 mg potassium, 58 g total carbs (<1 g dietary fiber, 32 g sugars), 6 g protein.Chocolate chocolate chip muffin:  440 Calories (200 Calories from fat), 22 g total fat (5 g saturated fat, 0 g trans fat), 60 mg cholesterol, 380 mg sodium, 380 mg potassium, 56 g total carbs (2g dietary fiber, 34 g sugars), 6 g protein.Wild blueberry muffin: 400 Calories (140 Calories from fat), 16 g total fat (3 g saturated fat, 0 g trans fat), 50 mg cholesterol, 480 mg sodium, 190 mg potassium, 56 g total carbs (2 g dietary fiber, 32 g sugars), 6 g protein.

These muffins are superb.  All three flavors in this variety: blueberry, banana nut and chocolate, are fantastic choices.  The chocolate tastes like the best chocolate cake you ever had, and the banana nut is my personal favorite.  With tea, one of these muffins makes my morning special.Each muffin has two servings, so depending on the flavor, you are looking at up to 500 calories per muffin, with very high fat content.As far as price goes, you can buy this same variety lot of Otis Spunkmeyer muffins at well-known bulk retailer stores and wholesale clubs, for half the price that Amazon has these today.  But if you don't have access to to a club store, I highly recommend buying these at the price listed.  Bring the case to work and be everyone's hero for a day!

column9: I love love love these muffins!!!!
column10: These are my favorite muffins now. They are so moist and good, I just got hooked on them right away.If you love muffins. You will love these.
Extremely Good and very Mouth Watering to the actual taste. Also tectured Very Nicely To the Touch and Feel
Delicious the best muffins ever will highly recommend them and buy them again. My kids love them there favorite is the chocolate one my favorite is the blueberry.
A little pricey, but very delicious and worth that price!  I love having the Banana Nut in the morning before I go to work its the best!

column4: Angel_Boy "Treat the people around you the wa...
column10: Very tasty. Generous size. Moist. The only 1 that wasn't great was blueberry- the blueberrys are little, dry things. kinda remind me of artificial blueberries one might find in a pancake mix. the cake part of it tasted like moist, dense pound cake, which i liked. the walnut/banana was the best- very bananany tasting-very moist.-the moisteness is probably due to the oil in product- your fingers are all shiny with the oil after holding the muffin.
they arrived on time they were fresh its just all good know problems will order again and again i loved them going to order soon.

column9: Great for rush hours when the house is in chaos!
column10: IMO, Pop-Tarts are not the most nourishing food, but they're convenient for when everyone is running late ... for school, work, or appointments.The kids like them because they're easy to pop into the toaster or microwave and they taste good--anything that's sweet, you know! Most kids I know seem to prefer the strawberry and chocolate-flavored Pops, but blueberry is my favorite. Clarification: I like them, but do not love them; much too sweet for my taste-buds, but still ... when in a hurry, they come in handy.I also like them because they have a long shelf life and are quick and easy to prepare. If you have very young children, either heat the Pop-Tarts yourself or supervise the kids as they pop them into the appliance of your choice. Don't want those little fingers getting burned!Kids learn fast, and all they have to do is remove the Pop-Tarts from the pouch and pop them into the toasting appliance or microwave. Be sure to let the Pop-Tarts cool briefly because the filling can get very hot. When using the microwave, use a microwave-safe plate.And that's all there is to it!Like I said, not the most nourishing food--although they contain some healthy ingredients--but it's quick energy and great for rush hours. We all have plenty of those.Enjoy!Reviewed by: Betty Dravis, 2008
These are awesome.  They are so good that my husband will actually grab one and eat one without even toasting it.  We love them as a snack at anytime, day or  night.

column9: Buy this, you wont think twice
column10: these are the best! if you love pop-tarts you have to get this! tasted very fresh. came with an expiration date with 1 year. you cant go wrong
These were the freshest poptarts we have ever eaten.  They were great.  I wish I could buy poptarts this fresh at the store.  I was really pleasantly surprised.

These are tasty whether toasted or not.  Personally, I think everything tastes better toasted but you can be your own judge.  I should mention, however, that these are not my favorite flavor.  Blueberry is succeeded only by Low-fat strawberry and LF brown sugar and cinnamon.  I guarantee that if Kellogg came out with a LF Blueberry pop-tart, it would quickly rise to the top for me.  The LF pop-tarts toast and taste better. Less pastry and more of that delicious goo. Mmmmmmm.... just thinking about it makes me hungry for the future.

Quite possibly the best food known to man.  As may have been mentioned,these are not the most nutritious items around, but there are very few people who will choose an apple over a delectable Pop-Tart, either raw (straight from the foil packet) or toasted until the edges are an attractive golden brown. My personal favorite are the blueberry, either frosted or plain, but the strawberry are also delicious.For the uninitiated, Pop-Tarts are a flaky pastry wrapped around a filling, sometimes topped with frosting and sprinkles. They come two to a mylar envelope, four mylar envelopes to a package.  Originally, Pop-Tarts came in a couple of fruit flavors and had no frosting, but they've added tons of flavors since I was a kid.  (I'm an old lady and can have Pop-Tarts whenever I want them.  This was not the case when I was a child.)  Happily, Pop-Tarts stay fresh for a long time in the package.  I can't say how long they stay fresh because they don't last very long in my house.If you haven't tried these tasty little handfuls, I urge you to RUN, not walk to your closest grocery store and plunk down a little bit of money for a box of these.  Once you've tried them, Pop-Tarts are available here at Amazon.  :-)

column9: Easy filling breakfast or snack food
column10: My whole family loves these straight out of the box or toasted and the kids even take them to grandma's when we travel.My kids eat them at the bus stop during the school year or have them for a snack after school.
I got this at a very good price and it is some of the best soymilk I've ever had.  It actually tastes good.  Very happy with it.

I love to drink this in the morning or at night with a snack. Very tasty :P Its light and smooth, yet flavorful. The carton is easy to open and comes with an adjustable straw. Pearl soymilk is organic and lactose free. Kikkoman is an awesome brand of various soy products.
This is awesome.  It is so unlike "regular" honey that it deserves its own food category.  Don't waste it on tea - eat it right out of the jar, just 1/4 of a spoonful at a time.
I purchased Lehua honey from Amazon for a special event.  It arrived on time, was very fresh with just the right amount of thickness.  It's delightfully sweet without being too strong or tangy.

OK. I admit it. I'm one of the few crazy folks that really like fruitcake. I always have from the first piece I ever tried at our church's fruitcake make/bake/sale (they're fun to make, too. Especially in large quantities!). I like them dark, light, medium as long as they're on my plate. But I have to admit, I like the cake part to be a bit moist, not dry and grainy like these (remind me of Scottish fruit bread, actually. The taste is very good, the candied fruit and large pecans are tasty too. But the cake is dry...I also bought one for my Father-in-Law... we'll see how he rates it.

Gave this as a gift to my mom who loves Jane Parker fruit cake. She enjoys both the light and dark fruit cake.  I also like this fruit cake because it is cake with fruit mixed in.  So happy you offer these because we can no longer buy Jane Parker brand at a local store.

This cake is delicious!  My whole family loves Jane Parker fruitcake.  My aunt use to give me and each of my sisters a Jane Parker fruitcake for Christmas.  That was back when you could purchase them from A&P.  After A&P stores closed in Virginia and my aunt passed away, my sisters and I would try to find a place to order these fruit cakes.  We were so happy to fine them on Amazon.com and have been enjoying them ever since.  It's the same familiar taste that we've longed for.  The cakes we've had so far have been moist and delicious.  I can't wait to get another one.

My husband HAS BEEN BUYING A & P FRUIT CAKE FOR TOO MANY YEARS TO COUNT, BUT NOW WHEN WE SEARCH A & P IT COMES UP  JANE PARKER,  THE INFERENCE IS THAT IT IS THE SAME ... BUT NOT EVEN CLOSE.... DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY ... YOU WILL BE SADLY DISAPPOINTED.  IT IS DRY , UNEDIBLE AND SQUARE ---WHOEVER HEARD OF 'SQUARE' FRUITCAKE....  YUK!!!!!!!!!!!
My family loves dark fruit cake.  This one is moist and so flavorful.  My mother would have loved it.
This coffee is awesome and the fact that is has more antioxidants than most green tea is great.

I had heard about this tea (pearls) and looked them up on Amazon and bought for me and a gift for someone. We have all been pleasantly surprised at the quality and taste of the teas. It also makes an excellent gift for those into tea.
I am happy with this product because it has made me regular again. I use it in everything I cook. I even use it in my drinks! Will definitely re-order when supply runs out!

I was a little worried about these fruits but they have a very sweet/tart taste and a natural flavor to them.  I am very pleased with this purchase and add them to cereal and to oatmeal.  Keep them refrigerated and they will be ready whenever you have a taste for them.
I had a hard time finding Passion Fruit Tea Bags at the store. I used the tea bags to make Iced tea and it was really good. I look forward to ordering more flavors from this brand.

column9: Awful - threw it and a giant pot of chili pork away
column10: I ordered this for my pork adovada recipe. This was way too spicy and tasted ... I don't know how to describe it.... metallic or chemically. I threw a $30 pot of chili pork away along with the two containers of "new mexico" ground chili powder. The risk of trying a different brand cost me $50! Would not order this brand again. There was no link to contact the seller nor a return option.

My Gizmo was diagnosed with diabetes in July and the Vet recommended teeth cleaning and dietary changes first then we will go the insulin route if necessary. So far so good. We bought the DM dry food to go along with the wet. He likes the dry when he has the urge to crunch but is hooked on the canned. I spoon out the canned food by the 1/4 of the can. I lid the rest and just give him more when he is ready for it. I keep the crunchy available. He goes thru 1/4 cup of the dry every couple days. He goes thru a can a day.  The vet placed no restrictions on how much he can eat in a day so Gizmo is happy to eat to his hearts content. He is a very large tabby mix and was about 25 lbs before. (He was very athletic and was always catching birds and chasing the dog) He is now down to 18 lbs and it feels weird to pick him up. He had no problem eating this food and that was a worry because he would turn his nose up at anything other that the canned whitefish pate. I don't know what else to tell you about this product except it is working well so far for my cat. My only problem is the price - but since the insulin treatments seem to be painfully high, I am glad that the diet modification is working for $2.00 "ish" a day. The hard food he liked also and crunches away happily. I hope you get the option to try diet modification first and that it will work for you also!
Great product.  Watch the heat though, it is very, very hot once up to temp, and with the weight and density, that heat will exchange to other objects fast.

I went to a very fancy restaurant in my home city, they had this himalayan salt grill, not cheap, actualy very expensive... but great experience, and just awsome taste!So, after searching the web i found them...bougth 4 of them!Great for parties, or just having a romantic evening at home... slow cooking your slices of beef with a salty spacial flavor, while having some wine.. try it, will not be disappointed, and have a nice evening!search the web and download cooking ideas...and care instructions!

Authentic Pesto Genovese consists of: basil, extra virgin olive oil, pine nuts, pecarino (sheep) cheese, garlic, salt, black pepper.  Although many Americans are clueless, olive oil is not just a fat, it is a flavoring.  And it is one of the key flavors in real pesto Genovese.  Walnuts are an acceptable substitute for pine nuts, though I think they are much more commonly used in the Piemonte.  It's hard to picture why one would mix the two nut flavors together, but I will admit that I have not tried it.

I've grown quite fond of the Pastariso products and buy this one by the case. Anyone trying to find good alternatives to gluten pasta knows the difficulties but this brand is a nice alternative. Two things worth mentioning: (1) the pasta takes quite a while to cook and it is important that you wait until the salted water is at a ferocious boil otherwise the pasta quickly clumps together and cannot be undone (2) once cooked and in your meal, this pasta does break up so if you imagine twirling it around your fork in a good spaghetti dinner you may be disappointed.

column9: One of the best litters. Shipping litter bad idea though
column10: No doubt in my mind that Fresh Step is the BEST litter on the market. Buying online though is tricky.I bought 10 boxes when they were $10 on Amazon. A fantastic buy. However, all but 2 of the boxes were received split open. I bet you can imagine the mess. I don't know if the cost savings is worth the clean up hassle. I had litter all over my porch and entryway. They were still in a shipping box but there was hardly anything in the box to keep the litter from slamming around during transport. And being so heavy,I am sure the carrier didn't treat them like a caton of eggs. I bought so many because I like to stock up when things are a good price. Maybe that was my first mistake. I have 4 indoor cats and do go through a lot of litter though.

column9: This deserves the award for best cat litter!!!
column10: We just got our kitten a little over a month ago, and we have searched desperately for the "perfect" cat litter... One that covers up the cat-created odors that doesn't have the normal "cat litter odor" itself.  We tried pellets, we tried supposed instant action, and we tried an all-natural corn based litter that does NOT live up to its name.  Then I went to my favorite pet store, and asked an associate what they recommended based on my needs.  Fresh Step was their answer, and it's the answer to my wishes!  This stuff works amazing, and it smells sooo good!  (Well, for cat litter lol!)  The carbon really does work to cover up the odors and it lives up to its description of Fresh Step... everytime Bella goes in and does her thing, as well as when I am scooping and moving stuff around, a pleasant fragrance is activated.  I can't imagine using anything else... this stuff is amazing!!!

This is the only car litter I use.  I've tried arm & hammer, I've tried the crystals, and I've tried the non-clumping litter.  This stuff is better than all the rest!  It creates a bigger cloud of particles around you when you scoop compared to the other products, but a small price to pay against all the benefits.

No one likes kitty litter. It's the worst part of sharing your home with a cat, or in my case, two cats. I have a really small apartment and I keep the litter box next to the door in the living room. I've been to some of my friend's places who have cats and the litter box smell takes over the apartment. They swear they just changed the litter, but no matter, it still stinks. (They use the arm and hammer brand - definitely not my favorite.) This litter is the bees knees. Guests are always surprised when they see the litter box as they are leaving, they swear they never smelled anything the whole time they were over. Not to be gross, but I've gone a week without changing the litter (hey, I forget!) and that's usually when I start to smell the litter, reminding me that it needs to be cleaned. I don't know any other brand that covers the smell up as good as fresh step.

column9: Nice to have litter delivered to your door!
column10: My male Van is very picky with his litter, but ever since I have started using this regularly he has not had one single accident or urinated on any other surface than in his box.  Great litter, great price.

I love this product. I ended up going with it after having it be recommended by friends and family. Read some reviews online and I went ahead with the purchase.The product is great, the litter box is very simple to clean and doesn't smell! If it does smell, you're feeding your cat the wrong food, try something else and you'll be shocked!

column9: Fresh Step VS Tidy Cat... Fresh Step Wins!!
column10: I was so disappointed with Tidy Cat scoopable litter that I was about to go back to the regular litter, but decided to give it one more go with a different brand.  The trouble with Tidy Cat is that the soiled litter would turn to a thick, sticky mud that was very difficult to scoop and would leave a lot of mud-like residue behind.  I would end up emptying the entire litter box, clean it out, and start from scratch which defeated the purpose of scoopable litter.Fresh Step proved to be a major improvement.  It is so much easier to scoop and doesn't turn into the sticky mud that Tidy Cat would form.  I can actually scoop now and not have to empty the entire litter box.Both Fresh Step and Tidy Cat controlled odor.  Tidy Cat's plastic container was a bit easier to transport.  Fresh Step prevents litter waste; thus, saves money as pound for pound it scooped better and last longer.  Fresh Step wins hands down as it is by far the most scoopable litter.

I love Fresh Step, smells nice and is scoopable. You will save money because you wont have to add a lot of litter because it scoops well. I would forget to clean my kitties litter because I would never smell it. I tried arm and hammer litter and hated it. Who wants a house that smells like cat urine and feces?

I don't buy this online, so I can't speak for that, but this is the only kind of litter I've ever used (or ever will). I've used this brand since the day I brought my boys home.  I was unsure then about what kind to get, but it turns out I picked the right one.I have three cats, 3 litter boxes and a small 650 sq ft apartment.  You can't tell that I have cats (well, they'll come up and greet you and *then* you'll know, but you sure can't tell by the smell.)  The carbon / odor control / multi cat litters by Fresh Step all work very well.  I only buy the scoop-able, not the clay.  Works like a charm and a snap to scoop / clean the litter boxes.  Many of my friends have cats or rescue them and always remark how clean the apartment smells- fresh scent and not a trace of anything else!  They always ask me what kind of litter I use and I'm happy to inform them :)

column9: Really wanted to like this, but...
column10: I used another one of the Clorox brands of cat litter, one that was more expensive, for my last cat who passed away. Now that I have two kittens, I thought I would try to save money. I found the Odor Shield formula at the local Big Box Store - only it did not say if it was scented or unscented, as it shows on the pictures here. I even wrote to the company, asking to verify before i purchased it, but they merely sent back a form letter. So I thought, it was by the same company that made the other litter, how bad could it be? For clumping ability, odor control, and my cats using it - it was very good. However, it was indeed scented, and there was now dust everywhere - not just near the litter boxes in my laundry room, but over most of the house. Also, the kittens reeked of the scent for quite a time after they had finished using the box. When one of my kittens started itching, I switched back to the other, more expensive brand of litter. Although I am still not sure if the extra scent and dust from the Fresh Step was the cause of the itching, I won't bother trying any box of Fresh Step- even if it says its unscented and low dust. Because the other litter has proved my point, and I can now fold clothes in the laundry room without worrying that I am putting clean clothes on top of a washer/dryer covered in litter dust. Sorry, Fresh Step, I was hoping on saving some money here. Anyway, although I did not purchase the cat litter from Amazon, I just wanted to warn others before they made the same mistake I did.

First off, the litter does an excellent job at covering up the smell of urine and feces. But, what it fails at is clumping and tracking.This litter, to me, is comparable to a very low quality litter. It doesn't clump the right way, and it often stays muddy. I put a generous amount of litter in my box, but it still gets muddy. It also tracks worse than any other litter I have tried. The thing that bothers me the most is the amount of dust that expels from the litter when you pour it. It's so full of perfume that it makes a gigantic cloud.If you're looking for a litter to cover up the smell of your cat's feces and urine because you don't pick it up as often as you should- this is it. But, if you're looking for a litter that clumps right, doesn't track, and doesn't create clouds of dust, then this is not for you.

I used Fresh Step cat litter for many years and was quick to tell any of my cat owner friends that it was the best "bang for the buck" litter. It clumped hard, making the chore of cleaning the cat box a relatively easy one. Sometime around 6 months ago, that all changed. Now, it forms a sludge in the cat box that is nearly impossible to scrape out. The amount of effort necessary to clean the box could easily induce a muscle strain or hernia for those unfortunate enough to purchase this litter. Interestingly, after having this experience (twice, because I thought maybe I just got a bad batch the first time) I turned to Scoop Away which I always considered to be a similarly good product, only to find the exact same thing. What the heck? Turns out both products are made by the Clorox Pet products Co. Consider yourself warned!

column9: Cheez-It Crackers are #1. Hard To Resist.
column10: Cheez-It crackers are one of my favorite snacks. I try to avoid them ad much as possible in order to maintain my medial diameter. It's difficult. Great care must be taken in passing them in the grocery store's cracker/cookie isle. Just the other day I was there and something distracted me. When I looked up, there were the Cheez-its. I couldn't resist. That evening I finished half the box  while watching a movie. They're that kind of snack. Goldfish are good, to be sure, but they're nowhere near as addicting as Cheez-its. No, Cheez-it's are #1. Now, I'm going to have to work on rebuilding my resistance.Gary Peterson

The celtic salt is totally all-purpose -- I use it in baking and to salt just about anything.  The one issue with it is that it's a very moist salt so it doesn't have the easy-pour most people hope for.  Himalayan salt does very well for that.  But the himalayan salt, despite its awesome properties, can feel gritty at times, even though it dispenses well from a standard salt shaker.  Ultimately, I totally prefer the celtic salts, so I throw some rice into my shakers as a dessicant, and even though it takes a little bit of effort to be sure the salt is unclumped, you know you're getting a high-quality product that is feeding your body and tastes divine.

With the other reviews I wasn't really expecting much, but I was buying different seeds from the same store and was looking for a way to justify the shipping costs by buying more than one item. The item looked like an interesting experiment and if it turned out well I had a small tree, if I didn't I was out less then $1.Followed the instructions and pretty much saturated the soil when I first planted it, so much I was afraid I'd killed it right off but after that rocky start I set it in the sun and let the soil dry out. I didn't wait until the soil was too dried out before giving it a little more water, about two weeks later I ended with a seedling that I had to take out of direct sunlight immediately because I nearly did burn the leaves. All in all it's hard to say much until it starts growing a little more and I don't want to count it until it does. Small note, learned they're very sensitive to too much water and too little water as well as climate, they also take a little time to grow. Could be the season that let this one sprout or just luck but I'm willing to be happy with either, if nothing else it is a plant. I'll try to keep this updated as it grows but the basic response is if you got time and a little money this is worth a shot but if you are absolutely counting on any seedlings I'd try something will grow a little easier.

The only problem is the coriander is so large that it's hard to get into the grinder and the grinder gets plugged up, having to reverse grind. The blend is beautiful, flavorful and gives of an incredibly fresh and strong pepper scent when ground. The difference between these corns and those bought in a typical supermarket was evident. column9: Subtle & Varied Peppery Spice For Every Dish!
column10: The problem(s) with preground supermarket pepper is that the peppercorns are the cheapest that they can buy...and the preground product has already oxidized and lost all its freshness, potency, and breadth...which means you end up using much more of it than fresh-ground, and even then the flavor profile is flat and overpowering at the same time.This mix is the definition of "peppery"...like the way you would describe a certain note in a fine wine or French perfume...and the subtle zest really opens the other flavors of the dish the way fresh herbs from a garden do.
