It does not jolt you like caffeinated drinks, but gently gives you a lift.  The flavor is also mild and pleasant.

column9: For those looking for what I know you're looking for...
column10: ...look somewhere else.  I tried everything when it came to making this tea work and nothing did the trick.  This is the first time I have ever tried Coca tea and didn't expect much but what I got was nothing at all.  In fact, I've never tried any other coca products (yeah, that one) and thought this might be a starting point before I jump in to the big boy stuff.  Baking soda, bucal, the tea itself?  Nothing.  So, shop somewhere else if you're looking for a quality product.

Adding something besides "greens" to a salad can turn it into a meal. I serve these in a warm salad with sautéed greens and croutons, and in a cold salad with spinach, cucumbers and all the "usual" green salad stuff. I hope they try other varieties (like carrot) in the "ribbon" form.

I love Chai Tea but needed something that was caffeine free that I could have at night. This product is so good, its better than warm milk when you cant sleep that your mom used to make. While its not quite Starbucks its good enough that I drive right by and save myself $5 everyday.  Its good enough that I use the automatic order and deliver option on Amazon and get a shipment every 2 months. its great for a last minute gift of any occasion and looks good with my holiday cookies.
THE SMELL WAS BETTER THAN THE TASTE. THE TASTE WAS GOOD BUT IF IT WOULD HAVE TASTED THE WAY IT SMELLED THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN GREAT.

column9: Candhy Crate Kooky Kid Crazy Candy GIft Box
column10: Not worth the money. The product did not have as much as picture shown. Way too much money for what you think you are getting. Sent for a present, very embarrassed when parent called and said I hope you did not pay too much for this.

These candy boxes were a BIG hit with my sons and their friend.  I bought three boxes (two for my kids and one for their friend) for my son's birthday and the kids really had a blast with the candy.  Lots of fun for the kids.

This was a present for my niece and nephew who live halfway across the country.  I miss them dearly and wanted to send a little something to let them know I love them.  They LOVED the crazy candy, and taunted each other with the booger flavored jelly beans.  It was perfect, exactly what I expected, and they loved it. My only gripe is that it really was a bit costly.

column9: Great gift but, pricy for a small amount of candy
column10: I bought one of these for each of my daughters for Christmas. They come in cute boxes. But, I wish they had more candy in them for the price I paid. I know they'll enjoy them though. A nice idea including all of these things in one gift box. My daughter's had the yucky jelly bellies before and thought they were hilarious. So, I know this gift box will go over well.

column9: Will be put a smile on ANY kids face-Great Value!!
column10: I bought this for a child that is staying in the hospital long term, I wanted something that would make him laugh and be fun. Just heard back today and he LOVED it, it was FULL of candy unlike what some other reviewers have said and it had all sorts of fun and wierd kinds of candy. Will definately buy again for other children, 5 star ALL THE WAY!!

There was a lack of information about this product shows a picture that contains a variety of candy. There was one candy I saw that I wanted the box set for. It was the BUG CITIES!!!! It shows that it has them but it does not. Do not be fooled.

I am so disappointed that I bought this. The box is small and is filled with more stuffing than candy.  I could have spent $5 at the grocery store for what the contents of the box entails.  Very disappointed, and debating in giving this gift to the child I had in mind.  May go to the store and buy more candy.

You don't get all the candy pictured. And there isn't 30 kinds of candy like the description says. It does come in the box as pictured. I was given some really hard gummi grubs and spongbob chocolate coins instead of tube of powder,dirt and worms,and the hard bugs in a jar.Not bad,but not worth the amount since I can buy all this candy in the store.

If you want the BEST and EASIEST and most DELIGHTFUL/Delicious Dip - please try this product.  You simply mix 1 cup mayo & 1 cup of sour cream with the contents of the package - add your favorite chips and you will receive "rave" reviews every time.  This dip is always the hit of the party - I had been purchasing this item  from a store in my home town but they just could not keep it in stock........ it simply "flew out the door"  so Amazon and one-click to the rescue.  ENJOY!
I don't have access to vanilla beans and this is perfect they some packed great. I'm in love with REAL vanilla beans!!

White Truffle infused Oil by Ranieri- 8.5 oz is quite good and wonderfully aromatic. It is delicious drizzled lightly over roasted potatoes and grilled vegetables.  I loved the incredible effect it had on scrambled eggs.  Since experimenting in the kitchen is a passion of mine I  will continue to search for many more recipes using this amazing oil!

I grew up drinking this tea in New York, and now that I know it's still available I'll be ordering some more.  It's good anytime, but it's the best thing in the world when you've got a sore throat from a cold or allergies.  Steep to medium strength, then add a large dollop of honey and mix well.A few years ago I asked my doctor what he recommended for a sore throat, and he replied "Whatever works."  So I told him my best remedy was Chinese tea with honey and he said "That sounds good, I may try that."  I should have charged him for the advice.

I was first served this delightful afternoon tea by my future wife more than 40 years ago.  We still enjoy it and appreciate its wider availability.  Contrary to the blurb on the package, which Amazon has printed here, my understanding is that Ch'in Ch'u tea was first blended by J. G. Friedman ("Jack") and named by his wife Isabelle, of whom my wife and I have very fond and warm memories.  They were the parents of my mother-in-law, now in her 80's.  Just wanted to set the record straight!
The bottle was larger than I thought. The extract is fantastic. This makes the best cakes and french toast casseroles.  My favorite use is in lavender-butternut pound cakes.

I love this tea!  I first tried Rooibos at Starbucks.  I have made my own version of their Rooibos Latte with this tea and I like it even better.  I like that it's decaf too.  Excellent tea that I enjoy just about every day.
I love this tea with a little honey in it.  It is very relaxing and has a mild pleasant flavor, not too strong.  Since it is caffeine free, I can drink it day or night.
I've become a big fan. I drink it at work. If the half-cup goes cold, I pour some inexpensive unflavored sparkling water in it and it's delicious.

This is so much more than most chamomile teas.  It is flavored with other herbal ingredients for a wonderful cup of sleepy tea.  The price for three cans at Aamazon beats the price for two cans anywhere else.  I love this tea!

column9: Milder than most of the bold flavors with a slight  zing of lime citrus flavor!
column10: These almonds are very good with a slight zing of citrus lime in the favor.  I was surprised that the chili flavor to me was not as bold as I expected. Some of the Blue Diamond bold flavors like the Wasabi and Soy flavors are just, WOW, bold and overpowering.  This flavor while it was good it is milder and I didn't get a hint of a lot of chili until a minute or so after eating a few.  Even then it seems mild when compared to some of the other bold flavors.One serving of these nuts is 170 Calories and it contains 6 grams of protein, 5 grams of carbohydrates, 3 grams of fiber and only 1 gram of sugar and 1 gram of saturated fat. You also get calcium, vitamin E and magnesium from the almonds which are good for your body, heart and bones. I would rather eat 28 of these almonds for 170 calories than 11 potato chips for the same calories and none of the dietary benefits.This flavor has only 5% of your daily intake of sodium. The only problem with these almonds is that they taste so good you have to be able to close the can and walk away. If you don't like the super bold and spicy flavors then this flavor is ideal for you.I like all of the Blue Diamond Almond products as I feel that they are healthier for you as long as you don't overdo it in eating them.  This is still a great flavor and I like them!

column9: Can I offer you ladies a cool beverage or a tasty snack?
column10: These almonds are very tasty and popular at my workplace. If you've had wasabi peas, you'll probably like these too. "BOLD" is a bit of an overstatement, as these almonds are not as intense as the peas with the nasal burn, but still do have a bit of kick. I wouldn't say the soy sauce flavor is that apparent, though, but I'm not counting that against the product.Most wasabi-flavored snacks really contain horseradish because it is a cheaper substitute. Wasabi is notoriously difficult to cultivate and the chemicals that give it its characteristic pungency are volatile.I like these a whole lot and routinely buy several cans of them from my drugstore whenever they are on sale. My mom's factory wo-workers like these too. However, I took this to a baseball game and it was almost universally hated. Go figure!

column9: Bold BBQ taste that is not too spicy!
column10: I love these Blue Diamond Almond snacks and I particularly like the bold flavors.  This flavor is very good and the smoky BBQ taste just sets off the flavor of the crunchy almond that it coats.  I like an evening snack while I read a book and these for me are just so much better than chips and other snack foods.  It gives you a chance to snack but still eat healthy.One serving of these nuts is 170 Calories and it contains 6 grams of protein, 3 grams of fiber and only 1 gram of sugar and 1 gram of saturated fat.  You also get calcium, vitamin E and magnesium from the almonds which are good for your body, heart and bones.  I would rather eat 28 of these almonds for 170 calories than 11 potato chips for the same calories and none of the dietary benefits.This flavor does have 7% of your daily intake of sodium and if you are on a salt restricted diet then make sure to watch your salt intake.  The only problem with these almonds is that they taste so good you have to be able to close the can and walk away.This is a very good product and I recommend it to you!

column9: Crunchy almond treat with a sassy Jalapeno kick!
column10: Rather than just eat chips for a snack I love the Blue Diamond Almond snacks.  This is one of my favorite flavors and the only problem is that they are hard to stop eating.  They have a nice rich smoky flavor and the jalapeno is just enough of a spicy kick to make these almonds taste better.The nice thing about this treat is that they have only 1 gram of sugar while giving you 6 grams of protein and 3 grams of fiber.  They are a healthy snack and you get Vitamin E, magnesium and calcium in every serving.  This particular flavor does have 180 mg of Sodium (7% of a daily 2000 calories diet) per serving but they really taste good!  Just make sure that you only count our 28 almonds and eat one portion for 170 calories.  It is really hard to do and they taste so darn good!

column9: A hot, bold and tasty snack!
column10: I love Blue Diamond Almonds and this bold flavor gives you a spicy hot choice for a snack.  They are rich in vitamin E, magnesium and calcium while only being 170 calories for one serving.  They also add 3 grams of dietary fiber to your diet and 6 grams of protein while only adding 2 grams of sugar.They do contain 15 grams of fat but only 1 gram of saturated fat and 0 grams of trans fat. (Mostly they are the good stuff)  If you want a quick snack that is high in protein and low in sugar and sodium these are pretty good and spicy.While there are other flavors that I like more this one is still very good.  Just remember, they are addictive so you only get one serving!
I love these.  I bring them to work for a between meal snack.  They are bold and really take the edge off my hunger.

I'm a big fan of Blue Diamond brand Almonds. I really like the bold flavors, Habanero BBQ and Lime & Chili. I've never seen the Jalapeno Smokehouse flavor at the local grocery store so when I saw them on Amazon I decided to buy them.I'm pleased to say that I wasn't disappointed. This is right up there with my favorite flavors. It has just enough heat and jalapeno flavor with just a little bit of smoke. To me, these have almost as much heat as the Habanero flavor. Which isn't a bad thing. I like spicy.I would defiantly recommend these if you like the Bold line of Blue Diamond Almonds.

column9: Not habanero-y at all, but still insanely addicting
column10: The heat here is very very mild. I've had habanero sauces and chips that were so hot they made me cry for help. These are not like that. Only occasionally will you get a little kick. It's actually mostly tangy and tomato-y. The dusting of flavoring on the outside of the nuts will coat your fingers in an orange film.Satisfyingly crunchy and tangy, it's really hard to stop eating these. Even though the habanero kick isn't there as promised on the label, it's still really tasty. I highly recommend these. Sodium content is very low at 4% per serving. High in Vitamin E (35%) and magnesium (20%). This 1 pound bag (x3 bags) is a great deal compared to buying the 6 oz tins at the store, however, when my local Walgreens has buy 1 get 1, the price drops to about $0.35/oz.Blue Diamond makes about 8 other flavors that I know of. My favorites are the Soy Wasabi, Honey Roasted, Smokehouse, Dijon Mustard.

I'm a big fan of the Blue Diamond brand almonds and I especially like the "bold" flavors.The Lime n Chili flavor is my favorite with the Habanero BBQ being a close second.I agree with another reviewer that says the tartness of the lime flavor is just enough to bring out the chili flavor. Its a nice balance.I would say my only complaint is towards the end of the bag the flavor can get a little overwhelming because of all the extra spices that accumulate towards the bottom.
these taste amazing. might make the poops burn a little :o but they taste amazing. the salt and vinegar ones are the best and very addicting.

When I first tried these tasty almonds, I was amazed at the great marriage of flavor. Has the kick of wasabi, and the sweet taste of roasted almonds. The first one is an eye opener each time even after you have had them many times. Bold and fun! If you like sushi, and you enjoy the taste of wasabi, these are for you.

Diamond AlmondsAlmonds are a good source of magnesium. One ounce contain approximately 20% of the RDA for an adult recommended dietary allowance (RDA)Recommended Dietary Allowance (RDA) the amounts of selected nutrients considered adequate to meet the known nutrient needs of healthy people. The RDA is based on scientific knowledge and has been presented by a committee of the Food and Nutrition Board (FNB) of the National Academy of Sciences (NAS). The Canadian equivalent is the Recommended Nutrient Intakes. RDA is generally accepted throughout the world as a valid source of information. At least 40 different nations have as well as organizations have published standards similar to the RDA.Magnesium is the fourth most abundant mineral in the body and is essential to good health. Approximately 50% of total body magnesium is found in bone. The other half is found predominantly inside cells of body tissues and organs. Only 1% of magnesium is found in blood, but the body works very hard to keep blood levels of magnesium constant.Magnesium is needed for more than 300 biochemical reactions in the body. It helps maintain normal muscle and nerve function, keeps heart rhythm steady, supports a healthy immune system, and keeps bones strong. Magnesium also helps regulate blood sugar levels, promotes normal blood pressure, and is known to be involved in energy metabolism and protein synthesis. There is an increased interest in the role of magnesium in preventing and managing disorders such as hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes. Dietary magnesium is absorbed in the small intestines. Are you taking enough magnesium in the diet? The recommended daily allowance is 300mgs/day for men, 350mgs for women. Magnesium is extremely safe by mouth - too much simply causes diarrhea. Try increasing the amount of magnesium you take by mouth until it causes diarrhea, then reduce the dose slightly so it does not. This is called taking magnesium to bowel tolerance (just like using vitamin C to bowel tolerance.Almonds are a good source of Fiber.One ounce contains approximately 12% of the RDA for an adult.So, in summary, Almonds are a very healthy snack, so what's left to say?Two things:1st be cautious about "bowel tolerance" or "happy bowels" if you prefer.2nd Taste.  I realize that taste is a personal thing.  That's why they make chocolate, strawberry, and vanilla.Here's my current favorites" 1st Blue Diamond Dark mint dark chocolate (reminds me of the chocolate mint Girl Scout Cookies with less sugar).2nd Blue diamond Dark Chocolate Oven Roasted3rd  Blue diamond Blue Butter Toffee4thd Blue Diamond Almonds Bold Habanero BBQ (reminds me of  BBQ potato chips again with less sugar).5th Bold Blazin Buffalo Wing6th Blue Diamond Almonds Cinnamon Brown Sugar7th  Blue Diamond Almonds Lime `n Chili8th  Blue Diamond Almonds Smokehouse9th  Bold Wasabi & Soy SauceBut that's just me: you might have a completely different take on these flavors. 4th  and 5th are very close.GunnerMay, 2012

Not a big fan of chili actually... so these almonds are perfect!  ok sounds weird right!!??  What i am saying is that i LOVE LIME, and these almonds are mostly lime with a very subtle hint of chili n spice as an after thought... PERFECTION!

These are great almonds, especially in these 1.5 oz packages.I introduced these to my boss and he loves them too.Great portion control packs.

column9: Best flavor and best price of any Blue Diamond almonds!
column10: The flavor of these is just amazing. They are really addicting. They are slightly spicy, but they shouldn't be too spicy for anyone's palette. My 6 year old son really enjoys these, too. My suggestion is to open the 1 pound bag and pour a serving or two into separate containers for snacking. If you eat directly from the 1 pound bag, you are likely to eat the entire thing in one sitting because they are so addicting. I've also tried the Jalepeno Smokehouse and the Salt & Vinegar flavors from Blue Diamond. The Jalepeno Smokehouse are actually a little spicier than the Habanero BBQ if you're wondering. Compare the price per ounce on these and you will see they are the most affordable.

I was concerned that these might be too hot, 'Habanero', but the heat is perfect as is the flavor... they are bold, if you like stuff plain--these are not for you... but if you like a robust flavor, a definite must!  Took some to the office and my office is all addicted by these now, you can't eat just one.  From a texture perspective, they are perfectly roasted - not chewy and not powdery, they are crisp.  I'm on a Paleolithic 'Paleo' diet and nuts like these are okay for me to eat - so they make a great treat.  I've gone through 7 bags in 3 months (sharing, of course)... I definitely recommend.

This is the best product Blue Diamond sells, at least in my book. Spicy bbq flavor, like eating chips, but a much healthier alternative. You will not be sorry for buying these. I order these all the time, great deal on 3 pkg of 1 lb bags. YUM  PS:I am on atkins in the maintenance mode and miss chips, this is the replacement I was looking for: Far less carbs.

These are sooo great tasting and the individual  packaging is  great to get them handy around. Perfect buy to stock up as the individual packets are rare to find and there are many favors available however this one is my favorite.
Love these almonds!  Great flavor -- really hits the spot when those mid-afternoon hunger cravings set in! You won't be disappointed with this purchase!

I used to buy the highly spiced and addictive Wasabi peas from an Asian grocery. They went great with beer. But the crunchiness of the dried peas got to me and my husband after a while, so we stopped getting them. When I run across Blue Diamond Bold Wasabi & Soy Sauce Almonds, I was ecstatic. Now I could once again enjoy the taste of Wasabi as well as enjoy the health benefits of almonds at the same time.You can tell that these almonds are flavored as they have a powdery coating. I was a little bit worried as I remembered that some of the wasabi peas were very hot. In case you're not familiar with wasabi, it is the green paste that is typically served with sushi and diluted down with soy sauce. It is also known as Japanese horseradish, and is quite hot. Fortunately, Blue Diamond has tempered the wasabi with  the savory taste of  soy sauce and it's not as hot as it is in Japanese snack food. But make no mistake, it still has a nice kick, but it doesn't have a long lasting effect. The initial punch of heat fades out quickly to make way for the salty, slightly smoky flavor of soy sauce, making it a very enjoyable snack.5 star snack!

column9: WOW! Smoky With A Nice Slow Burn
column10: The taste is perfect. Smoky with just enough heat to let you know it is there. These don't have 5 alarm heat if that's what you are looking for. These almonds are perfectly seasoned and very addicting. Great if you are on a ketogenic or low carb diet.

column9: Wasabi Lovers Rejoice! These Wasabi SoySauce Blue Diamond Almonds Taste Fantastic!!
column10: Hello everyone, I just had to write a review for these Wasabi and Soy Sauce flavored Blue Diamond Almonds, because I enjoy them sooooooo much! I am a bit of a wasabi junkie as I love sushi with plenty of soy sauce & wasabi, wasabi flavored shrimp chips, and tuna sandwiches made with wasabi mayonnaise, but my new wasabi flavored favorite are these Wasabi and Soy Sauce Almonds from Blue Diamond. The flavor is fantastic, as it is spicy but not so much to bring tears to your eyes. Also, the price of this product is great as well. Sometimes when my money is tight, and sushi is a little too pricey, I like to buy these almonds as an cheaper alternative, to satisfy my wasabi craving. Treat yourself to these awesome almonds today!

The Jalapeno Smokehouse almonds taste great and are a nice healthy option for a snack. The flavor is bold, but not overpowering or "hot." I also think they would be excellent chopped up and added to a salad.

If you love almonds - especially Blue Diamond Almonds, these are great!  It is like Blue Diamond Almonds on steroids.  They are not incredibly spicy, but they have a little zip and a good amount of flavor.  A better buy than the Habanero BBQ ones for sure.  I would buy them again and they are great with a cold beer.

These are excellent. The flavor is strong and pleasant. I think the package size is perfect for snacking.Besides general use, I recommend these if you go to a desert; these make you want to drink more, which is important as it is easy to get dehydrated and not notice it in desert environment.

column9: So good - tastes like sushi without the fish.
column10: I am addicted to sushi, which is an expensive addiction.  I always keep a tin of these at work and at home to satisfy the craving.  My boyfriend, who doesn't like sushi, really enjoys these too, so they aren't just for sushi lovers.  I believe they are roasted, so they are not as healthy as raw almonds, but they still make a great afternoon snack.
These things are great. Perfect size bag for an afternoon snack. If you like salt and vinegar flavor you will like these.

column9: The best almond flavor out there. How could something so delish be so good for you?
column10: The "Jalapeno Smokehouse" flavor is the best flavor in the Blue Diamond "BOLD" series, hands down. Unlike some of the other flavors, this one really tastes like what it's supposed to taste like -- that is to say, smoky jalapeno peppers. To my jaded taste buds, the pepper spice is fairly mild, but I imagine most people find it packs quite a kick. It's a good thing these huge, perfectly roasted nuts are great for you, because I eat them constantly. Hey, my HDL cholesterol (the "good" cholesterol) has actually risen as I've gotten older. I like to think it's partly because of these luscious babies. Dr Jeddy prescribes a handful every day!

column9: Not as crunchy as the other Blue Diamond flavors
column10: I'm addicted to Blue Diamond almonds. I've tried all the flavors -- and this was the last one I tried. I love salt, I love vinegar, and I love salt-and-vinegar potato chips, so how could I lose with these?Well, I'm just not that into them. The flavor's great and the almonds are fresh, but somehow the texture just fails. The almonds just seem... soggy. They don't have that wonderful crunch that the other Blue Diamond flavors have. And that flattens out the whole experience of eating them. I've eaten about 10 bags so far, and they all have the same lackluster texture.Oh well. Guess even my ol' reliable Blue Diamond can't hit it out of the park every time.

column9: It's like crack, without the cocaine base
column10: I don't know what they put in these things, but whatever it is it's addictive. The combination of soy sauce salty and wasabi spicy create the perfect storm of "I'm going to eat this entire can RFN."The cans are all perfectly sealed and the almonds are always fresh - what else can you ask for? The cost is also lower than in local stores, but you can buy the larger bags cheaper (per oz) from some Walmarts if you can find them.Almonds are supposed to be appetite suppressants, but for me it's usually because I ate an entire can of them and am not hungry any more.
I gave half of the 6 pack to my friend visiting from Tokyo. We both love them. Although, it would be nice if they came in bigger cans.

column9: Great Low Carb snack to go!!
column10: Before we switched to eating low carb, we used to LOVE a nice big bag of chips.  I was missing those zesty salty crunchy snacks, until we found these delicious almonds!  I have tried all of the flavors and love them all, but these are my current favorite.  I like the snack size packs as a reminder that I have had enough since I can never stop eating them (just like potato chips, no one can eat just one).  A whole package is only  8 grams of carbs (only 4 grams of net carbs if you are an Atkins dieter).  These almonds have a nice crisp texture (even better if you put them in the refrigerator for a bit) and the seasoning is evenly distributed.  Not to strong, but also not too weak that it gets lost on the almonds. A package of 12 only lasted about a week in our home, back to order more.
These are better than chips -- you can't eat just one!  Seriously, great snack when you're on the run.

column9: Like Salt & Vinegar Chips, but healthier!
column10: If you love salt & vinegar chips like I do, these are for you.  Great salty snack, high in protein, pretty filling, and without the grease of potato chips. Definitely recommend!
The product arrived on time and fresh and this was the only place that I have found this tasty snack.  I would buy them again.

column9: Healthy, satisfying snack on the go
column10: While trying to cut back on carbs, and add more protein to my diet, I discovered this wonderful tasty snack.  At 260 calories, even this 1.5 oz pack is too much for a snack, but I divide the packs in half again and have a healthy snack that helps satisfy my hunger in the late afternoon.  They're also good as a breakfast on the run. The wasabi adds a wonderful punch-love them!

Not generally a big fan of wasabi or of almonds, but somehow find these particular wasabi and soy sauce almonds to be a healthy addiction. I've been participating in Weight Watchers for the last couple months (doing well).  I like to have a healthy snack at work mid-afternoon so I bought a bag of these at the grocery store. column9: I'm an addict!  Great for low carb

I absolutely love these nuts! I can't find them where I live so I will continue to order these from Amazon. They are well worth the price.

column9: Delicious and good value; we will definitely order again!

And they're great to stash when you know that you won't be able to grab a real meal, but don't want to find yourself at a vending machine or 7Eleven buying crap b/c you're so hungry.  Even my (naturally thin) hubby loves them.  Perfect!
I discovered that this particular flavor wakes me right up for the long drive home after dark.

column9: Do NOT get me near these!

These almonds are the most wonderfully satisfying snack ever. If you like salt and vinegar chips and you like almonds then you will absolutely love these nuts. I love these nuts and it seems that most stores carry all flavors but the Jalapeno, I won't hesitate to order these again if I cannot find them next time, gotta have 'em!!!

column9: Delicious, just like Salt and Vinegar Chips!
column10: These are great! As a lover of all chips I'm so happy to find a healthy alternative.It's a great, flavorful snack.

Almonds are one of the most healthy, satisfying foods you can find.  These are nice and spicy with the right snack size.  I debated getting these or the big tins, but the small bags helps me control the overeating and mindless snack munching.
Enjoyable all times of the day. Just the right amount of salt and flavor. This is becoming a favorite in my house. I also take it to work to satisfy that afternoon craving.

These are not easy to find in stores...and one must be diligent to keep them on hand! They do not create sores from acidity...they are better than any salt and vinegar chip I ever tasted. Highly recommend. Even better...new individual packets you can throw in your purse have been seen!

column9: Absolutely the yummiest of the Blue Diamond flavored almonds
column10: I've tried smokehouse, jalapeno smokehouse, honey roast, lime and chili, and natural. But these are really the best of the lot I've tried. column9: You can definitely taste the salt & vinegar
column10: Even though I (thought) I hated them for 25 years, I am a recent convert to the great taste and nutritional value of almonds. It is hard to find a quality almond. Some are too hard, some are too "dry," some are too plain. Without a doubt, Blue Diamond produces the best-tasting almonds. I have had many different brands of almonds and if you are eating them out of the bag (IE, not cooking with them or mixing them with something), quality can go a long way. Blue Diamond almonds are very flavorful on their own. I typically do not like a completely plain almond, so decided to try their Bold series.The Bold Series has several different flavors. Some of these are hit and miss with me. Some of the flavors are "too" bold, and some taste great the first few almonds, but quickly overwhelm you. Since my favorite Blue Diamond product is Blue Diamond Almonds Roasted Salted, 6-Ounce Tins (Pack of 12), I thought I would give these a try.  I have been disappointed with other products within their Bold line, but these aren't too bad.You can definitely taste the salt and vinegar, and it's pretty much the same amount of flavor you would find with Salt and Vinegar potato chips.  Normally, I can eat half a can of Blue Diamond almonds in one sitting, however the strong flavor of the vinegar overwhelms me a bit and I can usually only eat half a serving of these at once.  If you're a big Salt and Vinegar fan however, these shouldn't be a problem.  While the Salt and Vinegar Almonds aren't my favorite in the Bold line, I do like them much better than the other varieties, and will probably get them again.  If you've never tried them before, you may want to start with purchasing just one can rather than 12.
I wanted more wasabi flavor but there is enough for a good balanced taste. Really, they are pretty good. You can actually find these in walmart for $3 a can so its about the same as buying here.
these are the best flavor - very nice lime/chile taste goes great with the almonds. i agree with ms.cox!

column9: A nice enough flavor, but I wouldn't describe it as either "Blazin'" or "Buffalo Wing."
column10: I'll start off by noting that I love almonds, I eat almonds every day, and I particularly love Blue Diamond almonds. The most important qualities of almonds, for me, are freshness, quality, and careful roasting. Blue Diamond almonds get 5 stars on all those parameters.And I've tried all their flavors, especially their "BOLD" line. Alas, their definition of "BOLD" is apparently "a little too spicy for kids." This flavor is okay, as a change of pace, but doesn't exactly set my taste buds a-"blazin'." It doesn't taste like Buffalo wings -- it's too sweet and not vinegary enough. And it's definitely not spicy enough. I realize that real Buffalo wing spice can be brutal, and might not suit a mass-market snacking product. But really, they haven't even tried here. There's not even a hint of Tabasco, for example.As I said, this is a pleasant enough flavor, especially if you need a little change from, say, my favorite, Jalapeno Smokehouse. But it doesn't taste much like anything in particular. They could have called it "BOLD Generic Faux-Spicy Snack to be Eaten Brainlessly While Watching the Game" flavor and it would have been more accurate.

Ordered these because I wanted to try them and none of the stores in my area seem to carry them. Normally I eat the habanero bbq or the wasabi.For spiciness they are better than the habanero but not as much as the wasabi can be (though in all fairness the wasabi is in a whole different taste spectrum anyway)Flavorwise is where they lose out. They taste MUCH saltier and the flavor itself is overpowered by that until you get to the end zing where the spice kicks in.In summary, they are edible and I will finish off the cans that I ordered but I will go back to purchasing my wasabi and habanero after that.

Combine that with almonds being one of the healthier snack options, and you've good a good treat.  Much like the other flavors, the bold flavor makes moderation fairly easy as I could not imagine going overboard on these.  Enjoy!

Diamond AlmondsAlmonds are a good source of magnesium. One ounce contain approximately 20% of the RDA for an adult recommended dietary allowance (RDA)Recommended Dietary Allowance (RDA) the amounts of selected nutrients considered adequate to meet the known nutrient needs of healthy people. The RDA is based on scientific knowledge and has been presented by a committee of the Food and Nutrition Board (FNB) of the National Academy of Sciences (NAS). The Canadian equivalent is the Recommended Nutrient Intakes. RDA is generally accepted throughout the world as a valid source of information. At least 40 different nations have as well as organizations have published standards similar to the RDA.Magnesium is the fourth most abundant mineral in the body and is essential to good health. Approximately 50% of total body magnesium is found in bone. The other half is found predominantly inside cells of body tissues and organs. Only 1% of magnesium is found in blood, but the body works very hard to keep blood levels of magnesium constant.Magnesium is needed for more than 300 biochemical reactions in the body. It helps maintain normal muscle and nerve function, keeps heart rhythm steady, supports a healthy immune system, and keeps bones strong. Magnesium also helps regulate blood sugar levels, promotes normal blood pressure, and is known to be involved in energy metabolism and protein synthesis. There is an increased interest in the role of magnesium in preventing and managing disorders such as hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes. Dietary magnesium is absorbed in the small intestines. Are you taking enough magnesium in the diet? The recommended daily allowance is 300mgs/day for men, 350mgs for women. Magnesium is extremely safe by mouth - too much simply causes diarrhea. Try increasing the amount of magnesium you take by mouth until it causes diarrhea, then reduce the dose slightly so it does not. This is called taking magnesium to bowel tolerance (just like using vitamin C to bowel tolerance.Almonds are a good source of Fiber.One ounce contains approximately 12% of the RDA for an adult.So, in summary, Almonds are a very healthy snack, so what's left to say?Two things:1st be cautious about "bowel tolerance" or "happy bowels" if you prefer.2nd Taste.  I realize that taste is a personal thing. Diamond AlmondsAlmonds are a good source of magnesium. One ounce contain approximately 20% of the RDA for an adult recommended dietary allowance (RDA)Recommended Dietary Allowance (RDA) the amounts of selected nutrients considered adequate to meet the known nutrient needs of healthy people. The RDA is based on scientific knowledge and has been presented by a committee of the Food and Nutrition Board (FNB) of the National Academy of Sciences (NAS). The Canadian equivalent is the Recommended Nutrient Intakes. RDA is generally accepted throughout the world as a valid source of information. At least 40 different nations have as well as organizations have published standards similar to the RDA.Magnesium is the fourth most abundant mineral in the body and is essential to good health. Approximately 50% of total body magnesium is found in bone. The other half is found predominantly inside cells of body tissues and organs. Only 1% of magnesium is found in blood, but the body works very hard to keep blood levels of magnesium constant.Magnesium is needed for more than 300 biochemical reactions in the body. It helps maintain normal muscle and nerve function, keeps heart rhythm steady, supports a healthy immune system, and keeps bones strong. Magnesium also helps regulate blood sugar levels, promotes normal blood pressure, and is known to be involved in energy metabolism and protein synthesis. There is an increased interest in the role of magnesium in preventing and managing disorders such as hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes. Dietary magnesium is absorbed in the small intestines. Are you taking enough magnesium in the diet? The recommended daily allowance is 300mgs/day for men, 350mgs for women. Magnesium is extremely safe by mouth - too much simply causes diarrhea. Try increasing the amount of magnesium you take by mouth until it causes diarrhea, then reduce the dose slightly so it does not. This is called taking magnesium to bowel tolerance (just like using vitamin C to bowel tolerance.Almonds are a good source of Fiber.One ounce contains approximately 12% of the RDA for an adult.So, in summary, Almonds are a very healthy snack, so what's left to say?Two things:1st be cautious about "bowel tolerance" or "happy bowels" if you prefer.2nd Taste.  I realize that taste is a personal thing.  That's why they make chocolate, strawberry, and vanilla.Here's my current favorites" 1st Blue Diamond Dark mint dark chocolate (reminds me of the chocolate mint Girl Scout Cookies with less sugar).2nd Blue diamond Dark Chocolate Oven Roasted3rd  Blue diamond Blue Butter Toffee4thd Blue Diamond Almonds Bold Habanero BBQ (reminds me of  BBQ potato chips again with less sugar).5th Bold Blazin Buffalo Wing6th Blue Diamond Almonds Cinnamon Brown Sugar7th  Blue Diamond Almonds Lime `n Chili8th  Blue Diamond Almonds Smokehouse9th  Bold Wasabi & Soy SauceBut that's just me: you might have a completely different take on these flavors. 4th  and 5th are very close.GunnerMay, 2012

column9: A good flavor but not bold in comparison to some of the other flavors and more salt!
column10: I love all of the Blue Diamond Almond flavors and they are my favorite snack.  This one while good was not great for me.  When I hear the word "Bold" I expect something over the top and this one was just sort of medium.  It seems that they aimed for the middle of the road when it comes to being a spicy flavor!  We have Buffalo Wing restaurants here that offer about 6 grades of spiciness from hot to death and this wasn't even close.If I compare this to the Blue Diamond Wasabi & Soy spiciness it is not even in the same galaxy.  This is still a good flavor but not what I was expecting.One serving of these nuts is 170 Calories and it contains 6 grams of protein, 5 grams of carbohydrates, 3 grams of fiber and only 1 gram of sugar and 1 gram of saturated fat. You also get calcium, vitamin E and magnesium from the almonds which are good for your body, heart and bones. I would rather eat 28 of these almonds for 170 calories than 11 potato chips for the same calories and none of the dietary benefits.This flavor does have 9% of your daily intake of sodium which is almost twice the amount in many of the other Blue Diamond flavors. It has even 50% more salt than the Bold Salt `n Vinegar flavor? For that reason I will eat this flavor more sparingly.The only problem with these almonds is that they taste so good you have to be able to close the can and walk away. If you don't like the super bold and spicy flavors then this flavor is ideal for you, just watch the salt.I like all of the Blue Diamond Almond products as I feel that they are healthier for you as long as you don't overdo it in eating them. Since they have a more moderate flavor than what I was expecting for a "Bold" product and contain so much salt I gave it 4 stars.  I eat these almonds because they taste good and are healthier for you but the extra salt in this one negates some of the health benefits in my opinion. This is still a good flavor and I like them but not love them!
These are delicious. I will buy them again and again. They are not for everyone, but if you like wasabi peas, you will love these. The flavoring works great with the taste of almonds.

column9: First tried this tea in Hawaii
column10: I first tasted this tea at a very expensive buffet in Hawaii.  I enjoyed it so much I asked the waiter about it and he gave me several bags to take with me.  I'm not too picky about my tea, as I feel even the cheap lipton stuff is fine for day to day hot or cold tea drinking, if used properly.  I've tried dozens of different types of tea as I've been drinking both hot and cold tea all my life.  This tea gives off a sweet smell and has a taste similar to some chinese "flower" teas.  The nearest I can come to describing the flavor is if you've had a Kerns Guava, imagine a much more mild (not as sweet) version of that flavor in a tea.  This is by far the best tea I've ever had.  If you enjoy flavored tea, if you appreciate the difference between Earl Grey and cheap Lipton tea then you'll enjoy this tea also.

column9: Like sweet tea? Try this out for something different.

If you like passion fruit flavored tea, definitely give this a try.
I love this tea.  Brew it hot and make iced tea for Summer and keep hot for the rest of the year.  Very refreshing iced tea.
Love the Hawaiian Islands tea company. Their teas are all tasty - a real treat. They come packaged in vapor proof bags for each teabag assuring freshness.

better than expected and delicious. well priced, soothing stomach warming remedy; cheaper than whole foods market and so nice to be deliverd

I had been buying this candy from a machine (for a quarter at a time) and filling a ziplock bag to take home.  I tried to find it in the bricks and mortar stores, and they don't seem to have it or even know what I am talking about.  I even checked the bulk candy place in the mall (which seems to have gotten very expensive), yet even they didn't seem to know.Nitwitz works well as a "candy dish" candy because the pieces are solid (no candy dust) and don't seem to leave a residue in the dish (like a gummy candy might).  These are very similar to Willy Wonka Runts, but somewhat smaller and more tart.  The only issue with it is that it seems that the oranges make up an outsize percentage of the mix.  I suppose that it is possible that buying it from the machine somehow filtered out the larger orange pieces.  Also, the orange pieces are more like jawbreakers and I will have to warn guests about trying to bite down on them right away.  The other pieces are not quite as hard.Overall, I am pleased with the 2.5 lbs. mix and it should last me for several months.  It arrived in an unlabeled, sealed plastic bag inside two padded envelopes.  There does not seem to be any broken pieces.

There's no aftertaste that I can pick up, and it really does have the peach flavor, and no bitterness that tea sometimes has.  I used 4 teaspoons in a 16 oz snapple glass bottle (for that authentic feel, and also because it was handy), and it really tastes the same.  It looks a little darker, but that's fine.  I'm very happy with my purchase, given the money I'll be saving!

Lipton Instant Diet Peach Tea (Lipton Instant Tea Mix, Diet Peach, 2.9-Ounce Jars (Pack of 6)) is a taste treat.  Living in a place where peaches are grown and where there is an annual peach festival in our town, we have become discerning about the taste of peaches.  This peach tea has an authentic peach taste.Not only does it satisfy our desire for a peach taste when peaches are unavailable; it gives us a little kick.  We like the sweet taste without all the calories too.  We consider this tea a winner.Ingredients are maltodextrin, citric acid, instant tea, natural and artificial peach flavor, aspartame (sweetener). It disolves easily.I hope you find this review helpful.

column9: MUCH better than carrying home gallons...

Great price for a product that for some reason is not available in our area.  My wife loves this.  It ends up being much cheaper than Diet Peach Snapple and just as good.

column9: Lipton's Peach Flavored Diet Ice Tea Mix
column10: Good taste, hard to find in stores/supermakets...Why? A good way to cut down on  diet carbonated beverages.A little pricey unless you purchase in bulk on Amazon.Why aren't other brands making similar products?

This went above and beyond my expectations! I've tried other diet teas and they seem to all have a distinct "diet" taste. These teas are great, very good flavor, no diet aftertaste! column9: Peach Tea - Best Summer Drink - or anytime!
column10: Peach tea by Limpton is so much better than the other flavors.  I have had this before but have been unable to find it in our stores for the past year.  Amazon had it and delivered it in a timely manner.  Add a little lime and you are set for the heat!

column9: Love this tea, but tired of broken bottles!

I am upset though, afer writing Amazon and telling them that two or three times my whole box was covered with tea, due to a broken bottle. I had to deal with glass and messy clean-ups. Best prices anywhere. Hard to find in my area so we stock up when possible.

I really like this Lipton Diet Peach Tea, its one of the best Diet Peach Iced Tea on the market right now (Crystal Light and Arizona branded dry mixes are also good). Not sure which ingredient in the drink mix makes it do this, but kinda makes me wonder what is really in there.  I haven't seen any of the other Lipton drink mixes do this, but this is still an excellent product.

column9: Just as good as the national brand bottled peach tea
column10: Use some cold, filtered water and you will have a tasty, peachy glass of tea which will satisfy on the hottest day!

column9: Lipton Instant Diet Peach Tea Mix
column10: I love the product; however, two of the jars arrived broken.  The packing should be revisited.

So I got the instant and it's great stuff; forget the raspberry since it tastes like medicine. However you can get it cheaper at the local grocery than through Amazon, and now they finally sell it already reconstituted in bottles here (USA) but the instant is a far better deal since you get 10 quarts out of a jar. I've paid from $3.59 to $2.99 for a jar.

column9: Poor Product and even Poorer Service
column10: We ordered this Jamon through Amazon (thank goodness!). The merchant missed the promised shipping date and the Jamon arrived late. Upon opening the box, we first noticed a large tag around the product that stated "Keep Refrigerated". The item was shipped unrefrigerated in a simple cardboard box. Upon opening the product package, it was covered in a yellowish slime with white mold spots on it.We contacted the merchant who refused a replacement or a refund stating simply "We do not offer refunds on grocery items" - and they closed our request. Fortunately Amazon's "A to Z" guarantee saved the day for us and Amazon is refunding. We will not do business with this vendor again. We will instead pay the slightly higher price at La Tienda as we had previously. So much for trying to save a few dollars using another vendor.

column9: Good Serrano Ham but no ham-stand included
column10: The ham is good and it tastes not as salty as other serrano hams but if you don't want to spend much more money in a bellota ham it'll be fine, you'll like it.The only issue or misunderstanding was because the other reviews, because according to them, it was supposed to come with a ham-stand and a knife and it didn't.

I bought this for Christmas. It is a Spanish ham and more or less as advertised. It does not come with the hoof on as pictured but comes with a ham-stand and knife (jamonero)which was a very nice addition. Now this is a bit pricey if compared to what it would sell for in Spain (around 70$)--shipping and import etc. would obviously add quite a bit to the cost but this much... I don't think so.

column9: very yummy and very easy to make
column10: I bought this at my local BJs with one of the weekly coupons. I am not an awesome baker on any level, but this was so easy to make and smelled amazing! The only downfall to me  was way too much cinnamon crumble. It was a little hard doing the 2nd layer but I'm sure that is a learned skill.The cake stayed soft the while week we had it for breakfast gently wrapped in plastic wrap. I don't think I would pay $20 for it, but it is certainly a good product :-)

column9: Love the Company!!  But not as good as the ones in Starbucks
column10: I originally found these in starbucks,and they are sooo delicious! At $4 a pop, I decided to buy the bag to save a little cash.. however, it didnt really pan out as the bag for three was about $12, and they didnt taste as good as when I bought single.  I am still a lover of Two Moms, but will most likely go back to buying as a treat when I am in Starbucks.  oh well..
would of rated this 5 stars if it included sesame on some of the lil snacks and if it eliminated the peanuts but a good family treat and lasted quite a while
This is great stuff and it's the same product that the Girl Scouts sell in tiny cans.  My husband loves the Hunter Mix. We signed up for a monthly shipment because the shipping is free that way.
My mom turned me on to this nut mix.  It is kinda like a chex mix type of thing.  I think that they are great and a good high energy snack.

I received a container of this snack mix as a gift.  My husband loved it so much that I placed a subscription so he could receive a new container periodically.  He was delighted until we learned that they were out of stock for the second delivery!Still, we're looking forward to the next delivery.

Was looking for something salty and crunchy and this fit the bill just fine.  Was surprised that it was more than just nuts... sesame seeds and also had a little kick to it.  Would definitely buy again.
This is a very tasty can of nuts. Southern Style Hunter Mix is some of the best nuts I've ever had.

I purchased a can of these Hunter Gourmet at Sam's Club thinking I was purchasing a can of mixed nuts.  Was I surprised to open the can and find very few nuts....mostly crackers.  Very disappointed.  The outside wrapper appears that one is buying a nice size can of mixed nuts.  I hope this remark gets to the manufacturer.  I was not able to pick up squirrel brand web site on the computer to leave my remarks with them..Jan
hunter mix is a very healthy snack mix and is one of those things that it's hard to quite once you start eating it. I will be ordering more
Actually more than 85% are fried bread chips ... I really hated it. I don't understand why the rating were that high as I was ordering the product.
Amazon's handling of this purchase was excellent. If all on-line purchases could be handled as efficiently as this, it would be a pleasure to buy most items over the net.

column9: These crawlers will put you at ease
column10: When I first received this 5lb bag of candy from my friend for Christmas, I thought to myself how times have changed.  In the past I had always received a giant box of cherry sour ball candies.  When this bag showed up, I knew I had graduated to the next level.Upon inspecting the bag I realized it did not contain a zipping closure, so this would become my responsibility.  Luckily for me an old bag of "Bare Fruit 100% Organic Bake-Dried Granny Smith Apple Chips" was safely in my file drawer.  I knew that it would come in handy one day.  After transferring the contents of this bag of "Large Bite Crawlers" from Trolli my first instinct was to share this with my co-workers.  This day in particular we had been pushing our manliness by eating raw habanero peppers to see which guy would cry first.  While these crawlers did not ease the pain in which we had inflicted upon ourselves, they did however bring a smile to our face.  In the end I realized these candies are what it's all about, colorful worms wrapped in sugar... little bit sweet, little bit sour.TLDRThese crawlers are great, especially when you've had habanero pepper man contest prior.

I didn't realize that "mini" crawlers meant the very small ones (maybe an inch or so big?), but I'm actually happier that they are! I thought these were the ones just a little bigger (about twice as big, in the regular packages in the stores)... but these are absolutely perfect. I love them, and they make a perfect reward treat for my potty training little boy, and for a fun reward for helping for my twin 4 year olds. The package is big, so make sure you have a ziploc bag (or two) handy to put them into to maintain freshness. As long as you re-seal the bag, these yummy tiny worms are delicious! We all love them in this house, adults included. I have now ordered my 4th bag from this same company.

Got this for my husband for our anniversary. He loves this, although they haven't lasted long. He's devoured most of this bag already. Exactly as product description described, one huge bag of sour Trolli Gummi worms!
This is an excellant finishing salt for those who wish to add that smokey flavor to any dish. This is not a lite smokey taste but rather robust, use it at the table.
I use a pinch an meats when I grill or broil. Love the alder wood taste of this salt, broil indoors and get a rick smoked flavor. A little goes a long way!

It taste great! It has a great smokey flavor and taste great on burgers,chicken,pork and fish.  And although the container is small, a little goes a long way. Great on lamb and on veggies also. Throughout the years anything that I have ordered from Amazon has always been a great product and I have always received excellent customer service. I love Amazon Prime also!!!
a wonderful salt for almost anything. is really good to put on steaks and then tenderize. makes the meat very tender and hold in juices. My favorite cooking salt by far.

This is a perfect salt for dressing grilled items.  I use it with a Heuck 33004 Pre-Seasoned Cast Iron 17 Inch Reversible Griddle to make steaks that taste like they were grilled over charcoal, but without the mess and bother.
The product was as advertised.  A little coarser than I expected, but good non the less.  The company shipped it quickly.
Looked for something other than chocolate and found these organic cookies which were well received by the grandchildren.  Would certainly look at this seller again.
This was purchased as a gift.  My sister said they tasted very good and were really cute.  However, for the $$ you pay, she only got 8 cookies.

I didn't get a chance to sample these organic cookies myself, but I sent a box to my sister in law as an advance Easter pick-me-up surprise and they have been a phenomenal hit. The cookies are delicious and look great, and  Beautiful Sweets has a whole variety of themes for year-round occasions.One very minor issue, I wish the product page had specific information about shipping times. It took Beautiful Sweets about a week to ship my order; there's nothing wrong with that, but it would just be nice to know, especially when you're used to Amazon shipping everything so quickly.On the positive side, they emailed with tracking number as soon as the package shipped.I will definitely be ordering more from Beautiful Sweets in the future. Sister In Law doesn't know it yet, but she's getting the Halloween special!
Great enjoy a lotvictorio kitchen products, root beer, slushie makers, ice crushers Product imageSlushie Express Syrup Flavor Splash 3 Pack

column9: I JUST LOVE THE KING OF BEERS
column10: its the king of beer. i do prefer the canned bud but bottles are ok. i can drink about 13 cans of budweiser without heaving my guts out which is more then i can say for its competitor. there labeling is beautiful and there advertisements are  near perfection.

When ordering I was expecting the dog food to be what was described or look like the image.  The food came and the only thing that was correct was it was the weight management dog food.  The dog food will work but I like to receive what I ordered.

I love them! They're crunchy on the inside and smooth and creamy on the outside. They're basically biscuit (malt) balls covered in chocolate. We have a weak imitation over here (Whoppers), but Maltesers are much better, I think the chocolate is a better quality, or just smoother and creamier. Actually, I don't know if Whoppers or Maltesers came first, but I definitely prefer Maltersers.Get the 5 pack, in fact I once bought a 25 pack box and hid it from my wife. It lasted me one week and I had to see Dr. Johns, DDS soon after that.

BEWARE! These are highly addictive! I became obsessed with them on a trip to Scotland. The chocolate is wonderful- not that waxy coating you'd find on US malted milk balls. It is real, sweet, creamy chocolate, and the malted milk centers are to die for!

I grew up eating these yummy chocolate malt balls in Hong Kong.  The chocolate is rich and creamy while the honeycomb malt center is so crisp!  I love them!  I tried the Whoppers and they were no comparison to the Maltesers.  Too bad they're so hard to find and sold out here on Amazon.  My local Cost Plus World Market carries them.

it's been a while since i last had Maltesers. it becomes hard to find in the market. Everytime i eat Whoppers it always remind me of how better the Maltesers are... sad it's rare. until it pops in my mind i should go look in Amazon and alas found it! every person's taste is different but for me this is the best chocolate malt... the center feels like it melts away. chocolate lovers should give this a try.

Go ahead and forget everything you think you know about the delicacy known as chocolate covered maltballs. Now try these -> Mars Maltesers chocolate coated piecesThese little jewels are made by the same company, MARS, but they are from a different manufacturing plant in the UK. The chocolate is rich and creamy, the malt center is crisp, crunchy, and clean. The entire experience is different than what we have in the US known as "Whoppers" and some lesser known regional brands.But be careful; once I tried Maltesers, I cannot put what I had grown to know and love in my mouth anymore. I'm scouring the web for these babies and I found them here on Amazon. Lucky for me they come in multipacks! Mars Maltesers 37g x 5 PackEnjoy
Delicious!Luckily my father now lives in Australia and has gotten really good a sending me these on a regular basis.

For $9.99 they sent me 5 two oz. Pkgs. With about 10 small malted candies in each.  That makes each pkg. Cost $2. and each little malt ball $.20 each.  I don't care how good they are, this is an outrageous price.  Live and learn I guess.

I'll stick to Whoppers, thank you very much. It's not like I don't enjoy expensive high end chocolate, either. These things have a weird aftertaste and too thick a gloppy layer of chocolate on them. I know they're supposed to be "better" malted milk balls but you can have them. I think most of the hype comes from literary people who liked Bridget Jones Diary and wanted to like these.
Chocolate Raspberry flavoring is distinct but not overwhelming. Absolutely wonderful aroma. The coffee itself is a smooth blend without any bitterness. I will order more of this coffee.

column9: Not Exactly What I am Used To
column10: This is NOT your European buckweat kasha that we love and used to cook it for years with an absolute consistency: wash, add water, and boil until it's absorbed. My wife experimented several times with this buckweat, but always ended up with not edible mess of variable consistency.

column9: Not as good as I expected
column10: This buckwheat is very flavorful while uncooked. However, it is dried/roasted in such way that if you cook it the standard way you will end up with mush. You have to follow the recipe on the bag (or some variation of it) in order to get the grainy consistency. To me, this method of cooking is more complicated than what I am used to and to a certain degree compromises the flavor. I am used to the kind of buckwheat that you can cook in a rice steamer and it does not turn to mush.I know in non-organic world there are better products. Not sure if there is any organic buckwheat that is better than this.I absolutely love the cracked buckwheat variety by this company -- that kind is usually cooked to be mushy and there the drying/roasting method used by this company puts it well above anything else I tried.

If you are Russian and looking for good buckwheat kasha - don't buy that one, it's totally different thing. It smells like medicine and tastes weird, not like regular simple buckwheat. If you are the person who decided to try a buckwheat first time - don't buy that one, you will be disappointed and never know what a tasty meal it should be.

Better than Wolff's Kasha. I grew up eating Kasha and it is an easy to prepare healthy meal. Bob's Red Mill has a great selection of all things GRAIN. If you are ever in the Portland area you should check out the store/restaurant. Great vegetarian selections as well as meat eater stuff.
Great, high quality. The best that I have tried so far. I am ordering almost everything from Bob's Red Mill now. I have never been dissatisfied with anything.
i got real disappointed when i saw how unripe the thing is. Supposed to be dark brown, and that stuff is light green!!!!! smells funny too, like glue. american version of buckwheat, presumably

column4: Shira Anthony "Author & Avid Reader of M/M Ro...
column9: Tasty, healthy alternative to rice or potatoes
column10: My family likes this product as a side dish with fish or chicken.  Good, nutty flavor, great Bob's organic quality as always.  We use a lot of Bob's products, and it's much cheaper to purchase them in bulk at Amazon than at our local grocery store.  I've also used this combined with chickpeas to make my own falafel from time to time.
I love to make kasha stuffed cabbage rolls and was having trouble finding kasha in the store so I bought this. Excellent quality, price and best of all delivered to my door!
This Kasha tastes good,it cooks great in my rice cooker,it's great with milk as morning cereal(AND BETTER FOR YOU) and I feed it to my son who loves it.Great product.
Kasha is good and healthy. Your price is good too, so it is a winner.

column9: It is not "KASHA"! Tastes bad, do not waste your money.
column10: I am from Ukraine, so I grew up on buckwheat, and I know how "Kasha" is supposed to taste and look like. This is not it. Once you cook it, this Kasha looks like goo, not like Russian Kasha is supposed to be - very flaky, with each piece of wheat separated. It tastes pretty bad too, like it got burnt or something. No matter how much butter or salt you put in, it still tastes bad. The only reason I bought this product because it was organic and I did not want to buy it on Russian website (was afraid of them stealing my credit card), but now I have to, because THIS is not good.

I bought this flavor because I couldn't find the chocolate flavor by itself.  I am so happy I did buy it because it is my go to sweet.  I strongly recommend this flavor to everyone.  I only wish I could find a larger bag of them.
they were OK, i liked that they weren't too sweet, but the caramel flavor was very fake tasting, i wont be ordering again. my quest for the perfect caramel lollipop continues

Maybe mine were a bit old. I didn't get the great caramel flavorI was expecting. Possibly it was because they are artifically flavored.A friend recommened these, since she had them last fall. I don't knowwhy they were priced so high. I won't order again, I'll wait until falland pick them up a local store.
these are delish !!.. why not make it a reg. item so we wont have to overpay !!glad i ordered them, but wont pay the price for a second order
product arrived when stated, intact anc correct.  was able to track online with ease.  would definitely order from them again.
Caramel with tootsie roll, WOW WOW WOW! These are great, not too sweet just right, hope they keep the coming!
A little disappointed in this product.  I feel it was over priced for the quantity you get.  The flavor is okay but I still prefer the traditional flavors-my favorite is orange.
I buy this at our neighborhood supermarket.  It really is the best soymilk - best flavor, best texture, everything.

Our two 4 month old kittens absolutely LOVE this food. We tried Wellness kitten dry food, and they weren't too crazy about it, but they immediately took to this stuff! Not only do they love it, but we love it because it has extremely high quality ingredients and is healthy for them. We also love it because it is very reasonably priced for a premium quality food. We feed our kittens both this dry food and Wellness and Merrick Before Grain wet foods. When they're older, we'll definitely be moving on to Chicken Soup for the Cat Lover's Soul, because we couldn't be happier with this food!

I am so glad I found this product on amazon after research! I noticed my kitten was not immediately drawn to it so I added some moist food to the top. The kitten's fur is short hair but so soft and has a nice shine ! This is the only place I can find it and it is a good price with subscribe and save.

column9: OMG, there was a one-cat stampede to the dry food bowl
column10: (PRODUCT LINK: ASIN: B0018CE77Q)Cotton ran really fast to his dry food bowl when he got a sniff of this!  And I am speechless; his love affair with this continues.  The company doesn't have wide-enough distribution, but deserves it.  They make a splendid product.However, Amazon has it.  Bet you can't guess where the reorder will be sent!
Excellent cat food. All six of my cats like it. Has no bad stuff for fillers.Reasonable price for a premium cat food.

I have tried many different kitten/cat food for my almost 1 year old kitty. So far, Chicken Soup for the Kitten Lover's Soul is her favorite. She eats a lot and plays hard, which makes me very happy. Also, in comparison to many grain-free, high quality cat food, Chicken Soup offers the best value for what you pay for. I highly recommend it.

After the glowing reviews I purchased this cat food for my 3 rescue kitties.  It seemed a reasonable price for higher quality food...it was, and it is, trouble is my guys won't touch it, prefer the cheapo kitten chow!  I will keep trying...you know how cats are...

I was using Wellness Core for my six month old kitten and have been using CSFPLS dog food for my three adult dogs. The price for the CSFPLS kitten food was cheaper than what I've been spending for Core so I thought I'd give it a try. So far, so good! The kibble is 'x' shaped which makes it easy for her to pick up and she runs to her bowl as soon as I give her her breakfast. I'm super pleased with the ingredients and am happy she took to it so well. I am hoping that it treats her as well as the dog formula has treated my other furkids. Soft coats, shiny eyes and good activity levels!
Heard great things online reviews and agree with them. My boys love this food and have even moved on to the adult formula

column9: Light and Delicious - a treat with no guilt
column10: Love these little treats.  They are gluten free, I think, and just delicious.  With around 100 calories a bag, they satisfy my salt and crunchy craving without making me feel guilty.  I carry them in my shop in Hollywood, Fancifull Fine Food and Baskets, and when I offer them at a tasting they always sell out.

I am pretty discerning when it comes to chocolates and I have to say that these are as good as it gets.The variety in the box is both fun and creative. The base chocolate is super smooth and exquisiteness in its mouth feel and aftertaste of pure cacao..My favorite one is the meyer-lemon-lavender heart with dark chocolate genache  - First of all, its BEAUTIFULLY hand painted and when you place it in your mouth, there is the rich chocolate shape - the genache filling has a frontal meyer lemon - then rich chocolate and finally a finish of floral lavender...OH MY WORD.If you want to impress....THIS is the box to get...seriously great.

Betty Lou's Spirulina balls are the greatest source of nutrition that I know of because I have a great deal of food allergies and they are an all around source of nutrition that also just happens to taste great. They are very easy to carry to work for a quick pick me up later in the day as well.

I have tried every type of dark chocoalte without dairy (surprising how many 'dark chocolates' contain dairy!) and these are hands down the best. A nice combination of smooth chocolate flavor without being overly sweet or being too bitter. FAN-TAS-TIC!!!

This is a superior chocolate - my new favorite in the 70% range. It's ultra creamy and velvety, with a smooth, rich, deep, dark chocolate taste and a nice, long finish. It's hard not to devour the entire bar at once.

Organic dark chocolate is the bee's knees, especially Newman's Own. This chocolate is, of course, very rich and tasty, but not all that bitter for being over 70% cocoa. There is a little bit of a crunchy after-texture (best way I can describe it) but in my opinion it doesn't take away from the deliciousness.

This cereal is really good. It has just the right amount of sweetness and chocolate flavor. My only complaint is that the box is too small. It only has 7 servings, so if more than one person in your family is eating it it will go quickly.

column9: Amazon, why have you forsaken us???
column10: This is a fantastic cereal, and is higher in fiber and lower in sugar than most. Not sure why it's only targeted at kids, as it's CHOCOLATE CEREAL!!! We're all adults in this household and we LOVE it.Unfortunately, it sells out in a couple of days whenever Amazon carries it, and then they don't restock it for months at a time. I don't get that at all. I would subscribe to this if I could, and I won't buy it from a Marketplace seller, as their prices are ridiculous. ($10 a box??? Seriously?)So come on, Amazon, and get it together. You should have plenty of this in stock all year round, like you do the honey flavor (which is dull, dull, dull).Cereal: 5 starsAmazon: 0 stars

This is a fantastic cereal.. great for desert too where it hits the spot.I couldn't believe to see it sold here for $6 a box! Come on, people!When will Malt-O-Meal make its version of this stuff? I'm sure the price would be more reasonable and taste just as good.
Jewel stopped carrying product and I'm delighted to be able to purchase it at Amazon..  Kids love it.

column9: Amazing cereal dry or wet, and fills you up
column10: Each serving has 6 grams of fiber! And a serving size is a whopping 52 biscuits, so this is an incredible snack that will fill you up without making you feel guilty about eating cereal yet alone having that chocolate flavor. You either like them or you don't, but for those who like this cereal, they usually enjoy them a lot!I completely recommend this cereal to everyone because it's a great snack for those trying to eat healthy, but still looking to snack on something that will satisfy them for hours after eating it. Amazing taste with or without milk.

column9: Light peach flavor with no added strange herbs....
column10: Nice light pure peach flavor.Does not 'feel' caffeinated, even tho it does have caffeine...light in all regards.Enjoy it very much, great value and a plus for me...none of those strange herbs that are often in flavored teas that make them all taste the same.A winner!

Perfect balance between the peach flavor and the flavor of the black tea.As Hurricane Irene approached my home and the surrounding trees, I decided to wait it out in a motel. St. Dalfour Peach was the only tea I packed.What more can I say?

column9: Excellent Tea and I felt a good price
column10: I first drank this tea at Mountain Lake Viginia and enjoyed it so much I looked all over to buy it. I finally found it on Amazon.com where I can find most things.

column9: ST. DALFOUR Golden Peach is Delicious
column10: A relative of mine served this tea. I wrote the name down and kept a lookout for it in grocery stores but never found it. I finally ordered it online and was not disappointed. Great flavor, purchasing experience was fine too. Mmmm...

Taste is very pleasant, but there is a warning in box to not let tea bag brew too long, and that is dead on.  The flavor immediately permeates the hot water, so attention to timing is important.  I have not tried it yet, but assume it would make very good ice tea as well( and if you wanted to be real frugal - probably with one tea bag!)  I will be trying some other flavors as well now.
I just bought this peach tea for the first time at Big Lots in Oregon. It tastes great and it was only $2.00 for a box of 25 tea bags!

column9: This should be Tea with Golden Peach Essence
column10: Total disappointment. This is not a rich or robust peach flavor, but essence of peach. What a shame. Too bad I purchased the 6 box order. I guess I should have read all of the reviews.

column9: A bit of a mild taste
column10: This is a very mild tasting tea. I was sort of expecting it to hit my taste buds and BAM; but that didn't exactly happen. It's a great price for the amount you get, and it being organic, but it doesn't have the strongest taste. It certainly doesn't taste offensive at all, but I recommend a different tea if you're looking for something with more of a kick.
This tea has a very weak peach flavor. I do not intend to order it again. Stash Premium Peach Black Tea has a more robust peach flavor.

column9: High-Quality cat food that looks like food
column10: My cats love most of the TikiCat flavors, so this is mostly a review for the overall line of cat food. There's a great review on a blog called Green Little Cat (no affiliation), with a picture of what's inside the can.All the food looks like food! There are rice grains and pieces of calamari, and in the flavors with prawns, there are tiny little prawns! Not just some weird mush! The chicken flavors are shreds of chicken, and the salmon flavors are chunks of salmon where you can actually see the flaking that fish tends to have. It's really great. All but one or two of the flavors even qualify for low-phosphorus diets (for urinary stones/certain renal diseases)! The highest protein flavors are Ahi Tuna, Chicken, Chicken+Egg, and Chicken+Salmon. The others are still very high protein, but they do have other stuff, too (like rice, greens, etc).Overall, I am very happy feeding this to my cats (alongside Orijen dry food), because I can actually see the ingredients, the company is exceptionally responsive to customer questions (they will send you a comprehensive nutritional breakdown if you email them!), and they really pay attention to nutrition.
I was first introduced to Tiki at a local pet shop when I asked what food seemed to be the most popular by sales.  The cats went NUTS over it, and the rest is history... The Rexes love it!

Saw all the recommendations on Amazon for this wet cat food and decided to try it.  My cat goes crazyyyyyyyyyy over this stuff.  Its made with human grade ingriedients and smells great.  I smelled it for the first time and almost put it on a cracker for a snack lol.  Buy this and your cat will love you for it.

column9: Excellent but go to Trader Joes
column10: This is the best GF bread out there!  So delicious and perfect for a sandwich, french toast, etc.  But I get it $2 cheaper at Trader Joe's.  Single loaves are $4.99.  Too bad Amazon cant give you a good deal to buy a case of 8.  Oh well, I tried.  But do try the bread- so good.
If you have a costco membership they carry a 2 pack for around $7. That puts it around the same price of a good loaf of regular wheat bread.

This is very tasty bread.  I am one who cannot forego my bread and we've all heard how bad it is for us except for Udi's gluten free Whole Grain!  As most have said, it makes the most delicious toast and if you didn't know you would swear it was just a good old fashioned style white bread.  It's not.  It's healthy!  I wish they would figure out how to eliminate the holes though.  I took some photos the other day of two slices from a loaf I bought and the holes were huge.  It is so delicious that even a loaf full of holes is better than no loaf at all!  It's so expensive too but a luxury I must have.  I buy it locally from my grocer's frozen food section and forego all other bread.  I used to buy artisan breads and bagels, etc but no more since I learned to read labels and know what to look for.  Thanks for the hint and I will look for it at Trader Joes or Costco to try and save a little money.

column9: Oh UDI's you have brought sandwiches back into my life
column10: Wheat makes my kidney's hurt, gives me migraines, and does unpleasant things to my stomach. I have tried other gluten free breads and they were not worth the money I spent on them. This however is incredible! It did not even taste like gluten free bread. It tasted like bread. I've been making my chicken, swiss, and tomato sandwiches every day and they're so good.  The only thing that could make this bread better is a better price. It's $5 a loaf and some of the ingredients are not expensive ones. I hope the price goes down.

I will buy and eat Udi's white bread in a pinch, but I like the whole grain bread ten times better. The taste is great and it doesn't fall apart, although I still prefer to make open-faced sandwiches so there is no crumbling at all.I had that problem with air holes that one reviewer mentioned on my most recent loaf. I will definitely be more careful because, at Udi's prices, I'm not interested in paying for air, but I had that happen to me once or twice back when I was eating regular bread, too. Air holes happen.I do think this is one of the first things, with doctor/nutritionist approval of course, that a person should grab after they discovered a gluten allergy or sensitivity.
