But be warned that you will have lots of crumbled Clif Crunch bars if you order this through Amazon.
Love, love, love these!  My husband first brought one of these home from the New York - Five Boro Tour, and I am hooked on them.

column9: a dark chocolate lovers' delight, a blueberry lover's disappointment
column10: "Cocoa" is the ingredient on the label of the chocolate peanut butter Clif crunch bars but I found these Clif Crunch snack bars less overly-sweet than many others.  They taste like they contain dark, as opposed to the easy-to-find milk, chocolate. I recommend them to dark chocolate lovers and ordered three more boxes, straight-away.On the other hand, the blueberry bars are a loser, in my opinion. There is only a faint blueberry flavor.  This blueberry-lover would just love one choc-full of dried blueberries, adding the appropriate blueberry flavor to these crunchy snack bars.
I really liked these bars. They are really good. Finished them in a week and would definitely order again. I wish I could find a coupon
I was expecting two packs of these like the description said, instead I only got one box.  It was a total rip off.

I came across these granola bars as part of the Subscribe & Save program.  Much to my dismay, the subscription service option was discontinued.  They are so good, however, I've continued to purchase them.  Even my children really like them and they usually only like granola bars if they are packed with so much sugar and covered in chocolate to the point you can't distinguish them from a candy bar.I like the Clif brand and what the company is trying to do, besides offering a more wholesome granola bar without compromising taste.The granola bars are certified organic by QAI and packaging is made from 100% recycled material.  Hey, every little bit helps when you're trying to reduce your carbon footprint.
I wasn't real confident that these were going to taste all that great, but my expectations were far exceeded! These bars are so very tasty! Easily the best crunchy bar I've ever had.

This crunch granola bar is on par with every other product from Clif.  It is, as the name would imply, very crunch and extremely delicious.  My favorite granola bar was Nature Valley, but this definitely took the cake.  Simply put, it's delicious.

I normally do not like "crunchy" bars because its a hit and miss proposition. Sometimes too hard, sometimes too soft (feel like Goldilocks). But the taste and texture gets a passing grade from me. Will buy more.
Love the peanut butter crunch bars.  Normally buy them at Walmart for 3.99 per box.  Walmart has been out so I looked here.  $15.75 is outrageous for 2 boxes.

I've tried a wide variety of granola bars and I have to say, these are some really great tasting bars. If you like peanut butter, you will love these. Each box comes with 5 packages of 2 bars a piece. These are a great snack for the middle of the day. I'm looking forward to trying out the other flavors. If you get it with S&S, the price is very low as well. Overall, this is a great granola bar at a great price!

I prefer these over comparable granola bars in both taste and texture, and the fact that Clif uses 'Organic' ingredients is an added bonus.  I am an avid hiker, and these have held up better than other brands on my hikes.

My daughter loves these bars.  The order came quickly.  No complaints whatsoever.  The only thing I would mention is that these bars are crumbly and do not "travel well" compared to the softer bars out there.  So I think we will have some softer bars for travel and these bars when travel is not an issue.  Hope that makes sense!

These snacks are perfect for the on the go exercise enthusiast.  They don't taste too sugary and are a great pick me up for when I need to replenish on the food front.  For the price I paid, I'm very satisfied.

I like Clif bars because they taste good but not great enough that you want to eat a whole lot of them. These crunch bars are no exception. I usually have clif bars in my school bag to stave off hunger during classes before succumbing to the call of a vending machine.The Chocolate Macadamia Nut flavor is a bit too sweet for my tastes which was a little surprising for a Clif bar (but it is chocolate). I like that each packet comes with two thin bars rather than one big granola bar - great for sharing or portioning.
Packaged well item tastes great can be messy when you attempt to eat that clif bar falls apart. However I want more of this product.

I like Clif products in general and this one is also pretty good.  It tastes good and it has better list of ingredients than the more processed ones from Nature's Valley, etc.  But the thing crumbles too much.  It doesn't hold together very well and from the moment you open the package, there's crumbs all over you.  Just be aware of it.  It's tasty and crunchy as they say on the package.
The bars taste good, but they are REALLY crunchy! It's almost impossible to eat them and not make a huge mess of crumbs--definitely not good for taking on the go to eat in the car!
There is a definite, crisp and crunchy texture to these bars. Some other bars have a slight chemical aftertaste. These are probably healthier then cereal.

My grandson, who is in special forces training in the Air Force requested these.  Needs a lot of protein for his training.  Asked me not to send cookies or junk food.  Wanted these instead.  Lots easier than cooking, packaging, and trips to the post office.He said his favorite is the Blueberry bars.

I love these things! Usually they go on sale on Amazon and I only buy them when they are about $6 - 7 for the pack of two. My favorite kind is the white chocolate macadamia nut. However, when I bought them I wasn't expecting them to be quite so messy. They are definitely crunchy, and you will get crumbs everywhere - so keep that in mind. Otherwise I love the things! I'm a college student so this is a good breakfast or snack on my walk to class.

I purchased 5 boxes of these. I really enjoy the taste and nutritional value of the bars. Great starter, mid day pick me up or evening snack (dip into milk). These are crunchy. Great price & excellent Amazon service!

The "healthiness" is great, as are most CLIF products.The price, even with subscribe and save is way too high.There is not much difference from just buying regular granola barsThere are only 5 packages in each box (with 2 smaller bars in each)I always wonder why they make such big boxes and only put a few items in the box....who only eats 5 granola bars?

column9: Taste just like Chocolate Chip Cookies!
column10: First off let me say that I've been a fan of Clif bars for a while now. So I saw these at my local grocery store and decided to give them a whirl.WOW! Just wow! These take exactly like crunchy chocolate chip cookies. They are absolutely delicious. I find myself craving these now instead of brownies or a candy bar. I was actually eating them in class one day and a few people tried them and now are also obsessed. Great product and completely yummy!

Great for on the go, I work in a job that I don't always got to eat lunch on time so grabbing a bar is a great way to eat. These are great, the only thing is that it comes in a 5 pack because 2 bars are in each pack. But it is still a great deal
Just as good as the other Clif bars, but dry and crunchy. Tasty, portable, and cheaper than the others. Perfect snack.
We love these granola bars. I didn't realize that they were crunchy when i ordered them and it was such a nice surprise. They have great flavor and I feel good about my family eating them.
This cliff bar is much more expensive than the nature valley products. But, it is not worth to be pricey.

This new product packs the perfect crunch into sweet bar. I love the bits of white chocolate. The only downside is that it crumbles incredibly easy so it's pretty messy to eat. But overall, it is a very satisfying bar!

column9: Decent granola bar, but the packaging is a bit misleading
column10: When I first opened the box I was surprised to find 5 packages of granola bars, each with 2 bars each, so a "10-pack" has 5 packages with 2 granola bars in each package (I never noticed it was normal to do that with granola bars), hence the serving size is 2 bars. The price for each packet is about the same as that of a normal clif bar, so I don't know if it's really worth it to me. You get about 60% more mass with a clif bar than with this for the same price.That being said, they taste decent and taste good broken into pieces with peanut butter and nutella.

These are so awesome. They have great crunch, without being really hard (like nature valley) and the little bits of chocolate throughout the bar are delightful. I would eat these for dessert instead of cake or brownies. Peanut butter is good too.
Figured I'd try these when Amazon lowered the price and glad I did!  My wife and I both enjoy these very tasty bars and it is a much healthier choice than a bag of chips!

These things are awesome!  I only ordered them because they were on a good sale on amazon, but now I'll gladly pay full price.They taste soo good!  No high fructose corn syrup, a big plus.  They do have "evaporated cane juice" as the sweetener.  I'm not familiar with it, but a quick google search shows it to be a healthier and better alternative to regular cane sugar.Great texture and crunch, and great flavor.  A perfect snack that is much much healthier than a lot of alternatives.I could not imagine a better granola bar.  Try these, you won't be disappointed!
My parents sent me some of these in care package while I was deployed and they are amazing.  So much better than nature vally bars.

column9: Pretty good break from other brand granola bars
column10: I got the white chocolate macadamia flavor of these.  They really aren't any different from any other granola bars.  The white chocolate flavor isn't as strong as it is in the regular Clif bars.  Overall, they're tasty and reasonably priced on Amazon.
Great crunch and taste.  Love the auto ship program with discount!  I can't find these in any stores in my area, was so happy to get them on Amazon.

I love these granola bars!  I can honestly say they are the best granola bars I've ever eaten.  They also have protein, and I love eating them just as a snack as well as if I'm on the go or post workout.  My only problem is they are hard to find in grocery stores...and I usually don't like to wait around to fill out a "please stock this item" form.

Love Cliff bars, but have only liked the Peanut Butter and Chocolate Chip Peanut Crunch flavors (maybe an occasional Blueberry).  The others are too sweet for my taste.  These are my new favorite.  Great taste combination.  Go Cliff Bars!
These are the best crunchy granola bars I've tasted. They are excellent alone or with a nice cup of coffee. Highly recommended!

Got these with a one-day shipping delay, but still very quickly with Amazon Prime.  The taste is quite good, perhaps a little on the sweet side - especially when you hit a pocket of white chocolate.  The big problem is the condition of the product when it arrives.  I opened my first 2-pack and the granola bars were crushed into nuggets and powder.  Strangely, the box wasn't in bad shape, just the bars.  A few days later, I opened the other box of granola bars, which was in better shape than the first one, and the first pack I tried again contained smashed fragments of granola bars.  These are no fun to eat, as you can't really open the pack and pour it into your mouth (I tried), and if you pick out the big chunks you get fragments and powder sticking to your fingers, and on your clothes (and in your beard).  I'll eat the rest, maybe out of a bowl with a spoon or something (with some fava beans and a nice chianti...), but I won't be ordering any more crunched Clif Crunch bars.
What looks like a great deal is actually a terrible one. This is ONE box of 5 packs of granola bars (packed like Nature Valley). So, instead of receiving 20 snacks, you get 5.

column9: Identical taste to Nature Valleys Granola bars
column10: I was hoping that the taste of these granola bars would different from Nature Valleys but it turns out they taste pretty much the same if not identical... maybe a little bit less sugary.Oh well, moving on... I just hate when companies deliberately trick consumers, the freaking box got 5 packs, just put that on the box.

These bars are tasty and delicious.  You get 20 bars for a decent price (depending if you do subscribe and save).  These bars are great for my little ones, they love them, and they are a good healthy alternative to candy or cookies.
The listing of the box describes as twice as many bars as there are servings.  Each foil pouch contains two very small bars, which together make one serving.  The 10 count is really a 5 count.
These granola bars are very similar to the Nature's Valley brand bars.  The Clif Crunch Bars are very messy.  They crumble.  The flavor is not as good as the flavors offered by Nature's Valley.
Item tasted plain and was crumbly. Did not taste at all like it is described. We were disappointed with product.

Just when you think you're eating healthier - you research to find out "Your NOT" with Clif Products. Theirs so much sugar, carbs & fats in these products that you might as well eat cookies or candy bars. They definitely taste better and you get the same sugar & calories.

I purchased this because I could not find star anise in the local stores.  The order came quickly and the container is very large.  I think it was a good deal for the money.  (Tip:  steep some star anise in hot water or add to chamomile tea for a natural sleep aid.)

I've purchased a few JBMC whole beans from different roasters over the years, and wanted to share my experience with this particular seller.I was running low on my normal supply of JBMC and decided to give this seller a try, because of their slightly lower price, and they had it in stock and shipped it out immediately.My opinion is that the JBMC beans from this seller were either old, or something went wrong during their roasting process.  The grind has a slight sour smell when brewing, which in turn gives a slight bitter taste.Good JBMC is very smooth; on the lighter side; slightly sweet and spicy with a nice finish.  Like good 100% Kona coffee, there is no bitter aftertaste.I tried different grinds, #16 and #24, and prefer the #24 grind for a single cup brew.The place I normally get this bean from (Lion Coffee) did get a fresh batch of JBMC beans in last week, so I was able to compare both; and the Lion JBMC roasted whole bean wins hands down.My recommendation is that if you are willing to spend $30-$50 a pound for JBMC beans, make sure it's direct from one of their certified distributors like Mavis Banks.

column9: If you enjoy good coffee, give this a shot
column10: Quick Review:  Island Roasters 100% Jamaica Blue Mountain CoffeeI recently received a pound of this coffee as a gift, and looked forward to getting to sample some 100% Jamaica Blue Mountain coffee.  The short version:  AMAZING!!!  I actually had to wait a couple days after trying the first sample to write this review... I was too giddy after that first taste to write an objective review.  Yes, it's THAT good.So, here's the review after a couple days of drinking the stuff and having some time to reflect on the experience.Before diving into the description of the actual drink, I need to describe the experience of simply opening the vacuum bag and inspecting the contents.  Once the bag is opened, there is this magical release of coffee perfume that is simply divine.  The smell is not something that one can adequately describe... it truly needs to be experienced.The beans themselves were medium-dark brown, and glistening in a uniform sheen...all were roasted perfectly and uniformly.  I quickly got down to business... ground some of the beans and started the brewing process.  The beans were so fresh and so laden with volatile oils that the ground coffee bits adhered to each other... it looked like you could have easily molded the grounds into shapes with your hands! This was really fresh coffee.  Once again, after grinding, another burst of coffee perfume pervaded the kitchen, bathing the air with an amazing aroma.Now for the moment of truth...tasting the stuff straight up....was...just... WOW!  Lots of coffee perfume with an incredibly complex mix of floral notes.  Very well balanced... just an amazing array of flavors, beautifully arranged with hints of sweetness along with a lovely backbone of acidity to keep everything in check.  Absolutely no hint of bitterness.  In fact, this was the most smooth coffee I'd ever had.  Delicate, complex, some ephemeral fruit notes, balanced, and most of all, just smoooooooooth.If you are a coffee enthusiast, give this stuff a try.Highly recommended!

When coffee was being ground I could tell the beans were old and dried out, not a good flavor or or even much of any flavor at all, save your money on this company.Called company and they made restitution.

I originally gave this product a bad review. The same day I received an email from Hawaii Roasters saying that they stand behind their products and would offer me a full refund if I am not satisfied.This got me to thinking that if they are that willing to stand behind their products then perhaps I made an incorrect assumption about the coffee.I compared this to another bean I purchased and my comparison was NOT apples to apples. The person at Hawaii Roasters was kind enough to point this out.Also, I discovered that I was making the coffee too strong. My regular roast requires me to grind more beans. Using the same amount of these beans is not necessary.So, first I want to commend Hawaii Roasters for their quick response and their willingness to stand behind what they sell.Second, I apologize for jumping the gun with my review.I will definitely do business with them again.

My colleagues and I were anxiously awaiting the arrival of this coffee. We are "Coffee People" and all of us have wondered how good Jamaican Blue Mountain coffee would be. None of us have tried it because it is cost prohibitive.The coffee received was stale and bitter. We were expecting to pay a premium for this coffee, however, we were not expecting the Sanka style flavor. Because we were not able to return of exchange this coffee, we were essentially ripped off. Enjoy the forty dollars Hawaii Roasters, it is the last you will receive from any of us.
I always heard that Jamaican coffee was the best, after trying this I totally agree!  Taste and aroma are heavenly.  I'll definitely buy again!

This company is top notch. Why I say this is because I was not satisfied with a particular product, left a comment, and was responded not only in only a matter of hours, but by the president of the company stating what he would do for me.  I am in the retail business and the customer service I received, will continue my purchasing from this company. Again, thank you for your quick response to resolve my issue and look forward to doing business with this company in the future.

No, I don't understand the subtle flavorings that critics talk about. I just know after 51 years of drinking coffee, this is simply the best tasting coffee I have ever had. Kona is my second favorite. Try this coffee. You will not be disappointed.

column9: OH yes Baby. Bring it on!!
column10: I have been looking for Jamaican Blue mountain that is reasonable for a long time. I used to get it from a certain coffee house but the price was insane ($45/ half pound) so I tried others here on Amazon and various places. JBM is acknowledged as the best in the world and it is marvelous to taste. I ordered this with some trepidation as I have been disappointed before but i just opened/ground and tasted this and OMG this is superb. The price is steep (although not highway robbery as some others are) but worth  it as a treat. I have ordered Kona from Hawaii Coffee roasters and it is also excellent.Love this seller. Will be back (gotta wait for my tax refund to afford the JBM and KONA together). Enjoy folks it is something special.

column9: Hawaii Roasters 100% Jamaica Blue Mountain Coffee, Whole Bean, 16-Ounce Bag
column10: Now I know now why the Queen of England prefers these coffee beans. I tried it with French press. It is simply heavenly and refreshing. The smell of the beans is another enjoyment. It is expensive though so can be used on special occasions

column9: Oh, how I love this coffee!
column10: This coffee is just delicious. Rich and smooth. Strong with no bitter taste. There even seems to be a hint of a chocolate flavor. Well worth the $. Try it....you won't be dissappointed!

I have always bought Kona 100% coffee.  This time I bought Jamaica Blue Mountain coffee.  I was not impressed.  The coffee beans did not smell fresh and the taste was not the smoothness I expected.  I really expected better and for the price I expected what it advertised. I would not recommend this coffee.

The beans arrived exactly as described by the sellers. They're medium roasted and look and smell fresh. The quality was there, and the taste was great, but beware these beans are quite acidic. They have a very sour after taste and after about a week of using it for espresso, I just couldn't continue using them.I know that JBM beans in general tend to be more acidic, and overall these are on par or better than many other JBM beans that I've had before, but just beware as a buyer that they are rather acidic.No complaints about the seller - the beans arrived fresh, fast and well roasted.

I have tried three pounds of JBM coffee beans this year from Hawaii Roasters and Wallenford. It has become my favorite when I have time to make a cup in the morning before I go to office. Starbucks house blend and Peet's coffee are daily served in work. I limit to one cup each day in the preference order of JBM, Peet's and Starbucks. I use a Keurig single cup brew machine at home and have also tried a dozen different other brands from different regions with varied darkness. The medium roast JBM coffee came out to be exactly the coffee that I like - smooth and pure. I cannot tell much difference between the beans roasted by Wallenford and Hawaii Roasters. Bean size, shape, aroma, and quality look similar. Only difference is that beans from Hawaii Roasters will split shells to my grinder cover when I grind them while there are almost none with Wallenford beans.

column9: It's good, but not worth it
column10: I bought these to see if Jamaica Blue Mountain lives up to it's reputation.  I'll admit I usually drink tea, and normally take my coffee with cream and sugar, so these beans may have subtle qualities that were wasted on me.  The consensus in my household was that while very good, these weren't noticibly better than many beans a fraction of the price.

This coffee tastes delicious.  It is smooth and rich and grinds really well.It smells so good when it is brewing and then tastes just as good.I've been trying other whole bean coffees and Jamaica Blue is one of the best.Great to wake up to in the morning.

Its not bad coffee. If it was served at work I would say pretty darn good. But, I enjoy a REALLY good cup when I am home and this was so mellow in taste I had to double the strength of it just to taste the coffee. Ill go back to Hawaiian Roasters Kona coffee, that's a keeper.

column9: Not taste like blue mountain coffee.
column10: I bought this coffee  month ago.  But it doesnot taste good at all comparing to peet's blue mountain coffee.

I've been ordering the Hawaii Roaster coffee for several years and decided to venture off Hawaii and try their Jamaica coffee. Needless to say, I love it! It is a nice change and was great before I hit the slopes this morning! I'm sold and appreciate the added variety!
Order this coffee to try the dealer out -- was pleasantly surprised with the freshness and flavor of the beans
If  you are  looking  for  blue  mountain  coffee,  with  great  customer service!

I was searching for easy, quick, no-mess snacks for my busy lifestyle. Despite the fact that these are promoted for kids, they are very convenient snacks for adults, too! No spoon, no spill, no drip! And they are YUMMY!
Great product. Ideal for taking to school or in the car. I'm glad Amazon is offering this product at a competitive price.
We are used to having this product in France and It was a great surprise to have been able to find it in the US, and for a great price.  It's portable, great for snack time, and the kids love them.
It's applesauce, that you can squeeze.  What else is there to say??  It's a good travel snack, my 2 y/o finds it much easier to use than a spoon and bowl, and it's less messy.
Loved the fast service on my purchase and my kids love this applesauce and I love that it's on the go.  Perfect!
my kids love GoGo Squeez products, but the AppleBanana is not their favorite flavor.  I still buy them for them so they have variety and they do get eaten, just slower than the other flavors.

My toddler daughter loves these packets.  My only complaint is that the cap is a choking hazard, because it is so small.  I love being able to offer her a snack that is made from real fruit and not overly sugared.
It's healthy, easy, my kids love it, & it travels so nicely I take them everywhere! The lid screws on/off & when they're done they don't have messy hands & faces!

I keep a few of these in the diaper bag for my boys.  Both the baby and the toddler.  They both love them and these are their first choice for a snack if we are out.  The toddler I can just open and hand it to and he'll suck it all out.  The baby is starting to get the hang of sucking it so I don't need to squeeze it.  No spoon, no mess, easy snack, and no added sugar or high fructose corn syrup!!

My kids (1 and 3) would gobble this huge box of squeezies in a day if I let them.  As it is, it does last me about 3 weeks (about 1/day, this is an absolute treat for them). Convenient for on the go and my kids eat these for dessert.  Also cheaper here than the grocery store so will continue to buy these.

column9: Great Price and Good Quality Applesauce
column10: I bought this 48 pack of the AppleBanana Applesauce after having a hard time finding it in stores, especially in the large packs.  This was the best price anywhere and my kid really loves the applesauce.  I have tried others, but this is his favorite.  It is easy to carry around and quick.  And it tastes pretty good.  Great product.

How do I love thee, let me count the ways!This is such a great product to have on hand in the car or in a bag for the kiddos.  My 2 year old daughter loves the flavors and gets a nutritious snack at the same time.  I make sure to always have a pouch on hand.This is the best price I've seen for this product.
Great price and awesome snack for my 2 kids.  They love these and while I'd prefer them to eat fresh fruit, this is a decent alternative.  So much cheaper on Amazon then in the store or even Costco.

We have these in several flavors.  Ever since we found the baby food pouches that are proliferating on store shelves, we've been a fan.  It's a great way to get a snack in without alot of mess.  We carry them in the diaper bag religiously.  These have been a better, cheaper choice than the baby-food brand options.  No extra sugar and additives (if I recall that correctly), and less money per oz.  The boxes arrived in perfect condition, and in bulk, it's cheaper than big box store prices, even when they have them on sale.  We've recommended them to friends.

column9: Love the apple better than the apple/banana
column10: I love these for when I jog long distances - instead of using the gels; it's got the re-closable top and I like the taste.  Well, I actually like the apple WAY better than the apple/banana.  Also, I keep a box in the car and at work... it's a quick easy and CONVENIENT snack... so I don't have to worry about being tempted in going to a drive thru when I'm hungry.  I'm betting kiddies would like it - as it's similar to a sippy box ;)

Apple Banana Applesauce is the shiznitz!!! I love the baby food and look ridiculous eating it,but the GoGo Squeez Applesauce is fantastic i don't feel at all silly eating it! To bad they dont sale bigger pouches :)

These are SO FREAKIN' GOOD! I'm not much into kiddie candy, but when the local Dollar Store had a candy dish set out, I grabbed a box to try. Before I left, I went back and grabbed another box and told myself I'd stop in the next day and grab a couple bags. But, OH NO! They were all gone! So I searched all the area Dollar Stores, and sadly, there were none. I'm really hoping to buy them from Amazon as the only other place I've found is the Candy Warehouse, and who can afford their shipping?!

At the time of this review, the product description states "Fruit & Nut Delight, Almond & Apricot, Almond Cashew + Omega-3, Cranberry Almond + Antioxidants". These are not the flavors you will receive. I love KIND bars, and I get 2 boxes shipped to my house automatically each month. This month the flavors inside the box have changed, but the product description has not been updated. This is what now comes in the 'minis variety 12-pack':Almond & Coconut (instead of Almond & Apricot)Cranberry Almond + AntioxidantsFruit & Nut DelightNut Delight (instead of Almond Cashew + Omega-3)I've never eaten a KIND bar I didn't like, but if you are ordering based on favorite flavors, please be advised you are not going to receive the varieties currently listed.

This product is very good. The quality is excellent. Wonderful midday snack for the mini's and they are great for curbing hunger till dinner. The larger bars are good to replace lunch. Cranberry mixture is my favorite.
I love these bars but it makes more sense to just buy the regular size rather than this small size.  It is much more cost effective.
I enjoy Kind bars and this sample pack is great for two reasons: 1. variety 2.  they're about half the size of a normal bar so it's a perfect sized snack

column9: However, too expensive and no real discount in the Subscribe & Save
column10: I absolutely love these bars, and with Celiac in my family, they were the perfect breakfast bars and snacks when traveling.. Great tasting, and not very fattening.  You can feel good giving to children or treating yourself!  The perfect balance.however, both Harmon Cosmetics and Shoprite offer cheaper for each bar, which is sad, because I love ordering online.  I also think it is not fair that the Subscribe & Save prices keep shifting/ increasing to the point there is no benefit.  I will continue to buy, just not through Amazon.  And Kind Bars need to offer some rewards program for those of us who are loyal consumers.

Friends of ours who are field biologists recommended these to us.  They like them because they are natural and delicious and don't melt when you're out in the weather for long hours.  Wow! They are soooo good!  They are a bit pricey, but an excellent healthy splurge.  We have tried the apricot and almond one and look forward to trying the others.

A local store charges 2 dollars per bar.  This is wonderful.  Thank you Amazon for saving me money.  i will be purchasing this product again and others at work are purchasing their bars from Amazon new too
Very tasty and I love the ingredients! These are my favorite healthy granola-type bar. Not dry at all, and the flavers aren't overwhelming like in some others I have tried.

These are a bit small, and sorta pricey as other reviewers have mentioned, but I actually like the smaller size - the larger ones are a bit too much for me.  So these are perfect.  And since I can't find the mini ones in the store, this is a great option for me.  I also like the assortment because a big box of just one flavor would get pretty old after a while.  Wish there was a variety pack of the big sized ones for my husband.
It is nice to get these minis that I cannot get at my local supermarket. The minis are perfect size. These came good packaging and timely

A friend gave me a "Kind" bar and i was surprised at how good it taste. The bars are just sweet enough, to quench a sweet tooth, and good overall. The variety pack is great for the various flavors and would highly reccomend the minis to grab and go.

Great healthy snack in a variety of flavors. This box will be a great addition to your pantry, kitchen counter, and emergency kit! I never leave the house without putting one bar in my purse - helps to avoid fast food temptations. The larger bars are great too - especially when paired with a salad for lunch. But the smaller bars are super convenient for on the go between meals or at home when I'm too busy working on a project to stop and create a raw vegan masterpiece.

I keep these stashed in my purse for when I need a quick and relatively healthy snack.  I also have one in the morning before working out. The mini size is perfect -- just enough to feel sated without feeling "full."

I have tried MANY snack bars and this is the healthiest and tastiest out there.  I love the MINIS because they're all around 100 calories so I can keep track of daily calories.  I just wish they weren't so expensive.OH .... don't even use the KIND website, as they fraudulently charged my credit card after cancelling my account with them and it was a major hassle because they wouldn't admit it.  Amazon will be where I buy these from now on.
I especially like the apricot. Coconut is good but I don't like the flavor of the cranberry bars. They are a great snack and addition to salad for my packed lunch.

I bought this product after it was recommended to me as a good GF food.  It taste very good.  And handy to carry around without getting messy.  No chocolate or sugar type coating to melt.  I did read that they were mini, but was suprised at how mini they were. So cost wise thay are a bit pricy. I will buy the regular size now that I tried these bars.

I seen this item on QVC the items was a full sized bar full with nuts & fruits soft chewy. I like to research items before purchasing them and found the minis on Amazon and decided to purchased the minis to try. They are ABSOLUTELY delicious soft, chewy and full of fruits and nuts great snack to grab when you're running out the door. Will definitely purchase this item again - I prefer the minis over a full size just the right portion.
These are great tasting.  I always carry 1 with me to avoid any "bad food" choices I will regret later!
I love these snack bars.  They are so good and I love the fact they have cranberries and almonds in them.  A little expensive but so tasty.
Really like the way these taste.  Can taste the fruit.  Great snack anytime (I also tried the snack size variety which are great to try new flavors).
I like to buy these at Starbuck's but they're $2 for the full-size. The mini's are perfect for a snack and well worth the price.
just great for a quick pick me up during those times that just on the go or instead of skipping a meal
It's very delicious, almost the best the bars i experienced. Also, the bars do not have too much sugar, very healthy.

Kind bars are GOOD.  I'm a hiker and it's tough to hike in food that is both lightweight and tasty.  Kind Bars are the best I've found.  No more powerbars for me.  They are full of natural ingredients - you can see them all.  About 170 calories per bar (average).  Some of my favorite flavors are Chocolate Cherry Cashew and Cranberry Almond, but there's not a "bad" flavor.  I keep these at work for that mid-morning snack and in the car all the time.
These are nice and taste good but couldn't act as any type of meal replacement in and of themselves. Maybe if you ate more than one.

column4: Julie A. Smith "Julie @ Knitting and Sundries"
column10: I purchased these with Subscribe and Save for my college student.  For some reason, I thought that there was more than one box for the price, but I thought incorrectly, and WAS going to cancel my subscription.  My daughter, however, said that these were YUMMY and wanted me to keep sending them, so instead of cancelling the subscription, I decided to keep it and simply send it less often.  It makes for a yummy treat when she's on the run.

column9: Great Ingredients and low calorie count
column10: I find myself needing to snack during the day. I don't want to eat carbs and when I read the ingredients on most "health" bars there are too many that are not natural and probably quite unhealthy.  I love Kind bars in general and when I found these in the mini pack, I was thrilled  Only 100 calories.  They taste great and I like all of the flavors.

column9: So good I could eat the whole box!
column10: These Kind Bars are so yummy it is hard to stop at just one.  I always order the minis for that reason!  They are healthy, nutritious and delicious.  Nothing left to ask for.  So good!

Don't know that I've ever had a bad KIND bar, they are all fabulous.  They are also pretty calorie dense.  I like this smaller size for my midmorning snack and for popping in the kid's lunches.  Teenager wants the full size bars (and several of them at a time), but Middle (age 13) and Little (age 10)  like this size.

column9: The Best Fruit & Nuts Delight Bar ever.
column10: I enjoy having my Kind daily and my kids (8 and 6 years old) as well. Kind has good flavors and it is a good source of energy for me at work and in my time breaks.I couldn't leave home without kind in my purse. It is the THE BEST Fruit & Nuts Delight Bar ever.
The package arrived on time and undamaged.  The bars tasted good and fresh, and they weren't broken.  I will keep buying these since I can't eat gluten and they are pretty yummy!

I have bought these in retail health food stores in the larger size, but this size is better for me for a gluten-free snack.  It is another gluten-free product that even my husband likes (doesn't taste like "sawdust"!!).
and kind of small for the price.  But I love the variety, and I do need portion control, so they are good in that aspect.  but still a bit spendy...

The first delivery was great! I had all the varieties that I enjoy in the store.  The second was changed and there were more nuts and less fruit.  Instead of the apricot and almond, I had a coconut mixture which was like drinking a bottle of Hawaiian Tropic.  I am going to just order the full size ones and cut them down.

column9: Delicious and Just the Right Size
column10: These mini bars are delicious.  My kids especially love the almond and coconut ones, and the small size means that I get fewer calories, and the kids do not throw half of it away!

column9: Great snack, great price, great variety.
column10: My wife and I are granola bar eaters. For a long time we ate the Fiber One brand but recently switched over to the KIND brand.First, we originally thought this product was too expensive (despite it looking and reading better than other products) but recently found them on Amazon.com for a reasonable price (using subscribe and save) and decided to give them a try.We find the KIND minis are great for a midday snack and fulfill our granola bar needs. While they are in-fact small in appearance, they seem to pack quite the energetic punch. The variety pack is great for those who might get sick of the same-old-routine.I hope you found this review helpful.
really good bars and so nice to have the variety pack.  bars are really effective for appetite control and these are delicious.

column9: Tasty, but not so much variety
column10: I love KIND bars and was really excited about smaller bars and a variety of flavors. I was kind of bummed that the majority of the box was filled with the plain "fruit and nut" flavor. Still love the smaller sizes, great for a mid-day snack

I love these mini-bars. All the varieties are so good. They are gluten free so don't bother my stomach. I have reordered several times thru Amazon. Can't find the mini size in any store. I'm going to introduce my grandkids to them this summer. DJD

column9: SMALL!! NOTE MINI BEFORE YOU ORDER.
column10: I LOVE Kind Bars.  You can't go wrong there. BUT...Its important to READ before you order.  These ARE MINI for sure.  I thought I was getting a good deal with the cheap price.  But note...these are not the normal sized KIND bars.  They are definately SMALL.
I was looking for something gluten-free. Wow, what a terrific alternative to traditional granola bars!  Soft/chewy, flavorful....they taste REAL. Enjoy! (even if you don't need gluten-free :)
These bars are very tasty and just the right size for that in between snack (~100 cal per bar.  I love them.
I like this a lot; it fills me up in the morning and it makes me feel good eating it. Ships fast and Cranberry is my favorite.
They are by far the best nut bars out there.  They make great afternoon snacks.  I like the minis because they are less calories.

column9: KIND BARs are delicious and the variety is just amazing!!!
column10: Normally I would find these bars when I walk into a catering place like au bon pain' or Jamba but thanks to Amazon this made it more affordable. The flavors are amazing!!! Just what I need for my everyday diet. The bars provides you all the nut you need from cashews, peanuts, to almonds. If i every need an energy boost or just something that keeps me from starving then KIND bars is a healthy choice to go......

I have seen KIND bars in the local natural foods supermarkets in my area for a while now. I always wanted to try them, but one regular size bar was a little too pricey for my budget, and I was afraid they would taste like other health food bars - flavorless and chalky. I was very wrong, but we'll get to that in a moment.My mother told me about this amazing and healthy fruit/nut bar called KIND bars. At the time, I couldn't remember if it was the same brand of bars I had been seeing in the supermarkets. She told me I had to try them. I'm pro healthy and I'm always on the look out for wholesome foods that aren't full of HFC and other crap. I'm prepared for the day when I'm old and grey and the news reports that HFC isn't safe after all. I've researched a direct correlation between high fructose cornsyrup and obesity in America. I'm going to go out on a limb and say that it is probably responsible for many illnesses that are becoming predominant in our society paired with the entirely too large portions we are accustomed to eating today. Most of us have no idea what it's like to actually be "starving" and if we did experience starvation, most Americans could live off their fat reserves for quite some time. We need to stop "dieting" and start changing our eating habits and lifestyle!Okay, where was I? Oh yeah, so the KIND bars, they definitely meet my healthy expectations above and beyond AND they are also delicious. I finally picked up a regular sized bar and although it tasted amazing (almond and apricot), it was very filling and I had to save half for later. When I saw there was a variety box of mini bars, I was elated. It is the perfect size for me and each flavor is incredibly delicious and unique.I would recommend trying them first before buying an entire box (we are extremely wasteful as a society as well), but I'm confident that the majority of those that try this product will be very satisfied.
The mini's are really great for anyone looking to see what kind of KIND bar they will actually like.  They are too small for a snack replacement but good for snack supplement.

column9: Nutritious snack that tides you over
column10: The variety pack is nice. It is a bit expensive, but the snacks are perfectly sized to tide you over to your next meal. It is wholesome, nutritious, and tasty.

We love these snack bars, which we first enjoyed at a local coffee shop.  My husband is diabetic and enjoys one of these with his tea each afternoon.  So glad we found this tasty and available product!

I order this for our office and we love the taste of these Kind bars. The size of these bars and the variety we get is just perfect. Great for snacking throughout the day and we get to try the different ones they offer.
i love the mini size.  they are just right for an afternoon snack.  i love the variety pack, i wish they had more flavors in this size.

I love the cranberry & almond bars so I decided to try these minis for the variety.  I have not been disappointed with these either!  I like the smaller size to carry in my purse and they are just the right size when I need a bite to hold me over to my next meal.
a great grab and go snack for any diet or age. satisfying without the extra junk in many bars. a good way to add a bit of protein into your day.

column9: Love the bars, but they made a dangerous change to the items included in this mix...!
column10: I really love Kind bars but I was very disappointed when they recently changed the mix of bars included in the multi-pack.  My husband is allergic to peanuts but can eat all other nuts.  Previously the mix included only one bar with peanuts, which was great - I ate those and he could have everything else.In my last "subscribe & save" shipment, they sent a different mix of bars which has TWO kinds of bars with peanuts in them.  I am mad that they made this dangerous change without alerting us - previously there was one "color" of wrap that my husband knew to avoid.  He could have been sent into anaphylactic shock if he had mistakenly eaten the wrong bar because of the "blind" change.The mix no longer includes the apricot bars.

I AM SURE THESE BARS ARE VERY GOOD, BUT PROBABLY DURING SHIPPING THEY BECAME TOO WARM! I HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO ENJOY A SINGLE BAR. THEY CAME STUCK TO THE PAPER WRAPPING ALL THE WAY AROUND AND I CAN'T OPEN TO ENJOY THE BAR. I HAVE THROWN THE CONTENTS AWAY. I WOULD APPRECIATE A REFUND TO MY AMAZON ACCOUNT.DON MARTIN
THESE BARS ARE GREAT. THEY ARE JUST THE RIGHT AMOUNT OF "SWEET" TO SATISFY YOUR SWEET TOOTH. THEY ARE LOADED WITH NUTS AND PACK A REAL PUNCH THAT TIDES ME OVER TIL DINNER TIME. HEALTHY SNACK!

I only liked the cranberry and the coconut/almond.  I do not wish to receive the variety packs.  Please take note of this and acknowledge receipt of this email.  If there is a telephone I can reach you at please enclose.

column9: MiNi is too small, Terrible Value per OZ. = about 100 Calories @ a High Cost
column10: Yes, KIND Bars are a fantastic product - while the mark up on the whole foods used to make them can put them out of reach,  =  making raw unsalted almonds and dried fruit from Trader Joe's a more cost effective road to adding more 'Lightly Processed' foods to your plate.Boy, this box feels MiNi when you pick it up, and if Amazon wants to take over the world with the 'Amazon FRESH' wave, for home delivery, then they are going to have to develop more ways for us to "FEEL" the products in our hands before we put them in our carts...The  Subscribe & Save  option does make some of the KIND bar products more accessible to us, but this specific 'MiNi' bar product reminds us that our wonderful worker bees at Amazon can, should, and will NEED to ramp up their great work for us and do better by clearly showing the* PER OUNCE COST *  =  for consumable products in the future,  or at least clearly display the Package WEIGHTS for food items.CAVEAT EMPTOR, oh please let's revive CAVEAT EMPTOR in or logic sets.  Business people live by it, just waiting for us to forget what our job duties are as consumers."LET THE BUYER BEWARE", not the seller :)  (It's just the reality of things, it's not ideal, but live it.)  goog: define: Caveat EmptorCa·ve·at Emp·tor:-  The principle that the buyer alone is responsiblefor checking the quality and suitability of goods before a purchase is made.

I ordered this product with the expectation of receiving a fresh product. There were clumps in the individual cups that didn't dissolve in the hot water coming from the machine. Other K-Cups that I've purchased are all powder, but the Cafe Vanilla had problems that you could hear when you shook the cup. With the clumps not dissolving in the water, the flavor is more watered-down than it should be. I have used other products from this same line of K-Cups, but this was sub-par to any other K-Cup I've ever purchased.

We like these because they are individually packaged and easy to throw into a bag when on the go.  Great for a little sweet pick me up and healthier than most other sweets.  I was buying them at the grocery and found it less expensive and easy to order from Amazon.  My kids and I go through them fast enough to not worry about them getting old and since each prune has its own sealed pouch, they don't dry out.

I love these prunes because they are always fresh and easy to take with me. My 2.5 year old daughter eats them too, after I cut them into smaller pieces. I just wish Amazon's price was better. I can not justify buying them here when I can get them for $2 each at my local grocery store. Amazon's price should be $20 for this case of 10.

I used to Not eat prunes. I tried these & found that I really like them(not so with many of the other brands of prune), the flavor was pretty good & I like the fact that these are individually wrapped. The flavor is good. The texture is good. And because they are individually wrapped they do not stick together, also makes them easy to pack into lunches. These are great prunes.

I've been buying these wrapped prunes for a while now and I love them.  I've had maybe 3 or 4 that weren't perfect, but that's a lot lower percentage than when I buy big canisters of prunes that get dry and go bad before I can finish the whole container.  These prunes are as sweet as a candy bar, yet much healthier (I hope!).  They're expensive but worth it.

column9: What a great way to package this fruit!
column10: I absolutely love these!Each canister is filled with individually wrapped prunes.I am the only one in our house who eats these.  I've tried buying the bags,and buying another type of canister, but they always get dried out before Ican finish them all.  This is just right - allows me to eat them when I want to,and I always get a fresh product.While they could do better on the cost in my opinion, I have not had a bad onefrom this canister from Sunsweet yet. Is it the best value for your money?Depends on how you look at it - it costs more per prune, but in my case, I have a lotless waste. So, it is a flip of the coin.The fruit, however, is fresh, soft and tasty. Don't let an "old person" image of pruneskeep you from trying this yummy fruit!

If you ever thought prunes were for only for people with health problems then you are in for a shock. These things are DELICIOUS. Sweet, moist, a little chewy, it's like candy. I would eat these just for the taste. It's the perfect afternoon pick me up, along with a handful of nuts or mini bag of popcorn. Best of all though, are the health benefits. All that fiber definitely has an impact. I have 3-4 prunes a day and let's just say it really does keep you regular if you catch my drift. My digestive system has never been so happy! Trust me, it's a noticeable thing. I started eating these around the time I started eating healthier in general, but I've lost over 15 pounds in 2 months after I starting eating these (at only 100 cal and no fat for 5 prunes, it makes sense). Plus all those vitamins are great in general. Fiber is also good for your heart health, can't ignore that when heart disease kills more people than the next 7 leading causes of death. Combined.I love that these are individually packaged. I sometimes buy the ones that come all together in a bag and by the time I get to the bottom they're always a little dry. These stay moist no matter how long it takes me to eat them. I love that can I just throw them in my bag with my lunch and don't have to worry about getting a tupperware. It's wasteful, but they really taste a lot better. I can't rave enough about these. They taste amazing, they are great for you, they're filling, what more could you ask for?
If you like the slightly smoked flavor you'll love these little guys. Leaves any other sardine product in the dust.

The attractive scene on the can caught my attention while cruising a small gourmet grocery. I'm an avid fish eater and was curious to try these.  They are wonderful. I love smoked fish and these beat any standard sardine I've ever tried.  I wish Amazon offered them in multipacks with free shipping - I'd buy a bunch.

If you like sardines you will love riga sprats. They have an excellent smoked flavour, though they now seem packed in a little too much oil.When first purchased, a few years ago, they were packed in an attractive  radial pattern - now just standard  sardine fashion.
These are wonderful. We have been very happy with this product even my teenage daughter likes them. I am very unhappy that they are no longer available.
These Riga sprats are hard to find, but well worth the search.  Perfect on their own, for lunch, snack, or hors d'ouvres. Great price on Amazon, quick delivery, too
If you are a sardine eater, you'll be a sprat lover! Great smoked flavor (not too much) and perfect amount of oil. It's good to have a source, I keep several cans on hand and share as gifts.

This was a great way to try out all the teas flavors without the worry of buying one flavor and not liking it-stuck with the cost of six boxes.  I loved most of them, but there were a couple that were not my favorites.  None of them tasted bad, and most of them seemed to enlighten me in some way.  I would not buy the variety pack again-in bulk.  The favorites that I liked will be purchased in bulk.  I would recommend if you buy this, give a box or two away to a friend or family member.  Then you can pick and choose or trade teas.  Next time you will know what you like out of the bunch and can order from there.

As a foodie, I'm also a bit of a snob about teas, generally preferring organic, muslin-bagged or loose teas. That said, this Stash Chanakara Tea sampler, on first try, immediately became my favourite tea purchase, and I promptly ordered this excellent bulk value offered by Amazon, soon after trying each of the seven teas included in the box. Each tea "chakra" consists of extremely aromatic and flavour-filled combinations of herbs, flowers, leaves of a colour corresponding to each chakra. While I cannot offer evidence of their efficacy in chakra work, I will say I did some best-guessing about where my particular energies were on a given day, and found that the chakra-tea I chose each time really did seem particularly soothing. New age-y ideas aside, the teas really are extremely flavourful without being overly sour (as I find many brands, like Celestial Seasonings, can be). The scents are noticeably lovely, and for me, I didn't find one flavour that I didn't truly love. Highly recommend.

Chankara teas are Stash tea's new line of Chakra (energy center) teas.  Like all Stash teas, they are excellent.  You may find you favor some flavours more than others, which is the perfect reason to try the sampler, so you can see which flavours you like best.  They are made with natural ingredients and flavorings and I have found the taste of Chanakra to be quite different than the other flavoured teas I have experienced.  Each bag is sealed in its own foil package, to seal in the delicate flavour.The Chanakara line has a flavor for each of the 7 major Chakras of the body and you will see individual reviews that I have written on the various flavours.Chakra 1 -- Root Chakra -- base of spineChakra 2 -- Sacral Chakra -- sexual areaChakra 3 -- Solar Plexus -- belly area, around navelChakra 4 -- Heart Chakra -- heart areaChakra 5 -- Throat Chakra -- throatChakra 6 -- Third Eye Chakra -- forehead, between eyebrowsChakra 7 -- Crown Chakra -- top of head, centerMay I suggest natural sweeteners, if you need a sweetener: honey, agave cactus nectar (natural food isle of food store), or unbleached brown sugar (in sugar isle of food store).This is also something different to share with friends, and of course, something special to talk about if you have New Age friends.

Interesting!  I really like it.  It has a different taste, hard to describe.  It is smooth, with a very light touch of zing (the ginger) and a light fruit taste.  It is blended and packaged by Stash, so, if you are a tea-lover, you know it's good.  Stash makes a great full-bodied tea.  This one is a caffeine-free herbal tea.The ingredient blend is: hibiscus flowers, orange peel, ginger, chicory, damiana, peppermint, and natural dragonfruit flavor.This tea is labeled as "2nd Chakra," so it is intended for the Sacral Chakra (the one that has to do with sexuality).  According to the envelope, the damiana herb is said to enhance male and female sexuality, so there is the connection.For my metaphysical friends:  if this tea is also made with the "intention" of opening or stimulating the 2nd chakra (which I assume it is), that will be an added benefit.  The chakra teas are new and I have noticed they make one for each of the 7 major chakras.  I will be trying them all.(Note: I participated in a group meditation the other night and had combined a 2nd Chakra plus a 6th Chakra tea bag and drank the tea before and after. It was an excellent Violet Flame meditation session.  The combination of teas had a nice taste, too.

column9: very interesting smell and good taste
column10: When you first open the envelope the smell (aroma) of the tea grabs you.  If your not use to strong herbal smells might be a turn off.  The taste is very pleasing and more mellow then the aroma.  I enjoy this tea and will purchase it again.

The Chanakara line is by Stash teas, an excellent tea company. Vanilla Honeybush is naturally sweetened with vanilla and orange peel with a scent of honey.  If you only use a light touch of sugar, you probably won't need any.  This is a caffeine free herbal tea.  You will probably want 2 tea bags to a 24 oz cup of hot water.100% natural ingredients in the order listed are: organic [African] honeybush, orange peel, safflower, and natural honey vanilla flavor.  Each tea bags is sealed in a foil envelope to keep the delicate flavour in tact.This tea is designed for the 3rd chakra (energy center) which is the solar plexus.  It is deliciously smooth and vanilla-y.  I have found that each of the Chanakara flavour has a very distinctive taste--quite different than other flavoured teas I have experienced, and I am a big tea drinker.If you want to use a sweetener, may I suggest natural sweeteners: honey (to complement the honey vanilla taste), agave cactus nectar (liquid-found in natural food section of grocery store), or unbleached brown sugar (next to the white sugar in the food store).

I am a big tea drinker--been so since childhood.  I appreciate a good-tasting, full-bodied tea and Stash has never let me down.  Being into Reiki and the energy stuff, I decided to try the Chanakara (Chakra) teas.  I have already tried the ones for the 2nd and 6th chakras.  Today I needed grounding, so I tried the 1st chakra tea.  Regardless of whether you are into metaphysical energy or not, this is a very nice tea.  Besides having the health benefits of organic antioxidant-rich South African rooibos, it also has a smooth taste with a slight sweetness (as red tea does) and a light fruity taste--very pleasurable.  It is caffeine free.  I did not add sugar but if you do, I suggest a natural product like agave cactus nectar (natural foods isle of grocery stores) or the unbleached brown sugar (in the sugar isle of grocery stores).Other ingredients listed on the package are: Rosehips, Hibiscus, Raspberry Leaf, Uva Ursi (soothing), Citric Acid, and Natural Strawberry Flavor.  The strawberry adds such a nice flavor to the mix.  Each tea bag comes in a sealed foil wrap to protect the flavors.  (I can still smell the tea in the empty package from about 11 hours ago.)  It claims to be a 100 % natural herbal tea.Note that it is very difficult to find a store selling these special flavors.BTW--if you don't know it already, the first chakra (energy center) of the body is the "Root" chakra, found at the base of the spine.  It's color is red (bright red if it is healthy).  It connects you with the earth so that you may be grounded and centered in your physical body.  Many of us believe that keeping our energy centers balanced helps us to stay physically healthy and emotionally strong.

I bought this tea because I was looking for red tea (Rooibos) for its healthy properties and also because it is naturally caffeine free. This tea has a lot of antioxidants but does not taste healthy at all, it is more like a herbal tea when you want something sweet (I do not add any sugar to it). At the beggining I thought the taste was a little artificial, because in other flavored teas you cannot feel the fruit taste, but if you are looking for a flavored tea where you can really taste the other flavor, this is it. I love it and my 6 packages are almost gone.
This is a lovely herbal with a very soft yet complex camomile based flavor. It is perfect when you want something hydrating, warm and comforting, but not bold or acidic.

This tea (number 3 only, not other numbers necessarily) is the best tea on earth for instant stress relief. You can actually feel the stress disappear as you sip the tea. I have tried the other numbers in this brand 1-7 and although some of them do as they claim (benefit for each chakra) this is the best one, by taste and results. I give my neighbor a box every time I order bulk from Amazon. She is an elderly lady and loves this one too but not the others. You will not find a cheaper price for this tea and I bet it will go quickly because you will enjoy it so much. You only need one per day to get the lasting effects. Have fun and feel great. Thanks for letting me share.

I like this tea a little better now that I've learned to brew 2/3 of a mug instead of a full mug.  The first cup I brewed was washed out and tasted vaguely of dirty water.  Brewing less lets me get the full flavor of the tea from a single bag.Dragonfruit is an exotic, colorful fruit I've had in Hawaii.  It tastes like nothing, if nothing tastes little bit like melon rind and vanilla pudding.  The lack of strong fruit flavor in the tea, then, isn't too surprising.You can find the dragonfruit flavor if you look for it, but it's a subtle rounding influence that binds the herbs and spices of the tea together and is nearly lost under the stronger orange peel flavor.  The top notes are the ginger and other spices that make this tea almost an herbal "chai remix," sans black tea.  Although there is no clove in the tea, the chicory and damiana do a good impersonation of it, but with a cost:  they impart more bitterness to the beverage.If you like chai and believe you would still like it without the nutmeg and other "pumpkin pie spices," and if you like a bit of bitterness in your lightly and naturally sweet herbal tea, this could absolutely be your favorite tea.  It isn't mine, but there's no accounting for taste.

column9: I can take it or leave it
column10: This is a nice tea.  It is!  It's just not MY cup of tea, as the saying goes.I was surprised at how sweet it is, and had to check the ingredients several times in an effort to figure out where the sweetness comes from.  As other reviewers have commented, it tastes a little like artificial berry flavoring.  There are no artificial berry flavors listed, but that's what the tea tastes like!  "Natural strawberry flavor" must be some special kind of potent.I couldn't pick out the rooibos flavor, though I'm sure it's under the stronger berry flavor somewhere.

I love ginger from time to time, but many infusions can be a bit . . . punishing.  What can I say?  I'm a heat wimp when it comes to spices, but I still love ginger!This tea provides a delicious ginger flavor that can't be ignored without an overwhelming pepper note.  I agree with the other reviewer - the other ingredients in this brew can't be detected and identified individually by my untrained senses, but I think they work together to make a more mellow, rounded tea flavor with a sweeter scent.If you want to try a ginger tea that isn't too intense, this is absolutely the tea for you.

column9: Great deal and in perfect new condition
column10: All items were in tip-top condition and well packaged. Thanks what a fantastic deal!I would definitely purchase this item again!
I enjoyed all of these, but I kind of wish I didn't order so many of the variety - there are a few I like best and I've had to open all the boxes to get to those few.

I really was looking for Rooibos tea but got distracted by the nice packaging and name. Actually didn't realize (duh!) until I got the order of 6-packs that these taste more of berries than rooibos. Not my cup of tea, I guess!

column9: Health benefits good, but would not buy again
column10: It is a very healthful tea, but the flavor is too woody for me.  If they had added more orange peel, that would have been better.  It just is quite odd tasting.  Woody almost like artichoke, maybe.  Hard to describe.  Not terrible, but just a bit weird.

Blended and packaged by the Stash Tea Company, makers of high-quality teas, this is tea for the throat chakra, also known as the 5th chakra, which relates to the color blue.  It is called "Blue Ginger".  (A chakra is an energy center in the body.  We are generally said to have 7 major chakras.)This caffeine free herbal tea is made of 100% natural ingredients (per the wrapper), listed in order as ginger root, blue malva flowers, vegetable juice for color and natural (tropical) feijoa flavor.  As do all the flavors, each tea bag comes sealed in an individual foil package to preserve the freshness and delicate flavor.  (If you are a tea lover, this matters to you.)The color is yellow.  Even with 2 bags for 24 oz water, the taste is smooth but weak with the bite of ginger.  You do taste the ginger in sufficient quantity, but it doesn't have any special other taste that I notice.  Although not one of my favorites, it will probably be useful for settling an upset stomach. (Note-I am NOT a doctor.)  Don't we usually go looking for ginger-ale for an upset stomach?  Well, if you check the ingredients, it's hard to find ginger listed in ginger ale anymore.  This tea has ginger as its primary (most plentiful) ingredient.So, it has an acceptable taste and is probably useful for calming the stomach.

column9: Great for a bagged tea, even better if the melon was stronger
column10: I'm a total tea snob, drink mostly loose and hardly ever buy bagged teas (especially green) but I figured I'd give this one a shot: green tea is my favorite, melon is my favorite flavor/scent, and I love yerba mate's natural energizer properties.I've also had a great experience with Stash products before (LOVE their green chai tea), so I figured why not.The tea is actually really good. My initial reaction, after trying a few flavors, was 'bleh!' and a solid 2-stars. After getting used to the flavors a bit more, I decided 3-stars was more appropriate.I love tea samplers, trying all these different flavors, typically there are a couple I don't care for and a couple I love. No so with the Chanakara sampler: I didn't like a single flavor.These are caffeine-free herbal teas that have more of a purpose than just being warm and tasting good; each flavor supposedly gives you some benefit. The strength of that benefit undoubtedly varies according to the person (I didn't notice anything).Each tea is packaged in nice two-colored package, telling what that tea is good for. On the tea box it has all the flavors, as well as a chakra chart telling you briefly about the 7 chakras. Each tea bag has the number corresponding to that chakra. (That was pretty interesting.)Missing from the box and the individual tea packages was any kind of brew time. I normally ignore brew times anyway, but I thought in this case perhaps I was brewing it incorrectly... I guess not. From watered-down to a cup of hot liquid seeped for 5 minutes, no matter the level of sweetener, I did not like these teas.The tag on some of the tea bags just says `Chanakara for Mind, Body & Spirit' rather than telling you the type of tea.Red Berry Rooibos, an herbal tea for health & prosperity (Ingredients: Organic rooibos, rosehips, hibiscus, raspberry leaf, ova urea, citric acid, and natural strawberry flavor). I had this tea when I was sick. Didn't smell very good. Tastes like preserved strawberries, but weak. More sweetener didn't give it more flavor. On the other hand (when not sick), drinking it with dried mango made a good breakfast.Vanilla Honeybush, an herbal tea for gathering strength & power (Organic honeybush, orange peel, safflower, and natural honey vanilla flavor). The tea bag smelled really nice, like a dessert, but the taste is icky. Almost like watered-down liquid cheerios.White Lotus, an herbal tea for meditation & wisdom (Chamomile flowers, chrysanthemum flowers, lotus flowers, lotus flavor, and linden flowers). The tea bag did not smell good, but the tea smelled and tasted mostly like Chrysanthemum tea, and a bit like chamomile. It takes some getting used to, then it's not bad.Melon & Green Tea, a tea for love & harmony (Organic green tea, orange peel, jerboa mate and natural melon flavor). Didn't smell very good. If you put a lot of sweetener it doesn't taste bad... but it doesn't taste good. Very dry.Dragonfruit, an herbal tea for passion and creativity (Hibiscus flowers, orange peel, ginger, chicory, damiana, peppermint and natural dragonfruit flavor). If you've ever tasted a dragonfruit, you may find this to be not far off... it's not very good. Let it sit longer and it's OK.Guanabana, an herbal tea for imagination & insight (Orange peel, rosehips, hibiscus flowers, lemongrass, eyebright, bilberry, licorice powder, vegetable juice for color and natural guanabana flavor). It's palatable, but not good.So, sadly, I didn't like a single flavor. I've enjoyed samplers such as Stash Premium Green Tea Sampler and Stash Premium Herbal Tea Sampler, which I recommend in lieu of the Chanakara tea.

I read about this product on a gluten-free web group, and decided to give it a try. My spouse is on a gluten-free diet, and really misses bread. To prepare the dough, you use the provided mix, two eggs, oil (I used olive) and milk or milk substitute (I used soy). You then roll out the dough in 1/2" diameter strips and bake for 25 minutes. The finished sticks come out looking like bread (browned, but not the dark brown characteristic of wheat flour bread), and smelling good. I bet you're wondering with such an ingredients list how a pet food could be less than exceptional. The truth is, Chicken Soup for the Cat Lovers' Soul is a great food to feed your cat, but maybe not ideal.I have tested several different pet foods on my felines (everything from Special Kitty to Innova). We have three beautiful cats, a Calico DSH, a Blue Russian, and a beautiful Persian. I have found some pros and cons to Chicken Soup.First off, the ingredients are fantastic, no doubt. From fresh Turkey to spinach and blueberries, the list is sure to impress any conscious shopper. I have no problem feeding this food, if it were simply for the ingredients alone, and at at least a dollar cheaper and a pound more than the nearest competition, it really seems like a great deal up front.Our cats love the taste of it and most any cat I've encountered has never refused this food. They love it.My cons with Chicken Soup is that all of our felines develop a deficiency of vitamin E, obviously noted in their coats. With other foods, their coat is silky, shiny, and just a joy to pet. When we switch to Chicken Soup, their coats feel firmer, rougher, and more matted. Their eyes are not as bright. We've tried this switch a couple of times and it happens each time we switch to Chicken Soup.And even though our cats adore the taste of Chicken Soup, their energy levels aren't quite as competent as normal, compared to when they are being fed holistic, grain-free foods (Taste Of The Wild, Blue, Innova)So to wrap it up,PROSValueWonderful, fresh ingredientsCats love the tasteCONSGrainsVitamin deficientDecrease in energy level and coat textureAlso, the ingredients list on Amazon.com is no longer applicable. Here is what the current product's ingredients are :Chicken, chicken meal, cracked pearled barley, turkey meal, powdered cellulose, white rice, potatoes, oatmeal, millet, chicken fat (preserved with mixed tocopherols), natural chicken flavor, salmon, turkey, duck, ocean fish meal, flaxseed, sodium bisulfate, egg product, potassium chloride, DL-methionine, choline chloride, dried chicory root, taurine, dried kelp, carrots, peas, apples, tomatoes, blueberries, spinach, dried skim milk, cranberries, rosemary extract, parsley flake, yucca schidigera extract, L-Carnitine, dried fermentation products of Enterococcus faecium, Lactobacillus acidophilus, Lactobacillus casei and Lactobacillus plantarum, dried Trichoderma longibrachiatum fermentation extract, zinc proteinate, vitamin E supplement, niacin, manganese proteinate, copper proteinate, zinc sulfate, manganese sulfate, copper sulfate, thiamine mononitrate, vitamin A supplement, biotin, potassium iodide, calcium pantothenate, riboflavin, pyridoxine hydrochloride (vitamin B6), vitamin B12 supplement, manganous oxide, sodium selenite, vitamin D supplement, folic acid.Thanks for reading.

I must agree with the first reviewer that it didn't spread as easily as the CheezWhiz in the jar.  It is a lot thicker than it used to be.  At one time we could buy the cans in our local Cubs stores in the Twin Cities, but they have since stopped carrying them.  Then, it was exactly the same as the CheezWhiz in the jars, and very spreadable.  Now I have to scoop a little out to soften in the microwave before I use it, if I want to spread it on a sandwich or crackers.  The taste is about right to me and I do use this product on everything: sandwiches, sauces, casseroles, you name it.  I really love CheezWhiz and I will purchase the can again when I run out of the other one.  It would be handy to store if they still came with the big plastic lid.  I have made my own CheezWhiz in the past, and if you make your own you can control how thin or thick it is.  If you want to make your own, cube a two pound log of Velveeta, and add it to the top of a double boiler, along with a cup of milk, a stick of butter or margarine, a pinch of sugar, and that's it.  You cook it on low heat, give it a stir now and then, and at the end you have a CheezWhiz like product.  I generally used more than one cup of milk when I made it.  When my kids were small, it was cheaper to make it, now it's about the same price, so I just buy it.

column9: Weird, medicinal, and not very healthy considering it's so excited about its "green tea infusion"
column10: This is the newest aloe-based tea entry from Chantea. It's a "health drink" that touts its green tea component prominently on its label, which wisely is a wraparound given that its inclusion of tons of little pulpy bits is going to put many drinkers off. Except for orange juice and the like, most people don't have a lot of experience with non-smooth clear drinks--this looks and feels in the mouth a lot more like bubble tea or mega-pulpy orange juice.The taste: oddly medicinal, with the passionfruit carrying the tone of the drink and a strange astringent aftertaste that lingers way too long on the tongue. I didn't taste much green tea in this, but that's not a huge shock given that the first two ingredients on the label are water and sugar. The main flavors are "sweet" and "strange fruity sensation." Indeed, this tiny little 11.5oz container is apparently considered 1.5 servings (another thing that will put off American drinkers at least, who are accustomed to consuming a bottled drink at one go and certainly won't pour out only 2/3 of the drink and save the rest for later), which makes it possible for the manufacturer to put its carb count at 20g rather than the 30g it probably should get--which makes it pretty much an uncarbonated soda. I'm very put off by the fast-and-loose game played with the nutritional label.The texture was also unpalatable. I'm no stranger to pulpy bits in my drinks, but these were as numerous as they were undefinable. Were they aloe bits (doubtful but possible, but they looked precisely like an orange's pulp)? Were they passionfruit (way more likely but passionfruit pulp is not in the ingredient list)? The ingredient list gave no indication whatsoever what I was tasting.I think this drink would appeal way more to consumers who are used to pulpy drinks like bubble tea and who don't mind drinking that much sugar water--and who are way way into passionfruit. For me, as much as I'd looked forward to trying it, I couldn't finish the bottle.

This green tea is much more sweet in the vein of Asian "bubble tea" (minus the tapioca pearls, of course) than the fake-tasting cloying sweetness of American teas like Arizona.  The floating bits of fruit pulp and the distinct aftertaste of passion fruit also make it clear this is something unusual.  I couldn't taste the aloe vera, but the tea is a little "heavier" than one would expect if used to plain green tea.I found it refreshing with spicy food but a bit too substantial to drink by itself.The bright packaging and Asian-looking design invoke Japanese design, and the taste is similar to drinks I've had on my travels as well as in Asian restaurants in the US.  Recommended.

The Chantea Aloe Vera Green tea, Passion Fruit is delicious, however I could have done without the bits of fruit floating through the drink and into my mouth.  Just not a feature of a drink I prefer.  I probably won't buy it because of the bits of fruit, which is disappointing because I really enjoyed the taste of the tea overall and would have liked to gotten the benefits offered of the Aloe vera and Passion Fruit.

column9: Ok, taste, but too many calories  and too expensive
column10: In the past I've enjoyed drinks with Aloe Vera. And I love green tea, so I had high hopes for this drink.  The taste is ok, though the bits of passion fruit make give it a texture that is rather slimy. That combined with the fact a one cup serving has 80 calories, makes this a drink I would have to pass up.  This might not be a problem for green tea drinkers that are not worried about calories, but they might be turned off by the bits of passion fruit floating around in the drink.  Also the price is a bit prohibitive.  It works out to $2.08 per bottle, which seems a bit much for an 11.5 oz drink.

There are jelly-like matter floating in the bottle, which at first made me spit it out as it affected my gag reflux.Apart from that, it's very, very sweet, with the passion fruit overwhelming the drink.It's not my cup of tea and I doubt I'd ever buy this.I really found the mixture hard to swallow.
Light, crisp, and refreshing.  Once you get past the aloe bits.  they were kind of a turn off, but this tea was quite good.  Best very very cold!
Truthfully,I couldn't go past the first sip. The flavor was good, like a green tea beverage but the consistency was too weird. It was like it had lumps of mucous. Ugh.

column9: Your enoyment may depend on how much you like the pulp
column10: There are a great many green tea products available to the consumer, to say the least. I think what distinguishes this from the others is that this one really has a lot of pulp in it.
