column10: These are delicious cookies but I just cancelled my subscription. I hope the price comes back down so I can buy them again. They are the best ginger snaps I have found so far but the price is just too much :-(

These are my favorite ginger snaps & I was so pleased to be able to order these in bulk from Amazon.  I even got my first order from Amazon Warehouse so they were deeply discounted.  These are great with peanut butter.  Yum.  I also like to crush them up a little in my mortar & pestle & mix them into my granola.  They also make good cookie crumb pie crusts.  There are so many great uses for these including of course just eating them out of the bag.

My order for Mi-Del Ginger Snaps arrived a few hours ago and I tried my first one ... okay, I'm on my 10th cookie now.  My first bite of one I noticed it had a hard crunch.  I like crunchy cookies, others may not.  I read here that you can leave the top opened on the bag overnight to soften them.  The cookie is about 3-4 bites worth.  On my first bite I could feel a little tongue tingle.  Each subsequent bite produced the same warm tingle and THAT is what puts this ginger snap in a class of its own, never losing that 'bite'.  It's not too overdone or underdone on the spice, it's a perfect little cookie.  Not to mention they are 26 calories each, and ingredient that are pronounceable, this makes for an excellent little treat with coffee, tea, or vanilla ice cream.  Excellent product that I will purchase again.Note: Expiration date on the bags are December 17th, 2010 but I don't think they will last that long.--Sailor Hill, CA

I originally bought the Mi-Del cookies at a local odd-lots store over a year ago. I felt a sense of loss after the store stopped carrying them, since no other local grocer stocked them. So I was glad to see that they were available, albeit in bulk quantities only, via Amazon. I love these cookies, and best of all, they're about as healthy as you can find anywhere. I have to watch my intake of saturated fats, and per 5-cookie serving, the Mi-Del snaps have zero grams of sat-fat. They're delicious, with a nice, somewhat subdued chocolate flavor and a crunchy snap. I keep them in the fridge and they maintain their freshness for MONTHS. Twelve packages may seem like a lot, but I look forward to devouring every one of them. I've also tried the vanilla and lemon snaps, and they're equally outstanding.

I've seen these for sometime in my local grocery store, but was reluctant to buy them. From the packaging they look hard and tasteless. It turns out that they are the perfect amount of softness to dip into English tea and still hold up. And they taste wonderful. Love them.

column9: My Favorite Cookie of All Time
column10: This is the cookie that is the bain of my existence. I absolutely love it.They taste best when they are really fresh so if you buy this 12 pack dont wait 6 months to eat them all ... they dont have a long shelf life ... they get hard and loose flavor even if you never open the bag. This is probably because they are made with natural ingredients and dont have the preservatives found in other cookies.But honestly i love these cookies they are sweet, crisp and very gingery ... even my sister and brother in law who don't eat anything "healthy" or "organic" because they think it wont taste good, where impressed with the taste of these cookies.Now they are hooked too and buy them all the time.

This cookie stands up very well to dunking in milk (about three dunked bites per cookie), and with mostly organic ingredients is about as guilt-free as possible in a cookie. We like a crisp ginger snap, and while the bag isn't self-sealing it seals well if you have a clip. We find the ginger level to be just right -- not overpowering, but definitely there.One correction to the ingredient list posted on this site -- there's no grape juice concentrate in the cookie, according to the bag I'm looking at right now and the Mi-Del website.Per serving size of 5 cookies: Calories 140; Total Fat 4g; Carbs 22g; Fiber 1g; Sugars 11g.

column4: Shop-til-you-drop DIANE "I want it ALL-I want...
column9: So good people are taking them from me!
column10: These cookies seemed to be a pretty good deal when I saw that there was a special offer on them. I LOVE cookies (who doesnt??) but am kinda picky about texture. I dislike soft mushy cookies although if desperate...but I know that "snap" cookies are usually not soft so I took a chance and ordered a case!  I live alone so a case of cookies was, at once, both frightening and decadent---but I think I am going to have to order another case!  Everyone who tasted these asked me "so where did you find these?"  Of course, since I am the online shopper from hell, everyone figured I found some obscure website and paid a fortune. "Natural" and "Organic" are buzz words for "gonna cost ya more" but the price was great per bag. After I told my friends and family who tasted them that I ordered a case---the bags started disappearing pretty fast! I got hit with guilt---What are YOU going to do with 12 bags of cookies? (duh--eat them!) and everyone was very happy to lighten up my stash by taking a bag so I dont overeat! Dont I have the BEST friends and family??? LOL  Seriously--I was happy to hand them over! I enjoy turning people on to new finds. I gave a bag to my Parcel Post guy and my UPS guy (after all--they lug all the boxes to my apartment!) and they were happy! And there is a method to my giving-away madness (especially to the carriers)! Less dropping and throwing around of MY boxes!Ok--they are nice and lemoney (?) but they could even be a bit more lemon-like for me! They are made with more healthful ingredients (no trans-fat) so even though I am pigging out on cookies--I dont feel nearly as guilty! And at less than $2 a bag--I think they are a greal deal! Plus it never hurts to have extra cookies in the house because a cookie emergency can happen at any given moment!  So--order them!  I think you will be pleased!

Crispy, chewy and intensely flavorful -- WOW, they are just great. I've loved ginger snaps since... forever. So, I've tasted lots of brands both good and bad. Some of them have no ginger taste at all -- We like to call them "flour snaps!"Mi-Del Old-Fashion, Swedish Style Ginger Snaps have great taste, healthful ingredients, and I highly recommend dunking in some hot coffee or tea for even more of that comfort food feel!If you don't like them... Well, I can only quote The Lovin' Spoonful:"It's like tryin' to tell a stranger 'bout rock and roll!"

Mi-Del Old-Fashion "Swedish Style" Lemon Snaps are a crispy, chewy, lemony delight! If you are always in search of healthy snacks that aren't short on flavor, these are the cookies for you.These Lemon Snaps are made with organic unbleached wheat flour, canola oil and natural lemon flavor -- there's no artificial "lolly-pop" lemon taste here. You can just imagine squeezing the lemon into the mix, yourself.Five cookies have 140 calories, so it's not too much for a little something to get you through your day, or after dinner as a light dessert without the guilt.Highly recommended. Yum!
i have to agree that these are delicious tasty cookies.  i'm not a vegan & i don't have a problem eating gluten. i just like yummy cookies & these cookies are yummy!
ya cant stop eatin them,they are so good,my friends are addicted to them,,were all gonna explode

These are healthful, smallish (about the size of vanilla wafers), tasty and flavorful snappy cookies.  They are sweet but not overly so and have a bit of that molasses taste that ginger snaps are known for.  They have a really nice ginger bite too.  They are great to have with some tea, milk or even coffee.

Look, I love ginger. Ginger ale/beer, pickled ginger at sushi restaurants, ginger salad dressings... and I love ginger cookies. I have tried who knows how many other brands of ginger snaps and _none_ are as good as these. Mi-Del ginger snaps are the MOST gingery. Spicy. I love how snappy they are.If you are really a fan of ginger, real spicy ginger, then these cookies are for you.

Mi-Del Swedish style ginger snaps are delicious and nutritious!  They are made with organic flour and ginger, and are great with any meal- especially with coffee or tea.  It is not easy to find these treats in a market- and ordering from Amazon is quick, easy, and cost effective.  They arrived promptly, without one broken ginger snap. Thanks, Amazon!

I eat these snaps by the pound, everyday, all day.  Anything ginger tastes good to me.  I'm signing up for the auto-ship, otherwise I'd make umpteen trips to the store.  Finding a cookie with unsulphured molasses is difficult & a requirement for me - I'm anaphylactic to sulphur.My husband is now munching them too, so I'll have to double my order!Thanks Mi-Del!  :)Kristina
These are great. You can't tell they are gluten free, they are just great ginger snaps. No after taste.  Super crispy.  May have to try some of the other flavors.

About five or six years ago I used to buy mi del cookies weekly hoping that the cookies wouldn't add inches to my waist line. From what I rememeber , it was really yummy but had to stop buying them because it's expensive.
I've been eating these cookies for years and years and they are so good - perfect texture, perfect taste - this is a great price - you can't go wrong with these healty ingredients.

I love to bake but I don't always have time.  When I'm really busy, I buy MI-DEL cookies because they taste as good as homemade. My favorite are the ginger snaps. They're crunchy with a real authentic ginger snap taste. I love knowing that they're all natural and the kids LOVE them.

Yes, they're hard and really spicy, but I like it!  And what other cookie can you eat 5 of for only 140 calories and 11 grams of sugar?  And ginger is an anti-inflammatory spice that is good for headaches, arthritis, high blood pressure, you name it!  And they're made with whole wheat and no refined sugar... Wow, this is the world's most perfect cookie!
Love them, very "gingery".  Great with your favorite tea or coffee.  Love that they are using natural ingredients.

column9: The Greatest Snap I Have Ever Snapped
column10: I dip these in my coffee -- alone they are probably a bit too crisp.  However, these have excellent flavor and a great ginger burn after you've had 5-10 of them.  Highly recommended.
Cookies are a little to hard for for me they taste okay but would not buy again sorry that's my review !

column9: Not Very Chocolately, A disappointing texture and flavor
column10: I bought these cause I'm a chocolate snap lover, and I had been craving some. The lack of trans fats and description drew me in.Let's just say this: I took these over to a family party, and none of the kids liked it. NOT ONE. And most of the adults, the best they could say was, 'Eh.' I think two folks had more than one.I'd have to say skip these cookies. They don't make your mouth sing with chocolatey snappy joy.
I received the Lemon Snaps faster than expected, but one of the bags was missing from the order. The cookies are ok, but not much lemon flavor. I give them a 5 out of a 10 rating.

column9: Not My Idea of Vanilla Snaps
column10: I absolutely love the Mi-Del ginger snaps, so I thought I'd try these in vanilla, thinking they'd be just as tasty.  Unfortunately, they didn't have the vanilla flavor I'd hoped for, and I wasn't crazy about their consistency.  They almost seemed stale, although I'm sure that's not the case.  As I actually prefer the name brand vanilla snaps, I gave these away to my local food pantry.

column9: Healthy snaps that taste good, too
column10: I ordered both the vanilla and the ginger snaps, and like both kinds. The high quality organic ingredients provide a "guilt-free" eating experience. I'm not sure if kids would go for them, but will try them out on my nephews next time I get a chance. I ordered two 12-packs so will have cookies for quite a while. Mine expire 6/20/08 so don't buy TOO many in advance.

I like the fact that the Mi-Del cookies are low-fat and use some organic ingredients.  I love the Mi-Del lemon and vanilla flavors, and their ginger snaps are ok -- BUT these chocolate snaps are no good.  I'm a chocolate lover, so this is rather disappointing.  The taste is similar to the ginger snap, but it's off quite a bit - slightly bitter.  It's as if they didn't put enough sugar in these snaps to counter the bitterness of cocoa powder. It also has a poor aftertaste that's slightly bitter (the lemon snap aftertaste is awesome keeps me wanting more).Gotta give it 1 star - yeah, I ate 10 of these to give them a chance, but I threw away the rest of the bag. The crunch and texture is the same as the other Mi-Del Snaps, but the flavor is off.  Not Recommended.
These cookies are hard & somewhatlacking in taste. We threw out half the bag.Mostly because my children did not likeginger snaps & my husband and I did not care for these.
Good aroma, good mouth feel, but the taste...flavorless.  Like a crunchy lump of flour.  Might help if they put some ginger in it.

I ALWAYS MAKE ANYTHING I BAKE FROM STRACH  BUT SHOPPING IN COSTCO ONE DAY I SAW THIS PRODUCT AND SINCE I WAS HAVING CHILI THAT NIGHT FOR DINNER I THOUGHT I WOULD TRY IT  WHAT A GREAT PRODUCT  SO TODAY I GO TO GET MORE AT COSTCO AND THEY DON'T HAVE IT  SO I WENT I LINE AND ORDERED IT FROM YOU  WE LOVE IT  AND WHAT IS LEFT OVER IS GREAT FOR YOUR MORNING COFFEE

This Penquin Cornbread has me dreaming of cornbread and smelling it when there is none.  I like others got it at COSTCO; this was originally about a year ago.  I had a dinner party and everyone raved about it.  Now I went back for more and nothing but an empty shelf.  (I think they just keep it around the holidays.)  Since I can always depend on AMAZON, I checked here.  Well you/they do carry it which I am thrilled about, but you're/they're out.  Don't get me wrong I can usually do without cornbread for long periods.  HONEST.  But not since this Penquin Cornbread.  It's good and goes with so many dishes.  The perfect compliment.  It also seems to substitute for meat if you're eating vegetarian chili or an all vegetable meal.  The other store bought varieties just didn't fill that bill, too sweet and flimsy.  OK AMAZON I'LL JUST CHECK EVERY DAY.  OKAY.  Really folks this stuff is unusually good; just add 1 egg and oil.  Convenient as well.  I usually line my black iron frying pan with foil and spray with PAM.  You can order it from the company (Penquin) but for such a high delivery fee.  I'm trying to wait for AMAZON hoping it will not be as much for delivery!!!

This is the best cornbread I've ever had! I've tried other brands and I've also used one brand for years, but my mom went to Costco and bought this to make cornbread stuffing for Thanksgiving, and we polished off a whole batch of cornbread and had to make another one for the stuffing. LOL! I highly recommend this.

Like all of you I am dying to get more of this wonderful cornbread.  I finally gave up and called the company direct to see where I could get it.  The rep told me it is only sold at Costco during the fourth quarter.  They will start selling it in late September.  Not sure if it will be at all Costcos but it is worth calling your local store to make sure they order enough for you for the next year.  It usually has a year or longer shelf life so I recommend stocking up.  He also suggested I go to Target and get the Honey Amber Cornbread.  It is very close to this one.  I think he said it was by Archer Farms, I'm can't remember.  I hope this helps all of you who are dying to get more of this wonderful cornbread.  Have a great day!

Costco carried this particular brand of cornbread for many years, but appears to have stopped carrying it.  Big mistake.  This is hands down the best cornbread period.  It is moist and sweet.  Almost cake-like.  Perfect with Chili or Pork BBQ Country Ribs.

I've been searching for a long time for a good cornbread.  Bought this on a whim.  It is DELICIOUS!  It turns out moist, sweet (but not overly), light, and yummy!  I'm not even much of a cook and this always turns out perfect!You just mix in 1 egg, milk, and oil and bake at 350 for 35-40 minutes in an 8x8x2 greased pan.I can't say enough good about this product!

I love cornbread, but find it very dry and bland............even when I make it. However, this cornbread is moist and delicious.  It even has corn right in the mix.  Yes, I purchased it at Costco, but the shelves were being depleted.  I guess the word is out on this.

column9: Hands down, the best boxed corn bread mix I've found.
column10: I love corn bread and corn muffins, and have been eating the cheap stuff for years. Every so often I will make my own from scratch, but that's too much work for the time I usually have. So when I found this mix, I was very excited. And after tasting it? I was even MORE excited! It is so moist, with actual pieces of corn in it! My husband, who really DOES NOT LIKE corn bread even likes this! My dad, who I consider a corn bread connoisseur, LOVES it and now wants this instead of his regular corn bread. It's not available everywhere, so I end up buying multiple boxes to ship home with family!

column9: "Seasonal availability" and southern style baking advice
column10: When I found the shelves at Costco empty and complained to the checkout cashier she smiled and informed me that Costco will carry this wonderful product during the spring and summer months only. Sure enough, it's now March and I found it there last week! What a relief.... I think they have it wrong though, it should be on available year round, and certainly during the fall and winter when comfort foods such as chili are frequently on the supper menu. On another note: if you want to enjoy it even more, try baking it the way the Southern grandmother would: simply add an extra couple of tablespoons of oil to a heavy cast iron skillet, place it in the oven while it is heating up, remove hot skillet and pour in the cornbread batter. You should see the oil go up the sides and sizzle a bit. Bake for about 35-40 minutes as directed. This extra oil and hot skillet method creates a very " crispy " bottom and side crust (not to mention a few more calories, but you want to be authentic, right ? ) Serve with some cooked greens such as swiss chard, kale or collards.... dee-licious!!  You can also have more cornbread for breakfast the next day if there is any leftover, which is unlikely.
I, too, bought this at Costco and can't find it there lately. This is the best cornbread mix ever. Moist, Bits of corn in it. Very flavorful.

It's back at Costco!  For those of you who were so disappointed when Costco discontinued this cornbread, which is the very best, weep no more.  I visited my local Western PA Costco yesterday and lot and behold, there it was.  For what I paid to get it through Amazon's vendor, I could have bought at least two in the store.
Great corn bread mix.Perfect for thanksgiving.It is a seasonal product so stock up.Expiration date is up to 2 years .Way cheaper at Costco though.

column9: Best Ever, but when will it be available???
column10: This is THE best cornbread mix ever and I have purchased it several times on Amazon. It's almost like a cake, just the perfect mixture of sweet and corn flavor.  It always is so moist and is still good re-heated as leftovers! However, suddenly, it has not been available on this website and I am heartsick!  I've even gone directly to the manufacturer's website and nothing there either.  Can it be that they have stopped producing it???  Say it isn't so.

column9: half cornbread half corn muffin = penguin
column10: This is the best cornbread/muffin mix ever! First of all, it's so easy to make even my husband can make it! Second, it smells delicious -- like roasted corn.  I love to be woken up by my husband's freshly baked cornbread on a Saturday morning.  Third, it tastes amazing...not too sweet, moist yet still crumbly. Finally, it has whole corn kernels in the mix that rise to the top when you bake it so it not only tastes and smells great, it looks great too!  We have brought this cornbread to dinner parties as a side dish and have gotten lots of compliments.You can add an extra egg or two to turn it into corn muffin (and maybe some more sugar if you like sweet).I too am having a hard time finding it at my local costco and have signed up to be notified on Amazon when this product becomes available.

My husband bought this cornbread at COSCO and we just loved it.  COSCO has stopped selling it in our area and I have been searching everywhere for it.  Since we always find everything we want at Amazon, we thought we would give it a try and HERE IT IS.  Can't wait for it to be in stock !!!

column9: As good as, or better than, from scratch!
column10: Like so many others, I haunted the Costco aisles for weeks until finally giving up. Amazon is my go-to place for hard to find items so here I am!  I make most things from scratch, but this mix is by far the best!  I am delighted to be able to still keep it in my pantry.  BTW, you can always tweak this by adding a spoon of sugar, or a can of creamed corn. I usually saute some finely chopped onion and poblano pepper, toss them in with the other ingredients and bake.  YUM!!!  (If Costco has picked it up again, it's not showing up in this area, yet.)
The best corn bread mix ever.  Totally natural, lovely pieces of real corn.  Tastes great alone, or added with jalapenos.  Hearty and delicious. Highly recommended!

We too were introduced to Penguin Corn Bread at Costco which used to carry it seasonally in the fall.  We are all cooks in our family but can't improve on the taste.  This is the best, sweetest corn bread.  We used to buy a number of boxes each year as it has a great shelf life and would last until Costco sold it again each fall.  Were sure to serve it to friends and family.  Our grandkids have been asking about it for the past year since Costco discontinued it and we are delighted to be able to get it through Amazon.  Thanks for carrying it and making it a prime item.

Had son's fiance and her parents over for breakfast after church and they raved about this cornbread...so I gave her Mom the rest of my 6 pouch box and now I can't find it anywhere.  Found it at Costco once and not there anymore.  I want my cornbread back!!

I am suprised to see so many positive reviews.  I like cornbread that is sweet - this is not sweet at all...and I mean at all...It is actually quite bland and more doughy than I'm used to...with a bit of an aftertaste.  I just threw out the rest of the box - we just couldn't bring ourselves to eat it.

I have been drinking this tea for years and I am happy with the exquisite taste that comes from naturally grown Black Sea region tea. No pesticides/chemicals have been used in growing this tea, it is pure, it is natural, it is rich in taste and above all it is healthy.It is loose tea so you need to have a set of two teapots, one at the bottom for boiling water and one at the top for brewing tea.

column9: Good Turkish tea, but not the best
column10: My boys fell in love with Turkish tea when we visited Turkey last Xmas, and drank honey-sweetened Turkish tea along with baklava several times a day to ward off the cold. Back in the US, I tried to find some good Turkish tea. I ordered several kinds. After doing thorough testing (!!) we decided that this was good tea, but not the best we found. Our favorite was Black Tea (Turkish Tea).We brew it in a cast iron Japanese tea kettle, pour boiling water in it, then dilute it in the glass or mug to the concentration we want. We often sweeten it with honey, and I typically add a drop of lemon.

column9: I am thrilled to find Kuner's on Amazon!
column10: I found this brand several years ago at my grocery store and then... NONE! Kuner's tomatoes are just SO good and the price on Amazon is less than what I was paying - THANKS Amazon:)
I was surprised to find this candy at Christmas time.  I'm not a big fan of hard candy but this has original flavors that are wonderful!  It reminds me of my childhood.  It's worth every penny.

column9: BEST OLD FASHIONED CANDY IN THE WORLD!
column10: THIS IS THE BEST DURN OLD FASHIONED GOOD OLE AMERICAN CANDY IN THE WORLD!!!THE PRODUCT ARRIVED PROMPTLY AND WELL PACKED AND OF COURSE, ABSOLUTELY FRESH AND DELICIOUS.LOVE THE PRODUCT AND LOVE THE COMPANY.THANK YOU AMAZON.COM FOR GIVING US ACCESS TO PURCHASE THIS CANDY.

column9: A wonder taste from Christmas past
column10: As a boomer, I remember my grandmother having these candies at Christmas. When I found this product I was thrilled. Many times childhood foods and are memories sometimes disappointed when we find lost items. Trust me this lives up to my memories!
I was surprised when I opened the candy canister to see it was only half full. I was very disappointed and will look for another candy company who makes old fashioned Christmas candies.

column9: Shipping cost outweigh the joy of this product
column10: I could not find this candy anywhere and my mom really wanted it. It was $6.95 and the shipping was close to $6. The amount of candy is very little...not enough to share at Christmas. My mom was happy though.

We discovered this on a trip to Maui in 2009.  It was so wonderful to find it again online when we returned.  It is a great seasoning!  We use the Hawaiian Island Original and Smoke.  The smoke can be used on virtually any meat and the original is a great addition to anything from scrambled eggs to potato salad!  It has seasonings that can only be found on the Hawaiian islands.  Truly unique and delicious!  We were very happy to find it in the 32 ounce size!  Much more cost effective!

column9: Great tasting, easy to use gluten free bread crumbs
column10: You can spice these up a little or just leave them plain. Either way, they coat and brown up beautifully--can't tell the difference between them and gluten bread crumbs. I wholeheartedly recommend them.

Have used these in two recipes since receiving them a few days ago.  They were delicious in both recipes.For the first meal, I used ground turkey to make turkey burgers.  In a mixing bowl, I combined the crumbs with one egg, chopped red and green bell pepper, chopped Vidalia onion, garlic powder, oregano, and salt.  Mixed it all into my ground turkey and made burger patties, then sauteed them in olive oil on the stovetop.  They developed a beautiful brown crust, and were moist and delicious.  I have to say that they were even better than the way I normally make them.My second time using them was last night, I made baked haddock.  On a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, I laid out 2 lbs. of boneless, skinless haddock.  In a small bowl, I mixed crumbs, garlic powder, and oregano.  I had also ordered some Schar GF table crackers that arrived all broken, so I smashed a couple of those up into fine crumbs and mixed them in too.  I sprayed the fish with Pam olive oil spray, topped each piece with the crumb mixure, sprayed the top with a little more Pam, and baked them for 40 minutes at 350.  They were excellent.  I couldn't even tell the difference between these and the crumbs that aren't GF... in fact, maybe these were even better.I highly recommend these, and I will keep a lot of them on hand to use in any dish requiring bread crumbs.  You should be aware that they do contain soy, in case anyone is allergic or sensitive to it.  (The crackers do not contain soy, so if you're sensitive to it, buy those instead and smash them up.  They are a tasty alternative.)

column9: Great tasting!  Makes chicken tenders just like restaurant.
column10: This product is a must for any gluten free family with kids.  Chicken tenders were a msin meal in our house prior to going gluten free.  There is a recipe on the package using olive oil and cooking in the oven instead of frying that tastes fabulous.

These gluten free bread crumbs worked well for the recipes I used them in.  However, I was able to find them at much cheaper prices after doing some additional research at my local stores.  No complaints about the quality of the product, though!

I ordered this item, a 10 pound BAG of sour cherry Jelly Belly jelly beans but what I received was a previously opened BOX of jelly beans which were crystallized and melted together and looked nothing like the image above. In addition, the jelly beans were simply dumped into the cardboard box with no wrapper whatsoever. This box had a seal on it which had been cut through and then retaped. The external shipping packaging was undisturbed. When I have ordered Jelly Belly jelly beans from other vendors, they have come in plastic bags, shipped in a cardboard box.Since I really wanted what I had ordered, I was disappointed to see that upon return of the defective merchandise, I was only eligible for a refund, not a replacement as Amazon was out of stock on my item. I sent the item back and was surprised to see that today, when my return processed, there is now 1 ten pound bag of sour cherry Jelly belly jelly beans in stock. I wonder if the in stock item is the very same defective item which I just returned.

column9: Sweet but packaging was a REAL bummer!
column10: These jelly beans are my favorite. The problem was that little care was taken in packing. When the package arrived, I was so excited that I opened the package in the parking lot of my office. The inner packaging was broken and I wound up with nearly the full pound on the lot! Try Superior Nut thru Amazon instead; they packed them right and it arrived perfect!

column9: cant believe I can have such a good lunch at work
column10: I bought the 12 pack and keep it in my locker at work- Make a pot of rice, and you will feel like your at an indian resturant. I'm no expert on indian food, but I like this and with the spicy zip it is much better than a balony sandwich.

Took a chance on this because I love Indian food, but no one at work shares my sentiments, so heading to an Indian restaurant for lunch is out.  Delicious!  It is listed as "mild" but i found it to be more medium - still, it wasn't too much for this "spice wuss."  Would be great with rice, but not needed - it was very filling on its own.  Definitely regretted forgetting a piece of naan to go with though...oh well, will have to buy/eat again!

column4: Jeri J. Steele "Jeri J Steele, Pioneer Inform...
column10: I love Indian food but never have time to go sit at a restaurant. This product helps me have a 'heat 'n eat" meal on hand. Just cook up some rice and put it on top and heat.  The spinach is fairly well spiced but could be too warm for some people's taste.
This is a great substitute for canned broth and it is much better than bouillion cubes.  This is not as salty as the regular concentrate.

column4: Miss Betsey Trotwood "Only bad witches are ugly"
column10: I'll never be able to make chicken soup as delicious as my grandmother's. I'm too lazy to stand over the stockpot for an hour skimming like she did. I'm too impatient to wait for the stock to chill so I can remove the solid fat at the top. And I'll never be skilled enough to make my own noodles. Even so, my chicken soup is pretty delicious thanks to good ingredients and this broth concentrate. Unlike most supermarket bouillon and aseptic broth boxes, this stuff actually tastes like chicken, and not like Chicken-scented-salt.I love that it takes up so little room, has minimal packaging and especially love that I no longer have to schlep boxes of chicken water home. With a family member who must avoid nightshades (potatoes, tomatoes, peppers) this product's ingredient list is perfect! (And I know Gramma would approve of the schmaltz.)I use this product to fortify soups, gravies, and sauces. It adds a lot of flavor to home-cooked dishes, elevating them from the everyday, thrown together in a hurry meal to (alas, nearly) "Made especially for you with love and care by Gramma."

column9: Terrific for soups, anything, really, this is a keeper!
column10: For us, this is one of the most important products that Amazon carries,  I'm a porph, and can't have garlic or onion in food. It's very difficult for me to find a broth that is "safe" and this one is perfect, Plus it tastes good!  And is organic,  It's really the perfect broth,  I make lots and lots of soups, stews, and various other concoctions in my beloved crockpot, so these little pouches are being slices open almost every day,  They are so convenient, We have a small kitchen so space is limited, these are perfect in that respect also,  In fact I'm going to reorder them today!

Savory Choice makes well flavored broth concentrates that are very convenient to use. This reduced sodium chicken broth tastes just as good as the others. If you just need a little broth, it's so easy to reach for a stick of broth rather than open a can and not use all of it. The broth concentrate in the stick mixes with a cup of water for normal strength broth. Sometimes I just add the concentrate to the liquid in the pot of what I'm cooking and stir it in when I want to up the flavor. I use both the chicken and beef broths regularly and the turkey broth at the holidays.

The true test of any broth, be that in solid form, powder or liquid, is in the taste. You heat one cup of water and use it then you drink it (of course herbs, pepper, tabasco sauce, etc., can and should be added for the test, nothing wrong with little creative add ons) and once you are done you will know if this broth met the basic requirement of taste. The taste on this product is not equal to that of the competing brands. Rather sweet and of course one pays extra (I do mean extra) for the lack of salt on the preparation. I use regularly the Savory Beef and even though it is a little on the pricey side I have to admit we like it a lot. I thought that reduced sodium might be an interesting and healthy option, only to discover (a little too late) that it does not meet the taste test. It is more sweet than I am sure it would be if I was to boil a whole chicken for the broth it yields.  I suppose that this product tries hard at being good for you and maybe it is, but for the money and the quantity provided it falls short of the mark. Perhaps the regular kind might be better and when one thinks about it the reduced sodium is a relative thing. Say you are making dinner for 4 and you decide to use regular broth without any salt constraints all you would have to do is refrain from adding additional salt and your probably be okey in the sodium intake department, plus you would definitely get more honest flavor than using this product. Only four packets are included with each box and that, my dear reviewers, is like liquid gold in its value. The regular Savory include 12 per box and that is a little more encouraging when you are trying to get a nice deal. If you just boiled on cup of water and dissolved one of the packets in said water and drank it you wouldn't be able to say: "Far out, this is one great cup of broth!". Much too sweet to taste really like chicken broth and perhaps you might need two of the liquid gold packets instead of one, for a truly invigorating cup. Tried it, used it and hereby give it 3 Stars at the most for this delicate, sweet tasting, sodium free version of chicken flavor.

A single (pack of 4) was $2.39 (regular price) at a local supermarket yesterday. If I remember correctly, it had an expiration date on it that isn't years into the future, so I don't think I'll buy 6 boxes just to save less than 6 cents per box.

Finally!  A GREAT tasting product that is also low sodium and does not contain MSG and is Gluten Free!  Since when did the foods we eat, all become science experiments!  Thank you Savory Choice for making a great and very handy product.  Not only is it great, but it's easy to store.  Got the Turkey, Vegetable, Beef, Chicken and the Demi Glace.  THANK YOU, THANK YOU, THANK YOU!
THIS IS A VERY GOD PRODUCT FOR THOSE OF US WHO ARE ON LOW SODIUM DIET.  TASTES SO GOOD AND CAN BE USED IN SOOOO MANY DISHES.

For several years now, I've been using the Savory Choice chicken, beef, and vegetable liquid broth packets.  I've used both the regular and reduced sodium chicken broth packets.  For the many soups I make in the Rival mini-crockpot, I usually use a Savory Choice regular chicken broth packet. I first purchased a box of the broth packets at Whole Foods and later, from Amazon.  I like to make a variety of soups.  The Rival mini-crockpot will make probably 2 cups of soup.  Add fresh vegetables (or frozen meatballs), an envelope of the Savory Choice chicken stock, chopped onions, and a splash of olive oil and let the soup cook for quite awhile for the flavors to blend. Using a purchased appetizer to make a soup also works for me.

column9: Taste is great! Packaging leaves lots to be desired
column10: As far as taste, there are no complaints. It is very meaty, not much sodium taste. These sticks are also only 80 calories with 45 coming from fat. It also has a fairly high 5g of protein.The packaging, however, sucks. These rectangular boxes are made to be displayed in a store. The edges are perforated so that the box can be torn to look like the above box. If you barely press on the sides of the box, the perforation breaks and the top of the box opens. This leads to the meat sticks being thrown out. Consequently, there are missing sticks when you receive the shipment.For the past few months, I have purchased 2 boxes a month on subscription. For the past 2 months, I have been missing over half of a box worth of meat sticks when they arrived. I did complain the first month and I was credited; but this month, I did not check the boxes until I had had them for a week or so. I do not feel good about complaining about this two months in a row. I will suffer this loss.As far as what is causing this, I can only offer conjecture. 1) Amazon is using robots to pull and pack this stock. Those robots are squeezing the boxes too tight and some of the meat sticks are slipping out in route to the shipping box. 2) The people grabbing the boxes are squeezing too tight and slinging the sticks out.While my kids and I thoroughly enjoy these sticks, I am cancelling my subscription. I cant keep calling to complain about no receiving all of my purchase for fear of getting banned. It is too aggravating to continue to buy these and not get what I pay for. IF the company chooses to repackage these in a box that will not tear open easily, I will set my subscription back up.

column9: Brooklyn Beans meets with approval of Peet's coffee snob
column10: I tried this coffee at work, despite my skepticism about K cups, and having come of age in Berkeley and learning at Peet's what a truly great cup of coffee is.  But I can honestly say, aside from a fresh brewed batch of Peet's from the French press, this is the BEST I've had.  It beats by far any other K cup I've tried.  Leave it to Brooklyn Beans, inspired by the new nexus of the foodie world, to perfect coffee in the convenience of a K cup!  Well done!

I was very disappointed in this coffee pod. The first few that I tried broke open during the brewing process and got grounds all over. The coffee is not a very bold or strong flavored coffee. Won't purchase this item again.

column9: 1st batch bad but customer service came through...
column10: Our initial box of Brooklyn Bridge Blend K-cups had problems and we were certainly disappointed. As noted here by many reviewers, some of the K-cups seem to "explode" and dump coffee grounds into your cup of joe.  Not good! I contacted their customer service and they were very apologetic and admitted to a quality control problem with some of their early run k-cups.  They quickly sent out a replacement box - and in addition - a second box of Corner Donut Shop. We have had no problems at all with these and I am very pleased with the taste of the Donut Shop blend as it is more bold than the Brooklyn Bridge (which my wife prefers).  We will definitely be ordering more. They acknowledged  the problem and made it right immediately.  Too bad that seems to be the exception to the rule these days in customer service. All in all a great deal on this coffee through Amazon subscribe and save.

column9: Excellent taste and a fun brand too
column10: I was compelled to try the Brooklyn Bean Corner Donut Shop variety (having been born in Brooklyn, but live outside of Boston now) and I am glad I did.  I actually like to start my day off with their French Roast or one of their other dark roasts but the Corner Donut Shop is my "go to" variety throughout the day.Not only does the coffee taste great but it is a fun brand.  Someone has been super creative in the naming of the varieties.  "Anybody want a Brooklyn Bridge?" is my favorite line.  I keep most of the varieties in my office as they are a favorite of many.

This coffee is actually pretty tasty, and I would consider trying other blends from Brooklyn Bean Roastery. However, more often than not, I wind up with coffee grounds in my cup. Sometimes there are so many grounds I have to dump the whole cup. I don't have this problem with other types of K-cups I use, so I wonder if this grind is too fine to use in K-cups.Otherwise, this would be a nice cup of morning coffee.
So happy overall with this! I loved the great taste and it worked perfect. So glad to have found it.

I have to say I was a little apprehensive to buy this product for the price, but I like to keep my K-Cup price under $0.50 and Sam's Club was sold out at the time, and I tried this.  The Fuhgeddaboudit is very strong, but that's how I like it.  Overall, I was impressed.

column9: The negative reviews made me want to try  it
column10: I'm always looking for new K-cups, and I read all of the negative reviews for this brand.  What impressed me was that every one of those reviews was answered by a company representative and appropriate compensation was offered to each buyer.  So for that reason, I overlooked the negatives and decided to buy.The coffee arrived at my front door the next day.  So far, I have had  no issues with coffee grounds and breaking K-cups. I'm certainly not a coffee expert, but I can honestly say that I am enjoying the Breakfast Blend--and the price was great.Keep up the good work, and thanks for the great coffee.

I haven't experienced any of the pod issues, but I'm only three pods into the box. My review is on the flavor of this coffee. The description claim is that it is a "Flavor match to Coffee People Jet Fuel. Tasty, full-bodied, smoky blend." This stuff tastes nothing like Jet Fuel. Even though the "best by" date on the box is 02/13 this stuff tastes old and stale to me. Unfortunately I bought two boxes so I'll muddle through, but then I'll be going back to either Jet Fuel or Black Tiger. If you're a fan of either one of those, fuhgeddabout Fuhgeddaboutit and stick with your fav.

Now I don't have to run out to the coffee shop to start my morning with a delicious cup of fresh brewed coffee to my liking.  I am not an expert but like everyone else some coffees definitely taste better then others and you can have starbucks and probably dunkin donut as I truly enjoy this one and drink it other times during the day when I feel like a cup.It is a nice blend and tastes delicious no bitter or after taste and I have tried your other blends but also enjoy the decaf when it is later at night.  Served it to friends who live and even used to live in Brooklyn and they agree it is a winner.Keep making this delicious product at an affordable price and you will have a customer for life.

I have been using Keurig for a couple of years now, and have a tried what I thought was nearly every brand of caffeinated coffee.  After hearing about their facebook page, I tried their sample box.  I was truly amazed that a company that, quite honestly, I had never heard of before made such an amazing brew.  The Brooklyn Bridge blend was really smooth.  The French Roast was full flavored, but my favorite was Fuhgeddboutit.  I'm a fan of strong coffee.  If you need a coffee that will not only taste really really good but wake you up, grab a box of Fuhgeddboutit.  That will kick your @$$!!.  I am truly pleased that I found them, and will continue to drink their coffee regularly!
Brooklynn Bean Roastery Coffee makes some wonderful blends of coffee.I love the names they have, I do not have one blend that I dislike. Fuhgedaboutit is a great blend.  A must have
This is the best coffee I've ever had...that is for sure..my hubby n I simply fell in love with dark roast!....would love to try some more!..thanks a ton Brooklyn Bean!!!!...U rock!!!
Join their facebook page! They have a lot of giveaways. I'm giving it four stars because ive read good things and am going to try it.
have tried this coffee from a friend it was great will buy. also will spread buy word of mouth. keep up the good work and thanks for having the k-cups of different varieties

I recently tired your k-cups through a giveaway you had. I'm in love. My old favorite was the Donut Shop from Keruig and now it is your donut flavor! I love it. All the others I have tried from the sample back too are great!

Seriously great coffee, amazingly bold and a great wake up call in the morning, Its like riding the Cyclone without the safety bar! As a Brooklynite myself I can say that would definitely get the ol blood pumpin just like this coffee does!
Had the sampler pack and I was impressed. Loved the Cyclone the most. The Columbian was nice and balanced also. I would try this again.

I bought the 36-count Brooklyn Bean Roastery,Cyclone, for Keurig,got the product in the mail,The coffee pods where packed ok,made the 1st cup= blow out,2nd cup= blow out,3rd cup received coffee that tasted very old,So I brewed acouple more cups got the same taste,All togather I had 22 cups which brewed ok,Still tasted like the coffee was scraped from the bottem of the barrel,and 10 blow-outs,also had a 4 that did not puncher.Now I realize that some may say that my maker was at fault,BUT I did check my maker,No Problems.I also bought coffee from another maker (Jet Fuel)which was very good,so I kinda now what stronger coffee tastes like.So I will not buy this coffee ever again.Thanks  Update= Brooklyn Bean sent me another box of coffee,It was far better than the last one. Only 2 blow outs,the taste was ALOT better than last time,alot smoother and taster,so I will be buying this coffee again.THANKS Brooklyn Bean.

We are currently enjoying the fuhgeddaboutit dark roast & it's excellent! We're not quite coffee snobs, but we're WELL past Starbucks & corporate coffee. I'm always hesitant to try something other than our favorites from our local roaster here in Kansas City, but this dark blend is just excellent. It's smooth, not bitter, and doesn't require me to add a ton of half & half to get it to my liking. I'm really excited to have found another coffee to indulge in - and while it's not local to ME, per se, it's a small local business and I am ALWAYS happy to support small, family run companies. I'm really anxious to try to the Corner Donut Shop blend next. Yay for java!

column9: Kcups leaking and coffee tasted old
column10: The kcups looked okay, but many of them sprayed coffee on the counter, had coffee grounds coming out. I won't buy this again.

This is an extremely inferior product. Six of the coffee pods were broken open with grounds pouring out of the box. The remaining pods were ALL stale even though the use by date on the box was  December 2012. All went in the trash. I'll never buy from  Brooklyn Bean Roastery again.  Also, I bought two different coffees  (French Roast and  Fuhgeddaboutit). Both boxes of 36 each were in the same sub standard condition.

Very disappointed with the product.  The coffee had a distinct "burnt" or "stale" taste (as most decaf coffees do) and about 1 out of every 5 or 6 k-cups leaked all the coffee grounds out of the k-cup and into the coffee mug.  I won't be re-ordering this product.
I will never buy this again...I would say 2 out of 5 would leave grounds in my cup.  I had to throw it out because it had so much in the cup.  Never again......

column9: I didn't like the French Roast
column10: Re: French Roast...This coffee was weak and miserable! It's a value, but don't fall for the okie doke....This is not a good cup of Joe.http://www.amazon.com/Brooklyn-Bean-Roastery-FrenchRoast-36-Count/dp/B006Q822L0After writing my original review the Mfg contacted me and offered me samples. Let me just say they were polite and not even the slightest bit defensive. They just wanted to prove to me like they can brew a cup of coffee that didn't taste like dish soap! And guess what...The Colombian and Fuhgeddaboudit brands were good!Now the big question is...Would I buy this brand again? Absolutely! Integrity is hard to find and they have integrity.

column9: Great Mild Coffee along with some Brooklyn Hometown Pride!!
column10: My husband is from Brooklyn, and even though he doesn't live there any more, maintains a somewhat alarming amount of Brooklyn pride, so of course, I had to buy this for him.  We tried the Brooklyn Bridge Blend.Usually, I have to put a lot of sugar in my coffee because I think its too bitter, but this tasted mild, (not weak)  just... a pleasant coffee flavor without being too strong for me and I was able to cut out some sugar, which is always nice.I had one cup with a few grinds floating on top, but I've had that with almost every other brand I've had also, so I'm not concerned.I'd buy this even if it was the same price as other K-Cups, because my husband got such a kick out of the name and label, and of course, we both enjoyed the coffee, but the fact that its cheaper than other brands is great too.

I bought these the other day because they seemed a good deal and also had many different flavors. I used the first one and the Keurig seemed to drip out instead of flow. I tried to use a regular K-Cup that I had and it worked fine. I tried this with over 10 of The Brooklyn K-Cups, I am completely dissatisified, and wish I could rate this lower than a 1. I would never buy another one of their products!!
The Corner Donut Shop is my new go to coffee. My house smells amazing when brewed and it's yummy. Mmmmm... donuts.
I find the coffee to be quite good, although a bit weak except on the small cup cycle.  also, I had one cup which left grounds in the cup.  quite a good flavor overall.

I preordered this product and have been very disapointed in it. Almost every time that I brew this in my Keurig brewer there are grounds in my coffee. Sometimes the bottom doesn't punture and the k-cup flows over and at other times it does but there are still grounds. I have had to brew two cups usually to get one cup of coffee. My other brands don't have this problem. I gave it one star because when I do get a decent cup it tastes OK.

Ordered Fuggetabout it and while it is a decent tasting coffee, it is far from bold or dark roasted enough. I was looking for reasonable k-cups, but this is not an item I'd purchase again even at a lower price.I was IMPRESSED with Brooklyn Bean Roastery's response!  They sent an order of Cyclone at no cost...and it was a full order not a 6-10 kcup sample!  They followed up to see if I was happy with Cyclone.Cyclone was very good and I'll order more.  The cups have brewed perfectly each time.  I've seen some comments that weren't positive, but the company seems to be working hard and it's worth trying.

The price seemed reasonable so the wife and I thought we would give this French Roast a try. We were very disappointed. The aroma and taste were more reminiscent of vending machine coffee. If you are expecting something similar to Starbucks, Tullys or Green Mountain French Roast this coffee is not for you. Very weak and not full bodied like you would expect from a French Roast, even on the strongest setting on our Keurig machine.

column9: Better, Smoother Than Emeril's Big Easy Bold
column10: UPDATE! I just got my new Box and the seals problem is gone, the coffee is lovely, strong BROOKLYN STYLE ... with a low acidity that makes for a relaxing GOURMET cuppa Joe...Fuhgeddaboudit! Thans to BBR for being a terrific Amazon supplier! :-)Well, I pre-ordered this terrific K-Cup, and had some problems with initial run of seals, and strength. Happily the folks at Brooklyn Bean will send me a FREE new box ... and btw you get 36 ct. boxes here not 24!The coffee is smooth, strong and bold...a real "Brooklyn" cup of Joe...and it is very reminiscent of Emeril's Big Easy, only stronger and smoother, much smootherNice chocolate overtones to my palate.So drink up Brooklyn and Fuhgeddaboudit!

column9: Hope you have a tea strainer
column10: Because I get a ton of grounds half the time I use this particular coffee. Not worth the savings. Better to spend a couple extra bucks and get the good stuff. Flavor is O.K. but not good enough to overcome the defect.
If you can get water through the k cup the coffee is good.But I have had to much trouble with cloging brewer water not going through k cup and coffee grounds in the cup.I would not recomend.

Cyclone is smooth, good tasting coffee, but not very robust. It was suggested to be a substitute for Dark Magic coffee - to my taste, this it is not.  To get the flavor I want, I use 6 ounces max water when making this.  The construction of the kcups does not seem to be up to par.  Coffee grinds are found in the box and sometimes in the bottom of your cup.  The brewing flow sometimes backs up.  Nevertheless, I rated it a 3 because I really like this coffee after dinner.UPDATE June 14Received replacement kcups from Brooklyn Bridge as promised.  They work fine, brewing well, no grounds in coffee.  Because of better brewing?, coffee seems to raste better in this batch.

column9: Marginal coffee and poor quality control
column10: The quality control is poor, the pods arrive with coffee grounds stuck to the outside under the rim and the foil tops are stuck on unevenly and not straight. Clearly not made by the same people who make "real" K-Cups. Beyond that the coffee is marginal at best, it is not strong and has the grainy taste that I normally associate with cheap diner coffee, not a good coffee flavor at all.This goes down as a lesson learned and an example of getting what you pay for. Back to the Big Box store for the Barista Prima Columbia, now that's a decent cup of coffee, I just wish Amazon carried it at a decent price.****UPDATE****The good folks at Brooklyn Bean sent me a replacement box and I thought it was worth an updated review. Initially I had tried the "Fuhgeddaboudit" blend as was not impressed. On their recommendation I tried the Cyclone and it is much more to my taste, I would happily brew it instead of my normal Barista Prima Columbia blend. On the basis of the flavor I would give it 5 stars, but this morning I had a "filter blowout" and wound up with grounds all over the counter, so I knocked a couple of stars off. That's one failure out of about 15 brews, and may be an isolated incident. I'll keep brewing and may well order more and will update my review to reflect any future failures.

I was not sure what to expect, given the mixed reviews. I decided to try the Brooklyn Bridge Blend because I do like Green Mountain Nantucket Blend. I am about half way through the box with no no brewing failures in my 2006 B50 Keurig brewer. It is not quite the same flavor as the Nantucket blend (in my opinion), but it is not bad at all. It is a bit stronger, and has a bit of an aftertaste that I associate with stronger roast (like French Roast). I will probably try their Colombian next - but would buy this one again at some point. Still searching for a good replacement for Columbian La Verde though...

These kcups are not sealed correctly and as a result the fail.  Top seal opens up and sometimes the filter inside shifts and grinds jam up the coffeemaker.  Many of the cups are stale as a result of the poor seal.  I purchased 4 different Brooklyn Bean Roastery flavors and they all had the same issue.Company was contacted and quick to send replacement, unfortunately these also failed and many were stale. Hope they correct their product.

column9: wont work in keurig coffee machine
column10: the k cup of brooklyn coffee may be a little taller? I don't know why but won't work in Keurig machine...what a messDON'T BUY THIS SAVE YOUR MONEY db

I actually liked the coffee in these k-cups.  I liked it a lot.  But the k-cups exploded in my brewer.  Not only did the cup of coffee not brew properly, but the explosion clogged up my machine.  It took me 2 days to clean it all out.

I love coffee.  I drink it all day long.  But sometimes I want decaf, especially in the evening or when I'm not feeling well.  I recently got a Keurig machine so I gave these a try.  The decaf is delicious.  It's smooth, goes well with flavored creamers or half and half, and is strong without the caffeine.  I'm really not sure what everyone is complaining about.  I love the price, and I'm going to order some of the other flavors.  This package was a gift from my boyfriend.  Guess he's a smart guy!

column9: Tastes Amazing! Great customer service as well.
column10: Tastes great, and had zero problems with the packaging and brewing. WONDERFUL product. Definitely recommend it to coffee lovers and Keurig owners.

This coffee has the best flavor of any k- cup we have tried. It has a different nutty flavor. We have been through everything from strabucks, green mountain, emrils, folgers, caribou, newmans, etc. I will say that a few coffee grounds make it into the cup, but that doesn't bother me. We will be trying the other flavors ASAP.
So glad I had it ordered.  The taste is sooo good.  The price was sooo good also.  We like to get more. My daughter loves it too!!  Janet

I had heard this brand was very good by co-workers, so finally tried it for myself!I have to say that I agree with them! Great aroma, as well as taste. Look forward to trying all of the flavors and blends!I will be back for more soon!....

column9: Very poor taste for this dark roast
column10: I've given the "Fuhgeddaboudit" roast a few days to see if I just needed to get used to the flavor, but it still tasted weak with a bit of an ashy aftertaste to me this morning.  I've tried selecting the smallest size on my Keurig, but it still has that weak gas station taste.. now with smaller volume so I can chug it faster.I've gone through 10 of my 36 cups without any of the quality control issues others have talked about.  I just really don't like this roast.  For reference, I tend to enjoy Jet Fuel and Dark Magic roasts... and was hoping for something similar here.  I would give it one star for taste, but added a star because of the creative dispenser structure of the box and the cheaper price.  In this case, I did get what I paid for I guess.
Really good coffee. Good flavor and would buy again. Like robust flavor that is also smooth and this coffee is both.

column9: Second Worst Coffee I Ever Tasted
column10: First, the pros:  The label is very nice looking and the packaging is swell.Unfortunately, that is where the praise ends.  If you have ever tried to reuse a k-cup you'll understand what this coffee tastes like.  I did an experiment weighing five different brands of coffee and found all to be 1/2 oz. or more except Brooklyn and it weighed one tenth of an ounce.  That's 1/5 the weight of Dunkin' Donuts, Newman's Own, Millstone and 1/6 the weight of Starbucks.  This is the second time I've ordered coffee from Amazon and found it to be lacking.  Since they won't take returns, (even from prime members) I don't think I'll order any more coffee from Amazon in the future.  The reason I titled this review the second worst coffee was because I got tricked into buying a coffee that was really just instant coffee in a k-cup cartridge.  On second thought that actually was better than this.

I picked up a Kuerig a couple of months ago and began a quest to find a reasonably-priced supply of k-cups to use in the machine. I stumbled upon the Corner Donut Shop item and pre-ordered it before it was ready to ship. It arrived a couple of weeks ago and I have gone through almost my first whole box of 36. Out of those 36, 22 of the cups did not brew correctly and left me with a disappointing cup (or partial cup) of coffee. Most of the failures left grounds floating in the cup which was not good, but some of the cups left grounds all over the inside of the machine and required me to clean up.BUT, of those cups that brewed correctly, WOW! The coffee is great. It has a great flavor that is reminiscent of a donut chain that has great coffee and does not have a bitter after taste like some of the k-cups I have tried.I give the rating a 3 which is the mean of a 5 for taste and a 1 for packaging.I'll wait a few months and see if this product is still being offered and try it again. Who knows, maybe they'll fix the packaging by then?!

Only the guys in the Soprano crew said it...and we all know where they were from.  Yes, people from Brooklyn are colorful; however we do not necessarily scratch when it itches, we stand upright and don't need to use our knuckles when walking. We are not neanderthals. If you want some of those, go across the river to you-know-where.  Despite the silly name, I tried this coffee and it's excellent.  Really rich, lots of flavor, not bitter, and the fragrance makes you want to rub your cheek against your mug and whisper sweet nothings.The blend makes a great morning coffee, it smells and tastes just the way coffee is supposed to in the morning and makes you wish you were seated at a big farm table with platters of ham and eggs and country biscuits. You can drink it during the day because it's not acidic and you don't get a sour stomach or that overcoffeed taste in the back of your throat.  And it's rich enough to make it the perfect after dinner coffee too. (Add a little bit of condensed milk and it's dessert.)Keurig is not the best coffee maker in the world, but this particular blend works very well in the machine and is now my go-to K-Cup. Keurig's main benefit is that it's fast so there's no standing on one foot and tapping your head against the counter while waiting for the coffee to brew. With Fuhgeddaboudit, there's no sacrifice of flavor for that instant gratification.Some reviewers have had problems with the k-cup itself, but I haven't.  I'm on my third box and not one leaking or grounds-spewing incident has occured.
Oh! I just loving it. I must have a cup of K-Cups in the morning. It makes me cheer-up in the morning. Oh yaa of course in the evening for next boost :D. This is awesome. I need K-Cups everyday.

I bought this and Cyclone as I like Extra Bold.  Pre-Ordered without realizing they are "clones" of other products I already know are not my favorites, and BAD clones at that.  WAY TOO WEAK to bear the Extra Bold label.  Avoid these if you like your coffee strong!  Try Double Black Diamond.

My office has a keruig machine, but after a few months our budget was starting to strain with the cost of the k-cups. Many of us who really prefer a good cuppa in the morning (or noon, or night) often buy our own supply now. I really love having a lower cost alternative that gives me the great taste I want. The ones I've tried so far have been delicious and they work perfectly. I've seen a few reviews about faulty cups, but I haven't seen anything of the kind.

I was anxious to buy the Boston Bean decaf breakfast blend k-cups for my husband. However, he did not even get to taste it.  There were no filters in the pods and as you can imagine we had coffee grounds everywhere!  We tried three of them in hopes that it was just one or two that got past quality control.  Now I have my Keurig to clean since it is stopped up.  I LOVE the Keurig....hope it isn' ruined!

I was looking for another dark/bold coffee. From the description, Fuhgeddaboutit sounded like it would be a nice change from previous purchases of Jet Fuel, Fog Chaser, and Black Tiger - all of which are terrific coffees. Very disappointed because this was neither dark or bold. I shared some of the k-cups with coworkers to get their opinion and the most positive response was that it tasted "funky", at least more positive than "tastes like paper".Sorry, this one didn't cut it...

column9: UPDATE Great Customer Service made me a Customer again
column10: I read the reviews and just wanted to report that my order brewed fine, no mess. I have since ordered another batch and hope I can report back with the same.UPDATE: received my order of Brooklyn Columbian Medium Roast and brewed a few cups....all grounds:( Changed to 3 stars since the original order for Brooklyn Bridge was tasty and mess free.UPDATE 6/3/12 Received my replacement box from the company...no problems and a great cup of coffee. Thanks, can't wait to try more flavors!E Hallman

column9: Verified Purchaser of Cyclone Blend ~ By a Coffee Snob
column10: I purchased this on Amazon and have no association or affiliation with this company.I was skeptical because of reviews but decided to give it a try since I LOVE my Keurig!And we LOVE it! I like a nice bold cup but that is smooth... this is it!  I always putit on the 2nd cup setting (above the espresso size) for all of the K-cups for myself..my husb puts it on the third setting.  I made this coffee first for my husband on the3rd setting and took a sip .... YUMMMY!!!!!! It was PERFECT... bold and smooth! I wasso excited! My husband took a sip and loved it too!I am glad that I can have one good full cup on the third setting and not two cups ofEmeril's Bold (which I love too) or Green Mountain Italian Blend (which I LOVE too).I did have one cup where some grounds were found on the top of the coffee... I was like"Oh man... this is not good!!"  I just took a paper towel and skimmed it and they cameright out and it hasn't happened since. And we've had about 8 cups of it all together.I'm thinking that maybe with these cups you really do need to line them up right? Probnot... maybe just growing pains for these guys.Seems like a neat company and I will be buying the Cyclone again when we get close torunning out!Please keep the price the way it is...!Lisa

This coffee is great! Has a nice smooth rich taste. It's not too light and not too dark but perfect. If you like a medium roast coffee you'll love this. I also like that the price is a little cheaper then some other brands. No problems with the k-cups here, they brewed just fine. I recommend this coffee.

Fugeddaboutit coffee has a nice rich taste that both my husband and I like, a tough task to hit.  The packaging is a plus, as well, insofar that it allows you to open it as a dispenser.  This is a pet peeve I have with many of the other K-cups I purchase because there is no easy storage option. Finally, the little character makes me smile.

column9: Brooklyn Decaf Cups spread grounds all over
column10: I too ordered two boxes of Brooklyn K-cups - decaf in my case.  Grounds were everywhere inside the Keurig holder, and the Keurig no longer made coffee since the little hole was clogged.  We blamed the coffee maker and cleaned it out.  It worked fine until we tried another Booklyn decaf k-cup.  Again grounds were all over the holder, the k-cup was full of water, and the coffee maker was clogged.  There is something seriously wrong with the packaging of Brooklyn k-cups.  I see Amazon won't take them back so I may try to open them all and use them in our drip coffee maker.
Amazon should have quality controlled this garbage coffee and offer refunds or exchanges to make it up to those that spent good money on this product. BUYER BEWARE, this is garbage.

I have made my way though 6 of the k-cups and so far so good.  As far as grounds I have had none.  On the taste of the coffee, it's ok.  They claim flavor match to green mountain breakfast blend....not sure about that as I find it be a little more bitter on the back end.  Is it bad, no its not.  Is it a memorable cup of coffee not really.  Overall I put it in the same class as folders meaning somebody hands you a cup and you will drink it, but probably not ask what it was (good or bad).******Update 4-28-12******After my initial review, I was contacted by Brooklyn Bean Roastery asking if they could send me sample of the other roasts of coffe.  Today FedEx just dropped off 36 k-cups mixed between the different roasts.  Currently, I am drinking the Colombian and find it  to be very good.  Total I have run 15-20 of there k-cups through my Cuisinart with no grounds and no unusually long brew times.  Overall, I will keep my subscription I have change to a different blend than the breakfast blend which I originally ordered.

Since it was a new product just released there was no feedback. I usually look at feedback before purchasing. Today looking at the feedback I would not purchase this Brooklyn Bean Roastery Breakfast Blend Coffee. 2 out of the 1st 4 k-cups I used plugged the machine and NOTHING came out. Also it plugged the k-cup holder needle so the next k-cup of my good coffee was wasted also - nothing came out until I cleaned the needle. Soooooooooo it took 3 k-cups for me to finally get a cup of coffee. I am disappointed because the Brooklyn coffee had so many choices and reasonable prices that I was ready to buy more. NOT NOW......J Fred Madden OHIOUpdateThe Brooklyn sent me a complete replacement of my original order. So far I have tried 3 of the replaced k-cups and they worked like a champ. I believe there was a problem and Brooklyn solved and resolved it!! I will try some of their other flavors and hope they all will work as wellJFRED

I want to say this coffee is very good .Have had no issues with bad pods .Check your machine if you are having issues with pod breaking open .Sometimes the  needle get clongged or worn and you will start having this issue.I love the price of this coffee.Great taste you will see the price of kerig pods come down soon the patent has expired
The bottom of the cup is to hard or thick and the coffee overflows sometime other than that the coffee is very good.

This is a full-flavored coffee that brews delicious even when I make the large travel mugs I generally drink. It never tastes watered down and always makes a satisfying cup. I have not experienced even one of the brewing mishaps that other reviewers have commented on, so it appears the problems have been fixed. No explosions, no grounds in the cup, just delicious coffee. I am very sorry this is no longer available for Subscribe and Save, as I'd keep ordering a regular delivery. I love this stuff!I am on my very last cups of this flavor and have tried their other varieties.  People who stop by my office really enjoy the coffee.  As of right now, only the Columbian is still available through Subscribe and Save and I am ordering that with the hopes that I will like it just as much and that it will remain available. column9: Don't listen to the other reviews.  Here is all you need to know.
column10: I've read the reviews about it clogging the machine and grounds spilling all over and it's all moot as far as I'm concerned. I purchased the Columbian flavor of these K-Cups. The coffee was OK, but it involves some work to get it brew correctly. The sides of the cup are not rigid enough for the keurig maker to puncture the bottom of the cup easily. There is a noticeable difference in the thickness of the walls of these K-Cups versus any of the other brands that I have. When I placed the first cup in the machine and pulled the handle down, the machine started brewing, but nothing came out. I realized that the sides of the cup had bent and the bottom was not punched through, so no coffee could come out. column9: Not as Strong as other French Roast
column10: We have been drinking the French Roast from Tully, Green Mountain, and Starbucks. We decided to give the French Roast from Brooklyn Bean Roastery a try. What a dissapointment.First, the taste is extremely weak if we set the brewing to "12". So we have to change it to brew at "8".If we brew it at 12, it taste almost like tea. Actually to get the strength as strong as the other well known competitors we have to set the brew at "6". So basically eventhough the price of these is cheaper, you won't save money as you have to use almost twice as much! We went through the whole box (36 k-cups) and all of them have the same consistency, in order to get a strong blend we have to set the brew at "6" or "8". Compare to Tully, Green Mountain, or Starbucks, with setting to "12" we always get a very strong coffee. After all, French Roast is suppose to be a fairly strong coffee.

THE COFFEE IS EXCELLENT WHEN YOU CAN FIND A K-CUP THAT DOESN'T EXPLODE IN YOUR COFFEEMAKER. ONE OUT OF EVERY 6WILL ACTUALLY MAKE IT THROUGH A COMPLETE BREWING CYCLE WITHOUT EXPLODING. However, flavor gets trumped by inconvenience and unfortunately it is very inconvenient to clean your Keurig after a K-cup defecates its grinds all over it during the brewing process. column9: Delicious Coffee - Horrible K-cup manufacture - RESOLVED
column10: I purchased the Brooklyn Bean Roastery Breakfast Blend Decaf K-cups as I am always looking for a decaf coffee that I enjoy and can just continue to order over and over via auto-ship.  My first attempt to brew a cup of this coffee resulted in a cup full of coffee grounds with little to no coffee, as well as a backflow of the same into the Keurig Brewer; as did my second, third and fourth attempts.  I thoroughly cleaned out the Keurig machine and tried again - same results!  I put in a Green Mountain K-cup and it brewed flawlessly.  When I was ready for another cup of coffee, I tried the Brooklyn Bean Roastery coffee again and this time, I did get a cup of coffee, albeit still with a healthy serving of grounds included.  I strained the coffee and was delighted with the flavor.  It appears that for whatever reason, the filter inside the K-cup breaks and releases grounds during brewing, which of course clogs the delivery port of the brewed coffee and the whole process is back-flooded into the brewer.  I have been able to get a cup of coffee from about 1/4 of the Brooklyn Bean Roastery K-cups that I received in my order.  While I really enjoy the flavor of the Breakfast Blend Decaf from Brooklyn Bean Roastery, I cannot continue to purchase them until the manufacture of the K-cup is resolved.  Hopefully, they will be able to do this soon and post a note on Amazon - perhaps list the K-cups as "New and Improved" or the like, so that we can know the problem has been addressed and fixed.I have received a replacement box of K-cups from BBR and to my pleasure, every k-cup brewed perfectly.  Same great tasting coffee and now... no grounds!  I will definitely be ordering more.  Thank you BBR for the replacement K-cups and for fixing the original problem with the manufacturing process.  My original rating was 2 stars; I have increased it to 4 stars and if the subsequent orders I get from BBR continue to brew properly, I will increase the rating to 5 stars.
