I've eaten it several times in one day. I had this with soy milk rather than normal milk so maybe that makes it taste different, but I was very happily surprised at how good it is.

OH we LOVE these  mac and Cheese noodles!!just a few months into escaping GlutenTY SO MUCH for creating noodles its Safe for me to eat!!what a blessing you arehave fed Father in law these when he came to visit from Alaska last monthHE LIKED them TOO!!

column9: Better than Kraft, in my opinion
column10: Although I don't prefer it over the other two gluten-free mac&cheese options offered by Annie's (the deluxe cheddar and the rice shells with white cheddar), I still must admit this is a really great stand-in for anyone who can't (or chooses not to) eat gluten.I recommend playing around with add-ins and seasonings (sour cream, onion or garlic, hickory smoke salt), to make it a bit more interesting.The pasta itself holds up well (as with the other Annie's products), although I find it needs a few extra minutes to get it where I want it (I believe the box says 8-10 minutes).  It doesn't fall apart like many rice pastas.  The cheese sauce definitely tastes less artificial than other brands like Kraft.

column9: If you like Kraft Mac and Cheese you will like this.
column10: This is the first product that tastes like the Kraft Mac and Cheese.I usually end up eating the whole thing in one sitting.

My two little girls are VERY picky about their mac n' cheese.  After we all went gluten-free, I was scared that we wouldn't find anything that they liked....until we found Annie's.  You can't tell that it isn't the "regular" pasta and my kids eat it up like crazy.  I don't like mac n' cheese, but I like this one!  Definitely give it a try!This brand is frequently sold out at our local stores, so I exclusively buy it on the Amazon Subscription Order - which is fabulous!

I tried many many other boxed gluten free dinners, none of them are as good as this is to their 'gluten' orginals!The kids and I absolutely love this stuff! We throw in veggies, hot dogs, hamburger, beans or just eat it plain.We have subscribed to this on Amazon, because it is 19 cents per box cheaper than the local grocery store...and I don't have to drive there to get it!

We have a little boy who is sensitive to gluten, and he loves macaroni and cheese.  Annie's rice pasta and cheddar tastes great, and he adores it!  Some rice pastas taste gummy; this one doesn't.  Taste is great  and the natural ingredients are a plus.

Annie's Homegrown Rice Pastas are the best we have found and we are of Italian heritage. We served it to our guests. They all say they could not tell it wasn't wheat when we tell them that they had had rice pasta. It is delicious and works well with Hot & cold dishes.

This is the ONLY GF mac n cheese my picky 12 year old will eat. If you miss Kraft Mac & Cheese will certainly replace that missing feeling. My other two children (who aren't gluten restricted) also like this product. I used it last Thanksgiving when I was hosting and no one could tell any difference they were in awe. I recommend this to all my newby GF diet friends.

column9: You can't tell that it's gluten-free.
column10: This is a wonderful gluten free product that is definitely a great replacement for the "real thing."  The noodles are nearly the same texture as Kraft's Mac & Cheese.  They're not grainy, gritty, mushy, etc.  The cooking directions are just as simple to follow as the traditional versions.  I find the sauce to be a little thin when I follow the directions exactly, but it's easy to customize it to your preference.  The cheese sauce isn't as strong as Kraft's, but I really think it's better that way.  You can always add to it if it's an issue.  (I don't know if this reference helps many people - but it's similar to Trader Joe's Mac & Cheese.)  The suggested serving size is realistic.  One box is plenty for 2 - 3 children.I'm really happy with this product.  It's something that I can give to my son with Celiac disease to help him feel like he can eat normal everyday kid-food.

I am gluten intolerant and just found out that my daughter has the same concerns.  She is in first grade and is switching over to a gluten free diet.  When we tried this mac and cheese, not only were we both disappointed, but honestly, it tasted awful!  There are not too many GF things that I don't like, but this couldn't even be doctored up.  I tried!  Not impressed.

My son loves macaroni and cheese. He is gluten free and at first it was hard to find something that compared. this does the job. He loves and so don't we. Its is much more creamier than regular mac and cheese

Annie's G-Free Mac & Cheese, is awesome. For kids or adults having a replacement for Kraft M&C is great. Having eaten both, I admit there is a taste & texture difference. If your child is newly diagnosed with Celiac, then they may not like this the first time around. Be patient, it will likely take time for them to get used to it. Amazon's price for a case using subscribe & save is probably the best deal around.

The Pasta and Cheddar was wonderful, as always. It allows my wife, who is Gluten sensitive, to have mac and cheese, which she loves. My complaint lies in the packaging. I had indicated that the item was a gift, yet the package arrived with the contents boldly indicated on the box. It also had the invoice openly displayed, which I had requested not be done. In short, LOVE the product, but the packaging policies need to be reviewed.
This is so good i buy it by the case.  I also keep a case in storage for survival food.Ron
a great GF mac & cheese for picky kids.  we have 4 kids 10 and under, and they all like it.

This is one of the first gluten-free foods my daughter found edible when she was diagnosed with Celiac five years ago. It has become one of her comfort foods in spite of the fact that she was never a fan of quick-to-fix mac & cheese before her diagnosis. Gluten-free foods--especially pasta and macaroni can be really fussy--so please take note--just because some reviewers make talk down certain products it's really a matter of personal taste. Don't be afraid to experiment for yourself!!

We finally found an alternative GF mac n cheese.  The kids sure miss my Kraft every now and then so when we stumbled upon this alternative that was GF we were so happy!  At least they can now have some good GF mac n cheese that doesn't seem all to different from the regular Kraft version.  The noodles look like Krafts, however the cheese is slightly different tasting.  Not bad but just not exactly Kraft.  We add extra deli american cheese to ours and that seems to help.

When we recently found out my teen son had a wheat allergy, macaroni and cheese was one item he was worried we wouldn't find a replacement for.  He was almost right.  After trying several, we came across this one.  If it passes the taste test of a teen boy, it's definitely worth a try!

I tried this back when I was first diagnosed; there were almost NO products out there that were gluten free, so I was really excited to try this. I'm giving this 2 stars because it actually is edible, but just barely. I couldn't bring myself to ever buy it again, no matter how much I missed mac & cheese.
This product is an excellent alternative to the gluten version of mac n cheese in a box.  Cook as instructed and the dish comes out great - tastes great too!

My daughter loves this mac & cheese.  We are new to the gluten free diet and she has always been a picky eater.  This is one of the few things I can feed herwithout any complaints.  She enjoys it several times a week.

As far as taste goes, Annie's is a good option.  However, I found that I could not eat a lot of this Mac and Cheese because the rice pasta is so heavy on the stomach. It left me feeling almost too full and a bit uncomfortable.

I USUALLY MAKE THIS WHEN IM CRAVING FOR A QUICK SNACK OR A YUMMY SIDE DISH. YOU CAN HARDLY TELL IT IS GLUTEN FREE BECAUSE IT TASTE SO GOOD. I GET KIND OF BORED WITH THIS AFTER EASY IT VERY OFTEN FOR THE PAST MONTH, BUT NO DOUBT, IT IS A DELICIOUS FOOD PRODUCT AND IS EASY TO MAKE. GREAT FOR PEOPLE WHO ARE ALLERGIC TO WHEAT.
I loved the cost per box after purchasing the case of this product.  I enjoy this Gluten Free Version of a quick Mac/Cheese.

column9: Love it!! Always rinse the noodles!
column10: My whole family gobbles this up - do not be afraid to cook longer than the box says to get the noodles nice and tender.  Then I always pour the cooked noodles into a strainer in the sink and rinse all the "sludge" (from the brown rice) with cold water.  Then I warm it back up in the pan, usally adding some sour cream, butter, & salt/pepper to the sauce mix.  As a former lover of all things gluten-containing, I have to say that when the rice pasta is rinsed, I think it's just as good if not better than traditional wheat pasta.  "Shocking" the pasta with cold water makes all the difference in the world! Hope this helps.

column9: Delicious...and my kids think so too!
column10: This is the best mac n cheese gf product we have tried so far! My kids eat it with more vigor than regular mac n cheese. The noodles are a little big and it seems to disappear really fast, other than that, it is definitely a good deal for the cost(usually one of the least expensive gf prepared foods).

I LOVE this macaroni and cheese.  Haven't had mac and cheese in over a year since I went gluten free.  I was surprised how big the noodles are.  I am doing Weight Watchers and 1 cup of this is just 7 points on the points plus program!  My 9 year-old just went gluten free a month ago with me and she was so excited about this product because she is feeling deprived of some foods she loved.  Will be staying on the subscribe and save with this one. Thanks Annie's Homegrown!

I was disappointed to discover after receiving it that it is NOT kosher, despite being labeled Kosher - KSA Dairy in the description.  I spoke with the KSA and Annie's today - both confirmed that this product hasn't been certified.  I'm giving this 5 stars b/c I'm sure that it's delicious & don't want to mess up Annie's rating - but hope it'll be kosher soon!  :)

I'm new to the gluten-free way of eating and have been experimenting.  I just happened across this in the supermarket and thought I'd give it a try.  I generally don't eat much in the way of pasta, but since I often feel unwell, the convenience was appealing.  Other reviewers commented on the need to cook the noodles a bit longer than the directions call for and I think there may be something to that.  I ended up using the 14K BTU burner on my gas stove for a full 10 minutes and they came out great.  I think if I had used the regular 9K BTU burner and stuck to the required cooking time, the noodles may not have turned out so well.  You also need to stir the noodles within the first few minutes that they come to a boil or they will start sticking to each other and the bottom of the pot.I was a little apprehensive about how this dish would taste and I have to state that I really couldn't tell the difference between this product and the "regular" version.  I was never a huge fan of the Kraft  product because I prefer homemade to stuff out of the box. But allergy season is looming and I knew that I needed a variety of convenience foods on hand for the high-pollen count days that always make me too sick to prepare meals from scratch.  But as grateful as I am to find another gluten-free food that I actually enjoy and want to stock in my pantry, this is one that will have to be an occasional indulgence. Because even though it is gluten-free and its target market is more health conscious than average, this product is quite high in sodium. I'm very surprised that health-conscious parents would feed this to their children often enough to need a subscription! Especially when frozen vegetables are so quick and easy to prepare.
I send this product every month or so to my Grandchildren in Virginia.My granddaughter has to eat Gluten free food and this one is good for her.

column9: This stuff is amazing - and the Amazon price can't be beat!
column10: My 3 year old AND my husband are gluten intolerant (and we have suspicions about my 1 year old daughter - Yay for genetics! lol). Mac & cheese was one of my son's favorite things to eat prior to our little health 'discovery' about a year ago and it used to break my heart to have to explain over and over to a toddler why he couldn't have simple macaroni (or cookies, crackers, pancakes... you get the idea). This stuff is a LIFESAVER. It tastes great - my son gobbles it up in no time every time I make it for him. The only store that I can find this at is a major-chain health food store that's about 25 miles away - and the price is double what Amazon is charging. Buy it - you won't be disappointed. I'm a customer for life.
I buy this gluten free mac for my husband but, I love his mac and cheese better than none gluten free versions.Totally worth buying!!!

Boiling the noodles a minute or too longer makes the noodles softer if that's your preference (it is mine). Make sure that you have a lot of water in the pot to boil the noodles and remove the starches. Then before you add the noodles back into the pot, melt two pats of butter and two slices of Kraft sharp cheddar cheese in the pot until it is the consistency of a rich cheese sauce.  Don't overcook this sauce - it will dry out!  When mixing the powdered cheese, use whole milk instead of the reduced fat milk and wisk the mixture until it is smooth.  Add the sauce you wisked into the pot with the noodles and the first cheese sauce base.  Heat the entire mixture again for just a minute or two until the sauce thickens up.  The final dish is incredibly rich and delicious.  Easily comparable to the best box product out there...seriously! And it's gluten free.
My children really love this mac and cheese.  Before going gluten free, the only other mac and cheese they ate was annies so it's great they have an alternative!!  Thanks
I was very happy to eat some gluten free mac & cheese.It was good, but I didn't boil it long enough so it was chewy.The cheese sauce had good flavor. Yummy!

My husband and I love this gluten free pasta.  You do not feel too stuffed after having this like regular mac and cheese. I usually mix the cheese mix with yoghurt and it makes a creamy cheese sauce.  Delicious!
This is a very good alternative to regular box mac'n cheese. I think it is even better as left over warmed up in microwave the next day.
A good experience.  I live in Costa Rica and we don`t have many gluten free products.  This way (internet) is very important for us.
This is a must have staple in my home. It tastes great and is nice for those quick on the go days. No regrets having this auto shipped monthly to my home.

versus making your own gluten free mac and cheese (or any mac and cheese for that matter). Great for quick dinners for the kids, or even as a side. I doctor it up by adding milk and butter ~ the same as you would for any other boxed mac and cheese. It's a keeper!

My daughter has a gluten allergy and is very upset that she can no longer eat many of her favorite foods.  Her absolute favorite was mac and chesse and this has made a great substitute!  We have tried other gluten free brands but this is her fave.  She loves it!

I have tried most of Annie's pasta products and have yet to find one that tastes as good as this one.  The others tasted artificial to me.  The cheddar mac is a really good substitute for the "real" thing.

column9: Great tasting, texture mac and cheese
column10: This is so delicious it's difficult to keep it stocked in the house, even though I buy it by the case. We usually add a little bit of additional cheese and sometimes make it an entire meal by adding broccoli and a little ground turkey. Great staple that I won't be without.

column9: Best replacement for mac n cheese I have found
column10: I just add a little shredded cheese to mine to thicken it up a bit. I have tried the frozen gluten free mac n cheese and it had no taste. This is the best I have found so far, apart from making it myself of course :)
I love this mac and cheese and the price by the case cant be beat by my local stores. My husband who hasn't like any of my gluten free food actually would steal bites of it lol

column9: Best gluten-free mac and cheese I have found!
column10: If you are looking for anything close to Kraft, this would be it.  I like to add a little extra cheese, just for extra flavour.

The flavor and texture of the macaroni is decent; not as good as Tinkyada rice pasta products I've had, but palatable.  But the "cheese" sauce is seriously lacking.  I had to add a considerable amount of shredded cheddar cheese to make this actually taste cheesy.  Given the high price per (puny) serving, I shouldn't have to be doctoring it up to get to taste like macaroni and CHEESE.

I am going to take the advise of the first reviewer and add a bunch of stuff. I guess I was hoping this would taste like Kraft Mac and Cheese and no go. My kids like it and that is what matters most I guess. We just went gluten free and so I maybe over time we will get used to it. We are also eating rice sticks that are sold mostly to chinese restaurants and those are GREAT! Made with just rice and water-you can use them for just about anything.I guess that will be more to my taste. Good luck on this item-not for me-kids would say it is pretty good though.

column9: Awesome GF & All Natural Mac & Cheese!
column10: You couldn't ask for better Mac & Cheese that's GF, all natural, easy to make, and doesn't cost a fortune!

for the first time since I was diagnosed with the celiac disease (2 years ago at the age of 27) I've found that the taste of this pasta is the same as what I was used to eat. I've literally quited pasta before I've found them!

column9: Nice flavor and great texture to the noodles
column10: Annie's GF Rice Pasta and Cheddar Mac & Cheese does not have the same flavor as what you ate before going gluten free so do not expect it to taste the same.  After you get over the fact that it does not taste like Kraft you can appreciate it for what it is, a nice way to have a quick meal.  It is not a main dish, more of a lunch.  I cook the noodles exactly in the range printed on the box (setting a timer). They always turn out al dente.  Then I add the powder and some coconut oil (as a butter replacement).  I stir that up and then add some milk, less than the package recommends because I like a sharper flavor.  I return it to low heat as I stir and combine the cheese powder with the milk.  It turns out smooth with a mild cheese flavor.  I divide the box in half for two adult servings.  My husband eats the whole box.For a change I have also mixed freshly grated Parmesan cheese with it for a change and I love the flavor that adds!

Annie's gluten free is better than regular mac and cheese to my husband and I (who is a real lover of the dish)! We started eating according to our blood type which means gluten free.  We were buying this macaroni and cheese at about $4 a box.  Buying it in bulk is much more efficient, and we really enjoy the product.  Shipping was prompt and on time as predicted.  This product really is a great substitute for Kraft. Kudos Annies!
My daughter is celiac and really missed Kraft's macaroni & cheese.  Luckily we found Annie's because she loves it.  She now lives in Ireland and I have to ship it to her by the case.

I got this for my husband and he loved it. He can't eat gluten and I think he was relieved to see that he still could have the foods he used to eat. My only complaint is that it seemed to be almost half the amount of the nongluten products. He's a big eater, so I had to make two boxes. But I'm glad the product is available.

column9: Good substitute for "regular" box mac & cheese
column10: I buy this product for my son who is on a low wheat diet.  It's pretty good but as others have noted you must cook the rice pasta longer than the box indicates for it to be edible (especially for a child).  After the pasta is cooked I prepare it just like you would prepare the typical box mix (add the butter/margarine back to the pan with the hot pasta, then add in a small amount of milk to get the correct consistency).  If you have an extra minute or two, it is also better to heat up the mixture in the cooking pot/pan.  This blends everything together really well.  My opinion is that it is not good at all if you follow their preparation directions (my son has rejected it several times when prepared by their directions).

column9: Great healing properties for burns and cuts!
column10: I have used this Manuka Honey for various types of degree burns. Burns heal, faster, cleanly and leave less scarring. I also used it on a really bad laceration and crushed finger tip that was almost cut off from a door. The price might be a little expensive, but its well worth the price for the healing properties this awesome medical grade honey has. Look for either the MGO 400 or its equivalent UMF 20+. This type of honey is not like table honey, it a powerful honey that is only found and created in New Zealand has great antimicrobial, anti-fungus, antibacterial, antiviral, antibiotic and antiseptic properties. It can also be used for acne, skin disorders, and is safe for use in infections in the eye socket, nasal cavity, and ear cavity. It may be taken orally to provide great health for your digestive system and overall health. Do your own research and be patient, and you will see its great healing benefits. I highly recommend this product!

column9: Initially sceptical but it is doing as predicted
column10: Cleared up my lingering laryngitis, which was not being helped with any dr prescribed medication. We have used it 3-4 times now when the family have seemed to be coming down with colds. A teaspoon in the morning - we put it on the cereal or eat it off a spoon, within 2 days in each case we were back on track.(ie. green boogers the color of lettuce and severe congestion, to clear mucus and next to no congestion). My mother in Australia put us on to it - she used the UMF 24 to clear her own Laryngitis and enlarged nodules on her vocal cords (she's a teacher and after 40 years of yelling after kids I guess it took it's toll - I guess I didn't help much on that score either!). As a side affect she noticed it really alleviated her arthritis aches and pains, so she now eats the active honey as a form of maintenance. She's a firm believer.

column9: BETTER than the other MORE EXPENSIVE manuka
column10: I purchased this brand after trying several others, including the most popular brand on Amazon.  I must say that this brand (Manuka Health) has been the best one yet.  It is better than the most popular Wedderspoon brand and better than the more expensive Watson and Sons. So, if you're looking for quality then this is the one for you.  UMF/MGO rated and does not disappoint.  Definitely will purchase again.

This is pretty pricey so I use it as a "last resort" when I am having digestion/stomach issues. It works great for that, but is so expensive that I try other things first.  The price is the only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5.

column9: We love this and the price is decent...
column10: I've read wonderful things about the benefits of this honey. Hopefully it's not a fad, health tip gone viral. We enjoy the taste. Very sweet and bold. You don't need much to go a long way. The price is decent, granted this type of honey is more expensive than most...but after doing some searching this price was fairly competitive compared to grocery store. We've re-order this because we were happy with it. We use it in our vegan protein shakes. Tasty :)
this is a special kind of honey, tastes different than your traditional, a lil more like medicine, which it is medicinal, does wonders for my stomach issues
The jar was to small and is disiving from the picture that it shows on the web. It was 1/2 half empty already when i open the jar.I hope this is helpfull when you buy this product.
Bought for my wife and she took to it right away. SHe is the one who requested the honey and it is practically empty. Had to get more.

column9: Nice light tea with earthy flavor
column10: I'm on my second order of tea (having already gone through 12 boxes) and I've come to really enjoy this tea. It's light enough that I can drink two cups everyday and the flavor never gets old.The brown rice is the real winner here. It compliments the green tea perfectly. This tea seems to have a settling effect on my stomach and has enough caffeine to give you a little boost without giving me a headache (which I almost always get from drinking coffee).

Green tea by itself is nice, but adding brown rice gives the green tea a smoother after taste. It adds a nice nutty flavor that compliments sometimes bitter taste of green tea. Eden brand is definitely one of the better ones on the market.

Eden Foods Inc. is the oldest independent organic food producer in the United States, having been formed in 1968 in Ann Arbor, Michigan. One of their product lines is a range of interesting and delicious teas. A really interesting tea is their traditional genmaicha - a Japanese tea made with green tea and roasted brown rice. It has a mild flavor that includes the green tea (it can get lost if there are too many other favors) but also a sort of earthy, smokiness.Want a great drink experience? Drink it with sugar and a thin slice of orange!This is a delicious tea, from an excellent company. If you are into organic, and want a great tea, then get this wonderful genmaicha.(Review of Eden Organic Green Tea with Brown Rice, Traditional Genmaicha)
best genmai cha I have tasted. I have tried different one's from my local asian market and I think the nutty flavor of this one is tops!
Love this tea...it has the distinct nutty, roasted flavor of brown rice.Hot or iced, it's the best!

column9: Eden Organic Green Tea with Brown Rice
column10: This is a good flavored, lightly nutty tasting tea.  We received it promptly and was what we expected.  Would recommend it to others that don't care for sweet teas.

My wife liked the Yamamotoyama Genmai-cha Green Tea with Roasted Brown Rice, 1.69-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12) green tea with roasted brown rice & asked me to order more.  While I was shopping, I found the same type of tea from Eden.  The Eden tea appealed to me because it was organic, got great reviews, and was more expensive than the Yamamotoyama brand, so I assumed it was better quality.  When I got the tea, I made a cup of each at the same time to compare.  I was surprised to see that the less expensive Yamamotoyama was a little darker, and the roasted brown rice flavor was stronger.  I realize the roasted brown rice green tea is considered inferior, but if you like that taste, I think more of it is better.  I think the reason for the difference is that, the Yamamotoyama had about twice as much tea in the bag as the Eden.  I'll try to post some pictures.

column9: Great Genmaicha but not the best
column10: This is a great tea, no doubt about it. However, the rice flavor overpowers that of the green tea. Actually, I don't know if you can really taste green tea at all. If you want a more balanced organic Genmaicha then I would highly recommend Two Leaves & a Bud Organic Gen Mai Cha Tea. It's more expensive but it's much more balanced and you can taste both green tea and toasted rice. Give it a try and you won't be disappointed!
Plain tea or even regular green tea does not do it for me anymore thanks to this DELICIOUS tea! No sweetener required...breakfast, lunch, dinner or anytime. I Love this tea!
I use several bags of this tea.  Organic, great value and great tasting.I bought a case of it... great shelf life and great to have it delivered to door with amazon prime w/o shipping costs.

I love the convenience of ordering this special tea from Amazon.com.Genmaicha, the Japanese Green Tea with Brown Rice is wonderful for soothing my stomach.I drink a cup or two every morning to rid myself of the "queazies."

Absolutely my favorite tea, hands down.It tastes light and nutty with a beautiful golden color and really nice aroma. I buy mine at a local grocery store and I can't imagine ever going without it. The tea bags are individually packaged and come in your standard-shaped tea bags. I've never had loose genmaicha so I can't compare the tastes. It's hard to get much better than this stuff though.
I purchased these as a gift for my Mother.  To quote her, "YUM".

If you want to make sure that everything in your office is humming smoothly, make sure you pick up these chocolate bars for Valentine's day.  Every secretary absolutely loved the chocolate itself.  It's very rich, and the freeze-dried raspberries were far superior to the usual raspberry cream or artificial flavorings. As an added bonus, each wrapper has a poem in it, making the gift that much more thoughtful.  If you have 8 women in your life who like chocolate, or one woman who LOVES chocolate, this is a fantastic purchase.I even kept 2 bars to use for chocolate mousse, which I can't say enough good things about.

column9: Chocolove Premium Chocolate Bars, Raspberries in Dark (55%) Chocolate,
column10: I was scared to try this flavor bar, I love the other ones by this brand so I wanted to branch out and give this one a try.  I thought that it was going to have this fake raspberry flavor to it and that it was going to leave a terrbile after taste but it was really really tasty.  There were real raspberries in this dark chocolate bar and the flavors melded together so well.  You wont be dissapointed in this one bit.
Simply a rush of amazing chocolate goodness of which words fail me in any attempt to adequately describe.

I used to hate dark chocolate. The ones I tried were bitter and bland. Then one day I tried this delicious chocolate. It was smooth, flavorful, full of cocoa-y goodness that melts on your tongue. Since then, I've tried other brands like lindt, green and blacks, endangered species, scharfenberger's... They're all good, but none surpass chocolove in taste.

I had a problem with my order on a different website trying to order this same product, but I had no problem receiving my item the second time with this company.Product: Dark chocolate squares kissed with pieces of raspberries. The surface of one piece of the chocolate is engraved with a cute, little heart. The chocolate itself is sweet but lightly bitter.Service: Their customer service is  great. They were nice to talk to and made sure that my item would be shipped to me in a timely fashion.

column9: Good chocolate, and fruit lends crispy twist
column10: I bought a single of these bars as part of an Xmas gift, and this one was one of the best.  The freeze dried raspberries are definitely different from other fruit in chocolate I've had: they are actually a little crispy, which was a surprisingly nice touch.  The chocolate was good, and the packaging is attractive.  The love poem is a little lame, but in general, I'd buy this again.  In fact, I'm considering it right now.

column9: Decadent dark chocolate; a healthy treat and attractive gift
column10: The news just keeps getting better and better for dark chocolate!Dark chocolate contains flavanol, the phytochemicals that boost the function of vital endothelial cells, which line up inside the blood vessels, thus slashing the risk of cardiovascular disease. Eating dark chocolate also releases dopamine, a feel-good hormone.Now, we've learned that dark chocolate helps you lose weight!A study released this month by the University of Copenhagen suggests that eating a little dark chocolate rather than milk chocolate may banish cravings for sweet, salty and fatty foods and thus make you lose weight.Health benefits aside, we purchased these dark chocolate bars from Chocolove as a Christmas gift. We send a holiday care package to our friends living overseas each year. Each package includes an assortment of gifts and treats, which we try to buy from local companies here in the Northwest (Chocolove is produced in Boulder, Colorado).The Amazon order includes a box of 12 bars, each containing freeze-dried raspberry pieces enveloped in Belgian dark chocolate crafted from African cocoa beans. Of course, we tested one bar before sending off the rest as Christmas gifts.These chocolate bars are decadent and nicely accompany a cup of hot tea.In summary, these chocolates are delicious, reasonably priced and the attractive package design (each bar includes a love poem!) makes this a perfect gift for Christmas, Valentine's Day or any occasion when you want to share your love.BTW: In addition to this box of dark chocolate bars, we also purchased and recommend McSteven's Olde English Toffee and McSteven's Jolly Blend Cocoa as Christmas gifts.Last year, we bought truffle collections from Seattle Chocolates to send overseas. Each order -- Blackberry Crème Truffles, White Chocolate Orange Truffles and Pink Polka Dot Assorted Truffles - included three boxes of individually wrapped truffles. These chocolates are no longer available on Amazon but keep an eye out should they return.

I gotta say im very impressed with the quality  and preformance of this product. I've used protein shakes, weight gainers, etc and nothing comes close to this. One or two pills 15 mins before your workout and your good to go. Makes going throught reps a breeze, and since I've been on it added 10 lbs of lean muscle and just feel ripped. Overall great product!!

I experienced what you are supposed to with kre alkalyn - a bloat-free strength surge. Problem is that it has now twice caused a very strange reaction - I develop a constant, small burping habit - EXTREMELY ANNOYING! I researched the problem and all I could come up with is that the "PH buffering" aspect of the product threw my PH off - and created a GERD-like reaction - burping. I went on an alkaline-forming food regimen and the problem went away in a few days...

This is my favorite go to dinner when I want something really tasty, but really easy and fast.  My favorite way to make it is to bring it to a simmer and add chicken breast, so that it cooks in the soup.  Sometimes we add a small can of corn, and sometimes, some fresh basil shredded on top at the end.  It's absolutely delicious!!!!!! Enjoy!!

column9: As close to fresh made as you'll get!!
column10: This is fresh tasting and has all the ingredients you'd want....the lemongrass and galangal are GREAT in the can...they only add to the flavor and are easy to pick out, and there's not too much that it's annoying or too filling in the broth content.I can't agree with another reviewers input on it being too spicy....unless you're just not used to Thai or Asian chiles in cooking, or are not used to hot spices.  I actually added fresh hot chiles because I like it hot!As it is, this is a great base!  I added some chicken breast and a bit of chicken stock, fresh mushrooms, fresh cilantro, some fresh chopped red serranos, squirt of lime juice and some bean sprouts and you've got a meal!  If you're camping or in a rush, the soup alone from the can is wonderful as well.Let me repeat that....what comes in the can is perfectly WONDERFUL and you don't need to add anything if you don't want too.SOOO happy this is available!!

This soup is really wonderful. I used to buy it at a supermarket 10 years ago, then I moved and couldn't locate it again (at any local stores). I finally brokedown and ordered a case online. Tastes as good as I remembered.

column9: Good Flavor. Good Spice. Good out of the Can or as Base for Additional Ingredients.
column10: Thai Kitchen describes this soup as "a delicious blend of coconut milk and the traditional Thai flavors of ginger and lemongrass".  It is a very good blend, and I really enjoy the spice and flavor.  The soup does have an initial bite because of the spice, but if you are a spicy food fan, it is not overwhelming at all.We use the soup either straight out of the can or as a base for a larger, more ingredient-filled soup.  Either way, this is a yummy soup that I will buy over & over again.NOTE: Picture on can is misleading.  The soup is more "brothy" than chunky.  In fact, not many "chunks" at all.Serving Size: 1/2 can - 2 servings/canPer Serving: 200 caloriesTotal Fat: 13g (saturated)Cholesterol: 0mgSodium: 730mgTotal Carb: 19gDietary Fiber: 1gSugars: 11gProtein: 0g
This soup is not for just eating! Use it on fish, chicken when baking.The flavor is outstanding!!!!Best soup for cooking with other items!

Bought a case of this soup & am sooo happy I did! It's just THE perfect thing to have when I get one of my "just have to have it" Thai food cravings which, invariably, occur when our local Thai restaurant is closed! No problem with this can on-hand to the rescue! It's perfect as it is just from the can & not too spicy at all! I eat everything in the can & I love that the lemon grass & Thai ginger pieces, galangal, are tender enough to eat! Makes a perfectly tasty & quick meal for two when I add a little bit of shredded chicken breast, some corn, can of Asian straw mushrooms & a cup or two of Thai Jasmine rice! Very filling & just hits the spot & satisfies that craving! Can't beat the price of less than $3.00 a can! Going to definitely order another case for this coming winter season! Nothing like a steaming hot pot of delicious Thai goodness on a chilly winter's evening but it's also good anytime of the day & I admit I've even made this for breakfast! Highly recommend, if you love Thai soup as much as I do & your Thai restaurant is closed! Great by itself but also makes for a wonderful soup base to creatively add whatever protein or veggie you want!
I love taking this soup and adding frozen vegetables and meat to, let it simmer awhile.  Delicious large meal for 2.

column9: Very nice mild and balanced Thai Coconut Soup
column10: I like the flavor of this mild Thia Coconut ginger soup by Thai Kitchen and it is gluten-free.  You can easily add spice and lime leaf and lemongrass if you want to make a spicer Thom Yum  or Thom Kai or you can leave it mild.  My local WF says MSRP is $2.69 and that's what they sell it for so i don't know why the MSRP is shown higher on Amazon but you end up pretty much paying about full price without a discount for bulk purchase.  It is a nice soup base to add other veggies too as well and satisifies that I-gotta-have-Thai hankering.

Shaved coconut, mushrooms, baby corn, lemon grass, bamboo shoots and a perfectly balanced flavor profile. It is made with whole Thai chiles, however, which give it a lite bite, so you might want to keep an eye out for them.

The nutritional information about this product on the Amazon website is incorrect.  Rather than having 14 grams of carbs (including 3 grams of fiber) per serving of 7 ounces as the Amazon website indicates (as of 3/21/12), the nutritional information on the can states that the product has 19 grams of carbs (including 1 gram of fiber).  In terms of "net carbs" this means while the nutritional information on the Amazon website suggests a serving has 11 grams net carbs, in fact a serving has 18 grams net carbs, an increase of more than 60 percent over what the website indicates.I haven't tasted the stuff nor will I so my rating is not based on the taste of the product.  Rather it is based on the incorrect nutritional information posted by Amazon which misleads those of us who are trying to limit their intake of carbohydrates.

This has a wonderful flavor but tongue-searing, eye-watering effect.  It isSO spicy hot - the other reviewer must have an asbestos-lined mouth to call it bland! I diluted it down with regular coconut milk, chunks of chicken breast, julienne carrots, and finally added some instant mashed potato flakes to thicken it up, and eventually was able to enjoy more than a couple of spoonfuls of it at one time. It is definitely worthwhile, but also has way too much of the inedible chunks of ginger and lemongrass. Try it at your own peril!
Bustelo would be my second choice.  Instead, I would recommend tryingMayorga Organic Cafe Cubano.  Mayorga will ship to you. Their beansare nice, fresh, dark and oily.  Great strong coffee.

column9: The best cuban coffee out there...
column10: In my attempt to duplicate the Cafe Cubano's my wife and I have in Miami, I bought this product after much research.Cannot get this where I live (Colorado) so had to order online.  This is the supreme standard of Cuban-style coffee beans.  Beans came in perfect condition and vacuum packed in the bag displayed.I have not tried Pilon, but these two brands come from the same company in Miami.  Pilon from what I gather is the more standard version, while the Bustelo Supreme is the higher line.Trick - be sure grind these very very fine, and add (lots of) sugar in the carafe where the espresso will pour into from the machine, this allows the sugar to carmelize and it tastes more authentic.

This is the best coffee we've found commercially available.  The whole bean product gives us a fresh cup of coffee every morning.  The flavor is smooth, but strong.  There's no comparison to the yellow can Bustelo (as seen on two and a half men).  We buy four pounds at a time and, with Amazon's shipping, it's really a bargain.  There's no better coffee around.

column9: Where are all the high fructose monkeys?
column10: Cause this stuff has it, Lea & Perrins doesn't!But thats not why I'm rating this so low. It gets two stars because its terrible,a thin watery pitiful substitute for L&P that does no justice to any dish, andespecially not to a Bloody Mary.Heinz is a pretty good brand name, I have never understood why they cant get thisright. Check it yourself, pull a bottle from the shelf, turn it upside down and seehow quickly it runs down the sides leaving nothing behind. I suppose if you cookedthis down to about a 60% solution it would be ready to use, but right out of thebottle its a pretty weak substitute for real Worcestershire sauce. I did have abottle of this that I fortified with a Tsp of anchovy paste and it tasted much better.

column4: D. Mikels "It's always Happy Hour here"
column10: The herbs and spices in HEINZ WORCESTERSHIRE SAUCE perk up and enhance the flavor and taste of a wide variety of foods, and are terrific enhancements for cooking, seasoning, and marinating.  But this, ladies and gentlmen, THIS is what WORCESTERSHIRE SAUCE was made for:*1.5 lbs. lean ground beef*half an onion, sliced and diced*2 eggs*dash of milk (2% fat recommended)*4 table spoons HEINZ WORCESTERSHIRE SAUCE*2 table spoons Tony Roma's Barbeque Sauce*1/2 table spoon Heinz White Vinegar*pinch of McCormick Garlic Salt*season with McCormick Black Pepper*add sprinkling of Quaker Oats*stir/mix thoroughly; place in cooking pan*cover top of meatloaf with a layer of Heinz Ketchup*sprinkle liberally with Lawry's Seasoned Salt*bake at 385 degrees F for 50-55 minutes*EnjoyIt's the best meatloaf on the planet, hands down, and it's ultimate flavor is made possible by HEINZ WORCESTERSHIRE SAUCE. Wow. I'm hungry!--D. Mikels, Esq.

I tried Coco Samba for the first time from a friend and loved it. I am a huge fan of anything coconut, but it must be fresh and this drink was exactly what I was looking for. It was if I stuck a straw right into a coconut. The taste is addicting...I have to buy a case! I like the container too :)
While in the mid-west I discovered these in the large bags and set about finding them on the web.Costs a bit more with shipping but these are the best snack chip/comfort food in fhe universe!!

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column10: I'm a big fan of chamomile tea, partially because it's one of those teas where you don't have to worry about letting the tea bag steep overly long. (Tea drinkers will know what I'm talking about.)This has a nice mellow flavor and brews up quickly. It's the typical chamomile flavor, and while it's very, very hard to mess up a chamomile tea, this is pretty nice. It's incredibly soothing- so much so that I had to fight the sleepy feeling that drifted over me. (So if you're having trouble sleeping, this will be perfect!)I'll absolutely drink this brand again.

column9: For those nights when sleep is difficult
column10: A friend was kind enough to send me some Harney & Sons Egyptian Chamomile Tea, and I have had ample cause to rejoice at my friend's generosity!  It is awesomeness epitomized.  Ideal for those nights when sleep is interrupted and one needs to recompose oneself into something suitable for slumber.  I recommend the Egyptian Chamomile, and all products by Harney & Sons, with unhesitating approbation and undiminished praise.

Doesn't even taste remotely of red velvet cake as described.  However, it is warm and rich, and the rooibos base is loaded with antioxidants.  I tried adding some coconut milk, but it didn't really help the sweetness.  It's just not there.  A nice middle of the day tea, but definitely not dessert!

I bought a can of this in a retail store. My coworker loved it so much she took it from me so I bought another can. I served it to several friends and they all love it. It's an "earthier" tasting tea so it might not jive with many people. It's got subtle undertones and a deep rich flavor. Adding some sugar makes it even tastier. It's a great substitute for a hot cocoa on a cold night. If you're the kind of tea drinker who expects artificial, corn-syrup laden Snapple flavors in your tea, then don't bother with this one.

column9: Nice cup of tea, but not worth the price
column10: I love the Coconut Cocoa tea, so I was excited to try this one, even though it was listed at about four dollars more than I paid for the other.  This was a nice cup of tea, but despite brewing/steeping at directed, I don't get any chocolate flavor from it.  I'll drink it, but won't be buying another can, especially at $10.69.

column9: I love it but it's not for everyone
column10: I love the flavor and smell of this tea but pretty much everyone I work with hates it.  Take it with a grain of salt because taste is subject to perspective and I find that while many will not like this tea, some will love it.

column9: A great alternative to dessert - simply delicious!
column10: Well, I don't quite know what the other reviewers are talking about... I've tried this tea and found it absolutely delicious. When I first opened it, I did get a strong rooibos smell, as this is the tea base. However, once brewed, the smell changes to a sweet, tangy smell with chocolate undertones. simply wonderful.It's true that it doesn't taste exactly like red velvet. I mean, come on, you're talking about tea... not a true cupcake with frosting. However, I add a splash of vanilla coffeemate and it tastes very close to me. I get the chocolate undertone and the flavor is sweet and amazing, with a bit of a tange, not unlike true red velvet. It's a perfect after dinner treat! Plus, the bright red hue they have managed to develop really makes you feel like you're drinking liquid red velvet (thanks to all natural beet extract!).I only gave this a 4/5 because without the coffeemate, it isn't quite sweet enough for me, and I think the creaminess helps to bring out the chocolate undertones.Overall, I plan on buying this over and over again in the future!
I love green tea and maybe I'm just not used to the robios tea, but this tastes artificial and kind of gross ... not a substitute for something sweet after a meal like I was hoping

column9: A sweet sensation with a very sweet value.....
column10: As one customer stated, it is hard to find. Only very few places sell these today. Good thing I went to amazon. Why pay $0.99 for each bar elsewhere when you can get it here on Amazon for only [...] a case? If you have Amazon prime, this deal may make it sweeter since you get free 2-day delivery. I have tested my amazon prime benefits for the first time on this item and quite frankly, it was way faster than the Super Saver shipping speed! No minimums were required, but a $25 minimum was required for the Super Saver shipping promotion. Get amazon prime today and save big on what you really like! Don't get this elsewhere. Get it from amazon!

I ordered these for my son, who LOVES the raspberry mambas.  We opened up every package in the entire box to find a total of two raspberry packs (out of 24 packages).  The rest have lemon, orange, and strawberry.Also, note that these are the three-pack packages, not the four-pack packages.If you like lemon, orange, and strawberry, this may be a good deal.  If, like us, you expected more raspberries, it will be disappointing.
This product is excellent recieved as promised and these our yummy. I like amazon so you should try them they won't let you down.
My kids love these, I think they're okay.  They're hard to find and this is the best price I found.

Friends of ours (former Vermonters) introduced us to this product a couple of years ago and we have loved this refreshing "mint" ever since.  Actually, there is no peppermint in it at all, just the crisp taste of ginger, mixed with organic Vermont maple syrup, organic tapioca syrup, and organic crystallized cane juice.  I have to dole this out to my daughter in small increments or she would eat half a tin in half a minute.  She can't stop!  It's great after a meal as it helps with the digestion though it is good just about any time.  Once we had run out of the GingerMints and bought some other brand.  There was no comparison.  We're glad that we could get this 6-pack.  We bought two.  All this talk of GingerMints has made me want to pop a few in my mouth.  Mmmm...

I have never had much stuff with ginger so I had no idea what to expect with these when I picked up a tin. They have a very satasfying kick at first, but settle into a very pleasent sweetness. I tried a different brand of ginger mints later and was so disgusted I spit it out and threw out the tin. These are worth a try whether you love ginger or arenotyet familiar with it.

column9: Not quite gingery enough for me
column10: The ginger flavor is a bit too subtle for me and it's overwhelmed by sweetness. I think most people would like this balance, but I'm looking for more of a "bite" in my ginger candy. The texture is a little unusual - one reviewer described it like those valentine candy hearts, and I'd say that's pretty accurate. They dissolve a little too quickly in my opinion. I probably wouldn't buy these again.

This GingerMints have a great flavor.  They have a subtle vanilla and maple flavor although the predominant flavor of course is ginger.  They tend to melt in your mouth and are not really granular textured.

PROS: cute packaging (albeit somewhat annoying) and true ginger taste.CONS: texture, high price tag, and uppity self-righteousnessMy brother and I tried them on a whimsy and both quickly came to the conclusion that we wouldn't buy them again.  Their ginger kick is fine and subtle but the texture seriously reminded me of chalky valentine candy hearts (you know, the ones that people can't seem to get rid of fast enough). The inside of the tin was also full of blatant feel-goodness. I hate that kind of talk on organic/all-natural products. If you have a good product that's also good for the environment, it should speak for itself.p.s. altoids are pretty gluten-free too and nut-free too (though they may be processed in a plant that also processes other products).

5 Stars for the coffee and 1/2 Star for the price - CAN YOU SAY RIPOFF?We love the blond roast Veranda Blend from Starbucks.  That is surprising since I've never been a big fan of Starbucks coffee.  However this blend hits it out of the park.  It has a rich, pungent and unique flavor that is exotic and potent.  In fact we are hooked on this blend to the exclusion of other coffees.Unfortunately, I will NOT be a buyer here until Amazon or their marketplace sellers get realistic with their pricing.  They are taking the Costco package (40oz) and reselling it at a 50% mark up!  NO Thanks, I will continue to buy this great coffee at Costco for $19.95/40oz bag.  Get real Amazon this is a ripoff.  Very un-Amazon.  In fact, this package equates to buying the retail 1 lb bag at $12/lb which I can get anytime at my local Von's/Safeway.  Too bad.  I would love to sign up for a subscribe and save on this item if it were priced realistically.Disregard the 1 star review posted here.  This reviewer must have ground the beans incorrectly or brewed the coffee incorrectly which is obvious by the content of their review.  I have never had a problem with either the brewing or flavor of this awesome coffee.Update: Costco stores are discontinuing this item so they have reduced the price, I just bought 10 bags (yep 25 pounds) at $14.95/bag = $5.98/lb!
Great service, got here when it was supposed to, delicious coffee, I'll order again! Blonde roast is a great alternative if the other SB blends are too strong for you.

column9: Plugs paper filters - overflows everyday & Bland
column10: Blend ? Blonde ? no they mean BLAND.  Starbucks Veranda Blend, Blond . . . . The taste is a bit bland, but the main problem is that it plugs up paper filters causing an overflow on the counter every day . . . or when you think its done, you remove the coffee pot and the basket valve dumps a cup of coffee all over the place because it is jamned up with grounds that ran over the top of the paper filter.This issue is the coffee, not the coffee maker, but maybe some coffee makers that feed the hot water in more slowly would not have this problem.So, we tried mixing this stuff 1/2 and 1/2 with Starbucks French Roast just to get rid of it, but it still plugs the paper filters mixed with the French Roast.There may be variables with differennt filters and coffee makers, but we cannot be the only one with this big mess every day.

OK, so this soup is full of fat and sodium, but it's still the best tasting cream of chicken soup anywhere! If fat and sodium is a problem, then just drink less of it. The best tasting cream of chicken is when you add 1/2 full milk and 1/2 water, but that might be a bit too much, so you can use 2% milk instead. The way I make it is to put the soup in the pan and slowly add the milk and water. If you add water/milk right away to the soup you'll get lumpy soup. And there are tons of recipes on the internet, it's just the best tasting soup ever!

column4: D. Mikels "It's always Happy Hour here"
column10: Certainly, CAMPBELL'S CREAM OF CHICKEN SOUP is excellent in a wide variety of dishes and recipes, but this, ladies and gentlemen, THIS is where CAMPBELL'S CREAM OF CHICKEN SOUP totally shines:*Take one baking pan.*Pour in one 10.75-ounce can of Campbell's Cream of Mushroom Soup*Pour in one 10.75-ounce can of CAMPBELL'S CREAM OF CHICKEN SOUP*Use one of the cans to add 2 1/2 cans of 2% lowfat milk*Stir thoroughly until the mixture is smooth*Add 6 chicken thighs (or 4 chicken breasts)*Add a pinch of McCormick Onion Salt*Sprinkle McCormick Black Pepper liberally over entire pan*Bake at 385 degrees*After approximately 20 minutes turn chicken over*After approximately 15 minutes turn chicken again*Add Minute White Rice sufficient to absorb the sauce*Bake for approximately 20 more minutes (ovens do vary, but do not remove until chicken is thoroughly cooked)This is a delicious dish, the chicken and rice being thoroughly enhanced by CAMPBELL'S CREAM OF CHICKEN SOUP. Bon appetit!--D. Mikels, Esq.

I've loved this brand of soup since I was a child (I'm 54).  Campbell's Cream of Chicken soup is my must-have "comfort food", and is very nutritious.  I always feel so good & energized after eating a large bowl.I'm lucky that I don't have to avoid salt/sodium, as people with high blood pressure do, since there's quite a bit of sodium in this soup.Also, I wish there were a few more bits of chicken in it, but since Campbell's is trying to keep the price competitive, I'd rather have less chicken than no soup at all!
Poured over hot toast, your oven roast, or eaten as soup, hot or cold...a tasty, nutritious, and economical meal every time...a great addition to your menu.

column9: Delicious and healthier alternative to other fried chips.
column10: Since these are fried in oil, they are by no means a health food, especially if you are focused on calories.  That said though, they are an excellent snack and a much healthier alternative to potato chips or corn chips.The main thing that surprised me about these chips is how good they taste.  To me, they taste just as good, and are just as fulfilling, as the other salty crunchy snacks that I tend to munch on in the evenings.  I enjoy them plain out of the bag, and also find that they are good with salsa or dip.I wish the price was a little lower on these, but otherwise I think they are great.  I highly recommend that you try them.

column9: Great light taste and keeps ya running
column10: This is the best sport drink I have ever used.Most other products I have used in the past left my tummy aching after drinking them.Nuun tablets not only taste great and didn't slow me down.

column9: The piture of the product was confusing
column10: The price said it was for individual tubes but the picture showed a box of 6 tubes.  So I ordered 5 just in case it was a box of 6 but it was 5 tubes not 5 boxes of 6 tubes.  Also, this vendor used a shipping method that means they came by container ship not priority mail.  Suppose to arrive Feb 17th - Came March 6th.I really like this product because in the tropical heat I leach electrolytes and nuun doesn't have any calories and has what I need in it to keep from having to eat salt or chips.  Unfortunately it is hard to come by on Guam.
THis is probably my favorite Nuun flavor of all of them and I have tried most.It is the perfect balance of flavor, not too strong.

I used these for the first time this summer hiking the Grand Canyon and other places out west, we took down bottled sport drink and these tablets to save weight. At home I tried them and thought they taste like watered down grape jello, but not bad. On the trip I was amazed, sports drinks got hot and tasted gross and sticky, made you feel bloated yet still thirsty. These little tabs cover the taste of water, didn't make your mouth feel gross and you could feel the pick up it gave you. Completely satisfied with the product and willing to try other flavors. It was easy to use, pop them in your bottle and they fizz away, a quick shake and your ready to go. Don't pop them in your mouth, as a buddy of mine did thinking thats how you used them, he gagged his way through for quite a while, I still laugh at the memory.

These are great. As a Central Texas deck builder, I'm in the sun all day long. After years of struggling with hydration, I've finally found a solution. I freeze 2, 1 liter bottles and 1 gallon bottle every nite. I add 1 tab to each bottle and I haven't had a single problem hydrating this summer, no cramping at all. THANKS

Nuun is a great product and extremely easy to take on the go. My husband keeps a tube in his golf bag and I keep one in my purse. Fruit punch has a great flavor without being too sweet. Highly recommend this product to anyone looking for a good hydration product.
I work in a dry environment and drink water all day long. I have found many of the Nuun flavors to be very satisfying. This is one of my favorites.

I've tried almost all the flavors and the grape and fruit punch are the best. I am a crossfit trainer and people at the gym steal these from me all the time! Great if you are low or no carb diet like paleo/primal.

I had been using the 'original' Chebe mix. Then from the Chebe website www.Chebe.com, I saw a recipe for sticky rolls using the Cinnamon version of this item. Wow....they got rave reviews from even the folks that didn't need to eat Gluten-free. GOOD STUFF! Easy to make. Certainly an item that will be used again and again at our house. You can use this mix to make several things, so it is a multipurpose mix. Again you can check out www.chebe.com to find ways to use it.

column9: If I can do this, anyone can!
column10: I'm not a very good baker, but I have been sooo craving cinnamon rolls.  I was worried when I read some of the reviews, but I didn't add anything special and they turned out fine.  Well, except for two things: #1, because the mix makes 11 rolls, I put water in the empty muffin holder.  That may have helped them to be so moist and almost slightly fluffy.  And #2, anything tastes good with a cream cheese glaze/frosting so I mixed together 4oz. cream cheese, 1/4 cup butter, 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar, 1 1/2 tsps milk, and 1/2 tsp vanilla and generously frosted the rolls while they were still warm.  I had plenty of frosting left over, so I put it in a baggie and will use it for the next time I make rolls.  I'll just cut a corner of the baggie and squirt the frosting out.  Oh, wait, there's one more thing I did differently.  Before I rolled out the dough, I was going to flour the board (with gluten free flour) but decided instead to lightly sugar it instead.  I dusted the rolling pin now and then with it, and the dough didn't stick to anything.  I've eaten quite a few now and they were delicious straight out of the oven piping hot, slightly warm later on, and cold hours later. They were pretty easy to make, and I am so full now. (A note: my son is not gluten sensitive he's just allergic to wheat so I don't know if the frosting I made is gluten free or not. You'd have to check that out yourself.)

We have converted to a GFCF menu because of my 3 1/2 year old son. He LOVES all of the normal kid stuff: including cinnamon rolls out of the tube. These we very tasty and the entire family liked them. We put brown sugar inside.

What a nice treat these Chebe bread mixes are for those who are trying to adhere to a gluten-free diet.  I have tried several variations and they all have turned out great, including some PB&J "tarts".  And the Amazon price was less than my local natural foods store.

So I happen to miss the taste of yeasty cinnamon rolls, so I added half a packet of rapid rise yeast and let it sit for about half an hour before I put it in the oven...and NOW I'M ORDERING A CASE. Holy heart failure. These are quite possibly the best thing I've eaten in 7 years of being gluten free. THANK YOU, CHEBE!!

A gluten free dream. I love all the chebe breads i have ever tried.... which is this cinna bun, regular, and pizza crust ---- i love the heavy texture, they stay together, and are full of flavor. MmmMMMMmmMMMMmmm!!!!!!!!!thank gawd FINALLY there is some gluten free baked good that i can eat, has no allergens, tastes good, and doesnt have a ingredient list 100 words long! YAY! xoxoThese cinna bun taste so good with nuts and raisins added.... but also banana too!

I've been gluten-free for five years. My husband and I have tried many different bread products. I was very excited to try the cinnamon rolls because I have been craving pastries. I bought the Chebe breadsticks and love them so I thought this was a guaranteed winner too. My husband made a pack for me today. I wasn't too impressed. The texture was more stiff and it had an off taste. I guess I was expecting a "regular" cinnamon roll! :(I've found through the years that you can get used to anything if you want to so I'm sure I will like the cinnamon rolls after a few attempts. I will definitely be sticking with the breadsticks though!

I've done the several batches of this mix. Before anyone claims they hate it, try these simple tricks.1. Add 1 tsp of baking powder -> adds fluff (1 tsp for every cup of flour)2. If allergic to eggs -> use Ener-G egg replacement. Follow the directions. Add 1 tsp of olive oil (help with the texture since the egg fat isn't present)3. DO NOT OVER MIX! GO slow if you have to. Watch a video on knowing when the dough is elastic so you know when to stop. (One of the flours in this batch gets hard from over mixing - will update when I remember which one)4. Keep the 3 tbsp of oil (I used olive oil) Chebe calls for. If you replace with applesauce, it will add as a binder. Trust me, you do NOT want two binders in a recipe.5. Take your time rolling the dough to make it nice and tight. This keeps the Cinnamon mix in the middle.6. To heat up the rolls again, DO NOT USE THE MICROWAVE! Use a toaster oven or a nonstick pan with a cover. I personally use the pan and steam heat the rolls again.These tricks may not work for all. I will update when I learn more and feel free to post your own tricks.

Great that they are gluten free. Unfortunately, they are flavor free.  If you didn't add the butter or sugar as recommended they would be softened cardboard.  They do not turn out as pretty as the box cover.  Not very impressed.

column9: Chebe gluten free cinnamon roll mix
column10: I was extremely dissatisfied with this mix.  My daughter is Gluten free and we were both excited to try them out.  However, in all honesty, we thought they were horrible.  I personally, would never purchase this mix again.  It was a waste of money and time )0:

These are fabulous!  Tastes great, no real 'gluten free' taste as some things have.  My kids loved them also.  They are on the smaller side, and it might help with portion control, but we couldn't stop eating them. =)I would definitly purchase again!  I also love their pizza crust mix.

For those on a gluten free diet sometimes it is difficult to find things that make us happy. Well that is not the case with these Chebe Cinnamon Rolls. When made fresh they are warm, soft and just perfectly cinnamonny! THese are perfect for the mornings with the Sunday paper. With simple ingredients and instructions these are sure to be a favorite.Find them here..Chebe Bread Cinnamon Roll Mix, Gluten Free, 7.5-Ounce Box (Pack of 8)Or get a variety pack and try them all!ChebeAllVariety-12pk
This is the first time I have tried this product.  We loved it.  Will continue to use products by Chebe.

column9: Delicious! But you do need to add eggs, oil, sugar, and cinnamon
column10: When I first made these, I was resentful that I had to add so many of my own ingredients, but I had been searching for a decent gluten-free cinnamon roll for such a long time. Well....the results were worth it. I love 'em!  Instead of baking them in a greased muffin tin, I used cupcake liners and that worked out great. I also added walnuts. And I didn't bother to use a rolling pin. I flattened out the dough inside the mixing bowl, added the fillings, rolled it up and sliced it. The texture is pleasantly chewy. We ate them over a three-day period and, kept in a plastic baggie, they never  dried out. They were just as delicious on day three as on the day they were made. I would imagine that these could easily be turned into a more decadent treat by making four large rolls instead of twelve tiny ones and adding your own vanilla frosting.

column9: Not for us- at least not yet
column10: I notice one reviewer added yeast to the mix- that might make these better.  The taste isn't too bad (I added currants to the filling) but the consistency is nothing like a cinnamon roll.  The way mine turned out they are kind of like bread which hasn't risen properly.  Kind of heavy- and more like crust (doughy crust rather than crunchy) than bread.  i only bought two boxes at my local whole foods- because I've been burned before by things that were supposed to taste like my favorite foods, and then didn't.  I'm going to try adding yeast to my other box of mix- and see if that makes it any better.  Right now I'm disappointed, though.

I was so thrilled with the Chebe pizza dough, and breads I bought that I had dreams that the Chebe cinnamon roll mix would be the same. But they didn't turn out. They where not airy like the other breads, and like every other gluten free cinnamon roll I have tried, the sugar rolled into the middle just cooks the dough to quick. Sad.

Ok, nothing looks like the pic on the box, and these don't really for me, but I loved them anyway. Waited 2 long years to come across something like this, even my daughter likes them - I have to hid them so I have some for myself. My sister also made a huge apple turnover with the mix. Well worth a try!

I love this mix!I make these two ways, either as a sweet bread stick or as monkey bread.To make the sweet bread sticks I follow the instructions on the package then roll out small portions into sticks.  These are great as snacks and to satisfy a sweet tooth without being overly sweet.To make the monkey bread I follow the instructions on the package then roll small balls of dough and place in a baking dish.  I cover the dough balls with a cooked butter/brown sugar and nut mixture and bake.  Super sweet and dense, definitely not an every day snack!This mix is a great starter to make your own recipes, the website also has tons of recipes to try out!

It took the second time for these to be good. The first time, I ate them as they were coming out of the oven, couldn't resist the aroma. Yes they were too chewy, or gooey almost play-doh like. Still good but I did not like the consistency.However, the second time I did as recommended added baking soda/powder, and they did rise a little bit! Again I couldn't resist the aroma, still play-doh like. However the next morning they were PERFECT! Not play-doh like. So if you can resist wait till the next day. I just left them out on counter.Pretty good, next I will try to add some type of frosting.

If you like manioc/tapioca flour/starch, chebe does it best!  I don't care for it as it is too gummy chewy on the inside and doesn't taste like a bakery item to me at all.  But of all the manioc/tapioca products I've tried, I think Chebe does it best!

column9: Not as happy as with other Chebe products
column10: I've used Chebe products for about a year now, and love the cheese and foccacia.  I just haven't gotten the hang of this one.  It comes out hard, and not chewy.  It may be the way I'm fixing it, but after 2-3 attempts, I just gave up.

I tried a free sample pack of the cinnamon roll mix and am sadly disappointed. I've been gluten-free for six months now and am not a bread-y person. However my family has been making cinnamon rolls for Christmas all my life so I thought I would try this out. Doughy, rubbery texture. Literally like eating a piece of rubber. Waste of time in the kitchen.

The box to this product boasts not using eggs or milk, but asks you to use them in the ingredients (many gluten-intolerant folks also cant have milk or eggs). I used the never-fail flaxseed egg replacement and put almond milk instead of cow's milk. The dough had a consistency reminiscent of seitan and was tough to roll and very greasy. The rolls cooked, sure, but they didn't change shape at all, were hard on the outside, and chewy on the inside. Really kind of nauseating. Wouldn't recommend this mix.. especially not for vegans.

column9: Absolutely LOVE this versitile mustard, BUT ...
column10: ... look for it to cost around $7-$8 in stores.  I served the recipe for the breaded baked chicken, found on the Rothschild website, to my family at Christmas and it was SOOOOOO good!  Not one complaint!!!  Even my young niece, who is a very picky eater, relished it.  However, this price is outrageous.

Minute Maid quit selling their frozen lemon juice.  Why, I don't know, but then I needed too find a replacement and juicing lemons is too much work for my arthritic fingers.  So I embarked on an internet search for a replacement.  Lakewood Organic is what I came up with.  Of course it costs more and I have to buy a case at a time, but it tastes better and "organic" has to be a plus, right?  Yeah, I don't know either. But the bottom line is Lakewood tastes really good and it's all I can find.  If Minute Maid brings back their frozen lemon juice again, what will I do?  Well, price is more of a factor now, so I honestly don't know.  If their price were the same, then I'd go Lakewood without a second thought.

Have used the run of the mill lemon juice concentrate from the store to make homemade lemonade. This organic lemon juice is awesome-fresh, natural flavor and makes wonderful homemade lemonade. I have used it in Tabouli salad as well. Delicious!  Enjoy!

For organic lemon juice, this is also a great product at a great price.  Some seasons, small organic lemons run you 99 cents each at the grocery store.  We have recently started making a great deal of raw vegan food, of which much calls for lemon juice.  I love it that we have found this product!

Too often cooking-up something requires fresh lemon juice to give it that certain 'zing'. The stuff from concentrate just doesn't have it. But if the dish calls for lemon juice I would usually find myself heading for the store and paying too much for the lemon or two I needed. Until I found the Lakewood Organic. This stuff is as close to fresh as you can get ( it is pure lemon juice- not from concentrate ) and has that unique clear flavor that real lemons offer.While a little pricey, I still bought a case and keep it refrigerated in our spare frig. The shelf life is extra long this way.  I'm guessing it'll be used up very quickly anyway because my wife just discovered my stash and likes using it on her salads. It also makes great lemonade. A squirt in the ice tea during summer means adding just the right amount of tartness. Good stuff. I will be buying more.

This was our first purchase of Lakewood lemon juice. Right out of the bottle, we were very happy. It is smoother than the other organic brand we normally buy. Now we use less sugar when making lemonade and when poured straight into water it is very tasty. We will be purchasing this again.As an aside, I left positing packaging feedback on this item. It was one of the best packed things we have ever received from Amazon. In a box with custom Styrofoam and well marked "fragile" there is no worry over these getting damaged in transit.A suggestion to Lakewood: I would love to see these in 16 ounces instead.

I have been looking for an organic replacement to REALlemon Juice concentrate.  Looked at a couple of different brands. Even ordered some of the wrong things that didn't even taste like lemon.  This stuff is great!  I put lemon juice in my water on almost a daily basis.  My wife makes a phenomenal lemon merengue pie... now its beyond phenomenal!  I would suggest this to anyone looking for fresh squeezed lemon juice without the work.  Remember, its organic so the price is reasonable.  I did cut back on the amount that I use daily.  I bought this a month ago and have used 3 bottles so far, and gave one to a friend.
I make our own lemonade with this lemon juice.  It has nothing added to it, it's just plain lemon juice.  Therefore it tastes great!  And it's organic!

I like this product enough that I used to buy at least a bottle a week locally - mostly to flavor my mineral water and ice tea, while adding some Vitamin C. I was scared to mail-order a 12-pack of glass bottles filled with liquid. I envisioned disaster. Not to worry. They were set in a special foam spacer insert and well-protected. They all arrived intact. The package was still easy to open. The price is really good. I would not hesitate to order again. Good job!

column9: Use this product to make hard lemonade (Home Brew)
column10: 1) I bought the case to make a 5 gallon batch of hard lemonade. If you arent going to juice your own lemons and want to be able to control the type of sugar added in your must you need to use juice. ReaLemon has preservatives that preclude it's use. Fresh squeezed is WAY too expensive, especially if you want to use organic lemons.2) I used two of the bottles for making lemonade, marinade and doing lemon drops. The only real difference I can see between this product and fresh squeezed is that it lacks the high note astringency that fresh squeezed has. This astringency can mask some of the bitterness inherent to lemon juice. It also does not give you the option to zest the lemon for the essential oils. The flavor is what you would get if you juiced your lemons and allowed it to sit in a bottle for a little while. Thats because that is what this is.FYI the recipe for hard lemonade:2 pounds of light Munton's dried malt extract15 pounds of raw sugar125 ounces (basially a gallon) of this juiceLalvin EC-1118 Yeast2 tbsp of yeast nutrientabout 4 gallons of waterIt turned out awesome. About 16% ABV. I used way too much lemon rendering the drink difficult to consume straight from the bottle. However it was WAY too strong to drink that way. I used this blended 50/50 with a batch of Bavarian Wheat beer. It made a STELLAR shandy. My wife also used it blended with fresh brewed tea. Its what we drank for refreshment all summer. I made it strong and it was great blending with all sorts of fruit juices for sitting on the back porch in the heat of the summer. I'm doubling the recipe this summer it turned out so good but not using as much lemon juice. One case should make about 10 gallons of hard lemonade.

Fantastic, fresh, best taste of them all - only wish it came in larger bottle sizes!  I'm on my third case this year!  Delicious!  Make your next lemonade with this a "Simple Syrup" lemonade recipe.  WONDERFUL!

column9: T H E......B E S T.......L E M O N......J U I C E......( P E R I O D )
column10: LAKEWOOD ORGANIC PURE LEMON JUICE, (here sold as) 12.5-OUNCE BOTTLES, PACK OF 12, tastes far better than my second choice, (Minute Maid Frozen Lemon Juice....which IS on the market, as of this writing...in stores, at least).  Lakewood Organic Pure Lemon Juice IS expensive......but I have seen tiny plastic containers, shaped like lemons, that ALSO are of organic lemon juice...that sell for much more.  Lakewood Organic Pure Lemon Juice is ALL JUICE, and NO WATER....so, (although the juice does not COME from concentrate), it IS, (IF you use lemon juice mainly to make lemonade, as I do), a concentrate, of sorts, (and a natural one!), all in itself.LAKEWOOD ORGANIC PURE LEMON JUICE has a much fresher, and more delicate flavour than Minute Maid Frozen Lemon Juice.  "Lighter" in this case does NOT mean less intense...it's just a teensy bit sweeter, that's all.  NATURALLY sweeter, I'm sure....!A few years ago, I began to weigh SO much that my doctors told me that the pre-diabetes I had had for years, had finally turned into real, Type 2 diabetes!  (Yikes!)  However, just about that time, I had made arrangements to visit a friendin Canada for about 3 weeks....and, having taken the cheapest tickets available, could NOT ask for a refund.  The doctor said it would be OK to go....IF I took things slow and easy, gave myself an extra 2 hours to reach the airport, and took things VERY easy whilst I was on the trip.  And -- try to lose some weight, and cut down, (drastically), on the sugar, fat, and cholesterol,  I took his advice, and, armed with several pamphlets for new diabetics, I boarded the plane to see my friend.We had a nice visit....but unfortunately, I wasn't able to go to all the places I had planned on going.  (I comforted myself with the thought that the "Chateau Fontenac", one of Quebec's premier attractions, had been around a lONG time, and if I didn't see it on THIS visit, I would probably be able to go there next time.I went shopping with my friend, but cut down the shopping trip strictly to 3 hours, and didn't visit all the departments at "The Bay" department store that I wanted to see.
