I even recommended this cake mix to a professional wheat-free bakery that makes rock cakes. I swear, I have cheated a few times before, and this stuff is just as good as a wedding cake. Speaking of wedding cake, if I ever get married, this is going to be what it's made of. I know all you skeptics out there think I'm just probably not a very picky person, but I swear, try this cake. If you cook it correctly, you will NOT regret it! I had my brother try some without telling him it was gluten free, and he just woofed it up and said it was terrific. He was amazed to learn that it was actually gluten free. This will be the best gluten free cake mix you can get your hands on. When I took a bite of this cake, I almost cried, for two reasons; 1. This cake was everything I wanted and more, and 2. The cake was burning my tastebuds off because it was so hot, I couldn't wait for it to cool off! It looked sooo good. BUY THIS CAKE! IT WILL CHANGE THE WAY YOU THINK ABOUT GLUTEN FREE BAKING!

column9: A Decent Cake For Busy Gluten Free Cooks
column10: Kudos to Betty Crocker for jumping into the growing gluten free marketplace with a reasonable price, good-tasting product.  For those who don't usually like mixes, especially from large food corporations, let me say that this mix has nothing artificial in it and just brings together the gluten free ingredients would buy yourself.  You even add your own vanilla ~ nothing artificial.  I have served these as cupcakes to people who *can* eat gluten and those people either said they were indistinguishable or preferable to regular cupcakes.The cakes do easily over-bake, and do dry out within one day (as do many gluten free baked goods), so I give them a 4 star rating.
I am on a gluten free diet - this cake mix is great.  Easy to use and it test great.

Tired of paying $20-$50 for a simple gluten free cake? You can make one at home for just a little more than a traditional cake mix. Simple to make just like any Betty Crocker cake. Use Betty Crocker icing--it's gluten free too!. There is no funny taste from those different flours used by other gluten free cake mix makers. You know what I mean.It tastes like a "regular" cake. My only caution is that it is a little denser than regular cakes and like all gluten free baked goods it doesn't last as long as regular cakes do and tends to dry out after a day or so. But I make cupcakes and freeze some for later-they stay fine in the freezer.But if you're planning to eat it within 48 hours its fine. I have bought commercially made cakes that were not as moist and dried out much faster. All in all, this cake mix is the best I've had.

This cake was actually good!!! It's more dense than normal yellow cake- but I also substituted yogurt for the butter and added a little oil. Less fat! It would be super yummy as cupcakes with some raspberries or other fruit mixed in the batter... or as a coffee cake. Yay Betty for giving us something fast and easy and also Gluten free!!!

I don't have to be gluten free but I had tried it in the past and felt some better so decided to go that route again. A friend told me about this cake mix and I made it tonight but with no frosting, just to eat like a muffin with a summer meal and fruit. Oh my goodness it is so moist and yummy. With the special and the subscribe and save it is way cheaper to get her than in the local grocery like I did today.I can highly recommend this to anyone who wants wonderful gluten free cake/muffins.

For a gluten free cake this is ok. I was planning to try making it with oil but have not done so yet. in gluten free butter unless it's in cookies doesn't stay moist. i still prefer kinni kinnick cake mixes. The problem i had was besides just being ok this only makes 1  8x8 which is disapointing. i felt it didn't hold up by the end of the day it was soggy. i would still use it but not my first choice.
This product works nice. When you drink the tea, you can actually feel the effects of it. It warms up your body inside immediately. It does actually work but you have to stick with it to maintain.

I ordered this sausage because I had it at a christening party. This did not taste like the one at the party that we went crazy over; it was far better!  It has a slight taste of orange that really makes this so unique.  Don't think this is in a class with the sausage you're used to eating! This is in a class of it's own!  Order two packages, I guarantee you'll be sorry if you don't!  Fast delivery, we are very pleased with the whole transaction!Van

First I want to comment on their extremely fast delivery.  I placed my order and the next day I received it.  The meats I buy are all delicious.  When my son was in town I made a very simple dish with sliced Greek sauage, green peppers and onions.  My son was not planning on eating at home that day for he had plans to go out but once the aroma of the cooking sausage filled the air, he not only had one serving but he came back for seconds.  I highly reccomend this vendor.  They also have a great selection from other countries.

I ordered these sausages as an experiment, to accompany the Mizithra cheese I was buying.  They were very good, just different from what I am used to.  And I am a sausage fanatic (Knockwurst, Knapwurst, Mettwurst, Andouille, Bratwurst, Chorizo,etc.).  If I were doing another Greek meal, I would order them again.

Sadly, in 2009 I was feeding my dogs Beneful from Walmart. Two of our min pin dogs lost their hair and one died from having (0) blood pressure, which never knew was even possible as we rushed him to the emergency dog hospital. One of the 2 others now has been diagnosed with cancer and is only about 4 years old. At the time, I gave the dog food away then started cooking for them myself for a while which is a real pain.I then started doing research from the site dogfoodadvisor.com and found Orijen's 6 fish from Canada rated 5 stars and went with that for about 1 year and one of our dogs, a 3 year old started growing her hair back. We liked the Orijen's and the health benefits but my dog's didn't. They would sniff it and walk away. The other down side was that in the town in which I live has to ship often resulting in 10 days or so to get it.So I started looking around at PetCo one day because I ran out, looking carefully at the ingredients of various foods and found myself head wagging at corporate marketing compared to ingredients of most dog foods. Anyways, I found this ugly brown bag with the typo - Organix. I continued looking carefully at others still comparing then came back to the ugly brown bag of Kibble called Organix, picked it up and bought the 15lb bag.First thing I did was went to the dogfoodadvisor site to check reviews and it wasn't listed and then became worried. I could only count on the Orgainix's labeling of being honest and accurate - right.What were the ingredients?Ingredients: Organic chicken, chicken meal, organic brown rice, organic peas, organic millet, organic oats, chicken fat (naturally preserved with mixed tocopherols and citric acid), salmon meal, natural chicken flavor, organic quinoa, dried egg product, organic flaxseed, minerals (zinc proteinate, iron proteinate, copper proteinate, manganese proteinate, calcium iodate, sodium selenite), organic carrots, organic apples, organic broccoli, organic pumpkin, organic pears, salt, choline chloride, potassium chloride, vitamins (vitamin E supplement, l-ascorbyl-2 polyphosphate, vitamin A supplement, calcium pantothenate, niacin, riboflavin, vitamin B12 supplement, biotin, thiamine mononitrate, pyridoxine hydrochloride, folic acid, vitamin D3 supplement), chondroitin sulfate, yeast culture (Saccharomyces cerevisiae), dried Enterococcus faecium fermentation product, dried Lactobacillus acidophilus fermentation product, dried Aspergillus niger fermentation extract, dried Trichoderma longibrachiatum fermentation extract, dried Bacillus subtilis, fermentation solubles, rosemary extract.I've now went through about 60lbs of the regular dry kibble with my 4 min-pins and guess what! My dog who is now about 12 years old that had lost her hair from Beneful has about 95% of her hair grown back :). One of our girls had puppies about 3 months ago and we fed them the same as adults > Birth> (youtu.be/FjE3akdY0i8). We just heated up a little water and allowed the kibble to absorb and fed the puppies 3 times a day.Our Min Pins get fed twice a day, only 1/4 cup! They love the dog food Orgainix, they are happy, have clear eyes and a shiny THICK coat. A photo of Baby and her puppy is posted.Also, the food is now listed as 5 STARS at the dogfoodadvisor.com/dog-food-reviews/castor-and-pollux-organix-dog-food-dry/If you look at the way most production dog food is made you would never feed it to an animal. Corporate greed is what it is and lets just hope Castor and Pollux from Organix keep their integrity by not succumbing to the slice & cut tactics of greed and continuing their current pursuit.BTW, It's made in the USA!

I switched from Blue Buffalo Puppy to Organix Adult for my growing dog. He loves it and eats every last kibble. On another positive note, you can't beat the value of this food--our dog eats 1 cup of Organix per day vs. almost 2 cups of Blue Buffalo.
Have been using this product for 2+ years. I believe it is helping keep our dog fit, healthy and with great energy. Clean in the dish and easy to clean-up in the yard.

My dog loves this stuff.  It's SO much more healthy than the garbage you get at the grocery store.  Her coat is much more slick and is no longer 'greasy' feeling, breath does not stink and she has more energy.  Great stuff!My prior dog was also a lab, he was 15.5yrs old and loved this stuff.  He lived a long healthy life and I'm convinced it was from the good food he got.

My dogs absolutely flip for this food - unfortunately I discovered one of my dogs has a grain allergy and so I've been feeding them the grain-free version.As far as ingredients go, it's pretty quality stuff. (I'm not sure why the amazon ingredients list currently says "chocolate" - that's a dirty lie as there's none in here. The first five ingredients are chicken, chicken meal, brown rice, peas, and millet. Source: [...] )

I own a doggie daycare and boarding facility. I keep these stocked in our lobby all the time... it is everyone's favorite. Dogs love them and the owner's like the size of them... not too big and not too small. They also have a nice texture... again, not to hard and not too soft and the dogs seem to like the peanut butter taste. Very reasonably priced for a good quality product.

column4: Kelly G. Burgess "Homeschool Teacher in VA"
column10: These are the best cookies ever!  They have such a unique flavor that can only come from Lyle's Golden Syrup, and the texture is wonderful.  It has a buttery crispness to the cookie itself, and the cream is not overly sweet.  It's a perfect marriage of texture and flavor.  Absolutely wonderful with Tetley British Blend tea!

This tea is really pleasant and enjoyable, with a fragrant floral aroma. Herbalists have traditionally used magnolia for mood enhancement, and I find that I feel gently clear, positive and energized when drinking it.I find it best not to steep it for too long (as green teas will get bitter after 1-3 minutes). This one seems best when steeped briefly for one minute or less. The tea bags are quite potent, and I can use the same one again during the morning hours for making several cups, all with great flavor and nice energy.

I have used these Bunhead Jelly Tips for blisters! I started a walking regiment in October and walked for an hour a day. My toes had blisters so I bought some of these at CVS and it actually helped me to keep walking without any pain. Love them!

In remote Alaska we never get deliveries of fresh milk. Unless you have milking goats out here you'll never have fresh milk. This canned milk is a great alternative to fresh milk. It's much thicker, but perfect for baking when watered down. It's great for mixing with fresh berries, drinks like coffee and hot chocolate, and cereal. The taste is much sweeter than normal milk so kids usually really like it. It's perfect for camping and tastes good warm or chilled. I suggest trying it mixed into coffee or with frozen berries.Taste: 5 out of 5Child-Friendliness: 5 out of 5Usefullness: 5 out of 5Great things to try it with:Hot drinksMaking milkshakesBaking (when watered down)CerealFruit and BerriesChocolate Milk

column9: The best cookie I have ever tasted
column10: This gluten free delight is soft, chewy and has intense ginger-molasses flavor. I threw out all my other gluten-free cookies, and am only eating WOW products.  They are all good, but this one is exceptional.

I was looking for a chicken/duck dog treat that isnt made in China (most of the popular ones state that they are on their packaging). This one, with its dual French/English labeling and Free Range title, appeared to be a North American free-range organic-type natural product. Especially given the price. But it is NOT, it is also made in China. Upon closer inspection it says this product has no ADDED hormones, antibiotics, preservatives... but it doesnt say the product is FREE OF these additives. I feel duped, and I am returning.  I can get the same China-quality for half the price without being taken for a ride.

column9: #1 treat for a very finicky dog!
column10: When offered a smorgasbord of snacks and treats, Rudy (springer spaniel) always chooses free range chews first!
My little Cavalier King Charles is a very picky eater, but these are his absolute favorites!

Dogs know which treats they like best.  These are my dog's very favorite so I refer to them by saying, "I'll give you a million dollars."  Now that he knows this phrase, it gets him moving when he's reluctant to get in the car, or helps change his mind about an agility obstacle that makes him nervous.  I also use these as high-value treats for classical conditioning; I give these out when my dog is meeting a new person, or when I'm talking to a neighbor in the backyard, to create positive associations so he's less likely to bark.  Of course he also loves getting these just as a treat.  A bag of these treats can be stretched by cutting each one into about 3 pieces to use for training (big enough to still be chewy instead of swallowed whole), but I leave some whole for regular treats.  A whole one is big enough that my dog will carry it away to eat, and he will guard it from another dog, so be aware of that if your dog is a resource guarder.I highly recommend trying these.  Don't be fooled by the tear notch above the zipper; when I open the bag this way the zipper ends up getting ripped.  Cut the bag open above the zipper to make sure you can reseal it.  The thick plastic keeps the treats fresh.

The tannin content is so high that you can feel it in your teeth, even when it's cold.2.) column9: UNSAFE - choking hazard - try VeggieDent chews instead
column10: Our vet recommended getting "C.E.T. chews" to help clean our dog's teeth, so I looked around online and came across the VeggieDent chews and the HEXtra premium chews. Both of these met the requirement of being "C.E.T chews" but they looked (and sounded from the description) very different from each other, so I wasn't sure what kind to buy. Based on the reviews for each, it still wasn't clear what would work better, so I ordered one pack of each. I was worried that the VeggieDent chews would too easily be consumed and therefore wouldn't do much for cleaning her teeth, and I was worried that the HEXtra chews would be a choking hazard because they wouldn't come apart easily enough and she might swallow them whole.The VeggieDent chews were definitely easy for her to break pieces off of, but she was quite happy doing so, and it took her about 15s or maybe a bit more to eat it. She chewed each little piece that broke off while she ate it, and it was definitely cleaning her teeth. The HEXtra chews, however, are a choking hazard, and I will never give her another one. She was very excited to get the HEXtra chew (they smell terrible but apparently good to a dog) and chewed on it for a second or two, and then in one quick gulp it was gone. The whole chew, still in one piece. It was in her mouth for about 2 seconds. She is a VERY strong chewer (she can take chunks off of a black kong easily in 30 seconds or so, and she's a medium-large dog), and had no desire to chew pieces off of the HEXtra chew, I'm guessing because the moistened chew seemed like something to be swallowed whole. The HEXtra chews were useless for cleaning her teeth and a choking hazard, and I would never give her another one.In summary, the VeggieDent chews were great for cleaning our dog's teeth (though they didn't last particularly long, but if you're looking for something to last long, try a kong product), while the HEXtra chews did nothing for our dog's teeth and were also a choking hazard because she swallowed it whole within a second or two.Note: I've posted this review for the VeggieDent chews as well, in case it's useful for people who may be debating between these two types of C.E.T. chews.

column9: Careful giving to your dog if she's a quick swallower!

These C.E.T. Hextra chews are fantastic!! My dog DEMANDS them every evening after dinner and they keep her teeth clean and breath fresh (good dog breath!)
My Yorky loves them. I buy the big ones(they have different sizes to choose from tho) and it gives her hours and hours of chew time. Great for her teeth.

column9: For those who won't brush their dog's teeth...

This is a good item.  My dogs love it.  Cut up some for the little dog.  She loves them too!  Seems to help the breath a bit :)

My dog can't wait until it is treat time every night. She takes her chew into the other room to enjoy it in peace!!! If you go into the room, she takes her chew and leaves for another empty room. She likes to take her time and enjoy it without distractions. I buy them for her all the time.

My dogs' vet recommended the CET HEXtra for the tartar build up on my older dog who has had dental cleanings. It works! It has also helped my other dog who has never had a dental cleaning. It does have a medicinal smell. The dogs of course LOVE these things.

I've been buying these for my dog for some time but the last bags I purchased are inconsistent with ones bought previously. The most recent chews are tiny and thin and I bought the ones for large dogs. Looking for a new product.

column9: Great Product But Inconsistent Sizes and Density
column10: I love this product.  My dog absolutely loves them.  The problem is that the chews are not consistent.  There are many of them that are too small or way too thick so you end up having to throw them away.  They really should be the same sizes and density but unfortunately they are not.  Some of the chews in this pack really belong to the 51+ pounds pack.
I used to buy CET's from the vet, but these are almost half the price & ship free with Prime. Can't beat that.

column9: Too much variation in size of chews
column10: My dogs love these chews...must have one every night.  However, I am continually disappointed in the quality control with this product.  I have ordered numerous bags of these chews and the variability in size between bags is amazing.  Sometimes you will get a bag that has thick chews that are  suitable for my big guys, other times the chews are paper thin and twisted.  They do help keep teeth clean.  Don't leave dogs alone with them because they can be choking hazard.C.E.T. HEXtra Premium Oral Hygiene Chews with Chlorhexidine, Extra-Large Dogs, 30 Chews

this was my first time buying the hextra chews for my two dogs. they like them but i had no idea that it would leave stains on my rugs, carpet and furniture since the product description had no warning of this. i read some reviews where others didn't have this staining problem so maybe i just got a bad batch? even so, i wouldn't recommend the hextra chews just incase and would suggest getting the other version, C.E.T. Enzymatic Oral Hygiene Chews. they are just as good for the dogs teeth without the chance of staining plus are less costly. also my dogs do tend to gag on them once they've chewed the large size piece down small enough to where they think they can just swallow it whole. eventually they do spit it up and realize they need to chew it a bit more. the product and my dogs vet mentions that the C.E.T. chews are easier on digestion than other rawhide chews so i don't feel as concerned with my dogs swallowing the small pieces.

This is our first on-line purchase of the CET HEXtra chews after getting them from the Vet for years.  Our 21# Scottie-girl prefers the large, as do we.  I don't care for the smaller size in a chew like this.  I'd rather be able to see it while she's chewing.  I reckon the chlorhex-a-stuff gets chewed/licked off pretty quickly and it's certainly a distinctive aroma.  Our Scottie-girl has a collection of these in various places around the house and she picks out her 'favorite' from time to time.While we have found a skinny-er-than-normal chew occasionally(one or two per bag), they are usually still large enough to call 'large', I suppose.  The problem with the really thins ones is their propensity to go 'limp' rather quickly.  I usually nab these while the young lady isn't looking and dispose of them straight away.  As such, she will get one or two 'outings' with the skinny ones and in the trash they go.The savings over our vet's price is about $10/bag; so I do feel a little less guilty when ordering from the 'zon for such a savings.  I could see us doing this about half the time if the prices stay the same.  I'm still happy to support our vet with retail purchases since the office has been very kind and helpful with our little 'girl'.Product was as described and delivered in a timely fashion...two paws up!

My dogs were in desperate need of some breath freshing (as well as teeth cleaning). I have been using these for about 4-5 days now giving each of my two dogs one after dinner every night and I have noticed a difference in their teeth and breath already! Also if you are worried about a finicky eater- DON'T. My rescue dog doesn't like raw hides or any chew toys but he actually chews and finishes these and in about 15 minutes! I plan on making this an after dinner ritual from now on! I wish they were a little cheaper so it may be more of an every other day ritual :)***Update: So my golden retriever just had his annual exam and this is the first time that our vet has said his teeth looked great! He usually pushes us to have a dental cleaning and again...this is the first time he has not told us that Ramsey needed a dental cleaning! I am just amazed at the amount of tartar that this has removed. Other than a few brown spots around his gumline on his back teeth his teeth are white and shiny! Oh and that knock-you-out bad breath is a distant memory!

My dog was chewing on these chews and since they seemed thinner and smaller than the last batch, I kept a close watch on him. Last night he started choking and gagging as he tried to swallow the partially eaten, soggy chew.I first tried to give him the Heimlich, then had to pull the part of the chew sticking out from his throat out! There was blood all over his blanket. It was very traumatic to say the least. DO NOT BUY THESE!!! Get Greenies or something else that's not a choking hazard.

column9: Not the same as they used to be

column9: Great Product , Just A Little Over Priced
column10: These are a great product, they do remove the plaque from your dogs teeth but it takes time. I've got 2 Golden Retrievers , and if they don't get one of these after Dinner, they think they're in trouble and pout all night.  They're a great product but do get pricey if you use them on a daily basis like I do.

column9: A favorite in our house-with good medical benefits!
column10: My finicky pup loves these, and they are (per my vet) good for his teeth. I pay the extra for the HEXtra...I think it's worth it compared to multiple teeth cleanings.
My vet raves about this product.  I order it constantly as my dog cannot go a day without one.  The best treat you can give your dog.
I have purchased several bags of these chews.  They really clean the dog's teeth and you can see a difference.

column9: I swear by it- it works!!!
column10: I have a 3yr. old female border collie and she absolutely loves these treats! I got her the one with the chlorhexidine since I know it will work on reducing her calculus and it has! I have been giving her these 2x/daily after her meals and she chews it up right away. I agree that any type of treat you should supervised your pet accordingly but knowing my dog she's very smart and knows not to swallow it whole- she takes her time chewing and licking the taste. There is a strong smell to these treats which make them more attractive to the dog but honestly the smell isn't that bad. Overall it really does work and I'm so glad that Amazon offers it at such a great price and speedy delivery! =) Will definitely be buying more for sure!

Have been using these for 6 of the 8 years we have had our goldens and their teeth seem to have stayed in unusually good condition. Very little buildup, and only one cleaning in 8 years between the two - just a warning they do not smell good at all- we refer to them as stinkin bones, but they work so well!

I've been using these for 3 years for my golden doodle Karma.  They help keep his teeth clean and he chews them up readily.  I had been getting them at the vet for about 50% more than these go for so figured I'd start paying less for them.
The chews were very well received by our three dogs.  It certainly serves the purpose for which we ordered this item.

column9: The dogs love them, I love them!
column10: I have an English Mastiff and a Rottweiler.  My mastiff was having some seriously nasty breath so I bought these to see if they would help.  My dogs are fairly picky when it comes to bones, etc.  They both enjoy these chews tho.  I give each of them 1 per day and within 3 or 4 days their breath has dramatically improved.  I have not had any problems with the dogs choking on them thankfully.

Having seen these chews advertised many times, I had to give them a try, finally.  I was very pleased with the results that my 18 month old Aussie has had with the chews.  She loves the taste and smell of them (I don't mind the smell either), and I love even more that they don't leave stains on my furniture like typical rawhide chews do.  I did not give 5 stars only because they can be choking hazards if your dog is not supervised when eating these.  But as long as your mindful of watching your dog while they enjoy these treats, I have nothing bad to say!  It's a great preventative to bad breath and bad teeth!

The chews really seem to do the job.  My Lab mix  will turn his nose up to the typical rawhide chew.  He really likes and looks forward to getting his C.E.T. HEXtra chews.  He can hardly wait once he hears the bag.  His breath isn't bad at all. Even though he was a rescue dog his teeth were in pretty good shape.  The vet from the rescue gave him a clean bill of health.  Too soon to take him to my vet for a check-up.  I will know in a few months what my vet thinks.  But just looking at his teeth for an 8 year old dog they look pretty darn good. This next bag is for X-tra large dogs hopefully it will have more unformed sized chews.

My golden retriever absolutely love these.  In fact, he actually begs for them each morning.  If he thinks he can get one of these, he will spit out his mild bone for them.  He knows where they are kept and will stand by the cabinet hoping he gets one.  We don't give them to him when he is not supervised because he has a habit of wanting to swallow them too soon.  His teeth are completely white!

I like this product, it was a reasonable price and shipped fast, I can longer use this because my poodle will not chew he swallows it whole so no more but it does keep the teeth clean, wish I could use it.

I would never retract that the product seems to be excellent for our pet... and she really enjoys them.  I guess my now somewhat jaded view of the firm itself is from the fact that we did purchase a bag that was indeed problematic for our dog.  After incurring over $1,300 in vet bills to discover that base cause was that new bag of Virbac Chewies... Our contact with Virbac was friendly from a customer service standpoint... but the net result was not one dollar of help toward the .. for us... rather substantial vet bill. It seemed to be a management attitude of .... "there is no way our product could have had anything to do with the spewing diarhea.... so just go away"Needless to say... we will find an alternative to Virbac in the future...It's really a shame... because before that bag and since... there has been no problem.  However.... as a small business owner... I cannot support a firm that has such a black and white attitude toward such matters.

column9: Healthy chew to keep your dog busy!
column10: I bought both the CET HEXtra premium oral hygiene chews and CET Enzymatic Oral Hygiene Chews to switch off so my dog doesnt get tired of chewing the same thing over and over. I have a 13 pound Chug (pug chihuahua mix) and I buy the large then cut them into 2 or 3 long pieces. At first I gave her the Enzymatic chew which lasted her a whole day or even two which is good because she usually goes threw chew treats within an hour. Then I gave her the HEXtra chew to try and she loves this one. I cant even get within 2 feet of her before she starts growling then she just runs away with it lol. I find that most of the chews for the HEXtra are much thinner and easier to cut with basic scissors. After she had a taste of the HEXtra she slowly steers away from the Enzymatic each time we give her one. After 2 weeks whenever we give her the Enzymatic she just licks it a couple times and then walk away. For the HEXtra she still goes crazy over them! She goes through all the tricks I taught her without saying the commands lol. I dont know what the big health difference between the HEXtra and Enzymatic but if I had to recommend one I would suggest getting the HEXtra. Hands down your dog will love it. Like anyone has mention well with any kind of chew treats remember to take it away when it gets small or it can be a chocking hazard.

Our last weimareiner could not tolerate rawhide, but he needed something to chew. These chews are perfect! They dissolve in their systems, don't smell, and are safe for him to eat daily. His teeth looked great too!We normally buy the large size, as the xl seem to be too thick

My 12-year old lab-ish dog usually has to have her teeth cleaned annually, under general anaesthesia. We started buying these in medium size about 8 months ago. She eats about 3 per week. She will take in in her paws, lick and chew it away for about an hour. (We offer her one every day, but sometimes she doesn't feel like eating it, sniffs it and walks away). Not the cheapest dog treat, but a great value considering: 1) quality of ingredients that are beneficial to our dogs' health (surprised at how many dog treats on the market are actually bad for them), 2) our dogs (of different breeds) love them, and 3) after half a bag, dogs have visibly cleaner teeth and healthier gums, and fresher breath.Recommended by our veterinarian and now we recommended them to you... for your dog.

When at the vets, my yellow lab pup Cooper was given a chew for a treat. He loved it, so I ordered a bag of them for him and his 7yr old Lab/German shorthair sister Tehya. I have my daughter giving her dog the chews as well. "Good job" Virbac!!

column9: Dog loves 'em but they don't last long

This product is great. The cost to have the vet clean my 3 dogs teeth was outrageous so I tried these. I first bought these chews at my vets office for twice the price I paid here. I give each dog one chew daily and I no longer have to have their teeth cleaned!

I have three dogs, and they can be picky about what food and treats they like.  When offered these chews, though, there is no hesitation at all.  And the dogs always chew them up right away, they never get stashed for later.

column9: It's WORTH it and my dogs LOVE it!!
column10: My dogs love it and the great thing is that it doesn't upset their stomach and it does not give them the runs.  Great for teeth and gives them something to do.  The only concern is that you need to watch them because they can choke on it when the piece gets small.

My Old English Sheepdog has been of those that for 13 years been prone to plaque build-up. She is too old to risk anethesia so Vet suggested this product a year ago and though not perfect it has done a surprisingly good job of cleaning her teeth.

column9: My dog LOVES these bones and so do I....
column10: These bones really freshen the breath and clean the teeth.  My dog was a rescue whose teeth were beyond gross.  After having them professionally cleaned, he still had terrible breath.  After giving these on a regular basis - his breath is much more pleasant.  I usually buy these from my Vet at a greater expense.  Glad to find these online for less money, more convenient, and don't have to wait for a Vet appt to get them.  I bought 3 more bags since this order.
My lab loves these...she thinks they're treats :) I use them as a lunchtime snack in addition to daily brushing.
When I grab the bag, she follows me to get her chew!  My little girl is a chewer (I call her "Chew Girl") and she loves this product!

My dogs love these!  They get extremely excited when they know they're about to get one.  Two of the three dogs we have are four years old and their teeth are really clean.  My older six year old still has some buildup but these do help her go a little longer between cleanings.

I've been giving one of these a day to my dog for the past 2 months. She previously had a bit of tartar build-up on her back teeth despite a very healthy diet and daily compressed rawhide bones. Plus, my dog loves these chews.
My two dogs just love these chews. The added advantage of dental hygiene is great. The price offered at Amazon was super!

These are durable chews. I'm not entirely sure they're helping our dog's teeth but he likes them. My complaints are 1) the sizes (thickness, length) can vary greatly and 2) the odor can be a overwhelming. Sometimes it seems like I've stuck my nose in a bag of soured beef bouillon.

I bought the large and should have gotten the x-large.  I have a 75 lb chocolate lab and 100 lb golden retriever. They go through these way too fast.  They're too thin for their size.  I now make them chew them up outside.  They put off a pretty strong odor.

My dog loves them but they are pricey. Too high in price to continue to buy them when there are cheaper alternatives.

Our dog loves these and has one everyday for dental health, but you need to only give them to your dog when you will be able to watch them.  When the treat gets small the piece can become a choking hazard.
I'm happy to have discovered this product, my dog is happy and so am I no more buying products that I'm wasting money on.

My lab loves these!! I purchased my first bag from the vet at a much higher price.  What a great surprise to find the same exact product at 1/2 the price!! They really keep my dogs teeth clean, he thinks he is getting a super great treat, and it is much easier than brushing his teeth.  You really should try this product.
seems to be working well. the dogs love them and are back to chewing :-)

I order these chews for my westie Goofy and he cant get enough of them.  I give him a few a day when I order the smaller kind, but these larger ones last him a little longer. I was so luck my vet recommended them to me and I have been using them for my dog for over a year.

These CET dog chews were recommended to me by my vet. One of my dogs has diabetes so this was good that she could finally have a treat that would not hurt her.  And my vet does not recommend many products at all. My dogs love them and they do help clean their teeth. It is a win-win situation.

These chews help keep my dogs' teeth bright white and they absolutely love them too!
My dog loves these chews.  She does not let me brush her teeth so these are wonderful for her dental hygiene.

We have two Australian Shepards, one Mini and one full size. Both love the Hextra Chews. The full size AUssie just licks hers until the mini has finished his and then she taunts him by chewing on hers as he watches.

column9: makes breath smell better; dog always gags on them

column9: Favorite part of my dog's day
column10: My 60lb Siberian Husky loves these chews. It is the favorite part of her meal. I'm not sure that they really remove plaque that well; we've been using them for years, yet we still have to get her teeth cleaned annually.

Our Vet recommends these dental chews to control plaque and tartar on our dogs teeth.  However, our dog thinks of these as a great "treat."  All we have to say is "do you want a chewy?" and she starts jumping and twirling in the air with excitement!  Recently, she spent a few days with a dog sitter who didn't know about this particular brand... after seeing our dogs reaction she went online and purchased some for her two dogs.  I highly recommend these as safe and easily digestible treats that provide a good work-out for your dog and help keep their teeth clean and fresh smelling at the same time!

It is a cut above your usual Poptart- It does not contain high fructose corn syrup, hydrogenated oils, artificial colors or flavors, or any other additives. It even has organic ingredients and some whole wheat content! HOWEVER, I would not make these any more than an occasional treat. It does still contain 18 grams of sugar, and most of it is NOT from fruit. There is also only 1 gram of fiber, and only 3 grams of protein. It wouldn't hurt for the whole wheat content to be bumped up a little, and it wouldn't even be noticeable if white whole wheat flour was used, or some other healthy flour. The current combination will put your blood sugar on a roller coaster. It also has a lack of added vitamins, which is one of the only good points of other Poptarts.As for the taste, it is pretty intense. You can really taste the strawberry!  It's nice and slightly chewy, although not annoying, rubbery or tough. It sort of reminds me of a soft sugar cookie in terms of texture. Try it yo'self, and see what you think- It's still healthier than your average Poptart.

Yeah, I know, it's a matter of taste.  But really, do we want so many things so awfully sweet?There are a lot of flavors out there besides "sweet," you know.These pastries aren't as sweet as Pop Tarts, very true.  I find (and I'm talking unfrosted) that I prefer tasting the strawberry stuff and the pastry stuff rather than the sugar stuff. This is a concept that takes some getting used too; but it's really not all that difficult.Not that these Nature's Path goodies aren't sweet; but they aren't as sweet, so sweet your mouth feels like it wants to go immediately to the dentist after you eat one.Shall we mention that these just may be better for you?  Well, I'm no nutritionist, so let's leave that part to the scientists in the crowd.

I stopped eating pop-tarts because of all the junk that was in them (hydrogenated oils, artificial colors, etc).I tried these and - wow!  They are actually better tasting than pop-tarts.  They still have the rich buttery crust, but their filling is actual fruit, and tastes incredible.These look exactly the same as pop-tarts, right down to the foil wrapper and little grooves on the back of the pastry.  They have organic ingredients though, and no hydrogenated oils, white flour, or artificial colors.This doesn't make them completely "healthy" (these are still over 1/3 sugar by weight), but for an occasional snack they are awesome.

column9: Great product- not great Amazon fulfillment

They taste just like pop tarts, but are organic so I can feel slightly less guilty about feeding this stuff to my kids.The order fulfillment is not great assuming this is a personal order and not a buisness. column9: My kids eat these like candy
column10: My kids, and truly my husband and I too, love these pop tarts. They are super soft and great without toasting them. They are a convenient snack and a great source for breakfast!

column9: Great Flavor without too Much Sugar

These are a good after school snack and can be eaten cold or from the toaster.  The strawberry is a good flavor, but the cinnamon flavor is worth checking out as well.

This is a great item for those in a hurry who don't like the sickeningly sweet pop-tart type items.That is me. That is why I gave it 4 stars instead of 5.They taste really good though.

column9: Yummy Blueberry beats out Strawberry in my humble opinion
column10: I bought both the Blueberry and Strawberry versions of these through Amazon's Subscribe & Save Program. I refuse to pay the grocery store prices for a treat like this so, for years, I've done without. Both Strawberry and Blueberry are good but I find the Blueberry to have more fruit flavor than the Strawberry. Either way, if you're like me you'll enjoy this product and, the Amazon Subscribe & Save price is quite reasonable too!

All natural product, no HFCS or Trans fats.  I bought 12 boxes of these, and managed to get through all of them without getting sick of eating them.  No, not in one sitting, but with a lot of "health" foods, you slowly get tired of them over time, and/or they start to lose their taste.

column9: My son likes them, but if you are a Poptart fan, beware.
column10: My toddler son always wanted to eat my full-sugar/additives Poptarts, so I found these as an alternative.  They aren't nearly as good as regular Poptarts, but they aren't horrible.  I think if I wasn't so addicted to sugar, I would like these more.

I have ordered chips from Amazon before and they have come no more broken up than what you would buy at the grocery store -- specifically, the Bearitos blue corn chips.  They came double boxed with outer box being particularly strong.This time, these Mexi-Snax Sesame chips were sent in the original manufacturer's box and were really smashed.  I called Amazon, and said it must be the single box vs. double box that got them all smashed.  Amazon graciously and quickly sent me a new case of the chips, double boxed as requested.  They were smashed up even more!  I finally figured it out:  these chips were packaged like they were "vacuum-sealed"... there was absolutely almost no air in the bags, and that's why they crushed easily.  (The Bearitos chips had plenty of air in the bag, allowing for shifting during shipping, which is why they arrived in almost perfect condition.)I called Amazon again, thanked them for sending the chips double boxed, but told them they were more crushed than ever, and I felt it was a manufacturer's packaging problem and the apparent "vacuum-sealing" of the product.  They quickly refunded my money.So while I was not pleased with the Mexi-Snax chips, I was extremely satisfied with Amazon's customer service representatives and their handling of the situation.

The chips weren't as good as I remember them being years ago when I purchased them from the local healthfood store but these may not have been fresh.  They also were bags of crumbles though the shipping was adequate which makes me think they were crumbled before they left the warehouse.

As a fan of Gears of War and energy drinks, I had to try this one. After I opened it and poured it into a glass, I knew I wasn't ready for it. I might as well have cracked open a glowstick and poured that into a glass, because that's about the color and consistency of this drink.Kudos to whoever made this beverage, because it really does look like "imulsion" from the Gears of War game, but there's a difference between textures on a screen and something I'm about to ingest in my physical body. My first thought when pouring it was literally, "oh, that can't be healthy." My point is, damn... this stuff is green.All that would of been fine had it taste okay, but it tastes like it looks. Seriously, if you took the insides of a glowstick, added carbonation and taurine, I'm pretty sure it would taste like this. I enjoy most energy drinks, but to finish this, I had to add some potent adult potables to the glass.If you're a huge Gears fan, or if you're sadistic, go ahead and buy one.

So I was looking around the internet for reviews on this and I noticed there really are none.  This drink is not a necessary need for a Gears of War fan, but it is funny to have.  Imulsion, in Gears of War, is alternative fuel that gives humans a horrible lung disease and turns Locust into horrible mutated monsters.  That, and the fact that no nutritional information or taste-reviews for this product lead me to believe that anyone who has tried it has died.  Cheers!
It's bright, it tastes like lime and it's yum. No worries about rustlung or becoming Former to be had. More words.
tastes almost like an amp or sprite, this was very good i am getting the 24 - pack for sure!!!!!!!!! definetly a buy

column9: Imulsion, i can feel the power!
column10: As a huge fan of the Gears of War series this was another must have. It tasted very sweet and looked like imulsion too. It was smaller than i expected but at least i got 10. Overall if you love the game you'll probably like this drink. I drank one in the morning (after a bad nights sleep) before i went to help sort food and felt awake and did my job quickly.
Label looks really cool, the drink is much smaller than anticipated. Shipping went perfect, and arrived on time, would buy from there again. Liquid inside is neon green in color.
wel...it's quite small for the price 250ml...it doesn't taste bad...but it's not like amazing or anythingIf you got a friend, fan of GoW, you can share it, like 2 shots lol
I did not want to drink, but I did.It was the best energy drink I had in awhile.I still have the can.

I loved this as a collection piece. Only problem was, it tastes like crap and I couldn't really feel any 'energy drink' effects. So, depending on what you want it for, it could be the best or the worst thing to buy.

column9: Best Wheat Ever... Bigger and Better
column10: This wheat is so amazing. It is bigger and sprouts better than other top brands.It tastes great and is also packed for food storage lasting years and years. I couldn't use another brand after using Handy Pantry. It also was shipped super fast.

I purchased this wheat to use for grinding into flour. I have been extremely pleased. The wheat came in a sturdy bucket, with a resealable lid. The bucket is something that can be kept and used again.I was impressed that the wheat was very clean, and made if nice, beautiful kernels. The wheat was clean enough to go directly from the bucket into the grinder.Paying the shipping was painful, but still a better deal than purchasing at local health food stores.
We have started grinding our own wheat for bread making and other flour uses.  The Red Wheat product grinds up easily and produces an excellent flour base for any food product requiring flour.
The seed had a large amount of foreign matter in it. I had to clean the seed ounce by ounce before I could use it.

column9: Seen better, I don't get as much juice
column10: I was looking for a bigger quantity and switched from a 5 pound bag supplier. But for some reason this doesn't grow as evenly in the EasyGreen as the previous brand I used. It develops an overall thicker and bumpier bed of roots while some of the grains don't grow up quite as fast (without hydroponics or soil). Yields about 20% less juice. Considered all, it's still a good value and I sure like the container.

The Cafe Altura French Roast is one of the best dark, rich and fragrant coffees I have ever drank.  We were return customers for the French Roast and may try something else next.  I would recommend to all who love deep rich coffee...If you like a weak watered down brew don't buy.

Café Altura's Biodynamic French Roast is a rich, full-bodied coffee grown in Chiapas, Mexico.  The beans are oily and fragrant, and produce an exceptionally smooth cup of coffee.Living on a small agricultural island where many of the local farms practice varying degrees of sustained agriculture, I find it an added benefit to be able to support biodynamic farming efforts with my purchase of an excellent cup of coffee.  As several of the other reviewers here have pointed out, you're not likely to find better coffee or a better value.
Got two big bags of this for about $17.  Thought it might not be too good -- it was very good, smooth, and tasty :)  Not at all bitter or acidic. I bought more already!  Great deal great coffee.

This is a great strong French Roast. Love the fact that it is Organic! Our only complaint is that the great aroma it has when just ground doesn't translate to the actual brewed cup. Taste is flavorful and  full bodied. Great buy! I would buy it again.

column9: A Fantastic Roast that's Earth Friendly
column10: I was looking for a dark roast that was also organic. Amazon happened to have a great special on this coffee. I was not disappointed at all and have bought this product again, after the special expired. It's a quality coffee with a rich taste. As a bonus, it's grown the "right" way through organic/biodynamic methods. If you care about environmentally-friendly farming and/or supporting small farms, this is a product you should consider.I use these beans with a burr grinder and a French press. The beans are very oily, as French roast ought to be. They are packaged well, but I highly recommend placing them in an airtight container after you open the bag.The taste is phenomenal. If you like bold and dark coffees, this French roast is the way to go. The taste is very strong, but acidic. Cafe Altura also has other beans available if you're looking for a lighter roast. Overall, this is the best coffee I've purchased from Amazon. If the company has another two-for-one special, I'm going to order a ton a Cafe Altura beans!

I just purchased a new Capresso Grind & Brew machine and this coffee was my first choice based on the reviews and reasonable price.I'm very impressed by the freshness and SMELL of these beans. Heavenly!The end result is also very good...although for me lacks just a bit of complexity. It is rich and smooth, but somewhat mellow in personality.Don't get me wrong...I'm going to enjoy every cup of these beans as my Capresso gently grinds the beans just before brewing. I have the machine set to grind at largest/coarsest setting. It is a conical burr grinder...so it is not burning the beans as it grinds. I don't think I could improve the process used to experience this coffee.Would definitely re-order...but will also try other styles from Cafe Altura to inject some variety.

column9: Very fresh and tasty! Very Bold but balanced.
column10: I am generally a Seattle's Best coffee fan, but this competes well and is a bargain compared to some higher priced brands. The first bag impressed me with really oily fresh beans. The smell was somewhat off-putting when opening the bag for the first sniff. However the first batch through my French press was delicious! Upon sharing this with a few colleagues at work, the opinions were favorable. We like our coffee dark & strong with no acidity. Cafe Altura French roast is a winner and will also produce a fine espresso or a stout iced coffee. Okay- this is an update to the above: Upon trying an espresso grind, the coffee is still tasty but the oily beans finally killed my cheap burr grinder! If you are going to have freshly roasted, dark roasted, oily beans coffee, then use an inexpensive chopper-grinder or invest in a commercial grade, conical burr grinder. This is good coffee, but tuff on cheap grinders!
This is one of my favorite coffees. It's got a rich flavor, and has a nice bite without being too acidic. It's also a great value.
Great coffee. Great price. Very dark, but not bitter.  Possibly very acidic, so if that bothers your stomach then maybe avoid this blend.

I'm probably on my 8th bag or so. I use it for espresso. It's a good coffee. In particular it does not have any nasty citric aftertaste. I know some people like citric aftertastes, I am not one of them.The 'biodynamic' label sounds really new-wave hookie pokish, but coffee tastes fine. 'organic' coffee is still mostly monoculture, and the old growth is chopped down anyway. That gets too political thought.

Cafe Altura's French Roast is a very good coffee.  Packaged in a sealed container, upon opening it you are met with an intense aroma of dark roasted coffee.  The beans are uniform in size and properly prepared into a french roast; dark, oily, but not burnt.  Using a french press, I enjoyed a cup and was pleased with the aroma and flavor which was strong, tangy, a hint of sweetness and not bitter.  Overall, this is a very good french roast, especially considering the price.  I had been enjoying a Nicaraguan Organic French Roast for the last few months costing approximately the same price per pound, and Cafe Altura is clearly a better prepared coffee.

column9: Excellent Coffee at a Great Price!
column10: This is a rich, full-bodied coffee. I drink at least a pot a day and I have yet to get a nasty acid kick-back. I am going to try some other varieties of this brand, but will always keep some of this on hand.
I bought a couple of bags of French roast beans and I love it!I grind my own very fine because I love a full bodied cup of coffee.In fact, I decided to buy more while it was on sale!

Very oily, rich color and aroma, great smooth dark flavor. Also kind to peasants and all that. If you like French roast, this is better than the stuff in the grocery store and for less -- and if you buy two, shipping is free!UPS, on the other hand, gets a much worse review from me.
Best coffee I ever bought. I grind this very fine and add boiling water to a french press. I've stopped going to Starbuck's, etc., completely: this is better.
This producer, Cafe' Altura, exudes quality. This French roast, organic oozes delicious aromas the second you open the bag. Smooth, with a supple texture and delicate aftertaste. Another winner!

We have ordered this coffee for years on Subscribe and Save.  There was a time when it was a good deal but those days are over.  The price has now climbed out of the "reasonable" range and I will be canceling my subscribe and save on this item.  It was under $20 for years now its climbed to over $26.

This is the only coffee I have bought for the last year. It doesn't seem to have high acidity and the taste is full bodied without over roasting the beans the way some others do (to mask that they are using low quality coffee beans). When the beans are over roasted the coffee tastes too strong, burned, and bitter. This makes an excellent high quality cup of coffee everytime. Make sure you are using purified water so that you do not introduce chemical tastes from tap water and to use the right size of grind for your method of making coffee. I use the pour over cone filter method. Enjoy!
I will be reordering. It is wonderful.  It has a dark delicious flavor.  I make stovetop espresso and this makes wonderful espresso.

We are huge fans of dark roast coffee, where the beans are glossy & dark, and the flavor is rich & complex.  If this is your idea of a good cup of coffee, Cafe Altura's Organic Biodynamic French Roast is the coffee for you.  The beans are shiny & aromatic, producing an excellent cup of coffee that does not disappoint.  Cheers

Very good taste, not bitter.  I like a rich dark strong cup of coffee in the morning and this suits the bill.  I am also going to try more of their dark roast coffee.  Will let you know what I think as I try them.

I purchased this to get a good french roast at an affordable price.  The biodynamic, organic preparation was a plus.  When I open the package, I get a wonderful aroma, and it promises a fabulous, smoky cup of coffee.  Unfortunately, I don't get the depth of flavor that the aroma promises.  In addition to the less-than-satisfying flavor, I find that it has a bitter after-taste. The strength and smokiness are there, but the flavor is not well-rounded.  I've ordered this one time, and when the bag is gone I doubt that I will revisit it.Update:  I wrote the above review prematurely.  I discovered that when I use less grounds, I get a wonderful cup of coffee with wonderful smoky roast flavor.  It is just what I was looking for, and I have reordered.

While I don't completely understand the "biodynamic" part of the coffee, what I do know is that it presses into an exquisite espresso. The flavor is rich and complex while staying smooth and not overly bitter. My husband likes a nice Americano with enough water to nearly negate the beverage being coffee. Cafe Altura holds its flavor even under such adverse conditions. The only down side is that my body has usually had enough coffee long before I want to quit drinking it. Having it show up on my doorstep when I'm down to the half cup of beans is so perfect. Subscribe and Save rocks.

Without a doubt, this is the smoothest whole bean coffee I've ever tasted. I don't know what biodynamic means, but it's delicious!For a French roast, it's not that bold. I use a Mr Coffee grinder (which I've reviewed in the past) and a Melitta single-serving drip cone. It's a basic setup. But everyone who's tried it RAVES about it. Even the cream&sugar crowd can drink this black. This is the perfect coffee to get non-coffee drinkers hooked. It tastes almost as good as it smells.The beans have an oily sheen. I don't know if that's some sort of edible sealant to keep the volatile flavor oils from wafting away, or if the beans are so full of flavor it's exuding from the surface. Either way, this is a winner.I haven't subscribed yet because I'd like to try the other Cafe Altura products before I commit to just one, but this  one's certainly at the top of my list. I've ordered this one 4x already.I've noticed this thing has gotten pricier since the first time I bought it. I got two 32oz bags the first time appeared on Amazon. That's okay though. It's still cheaper than Trader Joe's and definitely tastier.
I had a little trouble arranging the monthly coffee shipping plan but the coffee beans are incredible- fresh, oily, darkly roasted to perfection.

I've been a subscribe & save customer for almost two years with this coffee and I can't say enough good things about it. I sometimes try other brands of organic coffee but this is a standout. Convenient 2 lb. bags and monthly shipments suit me perfectly. Cafe Altura Biodynamic French Roast is the best coffee if you like bold flavor and missing all the insecticide sprays  you get on regular coffee beans.I recommend burr grinding only what you are brewing and storing the coffee in an airtight container at room temperature.
Very great tasting coffee.  The price is even better when compared to other beans.  If you do the "Subscribe & Save", you get even more of a discount (plus no tax or shipping charges).

This is a very good organic coffee!  Another good coffee, which I don't see on Amazon, is Monroe's Coffee.  They have organic coffee as well and the Kona Coffee and Jamaican Blue Mountain Coffee is VERY good!  It's practically roasted when you order it.[...]
Excellent quality, makes a great, sharp yet earthy cup of Jo'. Would recommend  to all of my friends.
this is simply the best coffee i've ever tasted - dark, rich, gooey beans.  and if you read the outside of the bag, you'll feel good about doing the right thing for the planet.i heartily recommend!!!
This was a good dark roast columbian coffee that woke you up in the mornings. Fresh and tasty.

column9: Save money, Almost as good as Peets
column10: I was looking for small ways to save a buck and we found this coffee. tastes great, nice oily beans for a bold coffee. you get maybe 3 times as many beans but a few dollars more than you would for peets at the grocery store. use subscribe and save feature for a %15 discount.try it out.
This coffee is exceptional.  Espresso dark and deep yet smooth.  My only other comment is that this should properly be called an Italian roast as this is clearly beyond a French Roast.

column9: A bit to strong for me
column10: I mix this with my Peets french roast like I read in one reveiw and cuts the edge off the strong taste . Figured I would save some money seeing Peets costs more . If you like strong smokie taste then its for you , for me and my tummy its to strong .

column9: Excellent Coffee at a Great Price
column10: Great coffee and always fresh from Amazon.  My preferred flavor is the Dark Sumatra 32oz of which you get 2 bags. It lasts me a month. The coffee itself is rich and darkly roasted bringing out the oil which I like giving it a great, strong flavor. It's a great bargain at this price.

This coffee is very tasty. I too noticed the decaf text on the bag when it arrived. I emailed Cafe Altura and Cindy from their offices confirmed that it is not decaf (which I suspected after a cup of this wonderful roast). She stated it is "just a description of our different processing methods". In fact she says that Amazon does not sell any of their decaf products at all. Hopefully this will end the debate as to whether their Amazon blends are decaf or not.

UPDATE: I must have gotten a bad bag the first time around. I just got another bag and opened it today. The beans were aromatic, fresh, and oily. The coffee was perfect this time around using the same amount of beans as last time. The coffee was nice and bold. It was not watered down and weak. My coffee snob husband even loved it. I ordered another bag right away. I am hoping to get another good bag. :)For the price, this organic coffee is good. We pay about $9.99 for half pound for higher quality for local coffee shoppe beans. Overall the flavor was full-bodied, but it tasted watered down. We used the proper amount of beans, ground them fresh right before brewing, and just didn't didn't get the zing I expected. It did have a nice aroma and finish though. the acidity was well-balanced. I might try extra beans next time. I would definitely purchase this again and maybe mix this with our regular coffee to stretch it.

column9: It's OK but not that great
column10: After reading all the reviews, I expected a great coffee and was disappointed. This coffee may be much better than cheap non-organic coffee but not close to a lot of organic coffee brands I have tried in the past. First, it's very weak, I like my coffee strong but if I make it too strong, the taste is horrible. When I make it "just right", I find it weak and not very flavorful but my American friends find it delicious. I am from Europe, I like my coffee robust and flavorful.

column9: It may be good if it wasnt so stale....
column10: This coffee looked like a good deal and had some good reviews but dont be deceived!  I think this particular bag of coffee I got had to have sat in the warehouse for at least a year.  The beans, when ground, go to dust instantly. When I added the hot water to it (I use a french press), the water became very foamy - I have never seen beans do this before with hot water added to this extent. (talking 4-5 inches of foam above the water)Finally, the coffee taste itself is old.  Stale, old and if it hasnt been sitting in a warehouse for over a year then the company doesnt know how to cure it's own beans.  Move on, as it's not a "deal" when you cant drink the stuff.
I've bought several varieties of Cafe Altura and not only is it always a great deal, but the coffee is great.

The French Roast blend is a whole bean dark roast with a sweet aroma. Proper storage is required to get the most out of these beans since they come in a large 2-pound bag.  The resulting coffee is rich and nutty, just the right acidity and smoothness for a strong pick-me-up in the morning.  Highly recommended and a steal at Amazon's prices.

I've purchased this product twice.  First time was back in 2007, as a birthday gift for my sister.  She loved it.  She sent me a couple ounces to try and I too thought it was great, maybe the best coffee I have ever tried.  I drink coffee but am by no means a gourmet and I don't buy expensive coffees for my self.  I purchased another order (a couple weeks ago) as a gift for my housemate.  I can't believe its the same coffee.  It tastes like the Folgers or Maxwell House I buy at my local grocery.  It has a bitter aftertaste.  I'll be the first to admit I don't know anything about fancy coffee; but when we opened the package the beans looked wet with oil.  We transferred the beans to other containers and the inside of the package was lined with beans stuck on by the oil.  The beans weren't dripping oil but almost.  Is this right for fancy coffee?  Needless to say I am disappointed.

This is an excellent french roast!  Dark, oily, and fresh like it's supposed to be.  I got it with the Subscribe and Save deal, which makes it a bit more affordable than a similar (yet inferior, if you ask me!) product at the grocery store.  I shared it with my mom last time she visited and now she's a subscriber, too.

I really don't like this coffee. I don't know if this is true of all French Roasts and if that is something that others who like French Roast like, but this coffee tastes burnt to me. It even looks and smells burnt. The beans are black. I have had much better coffee and my husband calls me a coffee snob.

This is really a great cup of coffee. I've been searching for coffee like this for a while now. The coffee available at our local grocer is very typical. Expensive, corporate and definitely not as fresh. I use a stove-top percolator and the coffee smooth and rich.

I had tried the Columbian Dark by the same roaster and it was acceptable (Not Great).  Thought this might be better after reading all the positive reviews.  IT IS NOT!  It's almost undrinkable. Bitter/acrid aftertaste that lingers on the tongue long after drinking, and an acid stomach to go with it. I suspect this roast appeals to those who like Charbucks coffee which is almost invariably burned and harsh on the palette.I do like the organic aspect, but in this case that is not nearly enough to redeem this lousy coffee. I am going to give this company one more try and order the Sumatran dark. Keeping my fingers crossed. I've learned not to trust the Amazon coffee reviews very much, but I suspect I'm a lot more finicky with coffee than the average reviewer.

The great quality and flavor of these beans is negated by the claim of "Biodynamic" growing methods.  "Biodynamics" is a theory that holistic agriculture using homeopathy, shamanism, and astrology will harmonize nature to produce superior products.  No plausibility, no evidence, just unjustifiable claims.  Sell me delicious coffee, but leave out the nonsense!

I received only one initial shippment for this product, which is excellent!  But now it's been over a month late, with no communication about the new estimated shipping date.  I've cancelled my order.  Very frustrating.

Yes, I am a coffee snob. But this is only because I have discovered that I very much enjoy the differences gained from the effort and the investments of time and money...it works so much better if one uses the consistent grind of coffee that can be achieved with a conical burr grinder (my purchase of the Hario MSS-1B Mini Mill Slim Coffee Grinder was a crucial step towards coffee nirvana) versus the mixture of chunks and powder that comes out of a cheap electric blade grinder; the kind of smooth, rich, full-bodied nonacidic brew that comes from steeping evenly and quickly, like a real espresso machine can achieve or that I've been experiencing with the far less fussy and amazingly engineered Aerobie AeroPress Coffee and Espresso Maker, completely surpasses drip or French press; and the beans matter. In fact, it is really all about the beans. And they have to be fresh, for starters.This crap -- and I do mean crap! -- is anything but fresh.It tastes to me like the batch I received recently was roasted two years ago and sat on some shelf in a warehouse the whole time. No thanks!How do I know this? By taste, of course. And there is no "best by" date on this package to refute my claim.Since purchasing the Hario grinder and the Aerobie press, in July of this year, I enjoyed two other very good French roasts from "Just Coffee," purchased at my local cooperative grocery (yes, organic), and one purchased here, Volcano Dark Roast, Organic Kona Hawaiian Coffee, 8 Oz, Whole Bean. Every last cup brewed from these was heaven. During that time, I periodically washed the Hario grinder to remove the coffee oil buildup whenever I would begin to detect the effects of rancidity, and before trying this batch from Altura, I washed it again. So I know that everything necessary for a great cup of coffee was in place and ready to go.Except the beans this time were the deal breaker. A brew using freshly ground coffee beans stored in vacuum canisters should not taste bitter. The first cup was reminiscent of gutter water. I will not be falling for this again.To Amazon's credit and with my deepest gratitude, customer service responded to my feedback. But in all honesty, I believe this product should be removed from sale here.

I used to give my dog one of those green dental bones every night.  They were pricey -- it added up to about $50 a month.  Then I switched to a cheaper brand, but I found he ate those within a couple of minutes.These are actually cheaper and take longer to chew than the various edible dental bones.  (I am not sure why, but my dog can consume normal rawhide faster than these chews).  It takes him a satisfying amount of time to chew, and seems to help his teeth and breath.  I am really glad I tried these!  They may look like rawhide but are much better.

C.E.T. Enzymatic Oral Hygiene Chews, Large Dogs, 30 ChewsHighly effective for plaque control. Both my 5 year old Vizslas have maintained clean teeth & breath. Amazon has been a great source for the lowest price.
OH, these things smell awful BUT the dog loves them.  This will help keep his teeth clean and was recommended by the Vet.

I use these treats to put my Jonas in his place when I have to leave without him.  He is eager to go to his place to chew on his chews.  The only drawback that I have is that he can finish them in 10 minutes, minor detail.
Received in timely manner.  Excellent product.  I have 7 dogs and this product helps keep their teeth clean.  Everyone gets 1 in am and 1 in pm after meals.
Our dog loves these chews and the cost was more reasonable than what we were paying at the Vet's office.  Delivery was fast with no hassles!

column9: good for oral hygiene for older dogs
column10: This product was recommended by my vet.  Works well for older dog that's really too old to have teeth cleaned.  She loves them,  they get rid of "doggie breath" and they're a lot less money through this site than from the vet's offficeC.E.T. HEXtra Premium Oral Hygiene Chews (with Chlorhexidine) for Large Dogs (26-50 Pounds), 30 Chews
my dogs love these, they seem to be keeping their teeth clean.shipped fast, great price.

column9: Lasted longer than I thought they would
column10: The chew chips lasted a fairly long time for my evil chewers..about 45 min, which is pretty good.  They didn't smell bad, and I am guessing they help with the tarter since they spent time chewing on them.  I will buy them again.

column9: C.E.T. HEXtra Premium Oral Hygiene Chews - Great For Dogs!
column10: These are great... they not only help clean your dogs teeth but they also give them fresher breath and apparently they taste good because my dog loves them!

I have a 14 year old terrier that can't chew the really thick rawhide strips anymore.  Also, he's always had pretty bad breath.  I find that he's able to chew most of these pretty easily and they do help with his breath.  The only drawback is that the Chlorhexidine coating on the strips tends to stain the carpet so you have to watch that.  Also, the price on Amazon was about 1/3 what they charge at my vet so that's a big plus also.

We first tried this product to help improve my pup's breath.....and it worked great.....but the side benefit was that my pup loves them and goes through a bag in a week....they're expensive in the stores...but buying them on-line has been a blessing....in fact I have to order more!!N Hopkins

column9: C.E.T. Hextra Oral Hygiene Chews - Great Product!
column10: This is one of the best products on the market.  It promotes healthy gums and white teeth on my dog.  She loves these things and I am happy that she likes them so much, because it keeps her happy and her teeth sparkling!

I buy these for my 75lb boxer/pit bull mix. She goes through treats very quickly most of the time. But with these Hextra chews, they keep her busy for a little while which I think satisfies her even more. I find the large size to be perfect for her as the extra large are a tad too big. They are a great product and she just loves them. My vet recommends them to maintain her dental health as well.
This is the second time I've purchased from you and I'm very satisfied.  Thank you for the great service at a reasonable price.
I will be purchasing more of these. My hounds LOVE them. These are not messy like the rawhide.

We used to give our dog pig ears, which she loved. The problem was that they added weight and didn't clean her teeth. We changed to the CT Hextra premium chews on the advice of our vet. Greta loves these chews and her breath and teeth are clean and fresh smelling.

Our dog absolutely loves these things...Not sure what they're made of, but the way he grabs it and proceeds to run around the house, tossing it up in the air and catching it before sitting down to gnaw contentedly for 20 minutes or so makes me think it might be illegal.  The only thing he likes to eat more appears to be flies.  He's a strange dog...but we love him.HEXtra is great stuff that keeps your dogs occupied, and their breath smelling nice and fresh.  And, Amazon prices are about half what it is at the Vet's office for twice as much.
Both our Golden Retrievers love these chews and they certainly help us keep their teeth and gums healthy.
HEXtra Chews C.E.T. Petite 30 CountThese are the best chews you can give your dogs because they love them and they actually help clear the plak off of their teeth.

I ordered the CET HEXtra Premium Oral Hygiene Chews with Chlorhexidine for Large Dogs and the bag that i received did say that on the front, but when i opened the package, the chews inside wer for a much smaller dog.I have been giving this same item to my Labrador for 4 years and i KNOW that these are not what they are supposed to be.  I am very disappointed that i spent money on a sham!

column9: Great product but uneven quality control
column10: After spending over $600 to have my English cocker spaniel's teeth cleaned, I began looking for a product that would help eliminate or delay having this procedure done again.  On the recommendation of my veterinarian, I purchased a bag of these chews on Amazon (the prices are just too high at the vet's office).  My dog loves them!  He begs for one every evening after his dinner (dry kibble).  They are non-staining on the carpet and paws.  These chews, along with 3X a week tooth brushing with C.E.T. toothpaste, will hopefully keep his breath sweet-smelling and delay having dental work done any time soon. column9: UNSAFE - choking hazard - try VeggieDent chews instead
column10: Our vet recommended getting "C.E.T. chews" to help clean our dog's teeth, so I looked around online and came across the VeggieDent chews and the HEXtra premium chews. She chewed each little piece that broke off while she ate it, and it was definitely cleaning her teeth. The HEXtra chews, however, are a choking hazard, and I will never give her another one. She was very excited to get the HEXtra chew (they smell terrible but apparently good to a dog) and chewed on it for a second or two, and then in one quick gulp it was gone. The whole chew, still in one piece. It was in her mouth for about 2 seconds. She is a VERY strong chewer (she can take chunks off of a black kong easily in 30 seconds or so, and she's a medium-large dog), and had no desire to chew pieces off of the HEXtra chew, I'm guessing because the moistened chew seemed like something to be swallowed whole. The HEXtra chews were useless for cleaning her teeth and a choking hazard, and I would never give her another one.In summary, the VeggieDent chews were great for cleaning our dog's teeth (though they didn't last particularly long, but if you're looking for something to last long, try a kong product), while the HEXtra chews did nothing for our dog's teeth and were also a choking hazard because she swallowed it whole within a second or two.Note: I've posted this review for the VeggieDent chews as well, in case it's useful for people who may be debating between these two types of C.E.T. chews.
