This was all I came across but it left me sorely disappointed.  I love the intense flavor of the tea and this mix gives me none of it.  Even worse, there's no way for me to make it stronger! All and all it's a tasty drink, but it is NOT the tea you're accustomed to in restaurants.  I like my tea strong and I can't drink this at all.

Wife and I both enjoy this product and have for several years. I'd give it four stars just on my own, but the wife loves it and gives it the other star.Had dificulty finding it locally on a regular basis, and turned to an online purchase.Very happy with the online purchase, as well. I now buy a large amount at a time to keep our supply on hand as it stores extremely well, with each packet individually wrapped.We find it especially good for traveling, as we have a convenient and familiar comfort drink that we can count on anywhere we can get hot water.The friends and family we have introduced to this product have mostly been very positive in their responses to it, and several have mentioned buying their own afterwards.

This product was introduced to me by a friend as a Christmas gift.  I wasn't quite sure what to think of it but decided to try it out.  I love it.  Especially during the long winter months.  Good product...just add boiling water, or have it with ice.

column9: Tastes Exactly Like What You Get In A Restaurant!
column10: I did not buy this product off Amazon, I bought it at my local H Mart (although I had first found out about this brand on Amazon). I bought it to try it out and I love it. Given it is not healthy, it tastes exactly as how you would order in a Thai restaurant. I have not tried it hot, but I brew it hot, then place it in the fridge. My measurements were 1 cup per packet. Just measure out how many cups you want, boil that in a measuring cup in the microwave, add in the packets and place in the fridge. Wait until cooled to serve. It does not need any cream or sugar. It is sweet enough as it is! Perfect! Wish I could buy this in bulk it is so good! Now I don't have to wait until I go out for Thai tea!
Love this product. It's easy and it tastes great. I ordered 3 packages and I'm glad I did because I drink it all the time
Delivery came quickly. Exactly as advertised. Made my wife happy as she's been looking for this tea for several years.

column9: doesn't taste like thai ice tea in restaraunts
column10: I recommend NOT buying this product, it doesn't taste like real thai ice tea.  I'm surprised at the reviewer who said "i'm picky," for my restaraunt thai ice tea's i'm NOT so picky, so I didn't hesitate to buy this 12 back, because I thought how could it go wrong?  It went wrong.  tastes too milky, and nothing like Thai Ice Tea in restaraunts or even anything like Thai Ice Tea in Thailand!

column9: Came on time & as pictured, but doesn't tasted like authentic Thai tea in the least.
column10: This tastes like regular tea, mixed with vanilla creamer & powdered creamer, which I could easily make myself. The only authentic thing about it in my opinion was the orangish color.

column9: Nice decorations for St. Patty's Day
column10: I like the shamrock sprinkles when I decorate my baked goods for St. Patricks Day.  Little bit high priced and wish you got more than just the 2.5 oz. for the money.  I do like Wilton products and glad I could purchase it online!

These are perfect for St. Patrick's day! I made green velvet cupcakes topped with these shamrock-shaped sprinkles for work and everyone loved them. Please note, however, that there are more white sprinkles in this mix than the shamrock-shaped green ones. I didn't mind this as I thought it made my cupcakes look more classy, but these sprinkles may not be for you if you're looking for more green color on your cupcakes.

column9: Hungarian Pralines = American Chocolate Truffles = YUM
column10: The product description is a bit confusing because an American praline carmelly with nuts and is very different than a European one. The picture and the words didn't quite make sense BUT I took a leap of faith. Wasn't sure IF chocolate covered cherries alone and/or wafers would be part of the purchase.This yummy elegant treat is milk chocolate shell filled with a cherry bathed in creamy Cherry Liqueur wrapped in gold. There are 9 to each box which is considered 3 servings. These are NOT your granny's chocolate covered cherries though, there's a slight alcohol kick. This is a product of Hungary which is sold world-wide based on the many languages on the flip-side of the individual box.

When I ordered this product, it said it was real cinnamon (i.e."canela") and "product of Sri Lanka". I ordered based on that, but they sent me Indonesian "cinnamon" (not Canela). Not at all what I wanted, and this item has been deemed "not eligible for return", and the website has been revised to match what they sent me.I don't think they did it to be evil, but they should have admitted they no longer stock what I ordered instead of taking my money for something I did not want. This product is WAY too expensive for common non-canela "cinnamon", so I feel a bit ripped-off.  And now I still have to find some real canela. Two stars, because it's probably an overpriced yet adequate product if you weren't bait-and-switched from something else. For me, it was just a total waste of time and money. :(

Some of the cinnamon sticks have patches of mold. Other sticks smell like smoke, not cinnamon.  Previous orders were okay, but this batch will be my last purchase of this brand.  Grocery stores sometimes pull questionable products from the shelves until quality issues are resolved with the supplier. There needs to be an equivalent online response.

Organic green tea, with absolutely fantastic aroma is hard to find. This is a great example of a great tea. The leaves are very large when they open up, which is how the tea is supposed to be. Aroma is not overwhelming, great!!!! Will buy again and again!

column9: These are gingerbread. Not what I expected.
column10: The description on their website says they are sugar cookies, vanilla cookies but they are actually gingerbread.  Which is fine if you like gingerbread cookies but I don't. They were well packaged, fresh and nicely decorated but I have to return them since we didn't want gingerbread cookies.

column9: Wonderful product! I love the Wild  Rasberry Flavor! Great!!!
column10: I am a person with Crohns disease, & I can not have anymore all  the things I liked to enjoy eating, special treats-deserts. I just discovered this item at one of our local grocery stores, only to find out that they won't be carrying them anymore. So I looked on the bag,saw their site, & it said I could buy them here. So I highly recommed them to anyone who is on a restricted diet, and that can eat certain things, they have a wonderful taste,& I am sooo happy I found something that I can eat that won't hurt my condition! Please never stop making them or this flavor! I am a fan for life! Ashley in Vermont!!!

I used to buy the San Gennaro polenta rolls at my local grocery store, but they stopped carrying it a couple years ago. I haven't found it anywhere locally, so I decided to buy them online.I like that it doesn't have to be refrigerated before opening, that it keeps for a long time, and it's ready to go to be the carrier for whatever sauce you want. I usually use this recipe[...], with more wine and less chicken broth, and baked. Great vegetarian meal, also good with crumbled hot sausage in the sauce. One of these days I'll have to try one of the frying recipes too.

Cafe Altura's descriptions of their offerings are clear and accurate. Our preference leans towards mild - medium roast, and this variety along with Breakfast and Columbian have been wonderful. In the past I would enjoy Dunkin Donuts blend over any brew at Starbucks. These organic coffees have since relaced DD in our house. I hope Amazon continues to carry Cafe Altura which supports organic, responsible growing and also offer more deals in the months to come.

Probably would have been better if fresher.  No "head" at all in my French Press.  Not much flavor indicating it sat on a shelf too long.With coffee, fresh is the key word.  For the freshest coffee and very good prices I recommend Coffee Bean Direct.
I bought the French Roast, which was excellent, and this one, which I found to be weak and watery.  There was no flavor to it.  Would not buy again.
Biodynamic coffee is the only coffee my wife's kidney's can tolerate.  Beyond that, it just taste so darn good.

column9: Ok, I'm not a coffee connesieur, but...
column10: When I first opened up the bag, I didn't get that fresh smell of great coffee. It smelled like flavorless, strong coffee (which is, surprise surprise, how it tastes.) Plus the beans are really greasy... what does that mean? Not a fan.
Have been using this bean to make the morning mocha's for about 6 months, its a good quality bean.  Makes a nice dark flavorful espresso with good crema. Highly recommended.
If you are looking for robust flavor and a darker roast this is not the one.Beans seem a little dry and maybe a bit old.

column9: Tuscan Oil at Its Finest, but....
column10: Badia a Coltibuono olive oil is a legend, deservedly so. But be forewarned -- if you are used to the bland olive oils sold mass market in most supermarkets, the strong assertive character may come as somewhat of a shock. As noted in the Amazon product description, "according to Deborah Krasner in "The Flavors of Olive Oil", this oil "...is strongly and pleasantly bitter, with a pronounced burn....'It made my face scrunch up.' Very green and grassy, this is an oil made for drizzling.""  I would tend to agree with that. In my opinion, this is really at it's best drizzled over grilled meats, vegetables and salads almost as a condiment. For dipping bread and most cooking (it's too expensive for most chefs on a budget like mine anyway) you might prefer an oil from Sicily, Spain, Australia or California, which are softer and more buttery. That said, for purists, this may be the right olive oil even for bread dipping. It's flavors and aromas are remarkably complex and powerful.

This has been my favorite olive oil for years. It's expensive, and often it is hard to buy locally, so I was delighted to find it available on Amazon. I use it for everything - it has a deep, green color and a peppery finish - delicious drizzled on tomatoes or tossed on veggies before roasting. A little bit provides lots of flavor!

My tree arrived very well packaged with moist soil and no breakage noted.  The branches are thick and sturdy, and the needles are full and green.  This type of tree is meant to be outdoors, but due to the extremely cold temperatures we are experiencing in NH, I plan on keeping this one inside and winterized as best as possible until the spring.  I'm really looking forward to working with this one!

The tree arrived in poor condition; the pot was broken in numerous pieces. The branches appeared to be bent . For the price, it certainly was a very poor investment . I left messages with the company with no response.

The kids and I ate this for dinner last night and we all 3 loved it.  My kids are very picky eaters too so that's saying a lot.I found this meal to be very quick and easy to make.  It's not bad calorie-wise either.  The 3 of us split the box along with a piece of fruit and we were all very satisfied.  My 10-year-old daughter told me that I need to get a bunch more of these meals and my 8-year-old son said "I think this meal was made just for me".  He's the worldest pickiest kid in my opinion too.I'll be buying more of these meals for sure. Can't wait to try some of the other newer varieties as well.  Two Thumbs Up!  I highly recommend this yummy meal.

And HOW appropriate!Whenever I eat t-o-omany CHEETOS, theya-l-w-a-y-s go to MY"CAN"!I'm thinkin' that forthose of us overseas,THIS is the way to keepour guilty-pleasureFRESH... until we breakinto the goody-can!//////////////////////////

I have purchased many different teas from SerendipiTea and have been more than pleased with them. This tea sounded great until i read the ingredients on the box. I am a vegan and it contains traces of dairy. It did not say this on the website. So i have to give it to someone else. But it smells amazing.
The tea is pretty good. I had expected a stronger flavor of the ingredients. It is somewhat chocolate tasting but very little orange flavor. Not bad but not great either.

column9: Pro Plan Roasted Chicken Slices!  Great!
column10: The Pro Plan Chicken Slices are great!  I was trying to replace other types of dry chicken tender-type treats (Waggon Train), which it turns out were made in China, and I found these, which I verified are Made in the USA.  The only part of this product that is imported are the nutrients, according to the company, but the chicken is from the US and the Lamb is from New Zealand.  The company can't source the nutrients (vitamins) in the the quantity needed here, so they import them and test them, but the product is then manufactured here in the US.The representative on the phone told me that most of their treats are made in the US, a couple are manufactured in Canada, and that one treat she thought was manufactured in Columbia.  I asked why the label on the product just says distributed by Nestle Purina Petcare company in St. Louis, MO, and that the label doesn't say manufactured or "Made in the USA," and she stated that the FDA doesn't require that a label state "Made in the USA," if it is made here.  The FDA requires that if a product is made in another country, that the name of that country be stated.  I told her it would probably help the company, and consumers, if they would actually state "Made in the USA" on the label.At any rate, my dogs love these.  I have subscribed for delivery on this product, which lowers the price a bit, and also saves me the time and money of having to go to Petsmart to purchase them.  That way, I always have them in the house.  I go through about a bag every two weeks for my two dogs, a Sheltie and a Chihuahua.  Hope this info helps you! Thanks!

I bought these for my grandson who is 7 months old. He loves them and they are just the right size for a snack between feedings. His mom likes the convenience and ease in taking them along. I like ordering these and having them shipped directly to their house. It makes me feel like I have sent them a little present that is practical and appreciated.
My son is 7 months old and this has always been his favorite baby food - it is nice a thick, which he loves!

these are by far the best fruit gushers i have ever bought, each package contains two distinct flavors.berry and a passion fruit flavor.sweet but not to sweet.i tryed them myself and really enjoyed them,also the subscribe and save price makes them remarkabley lower than local grocery stores,my kids love these,

Do not buy this stuff, it's absolutely horrible. Actually did not order this item, had ordered the "marinade" which is a completely different item and was shipped this stuff instead. I'd already purchased this item at my grocery store and it was disgusting. Went through several botched deliveries with Amazon and this item. Only to find out that the marinade is no longer available. Donated the "sauce" to a local food bank.

column9: Best Cajun Shrimp Marinade ever for grilling.
column10: This is an excellect marinade for shrimp before grilling on a skewer with other items. I have been using for 10 years and never found anything better.
Wrong Product was shipped twice. Seafood sauce was sent instead. Must be a new formula.Old product was great. New product sucks. Not what I ordered. Not the product pictured. No refund. I'm screwed

I used to have EXTREMELY bad cramps during my time of the month. When I say EXTREME, I mean cramping so bad that I would have minor blackouts. My mother-in-law suggested I take some organic virgin coconut oil and I took a tablespoon of it, however it didn't taste good at all. It did make my cramps go away for that entire day. So my wonderful husband went out and bought me some of these capsules from the health food store, I was kind of skeptical b/c he paid $20 for it, but I thanked him and started popping the suggested amount, 3 caps, 3 times a day.Since the caps have a small amount in each cap, you have to take that many to get it in your system. The first month I took them, the cramps subsided to just enduring slight pain in the morning on my first day. The second month I didn't experience any PMS symptoms and even less pain on the first day. The third month I experienced NO PMS and NO PAIN through my whole 7 days. I've heard it is good for lowering your cholesterol and help maintain weight amongst other things. I'm just happy they made my cramps go away.
My wife is very happy with this product. She takes it , I do not. I don't know what she takes it for.

rated it one star because it wouldn't go to zero star, this stuff is a waste of money, coconut oil, it might work if you put it on a bicycle chain, or a zipper thats sticky otherwise don't waste your time or money.

They had several dozen cases of 11.7 ounce bags of this Brown & Haley Candy Cane Roca at Jack's 99 Cent Store a couple of days before Christmas so I couldn't resist buying a few.  I was a bit worried about how a combination of toffee, chocolate, and peppermint would taste but there was no need to worry because it works just fine.  I have really enjoyed them and so has everyone else who tried them--it is very difficult to eat just one or two.If you are a fan of the Brown & Haley Almond Roca, these are the normal little bars of buttery, crunchy toffee dipped in chocolate but without the nuts and instead they are drizzled with some pretty intensely flavored peppermint icing, like the filling in a peppermint pattie.  I think they go especially well with tea but not as well with coffee as the regular Almond Roca.The pieces are wrapped in the usual hot pink foil which is so much fun.Each piece of candy has 60 calories including 4g of fat plus they unfortunately contain coconut, palm, and/or palm kernel oil.  I do have to knock off a star for containing such unhealthy fat.

Bought as a gift for my 18yr old daughter.....she loves it and uses all day, everyday!  Works well for her so far for surfing, etc.  Hopefully will get used for college soon!!!  Definitely worth the price.  Only complaint is that when I emailed the seller with a couple of basic questions, I was NEVER answered.  This was disappointing.
The wife got a coffee frappe maker and uses this mix to make them at home. Saves quite a bit buying in bulk instead of paying $4+ for a frappe elsewhere!!Try it....

Our son has been eating another brand of gluten free bread for the past two years and when we tried this - he is sold. Tastes like white bread and he has been eating it up!  I did use the oil when making it over the butter.  I've found that the oil for some reason the mix rises better and cooks well.  Using butter instead, I would never eat this again! I thought it was terrible when made with the butter.  Then we tried the oil - it's a totally different bread.  Wonderful.

I'm surprised at the review for this product prior to mine. We are Gluten and Casein Free in our house and this is the BEST bread mix we have found yet. We use Smart Balance Vegan butter (made with olive oil) and this recipe tastes perfect. I'm VERY picky about the bread I eat and so are my kids, this tastes soft and isn't $8 a box. We get them from KA direct and its only $5.75 or so a box. Worth every penny for those looking for a good GF bread.

column9: Can be made to be egg free. The closest thing to "real" bread that I've had in the two years I have been gluten free.
column10: I bought this at the store and it sat in my pantry for a few months before I decided to finally make it. Boy have I been missing out. This was seriously the best bread. We have been using Bob's Red Mill Wonderful Bread Mix (and making it in our Cuisinart CBK-100 breadmaker). As far as taste, this bread blows it out of the water. However, the prep involved is much more involved. I want to try it in the bread machine but King Arthur does not recommend making this mix in the bread machine. They give directions on how to make it in the Zijorushi but the directions are not compatible with my Cuisinart.Since my two sons are allergic to egg, we used the 2 Tablespoons flax meal and 3 Tablespoons water substitution for each egg recommended on the King Arthur site and it worked out for us with this mix.It didn't really rise all the much and I was nervous but I put it in the oven anyway and it turned out GREAT! So don't be too worried if yours doesn't look like it is rising enough; it will probably be okay.

After trying a variety of pre-made gluten-free breads, I thought I would give this a try.  The yeast packet was not there, but should have been.  I called the 1-800 number.  The nice customer service lady talked me through what to do being that I happened to have had yeast in my cupboard (although recently expired).  The bread was easy to make.  Didn't rise like it should have, but that could have been my old yeast.  My husband thought it was ok.  Better than the gluten tortilla wraps he has been eating.  After pre-slicing the bread, I froze it with 4 slices per baggy.

This is the best GF bread I've ever eaten!  The mix is easy to use, with very clear instructions.  It does take a little time from start to finish, because it's yeast-risen bread.  But the results are worth it.  I have tried several mixes and recipes, and most of them either have a weird taste or crumbly texture.  This bread has a wonderful texture (like "real" bread) and tastes great.  One tip (this is also on the box) is that if your loaf lasts more than 2-3 days, slice it and store it in the freezer.  It will stay fresher that way.  Otherwise, it will become a little stale sitting on the counter. But even if it's a little on the stale side, it makes great toast!StephanieIndianapolis, IN

I have a bunch of food allergies and am very limited as to my choices. I like this bread mix. It tastes and looks great. The texture is good too and it is very simple to make. The only negative is that it takes so long to prepare.

Just finished making a loaf of this bread.  The texture is OK, but the taste is really not good at all.  The flour mix seems to consist mostly of tapioca flour, and it gives the finished loaf a very odd, slightly sour flavor.  The aroma is like a big ball of steamed corn.  This bread basically tastes just like several other brands already on the market, and at $8 (in my supermarket) it isn't exactly a bargain.  Too bad, I was hoping for something better from King Arthur.

Bought this mix to make fatcakes that my granddaughter could eat.  Fatcakes are normally made from regular bread dough that after rising are pulled into round thin pancake shaped pieces from a piece of dough about the size of a golf ball.  The dough is then dropped into hot oil(375 degrees)and fried on both sides until golden brown.  The cakes are then drained on paper towels and sprinkled lightly with salt.  Gluten free bread dough does not have the elasticity of regular dough so you have to use two spoons, grab a piece if dough and drop it in the hot oil (much like you would a drop cookie) and then using the spoons spread it into as large a flat pancake shape as you can before it hardens.  Once it is as flat as you can get it you treat it like like a regular fat cake.  Great with soups, chile or ham and beans.

Everyone in the family really liked the bread.  It was very easy to make, the texture and taste, quite good- better than many gluten free breads that I have tried.  Seconds were requested and toasted - well simply put...delicious.  Sandwiches, French Toast, stuffing, muffins, cheese bread...it worked well with all of these variations.I raise my glass to King Arthur Here Here!Sandra Bennett, Atlanta, GA

We have tried many gluten free breads including some from a local bakery.  This one is the ticket, easy to make, great taste and it didn't dry out like the others.  It doesn't have a grainy texture like some of the brands do.  Definate winner in our house!!! :)
I have tryed the fresh(?) and frozen Gluten Free breads which taste like saw dust and then happened upon this product.  It makes a large loaf, takes a little time, but is well worth it!!
Just an ordinary bread with not so special taste at all. Very disappointed, especially after reading all these excited reviews. Please note it's not for bread machines.

column9: The best gluten-free bread mix I've ever had
column10: I have tried to make most brands of bread mix but this one is the best.  It looks and tastes like real bread.  It definitely rises higher and tastes better if you make it with vegetable oil not butter. I also replace one or two of the eggs with only egg whites so it doesn't taste as eggy.  Also let it completely cool.  Like all gluten free breads, it tends to feel gummy before it completely cools (2 hours). The King Arthur gluten free loaf pan (it has side ridges that help the batter cling better) definitely helps it rise better than my old loaf pan.

Delicate in texture and just the right amount of orange peel and raisins to complement the dough. Generous in size. Enough for at least twelve people. The Panettone arrived about a week before Christmas and the tiny piece I have left is as fresh as the day I received it. It isn't a cake, but then it is not a bread. Just sort of in between. Would definitely purchase this item again and would  recommend it to people that want to experience Old World baking.Attractively wrapped for holiday giving.

I worked in an authentic Italian Deli for 9 years and this is the best panettone I have ever had!  It's absolutely perfect in texture and the balance of flavor is sublime; it isn't too sweet, or over-done with too much added in, and the little hard sugary things are a nice burst of sweetness.
I gave this as a gift and was told it was absolutely delicious and arrived on time and nicely wrapped.I would definitely reccomend this product to anyone.
I give this Italian Christmas Cake to my family and dearest friends during the holiday season.  They are delicious and the package is beautiful.  I just love the flavor of this cake.

column9: And I tried ten different ones!
column10: Fiasconaro is, by far, the best Panettone I have ever had, both here in the US and in Italia.  Moist, flavorful, aromatic, buttery, and with plenty of fruit!  I can't wait until I can have it again, with a nice cup of Illy.

The panettone was the first Christmas gift to arrive. Way before Cds, videos, books, dog treats and other items that you think would have been out the next day. It is festively wrapped and smells great. We will cut it on Christmas day. Be careful not to drop it on your foot, it weighs a ton and I am sure will feed a family.
The Fiasconaro Panettone made a wonderful Christmas gift - beautifully wrapped and be-ribboned. And, most importantly, it tasted delicious! Thank you.

This Tieman's Dark Fusion coffee was a very pleasant surprise!  It has an excellent body and flavor...as good as just about any other ground coffee I have had.  Interestingly I did not purchase it for the health/anti-oxidant benefits that is touted on the packaging, but after about a week the caffeine "jolt" of energy seemed smoother and more sustained.  I will be re-ordering.  I'd love to purchase it in whole bean form.

Well, I had high hopes, but for me this coffee just didn't take the place of my robust brew of either Sumatra or Costa Rica beans.  It doesn't have the same wonderful aroma in the bag or in your cup and the taste was just okay.  But for some it might be fine, especially if you like a milder cup of coffee. I'm just very finicky about my coffee and the fusion blend just doesn't give me the exact taste that I love.

column9: Better than Starbucks for many reasons!
column10: I tried this coffee before "just because."  It just so happened I had a migraine when I tried it the first time.  I've had migrains for years.  I had taken an Imitrex about an hour before I had my first cup of coffee.  Within abut 1/2 an hour, my migraine was gone.  Normally, I have to take at least 2 Imitrex and even then, the migraine hangs on.  Well, I had another migraine this time out and the same thing happened.  Exactly like the last time.  Not only did it kick my migraine, I also had more energy throughout the day.  The coffee also tastes fantastic!  It is dark, but not heavy.  My daughter (15) is also a coffee drinker and loves the flavored creamers.  She doesn't use extra creamer due to the dark coffee - she actually uses less because she likes the flavor of the coffee.  Starbucks is losing this family as a customer.

We love this coffee especially since it is in the subscribe and save option. It is dark and therefore, strong but the taste is not bitter. My husband never likes to the same coffee for more than a month so we rotate through 3 different kinds and I can always tell a difference when we use this one because it is not so hard on my system.

column9: Great beans fused with goodies! Guilt free addiction!!
column10: My brother who is a professional barista and coffee snob, he recommended this coffee. It has a very unique aroma and wonderful finish, and since it's fusion coffee and very much like novelty product, it's been a great gift for my clients. I LOVE that all the organic healthy stuff fused together, and the taste makes me feel like coffee connoisseur

I was not sure what to think of all the "fusion" items, yet after emailing the company with some questions (they promptly replied), I decided to order a batch.  It does taste like coffee, very tasty coffee - my husband didn't know that I had switched until I told him three days after starting with Tieman's.I do recommend this coffee if you have GERD or other stomach issues (the rep told me Tieman's has a ph of 5.4).  I am not seeing the claimed energy boost; however, I am not sure that I really had an issue with low energy in the first place.

column9: GREAT Coffee-Bold yet with no acid "bite"
column10: A friend gave me a bag of Tieman's Coffee (Bold) to try because I LOVE coffee.I like the taste very much and I like that it contains antioxidants. I've been reading a lot lately about the importance of adding these to my diet.I make the coffee strong and it's very bold, but has no acidity or bitterness. I'm ordering it through subscription to save money and to make sure I keep it on hand.

These are the best cookie in the whole world hands down!!!!  I have tried all the different varities and all of them are delicious.  I love to make grown up smores with them, toast a marshmallow and place it between two of these wonderful cookies....HEAVEN!!! Yummy buy them you won't regret them.

These, along with Walker's shortbread, are the archetypal accompaniments to an elegant tea, morning or after-dinner coffee, or  a serving of ice cream -- or wonderful on their own as a soothing tidbit during a break in your regular routine, or as a tantalizing bed-time pillow treat.The exceptionally good dark chocolate, paired with the very high-end cookie base, makes a wonderful melange -- not too bitter, not too sweet, with the crumbly texture of the cookie and the smooth, melt-in-your-mouth sensation of the chocolate stimulating all your tastebuds.Surprisingly, one (or two?) can be very satisfying.  Even my husband rarely gorges on these, making one box last longer than you'd think.  But he sure is eager to keep a supply in the house!  And if you use them when entertaining (which is a great thing to do -- they're very impressive), be prepared for guests to ask to take some home with them.  :)I originally bought these on Subscribe and Save, disposed of the case of 12 pretty fast, and desperately wanted to reorder, but at the moment they're only available from a third-party supplier.  Amazon, please bring these back in house!Absolutely FABULOUS.

column9: Second Best Cookie in the World
column10: These are wonderful cookies. The biscuit its self is buttery and crisp. The extra dark chocolate coating is incredibly rich, with just the right sweetness.However, I'm afraid it has to take a backseat to LU Cookies Le Petit Ecolier, The Little School Boy, White Chocolate.The obvious solution to the problem of which to choose........get them both!

Here's an item I picked up at a nearby Fresh and Easy market. They're a British company and they have a lot of imported European items. One of the latest that I picked up is a 5.3-ounce box of Petite Ecolier (Little Schoolboy) dark chocolate with biscuits. Each of the very delicious biscuits is topped with a thick wafer of very dark (70% cocoa) chocolate. Man, that really makes a delicious cookie! Yum! I can't recall ever having better. My thoughts were that these just had to be high in calories. Sure enough. One serving (two biscuits) packs 130 calories. It figures, doesn't it? Well, you know, I was reading that a serving of chocolate every day, particularly dark chocolate, is actually beneficial to one's health. Well, here's to my health!Gary Peterson

These cookies are just wonderful. IF you can manage to not eat them yourself, they are great little gifts for hostesses, guest stays, stocking stuffers, birthdays, or just a little remembrance. Taste great, and look lovely on a plate, and they're European. You can't go wrong with these. I'll never be without them.

column9: One of the best cookies ever
column10: I discovered these cookies through a membership in the Gevalia coffee club - a sample was included in a shipment I received recently.These are amazing!
I ate the entire box in about 7 1/2 minutes.  I am physically addicted to these cookies.  May actually need to go to cookie rehab because of The Little Schoolboy.

Although these are the same calorie count as a regular MilkBone, they can be broken up into 4 individual treats.  My large dogs find the invidual snaps incredibly tasty.  At first my dog tated it, spit it out, then tasted it and spit it out again.  But soon thereafter she would quickly run to her "biscuit spot" and happily munch away.  I like the fact that they have added ingredients to help with joint issues.  Although the individual snaps are small in size, they are crunchy enough that the dog thinks it is getting a full size bone, I don't know how Canidae does it.I just ordered a 4lb box.

The dogs loved these and they were easy to break into smaller pieces.  No complaints here!  And, the price on Amazon seemed very reasonable compared to what the costs are in the pet stores (especially when you have to actually go to the store and get stuck paying tax!).
A great product for senior dogs or to reduce the amount of treats you feed your dog for weight management. The biscuits come in a bar shape that you can break down to four small pieces.

I bought these as a healthy treat for my new boxer puppy. To begin with, I recieved canidae dog treats .. for senior and over weight. The description of the product does not mention this. My puppy ate the treats fine and seemed to enjoy them, but I found them to be a bit messy. After a treat there would be crumbs all over the floor. Nonetheless, my puppy found them tasty.

One of the best flavor enhancers that we have ever used.  My wife is from the Philippines and she introduced us to this great seasoning.  It doesn't hide or overpower the foods that you use it on, but brings out the best in them.

column9: SPECIAL to make even iced Tea!
column10: Alot of people do not know how to prepare loose leaf tea and miss a chance for new and exiting taste treats!  Although you need to purchase a loose tea brewer ie,'ball', then all you need to do is (after unscrewing the teaball top) is place about a 1/2 teaspoon of tealeafs (sic?) tealeaves--inside. CLOSE IT and hang the hook on the side of a 1/2 gal container that has been filled with water and sugar to taste. I uaually place my container in the 'fridge overnight and in the morning there is a delightful light iced tea waiting. Brewing times vary and you may add hot water to cold to make a stronger brew...This is so far my favorite. Let me know of any other really tasty tea,folks. ENJOY!!
My sister loved the orchids and vase. Beautifully presented and carefully packaged. They arrived well within time. Thanks a lot.

I ordered this twice--once to put together a trial bouquet, and the second time for my wedding.  Watching the order status both times was a nervous ordeal, as they waited three days, then sent it overnight (and both times I tried to time the delivery just so).  They came with the top half of the blossoms yet to open, and I never got them to bloom.  Overall, though, they served my purpose well.  They say doing your flowers yourself and via mail order is a terrible idea, but I am happy with my choice.
So good! Makes the perfect Chelada. The mix stays at the bottom so you can keep pouring beer in after your first cup is gone.

Perfect potful packets are a great way to go ... each package is pre-measured to make one full pot of coffee.  No guesswork on how much or little to use.  Mudslide is our favorite everyday coffee......... it is smooth with a hint of chocolate but it is not overpowering.

column9: Good, could be a little more bold
column10: Wish the flavor was a bit bolder.  The coffee itself is good, I just don't detect enough of a difference in this flavor from others, which I think is an issue with Perfect Potful's chocolate flavors.

column9: This is the best product for your garden
column10: I have been using Grass B Gone in and around my flower beds for years.  What a time saver!  The grass dies and the flowers bloom on.  For some reason I have not been able to find it in stock in town, and I see that the shipping from Amazon  is 1-3 months.  Hmmm- I might not need it then, but I'll order anyway for next year.  Normally, I use organic products and no herbicides, but this is so great that I have to make an exception.

column9: I didn't believe it would work!
column10: I bought a home with gardens that had  been totally neglected for years.  The grass was so bad, I  thought I would have to tear out all the ground cover and perennials.  Fortunately one of my new neighbors suggested I try Grass-B-Gon.  I bought one bottle of this product, to try.  I picked an area where the grass was especially bad.  I was astounded at how nicely this cleaned up my ground cover.  I went to buy more, and could not find it ANYWHERE!  The area where I used this product is grass free.  I wish I could say the same for the rest of my gardens!  I was thrilled to find this product is once again available!

column9: The Best Way To Get Rid of Unwanted Grass!
column10: I love this product! It makes gardening easier when you can just spray and get rid of unwanted grass. The frustrating part is when you can't find it anywhere. It disappeared for months and I was afraid they weren't making it anymore.This is one product you'll always find on my shelves. I also like the Weed-Be-Gone.When I go to gardening stores, they are always trying to convince me to buy some other product when I already know what I want. This works! I don't want to add water, mix, etc., I just want to pick it up, use it, and get on with my life. I have to 'fight' my way to the check-out counter, but it's worth standing my ground. It's easy to use and effective. I recommend it highly.
This grass-killer is fantastic for the many of us who can't possibly keep up with grass in the flowers.  Believe it or not, it really works!

column9: Finally - no more pulling grass in flower beds.
column10: My "old" knees and back are making it increasingly difficult to pull grass in my flower beds, but I love my daylillies, dahlias, impatients and petunias.  I called the County Extension Agent for a solution and he recommended Grass-B-Gone.  I looked at the local big-box garden supply and was not able to find the product.  I was very surprised that Amazon had this product listed as available.  I ordered the package of 6 because it was cheaper this way.  It was delivered promptly and in good condition.  I love it and it has performed as advertized, kills the grass, with no visible harm to other plants.  The only problem I have with it is that I had so much to spray, the hand and wrist got tired of the trigger sprayer.

This product arrived on time and, to my astonishment, it actually works!!  The grass growing up through my plants is dying, but the plants are just fine.  I'm delighted with the product.  The only problem I had was that there are no instructions for use - nothing on the container, or in the packaging.

At first I wasn't sure this was going to work because it doesn't give fast results like Round Up does on weeds.  I needed to get grass out of a pachysandra bed without killing the pachysandra plants, so I couldn't use Round Up.  I sprayed, looked at the bed the next day, and the grass was still there....but within a week it was all killed off!  This product is not in local stores in my area, so I had to buy it on-line.

We bought Ortho Grass-B-Gon from the local Ace Hardware a couple of years ago and found that it magically killed the grass in our iris beds without harming the irises. Now we can't find it in Ace Hardware or any of the local Garden Stores nor in Lowe's or Home Depot. What to do? Look on the Internet! Hurray! Amazon.com has it!

column9: Do not apply in Summer, know your grass!
column10: I love this stuff. Killed all bermuda in my yard with two applications (one Spring, one Fall). It has never returned one year later. This will only work when applied during the bermuda growing season, which is Spring & Fall. Bermuda is dormant in the summer, so don't bother applying then. And be sure you know exactly what your invasive grass is or it won't have any effect at all. Are you sure it is bermuda? Not crab grass or another invasive grass? It will kill any hybridized bermuda lawn grasses like BOB sod. So you really need to know what is in your lawn before you try this. Use your state and/or county extension website to identify your local invasive grasses. If you aren't up to the research, hire a professional landscaper to deal with it. The active ingredient, Fluazifop, is illegal for retail sale in many states, so you won't find it in the big box stores like Lowe's, Home Depot, or Wal-Mart. And an online seller may cancel your order if you are in one of those states. But even in states where retail sale is illegal, a licensed professional landscaper can apply the more highly concentated form of Fluazifop.  This is not the same as Weed-B-Gone!
Sprayed this around a rose bush several weeks ago.  Walked by it today and you guessed it. The grass is dead.

This product does a decent job but whoever packged it did a lousy job. It came in a cushioned packet with a plastic bag around it that wasn't sealed. I'm surprised the postal office let it thru because it was leaking so bad.  I had to put it on old newspapers on the floorboard of the car to get it home.

I wanted to kill off some extensive patches of bermudagrass in our KBG lawn, this did the job but did an even better job of killing the KBG wherever it was sprayed -- I was aware this would probably happen but the labelling didn't seem to mention bluegrass so I thought there was a chance the KBG might survive.Will mop up bermudagrass survivors with turflon ester, which is not as effective but allegedly a little kinder to KBG, now reseeding bare patches with Scott's KBG.I rate this four stars as it did what it was supposed to, but could have been labelled a little better.

Works! I have a terrible invasion of Bermuda grass in a landscaped non-grass area after removing a large tree exposing the area to direct sunlight in Southern California. Did not see any results (The "leaves" will turn brown) until about 10 days after the first application. Directions state to re-apply after 7 days and do not cut the "grass" during this period. One 24 oz bottle does not cover much of an area as you must spray directly on the "leaves". I have a approximately 200 sqft area and one 24 oz bottle was not enough for one application. I would recommend buying 4 24's or the 40 oz container if you have the same or more than a small area like mine. Product does not seem to affect any of the other plants as well! Will be interesting to see if this very invasive grass comes back as rizoles(?sp) grow up to 1 foot underground making any mechanical removal virtually impossible in a developed area.

This product takes about 10-14 days to kill the grass in the ground cover but it does eventually work very well. It also turned the evergreen ground cover a slightly lighter shade of green as it killed the grass. Overall, I am very pleased with this product and will order it again.
My local hardware store quick stocking this so was super glad to find it. Really cuts down on the crab grass that gets in my flower garden. Super fast shipping.

do not buy.  This is the same prodict sold in concentrate form as "Ornamec".  For the price they are charging you can buy almost a quart of Ornamec.  You then dilute down 1-2 oz per gallon for use.  This product should cost no more than $6 or $7 if you want the premix.  Check Ace hardware.

column9: Ortho Grass B Gone for Landscapes
column10: I ordered this product and as far as I have been able to learn, it does not exist.  The Ortho Grass B Gone for Landscapes is supposed to kill bluegrass that grows amongst your flowers in the landscape.  The product I received, did not say that.  The one I received is Garden Grass Killer that kills weedy grasses.  Bluegrass is not even mentioned in the directions.  Instead of the blue banner on front saying Landscape this one says Kills weedy Grasses without injuring Ornamental Plants.  It isn't the product that is pictured.  Very unhappy.

This is one of 6 coffee beans that we buy from Amazon (3 decaf and 3 reg). I blend the 3 together to make the BEST flavored coffee. The price works for me and having freshly ground coffee everyday is awesome.

I am a coffee "wuss"; I don't like it bitter, but I like it super-strong (I have an 11-month-old; I need strong coffee!). This coffee is amazing... light, aromatic, slightly sweet, but with a caffeinated punch!

I have tried every type of pre-made gluten free bread AND every mix....also have made my own mixes. While some turned out ok...some 'edible', none of them had the taste I craved. Udi's is THE ONE! I actually ate the slices right out of the bag. My sons also love this bread. I hope Amazon can somehow get us a subscribe and save! They also have the best muffins and pizza crusts. My local Hy-Vee stores carry this item, they also make a ready to bake pizza on the Udi's crust. This Artisan baker has opened a whole new door to bread lovers with Celiacs!! Thank you, Thank you, Thank you!

I first had Udi's white sandwich bread at a restaurant.  I spit it out because it was so good that I was sure they must have screwed up and given me regular bread.  But they hadn't, and thus began my love affair with Udi's bread.My husband doesn't have celiac disease but he still loves this bread.  The only reason he doesn't eat it all the time is because of the expense.The ends/heels of this bread can be hard so I grind them up in my food processor and freeze them for later use in recipes that call for bread crumbs.Highly recommended!

column9: What is with the high price
column10: We love Udi;s products but they are normal price at the store for $5-$7 for the bread & bagels & you can get them on sale sometimes also so they are way high price on this.
You can buy this bread directly from Udi's for a lot cheaper. The Bread is great but not at this price.

This is the best brand of gluten-free bread I have tasted! It is not dense or crumbly like the other gluten-free breads I have tried. The whole grain bread is my favourite. I go out of my way to purchase this particular brand, and hope that my local store will soon stock it. I also really love the Udi's pizza crusts and bagels.
Wife is allergic to gluten, I'm not - this doesn't keep me from eating this bread, it's reallygood stuff.

It was so hard to find these items anywhere, so when I found the crab apple jelly AND jam on Amazon, I got really excited.  I try to find "unique" Christmas gifts for my hard to please brother in law.  Well, crab apple jelly is one of his favorite things, and JAM is better appreciated from any fruit than jelly.  So I bought him both, as well as some Maine blueberry jam.  I think he'll be happy this year.

The beans arrived in plenty of time for planting this spring.  They grew well and climbed a trellis rapidly displaying a bevvy of beautiful scarlet blossoms.  At present, I have large pods of beans nearly ready to pick!

I bought these beans to plant on the side of my house to provide some beauty (the red flowers) and some beans for our dinner table. They came up fine and sure enough nice red delicate flowers. HOWEVER NO BEANS whatsoever. Will not buy them again.

These beans are coming up already.  I don't know about tasteyet.  That will come later this summer, but they are growing fast!We go outside every morning just to see how far they have grown.I think they will be a great addition, as far as beauty for the yard,and taste for our dinner table!  I did purchase these from Amazon.
I do Bikram Yoga almost every day and this is by far the best rehydrating drink I have had. It's so refreshing and one of these after class cures my thirst.
I love this product.  Tastes great. I use it before and during tennis matches for hydration.  I have not had any issues with cramping since I started drinking this product.

I must say these coco waters are very refreshing. I have ended up chugging 2 or 3 of these on a hot day, and they do really cool you down. The electrolytes really help you recover fast from a hot day, to a rough work day, to a heavy work out. These things are awesome. Plus the LIGHT mango and peach flavor is great too!But these packs are actually kind of hard to open honestly. I mean some of them will open fine, but twisty caps on them aren't the best. I actually had to take a knife and cut out the piece that was holding the spout to the tetra pack on some of them. But the 11 oz packs are really awesome.Do give these a try. And you will never go back to Gatorade!

column9: Vita Coco Peach & Mango Coconut water
column10: We drink a lot of this in our house since our children don't do dairy.  We use coconut milk, so its an easy transition to the coconut water.  You should enjoy the taste of coconut to enjoy this product.  Price is right, but keeps climbing which may become an issue.  I like having it delivered to the door without any other hassle.
this is the best flavored coconut water.  All the other's are from concentrate. "like sticking a straw in a coconut"

The blend is not as great as I thought it would be.  It's too sweet or artificial tasting.  I'm got these in the larger size because during the hot weather I wanted to down one of these while on the go.  Luckily, I did also purchase the plain coconut water so hopefully I'll be able to cut the taste.

column9: It's pretty good but not good enough for 5 stars
column10: I like this flavor, but it's nothing exceptional. Taste Nirvana is my favorite coconut water, especially the ones with pulp (5 stars for that one). I'm rating this peach & mango Vita Coco 3.5 stars and rounding up to 4.

column9: Great coconut flavor, with nice mango flavor
column10: Coconut water is supposed to be a healthier version of a sports drink- good balance of electrolytes with natural sugars.I like the taste and value of these (the 11 ounce ones were too small for a session at the gym).If they are far from their expiration date, the mango flavor almost tastes like fresh mango's. Closer to it, it still tastes fine, just not as good.Of all the flavors I've had (pineapple, plain, passion fruit, acai), this is my favorite. The others aren't bad, but if you like the taste of mango, and a little more bold flavor, this one is the best.

I order this product through Amazon because the price is unbeatable and it ships for free with Super Saver.  I drink coconut water everyday and the 17 ounce is two servings, is a great source of potassium and vitamin C!  As for the taste, I know coconut water doesn't appeal to everyone.  My roommate thinks they are gross but I prefer it to the taste of other sports drinks.  Peach and Mango flavor is a lot sweeter than some of the other flavors I have tried.

I love this flavor. My kids prefer the pineapple, but this one is my favorite. I also love this size. I can share one with my kids, or I can close it back up for later. The ingredients are simply coconut water, fruit puree, and vitamin C. My son is extremely sensitive to artificial ingredients which are not always listed on the labels. He has been fine with Vita Coco and loves them too!
Product is delicious - refreshing recovery drink after a hard workout in place of gatorade or other recovery drinks. Mixes well with glutamine powder.

Was sorry I ordered a case of these, as it tasted to me like, ... well the first thing that came to mind is the way cat pee smells.  Maybe I just don't care for mango flavor, although I like the fruit.  I have cancelled my subscription for these and switched to the pineapple flavor, and the one with a splash of guava, both of which are excellent.

I saw the vita coco boxes at the grocery store and was intrigued. My boyfriend said someone he knew liked it. So we got a box of pineapple and a box of peach & mango. LOVE THEM!! I tried other flavors, such as the acai pomegranate and I didn't like it very much. The tangerine isn't too bad. My favorite is peach & mango! I order that and the pineapple by the case now so I always have a cold box ready to go!! So tasty and refreshing, better than just plain ol' water! Definitely worth subscribing to monthly delivery through Amazon!!
I love this flavor.  It hydrates you fast and effectively, replenishing all depleted electrolytes.  Saves money on buying them individually too.

column9: tasty and refreshing -- favorite flavor, too
column10: i've tried several of the vita coco options, and this is by far my favorite flavor. so tasty, refreshing, and handy (given the squareness of the packaging, i can stack them on their sides and thus store them in a back, low area of my fridge that i otherwise couldn't utilize, which is very handy for my small-apartment space needs). highly recommended! i'll never get sick of this stuff.
I used to buy this at the store, but since I started drinking it a couple times a day, buying by the case makes more sense.

column9: Best of the Flavored Coconut Waters
column10: I have been enjoying coconut water for over 2 years.  For the most part I love the natural "regular" variety, but was able to buy a variety pack through Amazon.  After tasting the different flavored varieties, I found that I liked the tangerine but LOVED the peach/mango.  So far, the boxes I have enjoyed have been very consistent in flavor, which is the only downside to coconut water that I have found to date.What I particularly liked about these waters was the container.  It has a small screw top that makes the container resealable and less likely to spoil and/or spill in between drinks.  At 17 ounces it is unlikely for me to finish drinking it in one sitting so I really appreciate this small innovation.  I wish they could do this on the 11 ounce containers but this product is costly enough without adding to the expense.I am giving this particular product 5 stars, because of the combination of great taste and the innovative packaging.  If you need to pay attention to sugar, stick with the unflavored coconut waters because this is sweet, with about twice the natural sugars of the unflavored.  Not a reason to downgrade the product, but something to make a note of if sugar is an issue in your life.Give it a try and enjoy!

this is my favorite flavor out of all the coconut water choices. This is so much healthier than most of the other sport drinks.  We love it.  With free shipping, it was a better deal to get a case of this from Amazon instead of my local grocer.
Coco water has been a great discovery. It's refreshing to drink and it's quite flavorful. My whole family enjoys it. Our favorites are Coco water with pineapple and Coco water with mango & peach.

IT SAYS ON THE BOX EACH DRINK CONTAINS: THE POTASIUM OF 2 BANANAS & MORE ELECTROLITES THAN A SPORTS DRINK. THEY MIGHT SEEM A LITTLE HIGH PRICED BUT GO TO GROECERY STORE BUY 2 BANANAS & 2 SPORTS DRINKS AND YOU WILL PAY MORE TO GET THE SAME NUTRITION YOU GET FROM 1 JUICE BOX OF THIS COCONUT WATER.

Delicious, perfect. An all-natural fruit drink with fewer calories than a comparable non-diet beverage. The flavor is addictive -- just the right level of sweetness, real fruit flavor (great if you really like peaches and/or mangos), and a light feel. Would give this product 10 stars if possible. Plus these new 17-ounce containers have the great added bonus of a recloseable twist-cap.

column9: Expiration date is cutting it close.
column10: I am happy with the product.  I received it quickly.  My only concern is the expiration date is only a few months away.  I will most likely drink all of the cartons before they expire, but when I go in the grocery store and the expiration dates are a months later I have to wonder if that is why the amazon prices are so much cheaper.

I signed up for the reoccuring monthly shipment of the 17 oz. Vita Coco (both the Peach Mango and Pineapple flavors). I am very happy with the product itself - however, I only received 10 boxes out of the advertised 12. I would beware about buying the reoccuring shipments as you might not get everything you ordered.I am not able to return the product and am trying to find out how to report this to Amazon in the correct way. Buyer Beware.

I'm seriously addicted to this stuff. Its definitely one of my drinks. Its so much healthier for you than soda and has less than half the amount of sugar of sports drinks like Gatorade. I didn't even realize there was a peach & mango flavor, I'm going to go and look for it when I go to the store today!

We just had 4 cases of these from amazon and these are NOT the same as 11.2 oz ones. There are numerous brown specks or particles floating in the drink if you look it closely under the light. We didn't discover this until we realized that the drink did something funny to our stomachs afterwards. The constitution is much murkier than previous 11.2 oz packages and doesn't taste the same. We think this has a different processing procedure than the 11.2 oz packages. Maybe it has to do with the factory filtration system or even a serious quality control problem. As with all other food imports, very few are actually sample tested by FSIS/DOA for safety or against the ingredients listed by the manufacturer. Any feedback to us from other reviewers is encouraged. We'd like to know what these brownish particles are and why they are there. If you find it exactly the same as 11.2 oz ones, let other readers know too. For now, we'd suggest you go test one in a local supermarket and see if it's to your liking and compare these with 11.2 oz ones.

Maybe it's something that I did to it, but the first package was good, and my family liked it.  After that, all the ones that I made was dry.  I always make enough bread to last a couple of days, and this one was VERY dry and not very good after it cooled down.  When I make quick breads for breakfast, I try to make enough for the next day or 2 breakfasts, and this bread was just too dry.

Never thought I would be saying those words. This stuff is Fair Trade (ever hear about the "Darker Side of Chocolate"?), comes in GLASS not plastic, is fluffier and in my opinion more delicious than Nutella. Who ever thought 40 years ago that one day granulated sugar would be considered almost a health food? Well compared to the choices we have nowadays that's the way it seems. My eight year old granddaughter knows by heart the day my Subscribe and Save order arrives, making me "Super Mima" :-) Live a little!
My super picky family loves this spread.  We love Nutella, but I cut out the hydrogenated oils so we needed a replacement. Enjoy!
I love chocolate hazelnut spread and was spoiled by one that I picked up in NYC at Eataly last year but this is a very close substitute. Good chocolate flavor and very creamy.

I'm a big fan of nutella, but found this product to be more affordable online, and i wasn't thoroughly impressed with it. I did enjoy it, but i am deployed and my choices are very limited. If you are fond of the taste of nutella, this is a different flavor, just be forwarned.

column9: fair trade chocolatey smooth but on the sweet side
column10: Yeah, the pkg says the Cocoa is Fair Trade Certified and it's made in Belgium and it has no trans fat and nothing artificial but it's first ingredient on its list is sugar and it has palm and/or canola oil.  It's not as sweet as candy as Nocciolata Organic Hazelnut Spread with Cocoa and Milk -- 9.52 oz but it is MUCH more sweet than Justin's Nut Butter Natural Chocolate Hazelnut Blend, 16 Ounce plastic jars (Pack of 3) so no, I wouldn't buy it again on a regular basis but maybe occasionally.  It's incredibly smooth and chocolatey but it's on the sweet side.  Sometimes, I may want its sweetness on my english muffin or hard shortbread-like cookie, but after tasting Justin's non-sweet, hardy nutella, it's hard for me to switch on a regular basis to a sweet nutella.
Stellar Nutella substitute. Not as readily available or as cheap, but grab it w/ S&S and enjoy a superior mouthfeel and better ingredient list.

This product is has a slightly different texture than Nutella, it's thicker and a little less oily but it's made of better ingredients and I honestly prefer the taste. Plus, I love that it's not stored in a plastic jar.

This spread is better than Nutella - it is less sweet and has a smooth peanut butter consistency unlike the other brand which I find too sweet and syrup-like. Great cocoa flavor. The price is great too.

This stuff is OK, but truly it is SO not better than Nutella.  I bought a case of 3 based on the other reviews here, and I really have to say that they were all flat out wrong.  This stuff is WAY sweeter than Nutella, no way around that.  Plus, they are both made with sugar so they're equal in that ingredient, but obviously this product has more of it than Nutella.  To me, Nutella is the do all end all of hazelnut cocoa spreads -- it's really thick, it's really chocolatey, and yes, it does come in a plastic jar but at least you can recycle it, right?  I did prefer the glass jar of this one but that isn't why i buy something. If both products were equal in every way except for the glass jar, then I'd go with this.  They're not equal, so I'm going back to Nutella! Plus, Nutella comes in huge jars AND you can buy it at Costco.  How much better can it get?  Easy access, good price, fantastic flavor!  Love Nutella!
This is a perfect spread....not overloaded with sugar like Nutella.  I also like that it isn't in a plastic container (they are packaged in glass) and the cocoa is free trade.  Great product!

column9: Not the same as Nutella, but we liked it better.
column10: I ordered this once because it was the most cost effective natural option online.  It does have sugar, and it is sweet.  I find it better tasting than Nutella. It is smooth, creamy and delicious, we don't get anything else now.  We don't eat it all the time, but some of this spread on a slice of sprouted multi-grain bread is a wonderful treat.

I was a Nutella fan until I saw this on the shelf at the local Whole Foods.  Thought of giving it a try (Although more expensive than Nutella), and WOW.....thank goodness I tried it.  TASTES WAY BETTER than Nutella.  Yes, it is not as sweet as Nutella but I think that's how it SHOULD taste.  Too much of sweetness in anything is sick.  It is also not as greasy(emulsion-like) as Nutella.  It tastes more hazelnutty than Nutella. And it does not have artificial anything in it unlike Nutella which contains vanillin.  Nutella is not an inferior product but surely NOT BETTER THAN THIS ONE.

But..it comes well packaged in a glass jar, as opposed to plastic. Taste is very good, more chocolatey and less sweet then Nutella. 1-2 tablespoons go a long way, smear on rice cakes or use as a topping. That being said, I won't be buying this item anymore. Only because I'm looking for a better deal.

column9: Less Oily and Better Churned than Nutella
column10: This is an awesome spread. Much less oily than Nutella, creamier.Couldn't care less about the Fair Trade stuff. Typically, Fair Trade is more about politics than economics. And it usually ends up being more environmentally wasteful and expensive. Nevertheless, this is a better product.

The jelly beans are absolutely fantastic. I was set people up and ask if they want so, well of course they do. It's so funny when they respond by spiting it out and say "That taste like moldy cheese." I crack up:^D hehehehehe!!! I recommend these jelly beans to everyone. I really wish they would come out with a poop flavor. I heard they have owl's poop. However, I never seen it.

Kids and adults loved these.  Its a fun game to do with your kids, which one will you get?  Juicy Pear or Booger?  (Which by the way the kids said this was the grossest one).  They loved the experiment.

column9: Perfect for a Harry Potter  Party!
column10: I bought two boxes of these jelly beans as they were the closest thing you can buy (at a reasonable price) to the Harry Potter "Bertie Bott's Every Flavor Beans". I bought two boexes because I thought there'd only be 20 beans in a box but in fact there must have been at least 40. We had way too many left over. The kids got a huge kick out of daring eachother to try one. Shipping was fast and included in these $6/box jelly beans.
I bought EXACTLY the same thing today at Marshalls for $12.99.  Same company, same thing. Absolutely no difference.  $92 for salt - I don't care what kind of salt it is ... $92?!!!

i found this item at Whole Foods when i was visiting my hometown in California. I figured I would buy more at my local Whole Foods.  Turns out they don't shelve it here! Unfortunately most people are ill informed about vegan cats, including most veterinarians.Wild cats are in fact obligate carnivores. However, in domesticating the house cat and bringing it into our homes we have effectively removed the cat from its natural prey of mice, insects, birds, lizards, and other small creatures. During the past 100 years or so, as the human food industry was searching for a way to salvage and use all the waste materials from its processing lines, it came upon a wonderful solution. Lets boil it all up and dry it out and add it to the food we make for cats and dogs. As a result, the vast majority of commercial pet foods contain what are euphemistically referred to as the four D's, dead, dying, disabled, and diseased animals, along with other quite undesirable materials. Quite frankly, if you are feeding this junk to your pets, you are effectively poisoning them. We are seeing diseases in pets today that we have never seen before because of the wide variety of contaminated ingredients that are finding their way into the food we feed our companion animals. You know "garbage in, garbage out!"Now the issue here is not meat; it is about providing all the essential and non-essential amino acids (the building blocks of proteins) and vitamins and minerals that are bio-available to the particularly unique physiology of felids (cats). The quality, quantity, and availability of these nutrients can come from any source, and for those of us who are vegan, the best source is vegetable based.Tens of thousands, perhaps hundreds of thousands, of cats around the world live quite well on one of the several available vegan cat foods that are recognized as nutritionally complete. I personally have had 3 1/2 years of experience in feeding the Evolution kibble product that this review is addressing. It is a high quality product that is AAFCO certified as nutritionally complete for all life stages in cats. Not only is this product safe to feed your cat, but if you follow the recommended feeding procedures, you will find many benefits to both your cat's health and your wallet.If you desire more detailed information, I invite you to do a google search on vegan cats. I would put my web page information about this issue on this review, but it is against the policy for writing reviews on Amazon.Just for everyone's edification, I have researched this issue for well over 500 hours, read hundreds of technical papers, visited hundreds of web sites, and have made a commitment to specialize in feline nutrition as part of my Veterinary Technician studies. I probably know more about feline nutrition than 95% of all the vets in the world.My feline son is a vegan and will remain so because I am absolutely certain that his quality of life will be enhanced by his diet and that this choice will not be a detriment to his health.-------------------------------------Since writing this review in 2006 I have had a change in position about this particular product after 4 years of personal experience. The manufacturer of the Evolution foods was changing the formulation of the food on a regular basis and during that time I found that the Feline Kibble was not able to maintain the pH level in the urine of cats that was promised on the label and in their literature. At least that wasn't the case with my former feline son and my current feline son. As a result I can no longer recommend the use of Evolution Feline Kibble for male cats. Since urinary issues are different between male and female cats the Evolution Kibble MAY be satisfactory for feeding to female cats. Nutritionally the Evolution foods seem to be fine for nutrients but not necessarily adequate for maintaining the proper pH levels to avoid urinary issues for male cats.Consequently I am now recommending male cats use the Vegecat pH diet provided by Harbingers of a New Age. My son has been eating this food supplement in a specially prepared gluten formulation I created called a vegan feline roast. It is 62% protein, 33% fat, and 5% carbs and has a moisture content of about 60%. Almost a perfect combination of ingredients to mimic natural prey. My son finds this product to be very palatable and his urinary pH has been consistently at 6.4 for the three years that we have been producing and consuming this food. The drawback is that it takes about a half hour every 3 days to make the food and the cost is equivalent to a premium cat food. But on the other hand my son is trim, full of energy at 6 1/2 years, enjoys great health, no longer has urinary tract issues, and no other animal had to die in order to provide my son with life-giving nutrition.UPDATE:  4/17/11For those of you who are still considering feeding the Evolution kibble, please heed this warning.  Kibble is only 10% moisture content.  If you follow the directions given by the manufacturer to soak the kibble prior to feeding, you will end up with a mushy material that your cats may or may not like.  The danger in feeding the dry kibble is that your cat will eventually become so dehydrated that no amount of drinking will be sufficient to avoid hydration related illnesses.  Cats do not naturally drink water, they almost exclusively obtain all of their hydration from the food that they consume.  If they are eating something that only has 10% moisture, upon consumption the moisture that is contained within the digestive tract of the cat will be sucked into the food in order to give it enough fluidity to pass through the intestines.  This will often lead to gastro-intestinal diseases. Your cat will be constantly drinking water to make up for that deficiency, but no amount of drinking is enough to avoid the dehydration problem.  So please remember that the best source of moisture for your cat's health, comes from a wet food diet that is around 70% moisture.In October 2008 I wrote an article about vegan cats published in VegFamily magazine.  This information and more will help those who are interested in a vegan diet for cats understand more of the issues.UPDATE:  8/27/12My vegan feline son is now 8 years old and still maintains an extremely healthy life with absolutely no issues of any kind.  He has been using our Vegan Feline Roast product for the past 5 and 1/2 years and his lab tests indicate that his nutritional needs are being adequately met by his vegan diet.For those who are sceptical about a vegan diet for house cats, there is ample evidence that several vegan products are available to satisfy the nutritional needs of cats.  I am still not convinced that Evolution is a good product to feed based on my past history.  There are thousands of customers that seem to successfully feed the Evolution product; however, I believe that our Vegan Feline Roast Mix is a superior product that will yield far better results over the lifetime of feeding any house cat.  Our product is based on the Vegecat phi supplement offered by HOANA, which I have found to be an excellent product for hitting all of the missing nutritional elements that would otherwise come from meat.  The Vegecat product line has been successfully feeding thousands of cats over a 27 year period and we highly recommend the use of Vegecat for those people who wish to formulate their own vegan cat food.  The only difference between our food product and the HOANA vegecat product is that our product is a ready-to-make mix that has been specifically formulated for a high protein/high fat food that is easy to make and highly palatable to the vast majority of cats.I would caution people feeding the Evolution kibble to reconsider doing so.  The problem with kibble in general, not just the Evolution product, is the 10% moisture content of the food.  Cats that eat kibble exclusively will invariably become dehydrated and will not be able to consume enough water by drinking to avoid the condition.  Evolution kibble that is soaked with water prior to feeding, as recommended by the manufacturer, is an attempt to avoid this issue.  However, by soaking the product you will reduce the palatability quality to most cats and will make it harder for them to continue to want to eat the product.  This is a strategy to fix a problem that is inherent to the product itself.As time goes on, I become more convinced that using our Vegan Feline Roast product may in fact be a cure for diseases in cats like FLUTD and diabetes.  At some point in time I would like to perform a long term double blind scientifically significant study to support my empirical observations.  When my son started out 7 years ago eating Evolution kibble, he quickly developed a FLUTD condition, after 18 months of use, that cost $1500 at the vet to fix.  The last 5 1/2 years of eating nothing but our Vegan Feline Roast he has remained FLUTD free and maintains excellent health.  Just the savings alone from avoiding annual teeth cleaning has more than paid for itself in the use of our product.So my bottom line is to recommend not using Evolution Kibble in favor of either the HOANA vegecat supplement or our Vegan Feline Roast Mix.

column9: Kitties go crazy for veggie cat food!
column10: The two little darlings at my home have been eating this particular cat food since we got them from the local shelter at the ripe young age of 6 months.  We chose to switch them over to vegetarian cat food for two reasons: 1) both of us are ethical vegetarians, and 2) we could!We switched them using the same methods vets have recommended when undergoing any change in diet for felines--slowly mixing them together in differing proportions until all that they eat is the new kind of food.  In this way the cats do not undergo any kind of indigestion that might cause them to throw up (those with cats already will understand completely).But what was the surest sign that we were doing the right thing for our cats?  Even on the first day, and for everyday it was given to them after, they ignored the meat-based cat food, eating only the vegetable-based pieces from their bowl!  Everyday when I went to feed them in the morning, they would be waiting next to a bowl with meat-food detritus, staring impatiently for the vegetable goodness.As for their level of health, I have literally never known two cats to be sweeter or more active than these.  And I don't mean chaotic, but playful, pouncy, and sweet.  Is it all because of the food?  I can't say to 100% certainty.  But know this: when we got the kittens they were shy and scared, seemingly because both only have vision in their left eyes.  Now they are more daring than even the most normal of cats.All this and we don't have to participate in the inhumane practice of feeding waste animals to our companion friends!

Everytime I run out and get regular kibble or cans, my cats look scruffy and they seem to hate the store-bought stuff and hate me for feeding it to them.  On this food for years, my cats are shiny, never gassy, never fat though I leave the food out all the time in a bistro feeder, and their poop ain't sweet but seems less foul than when on other food. Only down side is that you have to remember to reorder it 2 weeks before you run out because it's not in any stores.  It's not cheap but with 2 cats a 40 pound bag ($90 including shipping) lasts me about 12 weeks, so under $4 a week per cat, maybe $2 more than Purina, $1 more than Iams and about the same as Blue or Nutro.
