column9: 4 years of success with this food
column10: We started using this food in April 2007 after a recommenation from a person who raises and breads AKC dogs that compete in prestigious dog shows.  I had told her how my cat developed allergies to most foods and really wasn't doing well with the Hill's Low-Allergen z/d Prescription Diet food.  Mine you, we always fed our cat premium cat foods.So, after ordering a $19.95 intro pack from Evolution Diet, we were thrilled to see our cat immediately embrace the dry vegan food.  Our vet had some concerns, telling us to make sure there is taurine in the food (which it does).Flash forward to his most recent vet visit which was last summer.  He had to be put under anesthesia for a tooth cleaning and while he was under, the vet gave him a complete physical.  When he was picked up, the vet wanted us to confirm his age.  15 years old was the reply.  She couldn't understand where we got that estimate from, surely it must have been wrong.  She estimate the age at about 6 or 7 years.  Well, we adopted him at a Humane Society as a baby so we knew for sure he was 15 (now 16).  All I can say is that the food must have had a huge influence on his "real age" vs. "physical age."  He has a shiny coat, he is healthy, he is active, and he still loves his food.  The only concern he has is a recent cracking of his bones of his back sometimes when he is stretching.  Luckily, he is not in pain and he still goes on his regular daily gallop/sprint, which sounds like a pack of elephants stamping around the house (this is one of his trademarks, he has always done this).In terms of moisture concerns or urinary issues, we have not had any.  We do not moisten his food.  He doesn't like it that way.  But he eats a lot of fruits and vegetables.  I didn't even know that cats liked fruits/vegetables before 1995, but this one aggressively stands firm on his love for them.  In fact, he has to have cantaloupe daily, it's non-negotiable.  It has been one of those things where he has demanded it for years.  Secondly, he loves bananas, so he gets a couple of pieces per week.  And, during the summer months, he gets asparagus spears, which happen to be his #2 favorite thing on earth, next to cantaloupe.  He has also been known to steal brocolli off of our plates and run away and eat it too.  He is really good at swiftly stealing food, even at 16.I give this food a 5/5 review because in my experience, it has been like a fountain of youth for my cat, who I adore.  I am so happy we were told about this food four years ago, and I will continue to feed it to my cat without reservations.

column9: Be Sure This Is What You Want

Some of these articles would come from dog food websites where the ingredient list would have corn as the first ingredient. We originally bought the Wellness brand Puppy food, but shortly after we got our dog, we realized that we were going to need food for a large breed puppy. Luckily, Wellness makes that food. It contains no corn and we have a happy, energetic puppy with a shiny coat and clear eyes. She never leaves a bite in her dish!

We were told by our local veterinary to feed our new puppy this food so we tried it to see if it would agree with her. Some foods we tried gave her very loose stools, which makes it a little harder to potty train when they can't control their bowels. Within 12 hours of starting her on this food her stools firmed up and has been normal ever since, and she seems to be growing well on it also. The Vet said she was in perfect shape for her age, but we only feed about 3/4 of what the bag recommends. Like the Vet said they are selling dog food, and most brands recommend to much food on their bag.

I did a lot of research before buying a new brand of puppy food for my AKC Purebred German Shepherd. He was underweight and would barely touch the food the breeder told me to buy. I decided on Wellness for it's quality ingredients and precise analysis. Well the first time I feed my puppy, he gobbles up over half their daily recommended feeding, after having fed him this morning a large canned food breakfast. I had never seen him gobble up dry food like that. As the day wore on I noticed an increased energy level in my puppy and he gladly had a second helping at night. I am already very happy and have high hopes for this food.

We have a German Shepherd puppy & have only been through 2 bags of this food, so I can't say "it's the best ever", but so far so good.  His coat is shiny, he's very energetic, & he never leaves a bite in his dish; he loves it!

Also, Eli had developed stomach growling after every meal on Science Diet. This no longer occurs with him either. I am very happy with the Wellness Super5Mix Puppy food for Large Breeds. You can't even be specific with which animal??  In addition to that there is a bunch of rice and filler.  Wellness has the good stuff - all natural and healthy ingredients that don't just fill your dog up, but provide nutritional content.

column9: Great psychological as well as physical deterrent.
column10: I have two dogs who loved digging up my garden and loved digging under the fence.My in-laws got me a Fido-Shock and I set it up.  During install I decided to test it out, so I held the wire and waited for a zap... nothing.  I double checked the wiring, held it again, and... nothing.As I stood there with the wire in my hand, perplexed, my dog jumped on me.  ZAP!Aagh!Yelp!I had failed to take into considerationt he fact that my rubber shoes didn't gound me.  When the dog jumped on me she grounded us both, and we both got zapped.Getting shocked is unpleasant, more in an unnatural way than in a painful way.The fence was immediatly effective.  I think they each got shocked one more time and learned their lesson quick.  After three days I unplugged the Fido-Shock unit but kept the fence up.  The fence was a psychological deterrent and worked for years.Eventually my wife took the fence down and six month later the dogs were back to their old tricks.  My wife didn't let me set the fence back up, as she preferred dead plants to "prison wire" around the garden.Maybe 5 years later I set up a new garden in the back yard that the dogs loved to tromp around in.  I set the fence up and the dogs immediatly began ignoring it.  I don't think they ever got shocked.I left it plugged in for three days anyway (just in case) and have had it off ever since.Fido-Shock works great.  The disadvantages are that you can see the "prison wire" and stakes, and you might accidently shock yourself.

Had a raccoon that would visit our deck, and rob the bird feeder.  Not that big of deal to us, in fact we liked it, but often would muddy up the deck, make a mess, and then started taking a big dump right in front of our deck door as big thank you before he/she left for the night.  (Raccoon droppings are very dangerous, and we were afraid our dog would eat it.)  Hooked the unit up to the bird feeder, and the second night we heard for the first time in our life an authentic scream of a raccoon.  (they really can scream)  So far has not returned, and we have not had any more presents left by the bandit!  (Tested it myself after I set up, and gives you a jolt, but no pain or damage.)  Would recommend for raccoons or other pests.  Very affordable, and easy to install.  I may take a picture of my setup and post later.

We love backyard habitat, but marauding Raccoons (cute, but don't want them to use our yard as a latrine), a gang of angry squirrels and crafty giant Norweigan rats finally got to me.  Being completely ignorant of zappers, it's all new, but this unit works fine.  I test it by touching the wires, to make sure it's on; the shock is not serious, but not something you'd voluntarily repeat, so it's not going to harm animals, pets, neighbors or yourself.There are two modes: grounded and two-wire.  For fence work, the two-wire seems best; the intruders have to touch both wires, so it doesn't bother birds (who only land on one wire).For ground use, you want to ground one wire into the ground, and string the other wire as the "fence".  The intruder only has to touch one wire and be standing on the ground.I had it in two-wire mode, with one wire accidentally touching a branch of a tree; the current went up the branch (!) and created a shock several feet up the branch.It's branded Havahart, which is a good name; it does what it's supposed to.Get the aluminum wire, it's easy to cut and splice, and you need some plastic standoffs; if you get the yellow stubby ones, you will have a problem mounting them since they require a post sticking up.  I nailed them directly into a wooden fence or the eave of the house, it's a lot easier than trying to affix them to a large nail stuck into the wood.For ground use, 10" wire sticks are great; the stubby standoffs do actually affix to the 1/8 wire, and you can adjust the height.Raccoons are members of the cat family, and their stool CAN (does not always) contain brain-worm larvae or eggs.  The life-cycle of these worms starts in the intestines of cats who ingest an infected mouse; for two weeks, they excrete virulent eggs of the brain worms.  The eggs are capable of surviving in salt water or your backyard for up to a year; if someone accidently touches the stool and then food, they get infested.  Moreover, wind-blown dust can contain the eggs.  When a human or a mouse gets infested, the brain-worm eggs hatch; the small worms go right through intestine walls, and settle in nearby cells, exploding them and multiplying to other cells, causing a mild but discernable reaction.The body immune system usually wins, and drives them into encapsulated form, in the brain tissue, but has to continually keep attacking them to stop them from spreading again and destroying the body, cell by cell.Alarmingly, 22% of the people in the US are infested with brain worms; there is no cure, the worms exist in the brain until death, just waiting for the immune system to weaken and let them continue destroying the body.The eggs pass right through sewage systems, which is probably how so meny people get infected, because cities like San Diego have a waiver from normal treatment requirements and dump primary sewage into the Ocean.  The eggs remain a danger for months.  This is also why the Sea Otters are dying in Monterey Bay, because they eat shellfish which are infected by nearby sewage operations where people dump cat litter down the toilet, or else when raccoon droppings get washed into the Ocean.So getting rid of cat and raccoon droppings is a matter of survival, and this is one way to discourage them.  Raccoons like to create "latrines" in one area, and the whole Raccoon gang uses it.  Don't let it be your yard, especially if you have kids.

column9: Worked and now it is quiet
column10: Three of my relatives shepherds on our adjacent property would fence run along two neighbors yards, one with a obnoxious pit bull, another with a noisy black lab.  Much annoying barkingand I was constantly chasing the one instigator shepherd away.  Very annoying, even happening in the night.  And the dogs on both sides were damaging the fence.  Bought 12 three foot heavy metal stakes one from Home Depot with holes in them, ground off the paint at the bottom for better electrical contact.  Stakes were 1 foot from the fence, top hot Al wire stretched on insulators, about 1 1/2 foot high.  Added another ground wire half way in between, then added a 5 foot grounding copper rod in the soil.  Gets dry here in the summer, but the double ground is extra insurance (ground through ground wire and also through the soil).  So far, 3 shepherd dogs keep away, shy away after a few shocks, it is now very quiet and peaceful and the neighbors are also thankful.  So far this brand has worked fine.

Even the farmers who told me how to buy a fence charger had never heard of chargers for different size animals.
This fencer stopped working after using for 2-3 weeks. It got water in it, after a heavy rain.What can I do?Ron
I brought this product and installed one month ago, Few days ago when I inspected, it's mufuction, I sent email to manufacturer but without response.

column9: Company should be sued!!!! Constant Shock DANGEROUS!!!
column10: Not sure WHY on earth this company sells this product with Continuous shock. This is VERY DANGEROUS for smaller animals and children, even up to the size of Golden Retrievers. Read other reviews to see the animals this had killed!Do NOT buy a fence unit unless it is a pulsating shock. There is NO reason for this. It costs very little to make this pulsating and is much better and safer.

In this age of identity theft, government surveillance, Big Brother employers and airport screeners whose security checklist seems to include getting to third base, personal privacy is a real concern. I mean, I see, touch, say, buy, eat, listen to, wear, think and ride things every day that I don't want ANYONE TO FIND OUT ABOUT. How to keep my secrets secret, and my privates private?The last thing I want is some stranger rummaging through my personal correspondence. So I hooked this baby up, drilled a couple of holes by the front door, and electrified the mailbox.This way, if anyone comes snooping around to sneak a peek at my mail, they'll get a letter, all right. The letter 'EEEEEEEEEEEEEE!!!' And maybe a new frizzy hairdo.Of course, I didn't want to jolt my friendly local mail carrier. So I set the power supply on a timer -- it's off between 8 and 10am. But when the clock strikes ten -- *bzzzzzzzztttt*!Unfortunately, I forgot to tell the mailman right away, and he had a few... 'accidents' before we touched base. I had to hose off the porch a couple of times, and touch up some singe marks near the mailbox. But on the bright side -- nowadays the mail is ALWAYS on time. He delivers by 9:30, never a minute later. And you know, the afro look really suits him.

I only gave this product an average since I did not hook it up because I noticed it was for  livestock only so I returned it.  The best part of this transaction was dealing with AMAZON.  They transmitted a UPS return lable within 2 minutes and shipped it off.  Had my ok for refund within 3 days.  Now that's the way to do business.  I'm dealing with AMAZON whenever I can from now on.  No fuss...no muss...no dealing with robot phones.  CONGRATS AMAZON.

I have been craving pizza so bad so I broke this out and was very satisfied. The crust is a bit sweet but with some Ragu tomato sauce, garlic powder and shredded cheese I was happy happy happy. The texture is thick like Neapolitan square style pizza as opposed to the New York thin crust. Anyway, I totally recommend this product if you are craving pizza. These microwave kits have a far better taste and texture than the freezer section gluten-free products I have tried.

I found this by accident and totaly love it, quick easy and convient. it is easy to tweak to make how you want, add a lil garlic for pizza , and even good as is for putting ham and cheese on too. love to keep them around in car for on the go .

After I prepare the pizza crust as directed then I put it into a pan and top the pizza crust with my favorite ingredients, then I put it into the oven at 350 degrees until the cheese is melted.  Taste great and is crispy.

The ease of preparation was great. The finished crust has a fluffy texture; more of a soft bread than a pizza crust by my definition.  The kids weren't exactly crazy about it either (for that reason).

I purchased this for Christmas 2011.  I love peppermint bark and like to try a new kind every year.  Its a very special yearly treat for me, so I expect a lot from the product.Pros for Scott's Cakes version:  Good organization and logistics:  the package arrived quickly, the candy was well wrapped in the shipping box and shrink-wrapped in a box of its own.  Candy was in good condition (i.e., no broken pieces) and fresh.This seller's peppermint bark achieves a nice mix of peppermint and white chocolate flavor.  White chocolate gives off a nice mellow tone; it is good quality.  There is no dark chocolate layer to upset the balance of peppermint and white chocolate flavors in one's mouth.  This attracted me to Scott's Cakes.Cons:  The quality of the peppermint pieces in the chocolate was very disappointing.  The ad mentions that the buyer should expect to see pieces of candy cane/peppermint starlight mints mixed with white chocolate.  The photo seems to support this claim, showing robustly sized pieces of candy cane in the bark.  I expected a very crunchy chewing experience, which I think is the hallmark of the best types of peppermint bark.  However, the pieces of peppermint candy are in reality very small; there is no sensation of crispness when taking a bite.  The peppermint candy has a chewy consistency, making it seem more like taffy.  Thus, there is no auditory pleasure in consuming this version of peppermint bark.

This non-sugar sweetened chocolate has an oddly waxy taste and texture.  Chocolate quality is only fair.  It will do in a pinch, but would really not be a first choice.  Even the Russell Stover line of sugar-frees are competitive with this line.

My child has tons of teeth and I watch him closely when he eats these.He does really good eating them, they are not messy like the Gerber cereal bars.These are meant for children that have been eating solids for a longer time.

I was looking for all natural flavored coffee (not easy to find) when my college aged son brought some of this home. I could not find it locally at grocery stores or Starbucks locations so I'm glad it's available at amazon. It has a mild vanilla flavor- not overwhelming like some of the artificially flavored coffees. I will continue to order it.
Really did not like the taste.  I feel like flavored coffees are pretty hit or miss, and this one is definitely a miss.

column9: Great taste with a hint of vanilla
column10: I've purchased this coffee several times and really enjoy the taste.  It's a subtle vanilla taste.  I've just ordered the caramel flavor and am hoping that it will be as good.

I love that this bouillon tastes more like a blend of herbs blend than just some nondescript salty flavor. The price here is great when compared to purchasing at a health-food or specialty grocery store. This is my favorite variety of Rapunzel bouillon, and I'm glad that the pack of 6 stocks my pantry for awhile.

I use the Vegetable Bouillon with Sea Salt and Herbs. It is wonderful for seasoning beans, lentils or any soup. Chicken Noodle, vegetable or  Chicken, Lentil. I have given away many of the soups I have used it in and always have the highest compliments.
This vegetable bouillon is by far the best I have found. It makes all my soups taste great and doesn't give that strong celery taste that a lot of broths have.

column9: Delicious as Jewish Chicken Soup--and I'm Jewish
column10: I now use this for my Matzo Ball Soup on Passover (we're vegetarian) and whenever someone gets sick in our house.  THIS BROTH IS DELICIOUS.  It tastes better than my aunt's homemade chicken soup growing up.  I use it for everything now---- in Vegetarian Shepherd's Pie, Veg. Chili, etc--- delicious.

This exact type of bouillon is my favorite to use, period.  I've tried numerous other brands, this has the best taste.  However, I do NOT recommend their "sea salt & herbs" mix, nor their bouillon without sea salt.  I'm sure for other kinds of dishes they might taste fine, but for my main cooking [asian], the simple "vegan/veggie bouillon with sea salt" is perfect.If you want a little less bouillon and a little more of your own style, just use one less bouillon than recommended [ie instead of 5 cubes for 10 cups, use 4 cubes].

I swear I could just heat this in a bowl of water and have it as soup. Please disregard the emotional rant of one uninformed reviewer...there is nothing unnatural or inappropriate in this bullion. I have used it for years and it is absolutely the best.I especially love the flavor as a base for minestrone. Ask and I will post the recipe!
This is the best bouillon ever. Too bad Amazon jacked up the price for non Auto Reorders, though. I's now cheaper at my local co-op store.

I searched to find a boullion product that has no MSG and no onions (my husband is allergic to them). The product description does not list onions in the ingredient list. I ordered 6 packages of this and can't use it now. However, the taste IS delicious so I rated it 4 stars. It would be 5 stars if the ingredients were as stated in the product description.

I'm vegan and like to make soup. I've tried a lot of veggie broths and boullions, including making my own from scratch. This is my go-to seasoning. In addition to homemade soups, I've used it to flavor ramen and as a base for vegan gravy. Even my carnivorous husband and kids like this.

column9: all organic, no chemicals? it contains MSG!!!!
column10: this company has some nerve!!! their discription is full of no chemicals or pesticides...all organic...vegan...blah, blah, blah....i have used this product for months!!! only to realize after a google search, that "yeast extract" is indeed a flavor enhancer, aka, MSG!!! this company made false promises to consumers that believe that they are buying a "healthy" product....how disgusting!!

column9: Good for making a cherry beer
column10: I bought this to make a cherry ale for my daughter's wedding reception and it worked well. I added it to my secondary fermenter. I just wish the price had not doubled since I last bought it or I would order again.

Thank you Amazon.com and Caffe Divino! This is the best coffee I have ever had, period! I have always tried different coffees; Espresso, Cuban coffee in Miami, French Roast in Paris, and both Greek and Turkish coffees. However, I must admit that I have been settling for, and have grown accustom to the "drive-thru" swill that is called "Coffee". The Morning Glory experience was just that, Morning Glory. It was akin to drinking a fine wine, where you take your time enjoying the bouquet, the taste and the finish etc. No longer will I glug a cup of swill, but I will take just a few extra minutes to savor this great coffee. Again, thank you Amazon.com and Caffe Divino!

I am, admittedly, not a heavy coffee drinker. I do not drink coffee daily, but rather look at it as a postprandial treat or have it on mornings where I'm getting off to a slow start, rather than using it as a daily ritual. So when I do drink it, I want the best. Although I haven't had extensive experience with different coffee brands, "the best" currently qualifies as Good Morning, Morning Glory by Caffe Divino. I take my coffee black and don't like to add anything to it. So I prefer the taste of Good Morning, Morning Glory since there is a noticeable different in the standalone flavor of their roast when compared to other coffees. Their roast uses higher quality Arabica beans from South America, and it seems like a lot of attention is paid to the quality of the product. It is perfectly-balanced and a very smooth and full-flavored coffee with no bitterness.I originally ordered the ground roast but if you have your own grinder, I suggest trying the Caffé Divino Gourmet Coffee, Good Morning, Morning Glory Roast, 100% High Grown Arabica, Whole Bean, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2) as well. There is not too much of a discernible difference in taste but I really enjoy the smell of the whole bean after being ground.

I adopted a cat from the SPCA earlier this year.  She apparently had many food allergies.  Discovererd the problem was chicken.  Almost all cat foods have chicken in it. Everything you can buy at big box stores has chicken in it.  I went into a pet store and just read lables.  I tried several; one very similar to this cat food with just fish supposedly.  But my cat started sneezing and getting congested again.  So even though chicken meal wasn't mentioned, it made me wonder.  She could also eat foods with turkey but grew tired of it quickly and went on a hunger strike.  This food, she is thriving on it.  Gaining weight.  Fur is so soft.  No sneezing or congestion. I have purchsed this food at a nationwide pet mart, too, but Amazon's price is comparable, and if a prime member, delivery is free and quick.
I am happy with this purchase. My kitty likes salmon/seafood flavored foods best. I love that I can trust Blue Buffalo to make a product with good nutrition for my cat.
Ok raw hides, but good deal. Better for adult dogs, I have a large breed puppy and he wasn't crazy about them.

I bought the Starbucks Caramel Syrup & it was SOOOOO good, I couldn't find it again, so I bought this, it is SOOO gross! It's all corn syrup, high fructose corn syrup, they are literally the first 2 ingredients. EWWWWWW!

If you've ever had the "real deal," you'll know this isn't it. After having had the Trader Joe's brand and the Giradhelli (sp?) brand, this stuff doesn't even compare. Very artificial-tasting. Don't buy, especially if you're using it in a recipe! Suck it up and pay more for the top-brand stuff (or make your own), it's worth it.

These snacks are more than fresh and flavorful.  They are versatile too.  I sprinkle them into to green salads and add them to steamed veggies.  They add texture and surprise to many dishes.  Laurelann

Odd combinations of fruit and nuts and pepper...sounded odd to me.  But these are FANTASTIC.  I eat them all day long.  Nuts are so good for you and as long as I am munching a little on these all day, I forget to eat much else.

I tried a pack randomly today at Starbucks.  I wanted something different from the banana bread or chocolate-covered graham crackers that I would otherwise buy.  This is some solid trail mix.  I highly recommend.  As a matter of fact, I am on amazon now to buy more of it so I can let friends try.
Not only are these a great selection of Sahale's products, but they taste great and are soooooooo good for you.
these spiced nuts are awesome... I especially love the ones with cranberries, pepper and orange sauce
This is the perfect treat for taking on the plane with you. Not too sweet, lots of protein to keep you from snacking.

Even if you love nuts already, these will blow your mind. They're healthy and delicious and come in a great portion. Though admittedly, if I'm really hungry, I just plow through the whole bag. All three flavors in the nut blend variety pack are delicious. They're the most complex, interesting blend of spices and flavors I have ever tasted with nuts. I wholeheartedly recommend these to anyone. If you hate nuts, these will definitely convert you. Better tasting and better for you than any candy or chips out of the vending machine. You can sprinkle them on salads to add a great little kick. LOVE, LOVE, LOVE them. Food nirvana. I don't know how they did it, but its magic in a bag.

These snacks are very different from any other fruit & nut bars I have tried. Very unique flavors, and overall really good. My favorite has to be the Cashew! The Pecan is also really good. Though there's chinese chilli and black pepper in those, the flavors are very mild and not spicy.I did not quite like the Almond one - it was very sticky and gooey and I could not snack on it while at work as it made my fingers all sticky and I had to wash my hands before touching my computer. Hence the 4 stars. But if I were to rate only the Cashews and Pecans, I'd give it more than 5 stars!

Found these in a local Whole Foods and decided to buy a pack...boy was I hooked.  After comparing to Amazon I decided to buy the variety pack.  Since Valdosta was my first flavor it has the edge in favoritism....but wow the other 2 are still irresistible.It is impossible for me to not eat the whole bag.  I keep telling myself I'll take a few bites, but before I know it every last drop is consumed.I'm considering Subscribe & Save...its too tempting.  Buy these you will not regret it!

For a healthy and guilt free snack, try these nuts.  The combinations of ingredients are interesting, the flavor is complex, they have a nice crunch.  All that's needed is "portion control" because they're easy to keep eating. Great product!

So far we have mainly enjoyed the pecan version of the snacks but there are also delicious varieties with cashews, almonds, and pistachios.  All have high quality nuts combined with fruit bits such as dried cranberries plus black pepper and/or other spices to add a touch of zing.  All in all these snacks are both delicious and healthy and a new favorite.

Although I love nuts, I was hesitant to order these snacks based on the combinations (black pepper on pecans?).  I took a chance based on the excellent reviews, and boy am I glad I did.  I started out trying the pecans because pecans (Valdosta) have never been my nut of choice.  However, they tasted so terrific, I had a hard time putting them down.  The almond (Soledad) and cashews (Sing Buri)are delicious as well. I will not only be ordering these again, I will be trying some of Sahale's other snack products.If you have issues with gluten, please be aware that the cashew combination is not gluten free, but the almond and pecan combinations are.  So you might look for individual purchases.

When I saw the price on this gluten-free pasta I thought there must be a catch...small quantity, bad taste, gooey, something...but I was pleasantly surprised.  The pasta comes in a 1 lb bag, cooks well, it's not gooey and it tastes great!  What more could you want?

Since I found out I'm gluten intolerant, I've been missing pasta. I don't like the consistency of rice pasta, so I needed to find something. This pasta really feels like wheat pasta. It's a little odd at first because it very much tastes like corn, but it's not a bad flavor, and it's masked by sauces.

The Jelly Belly people actually put real licorice in these jelly beans. There is usually only one of the licorice beans in a bag of assorted beans, so if you love licorice, you can buy them solo. These are authentic tasting and really good. You can't beat Jelly Belly for flavor.

column9: This is an amazing Jelly Bean
column10: I have met the creator/inventor of the Jelly Belly and I can report with full confidence, that this is one tasty Licorice Jelly Bean.  A Jelly Belly is smaller than Jelly Beans and that is why Ronald Reagan liked them so much.  My personal favorite flavor is Licorice.  5 STARS!

These jelly beans were very unusual when they showed up.  They came in a package without a jelly belly logo, the jelly beans themselves had no jelly belly logo, and I don't really know if they were actually jelly bellys.  I got them as a gift, so I didn't try any of them, but it was odd giving a gift where it didn't seem like they were anything special, like I'd bagged up some licorice jelly beans from the grocery store or something, big woop...so I was disappointed.  And because they were a gift I had no idea what they tasted like.  So were they really jelly bellys?  Who knows?  I felt silly giving them though.

Just because I sent an order of these jelly beansto my oldest son in Roswell, Georgia.  He travelsa lot and enjoys a snack while he is driving andhe loves licorice jelly beans.This would make a nice gift for any special personin your life.

column9: My cat went crazy for these
column10: I have 2 cats and when I saw these I gave them a try. They both like treats but my younger male cat went crazy for these. He wouldn't let the female get near one to try. She is naturally more shy and a bit of a picky eater so I'm not sure she would have been game for these if she had been given a chance. I think she just needed some time to smell them before gulping them down as the male cat was doing. Giving them 5 stars because they were a super hit with the boy.
Our cat is crazy for these! She starts to purr and rub against our legs when we shake the bag. She won't touch the beef liver ones though.

column9: the ONLY treats my cat loves!
column10: My siameese cat has never liked any of the other types of treats I have offered, from kibble type treates by Innova, Greenies, and Whiskers to freeze dried treats from Whole Life and Pure Bites (beef liver).  He explodes in messy puke everywhere from any other type of freeze dried treats.  But he LOVES these shrimp treats!  They are perfect sized tiny freeze dried shrimp with no additives and is a product of the USA, which I like.  They come in a resealable pouch and they smell pretty tasty.  I have been tempted to try one but have so far resisted the urge.  If your cat loves seafood (who doesn't?) then your cat will love these!

column4: E. Ledbetter "Owner, Rescuer and Foster Paren...
column10: My two rescue cats absolutely love these treats, we have the shrimp and the chicken.  They lived their 9 months in a room w/o windows and not much human contact at a shelter, and although we've had them almost a year now, one of them is still very shy.  These treats kind of opened him up and now he comes to his name and allows you to pet him when given his shrimp.  All I have to do is shake the bag and say "shrimp" and he comes running.  No other treat has done that for us!

column9: 1 cat loves it, 1 just likes it.
column10: I was looking for treats I could use for training. Two adult cats were new to our home and were learning what repeatable behaviors to do more of (use the scratching post and other things.) I wanted to completely avoid treats full of carbohydrates or other nasties that my adult cats would get loaded up with.  It was suggested to me to take a look at freeze dried treats as an option and I liked that these didn't look like some of the others that looked like styrofoam peanuts that would crumble into dust if one was dropped on the floor!They are quite small and look exactly like the shrimp that come in the shrimp flavored cup-o-noodles soup. Since the shrimp are very flat and very small, sometimes it looks like it is a challenge for them to see the treat and also to pick the shrimp up to eat them. They get it eventually. Sometimes it takes a little extra effort.My food-motivated cat took to the treats right away. At the smell of them, she gets excited and starts pacing and can't wait to munch on them. She loves them and would eat the whole bag if I would let her!The second cat who is not so much food-motivated did not know what to do with them at first. She actually did not touch these treats for the first two days I used them. Just before I was about to give up, she ended up taking a nibble on one of them and has liked to eat them since. This cat will eat a couple of them with some enthusiasm but then quickly lose interest.I haven't tried other flavors. Overall I really like the product and would recommend it and even buy it again. For the price and the amount of treats that comes in them, I am very pleased. I feel the value is great for such a healthy treat. I am still on the look out for the one protein-based cat treat that will drive BOTH of the cats crazy and keep both of their interest consistently.

column9: Crunchy little shrimp treats - nothing artificial
column10: We use these as a treat for a diabetic cat during and after testing.  They are low carb, and she really likes the light, crunchy texture.  It is hard to find a crunchy treat that is not cheap "cereal" (full of grains/filler); these make a great option for cats who do not like jerky-style treats.Our pickiest eater won't touch them, so they may not be a hit with every cat, but we've never found a treat she likes.The product has a very strong shrimp odor, but are dry to the touch and our cats don't make a mess eating them, so it really hasn't been a problem.  The zipper seal bag also seems to help keep the treats fresh.
My cat loves this product, and I couldn't get it from my pet store.  I'm glad that Amazon was able to help me get my spoiled cat's favorite snacks on time.
My cat did not like these at all!!! Even tried placing them in his food dish, HE ATE AROUND THEM!!!!!!

column9: Awesome...mega amounts of green M&Ms...and some red ones too
column10: Peanut M&Ms are my favorite kind, and the holiday assortment is the best...there are dark green and lighter green M&Ms, and some red ones too.  Yep, over half of the bag is green!  Repeat after me, "Green M&Ms"..."Green M&Ms"..."Green M&Ms"...We use Holiday M&Ms (well, just the green ones) for our family's annual Grinch party.  This is not an anti-Christmas party, it is, in fact one of our favorite holiday traditions...we all dress in green, the gals do each other's hair like Whos down in Whoville, and we eat green snacks (pickles, guacamole dip, green punch, green M&Ms, spinach dip, etc.) while we watch Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas (Widescreen Edition) starring Jim Carey.  It's a blast!The 56 oz. bag also provides the closest thing to a bottomless pit of peanut M&M delight that you likely to find in one unit.  Of course, if you eat too many M&Ms at one time you can hit what economists call "diminishing marginal return."  That is, the first 1/4 pouund will taste great, but once you reach 1/2 pound they will probably start tasting icky...and eating more won't help.  But, if you pace yourself you can make a bag this size last a good long time!5 stars for quantity AND quality of one of America's favorite candy treats!

column9: M&M taste good! But the package does not provide a good seal
column10: The package says it is a resealable zipper, but it does not fit well. You have to put it in the proper storage area to keep it fresh.

Tootsie rolls have a unique chewy and chocolate taste that you don't find in other candies. It seems like I have been eating them forever. They last a really long time without tasting stale or getting too hard, and do not melt the way other chocolate candy does if you bring them outside to eat on a hot day (though they can get a little sticky).I don't see how anyone can be deceived by the word "bulk", as the negative review suggests, since these are clearly stated to be 16oz. Moreover the negative review is based solely on the price on Amazon, which admittedly is very high, rather than on the quality of the product itself, which is excellent, regardless of where you buy it. Finally, the negative reviewer has suggested in a comment (which has been deleted) that because I live in the same state as the company that makes this product, there must be some connection between me and the company. There is none.Shop for price. I buy these for less than half the price on Amazon at my local drugstore (CVS).

The description uses the word bulk, so I didn't even think about the 16 oz. size description. Do not be deceived into thinking you are getting a large quantity. This is the same size bag you can buy at your local drug store for $2-$3 less than you would pay here. Very disappointed at how they mis-portray this as being "bulk", this is just your everyday average bag of Tootsie Rolls.
I ordered these for my husband in Afghanistan and they arrived to him in top condition. Like they were new and had not been sitting around a while like other company's. Thank you.
Who doesn't like tootsie rolls!!!  They are awesome!  If you've never had a tootsie roll, you need to try one.
Tootsie rolls are Gootsie rolls.  I ate the whole bag while watching the Broncos beat the J-E-T-S......don't know what I enjoyed more. Both were great!
Actually the snack is not bad. However, it's primarily apples, a few strawberries, some small blueberries, and in the first packet, one cherry. So fairly tasty, but misleading.

AVOID unless you want apple...( product held 90% apple) with less then 14  bitty bits of cherry or berry. If you desire BERRY try the CRUNCHIES freeze dried truly all berry!( if ZERO stars were available this would be a zero...good idea if it really were CHERRY BERRY...so OK 1 star)

These snacks are so very delicious.  I am always looking for a healthy snack and I was pleasantly surprised when I found Sensible Foods.They are so satisfying and delicious that I my biggest problem is having enough in the house.My sons love them and that is always a great thing.  I am so very pleased that they grab for these healthy snacks rather than junk.I highly recommend this product.  Just make sure to buy alot...they will disappear quickly.

It was very light and 'airey'. The flavor was fantastic. It is great to add to cereal if you want but I also loved it right from the bag. There is no moisture at all so it's totally unlike the raisin foods
This is an awesome product.  Its cruncy, its flavorful.  Everyone in my family loves it.  I plan to reorder it!
I Sprinkle these on my non sweetened cereals and love them.  They are also a delicious snack!  I am going to purchase another box right now.

Has replaced candy to curb my afternoon sweet tooth.  Delicious and easy to throw into your pocketbook or breifcase on the way to work.Also, much cheaper to buy in bulk then individually at the store.

I bought this product just for trying. I was nervous because my wife did not like me to buy food products over the internet because we had bad experience before. However, even before I went back home from work (I normally travel out of town), my wife and my son had already opened the box and tried the snacks. They told me this was the best dried food that they had. I tried myself. It was awesome. It is crunchy, not that kind of dry or oily from other brand. I definitely recommend it to others.
Everyone in my office loves these except for me.  They just do not suit my taste.  I do recommend, however, that you try them for yourself.

Great portable snack, healthy and sweet! But I also love to add some to granola, hot cereals or salads! Great way to add more fruit to your diet, without worrying about spoilage or damage taking it with you to work or school.

column9: A lot of apples... Not much else.
column10: I have purchased this flavor and all the other flavors that I was able to find and they were all pretty much a disappointment. When purchasing something called Cherry Blend, I expect that it should have a fair amount of cherries. However, that wasn't the case at all. All the formulas pretty much consist of about 90% or above just apples and very little anything else.If I wanted just apples, then I would purchase just apples but I didn't, I purchased something that claimed to contain more but I don't consider a couple bits of cherries to constitute a product called Cherry Blend.

Sensible Foods should really stick to Apples only.  This mix is mostly Apples...and very little of anything else.  I found a blueberry and one strawberry piece in one packet...the rest just apples.  If I had wanted dried apples, I would have bought dried apples.  I saw these on a shopping channel and the mix they presented had more of the berries than this mix.  I won't buy again...don't buy unless you are satisfied with just apples.

I ordered this product so my husband would have a healthy lightweight snack for a Sheep hunting trip he will be taking this fall, I was very surprised that my son has fallen in love with it, his favorite is the blueberries. I will be ordering more of this since my family love them..... Thanks

I tend to rate dried fruit snacks on a curve due to the truly horrible similar products I've encountered in the past, otherwise this item would be a solid 2 star. That said, lets break this item down.FRUIT MIX: 70-75% apple with the bulk of the rest of the volume being blueberries & strawberries( I assume I ate a cherry or two, I must have, since they are pictured on the package).CRUNCH: You would think with these items being called crunchy fruit snacks the fruit would actually be crunchy wouldn't you? Not so, only the apples were truly crunchy, the rest of the mix having the texture and consistency of the white part of popcorn(or possibly packing peanuts?).FLAVOR: In this mix, only the strawberries had a strong flavor, the rest of the fruit seemed bland in comparison(to me this is a detractor,but if you like more subtle flavors this might be for you).ANTICIPATION(how much do I look forward to getting my next serving): On a scale of vietnamese fish sauce to german black forest cake(w/cherries) I'd give it a brussel sprouts verging on asperagushood.All negatives aside, though this item is not as bad as some similar products I have encountered in the past, I probably would not purchase this product again.
Being able to carry berries without a mess is great. Dried is a great solution and these taste great too!

column9: Great sweet, but not sugary snack!!!
column10: Wow!  You can really enjoy on-the-go fruit goodness without all of the sugar found in other dried fruit snacks.  All the  flavors "pop" in your mouth.  It works well for me while doing the Weight Watchers "Points" system and  my diabetic husband (who normally likes sugary sweet snacks) loves this product also.

column9: Great lunchtime snack for my 5 yr old
column10: The whole family loves this crunchy, healthy snack!  My five year old daughter is a very picky eater, the majority of her diet revolves around fruit!  This snack is relatively mess-free (I mean except for the times when it's been spilled in the car!).  It's especially great on-the-go and for lunches, but really is an anytime healthy, enjoyable snack.If you like crunch, apples, strawberries, blueberries, and cherries (not many cherries which I understand as they are more expensive), try this snack!

I was pleasantly surprised by the simple goodness of these snacks.  They remind me more of fruit that has been "freeze-dried" (like the ice cream at the Air and Space Museum in DC, if you are familiar) than of conventional dried fruit.  They are light and flavorful with "nothing else" added to the fruit (as the ingredients state).  They might take some getting used to if you are familiar with sugary (high fructose corn syrup) dried fruit, though.  They are a great addition to organic cereal and low-fat ice cream, too.  Yum!
These were a pleasant surprise. I needed to pick something healthy for my husband and took a wild guess with this one. He really likes these alot and they fall within his idea of healthy food.
This product is drier and less flavorful than I had expected. Ended up using them on cereal, rather than as a stand-alone snack. Could have just bought cereal with dehydrated berries.

As someone who really enjoys dried fruit, I was very excited to try this product, but I must say that I was pretty disappointed in it overall. The crunch is a great feature for a dried fruit snack; however, the flavors were not very pleasant. The berries seem to be somehow simultaneously too strong and too muddled, and as other reviewers noted, it was pretty difficult to find any cherries in the mix. I did enjoy the apples--that fruit and the true crunchiness managed to pull three stars from me--and I may try one of the apples-only packages to see how I feel about that version. Two friends who tried the snacks also deemed them "okay, but not amazing." Overall, I can only give a lukewarm recommendation for this mix...

I purchased the Cherry Berry and Orchard Blend Snacks for my 2 and 4 year old girls.  They love them! They are perfect snacks for children (all natural, no sugar added, grown in the U.S.).  The Orchard Blend is slightly easier to eat (the pieces of fruit are larger) and the Cherry Berry is a little messier, but both flavors are a big hit.  I highly recommend this product for anyone looking for a delicious and healthy snack!  I will definitely keep ordering these items!
All fruit, nothing added.  It's sad that's so hard to find.  They have a great taste so it's a win all around.

I love these snacks, I've bought them loose whenever I found them for a ridiculous price because I love them. Then I found them to order on Amazon for a bit of a discount (being bulk).... and I am actually quite disappointed, both boxes I bought are pretty stale, even thought the expiration date is 2013. I can only guess the storage is not good where they are kept through Amazon.The flavor is great still, and they are edible, but this is the last time I purchase them through here.
If you like strawberries, you will love this low calorie, healthy snack.  They are also great to add to a high fiber cereal for a little extra kick.

I love molasses and use it mainly in baking. This is very good. I was expecting a little bit of a stronger flavor, because of the "Dark and Zesty" name. It reminds me of Grandma's brand molasses, maybe just a tad stronger. It's not too thick so it's easy to pour or spoon out of the bottle. The price is right too; less than I pay at the grocery store. Do be aware that this comes in plastic, not glass bottles.
Really love this,its just how I remembered Molasses tasting,Very good stuff.The only thing I didn't like is one of the leaked out and it was a bit messy

This is one of the best and natural tasting molasses I have came across. It is sweet, cake batter like consistency and dark brown. The product shipped on time. I used it to make Yomari(google it :)) It's the Nepali, more specifically Newari delicacy. The molasses tasted exactly like I used to eat back home. Thanks Slow As Molasses.
This brand has a wonderful, deep and rich molasses flavor. I was very impressed by the quality of the product. I highly recommend it.
This is your typical dark molasses. Tasty for sure and excellent in cooking, baking and using as a topping for cornbread and so on.

Wow, I thought I knew molasses before. Now I know molasses! I add it to my mud-like tea concoction every morning (pepper, cinnamon, ginger, cardamom, cloves, turmeric, milk, and various teas). It also goes in my cooked cereals. So now I've increased the amount of molasses in those creations, because I love the flavor this adds. It might be more "zesty", as they call it, than some people prefer, but it's exactly what I was looking for - not so much a search for sweetness, but flavor! I could write an ad for the "Slow As" company. Oh, I just did. Where's my check? Actually, I'm already addicted to the flavors this gives to my morning rituals, I mean, routines. So you can take my comments as honest, not commercial... or is it the addiction talking??

column9: Never Knew How Much I LOVE Molasses!
column10: Bought a case of this Slow As Molasses, Dark and Zesty, last December and I've been using it in MANY baked goods and recipes!  I've had opportunity to compare this molasses to other brands and varieties, and I'd say this is by far the best of the lot!  Yes, it IS very Dark and Very Zesty and that is what makes it so darn good!  I've never made better Pumpernickel!  The price of retail makes a case of this on Amazon VERY advantageous!!

***Updated Dec 8, 2011******From reading recent comments it sounds like this product has changed from when I reviewed it.  My package lists the ingredients as Blue: Deionized water, glycerin, red cabbage.  Red: Beet juice, citric acid.  Yellow: Deionized water, glycerin, curcumin.  More recent customers claim it now has chemicals.  If you are interested in natural food coloring, this doesn't sound like the product for you.  Hopefully Amazon will get the listing straightened out.****************************We avoid artificial ingredients, so after attempting to color icing for Chirstmas cookies with fruit juice and beet juice last year, I bought this food coloring to try out this year.  After reading the other reviews, I didn't have high expectations and was only hoping that it would be easier than making my own (and it was).But I was able to get rich, vibrant colors, not simply pastels.  Certainly they weren't the bright artificial colors you get with petrochemicals, but they were far from the pale pink and yellows I was expecting.My first experimentation was with small batches of icing - only using a few tablespoons of powdered sugar and milk and 2-5 drops of coloring.  The red came out a magenta, not Barbie pink, but definitely not red, either.  The blue was kind of a greyish blue.  The yellow was the most like you would expect.  I had also thought that the colors wouldn't mix well but I made green by mixing the blue and yellow and a nice purple by mixing blue and red.As one reviewer noted, they don't have as long as a shelf life as non-natural colors.  I bought mine in October and they are dated 5/2011.  But I put them in the refrigerator immediately (not waiting until after they were opened) and I have read on another site that carries them that this can extend their life up to a year.  The yellow separates so I shook it well before using.I was very pleased with the results and would definitely use them again. I'll try to post a photo of our Christmas cookies with the product.

It is fabulous that there is an all natural food dye safe to use for my child allergic to anything chemical and artificial in his food. However, the dye is thick and goopy and makes the frosting much thicker and pastier than it should be, not smooth at all. Also, you can not get a rich deep color with this stuff so plan for everything to be pastel if you need anything darker rather than lighter in color. Still, over all, because it is one of the fewest choices I have to color my candy and desserts for my child on the Feingold diet, I recommend it to at least try. The price is much too steep though for the quality the product doesn't give.

I'm disappointed and I haven't even used it yet.  When I checked the ingredients list on line everything was ok.  A little curious on why they used sodium hydroxide in the yellow, but everything was natural.  That is what I wanted.  When they arrived I read the ingredients on the box and to my surprise the yellow is listed: Glycerin, polysorbate, propylene glycol, filtered deionized water, curcumin.  Polysorbate and propylene glycol, which is used in anti-freeze, aren't natural.  I now can not use the yellow at all.  I have had to order yellow from another company that has all natural colorings.  I am hoping it arrives before Friday so I can use it the frosting of the cake I'm making for my niece's 1st birthday.  I am very disappointed and will not be purchasing this in the future.

I really wanted to like these. I bought the double pack so I would have one for home and one for school. The school used traditional food dyes and my daughter broke out in hives. Not good. But we just tried to make playdough with these colors and were unable to make blue or green or yellow. Shades of reddish-pink to purply colors were ok. Perhaps it would help if I used bleached flour . As is, I can only endorse this half-heartedly for those who aren't trying to achieve a very specific color. It's a lot of money to spend for a product that only works moderately. I wish I had just experimented with juices instead (spinach, beet, and carrot) as someone else had recommended. I still would pick these over standard food dyes since those are linked to causing cancer and no amount of fun with food dye is worth that!

If you have allergies, DO NOT ORDER THIS PRODUCT!!!  Or if you care about false advertising of the most egregious kind, DO NOT ORDER THIS PRODUCT!!I ordered this because my son has severe allergies to all chemicals.  If it weren't a serious matter for him, I would not be spending this kind of money.  I carefully read the ingredient list on the product page and for the most part, all of the colors were listed as containing deionized water, glycerin, and depending on the color, a type of vegetable color.  Sounds safe enough.  Imagine my horror today when I opened the package and read the ingredients on there.  The yellow, in particular, has Polysorbate and PROPYLENE GLYCOL!!!!!  This is an ingredients in antifreeze and paint and is derived from petroleum!  This is no better than regular food dyes you can buy anywhere.  This could have been very serious for my son if I had just took the ingredient list on the product page at face value and just used these.  Now, I have to scramble to find another truly all natural set of colors before his birthday party.  I also wanted to use these for cookies for Halloween, but who knows if I'll get new ones by then.  Amazon's site says this is not a returnable item too!  However, I called them and explained the situation, and indicative of the fact that they realize how serious this could be, they told me to just keep the item and they refunded my money.  This is the worst case of false advertising I think I've ever seen considering what I said above, that most people willing to spend this much for all natural coloring have the potential to be seriously, and adversely affected by these chemicals!By the way, you might want to check out the organic and all natural colors at seelectteas.com instead.  I haven't called to verify that their ingredient list is indeed as it appears on the site, but if it is, they just contain water and vegetable juices.  The blue is made from gardenias.  Someone else who sells colors, who may have been trying to get me to order their product instead, said the seelectteas colors are of a lesser quality and that some of the ingredients are sourced from China and that gardenias have not been approved for this use by the FDA.  I left them a message but they were already closed.  Maybe I'll leave another post here after I talk to them to see if this is all true.  As far as the color goes, I don't care if it's not as bright if there are no chemicals.

column9: Received the oack of 2 and realized the expiration date was within 3 months of receipt.
column10: Received the pack of 2 and realized the expiration date was within 3 months of receipt. Plus the blue was pink.

column9: Great Natural Product; Takes a Little Practice
column10: The number one thing to know about this item is that it is not made with petrochemicals or with any chemicals linked to cancer or to hyperactivity. That makes it the only food coloring that we use in my house. Having said that, I'll agree with the other reviewers who noted that the colors are not as vibrant as artificial, carcinogenic, hyperactivity-inducing dyes. Nothing makes a rainbow on pavement as pretty as anti-freeze leaking out of a car--it doesn't mean that I'll put it in my food!My advice for getting brighter colors in baking is to keep your pre-colored item as clear as possible. This means using agave nectar, honey, or rice syrup, for example, instead of Sucanat. I don't use any refined sugar in my house, so when I want to color something with India Tree, I use a light-colored natural sweetener like one of the aforementioned items. Rice syrup doesn't interfere too much with the India Tree food colors; in fact, I was able to make a beautiful mint-green ice cream with rice syrup as the sweetener and India Tree yellow and blue as the coloring agents. You have to practice to get it perfect, but if your kid isn't used to the chemical food dyes, then anything you do with these India Tree dyes will be a bright difference from plain brown or tan baked goods.

column9: India Tree DOES NOT contain toxic chemicals.
column10: I spoke to a woman at India Tree at length about their ingredients. She said that for a short run of the product, they used a formulation that included propylene glycol and polysorbate to help preserve them and keep them from separating. They have since changed their formula BACK to the original with just vegetable color, water and citric acid. What you see on the ingredients label is CORRECT.That said, these colors are not nearly as vibrant as I hoped they would be, but given they are not chemical colors I can't complain too much. My food allergic daughter gets to enjoy fun colors now, so I am happy.

There are two packages of 2.25 oz each TOTAL. Not 2 packages of 3 containers of 2.25 oz each (totally 18 oz) as the ad says. I have been cheated.I have no idea of the quality yet: I'm just mad that I was promised 18 oz and I have 4.5 oz.

column9: Too expensive for the shelf life
column10: I bought this product for my son who is on the Feingold diet and has very bad reactions to artificial colors.  I used it in May to make his birthday cake, luckily he wanted a "stealth bomber that blended with the sky" (he's very particular with his demands, I try to please) which required most of the cake to be sky blue.  These colors will give you nice pastels, but if you are looking for a very rich color, you will not get it from this product, no matter how much color you use.  The cake came out great, and I used the red to do the lettering which came out a nice darkish magenta, and was pleased with the kit in general.  I justified the expense since it was really the only option I could find, the cake came out beautiful, and it worked for my purposes.  Here I am 6 months later, trying to do Halloween cookies (wanted to make orange) and the red is now an ugly brown...the colors are expired.  (Shaking my head, well...they are natural, things in nature do go bad! duh)  So unless you own a natural bakery and are cranking out baked goods weekly and going through this product pretty quickly, its not worth the price.

column9: Not great but better than the alternative I guess...
column10: I have been looking for natural food coloring-  mainly use it once a year to make green mac and cheese and other items for st paddy's day...Of course, I had to use the blue and yellow to make green and was not very successful.  I comforted myself about the ridiculously high price by telling myself you only use a drop or two at a time.  Not so- kept adding more and more and the best I could get was a light yellowish, green...Tried coloring soda bread with it and no color showed up at all after baking.  I also figured I could use it for a while but it expires in 6 months so it's not something you can keep around forever although it is something I rarely use. I would have to use it in frosting to really decide if it has any value as a colorant...this is the only reason I gave it 3 stars- because I think coloring frosting is probably it's best usage and I haven't tried that yet.  Otherwise I would have given it one star for such a poor value and results.

This is great price for this type of product. The colors are wonderful, you do have to use a little more than the artifical coloring(made from coal tar and stablized with anit-freeze) but it's worth it! I haven't had any complaints about an after taste, this is a really good product for icing and baking.They do have a shorter shelf life, but they are natural !!!

For the first time in many years, my grandchildren were able to color Easter eggs, and make colored icing for their cookies.  They have allergies to all artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives and were thrilled to be able to do this.

column9: Very overpriced and ineffective...not to mention false advertising as 'natural'
column10: I was so anticipating these colors and when I received them I really wanted to like them...I didn't care if the colors were faint, but being unable to even faintly change the color of a half cup of rice milk using 3 or 4 drops?!Maybe this seems petty, but considering the quantity in the bottles, and the exorbitant cost for this quantity of product, these colors should absolutely turn such a small portion of rice milk pink!I can't go using half a bottle - nor would I want to considering the product is NOT all natural as depicted / advertised! I am going by other reviewers' reports on contents, as by the time I've got mine they've stopped including the ingredient listing on the product label/insert!Now I have spent $35 on 6 tiny bottles of useless, unnatural dyes. Thanks a lot!!Don't waste your money!For better, organic, kosher, gluten-free and even vegan (hooray!) colors go to Seelect Tea dot com  Even if they cost more at least you get what was advertised and you're not just throwing your money down the drain!!!(Why can't I give it 1/2 a star? I'm not happy about this product at all, not even to warrant ONE star)

column9: The blue and red aren't true-to-color
column10: I bought these to make Christmas cookies, but I couldn't make green or red. Turns out, the red is magenta and the blue is purply. If you're wanting great Easter colors, then this dye set is great! Otherwise, you're going to be disappointed.

Although it comes in yellow, red, and blue....the red comes out pink and the blue comes out silver when mixed into foods! If you don't mind non-primary colors, these are really pretty awesome veggie dyes.BEWARE, this company offers many other products but this is the only one that is vegetable based, the rest use toxic FD&C and mineral dyes just as anyone else.
These are way, way overpriced.  I just picked them up at my natural food store for $17.50!
I found the dyes easy to blend.  They produced lovely colors with extremely consistant results - Will be recommending in my next cookbook.  Very nice all-natural product.

If the product were advertised as "yellow, blue and pink" I'd give it 5 stars.  However, I am really confused as to how anyone decided to label the color red.Red, in my experience, is fairly universal.  Sure, there are variations- but usually red means red of some sort.  So imagine my surprise when a few hours before my son's birthday party, I added the "red" dye to the cake frosting only to discover that it is Barbie, Victoria's Secret, cotton candy pink.If you are making a princess themed cake or plan on pastel colors, this would be awesome.  I wouldn't reccommend it for a 7 year old boy's birthday cake though!

Not a big fan of this coloring, first off the yellow color looked like it had crap floating in it, and no matter how much i shook the bottle it never fully incorporated. The colors themselves were not good as well, when mixing it into icing the only color that really looked good was yellow, the blue almost had a denim hue to it and the red looked like something on the floor after an autopsy. all in all i was not impressed.

column9: Color food without all the crap.
column10: Synthetic food dyes are #1. Gross, and #2. Cause lots of allergic reactions in our family. If you just want to add flair to your food for the holidays (ie.. Easter eggs, Christmas cookies), birthday celebrations, etc.. This is the way to go! The price is a bit steep and it will not last as long as an artificial food colorant because it's made from actual food and not crud. But buying it once or twice a year won't totally break the bank either.

It's amazing that this product is still on the market.  It is so expensive and so disappointing.  These colors taste horrible and change the consistency of everything that I put them in.  It is nearly impossible to come up with the color you were aiming for, except yellow.  The red usually comes out a rust-blood color and the blue is either purplish or grey, even if you put half the bottle in. Yes, we have ruined many homemade items thinking we could try these colors one more time (ruined birthday cupcakes, play dough, and Easter eggs).  DO NOT BUY THIS FOR EASTER EGGS - It won't work!  Please save your money and find an alternative.  I should have believed the other reviewers!

column9: I expected dull colors, I didn't expect this poor of quality
column10: I knew better than to expect vibrant unnatural colors. The price was high, but I didn't mind as long as the product worked. I knew that there was no variety, except in that which you can make yourself with the given primary colors. What I didn't expect was that it would take a half bottle of coloring and I still wouldn't have any noticeable color in a cornstarch and water "slime" I was making for my toddler. I only used one cup of cornstarch...and it was barely off white after adding a half bottle of color. The yellow also separated so much that after several minutes of shaking, it still hadn't even remotely mixed back together. I am seriously disappointing and back on the hunt for a food coloring that will work and give me the opportunity to make my son the fun colored projects and baked goods I'd like, without poisoning him with artificial food dyes.

column9: Blue was not blue. Yellow and red were great.
column10: The blue turned out to be a faded shade of red-purple coming straight out of the bottle.The yellow was decent, but it's just turmeric, which is easier to do with dried turmeric alone.The red was quite brilliant.I contacted the company via email to give them my comments on the blue and unfortunately didn't receive a response.

My friend and I used these in our Wilton cake decorating class and our colors were always the best in the class.  I urge all decorators and colorers to shun the unappetizing neon chemicals that may poison your family and friends and use these superior, natural colors.

column9: Great if you aren't heating it...
column10: These colors make a bunch of beautiful colors, but if you are baking - BEWARE. The heat plus the baking soda will fade out most of these colors and your creation will be barely distinguishable from a non-colored cake. you can combat this somewhat by adding lemon juice to the batter. Your best bet with these is to use them in icing or for coloring liquids or anything else that is not heated...

column9: There has got to be better
column10: I'm surprised that this is the best we can do in the area of chemical free food coloring.  I could not get the red to be red, bright magenta is the best I could do no matter how much I added.  The blue was green at go in both of the two packages I ordered. The yellow was yellow.  Unfortunately I did not need yellow. My mother is a lifelong oil painter and a self described expert at mixing colors and she called it at the first drop. "That will never be red."  Over 1/2 a bottle later, still magenta. A very expensive waste of money.  And that color table that you see everywhere with their products is definitely false advertising. There is no way you could make a 1/3 of those colors with this stuff. Don't by this unless you want camo green, magenta, yellow, prayish purple and the colors you can make from those.

column9: yeah natural but....not for eggs, pale, short shelf life, etc...
column10: I bought mine at Whole Foods, and was excited at first, but no where on the package does it say that these colors do not work on eggs.  Okay, so reading their website it says these are not for eggs, fine, no more easter eggs, but what about coloring hard boiled eggs for kids' bentos?  Nope, the colors do not stick to a peeled egg either.  And it did not matter how much vinegar I used either.  Okay, so, moving on to frosting, no matter how much you add the frosting is always pastel, okay, fine, no real biggie, but the red comes out like a brick red color, really quite orangish, and I couldn't get a good a pink or purple because of it.  I guess I should have put the stuff in the fridge because it does not last well either.  I will definitely be looking for an alternative naturally colored food coloring, until then I am relegated to nothing more than using the blue to make the kids' scrambled eggs green a la Seuss.

column9: Overall, good experience using this food coloring
column10: I used this food coloring in some frosting for cupcakes, and it worked out pretty well.  The colors do tend to be more of a pastel, but it worked really well for what I used it for.  Once the bottles are shaken up, the drops came out just fine and mixed in fine as well.  I would recommend this for someone who uses food coloring from time to time, but if you use it constantly, and need really dark colors, you may want to look elsewhere.

The colors were very drab and disappointing. Even tripling the amount of dye did not produce much intensity and for $35?! We went back to regular food coloring. I would not recommend this product, nor would I use it to color anything else. What a waste!

So far I've only used the "red", but these are nice rich colors, and we loved them. My daughter cannot eat artificial colorings, not to mention how bad they are for you...  So I bought these for her birthday cake.  The red is very pink and I don't think it will ever be a true red, but it's very pretty none the less!  I would recomend these to anyone looking for natural colorings!

column9: I wanted to love this food coloring but it was just ok
column10: I wanted a non-toxic food coloring for my daughter's birthday cake frosting. This was the only thing on the market for me to chose from.While the price was a bit steep for me, I didn't have a local option to buy from.This food coloring produces a bright yellow, rich magenta, decent purple and decent blue. However, I found no way to get a true red or green. I was able to make peach and orange as well as pink and magenta. I was also able to make what I would call a 1970's bathroom "green".I used this to make a Chuck E. Cheese's butter cream transfer design. The mouse came out good but the whole cake took on a faded look. It wasn't a bright, vibrant kid's cake.With that said, I think the health benefits of using this type of coloring out weight the disappointment in the lack of true green or red. So I give it 4 stars instead of 3.

My child cannot have artificial food coloring and this product works well for coloring icing.  Just keep in mind that you will get pastel, natural tones and not the bright vivid colors you get from artificial food coloring.  I have had mixed results with mixing colors - I have better luck just using varying shades of the 3 colors.  This is a liquid color so you will have to reduce the liquid in your frosting so it doesn't get to runny.  Great product and will continue to use it.  Keep refrigerated after opening so it does not go bad.India Tree Natural Decorating Colors Set,  3-Count Packages  2.25  ounces  (Pack of 2)

There is nothing "natural" about propylene glycol, a bi-product of the oil industry and a known irritant and poison which is unecessarily added to this product. the seller is listing FALSE INFORMATION in this product listing - when the product comes, the ingredients list is different from the list provided here by the seller. I have made a complaint to Amazon and hope they will not allow this seller to go on providing only partial ingredients lists while marketing their product as "natural." DO NOT BUY!

I bought this dye for my son's second birthday cake. I needed the color's red, blue and yellow, which they addvertise that the color's are. I used both bottles of the blue (which is actually green) and came up with a pretty green. I used both the bottles of red and came up with a really pretty pink. The yellow worked great. I won't ever buy this brand again and wish I could get a refund for the products that I purchased. It was a waste of the $40.00 dollars or so.

First time trying guayusa tea - just as described, smooth and stimulating.  Much easier on the stomach than coffee, no jitters (even though I drink 2-3 cups throughout the morning).  Delicious taste, too.  Even if I haven't slept well, the tea helps me feel energetic throughout the morning and afternoon.  Definitely lives up to its reputation.

I have fallen in love with these Runa Teas  - I do mine loose  - I have the original  -- excellent nice gentle smooth taste  -  this is the same with lemon grass and hint of cinnamon  it is so smooth  -- these have become my go to drink in morning  no more coffee ---  I love the spice mix of this  - It doesn't overwhelm the tea itself  just adds to it  ---  these are excellent products  ! this one doesn't require any sweetener  --  I love when you can have a tea just the tea -- enjoy

The spice variety is one of my favorites-- it has a nice cinammon quality without being too overpowering like a lot of spice teas i've had. also, guayusa is a pretty amazing product in itself. Big thumbs up.

Runa is a brand new tea that I drink everyday. I love the balanced, energizing feel I get from it. Apparently guayusa has been drunk for thousands of years in the rain forests of Ecuador and is now making its way to market in the US for the first time. Runa also seems to have a great back story of environmental conservation and social empowerment of indigenous groups. In fact I just heard a story covered on NPR's Marketplace about the partnership between Runa, the socialist Ecuadorian government and the farmers.The Amazon Spice has a nice cinnamon undertone with high notes from the lemongrass, the Ginger Citrus is also really good and slightly spicier from the ginger with clean citrus zest flavor, the traditional is good to see what guayusa by itself tastes like- smooth and naturally, subtly sweet with no tannin. I've never had the spearmint but I bet its good for people who like mint tea.

Although I enjoy its flavor, I have never been able to drink coffee because it makes me feel jittery and nervous instead of energetic. Guayusa tea, on the other hand, is a different story, full of pleasure only. Drinking one or two cups of guayusa in the morning gives me energy all day long, without any buzz or jittery feeling. The flavor of this tea is also smooth and sweet, with perfectly balanced hints of cinnamon and lemongrass. It tastes nice hot but I find that I like it best cold.
This item arrived quickly, I've enjoyed breaking them up and making ice cream sandwiches with it. Although that's not the original purpose.  I'm sure they would work great for making tort cakes.
aparently, the cookie was tasty enough. Emma aet it in 5 seconds! very nice present! happy dog, happy owner, happy me! (the aunt of the dog! hahaha)

column9: Cute, but a waste of money
column10: I bought 8 of these cards in various designs for my friends dogs and my own at Xmas. Absolutely not 1 dog was interested in this item.They are cute...but a waste of money since dogs don't like them...I tried 8 different cards with 8 different dogs. Save your money.Petco sells them for $2.99 if you wanna still waste your money.

column9: Adds seasoning to otherwise bland food
column10: The other reviewer has food concerns and gave this product an unfair 1-star.  We have food allergies in our home.  That is why I never buy any food product online, until I read the ingredient list in person, then I research the best online price.I have bought this product, the cubed version and the low-sodium version over the past 10 years, and have been thrilled with the flavour it adds to soups, rice and pasta dishes.It's sad that a one-star could deter others from purchasing this product.  If it were so bad, it wouldn't be on the shelves.I highly recommend this for anyone who doesn't have any food concerns.UPDATE - March 2012 - I am happy to see that the other reviewer upgraded their rating to a satisfactory 3-star from the previous 1-star.

I bought this bouillon because it was gluten free but because I wasn't able to read the ingredient list I didn't find out that it had dairy in it. Additionally it is not possible to return the product even though it was never opened so it was a complete waste of money. Many people that have a problem with gluten also have a problem with dairy so I don't think it makes much sense to make a gluten free product that has dairy in it. Other common allergens that are in the product are corn and soy.After contacting the manufacturer I found out that the sodium free version of this seasoning is gluten (wheat) and casein (dairy) free so if you have these allergies buy the sodium free version.

column9: This is a real light and smooth tasting coffee.
column10: Peaberry coffees render a flavor that is concentrated and offers a livelier cup with a full body and distinguished aroma. The prized peaberry grade assures that you are getting ready to enjoy a coffee bean of high integrity and a roast of unmatched uniformity.

column9: We use this brand and type of coffee at work
