With the cream and sugar, though, I don't have any complaints.

I love Chai Tea.  I don't even put sugar or honey in my Chai Tea.  This was just not right.  Tasted burnt out of the keurig and the cloves are overpowering.  No amount of honey and milk could make this right for me.  I am suffering through my 24-pack and may just throw it out.  Very disappointing.  I've had this brand/flavor in the bags before (although not recently) and liked it just fine.  Even bought it multiple times.  Not sure what is not working right with the k-cup formula.

Just received my new coffee maker as a gift. One of the sample K-Cups was this black tea. I set it at 8 ounces.It was so delicious, with a bit of sugar and a bit of cream. I love Red Label English Breakfast Tea and this was as good or even better. Do not be afraid of this tea, you will not regret it. No bitter bite from over processing, just yummmmmmmmm!

I prefer tea that is not steeped too long. This tea is the closest I have found to the way I would make it myself. I run it through the Keurig twice, once at 10oz and once at 12 oz and it comes out exactly the way I like it. You may not prefer as weak a tea, but that can be solved by running it through only once.  It has a clean, refreshing flavor.
I drink this every morning with a tablespoon of sugar. Great tea with just the right amount of caffeine to survive the long, early mornings. Strongly recommend.

I received a Keurig machine for Christmas, so I purchased this tea yet I wasn't expecting much. Well I found that this makes the BEST CUP OF TEA!! I have to pace myself because I could just drink cup after cup it is that good!!
This black tea is delicious and I have found that reusing the cup doesn't affect the flavor until the 4th or 5th cup.

I love this tea! My wife is usually the big tea drinker in the house but after trying this in my Keurig I have to say I LOVE it. I didn't purchase through amazon though because I got the same amount 24 in a box for only 9.99 elsewhere but I would recommend it to anyone.

I love k-cups. They're pretty cool, and I like the idea of them, but I don't like sacrificing the flavor just for the sake of a cup. The tea tastes very watered down for some reason. And I am a tea drinker who doesn't add sugar/honey because I enjoy the natural sweetening properties in the actual herbs. But this herbal tea is missing something, especially with a name like 'Authentic Green Tea'. It's pretty disappointing for the price of these things, but I'll continue to drink it until I run out.

Length:: 2:06 MinsCelestial Seasonings english breakfast black tea is delicious both hot or as iced tea. The tea has a faint perfume but not overwhelming. I like different teas but find this one to be the best for hot and cold. I love that I can control the strength of the tea. Hot I prefer the medium button, cold, I use the largest cup button. Either way I get a perfect serving of tea.
Great tea and a great bargain if you own a K cup machine. Buy your coffee or tea at Amazon. The prices are great and the service is great. Ordering from Amazon direct is seamless.
This is my favorite tea for the Keurig brewer.  I do not like, and therefore don't drink, flavored tea.  This is the tea I prefer.  I have not been able to get in stores lately so I ordered online.
I use this tea as an ice tea instead of a breakfast tea. It is really refreshing and allows me to make one cup of ice tea at a time. If you find it a little strong you can add more ice or ice water.
I love this tea...and I am not really a tea person, but this is a great drink and it is a very tasty treat.

column9: A little weak at the 12 oz mug, but still tasty
column10: I use the Keurig Platinum (B70) brewer and the 12 oz. brew size. This K-Cup is a little weak at the 12 oz. size, but still enjoyable, as I usually make it a latte. For comparison, a Tazo Chai tea bag makes a slightly stronger cup at 12 oz than the Celestial Seasonings K-Cup. Compared to Timothy's Chai K-Cup, Celestial's Chai is stronger (which I prefer).

Wanted to sample the K-cups. Previously a "tea bag" user for the same product.  Will stick with the tea bags, as the tea is not only more fragrant, but extremely flavorful. Will not purchase K-cups again.
This is a very nice chai...doesn't taste like I thought it would..has a very strong spice taste..but still very good.
this tea is wonderfully spicy.  great on a cold afternoon! It would also be lovely with milk, but I prefer it plain.

column9: licorice taste, twinings chai is much better
column10: I am really disappointed in this chai tea. It has a distinct licorice taste. Twinings chai tea is much better. Do not buy unless you like a licorice taste.
This Tea is really good. It comes in an easy to use container.  Its not very sweet so if you want your tea really sweet you may need to add something. Good produxt.
This is very good and makes the house smell wonderful.  I would defintely recommend this to anyone just wanting a quick tea.
This is my favorite K Cup overall!  I love the flavor the the tea and it brews just right on the medium setting.

column9: Celestial India spice chai tea k-cups
column10: I brew this in a keurig 60 model, i like this tea, its good any time of the year. It is on the spicy side and will leave your pallet with a spicy after taste. But oh so good late at night. Good tea for every once in a while, i could not drink this every day as is a little on the strong side.

This tea is the reason why I bought a Keurig. It's my absolute favorite. I make a cup each morning to take with me to work (anyone who works a 9-5 needs a pick me up!). I usually re-order two boxes every couple of months, and my package always arrives quickly. I'll be buying these k-cups as long as they're available!
This is the best Chai I have found for my Keurig. It is not overly sweet like another kind I tried. It smells and tastes wonderful. Great on a cold night!
This is not even tea, it is not even as good as dipping a tea bag in the cup once. It's You'll be drinking hot water with sugar and honey.
I get this for my wife who really loves it.  I am not a tea drinker, other than ice tea.
This is a good Strong Tea. The Flavor is a nice blend not to strong and not weak. Smells great when brewing. You can add milk or drink it plain.
Great tea for the Keurig.  We love it!  Now for a good cocoa and apple cider.(Don't get the Green Mountain cider)

I have purchased the Celestial Seasonings Chai Tea tea bags in the grocery store, and was impressed with the flavor. So when I saw they had them in the K-cups, I immediately jumped on them and ordered a box. I was so disappointed in it. It tastes nothing like their regular tea bag version. Weak is a word I would use. And I'm not sure what kind of spices they put it in, but it's nothing like any other chai tea I've had. I do not recommend this brand. If you're a regular chai drinker, you will notice the difference and likely be disappointed.

This stuff is surprisingly strong and potent. I've always had a problem with chai tea bags because they brew such a dilute cup of tea. But with the Celestial Seasonings Keurig chai, the tea is dark and opaque. I got a huge buzz off of the caffeine. Best of all, it's pure tea and spices, unlike the Cafe Escapes Chai Latte, which is full of artificial ingredients.
I like the tea - but I noticed both an aroma and flavor of clove? I don't think this is ONLY green tea. That being said, I like it and most likely will reorder.

I'm an avid chai drinker--many different varieties of both lattes and straight black tea.  We purchased this product because we noticed that the Cafe Escapes chai lattes--a sweeter, creamier blend--did not actually have much black tea in it, and we still wanted our morning caffeine.  Neither my husband nor I could finish one mug of this stuff, and we will end up getting rid of the box.  It was that awful. There was none of the subtle spice blending--just a watery slightly clove-tasting flavor undercut by a bitterness that almost had hints of coffee. Adding a little milk, as we usually do, didn't help at all.  If you enjoy chai, I'd recommend Bigalow or Tazo and skip this one.
Smells nice but the flavor is weak.  I don't think the Keurig brewers really work for tea.  Good tea needs to be steeped, not just filtered like coffee.
There is a very strong clove flavor in this tea. I like my tea black and did not enjoy it very much. My friend from work added cream and sugar to it and thought it was great.
I usually order Twinings tea, but I thought I'd try something different. This Celestial Seasonings version of English Breakfast is very good, and I will make it part of my usual rotation.

I've tried several brands of black tea and I liked this one the most because I liked the taste of it:A) plainB) with sugarC) with lemon - iced or hotD) creamThe others I tried had a slight (to me) floral taste that didn't mix well with cream or lemon.

column9: The best that I've tried of the K-Cup tea offerings
column10: I've been drinking tea for years mostly for health reasons.  We recently bought a Keurig so I tried this black tea with our new brewer.  It had a nice full body taste and I found it had a better taste than the green tea varities I tried.
THIS IS SO GOOD!  I've had it hot and iced and am in love!  The chai flavor isn't overpowering, but you certainly know you are drinking a spiced tea!  I will definitely reorder!
I did not like any of the brew over iced tea flavors so i tried this and love it.  Would definately recommend for iced or hot tea.

I have always wanted to try brewing real English tea. I bought these for my Keurig, and they were so, so much better than my normal tea bags.  They may not be as good as real, brewed tea, but I think they're delicious.
This tea has a bitter taste that I didn't like.  I am fond of the Gloria Jeans chai tea that Amazon has been out of for a LONG time and will wait for that before trying anything else

column9: Great English tea for Keurig coffee maker
column10: I bought the Keurig coffee make to make coffee for guests but I now primarily use it to enjoy hot tea for myself.  This brand of tea is just to my liking and the price was reasonable with no shipping charges.  Win-win.
Great flavor, no bitterness and a wonderful way to start the day!Have purchased additional packages of this product since first tasting it when I purchased my Kuerig coffee maker.

Celestial Seasonings  English Breakfast Black Tea, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 24-CountThis tea has a great, smooth flavor. Even my husband, who is not a tea drinker, enjoys a cup of this.
This tea is fine, but not a chai favorite for me.  I don't think that I would purchase it again, but I will finish up the box.

column9: Lacks flavor and taste of Green Tea
column10: I recently purchased this hoping it would be good. I love Green Tea and enjoy trying different varieties. I was not too thrilled with this kind. It lacked flavor, was plain and just didn't have a strong green tea taste. I'd rather spend a little more for something that tastes more like green tea.

The India Spice Chai is a great tea.  I've tried a lot of different brands of Chai and hadn't found any until this one that compared to the kind I made with the actual spices in a pan.  I normally add a little milk and brown sugar to it after it's brewed, but it's very good tasting alone as well.

I bought these mainly for my husband to take to work in the morning, he usually uses actual teabags. So these were going to be the easy solution. However they were not as good as the actual teabags we have. Just wasn't his "cup of tea"

I stumbled upon Celestial Seasonings Green Tea k-cups at my workplace, and since have fallen in love.  For a nice, quick cup of green tea, I haven't found any better solution.  I have fancier or more old fashioned tea brewing methods that I use when I have more time, but I default to this green tea when I need a quick fix.Now about the tea specifically - I have tried other green tea k-cups (competing brands), and none have been as clean-tasting and crisp as Celestial Seasonings.  I will continue to purchase this brand for my green tea needs.

The Celestial Seasonings authentic green tea k-cup is very good.  One K-cup makes adequate flavor of 9.25 oz. of hot tea.  Most of the k-cup assorted coffee produces light, watery coffee at 7.25 oz., but this green tea has  good color and taste even at the max. 9.25 oz.  I would recommend this green tea k-cup.

I enjoy chai tea very much and my partner drinks only tea, no coffee. So when we purchased our Keurig, we wanted to try several varieties of chai to find the perfect one. I shopped on amazon and bought several types with  reviews, cost, recognizable brand and speed of shipping being accounting factors ( in that order).Pros: Quick delivery  The description is accurate and you get exactly what is advertised  Known brand  Fresh  The price is moderateCons: I mention price here again because it is cheaper in other forms ( tea bags)I prefer a non milk based Chai and so this was the ideal for me. I added sugar some days and drank it plain others and both were satsifying. My partner and I both enjoyed it above all the other flavors and I will reccomend and share with friends and family. I will continue to shop and attempt to find a better price, but would pay this again because it is worth it.

I tried this because I can't seem to find the Gloria Jean Serenity Tea which I liked very much.  The Celestial Seasonings was very very bland.  I even tried it on the smallest cup, and it made no difference.  There is no authentic flavor here.  I was brought up drinking green tea.  I especially like the Yama Moto brand green tea, but wanted something quick and easy in a k-cup. I like the Celestial Seasonings Mandarin Spice so I thought I would try the green tea.  I realize that coffee and tea are a personal preference.  For me, this green tea missed the mark completely.

Great Keurig tea pods.  This is not chai latte, so don't expect white milky beverages.  This is just tea flavored with chai spices.  I suppose if you add hot milk you could make a decent chai latte though, but I haven't tried it yet.  Very bright flavors, but not overpowering.
I have been looking for just a pain black tea with no flavors.  I finally found it.  I think it is my favorite tea. Not crazy about the flavored teas.  I use it for both iced tea and hot tea.
This is a great tea. Very smooth. I don't even use sweetener with it, but it isn't bitter at all. If you like tea, you will love this one.
Excellent tea and very enjoyable after a long day at the office.  also great on cold winter days and some R&R while crafting.
this tea was very good,love it and would buy this product again soon. this is my all time favorite of all teas.

column9: Love, Love Celestial Seasonings English Breakfast Black Tea K-Cups
column10: I can not express how much I looove the Celestial Seasoning English Breakfast Tea K-Cups!!!  When I purchased my Keurig, I was drinking Bigelow's English Breafast tea bags which I opened and used in the My K-Cup.  I had a rebate deal that sent me 2 boxes of the Celestial Seasoning tea K-Cups and I've been hooked ever since!The Celestial Seasonings is much smoother than the Bigelow.  I hadn't realized how bitter the Bigelow was, I can't drink it any longer!!  I'm a purest when it comes to my black tea, I don't like too many other flavors superseding the tea.I wish I could get this in tea bags too (to carry in my purse when at restaurants, at friends houses and what not)!The Celestial Seasonings English Breakfast is just an super-enjoyable cup of tea!

The taste is alright.  I love vanilla chai tea and I thought I would try this.  I added a lot of cream to it after it brewed and then it was more to my liking.  Next time I'm considering adding a drop of vanilla extract, I have a feeling that will do the trick.

I was disappointed when I drank my first k cup ice tea.  I love iced tea, however I do not like lemon in my tea at all - I just want the taste of the tea leaves.  The Celestial English Breakfast Black Tea has a lemon flavoring added.  Ugh ... I was really hopeful I could brew a glass of ice tea with my Keurig.  It is not bad tasting at all - it is just not what I prefer.
I really like his tea because it is mild and has a great taste and it taste good hot or cold. also you can brew the cup for 2 cups if you want
Product was as described. The green tea flavor is okay, it can be a bit strong unless you prefer stronger flavors. I would purchase it again.
This is a full bodied English Breakfast Tea. It is the one I drink when I don't need to drink a decaf tea. It is the best !!!

column9: Perfect Cup of Tea (Hot or Cold)
column10: This is the best tea I have ever tasted at home.  The flavors are blended perfectly.  I like to fill a cup with ice then do a quick brew with the Keurig Machine.  No need to add sugar or cream.  I just wish I could find a comparable decaf so I could have an excellent nighttime cup of tea before sleeping.
This tea tastes amazing!  It is not too strong or too weak.  It has great flavor, it it smells divine!

K Cups over all are a little pricey compared to just buying the regular product, I know! But the machine you use to make it ain't exactly cheap either! Having said that... this cup of Green Tea comes out perfect and yummy every time!Waiting for Celestial Seasonings to make more of my favorite flavors of tea in K-Cups!

I recently bought a Keurig Coffee maker because my husband and I love our coffee and tea, but sometimes want different drinks on certain days and this coffee maker fit the bill. We both enjoy this Green Tea. Likely the best of teas that I have tried so far. They arrived sooner than expected and arrived as described. Happy with the service and the product.

column9: Tastes great, good price and fast service
column10: This tea has a good flavor--not too strong or too weak. It isn't as great as say a fresh looseleaf but is comparable to Twinnings' Eng Breakfast.

I am not normally a hot tea drinker, but my Keurig makes it easy to experiment and try new things. This tea tastes great hot or cold so it has become my favorite tea.  It has a great taste and no bitterness that some black teas have.  Plus, I prefer to sweeten my own tea instead of having it presweetened for me.

Received it quickly.  Box my Tea K-cups came in were the universal boxes for all Teas with the label of the correct "Flavor".  At first, I thought I had received the wrong item.  It had pictures of fruit & flowers and I had just order Black Tea.  Packaging not the same.  Only "complaint" was box, but the correct product was received.

I'm more of a tea drinker than coffee. I am sick and needed some hot tea so my wife bought these English Breakfast Tea K-Cups for me while she was at the store. I had only used the Keurig for coffee so I was a bit skeptical. This tea is amazing. I am going to keep it stocked in my pantry from now on.
This is a tasty tea that can be enjoyed at anytime, not just for breakfast.  it has good flavor and fresh brewed aroma.
A little fishy tasting but I'm hoping for the health benefits of green tea and it is enjoyable for a good summer drink.
We got this as a sample in our new keurig elite. I plan on buying many more! Even my 6 year old likes drinking this with me. If you like tea, you can't go wrong with this!
This tea is GREAT!!!  Hot it is great morning treat! Just add ice, lemon and lime slices and makes a REFRESHING SUMMERTIME drink!!

This is my favorite of the K-Cup Chai recipes. The spices are balanced though fairly strong allowing this tea to hold up well with the additions of honey (or sugar) and milk. It's wonderful served hot or cold. For the cold version, add your honey (or sugar) and milk, stir, and then pour over ice. When doing the iced version, I find it works best brewed on the 6oz size and then poured over ice in a 24oz glass. I prefer this to the Chai Latte K-Cups because I can control the amount of sweetener and milk.
Great flavor.  Just enough spice.  A love Chai Tea Latte flavor also, but this is nice when you feel like something lighter.  I will purchase more!
We use this tea in the Kourig to make iced tea.  Just brew, then pour over a full cup of ice.  Easy, convenient and delicious.

column9: not the best chai tea I've tasted
column10: This India spice chai tea wasn't my favorite purchase. In fact, I am thinking I would relist the unused teas in the container and get rid of it. Hopefully someone out there loves it. It's almost a new box.

column9: GREAT seller and GREAT cereal GREAT price!
column10: This is a fantastic cereal and at a great price. It sounds like it's not but, when you get it, it's like buying 4 boxes - regular size. The shipping was fast, well packed so the cereal didn't get crushed. Definitely HIGHLY recommend.

I have never liked cereal while I was still living in the Philippines. When my husband introduced Raisin Bran Crunch here in the US..OMG I couldn't get enough of it! Exaggerated it may sound but I eat it breakfast , lunch and dinner..sometimes even before going to bed. I add slices of bananas with it and i'm in heaven. I'm just addicted and no regrets..I just believe it's healthy too even if I splurge on it.

This is a great morning tea it has no crash and keeps me going through the entire day.  I do love to drink coffee although this doesn't have the coffee taste it does have the kick I would strongly recomend this!

column9: Perfect touch to add to your regular coffee!
column10: I used about 1/4 c of these beans added to my regular brand of Guatemalan coffee.  They are the perfect touch of flavor for my morning cup of brew!

column9: As an adult with egg and nut allergies I am a big fan
column10: I have egg and nut allergies and am a big fan of Cherrybrook products - well, some of them - others taste like chalk.  This isn't one of them.  These cookies are so good we actually had people (without allergies) ask for the mix so they could make them at home.  I guess that is a pretty big ringing endorsement.  People without allergies actually choose to eat these.

As a mother of a 3 year old with severe food allergies (milk, eggs, nuts) I have tried several brands of 'allergy free' baking mixes out there. Cherrybrook kitchen is by FAR the best tasting...all flavors. If you are frustrated with the tasteless options out there, don't hestitate to try this brand- they taste like 'normal'! I'm partial to the brownies, my daughter loves the chocolate chip cookies and chocolate cupcakes (cake mix)!

I have tried all of Cherrybrook Kitchen Products and they are fabulous! Even without Eggs, Dairy and Peanuts these products taste even better than if I made it from Scratch. The Chocolate Chip Cookies rise well, have plenty of Chocolate Chips and taste great! I would highly recommend them.

This cookie mix is outrageously yummy.  It's so much better than any vegan cookie recipe out there.  I enjoy them more than a regular cookie.  We make them with Earth's Balance to keep it vegan and they turn out so great.  The texture is normal, like a regular toll house cookie even though no eggs, dairy or butter are used.  Our guests have loved them and have no idea they aren't a regular recipe.  Best find for my son who has allergies.  The ingredients are pure and simple without a bunch of unhealthy filler.  We love this cookie mix.

I had such high hopes for this mix but it was really disappointing. The main flavor was salt. Which made me think that maybe there was some sort of mix up between the salt and the sugar when the batch was made?... I hope it was a mistake. Though I will not purchase again.

column9: MMMMM... Better than Any other Cookie Mix - Period!
column10: My son has a serious peanut allergy and we tried this to get our chocolate fix. Well, this was the most unbelievably good cookie mix EVER. We actually just used it to make a large cookie cake at my son's birthday party. The cake was GONE within minutes since everyone was asking for seconds (and thirds!). No one could believe how good it was, especially since I (a horrible baker) made it!.Another fabulous thing about this is that if you are a "cookie dough eater" - you are able to eat it safely since there are no eggs added.Jude the Dude Children's Book on Peanut Allergies Jude The Dude: The Peanut Allergy Kid (Volume 1)

I just made these cookies for my son, who cannot have dairy and they are amazing! I was skeptical at first of how they would taste, but once I tasted one, all my fears/worries washed away :) They are delicious! My son(2) likes them so much that he is actually crying that he can't have more :)

column9: THE BEST Gluten, Dairy, Egg free cookie mix - Yum!!!
column10: We've tried pretty much all the various gluten free mixes and from scratch GF recipes, and have been disappointed with pretty much all of them.(we also need egg & dairy free, so often have to modify the other mixes/recipes to do this) I was absolutely amazed at how great these cookies turned out! I added some coconut shreds (tiny ones, not the big stringy ones) and these cookies were fabulous!They look like regular cookies, taste like regular cookies & have a normal texture. Someone who didn't know they were gluten free would think they were regular, super yummy cookies!For some reason, many Gluten-free mixes give me a very upset stomach (although hubby and daughter are fine) and Cherry brook did not. I'm amazed that the best tasting mix also turned out to be the best for not causing stomach upset! Yay! If you have this problem with GF mixes also then absolutely try the Cherrybrook!

My son has dairy allergy so he can't have most of the cookie from the bakery. When I saw this cookie mix, I decide to give it a try. The result is the most beautiful and sucessful cookie I have ever made. Not only my son loves it, my husband loves it too (he is pretty picky about cookie).

This is my FAVORITE gum. I've chewed it now for at least 30-years. Yeah, ...I'm getting up there, so what! ...hahaha I chew this gum every single day of my life, and will continue to chew it for as long as they make it. It is by far the BEST cinnamon gum on the market. I am SO HAPPY Amazon is carrying it now, because nearly all of the grocery stores have switched to sugar free gums, which don't interest me in the least. Thank you Amazon for making it easy for me to get the best gum ever made!!!

Big Red rocks, and with the great deal I got on Amazon it was too great to pass up! My order arrived much more quickly than I expected it to, and without any damage whatsoever. It was my first time ordering from the grocery category. I was so impressed with the service and the great deals I got that I will definitely order again. My family is STILL enjoying the Big Red, thank you Amazon!

When I was a teenager, I had a terrible addiction to Big Red. I don't know why- I'm not a fan of spicy and am not drawn to cinammon or anything like that. There's just something about this gum that makes me want to chew it all day.I sort of moved on from my addiction, but a decade or so I bought a pack just to keep in my bag for post-lunch-breath-refreshing and the gum was AWFUL. I found out that Wrigley's had replaced the sugar with artificial sweeteners and the results were disasterous. If I wanted sugar free gum, I'd buy Trident or every other brand on the planet. I just wanted that sugar-y, crispy stick of Wrigley's gum.Then a few years ago I bought another pack out of sheer desperation after eating a slice of pizza and was surprised to find that the flavor was back to how it was when I was a kid. Wrigley added back some of the sugar, but kept some of the artificial sweetener, as well.The end result is a longer lasting flavor, which is nice, although I really do have to stop myself from putting in a fresh piece every four minutes to get the flavor hit.I know chewing gum is sort of a bad habit, but it's better than some other things I could do when I'm nervous or working (chewing gum helps me focus, I don't know why...) or have a garlic-y lunch. I'm glad Wrigley realized not all of us want our gum healthier. I just want that classic Big Red taste and I'm glad it's back.

This gum burned the hell out of my mouth. I chew gum 8 hours a day while working because it helps me not think about smoking. First day I chewed 8 pieces of gum and woke up the next day with burns in my mouth. My tongue has been swollen for 3 days now. It hurts to eat and talk. I am not happy to say the least. Too bad amazon wont let me return this crap.
If you like the flavor of lime, you'll love these cookies. Not too sweet and the scent of lime makes your mouth water. It is hard to limit myself to consume only one package a day.
I love mango and I love Hi-chews!  This product arrived to me very fresh and fresh sealed in plastic.  The expiration date was also good for about a year.  I recommend!

For some strange reason, this flavor was not available on the island of Maui, I literally searched all the stores.  I was happy to find it on Amazon and it was actually cheaper than what I can get it for at Walmart...the downside is with the free shipping, I had to wait longer...but once I got my package I was soooo happy!

Bouncy little chews, more latexy and less waxy in texture than Starburst or Mamba. The flavor is startlingly like real mango, with even a hint of peel, more like biting into a juicy mango than eating the usual very intense fruit-flavored kind of candy. A light, refreshing, not-to-sweet flavor that's really special. I like every flavor of Hi-Chew I've tried, but mango is my favorite and the most unusual.

The candy is really good. It is $1.35 at the local supermarket I go to to buy these. It would be cheaper if I bought it from here and got 20 for like 17 bucks. if I bought 20 at the store it would have been like 30 bucks. good deal.

Oh mango hi-chew, how I wished I liked you.I love hi-chew a lot and I really wanted to try every flavor thinking I would love them all.  BUT mango hi-chew... I just can't feel the love.  First off I want to say that I love hi-chews because I find them to be milder and less sweet than starburst and I think a better chew.  Also I want to say that there is really nothing wrong with the mango hi-chew if you really really really love super ripe mangos.  Now I would say that I really do like mangos but not the super ripe mangos, I like it while it still has a little of a sour taste and the texture is more solid basically when it's sort of a yellow-orange color.If you love love super ripe mangos, where you wait for it to get really soft and it gets to that dark orange color and basically can eat it with a spoon because it melts in your mouth, than you will love this mango flavor because that's how the exactly captured it.  I'm not a big fan of that but my manager loves mangos like that, so I earned some big brownie points by giving him the rest of my mango hi-chew.  He really loved it, he ate the whole package (minus the one I ate) in about 2 days.  That's really eating fast!So even though I don't really love the flavor it was still a well made flavor and I felt the captured the taste of a really ripe mango well, which is why I'm giving it 5 stars still.
My 1st favorite flavor is the melon - this is a close second. Very smooth - doesn't stick to teath, etc.
Full of fruity flavor. Not too sweet (kinda like starburst, but not as sweet) WHich I love. I have things that are too sweet.

Was disappointed in the flavor of these. Had a wang to them. Hard to explain, and when I first bit into them, I was surprised in the taste. Others had given these a really good review, and I don't know why. The consistency was even a bit strange. I wished I had bought the melon flavor - it has to be better then this one.
This is one of the best coffees that I have ever tasted.I will always buy this brand.I am very pleased.

I use this rice vinegar in my sushi rice and when making a sauce to dip my sushi in.  For the sauce I use one part brown rice vinegar to one part soy sauce.  I've gotten many complements on that combination.  I also love that this rice vinegar is made from brown rice and that it is organic.  I highly recommend it.

While those at Cook's Illustrated know about most products, they don't know about Texas BBQ sauce. Not sweet. Not too spicy. Just right. If you know someone who comes to  Texas for the BBQ or a Texan feeling homesick, this is the sauce for them. Now I wish Amazon would open up this account!

This barbecue sauce is the best I've had so far. It truly is very tasty. Full of flavor but not overwhelming. Right amount of spicy and just a slight touch of sweetness. Very refined taste. Great quality. I can't wait to try the other flavors. A big difference from lower quality brands. It tastes exactly the way barbecue is suppose to taste.
Tried this BBQ sauce because of it's top rating in Consumer Reports and really like it. Rate it right up there with Sweet Baby Ray's.

I love the crisps and was much looking forward to their arrival, however, when they finally DID arrive two of the bags were punctured so of course the crisps were stale. I was very displeased, especially considering the time it took to ship and so will be buying my favourite munchies from different distributors in the future.
the plants were great but I did'nt water them in time and they died. my badI will order from them again.

I was lucky to read the first customer's feedback about the discrepancy between the number of Bags advertised compared to what he actaully received. I called Amazon Customer Service BEFORE I ordered to discuss the misrepresenation and seek corrective action for the previous customer AND myself in advance.Well, I ordered and received NINE bags as advertised - yippee! It's just that 3 of the bags were nearly FLAT compared to the remaining 6 bags which seemed pleasingly plump. I did open a flat bag upon arrival. The product was tasty and fresh and seemed to contain an appropriate amount of product just 50% broken chips. I'm not about to immediately open a plump bag to see if it's more air than product or the condition, but will update when I do. At about 2 bucks a bag a decent buy.The shipping package came very well packed with air cushions surrounding the box containing the Ritz Toasted Chips without dings. This leads me to believe the issue is with NABISCO and their packaging. This is my second disappointment with NABISCO products I've received through Amazon. I'm now wondering if NABISCO is selling less than perfect items through Amazon. If so, it should be noted and priced accordingly so we can make an informed decision.So I guess I'm lucky I didn't receive another buggy surprise BUT I'm not sure I'll buy NABISCO products through Amazon again. I hope you'll be lucky!UPDATE: Inconsistent condition of individual bags and contents. Flat bags - busted chips, Puffy bags - perfect chips. Not sure what else to say about Nabisco and/or Amazon on this.

column9: Price is a ripoff--only one bag, NOT bag(s)!!!
column10: WHAT A RIPOFF! Over $10 for one bag, when they are only about $3 in the local grocery store, which is where I would have bought it if I was not disabled and cannot leave my home!! I read the ad wrong and thought it said 8 bags, (not sure if they MEANT to be deceptive or not),but it said 8.1 oz bags with an s after bag. Shipping was over $6 but got a promotional credit for it. Bottom line is I will NOT buy from this person again!!!PS: The Ritz Chips are EXCELLENT though and it is NOT their fault!!! Just check yourRitz Toasted Chips, Dairyland Cheddar, 8.1 oz (Pack 6) local store for them unless you are like me and cannot get out.
Probably the best tasting hot sauce I've tried.  Has a nice kick to it too, but not so hot it's unbearable.

This hot sauce is without a doubt one of the best jalapeno hot sauces' on the market.  This is my second order and it is a great value for the price. It is a required staple in my pantry!  If you love hot sauce, you won't regret this purchase!

column9: Fica tree is not worth the money
column10: The base of the fica tree looks like a child's bucket.  The tree is so small.  The box it came in bent the limbs badly.  Overall a waste of money.

I agree with some of the other reviewers (for the NON-Classic syrup). I have been buying this product, mostly to add to coffee, for several years. At some point, I noticed that the flavor changed, and (to my palate at least), it was a change for the worse. After noticing some of the recent reviews, I made sure to order the "Classic" flavor when my supply started to run low. When it arrived, I taste-tested vs. the "non-Classic" syrup that I still had on hand, and (again, to my palate), the "Classic" tasted far superior. I suppose other people may prefer the new flavor, but for me, the Classic is the one I'll order from now on.

column9: Treat yourself and your family to the good stuff!
column10: AH!Laska Organic Chocolate Syrup IS BETTER than the alternaives. It's not only better for you, but it also tastes better and has a thicker texture too. The ingredients speak for themselves...AH!Laska Organic Chocolate Syrup:Organic Evaporated Cane Juice, Water, Organic Cocoa (Non-Alkaline), Xanthan Gum (a Natural Fiber Thickener), Organic Vanilla, Citric Acid.H**shey's Syrup:High Fructose Corn Syrup , Sugar , Water , Corn Syrup , Cocoa , Potassium Sorbate A Preservative , Salt , Mono- And Diglycerides From Vegetable Oil , Polysorbate 60 An Emulsifier , Xanthan Gum , Vanillin An Artificial FlavoringI know what I would rather have my family consume. No brainer. AH!Laska Organic Chocolate Syrup is just better and so good! Please continue to keep this in stock, Amazon!!!
This is a very tasty product which is all natural and avoids high fructose corn syrup. Nice alternative.
If you are looking for a good replacement for corn-syrup filled chocolate syrups this is the way to go.

I had been using Monin Dark Chocolate and love and flavor.  Just for variety I ordered some AhLaska.  What a mistake!  AhLaska is way too sweet and it has some kind of odd overtone in the flavor.  Sorry to say, it is at the point that it ruins anything that I put it on.  So I'm giving up on the AhLaska and going back to Monin.To help you decide whether my review relates to you, I'll tell you about my taste preferences.  I like dark chocolate, not on the sweet side.  I like my coffee and tea with no sugar.  When it comes to ice cream, I like just about anything that's high quality and well balanced.  Vanilla, chocolate, fruits and nuts are all great for me.I hope this helps you with your selections.  Bon Appetit.

In another life I worked at a Trader Joe's.  One of my favorite products there was a chocolate syrup that was sweetened with pure sugar (different from all the hfcs-sweetened goo out there).  That product was delicious.  I had to quit working there and move to a city where there was no Trader Joe's.  I really missed my Moo.  Ah!Laska is worlds better!I use it mostly on ice cream.  I'm sure it would be great in a variety of contexts, though I've read a couple of Amazon reviews that essentially recommend against using it for chocolate milk.Great not having to troll around trying to find this in a local grocery store.

I have loved chocolate milk my entire life and bought this immediately when I found it in a local store. I was impressed with the simple ingredient list and that it is organic... but I was concerned that it wouldn't taste as good as the Hershey's syrup that I've happily used for years. For comparison, I made two glasses of chocolate milk - one with AH!Laska and one with Hershey's. Wow - the difference was unbelievable! The AH!Laska syrup makes THE BEST chocolate milk ever! The taste is oh so good... so smooth and rich. The chocolate milk made with Hershey's now tasted weird and even grainy to me compared to the chocolate milk made with the AH!Laska syrup. Sorry Hershey's... I am totally in love with AH!Laska syrup and will not be coming back.

I really wanted to get a chocolate syrup for my sons to make chocolate milk with but hated buying hersheys because of the HFCS and other ingredients. Being in Alaska options were zero. So I ordered this off amazon in a 4 pack to save money hoping it was good and it is! We keep ours in the fridge, so maybe that's why, but it takes a few extra stirs to get it mixed well. But the flavor is great and I can rest at ease knowing (even though it's still sugary) at least it is organic and natural.

column9: AH!Laska Organic Chocolate Syrup, 22-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 4)
column10: You can purchase this product at Whole Foods if you have one close by. By far, the best tasting chocolate available, and NO HIGH FRUCTOSE CORN SYRUP! Love this stuff..

I had given up on store-bought chocolate syrup for good because we don't use products containing HFCS, so I was pleasantly surprised to find this product. It's thicker than H*****y's and tastes better, in my opinion. It's great on coconut ice cream and in soy milk! We are definite converts.

column9: Organic is the way to go
column10: Best chocolate syrup out there. No artificial ingredients, no high fructose corn syrup, and it pours out of the bottle better than another organic band we buy. My daughter won't drink regular milk so she gets nothing but chocolate milk, so the quality is important.

My family really likes that this is organic chocolate syrup.  It tastes great and we haven't had a problem mixing it with cold milk for chocolate milk.  We also use it on ice cream.  We're so glad that Amazon is including this item.

I was a bit mixed on whether to order this due to the inconsistency of the reviews.  I wanted to part with the high fructose corn syrup Hershey product so I gave it a try.  Excellent.  Mixed well into milk for my chocolate milk kid and worked great on ice cream.  I am sold and there is no going back.
I purchased this at the grocery store, not Amazon. It has a strange flavor. It is too sweet and not rich or creamy. I will not purchase again.

We ordered the Ah!Laska Organic Chocolate Syrup because it's organic and received generally positive reviews.  We find that it has a slight off taste - hard to describe, but it just didn't taste as good as we hoped or expected.  More noticeable when used full strength on ice cream; not so noticeable when used for chocolate milk.  We ordered the multi-bottle pack, so we will be using this for quite some time.  I don't think we will re-order it though.  Suggest that you order a single bottle first, if available.  Then you can decide whether you like its flavor or not.

column9: WOW!  This is the really good stuff!
column10: We were looking for some chocolate syrup without high-fructose corn syrup and found this.  MUCH better than we expected.  A hundred times better than Hershey's and made from real ingredients - not chemicals.

Since going gluten free for medical reasons, we have really tried to clean up our eating act.  All of the fake stuff in Hershey's syrup just wouldn't do because we drink massive amounts of chocolate milk.  I teetered back and forth on whether to buy this or not because of the mixed reviews.  Glad I just decided to go ahead and buy it because it is amazing!  My sons didn't even notice the switch but I do have to say it has a much better flavor and is a bit sweeter so I have to use a little less than what I did of the Hershey's.  I wish the price was a little lower but as I have discovered, eating healthier now and paying a little more money is far better than paying for it in our health later :)

We use a lot of chocolate syrup in our house. We have 3 little boys who love their chocolate milk, but we try to buy mostly organic and avoid HFCS altogether so I was excited to try this organic chocolate syrup. Upon first taste I was SO DISAPPOINTED! Tasting it as-is on a spoon it doesn't even taste like chocolate at all! At first you notice that it is VERY (almost sickening) sweet, and then you notice that it's a little bitter with NO chocolate taste.  After a second and then a third taste I realized it tastes like molasses. I didn't want to taint my kids thoughts on the taste, so I didn't say anything and made them chocolate milk using the AH!Laska syrup. They were disgusted. Bummer. Now I'm stuck with 4 bottles of molasses tasting syrup that no one likes and I still need a good organic replacement for the Nesquick syrup we normally use. Nice try AH!Laska but this needs a LOT of work!!UPDATE: We tried it on ice cream and it was pretty good. Kind of like the cheap hot fudge sauce they use at fast food restaurants. It might take us a couple of years to use up 4 bottles, but at least we found a use for it! I previously gave it 1 star for our initial experience with it's taste. I now give it 3 stars since it taste good on ice cream but can't be used for our chocolate milk.

Great flavor!  Many of the stores here are slow to stock organic products so I end up shopping on line a lot.  This wasreasonably priced including the shipping and was convenient and easy for me to purchase.

Use this syrup in my morning iced coffee.  Very good taste, no HFCS, and all good ingredients.  Only "problem" (if you can call it that) is it is a little on the thick side, so if you want it to assimilate into your iced coffee you will need a good tumbler that you can give a good shake to.  Aside from this, great product!

This is the greatest chocolate sauce I have ever tried.  It beats gourmet sauces, dairy sauces and any other form I have used in my life.  And the best part is that it is vegan and contains no nasty chemicals.  Its only problem is that it is seriously addicting to the basic chocoholic!

column9: Great alternative to high fructose syrups
column10: Found this in a local health food store, but this price is so much better and I save gas not having to drive to the other side of town to get it. Works great for chocolate milk, and I don't feel bad giving it to my kids every day: no high fructose corn syrups! Just all natural ingredients.
This has a great chocolately taste, but it doesn't mix well in milk.  Tastes great on ice cream though.

column9: my daughter loves it and I love the ingredients
column10: My picky child lives on chocolate milk as one of her main daily sources of protein, and I like that this syrup is available.  It's nearly impossible to make homemade chocolate flavoring with dry cocoa powder and sugar, too many lumps and too much effort.However, the syrup has been out of stock for a long time ... I hope Amazon is still going to carry it.  I have purchased the case of 4 several times now.  I cannot find this syrup in local stores.

I started using this because I drink a Mocha at home every morning. We have our own coffee roaster, grinder, and espresso machine, but ya, I'm a wimp and use chocolate syrup in mine! I used to drink Hershey's Dark, then I went on a gluten free diet, and Hershey's won't really say yes or no on the gluten, so I tried this. YUM! YUM! I ran out about a week ago and had to use Hershey's and it tasted AWFUL after drinking the Ah!Laska for so long. It's like $5.29 at my health food store for one bottle, so I buy the 4 packs here on Amazon. I WISH THEY WOULD KEEP THEM IN STOCK!!!!!!! Come on Amazon!!!!

Yummy and all natural, my kids love it - don't buy the artificial Hershey syrup when you can have natural ingredients. Go easy though this is still junk food but a much better alternative to the other junk in Hershey syrup!

We love this syrup.  The flavor is MUCH better than the leading brand and the natural ingredients let me know I'm doing something good for my kids.  Just a drop in milk (or rice milk, in our case) and the kids have a treat they love.  Thanks Amazon for stocking this product!

I was so disappointed in this chocolate syrup!  Had burnt sugar overtones, and VERY little chocolate flavor. To try to make chocolate milk taste at all chocolaty it became WAY too sweet... ughh.  I will have to keep searching for a good chocolate syrup, or face up to doing it homemade.  Hope the manufacturers take note!

Best candy bar ever.You can really tell the difference between regular milk chocolate, and this double milk chocolate. This candy bar has a white middle center thats softer than the regular brown milk chocolate its covered in. If you havent tried it, do yourself a favor and DO.

column9: Pretty But doesn't have a taste
column10: Got these for my son's bday party, They are very pretty to look at, but I was disappointed that it has no real great taste...

column9: Excellent quality and affordability from a trustworthy company
column10: We used to feed Innova kibble (made by Natura Pet, the same company that makes Heathwise) and were always impressed by its quality.  However, our dogs tended to put on weight quickly when eating it because it's pretty high-calorie, so we switched to Canidae about 5 years ago.  Well, now that Canidae has a new formula that caused gastric issues with one of our dogs, we've started feeding Healthwise.  As far as I am aware, this company was never involved in any of the recent recalls or had any quality-control problems, so we feel good about trusting them.  Our dogs' transition to Healthwise was easy, and after several months on this kibble both are in picture-perfect heath.  The other Natura Pet kibbles are pricey ($50+/35lbs at our local feed store), but at an affordable $33/35lbs Healthwise is nonetheless a solid product--absolutely no corn or by-products, good high-quality meats and whole grains, no fillers or junk, and all indications are that it's tasty too.  Hooray!

column9: Our picky GSD mix loves this food!
column10: We have a German Shepherd mix who we call "Snooty McSnooterson" because of her picky eating habits.  When we adopted her, we started her out on Chicken Soup dry dog food, but it was always a chore to get her to eat it, and she had ongoing issues with loose stools.  Since switching her to this food, she's always excited about mealtime, her stools are consistently good, and her coat is shiny.  Recommended!

I really like this brand of food because its made by a reputable company that makes high quality products, yet it doesent cost a fortune unlike other premium brands. Whats ironic is that this foods quality doesent even come close to those so called "premium" brands sold at vet clinics, just compare the ingridients. Yet it costs so much less. You dont have to break the bank to afford to feed this to your dog, plus its widely available, just check the store locator on their site.

This product has been great for our weimeraner. He was eating Wellness, which he loved. But they kept jacking their prices up- so we had to switch. Our dog food retailer recommended Healthwise as a comparable solution. He has very sensitive skin. With Healthwise, he still doesn't itch and it has no corn or by products.

The loose lavendar flower buds are great for putting into open boxes or  into net balls for storage areas to keep moths away.  I've used them for about a year with no moths.  It is a much more pleasant scent than moth balls and safer than inhaling the poisonous fumes.

column9: Beautiful Fragrant Buds, perfect to fill sachet bags
column10: At the last minute, we decided to make sachet bags for a Ladies Tea at church.  This product was ordered on Wednesday and received on Friday !!!  It was beautiful fragrant buds with no chaff.  We poured the whole 1 pound bag in a punch bowl and let the ladies fill their little sachet bags to take home.

column9: French Lavender Super Blue - is just Super!
column10: I was making sachets for Christmas gifts. I looked at many different sites for lavender, paying close attention to the reviews.  I was amazed at the number of ones that had a great picture, but had horrible reviews.  This one had a fab pic and reviews as well. WOW!!!!!  I am very impressed! It smells like heaven - and the lady at the post office agreed!  I just hate I'm hiding the lovely color - no sticks, just buds.  I'll definitely order again.
Wonderful product that I have used to make sachets and make other people happier.  scent and color is wonderful.  service was first-rate and super fast.

I purchased this lavender for the fragrance to remind me of the south of France. The product arrived yesterday and there is little or no fragrance. The bag is labeled "culinary lavender".  The product is not listed as culinary lavendar on the web page and it was reported to be great for making sachets - no way!  This was a total waste of money.

We used French Lavender to make sachet's and gave them as gifts at a wedding.They scented the space with their aroma and guests ooh'd and ah'd.  The sellershipped promptly and it actually arrived within just 3-4 days.. AlthoughAmazon indicated it would take 2-3 weeks.  Highly recommend product and theseller.
Bought this for my daughter's wedding. Product is fragrant, beautiful and arrived really quickly! You get a generous amount of lavender for the price.

THIS LAVENDER IS SOOO GOOD.IT LOOKS,SMELLS,TASTES ,AND FEELS GOOD.I USE IT TO MAKE SKIN PRODUCTS AND IN THE FEW MONTHS I'VE USED IT I'VE SEEN REMARKABLE RESULTS. THE DELIVERY WAS FAST,I'D BY FROM THIS SEELER ANYTIME. MY ONLY COMPLANT IS THEY STOPPED SEELING THE HALF POUND ,BOO!!SO LIKE A TRADDER I BOUGHT SOME FROM SOMEONE ELSE CLAMMING SUPER BLUE,AND FOUND IT WASN'T AS GOOD AS THIS WAS.

I've been researching lavende vs. lavender and you can do no wrong with this product. I could smell the lavender as I approached my mailbox from six feet away. Not in a bad way, but in a wonderful, deep inhale, great-for-summer kind of way. I was shocked because shipping was super fast and efficient - and I live in Hawaii, where it takes weeks for things to get there. It's a good amount to put in many bowls and places in different places of my house. The smell is not too overwhelming but incredibly fragrant. I'm a big skeptic of ordering things online, but everything with this product - from the shipping time to the quality of the objects to the little information sheet that came with it - was perfect.

I knew the lavender was in my mailbox before I got to it. What a smell. Exactly what I wanted and it came very quickly.  Can't wait to finish making  little bags to see if I need to order more. Hope so.It would be great if you could put your contact info on bag so it is easy to find again.Two thumbs up!!!

I wouldn't know how this product is, because I ordered it over a month ago and still haven't received it.  The post office trace said it is still sitting on the east coast; I live in the southwest.  I wanted the lavender for a craft making party last week...bummer.  I won't be ordering from this vendor again.
This lavender has a great fragrance and is brightly colored.  Will defiantly order again.  Thanks!

column9: Good If You Don't Have Fresh Lavender
column10: I am used to being able to pick lavender fresh so this lavender does not seem very fresh.  It is a good insect deterrent to keep in cupboards, drawers and closets.  I put it in little cloth bags.  I needed some right away, but will definitely try to grow my own next time.

This is Adagio's version of masala chai, and it's a very good rendition.  The flavor is a blend of spices, and while it's difficult to pick out individual flavors, I suspect all of the standards are in there (cinnamon, cardamom, clove, etc.)  The flavor is pleasantly spicy and complex, and this is my spicy black tea of choice.
Well, we use canellini beans frequently in veg soup. These have a al dente texture that I have not found in any beans I've purchase at Safeway. They are really excellent!

I have used this brand of canellini beans for two years now and am very pleased with them. They have a nice firm yet creamy texture and a really good flavor. I have used them in minestrone and in Pasta e Fagioli and they really hold up well. I recommend them for all your Italian bean dishes.I just went to reorder them and they are out of stock. I do hope Amazon gets them back in stock right away.

Positive comments from other Reviewers are agreed with here; buttery, creamy, smooth, etc. Very fine flavor with no salt taste whatsoever. I put two cans in my usual Pasta e Fagioli recipe, lightly rinsed, and simmered for about the last 30 minutes before serving. The beans dissolved very slightly which nicely thickened the soup. That doesn't happen with almost all other brands I've tried.The label reads "All Natural Preservative Free" and "Original Product Of Italy". Ingredients: White beans, water.Nutrition Facts: Serving size 1/2 Cup (90g), Calories 52, Calories from Fat 2, Total Fat 1g, Saturated Fat 0g, Trans Fat 0g, Cholesterol 0mg, Sodium 99mg, Total Carbohydrate 7g, Dietary Fiber 5g, Sugars 0g, Protein 4g.I'm gradually replacing most major brand and supermarket brand staple items with ethnic-specific brands such as Carmelina Brands.Remember, we are what we eat!
I like eating these beans as they do provide protein and fiber. The fact they are not salted is a plus for me, allowing my own seasoning to make this a delicious meal.

column9: Buttery and very nice flavor and texture!
column10: These are excellent beans and no funky chemicals added to retain color and texture.Canellini beans from Mangia Carmelina are bar none the best I've tried and you can make a simple meal for one with one can of beans, a scoop of Korean soybean paste and some Sriracha sauce heated up on the stove or in the microwave for a few minutes. So hearty and satisfying.I can't wait to try these in some Italian dishes too!Regarding shipping: I only got one slightly dented can in the bunch which I was able to open and use with no problem.A+++
First let me say that these beans taste just fine, however, there are way too many damaged beans in each tin and we were not expecting that.

I used to buy this beans at smart & final, so when they stop selling them  I had to find them. They are great tasting BEANS , easy to store, great when you are in a hurry. You can take them on a camping trip just add hot water and ready to eat.  LOVE THEM, LOVE THEM

column9: as close to homemade as you can get
column10: These are excellent, provided you make one alteration -- take a strainer and shake out as much salt as you can while they are still dry. Then follow the directions and in five minutes you'll have perfect (not too salty) refried beans.

column9: these beans taste so good just like from a restraunt.
column10: They are as easy to make as mashed potatoes from a box. You can make as little as you need and they taste so much better than any can of beans I've tried. I am latina and I know what refried beans should taste like, and I love these beans. You won't be disappointed.

This is definitely a better for you and tastier than the crap out of a can.  You can make it whatever consistency you want, add whatever seasonings and blends together really well.  Its a must have if your frequently finding yourself eating mexican food, and don't want to invest a lot of time and labor making refried beans out of whole pinto beans.  Its closest to the real thing, since literally all it is dried refried pinto beans.

I've been buying Trinidad Cookquick Refried Pinto Beans for over 2 years, and I have never been disappointed with the quality, and taste of these beans. They take only 5 to 10 minutes to prepare, which, in my experience, depends on your consistency preference when preparing the product. They taste excellent without additional seasonings, but they're fantastic when prepared to one's taste with added seasonings etc. I prepare them with jalepenos, cheese, and some chipotle seasoning to add a bit of a kick to them. They're even better if one adds just a little cooked chorizo and cheddar cheese. I've served these to guests as a side with dinner and as a simple dip. In my experience, every guest that has tasted and eaten these beans cannot distinguish these dehydrated refried beans from traditionally prepared refried pinto beans. In fact, my mother, who is Hispanic and regularly prepares refried beans from scratch, could not tell the difference. I highly recommend this product for its quality, flavor, price, and convenience. Again, they're fantastic.A side note worth mentioning: When I purchased these beans locally, the only store that carried them WAS Smart & Final. Unfortunately, the Smart & Final stores in my area can't stock their shelves fast enough to keep up with the demand.

column9: Treat for the Good and Plenty addicts...
column10: Someone in my family is a serious licorice lover, and so Santa decided to try these as a step up from the Twizzlers and Good-and-Plenty candies we usually find in our Christmas stockings. Wasn't disappointed - the taste was great, and they even seem to be a few less calories per mouthful. The packaging is attractive and they make a great gift, and they even look nice sitting in your finest candy dish, assuming they last long enough for anyone to see them.Definitely recommended for the licorice lover!

I currently have an intense craving for these little guys, and this is the best of the best, as far as I'm concerned; just the right ratio of candy coating to concealed licorice!  I bought them in bulk, and my order came very quickly.  Excellent!

I used this as small christmas gifts for family and it was noticeably fresh and much better tasting than the other stuff we used to buy from the mall.  Another advantage is the controlled portions; if you are licorice freak like us.
Smooth flavor and no aftertaste.  Refreshing!  Just love it!  Been ordering this from Amazon for a couple of years now...

I love these Splenda options and I truly dislike every other sweetener on the market.  Totally Light has mixed in Splenda perfectly (unlike some diet sodas I will not call out by name...).  This read tea peach is very light and refreshing and definitely makes drinking water much more enjoyable!

I love the flavor of this iced tea. It's sweet and delicious. I haven't been able to find this flavor other than in the combo packs anywhere locally. I like that I can order 3 boxes and have them shipped to my door!

I made a scratch coffee cake utilizing a mixture of this sugar with palm sugar from Thailand. The taste of the batter was incredible! Additionally, the crumb topping was a mixture of Big Tree's palm sugar with ginger root plus Billington's dark brown sugar, which has a deep and wonderful molasses flavor. My house church members who sampled this cake found it remarkable. They loved it, saying it was wonderful and rich. Beige/brown in its coloring make-up, the cake had a solid texture to it. The cake was made with goat butter and raw goat's milk, to boot, adding to its uniqueness. It will be one of my mainstay cake recipes and a cake to make and sell (if anybody's interested!!). I LOVE to make authentic cakes (which are always prayed over and blessed) using authentic ingredients, because mine are 'Cakes Like Grandma Made!'

OK, if you want palm sugar without the spice, this is not for you.  If you want a great tasting sugar that is also bursting with the flavor of ginger, this is fantastic and a staple in my pantry.  I use it for so many things, from curing bacon, to making chutneys, topping muffins, etc.

The sweetness of the palm sugar is overpowered by the spice of the ginger.  This is good for savory dishes, but awful for everything else.  It is a shame because of the incredible digestive benefits from the ginger, and the low glycemic index of the coconut palm sugar makes this a healthful combination, but it is a virtually unpalatable ingredient.

I sent these to my mum and she absolutely loved them!  They were delivered on time, looked exactly like the photo and the flowers survived for days, she couldn't stop raving about them.  I will definitely order flowers this way in the future!

column9: Delicious Marzipan with a Ginger Twist
column10: It seems that marzipan is an acquired taste and, in any case, something that people I've informally surveyed have either a strong opinion on or confess they've never heard of.  Like many who love the stuff I was brought up on it, as a child being served seemingly molecule-thick wafers of the precious substance only on the holiest days of winter by my German relatives.  Honestly, I thought it must have been genuine Ambrosia; solid gold ingots would have been treated with less reverence.  I've lost some of the reverence my ancestors had, mostly due to lack of scarcity, but I do love it.  And, the Niederegger company in Lubeck, Germany makes the best marzipan in the known universe.  Period.  Yes, it's just almond paste, but those in Lubeck craft it so finely, with premium ingredients and such an incomparable texture that this really is marzipan that stands head and shoulders above any other.  With full acceptance of the fact that I am a partisan in this particular regard, I can say with reasonable certainty that if you don't like Niederegger marzipan, you're just not gonna like marzipan, period.This is the classic Niederegger flat bar, with their delectable marzipan surrounded by dark chocolate and infused with ginger.  Not just infused, there are actually full bits of ginger in the marzipan itself.  To me, the taste that comes through immediately is more the traditional marzipan-with-dark-chocolate and I feel likewise about the aroma.  But wait, what's that aftertaste?  There it is, that familiar spicy-burn in the back of the throat that is unique to ginger.  The ginger flavor of this bar is distinct but subtle; with real juicy bits of ginger lurking about in the marzipan, some bites will give you more kick than others.  The product that was shipped hadn't been sitting around on the shelf and was quite fresh - the chocolate firm and aromatic, the marzipan silky and smooth, and the ginger juicy and spicy.  The price was reasonable if shipping is free and beat my local source by a significant percentage; this is a premium item and though it is relatively easy to come by, it is still esoteric enough to occupy only a niche on the shelf, raising the price.  Bar-by-bar, it is much more expensive than a comparable chocolate bar from Pennsylvania.  (which I also love)As to whether you will love it or hate it, that depends both on whether you like marzipan to begin with and whether, if you do, you also enjoy additions to a familiar flavor.  (something akin to whether or not you like nuts in your chocolate chip cookies, I suppose)  I think they've done a great job of matching a very strong flavor - ginger - to their marzipan in the right balance.  While I found it interesting and well done, however, it probably isn't something I'll be going back to; I don't like nuts in my chocolate chip cookies, either.  So while I'll be sticking with the marzipan/dark chocolate combination, I think this variation with the ginger is worth a try.  If you don't like it, though, don't let it turn you away from marzipan in general.

column9: Different but still Niederegger's superb quality.
column10: I love this combination. The ginger's spice (fairly gentle, in my opinion) is a great counterpoint to the slightly sweet marzipan and dark chocolate.Niederegger produces a truly excellent, and consistent, product (see my review of their plain marzipan in dark chocolate on chocolate ratings dot wordpress dot com).Amazon's price is far less expensive than anyone else's and my bars arrived in pristine, fresh condition.

column9: a bittersweet chocolate filled with slightly pungent ginger
column10: Not my favorite flavor, but a fine quality product; these bars are definitely worth sampling once, but if you're looking for a very mild or sweet flavored filling, this is not it. A fair balance is struck between the flavors, but this is certainly best enjoyed in moderation.
Def a good pick if you like ginger, which I do, but it does overpower the marzipan flavor. Excellent dark chocolate. Lovely as Easter gifts in place of those hollow bunnies.

column4: Viennese needing space "the world is a cabaret"
column9: Superb taste and flavor - superior quality and refinement
column10: in addition to above -for me - just the right amount of ginger with a subtle kick.prompt s/hwill re-order
If you are a lover of dark chocolate, marzipan, and ginger this product is the sublime combination the the three.

I was very disappointed in this particular Niederegger Product.  The Ginger is almost undetectable in the Marzipan and the price from the vendor was much higher per bar than the other Niederegger Products.  If you are a fan of Ginger in Dark Chocolate, look elsewhere.
The wafers came very quickly.  They were also just as described.The only way it would be better is if they came pre-blessed.
Product arrive on time and as advertised. They were helpful in a workshop that I held. The plastic cup is extremely useful to store the wafers.

column9: Great taste, not so great solubility
column10: Organic Valley makes high-quality dairy products and their buttermilk powder is no exception.  I wanted fresh buttermilk but my local supermarket does not carry any, so when I saw this, I figured what the hey.Having cooked with the buttermilk blend a few times now, I find that the results are comparable and accordingly delicious.  The only issue that might arise is getting the powder to dissolve.  There will be lumps for a short while, however, that is the price you pay for having fewer additives/ emulsifiers.  I for one, would gladly sacrifice an extra minute of stirring for extra purity.I'm curious to try the milk bath but for the moment, I'm more interested in mashed potatoes and biscuits.

I use this every day in milkshakes I make with cooked oat bran cereal, a tablespoon of this powder and a cup of skim milk.  I love the creamy consistency.  I just wish this product were available for the subscribe and save program.

This is one of many superb products from Organic Valley. They are my go-to brand for any organic dairy product. We purchase their milk, half and half, cream cheese, cottage cheese, sour cream, cheese, and now powdered buttermilk.Family farms, the best organic practices, and taste.
Yes, why make pancakes when you can take milk baths?  This stuff is very nice for that (and quite economical when purchased in these large containers).

column9: Watch out about the best used date
column10: They send me a pack that will expire in 4 months and it couldn't be returned. Really disappointed about this.
I USE THIS BLEND FOR ALL MY COOKING. IT IS ESPECIALLY GOODAS A YOGURT ADDITIVE

I used to buy buttermilk in liquid form and would often not finish it all before it went bad. It took up room in my fridge and I didn't use it enough. Having the powder is really handy because I have it ready for my bread machine recipes (many actually call for the powdered form), or spur of the moment pancakes etc.I totally agree with the person who said this is great for milk baths too. Sometimes I don't bake as much as I thought or I get another shipment before I'm finished with the last and I end up with expired or excess buttermilk. I put a capful or two of my son's tangerine baby bubble bath and shake some buttermilk in and get softer skin than with any of the bath products I've tried in the past.

I love the convenience of organic valley organic buttermilk blend, I usually have problem that the liquid goes bad in the fridge. I also buy powdered nonfat milk from the same company, I use about teaspoon in my coffee and use hand blender. Tastes like whipped cream :) Love it! And it's always available!
I live in Canada, and I could not locally find non-instant, dry milk powder, for baking bread. I was so happy to find this organic dry buttermilk blend!
What is there to say about buttermilk powder? The package came on time and I have already used some of one packet.  Go for it
When buying bulk (4 bags), I like more than a 10 month shelf life. So I will not be buying from Organic Valley again.

column9: Low fat, high fiber meal replacement bar
column10: I eat a high protein meal replacement bar every day for breakfast, and I have lost several pounds.  The bar is high in protein, which does keep you fuller longer.  By lunchtime I am usually pretty hungry, but I can hold out until lunchtime without a problem.  They are a bit dry, so I always have a drink on hand while eating them.  The chocolate flavor is great, not that cheap tasting chocolate that usually comes with diet products.  The bar has a nice chew, but isn't overly chewy, nor does it stick to the teeth.  They have a good flavor - not the best bar I have ever eaten as far as taste goes, but better than tolerable for sure.  These bars are lower in fat content to some of the Slim Fast meal replacement bars, which is why I tried them in the first place.This high fiber bar will keep you feeling full for several hours, and replacing a meal a day with them does create results.  Following their diet plan of two meal replacement bars a day with three snack bars will more than likely increase weight loss from the few pounds I have lost eating one bar a day.
I was buying these everyday for almost $2....I got them online for less than $1 each.  The protein staves off hunger until lunch and all for 170 calories!

column9: Protein Bar, tastes like a candy bar
column10: This is one the MOST delicious protein bars ever sold. 10 g protein, 180 calories, but it tastes like a crunchy chocolate candy bar. They're delicious, worth eating even if you don't want the protein. Buy some.

column9: Tastes like candy bar, yet nutrition is comparable to other protein bars
column10: I'm always looking for protein bars because protein makes you feel fuller longer and I have an "on the go" schedule.  I tried all 3 flavors of these bars because they were on sale.  I was NOT disappointed.  When I bit into the first one (double-chocolate), I did a double-take because it was so good.  I had to re-verify that it was a protein meal bar because NONE of the others I've tried were this good.  Not chalky, not too dense, just like a crunchy kind of snack bar.I then figured it must contain much higher calories than the others out there because it was so good.  Not allowed to paste urls here, but Google this: "Nutrition Bar Comparison Chart, Arranged Alphabetically by Product Name."  It's an AZ govt list of meal bars.  It didn't include the Special K bars, so I had to write it in, but this stacks up against the others.  10g of protein, 5 of fiber, 170 calories.  Also contains vitamins, which is required to be allowed to be called a "meal replacement bar."I normally have mine with 8 oz of skim milk for breakfast, which gives me 18 g of protein in one meal.  (I'm told to aim for 25g/meal)  It satisfies me till lunch and sometimes I have to skip lunch because of a busy schedule so I repeat the bar with the milk and am usually good till just before dinner.  My teen son claims it satisfies him for a few hours too.  He loves them too.  We went through them so fast that I came to Amazon to see what kind of deal I could get on them.  They have a subscription plan which saves quite a bit of money.  I started with 6 boxes and we're already running low and that was a few weeks ago.Few notes: if you're trying to keep sugar and fructose out of your diet, this isn't for you.  It's got those, but again, the total calories is 170/bar, comparable or less than the other protein bars out there.Also, for some reason, Amazon charges about $1 more/box for the double chocolate and the strawberry.  I did like both flavors, but the DC had slightly more calories and fat so to save on that and the extra buck per box, I went with the chocolately chip for my subscription.  It's still delish.Price-wise: if you opt to not do the subscription, the $15 price ($5/box) is still the best I could find.  These are running about $7-9 per box in the stores.This is like the best-kept secret out there!!

column9: Does the job but grainy like its got sand in it
column10: Tastes good but is very grainy/sandy in texture. I am sure there are better ones out there but these are the first i tried
They are very tasty and actually very filling which I was skeptical about.  I have a shake for breakfast and a meal bar for lunch.  Then i'm good to go!

column9: Kellogg's Special K Protein Meal Bar Chocolately Chip
column10: This ABSOLUTELY blows away its competition on the basis of taste!  Imagine eating a yummy candy bar, without being guilty of short-changing yourself on nutrition!  I compared the nutritional content of this product with that of two products in the same category produced by other manufacturers.  This product rated last of the three, in that respect.  (The other two candidates, while also resembling candy bars, were relative duds in my taste test).  I'm NOT claiming that a steady diet of these would be a healthy/appropriate diet for anyone--but moderation is a wonderful thing & so is this product!

The peanutbutter ones are my favorite, but I really like these ones too. arrived quickly and fully intact. none of them are stale or damaged. Pretty good deal considering that usually cost $7-8 per box in stores.

I've eaten one of these each morning for the last few weeks and I have found that for the most part they keep me satisfied until at least close to lunch time (might be hungry the last hour or so).The chocolate chip is my preferred flavor amongst the ones I've tried. The taste is close to a candy bar and the texture makes you feel like you're eating something relatively substantial. Some of the other breakfast bars I've eaten try to go light on calories and end up being either dense and small or very airy and you don't seem to be chewing much of anything. I think these have found a better balance.If I had one negative comment about them it might be that they're almost a touch too tempting. If I'm on a restricted calorie diet I always find that my will power is lowest late at night and early in the morning (really whenever I'm tired) and sometimes having just one bar for breakfast is difficult and I find myself nearly running out the door to avoid having another. If you find yourself in the same boat and are trying to control your calorie intake it might be helpful to have something less tempting on hand. If not these are a pretty good breakfast option that can help to control your appetite and get you to lunch with your calorie deficit intact.Conclusions:Tasty barsGood texture that makes you feel like you're eating something substantialPerhaps a bit too tasty if you have trouble having sweets in the house
This product tastes very nice. I like them very much.This product is very handy when you are hungry just open a pack and eat you are good to go for at least 2-3 hrs.

I originally bought these protein meal bars for myself as a quick breakfast replacement, but my young son started eating them as "chocolate bars" when he sort of went on strike and stopped eating typical breakfast foods.  He is an extremely picky eater and these bars have been a real lifesaver in terms of getting him some of the basic nutrition he needs!  He eats these once or twice a day, for breakfast and/or lunch, along with yogurt and cheese, and I feel just a tiny bit better about his nutrition than feeding him Pop Tarts or cinnamon rolls (which is all he would eat otherwise).
These are tasty, low in calories and seem to be of good quality.  I eat one as breakfast replacement or mid-meal snack.

column9: Tastes good, keeps me from being hungry
column10: I don't really eat these on a regular basis. These are my breakfasts when I sleep in late or my lunches when I can't be bothered. I carry one with me in my bookbag/purse just in case.
