While I'm sure that many have impressive nutritional benefits, the taste has consistently been a problem and until now I have only found products that tasted tolerable at best.  This drink is GOOD.  I mix it with almond milk and personally cannot tell the difference between this drink and regular chocolate almond milk.  My sister tried it and said that it wasn't bad but that she could "taste the green." I've tried adding a small amount of regular chocolate powder in addition to this powder and so far everyone's enjoyed it that way.  It's great to have finally found a product that's delicious as well as nutritious!

I read all of the reviews, but really didn't believe them. How could something this good for me actually taste good??! I just had it for the first time and it tastes just like Ovaltine. I am so pleased with this product. It is really delicious.

I have to admit, I haven't noticed an increase in energy, and I have been taking this daily for almost a month now. I anticipated the taste to be terrible, but this powder actually tastes pretty good when you put it in milk!

I love both the original and chocolate Amazing Grass Superfood Powder. I prefer this one for the days I want something little heavier, like chocolate "milk", or for when the grassy taste of the original flavour is a little too much. It gives a super shot of sustained energy - I chug a glass of this every day right before work and I'm set to go. The energy doesn't drop me like coffee and I know I'm beefing up on my day's veggie & fruit requirements. I do, if you've never taken it before, recommend drinking one scoop a day until you feel comfortable enough to increase it if you feel you need it. The energy was a little much to handle for my boyfriend and a couple friends all of whom never had it before.

column9: Palatable blend of impressive array of nutrients and antioxidants
column10: I ordered this with trepidation. I've never been able to swallow green food mixes, other than Green Magma (which is not "mixed", but just barley grass). Wheat grass makes me gag. Literally--cannot swallow it. My body rejects it and I gag and spit it out. So, over the years, trying green foods trying to find something I can swallow has been trying.Well, there ya go. This one works.I ordered it on the basis of numerous positive flavor reviews and I liked the list of nutrients/enzymes.30 calories per serving of 8 grams= 1 g fat, 2 g protein, 4 g carbs (2 g fiber), 65% Vit A, 30% of C and K, 15% of B12 and Riboflavin, 6% of iron and manganese; organic grasses (wheat, barley, alfalfa, spirulina, spinach, broccoli, chlorela); with antioxidant from maca, acai, carrot, rose hips, beet, pineapple, green tea, acerola cherry. Fiber from apple pectin, organic oat powder, organic flax seed powder. Also L acidophilus, peppermint, Siberian eleuthero root, and sea salt.The flavor is pleasant. It's like the taste of bitterish dark chocolate bars with a grassy undertone that isn't offputting. It's not like it's a chocolate malted or anything, but it works fine for me. I can drink this. I do not gag. Yay.I will reorder this. I like the healthful profile and the flavor.UPDATE: Okay, I didn't really expect a noticeable effect from this (I mean, I've had superfoods before and didn't suddenly go change the world or anything), but I have actually noticed an uptick in my energy after adding this to my pre-workout smoothie and my pre-chore protein drink. I've been adding it to BSN sytha-6 chocolate protein mix with an extra teaspoon (heaping) of Raw cacao (organic), and it's a nice flavor combo. I think it would be great with a banana, too, for extra potassium (a chocobanana vibe).Maybe it's placebo. Who knows? But as I wasn't thinking I'd notice a change, maybe not. But wow, I do feel an energy surge in the afternoon when I usually have a slump and I get through my 55 minute personal training session with more oomph.

I am a college student of health sciences and the mother to a 3 yr old toddler. I personally show very little response to "placebo effect" situations and I am a true skeptic at heart. I originally found the "kid" version of this product for my daughter while searching for something to boost her immune system. I spent hours on the computer researching the ingredients of these products. I decided to try the adult version for myself and I can honestly say that the Amazing Grass Superfood Powders have made a huge improvement in both of our lives. My daughter attends daycare and with that setting comes frequent colds/flus, some serious. She spent the better part of each month with varying degrees of sickness. Since we have using the Superfood Powders (months), neither she nor I have gotten sick. We spent time with my parents who were both very ill while she and I remained in good health. I have a greater amount of energy since using this product as well. I have chronic fatigue but the effects are greatly reduced since drinking this powder. It is also nice to know that my body is getting the nutrients it needs to perform well. It is difficult to include all the necessary foods in your diet that your body needs to thrive but the Amazing Grass products take care of that.Who cares whether or not it tastes "just like chocolate milk"? It isnt meant to be sold as a dessert drink. It is meant to keep you healthy. I mix one scoop of powder with 8 oz of almond milk and add 1 tsp of Ovaltine. It tastes great. No, it doesnt taste just like chocolate milk but it is definitely palatable and does not need to be consumed "fast". Anyone who has tasted pure Spirulina powder can agree that this is MAJORLY masking the flavor of its healthy ingredients!!Overall, EXCELLENT product! I am getting ready to purchase my 4th jar!

This stuff taste great! And that was my biggest concern. I wanted to try to increase my health without having to make myself gag lol. But I drink Muscle Milk and that stuff is really strong until u get used to it...but this product was great first round! I mixed roughly with an ounce of water with a few more ounces of almond milk (I free-hand measured both the milk and water) delicious!!! Honestly I heard it smelled strong and it tasted like "earth" not at all. I used one scoop as directed and I could smell the "green" and taste it but it was so slight I don't even know why someone would mention it. And I am just a 27 year old African American woman who wants to improve her health. I'm like 5 ft 151 lbs and I don't wanna end up sick from being over weight from not getting the proper nutrition. I know that diet and exercise are also important. I feel that if you think you can just drink this but not eat a balanced diet and exercise you are mistaken but I think this is a great add to a healthy lifestyle!

This is great for getting in all your nutrients.  Here is my Chocoberry Smoothie recipe I have created for my morning breakfast routine:  1 scoop Amazing Grass Chocolate Drink Powder, Green Superfood, 8.5-Ounce Container, 1 cup Blue Diamond unsweetened Almond Vanilla Milk, 1/2 cup frozen blueberries, 1 tablespoon unsweetened 100% cocoa, 1/2 scoop protein powder (after trying many, I use Whole Nectar Soy Protein Powder @ wholenectar.com or I have found at Costco), 2 tablespoons PB2 Powdered Peanut Butter - 85% Less Fat and Calories - 6.5 Oz.  I add a heaping scoop of ice, mix in my vitamix blender, and it's pretty good.  This comes to 225 Calories, 10 grams fiber and 17 grams protein.  You CAN taste the "greens" a little, but the peanut butter and blueberries definitely help.  The blueberries are great for antioxidants and the cocoa is great for health, too.  I feel full for a good 4 hours.  You can add more protein, if you'd like.  The Amazing Grass needs to be refrigerated after opened...I keep that and the peanut butter in my freezer.

I always buy something here in Amazon. After having a baby a year ago, I feel always tired and cannot focus on what I'm doing. I wanted to take some pills but am afraid of the side effects. I then went browsing for energy drinks and found this one. At first I was skeptical about it so I ordered the small one in case it doesn't work. I ordered it together with the blender bottle with blender ball. I was really impressed how it gave me so much energy after few minutes drinking it. The grass taste is still there even though I order the choco favor but I really don't care 'cause there are no other energy products that can give me this much energy and I feel that everything's so clear. I would definitely recommend this to a friend.

column9: Great Ingridents Have to get use to the taste....
column10: This just arrived in the mail today and I cracked it open and taste tested it.  The taste is not horrible, in fact it's very drinkable.  That being said, it doesn't taste great either.  I mixed it in a Blender Bottle and it was a pretty good consistency. I used almond milk as well.I later tried mixing it into my protein shake and it worked great!  I can taste the undertones of the chocolate amazing grass but it's about 10 times more palatable.I give it 4 stars because of the nutritional value and I can actually stomach it in my protein shake.  I didn't give it 5 stars because I don't think I can drink it as a stand alone.

As of this review I'm on day 4 of using this product. Have to admit that I was very surprised by how good this product is. Very good chocolate flavor, no grittiness or "grassy" flavor of the Amazing Grass Green powder, although I love that product as well.One of the things I missed the most in my transition away to a low-refined carbohydrates/sugar diet were chocolate milkshakes, and all the previous substitutes that marketed themselves as that were never satisfying, similar to the feeling of drinking a diet coke instead of a real coke with real sugar. I think I may have found a recipe that is very close alternative that's not only far healthier, but REALLY good as my morning meal replacement when I don't have time to cook breakfast, and it keeps me easily satiated until well after lunchtime. The benefit of that of course, is because I'm not starving for lunch or completely lacking in nutrition, it makes it much easier to make healthy choices during the lunchtime, instead of opting for the junk food my body would normally crave by that point.Here's what I make every morning in my blender if I don't have time for a proper breakfast8 oz Unsweetened Chocolate Almond Milk1 Scoop Amazing Grass Chocolate Drink Powder1 Scoop Nature's Life Low sugar, Green Whey Pro-96 (or your own low sugar whey protein mix, this one tastes great, the packaging is pretty over the top however)1 Scoop Flaxseed powder.1 packet of Stevia powder.Tastes really a lot like a chocolate milkshake, certainly enough to I can't claim that I feel a boost of energy that others are commenting on here, I'd say it's more of an evening out of my energy levels that keeps me going. I definitely don't need several cups of coffee I previously did to get going anymore, which is great. Will update as I finish the jar.

I tried the Amazing Grass Original Powder and it was okay. This chocolate flavored powder is 10 times better! After opening I store it in the freezer. I mix my powder with Rice, soy or coconut milk. Great Chocolate taste!
My four year old loves this thing, I also do. I mix it with a little bit of fruit and almond milk every day and he can't get enough!
I like the taste of the powder enough to sprinkle a scoopful to my cereal every morning and I am into my 3rd jar. Good source of fiber. Keep my skin clear.

This green superfood does not taste like chocolate.  There might be a hint of chocolate flavor at the beginning, but there's  a monstrous leafy aftertaste.  I might try the regular powder next time and just skip the chocolate charade.  I think it has effectively perked me up, though.

column9: TASTE NOT GREAT BUT REALLY HEALTHY
column10: i ordered the choclate one because i knew i couldnt drink those other flavors especially original. but let me say this despite being choclate its hard to drink it but i also know it is healthy and good for me.

column9: Tastes good, for a super green suplement
column10: this is pretty good, for a super green supplement.  I don't gag or have to force myself to drink it.  I usually just drink it with water, but if you blend it with milk, peanut butter and some extra cocoa, it's pretty yummy, but with that 'green' aftertaste.  I have only been taking it a few days, so I haven't noticed much difference. I do think it gives me a mild energy boost taking it once a day.

I wasn't sure how ordering this product was going to turn out for me since I've never really used anything like it before. But it's great! I put it in my peanut-butter/banana/strawberry milkshake and it tasted pretty darn good, not at all the "supplement" taste I was expecting. I'll probably buy this again. :)

column9: A Great Way to Get Extra Nutrition
column10: I have purchased the Amazing Grass Green Superfoods in both Berry flavor and Chocolate.  I much prefer the chocolate.  I mix it into a smoothie and the subtle chocolate flavor is pretty good.  The chocolate flavor is very mild and subtle, but not grassy tasting at all.  I made a smoothie yesterday with frozen cherries, lite vanilla soymilk, spinach, vanilla protein powder and the chocolate amazing grass.  It was very good and easy to drink.The Berry flavor mixes well in fruity smoothies.  I taste a bit of grassy flavor, but it is still drinkable.  It mixes very smooth.  I am able to get my 16 year old DS to drink it too.Amazon has a great price and I have recommended this product to a few friends as well.

column9: Best tasting superfood, but still not great tasting.
column10: It seems like none of these superfood/supplement powders ever taste GOOD. Some of them have made me downright sick. This one is about the only one I've found that is drinkable by itself. There is an earthy, grassy undertone to it that is a bit rough, but I mix one scoop of this (about a heaping teaspoon's worth) and one tablespoon of Ovaltine to 8 ounces milk (sometimes soy milk) and it's delicious. Sometimes I'll mix it with the Bolthouse Farms Chocolate Soy Protein drink. If I know I'm going to have a busy day I'll mix it with milk and a half-scoop of whey protein powder.No matter what powder drink supplement/meal replacement mix you choose, you'll want to invest in one of these: LaCuisineTM 18oz Tornado Portable Mixer. Add a little liquid, start blending, add your mix and then fill with more liquid. Your drink is now smooth and if you're a slow drinking like me you can zap it before a sip to keep your drink smooth all the way.Beyond taste, after a week of using the Amazing Grass Chocolate Superfood and changing nothing else in my diet or activities, I find myself having less trouble falling asleep, and I'm waking up earlier and with more energy.If you're wondering exactly what the difference is between this and the Amazing Grass Meal, the answer is about 100 calories and I'm not sure what else. The scoop in the meal can is about three heaping tablespoons (the superfood scoop is about a heaping teaspoon). The taste is almost identical.

I have tried other green drinks in the past and they were very hard for me to get down in the mornings no matter what I mixed them with. I have only used this product for the last two days. I made it with unsweetened almond milk and one packet of stevia both yesterday morning and today... I love it! At first I wasn't sure about the slightly unusual taste but I have to admit that I really enjoy it. It worked well in my shaker bottle. I made it up the night before and grabbed it to take to work in the morning. It needed to be re-shaken in the morning but I truly enjoy drinking this product. I actually am a little sad when I finish it. I plan to try to mix it with a scoop of protein powder also just to get more bang out of my breakfast shake. I would suggest this to anyone to try!

column9: Mix with Vitamix or similar blender - in shaker was no good!
column10: I first tried this in a shaker style cup and it was so gritty and gross (and I like other powdered greens that I've tried!) but I followed one reviewer's recipe with a slight alteration, mixed it in a Vitamix and it was wonderful!  6 oz almond milk, frozen banana, T peanut butter and a scoop of this powder and it was fantastic!!  Now I know I just need to mix it very, very well.

This is the first product in the Amazing Grass line that I have tried and it tastes pretty good, I was happy about that... It actually tastes good shaken up in a blender bottle all by itself with a bit of organic almond milk. In the blender it works great with bananas, strawberries, coconut and rice milk. I chose this product because it did not contain soy or soy lecithin. Soy is not recommended because it disrupts estrogens in the body and it also causes havoc with people who have thyroid disorders. I'm real happy about the probiotics included too.I couldn't find the scoop in the tub when I opened it so I called the company to find out how many teaspoons equaled the 8 gm dosage and they had me on hold a long time trying to figure this out. It seems they should know this information by heart, but no such luck. They told me the answer is about 2 teaspoons. If you happen to get a tub without a scoop, I guess that's a good approximate.

I have been taking this about a month and have noticed an increase in my energy levels. The taste is not that great when mixed with water. You will have to adjust your individual recipes but I usually mix mine with an EAS energy drink, some cinnamon and blueberries or bananas. This greatly improves the taste and texture.

Amazing Grass Green superfood chocolate is hands down the best tasting and healthy greens out there!  It also contains fruits and probiotics. I mix it with chocolate sugar free almond milk and chocolate whey protien for bfast and it is delicious!

I actually bought the trial size of individual packets and just tried it today. Wonderful! It's not really sweet, which is good (I add stevia), and it has a nice chocolate flavor. You really can't beat the nutrition it offers, either. Definitely a must.
I put a scoop in my post-workout drink and it mixes well. I don't like the taste on it's own, but with the protein drink it's much better. Very naturally way of getting your daily nutrients.

I mix this product with soy milk and a frozen banana or EAS chocolate protein powder and soy milk, great taste my picky kids will even drink it.  I think it is by far their best tasting superfood and you can't beat the price.  I've recommeded it to everyone, especially around cold and flu season.  When everyone was sick around me, I never got sick.

I love this product. For two years, I there were certain foods I couldn't eat such as something spicy because it would upset my stomach. Once I started taking this product, I can now eat how I used to without my stomach being upset. My digestion system is now back to normal. I also like the fact that it came in chocolate flavor and its low in calories.

column9: finally a green powder that i can drink without holding my nose
column10: My only previous experience with green superfood powder was with Garden of Life Superfood. It's awful. So I thought I'd give this a try since I LOVE chocolate. I do love this. This is my recipe for chocolatey goodness: 1 scoop of Amazing Grass chocolate, a few spoonfuls of low fat French vanilla Stoneyfield Farms yogurt, approx 1.5 cups lite chocolate Silk soymilk, 2-3 frozen slices of banana, a little flax oil, and a little crushed ice. Blend this in the Bullet blender and ENJOY! Will definitely purchase again even if a little pricey!

my opinion is: enh, I can take it or leave it. I would love to love it, and I do love everything about it except...the taste, lol. It's "ok" and tastes exactly like what it is: a grassy, cocoa-flavored liquid. It is, however, a convenient way to get more greens in your diet. BTw, Trader Joe's sells a much less expensive powdered greens that I'll try mixing with cocoa. Don't know if the TJ's version is organic or has the same quality.

column9: Not everything good for you tastes great.
column10: The title says it all. Amazing Grass Chocolate drink is gritty (even though I added in a little milk on my second turn) and that's okay, because it's filled with nutrients which would take 100's of food calories to collect -- and for only 30 cals per serving, I can deal with it.I'm just writing this to let others know that unless you hide it in smoothies, it's NOT going to taste like chocolate BUT the taste is bearable (you just have to shake the hell out of it if you only add it with water to save on calories). The serving size is only 8oz, so it's bearable on the taste buds but, yeah, there's no chocolate bar in my mind as it's being drunk.
I mix it with the Yoplait Smoothie packets and it tastes pretty good. It gives me lots of energy during the day. I would highly recommend it.

This stuff is so great.  I take it as a shot instead of mixing it as a shake.  I take it first thing in the morning.  I am pregnant and feel like I get everything I need for my growing baby when I drink this.

This SUPERFOOD is very good. I enjoy it with vanilla rice milk and have been adding a scoop of ground flaxseed meal. This is a great morning drink that gets me going. I would defiantly recommend this as it is full of nutrients and tastes very good!

I love this product! I have been taking wheatgrass for over a year and this is by far my favorite way to take it. Many of the other flavors are good too but this one mixes so easily with just milk. I also add this to protein shakes for a quick and easy way to get a helping of wheatgrass. I have found that it is best to first mix with a little water as it helps the wheatgrass mix better.

This is a great product to help you get the essential antioxidants/vitamins, etc in your diet.A friend of mine introduced me to this and I try to make it at least 2x a day.You MUST dissolve the first 1 oz. in cold water, otherwise it's a pretty bad mix.Keep the container in the fridge for freshness.I mix mine with Zico dark chocolate coconut water (just 1/4 cup) and the rest cold water.  It adds a little more flavor but without too much added sugar or calories.When I travel, I take along the small packets of Green SuperFood and try to find coconut water for mixing.  (This is great because it's even more difficult to get veggies/greens when you are far from home)

Taste great with your favorite fruit, vegetable, and liquid (water, milk, etc). I bought the 8.5 ounce and will order the larger size next time. The chocolate is delicious... it feels great to start my day doing something good for my body.

column9: Finally something that tastes great, mixes easily and is good for you.
column10: First of all I need to state that I have been drinking all kinds of nasty-tasting green drinks for over 10 years for the health benefits. I don't eat any sugar of any kind, and I focus a lot on how anything I consume is going to make me feel. Having said this, I think this product is the best-tasting supplement I have ever had. It reminds me a little of chocolate milk, but with a lot less sugar and garbage in it.I poured it into my water bottle after working out. I did not even shake it much and it mixed right in without being gritty or lumpy. I drank it about 45 minutes ago, and I feel good. I didn't get a "rush" of energy, but I feel more of a calm energy that comes from feeling healthy and well-nourished. I am looking for a product to replace the caffeine in the organic coffee I drink. I hope this is it. Time will tell. I also chose this product because of the health benefits of maca. Time will tell on that, too.Another thing I like I about this product is it comes in little individual serving packets. This would be great for camping. It seems to be easily digested and absorbed, which is another major advantage.Overall I highly recommend this product so far. I bought this company's chai vanilla meal replacement, also. It doesn't have any sugar. Unfortunately the chocolate flavor does have sugar, so I didn't buy that one. I will review that one after I try it. I'm just really thankful for products like this.I bought this product at my local health food store. It was on sale for $22.99. Amazon is again, by far the best place to buy things. Subscribe and Save is the way to go.

I have found a job as a computer programmer, and going from my previous job that was fairly physically demanding to sitting down all day, my weight has started to climb, so buying this product is my first attempt at a healthier living style.  At first I was a little concerned because a lot of people are having trouble getting over this product, and usually I am fairly susceptible to the flavor as well.  I was even a little apprehensive, because the smell is not the greatest.  However, the flavor isn't bad!  To me, it tasted like a very week chocolate milk (I mixed it with Skim Milk) with a very small hint of what I can only describe as an earthy flavor.  It wasn't a put off at all.  I was able to down the rest after my initial sip very quickly, use a little more milk to swish around all the left overs on the side and bottom of the glass and finish it off no problem.  As far as performance goes, this may just be the placebo effect, but within the hour, I had none of the usual sluggish feeling, and am generally feeling more alert and energetic.  I will update this review in a few weeks once I have had time to use this product more thoroughly.  But with the way I understand antioxidants to work, they need a while to clear all the toxins so it should only get better.  So far, I highly recommend this product!

What a better way to get my healthy greens and chocolate also!! This is great before or after my workouts or as a treat after my meals! I love the yummy chocolate taste and I feel good about all the health benefits while drinking it! I add an ice cube,a scoop of Chocolate Amazing Greens, water & mix-yum!

This greenfood powder tastes amazing!  Over the years, I've tried protein powders and energy drinks, but this stuff tastes REALLY really good.  I usually put some in a small jar and mix it with almond or soy milk in the morning.  By the time I get to work, it's shaken up and ready to go!  This tastes even better with chocolate milk!I haven't used it in any other way YET, but I know plenty of people use this in smoothies and juices.  Also, you can use this in baked goods like pancakes and waffles! (For recipe-> (...))Even if you don't usually buy this type of thing, you should give this a try.

Great product! Very nutritious and tastes delicious! I use it for my almond milk smoothies, and it tastes so good it masks the not so pleasant taste of other products I used such as spirulina and chlorella.

I started looking into "greens" products when we wanted to improve our health. I read all the reviews and finally found Amazing Grass. We tried the berry and didnt like it but the chocolate is good! It took my husband awhile to get used to it but he now puts it in his protein shake every, single day! I like it with almond milk, hemp protein powder and some raw honey. My kids like it too. I add it to smoothies with berries and they eat it up. Love it!

I really don't like many of the powder drinks. I think I generally can tell the powder is grainy and I don't stick with it. this was really tasty, I didn't mind the powder and the over all shake was great. I mixed it with a banana and almond milk and a spoon off peanut butter and it tasted like a okay milkshake.

I bought the chocolate and loved it and it makes me feel like I am doing something healthy for my body. I mix it with plain almond milk, crushed ice and spiruteen protien powder, I also put some organic fruit juice in it. Cherry juice for the chocolate and yum. My husband loves it also. I was so impressed I just received the berry flavor and will try it in the morning. I also bought the peanut butter chocolate protien bars, I just ate one and it was delicious. The only adjustment I had to make was the green grass color in the middle. The taste made it worth it. I can't wait to try more. and am shopping at Amazon for others items, I feel like I can have these things without any guilt of having sweets because to me they are just as good. I will give a review of the berry flavor after I have tried it.

Love the chocolate taste with a little grass undertone - really surprised - not too sweet. Have been mixing with water and unsweetened almond milk - best results to mix with a little water first like the package says. Will be cancelling my subscription to subscribe to the larger size - totally hooked after three days! Great product!

I was truly amazed at how good this tastes given that it is healthy for you.  If you mix with milk, it is best if you mix with 1 oz water first to avoid all the lumps and clumps.  It tastes okay with water, but tastes better (to me) if mixed with milk.  I have used skim milk, almond milk, and low fat vanilla milk plus I add a scoop of ground golden flax seed.  This is my morning breakfast drink - it fills me up and gives me energy.  One 8.5 oz container yields 30 servings.
The stuff takes a lot of stirring to get it dissolved.Then drink it quickly before it starts to settle on the bottom.

Tastes really great and I hope it is nutritional but I do not personally feel the difference.  I basically mix it with fruit, hemp milk, raw almond butter and fish oil and it gives it a chocolate taste - REALLY yummy!  I may purchase it again.

I love the chocolate smell and taste. I mix it with chocolate protein powder, chocolate coconut milk, water, lecithin granules (it actually hides that horrible taste), and almond milk. It makes a yummy protein drink for when I don't have time to eat.

Awesome flavor, great nutritional content, organic and gluten-free. Can't ask for more!! I add this to my protein shake each morning and get an added burst of energy from the greens. Also amazing how it eases out the bowel movements.

By far the best tasting superfood I've had!Great with some frozen cherries in the blender :) I have purchased different brands of greens in the past & these are the only ones I can put in a smoothie without making it unbearable!

I normally buy the original green superfoods but the chocolate is quite tasty. I mixed it with Vanilla Almond Milk. It mixes well enough although you do still get a bit of grittiness. I never tried it with just water or milk so I cannot really testify to its taste with those liquids. If you like chocolate...nice choice.

column9: Great Taste & Makes You Feel Like You are doing the RIGHT thing!
column10: I tried this, by a sample machine @ my Whole Foods Grocery. I was so impressed by the taste,I bought it there straight away.  Some green powders, the taste, you have to Stevia it up so much...This one, + Rice Milk, was very tasty PLUS you know it is doing very good things for you.I plan to try it with various fruits and such in my blender or juicer, too.All and all a good choice, and the pricing here is better than in the store :)

Let me just say this is delicious!  I am extremely picky when it comes to drinks, I don't like anything, and only drink water, so I was beyond hesitant yet I tried this and it was delicious!!  I drink a glass every morning for breakfast now.  I use one ounce of water to mix it then add 7ounces of organic vanilla almond milk.  I also love that I can subscribe and save here, so it can be automatically be sent to me. A 8.5OZ. PACKAGE MAKES 30 SERVINGS!!

I think this green drink is chocolatey and delicous.  I don't have a problem w/taste and texture as alot of people do, however, the taste of this is really quite good compared to other green drinks.  In fact, it tastes so good I hope I am really getting the green benefit that it promises.  Amazing Grass promises to be one of the best if not THE best green drink on the market.  The chocolate does cover up the green taste, but if you like chocolate that can be a good thing!! The texture however is a little gritty, but as the canister states is does dissolve better in a little water first then add your other liquid.  I will continue drinking this to get my greens and because it tastes good.  Amazon has a great price!!

I've been a vegetarian for about six years and sometimes vegan. However after starting work at a high pressure job out of college, I fell into the pizza, quick convenience food trap and have gained thirty pounds. Will keep drinking and buy it again in the larger size.

I've been using this off and on for the past 6 months.  I mix it with almond milk and some wheatgrass powder (from Amazing Grass).  Sometimes I'll add a scoop of chocolate protein powder.  I'm not sure about the energy because I drink coffee in the a.m. too, but what I've noticed is I haven't been sick this winter at all.  Every year I get sick a couple of times, so I attribute it to the Amazing Grass.  My kids won't drink green drinks but they do like this (minus the additional wheatgrass).

column9: a green powder I can enjoy
column10: Most green powders are "tolerated" for their health benefits and I have found a couple that are "least likely to make me gag" LOL. column9: Felt better but not a big difference
column10: While I was pretty healthy to begin with I haven't notice a huge difference after taking the product each morning for a month. I swear this drink is the reason!  I recently bought the berry flavor, not as good with milk.  Berry flavor is good mixed in a fruit smoothie. I like the taste.  It adds good flavor and nutrients to my daily protein shake.  As always, it's hard to tell how much it contributes to my overall health but I can say that I have not been sick this winter.

column9: Tasty way to get more greens
column10: My nutritionist recommended I get a serving of greens at every meal, and having this on hand (especially at breakfast) has been wonderful! The taste is very good, the texture is not a problem, and I like it a lot. I've tried some other flavors, too, and like them as well. Like I said, I had high hopes... but this just did not work for us.

column9: No inclusions of sand or shell fragments
column10: Nothing is seriously wrong with these farmed oysters from the People's Republic of China.  There are no inclusions of sand or shell fragments.  Just as clams are an extremely, extremely rich source of iron, oysters are an extremely, extremely rich source of zinc.  The only problem might be that these oysters don't taste quite as good as the best-tasting brands of canned whole oysters.  Like most farmed oysters from China, these oysters are dark gray in color, which might be considered a disadvantage by someone who has become comfortable eating light-colored, good-tasting, canned farmed oysters from South Korea.  Unlike smoked oysters, which are high in cancer-causing nitrosamines and cancer-causing heterocyclic amines, these oysters are quite good for your health.  Oysters are extremely low in mercury and other marine pollutants and moderately high in the long-chain omega-3 fatty acids, EPA and DHA.

I've been using Numi teas for quite some time. They have a great quality tea. I've been buying the bags because I never found loose leaf, so I was excited to see this available through Amazon.  I love the rooibos line of teas for their health benefits. Purchased two 7' topiaries to place on pillars and flank the interior of my front door. For a couple of months I would just toss the pill into her bowl with her food and she would gobble it up with everything else.  However, she eventually learned how to eat all the food and leave the pill.  At the recommendation of my vet I tried these and they work great.To mitigate the cost I don't use a whole pocket at a time.  Instead, as these are very soft, I'll rip off a very small chuck of a pocket and use that - all my dog needs is enough to cover the little pill. The problem is that my fingers smell very strongly after I use them, hence I have to wash them immediately - not a big deal but I dropped the review by a star for it as it's annoying.

These Pill Pockets are a must for anyone who has a dog that resists pill administration. I have a 16-yr-old miniature Poodle w/heart & joint issues. He fights taking pills, which isn't good for his bad heart. I put 1/2 Rimadyl tab, 1/2 enalapril tab, & 1/4 tramadol tab in one (1) Pill Pocket! Yes, all of those in 1 pocket. I pinch the pocket around the meds, then roll the pocket in my palms to seal it, & he takes it w/o any resistance! These are absolutely wonderful! column10: My cats all eat this, but I find it messy to serve, especially the chicken pot pie cans which seem to be 50 percent liquid. When you pull off the pop top, you can't help but get splashed by it. And it seems like you're not getting that much food for your money since it's so much liquid. The Chinese chicken is not as liquidy.I have no idea how to compare this to other brands price-wise because it is not sold in my state. I've never seen it in stores.

I take care of this cat for a friend of mine.  The cat is very friendly, but is an extremely picky eater.  I put this product in front of her and she ate the whole thing!  So, all I can say is this has to be good.The can are convient, but are single servings.  If you have more than one cat, the packaging is not "green" friendly, but the cat/cats will love the food!

I have four cats and they all like this food.  Since there is only one serving per can, it would be a better buy for a one cat family.  It doesn't smell bad and looks nice.  My daughter's kitten liked it very much.  The quality of the product seemed high.

column9: Pretty decent: but could be a little better
column10: Well my mother has a couple cats so I thought what the heck I'll get this stuff for her to feed them instead of hard food all the time.The cats who will eat anything and everything that you put in front of them were little apprehensive of this product. Granted the one cat does like spicy food but he did eat it throughout the days. They both like it but it's hard for them to get a hold of the pieces because the chicken is kind of stringy and not cut into smaller pieces and some of it ends up on the floor.But now that they kind of used to these they do definitely practically yell at me when I don't give them the stuff as soon as I open the can, lol. But it would be better if it were smaller cut pieces to reduce the amount that ends up on the floor.

According to the manufacturer's website, this (and many of their other products) contains menadione sodium bisulfite complex.Menadione is a synthetic precursor for Vitamin K and has been reported to have toxic effects. The use of menadione over the natural alternatives (such as leafy greens and kelp) is only for cost-saving reasons, hence usually only found in cheaper and lower quality animal food. It's surprising that pet food at this high of a price actually contains this substance.Menadione is banned by the Food & Drug Administration in over-the-counter supplements due to its potential for organ toxicity. It's also banned in Europe for human consumption.A study in rats showed that exposure to menadione "produced lesions in the kidney, heart, liver and lung." Chiou et al. Toxicology 1997.Menadione's toxicity seems to be due to its ability to induce oxidative stress in cells.Do an online search for menadione and you'll find more info from a pet food watchdog trying to stop the inclusion of this substance.In light of recent episodes of toxic pet food and the questionable behaviors of manufacturers and our regulatory agencies, I would advise you to avoid feeding this to your cats.

The ingredients in this seems to be better then "Fancy Feast" which is mostly fat. I have one finicky cat and one who will eat anything. Both love it. It is a good every other day [half way healthy] treat for them.

column9: She never turns up her nose
column10: I don't know if it's typical or not, but our cat gets tired of any flavor of canned cat food after a while. Sometimes she'll eat a flavor one day, but turn up her nose at it a week later. We vary the flavors, but she's picky. We've been trying the Petite Cuisine for several weeks now, and the four different flavors seem to give her plenty of variety -- she hasn't refused it yet. Here's hoping that continues!

Wow!!!  This cat food must have something like catnip in it.  After the first smell and taste, the cats have come at the first sound of opening another can.  My cats seem to really appreciate the taste.  It smells fine to me.  Cat food is cat food, to me, but, to my closest friends, at least my cats, they love this product.  It's a little more expensive than the cat food that I could purchase in a discount store, but, here again, I think that my cats seem to enjoy this a bit more.

My 2 cats loved this stuff! There are 2 kinds in the 24 pack, so you get 12 cans of each. Cans are small, 2.8 oz each, that is smaller than the fancy feast cans.The food doesn't smell like cat food and looks like people food. The sesame chicken and chicken pot pie were equally liked by my cats. They ate every bite of it, and they never do that with canned food.

I've got 2 cats that love their wet food!!  We figured this'd be a big hit & for the 1st couple cans it was.  My cats are used to your everyday  mushy cat food (Friskies I think), so when we opened this stuff I was surprised to see that this stuff actually looked almost some what edible.  It kinda looked like tuna with peas & carrots, although it was really juicy (seemed like almost half the can was just liquid).  Anyway long story short the cats devoured this food when we first gave it to 'em.  However I must admit the cans were a little small for 2 cats, but a can this size would be perfect for a 1 cat family.  (Here comes the only 3 star rating part)  Anyway, after the 1st couple cans it seemed as though the cats loved it, but then, all of a sudden they just stopped eating it.  I gotta tell you with my cats that's a rare thing to be sure.  Everytime we've tried to give it to 'em since they've completely turned their noses from it.  I can't really say that this stuff isn't good, all I know is that suddenly my cats stopped liking it, your cats might love it.  Granted, my cats are used to the mushy stuff I mentioned earlier, but to be fare they also like canned tuna/chicken (it could just be the big veggie chunks they didn't like, who knows).  I guess in closing, it's kinda up in the air as to whether or not you'll get the most out of your purchase or not, I know I won't ever buy it again, but again your cats might love it, kinda hard to come to a real definative conclusion:(.

column9: If it looks good, is it good for the cats?
column10: My two traditional striped cats eat mostly dry Science Diet cat food with a few NuCat vitamins added.  They also get Iams canned chicken, turkey, or beef once a day.  Brownie prefers the dry food but will eat some canned food only when the can is freshly opened.  Pi likes both.  We tried the Petite Cuisine Variety Pack (Yellowfin, Snapper, Tuna & Sole, Tuna & Shrimp) and the Petite Cuisine Variety Pack (Chinese Chicken & Chicken Pot Pie) over the course of sixteen days. Each cat got about one-quarter can each day.  I alternated cans of chicken and fish varieties.At first, the felines were enthusiastic.  After a while they tired of the chicken.  Pi would only lick up the gravy, while Brownie refused to even look at it.  The fish was better received.  They like the yellowfin and the tuna & shrimp.  The cat vote is for two of the six varieties.There is, however, a question of mercury in ocean fish.  A 1995 study in Japan found that cats that ate tuna had a higher concentration of mercury in their fur than cats that ate dry cat food.  The study and its results are discussed in an article that you can find on the web by using the search term "all about tuna fish".  I posted a question on the Petite Cuisine web site as to whether they had tested their products for mercury.  I have not received an answer.  My conclusion is that it may be ok to give the cats fish as an occasional treat but not as a steady diet.
