Great variety pack for cats that love their seafood! I loved loved loved! that this was a thirty two case, versus the usual twenty four. The cats are very happy with it, and so am I. This is definitely something I will buy again.

Who can account for a cat's taste?  My cat love seafood pate, and hates any of the various filets in other cat foods.  She also hates beef, chicken she will tolerate.All these people complaining about busted cans . .I have never had any problem with the quality of the cans or leaking cans.The other complain is that sometimes Amazon jacks up the price when their inventory is low.  This has nothing to do with the cat food . .  that is Amazon's pricing policy.  If you think the cost is too high, don't buy it.My supermarket sells this for 60 cents plus sales tax.  Amazon is 50 cents, no sales tax plus the convenience of free delivery.I would give this 5 stars, but I am not sure if my cat will like all of the 4 different varieties.  Cats seem to like very smelly fish food.  My cat likes this stuff.Follow up:  My cat doesn't like anything with salmon, so I won't be buying this pack again.

column9: my cats favorite is the pate
column10: She will eat others but  sheer joy is usually reserved for the pate. She is overweight so I was told to stop the dry food and only give her wet food. She gets half can in morning and at night..so far the weight isn't changed but she is happier and more demanding at meal time..can hardly wait.

My cats love the seafood variety and receiving it monthly at a great price was a huge benefit.  I have received the package damaged and the cans smashed open.  The smell was so bad I think it was that way for awhile.  Then last month the price went up from $13 to $21 so I cancelled.
My cat has such dry skin and this cat food is the best to use!  Cheaper than other brands and has as much water content as the more spendy kind.

Got this for a cat we were fostering who had problems with her teeth and couldn't eat dry food. She also wouldn't eat the higher end canned food. Even though she liked this, we switched to Fancy Feast, which she also liked and appears to have better ingredients.

Though others have said they have received cans that have opened inside the box I haven't had that issue. I have had  a few cans that were dented on occasion, but they were fine. My cat loves the canned food, and it was much cheaper than the local store to buy the food from Amazon. I've had it regularly ordered for the past three months and it has been great. I supplement this box of canned food with a boxes of other pate and other canned foods to give my cat a variety.

We just received this the other day and we had no issues with any packing or anything.  None of the cans were dented, and since my cats CAN'T talk they were not able to tell me if they liked this or not but since they scarfed the food down I am assuming so.For those people who say their cats didn't like the food, try switching the variety up on them, we order 3 different variety boxes, so that is 24 different flavors of food.  Cats do get bored of the same food over and over just like people.
but the kitty sure as hell likes it!The subscribe and save works for me, don't have to carry heavy boxes anymore and the price is right.

My cats love the Friskies Seafood Pate.  I had given them dry food and they just nibbled at it here and there.  I opened up a can of this and they got excited and stayed and ate hungrily until they were full!  Also thier poop is firmer and hardly even smells now!  This is all I give them and they are happy. I dont buy them anything else. :D

I wonder why there are these 4 people complaining about the price of this cat food. I subscribe to Amazon's gourmet foods and get the 32 can case of Friskies cat food for $13.57 delivered to my front door. If I went to Walmart in this state it would be an additional 9% sales tax and the price would be about a dollar more or almost $15. Add a gallon of gas and an hour of my time and it's over $20.  Is it just me or are you guys completely on a different page? Add your time, gas and sales tax and figure it out.  $15.57 to your front door IN 2 DAYS is a great deal and my 2 Siamese just love it! Think about it~~

column9: My Cats Love The Friskies Pates
column10: My cats love all the Friskies Pates, all six of them, although the price on amazon, even with a subscription and $1 off coupon, is far above what I would otherwise pay.  If you catch this at a good price, go for it.  The product is great.
While way easier than having to get cat food in the city, the Amazon delivery resulted in many dented cans. None were open, but not the best care...

I purchase this same exact case of cat food at the local grocery store for about $13.00.  I don't know why Amazon is charging so much. Buy local and get twice as much.With that said, as well as a 1-star rating, Friskies is a high quality cat food that I will continue to buy for my cats....but I likely won't be buying it from Amazon.

Walmart has this 32-can pack for HALF this price at $12.00 and even the local ranch feed store prices it at $14.00. Most of the cat food prices at Amazon seem to be very high and just may not be the place to buy these items.

column9: Never ordering cat food online ever again!!!
column10: I ordered this for my 17 year old cat. She only has one tooth and is very finicky. She will only eat the seafood pate of Friskies. I thought the purchase was a great deal since it was cheaper than Walmart and I could have it delivered to my house for a free price. I thought this was a good idea.Well, I was wrong.My housemate and I wondered what that godawful smell was. After weeks of dealing with cockroaches scurrying under furniture and fruit flies perching everywhere, I found out where they were breeding. One of the cans arrived banged up and maggots decided to call it home. You think fresh cat food smells bad?I brought home a premature infant and was afraid of all of the germs that infested the place at the time. I did not want a single risk posed to him getting sick. So I kept him in his room until I found out where the funk was coming from.The moral of this story is unless you don't mind infestation and possible contamination, don't order cat food online.

column9: Great food, but purchase from local store for A LOT less
column10: As 2 others have stated you can get the 32 packs from Wal-Mart for about $12-13. You also do have the variety of choosing different flavors and different textures like the pate or shreds. My older and younger cats would rather eat the shredded or meat bits then the mashed pate thing, and I think they don't have such a strong smell as the pate does either!If you do not mind paying double then go for it, but I am always searching for the lowest price and knowing that Amazon is usually cheaper thought I could find them on here, but that is obviously not true in this case! Better just to buy some when you're at the store. At the store it is about .42 per can and at what I have been seeing on here it is about .78 -.80. So if you're like me and don't go to Wal-mart all that often or even if you do, best just to stock up on a few cases and save quite a bit of money!

column9: A staple in my spice cabinet
column10: First I should state that I don't make pumpkin pies.  I am really not a dessert kind of guy, I leave that up to others.  However, I love this blend and use it all of the time.  My favorite would be for French Toast, I add a little to the egg and milk mixture and then sprinkle some on the finished product.  It also goes well with sweet potatoes, yams, Cinnamon rolls, peanut butter (just try it before you cast stones), carrots and many other savory dishes that could use a little bit of flavor.The combination of cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and allspice adds an extra dimension to many foods. I often make my own version from freshly ground ingredients but this brand is fine for when you want to add a lot of flavor in a hurry.

When reading the label in the store, I discovered that this contains sulfite, a preservative that can cause serious allergic reactions in some people.  I only get migraines from it. It is listed as an ingredient on the McCormik website.Why isn't it listed on the Amazon site? Are there other products with an incomplete ingredient list?  It would be wise to check the manufacturers website before you buy.
Wonderful flavor and truly versatile. This is a must have in your fridge all the time! Also makes a great gift. I definitely recommend!

column9: A simple soup with a bit of a sweetness
column10: I have eaten quite a few of Amy's soups and frozen entrees.  I've only run into a couple of misses and, fortunately, this is a good Amy's product.  Overall, it's a simple soup.  It doesn't have chunks of vegetables and is really just a little thicker than a broth.  If you love butternut squash and the sweetness that tends to accompany it, this is a nice soup for lunch. When paired with a simple garden salad, you have a complete meal. I've also provided it as a side dish as holiday meals, particularly Thanksgiving, because it pairs well with mashed potatoes and stuffing.When I first tried it, I thought it was missing exactly what it purports to be low in -- salt.  However, after two tries, I don't notice a lack of salt.  In fact, for those seeking a low sodium diet, this may not be your ticket.  A 14.1 oz. can has two servings.  Each serving has 290 mg. of salt, which is calculated to be 12% of the average person's daily serving.  If you eat the whole can, you are getting nearly 1/4 of your sodium for the day.  Still, this soup has less sodium (and calories) than Imagine Butternut Squash Soup, 16-Ounce Aseptic Cartons (Pack of 12), which is an equally tasty soup.Because this is a fairly light soup, it is easy to eat a whole can and therefore two servings.  Calorie wise, the soup is great.  It has 100 calories per serving (200 calories for a can).  If dieting or counting calories, this soup would be a good meal option.

This soup has a delightful, balanced flavor. Many squash soups are too sweet, but not this one. I'd be happy to hide the can and claim I made it myself, and I'm a good soup cook.This is great to use as a base for semi-homemade soups or sauces -- add your own vegetables or beans, or modify the flavor with whatever spices you prefer.
Tabasco's fine, but has such a strong vinegar taste.  Cholula is comparable for heat, but with a wonderful flavor.  I use it on everything!

column9: CHOLULA is one of the best!
column10: I don't recall how we got started on Cholula, but at one point I couldn't find it at any of the grocery stores nearby; I got so anxious that I wouldn't be able to get it anymore, I went online and ordered a case.  It's great on pizza.
I love, love, love this hot sauce.  It's not only hot like all the others, but it has flavor!  I use it on everything.  I highly recommend trying it, I know you'll never buy plain old tobasco again!

The grocery store for black-eyed peas is around $1.50 per pound. What makes this product (and many similar products available on-line) worth so much more? Local purchases do not involve shipping costs either. Check your local supermarket before you buy this stuff. 24 packages of beans would cost you $36.
I am not understanding the price? You can get this box from the  grocery store for 7 dollars why is it almost 20?

Kids like Goldfish crackers, the size, the shape, the color, the texture, maybe even the flavor. Personally I find them too bland to satisfy my occasional craving for something cheesy. These Xtra Cheddar Goldfish, on the other hand, though not finger licking cheesy are a step up from the regular Goldfish.  They do have an enjoyable flavor that could almost compel a snacker to eat the entire bag. That may or may not be a good thing.For flavor and satisfaction, the Extra Cheddar is definitely a better option that the original cheese goldfish.

Pepperidge Farms is becoming slack with the flavor of the infamous goldfish. Compared to the small size bag(6oz), this 30 oz carton taste like plain goldfish and not the flavor blast xtra cheddar we like so much and wanted to purchase. Price was right; however, it would have been great to have experienced the FLAVOR BLAST of XTRA CHEDDAR taste.
Great product for the price.  They stayed fresh for a while and tasted very good!  I love that we can get the cheddar blast in a large container.

My family loves gold fish, we eat them all of the time. Put them in soup, snack on them at lunch and late at night. I bought the whole grain version to have something a bit healthier... although they aren't healthy by any means! The box is a great size, it's a bit smaller then the ones you might see at a grocery store though so do not expect one of the humongous boxes but it is still a great size and lasted my family of 3 for about a month which is a lot more affordable than buying the smaller boxes every week! These do have a powdered cheese on them that can stay on your fingers unlock the original so if you have small children you don't want cheese fingers everywhere I would stay away from them.

My husband and I are dieting. He was looking for another sweet dressing because he was tired of Walden Farms' Raspberry Vinaigrette. Litehouse's Blueberry Pomegranate is pretty good, but we didn't find anything else we liked at all. I knew I had to try this when I saw that it was fat free. Although the bottle doesn't list the calories, I sent an email to the company and learned that the dressing has 25 calories for a two tablespoon serving size. I have to say that this is probably one, if not the best salad dressing I've ever eaten. We just use it as is, and don't add oil. I made a spinach salad with fresh cherries and blueberries, craisins, a tablespoon of reduced fat blue cheese (Treasure Cave), and candied walnuts. It was absolutely heavenly. I have tried other fruit combinations and candied pecans, as well. Butter lettuce works well, too. We liked this so much we finished the bottle within a week. Since I saw how fast it went, I ordered five more bottles, and one of their other flavor, wild huckleberry, which we haven't tried yet. If you use fresh cherries, I highly recommend the Oxo Good Grips cherry pitter, which will make quick work of the pitting.

I've tried several different berry vinaigrette salad dressings and this is my favorite.  Some friends and I tried both the huckleberry and chokecherry varieties from Huckleberry Haven (a Montana company)and we liked the chokecherry best.  It is sweet, but not overly sweet.  I mix it 50/50 with extra virgin olive oil to make salad dressing.  My new favorite salad is fresh spinach, feta cheese, pecans, blackberries and chokecherry/EVOO dressing.  Very simple, very tasty.
The best pumpkin butter i have used. is a bit hard to spread though, a bit dry. tastes good and very nutritouse.

We typically purchase these at our local Whole Foods, but they're ever so slightly cheaper online (and with Prime, the shipping price is far cheaper than driving to Whole Foods).  We love mixing these in with our smoothies in the morning, it makes them a bit more filling and extra-delicious.  We've never had a problem with Navitas, and all of their products are always quite fresh
The hemp seed has a nice fresh taste. Love it. Tastes better than two other brands I've bought in stores.

Hemp seeds are so wonderful! They can be added to salads or even breakfast cereal to get significant amounts of protein. A handful is 10 grams of protein! I also make hemp seed pesto with it and lots of basil! Can't go wrong with these.

column9: okay for pancakes; skip the other baking options
column10: I've been through about 3 boxes of Insta-Bake and tried many of the recipes on the back.  For pancakes, they're okay.  I like feeding my kids whole wheat pancakes, but honestly I think Aunt Jemimima makes a better whole wheat pancake mix product.As for the other recipes I've tried using Insta-bake, I've been disappointed every time.  The biscuits are flat, hard, dry little pucks.  No one wanted them.  I've tried a couple of times thinking maybe I just did something wrong.  Nope; they're gross.The cookies I made were also awful.  Yeah, maybe healthier than a tollhouse cookie but since I ended up tossing them out because, healthy or not, they STILL weren't worth the calories and at ANY rate, just tasted bad.  For a good cookie made with whole wheat flour I make these cookies [...]Anyway, for pancakes, fine, but there are other options out there.  Don't expect this product to be as versitle as Bisquick or Jiffy baking mix.

this is a healthier alternative to bisquick.  It uses whole wheat flour and other natural ingredients.  I used it to make apple cinnamon pancakes, and they were fabulous!  I'll let you know when I try it with my waffle iron.

Insta-Bake waffles are our family's weekend staple. There is no difference in taste from white waffles, and they're more filling, so we don't have to make as many. Our local grocery has stopped carrying this product, so I have to buy it online now. We won't do without it!

Love the ease of baking whole wheat items with this product. Biscuits are there own variety but quite good. I borrowed a whole wheat crepe recipe from a buckwheat pancake mix bag and used it with this mix and made great Insta Bake crepes. I just ate some very fine waffles made from the Insta Bake recipe. One can "switch to whole grains" using this book and realize a weight loss as I have.

This is a great baking mix!  I made pancakes using the recipe on the box and they were fabulous.  My family loved them--fluffy and delicious, like pancakes should be.  I also made the oatmeal raisin cookie recipe that is on the box and they are wonderful!  NOTHING like what a previous reviewer commented on them being hard and dry.  They are moist, flavorful and chewy.  My kids think they are great and don't even know they are whole wheat.  I can't wait to try the other recipes on the box!!

I don't use it for biscuits or pancakes since I have other mixes for that.  I love using this stuff for dumplings on chicken soup or stew.  It makes wonderful fluffy dumplings.  I also love it as a replacement for Bisquick in those 'impossible pie' recipes.  This stuff is great.

I just finished making the oatmeal cookie recipe that is on the box.  They turned out better then I expected.  I was anticipating what another reviewer had with hockey-puck type cookies...but, was happy to get nice, tasty, chewy oatmeal cookie.Look forward to trying other recipes using this product
Insta-Bake is a wonderful product! It's a quick and healthy way to make pancakes and waffles in the morning.

column9: Some of the best pancakes ever!
column10: Food manufacturers have made it very hard to eat healthy -- have you ever looked at the ingredient list on a box of pancake mix?  So when I saw this Whole Wheat baking mix at the store I had to try it.  I had tried other brands of Whole Wheat mixes in the past with so-so success, so I wasn't going to bet the farm on this one being too good in the taste department.  Boy was I wrong!It makes some of the best pancakes you will ever eat!  Your family will think you are pulling their leg when you inform them they are full of whole wheat goodness.A lot of whole wheat items come out "dry" and the taste can be off.  Not with Insta-Bake!  Hodgson Mill makes some of the best speciality "healthy" baking mixes and ingredients on the market.  The pancakes came out fluffy and full of flavor and moisture.  I was shocked and everyone loved them!For an added treat, try throwing in a handful of chocolate chips or some chopped up fruit.  Your kids will think you are serving them dessert for breakfast and gobble them down.  In fact, why not make some of these for dinner one night for a "special" dinner night with the family!

column9: Amazingly tasty and loaded with protein!
column10: I tried one of these Zing peanut butter chocolate chip bars at a health fair at my workplace.  I was surprised at how good it was.  I'm not a big health nut and actually very picky about what I eat.  This bar was soft and chewy and every bite was as good as the one before it.  I was pleasantly surprised especially after reading the healthy ingredients.  It's really hard for me to eat healthy even though I try, but most healthy stuff doesn't taste good to me. I am going to start keeping these in my desk for those days when I can't get away for lunch.If I hadn't been given a free one, I probably never would have tried these.  I'm glad I did.  I recommend you try them for yourself.

column9: the only "protein" bar i can have!
column10: I love these bars, they are amazing. They are sweetened with agave, I have a lot of food allergies (soy, gluten, dairy, and almonds) and this is the only bar I can have that doesn't have all that in it!  With the job I have, I'm always on the go..and often times I don't have time to eat. These bars have 10g of protein, 11g of sugar, 25g carb, and 4g fiber. I LOVE these bars, they are a bit pricey, but thats what you have to pay for when you have a lot of issues... :) Thank you ZING BARSSSssSS you really give me the extra "zing" to keep me going.

Stumbled upon these at Whole Foods in Southern California; I am a regular natural-products-shopper had not previously seen them anywhere on the East coast. I picked this flavor because it's one of few (3, I believe) Zing Bars that is also dairy-free and uses brown rice protein instead of whey. It was absolutely delicious -- rich-tasting and peanut-buttery, with a generous amount of miniature dark chocolate chips throughout. Very satisfying. I usually only go for the USDA-Organic bars (with logo), so I'm glad I gave these a look because they contain many organic ingredients; I suppose they just do not have certification. Glad to have discovered these and hope to see them in more natural foods shops both in person and online. Tip: I like to "knead" out bars so they flatten/extend to the entirety of the wrapper -- more fun to pick at and makes it last longer. (The Chocolate Coconut flavor is also out-of-this-world! It tastes like an Almond Joy!)

column9: Delicious and at a great price
column10: These syrups for Sno Cones are delicious. Our family loves them, we had also purchased a pack of the Hawaiian Ice syrups and we prefer these (and they are cheaper). A very good deal. I will be buying more soon.
EXCELLENT PRODUCT, SWEET TASTY AND THE KIDS LOVE THEM....GREAT FOR PARTIES OR ANY HOT SUMMER DAY....ALL OF THE FLAVORS TASTE GREAT...
These syrups are great for slushes. My kids love them and they are great for summer parties. Very good product.

I have ordered Hawaiian Shaved Ice 10 pint pack for $44 and this time around decided to try Great Northern Polar's 10 pint pack for $29 (both have free Super Saver Shipping).  I was pleasantly surprised and happy with my Great Northern purchases upon testing.  The ten flavors all taste very delicious and I prefer the texture of the shaved ice when G N P's syrup is poured on, as opposed to Hawaiian Shaved Ice's.  I'd definitely recommend this less expensive option for snow cone syrup!!
I bought a 10 pack of quart bottles of Great Northern syrups for my Polar Ice Cub shaver and they are so good, we all love it.  Well worth it.
A very easy process with good communication and the product exactly as advertised.  I particularly appreciate the packing - very secure.
Worth every penny, a little goes a long way.  Ordered these and many snowcones later, still have plenty.  The taste is awesome, and the thicker syrup covers the ice great.
I bought a 10 pack of this snow cone syrup for my grandchildren & they just love it. The taste is great & it's nice having it already to go, no mixing. I would/will be buying from them again.

I had recently bought an Hawaiian Ice Machine from Great Northern which we love.  The kids loved the flavors and the added cones and straws are an added bonus.  A little pricey but delivered to your door and ready to go.
this product is the best in usa , We bought this for our grown-up snow cones. Absolutely yummy. Pour spouts are easy to use Flavours are delicious

Usually these are priced the same as Planter's Deluxe Mix.  However, these contain a lot more peanuts, which are cheaper.  They contain peanuts, almonds, pistachios, pecans, walnuts and hazelnuts.  And I think that's the order of abundance as well.  Looking down into this fresh opened can here, I mainly see a lot of peanuts and almonds.  I don't find them particularly greasy or oily, but they certainly are not dry roasted.  The peanuts don't have skins.  They have 50mg of sodium, compared to 110 in most other Planter's mixes, and they have 600mg of Potasium, compared to the 500mg in the deluxe mix.
I found these nuts greasy, but GOOD - wish I could get this combination of nuts dry roasted.
Love this product, and the price was great as long as I purchased enough to qualify for free shipping.
Taste good and healthy. So hard to put the can down. Love it sooooooo much!Never tasted such a great snack and my love for nuts keeps me wanting more. I enjoy them everyday.

column9: Great Taste with a Unique Mix
column10: I've seen some of the reviews complain that this particular mix is just a typical one and there is nothing special about it. That is just simply not the case. It's odd to see too many mixes with pistachios and hazelnuts and they really do add to the flavor of the mix. As for the "Heart Healthy" aspect of it that probably is more of a marketing thing than anything. The basic part is just that nuts are a good source of protein and these have less salt than the regular mix. You won't miss the salt at all though.I would buy this particular mix over the regular given a choice every time.

This new product certainly takes advantage of the power of marketing. Basically, it's common nut mix marketed as health food. The price per can is about $2 more than nut mixes found in supermarkets and certainly much more than a "mix it yourself" solution. Great marketing, convenient, but a bit overpriced.

Well over half of the can is peanuts.  Not sure how heart healthy that is.  Almonds seem to be the second runner up and then the other nuts are thrown in here and there.  I think there was 5 pistachios in my entire can.  Don't waste your time... mix and match at the health food store or find a brand with no peanuts.
I find majority of the mix is of Peanuts, which is cheaper compare to other nuts. 2 stars cause favor is good

These are great snacks. I have been buying them for my toddler since I first saw them in my local grocery store.  He loves the taste and they are much healthier than candy.  I always have one in my jacket pocket or purse. The four rating is only because they are cheap but worth the money.

column9: I don't know exactly why, but my baby goes nuts for these!
column10: I began giving these to my daughter when she was 12 months old.  At that time, she was still having difficulty with many table foods - but she was able to eat these without any issues.  While other fruit strips are usually gummy and tough, these are extremely soft.  Sadly though, they're very expensive and have a lot of packaging waste.  That being said, my toddler REALLY REALLY REALLY loves these.  In the past she loved them so much that she used to cry when she realized she only had a bite or two left.  When she was going through her picky eating stage - these were always a food that she readily accepted.Now that she's approaching 2, I don't buy them very often due to the price.  However, these were a great food to use when transitioning to table foods.

My little boy loves these, and the most important they are healthy and taste great, I tryed them myself, and the best way to get them at the best price is with Subscribe and Save, I subscribed cause also is a difficult to find product at least at the groceries stores in my area. So Problem solved with Amazon!

My little girl loves these.  They taste great, are much safer for her to chew than the fruit rolls for older children that stick to your teeth.  Each bar is 1 serving of fruit; and they have no preservatives, artificial flavors, or artificial sweeteners.  They are individually wrapped and great for packing in purse or diaper bag.  I buy them in both flavors, and keep plenty on hand at all times.

My son loves it. They taste good. They won't break in to pieces fast he is able to hold it and eat most of it without dropping bit and lot of pieces. They are not massy and soft enough to chew with his gums. A strip closer to a dollar bit expensive I feel.

I love this stuff! I use it all the time for piping gel transfers & on cakes with "water" to make it look more real. I posted a few photos on here of my Hawaiian Themed birthday cake that I made for y'all to see, I used blue tinted piping gel for the waterfall. Be careful when tinting the gel though as it colors really well!

this product  ( Wilton Piping Gel, 10-Ounce), is truely a very ghood product, today i tried it for the first time , wanted to do some writing with <royal icing>, on a cake ,as i am still learning  anand lines and curves were not easy to do ,alwayes came out sloppy  and ugly ,till  i used the wilton piping gel , half a tea spoon in a cup of royal icing  made it perfect , had no troubleat all ,it was easy ,smooth and beutiful, i regret that i got only one pack, promised myself to buy more next time. highly recommended.
Perfect package size with a product that has a great consistency and texture. Perfect for all decorating uses. Would buy again.
Color is off, flavor is off, and worst of all when you pop a few in your mouth, they soon all stick together. I spit out the first mouthful and threw the rest of the five pounds away.
It's candy. What can you say.They have a very good cinnamon flavor;a slightly crunchy hard shell; andtaste very good.
I could not see much difference in these and the grocery store filets.  Good flavor though.  I expected larger pieces from Omaha.

Have tried various garlic in oil products and non compare to Delallo. It's always a hit at any function I have.  Even my young granddaughter loves them.  She always asks for them if I forget to put them out!  The garlic has such a unique taste, a hint of sweet, but yet still has a garlic taste.

These garlic cloves are amazing! I snack on them right out of the jar! I think nothing of ordering it by the case and having it sent way over here to the Hawaiian island of Kaua'i. Yes, it's that good! If you love garlic...or even if you don't check out these little morsels of white gold. You won't be sorry!

If you like food with a kick, you will enjoy this. Was fine for me but hubby thought it was a tad spicy so I will just use half of the seasoning packet next time (I have three packages to use) Not really sure yet if I will purchase again as this is just a good basic chili mix and for that is a little pricey. Is a good chicken chili and you could just add beef to this to have a nice spicy beef chili, which is what I will do next time. So for the price I can make my own alot cheaper. You add tomato sauce,a can of tomatos, a can of corn and black beans your meat and add the seasoning packet. Easy to do in the crockpot. Says it makes 11 servings but I think 5 servings is more like it. The only difference between the ingredients in this package as opposed to the Tortilla soup mix from this company is that this one uses black beans and the Tortilla soup mix uses navy beans. The spice ingredient packet is the same and the add ins are the same.
I'd assumed they'd stopped making this stuff.  Glad I was wrong.  You can't find it in stores around here.  Now if only I could find some of my other childhood faves, like Pizza Spins and Flings.
This is so convenient. I get this auto delivery. I can't find this item in any grocery store. I'm glade amazon offers this item. My family loves this tuna helper.
I have loved this since I can remember and it is hard to find now, thanks amazon!

column9: Great drink, but Nescafe needs to rethink pricing structure
column10: I'm quite happy with my Dolce Gusto machine, and 95% of the time we drink the Caffe Lungo.  That product comes in a box of 16 capsules, but since there is no milk/sugar capsule involved in Caffe Lungo, we get 16 drinks from every box.  One capsule makes one drink.  The iced cappuccino also comes in a box of sixteen capsules, but you need two (one coffee, one milk/sugar) for each drink:  so you are only getting 8 drinks from every box, at the same price as the other.  In other words, the iced cappuccino costs twice as much.  I think Nescafe should make each box the same number of SERVINGS, rather than the same number of physical capsules.  I do like to have these around for super hot days (like today :-) but it's not a product I'll repeat after August is over, simply because of the pricing issue.

column9: Great product but capsules are waaaay to expensive
column10: I certainly agree with all of the other comments . I love the pot but cannot deal with the price of the pods.Had I known how expensive it would be I probably would not have purchased the pot.

I agree, fabulous quality but the price.... way too costly.  Most stores are dropping the coffee pot and coffee because of lack of sales.  I'm sure its the price.  Too bad!  Add shipping and the cost is way off the charts.  Also, the expiration date on coffee is very short.  If you aren't careful you could buy a box off the shelf that has already expired.

column9: Not that expensive compared with "ordering out"
column10: This is by far my favorite of the flavors! I do like mine a little sweeter than it comes, and I've found that a little agave nectar is the perfect solution...it mixes wonderfully with cold drinks, adds just the right amount of sweet, and doesn't make me feel quite as guilty as plain sugar.I've noticed that the biggest complaint is the price, but I don't think it's that bad. I purchase my capsules locally--and usually on sale. On average, one box (or 8 servings) costs me around $9. That is just over $1/drink. If this is a new addition to your diet--then this may be a little pricey...but for those of us who are willing to spend $2-$5/drink at a coffee shop--this is a savings! A little perspective and moderation can go a long way in appreciating what you have in front of you!

This is one of my favorite dolce gusto flavors. I'm more into cold drinks. Just make over ice and it's delicious! No need to add sugar or anything, but sometimes I'll skip the milk capsule and add hazelnut creamer to it. There is three boxes of 16 capsules (8 of espresso and 8 of milk) which makes 24 drinks. Little pricey but compare it to Starbucks and it's a steal! Lol :)
We like the regular Cappuccino and thought we would give this a try. If you follow the exact measurements we thought this had a really good taste to it.

column9: Great, Loved it but what happened to the price?
column10: I purchased this coffee flavor for the summer when I drink less hot coffee. I love my dolce gusto coffee maker and have subscribed to receive several different coffees. I had not subscribed for the iced cappuchino because I wanted to try it first. I now go on to order and subscribe and see that the price has doubled. I am assuming because it is being sold by an alternate vendor and not Amazon but as much as I loved it I am not going to pay double the price. Amazon please go back to the orginal price and you will have an order from me again. Thanks.

I love this little machine and the ice caps are my favorite. Can't get enough and it's sweet enough that I don't have to add extra sugar. For those who complain any of these caps are not flavorful enough, your adding too much water. If you want a mega sized coffee, use two sets then. This is just right for me, not too sweet and right amount of flavor. I enjoy them every morning, it is always such a treat and reminds me of Europe a little and a feeling of being back home. My husband likes cappuccino the most.

I'm a long-time iced coffee addict but find most ready-made products cloyingly sweet.  This coffee has just the right hint of sweetness and a lovely frothiness that I'm unable to replicate with my cheaper home-brewed version.  Expensive, yes, but worth it.

column9: Nescafé Dolce Gusto Brewers, Cappuccino Ice
column10: This is a great iced coffee flavor. It has a pretty good amount sweetness, personally I wish it would be a tad bit sweeter ,but it is still flavored better than the vanilla latte macchiato. The coffee has a nice rich flavor and the milk foams up well. I will admit it does not compare to a coffee house, but frankly what home machine does and it is far better than anything you will get in the milk case of your grocery store.

I love my dulce gusto machine.  That thing is infinitely better than it's K cup competition.  My favorite is the cappuccino.  I ordered a 3 pack of this iced cappuccino thinking I'd like it because I really enjoy iced coffee at Starbucks.  This stuff though, not so great.  It's not bad, just not good either.  Maybe if they offered it with some hazelnut flavoring, it would be better.  I keep trying to offer the iced cappuccino to guests at my house because I've got three boxes of this stuff and I'm not going to use it all myself unless I get really desperate for caffeine. This beverage has yet to impress anybody I've served it to either.

column9: I have one these each day
column10: I loved this for summer it's really yummy.But I drink caramel latte and the hot chocolate in the fall-winter.This has a nice light and airy sweetness and a strong shot of coffee flavor.

Since I purchased my dolce gusto circolo I've been saving time and money not driving to get my morning venti mocha daily. Portions are approx. 8 oz per serving which is less than I am use to, but just as tasty.
I love this tea whether my stomach is upset or not! I drink on cooler days just for the satisfaction!
These are so hard to find!  In fact, impossible to find in Vermont - not for sale in stores.

I've had the Palm Island red clay salt and that was good but this is even better. It knocks the socks off Celtic & Himalayan salts too. Has an enjoyable salty taste and is good in Asian foods yes but other foods as well. I used it in cole slaw, hummus, havla, maccaroons & tabouli but I'm sure it would be good in anything.

column9: Bamboo Jade sea salt, amazing and unique!
column10: I recently had an wonderful opportunity to try the Bamboo Hawaiian sea salt.It smells like sweet green tea, and is made with organically grown bamboo leaf extract, which after looking at a bit of literature on this ingredient, it is loaded in lots of great nutrients.I tried it on Jasmine rice, grilled halibut and my favorite; mango.I loved this one!  Palm Island Premium Bamboo Jade Sea Salt, 6-Ounce Pouch (Pack of 6)

With so many different PEZ dispensers out there, how can I say that you ask?  There are a couple of reasons.First, most PEZ dispensers are simply that: PEZ dispensers.  They perform no other function (unless you count "catching dust").  These are also pullback cars, which cross the floor at a pretty good clip.Second, I'm old enough to remember when PEZ dispensers actually shot the candy into your mouth.  Trial lawyers ended that fun; modern PEZ dispensers are designed to merely push a piece of candy out far enough so that you can grab it with your fingers.  However, these PEZ dispensers use an entirely different mechanism, and at least in some of them, when you push down the button at the front, you can bounce candy off the ceiling!Note: Should you be so lucky as to acquire any of these accidental throwbacks, please be content to catch the candy in your mouth ON THE REBOUND off the ceiling, and for God's sake don't tell a trial lawyer!You get a randomly selected three out of the following four Models:PEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Blue #24 Jeff GordonPEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Red #9 Kasey KahnePEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Blue #2 Rusty WallacePEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Orange #20 Tony StewartThere are four other models that I know of, differing only in plastic color, paint, and decals:PEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Yellow #17 Matt KensethPEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Light Blue #43 Richard PettyPEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Green #18 Bobby LabontePEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Black Daytona 500 50th Anniv.Each car comes with three rolls of PEZ candy.

The description was misleading.  The product desriptor stated that it was an assorted pack of three and it listed all the different cars.  I placed the order thinking there would be three Pez cars coming.  When I only received one, I was very disappointed.  Because it was for my son's birthday, I had to look for something else online to put in my son's goody bag.  After I received it, I went to look at the description again because I thought I had read it incorrectly.  The description was not written clearly.

When I ordered this, I didn't really know what to expect. This is really a good idea. You just turn the lid on top to adjust your heat preference. And it comes out in a spray pattern instead of drops. I took one bottle to work and everybody liked it. I'm keeping the other two for my wife and I.  We'll order some more when this runs out.

column9: Good concept, but doesn't replace your regular sauce
column10: This is a good way to alter the heat of your dish, but it is a rather thin (watery) sauce.  It doesn't replace the other sauces in my collection but is useful for changing the heat of them or for spicing up another dish that I won't use a thicker hot sauce in.
Do not purchase..........I bought the 3 pack. In about 1 week, 2 of the 3 don't pump anymore. The 3rd has only been used by (a friend)twice.

Got this as a birthday gift for a teenage boy who loves spicy foods. Success! He said it was great, a fun and surprising combination of hot and spicy goodness and technology (because of the adjustable blending option. Teens are hard to buy for, it's great to have found this.

I like really hot stuff, and Dave's "Insanity Sauce" is one of my favorites, although just a little beyond my maximum "hot!" I really hoped that this product would give me the ability to have one source of heat on the table that could serve all tastes, from mild to "way hot." Unfortunately, this well designed product lacks much "oomph" at the high end of the scale. In fact, the hottest spice available is only as hot as the regular Tabasco Sauce, if even that.If this could be boosted so that the hottest setting gave something that hot pepper fans would consider to be at the edge, it would be fantastic. As it is, I'm thinking of returning the three bottles for a refund. Sorry, Dave.

These were to be our 5th, 6th, and 7th bottles of this. We're addicted. It's great to be able to adjust the heat of the spray.December 2010 REVISION: All three bottles we received from Amazon this time are defective! One would not spray at all, the other two worked for a short period of time and then stopped working. The company claims they have never had complaints from anyone else; they replaced one bottle but then said I should just get a refund from Amazon. I offered to send the (full) defective bottles back to them, but they are not interested.January 2012 REVISION: Amazon replaced these, and the new batch works fine. We love this sauce!

This is a wonderful rice topping and it has all the same toppings normally used in "ochazukemono" -- a kind of rice porridge.  Ochazukemono, to steal a line from Ratatouille, is a peasant dish. It is commonly eaten as a snack in Japanese homes.  Ochazukemono is simply rice with dried salmon flakes and dried seaweed covered with a tea cup of green tea.  While this dish is surprisingly simple, it remains one of my most enduring "souvenirs" from Japan.  I love this furikake because I can sprinkle it over rice, add a tea cup of green tea and have a quick, nutritious and (I think) delicious snack.

I was afraid it was going to taste like what I'd imagine fish food smells like, but I decided to take a chance since it's salmon. It didn't taste fishy to me... and it was delicious!!! I don't know the exact type of rice we eat, but we always get ours from an Asian grocery store in Charlotte. Add this (amount is based on your taste) to 1/2-1 cup of hot, steamed rice and compress it into a shape of your choice to get a tasty treat in less than 2 minutes (if the rice has been made already). I'm looking forward to adding this to chao ga (Vietnamese chicken porridge) in the future. My mother is contacting our favorite store in Charlotte to ask them to stock up on this kind of furikake. It's that good.
How awesome is this...we have the world at our fingertips. I love experimenting with different flavors and tastes from around the globe. Can't wait to try more products like this.
I use this wonderful furikake to make an ad-hoc ochazukemono.  I sprinkle it on rice and cover it with a small cup of green tea to make a simple, but delish rice porridge.

I've just tried this seasoning this morning and it tastes super good. I actually went back to my room to cook more white rice just to eat with it, a little soy sauce (very little), few drops of sesame oil and a little bit of chili sauce (sriracha). It was one of the best meal I've ever eaten. The aroma of the seasoning when it hits the hot white rice makes my room feel very cozy.
I couldn't find this at my local Asian grocery store, so I ordered it online. So much better than the plain seaweed + sesame! This furikake is seriously delicious. I'm buying this kind from now on.
I got this along with the wasabi furikake (I said the same thing for the other one, feels a little weird). I eat it with brown rice and love it.

This is a nice tasty furikake.  The product description did not specify if it contains MSG - ingredients on the jar do not include MSG and I did not get the usual headache from eating products with MSG, so if this is a concern to you, this does appear to be a good brand and product.
Excellent flavor in a recyclable container. Consider using it on noodles and potatoes, even cottage cheese. After a spritz of Smart Balance on popcorn, add this seasoning for a real gourmet treat.
Great flavor to put on top of short grain rice!  We love it!  Great quality too!

This is an excellent rice seasoning, not too salty, sweet or fishy. It is best used after the rice is cooked. I roll rice balls in it and also leave it on the table to use. I have also used it vegatables & noodles. The glass jars make nice little juice glasses too.

i bought a jar of this about a year ago and i still have most of it. it's not bad but, well, it's really fishy and i just can't get past the unnerving resemblance to fish food. i like lots of other furikake flavors (especially wasabi) but this one just doesn't do it for me. it's alright when eaten very soon after putting it on rice or couscous but the texture/flavor of it after sitting for a few hours is quite unappetizing. i now understand why people buy those little conatiners that let you take a portion to sprinkle on right before eating. maybe i'll try the tea/soup thing charlotte ann hu mentioned. that actually sounds pretty tasty and the flavor of the tea might help cut the fishiness. as for the price and vendor, the price is very reasonable and it arrived fairly quickly and in excellent condition.

When I read the ingredients on the jar I was disappointed because it's supposed to be just sesame paste but it's not. The ingredients are sesame and peanut. Peanut is used in some Chinese dishes if sesame paste is not available but it isn't as good as sesame. There's also no way to know how much is sesame and how much is peanut. At $11 a jar there's no excuse for the peanut. Also there is another source for this product @ $5.99, a saving of $5.

column9: To those concerned about "vegetable oil" ingredient list
column10: We at Polar strive for the highest standards with customer satisfaction and appreciate any and all feedback about our products or service. Recently, we have seen the public focus directed negatively at highly processed oils in manufactured foods.After great research with our suppliers, I'm happy to confirm that our "vegetable oil" is neither soybean oil nor cottonseed oil. In fact, our suppliers pride themselves in using only rapeseed oil. This ingredient is FDA approved and a great source for the healthy Omega-3 and -6 fatty acids.At this time, I'd like to direct anyone interested to a helpful article penned by the Independent/UK about this widely used but unheralded ingredient:[...]P.S. Personally, I love to grab these for a quick and healthy protein boost when I don't have time to cook a full meal. Just one pot of rice and some steamed veggies - grab a can of herrings or kippers and voila, dinner is served!

I love Polar canned herring - they're cheap and great out of the can (I usually wash it really fast with hot water since the sauce is pretty heavy if you don't pair it with anything) or with instant noodles. The only problem is that the hot tomato sauce is not spicy at all! However paired with any spicy noodle soup and an egg and it makes a great meal.

I bought these after buying the mustard sauce kippers.  I figured that the mustard were good what could go wrong.  At the worst I would have bunch of cans of tomato covered fish and I can always just heat them up, put some ketchup on them and have a fish sandwich. Polar got another recipe right. These things are pretty good. The sauce has just enough spicy zip to make them have creole flavor without toasting you tastebuds. (I still think I might try the fish sandwich idea, they are that good!) I will buy them again.  The fish is firm with just the right amount of smoky flavor.

Very good for snack or lunch. I do not think the sauce is hot - perhaps little spicy but not like your regular hot sauce.The only negative I have with these is not the herring but the can - trying to open it without sauce splashing all over is little tricky - the can is filled with the sauce to the rim.But like I said, it is nice and healthy snack or lunch and overall, I do recommend it - I will buy them again.

These are some of the best canned herring out there and I love them. The flesh is firm, the flavour is subtle and perfect to me.  They are actually packaged in Germany and marketed by Polar.  When I found them on Amazon at such a great price I immediately ordered them.  Regrettably they arrived dented and had burst open in transit and the smell was terrible.  Amazon quickly sent me a new shipment to replace the damaged ones so lets hope they arrive in better shape this time.  Kudos to Amazon for quickly replacing and that's why  I love Amazon!

Very good Herring for the price but if you like it Spicy like Polar claims it is, well its not very spicy!!! Nevertheless the Quality of the Herring is Good for the Price!!! Also you receive 9 6 Ounce Cans in Tomato Sauce!!!
the sauce is very tasty...a nice burn, but not overwhelming in heat...the fish was firm and pretty good...on a hard cracker for a snack...hard to beat

column9: Taste OK; not hot; contains "vegetable oil".
column10: I tried these after I tried the same brand in mustard (see my review of those in my list of reviews). First, you have to have no illusions as to how hot this thing is: not hot at all. Mildly spicy, that's all. I liked the taste of these kippers (just as I liked the mustarded ones). One warning though: ingredients include "vegetable oil". Google on this expression to find out why it's not good food (a "vegetable oil" most likely is some or combination of highly processed soybean oil, or cottonseed oil, or something similar -- these, nutritionally, are bad for you. Cotton isn't even a food crop, so you can imagine what you end up eating, it's completely unregulated). Well, at least this product does not contain gluten, so it's marginally less unheathful than the mustard version.The taste is quite all right though. Despite this, it will not become a staple in this household (due to "vegetable oil"). The best option remains the no-frills unflavoured version that contains more fish and nothing but water and salt in addition. I'll stick to those.------------03/01/2012: In response to commenter "Mister No" who wrote:> Vegetable oil is not ok for you and artificial flavoring> and paprika sauce instead of tomato sauce is ok for you?Yes. I'm unaware of any harmfulness of guar gum (modified starch feels more ominous, but again, I've never read of anything evil about it). What about paprika sauce? Paprika is pepper. What's wrong with pepper? Or was it paprika sauce instead of tomato sauce? Now, that would seem like a taste preference... paprika, in this product, is probably to supply the "hotness", not to replace tomato. Anyway... Some commenters leave mysterious comments... (Perhaps Mister No could elaborate?)

This snack is so multifaceted, there's 20 different ingredients and spices. It is spicy, but it depends on your tolerance level (I'm Czech but I have a love for spice food so it's maybe a 3 or 4 out of 10 on the heat scale). I've always found Haldiram's to be consistent, I like their snacks, most recently I bought a delicious Soan Papdi from them. If you have a local Indian mart, I would check prices there but they look fair right now ($14 for 5 14 oz. packs)
I bought the product and it arrived very fast considering shipping to Hawaii!. I was initially skeptical about ordering snacks online but it is great!!!. Fresh, tasty and very well priced.

column9: I Love this stuff!!!  I am a Xangoaholic!!
column10: This is the most wonderful thing that I have ever used...My mother has been battling cancer for 10 years and this gives her the energy to get going and not feel sick from chemo....I have been using it and my psoriasis is clearing up!  This is just amazing stuff!!  I love it and everybody should try it, even if you don't think you have any problems and you don't need it...Just try a bottle!!!
I became addicted to Chocomilk while in Mexico. It has a slightly malted taste and it is 10 times better than Nesquik. It is sooooo good!

column9: I LOVE LOVE LOVE Choco Milk!!!
column10: I grew up on Choco Milk.  My dad used to make a morning breakfast drink with milk, banana, egg, choco milk and ground cinnamon blended until smooth.  You can use frozen the bananas to make the drink thicker, like a milkshake.  You can also omit the egg if it makes you queasy.  We had a 16oz glass of this drink every morning when I was a kid.  It's the best!!

What can I say?  I have a sweet tooth!  I found this at Amazon.com and it is such a great price and tastes so good I have bought it about every other month.  So far I have orderd it 5 or 6 times. Goes great in a cookie jar for when the kids stop by.  Try some.

column9: What can I say - its 5 pounds of Runts
column10: They give you what you ask for, that's for sure.  Takes a while to even dent 5 pounds of runts alone, so I suggest having friends!Thumbs up!
well finally found runts.  i cant seem to find them at any of the stores anymore!?  not to bad on price

I recieved this item and was not pleased at all...the picture shows that you recieve all of these runts...but when i got mine...they did not include the pink and blue ones which everyone knows are the best...Could be way more specific next time! NOT PLEASED AT ALL!

We love Runts so when I found this item on here I was excited to order a bunch at one time, at a good price.  The runts arrived in a standard plastic bag type package through US Mail.  The outer plastic US Mail bag was almost completely distroyed, so the post office somewhere put another clear bag around it and tape the heck out of it.The runts were also in two plastic bags, within the US Mail bag and both of those bags were also torn.  Being that we have no idea who or what might have touched the candy, we asked for a refund.They were prompt on responding to my request for a refund, and took care of the problem for us.  Really great delivery time and such, they just need to box them up and charge for delivery.We would not have had any issues again, I might order from them again if they could assure me that they would be shipped in a safer manner.

We bought these for our candy buffet for our wedding. They were really well priced and the kids loved the buffet. They come in a nice big bag that was easy to transport. I will be buying these for my dad in the future

When I got the Runts in the mail, I thought I would get the Runts in the original package from the maker, but it was only a regular bag full of candy. So I was very disappointed how the candy came in the mail. I don't know if the seller had used their hand or something to scoop them candy into the bag or what.

I saw these on a TV show called Life on Mars, they looked good so I gave them a try. They are not as sweet as a S'more, which I like, and are very tasty.  I will be purchasing them again, and as the show suggests they are very good with strawberry milk.

I have tried close to 20 different kinds of cat foods over the last 4 years for my now 4 year old cat. This stuff is hands down the best I have ever used. All natural, he loves it. Keeps his coat soft and the low calorie really does work. After feeding him crap food full of fillers (pedigree, purina, etc) I switched to this about a year ago and it has been a nice slow and steady drop in weight for the cat. He absolutly loves this stuff, he is ussually standing at the bowl waiting for me in the morning all excited! Now that he has thinned down I will be transitioning to the indoor cat food.The best part is you can save a few bucks on amazon or if you need it in a pinch Petco always has it, but its ussually a few bucks more.

column9: Works best for my senior cat
column10: This food works out to be the best dry food for my overweight senior cat. I was trying grain-free foods for a while and he just gained a lot of weight and became constipated. Mixing it with this food helps reduce those problems. My cats do well on it and seem to like the taste of it, too. The small round kibble size is convenient for treat balls and automatic feeders. I feed them wet food twice daily, and then leave portions of the dry food mix out while I'm at work or sleeping so they have something to snack on. I would not recommend feeding exclusively dry food, but if you do feed some then this one seems like a good choice to try.

column9: Buy this cat food, great quality, reasonable price!!!
column10: This is an excellent high quality cat food at a reasonable price.  While it is double the price of your average store cat food like 9 lives, it truly saves you money in the end.  I have noticed over 3 months of use that my cats are eating less as they are more satisfied now and getting the nutrients they need.  I purchase cat food literally half as often so in the end am spending the same as if buying a poorer quality food. Also believe it or not, there is far less in the litter boxes now (no doubt due to less processed junk to eliminate and eating less quantity)so in the end I'm saving on litter as well.  The best part is there is a notable difference in my cats health.  All have shinier, softer coats and my 5 year old boy jack seems to be suffering less with allergies and his sensitive stomach.  Definitly a wonderful buy and a great product!!!  Shipped fast.

They are so happy and fit and Must love the taste of it because when their bowl gets anywhere near empty they ask for more.  They don't over eat but they don't like their bowls to be empty.  Its cute.

column9: Adding water solves a problem for one cat
column10: We have two cats. One cat eats normally and the second tends to overeat. I started using this product when both were under a year old and have continued as they are growing older. I have large feeders that allow the cats to freely eat or drink water.Recently the "over-eater" was at the vet and was found to have abnormal blood tests indicating a possible kidney problem. The vet suggested giving her more water and starting her on a kidney diet. I decided to try another idea before we went to the more expensive special formula. I put out a dish of water and added a handful of this cat food to the water. Our "over-eater" went right to the dish, sniffed and then began lapping the water. The second cat came over to investigate, waited until the food had absorbed the water, and began eating the moist food. Both cats seem to favor the moistened food but will often add the dry food to their diet. One month after starting this routine our "over-eater had normal kidney function tests.I have gradually added more water to the bowl, looking for the best mix so the food stays moist and the bowl has food in it for half a day. I now clean and refill it twice a day.Natural Balance Dry Cat Food, Reduced Calorie Formula, 15 Pound BagNatural Balance Dry Cat Food, Reduced Calorie Formula, 15 Pound Bag

column9: Not sure, but the cats like it
column10: I have no idea if this stuff is working. I purchased it because I have 2 cats that share an automatic feeder. That's probably my first mistake (of many). Small cat is spot on for her ideal weight, so I bought this food for The Fatty. Small Cat has maintained her weight despite the reduced calorie formula, but I do think that The Fatty looks a bit more trim and doesn't hang *quite* as low to the ground. The trade off, however, is that Fatty Face is now constantly underfoot, yelling at me to feed him and Small Cat will literally take food off your plate when you're not looking. They're always trying to break into the food closet and both of them get into the garbage if there's ANYTHING edible in there. They don't look like they're starving, but I feel like I'm now the proud owner of two raccoons.If you have the determination to ration your cat to less calories, then I would recommend this food. Seems easy on the stomach, neither of my cats turned their nose up at it, it's well priced for its quality, and FatFace Cat might be losing weight.I just hope you have garbage cans with lids.
I have a very finicky cat.  He won't even eat canned foods.  But he absolutely loves this food.  If you regulate the feeding, your cat will definitely shed some weight.

column9: My cat loves it just as much as the non-reduced calorie version!
column10: After trying various wet and dry cat foods for my then 6, now 7 year old cat, I finally tried the regular version of Natural Balance Cat food. He liked it more than anything else that I tried and so I stuck with that until I noticed that he still had a bit of a gut.I initially bought a small bag of the reduced calorie formula because I was worried he wouldn't like it. That disappeared as soon as I gave him a bowl of the reduced calorie formula. He munched on it like it was the regular formula.Since then, I buy the big 15 pound bags about every three months or so. I use an automatic feeder so that he can eat whether or not I am able to get out of bed that day. Even though he has access to a month's supply via the automatic feeder, he doesn't have the gut he used to. He's still a BIG cat, but not that much overweight, which is much better for his health.

One of my cats actually like this reduced calorie formula better than the regular one that he used to eat.  Their poop don't smell as bad as when they ate Purina cat food.  15lb bag also lasts for a while!

i feed this to all my cats and they like it  and i like the price and that there is no wheat, corn, nor soy bean meal in thisproduct.  the round size doesn't cause as much waste in the bowl either.  thank you for offering this lower calorie food.

Granted, Matt is now 21 pounds and needs to lose weight (maybe 4 or 5 pounds according to the vet) because he will eat just about anything, but he really likes this cat food.  We have to measure his food and can never leave any out for him because he will eat all day if left to his own devices.  No, he does not get any people food.  He did love Natural Balance from the start, and we have never bought this particular brand before.  Matt is 12 years old, so he is considered a senior, just like me.  I do not like doing this, but because he is so particular about his litter box, I have to scoop it every day (otherwise, the consequences are not pretty).  So, before starting him on Natural Balance, I noticed that his stools had become pretty loose over the last couple of months.  That immediately changed with the Natural Balance; everything is more solid, plus he is a little more regular than he was, although older cats do not always go number 2 every day.  Anyway, he is happy, and so am I.  I will revisit this review once time has elapsed in order to report on whether this product has helped Matt to lose weight.

column9: A Delicious Curry But Poor Quality Paneer...
column10: Having started to fall in love again with India food, my mother surprised me by purchasing this 5 pack of MTR Paneer Tikka Masala. Chicken Tikka Masala happens to be my favorite so it seemed like having it with Paneer was going to be a treat. That was not the case however. While the packages of this pre-made curry were very good, and I personally would order it again, I also found the packaging and product very misleading.To start, we'll go over some positives. Each package of Paneer Tikka Masala contained ample amount of gravy and paneer. In terms of flavor, the gravy was delicious and has some spice to it. It went well with both Basmati rice and Brown rice. Despite a 3 serving rating, I found each package made 2 comfortable servings that would satisfy a hungry appetite. Overall I would say the best part of the product is the gravy. It is delicious!However, there are some problems here that I should warn you about. The package lists this as a MILD spice but it is more like Medium/hot spice. I enjoy spicy food so this didn't bother me, but in my book this clearly isn't even close to MILD spice. While the gravy portion is absolutely DELICIOUS, the Paneer is sub-par at best. It tasted fairly flavorless and was chewy, no where even close to restaurant quality, in fact they tasted almost like heavily processed flavorless-cheese. Another problem I have is well, where is the "Tikka?". Not only does this "not" look like Tikka Masala but it doesn't taste like it at all. It has a very heavy "Onion" flavor to it rather than smokey tomato flavor, which is probably why they call this a "spicy onion gravy". If the package is MILD why then call it Spicy Onion? The product doesn't even come close to what is on the box. The box shows authentic white Paneer with a tikka masala gravy. What the packages really contain are Greyish-cubes they pass off as Paneer, and a onion soup colored gravy. Very misleading and not even in the same ballpark as Tikka Masala.I know I'm being harsh but the product is a little misleading. It really isn't a Tikka Masala like most are used to, but a Spicy Onion curry w/ low grade Paneer. Despite all these oddities, the gravy still is outstanding! Almost addictive I'd say! For the price you do get a delicious meal for 2 with each package that takes under 2 minutes to make. I still would recommend a purchase, and I would personally buy this myself it really is that good! Just understand that instead of an smokey tomato/onion gravy, you actually end up with a Spicy Onion gravy. If you do not like spicy food I would avoid this, however if you are a big fan of Indian Curry, and don't mind some spice, you can't go wrong. Just don't expect much from the Paneer or very much Tikka flavor.** Each Packet makes 3 servings ** (I found it really made more like 2 comfortable portions)Calories: 180 per serving (540 total)Fat: 9g (27g total)Cholesterol: 24mg (72mg total)Sodium: 400mg (1200mg total)Carbs: 18g (54g total)Fiber: 1g (3g total) / Sugar: 1g (3g total)Protein: 8g ( 24g total )Vitamin A: 2% per serving / C: 4% per serving / Calcium: 6% per serving / Iron: 2% per serving

I buy most of my flours from Bob's Red Mill in the 4-pack boxes, if only because having all the bags and boxes the same size makes it easier to store them.  It's good flour, and the bag's a good size for baking for a small family - also a good shape that will stand up on the counter while you scoop flour out of it.

Tapioca starch is a very handy item to keep in the kitchen. It is a thickener, but a very delicate one. There is a very slight sweetness to it that I think adds considerably to duck, chicken or goose gravies, or pork gravy.  The smoothness is like that of cornstarch, and and it gives sauces the same sort of sheen.  Tapioca flour is a good fast fix if your sauce is too thin and you don't know where you went wrong. I have even added a tiny bit to a runny Hollandaise and it worked perfectly. But be careful. Add it in pinches. It thickens quickly and under low temperatures. Don't overdo. And you can freeze sauces or gravies made with tapioca starch. If you use flour, they tend to break down and the texture can be a little grainy.I've bought this under the names Tapioca Starch, Tapioca Flour and Tapioca Powder. So far they are all identical. Bob's Red Mill is reliable. The texture of some of the asian imports is even better, but they're hard to find and not all equal in quality. Bob's Red Mill is a nice go to brand for anything from sorghum, amaranth, coconut and almond flours to fava bean flour. I haven't experimented with most of them, but plan to try the more exotic ones and see what happens.If you read James Michener, you probably remember his recipe for Oyster Stew in "Chesapeake."  The description was so mouth-watering, it sent me searching through a one hundred mile radius for an Asian market that sold the "secret ingredient." (This was back in those sad, dark days before the internet put the entire world within reach of our credit cards).  Here's how Michener's oysterman, Jimbo, made his He-Stew (a she-stew, fit for ladies, is not, to this lady, worth bothering with). I've reduced the number of onions from 8 to one, oysters from 48 to one dozen (to serve four) and celery to one stalk. If you are cooking for a crew of hungry arstermen, feel free to use michener's proportions.Start with a mess of bacon, one large onion (chopped fine), 1 stalk of celery (ditto), 12 oysters or more to taste (and pocketbook), oyster liquid, tapioca powder, milk, saffron, butter.  Jimbo fries the bacon until it's crisp, sets it aside and tosses the chopped onion and celery into the sizzling bacon fat. He cooks them quickly, so I'm thinking it's just a sweating, not a browning. Anyway, whisk them out after about a minute and add the oysters to the hot fat. You want to put a light browning on them...not cooked, now, just browned.  When the oysters are a lovely golden shade, lower the temp to barely simmering and pour in their liquor; let them simmer until the gills start to wrinkle.  (You want about 1/2 cup, give or take, of oyster liquid. If your oysters come up short, you can add bottled clam juice, chicken stock or water. Clam juice is best. Now throw in a small, and I mean small like 1/8 teaspoonful, pinch of tapioca powder. Remove the pan from heat and you should be able to see the tapioca powder start to thicken into what looks almost like a thin jelly. If this isn't happening, add another 1/8 teaspoon.  Let it bloom for about 3 minutes.  In a separate saucepan, simmer about 2 cups of milk (half and half would be gilding the lily. Don't be tempted. Just plain whole milk is going to be plenty rich). Pour the pan of oysters into the hot milk (Big Jim doesn't drain any of the bacon fat, but it might not be a bad idea to drain all but about one tablespoon of the delicious heartstopper). Then toss in the sauteed onion and celery. You can pour this into a big tureen or individual bowls, and crumble the bacon on top.  Big Jimbo gave it the added blessing of a sprinkling of saffron and, right before serving, a big hunk of butter. I like to serve from a big tureen, so guests know there is plenty and they can ask for more, but I add the butter to each individual bowl, so that melting gold and the buttery fragrance are the first things to hit the hungry crowd.This is so amazingly good, all conversation stops. People just slurp up their soup and their oysters.  Since this is a soup, find the smallest oysters you can. You don't want guests wrassling to swallow an animal as big as their palm.  After everyone has eaten to repletion, those with whom you shared this feast will kiss your hand in humble adoration. I usually serve this with ale, because I think you need something bubbly and tart to cut through the richness and I just like ale and oysters. But something flinty in a white wine, like a steely chardonnay, might go down very nicely.When I make this, I double and sometimes triple the recipe (because everyone wants seconds and, frequently, thirds) and make it a main course with lots of good bread and sweet butter.  Sauteed mushrooms and onions are a nice starter, a leaf or two of salad to follow. This is a good dinner to end with a cheese course, because it's rich, but not heavy and if anyone has any extra room to fill, the cheese hits the spot. Since the meal was creamy, you could jack things up with something sharp like a nice aged Reggiano, and some pears. No dessert is necessary, but if you skip the cheese, poached fruit is nice. If you have port, serve it with the cheese, or use it to poach the pears. It's a killer of a final touch.This is so easy to fix, a last minute dish that takes five minutes to prepare and another ten to make, and it's better than some concoctions that take an entire day of fussing and feuding to get on the table.(My other favorite non-recipe from a non-cookbook is from Peter Freuchen's Arctic diaries. He cooks up a mean Giviak, which is fermented seal stuffed with whole unplucked and uncleaned birds. You don't cook it exactly, you just bury it in the ground for about a year and let everything molder away until the birds taste like gorgonzola. You have to debone the seal without cutting it, so, what with all the hunting involved, there's a lot of prep time even if you don't do anything with the birds but catch them. The only beverge I could recommend is Alka Seltzer, but Freuchen recommends hot boiled moss water. Mmmmm. Moss water.)

Weruva definitely does not have any of that--you can actually eat the dog food and it'll taste just like dinner.Our boy has a sensitive stomach and he's a very picky eater. The first night we got him the regular Chicken with Gravy he ate that whole can up. He loved it, and when we tried feeding him anything different he refused. Then we ordered him the Kobe Master flavor and it quickly became one of his favorites. I'd definitely recommend this brand, especially coming from a very concerned dog owner.
