column9: Y U M M Y...C H E E S E....G O E S....O N....F O R E V E R ! ! ! !
column10: VELVEETA CHEESE has been around a long time.  I'm a "baby boomer", andI can't remember a time when it wasn't on store shelves.  I suppose that's one big bonus that comes along with this yummy cheese....it bridges generations, and allows two...or maybe even three, (or more!) generations of a family to talk about what THEY did with, and used, Velveeta for, when they were growing up...and in various stages of growing up!The taste hasn't changed....at least, not that I can tell.  Looking at the ingredients, though, I notice that colby cheese -- which I do remember once being listed amongst the ingredients -- is no longer there. Also, (and this is from Velveeta I got in the supermarket, where I believethe turnover is faster than at Amazon.com....although I can't be sure) -- anyway, the Velveeta I got from the supermarket seems a bit less yellow, a bit more white-ish, than the Velveeta I got previously from Amazon....and the Velveeta I had as a child.  I suspect from this that perhaps Kraft Foods -- makers of Velveeta -- are now adding more milk to the cheese, to keep the price as low as it is?  Looking at the ingredients, I can't see where adding more milk, (or more of something else that makes the cheese whiter), would lower the production costs....but then what do I know?  All I DO know is that Velveeta Cheese...though it tastes the same, is a bit whiter than before.  The pretty orangy-yellow colour is still there....but lighter...  The cheese also seems the teensiest bit less firm than it used to be....  I surely hope that Kraft returns to at least the last previous version of Velveeta, (firmer, yellower, but without Colby), before the newer version I detected in the supermarket reaches Amazon.  (Or could it be that Kraft makes two versions...one for supermarkets, and one for Amazon?)  Whatever the situation, I would like strongly to entreat Kraft to make a "Deluxe Velveeta" version -- the original Velveeta as I remember it from the 1950s: very yellow, much, much firmer, and using Colby cheese as one of the ingredients!  With a price midway between "modern" Velveeta, and "natural" cheeses, (perhaps on a par price with Kraft Deluxe American Cheese....or perhaps even a LITTLE higher -- and the words "ORIGINAL Velveeta Cheese Formula" on the package....it is sure to be a hit with all 21st century Velveeta fans...as well as those, like me, who remember it from the 1950s.  (Maybe there was even a version before the 1950s?  If so, please let THAT version be labeled "The Original Velveeta Cheese"....I know I'd be very eager to try it!That aside, it still tastes exactly the same as always -- at least to my palate, which remembers only as far back as the 1950s.  I have recently  heard from a friend,  that many people are "down" on Velveeta cheese --saying it's not real cheese.  OK -- it's not 100% natural cheese...additives have been, er...added.  But then the same is true of "Kraft Cheese", and many cheeses of Bordon and other manuacturers as well.  To get "natural" cheese, one always must pay a premium...and to get "organic natural" cheese, one finds it more expensive still.  (To get a middle-price, I bought "Kraft Deluxe American" Cheese from Amazon, recently. It was firmer, and had more natural ingredients.  But that wonderful, Velveeta TASTE was not there.  The Kraft Deluxe American Cheese, for all it's other virtues, had a flat taste, compared with the slightly-tangy, delicious flavour of Velveeta.  Although I might buy Kraft Deluxe American Cheese in the future, I will probably buy a LOT more Velveeta!And yes...Velveeta still melts...wonderfully! Just cut it in a few pieces, (no tiresome grating, as with other cheeses), and it will melt almost instantly!  (But the decreased firmness in the cheese, now, makes grating it -- for the "purists" who want even Velveeta to melt as fast as possible -- somewhat too easy: it falls apart too quickly during the grating process!I notice, on the end of the Velveeta package, an invitation to try two other varieties of the cheese: Velveeta 2% Milk, and Velveeta Pepper Jack.Is the Pepper Jack variety the same as the "Mexican" variety was a few years ago?  I see no mention o "Mexican" Velveeta on the package, and do remmber having it once, and finding it delicious -- but it was a while back, and I don't remember the flavour, exactly.  Is the new "Pepper Jack" variety the same, or different?Velveeta Cheese, I find, is great for sandwiches!  And it makes a pretty good 'macaroni and cheese' dish, too.  However, I must here admit that the BEST 'mac and cheese' I ever had was when I used 'Kraft Cracker Barrel' Cheddar Cheese with macaroni.  (Just like Velveeta, the Kraft Cracker Barrel Cheese comes wrapped in foil. This is perhaps more imporant with 100% natural cheddar cheese, (as Cracker Barrel Cheese is), because cheddar cheese dries up a LOT faster, even in the refrigerator, than Velveeta does.)  But for everyday sandwhiches....and even for fondu...Kraft Velveeta Cheese is more than adequate...and more than totally yummy!It is also better, and more economical, I think, to buy Velveeta, or any other cheese, (or anything else), by itself, and NOT in a combination -- such as "Velvetta Cheese and Shells Dinner", (or ready-made, canned or foil-bagged tuna salad, for that matter.)  Even if one is REALLY pressed for time in the morning, it's still cheaper to make mac-and-cheese, or anything else, by one's self, and not have it pre-packaged. (Healthier, too.)  Some great memories can be made by making all the sandwiches, or mac-and-cheese portions, the family needs, on Saturdays and Sundays.  Then -- if a surprise is wanted -- wrap up each sandwich in aluminum foil, WITHOUT labeling them, (except for maybe people's names, so everyone will get their favouriteS).  I like Velveeta and tomato, and also salmon, and also tuna sandwiches.  So, I pick one of the aluminum foil wrapped sandwhiches from the freezer, (with only my name on it) in the morning.  By lunchtime, the sandwich has thawed out...and I'm delightfully surprized by what it is!  (The Velveeta package says, "For best results, avoid freezing"...but, wrapped in aluminum foil, for only 24-hours, to at most, a week, I have found the flavour doesn't vary very much at all.)The ingredients in Velveeta are:  Milk  Water  Salt  Whey  Calcium Phosphate  Milk Protein Concentrate  Lactic Acid  Milkfat  Sorbic Acid as a preservative  Whey Protein Concentrate  Sodium Alginate  Sodium Phosphate  Sodium CitrateCONTAINS 2% OR LESS OF  Salt  Calcium Phosphate  Lactic Acid  Sorbic Acid as a preservative  Sodium Alginate  Sodium Citrate  Enzymes  Apocaratenal (Colour)  Annato (Colour)  Cheese CultureA "chemical feast"?  Not quite -- many natural ingredients, as you can see, are (also) included.(These ingredients are from a package of Velveeta I recently bought in the Supermarket.  The ingredients in the Velveeta boght from Amazon JUST MIGHT differ...slightly. Because, as I've mentioned, I suspect that this product, and most others, more more quickly off store-shelves than they do here at Amazon -- because many people either haven't discovered the wonderful convenience of shopping at Amazon, or don't yet have their own personal computers, and so the time to make careful shopping choices, (rather difficult when limited to 20 minutes at a library's computer.)  So, buy the "older" version at Amazon, if you can...I may be wrong, but I suspect that the formula for Velveeta has changed once again....and the newer one, (now mostly at supermarkets), is less firm, and less yellow in color, than the one I bought here, online.....But all in all, Velveeta -- any Velveeta -- with it's penchant for bringing generations together, its delicious, slightly piquant. taste, its wonderful, (and perhaps too good) quality of 'meltability', and 'spreadability'...all add up to a true "American Classic".  It would be great, as I have said for KRAFT to bring back "Original" formula Velveeta, (including the Colby Cheese)....but even now, Velveeta tastes JUST as I remember it.  So, one needn't go to a memorabilia store, and spend hundreds, and perhaps thousands of dollars, in an attempt to bring back the "good old days".Just go to your local supermarket, (and/or go to Amazon.com!), and buy and eat VELVEETA Cheese! column9: Finally, a light clam chowder that tastes good!
column10: I almost never review food items on Amazon, but for this one I had to. I've been looking for a delicious, light clam chowder for a long time now.First, let me just say, I think the gold standard for regular fat/salt clam chowder was Wolfgang Puck's brand. When that brand was sold to Campbell, the chowder stopped being made, much to my chagrin. So I looked at the other brands, trying to find a good substitute. Unfortunately, Campbell's isn't very good at all. Their broth (if you can call it that) has a weird, gloopy texture and an odor (some might call it a funk) that is quite unpleasant. Progresso's regular brand is pretty good, but is absolutely loaded with fat and salt. Also, the broth tends to "break down" (by this I mean separate into watery elements and cream globules) after ten minutes or so in a bowl with crackers. Store brands are even worse, just a giant bowl of salt.Since none of these were as good as Puck, I figured I might as well look for lighter options. If I'm not going to get the same flavor, I might as well cut the salt and fat, right? Again, Campbell's (both regular and "select harvest" brands) was not great. It was, actually, better than their full fat option, if only because it lacked the funky odor. But it was very bland and had a bad aftertaste. Healthy Choice was OK in terms of texture, but VERY bland in terms of flavor. Clearly, the removal of salt and fat was not compensated for.Now, in comes Progresso with their light option. Compared to their regular variety, the nutrition info is as follows (with original values in parentheses):Calories: 200 per can (360 per can)Total Fat: 5g per can (16g per can)Sodium: 1380mg per can (1720mg per can)Sugars are the same, and Protein gets a cut from 10g to 6g.So although it still is not "low salt" by any means, it is brought pretty well in line with Campbell's reduced salt line. The fat level is just as low as Campbell's light soups, too.The big difference in the ingredients seems to be in various fish powders and extracts. Lobster Powder, Shrimp, Crab Powder, Fish Powder, and Tuna Extract are new to the ingredient list. And guess what: it works wonders. The extra seafood flavor is very palatable, and makes up for the reduction in salt quite well. Whey Protein Concentrate (whatever that is) seems to be a thickening agent that has been added, too. Either way, this broth is delicious! Honestly, I tend to lick the bowl afterward, something I only ever did with Wolfgang Puck brand chowder. It has a very "Seafood Stew" sort of flavor to it, in the way that a good paella or linguine with clam sauce might.I am giving this 4 stars because they have reduced the number of potatoes and chewy clam pieces. It is a bit of a thin chowder as it stands. Crackers are definitely necessary to round this one out. But thankfully, the broth holds up pretty well over ten or twenty minutes in a bowl with crackers. There is also a bit of an aftertaste, though not as bad as the Campbell's brands.So, it's no Wolfgang Puck (still the best canned clam chowder for my money) but it is an acceptable and healthier substitute. Hopefully, Progresso tweaks the formula to make it a bit chunkier. But I'll pick this up on sale whenever I see it at the store.

UPDATED APRIL 2012: I'm returning 6 more pouches of PureBites Chicken today, after first calling the company for instructions. The same rep (female) who responded to my complaint in  Dec 2011 took my call today, but not knowing I had called before, she kept insisting there has never been a complaint about rancid bits before. I told her I called in Dec and she said "someone else likely helped you". Not wanting to argue, I moved on, but she clearly lied to me so I thought I should update about this. I was asked to include a note this time, to say where purchased but that has nothing to do with the fact that the company thinks it's "acceptable" that some fat is getting thru via processing. Fat cannot be freeze-dried so it will turn rancid even if freeze dried - read my original review and see how this was answered the 1st time I called last year...Very disappointing that the company doesn't care to hold the processing plant's feet to the fire about fat getting in, but then to lie to a customer is not good. But they will honor their satisfaction guarantee! So the only way to get this issue resolved is for all of us to get refunds. All you need to do is send the proof of purchase and your invoice to the address on the bag, along with your name & address. I find that about half of the bags are rancid. Dogs don't care, but cats won't eat rancid anything so very expensive if issue is ignored. Pls help make this company fix this issue by sending proofs in and forcing them to refund. Companies ignore issues until their wallets get hit. I hate to do this, but my cats beg for these and I'm going broke replacing rancid bags!ORIGINAL REVIEW: I bought two 6.2 oz bags of PureBites Chicken for dogs, first trying out a small cat size pouch found at PetSmart, and then moved up to the dog-sized bags/chunks, which I crumble with my fingers to get them smaller for my cats, who love this product BUT both of these bags purchased on Amazon had rancid chunks that smushed into slimy/greasy mush when I crumbled them.The company admits this happens, said it's part of the processing, nothing can be done, but it's not acceptable, and they will refund once I send proof of purchases & invoice to them.So it's hit or miss, and the company agrees...so just an FYI to warn others to check their bags!For those feeding this to dogs, and not breaking up the chunks like I do, please take note of this and check on the chunks before feeding. You can also detect a faint rancid odor if there are rancid bits in your bags.The reason for the rancid chunks, according to the company is that pieces of fatty chicken do get in, and fat doesn't freeze-dry, so without preservatives, it will go rancid. I knew that, but had hoped they could offer a promise to correct this; they can't and have no intention to do so. So I'll keep buying and hoping I get good bags, but will certainly take the time to get refunded whenever this occurs.The product is excellent when you get a good bag..just check each piece before feeding, or if you have a good nose for rancid odors, take a whiff and you'll smell the slight rancid odor, and can return the product.

column9: Wonderful natural treat Made in USA
column10: We got these as a x-mas gift and this is the BEST treat! I am very careful about what I give my Shih Tzu who is a puppymill rescue and has health issues. The added plus is that both my dog and cat LOVE these treats. My dog is more finicky than my cat and they both go crazy over these and b/c I know they are 100% natural chicken I feel confident giving them the treats. There are, however, two drawbacks and that is why I can't give it 5 stars. 1) A lot of the treats are wasted b/c they crumble and at least 1/4 of the bag looks like it is filled with sawdust (crumbs from the broken treats). Many of the pieces also crumble into pea-size pieces which are too small for a dog. Fortunately my cat does not mind the tiny pieces so I give these to him. These treats are also very expensive which I don't mind b/c the quality is so good but for this price, I wish so much would not go to waste. 2) Like another reviewer said, you do need to be careful b/c I have found a bone in them as well. I found a bone about an inch long embedded in one of the treats so now I am careful to inspect the treat before giving it to my dog. Even with these drawbacks, I still feel these are the best treats out there if you are looking for 1) healthy, 2)natural, 3) tasty treats that are 4) MADE IN USA. column9: DRY, OLD, STALE - This is NOT freshly roasted coffee
column10: BEWARE -This is NOT freshly roasted coffee.  It arrived with absolutely NO OIL on the beans.  They were bone dry, with NO AROMA.The bags the beans are sent in are the first indication of a problem.  They are NOT 1-way vented bags.  Those who know coffee and roasting...know that the fresh roasted beans continue to emit a gas for up to several days following roasting.  That is why you MUST use a 1-way vented bag when packaging and shipping fresh beans. The oils will quickly evaporate and the beans turn stale if the beans are exposed to air.I don't know why Camano Island thinks they can package this way for selling on Amazon.  The product the customer ultimately receives is NOT acceptable.I talked directly to Camano Island (since Amazon won't allow returns).  They offered to send me freshly roasted beans AFTER I shipped them the "bad" bags I got from Amazon.  It cost me 1/2 of my original purchase price to ship the "bad" beans to Washington from Michigan!  In my opinion, Camano Island should have only required me to fax or email my Amazon receipt to them or send 1 of the 3 bags to minimize shipping costs.I can only hope that what I receive back from Camano Island is truly fresh.What a terrible experience.I've been let down by Amazon.AGAIN BEWARE of buying this brand, packaged this way from Amazon.  Go direct.

column9: Awesome quality cacao nibs - powerful and satisfying.
column10: I'm a certified chocoholic with a weight problem.  I had heard that cacao nibs had all the health benefits of dark chocolate (way more, actually) without the sugar and junk food aspects.  They are loaded with antioxidants and have those powerful endorphin releasing stimulants.  They are also quite high in fiber (but also in saturated fats).I got my big pile of Navitas Naturals nibs and dug right in.  Well - these are a bit of an acquired taste; but once acquired, they really satisfy.  Cacao nibs are broken pieces of raw whole cacao beans that have been dried (and that's it).  They are brown, with a dark cocoa smell, and a seductive texture that's partly like a coffee bean (crunchy and hard), and partly like a piece of chocolate (buttery with a crisp and then melting fat).  The flavor initially gives you a cocoa hit and then a winey fermented flavor that is hard to describe.  The aftertaste is bitter like baking chocolate.  Like a coffee bean, there's some fibrous grit with the aftertaste after the creamy fats have dissolved on your tongue.  My first impressions was "phew - that's disgusting".  The winey flavor was off-putting and the bitterness in the aftertaste was hard to take.  That didn't prevent me from immediately having more, however - as the crisp rich creamy quality made me want more.  After a few pinches (maybe 3/4s of a tablespoon) I was flying!  I mean, these things are POTENT.  They really are loaded with all those endorphin releasing stimulants - and man they wake you up and then make you feel loved.  Over the next few days I kept a big baggie of these in my pack and ate them whenever I wanted a cup of coffee.  The stimulant effect is totally as strong as coffee - and more.  To go with the speed, there's a feeling of well being and intellectual stimulation that's seductive in the extreme.  I began to almost enjoy the odd powerful flavor.  My only concerns at this point are whether these are addictive!  About 1/2 way through my bag I have yet to hit a stem or a stone or an inedible piece (unlike what I've heard with some other brands).  The flavor and texture is pretty consistent as I work my way through too - pretty good for a totally raw organic product.I found that I could grind them up into powder in the blender and use the powder to "cocoa" up various foods (especially ones bearing some sweetness).  For example, after my workout I'd put a tablespoon of nibs and a tablespoon of chia seeds in the blender and grind nice and fine and then toss in a fist full of frozen blueberries, a glug of Walden Farms zero calorie chocolate sauce, 8 oz water and two scoops of whey protein powder (chocolate flavor, of course) and then blend.  It all whips up into a rich chocolatey blueberry shake that packs the nutritional wallop of a steak dinner with omega 3 oils, TONS of antioxidants, and a wicked emotional and blood sugar pick-me-up.  You can buy the powder pre-ground, but I imagine the goodies keep better in this coarsely cracked version.All in all - I think of cacao nibs as much as a drug like coffee as I do a food.  People who eat ultra-dark chocolate for the health aspects should absolutely check nibs out because my body tells me they have WAY MORE of the chemical goodies of chocolate with far less sugar and fat.  They also are brimming with a rich raw cocoa flavor that's weird and wonderful and hard to describe.  If you are bent in this way - this stuff is wonderful.

It's great stuff.  I find that things work that hadn't worked before.  I'm 62 and find my energy level increased. I eat the Cacao Nibs right out of the bag, but some people can't quite take the semi bitter taste of the bean.  I also put it in smoothies and love what it does for my body.
These nibs are great!  I don't find them bitter at all, but very mellow-tasting and satisfying.  Wonderful chocolate rush in tiny packages!  Good packaging and fast delivery too!

column9: Ultimate Organic Nibs Taste More Chocolate-y
column10: Love love love the nibs. I have tried this brand initially before moving on to a cheaper brand that tastes more chocolate-y!Ultimate Superfoods nibs are the best of the two but you can't get them on amazon.com. Lately, they have been sold out at Mother's and they're very own site, which is making me very desperate. I am a chocolate lover and nibs have totally replaced my craving for chocolate bars, hot chocoloate, chocolate milk, and other sugar-filled chocolate treats! Keep in mind when your trying for the first time: Ultimate brand has that chocolate after taste that you are wanting and give it 4 Stars. Nativas has a more bitter after taste so I give it 3 Stars.Also, nibs are great for your skin. You will notice the difference in a few weeks. Between my green tea and coconut water intake, my skin is loving this nutritional routine.The nibs will give you energy due to the caffine. So, if you feel brain farty...have a small hand full and it will focus you right up. This food is so wonderful, I encourage all who love chocolate and ...want to cut back on the Evil Sugar...to try nibs!!!!

We first discovered this stuff on a trip through the Hood Valley area's Fruit Loop.  Stopped on a lark, picked some up for family members as a gift.  They raved about it so much, when we came home we picked up a case online here.  If you like extremely potent horseradish cream sauce, this is for you.  I come from a family that knows horseradish well, and this is superior stuff.  Great on sausage, pierogi, ham, you name it.  Definitely worth trying.

column9: Nuts great but this is NOT A 3 PACK
column10: These nuts are addictively delicious but this is NOT A 3 PACK. This price is for a single can. It turned into a huge issue with the seller with him saying it wasn't his fault, it's Amazon's error. Took some major haggling to resolve with both parties ending up very unhappy.
Good balance between spicy and sour. It is annoying to the palate. Perfect for all occasions, but I recommend it for a night of drinking with friends.
Great for scrapbooking! I use the squares for mounting photos and the runner for almost everything else.

column9: Pretty Good product, but hard to dispense
column10: It works pretty well for the price, but I did notice that it is difficult to use. You have to use a lot of pressure in order to get a consistent solid line of adhesive. It will also stick to the roller. But hey, it sticks. It works. Gets the job done. I'm using it to put together my baby's book. So far, so good.
service and product. Very happy with this product. Thin, melts in your mouth, great little treat for dieters. Would happily purchase again.

column9: So addictive, so delicious, so comforting
column10: My bedside is almost always stocked with a bag or two of these bergamot candies, which I think are the best candies I've ever tasted. I love to curl up with "in bed with blankie, a bear, a book & a bag of bergamot bon-bons" (my husband likes alliteration.)(the bear is a refrence to our dogs as well as to my childhood Care Bear.) He loves to come into the room to find me literally curled up around our sleeping puppy, as my iPad kindle app and a nearby scented candle cast an otherworldly glow across my contented face and the dozens of candy wrappers strewn about the bedside floor. It's gotten to where I almost can't read comfortably without my cherished candies!TasteThe taste is a challenge to describe, but not a challenge to fall in love with. Though "unusual" by American palates, it is not an acquired or foreign flavor like rose or lavender, which we are more familiar with purely as fragrances, not flavors. It has a very sweet burnt-sugar taste at first, quickly melting into a complexity of full-bodied richness, very much like a strong, sweet herbal tea. Which is not a surprise, because the classic, well-loved Earl Grey tea is flavored with bergamot. The pieces are a square shape that fills my mouth, and they last a good while. I usually end up crunching into them when they get down to a sliver, for a last burst of flavor.PackagingThe packaging is simple, and recyclable. It's easy to dig my hand into the bag, pull out a handfull to keep right by my pillow, and grab one at a time. Unwrapping them is a snap - very important for someone with crippling juvenile rheumatoid arthritis - all I have to do is hold each end and tug gently, and the golden treasure is released in one quick motion.PriceThe only *only* drawback to being so addicted to these candies is the high price. That's the reason i couldn't give all 5 stars. Thank goodness they ship through Amazon Prime! I understand these candies are imported, but at the rate I go through a bag, and the cost per bag (I won't say so as not to date this review) these are even more expensive than they first appear to be. You may think "$x for a mere bag of bon-bons?!" and you'd be right. As in love with them as I am, I cannot always afford such a luxury. Hello seller, hint hint!So I wish wish wish that the price would go down a few dollars, or there could be a subscription service that ensures I'm well-stocked while offering a discount. I buy so often as it is, it just seems like good sense.ConclusionThe seller does have excellent cutomer service and superb selection of delights you rarely find in the States. I am a repeat client of the most repeating repeat purchases: I will *never* stop loving these candies. For my birthday and Christmas, the top of my list is a dozen bags, a true jackpot since I can only afford to buy two at a time. Imagine a dozen! And imagine a woman asking for CANDY for her 31st birthday!These bergamot candies are THAT GOOD.

I had an earl grey green tea that I'd fallen madly in love with, and I discovered this candy while trying to recreate that experience without the caffeine that sets me vibrating.The candies come in attractive packaging with stickers and details that are designed to lend it a bit of charm and authenticity.  Delivery was prompt, and as you might expect, these smell lovely right out of the box.They do taste a bit like perfume, if perfume tasted good. They do not taste like Earl Grey, but they never claimed to.  I passed them around the office and the other tea drinkers were excited to try them.  Thoughtful head nods went all around, and the official, unanimous verdict was, "Very interesting."  I'm glad we got to try them, but I don't think it's an instant addiction.  I also don't think they taste at all like burnt sugar!  Just standard sugar and flavoring.They can be sucked on as a hard candy or chewed.  They're just at that point between brittle and soft that reminds me of that old bazooka gum, except of course these don't become bubble gum once you soften them up enough.I tried dissolving them in green tea and got candy-flavored tea that still didn't taste like sweetened earl grey.  Again, not something the seller ever claimed, but I suspect a few more earl grey fans will wander over to this candy in curiosity!I'm not madly, wildly in passionate love with this candy, but it's pleasant and interesting, and I'm glad I tried it.  I may try violet and other flavors in the future.  You only live once!

I know you can buy these in bulk for cheap but I don't like to scoop the seeds out then try to figure out if they're too much or too little. If your cooking with annato seeds for the first time just be aware that it has some bitterness to it you can counter it with some sugar but that might change the flavor of your food.
So I don't know if this is "good" or "bad" annato seed.  I just know I can't buy it locally, so got it here.
I never imagined I would ever know what old people taste like...yeah, I was wrong... My advice, just walk away from this one.

I'm not a big tea drinker, but I love this tea. I have some joint issues (inflamation); I think it helps with that too. I agree with the first reviewer. I sprinkle a little stevia in mine too. -Wonderful.
I did not see these K-cups anywhere locally.  I think the rooibos tea with a little stevia tastes great.  These K-cups make coffee making and tea making so easy and with a lot less mess.
What else can I say? I bought it for the doctors at work for our Keurig and they love it.

Not the best cookies I've eaten. The icing is really sweet, the cookie itself is as hard as as a rock and tastes like sweet cardboard. But they sure are pretty. The kids seemed to be happy with them however.  The individual cookies are about 4 inches in diameter and come individually wrapped in the carton.
this company apparently does not seal these bags well,therefor the coffee beans lose flavor,also bags are so poorly made that one actually came apart,coffee did not taste like colombian at all,

Camano Island Coffee Roasters corrected the packaging problem, so my coffee arrived with a good aroma and oils on the bean. Colombian coffee is typically a bright slightly-nutty brew. Since Central and South American coffees are "washed," - these regions have plenty of water - taking the coffee fruit away creates a bright brew in the cup as it ferments on the cement patios. This coffee met with my expectations of a great Colombian coffee with a slightly-nutty clean taste.  The richness was outstanding, with a pleasing mouth feel and clean finish.

I've ordered this sauce several times and fall in love each time. The vodka sauce makes plain pasta a restaurant-worthy dish. Spoon it over chicken, toss it with shrimp, add it to pork, the options are endless. The flavors are just right. My seven-year old loves it as much as my husband and I do.There used to be several customers reviews, which were so outstanding I bought it the first time just based on what I read. Sometimes the packaging is not the most secure, so check all of the jars when you get them. Some people have had jars crack and I had a couple that opened. They weren't opened enough to spill, but when I removed the plastic cap, I could see that the inner seal was opened. Amazon sent more immediately, so I have continued to order them again and again.I'm glad this comes in a four pack because any time I open a jar, it's gone within the hour.Update:Amazon has improved their packaging since I posted my review, such an improvement that it is worth an update given the earlier concerns about open jars. The new-and-improved box is sturdy, with dividers for each jar, plus a styrofoam layer. Then the entire box is packed in an Amazon box. I do not think that anything can happen to the jars now, and I've never had any problems since the box improvement. Thanks, Amazon!

My husband and I liken this sauce to something we've had in an Italian restaurant on Mulberry Street in Manhattan.  I've never, ever tasted a sauce like this from a jar or bottle.  I've been able to purchase it in Shaw's in New Hampshire, but I believe they've removed it from the shelves because like another reviewer, I've noticed some of the inner seals not holding tight.  I hope the company addresses this matter, because they most certainly have a 100% winner with this product.

When UPS dropped them off I was anxious to see how they fared as every product of this brand that has a review makes adverse comments on packaging. I think the manufacturer must have corrected it since they came in a nicely made, well fitting box lined with styrofoam on the top and bottom and dividers. In fact I saved the boxes to use for seasonal mug storage. The product containers are thick plastic with a screw on lid that could also be reused. I washed a couple in my DW and they held up perfectly. As for the flavor and quality-WOW! I would like to have tasted more capers and basil,as there is a lot of onion, but the tomato cream base is good right out of the jar by itself. I ended making a chicken pasts dish that was wonderful. I hoped for leftovers, but one jar is really only enough for 2 servings with pasta. Take advantage while it is on sale by trying the gift pack. This really is an incredible deal.

Wow!! Thick and rich. Great taste and texture, use on all kinds of pasta, on bread for brushetta, on baked veggies, as a sauce to cook chicken or fish or other meats in.  Yummy!!!  Add artichoke hearts, hearts of palm, sauted veggies, ham, bacon, etc to sauce.  Best brand of pasta sauce I have tried.

I use it as a base sauce and just spice it up with things depending on what I serve but right out of jar with some grated cheese and black pepper is always great. Saute some shrimp in butter add some red pepper flakes and it makes a great pasta topper. I have done Sea Scallops by searing in ghee and adding to warm sauce with a dash more cream. I love it baked over Cod fish or poached in it. Just a really good thing to have on hand and there is nothing even close to it in a jar. For some picky kids this is great stuff to have on hand. I added it to Chicken nuggets, the supermarket kind they like and served it with pasta and grated cheese, they loved it! I made Italian "veal with peas" and used it, came out fantastic, brown veal in butter then simmered in water after browning till almost cooked soft. Then I added the sauce and simmered another 20 minutes with a can of peas, real easy and as good as my grandmothers version. Use only canned peas for this,  for some reason this recipe comes out better than with than fresh or frozen peas, Nana used canned too! Great Container to reuse, it also freezes well. Great deal with Prime free 2 day shipping!

So tasty and good.  The packaging is fantastic, so whatever the other reviewers were complaining about has obviously been remedied.  I LOVE this Vodka sauce, no other will do.  One jar feeds a family of four normal eaters pretty nicely.  I use it over sprouted grain noodles and I forget that I am eating anything healthy.  ENJOY

Oh, this is SO good!  Super easy (just heat in its own jar with loosened top in the microwave -- takes less time than to cook the pasta and doesn't even dirty a pan or dish!).  Love it with tortellini or any type of plain pasta.  Also great with sliced green olives added to it.  Don't believe the number of servings they say, though -- if you're anything like my husband, you'll barely get through one meal for the two of you per jar, with maybe enough left for him to take to work the next day.  We'd clearly need 2 jars if we have guests -- and it's definitely company-worthy, in addition to being a fast-after-work meal for ourselves.  My husband wasn't enthused about buying this but is definitely a convert.  We've gone through 3 of the 4 jars in 2 weeks.  You'll LOVE it!P.S.  The packaging problem reported earlier is DEFINITELY SOLVED -- you might even be able to run over the shipping box in a jeep without damaging the jars inside.  Well done, Scarpetta and Amazon!

If you can't take the time to make your own or you're just not a cook, this is THE best sauce ever! I am a certified personal chef - I cannot say enough about this sauce.  It is rich, flavorful and has just the right amount of seasoning. You can use it 100 ways! By the way - ALL the Scarpetto sauces are fantastic!
Restaurant quality, easily.  This sauce is just delicious.  This makes for such an easy (just pour on pasta) but stunning meal.  It will even impress your guests if they don't see the container!

We just recently discovered this product, thanks to Amazon.  I wanted to ship something practical and surprising and "homemade-y" to my hardworking out of state college son, in addition to usual boring birthday presents.  After reading reviews on Amazon, this vodka sauce seemed to fit the bill.  I ordered the pack of 4 to send to him directly....but within half hr of ordering I realised I forgot to change shipping address and this first order was coming to me!  When i went to correct,  the sauce was already being processed to be mailed out!  Within the hr!  My  sauce arrived the next day, within 24 hrs of ordering!!  (I live in Calif) I placed another order for my son, and his arrived in So. Carolina abt 3 days after ordering.  Packaging was great and speed remarkable.  If you like vodka sauce, this truly is worth trying...it's amazing, and hard to believe its not "homemade" but out of a jar.  My whole family loves it.

column9: Pure Pleasure, Delivered to Your Door!
column10: How convenient!  Ordered this in my pajamas and hoped for the best.  And boy howdy, it delivered - literally and figuratively.  It's wonderful to order something, have it show up at your door, and find out that it's a great product.  All four containers arrived safe and sound, and I couldn't wait to try it.  While it's definitely not what I would call a low-calorie product, serving it over whole wheat or multi-grain pasta has to help offset the the negative, right?! Ha!  But it is so-o-o-o worth it, we all need to reward ourselves with a little treat now and then.  I would purchase this again; this sauce tastes much fresher and more flavorful than typical jars off the store shelf.

Wow...incredibly good pasta sauce.  5 star restaurant quality...absolutely my favorite pasta sauce...and I can my own in fall.  Thanks Amazon for adding it to subscribe and save and bring gourmet foods into my world.  Can't say enough about how good it is.

column9: Ruined me for all other "store-bought" sauces
column10: I love this sauce. It is my go-to for when I need to get a fast dinner on the table. I love it on a fresh ravioli that my grocery store carries that has spicy italian sausage inside, but it is also good on plain old spaghetti or any other noodle. I have read through all the reviews and plan to try some of the suggestions people have made. I would love to hear more. This seems like it would be a very versatile sauce.My latest trick was to add some homemade chicken stock and a little milk and serve it as tomato soup with a salad and some crusty bread. A slightly pricy version, but everyone loved it.
Tastes so fresh they must cook and ship it on the same day. Very high quality ingredients. It's creamy and yummy.

Wow!  Who knew you could get this kind of quality from a sauce in a jar??  This stuff works with just about anything:  I've used it with shrimp, chicken, homemade meatballs, artichokes and mushrooms -- the flavor just blends beautifully.  If you've never had "vodka sauce" before, it's sort of like a creamy marinara sauce with a splash of vodka (but you won't taste any alcohol -- it all burns off).  This has chunks of tomato in it for some texture, too.  I liked it so much I've set up a subscription, and will definitely be trying more of the Scarpetto line of sauces.Preparation couldn't be simpler: just eat in the microwave right in the jar (loosen the lid first, of course); or you can heat it in a small saucepan on the stove.  Piece of cake.  Serve over the cooked pasta of your choice, or use it in a casserole with layers of cooked pasta and some chicken or Italian sausage.  Top with cheese, and you've got a meal.

I love Italian food, and homemade pizza and pasta is served all the time in our house. However, my husband and I are both super busy and most weeknights I just want something on hand to help make life easier. I have used a lot of canned sauces, but this is the best I have tried, I can't believe how fresh it tastes! I think this might even get by in some homes in Italy! I can't wait to try the other varieties

column9: I Buy This Sauce Every Year!!
column10: I buy this sauce at least once a year at the holidays.  I fell in love with pasta with Vodka sauce years ago in NYC.  In California, we hadn't started to see it at all....and I still don't know of a restaurant that does it as well as scarpetta's!  I've given this as a gift to a family member for at least four years and she has grown to expect it.  She and her husband love it, too!!

This sauce and others made by this company are delicious.  Scarpetta sauce is good and also makes supper fast, just pour in a pan and heat. Pour over spaghetti or other pasta and dinner is served.  The pesto they make is the best.

column9: No one will know this sauce is from a jar
column10: This sauce is so good, that I could eat it every day if I wouldn't gain a million pounds. It would probably be impossible to make a better bottled sauce.  I like to toss it with penne, rotini or campanelle.  It's so easy and delicious.

column4: Nicole Volz "Be the change you want to see in...
column9: First Jar great..but confused about storage
column10: I just received my first order of this pasta sauce yesterday and tried one of the jars out immediately.  I didn't see any cold packs in the packaging, and the jar said to refrigerate and use within 7 days after opening, so I stored it in the pantry until I open them.  I'm not sure if that was a misinterpretation of the instructions as there is cream in the ingredients, and now I'm nervous.Could somebody please tell me if this was designed to go directly into the refrigerator?Thanks :)

column4: E. Bernardino "Addicted to the Gold Box"
column10: This is a restaurant quality product; thick and with a great, distinct flavor. If you like your pasta, you will love this sauce! This product is so good, I wouldn't hesitate to prepare it for company- they will think you slaved in the kitchen for hours!If I could say one negative thing about this product, it would be that it's so delicious, I end up eating it right out of the jar with a spoon; thus, I am lucky to have any left for pasta!

Nice chunks of tomato, creamy vodka sauce.  Feels like you are eating at a nice Italian restaurant.  It really spruces up your plain old pasta at home and tastes homemade.  Half of the product saves well in the refrigerator until its next use.
I love Scarpetta! The tuscan vodka sauce is my favorite. So good! I recommend it to everyone I know!

I bought this when it was on special through Amazon--and wow!  It's terrific!  I froze the containers, and we break them out from time to time... and it's the freshest, most unique sauce I've had that's not homemade.  I have served it over chicken and with pasta...  Even the kids liked it!Very, very good!

Have not tasted a better jar sauce. I get lazy at times and don't want to do sauces from scratch. This is perfect for those times. My friends don't believe me when I serve this pasta dish and I tell them it's from a jar.I also add capers at times and fresh basil at others.
I expected a flat taste, after all it's still a prepared product. It was surprisingly fresh tasting and tasty. Had no problems with the packaging.

I am waiting for my box as I type this. I am salivating at the mouth just looking at the jar in corner of my screen. This sauce is soooo good! I never buy jarred sauce but this is to die for. You will not be disappointed!Oh and I tried it at my friends house. This is how I know that it's yummy! Buy the 4 pack...you'll need it!

I agree with other reviewers, this is a restaurant quality product.  By itself on pasta just a little fresh basil and cheese on top, delicious...or toss in some sauteed chicken or shrimp and you have a great dinner with a little more substance.  No problem with packaging as earlier reported.
Product was received from vendor quickly.  It is the best tasting non calorie juice around.  So glad to be able to get it here.  thanks
This is a fabulous drink, quenches your thirst, makes you feel good, but it goes down so good, it doesn't last long.  Tastes great anytime but tastes better when ice cold.

I bought this because according to the picture it was just the XXX water that I love.  The water arrived in a large box that fell apart as I was dragging into the garage.  As the box broke and the case of water fell onto the floor, I noticed that the bottle said XXX Zero, at first I thought it was just a new bottle.  No, I actually received the XXX Zero, which tastes ok at first but always manages to leave a nasty after taste.  I feel like I just wasted my money on something that I could have bought at the supermarket when it goes on sale for $1 a bottle.  I can't return this and I don't want to drink it, this is what I get for being lazy, and luckily I only paid $25.41.

column9: This is a grat post-workout drink
column10: This product is really pretty remarkable. It was suggested to me by my doctor. I do an hour on either an exercycle or an elliptical machine almost everyday and perspire profusely. His recommendation was based upon this product providing a good blend of electolytes. It also has relatively low calories (50 calories for 8 ounces - about a third of a less healthy cola or other pop drink).Surprisingly this drink has good flavor. Much, much better than any Gatorade product. I expected it to have an artificial taste, but in fact the fruity tastes seem natural. The blueberry-pomegranite and dragonfruit flavors are my favorites, but you might like others. The cost is high. I wish amazon.com would offer the 32-ounce bottles (especially in bulk), because they are considerably less expensive per ounce - at least that's what I find to be true at local stores.The reviewer who complained about this site getting the calories wrong is correct. It's not ten calories, but fifty per (8-ounce) serving. Still - as already noted - that's not a lot.

I am completely and totally hooked on glaceau vitamin water zero, especially this particular flavor, acai-blueberry-pomegranate XXX and recommend it highly. It is very tasty, and nutritionally has the following:100% of daily requirements for vitamin c100% for vitamin B5, B6, B1225% for vitamin A100% for niacin100% for pantothenic acidmanganese, vitamin B3, magnesium and antioxidant mineralsThere are few if any preservatives.It's also ZERO calories and flavored with stevia, a natural sweetener, supposedly less questionable healthwise than sucralose/splenda or other artificial sweeteners.I've tried about six flavors of glaceau vitamin water zero XXX (note that it looks  almost the same as glaceau vitamin water and glaceau vitamin water XXX so pay attention to the label) and acai-blueberry-pomegranate is by far my favorite, followed by dragonfruit and fruitpunch. I don't care too much for the lemonade one - it's too sweet. But then again I like to eat lemons whole and never put sugar in lemonade.The red-fruity vitamin water zeros are sweet but not overly sweet.In regard to the price, yes, it is over-priced here, especially when you add shipping costs. In my own local environment (near Boston), about five supermarkets and grocery stores near me carry it, at prices ranging from 99 cents per bottle to 3 bottles for $4 to (at pricey convenience stores) $1.99 a bottle. Given that I drink three bottles a day, the latter is too expensive. So basically I buy it in bulk at the lowest price, and dilute it to make it last longer. It's still tasty when you add a considerable amount of water to it.At the moment, Amazon does have a listing priced at 99 cents a bottle, and with free shipping for orders over $25, but it's only for the lemonade flavor.Since there are many electrolyte-type waters out there that are not very tasty, have limited nutritional value, a lot of preservatives and sometimes a hefty amount of calories - do yourself a favor at try glaceau vitamin water zero. However if buying at Amazon, do a search for all of them listed to find the best price and best shipping deal.

This Vitamin Water literally saved my life. I was completely dehydrated after a day of yard work, full of who knows how many oxidants. Just as I pulled the last weed of the season (October), I felt the earth spin underneath me and I toppled over. Oh boy, did I topple a good one!My neighbor heard me cry out and rushed over. He asked what happened, but I was totally incapacitated. I was on the verge of a coma. He asked me if I had eaten enough... then my husband heard the commotion and shouted out from the TV room "No--she hasn't had anything all week. She's on a stupid juice cleanse." I had been on a juice cleanse all week and it had him mad because I'd stopped cooking. He was living off of Nachos and it made him GRUMPY.My neighbor, Jack (he's a little fruity, but we don't mind because he keeps his yard so nice!), said "well, that's the problem. You need some calories." At this point I felt like I was about to go into convulsions. My eyes were crossing up into my head and I was drooling. Jack ran to his garage and brought back a Vitamin Water. He opened it and kept saying "calm down, calm down." I got very calm. Then I took one sip of that Vitamin Water, and BAM--I was back in business. I jumped up so fast that Jack said "hey, take it easy!" I took another drink of the Vitamin Water, and let me tell you I was CURED. I started mowing the lawn immediately.Now I buy the Vitamin Water almost every time I'm at the store. My husband doesn't like the taste, so I took one star off (just to make him happy). But I think it's a pretty great product. I don't know if I would buy 24 my first time. Just buy one at the grocery store first to see if you like it. Then if you do, you can buy more!

Who would order a 24 pack of something that can be bought almost anywhere for under a $1 each online for more?  Let alone nearly 3 times the price.  And warning to anyone that hates the taste of all of the artifical sweeteners, don't buy the "Zero" vitamen waters.
At 50 calories per bottle, it has 5x the calories they advertise. Not sure why they need to mislead in the Amazon description.
Their Kadhi Pakora is the best. No preservatives or artificial colors (their claim), and great authentic taste.Also try their Daal Bhaat
This is one of my favorite north indian dishes. MTR gets pretty close to the authenticity in flavor and texture. Its medium on the spicy scale. Recommend it.

column9: Wasn't my favorite.  One package melted on stovetop.
column10: Wasn't my favorite.  One package melted on stovetop after I followed the instructions.  Tasted too mustard-y to me.

column9: Oh Boy!  Yummy and very addictive!
column10: I love this pork jerky.  It is so good, it should be banned for being addictive.  I suppose that could be considered a negative.  One other negative for me is the amount of sugar/carbs in this jerky.  It isn't overly sweet, but if you are low carbing a bag of this can throw you off track!

I usually eat beef jerky.  This is the first time I've tried Oh Boy! Oberto BBQ Pork Jerky and I was impressed.  It's softer and more moist than traditional beef jerky.  It's got a lot of flavor which reminds me of Chinese fruit flavored beef jerky (which doesn't actually taste like fruit at all).  It's sweet, with a little kick, and very satisfying.  My hands are on the greasy side when I'm done, but it's worth it.

I purchased this item from two leaves and a bud. I am just getting into the world of loose teas, and this was my first experience with loose leaf peppermint tea. Let me tell you there is no comparison.The tea bags were ok until I tried this tea. Just opening the bag emits a heavenly aroma, you could  probably use it as an air freshener if you wanted to. Now for brewing the tea... I doubled up because I like peppermint, I used 4 tsp for 16 oz, but then again I love peppermint. I steeped for 5 minuted since there are no recommendations on the package.... wrong! The tea came out bitter, but after tasting you have this cool tingling peppermint mouth feel, which permeates into your sinuses. I know that doesn't sound very appealing, but if you are a peppermint lover as I am, it was absolutely sensational. I have never tasted peppermint tea like this from tea bags at the grocery store. I went to the two leaves and a bud website, and they have the recommended steeping times available for all their teas, and for the peppermint it is 1-3 minutes. Next time I brew it i'm sure it will be better. This tea would probably blend well with others as well. If you love peppermint tea, you must try this, and you will be hooked as I am!
I bought this coffee for my dad and he really likes it. It's good enough for a father's day present apparently.

If you want an excellent organic Hazelnut coffee that is rich in flavor, then Pierce Brothers is for you.A friend came to visit and when she tasted the coffee, she was impressed.This coffee is rich in flavor and has deep dark color and the aroma! Ah...Please try this coffee - you will become a loyal consumer.
This is the best hazelnut coffee I have had.  You don't even have to add any flavoring or anything and the best part is its organic.  I highly recommend it.

column9: Chocolates DO NOT contain real alcohol!
column10: For a product that sells itself behind a liquor brand, I was pretty disappointed that the candies did not contain real liquor. A coworker of mine purchased some malibu chocolates as Christmas gifts for everyone. These candies were great and contained real alcohol but, rather than asking her where she purchased them from (because she more than likely wouldn't have divulged) I decided to look for them myself online.The image shown on Amazon is very vague and (at the time that I purchased) offered no product description. Far be it for me to sound like some kind of alcoholic but, mentioning the non-alcoholic nature of these candies should have been one of the least of things put in the description to help inform a buyer's decision.I understand that it might be tricky selling things of an alcoholic nature online when it may be difficult to verify age, but those chocolates my coworker gave were so tasty that I would've been willing to jump through (some) additional hoops in order to verify mine.

I was quite disappointed that the item which arrived was NOT the one pictured.  It contained 3 varieties of Bailey's Irish Creme filled chocolates not the Grand Marnier, Mailubu or Kahlua ones pictured.  I purchased this as a gift, so I gave it to the person and they were appreciative.  I did request  some compensation for this overight and was issued a refund for 20%.  I guess buying from this vendor is like a box of chocolate and you can never be sure just whar youo will get.

column9: This gold can is top notch. I couldn't do without it!
column10: The gold can is excellent. I use it for everything from sauces like puttanesca, to frying and even salads. The price here of $41 is a bit high. I get this can for $30 at the grocery store. It used to be cheaper, too. I came here hoping I could get it for $20.So the 5 stars is for the gold can alone.

column9: Not bitter and easy on my stomach!
column10: We are huge coffee drinkers and drink it every morning and most evenings after dinner.  Years ago I used to drink Starbucks French Roast.  Loved the taste but it just tore my stomach up and it was very acidic. I was hesitant to try another Starbucks but love vanilla flavor so I thought I would give it a try.  If you are used to drinking flavored coffees, you won't taste much vanilla...just a hint.  Very smooth and overall good taste.The ingredients on the side of the package says:  Ground coffee, natural flavor (with corn maltodextrin, vegetable glycerin), ground vanilla beans, Indian sarsaparilla root.  Also on the bag it says, "To preserve that fresh just roasted flavor, keep this bag sealed tight in a cabinet (not the refrigerator) and brew within a week of opening."Overall I liked it.  If you want a coffee with just a hint of flavor, I would recommend this.  However, if you are used to lattes loaded with milk, cream, sugar and other flavorings, you probably won't taste much of a difference between this and unflavored coffee.

I tried this just to see if it lived up to the Starbucks name. The flavor just wasn't there. It has some vanilla flavor but not what i would expect from this brand of coffee. I think I will stick to my Torani Sugar-Free Syrup, Vanilla, 25.4-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 3) added to regular coffee. Then I can adjust the taste to my mood.
VERY TASTY MORNING BEVERAGE,ALTHOUGH I WOULD NOT NECESSARILY RECOMMEND IT FOR EVENING. MOST ANY FLAVORED COFFEE LOVER WOULD LOVE THIS NICE LITTLE PACKAGE FROM STARBUCKS.

I like a strong cup of coffee, but I don't like bitter coffee.  This coffee does not brew very strong, and is also bitter.  I've found this to be true of most arabica blends.  The beans have the aroma of vanilla, but the vanilla flavor was very subtle.  I think this coffee would be okay for someone who doesn't like their coffee very strong.  But, if you like a good, strong cup of coffee, I would avoid this one.

For me, nobody can beat Dunkin Donuts coffee. But the addition of vanilla can make just about any coffee palatable, and since this had the Starbucks name on it, I figured it was worth a try.But I couldn't really taste the vanilla. Overall, this coffee just didn't impress me as either bad or good. It just sort of sat there. Maybe it has to do with my coffee-making skills, but I don't know why the vanilla flavor wouldn't come through.

I was in Baoshan City, Yunnan Province, China last August and had the opportunity to taste the local coffee that they called "Small Bean" coffee.  The flavor was uniquely pleasant and very gentle in taste.  I was wondering if Starbucks would be interested in that kind of coffee.When I received Natural Fusions, I was pleasantly surprised to be brought back to the highlands of Southwestern China that I just got back from.  I don't know where this coffee is from, but I am quite sure it is a similar kind of beans.I am glad that Starbucks doesn't infuse too much extra flavor, in this case vanilla, to overpower the natural taste of this coffee.  If you like the usual bold and strong Starbucks coffee, you might not like this one.But I think this coffee is quite safe for entertaining guests that you don't know what they would like for coffee because it won't turn anyone off by it's fine, gentle, and somewhat classy flavor.Just like drinking green tea, which is always mild, but the joy is in savoring its fine natural quality.

I just finished this package of coffee, and I'm going right out to buy another package of it!  I've enjoyed this Starbucks Natural Fusions, Vanilla so very much.  It has just the right amount of bite, sweetness, and beautiful aroma.  It's a very fine grind, and it was perfect for my French Press, which I find to be the best way to get that perfect cup of coffee.  Starbucks has done it again with this beautiful combination.  I've found my go-to coffee!  Thanks Starbucks!!

column9: Nice complement to my Keurig coffee maker
column10: I recently acquired a Keurig coffee maker. It has been a good investment. And it includes a doodad that allows one to use something other than specially made "K-cups" (coffee containers explicitly designed for the coffee maker). I had earlier purchased this coffee, thinking to use it in my old Mr. Coffee machine (which never created the kind of taste that I wanted).However, in a Keurig machine, this works pretty well. I am still calibrating how much coffee should go in the container for brewing. One rather odd observation: There is not much vanilla fragrance when one opens the package; there is also not much of a fragrance when it is brewing. But when I drink a cup, the vanilla flavir is there.So, in the end, I find this a nice complement to my Keurig machine. I'm pretty satisfied, although the taste is still not as robust as I would like (but I am still experimenting on how much coffee to use, so this may resolve).

column9: Delicate with a hint of vanilla
column10: To be wholly fair to the product, I feel compelled to disclose that I'm not usually a brewed coffee drinker these days, except for restaurant outings. Having tried about every coffee around at one time or another, I find that Nescafe Clasico Instant Coffee, 7-Ounce Jars (Pack of 3) suits my personal tastes more than any other. I drink one cup black in the morning and a second in the late afternoon with lots of Half-and-Half.As for this product, it's quite a pleasant coffee with no bitterness whatever. If found it to be especially delicate in ambiance, even though I intentionally brewed it just on the strong side. Had I used this extra amount of coffee with other gourmet brands that I've tried, it certainly would have been much darker and bolder (and in all liklihood, harsh) in taste.I was surprised in regard to the vanilla (a flavoring that I generally like) aspect of the coffee. The aroma of the grounds is pretty significant and I expected a similarly infused flavor in my cup; however, the vanilla came through as little more than a slight nudge. I actually would have preferred a more prevalent vanilla taste had I gone specifically for a vanilla-flavored coffee. But this facet of the blend might represent a positive point for certain other vanilla coffee lovers.Would I personally buy this product? If there were no such thing as Nescafe Clasico Instant Coffee, 7-Ounce Jars (Pack of 3) then I could say with some confidence that I would buy some intermittently. I'm limited for health reasons as to the amount of caffeinated coffee I can drink each day so I'm looking for a *plain old roadside diner coffee* experience most of the time -- for brewed coffee that would be either Yuban Original Ground Coffee, 12-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) or Maxwell House Original Roast (Medium) Ground Coffee, 11.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), and not a gourmet-type brand. If I were choosing a specific *Starbucks* blend for myself, it would be Starbucks Christmas Blend 100% Arabica Whole Bean Coffee (1.56 lb. bag) which I slightly prefer over the one under review here.However, I would not hesitate for a moment to serve the Starbucks Vanilla to either casual visitors or dinner guests, especially since the vanilla flavoring is so subtle. This is a quality product which I think many people will much enjoy.

column9: no matter what I do, it still taste bad
column10: Taste bitter, in a bad way, some coffee taste bitter but smooth, not this one.  A hint of vanilla flavor but no coffee aroma at all.  I tried a few different way to make the coffe and no matter what I do, it just taste bad.

I normally drink organic dark french roast coffee from Trader Joe's, so I wanted to try a vanilla flavored coffe. I liked the slight vanilla flavor this coffee had, but I did notice that it had a much more bitter flavor then my regular coffee, and I don't think that is something I can get used to drinking. I went right back to my organic french roast coffee.

This is an excellent coffee for drinkers like me who don't like an overwhelming vanilla flavor.  Some flavored coffees I have tried miss the mark and the additional flavoring covers up the coffee flavor.  This had just the right light vanilla flavor along with a nice, smooth coffee flavor.  If you are someone who likes a stronger flavor, this product might not be for you.  Personally, I really ejnoyed it and would recommend it.

it is definitely Coffee with Caffeine.. Taste like vanilla mixed with coffee but not as strong as vanilla syrup or anything..I honestly don't like this coffee, which is personal taste.the coffee is well ground, and the smell of it brewing is very nice, but not the taste of it!

column9: Not too bold, strong vanilla aroma
column10: This coffee was not quite as dark roasted as I'm used to for Starbucks, but for me, that was a good thing. Sometimes I feel like I'm drinking from an ashtray on their very dark roast.The vanilla taste (and smell) are more prominent than in many flavored coffees, which again, for me, was a good thing. Though not overwhelming, you definitely could tell this was a vanilla flavored coffee.Nice fresh/consistant flavor through the whole bag.

column9: About as good as bagged Starbucks can be made with a Mr Coffee
column10: We don't have your fancy schmancy coffee makers. We just have the basic, Mr Coffee with a 12-cup carafe. It's really impossible to duplicate the flavor you get at the coffee bars when basic home equipment. That said, this coffee emerged full, rich, strong and most importantly, without that nauseating taste some flavored coffees have. My daughter and I are both coffee lovers and were both pleased.

I drink Starbucks coffee at home each morning.  I like a strong bold cup and therefore usually brew the darker roasts.  I am not a huge fan of flavored creamers but on occaision I will get a vanilla flavored coffee at a bagel shop.  I was excited to see Starbucks new line of flavored coffees because I assumed the quality would be just as good as their regular coffees and that the premium price would provide a genuine good hint of vanilla flavor.  I was deeply dissappointed in the strong artificial vanilla smell and taste when I brewed this coffee.  I couldn't even drink it with my 1/2 & 1/2 in it. It was worse than any gas station flavored coffee or instant vanilla coffee beverage I have tried.  The aftertaste was terrible and I had to throw away the remaining coffee.

I'm a big fan of flavored coffee. Usually you have to buy a drink that has been flavored but they come with tons of sugar. If not sugar the sugar replacement is a bit to nauseating. I love how this brew has the perfect aroma of vanilla that takes over the house in the morning. Will always look for an amazon bargain on this product.

OK...I've never reviewed a coffee product. I stick with book reviews...but I drink a lot of coffee when I'm reading and reviewing books.  So...this one was special.  I made my first pot and upon smelling the coffee, I was hooked. How good is it? I haven't tossed the ground coffee package yet!  It's empty, but it still smells good and reminds me of those morning smiles and good books.  Way to go, Starbucks!
this product tastes great, just like the coffee you expect from your local starbucks.  pricing and packaging are also great.  makes for a wonderful gift.  eNjOy!!!

column9: Starbucks french roast+tsp. vanilla extract= fusions
column10: I gave this a try, as I enjoy flavored coffee from time to time, and I also enjoy the starbucks brand, especially their darker roasts.  In terms of it's roast, this did not disappoint, so for you milder coffee drinkers, this might be a bit bolder in flavor for you.  That said, the dark roast with the added vanilla flavor didn't seem to fuse so well for me.  Instead of both flavors working harmoniously, it was like dropping a dash of vanilla extract to my french roast in the morning.  One flavor, followed by the vanilla aftertaste.  My local store carries this at 11 oz, and a starbucks typical roast at 12 oz for pretty much the same price.  So we're talking an ounce difference price wise.  The fusions coffee comes only ground, so it doesn't work for the french press users, and I just wasn't impressed.  Not horrible, but not worth coming back for more.

column9: It's ok. . . but I like Eight O'Clock better
column10: This coffee is really ok. . . I know what to expect with Starbucks.  I know what I don't like . . and what I do like . . . . But I have to say, especially for the cost, I really like Eight O'Clock better.  If you really want more vanilla flavor, I think you should give it a try.Eight O'Clock Coffee, French Vanilla Ground, 11-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)

Absolutely did not like this flavor at all.  It's sweet without tasting good, and that's really the only way I can describe it.  Add a little sugar to it and it only gets worse.  So far not impressed with the Starbucks flavors.  Have also tried the cinnamon and didn't enjoy it, either.

This coffee smells good when brewing but there is no vanilla scent at all. We thought that would be a bad sign but when we tasted it, the coffee was very good, even served black. The vanilla taste is very subtle. I served this coffee to family and friends and everyone liked it. My daughter said it was very smooth and she liked that the vanilla taste was subtle.

Unpleasant aftertaste, I bought this hoping I would enjoy it. Amazon had a great price. But I find it leaves an unpleasant aftertaste that I can only describe as a "burning" feeling on the top of the back of my tongue. Would not buy again.

I hate flavored coffees for the most part. Not because I dont like a little flavor in my coffee but because most companies use flavored oils and inferior beans and are often very bitter. This caught my eye because the flavors are in their natural form ground with the coffee. I thought I would give it a shot and LOVE it. The coffee alone is a good quality coffee and the suttle vanilla flavor really comes out when you add a small amount of cream and sweetner. It's not my daily coffee but I always look forward to drinking it!
I wanted to try this product and i really liked it. what i liked even better was the price. Great quality and taste!

column9: bought it at a great price
column10: My husband likes the coffee and we bought it at a great price.  (Starbucks is normally pretty expensive coffee.)

I was worried the vanilla flavor would be too overpowering, but I was pleasantly surprised to taste it and it was just a nice subtle vanilla flavor. I like that it's pre-ground as well since I usually have little time in the morning and it's just one less step I have to worry about. I would highly recommend this product if you like your coffee with a hint of flavor!

column9: What A Way to Start a Morning!
column10: This tasty coffee will brighten any morning.  The coffee is a perfect mixture of vanilla and strong bean.  Worth its weight in gold...if only for the smell as it brews.

I am not necessarily a fan of Starbucks coffee, nor of flavored coffees, but I have to say that I found this particular coffee very smooth and the flavor was not the usual overpowering, cloying stuff that you usually get when you get a flavored coffee. I use about 7-8 scoops (note: varies with the size of your scoop, mine is about a tablespoon size when heaping, perhaps a touch more) for a 12 cup pot and get a very nice tasting/smelling pot of coffee. I can see having more of this coffee when the current bag is done. P-)

I'm not a big Starbucks fan...I think their beans taste burned and bitter.  That said, surprisingly, I really like this coffee.  It still has some of the strong, Starbucks coffee flavor that some really like, but it is nicely mellowed with the vanilla flavor.  The vanilla is not crazy strong, but if you don't like flavored coffee, you won't like this.  I found it to be a great morning coffee.  I drink it with half and half and like the smooth, creamy, vanilla taste.

column9: Great coffee even from a non coffee lover
column10: I am not a huge fan of coffee, however, this coffee is excellent.  The aroma while it is brewing is outstanding and it really delivers once you take a drink.  The vanilla flavor is strong, but not overpowering, the coffee has a nice full taste.  I have served this to a few friends and they all loved it as well.Highly recommend if you are looking for a nice flavored coffee!

column9: Smells like vanilla, tastes like vanilla
column10: The best thing about it is the smell - while I do like the smell of regular coffee, the combination of vanilla and coffee smells make it incredibly pleasant.While some flavored coffee can taste fake, or have virtually no taste (other than coffee) this one actually has a nice vanilla and coffee flavors mixed in - and they taste natural to boot.If you like coffee, and enjoy vanilla, you can't go wrong with this coffee.

This coffee was something we approached tentatively, since we do not like strongly flavored coffee.  However, the quality was consistent with Starbucks' other roasts, and the flavor was not too strong.  A soft, morning coffee.  Very nice.

I must say that i'm not a fan of regular Starbucks coffee at the stores.  I'm a coffee lover and must have one every each day.  Anyways, i thought giving this coffee a try.  I must admit, i'm not sure what they mean by "natural fusion", but it sure does taste good. It's nice and smooth with sutble taste of vanilla. I personally like bolder taste of coffee and this coffee seems more bold.

column9: I'm not really a coffee drinker, but it's good
column10: Well, let me start off, I'm not really a coffee drinker. I only drink it when I'm tired. So I thought this would be nice to try since it has a little bit of vanilla flavor in it to make it taste better. So I would have to say it taste pretty good for coffee, but if you're expecting it to take taste like vanilla Frapuccino, you will be disappointed :-) . It has a nice light flavor of vanilla in it to give your coffee a unique taste.

column9: The first flavored coffee we really like! Will buy again.
column10: I ordered this coffee at at good price, not for the name. But both my husband and I were surprised that we really did enjoy the flavor and aroma without noticing a bitter after-taste. We are by no means coffee experts, we just drink our morning cup to get us going. We've tried different brands and don't usually give much care either way, except for flavored coffees which we usually avoid due to bitterness. They always smell so nice, but the taste, yuck. So maybe there is something to the Starbucks brand, it was good coffee, and I'll have to try some other flavors to see if they stand up to our taste testing as well.I should note that we make our coffee using an aero press which helps in taking much of the bitter taste out of coffee and we usually drink our coffee with just skim milk.

column9: Good coffee with a small flavor boost
column10: The Starbucks Natural Fusions Ground Coffee, Vanilla Flavored is a very smooth tasting coffee.  There is a very small hint of vanilla flavor that did NOT have a chemical taste.  However, I would have preferred more of a vanilla flavoring as opposed to the minute amount in this coffee.  All in all, this is a good coffee that is not bitter.  I would recommend it to coffee drinkers but not to those who are looking for a burst of additional flavor.

While I do like Vanilla flavored coffee I really don't like it over powering. In fact I usually blend 1/2 regular with 1/2 flavored. Well much to my surprise I didn't have to blend this at all, in fact I really couldn't taste any vanilla at all. It is a great tasting coffee but I really wanted vanilla. Maybe that's why it was selling so cheaply.

column9: Coffee is fabulous without cream & sugar
column10: I purchased this in hopes that I could drink black coffee to cut the cream & sugar from my diet. It's fabulous!

I like me some Starbucks coffee.When it is on sale or I have a chance to pick it up when out with a friend, it is always a treat.  I was excited when I saw a deal featuring their new Natural Fusions Ground Coffee on Amazon.I placed my order and (because of Prime) got it in two days. The first thing I noticed was the intense vanilla smell. I could smell it through the bag. After opening the coffee and making a bit, I was expecting an almost over-powering vanilla taste, not the case.I could only taste a hint of vanilla in the coffee.  That was OK, but I was hoping for a bit more.  Over-all, it is a good tasting coffee that has a decent boldness. While I prefer non-flavored coffee, I will admit, this coffee tastes pretty good and makes a strong consideration for future purchases. Especially if I can get it on sale.

It has a nice smell when you open the package, but not all that much like coffee. More like Vanilla extract,it really is very lightly flavored compared to regular Starbucks, it could be called Starbucks lite. It has a very pleasent taste but weak. I think if you use a bit more than the usual amount it has a more powerful kick but still not Starbucks par. You can taste a slight Vanilla flavor still not nearly as strong as other flavored coffee I have tried, still very pleasent and tasty though. Not sure I would buy this varity for myself. I like mine a little stronger. If you like a weaker flavored coffee, then you will like this.

I got this for my hubby, who is the real coffee drinker around here.  The smell when it's brewing is so delicious.  It smells sweet and kind of caramel-ish.  The coffee is smooth, and the flavor is subtle but definitely there.  We brew it in a Keurig machine using the filter attachment.  Definitely worth repurchasing.

We enjoyed this coffee and its hint of vanilla taste. It was a decent drink though certainly not the best coffee we have consumed.it is ground fairly finely and has a coffee odor while it is brewing. It really is a satisfying cup of coffee but nothing to make me rush out and buy it!Overall, a decent coffee, worth trying out!

column4: Caonabo Javier Peguero "Long live and prosper"
column9: A taste of starbuck at home
column10: I was amazed to have the richness and aroma of starbucks cofee at home. If you follow the instructions you won't notice any difference from the coffe yu buy at the starbucks shops and this home made brew.Highly recommended for people that don't have the time to wait in line, have harsh climate in their area or, like in my case, that live out of the continental US.I also recommend this coffe for everyone that wants to enjoy life!

Starbucks coffee has a signature taste that my husband describes as "burnt beans".  This SB vanilla blend has the same subtle "burnt" aftertaste, with a hint of vanilla that is just right- not too faint and not too pronounced.  For those who don't usually care for flavored coffees, it might be a nice change.

I thought this was going to be garbage - I feared it would be harsh and watery and have that fake-vanilla flavor you get with these kinds of things.Not at all.  This was a nice mild vanilla flavored coffee.  Starbucks tends to be harsh and watery when brewed at home.  But this wasn't - I was impressed.  Everyone else really liked it too - raved about it, actually.

I thought this coffee would taste a lot better than it did.  Maybe it would taste better with an expensive brewer.  Mine is not the most expensive but far from being the least expensive.  I wouldn't buy this coffee; the Yuban I buy has a lot better taste.

column9: Nice product as flavored coffees go.
column10: First off, I think it's fair I mention that I'm not a big flavored-coffee fan. That said, I did enjoy this product more than I thought I would. I chose it as a change of pace over my usual dark roasted plain coffees. The vanilla flavoring is subtle, natural-tasting, and doesn't leave much of an after taste as many flavored coffees do.
