But by now they know me, and they know my reviews and they're just wonderfully kind to me. When I received my package yesterday, I found a little matcha spoon included with my order! I don't know if it's a promotion I just didn't see, or if it was for me specially, but it certainly made my day!I don't know an awful lot about English toffee, but what I do know, I like. I got this one to try with my wife, in an effort to get her to like matcha. We'll see how it goes!When I opened the package, it smelled a lot like the Caramel Matcha from Red Leaf Tea, which is very promising. I love their Caramel matcha. Brewed up, it still smelled like caramel, but with a hint of chocolate. And that's exactly what it tastes like, caramel mixed together with tasty, tasty chocolate. I'm not a huge chocolate fan, but this is very, very good. Very sweet too, but not overwhelmingly so. But then again, I like my teas sweet. But when I see pictures of English Toffee, this is what I think it would taste like, so yay! I love that it even tastes like that crunchy caramel....mmm. This would be a very good starter matcha for those who like sweet things, English Toffee especially. I might even win my wife over with this one!
Fruits are so expensive now.  Even going to the Grocer each day is not enough to be ableto ensure every item is eaten and utilized.  This product is wonderful.

I purchased this tea to make iced tea and found it to be extremely weak in comparison to similar teas from other brands.  My recipe calls for 12 teaspoons of tea.  I used 18 teaspoons of this one and it was still much too weak to really enjoy.Davidson's has some great teas, but this isn't one of them.

Since this is organic, they water decaffeinate it.  This means that instead of using high pressure C02 they use water.  This removes some of the flavor from the leaves but allows it to be organic.  C02 is not harmful, but the process is no longer organic.  There are other methods of chemically removing the caffeine, but those are considered a bit risky to longer term health.This tea is okay.  I would not expect the flavor from the English breakfast with caffeine.  If you are interested you should look up how to decaffeinate your own tea with water on Youtube.  You'll understand how the tea gets this way.As someone who has to worry about blood pressure genetically I watch my caffeine intake closely.  If you are a big tea person though stick to the stuff with caffeine and decaf it yourself.

I bought this product as I desired a decaffinated English Breakfast tea. I have found that unless it is brewed twice or a lot of tea leaves are used, it is a very weak tea. I would not recommend it for someone who wants a full bodied tea.
This is one of the best decaf teas I've tried. Most of them have no flavor, but this one is almost as good as the caffeinated black tea.

Some reviewers were upset because they had to use a lot of tea (more than with full-caf) to get the strength they like. I did not have that problem because that's what I expect with decaffeinated teas. It took me a few tries to figure out how much tea to use and how long to let is steep, to get my perfect brew, but once I did, I have not been disappointed.A super delicious concoction I made with this tea also contained rose petals, vanilla, honey, and cream.
Someone gave me an iced tea maker. I like decaf tea and was not able to find reasonably priced loose decaf tea locally. This is a great product with a lot more flavor than you get brewing tea bags.

column9: A little on the weak side but good taste and good value
column10: We bought this tea as an everyday breakfast decaf and are happy with the purchase. Like other reviewers have reported, it needs an extra scoop compared to other decafs we have tried but once that is dialed in it makes a decent cup.Definitely a good value compared to individual bags.

column9: Quality: 5 stars; Price: 1 star; Average: 3 stars
column10: My picky friends and I all agree that this is close to the ultimate in chocolate . . .. . . BUT . . .. . . at the current (9 April 2010) tarriff of $7.99 for ONE BAR (plus shipping on orders uder $25), we'll continue buying it at local supermarkets (and even at the store everyone loves to hate) for $2.18 or a bit more; sometimes less on sale.Amazon, I ADORE you -- you often have excellent prices, your web site is the best, and nothing has ever gone awry with anything from you, so I buy lots of food here in addition to DVDs, CDs, techie toys, clothes, garden & kitchen stuff, and, yes, books, but surely you can find a more reasonably-priced source!

Cheap enough to buy for yourself, nice enough to give as a little gift.  Almond slivers and orange pieces in the chocolate make it unique and delicious, it's my favorite orange chocolate out there, and I have searched for these-- nothing beats it (so far)

column9: Great every day chocolate avail at my drugstore
column10: This isn't what I'd consider a premium chocolate like Godiva, but I like the intense orange flavor and the fact that I can buy it at my local drugstore on a whim. I keep it in the refrigerator and enjoy a piece a couple of times a week.

column9: Great product, but this is not the place to buy them!!!
column10: Great chocolate with orange flavor!  However, these are regularly priced at mylocal Rite Aid for $2.99 a bar (3.5 ounces) and often on sale for $1.99!!!

I've never been a dark chocolate fan, I need either the extreme sweetness of milk or some other intense flavors to catch my interest. This one does the latter. Very, very tasty with a few different flavor notes. Great for your chocolate stash... I picked mine up at Walgreens.
Everyone liked this cheese.  The horseradish taste was not overly strong like I thought it might be.  I was surprised at how much I was charged for shipping, but the cheese itself was very good.
This is a great way to sample a few teas without committing to large quantities.  I am very pleased with my purchase and highly recommend to others.

We have always liked these Australian-made corn crackers (I am from Australia and used to enjoy them there also). They are somewhat like rice cakes, but thinner, and obviously made out of corn. They are about half the thickness of your average rice cake and in my opinion, much tastier. They are great as a snack by themselves, our 3 year old daughter loves them, or with cheese or spreads. As long as you close the bag after use, the pack will keep fresh for a few weeks after opening.

Extremely tasty bread/toast substitute.  For Breakfast, butter and jam;for lunch, P & J or mayonaise and mustard and favorite meat.  Or Cheese.For all you Celiacs, this is heaven on earth!Real Foods Organic Corn Thins, Original Flavor, Wheat-Free, 5.3-Ounce Bag (Pack of 12)

It's tough to find a snack item that is(a) organic(b) low sodium(c) in BPA-free packaging(d) preservative free(e) not sourced in China, and last but not least,(f) tastes greatbut these are definitely it! (or maybe that should be "these are them" or "this is it"... whatever. LOL)I have always gagged on rice cakes (aka flat styrofoam hockey pucks) but when I first tried these I knew I'd found what I needed for topping with my homemade hummus, dips, spreads, nut butters ... you name it, these work great with it. And also just plain, because the pure corn taste is great all on its own. Obviously I buy them by the case. My only local brick-and-mortar source for these is Whole Foods (which is a 30-minute drive each direction, so not as "local" as I'd like) and the online price is better especially with free shipping.I continue to be extremely impressed with the quality of Australian products, by the way. In addition to these Corn Thins (made in the Sydney area) I also regularly buy hair and skin care products, crystallized ginger, and vanilla syrup -- all made Down Under. The Corn Thins were my first discovered and still the most used of my Aussie faves, however!

Make a ham & egg muffin using two of them.  Light miricle whip on both.  While hard frying an egg put a piece of fat free cheese on one and microwave for 5 sec.  Put it all together with or without a slice of ham. Salt & Pepper to taste.  The warm egg and cheese will warm up the thin slice of ham.Enjoy.

These thins are so versatile. I love them with both sweet and salty toppings. A great way to top these is with all natural peanut butter, banana slices, and organic agave nectar. It makes a filling snack. On the opposite spectrum, spread a thin layer of cream cheese across, then top with fresh, organic tomatoes, and spice as desired (you can make it Italian, Mexican, etc). These are delicious plain, dipped into soup, or crumbled onto a salad. I am thrilled there is a gluten free, non GMO food out there that is delicious and flexible. I highly recommend these for everyone, allergies, special food needs, or not. You will not regret it.

column9: Good toasted with melted cheese, but EXP date might be too soon
column10: OK, so it isn't exactly as good as grilled cheese, but melting a slice of cheese on one of these crispy discs in the microwave is close enough for me, plus no need for fattening butter. The "thins" are about a quarter-inch thick (maybe a little less), not too thick and not too thin.  They offer a multitude of options for quick GF meals, perfect for someone like me who typically eats several 1-course small meals throughout the day vs. 3 large multi-course ones.  The taste is very mild, relying on whatever you put on them to add 95% of the flavor.  By the way, they are called Corn Thins, but technically they are made out of "popped corn"; so they are a little puffy, sort of like rice cakes but thinner and crispier.My batch just arrived with an expiration date of October 2010, which is a tight time frame but because these are so versatile, I think I can manage finishing them by then.UPDATE (Feb. 2010) The last two unfinished packages were stale by the end of August.  In spite of the inner foil liners, they didn't make it to the specified EXP date and I ended up throwing those two away.  Because the bulk quantity is so high (6 would make more sense) I'm afraid I won't be buying this again; I just can't finish them in time.
I love this product because it can be eaten a with a sweet or salty topping and it is just great!

Corn thins are a blessing to my husband and myself.  We are currently on the Let's do Lunch eating plan.  They are such a welcome addition to this plan.  They can be used in place of bread.  We use them for breakfast with eggs, or lunch as an open face sandwich or dinner with soup as crackers.

These are a great substitute for bread if you are living gluten-free. I eat them nearly every day for lunch. Very tasty, esp as a part of a makeshift sandwich in lieu of bread. My 5-yr-old daughter loves them; she calls them popcorn cakes.
Better than rice cakes. Low calorie count adds substance to meals or snacks.in addition has great taste.unfortunately,cannot be a substitute for rye bread with corned beef
this an an excellent, tasty whole grain food. i checked around the web and found it for $2.99 a bag. i buy 10 bags at a time, so it's free ship.
These corn thins are great with egg salad spread on them.  Can't use all of them by expiration date? - Put the packages in the freezer.  They keep very well.
Gluten free corn thins are incredibly tasty and low in calories. They are a good replacement for bread or any crackers.

Bought a case (when I could get free shipping.) Buy them now in a major retailer who is located nearby. With a thin slice of cheese, or smear of almond butter--definitely a good energy boost for those of us who need that.

Real Food Organic Corn Thins are great tasting !They go perfect with "Let's Do Lunch's healthy eatingprogram. Their are so many ways to eat them. I like them plainor with honey spread on them for a snack. Melt low fat cheese on them ,then add a slice of fresh tomato and basil. I put them in the food processor or Ninja and make flour out of them.The flour makes great pancakes! There is endless ways to use them. Real Foods Organic Corn Thins, Original Flavor, 5.3-Ounce Bag (Pack of 12)
these snacks are delicious and very filling.  They help me maintain my weight and not seek fattening items.
This is a very good thin corn rice cake- while it may seem like a big order, you will be surprised how quickly you can down a bag of these.  Also a good low cal treat for canines.
I am so glad I bought these in bulk. They are addicting, especially with Justin's nut butter on them! Soooo good!! I love the fact that they are NON GMO too!

This product came recommended in the "Let's Do Lunch" book as a more tasty alternative to rice cakes.  I would have to agree.  Makes a wonderful substitute for tortilla chips. I can now enjoy my chips and salsa and not feel guilty!

Original Cornthins are wonderful for satisfaction as cracker and bread substitute.  Let's Do Lunch helped me to lose needed pounds, and the cornthins helped me to stay on the plan.  I would not want to do without them.

My husband is a celiac and has eaten rice cakes for years as a bread substitute. We came across these and with all the good reviews figured it would be worth a try. So very glad we did! They are MUCH thinner than rice cakes like 1/4 in thick and IMO much better tasting. I find myself eating them too and I dont even have to lol. If you or someone in your family has to eat gluten free get these you will be glad you did.
Simple, yet super tasty, it's good as is or with a flavorful spread. It's quite great with some raw almond butter and fruit juice-sweetened fruit spread!
This product fits the bill for the Lets Do Lunch diet plan.  Plus it taste good enough to eat.

Corn thins are the best subsitute for cracker and bread products. They are good just for snacking on and excellent for adding refried beans, tuna salad, chicken salad etc.  They are low in calories and it is popcorn which is very healthy for you.  It is a good carb.I don't go anywhere without my Corn Thins.  A sleeve of them are in my car at all times so if I am eating out I have something to go along with my meal.Donna
The taste is much better than the Wasa crispbreads that are in the LDL diet, I eat them with meat as a sandwich and crumble them in soups in place of crackers. Will definately buy more.

column9: This was everything I was hoping for
column10: I didn't want a run-of-the mill popcorn cake, and this isn't one of those. It's more corn tortilla-like, perfect for topping with taco salad or salsa. I'll definitely keep these around!

I have been eating these for years. They are fabulous! Less crumbly and airy than rice cakes, plus fewer calories. Scrumptious with butter, the best cracker for tuna salad, and wonderful with peanut butter. Perfect for the gluten intolerant, which I am.

While reading "How to do Lunch"  I learned of the corn thins and where to order them.  I must say that they are so much better than I guessed they would be.  I have now ordered the second box.  Thank you for carring these.

Great product.  This snack does not have a blah flavor, but actually taste like popcorn.  Put a little calorie free butter spray, diet cheese,low fat cream cheese, or even a deli type lunch meat on it and you have the perfect low calorie snack that is better for you than the candy bar you grab most of the time.  Great addition to any diet to save calories and loose wieght.
These are the only cracker/bread allowed on the Lets Do Lunch (Live)t...not (Die)T. They are wonderful.

column9: great stuff, i can't believe it!!!
column10: I bought this for the "let's do lunch" diet, and I love these. What a great product and very tasty!  This is a good substitute for bread, and my husband really likes them too!!! thanks !
I got these to eat healthier. They taste great with fat-free cheese or sugar-free jam.

column9: Severely allergic son gives two itchy thumbs up!
column10: My darling ten month old son is so severely allergic to MANY things including gluten, dairy, soy, nuts, peas, etc... Because I am nursing him, I have been desperately trying to keep up diet-wise with his restrictions.  When you are used to tasty meals and gourmet cooking, this lifestyle change (by force, I might add) is about trying to trick your brain into thinking cardboard tastes good... ie: rice crackers... yuck!  Oh but my delight in discovering Corn Thins!  I think I heard the hallelujah chorus when I tried my first bite and actually loved it!  It is a fraction in thickness of a rice cracker, far more flavourful and comes in a scrumptious variety of wholesome flavours.  And I can actually feed it to my son who LOVES them!  It is our bread substitute so we enjoy it with Sunbutter and honey or avocado & mango, etc... Hopefully you'll enjoy it as much as we have.  Who knew healthy could finally taste so good!

Ole Cape Cod Oyster Crackers are the best that I have ever tasted.  What makes them even better is that they are truly "all natural."  Most products have hidden preservatives and additives and claim to be natural but not with Ole Cape Cod Oyster Crackers.  They are definitely all natural.  I know because they don't trigger my migraines.  To top it all off, these crackers are delicious tasting.  I would not purchase any other kind but these.  I highly recommend this product to everyone.

I picked up the Red Ice Tea / Peach Mix in a 4 variety pack of teas.  This stuff is real good and well worth the price.The best thing about the Totally Light Tea2Go mixes are the health factors - ZERO calories, Sugar free, and 1 16oz glass of Tea2Go gets you 100% of the required daily vitamin C.All the Tea2Go flavors are great, but the Red Tea Antioxidant Peach is the best - Delicious!
100% vitamin C with every glass!  Tastes fantastic!  I've tried every sugar-free peach-flavored tea I could find, and hands-down, this one has the best flavor!  Made with Splenda, not aspartame, too!

I order these for my mom. She loves peach flavored drinks (juices) but was diagnosed for diabetes this year. This is a great deal for what your get. The flavor of the sugar free product is good and it gives her a great way to enjoy her peach tea. Just make sure you order from Amazon as other vendors charge 41 dollars or more for the same 4 canisters that Amazon charges 16-20 dollars for.

Beans not so readily available in regular supermarkets, these are quite good -- not standard large limas, but actual butter beans.  The seasoning packet is strong, and half of it per package of beans was fine for me.

I suppose I may be fussy, but this jam just didn't impress me. It's too sweet and seems to lack the tart 'kick' one expects from eating pineapple.  I suppose I'll just have to go back to making my own.
This is exactly what I needed...or rather my daughter did.  She lives in Switzerland and LONGED for decent decaf.  We were delighted to find it online.
This is one of the best decaffeinated coffees out there, specially to make espressos.I had served this at home after dinners and nobody could tell that it is decaf, they love it.
Wal Mart has this stuff at $3.99 per twelve pack; this price equals $12.50 for twelve. What's up with that??
I agree with the first reviewer.  I can get the same 12-pack from a local grocery for under $3.00.  This is a rip-off, pure and simple.

If you're getting this for cleaning your teeth then it's pretty good. But I'd recommend a different flavor. This doesn't last longer than three minutes. But it does clean teeth in between brushing pretty well.

I do not like to chew gum and can't chew it too long without getting tmj symptoms, new gums have flavors that last well beyond my tolerance. This gum is harder to chew, but somehow I don't get tmj symptoms. I like the way it makes my teeth feel like they've been polished! I buy it in bulk and leave it my car.

I have been using Xylitol for a year now. I am not Diabetic nor am I overweight. I just simply don't like to consume all that sugar. What makes this product bad is not the Xylitol, Its the Stevia component. The Stevia completely hijacks the sweetener to the point you can't taste anything else, not even your coffee.So it comes down to this, If you enjoy Stevia then buy this product. If you have never tried Stevia and your looking for Xylitol then look somewere else. Or atleast go to your local natural foods store and test run Stevia.I on the other hand have three boxes of this that I can't seem to move as quickly.

my dog is hospitalized with severe hypoglycemia and with poor prospects of survival.  One of the biggest causes of this in pets is food with Xylitol in it.  It is lethal if ingested.  If you want to use this please be careful you keep it away from pets. It is in loads of sugarless gums as well.
This wine is so tasty, sweet and smooth!  It's definitely a dessert wine, and would go GREAT with chocolate or cheesecake.

column4: Colleen "If it's not fun, what's the point?"
column10: I could not find the mix for the Chappli Kabab here on amazon.com, so I wrote my review for this instead.  I live in a remote area of the wild west Rocky Mountains where Indian or Pakistani cuisine is completely non-existent in the form of a restaurant.  Purchasing a cookbook online, even our grocery stores don't sell the spices needed to create such dishes.I met a Pakistani woman on a flight from LA who introduced me to these Shan mixes.  She said they are very authentic, spicy.  All you need to add is the meat/vegies.  The instructions are printed in English on the back of the box and are easy to follow.  She sent me some and I tried them.  They are delicious.  And yes, SPICY!!!!  I was afraid to use the whole packet of spice for my chappli kabab, so I used 2/3's of it.  Even that much was alomst too spicy.  The flavor was magnificent.

column9: purrrfect for the fresh pot of Joe
column10: This is just the right size to take along and make when spending the night away, travel or friends and to work! I love it.

I add this apple flavoring to the secondary fermentation of my cider.  I'd have to look at my notes to be sure but I think I add 1/4 tsp per gallon of cider.  So far everyone has liked the taste of my cider so this must contribute to the broadly positive feedback.  I will continue to experiment with what is too much but for now the amount stated works pretty well. Ok bye.

I use this to add a little more flavor to my home made hard apple cider.  A little goes a long way! I put a half tablespoon per gallon of cider.  I put it in, along with a little alcohol sugar (erythritol), just before bottling.  It makes my cider taste a lot better.

Great ... gentle Morel flavor ... not an overwhelming flavor like garlic or onions. ... Morel flavor ... conveniently ... on most any dish ... my family and I love it ... and will keep it stocked on our table. Even better when heated or on hot foods! We added the Soup, Sauce, and Gravy MorelOilla to mushroom soup just before serving ... WOW!

My family and I have been morel hunters for years.  We live in Iowa not far from the published address for FRESHMORELS.  I was excited when I stumbled on this product and the web site touted it as having "three times as much morel flavor as the actual mushroom".  I ordered one bottle of every type they offer. I prepared the food as advised on their website. The first bottle was awful.  There was not a hint of morel flavor and the oil tasted just this side of rancid.  I tried every single bottle hoping the previous bottles were anomalies.  They were all bad.  Then I noticed that the "ENJOY BY 12/01/12" was actually a little sticker that had been added over the label.  Underneath was something that had been scribbled over with a black marker.  I removed the marker with alcohol and revealed an expiration date in AUGUST 2009. I checked the other bottles...ditto.  An email to Freshmorels produced a response claiming that the original expiration date was a "printing error"...uh huh.
Just needs a bit more rhubarb. Overall it is very tasty and we really like the jams from this company (especially the marion berry).

I am originally from Belarus and I used to cook tons of buckwheat in my live.That buckwheat is something different from my idea of regular buckwheat. The grains are smaller, lighter in color, not toasted enough and when done it has bland scent not the full body aroma I remember. It cooks 2 times faster than original one-about 12 min., rather than 25min. and you need extra care if you want it flaky rather than sticky.Here is some advices if you want have it close to my idea of original buckwheat:1. Toast it in the pan or skillet with some butter over the medium heat for 2-3 min.(better to use a shallow pan than a deep one)2.  Add salt, boiling water (2.2-2.5 parts of water to 1 part of gloats)3. Lower the heat to just simmering and top tightly with the lid and cook until all water get soaked(do not stir-it breaks the grains)4. Put it aside for extra 5 min.

If you have never tried this product with an interesting name...do so.  I had it on a recent trip to Moscow, Russia and immediately searched for it once I returned to the USA.  It is a very tasy and versatile food.  I have it for breakfast, cold with spices, chopped veggies and mayo as a salad and reheated with veggies and pasta for a quick snack or light meal.

A lot of foods make me tired or make me feel 'off' after I eat them.  This is the exception--I feel good after eating buckwheat groats both right after and hours later, so I suspect it's good for me. :)  It tastes mildly nutty. I eat it with bananas and other fruit mixed in.  If you're looking for a healthy new cereal to try, give this one a shot.

column9: not what i was looking for
column10: Coming from Russia, buckweat kasha was something I wanted to have once in while here; I bought it before in the russian district. This one looks great in the package but cooks too fast and becomes all starchy and looses its taste. I threw the whole pot out. Now don't know what to do with all other packages.

Arrowhead Mills Organic Buckwheat Groats are a high quality whole-grain product.  This is my preferred brand for organic whole-grains, and I have never been disappointed over many years of use.  These groats are consistently clean and easy to prepare, and they taste delicious as well as being nutritious.
I use this cereal in a breakfast mixture that reduces cholesterol and cleanses the colon.  It helps to give me energy also.  Sweeten with stevia.  The stores were out of it so I got plenty on Amazon.

When i received this product i was very disappointed. The product was spoiled and old. I ordered several packages and after i opened one i contacted the seller and wanted to returned the other unopened and it was not possible.I am not recommend to any one to buy this product.

I am Russian and was looking for the traditional russian buckwheat. These look right at the first glance, but nothing like what I expected when cooked - the kasha comes out almost a mashed potato like consistency, with most of the groats sticking together and tasting nothing like a normal buckwheat kasha. Perhaps the groats are somewhat polished and their skins are partially missing, resulting it faster cooking time and lumping together? I have not tried the Belarussian advice of toasting it for extra 2-3 minutes, but if that does not work, I'll have to throw it all away :-(

column9: Kasha As Good As You Cook It!
column10: Kasha is can be a tricky product to cook and requires an extra step if you want it flaky, not mushy.  Many people, especially in Russian-speaking countries, eat kasha as a hot cereal for breakfast.  In that case you simply cook it 1 part kasha to 2 parts liquid with some butter and it will get to the consistency of thick oatmeal.  To serve it as a side dish say as classic Kasha Varnishkas (Bow tie Noodles), you need to first mix each cup of kasha with a beaten egg and toast it in a dry skillet until grains are all separated and browned. Cook them as you would with 2 parts liquid and whatever seasoning and vegetables you desire for PERFECT kasha.

column9: If you tried Russian buckwheat - you won't like this one!
column10: I am originally from Russia and my husband is from Argentina. Both of us didn't like this brand at all - it didn't get that consistency that Russian buckwheat has.  These groats come out like mashed potato. It is too light color. I tried to roast it - I got it a little brownish but the taste didn't come back. Who has tried buckwheat from Eastern Europe (Ukraine, Russia, Belorussia) would know that buckwheat has nice smell - before you cook it and after. This one smelled strange.After I cooked whole package and we didn't like it - our dogs didn't want to eat it too. I had to add their soft food so they would eat.Probably it makes a big difference how buckwheat was raised and where. Also how it was processed. Something is missing in this one. Still looking for Russian product.By the way, some my friends who tried it the first time liked it a lot. So it could be good for you also if you don't know the best.

column9: Stay away, or I wish I had listened to bad reviews.
column10: This product is very poor quality, it cooks into a hummus-like mass in the first 2 minutes of boiling, while about 10% of the grains end up undercooked by the end of the process. This can only be a result of a wrong processing and/or storing of buckwheat.Buckwheat is supposed to cook as a grain, preserving individual grains by the end of cooking time (like quinoa or rice) and not get mushy.in addition to mushiness and inconsistency (=large variance in how much time different individual grains take to cook), it has a flavor of burnt oil, which, again, means it was not prepared properly.I don't know what to do: I paid $20 just to have to throw away the entire thing that I cooked and to have 3,5 packs of unusable buckwheat sit in my pantry.I am appalled that Amazon would carry such a poor quality product and I urge you to stay away (and maybe head to your local Russian store to get some proper buckwheat).
As soon as I am finished eating with my first order of buckwheat from Arrowheadmills, I will order this buckwheat again. This is a high quality product, and very tasty.

This is Kasha, for those of Eastern European genealogy.  Back there they cooked it with eggs and pasta.I leave out the eggs and my wife calls it Kashta.  Great nutrition, a bit expensive--nowhere near meat, and  easy to prepare. For breakfast, quicker than some oats!  I'm looking forward to discovering the proper recipe to make it absolutely scrumptious to a picky vegan.Soy sauce or salt substitutes are good, but it needs more.  I've tried adding celery, onions, and carrots and ok, but something is lacking.  Still, filling and nutritious with pasta, and you can always add salsa.  Worth experimenting with and Arrowhead is a great company.I can get this locally, but at a higher price than from Amazon including shipping.

I am from Ukraine.I cooked buckwheat there for a 30 years. This one was horrible. As soon as I put it in the boiled water it was broken and had look as prepared oatmeal.I always boiled it 10-15 minutes before, but this one I have to use only for soups, not for kasha. I am very dissapointed with it.

An Irish friend turned me on to this tea a year-and-a-half ago after Thanksgiving dinner, and I have been drinking it ever since.  Other teas don't measure up in my book.  It is a full-bodied, flavorful tea.

I've always enjoyed a cup of tea, but after spending part of the summer of 2007 in Ireland I came home searching out that wonderful blend that is offered whenever you enter someone's home.  "Cup of tea?  Would you like a cup of tea?" Everywhere you went, that is what you drank.  I came home looking for the tea that would remind me of Ireland.  I found it in Barry's Irish Breakfast Tea and Barry's Gold Blend.  It is fabulous!
I love Barry's teas as I use big glass mugs at least 12 oz, and it's always just the right color and taste. :-)

I like a strong dark tea, with the amazon price this is the one to buy. I no longer need two bags and still get a strong cup of tea. This is the reason I enjoy this constantly good tasting tea, to jump start my day at any time.

This is quality tea blend with an excellent taste for the true Irish Breakfast Tea lover.  We had been buying the Taylors of Harrogate Irish Breakfast Tea, which is also an excellent blend.  However, Barry's gives you much more tea for less (80 bag boxes versus ToH 50 bag boxes).  The quality/taste is excellent, and the price makes it even better.

I usually have trouble with the acid in coffee, and have had to limit myself to only one cup in the morning. This coffee is so smooth and doesn't upset my stomach at all! I can drink all day if I want. And Deeelish!
Great coffee for the price! Rich and full without being bitter, will continue to be my regular coffee getting ready to re-order.

These are really very tasty peppercorns. They are difficult to grind in a pepper grinder..or at least my grinder.  They are pretty delicate peppercorns but well worth purchasing if you enjoy that special nutty pepper taste!

column9: My favorite pepper in the world
column10: If you're a big fan of pepper, then try this out. I absolutely love it. It's a bit pricey compared to normal pepper but the flavor is so wonderful.
Love this stuff! But, it's way overpriced here. It's  $6.84 at my local Sam's "BIG BOX" cub. About 1/3 of whatCandyStore wants for it.

column9: Love the product, not the price...
column10: I agree with the previous review about the price...but I'll 5 star it because the product itself is good.  However, you can buy it through sams online for $7.65...so even living in the middle of nowhere, you can find it cheaper online...
This cereal taste is good has all the rightingredients, can be a snack.They finally have a winner for morning,good job

Alright, I'll preface by saying that I have not had the pricing or expiration (not that I would notice) issues that some of the other reviewers have faced.  I prefer the 3-pack. I get them every 3 months and the price has always been between 6.50 and 8.50. This is a tremendous bargain. One of these boxes at Duane Reade costs $4.99+. I would probably get it delivered more than once every 3 months if I ate breakfast more.This is by far my favorite cereal, and while I may sound like a child, I'm 27. Since you're curious, the other members of the Cereal Rushmore are:Cinnamon Toast CrunchFrosted FlakesCorn PopsHonorable Mention: Lucky CharmsBoom, done.
Please send me $10 back.  This is way over priced.  Shame on them!!  I will not get any shame on me for a second order.  RIPOFF ALERT.

Maybe it depends where you buy this coffee, but my shipment of 80 Kcups from Amazon was pretty stale, flat and weak.  I've had GM Nantucket Blend elsewhere before and it was delicious, not so with this order.

column9: Brown rice that actually tastes good
column10: I never liked eating brown rice growing up even though my parents tried it for quite some time.  I looked and tried several different brown rice brands before sticking with this brand a few years ago.Some of my friends that brown rice takes a lot longer time to cook.  Well, this brand allows me to cook with white rice setting in a rice cooker.  The only adjustment that I have to do is to use 1.25 cup of water for every cup of rice.  I do like my rice to be separated, so I add 1 tablespoon of olive oil.  With this method, the rice always comes up good and chewy.

I do not need to put salt in this rice at all. This is very good quality and it tastes great.  We have been eating White Basmati  rice and were spoiled to it fragrant aroma and delicious taste; so we were skeptical when we were encouraged to eat natural brown rice for health benefits. After cooking this and with the unison approval of my young children we are going to be eating Nishiki Brown Rice for the foreseeable future!  Nice Rice, indeed!

I ordered this rice, willing to take a chance, and it turned out be the best brown rice Ive ever eaten or made.I have a rice maker that I have been using to make texmati rice and it was always ok, but the Nishiki rice cooks flawlessly.  Just set the rice maker to brown rice add the rice and fill with water to brown rice line and let it do its thing.(no rinsing or soaking etc.)  The rice comes out perfect!!  The texture of the rice is "meaty" it has substance without being cruchy or undercooked.  The taste is somewhat "nutty and rich".  If your on the fence try it I believe youll be happy.

Excellent quality rice. This rice is especially good for those who are iffy on the taste of brown rice as this rice has a much milder flavor profile. The whole family enjoys this rice.  Admittedly, I purchased this rice from an Asian market for less than $20 and do not plan on ordering from Amazon. But if you don't live close to an ethnic market and want a high quality, mild tasting brown rice, this is your brand.

column9: Oh, finally some brown rice I can eat daily
column10: I've been buying small amounts of brown rice at all the health food stores in Denver, my new home. Prices range from expensive to ridiculous; I've had stores order special types in for me to try.I don't know why I took a chance on buying a bag this large, but since I eat only steel-cut oats and brown rice as grains I will be using a lot of it.I'm very glad that I did. This rice has a great smell while it's cooking, I put it in my Zojirushi cooker and it didn't take all that long to have perfect rice.I use this rice in a variety of ways, even putting honey in it and using it as a breakfast cereal. My palate is undoubtedly weird, but I don't care, my diet has saved my life.As I will be eating this rice nearly every day, I'm very pleased with the price and thrilled with the flavor and texture.

column9: Nice not having to lug in the stores~
column10: I love being able to find a LARGE bag of short grain brown rice here on Amazon!  I love knowing that I do not have to lug it around and pick it up and more it so many times.  It is delivered to my door and I put it in my container right away.  No fuss no muss!  So hard to find large bags of rice for my Filipino husband and NOT have to have a BIG BOX store membership in order to get it!
Nishili is very good brand and the brown rice's quality is good. we love it and will continue to order it.

column9: Great flavor, but not for sushi.
column10: This rice has a wonderful flavor and texture. However, in the description it said it was great for sushi. Do not be fooled. Short grain rice makes the best sushi as it stays together very well.Though when cooked properly this medium-grain rice is STICKIER than the long grain variety, you may have difficulty trying to make any recipe where it is necessary for the rice to stick together.If you like rice to be somewhere between sticky and separated, then this is perfect for you. If you're looking for a good brown sticky sushi rice, stick with short grain.
I sprout this rice and it always turns out delicious. It's semi sweet and has a very nice texture. My favorite :)

Ofcourse we all know brown rice is healthier than white rice, and im eating this now because ive gone on a stricter diet to lose fat and build some muscle...so i bought this rice. I dont know how or what brown rice is supposed to taste like but this rice is pretty much flavorless (reason for 4 stars) the other reviewers say its quite good and flavorful but honestly its really not. But id rather have flavorless rice than nasty tasting rice. I have no problem eating it at all. Its healthy and it does not taste bad. Also as a final note, it does take a bit longer to cook than white rice, i dont why but it does and its not THAT much longer though. I very much recommend this rice. If your looking for some good healthy brown rice, this is a good one. If your looking for some flavorfull brown rice, this isnt it, but it doesnt taste bad though.
Shipped on next day. WOW!!!!!The product seems very fresh. I cooked the rice right away.Taste was very very good!Thank you....
Best brown rice i ever had! Although its a bit pricey compared to the other brown rice. I will buy this again!

column9: Every bit as good as white rice and healthier for you.
column10: We couldn't find bulk brown rice in stores from this brand (we really liked Nishiki white rice) so of course we checked Amazon and they had it.It's every bit as good as white rice and is more filling.  We usually use it in stir fry and can't really taste the difference between white rice.Eaten plain, you can tell there is a slightly different texture and a very slight "nutty" aftertaste which you can't detect if you add any kind of meat/sauce to the rice. It's still really good.

column9: Not as good as the Yoga organic one
column10: It is not as good as the Yoga Organic brown rice we usually have, Yoga is more tasty and cooks faster. This one takes longer(lonnnnng) to cook. But considering the price, it is ok. Still would prefer spending couple more bucks and buy the Yoga one...
It was just rice.  Nothing special.  I just wanted to order it online because I didn't feel like going to the store.  It is also difficult to find large bags of brown rice.

column9: The Way Things Should Be Made...
column10: This knife/cutting board combo is awesome.  Not only is it beautiful (red alder with maple and walnut accent), it's amazingly functional!Knife stashes in the board when not in use, board leans nicely against counter backsplash.When ready to use, simply pull the knife from the indentation, plop your fresh bread onto the board and slice away.  The knife is sharp, long, and simple to use.  Thick or thin, all slices look like professional cuts.When you're finished, dust the crumbs off the board, place the knife in it's holder, and replace it against the backsplash.  Looks good and works great!

This cutting board and knife product are really great.  The knife is very sharp and allows for very thin cuts.  Perfect for breadmaker breads. The storage area for the knife is even better.  Love it & thinking abour buying as gifts for my family members that bake their own bread.
This is the perfect slicer for homemade breads. The only slicer that we have found that doesn't crush a warm loaf fresh out of our bread maker.

column9: Lovely board, but no guides - I need guides
column10: This board and slicer came up in my search for bread slicing guides, and looked wonderful so I wanted to believe it would be a more solid replacement for our second Norpro slicing guide, which is perfect, but not very durable. It turns out that the stripe in the picture that looks as if it might be a guide, isn't. For those of you who are handy enough to cut straight pieces of bread without help, then this is probably a wonderful set, but in our house we need those guides to go by or the pieces come out all lopsided, so I will need to return this and keep looking. I'm giving it 4 stars as a compromise, although it's probably worth 5 for you talented folks who don't need the guides, and 3 or less for those of us who do.

This is a very good quality board and slicer for the price & the knife cuts well and nicely stored right on the board. I may be being a little bit picky to expect it a little wider or w/grooves to catch some of the crumbs-but that comes w/bread!Highly recommend

This version of a bread board and slicer is very cheaply made.  The knife is especially cheaply made.  I have one that I bought some years ago that is all solid wood.  This is made of plastic and wood pulps.  The blade is very cheaply made also.  Not happy,

I was looking for a snack cracker that was gluten free and thought I'd try these.  When I first saw the cracker I thought they would be bland and tasteless.  However, because they themselves do not have a strong flavor I have been able to enjoy them with cheese, hummus, cream cheese for lunch, and also with fruit-flavored cream cheeses and jams and jellies.  I had some this morning with my omelet.  This is a really versatile cracker! Wonderful for watching calories, too; no trans fat. Try them; you'll love them, too.

Natural Nectar's Cracklebred original are the best tasting and textured rice crackers I have eaten! They are great in soups, and go great with riccota cheese, peanut butter, or cashewe butter. I think they are just right, not too soft, not too crisp, and just anough flavor to be good.
We have ordered this product two times and the gluten free bread is very good. It is light and tasty and with small pieces of cheese makes and excellent appetizer.

Not a lot to say here -- simply a very satisfying cracker.  The best I have ever tasted.  Very crunchy without being hard on the teeth, goes great with anything (cheese, peanut butter, etc.).  Expensive, but well worth the price.
Not always easy to find gf snacks at the grocery stores all of the time.  Being able to get these from Amazon is really convenient.
Light, tasty, low-calorie. With cheese, prefer them to regular crackers.  A good crunchy snack on their own.  Excellent product in all flavors.

Recently I had a guest in the house with severe gluten allergy. I bought these crackers without any hope of enjoying them, but was surprised to see them disappearing quickly, everyone loved them!Usually products that restrict nutritional items - be it fat, sugar, gluten - charge a big price in the taste department  ;-)Not these - in fact, to enjoy a good cheese, it's much better to have a cracker without too much flavor, just great texture and mouth feel.These will be in our pantry as a regular item - plus, each cracker has only 17 calories!  My kind of treat, hands down!

column9: High Quality for Gluten Free Diet
column10: It is always difficult finding a good cracker when you are on a gluten free diet.  The taste and quality of the Crackebred is excellent.  They are crisp and hold up well with dips.  They don't crumble when you make a small cheeze snack.

column9: Hands down the best coffee I have ever had!
column10: My brother ordered this and told me that I had to try it.  I usually pour a little flavored creamer in my daily coffee but with this coffee I drank it black.  It is velvety smooth and has a rich chocolate after taste.  It really is a treat!  Its worth the price but I would reserve this for when you can really sit back and enjoy your java.  I would love to have it every day but with my budget we have to slum it with 8 o'clock coffee most morning.  To the people at Raven's Brew...keep it up, this is some amazing coffee!

my kids are in 1st grade now, and they do not want to drink from the kindergarten juice box size. It is a rite of passage into their development. Please offer this product and especially the carrot and apple in larger portion servings; even for the adults-please.

column9: This item picture is not what you will receive
column10: Amazon was kind enough to take a return on this item, but what is pictured is not what you will receive.  The picture shows Goya Frijoles Negros Volteados (refried bean paste).  This is a common dish in Guatemala where my family is from; however, what I actually received was Frijoles Negros Refritos (refried beans).  If you have ever eaten frijoles volteados, you will recognize that there is a fairly significant difference.After some research, I have learned that Goya no longer makes frijoles volteados -- apparently, they were selling the Ducal brand in America under the Goya name.  You can now buy the Ducal brand in the U.S. (I believe Ducal is owned by Goya and I think they have been selling it under the Ducal brand in the U.S. for a number of years now).  If you purchase Ducal refried black beans, you will be getting frijoles volteados.  Add some queso seco or sour cream and enjoy!

HERE IS THE STORY OF HOW THE PRODUCT FARED AT MY HOME:My kitties have been eating Fancy Feast for 4 0r 5 years. I get most of their supplies through Subscribe and Save plans through Amazon. However, when I make an outing to Petco, I look around to see what is new in the cat food aisle, browse through the Toy Line, and pick up an odd and end along the way.Once day while visiting my local Petco, I was checking out Fancy Feast to see if they had any new flavors out. Nooooooo! An employee happened along and asked if she could help me. Rather than give her the standard "No thank you," I told her of my delimma. My cats were growing tired of their routine diet. She said the same thing had happend to her, so she had given some of the new ProPlan flavor a try. She found that her kitties loved the fare that came in bites. Neither her cats, nor mine, are fanciers of Pates.So I found several new flavors for my spoiled loved ones and took them home for a try. Salmon and Rice were the first cans I picked out because this flavor is so obviously in bite size form. I also found a Trout entree and one with Beef and Chicken.Pro Plan Trout & Pasta Entree Adult Canned Cat Food in SaucePro Plan Canned Cat Food, Adult Beef and Chicken Entrée (Pack of 24 3 Ounce Cans).I took these offerings home to my kids and they were estatic! Salmon and Rice was a Favorite!!!!!!!!!!They licked their platter clean with no complaints.I have four kitties and they have just seen the vet who says they are all healthy and says their diet seems to be fine.I sat the kitties down and had a long conversation with them about how we should rate this entree. Because the can says it is for Indoor Use, we were hoping that on the days that they had Salmon and Rice, that their "potty smells" would not be so offensive. (Well, they did not really seem all that worried about THEIR SMELLS, but I was hoping). However, there is no change along those lines. Then they collectively pointed out that a Pro Plan Product called Seafood Stew (I cannot find it on Amazon) is their absolute favorite and the Trout is their second favorite.So, after much meowing, batting Dah Bird about, and waltzing off for a potty break, they all collectively agreed on 4 Stars. Having spent 30 minutes in negotiating this very enlightened discusion, all four decided on a nap in their favorite Cat Tree. 80" Cat Furniture Tree Condo House Scratcher Pet FurnitureSo, I was left with the  actual work of writing the review and grading the cat food. I was very temped to give the product 5 stars because my kitties gobble it down and are so healthy, but given the work that they did to make this decision, I will abide by their decision. Four Stars it is! Very good cat food. If your fair haired ones likes his/her meals in bites, and like seafood, then this should be a hit. Perhaps your kitty will give it 5 stars.Thank you from Gabriella, Trinity, Wisdom and Mercy

My cats eat only Pro Plan wet and dry food.They have beautiful, shinny coats and clean, good/healthy teeth, and bright beautiful eyes.At their last exam, the Vet said they are exxtremely healthy, due to a good diet of Pro Plan!

This has been my introduction to malt vinegar on fries. I'm not a ketchup person and I really like fry sauce so I decided to try some of this to see what Brits do. This cost $2 a bottle at WalMart. It was this brand or Heinz and this was 10 cents cheaper! I've used London Pub steak sauce and liked that product.This has good flavor. Kind of a bit sour as vinegar would be. Not overpowing. Gives the fries nice taste. I think I will stick to fry sauce though since it's so yummy!

Great and tasty tuna. Easy to store, easy to carry, and very easy to eat! A full pack runs about 200 calories of mostly protein. This tuna has a smoky, almost BBQ flavor to it and can be eaten on its own (although that's really no fun).If you want to take this tuna to the next level, add (1) cumin, (2) hot sauce, (3) salt/pepper, (4) a dash of paprika/coriander, and (5) chopped scallions and cucumbers. Makes for a very healthy, quick, and tasty lunch.

This stuff is is so awesome that I don't even have to add anything to it. You can eat it straight out of the pouch or put it on some crackers.  I also received the product 4 days after ordering it.  Thanks

column9: I keep lots of tuna packets on hand
column10: Am I preparing for the big one or prefer to eat all my food like a spaceman? No, I just like to not eat a bunch of junk and the smoked tuna pouches tastes good. Throw a little salsa or chipolte mayo, plus celery, onions or carrots to dress it up. Fyi, tuna in pouches is more dense than the canned stuff - which makes for better eating.

Every ding-danged can of this was DENTED TO HELL AND BACK!I was able to open these with a can opener and they were 'okay' but got dang, amazon.com! At least tell your customers you are getting super dented cans when you lower your price on manager's special.I refused to give this product a low rating just for the dents because the product itself is excellent.Pickled jalapeños in a lovely brine with a bit of vegetable oil, vinegar, salt and a wee bit of sugar.Honestly, these have become my favorite pickled peppers now! They are sooooooooo good.These peppers are a product of Mexico.

I bought this rice after trying it once in Hawaii and have left the other ones behind for good. It is a happy medium between brown rice and white rice, has an excellent nutty flavor rather than the stronger one of brown rice or the nothingness of white. The texture is grainy and a bit sticky, it can be used in place of either brown or white rice. I pressure cooked it (4c water/3c rice, two tsp salt and a splash of rice wine) for 18 min. and it comes out perfect every single time.

This is the best in-between rice; it is not a true white or brown rice.The best part is that it is a medium grain rice. It is often called sticky rice. The flavor is rich and the texture is perfect. You can get the health benefits of brown rice without the change in texture.This rice it a favorite at my house!

Love this rice. I grew up with medium grain white rice...then switched to brown trying to watch my weight and then I found Haiga rice. It's a great combination of white and brown and is very easy to digest. The taste is also wonderful!

I describe this rice as a perfect compromise between Brown and White rice.  It retains lots of the nutrients and fiber from the Brown rice, but tastes much more like an excellent White rice, as well as having a short cook time.  It could easily be mistaken for White rice if you see it in a pot.I wish this rice was more common.  The price used to be much cheaper and included free shipping.  If the price ever comes back to around $2/lb. with free shipping, I will buy a few bags more at once.
The rice is delicious and what I wanted, rice without the husk but containing the germ. It came quickly, so thanks.
We received this sauce as part of a gift pack from my mother for Christmas a couple of years ago.  Since then we have tried to find it as it is awesome.

I received this sauce as a gift a while back from a client of mine for my birthday. To be honest i was not expecting much but my wife and I ran out of our usual spaghetti sauce so we decided to use Rossi. We were amazed as it simply taste home made and is delicious!

This breakfast is absolutely delicious, however - it is more along the lines of a snack and not so much a complete breakfast.  For me that doesn't work as I'm on the go with school, work, and a family.  Throw in a bannana or some other protein with this and it becomes complete.  But this is not a 1 stop shop for a complete breakfast.AMAZING FLAVOR!
man i love these little suckers, how did they pack so much flavor into such a lil' bear?

This Healthy Request version of Chunky Chicken Noodle is delicious. It tastes the same as the regular version, which isn't true of all of the varities of Healthy Request soup. Before I start to warm the soup. I add a package of Ramen noodles, without the flavoring packet. The Ramen noodles absorb the chicken flavor of the liquid for a great taste. And makes for an inexpensive, and filling, complete meal that is quick and easy to prepare. With much less salt than the regular version.
Loved it til I saw the recent price increase.  Subscription price goes from $16 to $30.  Are you kidding me? I'm outta here.

column9: Converting a healthy choice into an unhealthy feast
column10: Being a senior citizen and all, I know how to stretch a buck here and there. If I don't, I go hungry, or at the very least have to see if Meals on Wheels has a few TV dinners to spare. When Campbell's chunky soups hit around a buck fifty or so, I start stocking the pantry.This soup is supposed to be healthy. I don't actually pay much attention to that. It tastes pretty good, it's filling, and I can even identify chunks of chicken amidst all the noodles. This makes it a good base for some further enhancements--more salt, some Parmesan cheese, Louisiana hot sauce, baco-bits, you name it. These chunky soups are an excellent opportunity for some culinary experimentation.If you're really determined to be healthy, then the basic soup is certainly as good as anything else out there. But at $1.50 a can or so, we might as well cut loose and party a little. A cheap thrill here and there is certainly better than daytime TV.

column9: Best canned cat food for the price!
column10: I adopted my cat from the local shelter about 7 years ago. We bought him the standard Purina dry cat food from the grocery store and he was fine for a couple years, until he started throwing up a lot. His stomach would hurt so bad he would hide in a closet or a corner and just moan. We took him to the vet and they told us he had a sensitive stomach; they said we either needed to change his food or he would have to get steroid shots every couple months--obviously we opted for new food, which they recommended as science diet sensitive stomach (only available in dry). His symptoms got better but he still threw up a lot and his coat was dull and full of dandruff.So, we did our homework, and found out that science diet is the fancy brand for Purina--full of fillers and unidentifiable ingredients (and costs the same as higher-end, natural foods to boot!). After much research we chose to try Natural Balance canned food due to it being relatively inexpensive and also full of natural ingredients. Right away we noticed a difference in our cat. He hasn't thrown up since, his coat is full, shiny, and beautiful, and he loves the taste of it. I would definitely recommend this to anyone! Trust me, it's worth the cost to keep your cat healthy and strong! Couldn't be happier with the results.

My cat's vet strongly recommended a wet food diet because she's pretty chubby. (4 pounds overweight.) He promised that the weight would just fall off. He wasn't kidding. After two weeks she has lost a whole pound.Per my cat's vet, the feeding instructions on the can aren't quite right. He said that a cat should weigh 10 pounds or less, so one can per day should be enough. Half a can in the morning and half at night seems to work pretty well.
I like the ingredients in this and my cat appreciates the taste. If she had thumbs, I'm sure she'd give it two thumbs up.

column9: Healthy Cat Food at a Reasonable Cost
column10: After the second cat of three cats in my household started having problems with Irritable Bowel Syndrome, I got serious about researching cat foods and decided to try Natural Balance. They make a totally grain-free hard cat food that I decided to supplement with their wet food. My cats love the Natural Balance wet cat food. The taste is obviously good to them and nutritionally it is a much healthier choice than Science Diet or Iams. Because Natural Balance contains more protein than cat foods that are loaded with grains and other fillers that cats do not need, it is slightly higher in calories. Thus, you may need to feed your cats slightly less than you are used to if you make the switch or consider the Reduced Calorie version. I am very pleased with the results of this cat food. Within a very short period of time, there was almost complete resolution of the vomiting/diarrhea/GI issues of my cats and their stool is less foul smelling. While two of my cats have always had lovely coats, one did not and his coat is now wonderfully soft in a way that it has never been. I will never go back to other wet foods.Amazon has the best prices I've seen for Natural Balance (a little over $1 per can for the 6 ounce cans of wet food) and it's convenient to have it delivered to my door rather than trekking to the pet store. One 6 oz. can is dense enough to feed all 3 of my cats for one meal and they seem full for about 8-12 hours. So far I've tried the Indoor Formula and Ocean Fish. My cats did not love the Duck and Green Pea hard food so I've avoided feeding the wet food version of that flavor and can't vouch for it. The cost is a little more than Iams or Science Diet but my cats are worth it and I am probably saving a little because they require less hard food overall.

I have 3 cats and was feeding them the Pro Plan, which is a pricey food when you consider the poor ingredients.  I am currently feeding a combination of this food, Wellness and Trader Joes. My local pet store sells this for the same price as Wellness though, and Wellness has no grains so I may switch to that as this does contain some. Ingredient list very similar to Traders Joes Turkey and Giblets formula at 69 cents a can. This is the only formula of theirs that does not contain brewers rice. I also supplement with a little Wellness Core/Indoor formula mixed. So far no problems , litter box smells far better.

It's excellent for your cat.  The veterinarians recommend this product highly.  It is a bit more expensive than the normal store brands but it is of superior quality and you can trust you are giving your furry friend the best nutrition possible when combined with their dry cat food.

column9: ONLY FOOD MY CAT WILL EAT!
column10: This may seem a little expensive if you compare it to store brands like Friskies, etc. but if your cat is like mine it is worth it. No longer do I throw uneaten dried up food away...sometimes entire cans. He LOVES this stuff and there are no pesky fillers to get in the way. It is also good for thyroid health.

I love this catfood because..it is All natural. (Chicken is the FIRST Ingredientlisted on the can..Much lower cost than other natural canned catfoods..I checked it out..like -40 cents a can less! Now that is a savings.. I buy ithere at Amazon..good price and Most of the time it is Free Shipping! Lots of good healthy ingredients. My two cats love the INDOOR Formula..and theyare Picky eaters.I can HIGHLY Recommend this product.

Very good product,it helps our (completely) indoor cats to maintain a healthy weight.  They like it and eat it well.  HOWEVER, based on ordering at least 30 cases, you should expect at least one can per case to be so crushed as to be unusable.  Two or three other cans per case will be dented, but usable.  As the outside packages arrive in good shape the damage must be occuring prior to shipment.

My four cats love Natural Balance dry indoor cat food and they are absolutely crazy about Natural Balance  canned cat food, Indoor formula.  I have one cat that likes it so much that she comes and stares at me at mealtimes.  And those mealtimes seem to be getting earlier and earlier.  Gotta love that cat.  Even though I am on a tight budget I spend the extra money on Natural Balance products  because I know they are healthy and will probably save me vet bills in the future.  Excellent food.
I have purchased several different brands, my cats love this one and I like that it doesn't smell up the cat box like other wet foods can.

column9: My Cats will not touch this
column10: I wish I had success with this food. I just purchased it because I read all the great reviews, I have 6 cats, all were formal ferals and rescued by me, along with ,many others I have found homes for. I have had cats my entire life (and other animals), and am older, so have a strong history with their food likes and dislikes. Not one of my six cats will touch this food. They eagerly wait for "dinner" I open the can, they sniff it and walk away. One even made a burying motion over it which was comical. They do have dry Fromm Cat food available at all times, but love canned as well. After reading how bad the supermarket available brands were for cats, I decided to try some "better ones". They have become quite finicky lately for some reason..but they at least will lick other brands. They want nothing to do with this food at all. I even left it in the bowl overnight, removed the dry, and it was untouched in the morning. I still am trying entice my cats with it by mixing in tuna and other cat foods, no luck. I bought a whole case, so have been giving the untouched food to the raccoons that forage in my woods at night, they have been eating it, so it was not a total waste. I know it is a great company and good food, but my cats will not go near it.

I came across Dr Oetker's Organic Cake mixes & icing several months ago. I LOVE IT! My boys, daughter in laws, grandchildren, many other family members, friends & also members of my church. I am sure some may "dislike" Dr Oetker's icing, but if you love a old fashioned, creamy, rich and TASTES YUMMY then you WILL like Dr Oetker's Organic icings and cake mixes. The "grainy" referral from the preceding review is SUGAR. I am 47 & my Scotish grandmother used to make old fashioned cream icing that had a lovely sugar crystal crunchiness (very fine and not an over-kill of crystals). Both the Vanilla & Chocolate Organic icings by Dr Oteker has this wonderful old fashioned flare and DELICIOUS. The chocolate reminds me of a fudge icing. If you are looking for a foo-foo fluffy, whipped or the store bought plastic cup of artificial fake gunk in a tub or ground carob health store blandish food types then by all means - "DO NOT" ORDER DR OTEKER. Buf if you appreciate sweetness, richness, old fashioned tasty delights - "DO" ORDER DR OTEKER!!! Do not allow 1 persons negative review desuade you from trying and posting your own "positive" OR "negative" review. Thank you for your time in reading.

column9: Tastes more like cornbread than vanilla cake!
column10: I actually bought this at Wal-Mart, for about $2.50. I wanted to try it because at only 140 cals per serving (for the mix only, as packaged) it comes in at 20 cals less than Pillsbury, plus hello, it's organic. I made it as cupcakes and they sank in, in the middle. Also, the consistency is way more like a corn muffin than vanilla cake. Kind of grainy, and actually the taste is quite reminiscent of cornbread too. Pretty gross!

These are a staple - I always have some made and keep them in the freezer.  If you add an extra egg they are more fluffy.  If you leave out the sugar, they make a great substitute for english muffins in eggs benedict.  I am very sorry amazon quit carrying these - I go through the 6 pack in 6 to 8 weeks.

This cornbread mix is so good, I serve it to the whole family and they have no idea it is gluten-free.  It actually tastes better than the grocery shelf cornbread mixes I had made and eaten before my diagnosis of celiac disease.The cost is compatible with most standard mixes.  I make muffins with the mix and they store well in the refrigerator and can be warmed up for another day without losing its texture or flavor.

We are eating gluten free by choice.  We don't like cornbread as a rule, because cornbread made without some flour is just yucky.  I bought this mix at the grocery store on a fluke.  We needed it for a meal.  OMG!!!!  IT WAS AMAZING!!!!  I've made it using sweet milk and buttermilk.  No matter what milk we use it is amazing!  Even my picky granddaughter wants it all the time.  Well worth the money.It reaheats well too.  We have kept it in the refrigerator, wrapped for up to 10 days.  After day 9, it started drying out, but still tasted good.  We microwaved it with a wet papertowel covering the piece and it was good.I've made it by standard recipe, as well as jalepeno.  Yummy.  Chop some fresh jalepeno's, a small tomato, and a bit of onion.  Use 1/4 cup LESS of the milk and add a small (the teeny 'individual') can of creamed corn.  yummy!

When I was diagnosed with Celiac's Disease I new I could not go without my sweet cornbread.  Finally, I found this, Gluten-Free Pantry Yankee Cornbread.  The only change I make to the directions on the box is I add a 1/2 cup of sugar instead of 1/4 cup.  It makes alot so I just freeze the cornbread and take it out when I need it.
This is one item that you would barely be able to tell that it's gluten free.  It's definitely a favorite of mine.

The Gluten Free Pantry Yankee Cornbread and Muffin Mix is great.  It is easy to prepare by just adding milk, an egg, and some sugar.  I have made the muffins every week since discovering this wonderful gluten free mix.  Everyone in the family - celiac and non celiac - eat and enjoy these muffins.

No gluten free diets here, but I buy it and make it fat free by substituting apple sauce for butter, sweetener for sugar, skim milk for buttermilk and extra egg whites for eggs.  I know, sounds dreadful, but it tastes suprisingly good.  The best mix I've tried for the fat free adaptation.
great product (anyone would love it even if you aren't Gluten Free) and great service---fast
The best tasting gluten free corn bread period!  My nephews loves these and I'm hooked now. Great stuff.Try it you will love these. If you have a need for gluten free give these a try.
This mix works nicely.  It is easy to prepare.  Bakes up pretty much like a jiffy mix which is what we used before going gluten free.  We do find that it is missing some of the corn flavor though.
I love cornbread and found this to be the best gluten free cornbread.  My family even loves it and it takes just like regular corn bread.
I love this!  I have made it for cornbread and also to use as breadcrumbs for cornbread dressing.  It is great to have cornbread again since being diagnosed with Celiac.

Corn bread is one staple I have missed since becoming gluten free.  I used to use a cheap little box, as my mom did.  This mix comes  very close in flavor and texture and works wonderfully.  It is pricey, but not insanely so.  Makes good Southern corn bread or, with additional sweetener of your choice, a good New England cake type.  I don't feel deprived anymore.

column9: Great Taste!  25.3 grams of carbs per muffin
column10: I've tried a from-scratch gluten-free cornbread recipe before, and it was too close to cornmeal mush for us to consider it cornbread.  I ordered this cornbread mix from The Gluten-Free Pantry on a whim, and the whole family is delighted with it.  It tastes great and has the consistency of "real" cornbread.I mentioned the carb count because my son was recently diagnosed with Type I Diabetes. Until we get more used to estimating carbs in home-made foods, a mix helps us be more exact about carbs per portion. One box of this Yankee Cornbread Mix makes 12 medium-size muffins of 25.3 grams of carbs, each.We do not have to eat gluten-free, but I've always found that a gluten free muffin always makes me feel less full, less like the muffin has congealed into a ball in my stomach. So we go gluten-free at times.You add sugar, milk, egg and melted butter to the mix. It calls for buttermilk, but I make it with whole milk and it still tastes great. Ingredients in the mix are corn meal, white rice flour, baking powder (corn), and salt. The label states it also contains soy, but I can't find any ingredient with soy (such as soy lecithin) on the box's labeling. It could be that it is manufactured with machines that also process soy products, so, just to be safe, they mention the soy.This is an excellent product and I highly recommend it. But it is expensive, considering that you have to add most of the recipe to the mix. You are paying for the convenience of not having to sift your own corn meal and rice flower.
I was a bread junkie before going gluten free-and have really missed it.  This cornbread is easy to make and really good tasting!  Irecommend it highly.

column9: The Best Tasting GF Cornbread Mix EVER
column10: I have been trying quite a few brands over the last few years.  This brand wins hands down.  It tastes great! Even when I make it with soy milk instead of the buttermilk in the recipe, it is yummy.

My daughter has eaten gluten free for quite awhile and showed me the best products and this corn bread mix was one of them....She adds cheedar cheese...green chiles and a can of corn and says it is delicious..but as all this type stuff..it is pricey...it makes one small pan of corn bread for the cost of about 4 dollars...you use buttermilk for this instead of regular milk...
This cornbread tastes just like my made from scratch cornbread. It is a great alternative to toast in the morning. Just warm it in microwave, butter, jelly and you are set to go.

My daughter has celiac and we have tried every g-free cornbread mix out there.  Being very southern, I only put a small amount of the sugar in my cornbread, we don't like it too sweet down here!  I added 1/2 cup diced jalapenos, 1/2 cup yellow sweet corn, and 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese and it was fabulous!  We eat it with our taco soup and chili all winter long.

I absolutely love this brand! We wouldn't even know it was gluten free! Myself and my daughter have found out only this year about our gluten intolerance and this cornbread sure makes gluten free living a lot easier.
I add grated cheese and some sliced green onions and make the cornbread as directed. It is a terrific "bread" for those of us who need gluten free food.

This is my favorite GF cornbread. My husband who does not need to eat GF loves it. I am so glad I buy it by the case. It taste like grandmom's cornbread (not dry) Due to the fact that it takes alot of butter for the recipe. It is a great treat. It is one of the few things I tolerate well and enjoy the taste.

I make dressing every year for the holidays, because my family loves the recipe.  This year I used the Gluten-Free Cornbread mix as the base instead of the brand I typically use.  Everyone said it is the best ever!!

I have purchased this item 3 times and have had positive results each time.  Though the finished product is very dense and not as sweet as the traditional Jiffy Corn Muffin, if you have gluten intolerance, you will find this to be an adequate replacement.  It does offer lactose free directions (a common condition for those recently diagnosed with celiac)which is my usual prep method.  The only drawback of the lactose free version is the oil tends to separate from the batter as it bakes, but does not effect the overall quality of the finished product.  Leftovers should be refrigerated, and reheated in the microwave for best taste.
My family likes these gluten-free cornmeal muffins better than the  non-gluten free.  A successful product!  Kudos, Gluten Free Pantry.

If you need to cook gluten-free then you know how hard it is to find good, simple products that do not taste "gluten-free".  I am not gluten-intolerent but my family is.  I don't like most gluten free products (I just smile and eat) but this one is really good. The mix has good flavor and texture, is simple to make, and makes dad a hero on "chili" night.  Much better than the Bob's Red Mill.  Only knocked one star off because I hate paying the higher price for gluten-free stuff.
These are sooooo good!  And super easy to make.  I hope Amazon starts carrying them again, or I'm going to have to find somewhere else to buy them.  So yummy and filling!

This cornbread is not as sweet as I would like.  I used paper muffin cups when I made it and half the muffin stuck to the paper so that was a bummer.  I think I like my mom's homemade GF cornbread better.
Excellent product with perfect customer service.. I have been and still am placing orders.. The kids and I love them. Ordered more to give out on Halloween

These things are amazing! Blueberry Pomegranate is the only flavor I have tasted, and I love it. It is helpful to read the label though. This company makes two types of the blueberry pomegranate - one with aloe vera extract and one without. I bought one without reading the label (I am allergic to aloe), and you can probably guess what happened. Not good. Anyway, I would give this product 5 stars if they weren't so darned expensive! However, I know that these are expensive drinks, and I have not yet been able to find them in bulk, so I am glad that Amazon sells them.

This is great gum!  I have never been big on chewing gum but I really like the Trident Splash.  I walk 2 to 4 miles every morning (weather permitting) and I chew gum when I walk (helps me think.  No music stuck in my ears! I want to hear the birds singing.).  I find the Trident Splash is the best for keeping its flavor!  When I found the Trident Splash Peppermint Twist I would buy all of it from the drugstore that carried it.  They do not carry the Trident Splash anymore nor does any other stores that I can find.  I'm just happy I found it on Amazon.com and hope the company who produces it does not discontinue this gum.  Thank you, Maxine

This is the BEST gum of all time.  I have been chewing this gum for years until I was unable to find it in Target, so I was thrilled to find it on Amazon as always.  Shipping was fast and the taste was fresh and incredible.... You will not be disappointed.
It's my favorite gum, but I have not been able to find it locally. Thank goodness for Amazon and Prime membership....was able to get it in a couple of days!

Very tasty and refreshing, this gum has that neat little "splash" when I bite into it that makes it a bit different from the typical gum. I had to search for it because Wally World and other stores quit carrying this flavor. I do not like the other flavors (and they do keep introducing new ones) other than the Vanilla Swirl? and the peppermint twist. Both are minty and pleasant.

column9: Great product, best gum ever!  Great shipping!
column10: Trident Splash Peppermint Swirl is the best gum I have ever had!  Wonderful taste!  Stays fresh for long!  Gum stays soft...does not get hard/tough after chewing for a period of time.

column9: impossible to find product, delivered fast!
column10: This is so awesome! This product has been discontinued and is nearly impossible to find, but this Amazon subsidiary has been shipping it to me super fast and well packaged for shipment. High rating.
First time I had this was when I was in Germany. I loved it and am glad it is available in the US. I buy it all the time.

column9: Use this mix for Chocolate Chip Bars (Blonde Brownies)
column10: There is a recipe on the side of the box for Chocolate Chip Brownies.  We call them Blonde Brownies.  My Grandmother had her own recipe that I used until I tried this one with the caramel cake mix.  This blows my old recipe away - keeps the brownies soft for days, fantastic taste.  I was so happy, until I could not find this boxed cake in any of my stores.  On a fluke I Googled this cake mix and low and behold here it is on Amazon.  Now I have to buy it, I have been missing my fantastic Blonde Brownies for a couple of years.

column9: The reviews so far are based on price...obviously neither read the description very well!
column10: I have had this cake mix before and when I made it for a work potluck with cream cheese frosting....everyone LOVED it!  I told them it was simply a box cake mix and several joked that I shouldn't have told :)  I have been looking for this cake mix ever since.  When a dozen people drop their jaws and tell you how fabulous of a cook you are, well, you tend to remember that moment.
