The previous reviews/reviewers obviously did not understand or look at the description.  The $32 is for 12 boxes and is in line with other hard-to-find foods from this vendor.  Amazon simply acts as a third party to market and make it more available.  Yes, the prices are higher than Wal-mart, but a lot of these foods you can hardly find anywhere anymore.

column9: IT'S A CASE OF CAKE MIX, NOT ONE BOX!
column10: Folks, you actually think a box of cake mix is $32? Duh- the price is for a case of cake mix, not just one box.  And I highly recommend it.

I love this flavor cake mix and it is always such a hit when I take it to Potlucks or have family over. It is very hard to find. I have to stock up when I go up to Iowa or over to Virginia. It is not sold or distributed in my area of Tennessee, and I can't get the grocery stores to stock it because they say it is not stocked in their distribution centers. I wrote Duncan Hines and they said they can't do anything about the situation, it is up to the buyers in the distribution centers. Oh well. I bought 14 boxes the last time I was in Iowa (Thanks Hy-Vee). I grudging shared them with family members who love this cake mix flavor also. I make this cake by following the box directions but then stirring in one can of any brand of Coconut Pecan Frosting (this is my secret ingredient). Stir it in well and then bake according to box, but adding 10 or 15 minutes to baking time. Cool completely then frost with one can (or homemade) of Cream Cheese Frosting. Always a big hit. Yum!

I was thrilled to learn that I could get DH caramel cake on amazon.com. I haven't been able to find it in our stores for years.  I thought that it had been discontinued by the manufacturer. I decided to try and get some info from Duncan Hinds, but found no way to reach them via the internet. I checked a little further an found that I might be able to order it from amazon.com. Yippee?I found out that it is a favorite of many other people too, requiring me to be on a waiting list to get it.  It was definitly worth the wait and the trouble. I was notified by e mail when it became available and placed my order.  It arrived in a timely fashion and I will definitely order it again.thankyou,caramel cake fanatic

If only Duncan Hines would market this cake in our region.  We were traveling and saw a carmel cake mix so picked it up to bring home to try.  This cake has to be their {D.H.] very best.  It was great finding it at amazon.  It's a must try!

column9: This Cake Must Come Baked, With Frosting & a Pound of Caramel
column10: This must be a joke, $32.28.  Please correct this mis-print.  I wanted to try the Caramel Cake mix.  But only when the correction has been made with the price.  Does Duncan Hines have it like that?
Is this cake mix REALLY $32.28?or $3.28?I dont think any cake mix is so great that people would want to buy it for $32 + shipping.WOW.

These are cookies worth eating. Having to watch my weight, I have to make my cookies count. This is way up there on the scale of delectable delights. Love the dark chocolate. Come on Amazon, you need to stock these at a reasonable price.

i have become enthralled to the act of devouring these toothsome tasties VERY slowly, letting the cakeish cookie slowly melt within mine mouth whilst the chocolate melts therein as well. finally, the molten confection gushes across my palate and down mine gullet causing INSTANT yearning to repeat the experience....  over,.... and over,....  and over....  unto diabetic coma....  alas...

We live in a rural area with limited products available at the local grocer. Amazon has lots of items that we typically use and we can have them shipped to us. The closest town that would have these products is a 2 hour drive one way. Needless to say, ordering them from Amazon is easy and cost effective due to our location. Only wish they would carry the Extra dark version. Thank you.

The packaging of these cookies has improved. They've replaced the plasti-tray thingie which didn't really protect the cookies with two very thin wrappers, one for each half, that tear easily open. They are somehow just right, and since they are separate, if you only want to use half of the cookies, the other half is still sealed. The product inside the wrappers is the same excellent cookie.

These are truly French & taste exquisite.  I became frustrated trying to find them in our stores (especially in -22 degrees in January) & decided to go this route.  I'm very pleased with them.  We just returned from our October France trip & I would be interested in other French products.
These cookies are really delicious. Buy them. Eat them. Be happy. yum yum yum yum yum yum yum yum yum yum yum
Product arrived as advertised. They taste very good and I would order these again in the future as they are a tasty crunchy treat.

The tuna was not as "Chunk" or dense as I perfer.  The tuna is packed with way more water than I would expect, which makes draining difficult.  The lemon pepper was sweet rather than acidy and spicey.  This was unlike other brands lemon pepper that I enjoy, especially when making sandwiches.

I was very happy with both the caviar and the company. The shipment arrived next day well packaged and with wonderfully reusable freezer packs. The caviar was fresh and extremely tasty. I would certainly order from them again.
It may have been just the one we had, but it tasted bitter. I'm hoping it was just that caviar and not that it was spoiled. It wasn't awful, but it wasn't worth it.

column9: HORRIBLE doesn't begin to describe this product!  Very disappointed!
column10: The product description says: "Keta Salmon Caviar is from the select roe of the Keta Salmon, which has very large eggs with a color that can range from bright red to brilliant orange."The caviar I received consisted of really small eggs (about half the size of those at a sushi restaurant) that are mushy, and taste awful. Also, the caviar comes in a can like that of tuna fish or sardines. (Wish I would've known that before placing the order).The worst part of all is the mushy, bad-tasting mess that's inside...probably the result of its ingredients: salmon roe, salt, vegetable oil, sorbic acid.I am NOT happy with my order and feel I just threw money in the garbage.  The *reality* of the product bears *no resemblance* to the photo posted on Amazon.I have three cans of this stuff and don't know what to do with them. I had a "taste test" with my cat and dog, who *love* caviar) and they both turned their noses up at it. NOT a good sign.  :-(

Few months ago, I bout salmon roe caviar in three different variety ( American salmon caviar, Canadian salmon caviar, and Russian salmon caviar) for try from GourmetFoodStore . They are delivered via express mail in cold pack. The products are all fresh and good condition. They are all taste as it should be, how ever the American product was better than Canadian product in my taste buds but the Russian product were even better for my taste buds.In view of these, I recommend all of the product equally, but Russian is my choice for my taste buds. Ian Hammie.

Ordered malossol salmon caviar, received some orange mess in a regular green tin. Brave soul that I am - I have actually tried this nonsense. It does not come even close to resembling what a fresh, properly handled caviar should taste like. If I am still alive in 2 hours I guess you can call it "edible".

The Red Caviar is very fresh and melts in my mouth in the way it is suposed to do.  I don't know how they can improve the packing, the can came all slime.It was send well packed (refrigeration) and it came on a timely manner.

column9: Mmmm you can't just eat one
column10: Bought these as a Christmas gift and they didn't last long once they were open. They taste awesome and it's hard to eat just one or two at a time. My younger brother said he had to give himself a daily limit so they would last.

column9: You will eat them till you're sick!
column10: I had always heard about 'buckeyes' so decided to order some to distribute at Christmas.  The peanut butter is a bit much for me but my son and great grandson loved them and he WOULD eat them until he was sick if allowed.
These Pop Tarts are highly addictive and one should be aware of that before purchase!  This is a huge crate of 72 and will tempt you without mercy.  Don't say you were not warned!

There aren't many things that my whole family agrees on but we all agree that these Cookies & Cream Pop-Tarts are awesome.  My husband always refers to these as the "Oreo" Pop-Tarts.  I personally don't like Oreo's but I do love Cookies and Cream ice cream and I love these.  We all eat these for snacks rather than for breakfast.  It's like having a cookie or something.  To me, they are good toasted or not toasted.  We eat them both ways.  I highly recommend this flavor if chocolate & cream appeal to you.

I haven't been able to find this variety of Pop Tarts in the stores near us.  So I purchased online from Amazon, even though the quantity was large.  No problem.  My grandson absolutely loves this variety.  He chooses this as his dessert!

column9: Once you pop you just can't stop
column10: I'm not talking about Pringles here folks. OM NOM NOM These pop tarts are, hands down, the BEST the BEST the BEST. This was a huge shipment taht arrived quickly and it provided nothing but pleasure for days on end. A++ Would buy again.
these are ok to me they dont taste like cookie and cream much but there pretty good :) to snack on or something :)

When I discovered that there were cookies n' cream pop tarts (and me being obsessed with everything cookies n' cream) I just knew I'd have to get these. I looked for them at a local grocery store but they didn't have this flavor, so I bought the Chocolate Chip Cookie flavor instead. Did not like those at all. Finally, after weeks of searching, I found them. These are VERY good! They definitely remind me of oreos (why wouldn't they? oreos are chocolate cookies with cream in the center, you know!) with a marshmallow-y center. These are definitely really sweet though, and I could never see myself eating them for breakfast, but they are a nice treat.I would recommend these to a friend (and I already have)!

If you're looking for something other than cookies on which to snack, be sure to give these a try. It's almost like eating an Oreo, but without the extra fat and with added vitamins.  They're marvelous as a pie crust too!  Not to mention, crumbled up on top of a hot fudge sundae!  Great stuff, comes fresh too, highly recommend!

column9: Not quite as good as the S'mores flavor
column10: I bought these because they are a little cheaper than the S'mores flavor which I love. These aren't as good as the S'mores ones but I still would buy these again.Others have compared these to Oreo cookies which is a fair assesment. The outside chocolate is kind of dry and doesn't have a strong flavor. The filling in the middle has a melted marshmellow texture to it, somewhere between Oreo filling and marshmellow. They aren't overwhelmingly sweet. I like the frosting on the outside. These go perfectly with a glass of milk.I think kids would love these along with adults and I would recommend them. Great snack for the office, school, or just anytime you're craving chocolate. I'm a bachelor who can't cook so I'm sure I eat Pop-Tarts more than most people.Not bad, Pop-Tarts. Not bad at all.

I was wanting to get Oreo but i found i didn't like the cream. These pop tarts however do not have that too sweet flavor, which was perfect for me. the cookie? (black part) becomes powdery when chewing so i had to drink water. (but the second part may just be me)
Cookies n Creme Poptarts are a great on-the-go snack that will satisfy your sweet tooth but they do get bland pretty quick.
That's about it. It's my favorite of the pop tart flavors. Get some real 3% milk and party. Oh yeah...

guilty pleasure. cookies n cream is my fave ice cream flavor and apparently i'll eat anything that tastes like it. these are super sweet you can heat up, or have em right out the box for a quick sugar fix

column9: Great dog food, not full of filler
column10: I have been feeding my dog Nature's Recipe since he was a puppy and had skin problems. I researched dog foods qutie a bit and concluded Nature's Recipe was superior for a variety of reasons including that it doesn't have excess carbs and there are lots of different varieties that have different health contents. You can purchase vegetarian, lamb, chicken, venison, etc. I buy a combination of this and the dry food for him and it has kept him happy and healthy (though it hasn't helped with his poor behavior walking on a leash ;). The issue with a lot of the other foods is that they do not have a great deal of health content in them; they contain lots of grains and other carbs. This is a bit more expensive but well worth it in my opinion.
I use this in my power drinks and it is wonderful.  It can be used in coffee, tea; anything you would put sugar in. Much healthier and tastes great!

I have heard a lot of reviews about coconut palm sugar (especially on Dr. Oz), so I decided to buy some.  Quite honestly, it has been kinda difficult finding things that I can use this stuff on or with.  I love coconut but it has a very distinct taste, which is not good in combination with some other flavors.  For the most part, this product is a novelty and has remained unused in my pantry. It isn't too expensive though and should be tried.

column9: Tastes exactly as described; not hard to get used to.
column10: At first, I had to add a little raw sugar to this to kind of calm down that burnt taste (as the product was described), then I found I was okay with just the coconut crystals.  I actually got these for my husband as he has (well-controlled) diabetes and I dislike artificial sweeteners, but he had purchased a huge supply of those yellow packets and said "talk to me about it when I'm finished using these up".  So I still have some, and may be back for more.  I can see this being delicious for a glaze over a cake or flan as well as everyday beverage use which is all I've done with it.  Product arrived fast and in good condition.
Our dog loves these chicken strips! And, they are made in the usa, awesome! We will be buying more of these in the future.
My dogs love these treats!!  I have tried several dog treats that my dogs just carry off and hide and never eat.  They can't get enough belly rubs organic chicken!!

I have been purchasing this product for the past two months and can not believe how much my dogs love it. I noted that the customer who added a review before me did not seem satisfied with the "USA origin" of the product. I also spoke to the manufacturer, however, and am completely satisfied with the documentation proof which was forwarded to me.Keep up the good work!

column9: Probably not made in the USA
column10: Probably not made in the USA since I can't get a straight answer from the company.  I canceled todays order and will throw out the remaining bag I have from my previous order.  Very disappointed because I thought I had finally found a safe treat for my dogs.  Guess I'll keep lookingUpdate.So, I sliced a pound of semi frozen chicken breasts the long way ($1.99), put them in my food dehydrator and wallah....Chicken Jerky in less then 4 hours!  I know what's in them, where they came from and how they were made. I ordered a simple electric food slicer today (from Amazon of course) just to simplify the process and will never, ever have to worry about where my dogs treats come from.

This product texture and smell seem very similar to Wagontrain chicken fillets.  The pkg clearly has a sticker showing made in USA, however, states manfactured for Meyer Country Farms.  I contacted Meyer Country Farms.  They would not tell me where this product is manufactured from.  He claims, USA, however he would not give me a city or state, so I have my doubts.  I will not purchase this product again.  The pkg. should show made and manufactured in the USA.

This is the best chow chow I have ever tasted! I've bought it for years from our local grocery store, until they stopped carrying it, so started ordering directly from Mrs. Renfro's. Glad to see it offered here on Amazon. My husband loves it on top of pinto beans with a big slice of cornbread. Yum!

This pasta is a wonderful wheat free alternative! It needs to be watched as the last few moments of cooking can take it from just right to a tad mushy.  I cook in-beweetn 7-8 minutes.  The flavor is good enough to be eaten in any pasta salad!!  I am not 100% sure of the complete WHEAT freeness, so please check if you need to avoid all wheat before purchasing.  This is NOT gluten free! Spelt has gluten, but you may be able to tolerate it; everyone is different in this regard.

This is the BEST pasta.  It is much better than what you find at the regular grocery store.  Pasta d'Abruzzo, I believe, means that it is made from the White Spelt.  This has a much milder taste than the whole grain variety.  My kids ask for it all the time.  It can be eaten plain with a little butter and salt OR you can add pasta sauce to it.  Either way works!

column9: a good pasta, not gluten free
column10: This is a lovely pasta made with a different wheat than other more common pastas.  It is not gluten free though - Spelt is a variety of wheat. Nice pasta though. If you need a gluten free pasta, try brown rice pasta like tinkyada rice pasta, which is very good as well.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: FORGET making your own! This is the BEST!
column10: We practically DRINK this Herdez Casera - its that good! We find the CANS to be far superior to the jarred ones, tho. Sounds strange, but as others have said, its true, the cans are more authenic. It is VERY close to the fine homemade salsa found in upscale Mexican restaurants, and costs less than making salsa from scratch.  But make sure you get THIS LABEL because the "new" label is NOT the same stuff - it seems like a different recipe. We pour this in a jar and store in the fridge and have NEVER had it go bad, even for a month or more. These are large, 28 ounce cans that fit nicely in a quart (or two pint) jar.)
My second time purchasing from The Coffee Mix and it's another great assortment of K-Cups! Nice to have a such a variety to try and then pick new favorites to buy a full box of.
The French vanilla flavor is stronger than in the Baronet or Senseo french vanilla varitey.  The coffe taste is also a little bolder.

I wouldn't have given this product even 1 star, but it did arrive quickly!  These are individually wrapped coffee pods packaged in a huge box.  The smell of them was great, but as soon as it came out of the machine, it looked and tasted like muddy water.  I tried several things to change the taste of it and nothing worked.  I just put tons of other things in it now so I can at least not be out the money I spent on it.  The Senseo brand is waaaayyyyyy better!!!!!

column9: Not as good as Senseo Paris French Vanilla
column10: I bought this to replace the Senseo Paris French Vanilla Coffee Pods that I like to use in my Hamilton Beach 1 cup pod brewer because the Senseo brand has been unavailable for quite some time.  Unfortunately, this is not as good.This review is mostly for those people who like a light to medium strength coffee, not the hard-core espresso drinkers.  I drink my coffee weak -- not super strong -- but also not watery.  My daily one cup of coffee is a treat I allow myself, and I use a smaller coffee mug (holds up to 8 ounces comfortably) so I don't need a lot of coffee, but, this coffee is extremely weak (even for me) and I have to be sure to use **no more than** 6 ounces of water with this brand, otherwise it is just too weak and watery.I've tried using 2 pods at a time to see if that would help but, oddly enough, even with 12 ounces of water per cup the coffee comes out too strong for my taste.  Plus, I just don't need or want more than one cup of coffee each morning.I've also noticed that this coffee has a very "acidy" aftertaste and tends to severely aggravate my heart burn which is not normally bothersome for me if I have only one (or rarely, two) cup(s) of coffee.  I also have had this problem with 'Folgers' brand coffee (the regular loose coffee) that we use in our large coffee maker if someone other than just me is having coffee.If you want a larger mug of coffee, you might be able to make this work for you by using 2 pods per mug of coffee.  It's just hasn't worked out for me.Note:  I have also tried Wolfgang Puck's "Caramel Creme" flavored coffee and it is a bit smoother without the acid aftertaste.  The caramel creme is much more like Senseo's Paris French Vanilla, but it still only makes a 6 ounce cup of coffee.
This was very good coffee, enjoy the pod style coffee makers the best. Quick and easy no mess to clean up after.
Bought this for my hubby for father's day.  He loves it!  I bought it Tuesday Morning with 2 day shipping and it arrived the next day.
Making coffee for one is boring. This product at least makes it NEAT. Work at a health food store, have a one mug coffee maker. This product just works at this price. So tidy.

column9: Weak coffee, my fault for purchasing "light" roast
column10: Weak coffee, which was very disappointing compared to WP Reserve Blend (medium to dark roast).  Still a clean, non-bitter, no-aftertaste coffee.  But if you want a GREAT rich coffee with all of those qualities, go for the WP Reserve, which is truly the best coffee I've ever had.

Right from the top, let me be clear.  I probably didn't purchase this for it's official and intended purpose.  I bought it for those hotel room coffee makers where the packets they provide are usually old, stale, and may have been in the room with the previous 20 people who stayed in your room.  The little 4 cup coffee maker on the counter used 3 of these at a time in order to make a decently-strengthed cup of coffee.  I'll give it the benefit of the doubt (maybe it was the coffee maker itself).  That said, the flavor was good, just not very "rich"/"bold".

I like these just as much if not better than Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal.  The taste and texture are both pleasing, they are actually a bit addicting.  I also find Malt-o-Meal to be an excellent manufacturer of hot breakfast cereals as well.  The price of Malt-O-Meal is a lot better than that of Kellogg's or General Mills and the ingrediants are just as wholesome and in some cases moreso.  YUMMY!

column9: I AGREE - addicted to these crunchy sweet squares
column10: I won't even purchase the Cinnamon Toast Crunch anymore - these are MUCH better.  The texture is crunchier, the taste awesome and the PRICE IS RIGHT.I work a VERY early shift so I eat these for 'lunch' when I get home every day.Be careful - VERY addicting:O)

The name Zinfandelic captures it all - this wine is a great example of Zinfandel that will please any Zin-fan. It's fresh, with fruit-forward flavors of dark berries and cherries. Hints of spice and earth and a nice finish.  The tannins are supple and well integrated, so it makes a great food wine. I keep a few bottles on hand for parties, as everyone, including the white wine drinkers  really like it. In fact, I've had some non-wine and white wine drinkers convert to red wine because of Zinfandelic Zin.  The duo pack includes 2 bottles of the current vintage and a fun wine tote (which, I'll be honest, I kept for myself).

column9: Not the same candy cigarettes i had as a kid.
column10: I have to say, either the other reviewers have lost their memories, or they did not have the same candy cigarettes that i had as a kid.  These are not the same things, they are a cheap knock off with a different taste and texture.  I am saddened by the people who thought these were the same things, that some of us remember as a kid.  Maybe they are younger than me and did not get to taste the wonderfulness of the original ones or maybe they have just forgotten.These imitations are just as someone else had stated on a different set of the same cigarettes.  I thought maybe since this one had better reviews, that it might be a different manufacturer selling the same cigarettes.  However i was wrong.  The other person is absolutely right.  These cigarettes do not have that chalky texture that the originals had.  Sure you may say, well isn't that a good thing.  No, it is not.  It wasn't like they tasted like chalk.  If anyone remembers pepto-bismal and how it was the only thing you actually didn't mind taking when you were sick.  You remember that flavor was very similar to the flavor of candy cigarettes.  The new texture is more gooey and chewy, which just doesn't feel the same when you eat them.The flavor was similar to wintergreen breath savers, but a little different in the originals and the new one is an off flavor of the same but just doesn't taste as good to me.  This product has left me completely disappointed, since i was hoping to get the same candy cigarettes i had as a kid, but am now left with 24 boxes of candy cigarettes that i do not even enjoy.  If you are a fan of the originals and remember the greatness of them, you will be hugely disappointed when these arrive.  The only way you will enjoy these, is if you never got to experience the originals in the first place and must have had these ones all along.Luckily though, they were under 8 dollars with free shipping from amazon, otherwise i would be demanding a refund.  I guess i will just give them out to random friends and hope they enjoy them.  I miss the originals, but now after trying these i am afraid they are gone forever.Also, i forgot to mention, the size of each box and the cigarettes inside are almost half the size of the original ones as well.
I love these! they are my favorite childhood candy and are so hard to find . Finally!

I just like having one of these candy cigs whenever I play video games. I didn't realize until the box came, but 24 boxes is a crap load of cigarettes! These babies are great fun and will last me a looong time!
We had a sock-hop themed party, and we ended up getting enough of these for just over one pack per person - that is 6 boxes, 144 packs - they ALL went!  Folks thought they were a hoot!
I'm 24, and I remember these at peewee baseball food stands and similar places when I was a kid. They were a hit at our Halloween party, and taste just as I remembered.

column9: Wow... Like I was a kid, until I got addicted
column10: I love these candy cigs - not sure how ethical they are these days to give out to the kiddos... but they are still as tasty as I remember. This case gives you a lot of the ol' white sticks, so be prepared to share them with friends.

A blast from the past, all my friends were blown away by this product!  They were so surprised that these still existed!  Just opening the box and taking a deep breath was a scent I had not experienced since I was a child.  I've had a blast passing them out to friends, most of who are x-smokers.  They enjoyed having a "cigarette" at their desk at work !Thanks for the item that has given so much joy to me and my friends!![ASIN:B000BXSRT2 World King Sized Candy Sticks 24 boxes]]

These candy cigarettes are great - exactly like I remember them as a kid.  Very fun to eat.  Not all of them have red tips, but I don't think they ever did.Free bonus - the case is perforated so you can fold it up into a fun display, like you might see in a store.

column9: The Only Cool Way To Smoke
column10: These were purchased for The Great American Smokeout. I'm not sure if anyone actually decided to quit smoking after getting a pack of these, but they were quite a hit. Hopefully they helped at least one person to smoke one less (real) cigarette.

I bought the world king candy cigarettes from Amazon.com  I didn't know they made these anymore. In the 50's we would buy them. So this christmas all my brothers and sisters and friends will get a pack of these just to let them remember the 50's.
I remember when I was younger, walking down to the local store and buying these.  They are as good now as they were when I was a kid.  I love them!!

column9: Fun to eat, reasonably low calorie
column10: I love these. They remind me of my childhood, and they're entertaining to eat. A "pack" of them (about eight sticks or so) is about 50 calories, and they take awhile to eat if you "smoke" them, so you can make this little snack last awhile.
My husband (and my children)absolutely LOVE these - I even like them!  They are just like I remember them when I was a kid.
I bought this item for a murder mystery party set in the 1950s. It was a fun, edible prop!
I bought these to bring back memories. And The price was a steal. Shared with many people at work and no one thought they made them anymore.

column9: Favorite candy but not happy when I received them.
column10: These are my FAVORITE candy! I decided that, when I went to a local candy store here and they wanted to charge me $1.00 a box, that I needed to just order my own for cheaper! The shipping was very quick.However, when I received them, they're all broken! I opened numerous boxes and all are in pieces. I couldn't find one full candy cigarette. On top of THAT, they are hard as rocks! Definitely not the delicious candy that I know and love. These were disgusting. I will not be ordering from here again.
Ordered these thinking they would be great based on the reviews. I just ate one and spat it out. It is barely sweet. It has barely any taste at all.

column9: Terrible service- don't recommend buying from here.
column10: I bought a box of these, excited that I would finally get to try the infamous candy cigarettes but the sender sent it to the wrong place- it had been delivered and I received the confirmation email but the mail-room that should have received it had no packages for me.  I emailed the seller that I never got my package and they apologized for not being able to help me because according to their records, it was received.  A few days later, I found the package, delivered to the wrong place- the sender told me they couldn't mail it to me again if it was sent back to them because it "wasn't covered" in the money I spent buying the candies.  Terrible, TERRIBLE customer service- if it's they're fault, they should take responsibility for it.

These are a great deal.  They cost about $1 per box to buy at the store.  I was worried that many would be broken from shipping but was surprised that only a few packs were broken out of the 2 cases I ordered.  Not Bad!  These tasted great.  There are some other Candy sticks that I have got before that had a different taste.  They were more chewy (not the gum) and barely had a taste.  These are the good original tasting ones that I have had for at least 15 years.  They have a good hard snap to them too.

I was disappointed when I tried these. I was expecting a wintergreen flavor with a texture similar to the dipping sticks included in Fun-Dip, at least that's how I remember them tasting fifteen years ago. I wouldn't be surprised if the company that originally manufactured the original either went out of business or discontinued them as these were probably very controversial.This item tastes more chewy and chaulky and there's not much flavor other than sugar with a waxy coating. I can't help but compare these to antacids. They are also thinner and bent and look more like a hand-rolled cigarette than one that is mass-produced.I would like to add that even though I consumed candy cigarettes as a kid, I do not smoke as an adult. My parents and school always reminded me of the negative effects of smoking so I honestly never had an interest, but I do ironically enjoy candy cigarettes, but sadly these aren't what I remember.
Only problem is that I don't know how to make them last longer. But that is not entirely a problem, eh?
This is a very good deal for this hard to find candy.  Kids love it and there's enough to go around.  And, as always, super fast shipping from Amazon!
Bought this as a joke gift for my fiance (he is a smoker who is trying to quit).  The package arrived very quickly, in great condition and it was exactly what I expected.

I saw these on the website and decided to have a little nostalgia party. I always bought candy cigarettes when I was little but as far as I can remember I don't think I ever got a box of completely unbroken sticks from the candy store. These came packaged very securely which is important for fragile candy, and I can happily report that not a single stick was broken. They tasted delicious and fresh(though I don't really know how one would taste for expired sugar). It was a lot of fun to have the box that folded into the little marquee. It was like having a piece of the candy store in my own home. Though this didn't bother me at all, the packages are not individually wrapped in cellophane like ones made for individual retail sale, but I could see some germophobes throwing a fit about this so I thought it would be worth noting. Overall product was perfect and exactly what I wanted.

Candy cigarettes are awesome! These are exactly how I remember them. They come in 24 "packs" decorated with a made up brand (Stallion, Kings, Lucky Lights, etc.) but they all taste the same. Each pack contains about 10 cigarettes, with maybe 2 of them broken. But as I remember them, you would always get a few broken ones, so it's not a big deal. They are sugar sticks, like you would get with the lik-a-stick in a fun dip package. But these are way cooler because it looks like you are smoking, without killing yourself (as quickly). I live in a dorm and gave packs of these to people on my floor and few people have heard of candy cigarettes, but everyone loved them.This product is really hard to find in stores, and if you do you will definitely pay more. That is why I recommend this product. Happy smoking! (Don't actually try to light these on fire)

column9: Great stuff but be sure you're ready for the amount!
column10: I love these sugary twigs and bought this package on a whim. A quick reminder: 24 boxes is a lot! Be sure to have someone else in mind when you purchase this! Otherwise, I fully recommend getting this if you have a soft spot for candy sticks.

I was very surprised how quickly I received the product. That was great. The price per case changes. I don't know why. Otherwise, I was very happy with their service and will definitely use them again.
EVERY YEAR I BUY THIS FOR ALL KIDS IN MY FAMILY.THEY LOVE IT.AND NOW ITS MY FAMILY TRADITION..
I love these things!!!!!I like them for the look, not for the taste.they taste a little weird, but still, great product.

column9: Hard to find reminder of childhood
column10: Nice reminder of childhood.  These candies are hard to find, and although these cigarettes are slightly different than I remember, these still are good.  The seller was extremely quick.
good price for the product.  Just like I remembered as a kid.

These candy cigarettes came in very useful for me in recent weeks.  Here is the problem:  Smoker's get to take an unfair number of smoke breaks throughout the day, and don't get judged for it, while the few of us making healthy life decisions are forced to work without breaks.  Here is my solution:  Buy candy cigarettes and pretend to be a smoker (works even better once it's cold outside).  48 calories in a pack, or lung cancer... you decide.

These candy cigarettes are every bit as good as what I remember!  It's been years since I have had one of these until I found them on Amazon.  Now I have my son hooked as well (I just don't let him see the package or know what they really are)!  If you liked these as a child, you will still love them.

ordered these for my daughters wedding cake overnight so that i would get them the next daythey came four days after weddingbut they are nice

It is difficult to find a good breakfast if you are diabetic.  You need complex carbohydrates, but also something filling and a food you can eat regularly without getting bored.  I now have Grape-nuts every morning for breakfast.  Low to moderate glycemic index, filling, good to chew (which is necessary to satisfy our desire to munch), and mixes well with whatever I want to spice it up with. However, I usually add mashed up strawberries (just a spoonful or two is all it takes) or sugar-free flavoring syrup, a banana, or whatever I find in the cupboard.  Fills me up, moderates my blood sugar, and stays with me most of the morning.

column9: Looks like 2-star cocoa being sold as 4 1/2-star cocoa... don't buy it!
column10: Ordered a package of this cocoa around April 25th 2011.  It was fabulous.  Worthy of the 4 1/2 stars rating. Deep rich color.  Well sealed.  So good we needed to reorder about a month later.  So went back to same amazon site, same picture and did reorder.  This time however, upon arrival it was not same company, packaging or label (hokey looking)... Instead of "Frontier" it said "Organic Herbal Essence".  Upon further investigation I went to my Amazon history and noticed first batch came from Sold by: Bangalla Organic Wholesale LLC and second batch came from Sold by: Organic Herbal Essence.  Keep in mind that Organic Herbal Essence is the cocoa that sells on Amazon that is only rated at 2-stars:[...]  I checked and can't return it. Called Organic Hebal Essence during business hours, left message, no one returned my call.  My opinion is just slapping a tiny white Avery label on the bag with tiny print (really tiny) that says "Frontier Cocoa" doesn't eliminate the huge color label on the bag that says "Organic Herbal Essence... Dutch Cocoa".  it certainly doesn't turn a 2-star cocoa into a 4 1/2 star cocoa.  My main frustration is it is obviously a different company and different packaging, but no explaination or offer to refund. Seems like a "bait and switch".  My advice; take a pass on this one until they get it sorted out.

column9: A dark dream of a product
column10: Can't say enough good things about this Cocoa. Have used it in cakes, breads, chilies - deep, dark, delicious. When it arrived I though a pound was a ridiculous amount to own. Now I find myself looking for excuses to cook with it and about to order another.

This is the first time I've purchased "Dutch process" cocoa, and I have to say, it is delicious! It is rich and mild, lacking the bitterness of regular cocoa powders. I bought it with no particular purpose in mind (I don't bake), just looking for ways to add more cocoa into my diet to get that great chocolate taste as well as the healthy antioxidants it provides. I've been enjoying experimenting mainly with adding it to hot beverages such as coffee or coffee substitutes. Often I don't even bother to sweeten these beverages - the mild flavor of this cocoa allows me to enjoy its natural chocolate flavor unsweetened. I even added a big spoonful to my oatmeal recently, along with everything else I normally add, and that was a treat! I'm looking forward to finding more ways to work it into my diet.

column9: Do Yourself a Favor...Buy it! You Will LOVE IT!
column10: Thanks to the other fine reviews, I opted to try this cocoa powder. It is delightful. While I really like the idea of fair trade certified, without the superior taste and texture it would mean little. Fortunately, it's not necessary to sacrifice quality when purchasing this 16 ounce bag of cocoa powder. Not only is it organic but it's delicious. The texture is fine/smooth, the fragrance is everything you would expect (maybe a bit more!) and the flavor is superb....all for a price you can't pass up. Unlike other varieties of powdered cocoa, this does NOT seem to have vanilla included which makes it a bit more versatile for some recipes.Excellent product!

I was so excited to receive my first dutch-processed cocoa powder especially after all the wonderful reviews of the Frontier one on Amazon.I was first apprehensive about the 'Organic Herbal Essence' - 'Frontier' mixup but when I saw a big red rimmed label with "Frontier" in green on the bag along with USDA Organic & Fair Trade mark/logos among other print, I quickly opened the bag and took out a spoonful of the powder to examine. I was slightly disappointed in the color, as I've read that dutch-processed cocoa powder had a deeper and sometimes redder color. I took out my box of natural, unsweetened Trader Joes cocoa powder and saw that the dutch-processed cocoa was darker and slightly redder in color in comparison, though not as much as I had hoped (and certainly not as deep as the picture on Amazon).I've also read that dutch-processed cocoa has a richer 'chocolatier' fragrance to it and so I took a whiff from the bag. To my dismay, a medicinal, acidic, spicey smell met my unsuspecting nose. I once again grabbed my Trader Joe's unalkalized cocoa powder and it smelled more 'chocolatier' than the Frontier bag. The expiration date is sometime in 2014 so I believe I either got a bad bag or this product is definitely not up to the hype. I even tried to mix some in my cup of coffee, as another reviewer had and raved about, and it tasted so.. 'off' and unappealing I had to mix in some sugar (I dont usually sweeten my coffee) and gulp down the rest (I hate wasting food and the coffee beans were kind of expensive heh).I'm still searching for a good dutch-processed cocoa powder, which is more difficult to find than I had hoped.. Thinking of looking into E Guittard, Pernigotti, or Green & Black next, at the recommendation of others, and Penzeys or Valrhona as last resorts (not available where I live and shipping is a killer). I'd suggest anyone looking for dutch-processed cocoa powder to skip this product and try the next option instead.

Do not waste your money on this product. It has an awful rancid flavor (this might be due to improper storage procedures and oxidation). Cannot return it either - Amazon return policy. Go for a superior product like the one from KAF.

column9: Very good, not sure I'd call it great
column10: I'm really new at buying cacao products (2 years new), so consider this a non-pro review. I have discovered the health benefits of raw cacao so my family has adopted eating cacao products (70% or more) and drinking cacao drinks, specifically smoothies blended with almond milk and raw organic cacao with a pack or two of splenda.  Talk about delicious! Remember I do this primarily for health benefits as a diabetic and you should do an internet search also if you are interested in what cacao products can do for you as a diabetic. New research is promising, so from that standpoint I give cacao products a 5 star rating for health and helping in my weight loss. Now for the taste rating. I've ordered several brands from Amazon and other companies also over the last 2 years. Frontier's product is good and the most recent of my orders, but I don't consider it as good as several other brands I've tried. Too be sure, it is good, and I recommend it, and maybe for cooking it would be outstanding, but it is to me not as tasty as some of the other brands. Your tastes may find this brand exemplary, so as they say, try it for yourself. I will close by saying again that I think this is a good product and worth trying.

I was hoping for more flavor. I have purchased dutch cocoa from Wilbur and their dutch cocoa is great. It has a wonderful rich flavor. This is just okay it is dutch so it's better than hershey's but it's not dutch. I would not buy it again if I wanted dutch I would stick with Wilbur or just buy Hershey's for the price.

If you're looking for a big ol' bag of great tasting powerful  chocolate cocoa at a great price,  then look no further.I split this with my sister who is a cookie making maniac,  and some of the cookies she made were to die for!  This time she got an entire box for herself.  Really good stuff!Try Cook's Illustrated Best Chocolate Cake,...bet you can't stop eating it.  It's super quick and easy to throw together.  No sickening sweet sugary frosting and just perfect.  I use this Frontier cocoa,  of course.BEST EASY CHOCOLATE CAKE:Makes one 8-inch-square cake.  Published March 1, 2009.  From Cook's Illustrated.We recommend using one of the test kitchen's favorite baking chocolates, Callebaut Intense Dark L-60-40NV, or Ghirardelli Bittersweet Chocolate Baking Bar for this recipe, but any high-quality dark, bittersweet, or semisweet chocolate will work. Instead of confectioners' sugar, the cake can also be served with sweetened whipped cream.INGREDIENTS1 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour (7 1/2 ounces)1 cup sugar (7 ounces)1/2 teaspoon baking soda1/4 teaspoon table salt1/2 cup Dutch-processed cocoa powder (2 ounces)2 ounces bittersweet chocolate , chopped fine (see note)1 cup fresh black coffee, hot2/3 cup mayonnaise1 large egg2 teaspoons vanilla extractConfectioners' sugar (for serving; optional)INSTRUCTIONS1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly spray 8-inch-square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.2. Whisk flour, sugar, baking soda, and salt together in large bowl. In separate bowl, combine cocoa and chocolate; pour hot coffee over cocoa mixture and whisk until smooth; let cool slightly. Whisk in mayonnaise, egg, and vanilla. Stir mayonnaise mixture into flour mixture until combined.3. Scrape batter into prepared pan and smooth top. Bake until wooden skewer inserted into center of cake comes out with few crumbs attached, 30 to 35 minutes.4. Let cake cool in pan on wire rack, 1 to 2 hours. Dust with confectioners' sugar, cut into squares, and serve straight from the pan; or turn cake out onto serving platter and dust with confectioners' sugar.

This is the best cocoa powder we have ever had.  So flavorful.  The packaging is a bag, so I suggest getting a nice container to put it in.

column9: Just what I ordered and it keeps my sweet tooth under control
column10: This cocoa powder is great for controling food cravings.  I use a large teaspoon of cocoa powder and 2 grams of Stevia in hot water.  It is tasty and eliminates my sweet tooth!  I ordered this in January and it was from Frontier.

I think I will have some happy friends! I need to make some brownies and chocolate cookies, and anything else I can come up with. Loved this Coco powder. Flavor is really good and so is smell. I am a Food blogger and I bake a lot. I just made chocolate cupcakes yesterday for Mother's day out of this Coco powder and I absolutely loved the flavor. Worth to buy. Will buy it next time for sure.

I highly recommend it for at home cooks. I am not sure what Amazon is selling right now, but the new bags are re-sealable which is a nice addition.

I was upset, and I called the customer service, and they sent me a new one without sending the defected one (which is bothering!!)I like the taste of this. I use this for drinking hot cocoa rather than baking. This tastes so mild. I mean, this is not too bitter for 100% cocoa. I like bitter taste of cocoa, but maybe it'll be a good point for most of you. Honestly, I think the taste of Ghirardelli cocoa is better than the taste of this, but this is organic so I believe this must have a better quality.(also fair-trade!) Anyway I am enjoying this with sugar-free vanilla syrup. This is a perfect way to enjoy delicious hot cocoa free of bad chemicals and high calories.
Have tried several organic cocoas, and this one rates right at the top for flavor, texture, and value.  Will purchase more.

If you like the true flavor of Chocolate (a bit bitter) this is the right mix. If you need it sweeter, add some sugar (OR better yet a healthy sugar substitute, like Xylitol) to make a great drink. I mix it with some instant coffee for a pick-me-up. One teaspoon does a full cup.

This is excellent cocoa and it has a rich creamy taste. I use it mostly for making chocolate milk using Meyenberg Evaporated Goat Milk (Meyenberg Evaporated Goat Milk, 12-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12). My recipe is:1  teaspoon Cocoa1/3 cup evaporated goat's milk1 cup water1 tablespoon sugar (or honey or sweetener)I add the ingredients in a drink shaker and shake it for about a minute. I use an 8 ounce drink shaker and add the mix in a large cup then add more water depending on how rich I want the drink to be. The recipe is flexible so you can make it creamier by adding more milk or richer by adding more cocoa.

This may not be five-star baking cocoa, but it is very good and more than adequate for my purposes. It's affordable, yet definitely a higher quality than what my local grocery store carries.I use it to make hot cocoa for my kids, as well as in baked goods and homemade chocolate syrup.
Hard to fin this cocoa but found it on Amazon.  The cocoa work great in the cake I was making.

This is great stuff. I use it in baking and making desserts with silken tofu. You have to be careful not to use too much though, I looked up equivalents for chocolate chips and if you follow those exactly it's way too chocolatey.
This is a family favorite, and it is a great price even with the fair trade, win- win.

I love Frontier products.  You can rely on them always being of excellent quality!  This cocoa is fabulous!  It has a wonderful rich chocolate flavor and is truly a treat in any recipe!  Outstanding organic product!
I would highly recommend this cocoa powder. It has a rich and pleasant flavor to it, might be the best I've tried so far. Well worth the money.

column9: ITS GREAT IN MY PROTEIN SHAKE
column10: I LOVE IT. IT'S NOT SWEET SO I ADD TRUVIA BUT I ADD IT TO MY PROTEIN SHAKE WITH FAT FREE MILK AND 2 TBSP OF THE COCOA ARE THE PERFECT ADDITION. I WILL DEFINITELY BUY AGAIN WHEN I'M OUT. I used this cocoa to make the King Arthur Flour fudge brownie recipe (on the bag of flour); it turned out perfectly.
Definitely some of the best cocoa I've used.  The only down side is that it cost more than twice what the standard store bought stuff does.
We love this organic cocoa, and cannot believe how inexpensive it is. You really do get a good product for your money here.

This product used to be sold for 11.24 about three months ago, ever since then the price has been going up more and more. The price went up 3 dollars in two weeks!!! I received yesterday my order of one 8oz bottle of that "pur Maple extract". Opened the bottle right away, i knew then it was a VERY weak extract.Put it to the test already, my recipe calls for 1 teasp. extract for the batter, I used 2 TABLESpoons, to no avail, as the cake, now cooled has no maple flavor in its batter TO JUSTIFY THE TITLE OF MAPLE WALNUT CAKE...THOUGH THE WALNUTS i TOASTED GIVE IT A GOOD FLAVOR.The glaze recipe called for one teaspoon extract also, I used a full TABLESPOON, and the glaze is delicious.THIS PRODUCT DELIVERS A VERY FAINT MAPLE FLAVOR, not what you would expect for an extract at that price.Will never purchase this item again, I am going to investigate other brands. I bought this for a friend that owns a bakery. She liked it real well.  I gave her the information to buy it direct.

At first I had a hard time removing these lids from small cans such as Fancy Feast.  The solution is to just add hot water to a bowl and set the can in the bowl.  This takes the chill off the cat food and also makes the lid easier to remove.  (The cats don't like cold food and they don't like the microwave method!!)

I have been looking all over for a lid that will fit both sizes of 3 oz. cat food cans -- some brands such as Before Grain and Blue Buffalo Wilderness have slightly oversized 3 oz. cans compared to Fancy Feast or Wellness.  Lids that I have seen at the pet store and elsewhere fit the smaller cans, but not the slightly larger ones.  Anyway, these Petmate lids did fit both size 3 oz. cans, along with two sizes of larger cans. HOWEVER, the plastic is so stiff and hard that they are next to impossible to snap on and off.  They were basically unusable and I threw them away.I also ordered another brand of lids (OurPets) for small cans and they are a dream.  They fit both sizes of small cans and are soft and easy to put on and take off.  Would recommend them over the Petmate Kitty-Kaps for sure.

I paid an outrageous price ($1.49) for this product at a pet store.  It is made far too rigidly to work on the smallest size cans.  Once it is on the can, it is impossible for me to remove.  I enlisted my husband's help and even he has trouble getting it off.  I was given a FREE can cover at another pet store.  It is a softer plastic and works much better.  If you use the smallest size cans, forget about this one!

The lid is good, it works very nicely on two different can sizes. BUT, I thought I was purchasing two lids. The photograph shows two lids, but only one arrives. Read the fine print - there is only one in the description. $5.99 for a cat food lid!

I was disappointed when the product arrived and only one can cover was inside. I assumed by the image I was getting two covers - one orange and one yellow - but I only got the orange one. Had I known or realized this, I would have purchased from another vendor. So basically, I paid $6 for one lid. Boo. I was also frustrated that the lid was covered in stickers with glue that DOES NOT WANT TO COME OFF! I've tried to removed the sticky goop, but now I have to go buy goo-gone to get all the crap off. I don't feel like this lid fits as good as the lid I had previously. It works and gets the job done, but I don't think it's keep the food super fresh. Oh well, lesson learned.

column9: Great product for small or large cans
column10: Easy to use and accommodates multiple sizes.  Sturdy construction.
I thought I'd be getting two lids but only received one.  They work fine for various size of cans but product is overpriced for just one of them.
These are the best canned cat food tops I've ever owned... They are sturdy and actually fit on pretty much all size cans.  Very useful.

column9: Seem pricey. I like them for 5.5  oz or large dog food cans I buy
column10: I don't use small cans like Fancy Feast, so I cannot comment on those. However, I like these because they LAST. I bought them at a pet food store which no longer carries them, probably because they are so expensive.Except for a lid I bought at least 15 years ago labelled Sargeant's, these are the sturdiest. The more flimsy ones always end up getting a crack in them and are not always tight.For me, the 4 stars, not 5, is because they seem expensive. However, on Amazon, it seems that most of the can covers are more expensive than you would want to pay. It's the S & H that is outrageous.

The good- fits the small friskies cans as well as the bigger cans to keep the food fresh. Fits on the cans with ease. Airtight.The bad- Hard to pull off the can since it is snug. Pricey for a piece of hard plastic.

column9: Does what it is suppose to do...cover cans.
column10: I have used these for almost 2 years on all the sizes of food cans that my cats and dog eat and haven't had any problems at all.  They are a stiffer plastic than the single size lids, but they still work well.  I have found that you do have to push down more on the smallest size cans to get the seal though. Anyway, I have a couple sets because it is so easy to have a lid that works on them all.

This is absolutely the best cat food can cover I have ever run across.  It fits all of the common can sizes, including the smaller cans.  They seal well and last a long time.  Another review said they were difficult to get on, and that is true for the first couple of uses, but they will give a little as you use them and become easier to snap on.  Great product!!

I use three different sizes of cat food cans (kitty loves variety), and these lids fit them all. Also, if you care about that sort of thing, it's a very cute design. The ears are helpful for pulling it off the can. :) I just wish I could find these closer to where I live so I wouldn't have to pay 4-5 dollars shipping every time I lost one.

column9: Kitty Kap is the best lid available!

If you like Chef Boyardee then you'll like this canned product. Fair price, quick delivery and stock my pantry. Works for me

This little known product has such great versatility . it will flavor and season rice , or try it with a little coconut milk to make a sauce for your rice or noodles .

column9: Great way to spice up rice
column10: This product works as well as the powder form of Puliogare paste.  Honestly I prefer the powder, since it store better after opening.  The paste form here has oil that oxidizes if not used quickly enough.  Really isn't a problem using up a pouch quickly enough if one likes puliogare rice.  I recommend this product for anyone who wants to make spicy Indian food at home.

I really enjoy these crackers.  They can be used for dipping, i.e., hummus, vegetable dips or just plain.  They are very good for dieters who want the crunch without the calories.  I highly recommend them!

Sour.  Goodness, the sour.  My boyfriend & I are connoisseurs of sour; we don't consider it sour until we've lost control of the facial twitching.  These do the trick.  Not really a great idea for small children... (under 12's should be brave souls)The three flavors are all good; the red (watermelon) is the sourest by FAR.  The green apple is mildest, and the blue raspberry is nicely in-between.  One frustrating aspect is that the sour lasts for about a minute or two, then the flavor lasts another 3 minutes (we literally timed it) and then you're chewing caulk.  No detectable purpose to this gum after the first 5 minutes.  Think of it more as a chewy candy-style experience.  Don't expect a bubble gum.  Despite this, I gave it a 4 because I really like the idea of sour gum - even if short-lived.The price is reasonable for the bulk amount, as well.  Good to pass around at parties and see who withstands it!  Also, does in fact blow decent bubbles.

This natural sweetener product tastes better than other liquid stevia I have tried, it tastes sweet without any chemical aftertaste.  This sweetener works very well instead of sugar in most applications (beverages), though with black coffee it is clear the product is not sugar.  Its probably the acidity level in the coffee that creates a different result than that with Iced Tea, which tastes very good with stevia.Other Stevia products have tasted more like a chemical to me when tried.
Sweet and tangy with just the right amount of kick.  That comes from someone that can't take too much heat.

this sauce is sweet, tangy, thick and is a great addition to pork, chicken, steaks or whatever you want it on. If you looking for something new and great tasting, give this and Tennessee red sauce a try. the Tennessee red is more vinegar base and more spicy but ends in a sweet note that can't be beat.
Goes great on ribs or brisket.Only thing I would like is just a little more spicey. Just cooked a great case of ribs and everyone loved them

Much better than anything you'll find in your local grocery store. It is a thick & sweet gritty peppered sauce with a little heat. It really mixes well with Blues Hog Tennessee Red sauce which adds vinegar and fruit character (also thins it).

This is a sweet BarBQ sauce what is good for most anything. I haven't tried it on fish yet, but it works with everything else. A good price as well and it comes in a goodly quantity. Try it, you'll probably like it.
This is my new favorite sauce just ordered it in the gallon. Sweet the a little kick! But not hotDanny

By far the most popular application is a blend of 50% Tennessee Red and 50% of the "Regular" Blues Hog.  Their Smokey Mountain variation (sometimes hard to find) is a stand alone rock star...a perfect compliment to a rack of ribs or a mountain of pulled pork. I would give this sauce 6 stars if I could.

Amazing sweet BBQ sauce with great flavor and subtle kick! It is absolutely delicious on ribs and other meats. When refrigerated it comes out thick but when left out in room temperature it comes out runny. One of my favorite. Highly recommended.

I grew up in New Orleans so I'm always hesitant to buy anything that says "New Orleans" on it since I am sure to be disappointed by the lack of authenticity. This cornbread however is delicious, moist and tasty. It gives you a homemade taste without all the fuss.

I've been using Folger's Coffee Singles for 3 years or so.  Since I am the only coffee drinker in the house, they are so simple to use and taste as good as brewed coffee...but no leftovers!  I also try to control my caffeine intake and what is more simple than a single serving of real brewed coffee made in your cup.  I take them traveling, better than the hotel coffee anyday.  The decaf is also great.  The answer to camping, work and play.
These coffee bags are so convenient and taste really good.Plus they are available in both regular and decaffeinated.
I love these things, use them at work every day, so much easier than messing with a coffee maker for the office. Also use them when we travel, hotels never give you enough coffee bags in the rooms.

column9: Break the cycle of overpriced coffee pods once and for all!!
column10: Just because these come in a tea bag type of pouch does not mean they can not be brewed in a single cup ($20) coffee pot. I tried this method of brewing single cups of coffee out of disgust with the price of the all-mighty K cups pods. With K cups, I found myself spiraling toward financial ruin simply to enjoy coffee in a single serving cup.So, for A FRACTION of the cost here is what I recommend. Purchase a $20 single serve coffee maker, doesn't matter the brand but this is the exact one I use with the metal permanent filter removed Single Serve Coffee Maker ...get the cheapest one you can find. All it is doing is heating water - keep that in mind. Put one of these tea bag style pouches in the filter compartment. Push it down really good in the filter holder and make sure the water won't flow around it as it hits the bag. Sit back and wait, soon you will have a perfect cup of Folgers coffee.I have not brewed a pot of coffee any other way since going to these. I have purchased hundreds of packets and have never been disappointed. I just hope Folgers doesn't realize what they have here and jack up the price.So...cut yourself loose from the K cup cycle and with the cash you save treat yourself by purchasing one of the out-of-service space shuttles, or send an entire class of graduates at your local school to Harvard.So...cut yourself loose from the K cup cycle and with the cash you save treat yourself by purchasing one of the out-of-service space shuttles, or send an entire class of graduates at your local school to Harvard.
I use at least two (2) of these coffee singles each morning.  Easy, fast and delicious.  Excellent product...

column9: Tastes better than instant, less work than a coffee pot
column10: These single packs are nice and convenient. Other brands make them, like Maxwell House also sold at Amazon, but I prefer the Folgers for now.  They work just like a teabag, you place them in hot water in your mug and let them steep. The amount of time to steep or dunk is relative to your what you like in flavor, simply let it sit longer for stronger coffee. For some reason, both this brand and others have chose to place 19 in a box, weird that they do not round off to 20. The bags are cordoned off in separate containers to stay fresh longer. While I will still use my regular pot for camping as it is part of the experience, I can see where this would be great for lighter weight backpacking, the flavor is better than instant for sure and not as messy.

I really enjoy this coffee. I use it at home and work.At work, I use it in my office. With some filtered water and my Black & Decker Cup-at-a-Time coffee maker, I make a cup of hot (just right) water. I put the Folgers coffee bag in the coffee mug first and let the hot water drip onto it while it's making. When the coffee maker (or in my case, hot water maker) is finished, i dunk my coffee bag for about 10 seconds. I then let it sit for about 30 seconds. Voila' ! A wonderful cup of coffee. Another definite plus is the aroma experienced while brewing! It smells so good! Also, I don't have to walk from the 3rd floor to the 1st floor where there may or may not be fresh coffee made.At home, I sometimes like a cup of coffee on the weekend. I use the microwave. These bags have no metal on them, so you can put the bag in the cold water in your mug and then microwave. I microwave for about 1 minute and 45 seconds. (With my microwave, this just brings the water to a boil when the microwave cuts off.) I let the bag sit or a minute or two and I have a great cup of coffee. Others like to heat the water by itself and pour it over the bag in the mug.This coffee taste great, is very smooth and very convenient. The price is very reasonable for what you get. It's also one of the very few coffees I have found that doesn't give me heartburn! I hope you enjoy it as much as I do!

My husband is the coffee drinker in the family.  And, after years of selecting and grinding the beans, steeping the coffee, he decided to try the coffee bags.  He decided he liked the taste and it was so quick and easy.  I let the coffee bag steep much longer than is recommended(5 minutes) and also dunk the bag for about 1 minute.
I LOVE THE FOLGERS COFFEE SINGLES, CONVENIENT IN THE OFFICE AND ON THE GO. GREAT TASTE. FULLY RECCOMEND FOR PEOPLE WHO ARE ALWAYS BUSY!

The taste and satisfaction of a cup of coffee made with a Folgers coffee bag lies somewhere between that made with ground coffee and that made with instant. And in that limbo territory it's closer to ground than instant.For those who want more flavor it's important to let the bag seep for at least five minutes or even longer if you don't mind reheating in the microwave. I like the taste of coffee made with these singles and use them when I just want one cup or when making a pot of "real" coffee is inconvenient or impossible. These singles are great for taking on vacation or for using at work.I still prefer my coffee from the pot, but these Folgers Classic Singles are a viable, convenient alternative in some situations. In fact, as I finish typing this review, I'm also finishing up a satisfying cup of coffee made with a Folgers coffee bag.

Ok this is a tea bag coffee. Really you expect Great move right along. But good these were surprisingly better than expected. We'll freeze the extra bags we don't use now to keep fresh over time. Backpack, camping and yes on the train in motel rooms etc. Used one of those little nify metal rods that heat coffee in the cup with a travel mug that's silcone coated outside and stainless inside and the heater fits just right. No trouble bumping around in train car either. Boils water in 3 minutes about and added the coffee bag to the boiling water before removal of the rod. Then unplug rod and cooled it under water faucet and repack it and capped the travel mug with it's lid after removal of the bag. Worked so slick....we did just love it...New thing for us anyway.

column9: Fresh & tasty coffee when I need it!
column10: I really like these in the office instead of brewing a full pot of coffee (sometimes I'm the only one who's drinking it).  It's surprisingly good.  You do have to let it steep for a while, otherwise it's too weak.

I am a huge fan of Folgers Coffee Singles. They're convenient, and the coffee tastes great. Ordering them through Amazon is a better deal than buying them at the grocery store because the price is significantly cheaper and they come to your door in a timely manner with no delivery charge if you buy in bulk. I'm on an auto delivery plan, and I couldn't be happier with it. Saved me even more money, and I don't have to remember to keep myself stocked.

column9: Great, convenient way to brew a cup of tasty coffee
column10: I stopped drinking coffee years ago, but recently decided that a dose of caffeine wouldn't be a bad idea.  Since I only want a cup or two a day, I looked for a simple way to get it done.  The Folger's single servings are great.  Each bag brews an excellent cup of aromatic, flavorful coffee. Just microwave a cup of water, dunk the bag for however long you like and you've got your cup of coffee. I find that 30 - 45 seconds of dunking gives me what I want.  I tried a generic brand from the local store - and it was pretty bad. Weak, little taste and lots of oil on the surface. The Folgers is real coffee in a convenient to use package. I'm sold on them.Jerry

Although Folger's Coffee Singles probably wouldn't receive a very high rating from a true coffee aficionado, they are perfect for a simple 'wake up with coffee' drinker like myself.  Since I only drink 1-2 cups of coffee a day they serve me well for daily use at home.  I have also taken them with me when traveling abroad and camping.  Easy to pack, easy to use.  I must say that I've tried other brands but like Folger's the best.

I LOVE THESE. Started using post labor.  GREAT cup of coffee, just DON'T follow directions. Make sure water is a ROLLING BOIL, not just hot, then leave the bag in for 5 full minutes. Perfect every time. I don't suggest longer than that unless you want it bitter. 5 minutes delivers a decently strong cup without bitterness (when lightly sweetened & a touch of cream). I use a large 16-20oz mug and two bags.

column9: Save money on K cups, use these bags instead
column10: I use these when I just want a cup of coffee. I make tea the same way. Just put the bag in my cup. Set it under the spout just as if I had put a K cup in the machine. Make sure to operate the handle after the blue light comes on. Then push the blue button you want for the size of the cup and the hot water flows into the cup, over the bag and in a copule if minutes I have a nice hot cup of coffee! I use the K cups for desert coffees. It saves money and is much faster and less wasteful than old types of coffee makers.

As the little blurb mentions, if you stuff the pouch into the Keurig dispenser, and use the 6oz size setting, you get a really great tasting cup of coffee; tried the 8oz setting, but it turned out to be a little too weak for my taste.  Try it, you'll like it....JimMc

This way of making coffee is an excellent idea for those of us who have an office and need to make one or two cups at a time.I will continue to purchase and drink this excellent coffee.  By the way, it tates much better than the ground coffee, in my opinion, but you know opinions, so make your own choices.  Try one box before you buy the six pack.Thanks

There's no denying that coffee singles are convenient for people who don't drink coffee every day or don't want to deal with the hassle of cleaning out the coffee maker (like myself).  However, the coffee from these singles is rather bland, with not much taste and no body.  Personally, I'm not convinced that theses singles are that much better than instant coffee.  Use them for the caffeine, not the taste.
Excellent Product, Great Price, On time Delivery, Highly Recommend this product to anyone that goes through a lot of coffee like my husband.

MY FAULT for not reading closely and reading reviews before ordering.  AMAZON'S fault for placing these products in with the K Cup. And of course they cannot be returned.  I will donate them to something or someone and be much smarter before ordering again!
A friend told me about this new singles bag Folgers coffee.  Started shopping and found the best deal here on Amazon.  Send my order, came quickly.  Very handy and great tasting coffee.

column9: Delicious coffee - much better than instant
column10: I go camping in a cabin that has no electric, but a wood cook stove.  Boiling water is not a problem, but a coffee pot is.  I hate instant coffee, but that is all that is available there.  Then I found these.  These are a great alternative to instant.  I think the coffee is smooth and delicious - just as good as my fresh brewed at home.  They're easier to brew than tea - just one minute in boiling water.  Now these are one of my essential items when I go camping.

This is the worst tasting coffee I've ever had. I have drunk many cups of Folgers coffee in my life; I've never been a big fan of their product but it was good enough for consumption at work. This is the first time I purchased their single serving coffee bags. I was excited about the product because it "scratched an itch" I had. Little did I know that this coffee was not at all drinkable. I've tried it twice and both cups had this awful, skunky flavor. I will not be purchasing this product again. Caveat - both bags that I used for brewing were from the same box. It's possible that I got a bad box but I'm not going to throw good money after bad to find out.

column9: TOO MANY BAGS LEAKED  DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY
