Perfect for those enjoying just one cup at a time vs. several or the pot!  Especially convenient for travel.  I use them when traveling by air or at a relative's home who may prefer their coffee strong enough to slice!  Cheers!

column9: Good Coffee You Can Take Anywhere
column10: I love the convenience of these small little tea-like packets. I used to use the coffee maker at work but the machine seems to never be as clean as I'd prefer and buying coffee on the road can get pricey. So, I found these as a worthy alternative to the traditional drip systems. They're convenient and the price is right. They travel well and I highly recommend them to anyone that is often on the go and needs quick and easy coffee without the mess for that pick-me-up.One helpful tip: I get best results when I brew with hot hot hot water from my electric tea kettle. This is definitely the way to get the best flavors. After allowing the coffee to brew in my mug a few minutes I drop a couple ice cubes in and it's the perfect temperature for hitting the road.
I don't drink coffee so this is a great product to keep on hand for my coffee drinking friends & family.  Plus they say it tastes great.

column9: Great like a tea bag with good coffee inside
column10: This is so handy for work.  Microwave a cup of water and dip a coffee bag in it.The coffee maker at work is a big mess.  This is a very clean way to have a morning cup of coffee.

I am the only one here who drinks coffee in the morning.  It is a waste to make a pot for one person, so the bags are terrific and really taste great.  I have been using them for years and will continue to use them.

column9: Folgers Coffee Singles purchased on Amazon
column10: Although it's not as good as Folgers fresh brewed it is good enough for a quick cup at the end of the day. I would recommend this product.

column9: A different way of making a cup of coffee
column10: You should try these singles if you drink just one cup of coffee in the morning. They taste the same as normally brewed coffee, but it could take some time to get the brew process just right for you.Pros versus a coffee pot brewer: Less waste, less mess, less time to brewCons: Doesn't work well for multiple cups of coffee, prone to errorBecause the brew process has to be manually performed by a person, it is easy for someone to make a watery cup of coffee using these. It wasn't until I got the process down that my cups started tasting like real coffee. Ultimately this is the same stuff you put in a pot brewer, so it tastes the exact same if done right.When you read the instructions, its important to follow all of the steps. There are three important parts: HOT water, steep time, and dunk time.HOT water: I have an electric tea kettle which can boil a cup of water in about 1 minute. I like it because it automatically turns off after the water is boiling, and its less mess than microwaving a pyrex container or a pot on the stove. Mine is a white plastic one that cost about $12. I highly recommend this method because it will get the water the right temperature every time.Steep time: After pouring the hot water into a mug with the coffee single bag, the instructions tell you to wait a minute. My experience is you can vary this time depending on preference. More time equals stronger coffee. I generally let it sit for 1-2 minutes.Dunk time: The part of the instructions I skipped over my first time was the dunking process. The instructions say to dunk the bag into the cup for 15 seconds. I find this process is where a large portion of the coffee flavor comes from. Once again this can be varied to suit taste. I generally dunk for 10-20 seconds.After performing the steps as the box says, it ends up tasting just like normal coffee. If you're used to strong coffee, all you have to do is let it steep longer, dunk longer, or put multiple bags in at the same time.I like this product and use it exclusively now. It ends up cost me less than how much I was spending making small pots of coffee. Its also more convenient for me. Highly recommend giving this a try
Folgers Coffee Singles have been a favorite with us for several years for their convenience for making quickly a satisfactory cup of coffee or a quick iced coffee.
I'm not a big coffee drinker and it's hard for me to brew a perfect cup each time, but with Folgers Singles EVERY cup is perfect. It tastes better than brewed and is easy and convenient to use.

column4: Michael Santomauro "What sort of Truth is it ...
column10: It has the most rich and pleasing taste of hundreds of the different coffees I have ever tried.I only want to sleep 4 hours a day and this coffee keeps me awake--I LOVE THE TASTE OF FOLGERS--in tea bag only.I use my Keurig machine for my hot water.

I wake up with Folgers everyday for the last few years now. I love the aroma and taste, and I like that this comes in pack of 6, it stocks me up for quite a while. thank you for the quick shipping too. I would definitely purchase from this seller in the future.

I like the test and convenience of these Folgers bags, but about half of them are defective. Yes, the bags are not keeping the coffee in because they are not well sealed. This completely gives away the "convenience." Great idea bad implemented. I regret I bought 6 boxes of this product.

Was camping in the Northern Rockies last fall.  We ran out of coffee, decided to try these for ease.  We'd been using an old fashioned percolator on the campfire.  One bag was weak, and even two were so so.  I can live with a few grounds I decided!  And the dog loves the grounds too... :D

If you think this coffee is good you should compare it to something that was not made in an old school percolator. This coffee takes me back to the coffee that was the standard in the early 70's. We have so much more choice today. With coffee that really tastes good. One thing this coffee is good for is if you are cold and tired and you need something fast to get you going this stuff will work.

Took these camping. While convenient to lug around, I ended up using 4 packets in a cup and there was still no strength (both in flavor and caffeine). Next time will just throw some dirt in the cup and swish around with water.
Without a doubt, the worst cup of coffee I've ever had in my entire life.  Has no body, no taste.  Awful.

I thought I had ordered the coffee K-Cups as that is what I had brought up on the screen.  When they arrived and a saw that it was not the correct product I went back to Amazon only to discover that they were not returnable.  I will NEVER order these type of products from Amazon again!~I donated the package to the local food bank.
I searched k cups and these came up. I ordered 30 dollars worth and now I cannot return them so I am stuck with a product I do not want.

Lipton Tea to Go is great I love it.  The price is about what I paid in the store but this seller is charging shipping on each individual box of tea.  I was going to purchase all in stock which was 11 boxes at $2.00 a box should have been $22.00 + shipping it was like $66.00 for the order. THE PRICING IS DECEIVING.

column9: Almost as Delicious as a Mango Margarita, Just a Bit More Tart
column10: Lipton Green Tea to Go, Mandarin and Mango offers a fresh-tasting delicate sweet tea that delivers zero calories and ten mg of caffeine per eight ounce fluid serving.  The Unilever product comes in a small box, packed in ten handy flutes.  It is, the manufacturer states, made from real tea leaves and contains 80 mg tea flavenoids per eight fluid ounce servings.  It is also sweetened with real fruit flavors.  It is, as well, easy to prepare.  You can add a packet to one bottle (16.9 fl. oz. of water), or half a packet to a glass of water: just stir and enjoy.  The tea does take a little bit longer to dissolve than some other mixing powders, so you do have to shake, or stir well.  It's obviously a handy thing to keep on hand for the office, the gym, the backpack, or anywhere you are on the go.  I've found it's a good pick-me-up when I'm hot and tired in the afternoon.I found the taste quite sweet and delicious.  What can I say, I just love mango Margaritas, figure somebody snuck that recipe out of paradise.  The mandarin orange taste here does add a bit of tartness, too.  However, in the list of ingredients I find Aspartame (Sweetener), Corn Syrup Solids, Modified Corn Starch,  Maltodextrin, and  Acesulfame Potassium as sweeteners: these ingredients concern me.  (Of course, I've no idea what might be in the mango margarita mix that bars use, so.)  I'm not a dietitian, just do my best to eat healthy stuff; this drink might, still, be more healthy than diet soda, I just don't know.

column9: Lipton Mango Manderian Tea o Go
column10: Very disappointed I can no longer buy Lipton Mango Manderian Tea To Go.  It was my favorite summer drink. Lipton, please bring this great tea back.

I was very disappointed when I found out that Lipton had discontinued its "Mango Mandarin" flavored green tea!  I used to buy five boxes at a time when I would go grocery shopping.  I'd keep some at home and bring some to work.  A few months ago, maybe even a year ago, that I went grocery shopping I thought they had just ran out but I was told that they had discontinued it!  I hate that.  I hope they realize that many people like it and want it back on the shelves!

I am very disappointed in Lipton for discontinuing this product. Like another reviewer I agree that their new products made with honey are way to sweet and their combinations of flavors don't compare to the Mandarin/Mango flavor. I called their customer service line to voice my opinion and my disappointment.  Their customer service representative was very nice and stated that she would make note of my disappointment and then offered to send me some samples and coupons for some of their new teas, which was  a very nice gesture.  I did recieve the product and coupons but have not found anything that tastes as good as the Mandarin/Mango ice tea mix.  I hope that if enough of their customers let them know how disappointed we are, they'll bring the product back to the market (just the way it was with no changes).  I live in MA and traveled to CT to purchase all the product one store had in stock . . . And now my stock is almost gone.  I refuse to pay what the online retailers are charging for the product, paying the s/h per box is ridiculous.  :o(

It is a shame that lipton has discontinued this product.  One of the best.  Now they have that Junk with Honey.  Awful.  Re think Lipton. I paid the price from this " Discontinued Vendor":  Who ever it is they are very smart. Pay if you love the product.  I was glad to get it.

This is a really good product.  I like the flavor and I am really sorry to see it off the grocery store shelves.  I have tried many different flavors of Lipton Tea to Go and find the Mandarin & Mango to be my favorite flavor.

column9: best trail mix on the market
column10: None of that super-sugared [candied] dried fruit or flat tasting candy [e.g., chocolate] chips to mess up a yummy, but healthy snack. Don't get me wrong, I LOVE chocolate--the darker the better--but what they put in trail mixes is worse than nothing. If I want candy, I'll buy the good stuff.Thanks, Amazon. My local market no longer carries it.
I loved this product and I can't find it in my local stores.  I had to be careful not to eat too much :).

column9: The perfect drink to go with .
column10: This is the best mix I've ever had and I tried them all,however I can't find them in any of the markets I frequent. The best drink to go with them is ice cold fat free milk, filling too.

Excellent tasting product containing heart healthy nuts and seeds without much of the heart unhealthy salt found in many other trail mix products.  Salt is the last item on the ingredient list.  It is also not very oily and I particularly like the generous amount of cashews in each package. The downside of being so enjoyable is that there are 800 calories per package (160 cal/serving) and it is very hard to eat just one small serving.Enjoy!
Pretty good snack mix, but definately was too heavy on peanuts. Bags seem to not be evenly mixed.

It is so nice to find this. We used to buy it at walgreens but they quit carrying it. They carry only their store brand now which is way to salty. Excellent to have our favorite Planters Trail mix! Thank you so much Amazon!! Nice healthy snack!
love the way the trail mix tasted with out all the salt it was great it was fresh and has a good taste to it.
Thank you Amazon, I ordered the "Nuts, Seeds and Resins" as it was not available in the stores. I am very happy, the product is fresh and as I expected.
Most excellent trail mix and in just right size for portability and having enough product. Shipped lightning fast. Even with the free shipping option, it came in 3 days.

I like healthy granolas and cashews so i naturally like this. My only complaint is they went a bit overboard on the small seeds. I ended up eating most of it and all I had left was the small seeds on the bottom. I like seeds but that was a bit much. I will try the other flavors though as I do like the trail mix. I was almost surprised at the amount of fat though: 12g per serving, 5 servings a bag.

This is a more refreshing coffee.  Tastes clean, rather than a dirty/overwhelming experience.  Light, with touches of milk and sweetness on the palate.I just woke up.  These are the words that came to me.

I bought this after reading Opinunated's review of Sambal Oelek.  In their review they listed ingredients from label but failed to list all ingredients.  I thought I had finally found a chili paste that didn't have a bunch of preservatives.  Unfortunately Sambal Oelek has a couple.  Here is the entire ingredient list:  "Chili, Salt, Distilled Vinegar, Potassium Sorbate and Sodium Bisulite as preservatives and Xanthan Gum.  CONTAINS SULPHITE (Sodium bisulfite)".

This sauce is AMAZING stuff. I don't like extraordinarily spicy food, and this is perfect. It gives a nice kick of fire without being overbearing. What I especially love about this sauce is the sweetness. Purely from a flavor standpoint, this sauce is delicious. I love to ladle good-size spoonfuls of this stuff onto my rice and stir-fry dishes. It's addictive!
Nice heat, good flavor, plays well with other ingredients.  Mix w/ mayo and agave, pour over cubed chicken or shrimp for appetizer....add to pasta, rice or lettuce--yum!
IF you are someone who likes hot sauce this is a nice change.  I find it especially good on eggs, but can be used on just about anything you would put hot sauce on.

This chilli is so fresh, you can't believe it came from a bottle. I use this to marinade fish, as part of the dipping sauce for dumplings, and add it to just about everything! It adds a kick and freshness to the dish.

I LOVE this sauce.  It is great on just about everything - I'm a hot sauce freak and cannot use sauces with garlic.  This sauce fits the bill - hot and great taste!  If you like hot, this is the sauce for you.

The overall taste of this sauce was a disappointment to me. I love many of this company's products so I was a bit surprised that this chili paste didn't taste any better. There are bitter notes to this sauce which I attribute to chile seeds, vinegar and an excessive amount of salt.  Buy some dry red pepper flakes and you'll eliminate the bitterness of this sauce but otherwise replicate it almost perfectly.I much prefer the Huy Fong's Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce. It is not only hotter but it has a wonderful sweetness to it combined with some pleasant garlic notes.This is a good company but not every one of its products hits the mark. This chili paste misses the mark by a wide margin in my view.The product label lists (in this order) chiles (with seeds), salt and then vinegar. The vinegar and salt add a lot of bitterness. As I said - I like this company's products but not this particular one. Salt and vinegar do NOT complement chiles that well in my view.

column9: Si ves esta salsa comprala inmediatamente
column10: Esta salsa no es facil de conseguir, a menos que tengas mercados asiaticos cerca de tu casa, tiene un balance perfecto de acidez y picante con unos toques dulces que apenas se pueden percatar.La puedes usar para cocinar, aderezar, sazonar y es muy versatil.que bueno que Amazon tiene este producto, algunos se pueden parecer, pero yo recomiendo exactamente esta salsa.
Appreciate the fast service for this very useful item for cooking.  I only found it in a store in Florida, and could not find it in New York.
Very tasty, not heavy just a light plain salt taste with a hint of herbal flavor to it. Just love it!

column9: goes on everything, not too spicy!
column10: This sauce goes with everything.  It's not too spicy once you get the first couple pours out of the bottle.  Mae Ploy's is the best I've had, although any brand will probably be good.
This is great mixed with mayo, sour cream etc.,...but use a tiny amount...this is hot!

column9: All's fair in love and chocolate
column10: Equal Exchange Hot Cocoa is... okay. It's good if you want something to warm you up on a cold winter evening. The directions say "add hot water"... resulting in a blend that's somewhat bland,with a strange aftertaste. This is odd,considering that Equal Exchange's chocolate bars are excellent,along with their coffee. Perhaps it would taste better in hot milk. It's good for flavoring coffee. One can make a good cup of joe with it! I think I'll get their chili-flavored cocoa some time soon. THAT looks like it has a kick,unlike this.

The cilantro seeds I ordered from GROWaLOT through Amazon not only arrived before the expected delivery date, they also came with free plant markers and a thank you !  The instructions in the seed packet were easy to follow and within a few weeks the cilantro began growing.  Excellent product and excellent service.

Our very picky BOM (beagle/pomeranian) AbiGirl, will not eat just "anything".. in fact, she won't eat most anything unless it is human grade food. When we found Nature's Variety canned foods, I was so relieved to see her wholeheartedly gobble her portion and LICK THE BOWL!Now we are relieved to know that she is getting good quality food with all the supplements she needs to stay healthy. Just read the ingredients and take a sniff- and you'll be ready to put some of this on a plate for yourself! This Prairie style Beef and Barley is her absolute favorite. She likes the Instinct Chicken and Turkey as an alternative. We believe it's worth the price  - great quality, wonderful aroma and first rate nutrition.

Those who label this as weak and  tasteless must be used to drinking straight espresso because this is very good tasting coffee and not weak at all. Although sometimes I question amazon reviews generally...This is a delicious cup of coffee not to strong not too weak (I tend to lean towards strong coffee personally). I do have 1 complaint though, It did not seem to brew a larger cup than that of my other t discs, I really doubt if that is 12 ounces.That being said I prefer this to my Starbucks blend t discs. Starbucks is a slight bitter in comparison, this is richer and a perfect middle ground between dark and light brew with terrific flavor!
This is a nice mild brew no where near as strong as the Starbucks brand of discs. It fills a travel mug nicely without having to add any extra water at the end of the cycle.

Clearly this is a subjective matter since I'm in disagreement with previous reviewers.  But while I have at least enjoyed, even loved other coffee varieties in the Tassimo machine, I hated the Gevalia Morning Roast so much I threw the rest away after making several attempts to tolerate it.  It was terribly weak, almost chemical-tasting; it tastes like what comes out of a traditional drip coffee maker if you forget to replace the used grounds with fresh ones.  (For the record, my favorites are the Starbucks House Blend and Colombian; Seattle's Best Henry's Blend is milder, less flavorful than those but still a decent cup of coffee, and cheaper than the Starbucks; Starbucks Verona is too strong for my taste.)

column9: This is MILD not MEDIUM roast
column10: While the product description on Amazon is "Medium Roast", this is actually "Mild" - clearly seen on the lower left of the package in the photo.  I didn't know this until I received my shipment today.  (I wish I had paid more attention to the photo.)I haven't tried the coffee because I'm generally a fan of stronger coffee.  I just wanted to warn that the description was incorrect.

This stuff is absolutely horrible tasting, and not just one batch from one seller.  Over the past 14 months, I have had Gevalia's 12-oz. "Morning Roast" for Tassimo several times, and purchased it from Wal-Mart, the local grocery, Kohl's and even once through Tassimo Direct.  Not only was it metallic-tasting weak coffee every single time, but about 30% of the T-discs end up clogging about halfway through the brew cycle, and when they finally let loose, almost all of the grounds come squirting out into my coffee cup, ruining it anyway.  This is not a brewer problem (have cleaned and de-scaled both of my brewers), nor a water problem, as I use bottled water for coffee.  The worst part is that when you try to get any satisfaction from Tassimo, or even try to report that there's a problem with these particular discs, their idiot customer service people just want to refer you to the espresso disc recall!  I will not buy any more Gevalia branded coffee.

column9: Coffee shop patrons, this isn't for you
column10: For fellow coffee drinkers used to premium coffee shop-style java, along the lines of Peets, Starbucks, et cetera, this is not the same thing. Chances are you'll hate this Gevalia stuff. Doesn't even measure up to McDonalds coffee. Weak, bland, little flavor other than a slightly chemical, synthetic taste. I tried collecting just the first half of the brew, hoping for a little richness or something even approaching a medium roast, and no luck.

column9: Not too weak Not to Strong - good cup of coffee
column10: This coffee saved the Tassimo machine from being returned.  I had a Keurig for years and to the most part it worked pretty well but there were two issues.  With all the flavors available I ended up using just one, Donut Shop Coffee by Coffee People which I liked.  However, the Keurig machine I have only has one brew size and I would end up using 2-3 K-cups a day to get a nice big cup of coffee in the morning.  The other issue was it just did not brew really hot coffee.Enter the Tassimo - I was really nervous about the limited selection of coffee available but I figured if I could find one I like it would be a good solutions especially since I  like the fact that on occasion I can make a cappuccino or other fancy drink.  The Starbucks coffee is just too strong so I tried the Maxwell House which was just OK.  I then tried the Gevalia Large Morning Roast and I hit the jackpot.  It as a good large serving so I was only using one t-disc.  It was HOT and it had a nice strong (by my taste) non-bitter flavor.  It reminds me of what I got in Italy when I asked for american brewed coffee.

While it is true it does gave a big hearty serving of coffee.  It is most certainly lacking in the taste department.  For me the coffee was very weak and almost watery.  While I am sure for people who tend to enjoy much milder coffee then I prefer it might be great, it is not great for me!  I am going to stick with my Starbucks Columbian t-discs.

This is my favorite brew for my Tassimo.  It has good flavor - robust but not too strong for first thing in the morning. What I like the most is that it makes a 16 ounce cup which is great for morning. As far as I know, it's the only T-Disc that makes a cup that large.  Enjoy!(Updated 5/15/11) I continue to be surprised that there are people who call this brew "weak", "metallic-tasting", and "watery".  I like a fairly strong cup of coffee and have always found this to be pleasant. So, after numerous cups and many re-orders, I still find this to be my go-to brew in the morning. I also continue to wish that other brands and brews were available in this larger size.
If you are a fan of Tassimo in general, this is not the coffee for you.  Bland, boring.  Skip it.  I miss Henry's Blend!

column9: good not great makes a nice large cup
column10: I am new to Tassimo and got this particular coffee at Bed Bath & Beyond as part of a sampler pack.  I generally like a medium blend coffee, which this is, it is not a dark roast like most of those available at your neighborhood Starbucks.  I can't compare it to the Starbucks Tassimo brews since I have not tried those yet other than the Latte which I liked.  Anyways, this did make a bigger cup, not sure it was really 12 ounces of coffee as advertised, but definitely a good sized cup of coffee. The resulting brew was nice, i gave it 4 of 5 stars since it had a somewhat synthetic instant coffee flavor as compared to a true drip cup.  I do like my coffee strong, and this Tassimo brew was almost strong enough for me.  I think maybe the amount of coffee in the disc is a bit too little to do a large cup right.  I would compare it to Starbucks Via brand of instant/regular coffee, except that it makes a much larger cup than one Via would.  It had a little of the same instant coffee flavor, and maybe Gevalia is adding some instant coffee to get the large size serving (Gevalia is owned or at least the t-discs are distributed by Kraft which makes the Maxwell House products too).  I would recommend it if you like a medium roast and want a larger cup of regular coffee to get the day going or get an afternoon pick me up.  And the price is a little better than some competitors especially considering the larger portion size.Edit 12/17/2010:  I continue to like this t-disc, it does make a large cup (although there are less in the package than other t-discs).  I also find that if I let the full amount of water come through the t-disc it ends up too weak, like some other t-discs I have tried.  So I pull the cup out a little early to keep the brew stronger.

column9: Gevalia Morning Roast vs Dunkin Donuts coffee
column10: I like Dunkin Donuts coffee and tried a bunch of T-disc offerings to find something similar.  I think this is the most similar I've found so far.  It makes a 12oz serving though and I don't have a cup large enough but that's an easy problem to fix.  It's not very strong, it's not bitter, I like it. I use one teaspoon of sugar and skim milk.Gevalia Morning Roast Coffee (Medium, 12-Ounce Servings), 14-Count T-Discs for Tassimo Coffeemakers (Pack of 2)

I find the Signature Blend from Gevalia to be the best, but these Morning Roast discs are fine when you want a larger, travel-mug-sized serving. The flavor isn't as nice as the Signature Blend (which I find to be excellent), but it's still OK. It's a little milder than a normal cup of coffee, but I didn't find it overly mild or tasting watered-down. And it does make the right amount for a travel mug, filling it to a good level.If you like taking a travel mug of coffee with you when you leave in the morning, then these discs will serve well.
I really enjoy a cup of this coffee in the morning.It is a perfect FULL cup of coffee.

If you are searching for a replacement for Starbucks coffee discs, keep going.  These discs produce a very weak cup of coffee, possibly because they put in enough coffee for 8oz but this makes 12oz. I brewed/tasted two cups and threw out the remaining discs.That said, not everyone one likes Starbucks coffee.  This may work for you if, like my mother-in-law, you think all Starbucks coffee smells like wet goat and prefer Maxwell House or Folgers.

How a supposed Swiss company can create and call this "coffee" is inconceivable to me.  Gevalia's Cafe Crema is acceptable, but this stuff doesn't even qualify as coffee in my book.  Even with milk this tastes like burnt metal.  I've had better coffee out of an army ration.  Anyone who rates this higher than one star has either never had real coffee, or drinks their coffee while smoking a cigarette.  Disgusting.

column9: Coffee grounds everywhere - more disappointment from Tassimo!
column10: Bought this new item, have received my Tassimo fix for the exploding t-discs - this one blew out and got coffee grounds everywhere and in the coffee. What a waste! Getting ready to buy a dishwasher and will never buy another Bosch product - so disappointed with their Tassimo products and customer service is horrid!
Purchased Gevalia Morning Roast Coffee (Medium Roast, 12-Ounce Servings), 14-Count T-Discs for Tassimo Coffeemakers (Pack of 2), however Mild Roast was received...

This coffee is mild in flavor, but tastes good in the morning.  The key to this though is the large size, which to me is great for my thermos every morning.  Only 4 stars because I personally like a bolder tasting coffee.  Although it's not the most distinct flavor, most likely it will surpass what ever garbage coffee is normally mass brewed in your boring, drab office
We use and like the Gevalia coffee very much and will continue to buy this good product on Amazon. The product is excellent and the delivery is very good and free with a minimum purchase.

column9: Finally a full cup of drinkable coffee
column10: I'm very happy that I bought this.  I had considered getting the Kcup maker (I have at the office) because I hated having to use two disks for a cup of coffee.I use big mugs and this was great from the first hot sip to the final tepid gulp.I guess I don't need a new K-cup maker
After reading the reviews, just want to mention that the price is for 2 packages of t-discs, so it is a decent deal.

While I like this coffee in the same way that many other reviewers have already articulated, Amazon's usual top pricing is way off. Not only has the availability been poor, but I'm buying this package for less than $10.00 from one of the many Coffee Pod/Disc Internet Providers.Amazon almost always has the best (lowest) pricing! What is wrong in this category?

The Gevalia Morning Roast is my favorite T-Disc for a few reasons:First, the large size.  During the week I want to fill my travel mug as I head to the bus and this disc makes the perfect size cup.  Big enough to satisfy my coffee fix but also leaves just enough room for a little milk.Second, it is a great mild flavor.  I'm not a coffee snob and I don't need anything fancy.  Just an easy to drink cup and this works great.  I've never had a chemical taste like another reviewer mentioned.  I like some of the Starbucks discs, but I don't think their flavor really makes them worth the extra price you need to pay - especially since you need to make two discs for one full travel mug.Finally, this is the disc that I have the least problems with exploding.  I like the Tassimo system in general, but I frequently have problems with grinds getting into my cup.  The Starbucks discs almost always have some sort of explosion which leads to a mess in the machine and grinds on the bottom of my cup.  I don't have that problem with this disc.If you are really picky about your coffee then this might not be the brew for you.  But if you just want a nice, standard large size cup then this is really great.

The Gevalia Morning Roast coffee T-Discs has great medium bold flavor and is just perfect in the mornings. I've bought it several times and keep it stocked in my kitchen. The Tassimo coffeemaker turns out the perfect cup.

Gevalia is our favorite coffee for our Tassimo. The Morning Roast brews a 12 oz cup, which is nice as you run out the door in the morning. It's lighter than their Signature Roast (which I probably prefer), but that brews a smaller cup. We'd had a Keurig previously, and I like the coffee with the Tassimo better (largely due to the availability of Gevalia); it's brewed hotter and stronger and the cups are larger (more fluid ounces). I do wish they'd make organic coffees, though!

column9: Great way to start your day
column10: This is a big coffee.  12 ounces is a larger coffee out of the Tassimo machine, and I ran a cup over once. Not as strong or as bold as some of the 8 oz. Starbucks discs, but a great taste for most folks.  Highly recommend.  I would give a 5 star rating but it isn't a overly unique flavor.  Will continue to purchase.
This is the first time that I've tried the larger serving discs.  I have always added water to the other coffee in the smaller pods.  This 12 oz. works great and the coffee is devine.
Although this coffee is not bold enough for my taste, it suits my wife's taste.  It is smooth without an acidic aftertaste and makes enough for two cups from each T-disc.

This is a great cup of morning coffee for everyday drink-ability. Make sure you have a coffee mug that can hold at least 12 oz. with room to spare, since this is a larger brew. The coffee itself is nice and mild.

No flavor at all.  If you want watered down cofee then this is for you.  Despite making a "larger" cup all they due is push more water through the same amount  of coffee as their other products (almost too little as it is IMO).  I expected the discs to be larger with more coffee but unfortunatly that was not the case.  They just send more water through which ends up watering it down and then they have the nerve to label it as "medium".  I suppose if you want a mild coffee then this is the one for you, but not if you want something with even a shred of taste.  My only solution has been to swap the cup out about halfway through the process and dump the second half of it.  Otherwise it would have been a complete waste.

I normally order our Tassimo beverages from Amazon since it ships so fast via Prime, but this time the Gevalia morning roast we received had a really bad, metallic taste to it. Not sure if that's because the coffee itself is old or if it was just a bad batch. Other pods we had in the cupboard (Starbucks espresso) tasted fine, so it's not my machine. I'll order straight from Tassimo direct going forward.
I like the 12 ounces this pod gives you, this is my favorite during the week when I am filling up my travel mug. This leaves just enough space for creamer.
I have a Tassimo and I buy my T-Discs at Bed,Bath and Beyond For$8.99 for the14 count Gevalia Morning Roast (pack of 2).You're asking $17.98 for the same pkg.which is double the price. Incredible!

column9: drinkability?  maybe if you've already burned off all your tastebuds
column10: This is my first review of any T-discs.  I'm not too picky, but this is some seriously weak coffee.  Some of the Gevalia stuff is pretty good, like the cappucinnos and the carmel latte.  Do not buy this one though. I usually look forward to drinking a cup of coffee on my way to work in the morning.  I'm close to just tossing this stuff after gutting out 4 discs.

column9: One of the Worst Coffee's Ever !
column10: Bought myself a new Tassimo for Christmas!  Yea!  My Wife, with good intentions, bought me an assortment box of Gevalia Coffees.  It included Morning Roast, Signature Blend and French Vanilla.I never got as far as the French Vanilla before throwing out the whole box (46-count)!Tasted like weak, cheap, franchise-restaurant coffee...abosolutely NASTY.Tried cutting the brew time...ended up with slightly stronger nasty coffee.  Don't waste your money. The Starbuck African Kitamo is a very nice, mellow (not weak),coffee.  And if you like a Wonderfully Robust-bold coffee that is full of itself (and flavor), the Starbucks Verona!  Try it and you'll never be the same Coffee Wus that you are now!.

YerbaMate is truly remarkable. I am sensitive to coffee (makes me climb the walls) so, I really didn't know how my system would react to this particular tea. I'm glad to report that there were no heart palpitations, no jittery  nervousness,and no restlessness.  (with coffee I'm bug eyed for the majority of the night) What I did experience was mental alertness. Since the morning is not my "cup of tea" (pardon the pun), and "the night of the living dead" (or more precisely "IT rose from the bed")  describes my attitude toward a new day more than the phrase "rise and shine"... this is a welcome relief.  There is a slight bitterness to the flavor, so you might have to aquire a taste before you can enjoy it. However, to be truly awake first thing in the morning without all of the nasty side effects is worth the effort. Yes, to the horror of some, and the amusement of others..I can think first thing in the morning again.

This is a very tasty tea. It doesn't make me all hyper and jittery, but a gentle "lift". It is also sweetened with stevia (which the company also sells as a separate product, both in powder and in liquid formula and both of which I also highly recommend.)

This has just the right amount of sweetness and I am so happy it is stevia.  Definitely an eye-opener and good alternative to coffee to wake up and start the day.  If it tastes too bitter it is probably too strong.  If you mix it with black tea it is like Celestial Seasonings Morning Thunder tea.  Yum.

I bought this tea for myself after finding out I had candida.  I boiled 4 tea bags each night in a glass Pyrex measuring cup, drank the liquid, and within 2 weeks, all of my Candida side-effects were GONE!GREAT product!-Linda

The product is not as fragrant as I expected. The color of the lemon peel powder is very pale. Not much of the taste and smell. I rather go to Penzey Spice and pay more for the quality. Now my kids don't ever have cool-aid type drinks, so to them, this taste like a treat! Oh, and we are also very sensitive to different foods (gluten, dairy, etc) but eating this before we eat those foods helps them to be not so sensitive!

column10: maybe this is just coincidence but since starting to regularly drink the wild berry amazing supergrass for kids, our 8 year old has slowly started to develop a taste for vegetables.  a couple of years ago he would only eat fruit but refused any veggies--particularly the green leafy kind that are so good for you.  not wanting him to just depend on multi-vitamins for complete nutrition, i found the amazing supergrass products and decided to give it a try.  it was a great decision.  the wild berry flavor was perfect for him because he liked the fruity taste.  because it is actual wheatgrass and veggies, the superfood powder does not completely dissolve like koolaid would--there's still a sediment that remains after you mix it with water.  i thought this might be a problem, but my son just chugged the whole thing and liked it.  needless to say we were delighted and kept giving it to him.  we still tried to make him try some veggies, and after he drank the superfood for awhile he became more amenable to it.  now he eats spinach, broccoli, onions, and carrots!  now i'd never make the crazy claim that this superfood will make a kid like veggies, but whether it was pure coincidence, acclimation to digesting or tasting the veggie "sediment" that is leftover, or psychological acceptance of ingesting vegetables and feeling perfectly fine--it worked!  we will continue to supplement his diet with this wild berry superfood.  as a parent i seriously couldn't be happier with it.
