column9: U Have Bad Taste Buds If You Don't Like This Stuff
column10: I was actually first introduced to Tony Chachere's Creole Seasoning during my first visit to China back in 01. My wife's former teammates are from Louisiana, and apparently they brought this stuff anyplace they went. Although we don't bust out the Tony Chachere's at restaurants, my wife does use it in a lot of meals she prepares. It has a very slight kick to it so our girls (ages 4 and 7) do not like it, but we are definitely fans of this seasoning. It's great in eggs, mac 'n' cheese, soups, Mexican meals like tacos and burritos and more.

For example, I used it this morning in deviled eggs b/c I was out of paprika . . . once again, another fantastic result!  It is especially great for kicking up the flavor of, say, whiting fish (which is quite possibly the most dull food I can think of otherwise.) Check the reviews for the 12-pack for more details.  (Those who reviewed it there complaining of too much salt don't use it as sparingly as I do, I suppose . . . I use it as the description says, "instead of salt.")

In my household, there is more Tony's than salt or pepper.  The reason is that it is the best seasoning ever made.  The only real contender is "More Spice" Tony's, which has less salt and more spice (as you might guess from the name, see: Tony Chachere's More Spice Creole Seasoning - 7 oz.), but they're essentially the same.

Take something simple like a bowl of plain white rice. The taste on a scale from 0 to 10 is probably a 5 (i.e. neutral). Add a little bit of Tony  Chachere (and perhaps some olive oil?) and right away the taste jumps to an 8 or 9. This stuff is amazing. It really brings up the flavor of your food and it goes well with so many different food items like chicken, turkey, or even vegetables. The only negative is the high sodium content and I have not tried the sodium-free version as I haven't seen it in stores. The regular T.C. adds less sodium to your diet than regular salt and tastes a lot better :) Amazon usually has great prices but for some reason this product is overpriced here so I would just buy it at Walmart for less than two bucks.1/24/12 update:I finally found the sodium-free version in a health food store and all I can say is WTH??? It doesn't even taste (or look) remotely like the real stuff. My advice is to stick with the original recipe.

We have used this Creole Seasoning for Years.In the winter we use it as seasonings with homemade soups too.It tastes good with a dumpling or chicken noodle homemade soup.Use the seasoning instead of salt or balance both seasonings.We love it!

Forget salt-- this stuff is WAY better! I use it on my eggs, broccoli, brussel sprouts, or any vegetable, add it to my sandwich to give it a nice kick, oh and it's great on edamame, and any kind of meat! Haha basically it goes on anything!! Salt tastes bland after this great stuff!! And if you want it even more spicy try the More Spice, or less sodium try the Lite! You can thank me later!

Tony's adds a flavorful, slightly spicy kick to just about anything. I prefer to use it somewhat sparingly, because it does add some heat and because a little goes a long way. We use it on grilled vegetables, breakfast potatoes, foil packets of potatoes and onions when camping, on broiled fish. It's basically our go-to spice blend. Try it-- you will NOT be sorry!

I discovered this seasoning while searching shopping one day. I was looking for another seasoning and realized I own a few dozen hot sauces but basically no pre-made seasonings. I spent a good 20 minutes in the aisle looking at stuff as other shoppers walked by. There's are so many choices out there that it's hard to made a decision on what to buy! This was the first item I came up with, it has the most ounces and is also the cheapest! The taste is amazing and the best of the four seasonings I bought. Nice and spicy!! I've used it on pizza, soup, chicken, pasta, etc. and it's been amazing every time. It's become a favorite and I think the possibilities of using it on food are endless.  I give it 5 stars! Great product! Glad to have discovered it!!

I prefer less salt than this mix so I buy this when the more spice is not available. I also buy the Mccormick bayou cajun spice which is cheaper Abdul just as good. I prefer these to the slap your mama and luzianne brands.TipTony's and every paprika containing spice can be enhanced by adding the spice to a small amount of vegetable oil (thin spice roux) and heating it gently before using. That oil enhanced flavor is my 5 star review.
I just bought this stuff to make homemade alligator jambalaya, (used this instead of salt in the recipe), and it was AWESOME!GREAT compliment to any chef's kitchen!
I make a Jambalaya in my rice cooker and I couldn't make (or eat) it w/o Tony Chachere's Creole Seasoning!
I just ran out of this, and Safeway doesn't carry it anymore, so I'm buying it here.  Good stuff.  I use this when grilling okra kebabs, just throw some olive oil and chachero's on there.
I've used this product for many many years. Can't cook without it. I also use many of the other products they make.
We've been using this seasoning on steak for a few years now and we love it, that's all we use on the steak.  Yes I do agree that it can be very salty, so use in moderation!
This is more like seasoned salt than "creole." We have it at local dollar stores where I like and they can't give it away there.

column9: Agreed, this IS better than salt.
column10: I've tried all the "Cajun" brands like Louisiana, Konriko, and Luzianne,and for my money this is the best of the bunch.I actually call this blend "Chicken Magic" cause thats what it does toa roast chicken...its magic. And yeah, or course its got salt in it. Duh!If you are intolerant to salt then its easy enough to make your own Cajunblend with a handful of spices, but if you desire the convenience of somethingyou just grab and shake on you wont be disappointed in this cornerstone ofthe Chachere's product line.Great on everything from pork chops to fish or boiled shrimp, and especiallyfor perking up green veggies. And if you're making fried chicken or fish....getthis and dont be stingy with it. 5 Crawdads!

If you're looking for slightly "improved" salt this might work. If you're looking for spicy seasoning it won't - it is mostly salt, everything else can barely be noticed. Way too salty to be used as any sort of seasoning mixture.I've been using my safeway-bought cajun spice instead and it tastes much better...

column9: Mostly salt with a little kick
column10: This product is salt with some other stuff mixed in with it. The label is not real specific about what is in it other than "salt, red pepper and other spices, garlic and silicon dioxide".I use it strictly as a salt substitute. It has a little more flavor than just salt but to me it is not really Cajun seasoning as it has no real heat to it and is quite salty. It is just too salty to use enough of it to taste any heat, or to use it as a rub.I have gotten a canister of it as gift now and then because people know I like hot sauce. I use it, but I would not buy it on my own.
It is a darker roast than I usually get but it still has a great flavor.  I just have to add a little extra cream and sugar.

My 10-year-old daughter and I both love these.  Depends on your personal tastes, I guess, but we both really like the moist, chewy texture and they're really sweet without any added sugars or other sweeteners.  I can see where they would be great for baking, but we buy them for snacking -- I like the fact that because they don't need to be refrigerated after opening, I can take them on long car drives for a healthy snack (and one that doesn't make a mess and leave crumbs in the car!)  A serving of these along with a bottle of water makes a perfect mid-morning snack - quick, easy, healthy, and filling.

I use these in my baked oatmeal and they are wonderful.  Very convenient.  Nice texture and taste after baking.  Not great for snacking right out of the bag, in my opinion.  I didn't care for the rubbery/chewy texture right out of the bag.

The taste is not bad but the texture is not to my liking. It's like dried soft apple slices, just like what the another reviewer said, "rubbery." I wish it has a little crispness. Nevertheless, it beats snacking on potato chips. But would I recommend it.... NO.
the sun-maid apples i received from amazon.com are delicious and i plan on buying alot more in the near future. i am very happy with them.
Very rubbery and tastes more like chemicals and preservatives than apples. Very disappointing. Not even chopping up into oatmeal could save it.

I don't know if it's just me, but these taste rather salty to me. Perhaps it is the unnatural preserving additives found in the product's ingredients. Normally I'm quite fond of dried apples, but these just don't do it for me. My family members, on the other hand, don't seem to mind and actually enjoy them.

If these are as nutritious as they are tasty, it's a fabulous alternative to real apples. These are NOT the fully-dried apples you may have had. They are partially dehydrated, with a nice chewy texture. They are a little tart, but I'm not sure if that is the apples or the sulfur dioxide. It's a pleasant tart, in any event. Hope sulfur dioxide isn't a dangerous ingredient, as it's all there is except apples.Quality of the source fruit is excellent - no core, seeds, skin or other "bad" bites.I should also mention that this is a rather large serving.I snack on these in my office, and one bag serves as about four 120-calorie snacks for me.So it's a much better buy than it might appear.

I bought this thinking I was getting a bag of dried apples. It even says "DRIED APPLES" in the ingredients.They're good, but this isn't what I wanted.Dried apples are hard and crispy, not soft and chewy.
The flavor is ok, but, the product contains sulfiting agents.  Good product, just not a "whole" food.

I was surprised by the lack of quality and taste of this product.  I thought it tasted of the chemical preservatives.  I was however able to use the product in baking.  I would not buy the product again.

As others say they are rubbery and all the crisp texture is gone.  The taste is "fair".  The remaining quality is ok, just a few harder pieces from the inner apple made it into the package.The inside packaging also has a soft chemical smell as well.  Maybe too much preservative?  Not sure, but I'm not terribly happy.  I've had better luck with other brands that are similar but seem to retain some level of crispness and seem much fresher.  I will go with something else next time.

Actually, the dried shrimp needs to be softened first. You wouldn't need to worry about its shell. It needs to be soaked in water for 15-30 minutes. Its ready when its soft enough to be easily chopped up. Then it can be used in stir fry. The price here is ridiculously expensive. It should only be around $2-$3 at an asian market.

I purchased with the idea to use in my stir fries and fried rice for vibrant flavoring, but I didn't realize it had the shell on them yet so I had to hand clean those tiny little shrimp to use as intended.  They tasted OK, but more trouble than I anticipated for my needs.

I've ordered this type of pistachio from different places and these have come the closest to the one bought in Turkey.  Not only was the flavor the same, but opening the individual nuts was easy and for those who eat a lot of pistachios you know that's important.

In the past, I've ordered Turkish Antep Pistachios from several places, including Zenobia and Bayside Candy (If I recall that name correctly), and Superior Nut had a far inferior product.  They just seemed much drier and far less flavorful than the others that I was used to.

You get what you pay for...  I was excited to see Turkish Antep Pistachios at this price, but was disappointed when I began eating them.  They were not as flavorful as other nuts I have eaten.  Yes, I paid more for those, but if I had it to do over, I would have spent the extra money to enjoy the true flavor of Antep pistachios.
I bought 5lbs of these and was unpleasantly suprised by a tasteless bag of dried out product.  Don't waste your money.

This is my third order of Turkish pistachios from three different vendors. As with the two previous orders, the nuts are good, but not the freshness or quality I experienced on my many trips to Turkey. At first I thought I was being too harsh in my assessment, heck Turkey is what 5500 miles away. But, on second thought , why shouldn't I expect a better quality nut? Yes, time is a factor in nut freshness, but how long should/does it take to get these nuts from Turkey? Or maybe they are keeping the best ones for themselves, I would. Anyway, out of 5 pounds we are about  half way through them as I write this review. The nuts are very lightly salted, which is perfect for me. The shell color is a perfect tan. Nut color has been the typical light/med green to an undesirable yellow/tan/brown, with the ratio being 50/50. The texture is, as expected, better with the green nut than the yellowish nut, which tends to be much drier, and powdery. One of the things you will find with Turkish pistachios are un-cracked shells. Trying to crack one is not easy, it fact they tend to shatter. So far, this batch has only yielded 4 or five un-cracked shells, pretty good. Would I buy again? YES, though they are not up to my expectations, they are still better than the California variety.

TURKISH PISTACHIOS ARE THE BEST ON THE PLANET.  ONCE YOU TASTE THEM YOU WILL NEVER EAT ANOTHER CALIFORNIA NUT.  THIS COMPANY WAS GOOD.  FAST DELIVERY AND TERRIFIC PRODUCT.  I BOUGHT THE 5 POUND BAG.BOB
Hey, it came in quick and I'm using it when ever I can in a green smoothie. Just a pinch betwixt yer fingers.

I alternate between this and crystal light lemonade for the gym.  I find it makes the water much more interesting and stops me getting dehydrated because I actually finish the water bottle.  I actually use one packet for 2 regular water bottles and find it still gives a good flavor,  no cloying aftertaste,  and no calories!  Can't ask for more than that.  This is a regular on our shopping list and I keep it in my cart all the time and watch the prices,  because every so often Amazon gives a really good discount and then I buy 2-3 and that keeps me going for a while.Love it,  would happily recommend it to everyone.

Crystal Light On-the-Go Pink Lemonade, 10-count box(pack of 6)is a great way to spice up drinking plain water. I wish it was packed with 12 boxes instead of 6 boxes so I didn't have to order it so often.
Fab for taking out and about, makes drinking more water so easy and the kids love it, my dads now asked me to get some for him

I love all the crystal light products, low calorie and delicious. I used to always get the iced tea (amazing), but switched to pink lemonade because it doesn't stain my teeth the way iced tea and soda does.
I drink water when I am at work and these little packets help! I hate the taste of plain water for some reason. But using these packets I drink plenty of water for the whole shift!

As someone who recently gave up soda, I very quickly learned that your alternatives are slim if you aren't drinking caffeine and/or carbonated beverages. These mixes have been wonderful. I like water enough, but sometimes I just need some flavor! I even take these to restaurants and mix one into a glass of water. It has really made giving up sodas much easier.

I was looking for the individual packets of Crystal Light (for a 16 oz bottle) and came across this item in pink lemonade flavor.  This was the first time that I had seen this lfavor.  I had previously gotten the individual packets in various flavors (honey and green tea, raspberry ice, raspberry lemonade) but have been unable to find them so it was great to find the pink lemonade flavor. I have been enjoying them since I got them.

Purchased lots of Crystal light and this is the first time that the box's were loose and the contents of the packs are all stuck together. I tried one and it seems okay - just learly that everything is stuck and the powder is like a rock.

Living in Australia for the year and they don't have crystal light. I am going to continue to order my crystal light from amazon because the price is so much better than buying at the store. My crystal light came super fast to my apo too.

I had to give up soda when I was diagnosed with diabetes.  But let's face it - water can get boring.  This pink lemonade did not taste like a "diet" drink.  It was convenient and delicious with no aftertaste.

The Pink Lemonaid flavor is good, but not great and I tire of it quickly. I will not be buying it again. I noticed that it adopts a sourness when I leave it out (mixed in water) overnight. Yuck!It's good every once in a while when you want a different flavor, but I wouldn't want to keep it in bulk.

I love tacos & these are just right when I want corn shells. I like these better than the boxed shells as I can make them as hard or soft as I want. They are easy to prepare just follow the directions on the package.

I make a lot of Mexican food at home.  Not crappy Mexican food with ten pounds chedder cheese, but real enchilades made with goat and chicken and pork. Flavor them with cocoa, ground red peppers and chili, cumino and salt and pepper...real tomatoe and garlic.  These tortillas are perfect for my fine filling.  The extra thin is just enough to compliment without over shadowing the flavors of my mixture.  Try them and you will not be sorry!

column9: A real surprise, beats the expensive Keurig K-cup brands
column10: I bought a used Keurig K-70 single cup coffee maker from an Amazon seller and was pleased at the taste and quality of the brews but found the darker Keurig brews a bit strong and bitter. Also, the K-cup brews cost me about 60 cents per cup, a better price per cup than Starbucks, but not as well flavored.  I started washing out and re-using the K-cups with the little aftermarket clear plastic covers and they work great, allowing me to re-fill with other coffees.I worked my way through many coffee brands at around $6 to $10 per K-cup pack or 10-oz can, but none were exceptional. (stay away from the WalMart house brands or you'll be sorry.) I had bought a 10-oz can of Cafe Bustelo at the local Dollar Store for about $3.60 because it was so cheap, but put off getting into it until the others were used up. Frankly, I waited because I was expecting something really bad, considering the low price. ... WOW, was I wrong! ... It was by far the best of the lot and I'm hooked. ... Nearing the bottom of the first can I started looking for a replacement,  assuming finding another can would be simple but couldn't find one anywhere in town, including WalMart, so I'm ordering a slightly higher priced (plus shipping) four-pack of 10-oz cans from Amazon. ... Not because it's so cheap but because of the nutty, roasted, non-acid full-flavor. ... I refill a K-cup with Bustelo but don't pack it tightly before putting the little after market lid on. It probably costs me about 6-cents per cup now for excellent custom brew coffee.cheers!

Excellent taste nice bold flavor, not bitter (like it better than Starbucks, and, added bonus, 1/2 the cost).  Just ordered off of Amazon, but found that it is only $3.83/10 oz can at Walmart, so I would suggest trying there first (same 4 can order at Walmart is $15.32).  They were out, so when I found it on Amazon, I ordered.  Still worth the price though.  Very much recommend!!

Great stuff! I use this with my Mr. Coffee espresso maker and it makes a great latte!  I've never consider the taste or smell to be stale at all but I'm also not experienced in higher end beans.  Will buy again!

column9: Excellent day-to-day espresso... in a can!
column10: This is espresso. In a can. Yes, a can. Is it as good as the place on a Seattle street corner that custom orders, roasts, and brews? No, absolutely not, there's no comparison. But it is better than anything you can buy in a grocery store and perhaps Amazon. Full flavored, loaded with caffeine. It has a rich warm nutty and and somewhat chocolaty flavor. Perfect for those of us who cannot get to or afford that hand-crafted espresso on a daily basis. It also happens to be perfectly ground for my espresso machine.I love this stuff.

After I trying Cuban espresso in Florida, I was hooked. I went online and bought this and didnt realize that they have them at the grocery stores in town. I love this espresso. It is cheaper than going to Starbucks everyday. The flavor is smooth and you get your daily fix. LOVE IT!

I bought this locally for roughly the same price as here on amazon.I make "Espresso" using a stovetop pot or "moka" if you please, as well as my Aeropress.For my Aeropress I use 185 degree water.I am an espresso person, at least the "espresso" that can be made with the above two devices. I really love a good cup of strong, flavorful coffee.I think an underlyign problem with coffees branded "espresso" is that they tend to be deep dark roasts, that put out a bitter aftertaste by nature. I've tried cooler water in the Aeropress, but it still comes out with that espresso...tangy bite at the end that makes you want to cringe after every sip.If you really want good coffee to be used in an espresso pot or maker, I would recommend just grinding down your already favorite coffee to the espresso powder, and brew with that.That being said, I rate this a 3 because it IS a good base for making flavored coffee drinks, because the flavor is so strong that it won't be masked by milk or flavors, giving you a pretty well rounded vanilla cappuccinol or just traditional cappuccino.So, overall, would not buy again, as I do not usually make espresso into specialty drinks, but rather I like it plain.  For this purpose...the flavor qualities of Cafe Bustelo are not up to par.

I'd very much like to see Amazon offer (at a reasonable price) Estrella espresso, which comes from the same company that roasts Bustelo,Pilón, Ideal, Oquendo, etc, but until that time I'll continue with Bustelo.  Bustelo produces nice crema, I enjoy the robust flavor and the price through Amazon is more than okay.  I can't get it locally, and I used to buy it direct through Rowland (javacabana.com), but some sloppy and indifferent internet sales forced me to give up on going through the Rowland online store.  It's much safer to go through Amazon, and getting issues addressed in a professional manner ... this is what Amazon does.  I enjoy Bustelo, and Amazon provides the service one would expect.
My wife's favorite for Years now!!you cant find this cheaper anywhere but here, so dont waste your time.

Just placed my order for 4 more cans of this coffee. I started buying it on Amazon because it was nearly $2 cheaper per can than buying from my local grocer. I love this coffee. It has a very rich flavor without the bitterness of other coffees. Try it, you'll love it.http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B001ET5XXK/ref=cm_cr_rev_prod_title

Smooth and well-balanced. Though not cheaper than my local grocery. Give this coffee a try, it should be available at most groceries. And when Amazon beats my local prices, I'll be sure to pick it up online.
I love this coffee!  I make this in a french press each morning, very strong and smooth.  I add a splenda packet and a bit of fat free half and half - perfect!

I bought my first can of Bustelo last week at the local grocers to try this brand out.  I was pleasantly surprised because at three ninety-nine a can I figured this would be a cheap-tasting brand.  It's not.Although it lacks the crema associated with Italian espressos, my cappuccino tasted quite good and robust, resembling a Starbuck's cup but at a much more affordable price. It was so robust I didn't need my usual second cup.Although this coffee doesn't have the flavor of a Lavazzo I would still recommend this brand for those who appreciate a strong cup of coffee in the morning.  Prepare it according to directions.  This coffee is made for "Latin tastes" and that means strong and bold.Unfortunately, this coffee is still cheaper at my local grocers than through Amazon, even with the ridiculously high 8.8% sales tax here in Arizona.
Cafe Bustelo is better than all other espresso's out there,a shade more ahhh factor, than Illy, Alessi, and even the Gevalia espresso's. I am yet to try Pilon.

This espresso is much better than I expected.  For the price, and the fact that you get 4 cans, I wasn't expecting much.  But the flavor is excellent, the grind is perfect for espresso, and I've got enough for a while!For the price and amount you receive, this is more than a 5 star product.
For the price you can't beat this espresso. The cans come sealed (can opener) for freshness which is great b/c I don't drink espresso everyday.

I bought this to use with the Bialetti 6799 Moka.  I am very impressed with this setup.  It makes good strong coffee but isn't bitter.  Nor does it have a bad aftertaste.  I thought the coffee smelled really good and fresh when I opened the can.  I have also used this coffee in my 12 cup drip maker and its really good there too.I need to stay up really late at night and I was looking for a caffeine boost.  But this coffee doesn't seem to be really caffeinated.  So it isn't helping me much in that regard.

column9: for those unfamiliar with espresso coffee...
column10: i would like to share an afficionado's take on this specific item. through the years i have tried several brands of espresso coffee which i prepare as 'café con leche', espresso with frothed milk and sweetener. (i use honey). café bustelo, consider i, as one of the best. had i my druthers, i would have purchased the decaffeinated version. this, however, was not available at a reasonable price. incidentally, decaffeinated coffee isn't: it simply contains one half the usual amount of caffeine, while preserving the full bouquet of taste and aroma, if properly roasted. i had ordered, through amazon, the 4 ten-ounce bricks, not the cans, which, for some reason, are currently shown as unavailable. they arrived in a timely manner, with a 'best by' date one year and eleven months into the future. to my taste, another top brand is 'el aguilar'. i don't like 'pilon'. there are quite a few other brands of cuban or espresso coffee on the market which i am yet to sample. maybe you'll be the one to try them as well.enjoy!
Bustelo is by far the best coffee around, but its so hard to find it in the 8oz instant version anywere else other than in Miami.....Amazon pls bring the 8oz instant! NOT the freeze dried pls

column9: Great coffee..if you are used to prison food
column10: This stuff stinks.  I feel bad even donating it to the food bank.  I am not even convinced it truly is coffee.  It does not compare to any thing I have ever had with a brand name on it so it is very hard to describe. If you like coffee this is not for you.

column9: Is this a can or an ashtray?
column10: Cafe Bustelo releases a stale, pungent aroma when the can's seal is broken: you are forewarned by an odor reminiscent of Maxwell House or perhaps Folger's that has been ground together with cigarette butts.  Draw a demitasse of espresso and you can either 1) dissolve the enamel off your teeth by drinking it or 2) water it down to Americano strength where it will merely taunt you, daring you to drink it even when you know you shouldn't.  This is honestly the worst espresso I've ever tasted.  No body, excessive acidity and bitterness, unpleasant chemical aftertaste.  Yes, it's cheap - but the more important question is: are you?
Very pleased. A little pricey, but worth it. Service was good. Fast delivery. Product appeared fresh.

column9: Used For Years and Love It!
column10: I have been using this seasoning for years. The seasoning itself comes on one side of the packet and a bag for cooking the wings on the other. So this and the wings are all you have to have.The unique taste is delicious!  I prefer this mild mix and eat cheese with the hot wings.  And, although there aren't microwave instructions included, that is my personal favorite way of preparing them.  It can vary, per microwave of course, but it can take anywhere from 13-20 minutes to cook them depending on the wattage and the size of wings.  When serving to others I have found some preferred the oven method(instuctions are on the packet).I used to be able to find this in some of the dollar stores, but no more. My local grocery does have these, but the price listed here on Amazon, for the volume, saves about five dollars.
Simply the BEST I've had....SOOOOO tasty and easy to make with the cookin-bag. NO mess or pan to scrub. HIGHLY recommended !!

For those with Celiac disease or anyone for that matter, this flour is excellent. It is certified gluten free and does not raise your ttG. Only .07% of celiac's will react to avenin in oats. I am convinced that it is still cross contamination from non-dedicated facilities where people say they react to oats or there are other reasons for reactivity. You can use this flour in any recipe you would use a wheat or other flour. The approximate ratio is 1 1/3 of oatmeal flour to 1 cup of wheat. Experiment for the consistency you need. It will also absorb a bit more liquid than wheat flour. You MUST add 1 tsp. xantham gum per 3 cups of oat flour as a binder. Oat flour makes superior pancakes, waffles, shortcake, cookies, I could go on and on. Again, just  substitute as above with xantham gum and you won't be disappointed. Don't waste your time on those breads and cookies at the store that are expensive, fall apart and taste like sand.  Thank you Bob's Red MIll.

column9: The tastiest flour I've had for ages
column10: Most affordable gluten free flours are made from rice, corn or soy. Those flours these tend to taste rather bland. Oat flour brings back some of the old flavor and is more nutritious than rice, corn or soy flour. I use it in almost all of my recipes, I love it!

column9: a gluten free flour that tastes wonderful
column10: It's not gritty like rice, or beany flavored. This flour is the closest thing to wheat i've tried so far. As far a cookies go anyway. I don't know if I can make a bread out of it.

If you need a gluten free Oat Flour that works well for Gluten Free bread-- this is a good choice. It mixes up well with other gluten free flours, and produces a loaf of bread the tasters rave about. You will have to add a bit more liquid to the bread recipe-- as this flour absorbs more liquid compared to other gluten free flours.
So happy to see GF oat flour for sale now.  I am using it in multiple recipes with great results.

column9: Bob's Red Mill GF Oat Flour
column10: Bob's Red Mill GF Oat Flour is a nice addition to baked goods, adding more flavor when blended with the more bland white rice flour. It also is a GREAT flour to use in oatmeal cookies!

Ever since I started baking with gluten free flours, this is by far my favorite.  This oat flour adds a subtle sweet flavor and helps create a very soft texture.  I find that it works well with brown rice flour too.I used to make my own oat flour at home but my flour was never finely ground like Bob's Red Mill.  This flour saves  time when I bake with it (and patience too).

column9: Excellent Low GI Carb Source For Shakes/Smoothies
column10: If your focus is health and nutrition you can't go wrong with this product.One of the first rules of sports nutrition is oats for breakfast.  Many people, like myself, either don't like the texture or taste of traditionally prepared oats, or simply prefer the convenience of 'mass gainer' shakes.  After doing my research, I'm convinced the myth of 'powdered' vs 'whole' grains affecting GI is insignificant.  Oat flour still retains the soluble fiber of whole oats, preserving its valued low glycemic properties.This product allows you to make a great shake that has all the health benefits of steel cut or rolled oats as a hot cereal.I prefer the following simple shake:2-4 ice cubes1/2 cup oat flour1 scoop vanilla whey protein (25g protein)1 cup liquid egg whites (pasteurized and safe for raw consumption, 25g protein)1/2 cup mixed frozen fruit (strawberries, bananas, peaches)add water to the blending cup fill line (I use the Tribest Personal Blender PB-100 Blender with 16oz cups)This is a tasty, healthy, highly nutritious, protein rich, low GI carb breakfast.

column4: Mark Teller "author, screw the recruiter, and...
column10: Good company, but the product is not necessary.  Just put whole oats into a normal blender/osterizer and run on high speed until it is powderized.  Thiis product costs quite a lot more than regular oatmeal.  When baking with this item, the cookies are esxtremely dry and mealy.Nothing personal, guys, just the facts.

column9: Organic tomatoes in a BPA lined can! Why?!
column10: I used to buy two cans of this sauce every week because it was affordable, tastes good and organically grown. I was shocked when I learned that the cans are lined with Bisphenol A (BPA)! I called the company directly and they confirmed this. I can't understand why they would use organic tomatoes and then package them this way. I told them that until they change this I would no longer buy their products. In the meantime I switched to Newman's Own organic sauce in a jar. Granted it's not fat-free but I'd rather have some olive oil than BPA.Muir Glen please change your packaging!

Muir Glen cans are lined in plastic and leach Bisphenol A. Too bad because this was a great product and was a standard in my household. My initial conversations with them they contradicted this fact, which to me was misleading. General Mills owns Cascadian Farms as well and now I don't buy there either.Now we use BioNature in jars or Pomi products in Tetra Pak cartons. All canned tomato products use BPA and so do many of the lids of jars used in food containment.Now I also just make from scratch which is made simple by chef Andrew Carmellini in Everyday Italian. Lydia Bastianich is another favorite chef that deserves mention for simple yet big flavors.Boil, peel, freeze and store. Can manufacturing companies that I corresponded with said they were working on a solution for later this year or next year.
Tomato sauce is tomato sauce. Well...I thought so at least. This stuff is just amazing! I bought some to try and I used up the whole pallet in a week then went back for more.

I was so happy to find organic tomato sauce available online! However, when I first ordered the product, 9 of the 12 cans were badly dented (multiple, deep dents). Amazon kindly sent me a replacement. It just arrived, and 5 of the 12 cans are severely dented. Amazon's boxes look fairly sound; I think the problem may have occurred before shipment to me, as the dents were not confined to the cans on the sides of the pack.

Great stuff to have around for backup when out of fresh tomatoes. Being health conscious, I try to have minimum other unpronouceable ingredients included in the can; this fit the criteria, and is as close to fresh in a can as possible.

If you are looking for a tomato sauce that has exceptional quality and taste then this is the one to buy.Would like it if they sold it in larger cans.Great, wonderful, fantastic!  Thank you Muir Glen.
The sauce is great. All organic ingredients and nothing bad added. However, but most of the cans were severely dented.
I really like this product and will continue to order it. Feel really good about using organic tomato products. Excellent taste.

column9: the only tomato sauce for me!
column10: This is the only tomato sauce I will use.  It has a bright, fresh taste that does not need any alteration except fresh basil and garlic.  Unfortunately it is no longer available locally.  Amazon to the rescue!
Muir Glen Organic tomato products are the best. This is the only place in my area that I can find them by the case. Thank you and please keep them available.

Muir Glen no longer uses BPA in their canned products!!!!  This happened within the past year, and you can check with them directly to confirm.  It's so exciting!  A great product, available in most grocery stores and without BPA... Unheard of!

This peanut butter is far & away the best peanut butter I have ever tasted... which is saying alot because I eat peanut butter almost every day. I have tried many other brands of peanut butter, some more expensive, many that were less expensive, but Maranatha Organic Peanut Butter is my favorite by far. What separates this peanut butter from the rest of the pack is that it's creaminess & its incredible peanutty flavor- absolutely perfect! Peanut butter lovers, once you try this variety, you will stop eating anything else! Yum!Note: I am not a fan of Maranatha no-stir peanut butter, nor their other no-stir nut butters; the no-stir varieties taste incredibly strange & unnatural.

column9: tsk, tsk, tsk, thought Amazon was supposed to have good prices
column10: Walmart has this way cheaper, like $4.00 for a 12/pack=48 for $16 instead of $88, like WTH Amazon?

These cough drops really do the job.  They "vaporize" into the whole head and they let you know they are working.  They are so much more than just a drop to take for a cough; they help with the throat and the congestion in the head.  There are no other cough drops worth the money you spend on them.

column9: The ONLY flavor that makes sense...
column10: This is just my opinion, but whoever thought to use peppermint as a flavor for menthol cough drops was a pure, simple genius! The peppermint compliments the medication so well, these not only WORK better than any other flavor, but they actually TASTE decent too - like a really strong breath mint.Cough drops, by nature, are going to taste minty one way or another, so why fight it?Usage suggestion: Smash one so it'll dissolve quicker and stir the pieces into some hot chocolate. The result is a great mint-chocolate flavor and a cup of cocoa that will help ANY sore throat.

column9: Hall's Ice Blue Cough Drops Work
column10: Hall's Ice Blue Cough Drops work. I have multiple meetings requiring me to talk a lot, and this product tames my cough so I can do my job. I like getting the box of individually packed cough drops. It's convenient for me.
My dog loves these treats.  Our vet recommended them for improved dental health, but no one carries the small size locally.  My dog is only 9 pounds, so these are great!
We buy the teenies for our dog.  She only weighs 8 pounds and absolutely adores these edible bones.  These bones are her absolute favorite treats.

My 8 pound puppy gets a greenie every day.  She's a pretty picky eater, and usually takes forever to finish a meal (there are lots of breaks in between bites).  But her greenie is the only thing she will eat without stopping.  She loves the taste.  They also seem to be easy to eat - soft and chewy - so if your dog has sensitive teeth, this might be a good treat to consider.On top of that, greenies are supposed to help with your dog's dental health, which is great for me, because brushing my dog's teeth is really difficult.
My 2 yorkies loved these. They would steal them from each other and it was quite entertaining to watch them. I would buy again.

column9: Great way to try out Greenies!
column10: This is the best way to buy Greenies for the first time! This way you can have your dog try them without spending alot of $.My dog is a very picky eater,so I ordered this mini-treat pak first.If your dog loves the Greenies,just hold onto the zip-lock pouch these come in and order a larger size the next time.Then just refill the pouch as needed! It's convenient and great to have when traveling with your dog!
Great treat for dogs. They love the taste, and they clean the teeth. Came quickly and in good condition. Be sure to get the right size for your dog.

My chihuahua Rocco loves Greenies.  He is a little over 5 lbs but can scarf one down in no time.  I was sceptical about it helping his teeth, especially since the recommendation is one daily.  I use them less frequently, however, I still have noticed a marked improvement in his teeth when I do use them consistently, a few times per week versus daily.  I consider them a special treat and my dog really enjoys them.  They cost $8.99 or more in the pet store, so $6.73 is a deal!

column9: Dogs cannot digest this, vet told me to stop
column10: Our vet asked us to not give our dogs these because they cannot digest them. Whatever they are made of does not break down once eaten, made my dog sick and when I cleaned his potty I saw entire chunks on the treat. They claim the new formula is digestable, but it wasn't for our dog at least...

I admit it, I've been a bad momma and my 3 year old Yorkie's dental health could be better. After a recommendation from a friend, I went out and got a few of the individually packaged ones just to make sure because my pup is a bit of a snot about what she eats. Much to my surprise, she ran off with her Greenie and hid under the chair so the other dogs couldn't steal it from her! It wasn't until weeks later that I observed the ingredients list. Shock of all shocks, my little carnivore is totally into these and there isn't a HINT of any sort of meat in them. Other treats have been snubbed, biscuits go uneaten and the money we spent on treats is invariably NOT worth it. Greenies changed that completely!The only complaint I have is the steep price. I'm grateful to have such a little dog because I get more bang for my buck, but they're worth it. And it's probably much wiser to buy them here in bulk for a dog who's getting them daily. The vet also says these are pretty high in calories, but as our dog is 3 pounds and doesn't eat much anyway, I think these suit her well.

I didn't realize that there were only 6 in a package and for that much money, it's not very cost effective.  I've been cutting them in thirds for her.  She DOES like them so I think I'll get a smaller size next time. They do work, her breath is much better and her teeth are cleaning up nicely.

column9: Greenies are great for dogs oral health!
column10: Greenies are great for dogs oral health. I give them to my 2 Pit Bulls as often as I can afford to. They are good for the teeth and gums and they digest safely (unlike rawhide). I highly reccomend them!

This is my first review ever.....i had to write one......why? because GREENIES are THE best!!I have a 4 year old Shih Tzu, and like any other dog, he loves dog treats.  The problem is a lot of treats are bad for dogs, and they make him have diahrrea or he throws up.  Well Greenies don't do that to him!  I've given him at least 10 in the past 2 weeks, i give him basically one every other day as a special treat for being a good boy.  He's a good boy a lot! hahaAnyway, when i pull out the bag of Greenies, he hears it, he sees it, and goes BONKERS when i open the bag because his keen nose can pick up the scent of what is about to be a delicious treat!If you aren't sure about what treat to buy your dog, look no further, this is THE treat to buy!

column9: Absolutely wonderful, but if you are not used to eating healthy foods your review might sound like the other 1-3 star
column10: These are great and for a gluten-free snack that is not full of additives, corn, etc. this really helps keep those cravings to crunch and eat breads and chips away... I have been eating healthy for many years now though & could see how if you think you eat healthy, but still haven't cut out preservatives, sugars, corn, etc. you might not be ready for this healthier treat... although with soy still included I wouldn't consider it super healthy, but we're getting closer :)

column9: Want to stop eating these, but I can't
column10: I picked these up for my daughter who is gluten free. A friend of mine told me about these. I finally decided to bite the bullet and give it a try. Was looking for a pretzel replacement for her. These things shouldn't be good. Yes, they have a nutty/overdone taste to them. They have hard seeds. But that's why they are so good! That's why they are so addicting. They satisy that crunchy, salty need. And they are probably 100 times better for you than a standard pretzel!

Well, they have an ok flavor..  but it's the seeds that do them in...  Very hard.  Now I love crunchy food... but these are teeth breaking crunchy..  I was getting them for the whole family, but I seriously doubt my kids will be able to chew them...  Don't think I'll be buying them again...
I won't be purchasing these again. Something tastes a little burnt to me and some of the seeds are like pebbles - really hard to chew thoroughly. I'm afraid I'm going to chip a tooth or something.

I originally tasted these as a sample at Whole Foods. I immediately bought several bags. They are very crunchy, which I like. They are also a healthy snack with just the right amount of salt. Even though I am a gluten eater, I love this snack!

As you might be able to tell by other reviews, this is a snack that you either love or despise.I personally love these pretzel sticks; They have a fantastic crunch to them, and I like the texture of having larger seeds (flax, millet, quinoa, etc.) intact to crunch on their own.  There's just enough salt on them so that they are pleasantly tart but not overwhelming.  They are also extremely healthy and relatively filling.Some dislike the taste - a friend said they tasted like baking soda.  Many complain about how hard they are - and they are very, very crunchy and some are a bit tough.  But if neither of these bother you, you may end up addicted... like me.The bottom line: go buy them in your local Whole Foods or Wegmans before ordering a whole 12 bags.  That being said, if you do in fact like them, you will, in all likelihood, find yourself back here buying them in bulk.

These are quite crunchy- but i think a pretzel should be. I love these b/c they're not oily or greasy and have a lighter salty taste. The ingredients are great (nothing refined or yucky). They don't taste like the pasty refined flour pretzels but have the whole grain and seed taste.

Well, they ARE crunchy--except for the seeds that are so hard they don't crunch. And maybe they are healthy, but I do not find the taste attractive.  It's not bad, for sticks and twigs, but I prefer more flavor, in this case, more salt.  Maybe some garlic to bring out the grain flavors?  These really remind me of some of the organic snacks in the 70's--you eat them because they are good for you, but you'd really rather have something else.  I'll stick to Beanitos.

column9: I reordered after the first case.
column10: This is about as healthty as you can get when it comes to "snacks".  I like to dip them in almond butter for some added protein.  I would rate them a five but like all the Mary's products, they are fragile and you end up with too many small pieces in the bottom of the bag.

I'm actually chomping on the curry flavored version of these as I write this, and disagree with the individual who thought bird-seed preferable (not that I have anything against birdseed as he/she apparently does!) I'm always looking for snacks that satisfy the need for crunching and are flavorful without being overly salty, not made with oils (i.e. peanut, soy, canola), and seem to have good stuff in them (these includes amaranth, flax seed, quinoa, brown rice, millet, and chia seed with the curry and sea salt). The name isn't appealing but I find them tasty and VERY crunchy. In fact, they're probably not for people with loose fillings in their teeth! My only issue with these is that, for my taste, they could be a tad lighter on the salt - but I still enjoy them.

column9: Great gluten and dairy free snack
column10: We have a son that has issues with gluten and dairy. These are great. They are both gluten and dairy free and they are crunchy, tasty and convenient. We take these along with us all the time in my son's bag. He's a somewhat picky 2 year old and he loves them and so do we. The only problem is, I wish they were a bit cheaper. But, like most gluten free foods, they cost a lot. I also wish they offered a larger bag.

If you are into healthy eating these will be for you.  Even if you aren't you will likely enjoy them.  I can't eat gluten and I love these.  I often bring them to family events with hummus and inevitably everyone ends up eating these instead of the chips.  All my kids like them- they are 11, 10, 8 & 1.  If they are kid approved you know they aren't as bad as a previous reviewer stated.

column9: Sticks and Twigs is an accurate description
column10: A prior reviewer stated "you won't be able to eat just one". I think they meant "you'll barely be able to eat them"I'm a curry lover and purchased the curry flavor from a local store. It is really hard to describe these, but they truly are quite unpleasant. Nobody in the house will eat them. They are rock hard, and I can only imagine that a handful of bird seed with some curry powder would taste the same. Given the price difference between bird seed and these, I know which I would purchase if I wanted a similar experience in the future.

This product has the best ingregidents you are going to findn any "junk food" or "snack food" period.You won't need to eat the whole bag to feel satisfied.You won't feel any "side effects" after eating them,like getting brain fatigue or feeling tired, like youwould with other snack foods.You feel like you are eating something healthy, because you are.

I found these shortly after I discovered my 3 kids have developed a sensitivity to wheat. Finding healthy gluten free snacks is tricky but finding gluten free snacks that the kids actually like is trickier. They love these plain right out of the bag or with dip or hummus. So do I! I can't find them anywhere near us so I am glad that Amazon has made them accessible. They are more flavorful than regular pretzels. With healthy seeds as ingredients, you won't be able to eat just one.

column9: Acquired taste, but oh so addictive.
column10: I decided to try these after reading a blurb about them in our newspaper.  It's hard to compare them to pretzels, other than the shape.  I'm so-so about pretzels (I find them boring), but these are anything but boring.  The crunch is absolutely addictive.  Even my husband, who is less than forgiving about "healthy food that tastes too healthy", loves them.  We bought a second bag at the grocery store (4.49 per bag) before deciding that buying them by the case (at 3.46 per bag) was definitely the way to go.  My only hesitation in doing so was wondering how far out the expiration dates would go.  I'm hoping that the expiration date on the shipment of 12 is at least 2 to 3 months in the future.  Don't let me down, Amazon!

Mary's Gone Sticks and Twists arrived just a short time ago today.  Tore open a bag and started snacking and can say with confidence they are DELICIOUS.Chock full of Omega-3's without and ZERO oil added.  15 of the sticks are mmonly 150 calories.  300mg sodium is a bit high but nothing off the charts.Just dipped them in chipotle sauce and ate one bite at a time. . . slowly.Great alternative to the many 'organic' snack foods in the stores, almost all of which have added ('organic,' but so what, oil, or worse, some form of sucrose (white sugar) in disguise ('evaporated cane juice' or some other illusion that 'it's not sugar.'It's miraculous that these Sticks and Twists, NOT made with any of the usual ingredients that hold snacks like these together and not only don't fall apart into crumbs (wheat flour or oil or baking powder or anything like that), but taste better than any pretzel (even pretzels are made with flour and oil and sometimes sugar) I've ever eaten.I would suggest getting these and enjoying with a good conscience!
great healthy snack! only comcern is alcohol listed in ingredients. no place for it in health food. should be removed.

This is a great price for a bag of Sticks & Twigs. I have been purchasing them in health food stores for $4.79 per bag. Amazon offers a bulk order of 12 bags per box at $3.10 per bag with no charge for shipping. Great item and great savings!

Yuck. And to call them sea salt is a lie. They should call them no salt. They don't resemble a pretzel in taste in any way. All I could taste was a strong sesame seed taste. It's true what others say, there are some super hard seeds in there. Kept getting stuck in my teeth. I can't really think of anything good about them. They are healthy but so are many many things. Don't bother with these.

column9: Mary's Gone Crackers Sticks & Twigs, Sea Salt
column10: I love these crackers !!! They are so good I order them more often than I ever suspected I would !!! I definitely recommend them to my friends and family ... They are yummy !!!

I'm always wiling to try a new gluten free snack - and this one looked interesting. I love sea salt and I love pretzels. The taste is just average. The seeds give a very odd aftertaste. The worst part is some of the pieces are ROCK solid and I am seriously afraid that I am going to crack a filling with every bite. What on earth can I dip these in to soften them, hot tea??

Perhaps they're an acquired taste, but you can't beat them for filling in the snack-gap after finding out about my gluten sensitivity. They're always on hand in our house due to their portability and crunchiness. Nice snack to have around without feeling guilty about empty calories.

I love this product and in the past I have had no problems.  In my last shipment about 2/3 of the packages were stale.  This is the only time this has happened so I will try once more, hope the next shipment is better.

column9: taste good organic and glueton free
column10: there are not many options for glueton free and organic crunchy snacks this tastes pretty good.  Good delivery and best price I have been able to find.

column9: Marys Gone Crackers has the best GF "Organic" products
column10: Marys Gone Crackers has the best "organic" GF products on the market.  There are many GF products to choose from....many have ingredients that are no better than the regular snacks in the grocery.  They are just GF.  These products are actually made from organic ingredients and are good for you.  Try them... you will never go back to the junk GF products.
These burnt flavored, wannabe pretzels, are disgusting.  For the price I paid, I am extremely disappointed.  ALL WRONG!  Won't be buying this product, or anything else from this brand.

These things are gross.  I really mean it.  Both me and my g/f tried them and spit them out.  They taste like stale pretzels with no flavor filled with seeds.  I don't think mustard would help to get these things down.  I am really astonished that anyone would give Sticks and Twigs anything over 2 stars.  I think that these may be company employee reviews.  I am not even a picky eater and had to throw out the entire bag.  Stay away...stay far far away from these atrocious crackers.

column9: Great Soup and easy to make
column10: This makes a delicious Egg Drop soup and it is easy and convenient to make.  I like being able to make it on a cold day.  The flavor is really good.

column9: A really good way to spice up your diabetic cooking and treats!
column10: If you are a diabetic and have ever attended a nutrition class for diabetics you probably have heard of this product.  We have a whole collection of the different flavors and I have posted a photo of some of the ones we use the most.  This is an ideal additive to diabetic cooking, baking of foods or the mixing of drinks.  It is sugar free and calorie free and extremely low in sodium.These mixes are ideal for use in coffee, tea drinks, Italian sodas, cocktails, pancakes, waffles, diabetic cakes and muffins.  We even found a diabetic powder that you can mix with ice, fresh strawberries, some of this flavoring, and skim milk and then blend into a dietetic strawberry shake.  If you freeze your strawberries and add in a little Splenda® then the taste is really good.Flavorings like these are nice to spice up your low calorie drinks and food and the Da Vinci Gourmet brand is the best we have found.  They are internationally recognized as the highest quality flavoring made and one tablespoon = a free food exchange for a diabetic.I strongly recommend this to you as a great product!

I love DaVinci's sugar free syrups. I've searched everywhere for diet strawberry soda, but cannot find anyone who makes it, so I had an idea to make it myself. DaVinci's sugar free strawberry syrup + Sprite Zero = DIET strawberry soda! It is delicious!
Sprout are the best. i tried happy baby brand before but the taste of this ones is much better. recommended
I highly recommend the Sprout baby foods. My daughter really loved this blend, I am back to buy more. I am very at ease feeding her this as the ingredients seem very fresh.

My son is a picky eater and will snubbed most foods for the first three or four times. He loved this from the get go and was actually leaning forward to get more.I tried it and I liked it as well. It smelled wonderful.

I picked up several varieties of Sprout baby food for my daughter. She enjoyed them all, but this flavor was her favorite. I liked that these are loaded with fruits and veggies and are all organic. The packaging is also great - each pack is almost flat and slips conveniently into the diaper bag or purse, seals more securely than the Gerber plastic tubs and is less likely to break than the glass jars. Overall, we loved the ingredients and packaging.

This company has the best quality tasting baby food so I buy them all even though the packaging is kind of messy to scoop out of. This flavor is my little ones favorite and it is made of healthy quality ingredients. I've tasted all of their foods and understand why my little one gobbles this right down and spits out other baby food.

I count that as a good thing because my baby doesn't take to sweeter foods.  This flavor concerned me because of the apples and mangos, but they've blended it perfectly with the carrots.  It's tasty, but not sweet.  Love the food combinations with this brand.  Not wild about the packaging, but it is what it is.

My son is an incredibly picky eater and we have trouble just getting to eat baby food (at 11 months), and he LOVES this brand.  It costs a little more, but to me - if he eats instead of clamping his mouth shut - it's totally worth it to me.  I taste all of the food I give to him and this was by far my favorite (though they have all been great).  And he absolutely loved it - he finished an entire package with no problem!

column9: Very good hair and skin moisturizer!
column10: I bought this because I wanted to use it for my hair. It's work on my relaxed hair is great! It makes my hair feel nice and soft and moisturized. Sometimes I use it as a moisturizing sealant. As for the skin, the moisture lasts the entire day! I wouldn't apply it to the face though--especially if you have acne issues. It's a little heavy...Overall, I enjoyed this product and will probably be buying more of this. I gave it a 4/5 because I don't really like the smell of coconut--this one just happens to be really strong.

Good stuff arrived quickly.  I read somewhere that there is really no such thing as extra virgin coconut oil only virgin, so extra might be clever marketing.  Look into this urself.Good product would get again.
DO NOT take a tbs spoon right off the bat...will make u deathly sick.. other than that, smell taste is great..I have seen no change as of yet.

I love the smell of coconut, so when I opened of Garden of Life's Extra Virgin jar I was in bliss. It smells strongly of coconut so I ate a little and... it didn't taste like coconut! In fact, it didn't taste like ANYTHING. It was very strange, but good. I am very pleased with this product and recommend it!

column9: LOVE THE COCONUT OIL, HATE THE GLASS CONTAINER!
column10: When it arrived, the glass container was broken. I had to get the coconut oil in another container. So some of the coconut oil were wasted since I didn't want to risk my luck getting hurt with glass in some coconut oil. I love the oil though. It smelled great! It penetrated in my hair well & it made it softer. I have natural 4a hair.
The Garden of LIfe Extra Virgin Coconut Oil is very thick. When mixed with hot tea or coffee it makes the beverage to thick drink.

column9: Don't know what all the fuss is about
column10: Got two of these, because the hype on it was so glowing.  I haven't used it much yet, but I can't see why it's so much better than other oils, except it is a lovely ointment for sunburn.

i have purchased just about every coconut oil brand out there and find garden of life to be the best. other less expensive brands often leave an odd aftertaste or chemical residue even if they claim to be organic. i find this product to be consistently clean tasting. have been taking daily for over a year and have noticed improvement in skin, energy, immune system, and clarity of thought/memory. after initially feeling resistant to the idea of eating fat, i can't imagine life without this product. no weight gain at up to 3 tablespoons a day. don't let the medical establishment's misunderstanding about saturated fats scare you into not using this product. i have only benefited from it after years of low fat eating that was slowly destroying my health. but do start slowly, its not uncommon to feel a little nauseous( apparently as a result of being unused to digesting fats) or to have looser bowels initially( it has been used as a laxative).......

I use this as a hair and scalp oil.  It leaves my hair soft and shiny. There's no greasy or residue buildup. It absorbs right into the hair and scalp,  If you apply to your hair, wait few minutes and then run your fingers through your hair, there will be no residue on your fingers--none.  Your hair will feel soft, supple, and look shiny.  A previous reviewer said she uses it on her skin. I do too. I usually put in on my face before bed.  Just like she said, it absorbs right into your skin and there is no residue.I started using it because my mom has uses it.  But, I never knew much about it.  I did an online search to find out more about this oil.  According to the information I got, with regular use, Coconut oil can help reverse sun damage and reduce signs of aging on your face and neck.  The article also said it helps eliminate "liver spots"  The reason given was that coconut oil breaks down so fast that it really does absorb into the layers of your skin, instead of just sitting on the surface like so many face creams and lotions do.  It is good for the skin. I'm 50, and my skin is holding up pretty well.  I have very few "liver" spots near my ears, but absolutely none on my forehead and cheeks.  A lot of people have a whole face full of them by the time they are my age.  It is a healthy oil to consume.  It is solid, but it breaks down so easily in the body that the liver(the real organ) doesn't have to even get involved in the breaking down process, like it does with most fats we consume.  It's a shame, I always thought this was one of the worst oils you could eat.  Turns out, it's one of the best oils to consume.  If you do an online search, you can find a lot of information about the many benefits of coconut oil by an MD. You can even find out how it got it's bad reputation,
We use this to cook in to get away from trans fatty acids.  This adds a pleasant taste to the food too.  We love it in our stainless steel pans.

AMAZING! On my skin, it's like heaven! On my hair, (I have very dry, relaxed hair) it was AMAZING! prevents breakage and is a great deep conditioner or you can mix it in with other conditioners! Also, its quite yummy! Make sure to always go ORGANIC EXTRA VIRGIN! My mother bought another type of Virgin Coconut oil from a store and it was NOT the same. I don't really like writing reviews but I just HAD to do this one!

I am very pleased with this product. The shipping was super fast and the glass bottle was sealed and in perfect condition. Of course with the awful heat wave we're still in, the oil had liquified but I put some on my hair immediately. My hair was incredibly soft for the next THREE days!!! I will continue to purchase from this seller one, because there's not a Whole Foods for miles where I live and two, I'm so satisfied with their business.

This is an excellent product, although it hasn't helped me lose weight yet, but I ran out of it before maximizing all its benefits.  The main uses have been for our dog (added a couple tablespoons to her food to help her skin), our dry skin, and even "intimate" moments (it's better than anything else we have tried).  Since coconut oil is a natural ingredient, hypoallergenic and antibacterial, it's perfect for inside and outside of our bodies (except perhaps, for eyes and ears).  My husband has eczema and it's been one of the most helpful products we have found.

If you care what your coconut oil tastes like, then this is the one to get. Other unrefined coconut oils I tried have a slightly greasy aftertaste. I like that it comes in a glass jar as some people have reported tasting plastic leeching into other oils.This oil tastes like eating coconut candy. It's very light, slightly sweet and not greasy at all.

column9: Wonderful for conditioning and moisturizing the hair and scalp
column10: I use this product on my hair and scalp and it is a great conditioner. It is very light and absorbs quickly in my hair and scalp. It is non-greasy. I like this product because it is extra virgin meaning it is the least processed and the most purest oil. It keeps the scalp moisturized so the scalp does not itch or get dandruff. I really like using this on my hair especially after washing while I air dry my hair. I used my first bottle and I just ordered another. It also has a light refreshing smell and not overpowering at all. Coconut Oil is a great product for hair, it also makes the hair shiny too. I recommend this product to anyone who wants healthy hair and scalp.

You can buy a gallon tub from the direct website for cheaper. So shop around on Amazon and other sites once youve selected the brand you want.Coconut oil, youve heard all the great things it does. Here are some things that hopefully persuade you more:Ive found that when refrying leftovers, such as chinese food or meatballs, it actually IMPROVES the flavor over the original. With coconut oil, you can avoid microwaving, which does alter the taste and texture, and some say destroys nutrients and adds toxins. Just stir fry with coconut oil and enjoy your delicious leftovers!It may serve as a bit of a replacement for vanilla in baking. The main purpose of vanilla is to add flavor. Unfortunately, the vanilla we had at home had the dreaded CORN SYRUP in it (READ YOUR LABELS). I looked online and it appeared that it could be omitted anyway, but as it turned out, coconut oil appears to provide that underflavor. Add a hint of coconut to your baking!Yes, coconut oil can be much more expensive than regular oil, but you cant and shouldnt cook with olive oil. Almost every other oil is bad (soybean, canola, corn) or just not as good (butter). Think of it as an investment in your future. I know people who arent of strong financial means that would be hard pressed to give up their "coco" as I call it.Enjoy!
