column9: Dingo Goof Balls... My dog loves them!
column10: These little, meat filled, dog chews are loved by my dogs. They like to eat the meat strip that's weaved into the rawhide ball, then use the ball for a play toy. My mom's dog however,eats the whole thing. We have been purchasing these for several years now. Good product.
My little dachshunds really like these.  They get the meaty part eaten right away so they don't always work on the rawhide part.  Good value tho and appropriate for smaller dogs.

column9: Better then shopping all over town
column10: I bought these at my favorite place to shop .. AMAZON.COM.  They came lickity split and I got a bunch cause my Foxy Lily Pom just hates it when she can't have her goof balls every single day.  THANKS AMAZON and thanks AG INDUSTRIAL SUPPLY LLC.

Our little 10lb dog loves! these dingo treats. She worries them until she gets all the red chicken bits out and then gives the rest to our Labrador Retriever who treats them like a 5 minute bubble gum treat. Works out all around!

column9: Your dog will go through them fast.
column10: I like that I can stuff treats in the center of them, but my dog's an enthusiastic chewer and she's through with this in no time.  I order them occasionally for a little variety.

The red part of the dingos was missing from 3 of the balls in one bag and two of them in the other. The others have not been opened yet and I found this very upsetting since this is the part the the puppies go for first. I don't mind paying that price if it is as shown. The bag show no white only balls.Theresa Miller
What a great product both my dogs love them, we have to order 10 bags every month because they go through them like crazy.
My dachshund, Luna, loves this treat. She is not normally one for playing with objects, but with this treat she acts like a goofy puppy. I would recommend this treat for anyone with a small dog.

I have two yorkies 1 yr old and a 3 year old they can not grasp the concept of fetching any type of ball so thats upsetting and everytime i buy them dingo bones its liek world world 3 in the house and when the wars over i find bones buried in all the furniture and they guard it. with these they know they are treats and they play with them and eat them and its just quiet in the house and all is right in the world. MY only bad thing is i wish the small version came in bulk!
My dog loves these rawhide balls.  This seller ships very quickly and is very reliable.  They are first rate!  I would highly recommend them  as someone to order from.
As always great product.  I have a 11yr old Chihuahua that loves them.  All of Dingo's products have been top notch for me.
These are good treats, but I can not say that they are any better than any other. They are bassically the same as any average treat.
She plays with them a little, eats the meaty parts, and gets way more enjoyment than she ever does from just a normal rawhide. Less time for chewing, but more time for playing.

upon reading the reviews and the fact that my dog loves the regular dingo bones and the dingo twists, if figured id try these too. theyre great. my dog loves the red strip of "chicken". lol idk about chicken being red but what ever, he loves it. keeps him busy and out of trouble. before he destroys the little ball i try and play with him rolling it around but he just gets it in his mouth and paws and goes to town. highly recommend this product. PS, Idk why, but theres a dingo dental mini bones...its the same as the other regular mini bones. those are also cool. I find those last the longest, so get those if you want these bad boys to last.

Having a finicky four legged eater can be challenging when they are smaller than your average small breed. I have a teacup yorkie, who like most fur babies is spoiled rotten, but most products out on the market and readily available are too big for tiny bite, and those we do find tend to be discontinued by local stores. We use to give my dog the mini dingo bones, which she loved but really had to work for. The goof balls are better for her size and age, really easy to get to the chicken meat. these are great for older dogs or puppies.

This is my dog's favorite treat.  He doesn't care for the Dingo bones.  Dingo balls are hard to find in Hawaii, well, at the stores that I go to, so, it's great that I can get them through Amazon.com.  Delivery is very fast!
My dog loves them but be careful if you have a small dog to watch them when they have the product as they are much smaller than I thought.
This product was purchased from a vendor who may have had this for a long time because the treats were stale and I will not purchase any more from this vendor. No good recommendation on this one.

I've used Falcon Farms 5 or 6 times over the last 18-months and each time the recipient is thrilled. Frequently I hear several vases are needed due to the quantity. Very pleased with the company, it's speedy delivery and consistent quality.
I buy mine from Sams Club! They are so good! Just like eating cheese with a crunch! Just beware once you start eating them you may not be able to stop.

column9: Product is good but Seller stinks
column10: Yesterday I wrote to this Seller stzting that I got 4 of these barrels of cheese balls, and each one had an expiration date of 1/07 --- seems like they went through their inventory and sent out everything that was old --- have not heard back from them, so that's why I am writing this.  We give a lot of these out to the kids in the neighborhood as presents.  Today we got another 4 from a Seller --- these 4 barrels had an expiration date of 2/25/12!!!The need to realize that taking old inventory just to get rid of it during the holiday rush doesn't really work --- it's going to be a long time before I order anything from them again...

Why would a huge plastic container of round cheese balls be selling for over 20 dollars?  Are you kidding me?  And the worst part is that the regular cheese curls are a thousand times crunchier and tastier anyway.  Cheese balls taste rather hard and lack the cheesy flavor in comparison to the actual curls.  Either way expect cheese stains all over your hands, and especially the furniture and Nintendo equipment (including TV and Wii remotes) in the living room.  A product that I fail to see why anyone would consider purchasing considering the many flaws.

column9: Yep, this is just like the ones from The Office.
column10: The episodes after Michael Scott Paper Company forms.  I bought them as a joke gift for a huge fan and they were perfect and roughly as dangerously addictive as you might imagine. :)
These cheese balls are the best and the only ones you can get pretty much since Planters stopped making them. But they have this same container at WalMart for $5.
All I can say is that these things are delicious and taste every bit as great as the Cheetos brand, in my opinion. :)  I will get them again soon.
Packaged nicely.  Arrived at my California home fresh.  Tasty, just as I remember when I lived in Maryland and could buy them at the supermarket.

column9: My Dog Devoured this in About a Minute
column10: I was hoping this would be a great chew for my dog's teeth, along the line of a bullystick. She's not much of a chewer, but I hoped the flavor would entice her to spend some time gnawing on this. But this isn't really designed for that. It's very crispy and breaks down quickly. While she loved the flavor of this--Tripe--she devoured the whole thing in less than a minute, negating the use of this as an aid in caring for her teeth. For my purposes, I don't think I'd buy it again. But if you're just looking for a tasty treat for your dog, this may be for you.
Nice big pieces, flavorful, and absolutely clean. I would buy this product again, especially since it's a lot cheaper than the porcini's in my local grocery. It takes about 20 minutes to rehydrate.

column9: Excellent dried porcinis for the price
column10: I have been ordering these for a couple of years now, and have yet to find a better deal on dried porcinis.  These ones are the "middle" grade; I like them enough that I have not been tempted to try the higher grade. As with all other dried porcinis I have tried, both stems and caps are included.  For those of us who can't stroll down to the local store and buy fresh ones (and I expect there are many of you out there), I think these are a good way to go.
The package of porcini arrived on time, and were of great quality.Very fresh, large pieces and very aromatic.Thanks for the service

column9: Not worth the price...buy fresh localy if you can.
column10: I tried these and must say they are not a very good deal for the money.  I even got a response from the seller (although no offer to refund my money).  Look for a local seller and save your money and taste buds for fresh.
My product arrived lickedy-split. There was no dillydallying; super quick service and a super fine product. A+ to the googolplex power!!!

My baby is almost 8 months old and she's showing an interest for finger foods. She hasn't learned the pincher grasp with her fingers yet so she can't feed herself cheerios but she sure loves to hold sticks of food in her hands. I try everything my baby eats and when I first tasted these, they reminded me of Cheetos. The cheddar flavor is very evident. Some pieces are small -- some even too short for her to hold -- looks like sizes vary slightly. She hasn't had any choking issues with these since they melt in your mouth fairly quickly. Sodium value is also fairly decent. I have noticed though that if opened (with lid on) for more than 1 week, it starts to become less crunchy and more on the chewy side.Nutrition Facts from label:Calories 35, Serving Size 18 pieces, Servings per container 6, Sodium 50mg% Daily Value for infants 0-1:Protein 0%, Vitamin A 0%, Vitamin C 0%, Calcium 6%, Iron 10%, Vitamin E 20%, Zinc 15%

These will be great for my daughter when she's over a year old or so, but at 11 months, she is not quite ready for something this large and crunchy.  They don't dissolve easily like the Gerber lil crunchies or puffs and I had to dig a whole wagon wheel out of her mouth so she wouldn't choke because she put the whole thing in there and it just sat there without dissolving, even using her teeth and gums to try to mash them.  They are about the size of a quarter so I tried cutting them up into cheerio size pieces but they still just sit on her tongue and don't dissolve and she has a hard time swallowing even the smaller pieces.  I bought a bunch in bulk so I will save them for when she's a little older.  I just wanted other parents to be careful what ages these wagon wheels are fed to.
My toddler loves these. Once open you have to finish them within a week or so or they absorb moisture and loose their freshness.

My 11 month old daughter loves these. Not only is the taste great, the texture is really soothing to her gums. She does prefer the Garden Tomato flavor over this one, but she'd rather have these than other teething biscuits. Would definitely recommend both flavors.

I like the veggie dip and the garden tomato flavors best but I think my little one would eat any of them.  He loved the puffs and now the crunchies.  They are a perfect size for getting him to feed himself but they can get messy.  Even when they get stale, he loves them.  It's a good snack for him and definitely a little overpriced, but Amazon has them cheaper than any store in my area. And I'm as a first time mom, I'm a sucker for any baby related foods that seem healthier than what my nephews are eating.

I started him off on the Puffs, since I was a little afraid of the Crunchies because they looked so big. But he actually has a lot easier time with these. They seem to dissolve a little better than the Puffs, and since they are bigger he can manipulate them better. He either holds them while he noms on one end (they dissolve fast), or he's able to push it around in his mouth well enough that he doesn't gag. The Puffs tend to go to the back of his tongue and he often coughs and gags on them. They are nutritious, and there may be better snacks out there but for right now these are awesome.

We attribute our son's new-found interest in eating finger foods to these little cheese sticks.  He first discovered them on a visit to grandma's.  They're perfect - long enough that he can hold them in his hand and still bite off the ends, and he appears to think they're quite delicious.  He's start being interested in other finger foods now that he has mastered these, but they are by far his favorites.  Would definitely recommend!

column9: Great product but I don't like the packaging
column10: I love these and my 8 month old loves them but I don't think the product canister does a good job of keeping them fresh.  It seems like they go stale VERY fast.  I don't think the baby cares but since I eat them with her it bothers me.

Gerber has an amazing line of products for babies and toddlers, but this product is a miss.  The Wagon Wheels are extremely hard.  They do not dissolve at all in the mouth.  I had hoped they would be similar to the puffs Gerber makes (only larger), but they are nothing like them.  We had to toss these.  I was scared my child would hurt her teeth or choke.

I wish I knew how to make these with a bit less salt. ALL my kids want to eat them from the 13 y.o. down to the toddler, but we try to save them for travel or a special snack because they cost so much per pound!They do taste very good. They are more spicy (not hot, just spice) than I had anticipated, but my toddler likes that. If yours doesn't like spice or you don't want them to eat a snack with a higher salt content (for toddlers) I'd skip buying this.I did buy these earlier, but then waited to feed my son until he was old enough to handle the spice.

My 14-month-old cannot get enough of these things!  If I would let him, he'd probably eat the whole container!  He whines and complains until he gets another one.  For those of you who have to be concerned about this, I was very happy to find out that this snack is gluten-free!  It's a great snack for little hands to hold on to!

I got these for my 8 month old twins, who at the moment are very big on self-feeding (and not on spoon feeding haha).  These are nice because they are bigger than the puffs and easier for them to hold on to.  They are pretty good, basically just a healthier version of cheese curls though.  My mother-in-law bought them the cinnamon maple flavor, and they are wonderful!  I wish they had a variety 6 pack on Amazon so that we could try all the flavors!

My 10 month old loves these. I've tried the Veggie Dip as well as the Garden Tomato. Actually, my hubby loves them too so I find myself running out pretty quickly!I love the fact that these are tasty, healthy, provide teething relief since they are crunchy, yet soft enough for our (as yet) toothless baby to "chew", melt in her mouth pretty quickly so there's no choking hazard, and are easy for baby to pick up with her own hand. Sometimes when my daughter is in a fussy mood and wont eat anything else, I put some of these in front of her and while she's concentrating on feeding herself, I sneak in a few spoonfuls of food. Very satisfied with this product and would definitely recommend.
it's very soft and easy to swallow BUT little salty for toddlers. I love its tasts too!!! i already ate half of the cans and try not to eat more... this is more ADULTS' snack than toddlers'

column9: Excellent snack for baby and toddlers
column10: My son loves to feed himself and prefers salty snacks to sweet ones. These were an instant hit with him as not only are they great tasting but healthy and safe for babies as they melt away in the mouth. My 3 year old also likes to share it with him and takes some to her pre-school. Its convenient on the go and reasonably priced. I recently got some Gerber Graduate coupons and combined it with sales and got some great deals.
It's hard to keep him off of these - I have to literally hide the canister and control his intake LOL

column9: Great Puff alternative to the "Fruity-yogurt" kinds
column10: Our daughter loves these!  She had a lot of trouble transitioning to solid foods, and we had to take her to a specialist. The specialist mentioned that if your child has trouble with solids and with chewing motions... you should use foods that are longer and thinner to encourage chewing on the sides of the mouth. These were perfect.  THey can be easily cut into rounds using a serated knife, and to encourage chewing, they are long enough for you to hold them to the one side of the mouth.Also, since our daughter loved puffs of all kinds... we wanted to at least introduce a variety of flavors. The garden tomato ones were a hit right from the get go and we continue to use them in "mixes" with other easy to pick up foods (goldfish, veggie crisps, etc.)Would recommend, will buy again!

I bought these for my almost 9 month old twins. I was totally shocked by how hard these wagon wheels were. I bought them thinking they would be like there other products, soft and safe to eat. While I can break them up into little pieces to eat that defeats the purpose I could just give Cheerios for a fraction of the price. I have to say i dont feel comfortable giving them a whole one to eat, they put in there months and they take forever to dissolve. Big miss on Gerbers part for these items.

My baby loves them and so do I!!  Tried them 4 years ago with my first and now with my 9 month old and they're still a great snack!!  Only complaint is that once the canister is opened, the product gets soft pretty fast.

column9: Great product, but look for a better price elsewhere
column10: My 10-month old loves these! They are helpful to teach him how to eat and relieve pain from teething, too. Look around for a better price: I was able to find a great deal at my local BJ's club: a mixed 6-pack for $9.99. At the supermarket, they are $2/can.Whenever we go out and run errands, I make a snack container for him. I mix a bunch of different snacks together and let him choose what he wants when fussiness ensues. He always chooses these or the Dr. Sears yogurt melts.

MY DD has trouble with solid foods but loves the puffs. I ordered this to get some variety from the standard gerber puffs/ sticks.  Unfortunately I ordered a pack of six thinking that these would have a similar texture to the other snacks.  These snacks are hard for ME to chew and actually cut the roof of my husbands mouth when he tried them. At first we thought it was just a bad canister, but when we opened the next canister... same issue.IF your child is to the point where they can chew these... they certainly are not in a stage where they need puffs anymore!Would not recommend.

My son, age 2, loves this line of products from Gerber. The only bad thing about this particular product is that he REEKS of maple syrup the day after having these for snack (no more than 1/2 cup size serving). It is a 3 feet away and can smell maple syrup type of odor - even after wash hands, face, and taking a bath.

My daughter loves these!  I used to be so super worried about her choking on anything; I even used to cut those Gerber star puffs in half.  Then one day she just chewed it up.  So I then tried the Gerber crunchies and she loves those too.  The cheese are her favorite, but she doesn't like the cinnamon maple ones.  Then I tried the Gerber Wheels and she loves them.  She holds them with one hand and then bits a piece off and chews it.  They are harder than the rest of the snacks but they still dissolve.  She did stick the whole thing in her mouth one time and I told her no, and out it came.  She hasn't stuck the whole thing back in her mouth since.  I would defiantly recommend these, just watch your child while she is eating them.

My toddler loves these little things, has since he was 10 months old. Although he can eat an entire can in one day now that he's 3...doctor told me that as a snack/filler this is not a bad thing to feed kids at young ages, has some good ingredients and isn't fried or full of fat.  Do try to eat the contents within a week, so they stay fresh and crisp.
I snack on these myself.  I and well beyond childhood!  Yummy!  I recommend these for the "young  'uns"  and more importanly for yourself.  Enjoy in copious quantity!
My baby's more than one year old. he don't like its taste, though i hope he can eats them, for i bought 4 cans. maybe it just eats like popcorns and has no other chedder taste.

column9: My 9 month old is crazy for these
column10: They're easy for her to pick up and she loves them over any other finger food I've tried so far. They're also not messy, which is nice for me.

I bought these for myself when I was pregnant because I wanted a low sodium snack. I love all of the Lil' Crunchies, but the Veggie Dip flavor is the best. It is mild but addicting. My son is now 9 months old, so when he's ready to try them, I'll have to buy enough for both of us ;)
My son loves these, but like any cheese puff-type thing, they leave crumbs and such everywhere.  My brother has banned these for his daughter, because the resulting poop is quite terrible.

My daughter loves these snacks!  I love them because they are so easy to take on little trips, and they don't mash into her clothes like other snacks.  (They do leave crumbs, but are easy to wipe off.)  Amazon has a much better deal on these than what I can find in the stores, plus free shipping with prime!

These have been my son's favorite snacks since I had first bought them almost 1 year ago. They're great for tiny fingers and for little ones learning to self feed. They fit perfectly into a diaper bag/purse so you can have one on you at all times. They're great with little one's meals or just a simple snack. The ONLY downfall is that they're a bit messy. After eating them I always have to find that I'm cleaning my son's hands of crumbs, but that's with everything. HIGHLY recommended.

column9: Better buy a few extra cans...
column10: My child, in a word, literally inhales these things! They smell & taste great and i would expect them to have a higher sugar content but they're actually a pretty good snack alternative, esp in comparison with fish crackers, cheetos, etc... You may find yourself sneaking a few :)

column9: My toddler LOVES these!  I wish they made these for adults as well.
column10: These may not be the #1 healthiest snack for toddlers, but they are very good.  The flavor is perfect.  It's not too strong, nor too bland.  They have a touch of salt, but it's not nearly as salty as many alternatives.  They are just the right size for little hands.  They're crunchy, yet dissolve easily.  In fact, these were my toddler's first finger food.  I often like to go with store brands to save money, but I've found that the taste of these is quite superior.As my toddler is getting older, I'm not buying these as often as I used to since they are expensive.  However, when she was still in the early stages of eating table foods, these were awesome.  I'm actually a little bummed that I'm not going to be getting them all that often anymore.

My toddler loves these and she has since she first tried them. She would eat an entire can in one sitting if I would let her. They are also great for teething, which is not something I anticipated. They are not the healthiest snack out there but they work great at pacifying an angry toddler stuck in her car seat.
My little girl loves this product.  She has these snacks on the go and at home.  They have a mild cheese flavor and are not too hard for her gums.  Love the ease of taking these on car rides too!
Son really likes these. He eats them for snack all the time. However now that he is 1 he doesnt like them as much

I bought these for my son after trying the cheese flavor.  He liked the cheese flavor so much I thought these would have to be good as well.  I wasn't disappointed.  The veggie dip is quite tasty.  My son loves them, and gets really excited when he sees the canister!  The only problem is they are SO good that my 7 year old is constantly sneaking them!

column9: great snack for baby and adult
column10: My baby started to eat this snack when she was 6 month old. It is her favorite all the time. Myself even eat it sometimes. It's such a low calories snack with great taste.
My 21 month old has loved this for at least 6 months. I've sampled them myself and I also find them to be tasty!  At least not quite as junky as chips, cheese puffs, etc.
My grandchildren love these. Their faces just about light up when I pull out one of these cans. I do have to split it up though or they struggle, both want the can and all the wheels.

We have 4 kids, ages 11 months, twins 3 1/2 years and 10 and ALL of them LOVE these.  They are always munching on these and especially the Cheddar ones.  They actually prefer these to other chips which is awesome since they're way healthier.
My 10 month old baby absolutly loves the lil crunchies snacks.  He has no problem eating them, they disolve quickly with minimal mess.

I bought these for my son to try, and he absolutely loves them! He's also tried the maple flavored crunchies, but prefers the veggie dip. His breath smells a little like garlic after he eats, them, but I'm not a vampire, so I don't mind. Ha ha! I call them baby cheetos, although they are very soft for toddlers learning to self-feed. I signed up for Amazon's subscribe and save program to get a pack of 6 of these every 2 months. I love the program and hope they keep adding more items to it. It's an easy way to keep those constantly used items in the house. I know as he gets older, we'll stop the subscribe and save, but for now, he loves them and eats them like crazy so I'm glad I don't have to worry about running out!

this case was reasonably priced and came in handy.  i was able to stash some at grandma's, home, and babysitters.  my munchkin loves these because she can bite into them, I love them because the dissolve and dont pose a great choke risk.

My toddler loves this stuff! She would eat the whole can if I let her but I only give her a handful as a special snack. The cheesy taste is not as strong as goldfish snacks but its cheesy/salty enough to excite young taste buds.
My little one loves these and you cannot beat the subscribe & save price!  It's a better price than any sale at a retail store!
My little one loves these and you cannot beat the subscribe & save price!  It's a better price than any sale at a retail store!
My little one loves these and you cannot beat the subscribe & save price!  It's a better price than any sale at a retail store!

column9: Must have but when on sale
column10: I got them when on sale so better price than the off-brands. Toddlers love them!A must have snack for toddlers. I wouldn't get unless on sale cuz you can get the off-brand which is exactly the same thing such as up and up at target for less.
Our little one just loves these in every flavor. They are very portable and keep fresh in the can. They have less sodium, fat and calories than the adult version of cheese puffs and extra viatmins.

I have twin girls and they can't get enough of these.  They eat them slowly.  Mostly they just suck on them until they get mushy then they break apart into pieces they can chew.  I actually like that they are bigger and easier for my babies to hold.  The puffs were too small and were harder for them to pick up and get into their mouths.
My 15 month olds love these and I have to admit that I think they are pretty tasty myself. They are like a healthier Cheeto. They melt in the mouth, so I think they are a good snack for toddlers.

My son is 22 months old and has been eating these veggie crunchies for over a year now. I never thought to look on Amazon for food items and I'm so glad a did!They are a fantastic price, very fresh and were delivered quickly.I will continue to purchase these here!
These were my babies first food she could self feed and she still loves them.  I think she started eating them around six months or so.

column9: Taste good but I wonder if it,s healthy for kids to eat
column10: I tried it myself. The taste is good  in my opinion. But It contains garlic powder so it stinks the breath after eating. And it is not all natural. Amazon price is good though.

column9: too much salt and WAY too much garlic
column10: First of all, I have major issues with children's snacks that are so full of sodium.I have to admit, my son loves these. What is not so great is the two or three days of garlic breath I have to endure afterwards. Was it so necessary to add garlic salt to a toddler snack?

My son is now 9 months old, he has been eating finger foods for a few months now. We first purchased the Gerber Graduates Mild Cheddar & he loves them! They do just melt in the mouth, perfect because he only had 5 teeth at the time. The only negative I have for these is some of the puffs are fairly large! If I give my son a handful of them, he stuffs them in his mouth, so the larger ones make me nervous. I ususally cut them in half. My new find would be the Target Up & Up brand - they are fairly cheaper & they are all the same size (perfectly smaller) So from now on, I will be saving a few bucks, and using those!
I haven't given this to my current baby yet as she's too young but my first LOVED them!!  They're very portable and yummy (yes, I tried them).  :)

Great in theory...healthy, organic, etc. ... however, this product does not dissolve in babies mouth NOR in Mommy's mouth.  My child, 7 months old, put one in his mouth, he has two teeth, tried to bite it, it did not break...he then sucked one for about 2 minutes then ... just like a kid...placed another in his mouth.  Reminding you, the reader, I was right there when this happened...he began to choke!  I lifted him out of his highchair, turned him around, did the Heimlich maneuver on him...he blew one out and then I pulled the first apple wagon out of his mouth.  On a lighter note, he's fine, prefers the puffs and whole grain cereal...but the dog couldn't even chew these!!!  We do, however, have friends, with a baby girl...same age...and she loves these!!!Happy Baby Gluten-Free Organic Puffs, Sweet Potato Puffs, 2.1-Ounce Containers (Pack of 6)
My little one loves these and you cannot beat the subscribe & save price!  It's a better price than any sale at a retail store!

column9: Must have for kids but go for on sale
column10: I got these when they had a sale on amazon. So I got them for even less than the off-brands.They are a must have for toddlers. I would get the off-brand if no sale though. They are exactly the same thing just not as pretty of a can.

These are without a doubt my daughter's favorite snack.  She has been eating them since about 10 months and they remain her favorite still at 17 months.  The other flavors they offer have not fared as well but these are still going strong.

Bought these for my 15 month old and he LOVES them.  It's nice having a savory snack as most of them tend to be on the sweeter side.He goes NUTS for them and I know it's not as empty as junk food since it has the tomato and cheese in it.The only thing is you have to use it quickly or it can go soft in the can if left for too long.It's also a bit messy so not so good for special clothes.Other than that ... OMG it tastes great!!  The Veggie Dip and Mild Cheddar are also great.

column9: Because our kids aren't obese enough
column10: Thank you Gerber, for helping us get our kids off to the right start!  Why should we parents take the time to prepare healthy snacks for our children and teach them to like REAL food, when you have Baby Cheetos in a can for them to enjoy?  One-third of America's children being overweight or obese simply isn't enough -- we need to strive for more.  America's kids need to learn to fill up on empty calories and eat for boredom, not hunger, starting at a year old or younger!  And thank goodness this product "tastes good" -- because that's all that matters, right?

I tried many, many times to make authentic Hong Kong style milk tea at home, to no avail. My tea cabinet at home overflows with varieties of tea. I read pages and pages of testimony and learned about how Hong Kong cafes have secret 5-tea or more blends, and the practice of adding eggshells to the pot when brewing. I could not replicate anything near my favorite milk tea, until I used Rickshaw. No blending with other teas needed, just boiled Rickshaw with one clean eggshell, added evaporated milk and condensed milk, sugar to taste, and voila! Real Hong Kong milk tea.

column4: M. Maher "Proud Army Wife and Mother"
column10: My daughter was diagnosed with celiac two months before her 12th birthday. I served this cake to my daughters friends and they loved it...even after being told it was wheat free! It was so much moister than any cake I've ever made (box or scratch). I had to bake it longer than the directions, but beyond that, it was just as easy to make as any other boxed cake mix.If you're wanting to try a gluten free cake that you're kids will actually eat...try this one! It passed the pre-teen kid test! I highly recomend it for us adults too!

Wheat free or not this cake is one of the best.  Worth every penny and far above any other gluten free boxed cake or any wheat containing boxed cake out there.  Their spice/carrot cake is also very good.  Recommended highly from on Celiac to the world.

This mix is the best Chocolate cake mix there is!  Our whole family enjoys this including my husband who is not celiac and a very picky eater.  When I make the cake I tweak the mix recipe a little. I use 3 large eggs, 1 cup apple sauce and 1/3 cup of oil instead of what is listed on the bag.  This mix and the spice are our family's favorites!

I never saw the flowers, but my Mom reported that they were absolutely beautiful. She is 91 years young so I knew she had plenty of vases around her house so why pay for glass vases when she loves flowers. In fact, there were so many flowers that she used two vases. If my Mom loved them, they have to get a 5 star rating!
Our recipient said she had so many flowers in this bouquet she made two arrangements. Great deal!!

column9: Mixed Review for Mix Flower Bouquet
column10: I ordered two bouguets for two different members of my family for Easter.  The first order was delivered promptly and in perfect condition.  Flowers were gorgeous (or so I was told).The second order was also delivered promptly (apparently), but FEDEX did not ring the doorbell or knock to deliver them.  Instead, they left the flowers on a not-too-often-used porch in 20 degree Michigan weather.  They were discovered 2 days later - in poor condition.My parents were home all day - both of them.  If FedEx had tried to notify them of the delivery, someone would have heard them.No refund was granted by the company.I believe the company has beautiful flowers, but the use of FEDEX as the delivery service failed them in this case.  I will not purchase from any flower company in the future that uses FedEx or UPS.  I will choose a company that uses a local florist shop for delivery.  A local florist shop will call if they are unable to deliver.I'm disappointed that Falcon Farms did not offer to replace the flowers or issue a refund.

I ordered this bouquet for my mom's birthday. They lasted well over 2 weeks. I ordered them without the vase, and they came in a beautiful box with tissue paper and flower food, ready to set in a vase. My only complaint is that they did not include a card with my Happy Birthday message.

I bought these for my mother's birthday, and she was extremely happy with them (and my mother is brutally honest).  She said they were "beautiful" for well over two weeks.  She also said they were a very large bouquet and arranged very nicely.  I will definitely buy from Falcon Farms again.

I was really worried about buying flowers from Falcon Farms as most customer reviews were either 5 star or 1 star without almost any in the middle.  So I had assumed that customer reviews were terrible but that maybe the manufacturer posted great reviews to counteract the bad ones.  It's hard to tell.Well, according to my sister-in-law the flowers look great and they arrived within two days of ordering them.
WE BOUGHT THIS AS A GIFT AND SHE ABSOLUTELY LOVED THE BEAUTIFUL BOUQUET!!!WE WOULD DEFINATELY BUY AGAIN!!!
I ordered these flowers for my mom when she was in the hospital.  She got them within a few days.  She said they were beautiful and plentiful.
Flowers arrived fast with ordinary shipping, fresh and delighted the recipients..this is about my 3rd order with same supplier and all delivered promptly and in fresh condition...

column9: Made mother and mother-in-law very happy
column10: I prefer to buy flowers without a vase because I have given very fantastic vases as gifts already. The flowers looked great (and came with plant food and directions) and were very ready to just drop in my previously gifted very fantastic vase. I will order from them again.

I inadvertently gave the wrong delivery address for my mom's Mother's Day flower bouquet delivery. The flowers were delivered on the Friday before Mother's Day as promised but were delivered to a house down the block. The fine folks that lived there kept the flowers and made no attempt to get the flowers to my mother. Mom was able to retreive the flowers four days later and she said the flowers were beautiful and still in good condition. Falcon Farms offered to send another bouquet at their expense but mom said the original ones were fine. Falcon Farms refunded the full FedEx delivery charge at their own volition. I will definitely use this vender again.
I sent these to my best friend after her accident. She loved them, she started crying.

I received this very nice bouquet of flowers. They arrived fresh and ready to go in to the vase (after reading prep directions first). Very colorful. Just wish there was maybe one more rose or lilie and or maybe two more gerber daisy's to make it look a little more nicer. Otherwise, very nice. Priced right for what you get.
Wonderful!! My gf loved it. She said it was the best she had ever received from me.
this is the 2nd time i ordered flowers for my mother and both times they were beautiful, lasted 2-3 weeks and were plentiful.  i was very happy both times as was my mother.  well worth it.

column9: Fresh flowers, look terrific, fast delivery, but be aware of $11 shipping
column10: I had these flowers sent to my Mom for her birthday, and they arrived right on time. She says they look great, and there are so many, that she made two very large bouquets out of them.  She received them yesterday and a few flowers hadn't bloomed yet, and but they opened overnight, which shows you how really fresh they are.Just as an FYI: be aware of the shipping charge. I had thought these would be 'included' in the 'things that ship for free' from Amazon, but no, since the flowers are from another vendor, there's an $10.99 fee. It's worth it, for timely, beautiful flowers, in large quantity.

column9: The picture is nicer than the real Bouquet
column10: This seems to be always the trouble with flowers. They look so niceon the picture but in reality the bouquet looks small and not so impressive.Still, it looked nice, nothing grand but OK.
The flowers were just beautiful and a very good value.  Had a problem with ordering though, and inadvertently ordered 2 bouquets, and received one myself.
These were a gift and when my aunt recieved them she said they were so beautiful, it has been a week and she says they are still lovely and the buds are blooming. Thanks!
She really loved the flowers. They were delivered exactly on time.The boquet included nice large blooms, and a lot of them! They stayed fresh looking for plenty long.Great work, Amazon!

These were Mother's Day flowers for my daughter.  They were delivered the Friday before Mother's Day in lots of time and my daughter was delighted with how fresh and beautiful they were.  I would certainly use your service again.

I received a picture of the flowers sent to a sick friend and was HORRIFIED!  It was a bunch of flowers, definitely NOT a bouqet!  It looks as is somebody purchased the flowers from the grocery store and put them in a Dollar Store vase.  Words cannot describe how disappointed I am!!!

Arrived in a box, box ok, flowers "gangrene" would be a nice and repeateabe discription. The flowers could have been picked along any trail in South America. they held up from the box to the vase and there expired. A small funeral was held.
The flowers were perfect my wife loved them. I would Recomend this to anyone buying flowers . They actually came sooner then I thought which is also pretty cOol.

Exceptional service.  Seller contacted me after I ordered to get suggested times for delivery and to provide the opportunity to include a gift card and a message.  The email I received from my wife after the flowers arrived (in just ONE day!) says it all:  "Thank you for the flowers, they are soooo beautiful!!!  They are bright and colorful with some unusual blooms, just my style!"  I will order from this seller again.
I hesitated in ordering these. I was wrong these were great. I ordered one for my mother and one for my wife, they both loved them. This bouquet is BETTER than advertised and worth every penny.

column9: The bouquet that saved my life
column10: It was my sister-in-law's 70th birthday.  I had forgotten the day.  She has had a stroke so I felt all the more terrible about forgetting.  I went on amazon.com immediately and sent the flowers.  They arrived in perfect condition, beautiful and oh so uplifting.  What a life saver!!  I was so relieved.  My sister-in-law was so pleased, and was amazed at the arrangement, colors and freshness!!  Thanks, Falcon Farms.

I sent this bouquet to a favorite friend following the death of her husband.  She said flowers were beautiful, arrived the day after I ordered them and really lasted.Her niece was a florist and says flowers were as good as any they had sent.

This chestnut roaster is very good.  It keeps enough moisture in the roaster to keep the chesnuts moist, but still enables you to get the flavor of roasting instead of boiling.  It is a bit small though, since most people roast chestnuts on holidays, I usually have to do a few batches to get a good enough portion done.  Easy to clean.
Taste like I remember as a kid. I did not know they were made in Argentina. I know where I will come for more!

I just love this cereal, no matter where it is sold. The only reason I bought it in Amazon is price. Normally the price in Amazon for this cereal is higher than the wholesale clubs and comparable to supermarkets, but it was on sale.

column9: Yummy, Full of Fiber and a Good Value
column10: This extra large size of Frosted Mini Wheats is an economical, tasty way to get a whole bunch of fiber into your diet.  Mini Wheats are a great deal like Triscuit crackers, only the biscuits are sweet instead of salty.  The cereal appears to be some kind of extruded wheat threads stuck together into a tiny pillow and baked.  That sounds horrible, but these are among the tastiest of breakfast cereals.One gotcha is that they become soggy in milk in a very short time, but it's an easy matter to eat the cereal dry with milk on the side.  Dunk if you wish.That's about all I can think of to recommend a breakfast cereal that you have probably eaten since you were a child.  Back then, you ate Mini-Wheats because they tasted good, and now you eat them because they are good for you. Pity that there isn't a little plastic toy in the package.  :-)

On a friend's recommendation, I tried one can of Verve.  I was skeptical because it was carbonated, and I've given up sodas.  Simply put, I drank it to be polite.  The taste was refreshing and the carbonation was very light, but still too close to soda for me to be comfortable.The big surprise was that the next day, I wanted another one.  I even felt like I needed it.  This has only happened to me once before, and that was when I juiced carrots/apples/celery for the first time.  I began having moments when I craved carrot juice, usually in the afternoon.  The same thing happened with Verve.  I felt like I needed the vitamins/minerals it provided.  The bad news was I had no idea where to buy it, and my friend was out of town on business.  Because of my lack of curiosity the previous day, I had to get on the phone and calling all over town to find it.  Annoying.  I did find it, and now I keep a week's supply in the refrigerator to drink one every day.  I am a HUGE fan, and feel like it is part of a healthy routine.  It has mangosteen, and that alone is a reason to drink it.
The product is great, and I've been using it for years, but you can purchase it way cheaper from the website..vemma.com and pay about $2.80 per can.

column9: Tried it and i love it!
column10: if your into keeping yourself healthy as possible the Vemma drink is definitely for you.With all of the vitamins in the Vemma drink you cant go wrong. [...]yes the product will cost you some money at first but it is definitely worth it. When you sign up you buy the product and become a member. if you decide the product isn't for you then send them the empty cans back within 30 days and get a full refund. there's nothing to lose but the opportunity. ps: it even cures hangovers;) signup and order here: stainsby.vemma.com  its cheaper than ordering it here on amazon

I give this product four stars because it adapts well to incorporating other ingredients, with very little extra trouble.When made strictly according to package instructions, it's a creamy macaroni and cheese type dish which tastes a bit better than the orange mac-in-a-box which we all knew as kids (seems much less salty, also, even when I use standard margarine rather than the unsalted butter it calls for).However, when you cut up fresh broccoli and throw it in the pot where the pasta is 3/4 cooked, saute minced garlic in the butter or margarine in the pot for a minute or two before adding the drained pasta and broccoli back in, and add extra milk and some grated parmesan cheese and fresh ground pepper along with the sauce packet, you get a one-pot entree that tastes very good now and will heat up beautifully in the microwave for your lunches throughout the week (if you make two boxes at once, at least!).

column9: Back to Nature Spirals & white Cheddar dinner
column10: Back to Nature Spirals & White Cheddar Dinner, 6.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12) I would have liked a cheesier taste even in white cheese.  This is like having alfredo sauce and for those that like Alfredo it would be great.
Delicious and creamy with an excellent white cheddar cheese flavor.  This has permanently replaced the super salty, orange-crayon-colored box product in our household.
This is th only Mac and cheese my kids all agree on. I like it too.  The other item, crazy bugs, is the other favorite.
I absolutely love this mac and cheese.  I eat it at about one night per week for a fast and delicious dinner.

I love love love this macaroni and cheese. Which is why I buy a case of it several times a year. I love how it tastes, and the best part is it doesn't give me the horrible gut rot that other varieties do if I eat more than a bowl! I can eat a whole box! I can never find it at the stores near me though, which makes me sad. I would love to try the other varieties they make but don't really want to buy those by the case!

I love my mac & cheese.  I've eaten Kraft spirals for at least 10 years and I've tried all sorts of other varieties (store brand, Annie's) that I thought were terrible, but these Back to Nature Spirals are amazing!  I have now completely abandoned Kraft in favor of these.  Oh, and after you prepare the box, try stirring in 10-15 grape tomatoes.  Yum.

column4: Y. R. Wu "The will to win is nothing without ...
column9: Tasty, but not all kids like it....
column10: I think it's great (for instant Mac & cheese, that is) BUT kids are picky eaters.  Our oldest loves it but for whatever reason our second oldest can't stand it.  I've even tried adding turmeric to give it the look of Annies regular cheddar mac & cheese.I'm thinking it's the noodle shape.  These are spirals instead of the more traditional elbow macaroni tubes.Just be aware...
my cats have had all kinds of problems for years. I have tried all different foods for them. this is the best one. It has actually helped them in many ways. highly reccomended.

column9: Medium Blend.  Good Flavor. Good Choice.
column10: This Millstone Hazelnut coffee smells fabulous during the brewing process, and its flavor holds up to a 10oz brew.  If you like hazelnut flavored coffee, this k cup is a good choice.Medium roast, smooth blend, great flavor and not bitter.  This one is a winner. When the price is right, I'll order again.

column9: Awesome coffee, but dont pay more than $6 per box!
column10: I have never bought this coffee on Amazon, but I did want to give a big thumbs up for the flavor! It tastes about the same as their ground coffee for regular coffee makers.... I just cant believe this company wants twice the amount of money for this coffee! And they want an additional 2-3 days to "process" before they ship? haha.... I currently buy this coffee at my local Fry's grocery store for $6 per box. You might want to try your local supermarket or wait for the price to be corrected here.

column9: Good but not worth the price
column10: Just like Breanna I ordered this coffee a while back when it was $.40 a cup.  I enjoy the Hazelnut as well as the Breakfast Blend.  I would be willing to buy this coffee again but not at the current price of a dollar something per cup, that's ridiculous.  There are a lot of K Cups out there for cheaper that are as of similiar quality.

Picked this up other other day for MUCH much cheaper, like .40 a cup now they are 1.19 a cup.I like the flavor and smell of these.  I came back to order again but a buck a piece I'm passing, it's not That good.

This is an excellent product that my wife and I both enjoy. I drink it often, as well as jamaica me crazy, and Kahlua coffees. They are all very good tasting coffees, and I don't see why anyone would not enjoy the flavor!!!! I highly recommend this product.

I have tried a lot of hazelnut coffees and this is my favorite.  The K cups perform well unlike another brand whose name I won't mention (WP) and the flavor is much bolder than every other brand.  Green Mountain used to have a bold one but it was discontinued except in sample packs (with other flavors).  This coffee has a nice taste, too.  I just wish I could find it locally and for less money.  You used to be able to get a bundle of large boxes from Amazon but they're not currently available.  I think this was the best price I could get but was disappointed when I received my 3 tiny boxes - if you overlooked it these boxes only contain 12 K cups each.  I'll keep looking for better value but in the meantime I can still enjoy a good cup of coffee made at home.  I gave it only four stars because of the price but I do recommend this coffee.
This is my favorite hazelnut coffee. I can generally get this at the grocer for $8-$9 per 12-pack, so at about $13 per 12-pack this is ridiculously overpriced.

I ordered this coffee a while back when it was $.40 a cup. I enjoy the Hazelnut creme as well as the Breakfast Blend. I would be willing to buy this coffee again but not at the current price of a dollar something per cup, that's ridiculous. There are a lot of K Cups out there for cheaper that are as of similiar quality. I don't know why they would even think this is a good price!!!!

I was thrilled to finally see this in a K-cup, but - whoa!! That price! Where does that comes from? And, why should I but here when I can buy from my local grocery store at 40% less any day. Plus, the occasionally have it on BOGO!!! I'll shop local or on Keurig.com for major savings.

column9: Hazelnut Cream K-Cups are my favorite
column10: Of all the hazelnut flavored k-cups the Millstone brand Hazelnut Cream is my favorite. It smells and tastes delicious. If you like nutty flavored coffees this is a sure bet.

column9: I'd Give it Six Stars if I Could!
column10: I'm pretty picky and difficult to impress but I tried the Millstone Hazelnut Cream and the fragrance and flavor reminded me of visiting an Ol' Time coffee shop and bakery. Besides the savory fragrance of the coffee, the flavor was smooth - not bitter, and kissed with just a hint of sweetness. You  get what you pay for so stay away from the high costs of the local grocery stores. Shopping online has it's advantages.Just a note: The coffee (taste) is superior to any flavor I've tasted in the past 4 years.

This is my favorite K cup coffee I've tried so far.  I thought it was over priced and then I had to pay shipping so it won't be one I buy often.  When you add the cost of shipping this is a very expensive coffee.  5 stars for the product, 1 star for the price, so I'll give it 3.

column9: Nice cup of coffee - but the price OMG
column10: I bought this coffee when it was on special on Amazon.  I liked it, my wife loves it. BUT when I went to reorder it  - I balked, the price was a lot more.  I guess I'll just have to use a hazelnut creamer on my regular coffee.
Considering what these K-Cups cost in grocery stores, this deal was one too good to pass up.  Thirty-six for $15.  This was a no-brainer.

I've long been a fan of Millstone Hazelnut coffee. It is a welcome pleasure that it is now available for Keurig coffee makers in a k-cup.I've tried all the other hazelnut k-cups. What I found with them was an almost pungent, smack-in-the-face artificial flavor. These k-cups, however, offer a subtle more subdued, almost creamy, even flavor and taste.To comment on the price:  I too was lucky enough to get it at the .40 a cup price.  Don't blame Amazon on the price/availability increase.  I've noticed a lot of (unfavorable) changes in regards to the pricing and availability of k cups on Amazon.com.  I emailed Amazon customer support and inquired about the changes.  In there words, "Due to a change in the manufacturer's distribution policies..." was the reason for the price/availability differences lately.Too bad, too.  I hope the manufactures get the acts together.  In my opinion, it behooves companies to work with Amazon, not against it!

Great job sucking us in! Great flavored coffee, could become my new favorite. Much bolder and darker roast than most other flavored k-cups. However, I too purchased at lower price (3 packs of 12 cups for $15 - bargain!) but find the new price absurd. Perhaps the marketing plan was to offer the new product at low price to entice the bargain hunters to try it and discover they love it. That part worked! Unfortunately for Amazon & supplier, the 2nd half of plan (raise price to over double $ of anything else) is a FAIL. Will not purchase this product from Amazon until price is reasonable and competitive. Shame too, love buying via Amazon. Love this new K-cup, but someone else will benefit from this pricing disaster.

I have been waiting a long time for Millstone's Hazelnut Cream coffee to arrive on the market in k-cups.  Although I am not a fan of flavored coffees in general and don't even like hazelnuts, the aroma and flavor of this particular coffee is divine.

column9: Shin Ramen punches the faces off of hangovers.
column10: Shin Ramen is by no means a healthy snack. For those without a degree in Food Science (with an emphasis in Junk), I'll summarize the ingredients for you:1. Salt2. Spicey3. Freeze dried vegetables, etc.4. More salt5. Noodles6. MOAR SALT7. MOAR SPICEYWhy then would a competing combat athlete and full-time professional such as myself subject their body to the gauntlet of toxins that this delectable soup has to offer? Well, dear reader, this competing combat athlete and full-time professional fancies himself an alcoholic beverage to take the edge of the next 14 alcoholic beverages. You see, I am also a competing combat boozer and although I am Terminator in most regards, even the mightiest of us fall - and how hard do we fall.Now, one could drink water and tea, rehydrate and re-electrolite'ilyze themselves back to health, but that takes too long. Sometimes a dedicated combat boozer has to go all Barry Bonds and take that "vitamin b shot" that makes them hit the ball farther and run faster even though they're ten years older. In this case, Shin Ramen would be the dodgey supplement in question and I recommend the bowl because if you drink like I drink, you will be in no mood to muss with a bag and will want to get directly to fighting past regretting every decision you made for the past 18 hours, which is nearly impossible to do with your gut threatening to evacuate your body through your mouth.

I used to buy these years ago in packet form from an Asian grocery store near Cincinnati and couldn't find them when I moved away.  They are a proper-sized meal, very tasty (and spicy) and just need hot water.  They are quite hot (spicy) and a bit salty:  you can tone it all down by just using less of the included flavor packet.  I like to add some pouch-salmon, tuna, or some sliced hard-boiled egg to make a very nice lunch or dinner.  These are great for traveling or a quick and easy meal with no cleanup.  Cheap too!  These are in no way like the grocery store Top Ramen or Ichiban, these are the real deal.
This is the best instant ramen (or ramyun, as this is spicy Korean style ramen with a beef broth) I have had. It is great for a quick meal, and the big bowl is certainly filling.

Yes they are. These are damn good. I love spicy food. If you don't stay away.These soups are so flavorful. Yeah they cost more than those ramen bag soups but these are quality. And the cups are BIG. Just don't eat too much of this stuff..it can be addicting ...and of course like pretty much all soups...these have MSG. So try not to eat too many of these aday. But either way this is good stuff

column9: Tastes different from the Shin Ramyun Bags
column10: Very good instant noodle. Tasty with some mushroom flavor. But the flavor isn't the same as the Shin Ramyun noodles that come in the bags. This bowl tastes more like the other Nong Shim bowls (kimchee, etc)...something about the bowl noodles from nong shim...they all taste similar.My fav instant noodle is the bagged Shin Ramyun.

With the sodium and calorie content of these, I wouldn't recommend them for a daily meal, but they make a great guilty-pleasure junk food snack or meal, especially if you add a few slices of good American cheese.  The cheese thickens up the soup, and helps to cut a bit of the edge off the spice, but still give your mouth that "I just ate good spicy food" feeling.  Tasty!Other additions besides the American cheese: canned or sauteed mushrooms, diced chicken tenders, sliced lunchmeat (roast beef especially), and stir-fry vegetables.

column4: E. Wenck "Spicy food is best food."
column9: A spicy meal or a large snack.
column10: Shin Ramen is one of the most popular in the world for good reason.  They contain a very tasty broth mix and dried vegetables.  These spicy bowls come packed with the same contents of the Shin Ramen bags with the convenient instant bowls.  The sodium content in this as well as other imported ramens is high but it isn't as noticable in flavor as it is in the American store bought counterparts(Top Ramen, Maruchan, Smack etc...)

column9: Best instant noodles I have ever had.
column10: Ok for all you ramen noodle lovers out there these are a must try. I must warn you these are spicy. And as with all ramen they are very high in sodium. These are good by themselves or add some pork, beef, or egg and they are even better. A must try.
Amazon shipped the soup, it arrived in 3 days and it was awesome! Nong Shim Rules!I highly recommend Nong Shim Noodles!
If taste is what u want, you got it!  Very filling and spicy, this will warm your belly and craving for more the next day!

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: BIGGEST bowl of BEEF flavored noodles!
column10: Korean style, so I assumed (falsely) that these noodles were VEGETARIAN. Who knows what I was thinking? Anyway, this is a BIG (4 oz) bowl of spicy BEEF flavored noodles. Very yummy, but really is spicy with the whole "soup base" flavoring packet. Maybe, as others have said, go easy on the flavoring packet at first til you know what you're getting into? All the flavor is in the packet (spice isn't separate) so it's tricky. These are ramen style noodles, too, so high in fat, since ramen noodles are FRIED. What you get, tho, is a BIG hearty-appetite size MEAL in a convenient take-anywhere bowl. Per bowl: 480 calories, 14 grams FAT, 2600 mg SODIUM, 78 carbs, 4 grams fiber, 10 grams protein. (26% of calories from fat.) Made in the USA,

This product is like a cousin of the famous college era ramen noodles.  The seasoning packet is spicy so if you don't care for a hot tongue, it would pay you to only use half of the powder or eliminate it altogether.  Also, since it is in it's own container, it is easy to add cooked vegetables and/or meat to make it a more robust meal.
This is by far my favorite instant noodles.  If you like spicy-hot food, you'll love this!  It's very spicy, even surprisingly so.  These bowls are big portions, too.

column9: Good Value - Plenty of Food for a Quick Snack
column10: This is a very good deal.  Lots of noodles - you get the equivalent of about 1.5 of those ramen noodle packages plus vegetables.I only use about a quarter of the seasoning packet though, any more and I get dehydrated.Overall - a good deal and recommended over cup-o-noodles and the other soup in a bowl products.

what can i say? this stuff is great. if you're like me and can't handle really spicy foods then don't use a full packet of the spice that comes in each bowl. i usually only use half of one then give the rest to whoever wants to add it to theirs. a full bag is pretty spicy but if you tone it down some to taste should you choose to do that then it's really good stuff. a friend of mine introduced me to it a few months back and honestly i can't get enough. i would definitely reccomend this to anybody who likes noodle soups in a cup. the spice makes the flavor of it but like i said, you don't have to use the whole packet that comes with it.

Easy to make and substantial in size, the Big Bowl Noodle is a decent lunch option.One caveat- you might not want to add the entire spice packet.  I like spicy food, but the full contents of the spice envelope created a noodle bowl hotter than I could enjoy.

I am very pleased with these Ramyun noodles. I first had them while stationed in South Korea. I have purchased them locally, but the deal from Amazon was aesome. The price I paid on Amazon was nearly half of what I pay locally. Also, the expiration date on the noodles from Amazon was afr lengthier than those locally.

I went to my local Asian market and bought a dozen different spicy chicken bowls.  This was my favorite, so I was happy to see them on Amazon by the case and with an subscription order discount.These are big bowls, as the name says, and make for a good lunch all by themselves.  They are salty and spicy, so if you're looking for a genteel cup of chicken soup, look elsewhere.  This bad boy will heat you up and set your eyes to watering.

This soup is AMAZINGLY good!  I was stationed in South Korea in 2005 and this soup taste the closest I can remember!  Its on the spicy side, but thats what I expected when I got them.  I will be ordering more of the 12 packs!!!  Also, they DO ship to APO (Afghanistan)!!!

This is one of the best instant ramen-bowls.Great late night snack (N.B. cures hangovers), satisfies your hot & spicy cravings, is super fun to eat on camping and ski trips, and it has no MSG. (SO AWESOME.)That said, beware the sodium content. Consuming the entire soup is an automatic 90% DV sodium intake. And honestly, you really don't need to use the whole packet to get the spice-kick and flavoring. Start with just half (or less, even!) and find your level of satisfaction.
Though not as good as the chicken, this spicy beef ramyun will fill you quite nicely.  The red pepper heat warms your stomach every time, though a whole packet of seasoning is a little too much.

column9: great but prefer bag over bowl
column10: I purchased both the "big bowl" and the "bag" of Nong Shim Noodle, both about the same price. However I prefer the bag version. column9: This is my favorite flavor so far
column10: I've tried several of the Nong Shim noodle bowl flavors, and this is my favorite.  It's not as spicy as some (like the Gourmet Spicy Picante), but is spicier than others (like the Beef & Ginger) -- I like it better than either of those, although I thought they were both OK too.

OOOH, the noodles were so soft - much softer than the other flavors!  the sachet was not too spicy - nice flavor. it has become my favorite flavor.  Although it is does not taste like lobster!  Quick nad convenient and a good portion size.  And great value offered by Amazon.  I take these to work for a quick lunch.

column9: Perfect for work or a quick, tasty snack
column10: I've tried a few of the other Nong Shim noodle bowls, such as Kimchi, Seafood, and Beef & Ginger. This one's easily the best. The spices provide a suitably lobsterlike flavor that you'd expect from bowl noodles, it's sweet, and there's just enough spiciness to keep it interesting without putting your mouth on fire. Unless you really let the noodles sit in hot water for too long, they remain pretty firm for the meal. On top of that, the bits of cabbage and other veggies aren't much but add a nice extra crunch to the entire thing. Highly recommended.
Soup tastes Wonderful but very Spicy if you insert the Entire pack of Red Pepper in!!! Nevertheless I put the whole package in and choke and Gag but my Sinuses are cleared right away!!!

flavor is definitely fishy with hot spice.  Noodle quality is good for an instant bowl type--which is to say, not as good as regular stant.  I tend to use 1/2-3/4 of the condiment pack--simply too salty.

These are my favorite flavor of all of the Nong Shim Bowl Noodles.These noodles don't have any real lobster in them, but I don't think you would know unless told.  The ingredients are heavy on crab, and contain other seafood as well as artificial lobster flavor.There are good amounts of vegetables, mostly Japanese Cabbage, in the bowls.  This element is quite good as well.I have always enjoyed the level of heat in these noodles, and they never get old.Also I believe these noodles are supplied only from Korea unlike many of the other flavors carried by Amazon which are made here in the US.  I think everything is better with these noodles from Korea.  From the noodles to the packaging.

This was the first Nong Shim Bowl Noodle product that I've had and based on the reviews for their other products, I was a bit disappointed. While there is no argument that this is better than cup of noodle, it isn't worth paying 6 times as much. Also the ridiculously high sodium content will deter me from buying this again.
Our family has enjoyed these noodles and I shall be ordering more.  They are really spicy and convenient to use.

column9: my favorite flavor of nong shim bowls
column10: Spicy Lobster is my favorite flavor of nong shim bowl. Although there's not much "lobster" taste, it follows the picante flavor. It is spicy, but does not have that sour taste that picante has. It is also half as spicy, which means I can eat twice as much!

I don't get these other reviewers, but at least I know I'm not alone in that my wife also did not enjoy this product...1) There is no lobster in this soup and the flavoring is listed as an almost last ingredient - crab seasoning is listed much higher.2) This tastes NOTHING like lobster and is a salty, flavorless mess. I love lobster as much as the next person, but this didn't even resemble lobster flavor.I'm not a picky eater and neither is my wife - but this soup was just not good at all. I've only tried one other Nong Shim bowl, the Spicy Chicken, and that one was pretty good. But the best one (by far that I've tasted so far) is the Gourmet Spicy Picante. It doesn't come in a bowl, but this soup is like night and day compared to the bowl soups. The flavor is better and the noodles are thicker and better tasting.

column9: not bad, tad pricey, but good and spicy

These are no where near as flavorful as some of the other Nong Shim products. They might taste better with some additions, but really you'd be better off picking a completely different flavor. Their spicy seafood is delicious, but these are no where near that in terms of flavor. I won't be purchasing these again.

I bought this because I was curious about what a lobster flavored noodle would actually taste like. I figured it'd probably taste like spicy seafood, which is pretty good, so I gave it a go.It's not very spicy, especially compared to all the other spicy flavors Nong Shim offers. The original flavor is super spicy compared to this. I also really like the "hot and spicy" flavor, which is one of my staples (and favorites). The "kimchi" flavor is better than this (and it's also slightly spicier). I also have the "neoguri spicy seafood" flavor which is another one of my favorites and much better than this as well. Even the regular Nong Shim "seafood" flavor (that's not labeled spicy) is spicier than this for some reason. I was a college student once and ate lots of Nong Shim noodles (I still do, but not as much)....Basically, this was kind of a disappointment based on my expectations from the name of the product. It's not bad, but it's one of the less tasty flavors. It's nothing special or distinctive. The ingredients actually listed crab flavoring but not lobster flavoring, which I don't really care about as long as it tastes good. I still give this 4 stars because it's better than many many instant noodles from other companies. Nong Shim tends to get it right and this noodle pales only in comparison to other Nong Shim flavors.

this is no different from the original flavor except it is much saltier. So if you think the original in underflavored try this flavor. Also, for those with allergies to seafood and shell fish this product should be safe because the flavor is artificial.

column9: Strong Oolong with Mint flavor and a hint of chocolate
column10: I enjoy this tea.  However, it should be thought of more as a mint tea than a chocolate mint tea.  I was looking for a flavored Oolong tea since I prefer flavored teas and read that Oolong is much better than green for fat burning (by the way I've lost 30 pound in the last 6 months by drinking tea instead of my Starbucks mocha and removing artificial sweeteners, sugar and wheat flour from my diet so there is probably something to this). This has the potential to be a very strong tea, which I prefer.  The chocolate is most prevalent if you take the teabag early and opt for a weak tea.  Even then, it is just of hint of chocolate not a strong chocolate flavor.  As the tea sits longer, the mint and tea flavors tend to overwhelm the chocolate so there is just the barest hint left.  The mint flavor is definitely strong enough that you can sweeten with Stevia instead of sugar or artificial sweeteners and not notice anything wrong with the taste.

On the downside, I would prefer more of a dark chocolate taste and a bit more caffeine kick but I suspect this is the sacrifice for going sugar free.

column10: I cannot start my day without a cup of this wonderful coffee. it is very tasteful with a finely balanced flavor because of an unbelievable thin grind. Try it and you will love it.

This coffee is our coffee crack whenever we are in Europe. column10: I love Celestial Seasoning's Madagascar Vanilla Red tea, which is sadly becoming harder and harder to find in stores.  But don't order this item.
