I personally think it works great in combination with other teas, my favorite is a combination of four bags of this tea and one bag of plum black tea to make a gallon pitcher, which tastes great both hot or cold.
It is difficult to find. I do not know how many boxes you get from Amazon, but the price is over 100.00.
You have to taste this, it taste like you made it from scratch.

column9: This Yerba Mate is a Keeper
column10: Other reviewers have mention the fine particles in Guayaki Loose Yerba Mate, but all the Yerba Mate I've tried had some fine particles, and this does not bother me. Yerba Mate is actually made from the leaves and stems of the South American rainforest holly tree, so some dusty particles are bound to end up in the tea.Admittedly, I don't love the taste of Yerba Mate without sweetener and a bit of milk.  It does not taste like traditional tea, it has more of a green tea taste, but much earthier.  I do not find this tea to be bitter, but then I brew it appropriately: stir the tea in a small amount of cold water, then add 185 degree water.  I steep for 5 or more minutes, and if I steep for just 5 minutes, I find I can brew a second cup using the same tea by skipping the cold water and steeping for about 10 minutes.In my opinion, Guayaki Traditional Mate brews up nicely to a full-bodied tea that perks up my brain during afternoon energy slumps, without the upset stomach and "on edge" feeling that I get from coffee.  In addition to caffeine, Yerba Mate contains antioxidants.  I am on my second bag of this Yerba Mate, and I'm very happy with it.  This same tea is available in Yerba Mate' Tea -Organic - 25 - Bag, so if the fine particles bother you, the bags may be a better choice.

Love this stuff and buy alot of it. Its a pretty good deal online here and lasts a while.I suggest this to tea drinkers and especially coffee drinkers since it has less caffeine but does not give me the jitters or a crash. I drink it all day long and it has increased the effectiveness and duration of my studying.

column9: Not authentic, but still very good
column10: Guayaki is the most common brand of maté on the market, and I bought it because of the good deal here.  Although there are more traditional brands out there with a much finer grind.  Other than that, I love maté. I totally kicked my coffee habit without really even trying. It gives you an alert feeling, but much different than from coffee- you won't be jittery at all.  Great for elimination, but totally not like a laxative at all.  Make it as strong as you possibly can!

I started drinking Yerba Mate about 4 years ago. I used to only drink it tereré (cold) but I was shown a couple of hot preparations with milk and sugar that I really like so now I do it both ways; Hot in the winter and cold the rest of the time.I have tried about 10 different brands. Amazingly they all taste a bit different. This was the second brand I ever tried and it remains one of the better ones.Yerba Mate is a wonderful substitute for coffee or soda. It makes me feel good and gives me energy but doesn't spike me up and down like regular caffeine. My soda intake has gone to almost zero since I discovered this stuff.It is a bit of an acquired taste but I recommend trying it both hot and cold with the different methods available so you can experience the full spectrum of taste that is possible!

I am one those people who lacks complete cognitive thought process until I have had my first cup of coffee. I usually follow it with a mid-day cup for added boost. Since, I've transitioned over to brewing yerba mate in my coffee maker I definitely feel a difference. I am energized mentally and physically. I remember where I park my car.  I can drink it alone, but I've added coconut milk and/or manuka honey for even more flavor before. By itself, it has kind of an earthy flavor. I am into that so it wasn't surprising, that isn't for you, but you want the benefits use your normal coffee embellishments (creamer, sugar, etc.) I can't even relay how much energy and focus this gives me. Not only am I alert, but I feel like I process information better. I'm not a morning person, but this gives me something to look forward to.

I love the taste of this mate, I love the company and what it stands for, protecting the enviornment & supporting organic farmers, the price here on amazon is really great, I took away one star only because most of my tea leaves were reduced to a very fine powder.  This was my second loose tea leaf purchase (I normally buy tea in bags) and the other loose leaf I bought (different brand, different site) had no fine powder.  So when I make the tea I get a lot of powder in my cup.  Not a huge deal, but I would prefer if the leaves were big enough not to leak through.  I'll probably buy this one more time & if I get the same thing I'll go back to the guayaki mate tea bags, which I love, I just wish they sold in bulk because I run out so quickly!!

column9: Tastes like green tea from the jungle
column10: This stuff is hard to explain.It seems most similar to green tea, but it has an earthier taste, nuttier maybe. I drink it through a high quality stainless steel coffee-like filter rather than the traditional gourd and bombilla. The gourd and bombilla just seem like way too much trouble to me.I have read it has more anti oxidants than green tea, and judging from the thick cloud of green "tea" it can produce I don't doubt that. It actually has some identical antioxidant components that green tea has after I researched it, but they have different ones as well that I won't begin to attempt to understand or explain.It doesn't give me the nauseous feeling that I experience with green tea first thing in the morning on an empty stomach, which other of my friends say they get too if they drink green tea on an empty stomach. Also if you brew it too long, it will not get bitter like green tea gets, which is very nice.This stuff is advertised as having a different kind of caffeine that is more mellow. I do not believe that at all, this stuff gives a serious kick. If you have ever experienced a caffeine headache, this stuff can give it to you in a single strong cup. I do not drink soda by the way, but I do drink coffee, about once a week. This stuff seems at least as potent as espresso to me. I am not a daily intaker of caffeine, so my tolerance to it is probably quite low, but that is my experience.I like it to switch up my regimen of green tea, since I don't drink soda, or much coffee, or juice, drinking only green tea and water can get bland. And this stuff is a welcome change of pace that is a pleasant and mellow taste.

I drink this stuff all the time. It is a loose tea so if the particles bother you you may like a tea ball. I drink mine from a hallowed out gourd with a silver straw. It can have a srong grassy biter taste to someone who isn't used to it. I for one like the biter not so sweet taste.

This is the first kind of yerba mate I ever purchased. I bought it at my grocery store, in the organic section. I didn't know what to expect. It is green and the size of the particles varies greatly. Some of it is actually a powder, and it sometimes seeps out of the infuser as you're brewing it. There are pieces of stem and the leaves are not cut to a uniform size.When you brew it, you need an infuser with a very fine mesh, and you can't submerge the infuser since stuff will leak out where it closes. You want a cylindrical infuser that opens at the top, and make sure the top of the infuser is not submerged. Don't try one of those round ones that closes like 2 halves of an egg, unless you want particles in your drink. There are special gourd things you're supposed to use, but I haven't tried those.Find a good place to let the infuser drain. It will leave a dark green stain on whatever it sits on while it drains. This stain will probably wash out, but you need to watch out for it. If you spill any of the powdery particles of th dry mix, and then if they get wet, they will make the same kind of stain.Having said all of this, I liked the taste and I used up two 16 oz. packages of this in just a short while. I looked around for a cheaper option and tried another brand.

Have been using this product for several years - never have been disappointed in what it promises.  Was so pleasantly surprised to see that Amazon carried the product.  And at quite a substantial savings.  Thanks, Amazon!

The flavor of this tea is good, but there are better. Also, it contained a lot of twigs and tiny leaf fragments that frequently clogged my bombilla. My favorite brand is Mate Factor. Eco Teas is cheaper and still very good. And they don't clog my bombilla :)

This is my first experience with Yerba Mate tea.  I bought it for health reasons.  It contains B 1 and 2, riboflavin, carotene, iron, potassium, magnesium, 15 amino acids and other things I can't remember.  Google it and you'll see what a power house it is.It improves digestion, mental focus and supposedly helps diminish food cravings.I made my first pot yesterday and I'm enjoying another today.  I like the taste of it - I don't think it's grassy as other people do.  To me it has a slight spicy after taste.It's from the continent of the Amazon River - sold on amazon.com - HA! - good grief I'm easily amused.....Steeped in hot - not boiling water.  That's good for me because I don't think I let water  boil in the microwave.I'd recommend this for taste, health benefits and the fact that it's a sustainable product from the Rain Forest.
I have been drinking Mate for years and this is my favorite brand. It is almost "soul cleansing."The taste is one that takes getting used to.I drink mine with honey.
We love to brew the tea and add juice or mint over ice.  Very nice alternative to black or green tea.

Love that it's fresh...  Husband says it's not a "true" paraguayan cut, as paraguayan cut is larger-  and this does tend to be a tad bit powdery- HOWEVER, it is VERY fresh and delicious!  Love it. :)  Five stars all around.

verry good tasty yerba mate, a bit harsh at first i recommend adding sugar or honey on the first fill for newbies and a bit of lemon , the taste then will become more light after the third refill, the seller shipped this faster than i thought. column9: Now I know why they call it "ginger" ale
column10: I used to think the "ginger" in "ginger ale" was a form of wishful thinking - like "strawberry" in "Strawberry Pop Tarts".  Not so with Blenheim's version. Tastes like ginger!

Blenheim Ginger Ale's Spicy Sampler pack is 12 bottles of some of the finest ginger ale I have ever tasted. When I say 'ginger ale', I do not mean the overly sweet, ginger-free tasting sodas commonly passed off as said product; I mean the actual, genuine article.Even the 'mild' has quite a kick to it, it is the kind of spice that opens up your sinuses and leaves you with a pleasant tingle in the mouth. It's sweet at first, with some of the floral notes you expect from real ginger, followed by a hint of lemon-y acidity, with the aforementioned sinus-burn (similar to horseradish) as the last note.Really, truly delicious on its own, and when mixed with a good whiskey, even better.
The spicy is spicy. The really spicy, could kill someone unsuspecting of it. It is a ginger/wasabi/horseradish type of hot. I enjoy it simply as it is, over ice, or as a mixer for a good bourbon.

column9: It really is the best ginger ale ever.

Its fantastic. Its spicy but in a refreshing way. This is my favorite summertime drink. If your on the edge about trying this i only have on thing to say to you...Come on!
I disappointed after trying..was expecting this to be as good or better than Maine Roots, Cock & Bulls, or Big Bens ginger brand drinks..not even close on spice. This was a letdown

column9: Perfect for a healthy lifestyle and harsh environment of a soldier
column10: I'm a soldier Currently deployed in Afghanistan.The Teavanna website does not ship to my location and was happy they had this on amazon. I purchsase this product in the beginning of august recieved it within a week (Pretty good).Aside from the bottled water here, This has been the only beverage that I drink.Quite my escape from reality. My mother sent me ice trays and i purchased the Black sage honey and it has been my own personal ice tea tea bar. Mild watermelon flavor, nice energy boost before training or just in the late afternoon at work.  A little greasy.  Perfect snack for Shark Week : )
Fake watermelon at it's worst.  Blech.I like the berry sharkies quite a bit, but not these.That said, if you like faux watermelon flavored things, you'll probably enjoy these.

These are a great work-out food.  They are organic, so you escape all of the yucky stuff, like artifical colours and HFCS.  They are not sickeningly sweet, so that is a big plus.  They are also a good texture.  Now, I love gummy bears, but not when I am working out.  These are soft, yet firm and not sticky.  To me, eating something like a really sticky, sweet gummy, while or just after exercising is yucky.  These won't make ya feel all gooey gross.  They taste good, too.  In fact, therein lies the rub.  They are so tasty (and they are organic, so that makes them healthy, right? :-)  ), that every member of the family ends up digging into them, even when they are not working out/competing. column9: My Girls U-18 Soccer teams loved Sharkies

I believe it helps keep their energy up during the second half of the game.I used to buy them at a local Performance Bike store but they stopped carrying them recently.I found them on Amazon and received them with regular shipping in 4 days which was good for me.I thought the pricing and ordering was very good through Amazon. I will order them again when I run out.

We were looking for a little boost for our long mt bike rides.  Something to switch up our trailmix stops, easy to digest, and a boost of energy to keep us from crashing.  These work like a charm.  Delicious, fun & different!  My only complaint, they are NOT good on a cold winter hike :) Just like gummy bears, they get too hard!  I'll have to wait for more summer bikes/hikes to pull them out again!

Personally I love the watermelon flavor, unlike some other reviewers, so obviously that comes down to preference. My only complaint is that they're hard to chew and get stuck in your teeth, though they're better in this regard than the Shot Bloks. I plan to alternate between these and the Jelly Belly Sport Beans, and it's nice to know these Sharkies are organic and have complex carbs and no refined sugars.
I love the Sharkies I just purchased. The flavor is the best so far and they work like a charm for all my long runs!
The flavor is ok, watermelon is hard to mimic.  I say if you want to try it go ahead but its not as good as berry and citrus.  Overall sharkies are a great product, nice boost of energy.

If you like refried beans that taste like just beans, no major spiciness or additional veggie ingredients, you will like these. These refried beans are hearty and easy to use in a variety of recipes. And with the lower sodium count, you are more likely to be able to incorporate these into a low-salt diet.I use these for nachos. I spread the beans on organic corn tortilla chips, top the whole thing with about a 1/4 portion of cheese (by that, I mean that I use maybe 1/4 of a cup for a 2-person portion; I guess you could say that I am cutting cheese out of my diet as much as possible), and stick it all in the oven for a few minutes, just long enough for the cheese to melt and the beans to warm up.Then I top the baked result with organic salsa.Wonderful!These beans make great bean-n-cheese tacos, too.Healthy and delicous--enjoy!

This is the second time that I have order a case of these beans.  The first time a couple of the cans were dented.  With the order that arrived yesterday 11 of the 12 cans were dented.All the packaging was intact with no crushing on the box.  11 of the 12 cans were dented - some horribly.  It is clear to me that the seller is providing seconds - which are then being passed along.  While they MAY be safe - I don't want to take that chance - and they were not advertised as "scratch and dent" type item.Update:  Contacted AMZ as item not eligible for return.  They told me to keep or throw away the dented cans and they sent me a replacement case in 2 days.  All cans in good shape on replacement.Great product - the glitch was somewhere in the order filling process.  We will continue to buy this product.

column9: Best ever, and gives me lots of low cost energy
column10: My taste buds aren't ruined with fast food salt and grease.  I LOVE being able to taste real food with Amy's unsalted brand.  They use such good tasting ingredients I can enjoy these refried beans, even without adding salsa.  Noticed I wouldn't be hungry for a long time after eating a few tacos made with these beans.  That's a huge deal when someone has low blood sugar issues.  Nice to just live my day instead of constantly trying to eat small meals to keep sugar levels from crashing.I keep a case of cans at work with some taco shells so I always have a quick, cheap meal on hand.

This is a great product, lower sodium than traditional canned refried beans,  organic, and just plain great! I use these as a simple side dish, or put them on tortillas and make a quick lunch or dinner. The price is also cheaper than if I bought a can individually every time I wanted some.

These refried black beans are amazing.  The spices are just right and perfect for everything.  Also, the price on Amazon is the best I've found.  We were paying more than $3 per can at Whole Foods, but can get them shipped free for around $2 per can through Amazon.  We're already on our second case!
So much better than regular refried beans!  I like the regular better than the light in sodium...I just add some salt and it's great.  Makes awesome nachos!

column9: We love Amy's Refried Black Beans!
column10: We eat an average of two can's a week of the black refried beans. They are awesome!

These are delicious!  So much better than the ones I used to buy.  My whole family agrees.  These were one of the first organic canned foods we tried and YUM, they are the best.  I buy them by the case and they go pretty fast.
Love these, and it's SO HARD to find lower-sodium products that still taste good. Now if I can just get Garden of Eatin to stop over-salting my favorite tortilla chips...

column9: Make sure you taste these locally before ordering a 12 pack!
column10: I love Amy's foods but the taste of these beans are not my favorite. They taste way different than other refried black bean companies. I think its that they are sweeter? Not sure but make sure you like the flavor before ordering. I just assumed I would and now I am forcing 12 cans of beans down my throat that I don't really care for.Nothing against Amy's or these beans. Just preference.

I HAVE EATEN THESE BEANS RIGHT OUT OF CAN. I SMEAR THE BEANS ON SOUTH BEACH MULTI-GRAIN WRAPS, (PURCHASED AT AMAZON), YUM. I LIKE MY BEANS SPICEY SO I USE SOME MEDIUM OR HOT SALSA MIXED IN, OR A FEW DROPS OF HOT SAUCE. YOU WILL NOT BE DISAPPOINTED WITH AMY'S BEANS, USE YOUR IMAGINATION  WHEN PREPARING.

The only refried beans I ate for the longest time were off the supermarket shelf.  They were okay -- I didn't know any better.  Then I tried these bad boys from the people at Amy's and now I'm a believer.  They taste sooooo much better than the supermarket ones and the black beans in this products are better for you than the pinto beans used in most grocery store refried beans.  Plus, my cat loves Amy's Refried Black Beans!  What more could you want!

column9: Don't Penalize Us for One Bad Shipment
column10: I have ordered these Beans from Amazon multiple times with no problem in shipping. I want to order more, as I do every few months, and I am getting penalized for one bad order. Please reconsider and make them available again!

This is the strangest tasting Amy's brand (or any other brand I have ever tried) refried black beans I have ever ate.  I have tried every brand that I ever found, it this one just tastes odd, and I like the regular Amy's refried black beans.  I think it is all the extra ingredients, specifically the green bell pepper and onion that give it such an odd sweet flavor, but I am not sure as I have never studied the ingredients before.  Under lying that sweetness is just a bland, non existent, "watery" flavor that does nothing for me.  I would have preferred a spicy flavor, so I have to add my own.  I will not reorder.

Has anyone had an MSG reaction to these? I know they say that they don't add any msg, but the last two times I've had these, I've had a definite MSG reaction. Perhaps it is one of those "hidden" msg ingredients.

column9: picture looks better than what you get
column10: Received as a gift and looks very nice until you open the packaging and realize portion sizes are very small with products that are not brand names you recognize (look & taste generic.)  Very low quality items that make it appear you have given a cheap basket when in reality you are paying quite a bit ($40) for something that recipient will think you spent less than $20.  Not worth the money.

Both my boys have autism and are on strict GFCF diets.  The foods by ENER G are very good.  These cookies, although rather crumbly, are delicious!My youngest son calls them 'white cookies'.  I am a VERY picky eater - but do enjoy eating a white cookie with him!  You should try them with some chocolate melted on them...oooh divine :)

These cookies are delicious. My grandaughter ate a whole package the first time she tried them. She has several food allergies and finding a delicious sweet treat is almost impossible. I will be reordering soon because she has gone through the whole box already and has requested more. I am so thankful to have found this product.
Slightly crumbly, but overall a very good cookie.  In my opinion very similar to Chips Ahoy but more airy, less dense.
Like a lot of gluten free foods there is a tendancy to crumble, but these arrived in very good condition.  The vanilla flavoring stands out.  Very good for light snacking or dessert.
son is gluten free, but not fun and tasty free, so these are great!!! I puthis icecream on these for a COOL snack.  Taste good to him too just plain.

My husband eats GF, and I don't, and its so hard to find him goodies, and hes always tempted to eat mine. Now he has some thing I'm tempted to eat, I thought they were ok cold but if heated up they really taste yummy.
I am addicted to these cookies.  They taste much better than the regular ones.  The only draw back is, that they should be available in smaller packages - to avoid binge eating.

column9: there are much better gluten and dairy free cookies
column10: My son would rather have no cookie than one of these cookies. The taste is okay. The texture is hard and weird even when microwaved. Short shelf life if you are buying in bulk. Not absolutely terrible but worse than average. Try Pamela's chocolate chip cookies they are wonderful, or try a baking mix.

These Amish products are very good and economical.  I find them, used appropriately, very helpful in cooking.  They seem to be clean, fresh, and very nicely made.  Their deliveries are good and timely.
This was great for my holiday baking. I made peppermint bark and it came out so good! I got rave reviews from everyone. I will definitely order more for next year!

So, I am a candied fruit slice fanatic, so please consider that I am extra picky in this category of candy.  My ideal fuit slice is one in which the rind (the part outside that thin sugar, white line) is really aldente, the fruit is somewhat dry and which provides some resistance to my teeth.  I found these to be, in general, too wet and too soft.  Perhaps I could have let them dry out in the air and get a little stale but I didn't try that.  I think, instead, I will try another brand.
These arrived completely uneatable. Maybe they got wet or maybe they melted somewhere but I threw them out. I would suggest not ordering these in the summer.

column9: Been reported to Amazon.  Buyer beware.
column10: Never received the salsa and the vendor never responded to my email.  Amazon reimbursed me thanks to their A thru Z guarantee.  This vendor should be removed from the site.

It's a neet gift idea for the person that has everything but after the last box arrived I realized that I paid a lot of money for salsa that is just Ok.  I'm not sure where the Gourmet part comes in. I've had better from the Market.
I ordered this as a gift for my son for his birthday. shipping was very fast, only two days. And best of all he loved his salsa. Thanks a Bunch!

column9: Salsa of the Month was Great!
column10: I just received The Salsa of the Month Club package and everything was great!  I was excited to try two new salsas from different specialty companies that I would've never been able to try.  They arrived in a sturdy box with foam packing peanuts.  I admit that I was a little nervous that they wouldn't arrive safely, but the glass jars were completely fine.  They were even accompanied by a newsletter giving some background about the salsas and the companies who made them.  They both looked so good, it was hard to decide which one to open first!  My wife and I decided to open the Pink's Mild Salsa from Pennsylvania to accompany our fajitas that we were making for dinner.  It was bold, fresh and made with minimal ingredients and also contained no allergens.  Medically, my wife has to follow a Gluten Free diet, so we are always concerned with allergens and trying to eat foods closer to nature.  A few days later we opened the second salsa (after scraping the first jar dry) and were equally impressed!  The second jar was a Picante Salsa from Hillside Orchard farms in Georgia and was very flavorful and had some visibly large cilantro pieces (my favorite), but was not as chunky as the other one.  This one was great to pour over tacos, as it had more of a sauce consistency, but it was a little harder to pick up with a chip.  Overall, I was very satisfied and I'm looking forward to next month's salsas!  This was the perfect gift for us and would highly recommend the Salsa of the Month Club!
The product took a bit long to receive due to a computer glitch (their's), but the product is worth waiting for.  Will order again !

I was hesitant to purchase this based on the only review, which complained about getting only 1 bottle.  The title clearly says 6 bottles.  The earlier review implied that they bought it from somewhere other than Amazon.  At the time I purchased, though, this item was sold & shipped by Amazon, so I didn't hesitate long.  I knew Amazon would make the matter right if I only received 1 bottle.  But I didn't - there are six.  And, the 2 oz bottles are twice the size of most extracts sold in the grocery store.  So my only problem is - how will I use all this lemon flavoring up!  I haven't purchased a lot of grocery items yet from Amazon, but so far, every one has been quality as well as a good deal.

column9: FIRST PHONEY SELLER IN 10 YEARS ON AMAZON.COM !!!
column10: "Said a PACK OF 6 I only got ONE (2 OZ.)bottle NEVER SET ME THE OTHER 5 AVOID THIS TAINTED SELLER"Where can I give a MINUS 5 STAR ?

column9: thumbs down on chicken and mackerel flavor
column10: I have two cats who both became very ill while eating the chicken and mackerel flavor. Consistency of this food was completely different than the chicken & chicken liver they normally eat. It was watery, almost soupy and had lots of black spots in it. It smelled fine but made cats very sick. I threw the entire case away after my cats got sick.  I haven't had a problem with the chicken flavor.

In all fairness this is the first time I've had a problem with the Chicken & Mackerel.  I'm hoping I just received a bad batch.  Watery consistency and chunks of darker meat which I can't quite make out.  Pet Food Direct contacted by Nature Organics and was told that there hasn't been a recipe change so I'm going to give it one more chance since this is my cats' favorite flavor.  Pet Food Direct customer service was great in that they refunded the three cases I had purchased.

column9: Fabulous food and a little goes a long way....
column10: I have two cats who are in the process of learning how to be "real cats" again.  That is, they are learning to like MEAT and not that nasty dry food made out of corn, wheat, and lord knows what else.  That nasty dry food is called "crack for cats" and with good reason, as the dry food is nothing more than corn kibbles that have  sprayed with an animal digest product (kind of like bullion soup broth) and dried.Anyway, I went to PetSmart and bought this product on clearance, 97 cents a can.  I also bought cans of WellNess, Nutro, BlueMountain, FancyFeast, Sophisticat (the store brand,) Avoderm, Friskies, Meow Mix, and others, making sure that I chose only those items which have meat products among the first 4 ingredients, and NO corn or wheat gluten. I am doing research to determine which nutritional canned products are most-liked by my cats.Okay, so this product is 95% meat. I put 2 teaspoons on a saucer and Tiki, half-tabby and half marbled Savannah, 8 months old and already 9 pounds--  went nuts. She loved it!  She's a semi picky cat, so-so with Newman's Organics, Friskies, Meow Mix, and Fancy Feast, while Whiskas and 9-Lives are paws down. She hates raw.  Poor girl, she had been fed dry Science Diet at the pound (she had been abandoned by a bad breeder) and her wild cat instincts are dull.  But I have never seen Tiki react to a wet food like this.Now, when I put the food in front of our Bengal, Tonga, a real dry-food addict, she just pushed it away with her paw and yawned. I've noticed that the better quality the food, the more Tonga dislikes it.  I think this is because  Tonga is almost 4 years old and she has had a habit of just nibbling on nasty dry food throughout the day. She's going to be a harder convert.It's been two days since I've taken the "cat crack" away from both kitties and this is a traumatic period for both (!), but if Tiki is loving this product, then it must be yummy!  Smart girl, she knows what is good for her.

column9: My Cat Loves The Organic Chicken & Mackerel Cat Food
column10: My Cat Loves The Organic Chicken & Mackerel Cat Food.  I had no problems with the shipper, the item came within 4 days.  I would order this cat food again.

My very finicky cat loves the Sardine and mackeral flavor!  And I like the natural ingredients. However, it is becoming very difficult to find in stores.  Petsmart is no longer carrying it and very few independent stores carry it either.  At least that is the case in our area of NC and in the Myrtle Beach area of SC.  Unfortunately it costs much more to ship it than it does for the product when purchased online.  But I highly recommend this canned cat food.

My cats enjoyed this flavor & the chicken & liver combo, but don't like the chicken & turkey combo...I do have to add a little sea salt, as it is bland ( my husband's idea). They do love it with the sea salt..

column9: Food good, service not so much
column10: My cats love this food, but I would not choose to deal with Pet Food Direct again.  Half of the cans in the 2 cases I bought, are dented and this company is useless to try to deal with.  I will stick to the food that is sold by Amazon only.Who needs the hassle.

My husband used/uses these mints daily. He especially likes the peppermint flavor, but we could no longer find them in any of our local stores. We did find them sometimes while traveling on a road trip in the truck stops, etc. Now we can get these mints anytime and in fact are set up to get a regular shipment automatically.  My husband will no longer go without these clasic mints that he loves so much!

The order came quickly and I will order from this company again but some of the mints were extremey hard while others were what I expected.  Not sure if they were older but the dates were the same I think it was because the plastic wrapping was not as air tight as the others??  All in all still good.
They arrived just in time for the wedding reception and were just perfect. Made for a very happy Bride. Thanks so much!
Shipped on time and VERY delicious!  Was a little disappointed at how the bag was only filled with candy 1/2-3/4 of the bag, but other than that, they were very good!

This is some goooood candy. The bag is, as others have mentioned, not filled completely, but it's still a lot of strawberry puffs! Definitely my favorite candy, and I'm glad Amazon has it or else I'd have to buy it for a ridiculous price at the mall candy store. By the way, these are perfect for road trip vacations; you hardly notice the long driving hours when you're munching on this goodness.
I'll keep this short and simple.Pros:-Very Fast Shipping.-Mouth watering taste.-Very Fresh.Cons:-The get eaten really quick lol.All in all this was a great buy and I would buy from this seller again!

I first came upon this candy at a gas station in Texas. I was looking to satisfy my sweet tooth while on a road trip you see I'm from the mid-west and I had never seen this Trolli Strawberry Puffs before. So when I came back home I went to the store and looked for them and to my surprise I couldn't find them anywhere!! So while shopping on Amazon I decided to look for them and I found them! They tasted just as delicious as I remember them... although I have to say the bag isn't quite as full as I would like it to be, but other than that two thumbs up!
this came pretty quickly, wasn't expecting it to arrive till later! anyway I am happy with it, like the other comments said before only problem is that there lots of air and not enough puffs!

column9: A bargain for a hard-to-find style of pasta
column10: Couldn't find this in our local Italian deli or grocery stores for over a year.  Bought a case and split with relatives.  Was soooo happy.
This is great stuff I bought a can to make some apples with a group of kids and it, worked, looked, and tasted great. With the left over caramel we made caramel turtles.
Caramel was extremely old and couldnt be used. Had to throw it all away. SAVE YOUR MONEY AND DON'T BUY IT. I WANT MY MONEY BACK...it was a waste of time. Would give zero stars if I could.

We just tried Wild Thymes Chili Ginger Honey Marinade and love it!  We marinated wild Alaskan salmon in a small amount of the marinade and roasted it in the oven. It added just the right amount of flavor without overpowering the dish. A little went a long way, so it added very few calories per serving.  We also love that while it is not sugar free, it is lower in sugar than similar products on the market, and it is made from a simple list of ingredients without additives.

After consulting with the seller I can recommend this product. The product is top shelf and it is everything the seller said it was. Freshness and taste is excellent  I will be glad to order this product again

Istara's Sheep's milk cheese has been a staple in our family for about 10 years.  We use it as a snack and with all our cooking recipes.  I do almost everything, grilled cheese sandwiches, mac and cheese, enchildadas, lasagna, etc.  We can not eat cow's milk cheeses, and we didn't like the taste of goat's milk cheeses.  Are friend's that can eat normal cow's milk cheese, love Istara's Sheep's milk Cheese.
arrived with over 75% broken pieces, seemed stale. I was extreamly disapointed in this product. Would avoid buying again. It was the first time in this household that candy got thrown out

column9: candy corn all broken because of soft packaging
column10: Candy corn sent in a small soft envelope was all broken. Was to be for Thanksgiving guest, won't be able to use it.
I received the package on time. However, I am sorry to say none of the seeds grew. Perhaps i have a black thumb? I am rather disappointed.

column9: The best root beer ever made!
column10: Gotta have my Barq's!!!  This root beer, with caffeine in it, is amazing.  When I need a little extra but don't really want coke or Dr Pepper, I get me a Barq's and the "bite" it has in it as opposed to other root beers, is just what I'm needing.  My son loves them, my dad loves them, my husband will even drink one every once in a while - and that's saying a lot, because he typically doesn't enjoy root beers!  A winner with our family, for sure!

column9: BEST ROOT BEER AROUND....HATE THE NEW DESIGN ON THE CAN
column10: This is the best root beer around.  Has a bite to the taste.  Very good.  There is a new design on the can.  Yuk!  Hate it.  Someone was lazy with the design.  It looks plain.  Why change a good thing?  When I first opened the 12 can box, I thought I bought the wrong soda.  Ok, I know I can get use to it but, I'd rather not.  Why do companies do this?  Who makes these decisions? They should have their head examined.  :-)

column9: Love root beer, but if you can find locally, it's cheaper!
column10: I agree with other reviewers - this is the BEST root beer, in my opinion.  A&W doesn't taste right too me, especially when I compare it to this.  A nice big iced glass of Barq's with extra foam on the top - YUM!!  BUT, isn't this a little expensive?  It could be worse, I'm sure, but you can get soda on sale for like 3 for $12 or less, plus you don't have to pay shipping.  So, I gave it 3 stars for the price, not the product.  If you can't find it in your area, than it's worth paying a little more for sure!

All cats are different, but in my experience both my personal pets and cats I rescue/foster seem to really love this food. I bought it initially because of the high calorie content when trying to put weight on finicky eaters and ill rescue kittens. I wasn't prepared for them to go CRAZY over this. I thought it might smell really gamey but it's fairly bland-smelling to me.I keep a few cans in my first aid stock.It's expensive but has actually saved some cats when they refused to eat other foods or needed extra nutrition. My IBD senior loves it and it keeps weight on her.As with any 100% meat food, this is to be used in conjunction with kibble or another balanced food.
I bought this as a novelty, and the dogs all gladly took as much as I'd give them. It has a plant/gamey smell to it.

column9: Product is not as good as it used to be
column10: No problem with the vendor or the shipping. My cat used to love this product & looked forward to getting it each night when I got home from work. I would  say "beaver" & he would come running & wait by his dish. This last batch is dry & my cat won't eat it. I even bought a can from a local pet food store & found the same problem. When I talked to the pet food store owner she said there have been a lot of complaints. I won't buy this product again & wonder what has changed  with the manufacturer. The local pet food store owner said this company is very difficult to deal with & it probably wasn't worth my time complaining because they are unresponsive. Maybe they'll care about quality when people stop buying their product.

column9: Smells weird, but dog loves it
column10: I have to say that this stuff definitely smells like it did indeed come out of some backwoods swamp or something. It doesn't smell horrible like green tripe or anything like that, but just smells swampy. Anyway, regardless of what I think, my dog loves it, and it did actually help him put on a couple pounds, which was my purpose for getting it. Beaver is supposed to be high quality food with a high calorie content. I wouldn't feed this to my dog all the time, but I'd buy it again.

column9: Horrible Smell, My Cats won't eat it!  Expensive!
column10: I am sorry I purchased this. I am not sure what made me try it.  My cats really hated it and I am stuck with a bunch of cans of food.  I am disappointed.

I am a huge fan of The Silk Road restaurant in Missoula, MT.  However, I am currently living far, far, away and miss the food and atmosphere at The Silk Road.  This spice allows me to bring a little bit of that to my own home.  I ordered the spice and received it in a timely manner.  Can't wait to try it out!  Thank you for making this spice blend available! - Aana

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: I tried this on a banana recently and I have to agree with the other five star reviews that there should be some sort of warning label about how addictive this stuff could be. Nothing like Nutella in flavor *or* texture and that for me is a *good* thing; the best I could do to try to explain the difference would be to compare/contrast - Nutella is to Hershey's what Nocciolata is to Godiva. Not that I have anything against good ol' Hersheys but my palate has grown up a bit over the years and I happen to LOVE the less sweet, more natural taste of this spread.To me, this tastes more like milk chocolate than dark which the description says it is made with; makes sense as it does contain milk too. You definitely taste the fresh toasted hazelnuts as well. The texture is great for dipping that banana in the two tiny teaspoons the label says I can have. Somehow with the perfect balance of chocolate and hazelnut just that little bit does seem to satisfy my cravings though.

This is a fantastic syrup!  Follow the "Prickly Pear Margarita" recipe on the flap...it is unbelievable!  Also good as just a splash into some cold OJ for a different taste.  I would definitely recommend to anyone with a taste for the southwest!
Had some of Cheri's prickly pear syrup while vacationing in Tucson.  Great to find it availble so we can never run out.

I was amazed how good this was.  Had some of the best out in Arizona this summer and had to try and make them back in NJ.  Was not sure how it would go, but turned out perfectly.  I even used their directions which were great.  You will not be disappointed with this purchase.  I bought 4 bottles.  Have 2 left.  Will bulk order soon.
I had had this on a recent trip to Arizona and decided to buy it on line. It was just as good

I have not tried another brand of prickly pear cactus syrup to compare but this is delicious and an excellent compliment to tequila. I found a terrific recipe that is similar to a Tequila Sunrise called a Sonora Sunset. Instead of orange juice, you use grapefruit juice and instead of grenadine, you use this syrup. Gorgeous and refreshing. The sweetness of the syrup is a nice contrast to the tartness of the grapefruit juice. Don't waste your time getting the small bottle, get the big bottle and save on shipping.
I love adding this syrup to my margaritas! they taste fantastic and have a beautiful pink glow to them now.  A little pricey for what you get though.
This product has the properties of keeping all systems running properly in your body. I have been using prikly pear for over a year now and it has increased my over all health by leaps.

prickly pear cactus syrup is very delicious and good for different ailments of the body...i purchased it to help lower lipids fat in body...cost a lot for shipping it though..almoost same price as the product...enjoyed it..taste good...order through amazon .com merchants.

First tried this product when a friend bought it to flavor home-made margaritas.  Bought some for myself and have used it as suggested in margaritas, on pancakes, and with vanilla ice cream.  Awesome all the way around!
This syrup is excellent. I have used it to make margaritas and they are the best. They are better than the ones at the high-end bars.

I can't wait for her to open them on Christmas morning!
My order for my came quickly and without any damage. I was right on time and enjoy every bite. It's time to order again and you can guess where I will order from again.

I was so glad to find these on-line.  My son fell in love with the candy at Halloween and I wanted Santa to bring him some too.  The price was fair and the cady was delivered in great condition with a good expiration date.  The only thing keeping them from 5 star is the length of time it took to get to me.  I would reccommend this vendor to others.Thanks
I ordered a box of chocolate candy bars. I received it promptly and in perfect condition.  The candy had a very good expiration date.

column9: Put them in the Fridge or Freezer!
column10: I don't EVER write reviews, however after helping a friend do some moving in the heat he offered me half of one from the freezer.  I had them at room temp before and it was very good.  Chilling them is even better.  Delicious and yummy product that I am now buying cases of them to stockpile in my new man-cave!
I don't see this in stores too often but my husband loves white Kit Kat bars. I ordered some for his birthday and he loved them. Good price and it's exactly what you would expect.

I first ran across these in a hospital gift shop. White chocolate is my weakness and these kit kats soon became my obsession. I even persuaded the school bookstore manager to purchase them and once she did, I pretty much bought half of the box, lol. Price quickly became an issue so once I saw these on Amazon, somewhat cheaper, I was sold. Price was only a few bucks cheaper than if I'd bought the whole box from the store and I do wish it was cheaper, but it'll do.

Kit Kat White Chocolate Candy Bar 24 ct, I love white chocolate so I had to get this Item. Kit Kat is a great candy bar and 24 of them in a box, very dangerous, I got it for Halloween, after eating two of the bars I gave the rest away and I am glad I did because if I kept it at home as I wanted to, I would have eaten the whole box, really, is that good! I am highly allergic to caffeine.  Unfortunately chocolate fits this category.  The reaction can be a deadly one for me.  I wish more chocolate products would use the white chocolate.  The white chocolate version of the KIt Kat bar is soo good.
Bought this candy because it was not in stores.  Original box was damaged and looked like it had been in the warehouse for awhile.  Candy was fine though.
Simply yummy! A fine tea to sit back with and relax, my daughter likes it too. Not too strong in flavor, just right.  Will buy again.

Lol, I just posted a review of Ito En Oi Ocha tea. This tea tastes like water from boiled spinach. Sorry, I'm pretty sure, even the used tea bags were mushy and stunk like spinach. If I were certain that this stuff could cure an ailment I'd buy it. I'm off to try this stuff... Rishi Tea, Green Tea Sencha, 2.11-Ounce Tin

I tried my first Equal Exchange bar yesterday. The cocoa flavor is deep and lingers in the mouth, the mark of a good chocolate, beyond what you would expect from the middling 38% cocoa content (most premium milk chocolate starts at 40%, 50% is common and there are some bars with 60% cocoa). The fact their cacao is sourced from Latin America helps, as South America is the ancestral home of cacao, and American cacao (specially from Venezuela, Ecuador and Trinidad) tends to be better than the industrial forastero grades grown in Africa or Indonesia. This chocolate was also conched properly, with a very smooth texture. The hazelnuts it is blended with are hard to discern, however. They may contribute to the smoothness.This is world-class chocolate. I would not hesitate to put it in the same company as the best from Valrhona, Cluizel, Guittard or Hachez. The price is relatively moderate for premium chocolate.I tend to be suspicious of the Fairtrade label. Their certification is expensive, and most of the money goes to pay Western experts than the poor farmers it purports to help. I tried "Divine" brand chocolates, as the company is actually owned by cocoa farmers in Ghana and the Ivory Coast, but was disappointed with grainy and fairly insipid bars. The good thing about Equal Exchange is the product stands on its own, even before the feel-good factor.

I have a pet care business and needed a product that was safe for all my dogs who had allergies.  I also thought that it would give the dogs some extra greens since I often notice them chewing on the grass on our walks.  All the dogs loved the treats (except one very cranky, picky pooch) and I've had no adverse affects or allergic reactions.  Definitely a good heathy treat that works well for dogs with Chicken, Beef and Grain allergies.

column9: Great Flavor but Bottle Top Hassle
column10: I used it in a Moqueca which is a Brazilian Fish Stew, and it was very delicious. The problem I had was with the bottle top. The recipe called for 1/4 c of the oil. Unfortunately, I was unable to remove the plastic top which does not unscrew.  It just has a flip top cap with a single hole in it and ended up just shaking it by drops into the measuring cup which was messy and a hassle.
I had never heard of Dende Oil before I read a recipe for Braziliam Fish Stew.  I had to make it authentic so ordered it from here!! So glad I did as it made the dish!!! It's really awesome!

While I prefer to eat red curry chicken at a Thai restaurant, this is a very acceptable ingredient to make the dish at home. After scouring the shelves at the local oriental markets this is the only canned sauce I found that doesn't have MSG. It doesn't have the intense flavor of the fresh curry paste, but it will do in a pinch. Note: it's not too spicy; just right for me and I usually order mild at a Thai restaurant.

Great on chicken and fish.  Lemon pepper move over!!!  This is great for kids, too! It is not too spicy, so my kids love it as well.  I used to be able to find this at my local grocery....can't find it anymore so now I have to order it online.  : (

If you're having trouble to eat your fish, this is perfect for it. I've tried it out with chicken as well, but fish and this are just perfect together, you just have to be careful to add it till the las couple of minutes of cooking time because the herbs might burn. If you love fish pair it with this and you'll se how different and delicious will taste. The price was very good though in supermarkets might be a little bit less expensive but it won't last for long in the shelves. (but I'm talking about cents!)

Recently purchased a bag of Dogswell Chicken jerky Treats from PetCareRX. When received at home a friend informed us to make sure that the product was not made in China as the FDA had issued a warning in November 2011 of a foodborne illness that was traced back to jerky treats made in China. Apparently this is the second such warning has been issued. Dogs were getting sick and even dying. No where on PetCareRX's site did they present the warning nor indicate the product was made in China. The package is unopened. Asked for RA to return product for refund. REFUSED!  PetCareRX says to pay for return shipping ourselves and they will not refund the outgoing shipping. They continue to sell the Chinese made jerky treats to their customers regardless of the FDA warning still in effect. After putting our pet at risk to ask us to incur further costs just to get back to even is ridiculous. SHAMEFUL.

column9: Caused digestive issues in dog with delicate system
column10: My dogs loved these.  However, I started to notice a correlation between providing these to my dogs and digestive flare ups in one of my dogs whose system is more delicate.  She was having experiences bordering on diarrhea several times a month.  Once I stopped giving her these treats, the problem went away.  So, I would advise others not to purchase them.

My dogs have been eating these treats for some time now, and although they love them, they are starting to show the symptom identified by the FDA. Naturally I am discontinuing them immediately.Here is the FDA warning.  [...]Thank you to the posters who first identified this.

Dear Huggy Fuzzleton _ Thank you very much for your review regarding the FDA warning about pet food brought in from China.  I tried a bag of these and my dog loved them, however, I don't want to purchase again after hearing they are made or even packaged in China.  You just can't trust what you're getting... you just can't.  I love my dog and just don't want to take a chance on her getting sick or worse, so I'm very happy you wrote your review.  I'm sure I can find some treats that are healthy and good for her, that taste good and are made here in the USA.Diane
Only once before have I tasted a better chocolate covered coconut macaroon, and that was long ago and far away.  The dark chocolate is lucious and it's very addicting.
I like these crackers, and they are hard to find in storesin my area, or they are too expensive. I was glad to find them@ that price.

It's a plastic spoon spatula thing that scoops poop. It performs its necessary functions.It comes in assorted colors. Although the cats probably don't care what color spoon you use to scoop their poop. They only care that their poop gets scooped.
It does what it is designed to do. If you need something to scoop cat poop than this will work well.
I use these scoops with paper litter and they work just fine. Van Ness has always done a good job with their litter products as far as my experience goes.
I have had this for six months, and it's worked very well so far.  For the price, you cannot go wrong!

This actually does a decent job, the excess litter can drain through the sides leaving the clump of your kitties unmentionable ready to be disposed of.My wife and I both use this, and it is a huge improvement over our last one. For the price you can't go wrong!
These do what they are supposed to do and are more sturdy than I expected.  I have two and use them every day.  If only they could make the poop and pee disappear!

It's a cat liter scoop.  Very pedestrian chore, but one that none of us wants to make any more difficult.  This scoop is large and sturdy.  It makes scooping clumping cat litter very easy. It fits well in the hand.  The deep basket means the clumps stay in the basket when you're moving from litter box to garbage bag.What more can I say?  If you need a cat litter scoop this one is inexpensive, durable and well designed.

column9: Excellent Scoop. Well Worth The Money.
column10: I bought three of these Van Ness Cat Litter Scoops at Wal-Mart about five years ago. I got excellent service out of them. I use the "clumping" cat litter and I tend to be somewhat negligent in cleaning the litter box. As such, a lot of the clumps can be stuck together. I've broken a couple of the scoops in attempting to break them apart. It's not the scoop's fault. It's my fault. Or maybe we could say that it's the litter's fault in that it has such a good odor control that I don't even notice the box needs freshening.Ah well, I paid less than a dollar each for these things at the time and they've lasted all these years, I'd say it was an excellent product well worth the money. I now bought a new one of a different brand and I hope it works as well. So far it has.Gary Peterson

I went to Walmart first but they were sold out of poop scoopers so I ordered this one online. I have this scooper and it has done a great job for several years. I purchased an additional one for a friend who had a smaller scooper that broke. The one I received was blue but I wasn't too picky on color anywhere and neither are the cats. I use a good clumping litter so nothing falls through the cracks.

What can I say, it's a poop scoop. After several years, ours broke and I snapped up two of these. They get the job done, which is the important aspect. And they are durable, we wont' need to buy new ones for many more years now! If you are looking for a kitty litter scoop, I would suggest this one for sure. It is affordable, and works!

By the time you figure out this product can't do the job, it's too late to return it.  The plastic is flimsy so scraping the bottom of the box is out of the question (I feel like I am about to snap it in two) and the slots are too wide for smaller clumps.  I'll be buying a different one soon.

I bought this to scoop cigarette butts out of a sand-filled flower pot and it does a great job. It's a little big for my needs, but does what it's supposed to. I imagine this is great for scoopin' poo too but I can't say for sure.
New to cat ownership. This works well. The cat is happy, the job gets done easily and efficiently. Good price and well made plastic scoop.

column9: I Could scoop poop better with a spatula
column10: This poop scooper is overpriced and too small. The slits to filter the litter are too wide. I've scooped alot of litter in my lifetime and didn't realize you could buy a "bad" litter scooper. This one is just a pain to use for the aforementioned reasons. You're better off getting a Boots and Barkley scooper for a $1.47 at Target.2 stars because it isn't COMPLETELY useless...

I purchased this scooper because it was metal.  When soaked in a 10% bleach solution as is needed when using on multiple litter boxes in our rescue room, the plating on it dissolved.  Will have to keep looking for one that will work in the setting that I purchased it for.

I ordered this 7lb bag of candy for my husband (his favorite!) because it was the only one listed as the "variety" in an assortment of Amaretto, French Vanilla and Irish Creme flavors.  The picture was even different than it is now, showing different colored wrappings on the candies to indicate that it was an assortment of flavors.  However, when it arrived, it was a 7lb bag of the same gold original butter toffee flavor, not the assortment I wanted.  I could have ordered the 2lb bag if I wanted all the same candy! Don't buy this if you're expecting an assortment because it's not.

I ordered two bags and didn't find out until they arrived and I opened one bag, that Brach's changed the size of this candy.  Each piece is smaller than in the past.  Apparently, they made a change in 2008 but I didn't realize until now because my past orders were filled with candy that had been made prior to the change.

This stuff is so worth it, and when you do the math, it's actually a bargain.  More on that later....Some background:  My dog is an 80 pound American Pit Bull Terrier.  He is the love of my life (ok, he's a tie with my husband).  He has horrible allergies, both environmental and food.  Because of this, his doggie dermatologist (yep, there's dermatologists out there just for animals!) has him on an elimination diet of just venison.  Being that I completely spoil my dog I've been looking for high quality venison treats to feed him when I stumbled upon the ZiwiPeak venison on Amazon.  I'd not heard of ZiwiPeak, but when I looked at how few ingredients were in there and did a little research, I decided it sounded about as close to bambi in a bag as I could get (sorry, I know that's a sad visual...).  So, I ordered a few bags of the ZiwiPeak Venison treats.  Titan went mad for them.  It was as if I was sprinkling him with magical venison fairy dust and he would do anything so long as I would continue to shower him with those heavenly venison squares.  You see, it's raw air dried venison, and it comes in these little compact squares about the size of a dime of venison jerky.  But it's still soft, almost velvety, as it is still raw.Titan suffers from a tiny case of separation anxiety, so recently when I had to leave him alone for a while and I was fresh out of bambi bones, I put a handful on top of his food and tip toed towards the door.  He barely lifted his head from the bowl.  For insurance, I threw a half empty bag of the ZiwiPeak Venison treats on the floor just as I slipped out the door...he noticed the bag, but kept eating from his bowl, pushing it around and digging through the kibble with his nose to sniff out the ZiwiPeak squares as if a pig searching for truffles in the south of France.  When I returned a couple of hours later, I searched the house for evidence that he wasn't pleased with my departure.  Apart from the garbage being knocked over (my fault for leaving it full, bad mom!) the place was fine.Later when I went to put down his dinner, Titan sat at the entrance of the kitchen and stared at the cabinet where the venison treats were kept.  When I told him to go and eat, he stayed put, staring at the cabinet.  I added a little canned venison to entice him.  No go.  Finally I poured a little bit of the ZiwiPeak Venison on top and he ran to his bowl and started eating.  Now, he will not go near the bowl unless there is a hefty portion of ZP in there.  Figuring I could save some money, I moved up from the treats to the 2.2 pound bag.  Once I went through that in a week, I moved on to the 11 pound bag.  I haven't made the complete transition to just ZP in his bowl, as I'm still mixing it in with his old stuff, but it's just a matter of time.  The vet has had Titan on one of those vet prescribed diets, which, when I looked at the ingredients on that bag, not only could I not pronounce most of them, but the list was HUGE and the first ingredient was POTATO!But back to my point:  I've bought venison treats for Titan that were anywhere from $10 for 5 or 6 ounces, (which translates to $30 per pound) to $44 per pound for venison jerky (and I paid it!!).  So, at $9 a pound, the ZiwiPeak Venison is actually a bargain.  And, it is high quality.  Not to mention, you know how sometimes your dog eats a bowl of food and then throws up and the vomit looks like a mixture of spongy kibble and foam?  Titan's never had that with this stuff.  I think it's because the ZP is so close to the natural thing that there isn't anything in there to cause it to expand which then causes him to throw up.So yes, overall, I'm very happy with the product line.  I think it's a pretty cool thing that I can use his food as treats and he still goes mad for it (much like a toddler with cheerios!).  I'll be experimenting with some of the other varieties once I'm allowed to introduce other foods per the doggie dermatologist; and I will be trying out the ZP canned as well.

column9: Amazing For Finicky Eaters and Stomach Issues
column10: If you have a dog that turns his or her nose up to all dry and wet foods from premium names such as Wellness CORE, Merrick, Blue Buffalo, Evo, Stella and Chewy's Freeze Dried Patties, Dr. Harvey's etc. then you have to give this a try. My dog is a 40lb Sheltie/Collie mix so having a large highly active dog that wouldn't eat was very stressful I hear many people with toy breeds having the problem but I never thought I would happen with a high energy dog. I was shocked that she hated all other dog food and would only eat a little if I wet the dry food and hand fed her she would really try and starve herself any other way and she was not holding out for human food because I do not give her any knowing the problem would of got worse, if that was possible. I found this food by searching online for food for picky eaters and this came up. I was not hopeful because a lot of the brands I previously tried had similar reviews of picky eaters liking it and my my dog not. When I read that it was jerky like pieces it sparked an interest because she loves those types of treats. The company sent me a Venison trial bag and I purchased the Lamb 2.2lb bag and she lovesssss it. She wakes me up now at 8am whimpering by the bag because she wants it soooo much. The smell and texture is incredible I never saw her eat so fast and she is so much more energetic and happy this food is amazing and not that expensive considering the smaller portion. I could not be more happy this product has everything I need.

column4: D. Mantelli "I am part of the Amazon Tribe kn...
column10: This is not your typical dry dog food, where meat is ground up with all kind of fillers. It is air dried and just look at the ingredients:Venison - Meat (min. 50%), Liver, Tripe, Heart and Kidney (min. 19.5%), Fish (min. 15%), Chicory Inulin, Green-lipped Mussel (min. 4%), Fish Oil, Lecithin, Kelp, Vitamins and Minerals, Parsley, Naturally preserved with mixed tocopherols, Additives: Vit. D3 592 IU/kg, Vit. E 7.4mg/kg, Copper (copper proteinate) 9.8mg/kg. Calories 1778 KJ/100g.The food gets 5 stars from the Dog Food Advisor and contains all the essential vitamins and minerals for your dog.

column9: My shih tzu's LOVE their Ziwi!!
column10: I have two VERY picky shih tzu's that have NEVER turned away from the Venison flavored ZiwiPeak. They eat it daily and are happy doggies! I recommend this product to anyone who has a picky pooch!

column9: One of the best dog food out there.
column10: I have a very picky puppy that would often rather starve himself, than to eat something he doesn't like. Because of that, he was becoming underweight and I decided to switch him away from dry kibble to have him gain some weight first before worrying bout his picky taste.However when I give him ziwipeak, he would finish it up right away!This brand is expensive, but based upon the amounts you feed, it isn't really that much expensive if you have a small dog. I have a 2 pound puppy that is expected to mature at about 4-5 pounds, and the costs is about 25cents extra a day. If you have a big dog that's gonna gobble up 1/3 of a bag or more a day, then that will be a lot more expensive for you.But......The quality of food and the fact that it is in a jerky meat form makes it a lot better than eating hard dry kibble all day long.Anyone would be bored of eating biscuits everyday for his entire life :/The quality of this food is unsurpassed.There have been no problems at all with this food at all as well either. No recalls, all made in New Zealand as well.Something that I tell a lot of people.Spend more on food daily, and not risk the possibility of having a sick dog due to some pet food recall. Vet bills are going to cost you a few thousand dollars.Expensive dog food will probably add up to the same cost as most over the duration of your dog's life, unless you have a really big dog.So instead of having to go through the grief of having a puppy in pain, and you undergoing mental and emotional stress, why not just give it a food that is good and safe and something that the dog enjoys, and spare yourself from all that unnecessary trouble?Yes times are hard and most people are having difficulty putting dinner on the table for themselves or their kids. So there are situations where foods like this are just too much to afford.So unless if your budget really is a problem, I would recommend this food to anyone!
