The bean is just what you want for making espresso without over spending. The flavor is balanced and the crema is what you expect in a great espresso. No bitter flavor exists like in other beans which give espresso a bad reputation.

I had settled into buying Starbucks espresso beans from Costco frankly because of the great price.  I prefer Starbucks Italian roast but the price on Starbucks espresso roast is too good.  My daughter introduced me to Lavazza Espresso Super Crema recently and have found it to be an excellent product.  It is Italian roasted and has a wonderfully full aroma and flavor.  It is very close to the Starbucks Italian roast.  Sign up for a scheduled shipment on Amazon and get an even better price.
We LOVE this espresso! The Super Crema is so nice. Great flavor. Great smell. It has made me a bit of an addict!

I'm a newcomer to the world of making my own espresso. I bought my first espresso machine a month ago and have been happy enough with the beans my brother sent me from his favorite specialty cafe in San Francisco. Then I ran out and realized my only choice (that I'm aware of so far) for whole espresso beans (where I live) is McStarbucks. Blech. Unbelievably bitter. So I trusted the reviews here and went out on a limb and ordered the 2.2 pound bag of Super Crema and I have NOT been disappointed! I actually look forward to getting out of my cozy bed so I can enjoy a few demitasse cupfuls of this delicious crema! I hope it stays on the Amazon market  so I always have plenty on hand and don't have to search for another trustworthy brand of everday (for me) espresso.

column9: Great taste, always the perfect crema
column10: I've been using Lavazza Super Crema with my Saeco Idea Go for over a year now. After going through several other brands, I'm glad I found this one here on Amazon. It always works perfectly and I get the same great crema all the time. The taste is exactly the way I like it, and it reminds me of what I've tried at espresso bars across Italy, especially Autogrill. Lavazza is a household name in Italy, and one of the most trusted brands when it comes to coffee. To top it, the Subscribe-and-Save from Amazon makes this coffee a great deal and I don't even need to worry about restocking when I go to the grocery store. I would highly recommend it.

We use this coffee in a fully automatic "Saeco Talea Ring Plus" espresso maker. The coffee is smooth, rich and delivers a very nice crema top. Prior to switching to this brand we would always use 100% kona coffee but started to find the cost being prohibitive. We now occasionally try other coffees in our espresso maker (typically when we are given coffee) and we quickly end up switching back. We make somewhere between 4-6 cups a day and no issues with a fully automatic machine, no issues with gummy beans etc.

Lavazza Super Crema is the best coffee I have ever experienced. I treated myself to an automatic espresso machine for Christmas and did some research on the best beans. Amazon has a competitive price for Lavazza and now I get it delivered monthly for an even better price. Anyway, after trying a variety of beans my first order of Lavazza Super Crema arrived and I was amazed at how smooth it was - almost like hot chocolate - no bitterness. One warning, it takes so good and is so smooth that you can easily become over-caffeinated! Now I have added another Lavazza coffee to my menu, a Decaffeinated Espresso Ground, that comes in 8 oz cans from Amazon.
This is the best espresso we've ever tasted! I liked it so much that I even subscribed on Amazon to receive this product monthly.
coffee was good, just as described, packaged well.  Shipped quickly and was fresh.  i ordered a ton of coffee, so i won't run out any time soon... but will be sure to buy more when i need it!

I live in New York City and while there are a lot of cafe's selling their beans, they can be somewhat expensive and not always convenient to go to.I came across these beans and with the subscribe and save option, it makes sense economically.  Also, having the beans shipped to my doorstep adds convenience.I have a Saeco Aroma machine with a pressurized portafilter.  I am by no means an espresso connoisseur.  These beans do the job.  I make a delicious cappuccino or latte with these beans.

i use an automatic espresso makerJura-Capresso 13214 Impressa Z5 Automatic Coffee Center we have used it everyday since 2008 (except for a while it was being repaired) our favoite bean is super crema... BUT... the quality does vary from bag to bag.... in one out of 7 or 8 bags the coffee can have a cheesy flavor which is why i give it 4 stars... it still beats all the others we have tried...

column9: If you use a Super Automatic this is your coffee!
column10: I didn't give this coffee 5 stars only because I have yet to taste a coffee worthy of 5 stars from me.  I have a superautomatic (mainly because it is convenient) and find this coffee the best for it (not greasy at all).  I have also used illy, but found myself underwhelmed by it considering the cost.  For the price, I believe you would be hard pressed to find a better roast.  I have found that 90% of the people who have stopped by my residence for a cup of espresso or a latte love this coffee.  Enjoy!

I purchased this coffee because the reviews were good, and I was not dissapointed! It is AMAZING! Smooth and creamy with no bitter aftertaste. And it is cheaper than Illy and tastes just as great! Whether I make espresso, coffee or a latte is is perfect!

column9: Not as good as their "Top Class" in my opinion
column10: I love Lavazza, but I think their super crema beans don't have quite as enjoyable a flavor as their "top class" beans - at least when it comes to pulling straight shots of espresso.If you are making lattes or an Americano or something, then I don't think the difference would be noticed. Myself, I think the Top Class beans have slightly more flavor. Crema production seems to be about the same in both cases. I'm using a manual lever machine (an old La Pavoni), so it may not product quite as much crema as a pump machine.The Super Crema is still a good bean, but again, the Top Class seems to edge it out as far as producing a really smooth tasting shot of espresso.

column9: Very good Return on investment coffee
column10: I found this coffee bean by amazon recommend. This coffee is not too mild but not strong. Normally I love the strong coffee but I love this Lavazza's favor. I rate 5 stars for and recommend for the easy afternoon or also the morning coffee.

column9: Flavor has changed...it is now terrible!!
column10: I have been drinking this flavored coffee for over a year. Up until now I have loved it. But the last package I got ( in the new packaging and labeling scheme) is absolutely terrible. The aroma is wrong and the taste is now sickeningly sweet. What used to be a slight hint of vanilla now hits you in the face like a wet glove. The coffee's flavor is absoulutely awful. I am sending it back for a refund immediately. So far the other Gevalia coffees I have are still really good but this one is a disaster after the formula for was apparently changed.

column4: My 2 Cents "A penny for your thoughts"
column9: Good for those with a sweeter tooth
column10: My daughter likes this. It tastes just like anything Swiss Hazelnut should. Still has good strong coffee flavor but seems to need less sugar. Maybe it's just the smell, tricking us but either way I guess less sugar is a good thing. If you like Swiss Hazelnut flavored things you will like this.

I have been drinking Gevalia Swiss Hazelnut for Tassimo for YEARS (at least 5) and have been on a subscription plan for delivery.  Just opened one of the newly packaged products.  Not only has the packaging changed, the product has changed immensely!  It used to be a flavored coffee, pretty much unsweetened, but now it is LOADED with a sugar substitute and tastes positively disgusting. I'm sensitive to sugar substitutes, so a little WARNING about these changes would have been GREATLY appreciated.  I now have several packages of this coffee that will end up in the garbage.  It's been so sad to see the decline of number of products available for Tassimo, but now to see what little they have left starting to change for the worse - I guess it's time to switch to Keurig (as much as I really don't want to).  I have cancelled all further subscriptions for this product.

In the four months that I've had my Tassimo and the many different flavors of coffee that I've tried, this is my 'go-to' coffee. I generally buy this product and one I haven't tried in each order.To be fair, I prefer Hazelnut to most flavors of coffee. I think this rates very high on the list of Hazelnut coffees.

During the time period when ALL the Latte were off the shelf, purchase this item and found that I did not like the taste!! Try putting cream into this coffee, but you would literally need a large volume to taste better.  I guess I am not a connisour of coffees and this product is still on my shelf waiting for me to give it a way.  I like my Latte, so no more trying other brands.

About 1 out of every 3 disks is bad & to my knowledge there is no reasonable recourse? Tassimo will not pay to have the product shipped back if the "original" post office package has been opened? How do you know a product is inferior if you don't open it? Tassimo refused to credit my credit card for unordered merchandise while their website was under revision, refused to pay for unordered return package because the outside envelope had been opened so I could see what was inside, etc. I'm stuck with the coffee maker until it no longer works. Their customer service was argumentative and their responses to my problems were not uniform resulting in serious delays & confusion.

This used to be a fairly decent flavored coffee, but the last batch I bought tasted like someone had dumped half a vat of cheap vanilla extract and half a vat of bad artificial sweetener in it.  Five phone calls to Tassimo "Customer Service" (worst in the world), one phone call to Kraft Customer Service (Tassimo's parent corporation), and on phone call to Gevalia customer service failed to produce an explanation.  Thank goodness I bought the Krapp from Amazon, because one e-mail to Amazon produced a refund.  I would NEVER buy this Swill Hazelnut again, and in fact, I would not have bought the Tassimo machine (which is actually a pretty good one) had I known how bad the customer disservice is.

After experiencing Gevalia coffee, other store bought brands, taste very bitter, acidity is noticeable.  I now gag at the coffees I used to drink every day for years.  Gevalia will spoil ya.  Full body, great flavor, NOT bitter and presents one  with a pleasant after taste.
Hazelnut coffee, I will have to admit , is new to me.  This coffee has the taste of moth balls.  I could not recommend it unless you love that smell.

I got a pack of Gevalia Swiss Hazelnut Coffee with my new Tassimo T-20. Do not buy this coffee. It tastes disgusting. Weak, off smell and taste. It's undrinkable.  It's worse than vending machine coffee. I am seriously disappointed and heartbroken. I was very excited to get a Tassimo and was hoping to drink a cup of hazelnut flavored coffee every morning.

I have tried many of the Tassimo coffees. This one is still my favorite everyday coffee. I don't get tired of it. I like some of the lattes for special occasions, but not for my morning cuppa. This hits the spot for me with a little cream.
I purchased this because I love hazelnut flavored coffee and this is pretty good if you like it with your hazelnut Coffee Mate, not a strong coffee, but reasonably good.

I bought this based on the overall good reviews and I'm very satisfied with the taste. The aroma is terrific. I also add one of these to the Starbucks Premium Cappuccino and two small spoonfuls of sugar to fill my 16 oz travel mug. Excellent.

The flavor of the coffee is just right.  I like how subtle the swiss hazelnut flavor is.  I only had to add a tiny bit of cream.  I really like this one.  I will buy more again in the future.  I am a very big coffee snob.  I can't live without my coffee.  These discs are really good and flavorful.

If you like hazelnut coffee, you have to try this one. The aroma is great..smells like hazelnut with a hint of vanilla! Tried various different t-discs but think I have found my favorite.Medium blend with no burnt aftertaste that other coffee brands have. Give it a try, you wont be disappointed.

This coffee comes in a shallow disc, similar to the Starbucks espresso discs. It smells good while it is dripping but if you watch the coffee as it comes out, about 1/3 of it looks pretty much like water. And what you get is a cup of coffee that still smells good but is very weak on flavor. I don't want to waste it but I need to read the manual again and see if I can stop the process before all that's coming through is water. Then I'd use 2 discs and hopefully get a real cup of hazelnut flavored coffee.

I like the Gevalia better than the Starbucks Caffe Verona my husband first bought me. The Starbucks is way too strong and bitter, in my opinion. However, I'm a "foo-foo" coffee lover, the more fancy the flavor the better. I like the Swiss Hazelnut as a basic coffee; although it's even a bit on the strong side, but not bad. I add the latte creamer or cappacino creamer to it...using a BIG cup.
Great taste, I normally don't like flavored coffee but this one is really good, ordering more soon.

I am a faithful Tassimo fan, and Swiss Hazelnut has become my favorite coffee. The aroma alone is worth it.I am equally ecstatic about Amazon's very intelligent packaging, which I hope will set a trend for traditional retailers as well. Now that I am getting older and crankier, I get very angry when I return home from WalMart or Target, only to find that both my mental and physical health are jeopardized when I try, for example, to open a blister pac of batteries.Thanks, Amazon, for doing what is environmentally right, for making shopping easy, and for avoiding the very real insult to honest consumers embodied in anti-theft packaging that requires our time, effort, and physical well being.
This is my favorite of the Tassimo coffees! Great, full-bodied taste and aroma. The smell makes everyone around me jealous :)

Used to LOVE this product!  I've been drinking it for 2 years but they changed the coffee and now it tastes so bad!! The Hazelnut was our favorite, followed by the Morning Roast.  Both are WATERY and DISGUSTING.  I literally spit it out. STAY AWAY!!
The worst part is that Tassimo Direct does not acknowledge that the product, which used to be my favorite, has been reformulated.

I myself don't like this flavor, but everyone else LOVES it. Since I bought the Tassimo for the convenience of having different varieties of coffee and tea for myself and guests, I always have some in stock. It's also fairly inexpensive.

This product is consistently smooth and great tasting. I would recommend it to anyone who enjoys flavored coffee. The smell waifs out of the coffeemaker (Tassemo) and drifts into the living room. What a way to wake up.
I love this machine and the hazelnut coffee.  It's great and the flavor is very hazelnut.  Will buy this product again.
Now this is my favorite of all the Gevalia brand coffee's - its light and full of the hazelnut flavor but not overpowering.  Would recommend this to all coffee drinkers.  A good buy also.

My first impression isn't as great as I thought based on the reviews.Started to brew my fist disc and I noticed that it poured too much water, resulting in a mix with no consistency, it tasted well enough but felt like a hot juice. It improved a little after adding some milk though.I've got a brand new Bosch brewer so it's not a matter of the machine itself, seems it's programmed that way.I'd rather buy the starbucks blends than this one, specially the Latte Primo. Great creamy texture.

This is the best tasting snow cone syrup we have ever had.  They don't package it very well when they ship it, but so far the bottle hasn't been damaged when received, just the box.  We have went through almost 2 gallons of this so far this summer and I need to get another one ordered.  Would highly recommend this product for it's great flavor and consistent quality!
I didn't like the flavor of this root beer snow cone syrup, it has a bitter flavor.It is a great deal tho so it's too bad it doesn't taste good. :(
After looking around locally for snow cone syrup, I found that this vender was about 1/2 price comparatively. Plus its delicious!

It's very runny and leaves a bitter after taste. I like my snowcones sweet. I guess I'll be dumping this out and going back to the the last syrup I purchased. I thought the large gallon jug would be nice.

column9: just a little bit too hard, should be chewy
column10: this review is for the cinnaman mento's..i  love them, thats all the candy i eat but these were hard instead of chewy like they're supposed to be...other than that the taste was delicious
This is good quality organic soup.  You can add beef or chicken to it and it taste great.  I would buy it again.  The price is good online with free shipping.

These are one of my dogs favorite treats. When they see the package come through the mail, they run around in circles and sit and wait for me to open the package so impatiently while wagging their tails like crazy. It's funny how they know it's for them. They must smell it. I love these. They are just the right size for training and for everyday use!!!!

I loved the flavor and strength of the Green Mountain Breakfast Blend.  Since the fully caffinated Breakfast Blend was not available on Amazon, I shopped for the next best thing.  I thought it would be a great idea to purchase the 1/2 caff, and perhaps I would get the same great flavor, same milder coffee and quality as the regular Green Mountain I was used to (with half the caffine).  WRONG.  Although still a perfectly drinkable coffee, the 1/2 caff seems to be a darker roast and not nearly as mild as the fully caffinated Breakfast Blend. Actually tasted bitter, as compared to it's fully caffinated counterpart. Priced well and free shipping as an Amazon Prime member, so that's a plus. I won't throw it out, but did go right out shopping for the Breakfast Blend I was used to.  This box of Half-Caff will be for "emergency" use for me.
I am trying to decrease my caffeine intake and this coffee is perfect for it...it tastes great and still has a good amount of caffeine but not too much

column9: Green Mountain Half Caff  K Cups
column10: Since we switched our coffee maker to the Krieg K Cup system recently, we have tried almost all the K Cups that are offered and my wife keeps coming back to the Green Mountain Half Caff K Cups.  Its her favorite, so thats what we will keep ordering.  Thanks Amazon, for the great service.

I needed a half-caff coffee to use in my Keurig to get me thru the afternoon (but not keep me up all night).  This coffee does do the job.The only negative is a matter of my own taste.  I MUCH prefer dark roasted coffee, and this is definitely light-to-medium.  Tastes like Denny's coffee.  Just fine, not earth-shattering...My very favorite K-cup coffee is Obsidian (by Caribou) - to get a sense of what I wished it tasted like!

I've been percolating coffee for 30+ years. To me, there is nothing like a percolator for a really good, HOT cup of coffee. However, even though I only drank two cups per day, if I missed my morning java, I would get one of those 'caffeine headaches;' not very pleasant. So, about 10 years ago, I started mixing equal parts of regular and decaffeinated coffee, thus solving my problem; I could still get a little caffeine boost without the withdrawal. Then we got a Keurig at work, and while I really liked the convenience, I didn't want to go back to 100% caffeineated coffee. I tried two different decaf K-Cup flavors and they were terrible. Then I heard about Half-Caff. It's delicious; a perfect blend of caffeine & decaf, and dare I say, just as good as my percolated coffee, which I never imagined. Actually, I have to say its better because of the convenience. In short, because of Half-Caff, I bought a Keurig for my house, and Half-Caff is the only flavor K-Cup I use (I don't like flavored coffee) Highly recommended! Well, gotta go have my coffee now...
This coffee is ok, but I wish they could make a decaf and half caf that had the flavor of regular coffee. It sort of has a slight maple taste to it.

I am very pleased with my purchase of the Green Mountain coffee Half-Caff K- cups. They arrived in a very timely manner and the packaging was excellent. These K-Cups are a great alternative to caffeine free coffee. It has much more flavor, still not as good as regular coffee but now I can drink coffee in the evening and not worry about falling asleep when I go to bed. Great!
Good cup of coffee and less caffeine.finally found one that I like and my guests like as well.The price was also very good.
A good 8oz cup of coffee.  Rich and satisfying with only half the caffine.  An option not particularly easy to find in retail stores.
This is the best way to buy coffee for my office. Least expensive way to buy convenience with harder to find flavor and brand.  I also buy this way for home.
Great coffee!  Love all Green Mountain coffee and all the wonderful flavors.  Would and do recommend this coffee to all my friends.
If you must cut down on caffeine as I did, you will enjoy the wonderful full flavor of Green Mountain Half Cafe
I like this product. Half Caff fixes the dilemma of too much caffeine with great taste. Product came in a timely manner and in excellent condition.
This is a wonderful cup of coffee.  I usually drink my favorite full-bodied blend in the am, but I have a cup of this as a follow up, to get some great flavor but less caffeine.  Love it!
Flavor is fairly good. I got this because sometimes full caf, regular coffee is too much. This works great and I don't get the over-caffinated feeling.  Will definately buy again.

I recently purchased the Caribou k-cups and this coffee came along with it. While I don't like it as well as the Caribou, it's not a bad tasting coffee. It's a very smooth coffee with no bitter aftertaste. And surprisingly I cannot tell that it only has half the caffeine. I usually get a headache if I don't get enough caffeine in the morning. I got no headache or any other side-effects from caffeine withdrawal. I will probably purchase this in the future.

I have no choice but to drink "half caff" since my stomach does not deal well with full caff anymore.  So this is the only half caff product I could find.  Honestly, it tastes very watered down.  I don't like it but have no choice.  It's either this, or no coffee at all.  Please make it stronger.  Thank you.

I normally drink half-caff and am very pleased with it, but after trying a sample of the Tully's French Roast decaf that came in a variety pack, I was truly AMAZED at the flavor.  I anticipated it being bland, not much taste but I was sooo wrong.  The flavor is so rich and robust that a couple times I checked the box to confirm it was actually decaffinated! Although I will continue to drink the half-caf, this product has taken the #1 spot on my coffee list!
Love the half caff k cups. I like the auto delivery plan. This way I never run out of them
This is our Keurig coffee 'go to' blend for most mugs of coffee. That's why we ordered the 50 count box. It's flavor is balanced enough to enjoy hot or over ice.

column9: Hard to find but worth it
column10: I see K-cups everywhere but not these. Found them once a while ago and haven't been able to replenish till now. I love these because although i am a coffee fiend (they did a blood test a while ago and found 90% coffee) I want to have these when I only need one cup and really don't want to be anything more than semi-concious. They are great for people who get the shakes from coffee also. I prefer really brewed pots of coffee but these are a great substitute when I only have time for a cup and really need to get back to sleep in a couple of hours. Great taste, expensive like all K cups but not bad if you only drink a couple of cups. Well worth keeping on hand.
Half caff makes a great cup of coffee at home in our Keurig - it is somewhat expensive for making coffee at home.  The consistency makes it worthwhile.

I will only buy coffe for my Kurig from Amazon.The product is always consistent in quality and taste.  I have bought k-cup coffe through Amazon.  You can not beat the price nor the efficiency in delivery.

Got for my fiance and she loves the taste, and the half calf is much easier for her to handle than a full caff, and it doesn't make her fall back to sleep like the decaf does.Before switching to half caff she was drinking Dark Magic, so if you want so switch to half caff from that, this might be a good one to try.
This coffee is perfect for those that was some decaf and some regular coffee and is popular with friends and a good item to have ready to serve guests

So glad to see this at a decent price at Amazon. Not easy to find Half Caff. I would even buy this in a larger quantity box.  Plus shipping was FREE. What more can you ask for. Green Mountain is my favorite and Amazon makes i happen.
Excellent coffee that provides the best of both worlds! Very smooth, and medium bodied! Great cup of coffee when you only need or want half of the caffeine shot!
I love these little 1/2 caff cups.  Great flavor as I had in my drip machine, shopped around for best price, and am happy with my purchase.

column9: Tastes good and the caffeine content serves a purpose...
column10: I've been drinking this coffee for a few months now and it's not my first choice in terms of taste but it still tastes good and it's helped lower my caffeine intake which is what I am mainly concerned with.  I switched to this coffee after I found out I was pregnant and was told to have no more than 200mg of caffeine a day.  I emailed the company directly at the time and was told that "The relative caffeine content in a 6oz brewed cup of Half Caff is 48-53mg" so it met my needs perfectly! I would recommend this product if you're not looking to give up coffee altogether but still want to reduce your intake.
This is a very good tasting coffee for being half-caf. I like this because I have to watch caffine because of my stomach. I will be ordering more, the taste is very good.
The product was over priced. You can buy it at a number of discount stores at a better price. And they are over priced.If you do the math, it cost over $10 a pound.
Coffee is ok but don't know whether I will reorder or not.  Rather weak but if your machine has the water level setting, I would suggest that you use one of the smaller cups.

We really enjoy Green Mountain coffee and their fair trade practices.  Our coffee of choice in the morning is a half caffeine type and we have found Green Mountain's Half-Caff to be THE BEST.  When you can get free shipping then this really becomes a good deal and well worth trying if you have not yet.  Highly recommend Green Mountain Coffee Half-Caff.

column9: Great Buy and the Price is Right!
column10: we've been devout Folgers coffee drinkers for over 35 years and never thought we'd switch brands. after my husband had a bout of heart problems, he was told to go to decaf coffee or stop drinking it, which wasn't an option. we started buying the Folgers half caff and he cut back to 2 cups a day. when i bought the keurig coffee maker Keurig B70 Platinum Brewing System i switched to the Green Mountain Breakfast Blend Green Mountain Coffee Breakfast Blend, 24-Count K-Cup for Keurig Brewers (love it) and bought the ekobrew refillable k-cup Ekobrew Cup,Refillable K-Cup For Keurig K-Cup Brewers 2-Pack - BROWN $ GREEN for him and his Folgers half-caff.on a whim, i decided to buy a small box of the Green Mountain half-caff k cups for him to try. i was very nervous about it because he's such a die-hard Folgers kind of guy. since i don't care for decaff coffee i didn't want to have to drink it if he didn't like it. he took a couple big drinks of the coffee and i finally asked him how he liked it. he said he liked it a lot, and thought it was much better than the Folgers half-caff, it seemed to have a lot more flavor. phew!in fairness to Folgers half-caff ground coffee, the reason he may think the Green Mountain half-caff has more flavor could be because of how much of the Folgers he used to make a cup. with these refillable k-cups it doesn't seem to be an exact science, so one cup could be a bit stronger or weaker than the next. i think this is what he was saying. because the Green Mountain k-cups are accurately pre-measured, you get the same taste in every cup.the bottom line is, he loves the Green Mountain half-caff coffee, and we will definitely be buying more of it. i asked him if he wanted to try the Folgers half-caff keurig coffee and he said, "ummm, i don't know". for a hard-core coffee drinker to be ok with that kind of change says a lot about the GM half-caff coffee. as least it speaks to me of how great this coffee is.

I have a sensitive stomach and can't take those fire-blasted, carbonized roastings that a lot of coffee has been subjected to, so when I saw a medium roast, I wondered if it would be a true, flavorful medium roast or charred beans with a toasted outside.  I also am trying to cut back on caffeine.  So it seems that this coffee is tailor made for me!I have a cup of this every morning and I love it!  Great flavor, not much acid, clean aftertaste and enough of a jolt to get going without so much caffeine I get the jitters.I'll definitely be ordering this in the 50-pack boxes!
This coffee tastes so good we have completely given up going out for coffee.  Love the ease of the product and Amazons fast shipping with Prime

This is a great tasting coffee.  By the taste alone, it would be difficult, if not impossible to tell that it has only half of the caffeine of their other great tasting coffee.  While in the brewing process, the aroma fills the air leading a person to anticipate the reward at the end of the brewing cycle.  If a person does not want the caffeine, this is the coffee for them.

You actually have me listed as purchasing a different item.  I purchased the 72 count not the 24count, which is a much better deal.  Hope that you offer the larger quantities more often.  Love the half/caff - just enough kick and great tasting.
It's really nice to find a half caff in the k-cups.  This is a nice balance with great flavor would highly recommend.
I have made my husband happy with the Green Mountain Coffee Half-caff. It sure makes my life a whole loteasier!
A very good coffee.  Great taste, great flavor for only having half the caffiene - husband loves.  Keep up the fantastic job of adding new items Amazon!!

column9: Great smooth cofffe, not too much caffeine.
column10: I am not allowed to have too much caffeine as it sets my heart arrythmias off . However, no matter what decaf I tried I hated the taste. I have been using this for a month now, and not only is it fantastic tasting, there are no jitters or no caffeine effects like with pure coffee. This tastes so delicious and I can have several cups in the morning. Also Amazons price cannot be beat.

This is going to be a staple in my house from now on- good flavor, less jitters, makes a great 'anytime' coffee. Decaf can be so uninspiring.I wish they would make flavored half caf....are you listening, Green Mountain..
I am a coffee person and had to cut back on the caff- when I found that the K-Cups had half the Caff I Tried it and it is great. Thank you
I am cutting back on the jitters, so this Half-Caff satisfies with a wonderful robust flavor!Will definitely order again.  Great price at Amazon.com!

Love this coffee, most k-cups are stronger than we are used to having with a regular coffee pot. So this is perfect. Can even get a couple of extra uses out of it for other cups of coffee. Good prices on Amazon for k-cups!
It is hard to find this type of K-cups..  It is very convenient to have these delivered to our door.  Great taste too!
When I want a second cup of coffee I love the half-caff! It's just the right amount of caffeine for me without the jitters.

column9: Less caffeine and still tastes good.
column10: For a while when I first got my Keurig I tried all sorts of K-cups and a lot of them are too strong.  I can handle a kick now and then but for every day the half caff is perfect and doesn't make me as jittery.

column9: Not up to my coffee standards

These "tostada shells" are great for making "cheese crisps" with cheddar cheese and a taco sauce or salsa. Simply heat two tostada sheels in the microwave for about 50 seconds and they come out very crispy. Then add shredded cheese and microwave again for about 20 seconds. Finally, top with sauce and enjoy! You can also use regular taco toppings, starting with either ground beef or rfried beans, for a tasty treat.The tostada shells are substantial enough to hold a lot of toppings without breaking. The shells are rather tough right out of the box, so it is better to microwave them first before adding toppings.

column9: Utterly delicious neat and born to be mixed.
column10: For the record, I'm not a liqueur drinker.  I'm a whiskey drinker who prefers single malt scotch and single barrel bourbon neat, never anywhere near ice and aired for 10 minutes before first sip after well sniffing in a small cylindrical glass.  I was expecting to HATE Red Stag - but it seduced me because it puts the taste of bourbon first.  It smells like bourbon with a hint of cherry pipe tobacco in the glass: notes of popcorn, molasses, tobacco, leather, and cherry.  At first sip the first taste is bourbon: corn, honey, bacon, and molasses.  The mid palate explodes with cherry and tobacco and leather.  It's sweet, but it's oddly sophisticated.  The finish is sweet with honey, cherry, and smoke.It's utterly delicious.  I polished off my glass like a hungry wolf.  The cherry is robust - but tastes real.  It never obscures the bourbon which shines through with character, age, and American cowboy splendor like Johnny Cash's voice.I'm a whiskey snob, but this liqueur is the only whiskey adulteration I've ever loved.  The cherry bourbon alchemy is killer mixed with coke.  It's even better in a modified Manhattan.  I suspect it will work in any mixed drink where bourbon plays a part and you'd consider putting in a cherry.Why only 4 stars?  I love this stuff - but I'm a whiskey purist and this isn't pure whiskey.  By all rights I ought to hate this...  Where's my glass?  I want more...

column9: Not just a side -- Add stuff for a quick main dish!
column10: While I still serve Near East rice pilafs as a side dish, I now fix them for a quick and healthy weeknight meal! For most of them, I cook as directed in my small rice cooker (Cuisinart CRC-400 4-Cup Rice Cooker). Five minutes after I hear the water starting its boil, I add a cup of cut-up cooked protein (leftover chicken, turkey, chickpeas, beans, whatever) and a cup or so of chopped veggies (fresh broccoli, carrots, onions, frozen peas). When the rice cooker light tells me the rice is done, so is everything else! (If you use a long-cooking whole grain pilaf, you will want to add these ingredients later in the rice-cooking cycle to avoid over cooking.) I guess you could also mix the meat and veggies in after cooking them separately, if you prefer. This is enough to serve three adults (unless they are really, really hungry.)I like the Toasted Almond mix so much that I often add nuts myself to the other flavors; the crunch adds interest.You can find recipes at the Near East website for other ideas.

This has always been good stuff.  For some reason I couldn't find it anymore at my local grocers.  Of course, after ordering a case from you every store in town started carrying it.  That was okay - it was nice having backups as this rice goes with everything!

Toast up a whole grain english muffin w/cinnamon and raisins, lite smear of natural peanut butter, spoonful of these delectable preserves, along with 3 ounces of OJ and you've got a perfect breakfast with just the right amount of calories and energy.  PLUS you've got these fabulous jars when ~boo-hoo~ they're empty.  Highly recommend, glad I ordered 5 jars :-)

A little sweeter than I would like,.but they taste very homemade and crazy good!  anyone who loves good preserves,.will love this! Also,.the jar is huge!

Have reviewed this product before.  Know going in that if you like your coffee strong, that you will have to use more than they recommend, but having said that and having tried other brands, these guy make the thickest concentrate out there...no question.  To be sure, like anything, it can get old, so my gal and I like to change it up...but we come back to this stuff more and more.  From using just as an enhancer by adding some to the morning pot of our standard brew, to iced frappacinos, to straight up hot...this stuff really satisfies.  Shipping is not cheap if you are far from New Orleans like I am because this stuff does need to be kept cold and so they insist on 2 day shipping, but I would rather it arrive fresh.  Highly recommend.
