Iams dog biscuits are the only ones I give my dog as they are flavorful, crunchy, balanced nutrition and in addition to all that they  make my Lab smile !  She prefers the small size though she is NOT a small size.  She gets two since they are small and thinks she is getting more that way. (Sneaky Mom)  You can't beat Amazons price.

column4: ROBERT W. ARGERSINGER "honey and sweeties friend"
column10: Just a Note to tell everyone that the  4 LB.Variety comes in BOXES ..NOT BAGS!! I have used these since I got my two French Bulldogs [5 Years] ....they Love them and they are very Healthy because of them ...this, according to my Vet!! Walmart Stopped carrying them, so I went over to Amazon where I do Most of my Buying anyway...I am never let Down by Amazon .....Good Luck with these Biscuits...your Dogs will Love them ...and Stay Healthy while Eating them...

column9: My dog likes these tiny treat biscuits!
column10: My order from Amazon arrived very quickly.My lab mix, medium-sized dog has trouble with large treats. These were tiny.When they arrived, I took one out and he sniffed at it very cautiously, then tried it. It passed his nose test and his mouth test.We're happy.EDITED to say that he has changed his mind. Now he prefers one size larger, but he still likes these.

Up until recently I have had 4 dogs. Sadly, one passed away from old age this past July. Anyway, all four of my dogs love these Iams biscuits. My finickiest dog never turns them down although she has turned down other brands of biscuits. The only thing that puzzles me is that the biscuits are now thinner than they used to be. They must still taste the same since my dogs still gobble them up. I had brought up this inconsistency to an Iams rep at a dog show about a year ago. His only answer was that they had 2 manufacturing companies and one must be making them thinner than the other company. I would think that their standards on this would be fairly strict so that the 2 companies would be manufacturing identical products, but apparently not. Oh well, it's not really a problem as long as my dogs remain elated with them, and since they are sold by weight there's nothing sneaky going on as far as I can tell. I love that I can order a pack of 6 on Amazon.com. Many times the stores do not have that many, so the 6-pack is really convenient since my dogs go through these pretty quickly.

column9: Dogs love them, a lot of treats!
column10: I have 2 dogs, one is a small chihuahua and one is an older sheltie. The small dog eats these things like crazy, loves them. The older dog has few teeth left (she was abused and we rescued her). A lot of treats we buy are to hard for her to eat but these are the right texture and hardness. She can chew them up and she loves them as well. Perfect for giving to the dogs after they use the bathroom.The value is great. I didn't really think about how many boxes 6 of these were but the deal is that much better when you actually see how many treats you have. It's an amazing amount and I'm set with treats for a few months at least!Great deal, I will be placing a new order when I start running low.... But that will be a long time!!I uploaded a picture so you can see how much the little dog loves these thing!

I have been giving my dog these treats since she has been a puppy.  She loves them and were great rewards for her training.  Best of all, they have kept her teeth and gums clean and free of plaque.  I recommend them to all dog owners.  Buying them from Amazon on a recurring basis has been a lifesaver.  These treats do not last long on store shelves so finding them locally has been difficult.  Thanks Amazon for solving my source problem!
this item is a good buy,  they are nice and fresh and the dogs love them.  This is a good product for the money spent.
Great deal, fast shipping.  Saved a lot buying these biscuits through Amazon - These biscuits are four dollars more a box at Pets Smart and other pet stores.

column9: Great Way to Buy a Great Product: Subscribe Today!
column10: I live in an isolated town, and you cannot purchase Iams dog biscuits within a four hour radius.  Unfortunately, Iams small biscuits are all my parents' spoiled dogs will eat for a snack.  Like another reviewer's dog, these dogs will not eat large biscuits, even though one is a Great Dane and the other is a lab mix.When I found the monthly subscription on Amazon and found they were slightly cheaper than in the stores (where I can no longer buy them; thank you, over-sized "super" stores that carry fewer and fewer products since you feel the consumer is at your mercy), I immediately ordered them.  They arrived a week later with free shipping.The packaging was neat and tight; very few biscuits were broken in the opened box.  They were also very fresh.  The expiration date was June 15, 2012.  Traditionally, the ones I've purchased in stores were only good for six months or less.  I subscribed for two six packs a month, and it's very satisfying to know I don't have to worry about my mother haranguing me to drive to Mississippi to pick up dog biscuits.  They come to the PO box once a month: No fuss, no muss, no bother.  And the dogs are infinitely happier. :)

If your pooch is pampered, this is the way to go.  All the Wal-Mart stores quit stocking these and so did Target so I had to start looking around to find a better value.  This is it.  They arrived quickly and sre actually boxes, not bags.  It's a good product at a great price.

This is an amazing amount of dog treats that will last a LONG time!!! What a great price!! These are the bones i give my dog after i let her out to use the bathroom and she comes back in. i have other treats for random times so this will last forever. i couldnt be happier!!

I don't know why, but lately I've had trouble finding these IAMS dog biscuits in the local grocery stores.  Since my German Shepherd loves them, I searched Amazon and found this Pack of 6 deal.  Rudy is happy.  His teeth are staying clean and all is good!
My dogs love them.  And they help keep their teeth clean.  BUT they do contain wheat to which one of my dogs is allergic.
Our dog is allergic to wheat.  It is difficult to find gluten free products in the pet stores.  These are great and my dog loves them.

My dog absolutely loves these treats, and the price on these was nearly 1/2 the price I pay at the pet or grocery store!!! Plus I don't have to worry about running out for quite a while, or shall I say my dog does not have to worry!!
I have a mini-schnauzer that cannot have over 10% fat or it will make him very sick. These treats show the maximum fat content to be under that range and he loves them.

These "treats" are hard to find in local stores.  They are the perfect size if your dog, like ours, thinks there should be multiple "treat-ops" during a day.  I also love the automatic shipment feature.It's just one more reason I love shopping with Amazon.
As a Hungarian, I have enjoyed these for years. Not quite as good as what you get in Budapest but still good.

The box of cigars is certainly festive and appropriate for a work environment, especially if smoking is frowned on.  The bubblegum cigars are very hard though, more of a keepsake than to actually chew.

column9: Best in nutrition & taste despite the Snickers brand
column10: I am hoping this will be included in the Amazon Prime selection soon because as a frequent protein- and nutrition-bar consumer, this one is the best I've found so far.I also like Odwalla Super Protein, Kashi Protein Roll bars, and Atkins Nutrition bars, but they are all 190-250 calories which I find a bit too high in calories for an afternoon or mid-morning snack.This Marathon Nutrition (different from Marathon Energy) bars comes in two flavors, almond nut crunch and dark chocolate, and the dark chocolate flavor is excellent and true to the description.  It has no discernible metallic/chalky aftertaste that many of the fortified bars have (although this includes a good range of vitamins and minerals too), and contains the following macronutrients:Calories: 150Protein: 11gCarb: 22g with 7g fiber and 9g sugarFat: 4.5g150 is just right for me, and 11 grams of protein with that calories profile is EXCELLENT.  Most of all, it's delicious.The only drawback that I can see in these bars is the relative unavailability in markets (I think it's still new), and its non-organic ingredients.  Overall, excellent, healthy product from a candy brand.
I'd rather have one of these than a candy bar. For the overall taste and nutrition (calories, protein, and fiber), I think these are the best on the market.

column9: Who would have thought Snicker & good nutrition would ever been associated .
column10: High protein, high fiber and low fat is not what I think of when I think of Snickers, but the Snicker's Marathon Nutrition bar has 10 grams of protein, 7 grams of fiber, 14 or 15 grams of sugar and only 4 grams of fat ... amazing.  This is the best balance of major nutrients found on any of the snack bars I have found.

These bars had very good reviews so I tried them. I don't like the fact that they taste like viamins.The bars expire soon also, as though they were close to expiration when I ordered them. Very disappointed.

column9: Snickers Dark Chocolate and Multi-Grain Energy Bars
column10: Twice now I've purchased Snickers products from Amazon:  Snickers Dark Chocolate and Multi-grain crunch Energy bars, and twice I received boxes whose expiration date was less than one month away and the bars tasted old!!!!  Hard to return food, so we just kept them, but if you are discounting a product because it is about to expire, then say so, so I order one box and not 3 by the expiration date! I even ordered some for my elderly parent in another state and was embarrassed to learn from her that she too received 2 boxes that were about to expire.

These were wonderful. I want to order more, but I live in the south.The only problem I had was there needed to be more dry ice packedin the box. By the time I got the box, the dry ice was not cold andthe bars had started to melt. Had to wait a day to let them hardenback up.

This is a satisfying low-calorie, high nutrition bar at a good price (although I've seen it cheaper in supermarkets when they have it in stock).  I'm using it as a meal replacement in an ultra-low calorie "Optifast-type" diet and it gets me through the three hours until the next meal very well. It has a tasty chocolate flavor and is a normal size for a candy bar (not one of those bite-sized low-cal bars). Congratulations to Snickers for making a low-calorie nutrition bar that tastes good.

I agree. This is the best bar for satisfaction/taste and calories. I too wish this bar would become available as part of the subscribe and save program. Currently I can buy it cheaper at my grocery store!

Its Good real Good!I like the taste. but that is to each of their own. I may like it you may have a different option on that.Amazon say its a energy bar, but I believe this is more of a Nutrition Bar.The Bar itself was not too hard or too soft.It wasn't too big but smaller sizing than to my liking.Its a great Bar Get IT!

There are delicious and filling. Full of protien and fiber along with a healthy dose of calcium and vitamins, this is a daily nutrition bar for me. Like already stated, these bars do not have any chalky or "health" bar taste or texture. They are crunchy and really satisy my candy bar cravings.

This is a terrific tasting energy bar. And it has REAL chocolate, not some fake chocolate flavoring. A bit high on the sugar ocntent, but probably helps give the energy boost. I like this much better than Power Bars.

column9: Energy Bar Has Never Tasted This Great!
column10: Snickers Marathon Long-Lasting Energy bar promises to give gym enthusiasts long lasting energy which is rarely found in most chocolate bars. It is typical to find lots of carbohydrates and fats in these chocolate bars, especially for Mars chocolate products, but long lasting energy? Isn't this just a fad?I have enjoyed Snicker products ever since I was a child. Guess Filipinos are patrons of most US products, especially their chocolates. I have accustomed my taste bud with the rich chocolate contents and satisfying chewiness these Snicker bars provide. I eat during examinations because a friend of mine informed me that chocolates are good brain boosters.However, the new challenge Snickers placed on their shoulder is to provide us with long lasting energy bars. I must admit that it gave me additional energy boost during stressful office hours but to say that it is long lasting is not acceptable.Gene Eden VIR 101 offers long lasting energy booster even if this is not the primary task of these all natural supplement. It is designed to shield the body from viral infection thus helping the body gain more energy for his or her daily activities.Mars may have exaggerated a bit in stating that its Snicker Long Lasting Energy Bar provides LONG lasting energy to its patrons. It would be enough to say that it gives extra-energy to those who will enjoy munching these tasty chocolates in between their gym work-outs.

I received this starter in short order. It came complete with directions. I just followed the directions and it worked fine. About the fourth day this starter actually had a kind of honey like smell to it. The starter even smelled good.Along with the starter was a recipe to make real artisan bread.Again, I just followed the recipe and the bread came out really good.It really looks and tastes like true artisan bread.Thank you so much for this starter!

I have been experimenting with baking my own bread, and have come to find out it is as much an art as a science.  I have gotten some starters from acquaintances, but did not like the taste.  I found this one online and decided to give it a try.  It worked great and tasted great.  Just like the package said, I added water and flour, and it was ready to use in a week.  I have the back up in the freezer, but am hoping to make this one last.

Depending upon how much you like M&Ms, will determine how much you like this product.  If you are crazy about M&Ms and the candy shelled coating, but don't want an overwhelming coconut flavoring, this product will probably meet your expectations.  It is just enough that you can taste it.  I was expecting a bit more coconut.  Certainly not to the point of a Mounds or Almond Joy, but something a bit stronger.  My coworkers who are not that sensitive to coconut flavoring, couldn't taste it at all.  They were "blinded" in that I did not tell them they were coconut M&Ms before I gave it to them. When I asked them if they could tell what flavor it was, most could not.
Picked up a box of these after I found the PB 'n J M&Ms that I was searching for. I like these too. So happy I discovered them.

We bought these to go along with the island themed party we were having.  What a hit!  The hint of coconut is addictive.  Most people ate all the M&Ms and were looking for more...should have bought more than 2 cases...

I am not able to get this flavor in any of the stores close to my home, so I stocked up with the 24 pack. I should really be giving this item 1 star, because it has completely broken my will-power. It is soooo good!

Ok folks, this is not a joke.  I am a real fan of hot sauce, hot peppers and anything that makes my eyes water, and I have to honestly say that Dave's Insanity Sauce is absolutely the hottest thing I've ever tasted.  I use one drop in about 25 ounces of home-made tomato sauce and it makes the sauce noticibly hot.  This is NOT a sauce to dash into your soup or to liven up some salsa.  DON'T USE IT LIKE TABASCO!!!  It is a heavy-duty hot sauce that should be used as in ingredient when cooking a decent amount of a dish.  My brother doubted its powers so I poked the end of a toothpick into the sauce and gave it to him.  The poor guy freaked and ate more Italian bread than I've ever seen anyone eat in my life.  This bottle will last you a long time.  Why doesn't it get 5 stars?  It's just too hot.

Come on, read the label. One of the manufacturer's suggested uses is removal of driveway oil stains.For the last five years or so, I have always had a bottle of this sauce on hand specifically for those friends who swear nothing is ever too hot. The ultimate gratification comes from watching as they disregard any admonishments that direct consumption of any amount greater than a swab on a toothpick is too much. It is particularly helpful to quiet those who cannot refrain from talking over movies or provide undesired running commentary during sports events. Invariably, for next hour their only objective is to regain the ability to breathe normally. The only downside is this ploy only works once.I like to mix about an 1/8 of a teaspoon with two ounces of regular hot sauce for buffalo wings, or add a dab to any taco sauce, however care is required because you can easily reach a point of diminishing returns as the unavoidable numbing of one's tastebuds makes enjoyment of the food impossible.

The first time I had Dave's Insanity* sauce, I was at a restaurant. The waitress had sensibly warned me about its intensity and suggested I put just a dot of it on my plate to test it out. "Hah!" I thought, "Maybe some of your typical hot sauce wussy customers can't handle it, but I'm made of stronger stuff" and I proceeded to pour a ketchup sized pile on my plate. It was not until I coated half a french fry with it and stuck it in my mouth that I learned the folly of my ways. I began to sweat and blush as my vision started to get blurry. There was not enough water in the world to cool the inferno blazing in my mouth. Such is the way of this sauce. Heed my warning as I should have heeded hers.It probably isn't the hottest on the market, but it's the hottest I could find. It heats up anything with the tiniest of drops, which means the 5 oz bottles lasts a good while (about a year to a year and a half for me, but I add it to almost everything). I was not a fan of the semi vinegary taste at first, but have grown to like it. This sauce is thicker then most, which I prefer to the more watery ones. Definitely worth trying if you like super spicy sauce, but if that isn't your thing, stay away.As a final warning, try not to get any of it on your skin. This stuff burns!*It should be noted that this sauce neither contains nor creates insanity. This is a clear example of false advertising, and I have written Dave many times regarding this issue. He has yet to write a reply.

column9: Perfect for when you want some serious heat
column10: There are times when I want something with kick but don't want the harsh taste of a lot of other hot sauces and this is perfect. As others have mentioned, be very careful of how much you add to your food as it has a serious kick. I also like to add this to other hot sauces to kick them up a notch. For example, this is great to add to Franks hot sauce.
Definitely hot, very flavorful.  If you're able to handle the taste of habanero's and enjoy that heat, this is for you.

i have been making my own hot sauces a couple years now, and ive always heard all these reviews about daves insanity, so i was happy to get a chance to try it to see what it REALLY is all about. ill compare it to my sauce , which is nothing but habanero peppers cooked with vinegar and salt and pureed in a food processor. daves sauce dosent attack your tongue right away,like my sauce does, first you taste the tomato/spice flavor, and a strong cayenne pepper type flavor, then it heats up slowly until it is a little hotter than my sauce. this is what i like about it.. the fact that it builds in heat and the warmth lasts a good amount of time.. what i dont like is it lacks that fresh pepper taste, and the fast bite that my sauce has. to be honest as far as taste goes, ive never tasted a hot sauce that had a better flavor than cholula.. too bad its too mild for me

column9: Great sauce!! but treat it with respect..
column10: I came across this sauce about five years ago. A Thai friend had brought it over and claimed it was one of the hottest things he's ever tried.. I told him that being a Latino guy, I was used to dealing with hot stuff, (Habaneros being my favorite because of bite and taste)I followed his advise and used a toothpick to put a tiny dot on a chicken wing... and it did the job well!! I came across this sauce again at a Ross store and bought a couple (which by the way, lasted for a long, long time).I was very impressed with how hot this sauce was that I went out of my way to put little DOT "Hazardous Material" and "Flammable Liquid" placards on it... specially after I found my roomate bent over the sink, making hissing sounds and practically scrubbing his tongue in an attempt to stop the burn, he had treated this sauce and if it was your common Taco Bell sauce... big mistake. Unless you like scratching bathroom walls, treat this sauce with respect! For beginners (or anyone without "hot sauce scar tissue") use a toothpick to test your limits and move up little by litte. It's not meant to add flavor to your food but to add bite to it. Try a small drop in your ranch sauce, you'll love it! try a drop in anything in the pot, from pastas to stews to chili, (be careful with soups, the heat multiplies). I now have about 2 oz. left in my bottle and have been scanning the shelves at Ross, hoping to find a bottle for under $3 but so far, it looks like I might have to place and order online..

"Dave's Insanity Sauce" is not to be taken casually or even as a way to add heat to individual servings, this is meant for larger dishes such as a whole pot of chili or a big batch of salsa since one or two drops will make a large amount of food VERY hot. That being said, this does have a really good flavor that adds a nice pepper tangy hit that complements most Mexican or South-Western dishes, but I wouldn't use it in Indian or Chinese style dishes. There are hotter sauces available, but this one is a good balance of flavor and heat.There are several amusing and somewhat painful to watch videos of people abusing this sauce on various web sites and a quick search will provide you with a lot of hits.Highly Recommended!CFH

column9: Dave's Homamade Colonoscopy In A Bottle
column10: This is my favorite hot sauce. It's the hottest stuff I've ever tasted. It's great with a little BBQ sauce on wings.

I was pointed to this stuff by a friend that told me it was hot and I would like it.Let me tell you now, your out of your mind if you think your going to use this to spice up some normal food.Only use this EXTREMELY sparingly in chili or to make Hot wing sauce.Two penny sized drops in your chili will make it the hottest thing you have EVER ate in your life.Think of eating a Habanero pepper, that's down right hot, this stuff makes a Habanero pepper seem like a pickle.For a good joke, drop a dab of this in your buddy's chew and watch him come unglued.
Excellent quaity of sauce. Great flavor, great afterburn. I only wish shipping was cheaper.

column9: If it doesnt make your eyes sweat, its not hot enuf!
column10: That is my husbands' view; he's the one who eats habanero peppers like they're radishes!!- he love's this sauce; he adds it to his own salsa blends to make them hot enough to melt your tonsils... he has quite a following for his home-made sauces.  When he can't get fresh habeneros he uses Dave's to turn up the heat.

having experimented with several hot sauces over several years including pyro diablo and snakebite habanero extract i can confidently say that this is the tastiest and hottest sauce i have ever used.  my only regret is that it is that it is nearly impossible to apply in small enough quantities leaving my eyes bleeding after every use.  perfect 5

column4: Marc Tomko "Absence of evidence is not eviden...
column9: Hot, but the flavor is lacking.
column10: This sauce tastes like brown bread mixed with barbecue sauce and vinegar. Sorry if that doesn't sound appetizing, but thats what it is. It's hot (oh man, is it hot) but I just cant find a good food to pair it with.The sauce is so thick that it's nearly impossible to get it out of the bottle, and by the time you get it out, it comes out so fast that you're praying for the future of your [...].I have it, and I like it because its hot, but I don't use it. It's been used maybe once or twice in the past few months. I have hotter sauces that I use more frequently because they taste better.Buy it though, its the original!

I have used only two bottles of this sauce over a period of years. I enjoy hot sauce on my food but this one can only be used on large quantities. I use it mostly with chili. One small drop,not dash,in a big bowl will have tears flowing from your eyes! If you like it hot! This is the sauce for you.
Please read the warnings!! This is NOT stuff to fool with!! Feed it to your pet or unknowing kids and I will hunt you down.
Its great if you mix a few drops with your pasta or in your burrito just to get a kick. Do not attempt to pour directly and eat -- can cause some pain. Be advised. Don't be a jackass.

I have used Dave's insane sauce in my favorite recipes for the past ten years and I would highly recommend it.  Be warned, this sauce is too hot for use at the table and is best applied sparingly during the food preparation process.

column9: For the serious chili head only!
column10: Dave's Original Insanity sauce is one of those sauces on the "must try" list that has avoided my radar for some time. However, tonight I managed to score a bottle and almost couldn't wait to get it home and opened.The obligatory side bar warnings included "not for use by persons with respiratory or heart problems" HAHAHAHAHA! Wait, for real? OK, so now my interest was completely piqued. I tore off the shrink wrap and shook it really well as I could see the labeled "pepper extract" floating into the neck of the bottle.I grabbed a Doritos hint of lime chip and poured a puddle about the size of a quarter (no fear) and in the hatch it went. The flavor of this sauce is good; smoky and rich with a dark undertone which is typical of high end sauces. There was a slight bitter flavor that also accompanies other extract added sauces. But the warm rich overtones mostly covered the thin vein of bitter. This sauce is a slow burner. There was no ghost pepper 'kicks your face like a mule right out of the gate' burn, but it started building about 30 seconds in and kept billowing up like someone shoveling coal into an already stoked furnace.This sauce is hot. Not hot in your ordinary stinging, tingly, brings up a little bead or two of sweat. No, more like throwing back a shot of molten lead, followed by a hot battery acid chaser kind of hot. I was really impressed with Dave's ability to make my face pound with every heartbeat and then for my tongue to wilt and go to sleep in protest. Despite my well earned capsaicin tolerance I have to admit I drooled a little bit as my mouth was not responding to mental commands. This sauce can easily stand tall against Blair's Mega Death (with liquid rage) and Red Ghost. The pain is searing and lasting and the subsequent endorphin rush awesome! I highly recommend it. Seriously. But please... don't come back all snappy and say, "what, you pu$$y... that sauce was nothing." Because I will know you are a poser... yeah fosho. Put on your big boy pants and give it a good try... and let the tears of happiness flow.

column9: I don't know whether to give this 1 star or 5
column10: This is the HOTTEST hot sauce I've EVER had. Nothing is ever hot enough for me and this is WAY TOO HOT. I ate a quarter sized bit in my tomato soup and now I think I'm going to have a heart attack and die. D: Goodbye cruel world.

Well, what its says is true. One drop is enough. It seasons a whole plate quite nicely. At my school were big on hot sauce... Sriracha is common place and almost overused. So when we first got this one drop was enough and scary for many. But we are starting to get accustomed to it and can add a little more. Keep the bottle clean. If any sauce gets on it and you touch it it can burn. But we like it. Good taste and heat.

Yes, I'm a chilehead. I not only grew my own peppers (jalapeno, habanero, and the hottest-at-its-time red savina) back in the mid-'90s but also made it a point to sample lots of hot sauces. I have a huge collection of hot sauces instead of liquor behind the home bar.Dave's Gourmet Insanity Sauce was the first ultra-hot sauce I've tried. What's interesting about this sauce is that it uses capsaicin extract in an oil base. This adds a lot of fury to an already fiery coarse and thick mix of tabasco and habanero peppers with a hint of smokiness within a tomato base. But you know you're into something brutal when you shake the bottle and witness the changing of the dark red contents to a fiery orange.The heat of this sauce creeps up on you. At first you begin delving into the already hot and slightly-smoky tastes and textures of the base. Then the extracts hit and lock onto your tongue. It's a very persistent burn that wiped that smug grin off of my face as I looked for the nearest glass of iced milk. And just when you think it's over, depending upon how much you consumed you may feel a wicked afterburn when you go and relieve the other end of your gastrointestinal tract.Dave's Gourmet Insanity Sauce is legendary. Even the label is worth a read. If you really want to test yourself or your friends you can't go wrong with this just for the burn.

This is a nice hot sauce, as everyone is saying it IS hot.  Don't attempt to be macho and eat too much of it on your selected dish, you will be rewarded handsomely if you do.  Come to think of it, I think this could be the subject of Johnny Cash's "Ring of Fire" song.I normally put a small amt in a bowl of chili and the heat is enough to make you sweat.  Sometimes, when I walk by the fridge I will grab a toothpick and drop it in and pull it across my tongue just to get the heat between meals.If you like things hot, you can't lose with Dave's Insanity Sauces.

My first experience with this hot sauce involved watching my college roommate lick the foil lining within the cap of a newly opened bottle. Five minutes later, sitting on the couch with his eyes closed and sweat all over his face, he proceeded to sit completely still for the next 45 minutes before the intense heat finally subsided enough for him to mutter a feeble "Holy $#%*"Sadly, this process was repeated the next morning. But instead of sitting on the couch, he was sitting on the bowl. And instead of silence, sounds that can only otherwise be heard during an exorcism were coming through the bathroom door. Once he had emerged, me and my other roomates stared at him curiously as he uttered these words of wisdom- "We must freeze our toilet paper if we are to ever eat this sauce again"Truer words have never been spoken, folks. As the rest of my roomates and I had our own experiences with Insanity Sauce, the cool, cool relief of an ice cold roll of toilet paper on a burning backside the morning after consuming this sauce, felt like there couldn't possibly be anything better in the world at that point in time. We thanked our roommate for his words of wisdom, and from that point forward, we always had a roll "chilling" in the freezer for subsequent MAD (Morning After Dave's) trips to the bathroom.I should probably add that there isn't much in the flavor department here, but nothing is better for kicking up the heat in anything you are cooking. A must have for 21 year old males everywhere

I ordered this for my dad, as he's used it to make beef jerkey for years.  He ran out over a year ago, and hasn't been able to find it anywhere locally so he was experimenting with other sauces.  Nothing was the same or even comparable to Dave's.  I found it on Amazon for a very decent price and surprised him with it.  He was soooo excited!!  Word of caution though, please read and follow the warning on the bottle.  It is VERY VERY hot.  When it says to start with one drop, seriously, start with one.  This little bottle will last a very long time.  Product shipped very quickly and arrived in excellent condition.  Thank you!

OK, I love hot sauce and spicy food. My chili can strip paint and clean engine parts. But this stuff is ridiculous.First time I saw it, I sniffed the bottle, thought "not bad", then put a drop the size of a BB on my finger and tasted it. I literally couldn't get my breath, and my tongue was sort of numb for a while. About 1/2 teaspoon to a pot of chili is about right, but do NOT under any circumstances put this stuff directly on food like you would with most hot sauce.

I first bought this about 15 years ago in a spice store, and it is exactly as the name implies. If you like hot sauce, this has to be in your fridge. It may be to strong to use in a large quantity, but it really adds a kick when added to other spices. I've probably tried 2 dozen "hot" sauces that were purchased at a grocery store, none are close to as good, or as hot as Dave's Insanity.

i think i know what childbirth feels like now that i've had this sauce. it was not unbearable in my mouth but what it did to my stomach - the pain was a crampy, burning pulse that i couldn't do anything about. tums, milk, bread, nothing helped. a solid hour of complete and utter misery.
Had this a couple years ago and it is still just as hot as I remember.  Follow the directions and use one drop at a time.
Great hot sauce, but only for those that like heat. Great on almost anything. I don't usually mix in foods, I eat it a drop or 2 at a time on chips. If you like heat....BUY THIS PRODUCT!!!

I bought this cos Jeremy Clarkson of Top Gear said it was hot and I thought he was being wussy. He's not. It's so hot I actually had palpitations when I accidentally added 4 drops to a big pot full of spag bol sauce.

I love hot foods and sauces and this one lives up to it. I use it in everything and have found I like about 3-4 drops in my foods for the heat, which is way too much for anyone else in my household. However, the only negative, if it even counts, is that too much of the sauce will alter food taste. The heat is fine but there is distinguishable taste that this sauce has and it can overbear the taste of your dish if you use too much. I have learned my dosage for foods so it works perfect for me.

I'm into hot foods - meaning habenaro and thai chilies are something I can easily eat without a bat of an eyelid. On our recent visit to San Antonio riverwalk mall I came across this brand and asked the lady which one is the hottest and she handed this over to me saying this is not the hottest of them all. And what better way to taste a hot sauce but to use Chicken wings. And Oh My God - first bite into the wing and my tongue started burning. I slowed down and ate all the wings and boy it was so tasty. So if you can sustain incredible heat this is for you. Be VERY CAUTIOUS.

when i was in the eighth grade i had a math tutor who thought he was a real hard nose. i taught him a life lesson. knowing that his big ego would hurt him, during a session i asked him if he liked hot stuff. "oh yeah", he said, "i love hot stuff!" so i reached for the bottle of dave's insanity sauce my pep-pep gave me. sure enough, my dumbass teacher stuck his whole finger in the bottle and took a big lick.now, back in the day, when i wanted to let people know how serious this stuff was i would dab a little on one prong of a fork and watch them go crazy, so i could only imagine what this guy was about to go through.he kept it in for about ten seconds. "thats pretty hot" he said coolly. within two seconds he bolted to the sink, where he stood with his mouth open under the running faucet for about five minutes. when he finally came back, looked at me and said "that was the hottest thing i ever tasted".you think you like hot stuff? dave's insanity sauce will humble you.

"Dave's Insanity Sauce" is not to be taken casually or even as a way to add heat to individual servings, this is meant for larger dishes such as a whole pot of chili or a big batch of salsa since one or two drops will make a large amount of food VERY hot. That being said, this does have a really good flavor that adds a nice pepper tangy hit that complements most Mexican or South-Western dishes, but I wouldn't use it in Indian or Chinese style dishes.There are several amusing and somewhat painful to watch videos of people abusing this sauce on various web sites and a quick search will provide you with a lot of hits.Highly Recommended!CFH

The label of this product says it all... THIS IS INSANELY HOT!I remember the first time I tried Dave's, a friend received a bottle for christmas and decided to feed it to us as a joke.  But it wasn't a joke, I almost cried.  The strange thing about Dave's though, is that once you try it and get past the first feelings of inadequacy (YOU CAN't HANDLE THE SAUCE!) you want to go back for round two.  Which is exactly why I bought this product... I craved it.  Maybe that's the insane part?I put this on everything I can, sandwiches, tacos, quesodillas, salads, beans and even now I am eating it on Mac & Cheese.I do recommend this product, with caution.

I put like five drops on a hot dog and had 2 of them.  It was hot I admit.  But it isn't that unbearable to me.  I thought it has a great flavor and not too bad.  I actually think this crushed habanero I have is hotter.Good stuff!!  Looking forward to trying Ghost pepper

This stuff is HOT!!!  I was given a bottle quite some time ago and use it often. While I still have some of the original bottle, I found it was available on Amazon and ordered more.  WARNING...a little goes a very long way.  I suggest you carefully add this to whatever your are cooking.  Start off with about 1/8 tsp. (a large drop) for a recipie and go from there.  I love spicy foods but this stuff is LETHAL!!!!!

For most purposes, I'm happy with Frank's Red Hot, Tabasco, or Cholula hot sauces.  But, if I'm really feeling the need for something hot AND tasty, I'll grab Dave's.  Careful though, a little bit goes a LONG way...  putting too much on will leave you uncomfortable for a good half hour.

I got my hot sauce just in time for christmas and i got free samples along with it which is great for i am always interested in trying new things. the hot sauce itself is exactly as i remember it hot!!!!! i got it as a gag gift for my dad who is obsessed with hot stuff.
this stuff is amazing. i used it in chili and it made the taste even better. i only put a cap of it into a 12 quart cooker and it was very hot. highly recommend.
I bought this for a hot sauce aficionado and friend in Costa Rica and the comment was "this is the hottest thing on Earth"

I bought a bottle of Dave's Original Insanity Hot Sauce after reading reviews that said "Use with caution", "feed your sadistic side", etc.All i can say is: this sauce is definitely NOT hot enough.  i used up 1/4 of the bottle within 24 hours of its arrival on a plate of fries and rice (it's only mildly hotter than habanero tabasco which itself is like tomato ketchup).  I've had much hotter stuff here in Asia.If you claim that you can take hot sauce or are a chilli-head and say that something like this is too hot even for you, you really have no idea what true chilli-heat is because this sauce is really nowhere near as hot as what many claim it to be.  The taste of vinegar comes through a lot more than the heat or any other flavour.  And no, there was absolutely no burn coming out the toilet end as well.Bottom line:  this sauce has only a mild 5/10 heatkick rating by my personal standard. 2 slices of raw chilli-padi rolled around the tongue for 10 seconds is still hotter than this.  Total disappointment!

This review is for the Special Reserce Dave's that is sold in a wooden casket. Way hotter than plain ol' Daves. I too had a near-death experience with Daves. A friend gave me an original bottle of Daves XXX years ago. He always said, "this is the hottest sauce out there". None of the sauses were hot. Without reading the label I downed a heaping teaspoon of the sauce. If I would have read the label I would have seen that it said it could be used as a driveway cleaner. Swallowing it without even touching my lips. It was weird. I didn't feel a thing. About 5 minutes I ran into the bedroom layed down and started doing puppy breaths as if I were giving birth to a demon. My stomach swelled-up like I actually had something living in there trying to get out. My wife came in the room and thought I was going into a coma. She kept on asking, "....what is wrong?". All I could mutter out was, "....bread, bread". I had to scream it so she would take me seriously, although it was difficult because I could barely exhale. It took a while before I exited the bedroom. I was pale. For some reason my son thought he should try it. He wasn't there when I went through my exorcism. He took a half a teaspoon and right from the get go started screaming like a banshee while holding his ears. That year he gave me a signed edition bottle in a casket. It was even more hot the the previous bottle. The bottle lasted for years. My youngest son even took it to school for a cultures class, saying it was part of our culture. When kids tried it they were running around the halls looking for water. Security was called and my son was taken into a room and questioned about the substance. He said, "...it is hot sauce". The security guy said, "...I've never seen hot sauce that does that, now tell me what it is". Dave's sauce has a mythological history in our family.I didn't care for the flavor that much. Melinda's XXX sauce has a great taste and they use habaneros and carrots. Muy delicioso. I am looking forward to trying Dave's Ghost Chili. If I survive that test I will write about it. If you do use Dave's just add a drop or two into your chili or popcorn oil. When you put it into the oil, though, be forewarned - everybody in the house will be coughing! If you want to get a good laugh, have a person shake the bottle before they try it. Let them get how much they want. Trick is, when shaking, they inevitably will get a little something-something onto their fingers. It won't take long before they scratch their nose, rub their eyes or, God forbid, use the restroom.

Well I just had this for the first time tonight. I used it to dip tater tots in and no it wasn't diluted or watered down. It came straight from the bottle. What I noticed first is the hiccups then the searing heat which was most welcomed. I grew up eating anything and everything as hot as you could get it and I have to say so far this is the hottest hot sauce I have had. Real close to eating ghost peppers fresh. For those who said this was too hot, is it ever really too hot? Seriously.

Ok heres the deal.  1 pea-sized drop will have ur mouth burning for about a half hour.  It's an "extract" sauce, it says it in the ingredients.  Which means the Capsaicin (the "Hot" compound) has been refined over and over again to produce the extreme heat.  It might be considered cheating, and I'm thinking this is probably what caused it to be kicked out of the National Fiery foods Contest.  The 1 problem here is that if your looking for flavor, you cant get enough of it because you can only use a little portion.  It's great to spice up weaker sauces.  Use it as an additive.  It will last a long time.  Bottle states it needs refrigeration after opening.

Most of these reviews read like items from 'The Vaults of Erowid' chronicling some outrageous psychonautic trip they have experienced.  Well, I can only concur and say that things will never be quite the same after ingesting a drop or three of thissublime elixir.Novices should be in no doubt of its potency: after all it does say on the bottle-- 'also strips wax floors and cleans grease from driveways'.

This stuff is the BEST if you love spicy and hot things as much as I do, then this is the stuff for you. I am making more and more meals with this sauce. However, I will warn anyone who is going to buy this because I was putting about 5-8 drops on everything I was eating for about 3 days and for the next week my stomach was in pain. With the amount of sauce I put in my food my eyes would water with every bite, my face was bright red, and I was sweating. So if you want to experience some great and insane hot sauce the I would recommend this. My next purchase of Dave's Insanity Sauce will be the Ghost Pepper sauce.

Okay, so I've read a lot of the reviews posted here on Amazon and it sure seems many claim this as a "cooking additive" or to use sparingly. I however find this to be a great hot sauce, but not to the point where you are at any jeopardy should you use this as an actual hot sauce on day to day food either. I myself live for hot sauce so have probably developed a tolerance of some sort. This sauce is indeed HOT. If you are not a consistent hot sauce user of hotter variety then this will be most likely hot for you. But if you are like me and order the hottest wings or the spiciest dishes or enjoy true hot flavor then this will most likely be a 7 out of 10 on the hot scale. I myself use this on single serving everyday meals as I would Tobasco. IE; Sandwiches, pastas, burritos, soups, anything you would normally add sauce too. Sure I cook with it too, but it can be used as a regular hot sauce. Yes, you should use a couple drops until you develop a tolerance. At this point I go through about a bottle a week, I use it that much several times a day. Hell I even have a video on youtube eating 2 tablespoons straight of the stuff...again its hot but not as bad as some people make it out to be!  See it for yourself go to youtube and search "Dave's Insanity Bitch Slap".
Just what I needed.Half a teaspoon of this baby in a medium-sized pot of stew and whoala.Just the right amount of spicy!

Nothing seemed hot enough for my husband until he tried Insanity.  He loves it.  All our friends bring him hot sauces that they thing are hot, but, nothing makes him happy like insanity. He puts it on almost everything.

Really Amazon, are all your stomachs this weak?? I wanted go get a good hot sauce and after reading the reviews here how this stuff will practically set your mouth on fire I eagerly ordered it. Maybe it's just me but when I tried just a drop of this sauce as reccomended, yes it was hot, and somewhat painful all around my tongue, lips and throat, but certainly tolerable. Ii feel I can casually put this stuff in my food.  then took about a teaspoon and put it on my tongue, i could feel my whole face sweating and my tongue burning. Drinking water didn't help. But the burning feeling goes away in less than a minute and you can start eating the sauce again. The taste itself is not very good but luckily i intend to use it really as an ingredient. If you think this is the hottest thing in the universe I feel sorry for you in a way because I'm sure there are hotter things out there.

I tried this sauce for the first time in SC a few months ago because my cousin Steven was talking about it. I rolled a couple of toothpicks in it and put it straight on my tongue to try it out and I was dipping my tacos and chips in it. I have had spicier.  I am from SoCal and that is normal for a lot of the mexican places I eat at. The only thing the sauce did was make my face sweat a little... As far as the burn in my mouth it was no hotter than the fried peppers you can pick up at any authentic mexican restaurant out here. I probably had the equivalent of a teaspoon in less than a half hour. I did not have to drink anything after it. The taste was okay. The only reason why I put it on my food was because it was the only spicy sauce in the house. It is a potent sauce... a little goes a long way but I was sorely disappointed by heat of it... maybe because it was because of all the hype.

When I first received the hot sauce I thought it would be dramatically spicy, but for my case it wasn't. I like the taste of it, but I've had spicier hot sauces before. I would recommend it for any hot sauce lovers.

column9: Has a kick - but far from insanity
column10: I enjoyed this hot sauce.  It does have a kick to it (not a burn your mouth/throat kick - more like a low&slow burn).  I found the flavor to be great & will use this liberally to make hot wings (my 14 year old son & his friends loved it also).  If you really want an extreme burn with good flavor try the after burner sauce from a company called Son-in-law out of Michigan.

First of all, this hot sauce doesn't have any flavor. I thought it would be a bit sour, but no. Its tastes like eating a flaming fart which brings me to the point about smell...IT KILLS YOUR NOSE.Thats all I have to say, but one more thing... It burned through the cap and overflowed into the fridge. k bai

We were at California Tortilla, and I saw this stuff.  So I got some and put a few drops on a pretty big burrito, and started to eat it.  Before I ate any, I got something around my eye and pushed it off, and my skin literally started to BURN.  It took a good 20 minutes of dabbing for it to stop burning, but that was my fault.Then I started to eat my burrito, and was fine for a few bits.  Then it suddenly hit me.  My throat was actually CONSTRICTED if I stopped drinking.  It took about 6 rootbeers, a bag of chips, some queso, and a granola bar to stop it from making me choking.  It was awful, and it ruined a $ 6 . 50 burrito.

This sauce isn't that good for someone who really likes things hot.  I eat Naga Jolokia sauce on a daily basis and this doesn't quite reach the same heat level and the taste is really bad in comparison.  I'm not a fan of the extract flavor and I suggest trying a Naga Jolokia sauce if eating on an individual meal.  I haven't tried this in a pot of food so maybe in that sense it works well but that's not what I use it for.

My one and only experience with this hot sauce was during a roadtrip to the coast.  I had packed my special blend of homemade Bloody Mary fixin's to enjoy in our Hotel.  Unfortunately,  this time I included "Dave's Insanity Sauce" which I had unwittingly bought for my husband who likes it hot.  Once we hit our room I made two potent Mary's & not knowing what to expect barely dipped toothpick in  Insanity Sauce & swirled it into my  cocktail.Immediately  upon my 1st sip FLAMES began shooting though my left ear "CARTOON STYLE"...It hurt so bad I thought I was going to have to go to E.R. Nearly ruined my entire weekend... On our last day in Monterey we found this little shop called Slow Burn (alas no longer open) which was packed to the brim with hot sauces from all over.. I would say there were at least 10 different bottles to sample. To my delight some actually had distinct flavor rather than just hotness and pain. My favorite was a little bottle that had a sombrero for a cap, (not sure the name) but yum! The owner explained to me why the Insanity Sauce caused me such pain. He thought it might be sugar that caused the heat to stick.  They're not all like that. I don't see sugar listed in the ingredients listed here though...

Well, I guess I'm the fly in this reviewer ointment, but Dave's is the only hotsauce that I won't buy. It has a synthetic quality to it and a flavor that is almost non-existent. This is due to its being made directly from capsaicin extract as opposed to actual peppers. It offers a nuclear level of heat that seems to be a recipe for ulcers in my opinion. According to Wikipedia, its Scoville heat (fire) index rates out 50,000 units which can be contrasted with Tobasco's 2,500 to 5,000 rating. Who needs that much heat? Not me or most human beings. This stuff is lethal. No thanks.

I put 2 drops into 3 scrambled eggs and mixed it up well. I took one bite and spit it out within 5 seconds and this junk burned the heck out of me.I'm not Mr. Hot Food but I do like spicy food. This stuff may not be poison but it isn't food in my opinion. What kind of people make a dopey product like this? There is a mild warning and a caution to use a drop at a time but that warning is inadequate.It was about 10 minutes of legitimate suffering that was completely unnecessary.Don't buy this junk!

column9: A healthy hot beverage that tastes great
column10: I specifically searched for a green tea that contained ginseng and Amazon led me to this one, which I purchased.  The package contains three tins with 20 bags in each, each containing a generous 5 grams of the blend.  It isn't simply green tea with ginseng; it also includes Gen Mai Cha (whatever that is...) and lemongrass.  The combo tastes great and it is smooth.  In fact, I prefer the taste over plain green tea.But the main reason I purchased it is to obtain fodder to brew up a "Healthy" hot drink for us men with Type "O" blood.  According to the health gurus, both green tea and ginseng are almost "Medicinal" for us types.  Well, time will tell on that claim, but what is immediately clear to me is that this tea goes down smoothly and gives me no detrimental side effects like my prior hot beverage, coffee, did.  Apparently, the Gen Mai Cha and the Lemongrass produce nothing noticeably detrimental, at least in the short-term.My only complaint about this tea is that it comes in bags.  I prefer loose tea, but I can, and do, live with using bags for all the other teas our household purchases.All in all, I am very pleased with the purchase.  Try it for yourself, especially if you have type "O" blood.  You may like it as much as I do.

I ordered this product during a promotional sale. I'm a fan of green tea and organic groceries, so I thought I'd give this tea a shot. While it was different from what I was expecting, I ended up being very happy with this tea.The product's description lists it as "Green With Ginseng Tea". However, it is a blend of Chinese green tea, Gen Mai Cha, lemongrass, and ginseng. This combination makes it taste distinctly different from traditional green tea (the lemongrass really adds something different), which threw me for a surprise. However, I enjoyed the blend even thought it was not what I was expecting.The product comes in small tins, making it ideal for travel. I brought some with me on a trip to Southeast Asia, which came in very handy for when I did not have access to quality teas and coffees.Overall, I'm happy with the taste and quality of this product. Just don't expect a traditional green tea flavor.

the add for this candy states it is hot and spicy, it is not. i purchase the candy because i wanted a spicy candy. this is the only time i have been unhappy with a purchase from amazom. you can buy better cinnamon buttons from walmart for $1.00 a pound.

Jake and Amos products are produced in the Amish farmlands of Pennsylvania and sold in the local farmer's markets there.  If you're lucky enough to live close by, you can sample these wonderful products.  If not, I recommend you try them here.  Their apple butter is so creamy and full of real apple flavor, I've never tried better.  It's fat free too.  They also sell a no sugar added variety.  Not only does it make a healthier spread for bread, it's also great on pancakes or waffles, and I've even used it as a condiment for pork chops and roasts.

I was very disappointed in the taste of the coffee. It did not taste like pumpkin coffee at all. It smelled more like French Vanilla and the spices were all off. I threw out 75% of the bag. What a waste of 5 lbs. of coffee!

When I first started to buy VitaGravy, my dogs loved it. After a few weeks, they don't seem to care too much for it anymore. They still get it in their kibble every day, and will eventually eat it when they are hungry, but they don't consider it to be a treat anymore. I still buy it because of its beneficial nutritional value and decent price compared to a pill vitamin supplement. One big negative I have noticed about it is that their face is getting dirty from it. They are white dogs and this product tends to cause increased tear and around-the-mouth stains. I used to buy all different flavors of VitaGravy, buy my groomer told me the chicken flavor is best as the beef and pork based flavors can cause an even worse increase in face staining.

column9: My dogs gobble up anything covered in this.
column10: I have two very picky eaters and they love this gravy on their dry food. When we run out they have trouble touching their food. But with Vita Gravy they eat every last bite. I love that it adds some extra nutrition and isn't like fatty or unhealthy table scraps. I only wish it came in bigger containers.

column9: Should get No stars - it's terrible
column10: Couldn't get my dog to go near this stuff. Gave it to a friend who's dog eats anything and everything.... except this product!

These are perfect treats to reward your dog's good behavior or to entice your dog's good behavior! They are perfect little bite size "flowers," made with quality ingredients here in the U.S.A.  They are fairly low in calories (7 cal. per biscuit) and low in fat.  I was concerned that my 80 lb. Bouvier wouldn't want a fruit treat or know she had this little biscuit in her mouth but she loves them! She even prefers them to the liver treats I was giving her.  Overall, a nice crunchy treat!
If you want a treat get a peanut butter Bobo Bar.  I reserve this flavor for special occasions.  It reminds me of a peanut butter cookie.

column9: Stones, hard sticks, plastic pieces inside
column10: I bought this from Walmart because it was the least expensive catnip they had.  Mixed in the catnip, especially at the bottom, were small stones, really hard sticks, and small pieces of clear plastic (looked like sandwich baggie plastic). I immediately stopped using it and am in the process of contacting the company. It reads that it is grown and processed in China. Could all these be in there because they have little regulations there? Hartz, shame on you!

column9: Ever see a cat not like catnip?
column10: I have a number of cats and none of them like hartz catnip. It comes from China, perhaps thats the reason.

When we got our German Shepherd his parents were being fed this food and he was getting the puppy version of it.  After doing a little research I've found that this is a good quality dog food.  And it's specifically engineered for German Shepherds which have notoriously sensitive stomachs. I've tried other foods and with this one my dogs coat looks a lot healthier and he has more energy. It also lasts longer than a #40 bag of the cheap dog food since he doesn't have to eat as much to get full. I used to get this food at Petsmart but I have to drive 40 min either east or west from where I live to get to a Petsmart so I found it to be incredibly convenient to be able to order on Amazon. I still buy it at Petsmart but I don't have to make special trip just for dog food anymore. And with Amazon Prime I can get it shipped for free and it only cost about $3 more than at Petsmart but it cost more than that in gas to drive there. I've bought this here several times and will continue to buy it here since it's so convenient.

So I walk in the door with this new bag of food. Arnold looks at me and telepathically says, "Damnit, a new bag of food. Can't you just stick with the purple bag I like?"I say, "Arnold, see this? This bag was made for German shepherds like you. Surely this must be better."Arnold crop dusts me with a fart and walks away.Later when he is hungry, I open the bag and give him his serving (4 cups twice a day for this massive fatty dog). Arnold gives it a whiff. "Hrmm, smells good. I don't trust it."He nibbles, and then takes a mouthful, and then the hoover vacuum in his stomach switches on and literally 3 seconds later it's all gone.I think he likes it. The End.

I've been through the research and unending label-checking to find a dog food that I was content feeding them, only to find out that my picky eater would turn her nose up at the food.  The other couldn't care less and literally inhales his food.  I went through all the varieties of Nutro, which is a well-balanced food with plenty of whole-meat proteins and whole grains, but all she would eat was enough to stave off hunger.  When I finally decided that I could drop another $10 per bag, I tried Royal Canin and both of my dogs love it.  The ingredients are high quality, the dogs eat it enthusiastically and the size of the kibble is large enough that my "Inhaler" chews his food thoroughly before he tries swallowing. It's expensive, but the bag lasts us two weeks with two big dogs eating 5 cups per day.  So, about $30 per week, $4 a day or $2 per dog per day.  I'm okay with that.

Our GSD is about two years old and has a very fragile digestive system (as many GSD). After trying the best in holistic food for dogs and spent a lot of money we decided to give Royal Canin a try. We were not convinced because it is not a brand highly recommended by various dog food web sites but it was still a reasonable brand. After about 8 months of using Royal Canin for GSD our dog is in perfect health. She has gained weight, she eats with appetite and obviously with pleasure.  We decided to stick with this brand.

column9: My shepherd and husky love this
column10: I have both a very large black German Shepherd male and a sweet Husky female who are both doing very well and enjoying this dog food. We tried Newman's, which worked for awhile (at the time, it was a big relief for a tedious journey), but this seems to be doing the trick: no more itchy dry skin for Bud and it agrees with Molly's food sensitivities as well. I can definitely recommend this dog food!
The food we usually feed our dog (a grain free product) wasn't available through amazon so I tried this and our dog took to it right away. Happy dog, happy family!

My dad was feeding my German shepherd the cheapest bag of dog food from costco for the past 2 years.  I brought my dog to the Vet  and the vet was appalled with the condition that my dog was in.  His skin was red/pink all over, and his coat lacked luster.  I switched to this food because my vet recommended it, and it was the best switch!  My 4 year old german shepherd eats slower because the kibble is much bigger and is shaped like an X.  His coat has shine, and did not have any issues with digestive problems, like we had when we switched foods.  Royal Canin is a little pricey, but worth the price for a healthy pet.
My GSD will eat almost any food.  However, many do not agree with him, making him ill for days. He loves this food and it leaves him feeling fit and ready for fun.  Very well prepared product.
dog loves it - euro german shep female 71 lbsgets down to it twice a dayvery convenient not having to go to store and lug this bag around.

I have owned German Shepherds for almost twenty years.  I love their intelligence and loyalty, but have been dismayed with the delicate nature of their digestive system.  I was so pleased to discover Royal Canin, and amazed that they make breed specific dog foods!  I have had both piggers (who wolf down their food) and pickers (who have to be tempted into eating).  I love the fact that the kibble is shaped like little crosses which helps slow down the piggers while it tastes good enough to tempt the appetite of the pickers.  I have been using Royal Canin for about ten years now and have been extremely happy with it.  But once in a while I wonder if there is something better so I go to the dog food rating websites out there on the internet.  Be careful - I have noticed that quite a few of them do not accurately reflect the ingredients listed on the German Shepherd 24 bag (or the Royal Canin website).  I don't think I will be switching dog foods any time soon! :)

I have been using Royal Canin for 8+ years.  I specifically use the German Shepherd version from Royal Canin.  The food is made in large star Chunks so my dog won't woof it down as Shepherds are susceptible to bloat. My Girl never has the runs and her stools are not huge masses (smaller fecal matter means less fillers).  Her coat is healthy and she gets A+++ at the vet every time she gets checked.  It is a little expensive but worth it.  I believe it is a good investment in my dogs health.  Sincerely, Gretchen's Mom

Great idea that a company actually created a dog food made for a particular breed. I think that's genius. Why feed your pet dog food that every dog breed eats? This dog food actually takes into account the make-up of your dog breed and what he/she needs to be strong. Our German Shepherd was a picky eater and then our breeder said to try Royal Canin. It was a hit and he now enjoys eating. I would highly recommend the Royal Canin line of foods for your dog.

The delivery time was next day it seemed but was short 3 days and the product is the best, no damage no complaints here, didn't have to park and walt to petco and spend 1 hour of my time buying it and I save money also.

I tried integrating this into my German Shepherd puppy's food.  He is currently on California Natural Lamb and Rice puppy formula, but I have a hard time finding it - so I thought I would switch to this Royal Canin.  He loved it.  But then he started getting diarrhea.  The diarrhea may have been from something he ate in the yard and not the Royal Canin.  Regardless, I donated the Royal Canin to a dog shelter.  This is after I read reviews on it, and discovered it has some bad reviews.  It has lots of fillers in it.  I prefer a more natural, healthier dog food (this is my opinion after what I've read).  There are good websites to compare pet foods and read professional reviews on them.

My favorite is the red corn, while my wife likes the yellow.  All three varieties taste great and have great texture.  However, I am not sure if it is totally worth the higher price compared to popcorn you would buy in the store.  The only other complaint I have is that the kernels are smaller than traditional kernels you'd buy at the store, so they tend to blow out of the air popper unpopped more than other kernels.
The popcorn trio was shipped quickly. The popcorn is fresh. This is also My second purchase of this product, and I will buy it again! :)

column9: good combo and surprisingly fluffy and delicious
column10: I love popcorn and have tried different varieties from store bought to gourmet.  This popcorn is light, fluffy, crunchy, and surprisingly delicious.  I love that it has a 3 different kinds of flavors (crimson red, buttery yellow, and corn sky blue).  It also comes in nice reusable containers so that you can use them to store other things such as lentils, beans, rice, or more popcorn.  Another plus is that these are GMO and trans fat free popping corn! A tip, when using a stove top or popcorn machine, don't put as oil and your popcorn will be light, fluffy, and crunchy.
we tried to pop this popcorn and it took forever to pop and tasted terrible.  we will be throwing it all away.

having the variety was nice and the kids loved the colors but it wasnt great. the texture was chewy and there is a lot of kernels getting stuck in your teeth compared to others. It was ok tasting tho and always fun to try something new in the hot air popper.

Well, bought this for my dad for his birthday since he loves popcorn. These though, no where near as good as I had hoped. Lots of hulls and old maids. Adding butter makes them even less crisp even though they aren't very crisp once popped. Sticks in my teeth too. Sorry, not buying again.

The most watery and tasteless pinot noir on the planet.Cali tools must be brain dead to give this a 90 rating,obviously shill rated.With all the bargain priced euro wines out there you would have to be pretty stupid to fall for this shill rated drainpour.

I'm a huge fan of Eden Foods products and always purchase their products regularly.  I found these noodles at Whole Foods one day and ever since have been hooked!  I love these noodles!  They make a mean vegetable stir fry.  They do not get mushy, and stay a great consistency, as long as you don't cook them for too long.  They are my favorite noodles to buy, and from a trustworthy company.  Glad to see Amazon carries them now, because they are expensive.

column9: Cheese and Garlic - Flavorful and Tasty
column10: My wife is in love with this cheesy garlicky spread. I am the garlic lover and she is not, which baffles me a bit. I love the smell of the stinky rose as they call it, when I cook or when it is fried that comes with some peanuts. It is a very tasty and I would say, although not an expert on cheese, that it is on the side of the gourmet. What I don't like about it is its crumbly texture. Instead of spreading smoothly on bread or cracker, it crumbles apart. In the box, the product is nicely wrapped in a classy aluminum foil.  Make sure to shop around for price.
8 Bottles of juice in the grocery store would be $20 why would I pay $94.66 there has to be a mistake made in the price or the number of bottles sold.

I've made my own Hollandaise for many years based on several recipes I was able to garner from some of the 5 star restaurant's chefs, and they were all palate pleasers. I decided to try a bottled one in order to save the time it takes to make it at home. After reading the 1st and only review for this product (which was a 5 star...I think the customer might have been trying to get someone else sucked into buying it!), I decided to try it. I purchased 4 jars. BIG mistake! This is the WORST TASTING Hollandaise I could ever imagine! Tried it at room temp, then tried heating it to see if the bitter taste would go away but to no avail. This stuff is horrible! The only nice thing about the product is the shape of the jar. I'm going to make a huge batch of my own home made Hollandaise and store it in the jars. Thought about giving the three unopened jars away, but I don't have any enemies I hate THAT much! I poured their contents down the toilet (hope it doesn't ruin my sewage system!) and thoroughly washed the bottles for my own use.If you're looking to have a great Hollandaise sauce at home, I highly recommend you MAKE it at home!

This is a really fine hollandaise that keeps indefinitely in the fridge after being opened, or on the shelf before opening.  It's just the ticket for a quick Eggs Benedict.  The maker's Bearnaise is not always available, but to turn this into a creamy Bearnaise, all you have to do is microwave some tarragon in a tablespoon of butter, then stir in the Hollandaise.I have been buying this product at Whole Foods for years, but I was thrilled to find it on Amazon, which saves me a longish drive.  This is a dream product that lets the home cook prepare some really special dishes, and I recommend it highly.

This pasta sauce is like marinara sauce with a generous dose of Tobasco sauce added, perhaps even hotter.  I love spicy food, so I don't mind it, but be aware of that before you serve it to your unsuspecting guests who might even nod along when you asked them if they like their food a little spicy.In other words, it's more suitable for Cinco de Mayo (Day of the Dead) fiesta than Thanksgiving dinner.In our family, we put mussels and other seafood into the sauce and the combination is excellent.  Maybe it'll work as marinate for chicken wings, and then BBQ on a grill, or bake them in the sauce in an oven.  I guess I should try those out.
Yes, the sauce is spicy as it is an Arrabiata but it is really homemade, restaurant quality. It is just so yummy! What's also great is that it can even make whole wheat pasta taste good!
This is my favorite pre-prepared marinara sauce.  I love it's spicy zing.  Good job, Mario.
This flavor is very smooth.  I enjoy it even more with a mix of diet orange.  Tastes like those orange sherbert and vanilla ice cream bars.

column4: TW Brown, Author, Editor, and Reviewer "Todd ...
column10: A pleasant surprise came when we tried the diet version of the SodaStream Cream Soda flavor. It has an even better flavor, less like caramel and more like actual cream soda. Also mixes well with the diet flavors of the "fruit" variety for a creamsicle taste!

column9: I didn't like it, but a friend did.
column10: I was hoping for something that tasted similar to A&W diet cream soda...  This was not even close.  Not sure what it tastes like, but I didn't like it.I haven't liked all the Sodastream flavors I've tried, but this is the first I actually DISLIKED.A friend of mine tried it (the same attempt) and she did like it, so... it takes all kinds. :)

I purchased this product along with several other syrups. I have to say, out of all of them I found this one to be the most unimpressive. It tastes way too sweet and does not taste like cream soda. I took a sip then dumped the rest. Aside from the orange soda, the flavors offered by Sodastream are not very tasty at all.

column9: The only place I could find Diet Cream Soda
column10: Well there's not a whole lot I can say about it. If you like Cream Soda and drink diet soda in general, you'll love this.  If you don't like either, you'll hate it. I purchased this to make orange cream soda and it was perfect.  Have to Oder more orange and cream soda

I enjoy my Sodastream machine and have purchased many of the diet flavors. The only one I don't like is the Diet Cream- it is undrinkable. My wife and I both both agreed on what to do with it - down the drain.  We both enjoy cream soda, but not this one. This is the WORST diet cream soda I have ever tasted in my life. Ever. And I've been drinking diet cream soda for as long as I can remember. This tastes like an awful, awful, awful chemical concoction. I have to just throw it out, what a waste of money. column9: Great Flavor, Strong vanilla covers any possible aftertaste
column10: This is great on its own, but I like to mix this with the diet orange syrup or the diet cola syrup.

These two happen to be the worst tasting of the bunch, with the diet cream soda being so bad it's in a class of its own.  Tasted like perfume or gasoline or something. Knock-off brands at Walmart or Aldi taste better.I'm so disappointed.
I have tried every diet SodaStrem flavor, and this is the absolute worst. It is WAYYYYYY too sweet. Tastes more like frosting than cream soda. Virtually undrinkable.

This is an amazing finishing salt. Big, bold smoke flavors. I've also used it as a brining salt with some liquid smoke, seasonings, and the usual brining liquids. Tastes like it was cooked in a smoker and, since I live in a highrise, that's a nice alternative.

column9: Another great tea from Earth Mama Angel Baby
column10: I love Earth Mama Angel Baby teas.  They have a chart on their boxes telling you if they're safe for nursing and/or expecting mothers.  This tea tastes delicious and it's organic which is another plus.  I drink this whenever I just want to calm down or am not feeling well.  It's supposed to be for Monthly Comfort, but it tastes so good I drink it all of the time.

column9: Could not live without this tea!
column10: I literally could not live without the Monthly Comfort tea. A friend recommended it to me for "the time of the month" and I tried it skeptically - especially as I am not a mother, a soon to be mother, or motherly at all. I start drinking at least a cup of this three to four days before my cycle, and find that most of the monthly annoyance of being a woman subsides. What was a week of unpleasantness, with two days of insomnia because the pain is so bad has no turned into a day or two max of light cramps, with no bloating either.To me it tastes like cinnamon and ginger, with raspberry undertones. It tastes delicious enough that I often have it all month long, not just on my cycle. It's especially pleasant on a chilly morning.I buy this in bulk now, because running out is simply not an option!

I've battled horrific periods for years, especially after the birth of my second child.  I wish I would have known about this many years ago!  This tea is absolutely fantastic.  I typically have issues with gaining upwards of 10 lbs of water weight during my menstrual cycle - not this time.  Cramping is significantly reduced, water weight is non-existent, even my husband commented on my much improved monthly demeanor.The tea is easy to make, though I would certainly recommend steeping for a solid 15 minutes for best results.  I drink two cups of this tea each day (morning and afternoon) starting a few days before my cycle and all the way through.  I do not normally enjoy tea, but I have to say, this is delicious.  I didn't even need to add sugar or other sweetener to mask the taste.I have used most of the Earth Mama tea products, and have been impressed by the high quality, delicious flavors, and natural remedies for my ails.  I highly recommend giving this product a try.
It smells like raspberry and cinnamon and is not too strong. It is great on cold nights to help warm you up.

When we got our Keurig coffee-maker, I was excited to try new coffees.  Most are way too strong for me.  I do like flavor, but way too often the K-cups are more bold than I like. column9: Excellent flavor, no after taste, smooth
column10: I cannot abide plain coffee so I've been sampling all the flavored coffees for our new Keurig machine. Some have just been too strong for me, too bitter, or too chemically tasting. I got some locally in a store and couldn't find it again, so I tried Amazon.com and found it.  The product is great for cheese and crackers appetizers.
