I've been really impressed with this grain-free cat food.  It is fullof nutrients, and my two rescue kittens love it.  I mix it with about aTablespoon of GNC Pets Ultra Mega Premium Milk Replacer for Kittenswhich is readily available either at Petsmart or from gnc.com.  Mykittens went from being rail-thin to nice and fat on this stuff.  Highlyrecommended!

I switch my cats food from time to time because I read reviews on other brands. Right now my cats have little if any problems with this brand. I imagine all cats throw up, but some brands seem to increase this behavior. Wellness seems to be stable and my cats are lively and playful.

This is a high guality food that a friend of mine advised me to try. It is a little on the expensive side, but my cat seems to love it. I usually mix it with a little warm water and make it into a paste. The only thing holding it back is you need a can opener.

column9: The only cat food my cat eats and loves
column10: My picky eater cat is getting older and rejects plenty of other cat foods. She loves this one and has less shedding because of the ingredients in this food.
Wellness food is the best cat food to keep your cat healthy.  My cats love this flavor but any flavor would be a healthy choice for your cat.
Cats are liking this flavor. Cans arrived dented so 4 stars instead of 5. Wellness is a healthy food to feed.

My cat absolutely loves this flavor. Normally, I have to coax her to finish her food, but when I give her a serving of Chicken & Herring, the bowl is clean in like five minutes. I do not understand why some of the other reviewers blamed the company for selling them bad cans--their cats probably just prefer another flavor. I say experiment to see what your cat will eat, and stay away from cat food with grains in it!

She LOVES this food.  Licks her bowl clean.  I think it's a very quality product. Canned food was recommended for her by our veterinarian (who only sees cats). . . who said it's closer to what they would "naturally" eat.  It makes me wonder if Wellness should consider "Mouse" flavor along with Turkey and Salmon!

I have two cats, one under 1 year old and the other is 4 years old. After researching about proper cat diets, I realized that they needed a good grain-free meaty canned food. Wellness fit the bill. The younger cat ate up the chicken flavor instantly and loved it! The older cat however, refused to eat it at first. She was used to eating dry kibbles and occasionally canned fancy feast. She kept refusing to eat the Wellness and I caved in and let her finish the bag of kibbles. Only when we didn't have any other food than the canned wellness did she approach it. So once she was good and hungry, and the younger cat was in another room, she crept out and started eating it!! Now she loves it and eats the chicken flavor with no problem. I haven't tried out the other flavors, but since I had such a hard time getting her to come around to eating it in the first place, I've been feeding them both the chicken flavor exclusively. If your cat won't eat Wellness, be patient and get rid of their previous food so when they get hungry they only have one choice. Mixing the old food with the new one wasn't as successful as just waiting it out. Their coats are super shiny and they are both at a healthy weight on a wellness diet.

My two kitties differ on many of their food preferences, and we are also mindful of their health and so we try to limit their fish intake.  So, we are grateful that we found the wellness turkey recipe.  It's something that they both absolutely love and something that we feel good about feeding them.

I would truly recommend this brand to anyone with a cat. My cat had a ton of problems - from vomitting to diarrhea and really smelly poop. Not only did this solve all those issues, but he now has the most silkiest, softest, shiniest fur. The quantity of food intake has also decreased. No more begging for food every 5 minutes. Another bonus - my cat now has a lean and toned body that I'm envious of.This product will save you a lot of trips to the vet!!!

column9: best cat food in the world!!!!
column10: My cat was very sick with kidney problems and she had little chance of making it.I tried every kidney food out there and remembered my daughter had a sick cat that liked wellness. My cats love it. Alli would not be alive today with out it.It is very creamy and full of moisture and very easy to eat. Thank You wellness!!!!!I purchased it very reasonable on Amazon with free shipping.

Did some googling on kitten nutrition and found that the food I was feeding my kitten did not have very high water content and that she was supposed to be eating a meat based food (grain is no good for cats).  This food seemed to match well with what google told me, and I've been feeding her this wet food for 2 months now.  She seems to like the food and she looks great.  She seemed pretty healthy before as well, but there was a noticeable difference after I switched her food.  Her coat is shinier and softer, she's more energetic, and has been maintaining a good weight.  I wish it wasn't so expensive, but I think its worth the price and I will keep buying it.

Wellness is a great cat food that my kitties just love. I chose this brand for its natural ingredients. Two of my cats have issues - one with diabetes and one with obesity. I needed a cat food that is grain free (for the fat kitty) and low carb (for the diabetic kitty). If you need a cat food that is not loaded with byproduct garbage, then Wellness is a great choice.

I ordered the Wellness Turkey to create a rotation for our kitten with Felidae grain-free formula. Until tonight he had only eaten Felidae, but when I opened a can of Wellness he went crazy for it! This will definitely be a part of our food rotation. Very high-quality food, mostly protein from excellent meat sources.

column9: Better than most canned food but still BAD
column10: I have a cat who had serious intestinal issues. I needed a canned food that was grain free and also I need a protein that was not chicken - I had to start my cat on a novel protein. I bought this on the recommendation of a veterinarian (L. Pierson) on her web site, for so called "acceptable" canned food, because it is grain free. However if you read the ingredients list, it contains other ingredients that the same veterinarian says are allergenic to cats (e.g. carageenan). Also, even though its name claims it is "Turkey", (the turkey was supposed to be the novel protein for me) the ingredients list lists chicken and chicken parts as its 2nd, 3rd and 4th ingredients. It also has the same type of thickeners, fillers, and "flavoring" that all the other run of the mill canned pet food has.I originally gave this a 3 star rating (because it doesn't contain grains), but as I typed my review I was reminded of the deception and it made me change it to a 2 star.

My background is 50 years of dog/cat owner and college degree in chemistry so I'm not completely ignorant about pet nutrition. After a few days of Google research and reading pet food negatives and positives, I decided on a mix of Wellness both wet and the dry exclusively for my two rescue/shelter kitties based on reviews and availability. Price was not a deciding factor. After 1-1/2 years, they still gobble it down and I'm pleased to report both kitties mental and physical health to be outstanding with shiney, smooth coats, regular bowel movements, and healthy, energetic activity. I contribute this good fortune mostly to their diet of Wellness and a loving home environment although my billfold wouldn't mind if it were a bit cheaper. In my experience, Wellness has been outstanding.

column9: None of our cats would touch it
column10: We have been transitioning our 4 cats over from the crap Purina makes to Wellness, and for most of the flavors, they love it. They like it much better than Friskies. Yesterday was the first time we tried the Salmon and Trout flavor, and absolutely none of them would touch it. They left it in their dishes all day and went hungry.I'll still give it 3 stars, because overall Wellness is better than anything else out there. Just be sure to test out the different flavors on your cats before committing to any bulk orders.

My two cats will eat anything. So why do I even care what they eat? I care because it's about their health and it's a important responsibility I accepted when I adopted them. This Wellness Canned food is very fresh and (according to the experts) has all the healthy nutrition cats need. I've tried a few different brands and this one gives my cats the best soft, full coat and even makes their poop smell less (super bonus!). It's pricier, but give it a shot.

column9: Very flavorful with a nice texture
column10: I love this rice, especially cooked in my steamer using coconut water or broth instead of plain water.  It's a great, healthy alternative to white rice and has more texture and flavor than regular brown rice.

During one of my "We've got to eat healthier" phases, I found this product. My family hates these phases because of the changes that take place.  We've begun to eat healthier over the years, but brown rice is one thing I can't get them to eat.  My son HATES brown rice, and anything he thinks might be healthy for that matter. Anyway, I decided to try it in spite of the complaints I knew I'd hear.  I like brown rice and it sounded interesting.  I used it in a recipe that normally called for white rice and it turned out great, EVEN my son liked it.  It does take a little while to cook and it is a little pricey, but it tastes good and it's good for you.
If you enjoy a nutty rice, this is the best ever. It is a bonus that it is so healthful. It even smells delicious cooking! I am diabetic and the net carb count is another plus!

In the past, I have avoided brown rice, although I knew it was much better than white rice from a healthy eating standpoint, because I just couldn't get into the taste and texture.  While this blend does not have a significantly different texture, the taste and aroma are wonderful.  Rice is a large part of the Southern diet and this blend takes dishes to a new level.  Following the cooking directions will yield a perfect product, not gummy,  but very satisfying, especially for a meatless diet or entree.

Our family is sustained by whole grains and protien, and this rice fits the bill for all!  The texture is great, and since my 3 year loves it, it's a keeper!  We just add olive oil, no salt, to the water, and enjoy alone.  It's also great in casseroles, soups & salads-YUM!
Takes a bit of time but easy to prepare.  Can add a variety of simple ingredients, savory or sweet, for a tasty side dish

I tried the Rice Select Royal Blend with a bit of hesitation as I am one who really has never cared for rice.What I found was a product that truly surpassed what I thought rice could be like. This blend is absolutely delicious easy to prepare and goes well with everything.While it does take a while to cook, I usually let it go for 50 minutes instead of their recommended 45 it is worth the wait.The red and brown rice, being whole grain are of course good for you but they are tasty too.The barley and rye included in this give the extra kick that rice has always needed for me. To me, it smells like popcorn while cooking but the flavor is much better.I consider this the one food item that I now have to have in my cupboard and I eat it multiple times a week.Personally, I eat it with a bit of salmon or tuna mixed in but have tried it with other protein sources and loved it with all of them.Bumble Bee Albacore Steak Mesquite Tuna, 4-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12)Bumble Bee Pink Lemon and Dill Salmon Steak, 4-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12)Give this a try and I swear, you will never go back to plain old rice again.

A little expensive as a steady staple compared to brown rice or barley. If you're looking for fiber it has twice that per serving of brown rice, but 40% of barley. Interesting texture. Regular rice eaters could find it a taste treat.
I have been eating these rice combinations for several years and they are extremely tasty!

column9: One of the best rice blends I've ever tasted
column10: In an attempt to make my diet less dependent upon simple carbs, I've been shopping for whole grain products that don't taste like sand, cardboard or twigs and pebbles.  RiceSelect has come up with a clear winner with this blend of three different grain products: Two types of rice, barley and rye.  It has a warm, comforting quality, good flavor and is just loaded with the kind of fiber we all need.  You could do a lot worse and believe me, I have.Try cooking it in stock or broth and adding just a touch of butter and salt.  I make mine in my rice cooker (If you eat a lot of grains, get one.  Trust me on this, you'll thank me in the end.  Zojirushi makes some of the best.) and it's a nearly no-fuss operation.  Ingredients in, cooker on, walk away.  Come back to an amazing meal.
RiceSelect Royal Blend, Whole Grain Texmati Brown & Red Rice with Pearled Barley & Rye Berries, 32-Ounce Jars (Pack of 4)We love this rice and we cannot find it in the regular grocery store.

In an effort to eat healthier, whole grain products, I found this at my market several years ago and have loved it ever since.  The flavor and texture are superb!  Even non-rice people seem to enjoy it at my house.  My problem these days is that no local market seems to be carrying this blend.  Yes, you can get it on-line, but then you need to buy 4 canisters.....a very large quantity for me.  BUT....if you can find it at your market, grab it!  For us, it's the finest rice ever!!!

I'm really pleased with this RiceSelect Royal Blend (brown and red rice, barley, and rye) that I found on Amazon.  As described by the other reviewers, it's outstanding in flavor, texture, and color!  What a great addition to meals!  It's well worth the extra cooking time.  I double the recipe since it stores nicely in the refrig for several days and reheats easily in the micro.
I'm not a fan of rice.Then my husband has this as a side dish for our meal.Wonderful!!! Now we add it to dishes or just eat it plain!!! Healthy,too.What more could you ask for?
this is a very good product.  the combination of flavors goes well with all meats and veggies.  cooking it al dente is great..

column9: BEST RICE MIXTURE IN THE WORLD !
column10: FIRST BOUGHT IT IN TOWN, BUT IT BECAME HARD TO FIND---USUALLY SOLD OUT---SO I ORDERED IT FROM AMAZON. NOW IT'S ALWAYS THERE WHEN I WANT IT.  GAVE SOME TO OUR DAUGHTERS AND SOLD THEM ON IT TOO.  4 CONTAINERS DON'T LAST LONG NOW !

I just love this rice, so much healthier and tastier than plain rice.  The texture is chewy and the flavor is nutty.  I have this rice at least once a week and always make enough so that there will be leftovers.  Reheats well for a snack or lunch the next day.  I add in cut up meat and/or veggies for variety.

This rice takes a long time to cook in my rice cooker, nearly an hour. But it holds up well and does not get mushy. The texture is wonderful. I will be reordering this rice frequently, as we have gone through three jars in a little over a month. So far, this is our favorite of the RiceSelect brand.
This was a great find.  A flavorful mixture of red and brown whole grain rice in 2-lb containers.  I'm putting them in food gift baskets for Christmas.

column9: Unique blend and texture, healthy AND tastey!
column10: So good I give this as a gift!  Had trouble finding it in retail stores so went to Amazon.  This rice blend is delicious, full of texture and flavor, and goes along with any meal.
I use Royal Blend as the only rice product here in the house.  I love the nutty flavor.  We use it at least once a week here.

column9: Another great blend of whole grain goodness!
column10: This rice is wonderful and I highly recommend it.  I use an automatic rice cooker so there is no work or guessing involved.  I think what I like best about this rice is the texture.  It has a lot of "crunch" left in it after cooking.  The Pearled Barley & Rye Berries add to that crunchy texture.  I sometimes like to add a bit of wild rice to the blend as well.  This rice blend has a lot more flavor than plain, white rice.  We also know that this whole grain product is much more healthy for you than the plain white variety.  I have occasionally found this rice in some of the stores where I shop but far too often I search for it in vain.  Thankfully, I can count on Amazon to have this in stock!!!I also like the Rice Select Royal Blend with Brown & Wild Rice with Soft Wheat & Rye Berries.  I alternate between these two varieties to keep things interesting.  I always make a big batch of this rice because the "planned overs" are also very good and can be used in a number of ways!
This rice blend is very tasty and has nice chewy bits in it from the addition of the barley and rye berries.  I greatly enjoy it.

Rice Select has the most wonderful grain mixes.  I cannot find the ones I want in my grocery stores and Amazon is so easy--I just cook them in chicken broth and add dried cranberries.  It keeps well in the refrigerator and is an excellent quick meal with steamed fresh vegetables.
Love this rice blend, much better than plain rice or pasta.
Flavor was good but didn't care for the texture.  One grain was thoroughly cooked while another was too crunchy.
Bought this for the dogs as something different and it turned out to be a really versatile mixture

I purchased this on Dec 21 for a New Years arrival. It arrived on Dec 23. Off to a good start. I served this hm on New Years day to 8 people. They all loved it. One of them asked for Burger's Smokehouse contact info so she could order one next time. It was flavorful, not too salty, moist and tender.What I did was wrap it up in foil like the instructions said and baked at 325. I then removed it from the oven, cut off the skin and fat and glazed it under the broiler.Don't let the fact that it comes with it's skin and fat intact scare you off. This ham is delicious and the fat cap helps keep it moist. It made excellent fried ham for breakfast the next day and great ham sandwiches for lunch.One clue to a quality ham is when you cut open the wrapper, a bunch of juice doesn't leak out which tells the consumer that this ham didn't have water added like many do. There are so many grades to ham that most people aren't aware of. They go in order of quality as follows:HamHam with natural juicesHam with water addedHam and water productFor special occasions, most people want one of the two highest grades which are not easy to find in your local grocery store.This "city ham" is one with natural juices but it certainly comes very close in quality to the higher grade "ham".This is one of the best hams I've had.

After having a friend introduce me to rose oolong tea, I was destined to find a product that was just as good as the homegrown handmade tea mixture...This comes pretty darn close!  I steep it for about 15 minutes and it comes out PERFECT.  Not too strong, not too light.  It definitely smells flowery and leaves a very pleasant taste after each sip.  I'm definitely going to buy this again as it's become my custom to have a cup of it before bed time.  It doesn't say it's caffine free but it does a great job of calming my nerves down after a long day!

It other words this is super pungent! If your not a rose fan and want something subtle, this isnt for you.  On the plus side-Loved it! Would buy again, as matter of fact am ordering another can, great oolong tea, chock a block with the most pungently gorgeous rose petals!  I really love this product! In my house it gets used for more than tea!  Use your imagination, youll come up with so many ways to use this product.  Give it a shot, you won't regret it. I just wish it was a little cheaper.  I cannot find another that comes close to this though.  Try a little in some plain vanilla frosting, OMG! Soo Good.
This is the coffee I love, thank you so much for offering it as the last supplier stopped selling it.  I will continue to get it forever!

column9: The BEST Coffee on the Planet!
column10: I can't say enough about the Melitta line of coffees!  They are by far the best coffee I've ever made at home.  I typically by the "Buzzworthy" and fill my "to go" coffee cup twice (using my Melitta Coffee maker, one large cup and one small cup buttons).  It's perfectly diluted, but still strong.  My mom prefers this brand, "Love At First Sip".  It's a milder blend, but still VERY good, even when pressing the small cup button twice.These coffee blends taste like the gourmet coffee you buy in the trendy coffee houses.  You will LOVE these coffees!

We have ordered this coffee several times over the past months to the exclusion of other brands. This makes a good everyday cup of coffee. It has Bold flavor without bitterness when produced using a Senseo machine. The frothing is even there. The pods are slightly smaller than those made for the Senseo but work well if placed carefully. The price is very competitive considering the quality of the product.

Melitta has a good taste and if you have no choice but to buy for your Senseo coffee maker, they are ok but you must know in advance they don't fit the senseo very well (too thick) and you have to force closing the top which I felt was the reason i had to replace my coffee maker.

column9: Does not work in coffee makers as advertised
column10: I purchased this product when Senseo pods were hard to obtain and thought it would be a good fill in.  The first pod broke my senseo machine and I should have given up then, however, the coffee box said it would work in any pod machine so I tried it in a Hamiliton Beach pod machine.  No luck, tasted like warm, brown water. Be very careful if you buy this product, it may ruin your machine or at the very least just be bad coffee.
does not work with senseo coffee brewer ... Pods too thick and does not work with double pod holder either.

column9: melitta pods for Senseo coffee makers
column10: There is a problem with the Melitta pods for Senseo coffee makers. The pods are too thick and cause the locking mechanism to pop open during the brewing process, spillinghot water outside of the nozzle. I have tried this multiple times, with the same result. If you use a used pod, the  already compressed pod works alright, but, of course, is notproducing full flavored coffee.

These Melitta coffee pods are great tasting!  I have been using these for a couple of years now and I love them. The "Love at First Sip" flavor is mild and smooth tasting.  This is the best price on the internet.  They arrive quickly and are always fresh and undamaged.  Very simple to use with the Melitta coffee system.  Buy some today!

The Melitta Coffee Pods are great. The coffee is just right and the pods are convenient for one person. The shipping is fast and the price is great.Thanks. I will order again since I get them every three months.
It is a good medium roast coffee - not too strong, not too weak.I like it more than Breakfast Blend that I got last time

column9: Love at First Sip is the best way to describe this coffee!
column10: I have been drinking this coffee for a number of years now and I can't find another coffee that is quite the same taste. "Love at First Sip" is the best name it could have been given because I fell in love with it the first time I tried it.  In the past, I ordered this coffee from another website but found that Amazon's Subscribe and Save plan is the best value.  Love this coffee and the price!

column9: Easy but not for the strong coffee lover
column10: Don't get me wrong. This is a fine product. It came well within it's date code and is a pretty good cup of coffee but I'm just more of a dark roast guy. I'll try another of Melitta's flavors.
When the pot is dry and the need for one more cup is working I love these pods.  They are easy to use and tasty to boot.  I have to say these are my go to cup when I am busy or just by myself.
This is a very smooth and flavorful coffee. I will be sure to order more of this
Drink this blend daily and I believe it is as smooth as a coffee pod can be.
Milder than its Medium-Roast brand, this coffee is nonetheless irresistible.  Great for an afternoon treat; smooth, rich notes cast a bit of sunshine on your day.

column9: Good flavor and they work perfectly.
column10: I've tried a few versions of coffee pods and have found that these are the best of the bunch. The pods come individually wrapped so flavor is always consistent. These pods also contain the most amount of coffee per pod so the flavor is much stronger.
Avoid this product. The price is spectacular but the coffee that results is quite bland. I was hopeful but in the end couldn't even use the pods. Keep looking.

Since Senseo pods are impossible to find, I thought I would give these a try.  Using one pod was like drinking hot water with a coffe colored tint.  Using two pods was marginally  better, but still did not yield a fuller flavor/robust cup of coffee.  I cannot recommend unless you like watery weak coffee.

These pods do fit in a Senseo machine - they are larger and thicker, so it's a tighter fit, but they work. The spring on my old Senseo lid broke long ago, but the thing still closes tight and doesn't leak, so I'm aware of the fit issues. In short, the Melitta pods are quite superior to the Senseo brand ones, and they make a better cup of coffee. It's my daily cup, and pretty tasty. It's not the ultimate, greatest ever, but it's good coffee.

These pods do not contain a weak blend of coffee, but will make a good strong cup of coffee instantly, in the Bunn Coffee Maker.I recommend these pods, as they are the best you can buy, for the price.

The pods do not fit the Senseo machines unless you use a double holder.  Even then the coffee is like tinted water.  The flavor would be fine if it were stronger.  I also had several pods that were broken when I opened the individual bags.

I enjoy this coffee in the afternoons.  It is just the right blend for a medium roast but really flavorful cup of coffee.  I drink Melitta's Buzzworthy in the mornings, but wanted something with not so much kick for my afternoon java break.  This is good coffee.
Was worried when Amazon all of a sudden seemed to run out of Senseo Coffee Pods, not to worry, these work just fine, coffee is of the same quality as Senseo and each pod is individually wrapped.

Bought this product as replacement for Senseo brand coffee pods in a Phillips Senseo HD7810.  The pods were too big, and caused hot water to leak and spray out of the machine while in use!  Made a mess, no injury/burns, but I will NEVER by these pods again.Putting the "double" tray in for a single pod led to no water pressure and a terribly weak cup of coffee.  Better than hot spraying water, though!

column9: The quickest perfect cup of coffee!
column10: I love the Melitta pods.  It's having the convenience of instant coffee while getting a perfectly brewed cup of coffee at home.  You'll never again have to wait for the whole pot to brew, and then have to drink the whole pot or pour out part of it.  You always get the first cup!!!!  It's totally delightful!!!

I think I must have gotten 3 shipments thus far. I canceled it today. Coffee is tasteless, intensity is not consistent and moreover 25% of the pods are duds. They produce nothing but light watery coffee. Instead I would recommend coffee pods by Senseo.

column9: Not a substitute for Senseo pods.
column10: Melitta One:One Java Pods, Love At First Sip, Medium Roast Coffee, 18-Count Boxes (Pack of 4)I was very disappointed in this Melitta product. The pods were too thick for my Senseo coffeemaker. And the coffee produced is definitely not as smooth as the Senseo Medium Strength pods produce.Do not use these Melitta's in a Senseo machine. The hinge of the movable top was very strained due to the extra thickness of these Melitta pods. I'm sure the plastic bits around the hinge would have failed if I continued to use the Melitta pods.I contacted Amazon and they, nicely, and quickly refunded my purchase price. Thanks, Amazon.MJR

These coffee pods will damage your Senseo coffee machine! The Melitta packing states that these will fit all single serve brewing machines. This is not true! They are thicker than the Senseo pods and when using them the Senseo lid pops open and hot water spills out. After contacting Melitta they send me an email saying I would have to buy soft pods. These are soft pods!?!? I'm very dissapointed! The coffee tastes great if you are lucky enough to fill a cup without spilling all water.

I'm very disappointed with this product. It doesn't fit well on the Phillips Senseo coffee pod machine. I typically do 2 pods for 2-cup brew so I had to do it twice with this one. Produced tasteless watery coffee. Tried this product just for a change from the Senseo coffee pods. I suppose I should just stick with them. I'm just very pleased that Amazon gave me a refund for it.
tastes ok but pods does not fit Senseo coffee maker, I wasted several pods to find a way to use them anyway.

column9: Makes very weak coffee with a Hamilton Beach single cup machine
column10: I've got a tiny Hamilton Beach single cup coffee maker that uses senseo pods. These melitta pods make a terrible cup of coffee in the machine, versus Senseo pods that actually turn out reasonably tasty for something so easy. I usually like a nice strong coffee (ie french press, aeropress), but for weekdays I settle for a quick and easy cup to get me going. However, the Melitta pods don't meet even a basic definition of coffee as far as I can tell. I've actually tried soaking the pods directly in hot water, and even then there is very little flavor. Kind of unbelievable. There is plenty of caffeine, just no taste whatsoever.

column9: Good flavor, does not fit senseo well
column10: I like this coffee, but as others have mentioned the pod is a bit thicker than the senseo.I tried both options:Put it in the single pod basket on the senseo, force the lock closed. This works well but feels like you will break the machine with time. It really needs forcing.Or you can put it in the double pod holder. The problem here is it is too loose and does not seal well leaving you with weak coffee. You can moisten the pod before putting it in the machine. This does result in good coffee but is an extra step.Also they come individually wrapped. Perfect for a hotel or other public use, but a bit of extra waste at home.I won't buy again, and am looking for another pod that works with Senseo.
My husband in the only coffee drinker in the family and this is a great system to make 1 or 2 cups a day and no clean up.  Love It!!
I didn't like this at all, it had a really funky taste. I tried several times to drink it and finally just threw it away - and I'm really tight with the dollar!

column9: Airplanes work Great for Santa Photos
column10: As a Santa I have found these airplanes are great for getting a child's attention for Santa photos.  The propeller lights really cause children to look at them (close to the photographer).  Great pictures of small children are the result.

This is a great toy (forget the candy!).  It can be used to teach all kinds of things about science and perception-, and the display is mesmerizing!  Whoever designed the electronics and layout is very creative.  A centrifugal switch causes the LEDs to illuminate only when the motor is spinning.  As the fan spins up, you learn why wagon wheels on TV westerns sometimes appear to spin backwards.  I really like this toy.

This product has "not for children under 3" on its label, but it's not for children over 3 either!My 3 year old son ate, yes ATE the propeller within just a few minutes of getting the plane, and who knows what that foamy rubber propeller was made of - checked the manufacturer's website and couldn't fine any information on materials for this item, only a MADE IN CHINA label which makes me shudder.  I got him to spit out the big chunks, but I suspect that he swallowed some as well.For a $5 toy, they should make the propeller out of something a little more durable and less dangerous.1 is the lowest score I could give this product, but honestly it doesn't deserve that.

I love these with a cup of tea.  I used to make my own Peanut butter crackers, but you can't always carry peanut butter and crackers with you.  This is the answer.  I kept them in my desk drawer at work.  Everyone knew I had them and they started to disappear.  Seems everyone liked them as much as I did.  LOL  I have them in my home all the time and bring them as snacks to the beach and camping.

column9: My Dog Loves Them and They Are Healthy Too!
column10: My five year old yellow lab loves these health bars. She gets a whole bar after a long walk or they are easy to break up for smaller treats. I love all the healthy ingredients. Thanks Harmony Farms.

column9: Harmony Farms Health Bars Dog Treat Review
column10: My dog just loves Harmony Farms Health Bars with Apples & Yogurt.  He will start to do his "tricks" to earn one before I even have it out of the bag.  I love the fact that it contains no wheat, which is hard to find in a dog treat.  This is his favorite treat out of everything we have tried.HARMONY FARMS Health Bars with Apples & Yogurt for Dogs, 18-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)

My dog loves these treats but I was unable to find them in the area we moved to so I was delighted to find them online. Great treat at a great value, I will continue to order from this company in the future.

column9: Skeptical at First, but Now a Big Fan
column10: My dog was initially skeptical about these thick, square, rather bulky biscuit and the first few days actually snubbed the product entirely.What he was doing and I later caught on to this was chewing them after lights out and after I'd gone to bed. I finally realized this when I awoke hearing a definite crunch by my bedside. I was very happy to see him eating and actually enjoying this pretty good quality snack.After the secret was out, he no longer kept them for bedtime chewing  but accepted them at any time I offered them.There are no wheat, corn, chicken or poultry by-products and when you see the overwhelming number of snack of poor nutrition, it's nice to experiment with healthier treats.These are large so this particular biscuit probably wouldn't be right for a little puppy, maybe a larger breed older puppy.
I bought a whole bag (pack of six bags) of these for my two little dogs--a Shih-tzu and a Shorkie, and they sniff them and walk away.

Although I have had good results previously with ordering this product, this latest batch smells very sour, to the point that I'm concerned that it may have spoiled and I'm reluctant to give it to my dogs.

Our German Shepherds love these and only one of them has a high food drive. My daughters mixed shepherd had Pancreatitis and cannot have any fatty or junk food treats, which rules out most biscuits or treats which she will get sick from if she eats them.  She can have a bunch of Harmony biscuits without having any problems whatsoever.  Shows me that the Harmony Farms product does indeed have highest quality ingredients and care in manufacture.
My Miniature Schnauzer absolutely loves these bars.  He must have one each night before settling in to sleep.  They are great!

Found these Health Bars with Apples and Yogurt at our WEGMANS.My dog loves these treats...and they are so wholesome.Oatmeal, barley and flaxseed among the ingredients.They are square...they don't have a bad smell..and she gobblesthem right up. I can't find them in Florida where we spendthe winter..so am ordering them on Amazon today.
Loved by my little shelter-rescued dog who has problems digesting wheat.  Makes me nervous that country of origin is China.

I have purchased this product from local stores and have purchase the fries from amazon.  These chips that were delivered are rancid.  I can't even stand the smell myself.  It now is in my trash can!  DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT FROM AMAZON.

I have been buying Sweet Potato and Yam treats for my 3 dogs for the past year or two. My dogs love them so we make sure we always have a good supply on hand. I purchased these particular treats from this particular supplier because the price was a bit less than usual. However, they are so HARD that even my big dog has a hard time chewing them!! And my older small dog will not even try to chew them, though they are his favorite treat. This is the second time I ordered this product from this supplier and both orders were the same, the treats are too hard for the dogs to chew!! I ordered a second time hoping I just got a bad batch from them or something. However, both orders were the same, too hard for the dogs to chew!! I don't know if they have been allowed to sit around and get old and hard, or what. All I do know for sure is that I will not be ordering any more items from this supplier!! It's not cheap if you have to throw it away in the end!!

I just wanted to say that if you want to get your dog a healthy snack alternative, this product would be a good one; if the vendor did not ship you old, outdated, dried out and hard crap.  Very disappointed.  Luckily, I found a store that is close to me that carries this item that is fresh.  I would NOT recommend this vendor to anyone.

column9: MAY BE DANGEROUS! Product developed white mold!
column10: I bought these imported sweet potato chips because they are less than half the price of SAM'S YAMS which are my dog's favorite treats. The first bag seemed fine, but the stored bags all developed what appears to be a silvery white mold, although the expiration date is December, 2013. I have no idea if this could be dangerous to dogs, but I tossed mine out, because we have had terrible problems with food poisoning of our pets from imported ingredients.If anyone else has had this experience I would like to know if the white stuff is natural or is, in fact, dangerous. Thanks!

My dogs LOVE these sweet potato chews so I was excited to order them a 2 lb. bag here.  I was very disappointed when the chews came, though!  While they weren't rock hard as another reviewer stated, they are dried out and not nearly as fresh as what I can buy locally.

We've tried several types of sweet potato treats but this is the best we've found so far, mainly because it's the only one our yorkie will eat:) Others are so hard/rubbery you can't even cut them with a knife. This brand is chewable for bigger dogs and tearable for our yorkie plus she loves the flavor. My only concern is that the product is made in China but the ingredients seem pure.

I'm quite sure I reviewed this product before. But, since you're asking....my dog loves these SO much;I'll review it again.  If I'm leaving the house, and I'm going to be gone awhile; I leave him a coupletreats to keep him happy for at least a little while. I've given him a mixture of this treat & that treatover time. But he always/Always/ALWAYS.....picks this one out of the pile first. A perfect treat; especiallyfor a dog with either a sensitive stomach/or skin allergies. And wholesome too !!
My dog has IBS (can you believe it??) and these sweet potato treats are easy on his stomach and he loves them.  Great price on Amazon compared to the pet store.

When you are looking for a Organic Veggie Treat for your Dog. This is a very good one. It is Rubbery Veggie slice that the dog loves to chew.Do not give too many in a days time or you will have a loose orange stool to take care of. So 1 or 2 a day is best. I also found that although the puppies love to chew them if you give them more than 1 a day their baby teeth/gums become painful.I switched to the Sweet potato fries for my puppies to keep away from the gum/tooth pain. My adult dogs Love the chips.Great change from all the other Meat-additive treats out there.

Healthy Pets reports that sick dogs who have eaten sweet potato snacks show symptoms similar to Fanconi syndrome, "a condition in which the tubules of the kidneys don't function properly."  According to Healthy Pets, products implicated in anecdotal accounts include:Beefeaters Sweet Potato Snacks for DogsCanyon Creek Ranch Chicken Yam Good Dog TreatsDogswell Veggie Life VitalityAccording to Becky Lundgren, DVM, of the Veterinary Information Network, "Anecdotal reports from veterinarians indicate similar concerns about sweet potato pet treats made in China. Although no evidence is available that these sweet potato treats cause kidney issues similar to those related to chicken jerky treats, pet owners should be aware of the possibility."You certainly should. A prudent course of action that every shopper should take is simply looking for a "Made in China" label on any package of treats, and, if finding one, returning it to the shelf.

This product deserves no stars.I read ingredients SO carefully. In my local pet store I decided to get my boys something different and bought them this treat. Checked the ingredients and they seemed fine. Brand is "Beefeaters USA". After a few weeks my dog was vomiting, had bloody stool, and drinking a lot of water. Five hundred dollars later after xrays and blood panels he came back cancer-free and with nothing blocking his system.Puzzled, I googled some of the brands of treats I was feeding them, and information on the organic dog food I feed them. Beefeaters is made in China AND is on the list of tainted dog treats. Thinking it was only chicken jerky I did not think to check.I learned the hard way. I will now either make their treats or make sure it is safe before buying.

My little dog loves sweet potatoes, so this seemed like the perfect treat.  The 'chips' weren't what I expected, but she loves them.  The 'chips' are big slices of sweet potato, and are soft, not crunchy.  I was disappointed at first, but Misha begs for them, so that's what counts!  The slices are too big for my little girl, but cutting them into smaller sizes isn't a problem.  Will definitely order again!  It's a shame they are made in China, but I guess they are too expensive to make in America.  They are irradiated (according to the FDA - Food irradiation is the process of exposing food to ionizing radiation to destroy microorganisms, bacteria, viruses, or insects that might be present in the food.) so they are safe for our four-legged babies.
My dog loves these almost more than his regular food! Good size on my of the pieces although at the bottom of the bag they get smaller.

Who would have thought of sweet potato treats for dogs, but my three love them.  They must have a sweet tooth, because these treats are devoured.  Visiting dogs belonging to friends & family really enjoy them as well, so I recommend you give them a try.
My little guy just loves these things.  When given a choice of these chips or regular dog biscuits he chooses these every time.
I love that these are all natural. They are soft and chewy and fresh. My dog loves them and they are good for her.
I have ordered this product before and my dog just loves the sweet potatoe treat (not knowing it is also good for her!).Product arrives very quickly and is exactly as advertised.  Will re-order soon.
My dogs loves these and they are so good for them. This product is shaped like potato chips. They get so excited when I get them out.
These are great. My dog's favorite, and seem to be a healthy snack. They are easy to cut in half if you want to give a smaller portion.

I've ordered these from Amazon several times.  Orders have always been timely and the product has been perfect.  Both my dogs love these treats.  My older dog took a bit longer to warm up to them but now he loves them too!

Our family dog, a 5 year old (human years) Shih Tzu didn't take to this at first. It took a good week before he would try it. After he tried it, he was all over it. He's allergic to everything so it was nice to find a treat that he could eat. We found this at Pet Smart and got the clear plastic bucket (about one pound of treats). It's lasted him about 8 months now--serving it to him about 2-3 times a week ahout 2-5 of these treats each time. We'll be getting him so more of these. He's pretty happy when he gets these.

This is my favorite thing to feed my 11 year old aussie for a chew.  Her canines have become pretty worn, partially because she developed a habit of chewing her way out of chain link kennels about 5 years ago (which I no longer keep her in) but also because I used to give her very hard chews when she was younger.  I still give her a chew in the evening but it is always something pretty soft.  I like the Sam's Yamz but they are pretty pricey and then I found these!  I purchased my supply from Amazon which is perhaps I didn't have the same experience as the previous reviewer with them being pretty hard. The pieces in the bag I got were very soft and chewy.  With free shipping these are a great deal and don't wear done my dog's teeth!

My dogs love these.  There a healthy alternative to the other treats out there.  The one thing with these are it softens the stool and turns it orange.  If your dog goes on the neighbor's yard that's good but we all know the pain of picking up soft poop.  I guess it all comes down to how much you love you mut.I only give each about 1 or 2 a day and thier fine.  If your dog likes these, then try giving them raw sweet potatoes or sweet potatoes that have been semi cooked in microwave.  My dogs eat them as it was the beef or turkey jerky.

column9: This product is dog food not a snack for humans
column10: I was looking for heathy sweet potato chips and see this item.  Ordered it quickly and had to return it because itis for dogs not for humans.I have nothing against dogs or dog food.  But I think the Amazon website needs to make a clearer distinctionbetween dog snacks and human snacks and not list them all on the same page for people to choose.

column9: French's Fajita Seasoning - The Best Ever
column10: I can not wait until Amazon starts carrying French's Fajita Seasoning Mix.  I was able to find a box of 6 packets about 6 months ago and started using it.  My husband uses it in both our steak fajitas and our chicken fajitas and it makes both of them taste wonderful.  I have used other fajita seasoning mixes but they are either too spicy or not enough.  French's is just right and my husband absolutely loves it and he is a fantastic cook in his own right.  His Chicken Enchiladas have won many county fairs and our friends and relatives are always asking him to make them and the fajitas.Please Amazon, get this product in as soon as you can.
I wanted the company to fix my problem, but they decided to instead cancel my order. It's cute, but I wouldn't order anything from them again.

column9: Great for ribs and chicken on the grill
column10: This is a great rub for ribs and chicken on the grill!  It gives it a bbq flavor that is sweet, but tangy.  We put the rub on and let it sit for a while - grill it up then put on the Bone Suckin sauce a few minutes before taking it off the grill - delicious!

it is gluten free which is a major consideration. unlike most vegetable soups, it is not full of tomato. it has a distinct mushroom and rice flavor that is different and very good. it is a bit salt, but most of Amy's soups are rather salty. it is much less expensive to buy at Amazon than at groceries and health food stores, and it is hard to find on shelves.

It's a convenient way to get vegetables and it's healthy and vegan. I didn't like the amount of oil in it - too oily. I got tired of a tomato base soup too - but I eventually got through 2 cases. Some cans were dented, but we didn't get sick from them - but dents in food cans causes worry and concern.I particularly liked the mushrooms in this. It was a little delight each time I got a mushroom in my mouth - just the right texture.I hope Amy's is working on the BPA issue found in the lining of their (and most everybody else's) cans.

I've been trying with limited amounts of success to eat vegan and low-gi. Amys soups are excellent for this, they make it very easy to lose weight. One limiting factor is fat cravings, eating vegan it's actually hard to get enough fat.This is a long way of saying this soup tastes great, I can tell it's oily and i love that about it. I need fat in my diet or I'll lose my mind and eat a whole pizza. Low-fat diets are a travesty anyway, creating a market for high-sugar high-gi products labeled as "healthy"So this soup brings oil and mushrooms and a very good flavor. I've had about a dozen types of amys soups, and this is at the top with golden lentil, no chicken noodle, and trader joes lentil vegetable (made by amys).
This Organic soup faithfully recreates the French style, has a very pronounced flavor to it, highly recommended and unique, not your average Vegetable soup, perhaps Amy's best soup of all.

I just bought this soup and it is truly outstanding. It is almost a meal onto itself. Everything is natural, organic and vegan. I love Amy's vegan soups and they really outdid themselves with this one. One of the best soups I've ever eaten!
product took a while to ship. the actual candy sticks were old, very chewy and fell apart easily. not what i was expecting at all. i expected them to be hard candy sticks you could suck on.

Received only 9 pieces of 8 different flavors for a total of 72.  I'm assuming you are supposed to get 10 of each flavor.  While they were packaged fairly well, with bubble wrap around them and only a few were broken, anytime you do not get what you paid for is a fail.

column9: Good Price. Not so Great Quality.
column10: You get what you pay for with these. We ordered them for our wedding but it was too late to order anything else once we saw the quality.  These are not nice like the ones you normally see in stores like Cracker Barrel.  They're a little smaller and not all are a uniform thickness or length.  I didn't taste any, but they did smell fruity.  I would not buy these again.

column9: this product was a good buy
column10: the product arrived ahead of schedule and was in perfect condition, that being no broken candy sticks. would recomend it to anyone who likes a verity of candy sticks.
Note these are Not as sweet as you would expect them to than if you got them from SEES, okay?
These are by far the best lemon cream filled wafers I've had.  If you like a strong, sweet, tart filling in a crisp wafer, I highly recommend these to you.

column9: Unbelievable SBC, what's in your heads?.  BRING BACK CLASSIC HENRY'S BLEND NOW!
column10: Well this review is as much to inform.  Henry's Blend is indeed gone, replaced by "Level Four" that states on the package "Henry's Blend."  It is NOT Henry's Blend.  It is similar in that it does not have a bitter flavor and there is no aftertaste and is smooth, but it has lost all of the nutty character that made this medium dark roast coffee my staple. I have no idea how I will replace the classic Henry's Blend, everything I try is a reminder of how great the old stuff was.  Fortunately I have 12 bags from an "auction site."  After that, I just don't know.  This is a classic "circling the drain" move.  Seattle's Best will either go back and consolidate product lines the right way, or they will be gone by this time next year. They have lost my business until they bring back "Classic" Henry's Blend.  If anyone has found a good alternative, I would love to hear from you!  Good luck fellow "Classic Henry's Blend" lovers!

column9: I (Used to) Drink WAY Too Much of This Coffee
column10: EDITED 01/2011 TO ADD: Henry's Blend is no more. This new teal-bag number 4 coffee may be presented as being the same 'balanced roast' that Henry's blend was, with nothing more than a fab new presentation... but don't be fooled. It's not just the bag that's changed: This stuff tastes like little more than brown water. YUCK!Original review (no longer applicable) follows:I originally bought Henry's Blend a few years back because it had a cat on it. They've since removed the cat, which is a shame because suckers for cat-promotions on coffee would totally pass this up as just another coffee.Anyway, I'm rather picky about my coffees. Previous to Henry's Blend I'd only truly enjoy something from our local bean roasters. I loathe Starbucks (tastes burnt to me), the other common brands all end up tasting watery and bland, but Henry's blend is just right - somewhere in the middle. It isn't too strong, it isn't too mild, and it has that stink that my mom calls the 'cat pee smell' (ironically) but not in a really intense way. More like mellow cat pee smelling.Anyway, I've tried others in the past few years but not one has had the right balance, and so back to Henry's blend I go. Its only drawback is that, at the rate I drink it, it's an awfully pricey habit to take up.

column9: Goodbye Henry. You will be missed.  :(
column10: I have been a loyal fan of SBC since it was Stewart Brothers Coffee waaay back. For the longest time Henry's Blend has been a staple in our home. Unfortunately, since corporate brass decided that a good thing needed changing, this replacement doesn't do Henry justice. We gave Level 4 a try and disliked it from the start. After going back and buying an original Henry's Blend and pouring coffee grounds out side by side next to the Level 4, there was a noticeable difference in color, texture and aroma. Sad to say, but I will have to find another roaster of our beloved beans.After hearing other stories like this with the other Levels and the disappearace of trusted blends, it makes me wonder if corporate is purposely trying to kill off SBC or create a media fiasco like Coca-Cola did with "New Coke" in the 80's. Who knows.Goodbye Henry. You will be missed.  :(

column9: Bring back the Original Henry's Blend!!!
column10: I agree with the other reviewers.  "Level 4 Seattle's Best" is NOT the same as "Henry's Blend."  Henry's Blend was perfect, level 4 just tastes "off."  I'll be looking for a replacement blend.

Seattle's Best has obviously been taken over by idiots. That's the only explanation for this new change in product look and taste. Are they trying to market coffee to grade school children? The new product presentation in bright colored, ugly bags with huge numbers on them is so unsophisticated and juvenile that it boggles the mind as to how this piece of rubbish got rubber-stamped by any executive who loves coffee. Coffee drinkers don't appreciate this kind of flashy, cheap looking product packaging and still they've tried to keep their original customers by stamping a tiny little reminder of "Like Henry's Blend" on the bag. Well that just rubs salt into the wound because the taste also seems to have been tampered with. I predict that this will go the same way as the Tropicana OJ fiasco and that they'll lose sales to the point that they'll be forced to bring back their far more sophisticated packaging and blends. Luckily, I have plenty of local roasters selling coffee that I can turn to and not feel ashamed for buying such a pathetic looking product. Henry's Blend, in the traditional red bag was a sophisticated, gourmet coffee and that sadly no longer exists.
Henry's Blend is a rich and flavorful coffee. It also does not have a bitter aftertaste. Frank Williams.
Here's a clue:Seattle's "Best" .....is ALL cheap Robusta beans!!!Tastes like it too... harsh and burnt-like... even in the light roasts...Cuz thats what Robusta tastes like..Heh..

This by far my favorite blend. When they had them BOGO I stocked up quite a bit, had to have a rain check, came back for more!Beautiful blend, aroma, when measured correctly and the water is filtered, you can make the best Joe!

Seattle's best numbering system is honest.  I like stronger coffee so I've tried the 3, 4, and 5.  The number 3 is coffee, regular strength normal everyday coffee.  It's a good flavor, not acidic, smooth flavorful, coffee. The number 4 is strong coffee, same basic flavor as the number 3, just stronger.  It's like using a full pot worth of grounds and only brewing three quarters of a pot.  My favorite is the number 5.  Number 5 is different.  Number 5 is extremely strong flavor!  Do not use a normal amount of grounds to brew a pot, unless you're really stubborn, you'll dump the pot.  It is good though, if you use about half the normal amount of grounds you get some very tasty coffee that you can actually drink.  I bought three packs of number 3 and 4 for work.  I brought in a bag of number 5 once, but that was a big mistake.  You see not everyone understands how to brew number 5 and I had some unhappy co-workers including one that spit a mouthful at his computer screen.  Yes, it's funny now, but it wasn't then.

column9: Delicious - one of the best coffees I have ever tasted.  Strong, smooth, and balanced.
column10: Delicious - one of the best coffees I have ever tasted.  Reasonably strong, wonderfully smooth, and balanced.  Seattle's Best French Roast coffee is also excellent but much stronger. Try Henry's Blend if you're not a devotee of very strong coffee.
for my taste this coffee is quite bitter, although it has no bitter aftertaste..the taste itself is quite ordinary...Lavazza is much better for me..

Sea Best is my favorite brand of coffee, which I discovered around 1999 while visiting Seattle.  At the time, I had to buy it in Seattle because it wasn't available elsewhere.  Now, I can buy it on Amazon!  I personally prefer it to Starbucks, which is more readily available.  Henry's Blend is a good medium "weight" coffee.  Not too strong, not too weak.  With Prime 2 day shipping, you can have your coffee very quickly as well.  I ordered this Thursday night and had it on my doorstep via FedEx Saturday at 9am.
My first cup, I said "wow" -- Henry's Blend is my favorite coffee now.On their site, the new "Level Four" says "Rich, Elegant, Complex (For Henry's Blend Fans)"

column9: Smooth flavor to wake up to
column10: Consistent smooth flavor that is a bit more robust than mid range roasts without the strong bite that some of the darker roasts have.  I like to create my own coffee "brews" and ofter pair Seattle's Best 4 (Henry's Blend) with Givalia Traditional Roast for my morning coffee.

This is such a great product.  I have purchased it in grocery stores, but sometimes can't find it so I ordered online. I was disappointed that in came packaged differently this time though. In huge bags. Not sure why this changed, but it is still a great product, and healthy eating.

I have tried the refried beans and really enjoyed them so I was equally impressed with the black beans.  Slightly spiced with a more sweet (cinnamon or cloves maybe) and they are really excellent as an appetizer or with tacos.  Works well as you can make exactly what you need.  Really good and well received by the family.
The easiest way for that Black Bean and Cheese burrito fix which afflicts many of us. Add a Low Carb, Whole Wheat Tortilla shell and you are good to go. I can taste it now.

column9: Great Handy Item and for Food Storage short term.
column10: We eat a Lot of Mexican and I like to keep a fully stocked kitchen and plan my meals on a whim.  So having this on hand is Great because it is such a fast simple side item and also a great ingredient in so many recipes.I was leery of buying this size, since I had never tired this before, but am so glad I did!  As soon as I opened the bag the aroma was amazing.  I did not realize these were seasoned black beans !!!!Well, I made made some and right my kids said "that smells amazing".  Use it in wraps, in casseroles, as a side dish, diluted as a soup, etc.  I will no longer be purchasing canned black beans unless I need them whole for a salad.  This is my replacement for both canned whole black beans and canned re-fried black beans.Now, the food storage part.  Obviously this is not a long term item (15+ years), nor is it packed as one.  It come in a plastic bag in a cardboard box.  I saved my old pasta sauce and pickle jars, and after washing and drying them, I store dry items like this in them.  I make a label  and tape it on.  I also copy the Expiration date onto the label.  This keeps the product nice and dry, better than plastic storage containers.Now if I want to really keep it fresh, I take half the box and pop it into a mylar bag and seal it with an oxy pack.  But I would still not save that for longer than three years - tops.But for the convenience and knowing its an item I have on hand for slightly long term storage - this can't be beat!20 - 1 Gallon Size (10"x14") Mylar Bags for Long Term Food Storage20 - 1 Gallon (10"x14") Mylar Bags & 20 - 300cc OxyFree Oxygen Absorbers For Dried Dehydrated and Long Term Food Storage

A piece of heaven disguised as cookies.The only cookie that comes anywhere close is a Malomare.It's still like comparing a Rolls Royce to a VW Beatle.  Once you've had a Whippet - you'll never go back!

column9: Good Cookies But I Still Prefer Mallomars and Pinwheels
column10: I bought a box ( of 12 boxes, I guess that is only shipment that Amazon can send of these cookies ) of these cookies 2 weeks from Amaaon and guess what, NOW THEY"RE ALL GONE!  I think I ate 3 boxes of thse cookies and gave the rest away and sold a few.  My impression overall of these cookies is that they are very, very well made, the chocolate alone is decandent, the shell is crisp but can be crispier, but they DEFINITELY add TOO MUCH SUGAR IN THESE COOKIES and for that rason I prefer Mallomars to these cookies, which are the closest cookies in comparison to these.  Mallomars look like Whippets and but they have a crispier shell, the chocolate is not as good cos it's not so rich and dark, but the cookie base is more solid and the marshmallow is not so sugary.  When you eat a Whippet the overall first taste you experience on your palette is a rush of sugar, but with Mallomars you taste the marshmallowy goodness with the sugar.  Pinwheels, a marshmallow cookie that is larger, richer, darker and better overall than both Whippets and Mallomars, have a chocolate coating that is not as good as Whippets but the cookie baase is chocolate, it is more solid and the marshmallow is understated.  I don't know if in Montreal, Quebec or wherever in Quebec they love these cookies ( on the package it says they are " Quebec's favorite cookie! ) they LOVE SUGAR but overally my impression is good of these, they defintely did grow on me after I eat maybe two boxes, but I will never buy them again, not one package and definitely not 12, they are just way to sugary for me since my local grocery stores carries PInwheels year round and Mallomars when they're in season there is no need to buy them again.  I heartily reccomend that you spend your hard-earned money on Pinwheels rather than these, if you're a sugar-concious American who apprciates a good cookie.
We saw a show on PBS about the making of Whippet cookies and just had to try them.  Couldn't find them in the US, but did order a case from Canada.  THEY ARE WONDERFUL!

One of the best cookies produced by Dare Co. of Canada.  For all lovers of dark chocolate and marshmallow.  Also made with jelly filling, but not as yet available through Amazon.  Try them.  You will not be disappointed.

This is the second time I've ordered these cookies. The flavor is very good, and I cannot purchase these locally.I was a little disappointed because, both times it seems as though the box was stored or shipped in too much heat. All the cookies are stuck together, and the chocolate seemed a little old because it was whitish and grainy.I still enjoy them, but I just wish they looked like they do in the picture on the box.

While at a triathlon in Mt.Tremblant, saw these on the grocer shelf.  Tried them and was immediately hooked!  Unfortunately thought I could find them in any Canadian store, but that was not the case.  Wish I had stocked up before I left but was happy to see them available online.  Perfect solution without the 12 hour drive.

I bought these as a substitute for Mallomars based on reviews from other Amazon customers - if anything, these are even better than I expected.  Rich chocolate shell over yummy marshmallow set on graham cracker cookie.  The only negative is that some cookies in each box arrive broken because of rough handling in transit - but they still taste great.

I have enjoyed Mallomars for the better part of 50+years.  I am thankful that they never changed the recipe and still use the same chocolate today as they have used in the past.  Having said that, I never thought I would come across a real competitor. i was wrong.....for me the Whippet is a real competitor....there seems to be more marshmallow in the Whippet and the chocolate covering and graham cracker crust is one par with the Mallormar.  All I can say is wonders never cease.

Love chocolate marshmallow cookies and gave these a try - now I'm almost (almost) sorry I did because they are so good they are addictive and now I just can't go back to the other brands.  The chocolate on these is excellent and has a satisfying crack when you first bite into it, not grainy or waxy like some others, but rich and smooth.  The marshmallow itself is wonderfully tender and light.  The cookie is small and unobtrusive. These are simply the best!

I bought these cookies because Mallowmars were out of stock everywhere, and I thought these would be similar. Other than the look, they are nothing alike. These Whippet Cookies are horrible. They don't even come close to a Mallowmar. They leave you with with a bad plastic taste in your mouth. Since I can't return them, they will be going in the garbage. I would give them away, but I would never subject another person to such a terrible cookie!

column9: Dare Whippet Cookies, Original, 8 - 8 Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
column10: Cookies were not shipped, or stored, in good conditions. They arrived with chocolate coating deteriorating and the individual cookies stuck together.  There also was no product expiration date so it was not possible to tell if the product was simply out of date.  I would not buy again.
