column9: a mini Moon Pie with a French Canadian accent
column10: These are everything that a Mallomar should be, or at least what I remembered them to be. Unfortunately, what they say is true: You Can't Go Home Again. My recent attempt to enjoy childhood again through Mallomars was an unmitigated disaster. The concoctions were dried-out and disgusting, looking like Phoenician testicles and tasting just as bad.Whippets on the other hand were a pleasant surprise from the very first box, and every subsequent box--now sold at my local Safeway, believe it or not--is a gustatory delight. It's like a mini Moon Pie. And these really do look as good in person as on the box. (William Foster would be pleased.)Pinwheels aren't a bad choice if you love chocolate: the cookie base is chocolate instead of graham cracker. Curiously, all three (Whippets, Mallomars, Pinwheels) are manufactured in Canada. I might have to move there to conduct further research.

The product was as expected, and the weather still cool enough that the chocolate hadn't melted enroute.It was discouraging that UPS dropped the case when handing them to us. It might be nice to have a bright 'VERY FRAGILE' sticker on the outside to make any handlers more aware. There were more broken cookies than there should have been, but they still 'eat'.

The product was shipped by U.P.S.  It was clearly marked "Chocolate - Store in a cool dry place."  It was, nonetheless, left at my doorstep when I was not home.  I do not know how long it had been sitting in the Florida heat before I got home, but the product was melted and all but inedible.It strikes me that I shuld have received a notice of attempt to deliver, and the product should be kept in a "cool dry place" until it could be accepted by me.

I know this is called "milk chocolate" but it is much different from a Hershey bar. Don't get me wrong those are good, too, but these are different. Like the difference between a good song and a symphony!This chocolate has a wonderful snap, a deep almost sweet/spicy/smoky/bitter flavor and wonderful smooth texture as it melts in your mouth. Almost a cross between a semi-sweet and a milk (but more on the milk side.) If you like dark chocolate, like I do, you will indeed like these. If you favor mild, milk chocolate, these push you a little further into chocolate heaven..I think you will like it there!If you have ever smelled wonderful chocolate cake or brownies baking, (and are sometimes disappointed that they don't taste as good as they smell) this replicates that aromatic experience into a intoxicating flavor. You will continue to experience the flavor even after you swallow. Very hard to resist these...I had to eat another chunk just to finish this review!

I really like this chocolate, at 41% it contains just a touch more cocao than most mid-range milk chocolate bars. Because of that, it's a little more bitter and a little stronger chocolate flavor, but still creamy enough and sweet enough to be milk chocolate. It has a nice snap when you break a cool bar, and it takes a moment to warm up enough to start melting on your tongue. When I eat good chocolate, I let the first bite dissolve on my tongue to better appreciate the scent, flavor and smoothness of it.This one is very smooth, it has a touch of lecithin which helps make for a smoother chocolate. The rest of the ingredients are cocao, milk, sugar, cocoa butter,, and vanilla.The flavor is very nicely chocolate. The wrapper says that there is a caramel flavor to it, but for me it tasted more toasty with a rich liqueur finish. The vanilla was barely noticeable but it did serve nicely as balance. It makes for a bar that's rich without being too rich and it's just a touch bitter like a good semi-sweet chocolate.I gave a piece to my dad who really seems to think chocolate is a food group and he was less enthused. He likes it well enough, but thought it was just a little too bitter and prefers the lower cocoa/higher milk and sugar bars made by other chocolatiers. He said "It's good, not great, but good."

I've used many cooking sprays and this refined coconut oil is the absolute best.  I use it religiously for eggs and omelets and they slide right off my stainless skillet.  The coconut is refined so that it is stable in high heat unlike olive and other oils that are not safe to use in high heat.Coconut oil has a buttery taste which I like too.  I highly recommend this cooking spray.I will also note that this spray is not like the coconut oil in the jar.  I've tried that too for my eggs and it does not work as well for a nonstick coating.  The spray is definitely different.

column9: great to have coconut oil as a spray
column10: I love this product and it's wonderful to have coconut oil in a spray can. I use it for everything that I want a spray oil for. I'm a huge coconut oil fan so this product was just made for me!The only reason I give it four stars is because the very first can stopped working after a few days. The spray push button seemed to "tip over" and would not dispense any oil, even though you could tell the cannister was clearly still about 95% full. That was a bummer since it's not cheap. I tried all sorts of things to get it spraying again without any success.Finally I broke down and began using the second can, and so far no issues with that. But I do subtract one star because of the defective mechanism which implies poorly made. If it happened to me perhaps it's happened to others as well.

column9: Best non-stick spray ever - and HEALTHY, too!
column10: I love this stuff. Coconut oil is so much healthier than other options, and most non-stick sprays contain ingredients I refuse to ingest. This stuff is great - I use it for everything (baking, crockpot, etc). Truly NONstick and HEALTHY!

I paid over $13.00 at local health/nutrition store for 1 can of spray.  I was very happy to find it for much less on Amazon.  It is still way more that spray Olive oil, but worth it in my opinion.  I think that it is much better for your health (please read up on all of the benefits of coconut oil) and it is better to use for higher heats than other oils.

I buy Just Tomatoes all the time. These are a staple in my home. I bring them to work in small tupperware so I can have a snack mid morning that is healthy. The taste is perfect. I usually buy the hot veggies and mix them with regular veggies. I find the hot flavor helps me to eat much slower and enjoy it more. This is a low calorie delicious snack that I will buy forever!
Love these. They are perfect when you are craving something crunchy and spicy. It is kind of expensive but they are good to have on hand for work snacks/traveling.

I keep them in my drawer at work also, for snacking on.  They are also awesome thrown into ramen noodles, or cup a soup.  I use the straight hot veggies, because I like it spicy.  Ok, I usually throw some red pepper flakes in my soup as well!  I highly recommend this product.

column9: You can't go wrong with a quality product from a dedicated Seller.
column10: You never tasted Vanilla Extract like this before. Sellers will help you with whatever you need. Very pleasant experience on both ends.

I was very excited to try this out as I've used mostly the generic seeming vanilla extracts from the grocery store.  Unfortunately in Beijing its hard to get even that stuff.  I was very excited to get the package and as soon as I opened the bottle I was really taken with the smell, its great!  I can't do a side by side test of the different extracts, but I made some cookies and pancakes with these, and they were delicious.  I am very satisfied with the quality of this vanilla.  Also the people at JR are very friendly people and enclosed a nice note so it feels good buying from them.

This extract is top grade and gives an excellent, if not hardy, vanilla flavor that permeates puddings, cake batters, and vanilla milk shakes.  I have only good things to say about this brand of vanilla extract.
Great product from a great company!  I used this to make ice cream and it has a rich vanilla flavor and fragrance.  The product was delivered in 3 day of my ordering it.  Excellent value too.
I love this extract.  It is reminiscent of the extract I remember from my youth.  Very flavorful and aromatic.  Equally impressive is the customer service you receive from these folks.

This extract is stronger than your normal vanilla. I made over a dozen cakes with this extract. It is dark in color. Stronger smell and taste. Everyone loved this vanilla. I used it in pies, puddings, cobblers. I want ever use anything but good vanilla. It is a rare treat and I always like the best. It goes a long way.It had a great price.Try some today and you will be amazed.Once you do you won't use anything else.
Excellent product.  Plus, the vanilla beans from this company arre great and come at a great price!

I ordered this with a 4 oz. bottle of chocolate extract from the same seller, and I am very impressed with their dedication to providing a quality product. The package was shipped quickly (I ordered on a Tuesday night and I had it on Friday afternoon via USPS Priority Mail.) and everything was wrapped securely and accompanied by a note sincerely thanking me for my order.This is one of the best vanilla extracts I've used. As soon as I take the cap off of the bottle it fills the immediate area with a wonderful aroma. I'm very pleased and will definitely order this from this seller again.
great vanilla i use it in all my recipes gives my cakes a great flavor
AWESOME! WONDERFUL! FANTASTIC! WILL DEFINITELLY PURCHASE AGAIN. Only problem is it won't last long. Next time will just buy a BIGGER bottle.

Had this over Thanksgiving 2011 for the first time. Very smooth finish even for someone who rarely or never has scotch. Little or no burn. No "peaty" taste. Super malty, almost like a caramel. If you are buying for a scotch-lover or for someone who loves whiskey and would like to try scotch, you can't go wrong with this label.
This candy variety pack is perfect for halloween when you have over two hundred tricker treaters. A very good value!! I'm quite happy with this purchase!
Arrived exactly as expected - great value for 2 large bags!  There were more of the Bits of Honey candy than I'd like, but overall, it was a great value.

column9: Great candy at a good price
column10: I ordered this candy for Halloween, and it arrived promptly with no breakages or damage whatsoever.  The Wonka series candy is a favorite around our household, and this year was no exception!  I like the larger bags as well - more to share with all the trick-or-treaters.

column9: Pretty tasty, but not chewy enough
column10: If you are a fan of Haribo, you will probably find these a bit... mushy, for lack of a better term. I like a chewier gummy product.The flavor is very nice, however, and not overly sweet, which I appreciated.

These are soooo good!  They are a bit larger than regular bagged gummi bears.  I can also confirm what the other person said about being "mushy," but I much prefer the texture of these to the regular gummies.  I would describe them as softer and tender.  But if you like the harder, more chewy version, you might not like these.I read in another spot someone complaining because they are yellowish instead of clear like they seem in the picture.  They are indeed slightly yellow (very pale) and not clear. So, if you are buying them as a decoration, beware!The only problem I have with them is not eating the entire bag in one sitting.

I have had the watermelon, mango, blue raspberry, and orange flavors of these gummi bears. They are delicious!  They are very flavorful.  They all taste like the flavors they are supposed to be.  We had bowls of these out at a party and everyone loved them.  I can't wait to try more flavors!
Gummi Bears arrived quickly and in good shape, not melted or all stuck together.  The grape flavor was not too artificial or overly sugary.  They made a great addition to our candy bar.

I got the cherry flavor which were awesome, but Maybe I should have picked one with mixed flavors for variety.They are bigger than normal gummie bears and I agree with them being mushy, but you can easily fix that by putting these in the fridge for a while. :) they were perfect after that.
Great flavor, though a little chalky. The only problem being that the quantity is too large for just one flavor. It gets old after a while.
if you like gummy bears and are looking for mango flavored, then this is it.  My family loves these gummies.  the best anywhere... I did my homework, trust me.  I'm a candy freak!!!
They have the best flavor and are so fresh. I order other flavors also with the same results. So Yummy!

column9: As always with Rothschild very good
column10: Bought as a Christmas gift fro my brother.  He managed to share and it was very good stuff.  Recommened for anybody that likes Rothschild dips even if your not into martinis.
These candies bring back great memories from my childhood. The product is beautifully packaged. I will now know where to shop when searching for an exceptional gift.

We loved it.  The time capsule package was a nice idea.  Lots of candy and candy bars.  The ice pack kept the candy bars from melting!  Great idea.  Some of the smaller candy had doubles so the family was able to share.  Nicely done, we really enjoyed the walk down memory lane.  Thanks!
I would have given this a 5 star but the container was not completely sealed. I took off the cap and the seal was partially lifted up. I have used it several times and the flavor is great.

It is so refreshing to find a canned cat food that will work as a meal in a second.  Five out of our six cats (all with completely different tastes) will devour this immediately.  There is no smelly oil or sauce dripping from the can as you try to open it.  The ingredients speak for themselves.  While my cats are usually on an organic raw diet, this canned cat food works as a substitute when I am in between orders, or as a quick fix when I am just too tired to mix and dish out the raw.  While they love their raw food, sometimes I almost think they are hoping it is "Avoderm for dinner".

column9: My cats go crazy for this
column10: My cats absolutely love Avoderm Chicken & Duck. They definitely have their preferences within the Avoderm products, but as a pet mom, I am so happy to see brands like Avoderm taking the initiative to use wholesome real food ingredients in their products. I am a proud Avoderm supporter and can really see the difference in my cats energy level and in how shiny and soft their fur is since switching to Avoderm.
My cat loves this.  Quality ingredients, and the avocado in it helps keep her coat healthy and shiny!  It's food I feel good about feeding her.

I moved to California a few years ago and discovered this product at my local supermarket.  All of their flavored coffees are outstanding - great tasting, very smooth and none of that artificial aftertaste you sometimes get with flavored coffee. This is my favorite, but the Chocolate Macadamia is a close second.Recently, I moved back to New York and started buying other brands of french vanilla/vanilla nut coffees as a substitute but found that many of them tasted like tepid syrup water. I'm so glad to have found this on Amazon, and plan on stocking up until I return to California because I cannot part with a good coffee.

column9: Wellness Puppy Food seems to have quality ingredients
column10: I have been feeding this to my puppy.  I am happy and comfortable about the ingredients that she is eating.  They are 'human quality' according to the label and they seem to be all either real food or vitamins. I like the fact that she is getting real chicken, salmon, fruits,  vegetables and healthy grains without the fillers and by-products.

My shetland sheepdog puppy loves this brand of puppy food!  He likes it, and I like because it's good for him.  This brand has been known to cause loose stools.  Every puppy/dog is different, but you should be warned beforehand.  That problem aside, this is an excellent product!

I would highly recommend this to those who keep their pups indoors. My two chihuahuas love it and poop less. They like its taste and I like the fact that it doesn't smell rotten like some big brands do.

I just recently got a Boxer puppy and did some research about dog foods prior to committing to a particular brand.  I found alot of positive results for Wellness so I gave it a try.  Well, when I took my Boxer to the Vet and the Vet asked what I was feeding him, I told her and she immediately stated she knew it was not a "typical" dog food.  His coat alone is beautiful, plus he is becoming a well developed adult very quickly.  While Wellness is a little higher in price, my puppy absolutely loves all the foods.  Dry, wet, treats!!!

column9: Good stuff... replace coffee and tea
column10: Ok first cran energy is caffeinated.... it has 55 milligrams of natural caffeine per serving.  Second its low calorie... only 35 calories per serving.  And last it taste great.  I used it to replace energy drinks and coffee.  Note its only 23% juice... thats how they get the low calories I rekon.

I absolutely loooooove this juice. My local grocery store stocked it faithfully for a few months and I faithfully bought 2 to 3 64oz bottles every week and then they just stopped carrying it! I feel like I need to stop by the local methadone clinic!! I want my Pomegranate Cran-Energy juice...sniff, sob :'(
My Doggie says YUMMY! a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p

This brand of dog treats is by FAR the most loved product of its kind my two miniature schnauzers have ever had for snacks. I have been feeding it to them for many years.  We  have tried other things but my babies always prefer the Purina TBonz!
I eat this cereal every morning!  It tastes good and keeps my system in check!

column9: It's all I eat for breakfast now
column10: I love this cereal.  It's crunchy and slightly sweet-much better tasting than any other "flakes" I've had.  And it's sooooo filling.  My work makes it difficult to eat between 9am and 2pm (the time I'd normally eat the majority of my calories).  This cereal gets me through without making me feel overly full or bloated (unlike, say, grapenuts or oatmeal).  And then there's all the benefits of flax and fiber.  My 3 year old likes it.  Even my husband likes it and he's very adverse to "health foods".  I'm a big fan.  I just wish I could buy it in larger bulk.

I have been eating this cereal for a couple of years now and I really like it. It has lots of fiber and great taste. I like buying it in the 3 big boxes and have it automatically delivered by Amazon. Very convenient.

My father-in-law loves these particular candies,Rademaker Hopjes that are made in Holland, and has had trouble finding them in town because the place he had always bought them could no longer get them, so I went on-line and found them here. It seemed to be the best amount for the money. He was happy when I surprised him with them. The only problem is now he will continually bother me to order him more.

I still don't understand how this isn't sold on the west coast. Being a Bostonian, I miss the little things, like Fluffernutter sandwiches. The horrid goo they sell out here is nothing compared to this tub of absolute awesome. You bet I'll be ordering more!
I moved to CA and after 3 years I had hit my limit -- I needed to have fluff again!!  I'm so happy I was able to get some.
The price paid was fair for the quality. I would prefer a finer grind to get more flavor from the grounds. It is a mild roast but has a good flavor. For being organic the price can't be beat.

My boyfriend puts hot sauce on EVERYTHING....and he is super picky about what he likes, so we have both tried so many hot sauces its not even funny. All of Veri Peri's sauces are by far the best and I can say with 100% certainty the search for the perfect hot sauce is over!!

I travel a lot and LOVE Spicy food! I make it a point to pick up hot sauces where ever I go. Of all the hot sauces I've gathered, from every where from New Orleans to Mexico, this is one of the best.  Love the range of flavors.  Especially the garlic.

I highly recommend VERI PERI Hot Sauce.  It adds tons of flavor and just the right amount of heat.  It's versatile and will liven up any dish.  You NEED to try this sauce and the other varieties!  Simply the best!!

column9: Better than something you'd find in the supermarket!
column10: I was a bit hesitant at first but this sauce is awesome.  I made a casserole dish and added a bit for extra flavor and everyone raved about it.  Def. a must have for your kitchen cabinet.
This is by far the BEST hot sauce that I have ever tried.  It is uber flavorful and the hot is just the right amount.  I use it on almost everything that I make.  It's definitely a go-to condiment!

I love this product!!  The hot isn't so hot it burns your mouth and the garlic added a perfect kick to grilled chicken. Highly recommend!! (Try the Hot on pizza...it's wayyyy better than regular tabasco sauce)

Trying to be more adventerous in everything I do, I gave Veri Peri sauce a whirl. Friends had tried it and raved. Because it is an emulsion, it can be used as a marinade which adds a whole dimension to foods like chicken and pork. And , an added plus, spicy foods rev up digestion so I've actually lost a few pounds...coincidence? Anyway, you will not be disappointed...try it!!

column9: Really good hot sauce - different than anything else.
column10: I use hot sauce on everything and try most hot sauces..but I don't like too too hot. This hot sauce has a kick but also adds a good taste to whatever you're eating. It's really flavorful and doesn't taste like your average hot sauce. Great on things like eggs, pasta, pizza, meat, rice.. I put it on everything! Sooo good. If you like hotter, my brother gets the hot one and loves that too.
This was the best stuff for my first trimester!  Even my husband enjoyed nibbling on it. Not too sweet and full of ginger flavor.

My concern before this was ordered was if it was made in the USA.  My e-mail was quickly answered with a yes.  If you are a crystallized ginger lover this is the place to get it.  GREAT price and GREAT taste.  We will order from this site again.  The only problem I have with it is keeping my husband from devouring it before I can use it in my baking.

My son has been enjoying Beechnut fruits and veggies since 6 months old, and I've been perfectly happy with them.  I got some of the other combinations on a whim when he was ten months old to try out.  One of them was this Country Breakfast mix.My son, normally not a picky eater, took one bite and refused adamantly to eat more.  At first we took his behavior for simple stubbornness and tried every trick we knew to get him to eat, but as the hour ticked on and neither his father nor I could make headway, we both tried the food ourselves.After that we threw out the jar and opened up some peach puree as an apology to my son.  The country breakfast tastes terrible.  I don't mean it tastes just odd or bland. It tastes like dirty dishwater that has sat for several days.  I can't believe we were trying to feed our son that!  So, we'll not be getting anymore of that particular mix--though I'm happy enough with Beechnut product for their standard fruit and veggie mixes.Please be aware that you probably don't want to order this in bulk unless you're sure your child already likes it and will eat it.  Otherwise it will be a waste of your money.Happy eating! ^_^ Shanshad

We purchased this at a local grocery store and haven't been able to find it since then...anywhere!  My 1 year old son LOVES this meal!  It doesn't smell bad (I don't taste his foods for him.) and he never turned away from it!

I have over the years ordered many brands of Biscotti from Amazon.com as it is my source for many items I can't find near my home.  When I saw the cobination of "CHERRY/CHOCOLATE/AMARETTO" Biscotti I was naturaly intriged and ordered three of the 9 oz boxes.  They arrived early and I headed right to the K-cup coffee maker for a strong Italian Roast to go with my newly found Biscotti.  It was love at first bite with delightful flavor's.  I have traveled all over Europe and throughout the Italian country side.  I have eaten every kind of Biscotti there is (I think) but, there is one that stands alone in quality/flavor/taste combinations and that is Bella's Home-Baked Biscotti.  As I said I ordered three 9oz containers and they were gone in a matter of a few days.  I liked this combination so well I ordered ten more containers with five being other flavors offered but, I am sure I will settle for just the one with cherries as my first choice of their offerings.  If you love Biscotti as I do or even if you want to try it out for the first time try Bella's with a good strong roast coffee and you will be back for more.  I have to offer kudos to Amazon.com for offering so many choices of everything and ensuring that the complete experience is rated A-1

column9: Great Product but My Dogs Won't Eat It
column10: Great product by Iams but my two mini pinschers would not eat it until they were starving.  I had them on the yellow package puppy Iams and they seemed to like that more.  Don't get me wrong the product is solid with healthy ingredients but my dogs just wouldn't take it.

I purchased this on Dec 21 for a New Years arrival. It arrived on Dec 23. Off to a good start. I served this hm on New Years day to 8 people. They all loved it. One of them asked for Burger's Smokehouse contact info so she could order one next time. It was flavorful, not too salty, moist and tender.What I did was wrap it up in foil like the instructions said and baked at 325. I then removed it from the oven, cut off the skin and fat and glazed it under the broiler.Don't let the fact that it comes with it's skin and fat intact scare you off. This ham is delicious and the fat cap helps keep it moist. It made excellent fried ham for breakfast the next day and great ham sandwiches for lunch.One clue to a quality ham is when you cut open the wrapper, a bunch of juice doesn't leak out which tells the consumer that this ham didn't have water added like many do. There are so many grades to ham that most people aren't aware of. They go in order of quality as follows:HamHam with natural juicesHam with water addedHam and water productFor special occasions, most people want one of the two highest grades which are not easy to find in your local grocery store.This "city ham" is one with natural juices but it certainly comes very close in quality to the higher grade "ham".This is one of the best hams I've had.
I got these for my husband and he really loved them.  The seasoning was tasty, but not too overpowering.  The nuts seemed to be high quality.  We'll definitely get more.

My cat eats this every night and she laps it up.  She seems to prefer this to the "roasted" and the "grilled" beef versions.  This smells "beefy" and has a thick sauce over the morsels.  Somehow, she is a Fancy Feast cat and I cannot win her over to other organic cat food brands.
This is so convenient. I get the cat's food delivered and I am not running around trying to find the type of catfood he likes.

I first recieved this as a gift from my sister who knew that I was on the hunt for the old "Bubs Daddy" bubble gum.  I found out that the Bubs Daddy recipe was purchased by the Super Bubble company and my sister found the gum on Amazon.It tastes EXACTLY as I remember it tasting as a kid.  Its a strong (not overly strong) grape taste and the flavor lasts longer than most bubble gums.After my niece had some of my gum, I bought her a box as a gift.  It arrived WELL before it was promised, its packaged well and the gum tastes great.If you or anyone in your life is a grape-aholic like me, they will love this gum!  Once again, Amazon comes through with a hard-to-find product!

We were talking about awesome grape bubble gum from our childhood at work recently. I got on Amazon and found this box of Super Bubble Grape. I bought it and it arrived quickly. I took it to work and we have gone through this box very quickly. This is a great grape-flavored gum!

The grape flavor tastes so good. The flavor goes away in like 30 seconds but I was expecting that. Your jaw will hurt because you will non stop chew for months. Grape also tastes much better then the assorted flavor ones.
These candies were purchased for use as on a candy buffet as a wedding favor. Grape isn't my favorite flavor, but purple was one of our colors, so these looked great on the buffet.

I bought the Super Bubble Grape, Original and Apple flavors in the 300 count packs.  The arrived in a timely manner.  The packing and quality of the product was great.  I have noticed that some of the pieces are a little smaller than they used to be.  I love Super Bubble gum so i will probably by this product again.

One word.  Professional.  From confirmation of order to speedy delivery via UPS, to an extremely safe and professional packaging job.  I could not ask for better service that what I received and I am a repeat customer because of it.

Tuna is a big hit with my kitties, so I knew they would love this pate, and they did!  They always go nuts when I open a can of tuna for myself, so now when I do, I will keep these on hand so they don't feel so bad!  And it has vitamins and supplements in there too, so it makes for a great little meal for them.  Love it!

The taffy had very weak flavor - most of the time it was impossible to determine what the flavor was, Every piece tasted the same regardless of the color. The taffy arrived in 5 one pound grease stained cardboard boxes. I could not determine what caused the grease stains. I would never purchase any more candy from this site. Only the ants seemed to enjoy this candy.

column9: I had to spit it out
column10: I really tried to like this stuff, I tried about 20 pieces (different flavors) and I had to spit them out they were so gross. The texture is soggy, the flavor is weak (can't figure out what most of the flavors are supposed to be), and there's this terrible, lingering aftertaste that's something akin to Pine-Sol - you know, the floor cleaner. I love salt water taffy, but this stuff was inedible. Don't waste your money on this!

column9: The salt water taffy was stale and hard as a rock!
column10: The taffy arrived in a box and not in a sealed plastic bag as one would expect.  The taffy is stale and hard as a rock.  This is the worst salt water taffy I have ever attempted to eat.  Do NOT buy this item, as you will be forced to send it back as soon as you get it, wasting time and money.

The descripton promises all sorts of flavors.  True, what is there is pretty good.  But I bought this for my daughter's family in May.  Her husband loves licorice.  A sample package they bought in Las Vegas had the licorice flavor included, but in 5 lbs of taffy - there was not a single piece of licorice in this order!  She was very disappointed, and therefore, so was I.  I can understand now why a 2-lb bag of licorice is suggested as a purchase to accompany this.  But 7 lbs???  That's what it would be to buy both.  Well, eventually I did buy the 2 lb bag of licorice, but not from this seller.  Also, this product does not have the Taffy Town tags that the sample from Las Vegas, and also the 2-lb bag I purchased, have on the candy wrappers.  I don't know what that is all about.
As specified and on time. However, this is too much of a good thing.  I have been stuffing myself each night for the past two weeks.

column9: Salt Water Taffy made by Taffy Town
column10: I ordered a 5-pound bag of assorted taffy (Taffy Town brand) through my Amazon.com Prime account because my kids really wanted some, and my daughter had recently gone on a trip to a taffy-making factory.  She liked it a lot, so we found this product, though it wasn't the same brand she'd had on her trip. However, she said it was just as good; I've tried some also and agree with her opinion.  BTW, 5 lbs. is a lot of candy!

column9: Old and hard as a rock
column10: The first time we ordered this it was so good. This time old and hard as a rock. We use it in a trade show so now left up in the air........Thankfully Amazon has such a good return policy.

This claims to be Taffy Town taffy,not even close the saltwater taffy I know. It is hard,bad assortment,and overall flavor sucks.  Also, every real piece of Taffy Town taffy I've had has the logo on the rapper, not this stuff. Find the real stuff elsewhere, you'll be glad you did.

The flavor of the taffy was good (not at all "watery" as stated in other reviews). However, the taffy was quite stiff, and did not seem very fresh.Additionally, this taffy is made with evaporated milk, which was a problem for several people in our family who have milk allergies. I was totally unaware that salt water taffy could/would contain milk.

I remembered watching slat water taffy being pulled in a candy shop window and was sick of the rock hard variety I would find in bags in our super market, so I turned to the Internet.  I was not disappointed.  This taffy is soft and delicious.  I would definitely order from fastparts again.

THIS SALT WATER TAFFY ORDER ARRIVED AHEAD OF SCHEDULE, WHICH WAS REALLY NICE.  IT ALSO ARRIVED AS DESCRIBED.  THIS WAS A GIFT FOR SEVERAL INDIVIDUAL AND THEY ALL LOVED THE TAFFY.  THE TASTE WAS EXCELLENT AND IT WAS A GREAT ASSORTMENT OF FLAVORS.  WOULD DEFINITELY BUY AGAIN FROM THIS SELLER.  THANK YOU FOR A GREAT PRODUCT AND GREAT DELIVERY!

I have ordered from this company before, and I always receive very quick, reliable service. The product(salt water taffy) is absolutely delicious, fresh, and wonderful.  I bought several pounds for stocking stuffers this year. I figure, if I love it this much, everyone on my list will!

The package was sent out quickly. The inside packages were all shrink wrapped to protect the freshness. It was a bit of a challenge to get it opened, but with the taste of my first piece, I was grateful they protected it so well. It was very fresh, very tasty, many new flavors I had not tried before. I highly recommend this seller and this assortment of salt water taffy. It is one of the best I have ever had. Thanks you made my day!
This taffy is delicious.  The packaging they have now seems different from before, and it keeps the taffy very fresh!  Yum!  This is my favorite treat!
This brand has a wide variety of flavors.  This makes a great gift or when you want to satisfy your sweet tooth.

For many years would order salt water taffy from Shrivers in Ocean City, NJ. Great stuff but the cost of shipping and the product is putting them out of reach in terms of total cost. Salt water taffy from Taffy Town is pretty good stuff the flavors are similar to Shrivers.

I have just recently become addicted to salt water taffy-thanks to beach club resort at Walt Disney world. (The restaurant there leaves you a handful of salt water taffy after you eat.) So since I live in Florida have not had the easiest time trying to find  real salt water taffy. I had been buying it at Bealls department store, but it was getting expensive. So i got the 5 lb bag to split with my son. This taffy by taffy town DOES have a salt flavor, but I like it. The flavors are all pretty good. Only one tasted chemically, still don't know what it was supposed to be. But most you can name & nail first bite! I'm having fun eating this candy. It came fast & fresh, I would buy it again. The assortment is pretty good too. They are not as hard & chewy as the ones you find in a box at department stores they are a little softer, but still fun to eat. Def. a great value too.
this tea is VERY mild. it came on time and was well packaged, not quite the flavor i wanted but it is a good drink

Bought those rememebring my fave candy from back home. They are good but a tad too sour for what I expecting.. just the tiny difference in between sour fun and just sour sour.. :)like you kinda of hurt when eating it rather than just have the tingling sensation
Although you might think wax teeth are just for children, they served as a fun trick-or-treat item at a Halloween party for adults! Very happy with my purchase, would buy again.
My son loves the Andy Capp hot fries but they are way too hot for me.  I like these. They have such a good flavor and texture. Warning: they are addictive!
Good price....Cheddar is our favorite of Andy Capp's fries.  Very fresh with a long expiration date.  Will purchase again and recommend as long as price is right

I am not in favor of this fry. I loved the white cheddar fries. They were said to be returning last October and have not. This fry is no where near the white cheddar. Will not purchase any more from Andy if this is the best he can do.
Kit had everything needed minus vegetables and meat. Instructions were easy to follow and the final sushi tasted great!

column9: Good stuff, though the book sucked.
column10: Came quickly and in great condition, though I will say I didn't care for the book. Wasn't very helpful, so I bought another book that was filled with all kinds of useful info.
Great product, very well presented in box.  Bought it as a gift and the recepient loved it.

Just tried my hand at sushi making for the first time with this kit. One mistake I made was that I did all the rice for my first time; which ended up being more then I wanted to make. I also will have to disagree with the book which says it only takes 5 minutes of de-starching/washing the rice. It took me an hour of constant washing to get it clear. The sushi book isn't really the best for recipes, at least the ones I like. It also suggests using items like turkey/chicken; which, seems too strange for me to even bother trying. The texture and flavor do not make sense for sushi.
I got this as a gift for my sister who loves sushi. She loves it and said it has everything she needs right there to make it herself.

column9: Without a doubt: the BEST honey ever!
column10: I first had Attiki honey on a visit to Greece in 2001.  It spoiled me for any other honey.  It is thick, almost taffy-like, with a full-bodied flavor.  I recommend it to everyone I know...and now I recommend it to you.

This is the perfect curry for Curried Chicken Salad.  We don't eat it that often and a can lasts us about a year.  The metal can and lid keeps it fresh.For the best taste, add a little water to a Tablespoon or so of curry powder to make a thick paste and let it rest for at least 30 minutes.  We then measure out the amount of mayonnaise needed for the chicken salad.  Blend in a little of the curry powder at a time until you get the flavor intensity you desire.We usually make it with 13 oz of canned chicken, diced onions, diced celery, chopped pecans/walnuts and the curried mayonnaise.  You can also add, diced hot or bell peppers, diced tomatoes, etc.

This is great stuff. We are not really officinados for curry, but this is a signature meal when my wife makes it. We have tried other powders and this is certainly the best for us.It has become the most popluar meal of choice when our adult children come to visit. Our problem has been determmining where we can purchase this product.

The mix could not be easier - just add water.  Texture is good and they are flavorful, but they're a tad salty as a plain sugar cookie. The add ins for various types of cookies are easy, and pretty tasty.
We love this mix. Got it at Christmas at the big box stores but couldn't fi d it again. So easy to use when making big batches.
This is my favorite tea, hot or cold. It has a beautiful fragrance. I like that it is individually packaged, keeping it fresh.

my baby has one of these in her fist most of her waking hours. and i think it's GREAT that she can't take a bite out of them -- that's the POINT of teething biscuits! you're not supposed to chew 'em up, your supposed to rub your baby gums and teeth against them, to sooth the teething irritation. (a teething biscuit that breaks easily is a totally dangerous teething biscuit, a choking hazard! so, please, ignore the negative review on this page, where someone complains the baby can't chomp 'em to bits. that's exactly why these are excellent!)

I love the product, they're yummy....however, my baby has choked as well as another friends baby while using these...they tend to break off and don't dissolve too fast. I'm sure when my baby is older they may be ok, but def a choking hazard!!

My son really likes these and hasn't been able to bite off any chunks. I like that they're made from organic oats and a handful of other recognizable ingredients. No wheat or soy. The simple ingredients look like something I could easily make at home, which is nice to see. At close to $7/lb, they'd better be pretty darned close to homemade quality and these certainly are.The only complaints I have are that they're a bit sweet and they leave brown muck on his clothing. Make sure your baby is wearing a bib before eating these! The sweetness isn't a huge issue and the biscuits don't seem to have much sugar in them, but these definitely fall closer to the "cookie" category tastewise. I think they're quite delicious, actually.I'd recommend breaking them in half before giving your child a biscuit, as they're longer and are likely to be dropped well before a dent has been made in them.

These teething biscuits are great. Our ten month old loves them. He will suck and chew on them until they are gone. Like another reviewer said, they do make a mess, but so does most food at that age.  I love the all natural organic ingredients.  These are very hard, which is as it should be since they are teething biscuits.
My baby enjoys gnawing on these cookies, they do not break off which is exactly what is needed of a teething cookie.

After reading the reviews on these teething biscuits, I was so excited I ordered a case of them. They're still sitting in my cupboard three months later. After a couple tries and near choking incidents, I have decided to wait on giving any more to my son. He is a beginning chewer and could not handle the large pieces. I would recommend using these for older kids ONLY. Had the same negative results with Earth's Best Teething biscuits. The only teething biscuits I recommend for actual teething babies are the Mum Mums. Those melt in the mouth, so no possibility of choking and keep my car relatively crumb free. Win, win.

Our 9 month old loves these. We don't necessarily use them for teething, per se, but he loves to gnaw on them at mealtimes. We started using them because we like the wholesome ingredients AND they are a decent source of iron (he has low levels). He is able to gnaw off pieces, for sure, but we've  never had any choking or even gagging. The mess on his hands and face wipes off easily afterwards, but I can see how that might be an issue if he was wandering around the house. As an added bonus, he smells like yummy maple for several hours after eating one. :-)
These are sturdy and easy for baby to hold. While they do make a mess, my babies thoroughly enjoy chewing on them. I am glad to have a healthy option!

The product was ok. I like that it has no dairy, as I was unable to find any that my son, who has a dairy allergy, could have. I ordered 2 vanilla boxes and 2 maple boxs. The vanilla arrived fine, but both maple boxs came broken. I did not feel comfter able giving my babies broken pices. I emailed the company twince to see if they would replace them and I have not heard anything. i also tried to call them, but their coustomer service number doesnt work. I WILL NOT be buying anything from this company again!!

My 11-month old twins seem to enjoy these maple-flavored biscuits very much.  However, they are quite crumbly for teething biscuits.  Several in each box are either broken or have hairline fractures causing them to crumble easily.  I have to test each biscuit and I can't leave them unattended for even a second, because they gag on crumbs routinely, so I must be present to fish them out.  Perhaps I just got a bad box and the next one will be great.

I have been purchasing these for several years. The kids liked them, and continued to like them after they got their teeth, then the adults started eating them, and we've just kept buying them.  But our last order contained 12 boxes of burned, over baked biscuits that no one could eat.  We plan to keep buying, and hopefully that won't happen again.

column9: Break off, have to watch the baby
column10: My baby isn't in love with them or anything, but when he does teeth on them, they seem to break off really easy. I've had to take chunks out of his mouth. He hasn't choked on them so far, but I have to watch him when he has the biscuit. I was hoping for something sturdier. They are basically like a dry dense cookie. Not dense enough, though.

column9: Delicious and desirable for babies without teeth
column10: These teething bisquits are actually pretty good, much like a graham cracker. Our baby's teeth started coming in at 3 months. Now, at 8 months, she is a very toothy baby. She can easily bite off pieces of this teething bisquit. Unfortunately, that makes her choke, as these are designed to be a slow dissolver. We had to take them away, even though she loved them.I highly recommend these over any other teething bisquit for kids who are teething but do not have the ability to bite off a piece.
These are great and my boy loves them. No sugar or other nasty stuff, and they stay solid for a long while, making choking less likely. A+++

They smell good, but my baby isn't interested.  She sucks on them for a minute or two but then chucks it on the floor.  I think part of it may be the biscuits are too hard.  Unlike other teething biscuits that eventually give the baby something to eat and swallow, these remain rock hard.  That said, my baby does like to chuck stuff on the floor.

These teething biscuits are great, if you HOVER OVER YOUR CHILD THE WHOLE 4 DAYS it takes to eat this mess factory. Holy Crap, my daughter almost needed a Steel Wool pad to get the dried gunk off her body. She had it everywhere, on her nose, in her nose, her eyebrow, her elbow, armpit and legs...plus the high chair needed a pressure washer! I seriously think concrete is mixed in with this recipe. The first time we gave one of these teething jaw-breakers to our daughter we realized we would be up until midnight by the time she finished slurping the brick down. Fortunately, my husband who will eat anything ate it and said it was actually tasty. Kind of like those first generation Power Bars, you know, the ones that tasted like eating your front yard. Needless to say, our daughter did not CHOKE THE FIRST TIME, BUT SHE DID THE NEXT and we have decided that she will not have these anymore, unless they have soaked in a vat of water for three days. These things are so dense they are probably like sea monkeys...they probably expand to the size of our house, so we will soak them in an igloo cooler in the backyard.Still, prior to our daughter choking on these teething bricks we did discover their magical powers. The next morning after her first gnaw session, our daughter was walking, talking and was even potty trained. My husband called me into her room the next morning and to my surprise, there my little 9 month old girl stood there holding her soiled diaper (yes, she undressed herself as well) yelling at my husband how she was sick and tired of having to pee on herself all of the time. We knew right then, the teether had something to do with this. We have been cautious thus far with giving her more since we do not fully understand the powers this biscuit holds! Thinking it would effect adults the same way, my husband bought a case and ate them over the next three days. He did not get smarter, but he has been constipated for the past 3 months and he cannot stop drooling. The second time we provided our daughter with one of these we found her the next morning downstairs watching Good Will Hunting yelling at the screen disproving all mathematical theories presented to the screen. Yep, our daughter then decided to build a nuclear fission reactor in my husbands shower! All I can say is be cautious of the biscuits power...your little Junior might be telling you how to change your oil the next morning or how to cook his eggs!- Show quoted text -

column9: So excited to find this candy & then disappointed when delivered.
column10: I was so excited to finally find this candy this year because it is my guilty pleasure from childhood and I could not find it locally this year.  I bit the bullet and ordered two bags for $11.50 with my Prime shipping.  When the box arrived the package was WAY smaller and so were the eggs.  For the price and quanity you would think this was a premium candy.  I am very disappointed with Brach's this Easter season and not sure I will ever buy these again.

I, too am disappointed.  The first time I saw this, I was excited.  I was thinking I would be buying at least 10 bags for that price.  Maybe they were about $1 to $2 a piece.  So after my bubble was "bursted"  I went on the Brach's web site.  The price for the 7 oz bag there was reasonable.  It had a feature that allowed me to receive an email when the product was in stock.  I have also looked high and low for the past two years.  What is going on?  I know I am not the only person besides the ones who commented that love these little candy "eggs"!!  Why the inflated price, I ask you?  Tsk, Tsk, Tsk.  And I am craving this like nobody's business!!  Oh, well.  The search continues.

I have looked all over for these delightful easter eggs for my grandchildren for a hunt this Sunday. But, you can believe me, I won't be buying these!! What a disappointment for me and the children. This is as bad as gas, it's price Fixing. Shame on you Brach's.

I agree...with the other two reviews.  What a joke.  Now the price is $14.49.  That is insulting.  I love this candy and look for it every year.  This is an insult though.  I would never pay this much...on principal alone.Note that I wanted to give 0 stars...but it wouldn't let me.

I haven't bought a lot of Easter candy beyond jelly  beans and chocolate rabbits for a long time. But this year I wanted something different, so I started looking for these candy coated marshmallow eggs.They were a favorite of mine in the past, but I guess they have fallen out of favor. I cannot find them anywhere locally, so I thought I'd check online. Amazon is my go to site for things I can't find, but $9.00 for a 7 oz bag of candy? I don't think so. Jelly beans again this year.

Got this candy as a gift for my dad.  He loved these and we couldn't find them anywhere.  After a lot of looking I knew I was going to be paying an arm and leg for these candies so I broke down and ordered them.  They came fairly quickly.  Dad  was really excited and shared one with me for my effort but they were TERRIBLE!  I used to love these candies too, as a kid, but this was not them.  These were HARD and STALE.  Dad did not complain because its not his style but he deserved so much better.In the end, while I was willing to spend the extra money expecting a great candy, they did not come anywhere close to the mark!!  Will not buy again!!

****This Cranberry Weightless tea is lovely, and has a marvelous taste. It seems to work as a diuretic, which isn't a bad thing, since it does so by promoting urological health. It probably does contribute to "Weightless" (weighing less) but only by ridding your body of excess water; still, if it can do this in a healthy way, I'm all for it. I like drinking it as a calming ritual before meals, which for me has some value, too. It seems to work for me; even more importantly, I enjoy it.The ingredients in Traditional Medicinal's Weightless Cranberry are: bitter fennel fruit 150 mg, red clover blossom 150 mg, uva ursi leaf 135 mg, cranberry fruit concentrate 60 mg, cleavers herb 52.5 mg., as well as a proprietary blend of: organic hibiscus flower, organic roasted chicory root, organic parsley leaf, and organic stevia leaf.Weightless Cranberry is part of a line by Traditional Medicinals that includes the original Weightless and a Weightless Cinnamon-Spice.Traditional Medicinals seems to be a responsible company. They adhere to sustainable and fair trade practices, use organic ingredients when feasible, and base their tea formulations on sound research and knowledge.The brewing instructions for this tea are very important: "For maximum benefit, medicinal tea must be properly prepared. Pour 8 oz. freshly boiled water over a tea bag in a cup. Cover cup and steep 10-15 minutes. These steps directly influence the amount of beneficial components that will end up in your teacup! Gently squeeze the tea bag to release any remaining extract.Drink 3 cups daily, one cup before each meal, for up to 2 weeks, then pause a few days before resuming." So, Weightless is a long-brewing pre-prandial tea...if you want it to work properly.Also note the following cautions: "Cautions: Tea containing bitter fennel fruit and uva ursi leaf are not for long-term daily use without medical advice. Contraindications: Not for use during pregnancy, while nursing, or by children under 12 years. Side Effects: Teas containing uva ursi leaf may cause nausea or vomiting in individuals and children with sensitive stomachs."****

column9: Tastes great and is good for you
column10: This tea tastes great and is good for you. Cranberry tea is an excellent tool to help cleanse the lymphatic system as well.  The fennel in this tea is a light and delicious addition and it mellows out the flavor of the cranberry.
Weightless cranberry tea is great for getting rid of water retention! I followed the directions, and I noticed that my jeans fit better.
I just love the taste of this tea. The weird thing is it cuts your craving for sweets. I drank it in the morning and before bed and lost 20 lbs.

I don't know if it really promoted weight loss, but it tastes great and is perfect on cold winter days. I will say that if I drank it late in the afternoon I felt like I had trouble getting to sleep, but that may be in my head.

It does what it says. weightless. It helped shed excess water around my waist, which women would love to lose. And also helped toned my uterus. Added benefit or cranberry. I urinated sometimes, guess because of UTI and never felt so great. No side effects what so ever and feel so lightweight.

column9: You can't beat it for a natural diuretic
column10: I love salt and shouldn't.  My biology causes me to retain water and shouldn't.  At least I don't think it should.  So I drink a lot of this tea, just to make sure I am not carrying a lot of water weight.  But I make sure I take potassium as well, so I don't mess myself up by flushing it all out.  Actually, to clarify, what I mean by I drink a lot of this tea is I have a Starbucks steel 22 oz hot beverage container, and I use 1 tea bag to 22 oz's, and throw in a little stevia for sweetening, and every now and then a dash of lemon juice.  I could drink herb tea all day long this way, it is the best way for me to get fluids.  I normally use only 1 tea bag with 22 oz of water a day, but sometimes I do 2 tea bags, with a total of 44 oz's of water, of this tea.  I would not recommend doing a cup of water per tea bag.  I have no idea if it would do you harm, and I am not saying it would, but it just seems if you are suppose to drink 8 glasses of water a day, or 60 to 80 oz's of water a day, that doing the largest amount of water that you can stand per tea bag won't do you harm.  I am talking any herb teas, but I happen to be reviewing this one.  Anyway, that is my experience with this particular herb tea.  I really like Traditional Medicinals brand of teas and use a lot of them in full protocols for addressing various health issues naturally.
This tea has a nice strong flavor and spicy flavor.  It is very concentrated.  They shipped it fast!!  Very good to get rid of the extra water weight.
Love this tea. Tge result is exactly what the advertisement states.  If yoy suffer from water retention it us recommended.

column9: Good Tea - not sure about weightloss claim
column10: Good Herbal tea - no ceffeine, refreshing taste. However, I cannot vouch for the wieghtloss claim. Maybe because I don't use it to lose weight or maybe because drinking the same quantity of any fluid (water?) before a meal will make you feel "full" anyway .....

So out of the 6 packs, 3-4 of them broke open. And since I wanted free shipping and combined my order into one package, my cute books also smelled like spoiled eggs. Three definitely popped open and the fourth one was opened a little bit but I didnt want to deal with contamination or anything so I threw them away. The remaining two were covered with the powder and smelled even though I washed the outside of the plastic so I had to triple pack it so it wouldn't make my kitchen smell ridiculously spoiled. And the bags are way big enough. I thought I was getting a great cheap deal for so much but if I could do this again I would buy it in a sealed jar and just the amount of one pacakage since most recipes only call for a few teaspoons or tablespoons anyways. Spice itself is super eggy in smell and taste so exactly what I wanted it for. Just not worth the clean up and excess waste you have to deal with and throw away.

I guess I didn't realize how much black salt I would be getting. It smells like eggs and there really isn't much use for it in many recipes. I'll have these for a long long time, I wouldn't buy it again.

This is the second time I've ordered the 4 pack of this coffee while on deploymen to Afghanistan.  Brewed in just a regular cheap drip coffee maker this coffee is outstanding!!!  I will order this on a recurring basis once I return to the states!! YUM!
Lavazza coffee is the best coffee ever, we love it, every pot brews up so smooth even when brewed very strong.

column9: The coffee is great, but other buyers were right: mysterious punch hole
column10: The coffe is really great, makes very aromatic, full bodied espresso.  I would just like to review the packaging more. I ordered several packs of these, packaged in bricks of 4, vacuum-packed, and covered with clear plastic. Very impressed because of the efficiency of packaging, very tightly packed. Of the 3 sets I ordered,  one set had one of the bricks with a punch hole at the bottom, seems mysterious since the clear plastic covering the 4 bricks was in no way punched and remained intact. It's just the one brick with the punch hole at the bottom. I wonder how it got that way. Anyway, this would have been 5-stars but for that. Highly recommend the coffee.

We love good coffee, but are not experts by any means. After Senseo stopped making their pods, we bought the Coffee Duck/Ecopad pack from Amazon but weren't sure which coffee to use in them.  Tried the Crema e Gusto based on high reviews and are happy we did! Best cup of coffee from our Senseo machine ever!  Much smoother and lower acidity than the Senseo coffee we were used to, and can get some nice crema when using the Ecopads. Price can't be beat, either!

My wife and I love this Italian coffee since we practically grew up with it...Out of the 4 in the pack, one of the bricks had lost its pressure but it still brewed greatly.The order arrived promptly and met expectation like the service provided.Thank you,M. & G.
Best Italian expresso coffee ever! It is a MUST to keep on hand and best served after dinner. Smooth, frothy, and never bitter.

I bought this to use with a 3 cup espresso maker.  This stuff seems to last quite a while, even though I fill up the holding dish to the top.  The espresso tastes great and in my opinion (if you flavor it right) is just as good or better than many of the coffee products that you can purchase that are made for you (aka starbucks, caribou, etc).  Buying it in the 4 pack also brings down cost quite a bit.Overall, a great product and highly recommended.  It is a very bold flavor, so if you aren't in to dark and bold coffee then beware.
This is my favorite coffee. I use it in my bialetti and it makes great espresso. Full and rich flavor. Somewhat hard to find in stores so u always buy on amazon.
This is an affordable and good coffee for my Gaggia Expresso machine. Good aroma, taste and price. I also like Illy, but the cost-benefit on the Lavazza is better... strongly recommend to all.
I love this stuff. Very smooth and rich. It is great to mix half and half with milk and just a little bit of sugar
others with a more 'soFISTicated' palet say its just OK. its fine on my taste buds and thats all that counts.  not too pricey, good aroma, good foam, all in all a good cup of espresso.nuff said.
What can I say more than in the title!! This is very good coffee. Every morning I enjoy my Cappucino!
Very good product, the price is fair. Fast shipping.I recommend to people who love coffee or espresso. Real italian taste. Enjoy it.
We make this every morning in our espresso machine. It is delicious. Definitely the way to go if you drink espresso every day.
Highly recommend w/ the AeroPress Coffee and Espresso Maker. Great coffee because of the taste and the aroma. Fast Shipment.

This coffee is so delicious--very smooth, with hints of mocha. It makes the most amazing cappuccino, too. With cream and sugar, this coffee is simply amazing. I purposely seek coffee shops that sell this brand of coffee because it is so delicious. Anytime I try other brands of coffee, I'm disappointed because it doesn't compare to the Lavazza brand of coffees. Buy it!
This brings me back to the time I spent in Europe. Better than any coffee at the supermarket for basically the same price. A no brainer here folks.

not okay for a drip coffee.  this fine grind does not work well in my drip machine and 3 out of 4 bricks arrived compressed and one not.will not buy again but will work for a one time deal.

column9: While I prefer the red Lavazza for a drip machine, this is perfect for my espresso needs.....
column10: Guys:Although the price recently went up, I received this 4-pack for $12 shipped (using Subscribe and Save and an Amazon clipless coupon).  Although it has a very high concentration of robusta beans (60 or 70%) instead of the market-favored arabica beans (40 or 30%),  it's the robusta beans which produce such an excellent creamy and rich crema, from both my stove-top espresso maker and my Nespresso machine (I fill my own home-made capsules with this brand...see Ne-Cap Nespresso® Compatible Refill Capsules ), and the espresso is absolutely perfect. No bitterness, just rich, dark and flavorful. Would buy again if it goes on sale (the Amazon price is still better than NYC supermarkets which sell one pack for $4.75),

My girlfriend and I prefer Lavazza over anything. We prefer the crema that Lavazza seems to produce better than other brands. This Creme e Gusto is superb (for a pre-ground). We always prefer to grind our own beans but we like to have a backup that is pre-ground for company so we can quickly make espressos without a lot of waiting between cups. We've tried several Lavazza pre-ground and all are pleasing, this is no exception. you aren't taking any chances here, except for a slightly higher-than-prefered price.

column9: For the ones who really love espresso coffee
column10: I love it!Exactly like a perfect italian espresso coffee should be.It's great for making a real italian cappuccino too!You'll love it.

I love this espresso coffee, it makes such a nice cup of espresso with an amazing crema.  It's very consistent and the flavor is smooth, however I have noticed that I get a major headache after drinking an espresso made with this coffee.  I am making it properly with the right amount of coffee so I know it's not that.  It's also not the caffeine since I drink drip coffee almost every day.  That leaves really one thing which is the robusta beans that is blended with arabica to make this coffee.Great coffee, just not for me and if anyone else experiences this then it's the robusta beans so just try another 100% arabic blend, it comes out good anyways.

A super fine grind that we find works perfectly in our espresso machine. Our decent grinder can't get it this fine and this produces great crema. The taste is nice and bold, and we love using drinking a couple shots of espresso with a couple tablespoons of condensed milk.

I love this coffee! It's so super smooth and yummy. I make it in my French press every Sunday morning. Highly recommended! I get it on subscription from amazon and the price is really great! Cheaper then the supermarket and I don't have to do a thing!

column9: Best coffee out there for Espresso machines
column10: I've tried just about anything when it comes to ground coffee for espresso machines, and nothing comes close to this Lavazza. I've been ordering it regularly for over a year now, and am very happy with it. It makes an espresso rich in taste and smell, with a pleasant hint of chocolate flavor (you can barely notice it). It certainly helps me start my day the right way!

column9: The best breakfast coffee we ever had
column10: We love Crema e Gusto for breakfast. It has the smooth and intense flavor of the coffee in Europe; no bitter or over roasted. There is nothing better.
LOVE THIS ESPRESSO, NEVER BITTER HAS A LIGHTER TASTE BUT IS TERRIFIC TASTING,I MAKE MY CAPPICCINO EVERY MORNING.NOT A DARK BLEND.

Using Lavazza Crema Gusto in my Moka is like being back in Italy. It makes a great cup of cappucino, without which I cannot start my day.  Rich flavor, strongly roasted but not burnt tasting.  The vacuum package keeps it very fresh.
The price at amazon varies for this product, it is competitive unless it gets to almost 30 for 4.  Quality is good.

Amazing espresso coffee! I strongly advise anyone who as the passion for espresso coffee to buy this brand! Although once in a while due to the packaging the bricks come with small holes making it loose it's freshness and vacuum properties...Besides this small problem it's definitely the best espresso coffee you can get in America!!!

After spending almost $5.00 a day for months at Starbucks on iced lattes with an extra shot, I finally got wise and did some research on Amazon. After purchasing an espresso maker, I had to find a quality espresso to go along with it. The description is 100% accurate. Smooth and not bitter. This is the best espresso I have ever tasted. Thank goodness I can order it from Amazon.

I recently bought an espresso maker  De'Longhi BAR32 Retro 15 BAR Pump Espresso and Cappuccino Maker  which I love, and wanted some good coffee to go with it.  Originally I was going to buy the illy espresso, but I saw this and it's cheaper and got great reviews, which are definitely well-deserved.  It's so delicious and I love the smell of the coffee - it's chocolaty.  MMMmmmmmmm.

I was enthralled with the coffee I was served in Florence, Italy years ago and brought some home.  Now, it's available in the U.S. and it's Lavazza.  My local market used to sell it and no longer does but amazon comes through for us.  The flavor is intense but not harsh and has a slight mocha flavor (at least to my untrained palate).  The only negative is my own fault by not noticing that I was ordering a 4-pack, so I have more than I need.  After giving one away to someone who probably won't appreciate it, I'm going to keep the rest and transport myself back to Florence every morning.  The grind is fine enough for an espresso maker but also works for drip makers, although you should use less than usual at first.  It's pretty strong.  Americans are inundated with choices of coffee these days, but I highly recommend trying Lavazza if you're a regular coffee drinker.  The price was very reasonable, even with the shipping.  Share the cost and product with 3 friends at first to give it a try.Ciao

I always buy Lavazza coffee. It has such a smooth taste and is a great value for the quality. I use Crema e Gusto with my Bialetti caffettiera and with my Breville espresso/cappuccino maker. I always get a lot of crema when I use this with my Breville machine. I've tried other brands but I always go back to Lavazza.

We're not really coffee experts, but have tried a few brands/roasts. This Lavazza Crema e Gusto has to be the best cup of coffee I've had. We've only used it in our drip maker so far, but will give it a try in our pump espresso maker soon. Yum, and highly recommended.

I used to buy only coffee that I could grind in the supermarket since I wanted the best possible espresso from my machine. However, I just moved to an urban area where I am unable to grind my own coffee conveniently (outside my home). So I searched on Amazon and found this coffee, which has excellent reviews. I figured it couldn't be better than freshly ground coffee, but that it was better than getting some old gross coffee from the convenience store across the street. Much to my and my boyfriend's surprise, this coffee makes much better espresso than any other coffee we have tried over the past few years (and we have tried many, including expensive coffee from Whole Foods). I don't know about the other blends from this brand, but if you like strong rich espresso, this one is AMAZING. Try it, and you'll see.

I first discovered this coffee while in Italy and was so happy to find it here.  It does have that chocolate underlay.  I typcally make a latte with it and have found it to make a perfect cup in my moka pot.
This coffee is great for espresso machines, but is a little weak in drip makers. Adding a little extra makes it great.

I bought this on a whim after some sporadic experience with an old, trusted roaster....  This is a very nice new taste for me.  It's a bit lighter roast than the two espresso roasts that I have been using.  It's got a nice, delicate taste that asks to be made on the strong side to show its best character.  I haven't bought ground coffee in many years, so this whole experience was a bit of a lark for me but I'm glad I tried it.  I'm using in a LaPavoni machine and a Moka rig and they're both working well with the grind as arrived.

column9: Smooth, incredible flavor - you'll never view your morning java the same way again!
column10: This coffee is soooooo smooth and flavorful - I absolutely love it! This coffee is so incredible you will never enjoy another brand again.

This is a dark, chocolaty cofee. Grind works well in my stovetop espresso maker. I have tried many different espresso blends and was not sure how this would be since it is a blend of robusto and arabica beans but it is rich, dark, and as others have remarked, not at all acidic or bitter. My new favorite.

I was an avid fan of the Lavazza Cafe Espresso (black can) for years.  I was about to sign up for the subscription service for this product on Amazon.com when I started reading the reviews about the Lavazza Crema e Gusto. One of my main concerns is if the acid in a coffee will give me an upset stomach.  The Cafe Espresso didn't at all, so I was leery to switch to something else.  I figured I'd give the Crema e Gusto a try and if it was too much for my stomach, I'd switch back.  No worries.  Not only is this a smooth blend, it has a richer taste than the Cafe Espresso.  I won't need to switch back!

column9: Lavazza Crema e Gusto is my daily coffee of choice
column10: I make coffee and espresso from Lavazza Crema e Gusto every morning. My friends love my coffee and Lavazza made with spring water is my secret.
I have always enjoyed this product and routinely order it from Amazon.  Thank you for stockingit, for it is hard to find.

I have always loved the coffee in Italy and it's the only place where I consistently drink cappuccinos - no bitterness, bite or overwhelming strong flavor, just great coffee.  Until we decided to give this coffee I try, we were unable to duplicate that Italian espresso flavor.  Now we can!  We've given up all of our other gourmet espresso blends and drink only this in our lattes, cappuccinos, mochas and Americanos.  And everyone we've shared this coffee with has done the same!  Try it - I'll be surprised if you're disappointed!

I am not a coffee connoisseur. I just wanted a cup of coffee that did not need tons of milk and sugar to cover the charred taste. Lavazza greatly surpassed my expectations. Now to get my hands on a Bialetti and begin my quest for the perfect cappuccino...

You can't go wrong with this [[ASIN:B001E5E0D8 Lavazza Crema e Gusto Ground Coffee, Italian Espresso, 8.8-Ounce Bricks (Pack of 4).  Nice espresso flavor, naturally sweet and mild.  It's our favorite everyday espresso  for  morning lattes or an occasional Americano, a nice consistent crema.  And really, you can't beat the Subscribe and Save Program!!  We've tried Lavazza Blu (a chocolate taste) and came back to this.After opening the vacuum sealed package, I transfer the ground espresso to a French (clip top)mason jar, and store in the refrigerator as recommended by the company.  I take out just enough for our two shots and put the jar right back into the fridge--it stays tasting fresh to the last cuppa:~)Delicious!!

taste is amazing! not bitter at all, best espresso coffee I have tried (still haven't tried Illy though) I would definitely reccomend this for anyone who loves a good strong cup of coffee. well worth the money.

column9: You don't need to got to Italy to have a great espresso
column10: Great espresso coffee. I own Breville espresso coffee machine and this coffee is perfect... not too core, not too fine. Taste is bold, chocolaty but not overwhelming to the palette. Love it.

This is by far my favorite coffee.  I used it continuously when living in Europe and am so glad to have found it on Amazon at a reasonable price.It is strong but very mellow.  No bitter aftertaste, and makes the first cup of coffee worthwhile getting up for.Please continue to make favorable price offers on this item and I promise I will continue ordering.

column9: Lavazza Crema e Gusto Ground Coffee, Italian Espresso, 8.8-Ounce Bricks
column10: If you are avid coffee espresso drinker look no further. This coffee comes perfectly pre-ground for espresso drinks. This espresso has a smooth rich flavor that is not too strong with a hint of a chocolate aftertaste. Warning after you drink this coffee a couple of times you will be hooked. If I had to compare this to Starbucks latté's, the Lavazza has a more refined and smoother flavor without the bitter burnt taste that Starbucks has.EnjoyJohn S.

I tied Lavazza at a coffee house in Milano and really enjoyed the taste. It doesn't have the bitterness that you find in almost all coffee houses in US. It is very full flavored coffee. I couldn't find it in US, not even at small European food stores. I searched online and Amazon has the best deal if you sign for regular delivery. You don't have to spend $300 to $400 for an espresso machine when you have an excellent quality coffee.
The best espresso money can buy. I use to like SegaFredo brand, but La Vazza crema e gusto is way ahead. It is very creamy, nice looking and smooth.
it is really good coffee, my italian friend recommended this product!!and i tried... and.... i like it so much... i ordered 8 bags...
I am not an expert but this espresso is to die for. Perfect each time from my machine. No bitterness, but strong.

I buy this coffee regularly from Amazon. It is smooth, full flavored, and not bitter. I love the free shipping as stores around my house are often out of it and charge more anyway. It deserves 5 stars for sure. I buy several 4 packs at a time or have purchased the case of 20. I never want to run out- it's a gourmet staple in my house and my whole family loves it.

This is my favorite coffee outside of Italy. It is the only brand my husband and I drink. We can't drink drip coffee anymore because it tastes so terrible compared to the Lavazza. If you are a coffee lover this is a great product, and you will LOVE it. My friends always come over for a Latte! Like the name, it is creamy with lots of flavor!
We love this coffee and have looked everywhere for better prices, but amazon is the lowest.
This espresso is amazing. My wife would not drink coffee until she had this product, now she has Lavazza espresso every day. Crema e gusto tastes wondeful, try it and you'll love it.
Lavazza Crema E Gusto together with my Saeco home expresso maker, produces the best flavor and richest crema of any expresso I have ever had.
We have been using this for almost a year now and having a subscription order really makes the coffee a good buy besides having such a great expresso taste.
Using this coffee and a stove top espresso maker (a "moka") I make the best espresso, my husband and I like our home coffee better than what we can get at Starbucks or any of the other coffee shops.
It's my favorite for over 10 years. Living both in Europe and US brew it in at least 4 different espresso machined, always perfect result. I and my wife absolutely love it! Highly recommend!
i use this for a stovetop espresso coffee maker and it worksgreat and the taste is nice and smooth.  All lavazza coffeesare extremely good.
This coffee is lack of body and lack of aroma.  It is not worth the money at all.  Do not waste your money and time.
Had to use twice as much of this as Medaglia D Oro to obtain the same strength. If you like Columbian, then maybe this is for you.

column9: NOW, THIS IS REAL ITALIAN COFFEE
column10: I drink this coffee daily and I love it!I am Italian and I know  Lavazza very well, that's the only coffee my family and I drink. If you are expecting a weak taste like the normal american coffee, do not buy this kind.The flavor is strong, just like coffee should be.I would raccomand to make it with of those italian coffee machines like Bialetti.

We originally purchased the Lavazza Crema y Gusto coffee pack when it went on sale, but I am re-ordering at full price because of the taste.Not sure if it's the blend or the roast, but it's a superior coffee by every measure. Flavor is full and robust, but not at all bitter. It's hard to describe it's smoothness without hyperbole, but try it once and you'll find yourself at a loss for words also. If you are used to the strength of a French press but want the silky smoothness of a breakfast blend, this coffee is for you.Vacuum packed into foil bricks for freshness. Do yourself, your spouse, and your office mates a huge favor and give it a try - and be prepared to start writing your own five star review.
This is a great product at a great price.  Works very well in our espresso machine.  We both have a double shot latte every morning.  Order this on a recurring basis so we never run out.

Lavazza crema e gusto is the best coffee. When you sip it, you can really tell that it has the true flavor of a good coffee.  I have it used for at least 20 years. My day is not the same, if I do not use my Lavazza Crema e Gusto Coffee. I can taste the difference between this coffee and the quality of other coffees. It has become our ritual for my husband and I to have an "Espressiata" as he calls it before he goes to work. This coffee makes my day. Mary Ann Vitale

column9: fancy coffee shop taste and smell
