Early Grey tea has replaced coffee as my beverage of choice not only for breakfast, but throughout the day.  Twinings makes the best tea on the market and buying boxes in bulk at a discounted price is an awesome deal.  I make a large pot of tea first thing in the morning with one Earl Grey tea bag and one Irish Breakfast tea bag and generally have one or two cups with milk and stevia sweetener.  What I don't drink in the morning is poured into one of two glass containers and placed in the refrigerator, giving me cold tea every day for lunch or dinner.  I still on occasion buy bottled black tea but the tea I make is FAR superior.  Taken on its own Earl Grey can be quite a strong flavor, but mixed with Irish Breakfast tea and a bit of milk, it is ambrosia.  Try it, you might like it!

If you are on a tight budget, as I am, then I think this Earl Grey is fine. For the same price, I prefer Bigelow.  For Pete's sake, stay away from Lipton's black tea.  (I can't speak as to their green tea.) I used to drink Lipton tea as we get the bags free at work.  Once I tried Twinings and then Bigelow, there was no going back. The Lipton teas are bitter tasting in comparison.If you are able to splurge once in a while, try Mountain Rose Herbs brand of Earl Grey. The difference will blow you away.  The bergamot really stands out in this tea, I mean REALLY.  I haven't seen it offered online here at Amazon.  I had to order it directly from Mountain Rose and it was $11 for one pound plus shipping. The tea is organic, kosher and fair trade certified! Their website is here:[...]So, if you like Twinings, try Bigelow, which is the same price, but a tad better.  If you are able to splurge, try Mountain Rose...but be warned, it will spoil you for other teas forever.

column9: Best for the money/ Great deal from Amazon
column10: I really like Eary Grey tea, and I've had some very good brands. However I have not found a better deal than this from Amazon.  Twenty-nine bucks for 6 big boxes includes shipping is better than anywhere online or locally.  The tea is good (but not the best I've ever had) and had a medium bergamot flavor.  I've only found stronger bergamot flavor in teas that cost many times more.  I'll save those for special occasions, and drink this for my daily "Earl Grey: Hot!"
Excellent tea - Earl Grey is a true black tea with a great aroma and taste. I know why Captain Piccard drank this!

column9: Best tea at the best price
column10: I have been drinking Earl Grey tea for years and have selected Twinings as my preferred brand. Since I have been drinking this particular product for a while, I have done research into the best prices and found amazon.com always wins. The only downfall - making sure I order the next shipment before the first runs out, but I have been pleased with how quickly the item ships and arrives. Tea anyone?

Reading several reviews about this tea, complaining about the extremely mild taste almost made me not to buy this product. However, I did and I am not dissapointed. I used to drink this tea when I lived in Great Britain and the taste is almost the same. Each tea bag is enough for one cup of tea but certainly not enough for a mug, but you can always use two tea bags. This tea is supposed to have a mild flavour but I did not feel it extremely mild as other reviewers. The aroma is is quite refreshing and overall is a really nice tea for the price. If you want a much stronger Earl Grey, try Whittard, much more expensive tough.
I love my Twinnings Earl Grey tea and purchasing through Amazon.com is easier and cheaper than going to the supermarket.

column9: Very Delicate Flavor Compared to Bigelow
column10: I enjoy this tea, but it is not my favorite Earl Grey: the flavor is just too delicate.  If you prefer a stronger flavor like I do, and want tea bags instead of loose tea, I recommend the Bigelow brand: Bigelow Earl Grey Tea, 40-Count Boxes (Pack of 6).By the way, the "Twinings Aromatics" Earl Grey tea is fantastic--probably the best bagged Earl Grey I've tasted--but I have only seen it in England. Try that one out if you can find it.
Rec'd tea in a timely manner and all was exactly as listed.  Great product.
i had a problem with my original order, but they made is so right ( and free) that i will definitly be back to reordere this. my mom loved it!
I drink this tea every day.  It is great to never run out & never pay to much.

An English nurse I worked with turned me on to this brand of tea. Other Earl Grey brands would get bitter if I spaced out and forgot it but while Twinings may get strong it doesn't get bitter. My local source of bulk buy tea bags dried up and I was lucky to find this tea at such a great price and I don't have to go to the store and buy a small over priced box. I love it!

The first time I tried Twinings tea was during a business trip to Durham England. The hotel I stayed at had several varieties of Twinings and I brought home some sample packs for my wife to try. Her favorite (and mine) was the Twinings Earl Grey tea. It is truly a wonderfully aromatic tea with just the right flavor. A truly unique tea for people who love tea. I'll have to admit, my tea experience was limited to the black tea/orange pekoe variety found anywhere here in the states prior to that trip. After drinking the Twinings Earl Grey for a few months, my wife and I tried a small amount of our old black tea/orange pekoe variety, and found it intolerably nasty. Be forewarned, very good tea will spoil you to other run of the mill varieties. I've since tried other brands of Earl Grey and none have compared to Twinings. I highly recommend it.
A very good product for the money. Affordable nice tea. Tea is getting so expensive that it's nice to have a good tea that doesn't break the bank.

I have a cafe and this product moves very quickly.  People really like the brand, "Twinings".  Having the subscribe and save is a nice benefit for a busy business owner.  One less thing that I have to inventory weekly.
We drink huge quantities of iced and hot tea.  This is an excellent buy from Amazon.  Great price and wonderful service - arrives every six months.  Earl Grey is my favorite tea!!

There are a great many Earl Grey teas on the market but, for my money, Twinings is the best. When I'm not able to brew it from loose tea I turn to bags -- and, although not as full-flavored, the resulting cup is quite satisfactory.This was my first "food" purchase through Amazon and I was very pleased with the price -- significantly less than buying the product at a grocery store.
Love this tea. If it's good enough for the queen of England, it's good enough for me (plus it is so darn good). I drink it very strong with milk. YUM!

Personally, I like St. Dalfour's earl grey tea better, but Twinings is good. Amazon ran a terrific promotion on this product in February and I bought a case. My advice: Look for Amazon's promotions on this product--get on their email list--their February deal beat the best prices at our local stores by a wide margin.

column9: Among the best Earl Grey Tea available
column10: I enjoy a good cup of tea and my absolute favorite is Earl Grey. Twinings Early Grey is among the best on the market, alongside Rishi loose leaf. A traditional English tea, Earl Grey is a black tea whose principle flavor is from the rind of bergamot oranges. Although there are various accounts of its origin, it is most likely was an Indian recipe (China is also a commonly attributed with creating the recipe) which made its way to England in the early 1800s. Named after Lord Grey, the tea is a flavorful black tea that is best served nearly boiling hot with or without lemon. It is NOT served with cream.Twinings is one of the oldest conveyors of Earl Grey and still use the same recipe as they have for well over a hundred years (soon to be two-hundred). Their tea is also endorsed by the 6th Earl Grey and his signature appears on their packaging. Not that this means the tea is superior because of any endorsement; in this case the tea speaks for itself.While I do prefer loose leaf teas, these tea bags provide nearly the same flavor profile as the loose variety and will not disappoint the Earl Grey enthusiast. If you've never tried Twinings, you owe it to yourself to do so. Enjoy!

column9: You can't beat this for Earl Grey tea
column10: I have been drinking tea for forty years and Earl Grey for almost as long.  I have tried every brand and was a devoted Bigelow fan until I decided to go to the experts and had several different brands shipped from a shop in London, UK.  The Twinings was the hands down winner.  It is the most perfect blend!  I love it hot or iced and was thrilled to find it on Amazon.  Now it arrives on a regular schedule at an unbeatable price.

I like Earl Grey tea in the morning, and Twinings is simply the best Earl Grey going.  Buying 6 50-count boxes is a considerably better deal than buying at a store, as long as you have the shelf to put it on.  Hey, if I'm buying nearly a year's supply I must think it's good.

I have a hard time finding this flavor of this brand of tea in my local stores. Wal-Mart carries it but the closest one is over 100 miles away. I was tickled to see Amazon carry this at such a great price. One of the reviews mentioned that this is not the same as the stores carry--they are wrong, it is exactly what you will find in stores. I have purchased this 2 times now thru Amazon & am sure I will purchase it again.
This is my favorite tea!!  What a great price, almost halfof what I usually pay, plus it is delivered free!!Wonderful!  I already received my first shipment.

column9: Twinings' Earl Grey is the icon in tea!
column10: I carry packets in my purse, there is no other like it. And Twinings began it all...you can't buy better and you can't buy it at a better price than Amazon!!!

This is by far our favorite brand of Earl Grey tea.  The flavor is nice and not too strong.  It is good as a hot tea and also makes a refreshing glass of ice tea.  As with other reviewers, I was happy that Amazon started carrying it and at a price much better than the grocery store.
Excellent. Just as advertised with incredibly quick shipping.Twinings Teas have always been a favorite of mine.

column9: Twinings is the best Earl Grey
column10: I have tried three varieties of Earl Grey now and I am amazed and somewhat pleased by how different they all are as it allows for different tastes.  Twinings has a light, bright slightly citrus flavor that I love. Bigelow Earl Grey, to me, is comparitively flat. Drinkable, but not the delight that Twinings is.You actually can tell the difference on opening the box, from the smell. I smell very little on opening Bigelow.  I also tried Stash Earl Grey and was nearly choked to death by a strong perfume stench that spoke neither of tea or of citrus. I did try it, a couple of times, and threw the balance of it away.I usually drink the tea iced, no sugar and sometimes with a squeeze of lime.  I cannot imagine using sugar, not needed.  My feeling on hot drinking is that perhaps a small spoon of sugar would be nice, but certainly not milk, partly because of the light flavor of the tea, but mostly because the milk does not compliment the citrus note.** update. Sorry Twinings I have been wooed away by Ahmad Tea. Their Earl Grey is stronger with a richer flavor.

I first tasted this tea way back in the late 70's, when I worked at a specialty restaurant. Now I use it in my secret recipe iced tea, it adds a flavor that no one can identify, but one that they can't seem to get enough of!  It's also good hot, with cream and sugar. The taste is like lemon and nutmeg. I've tried other brands, but Twinings is the richest in flavor.

This is as good a deal for this tea as it gets...I love Earl grey tea and drink it almost exclusively.  There are other brands that are good, but for the money Twinings is the best, you will not find it in the grocery stores this cheap, even on sale!
At 5.6 cents per bag (I bought 600), and 3 cups per 2 bags, this is a great bargain. (Over 15 cents each in store.)

column9: Great tea at a great price
column10: I love Twinings Earl Grey Tea and I was thrilled that  Amazon is carrying it at such a great price. Thanks Amazon

Earl Grey is an unusual type of tea because it is flavored with the herb Bergamot which has a distinctive flavor.  If you haven't tasted it before, I'd recommend you order a cup or try a smaller sized package because you might not like it.  It can, however, grow on you.  I like it very much; it's one of my very favorite teas.  It's quite popular in England both at breakfast and at tea time.  It is almost always available if you are out having high or afternoon tea.  It's made with black tea, so it, of course, has caffeine--though now it is available in decaf as well through Amazon etc.  This box has a large quantity of tea bags of high quality tea.  There are other brands, but Twinings is a good one (though not my very favorite, it's right up there).  Using bags is, of course, more convenient, but frankly, I prefer loose tea with which you can vary the strength as you wish.  I have friends who make it by the pot.  Those wanting weaker tea just pour it off earlier.  I like it stronger.  On the other hand, you can put a bag in a mug, stick in the microwave, and have tea in a few minutes.  Enjoy!  Hope you like the Bergamot!

It is not the Wonderful Twinings Earl Grey you have come to know and love.  They have pulled a "new coke" blunder and now the best Earl Grey tea ever is available no more!  This tea is weak and tasteless.I hate stupidity, especially from corporate marketers.
the tea bag lost flavor after just one seep. I can usually get more flavor on 2nd 3rd seep with tazo's

My tea came after three weeks and it was only one pack instead of six. I called and complained and the following week got another one pack instead of six.  That is all I ever received and my money was refunded.  Don't really know what happened...never got an explanation from the distributor.
Arrived on schedule.  I order decaffinated and they sent caffinated. Good tea either way.

I really like the raspberry green tea flavor.  I also like that it is minimally processed and that I can pronounce all of the ingredients it is made with.  The chia seed and caffeine combo provides a boost of sustained energy during those long workouts.  This may be TMI, but gels and goos are so sugary that they upset my stomach and go right through me.  Achiva sticks with me.

I love the new flavors.  The Green tea is one of my new favorites along with the Mango.  I recently ran the Oquirrhman Challenge 40.5 Miles.  I had a double serving of Green Tea Achiva and ate the Achiva beans throughout.  The Friday was a trail half 14ish miles.  It was tough, but it was nice that I didn't have to worry about my nutrition.  I felt great.The next day was the full marathon.  Again I had a double serving of Green Tea Achiva and then ate 4 packages of Achiva Beans through out the race.  Even with stiff legs I felt great and ran my fastest marathon in 20 years.  Nutrition is one of the hardest things to figure out during a race or even an early morning spin class.
I usually buy walden farms products but I like this ketchup very much . It is very sweet though it tastes more like spaghetti sauce its great on burgers and fries

So glad to see more sugar free foods using natural stevia sweetner instead of artificial chemical based sweetners. This ketchup is great tasting. It is a little sweeter then normal ketchup but I don't mind that. Especially since there are so many bland things out there that are natural, gluten free, sugar free etc. This ketchup actually has flavor!! I hope one day they make a to go packaging version so people like me with food intolerance can bring it with them to parties or places they will be eating and cant use regular ketchup etc. The bottle is just too big to bring with you anywhere but its packaged really nicely in a great thick bottle.

I bought the Raisin Brown Bread today on a whim at the grocery store (Publix in Florida) and I really liked it. Of special interest to me was the fact that no refined white sugar is used to sweeten it (only molasses) and no white flour is used (only whole wheat and rye flours). This bread is therefore quite closer to a South Beach Diet-acceptable "dessert" versus something you'd get in a typical bakery (with the possible exception of the molasses...didn't read that far).The raisins were sweet and delicious and the bread is rich and hearty. I paid $1.99 locally and found it to be a very good value. It was flavorful and delicious enough by itself that butter actually was a negative when I tried it! That doesn't happen often.I would recommend you try this product at least once to see what you think. I think it would be great to keep on hand as a snack, as one can could easily last you a few days of snacking.

B&M Brown bread totally took us back to our childhood.  Slice it into rounds about 3/8 inch thick.  The trick is steaming it so that it is hot and moist and serve with butter, which melts into the bread.  Looks like chocolate, but it is dark with molasses.  They still make the same stuff of our memories. Patience!  First can didn't get hot enough or moist enough, but the second and third were perfect.
This is just like I remember as a youngster living in New England. If you like hot dogs and beans, this will be a good addition.

I was looking for a canned bread with flavor for long-term storage. This product fills that need. I wish it was a little less pricey. The flavor is good. The biggest challange was getting it out of the can! I had to cut open both ends of the can and it still was a battle!

I WAS A LITTLE SURPRISED ,WHEN I OPENED  A CAN OF B & M BREAD , IT WAS A LOT TASTIER THAN I EXPECTED , FROM A CAN . WE USED A LOAF TO SEE HOW IT WOULD TASTE FOR SANDWICHES AND I ALSO MADE FRENCH TOAST , WE FELT THIS WAS A GOOD CHOICE AND HAVE DECIDED TO ADD IT TO OUR EMERGENCY FOOD SUPPLY.EVEN OUR DOG GAVE IT A THUMBS-UP .RUF-RUF..  JERRY REITHB&M Brown Bread Original, 16 Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)

My store, Food 4 Less, only sells the reason, which is good, but I love the reg. brown bread, so finding this  was wonderful. I keep a few in my long term food storage as well since they have a good shelf life,

I had hoped for a better cup of coffee but this did not deliver. Douwe Egbert is great coffee but i think i needed to get a better quality or something as this just did not do it for me. I would not order again based on price compared to getting locally roasted coffee. The merchant was good. No problemo.
Exceptional taste but not quite what we first had at the casino.  We will try other roasts until we find it!!

column9: Mr. Yoshida is a yummy man.
column10: Here in Gainesville Florida we have a place that serves grilled meats and vegetables basted in a sweet teriyaki sauce over rice. I'm addicted to the sauce, if I could I would go out and get a giant plastic container, fill it up with it, and pour it over everything there is. I would even consider teriyaki baths. I always want to take a million "to go" containers of the sauce when I visit but that would be really rude.  Since I cannot do that, I have found a substitute in Mr. Yoshida.  It's not as thick, and its not exactly the same flavor, it is a delicious marinade/sauce in its own right. If you love teriyaki flavor it's definitely worth trying. I put mine in stir fry, marinate meats, and use it as a dipping sauce for dumplings. I'm sure there is a million other different uses. Mr. Yoshida always does me right!

Yoshida's Original Gourmet Sauce is an excellent marinade for salmon! ...and steak, etc., but my favorite is the red salmon I bring home from Alaska.  The product was no longer available at Sam's Club, and I was delighted to find it on Amazon.  Besides, the smaller bottles are much better than the hugh bottle that Sam's carried.  I'll order from Amazon from now on!

I bought this thinking it was the thick sauce that Mr. Yoshida used to make.....It's not. It is liquid and thin, and lacks the flavor that the other sauce had....I will have to continue to look for the original, thicker sauce. This may be suitable for marinating meats. I tried it with some pork, and it was very strong. Just not pleased with it at all.Not what I was hoping to get.

This is the best terriyaki sauce I have found.  It is so hard to find the terriyaki sauce, plenty of the other sauces, but I have a receipe for this only.  I make a sauce for chicken wings.  I am so happy to find it here at Amazon.  Thanks Amazon.

Even though I bought this to bake biscuits for my dogs (baking powder is safe for dogs in the amounts used for baking... just don't let them eat the entire can at once, that'd be bad for anyone), I also use this in cookies I bake for my family, since it's sitting there in my cupboard, might as well use it for us too. My sugar cookies come out rising and tasting just like they do with regular baking powder. The sodium isn't missed at all. I use the same amount of it as I would regular baking powder. Very pleased with its performance.This sodium-free baking powder isn't cheap, but it's worth it and works like regular baking powder, and I couldn't find it in town at the stores I went to. I've been using it for over 2 months and I use it a lot, but these 3 cans are going to last a good while.
I take it every where.It is a great sizeto carry with yoiu. No little pastic bottles to put in the landfill.

i use it everyday for work.  easy to clean. dishwasher safe. no mildew. the handle is very sturdy. it shipped fast. nothing bad to say about it and it was a whole lot less expensive than the other big name brand water bottles.

These tasty bagel snacks are perfect for snack time.They taste delicious and have good healthy ingrediants. A little more salty than I would use, BUT STILL NICE.I recommend there knowing you'll fall in love with these delicious, crispy snacks.
My family really enjoys this product.  Flavor means fewer crisps satisfy, so my order lasted longer than some snack purchases.
I ordered a case to make chex mix for the holidays and they were perfect, arrived on time, and tasted great.

I had been buying these in the grocery store and found the price on Amazon to be a distinct discount.  These are too easy to eat non-stop, so I try to limit myself. My only complaint is that the amount of cinnamon/sugar coating on the bagel crisps can vary significantly between bags.
They tasted great, A lot of them were broken, but that did not diminish the flavor one bit.

These have always been one of my favorite snacks.  Probably not very good for you but as with anything they are fine if taken in moderation!  Not much else to say about them, it's bagle chips with cinnamon on top!

These bagel crisps are great.  They provide a slightly salty crunchy snack perfect for in-between classes or a short break on the job.  Everyone I've shared them with loves them too.  Nutritionally, they're ok:  not the best, but far from the worst.
This product is fantastic with any kind of dips or cheese.  I had ordered this product because my local supermarket wasn't restocking.

We love these crisps.  They are akin to a cracker as opposed to a potato chip.  As such, we use them in soup now all of the time and they are so much better than soup crackers.  We also use them with cheese and as the legend on the package tells you, the sellers developed them for their then cheese store.  However, these crisps became so popular that they left the cheese business for this instead. These are actual New York bagels, sliced and put back into their ovens to become crisps.  I buy a big bag of these at Sam's Club locally. I've also tried Stacy's chips but like these better.

column9: New York Style Bagel Crisps Cinnamon Raisin Review
column10: Excellent!  Unusual and very crispy!  Can be messy with lots of crumbs, but well worth it.  Have a sweet taste as well as cinnamon, but the raisin is hard to find! A healthy snack that even my cat likes!

column9: Great Price, Great Packaging, Great Taste!
column10: If you've never had these Bagel Crisps before they are about the size of a large potato chip but much thicker and made from bagels.  They are crunchy and taste like garlic and salt.  Compared to the Ranch Wheat thins (15 crackers a serving) I usually snack on, the serving of Bagel Crisps (6 crisps) has 10 less calories but fills me up the same.  However, there is a lot more sodium in the crisps, 320mg vs.190mg in the Wheat Thins.The package of 12 arrived quickly, well packaged, and fresh.  My particular order which was placed in mid July has an expiration date of May 2011.  Plenty of time to eat all 12 packages without feeling rushed!All in all... for a moderately healthy crunchy snack you can't go wrong.

I guess it's just that i'm a midwesterner, but this was *not* what i was expecting.  Not necessarily in a bad way, but there is not a hint of onion/garlic in this product.  New York Style... is what it must be.
I love these to take on trips and to use in chex mix. Awesome price compared to the store price.

After ignoring these in the supermarket for some time, I was introduced to them at my new job where everyone kept scarfing them down. Being a garlic lover, I just had to try one. I'm hooked. They are light, airy, and so full of flavor. They do get your hands a bit greasy reminding you that they aren't a fat free light food. I'm not into potato chips, so I searched my supermarket for the garlic flavor to no avail. How delightful I can order them from Amazon!I gave the review 4 stars because sometimes the bag is full of broken pieces instead of full bagel chips. As another reviewer said, a resealable bag would add to the product. However, maybe the creators know how quickly they will be devoured... :)

These are very good.  I like to put a little piece of swiss cheese on top of a few crisps and pop them in the microwave for a few secs: delicious!  Sea Salt is good, but the Garlic flavor is my fave.  Try 'em, you'll like 'em!

VEERY GOOD WHEN PACKAGED PROPERLY. EVERY TIME I'VE ORDERED THEM THEY EITHER HAVE ARRIVED WITH A LARGE HOLE IN THE BOX OR SPILLING OUT OF THE HOLE. I WOULD LABEL "FOOD PRODUCT& FRAGILE" IN BIGGGG LETTERS!!USE ONLY MY NICKNAME PLEASE.

column9: Not the taste that I was expecting
column10: These are very light and crisp.They had a lot more caraway seeds than I usually find in "everything" bagels.They tasted more like a dark rye than white.I'm used to a stronger garlic and onion flavor -- so I'll order a different flavor next time.Good product.  Fast shipping.
THE ABOVE ITEMS WERE DELIVERED ON TIME, AND WERE BEYOND EXPECTATION.THE ITEMS WERE FRESH, AND TASTED GOOD, AND WERE ENJOYED BY ALL.  MANY THANKS.
Not made in New York!! Why Not?The package is not reclosable.Great taste.
Roses are redRain gives them a soakin'I wish the bagel chipscame to me less broken.
this product that recibi was not in good state since 80% of the panesitos of garlic were divided

I have bought Kick'n Chicken many times over the years. It's a very versatile seasoning, you can put it on almost anything! I've used it on Burgers, Chicken, and even tried it in Spaghetti Sauce! Pretty much anything you want to add some kick and seasoning too.It's got some heat to it, but unless you really pour it on it's not overpowering. Anybody who likes flavor with their heat will love this stuff!

column9: Excellent Choice In Spices For Chicken
column10: I have used many different spices over the years and never really found one that was of this caliber. Weber hit it right on the money with this one!

I just notice that Amazon had a "video review" options because I would have liked to shown you the amount of bugs inside my bottle/grinder. There were small bugs inside just crawling around...GROSS!!!!!!!!!!!!

Having just returned from a vacation in Mexico our family had developed a real taste for these Mexican style "Japones" style nuts. We tried numerous brands while on vacation and all of the brands were pretty close in taste and texture. These however have a highly artificial taste to them with the tiniest peanuts within a lot of the batter. Unfortunately even after a couple of beers the other evening and thinking they may taste better with beer, I can say that was wishful thinking. They may work as sustenance but little else.

I just bought a pack of the these in the break room here at work and I was surprised when I popped one in my mouth. These peanuts have a candy-like shell on them?? I tried a couple more and could not stop! They have that great peanut taste with a hint of soy sauce and a little wasabi-like kick! Glad to see they are sold on amazon.com where I can get them anytime! I definitely recommend these little babies!

this is a good chocolate to savor and it is not just cocoa, but a good blend of dark chocolate that contains anti-oxidents for the heart and can melt in your mouth-what  call 'sucking chocolate.' Also excellent to melt briefly in microwave and eat with bananas, strawberries or other fruit.

I don't normally care for soup mixes, but thought a single serving mix was worth trying, especially for 150 calories per serving.  I was pleasantly surprised by the full flavor of these soups. They are a little thin, but still flavorful, and they don't have that 'processed' taste a lot of mixes have. They are high in sodium, but that's nothing new for a soup. Just be careful with the rest of the daily menu so it all balances out.  The red chili and the green chili soup mixes are perfect with a cup or two of chopped broccoli thrown in.  I tried broccoli in the tortilla soup but it wasn't a good mix. I may try adding chopped squash or some other veggie instead.My package was leaking powder when it arrived. Several of the packets were not sealed properly and had leaked out. Comida Loca customer service was genuinely concerned and very attentive and sent a replacement. I've also ordered another box from Amazon.

The reviews were good; variety sounded good, but by the time you add the chicken and the tomatoes and the milk, you've paid several dollars for about 1/2 cup of dried potatoes and spices.  Was not surprised to see that potato is the primary ingredient.Yes, as reviewers said, nice blend of spices but unless you add quite a lot of your own ingredients to the pot, there is no substance - just nicely flavored milk/water.  Will not buy again.

THIS WAS BEYOND MY EXPECTATIONS.  THE VARIETY WAS A GREAT BLEND OF DIFFERENT SOUPS AND SO EASY TO FIX.  EVEN MY HUSBAND LIKED THEM.  I QUICKLY ORDERED ANOTHER SET, BECAUSE IT WAS SO GOOD.  TASTY AND EASY

The potato soup is wonderful.  THe Green Chili Chicken soup (we add our own chicken leftover from a pre cooked chicken along with a can of chopped tomatoes - it is very tasty.  It is also spicy, so don't add a can of zesty tomatoes unless you can stand the heat...

column9: Very tasty with the right amount of zing
column10: This soup takes a little bit of time to make - it's not a mix with water and boil soup.  I followed the directions exactly the first time I made it and the second time, I added frozen corn and only used milk (instead of milk and water) for a heartier richer soup.  But the spices are just right!  I really like this product.  It is a quality product!  I live in Europe where I can't get any Mexican food, so this satisfies my cravings for something spicey.  And it's easy to pack or ship.
This soup is really delicious if you add 8oz. of smoked turkey to it during cooking...

column9: Quick and easy with plenty of flavor
column10: A quick and easy addition to any meal or is a great quick meal in itself. Plenty of flavor with a spiciness that is just right. This is so good, I plan to try Comida's other offerings.

Salt makes this taste good. I hate to say it but this stuff has been sitting on my pantry shelf for months and months. After making my first cup of hot soup (very easy, by the way, just add water and microwave....), I thought it tasted bitter and a bit flat. So, out of desperation, lately, I had nothing for snacking, so I made myself a cup of this soup. I added some soy sauce (don't know why). That made it absolutely delicious - salt was what it needed. Salt has that ability to 'fix' what is lacking. And it certainly fixed this for me. It has a very good taste, once adjusted with just a little bit of salt.

I had Turtle Island tortilla soup before, it was very good but I can't find that in the local markets, that's why I checked into Amazon and looked for it. Instead I came across the comida loca soup mix reviews, people seem really like it, so I ordered some and tried it out myself. I really enjoy the soup, it is very tasty and easy to make. I won't say it tastes better than Turtle Island brand, but it's definitely a lot cheaper. It cost about half the price of the other brand, but it taste just as good as the other brand. I'll definitely buy it again. Thank you for the reviews.

WE HAD ORDERED THE VARIETY PACK OF THE SOUTHWEST SOUPS ALSO FROM THIS COMPANY AND THIS ONE WAS OUR FAVORITE. THEY WERE ALL GREAT, BUT THIS ONE WAS TOPS.  WE ADDED A LITTLE HAM TO IT AND WOW!  GREAT SOUP AND SO EASY TO MAKE.

Actually, I couldn't make a soup this good even if I had all the indregients, and a fully-stocked kitchen.  The flavors are crisp and balanced, not too veggie-heavy nor too sharp, just the right balance and thickness.  And they are almost complete -- you just add milk, or water, and more ingredients if you happen to have them -- bell peppers, for instance -- and you have a full-fledged soup.  The Comida Loca soups are not "open and serve soups" nor are they just stock to which you have to source and prepare all the ingredients -- they are ALMOST complete from the container, and you add a little bit (milk, corn chips, etc) at the end.  So they are a terrific mix of easy but not over-preocessed.  As you can tell, I am a big fan and always have a variety of them on hand -- perfect for a northeast winter's day!

column9: You'll love Mrs. May's Trio bars.  Gluten & dairy free.
column10: Mrs. May's Trio bars are my favorite snack/energy bars.  I love them.  They come in four flavors.  Cranberry is not my favorite of those flavors, but I still really like it, just not as much as blueberry and strawberry.  Though cranberries are pretty tart, the cranberry bar is not noticeably tarter than the others.  It does seem less sweet to me than the blueberry and strawberry ones, but the carbs and sugars are the same so it may be my imagination.The name comes from the ingredients.  The bars have a trio of trios:  3 nuts, 3 seeds and 3 fruits.  The nuts, seeds and 2 of the fruits are the same in all the flavors.  The nuts are cashews, almonds & pistachios.  The seeds are sesame, pumpkin, & sunflower.  The two fruits that are in all the flavors are dates and raisins, but you don't really see or taste them so I wonder if they are cooked down into the "glue" that holds all the other ingredients together.  The third fruit in the cranberry flavor is dried cranberry.  The only other ingredients are rice malt, natural flavors, cane juice and sea salt.These are great bars for anyone who has issues with wheat or dairy.  The label says they are wheat free, gluten free, dairy free and kosher.  They also have no preservatives.  If you have peanut allergies, the label says they are packaged in a peanut free facility that processes other nuts.Because of the nuts, they have 12 grams of fat per bar, but I've been reading articles that say nuts are a great snack and the fat in nuts is "good" fat.  The label says there is 1.5 grams of saturated fat which surprised me but I guess some of the fat in nuts must be saturated.  To round out the rest of the nutrition facts:  calories, 170; total carbs, 14g; dietary fiber, 2g; sugars, 6g; protein, 5g; cholesterol, 0g; trans fat, 0g; and sodium, 45mg.I love the nuts and seeds and the bars don't have the mealy texture that a lot of energy/snack bars have.  They are low sodium but high in taste and they are really satisfying.  I used to get granola bars but these are so much better.

Too "crunchy," "made in China," are you kidding me? This is justification for the two stars reviews?These bars are an excellent value (less than a buck apiece), have a great shelf life, taste great and are about as healthy as you can get. column10: I got my first jar of it for four bucks at the local Price Chopper. Yes, 16 ounces. It is a very superior product. Just had a cup of chicken bouillon made with it - nothing else would do as I am nursing a cold. Ya know, CHICKEN SOUP! I also use it to flavor rice. It says reduced sodium but is still plenty salty, frankly. When I add it to rice cooking water, I don't use additional salt. Learned that the hard way. And I am a salt lover. Can't imagine how salty the regular version must be.The stuff is viscous, gooey even but dissolves fairly readily in water I've preheated in the microwave. Had to stir for a minute, maybe. Absolutely delicious, just what the doctor ordered. *smacks lips, feeling much better*
I'm so glad this is available in the larger size as well as the smaller 8 oz. Finding organic AND lower sodium in a large size was a bonus for me. This bouillon is fantastic!

When I was being offered a sample cup of this stock @ Costco I was weirded out by how they just offered the cooked stock by itself in a cup but I tried it anyways because of the wonderful aroma it gave off and I was astounded by how good it tasted! So I bought it, of course. When I got home with it I immediately used it for this vegetable soup I had in mind even though I was a bit skeptical about whether it'd go well with my recipe but even if it didn't, it's organic so nothing can beat that right? Turns out the soup tasted GREAT! Everyone loved my soup. Now, I rarely use bouillon/stock because I feel that it's very unhealthy with all the additives in it but having some in stock really helps when you're feeling lazy and don't want to go out to grocery shop just for some stock. Overall, I'm very pleased with this and will buy more in the future!

I looked everywhere for this reduced sodium AND organic base. The regular base has almost 800MG sodium which is way more than we need. I bought this once before but it is hard to find. I use this together with organic chicken broth, organic veggies and organic chicken to make a yummy homemade chicken veggie soup that is really good and much better for me than store brands loaded with MSG preservatives and coloring. Better Than Bouillon (Reduced Sodium) really is Better!

This stuff is delicious. 'Better Than Bouillon' Chicken Base is the best soup base I have ever used and I swear by it. I love using it when I make rice, it gives it an absolutely delicious flavor as it cooks. Yes it is expensive but this is a quality product. Highly recommended!

"Free glutamic acid" in high concentration is neurotoxic. Free glutamates have many many aliases (MSG is only one). These organic Better Than Bouillon products simply don't have the "monosodium" variety of glutamic acid, so they can say "no MSG". Its labeling trickery. The ultimate labeling question... WHAT IS "NATURAL FLAVOR"???

My mistake was not learning before buying Better Than Boullion Organic Chicken Base, Reduced Sodium the amount of salt it was reduced from.I find it so salty that the salt overpowers the chicken broth flavor. Using less only reduces the amount of salt along with the flavor. I was very disappointed.
Just for those on a low-sodium diet, who count %. I just used half the amount in the recipe and it tasted great.
I'm changing my review!This is probably the best soup stock base, that I've used.It tastes a whole better in a soup, than tasting it on a spoon!

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: Mini raviolis! Just right for kids!
column10: These Chef Boyardee Mini Raviolis from Amazon are the same price I pay at Wal Mart - about 88 cents a can - and its the kids fave, so having a case on hand is excellent! Each ravioli is bite size and just right for little kids who still like to eat with a SPOON. They are a little bigger than "spoon size" shredded wheat, but still small enough to fit a spoon. Not high in fat or calories, they make a nice hot emergency meal for adults, too! FYI: These contain SOY (TVP) if you need to know that. Enjoy!
This is for me.Deliver my food.No dents,sealed in plastic.No shipping cost.The price is right.Very good nutrition.This quantity allows me to have food on hand.

Now, this is ravioli done right. I've loved Chef Boyardee's ever since I was a kid, and the ravioli tastes as good as ever. I like mini better because it's easier to eat and less meaty for those who don't want too much meat, and the sauce is great for dipping a piece of bread in. Due to its high sodium/processed content, this is not something I eat on a regular basis, but it is fun to treat myself every now and then to this delicious ravioli. Yum!

Chef Boyardee! Mini Ravioli tastes pretty good, and one 15-oz can is a fair amount of calories, suitable for lunch or a small dinner for an adult female (ME).I like to always have a can around in case I need a meal right quick. I hope this becomes available again soon, because I've eaten all of the last 24-pack I bought.The other reviewer mentioned dented cans - my cans were all dented as well, but none of mine were broken or leaking, so I had no problem with it. The contents were perfectly good.

Product taste as expected but of the 12 cans that was ordered.  3 cans were extremely dented and 6 with some dents on the cans.  I will have to throw out the extremely dented cans as I am not sure when the cans were dented.  Not safe.

column9: Ill Even Eat it Cold , Out of the Can ! Thats how Good it Is !
column10: I loved this as a kid and I still like it today. What other food on earth could you eat straight cold, out of the can and it STILL tastes good? Its a nice quick meal and fills me up better then a can of soup.

It's the same Chef Boyardee that I've loved since I was a kid, but about a third of the cans were dented.  Of those four were so badly dented that I was too cautious to eat them.  Sort of negates the savings from buying in bulk when I have to throw four cans away.  I may try this again hoping I just got a bad bunch.  Either they need to be more discriminant in their product selection, or they need more careful shipping and handling.

Such a pantry staple. What a fantastic item to keep on hand for those weekend lunches or the 'fend for yourself' dinner nights. Truly the chef does ravioli right and the subscribe and save price is right also!
I'm not sure why this taste so different from the Chef Boyardee regular Ravioli, but it taste more bland. It's still a cheap snack to have around though.
Item arrived quickly in the mail. Product arrived as described. No dented cans. Ravioli does not expire until 2013. I would definitely purchase again.
These are great for lunches and buying by bulk makes it last forever. I just wish they'd put more sauce in the cans.

My mom made great spaghetti from scratch, but in a pinch she dished this slop up. Even as a child I hated the taste and texture of Chef Boyardee.Knowing her capabilities as a cook, I received this as though it was a bad episode within a nightmare.A form of child abuse? Probably not. But close.Buy this and give your kids a memory that they'll likely want to forget.
cheap if you have nothing else to eat. But if you have a sensitive stomach this slop is not for you.

Out of the 24 cans, all but two were dented and two were actually oozing contents.  Not sure if this is why they are priced reasonably and available through Subscribe and Save, or perhaps this is an oddity that won't happen again.

column9: Leave out the saturated Fats Please!
column10: I liked raviolis as a kid and thought I would enjoy the childhood flavors again. Chef Boyardee Raviolis taste pretty good just like I remember. Really filling too! Usually when a product is really filling I know it has lots of fat and these raviolis were no exception. 3.5 grams of saturate fat! I'm not accustom to eating that much fat and they made we feel a little nauseous shortly after eating them. Lighten it up Chef Boyardee!
Ordered 4 cases and almost every single can had a dent in them.  Amazon took care of the problem immediately.  Excellent customer service!!

Our family first experienced this kettle corn prior to a road trip. We had a small bag for sampling and the larger bag we decided to save for the road. Our entire family from youngest child to Grandma found this popcorn a perfect blend of flavors: carmel, not too sweet and the popcorn has the perfect crunch!Everyone loved it. My son shared some of the leftovers he had with his gramdmother telling her how wonderful it was.  Well, Grandma tasted the popcorn and she couldn't stop eating.  It was gone before we left town.  So to all who may choose to try this product be forwarned....it's addictive, just ask Grandma! The biggest challenege we had was not having enough on hand.  So our suggestion...buy the case!

This is the second brand of canned or bottled truffles. Firstly, what type of gadget gets this can to open? I had to use an old fashioned beer can opener which left me with the problem of fishing out the little truffles through a jagged opening. When I finally succeeded, chopped the truffles, and put my nose close to them, there was hardly any aroma. After adding them to the risotto I was making, there still was not much truffle perfume. This is a better quality truffle than the previous brand I'd bought. You actually could get that almost garlic like undertone to the truffle.I've pretty much decided that for a home cook, truffle infused oil of good quality is the way to go. You don't get the full spectrum of the truffle aroma, but what's there is quite intense.
I had never eaten steel cut oats before and didn't realize that they took 10-20 minutes to cook. We usually eat them on weekends when we have more time in the morning. They are very tasty!

My family ate oatmeal everyday for breakfast as long as I could remember. But it made me sick and I eventually stopped eating it, although I loved it. After 25 years of not eating it and missing it everyday I finally discovered that if it was Gluten Free I could eat it and a new world opened up for me. Once I tried Bob's Red Mill Gluten Free I have never bought another brand. I use the regular oats for mostly cooking, although I do sneak a bowl now and then, and the steel cut oats for breakfast.

column9: The best canned fish I've had!
column10: The Bar Harbor canned fish products are of the highest quality and offer a great value.  I've had this product, the Cabernet wine sauce and the cracked pepper varieties.Of the three, this is my favorite with the wine sauce a nice second.  The cracked pepper type is essentially this one with black pepper added, which really doesn't work for me (but is still far better than most canned fish).The fish is soft and moist and is not overpowered by any heavy handed oils or weird additives.  Very simple and pure ingredients give it a very clean taste with a wonderful texture.I highly recommend it!

Normally I buy Appel (imported) or Trader Joe's brand tinned herring, but was looking for a variety without canola oil and stumbled upon these on Amazon.  Upon ordering these, I had a tin right after I received them.  The price is right - the other varieties I was buying were slightly more expensive and usually there were few in stock at the store - maybe 1-4 cans only.  The Bar Harbor herring is great - no canola oil, tin is easy to open, and the fish is just the right texture and taste - not too smoky, not too overpowering.  These are great and I'll definitely be reordering!

This product is evidently produced in Canada, probably in New Brunswick, from wild herring harvested in or about the Bay of Fundy or the Gulf of Maine.The herring are filleted and then lightly smoked before canning. The result is a delicious, healthy and wholesomefood item that mates well with warm, crusty French bread or multi-grain crackers. Highly recommended.

Go ahead and google it. Oily fish like herring and mackerel keep you well down there. They're chock-full of omega-3 fats. Just as important, these little lifesavers--unlike tuna--are at the bottom of the fishy food chain, meaning that they have much lower mercury levels than well, tuna. I've been eating herring for years and Bar Harbor's taste like they just came out of the sea. Okay, that's not true but they do taste much better than every other canned fish I've tried.

I eat Kippers all the time. I have found that there is no correlation between price and quality. These pretend to be from local fisherman in Maine.I am from Maine, I could not find this company until I went to Google Maps. These guys are inland, and buying this stuff from Canada and Europe. No problem with that but please do not BS us. There kippers are only OK. I like King Oscar better, and Polar after that. And both those are cheaper. I do like that they have a goodly sized portion, but I can eat two King Oscars for less than one of theirs. Just saying.

1000% better than the Kippers you get at the Super Market.  These are delicious and the smoked flavor makes these a delicious cross between smoked bacon and sardines.  But these Smoked Herring are better than bacon.  Delicious, buy these and give them a try, they will fly off the kitchen shelf and make a great breakfast.

I was a little surprised to find myself buying canned fish on Amazon. And now I'm even more surprised to find myself inspired to write a review of it. But this fish is so good I can't help myself. Hands down, Bar Harbor has the highest quality canned fish I've ever had, and it's also the least expensive. What a find! I've had the Smoked Kippers, the Herring in Mustard, and the Smoked Mackarel: all stellar. I expect to be ordering these again and again.

Lately I have been indulging in canned fish, like the Angelo Parodi skinless and boneless sardines (which I like a lot). I've always like pickled herring, so I decided to give some canned herring a chance. I tried the Bar Harbor wild herring with cracked pepper, which is pretty good and has a slightly smoky flavor. But these natural smoked wild kippers beat the pants off that. They are incredibly satisfying to eat. I like how you don't have to do anything to them. They aren't packed in oil, like someone said, but herring is an oily fish. Maybe if you are used to eating those kippers that look like they are nicotine stained, these kippers will be bland. To me, they have a just-right amount of smoking. Also, they are not mushy but they are not stiff either, like a good sardine. I will be buying a lot more of these in the future, I can tell you that.

I love smoked canned fish.I eat kippered snacks and sardines quite regularly. I was pretty excited when I saw these kippers for sale. I promptly ordered a dozen cans because I was attracted to the high quality packaging and the eco friendly lingo on the cover.The interior of the can leaves much to be desired. The fish seams to be over cooked and falling apart. The flavor is pleasant but was greatly aided by a couple of turns of my sea salt mill. The smoke flavor is very mild and not at all what I expect from a kippered snack. The smoke flavor is there but not nearly as strong as I would desire.In all honesty I prefer the $1.00 cans of Brunswick kippered seafood snack I pick up at my local Big Lots. They are firm, smokey and correctly seasoned.  For a truly divine kipper experience I would recommend trying the Appel brand of kippers available here on Amazon.

I first ate sardines as a kid. My Dad had them all the time - snacks while watching football, Friday nights when his friends were over for poker. They were a staple on our family camping trips. I liked them then and I like them now although until recently I didn't eat them as much as I used to. I keep a can or two in the pantry and enjoy them now and then. Recently, I went to a gourmet food store and found Bar Harbor All Natural Smokes Wild Kippers. They were on sale so I bought a couple of cans. UNFREAKING BELIEVABLE! Comparing these to the regular sardines I grew up with is like comparing a 10 year old Kia to a brand new Lexus. The Bar Harbors are absolutely delicious! I just served these as an appetizer to some friends I had over for a BBQ. I opened a few cans and put the fish in the middle of a serving plate and surrounded it with a variety of crackers. My guests thought this was some kind of expensive imported smoked fish, they loved it and it disappeared quickly. If you have ever had sardines and enjoyed them then you will be extremely happy with these. It is hard to get over to that little gourmet grocery all the time, so I am very very very happy that I can order these on Amazon - and at a great price. Yes, Amazon's price is less than I pay at the gourmet store.
These have become one of my favorite snacks. They are little morsels of smoky goodness! Great on a Triscuit with a dab of wasabi!

After reading all the reviews I was really looking forward to getting these.  The arrived and I excitedly opened a can.  The texture was soft and the fish fell apart at the slightest touch. I could barely pick it up with a fork as it broke into a million little mushy pieces every time I touched it.  I thought it must be a fluke- an odd can that was abnormal.  Every can I have opened is the same.  The flavor is fine but the texture is totally off-putting.  I'll not buy any more.B. G. HuffPhilo, IL

These were truly a joy to eat, extremely tasty, something you actually enjoy eating as opposed to sardines which just aren't so delicious.That said, I didn't notice how much salt is in them until after I finished eating. There are 3.5 servings in the 6.7oz can and 280mg of salt per serving (listed as 10% of daily value, for just one serving... I ate almost the whole can, but I was hungry and they were tasty...) I wouldn't care so much, but it's not sea salt. (and even if it was, that's probably more salt than necessary) It's probably iodized sodium chloride (table salt), heavily processed and chemically stripped of all minerals.I allow canned fish in my diet because it is a good way to get omega 3's, especially while traveling or camping, but I am not so comfortable with the fact that the fish, while in the can, is brought to such high temperatures that it is considered sterile. Omega 3 fats are delicate, better to eat fish high in omega 3's raw, fermented, lightly seared, etc. Also concerned about leaching of the metal can. I only buy in water because I don't want to eat olive oil that has been so highly heated. It would be full of oxidized fat, but then again, maybe so is the fish after being canned. I am not so concerned with getting BPA free cans - They may take the BPA out and put in something just as bad or worse... a different bisphenol. I read someone saying the BPA was actually what kept the metals from leaching into the food. I think it was just their speculation based on tasting a metallic taste in a bpa free canned food, but it seems to me that could be the case.so what's worse, possible metals, bisphenol, and oxidized fats? or do the boost of omega 3 fats and protein, convenience, low cost, and lowest mercury content of any other fish outweigh these issues? (pcbs, dioxins are another matter and their levels depend where the fish come from) You must consider how much bisphenol, leaching metals, and oxidized fats you are getting in your diet already, and decide for yourself. You may want to get rid of all the other possible sources of these things and just allow yourself canned fish every once in a while.Ideally I would like to see on the can where the fish comes from and whether it is sustainably harvested. I also prefer spring water and sea salt or no salt.The wood smoking is another point of contention, because it forms carcinogenic compounds. However, wood smoking was done traditionally in healthy cultures, and is nowhere near as bad as charcoal smoking. Plus, it's really tasty.If you like canned fish for the low cost and also the health benefits, you might also buy a non oily fish head for very cheap and make fish stock which is extremely nourishing.I think I will stick to herring because it is so much more delicious than sardines. I can also buy wood smoked herring packaged in plastic in the refrigerated section for very low cost. It has regular old table salt :(, but I will give that a try too. Since it isn't canned I feel better about it.Didn't mean to give a lecture but there I went. As you can tell I've done a bit of thinking and research on this and maybe someone else can benefit from it.I think Crown Prince makes kipper snacks without salt so I will have to try those next.

If you like this kind of thing, then this is the brand for you.Not as salty as some other brands, with firm flesh and delicate flavor,it's a real treat on a salad, with crackers, in a fresh-bread sandwich,or straight out of the can on a camping trip or picnic.Or, serve with coffee, juice, eggs and crumpets (or English muffins) foran old-time British-style Breakfast, like I had on a trip to England many years ago.Bar Harbor Smoked Wild Kippersdeliver the goods.Imported from good old Canada.I truly love this brand.

I usually buy Trader Joe's smoked kipper snacks and really like their uber smokiness. These don't have the same density of smoke flavor, but they are packed in water instead of the heavier oil that TJ's uses and it gives them a more delicate demeanor. They are still tough enough to stand up to most people's rigorous "fork test". I am trying a different brand this next purchase, but I wouldn't hesitate to come back to these. Bonus points for a cardboard wrapper. Isn't it about time we ban plastic wrappers for goods that don't require the added freshness??
I realy injoyed the tast of these kippers, better then other's .I also injoyed the texture of the fish. I will recomend to frind's...

column9: Pretty good! Lightly smoked and tasty
column10: I like kippers and these are delicious. Lightly smoked, as firm as any canned fish is, and just generally tasty. I will be buying more of these for sure!

I've eaten a lot of fish. I've eaten raw, cooked, smoked, canned, & many other types. I've tried all kinds of herring, canned, & this is one of the best & for the price, it's even better. We do lots of mixed salads with great California Oil/Vinegar w/fresh baked bread w/them. A nice white wine also. Don't forget the wine. One other thing, they won't be around forever. One good thing about canned fish is that they keep well for years if stored right. One in Alaska.

I grew up in Britain, where kippers - smoked herrings - were a common breakfast food.  Wishing to make kedgeree, a anglo-indian dish featuring smoked fish, including kippers, I shopped around and, based on the Amazon reviews, bought this product.  The fish that I received may have been smoked but they were then packed in oil to reverse the effect of smoking.  The result is an overly-priced version of sardines in oil.  This product is a travesty of the art of producing smoked fish, particularly kippers. That said, please buy this product if you like relatively tasteless, oily cans of dubious fish.

They are very tasty and the smoked flavour makes them really special.  I like the fact that they are from Maine and are a carfully managed migratory species.  Great on salads instread of Tuna or chicken.  Stock up!

Bar Harbor brand seems to be top shelf in everything I have bought from them.  They aren't exactly giving away there products put because of the quality they are good buys.  No guessing with the Bar Harbor brand.  You get what you pay for.  Yes.....I reccomend this product.

These kippers have a very good flavor and the price is reasonable.  The only thing I am a little disappointed in is that the pull tabs break off of the lid and I have to open the can with a screwdriver and pliers.  Not so good on the quality of the can itself.

column9: They're fine, but not a quantum leap from what I can get in a supermarket.
column10: Kippers are really fishy fish that are great if you love fish but can cause others (like wives) to run screaming out of the house.  I purchased these due to the other reviews, and because at the time the price for 12 6.7 oz cans compared very well to the price of 24 3 oz little cans at my local supermarket.However, the overall kipper experience wasn't really much different from the stuff I bought off the store shelves locally.  What I got what just what I expected, a can of soggy fishy tasting fish that gives me a lot of protien and if served with the right bread or cracker and some spreadable chive and onion cheese is quite a healthy snack if I'm hungry enough to want to eat it.Oh yeah, the pull tabs break off really easy on these, so even though you can't wait to dive into these cans of kippers, take it slow when you open them or you'll be digging around for your can opener.

I had never thought much of paprika. Considering it mostly used just for color. That was until someone suggested Hot Spanish Paprika. Holy Moly!The flavor is delicious! Don't waste your money on those typical grocery store brands of paprika. They can't even compare.
The paprikas I purchased were of excellent quality. Been using and experimenting with all the flavors. I like the traditional the best so far.
The paprika comes in two different cans.  The hot is hot and the sweet is not as sweet but they work fine!

Amazing good and almost addictive. I would not have been nearly as happy with any oter combination of cheese flavors. Kudos to Cheez-it for hitting the spot! They probably could be better for me, but with such savory flavors, it was easy to eat just a handful and not overdo it. Par-tay in my mouth. The shipping was great and fast as per usual (yay Amazon!), the boxes were new not dated or anywhere near expiring, they was no cracker breakage due to shipping, and it was all that I ever dreamed of in taste. I approve.
OMG!I just gained 5 pounds. I really love these. They are so cheesy, I can't stop eating them; before I know it half the box is gone. I like the hot and spicy,too!
This is the perfect blend of cheeses!  The kids love them and so do the adults!

These crackers are my new favorite. The Parmesan really is the best. The sharp cheddar that comes mixed in the box is really good, too. I used to think the white cheddar was the best. Now, it's an 'old reliable'. I keep wondering which of these flavors would be best crumbled in the food processor, or blender to be used in meatballs, or meatloaf. Cheez-Its, made into crumbs, would be good on baked, or fried chicken, or fish, or on top of your favorite casserole dish. Really, try these, they're delicious.

If you're a fan of original, regular ol' zits (Cheez-its) these are not for you.The Parmesan zits are disgusting, coated with a moist, powdery, overwhelming, sour-ish flavor mess. Tastes nothing like cheese - or cheez, for that matter. Look at the picture on the box, there's little green specs of herb, like oregano or something. That's not on the crackers at all but they mixed in some fake oregano flavor with the nasty flavor powder. Original zits have flavor baked inside - not dusted on after the fact. This horrendous flavor also works its way onto the sharp cheddar zits, ruining them.My dog eats anything and she refuses the parmesan zits. I do, too. I'll never make this mistake again. Try 'em - you'll see.Gross!
these snack crackers are very tasty . You don't even need a dip just eat them plain. they have a mild flavor.price is comparable to grocery stores.
These crisp little jewels have become our favorite TV snack! Product arrived in perfect condition and immediately became a hit with us.
i agree with some others who LOVE them..........these are much better than the usual normal just regular cheez-its.  get em!!  don't know if i will share them or not - heh.

Wonderful cheese flavor that made me order it through the Subscribe and Save program through Amazon.  I no longer have to buy it at my local Jewel and having it delivered right to my door is an added bonus.

column9: Not as good as buying from the store
column10: I love these crackers, but I just received my first subscription shipment for these and I will probably not buy them again. There are an above average number of smashed crackers and they taste somewhat stale even though the expiration date is next year.

While both of the flavors (sharp cheddar & parmesan) are individually savory, the combined flavors were not great.  The first box I opened had a great number of broken and crumbled crackers, which resulted in the flavorings melding together.  In addition, the crackers had much more moisture than expected.  This moisture allowed the flavorings to mix further.The other three boxes were better - crisper and not as many broken crackers.  This allowed me to separate the crackers by flavor, which sort of defeated the "Duoz" concept.I had higher expectations and definitely would not have these again.

These came and the crackers were all together in one container.I thought the difference flavor crackers would have been in theirown container.  The flavors were okay, but hard to tell what theflavor really was.  Very salty.

Not a big deal for me since I can kill a box of these easily in one sitting, blood pressure, pre-diabetes, and cholesterol be damned, BUT!--note that the expiration date was January 2011.  I received my order mid-December.The ones on the shelves at Vons expire September 2011.  This has nothing to do with Amazon being tricky, I assume the online snack ordering just hasn't quite caught on enough for inventory to clear as quickly as in B&M stores.As for the Duoz product, I'm going to order straight parmesan next time since I every time I get a sharp cheddar I think to myself, "Damn! I wish it were parmesan."But you know what they say...sometimes you need to pair a pretty with an ugly to appreciate the former more.

column9: Hard to Find Easter item, Amazon had it!!
column10: Black Jelly Beans - Licorice Flavor - 2 Lbs. Tired of going store to store to find Black Jelly Beans? Sit down at your computer. Amazon is amazing!

column9: NO JOKE...The best brownies of my life, gluten or no gluten! Kid tested Mother approved!
column10: NO JOKE...The best brownies of my life, gluten or no gluten! Kid tested Mother approved.
Not as hot as I expected or would have liked but it sure is tasty!

column9: Deelicious and satisfying! But overpriced here.
column10: I recently discovered Thin Addictives, and they are, indeed, addictive! The pistachio almond ones are awesome, but I haven't tried the cranberry ones. I am only bothering to post this because I was looking to get a deal by buying online, but I found they are more expensive here. I bought them at B.J.'s wholesalers for, I think, $5.89 a box. The only difference that I can tell is that the ones on line have 20 packs per box, and the ones from B.J.'s only contain 15 packs--but still you can get THREE boxes of 15 for less than $2 more than they are asking here for one box of 20.

I usually am not a fan of biscotti, it is usually so dry there isn't much taste.  These are fabulous.  Even though they are extremely thin, they do not shatter when you bite into them, and the pistachio flavor is fresh, the other flavorings are subtle but really tasty, and I think there is just the right level of sweetness.  The individual packets make it easy to carry around in a pocket, and with a piece of fruit this is a great midday snack!  Others have mentioned in their reviews that it is cheaper elsewhere, but I don't think it is fair to give this 1 or 2 stars only because of price because if people are searching based on reviews, this comes up very low on the list.  Unless they read the individual reviews they might not realize the rating had nothing to do with taste.  So I agree with the reviewer who still gave high stars and then mentioned the price issue in the review itself.  BTW, on the company website it is only cheaper if you are willing to buy a case, which costs $35, plus shipping.  They are indeed cheaper at COSTCO but I don't have a membership plus would have to drive about 45 min to get to one.  I'd have to start by purchasing a COSTCO membership, so in the end that isn't cheaper for me.  I am really glad I can get this on Amazon (I have Amazon Prime, so there is free shipping) to get an occasional box to tide me over while I wait for friends to pick some up to me on their next COSTCO run.  These really are hard to resist, good that they are packaged in 100 calorie portions but very easy to eat more than one!

column9: gym socks fresher and more tasty
column10: The title is CRUNCHY, but the texture is stale and far from anything crunchy. Although the expiration says Nov. 2012, it probably either was never crunchy or should have been tossed 2 yrs ago.The flavor nonexistent. I thought perhaps me, shared with 3 other people. All felt minimal taste, nothing almond in it, perhaps HINT of pistachio, and terribly stale. The only positive with it is that the dogs like it. Expensive dog treat.
These crisp and slightly sweet toasts are delicious and filling.  They are healthy and a handy snack to keep in your purse for something that won't spoil lunch or dinner. A little pricey.

I don't usually review items, but I am highly impressed with this dog food.  After much research, I decided to go with Blue Buffalo based on very favorable reviews of the ingredient list.  What I wasn't prepared for was my puppy's response to this food.  We recently adopted a Treeing Walker Coonhound mix from a rescue organization and kept her on Science Diet for two weeks until she got settled in our home and I was able to figure out what we wanted to feed her.  I thought she was a very light and grazing eater because she would not finish her food at feeding time.  Rather, she would come back throughout the day and take a few bites at a time.  When we took her out, she would constantly eat grass.  That is, until we started the switch to this food.  As soon as the bag was delivered from Amazon, she smelled it and kept following me smelling it as I tried to put the food it away -- good sign #1.  Even at the initial 75% old 25% new food mix, she ate her full feeding at one sitting for the first time -- good sign #2.She is now fully transitioned to the new food, and eats her full meals in one sitting. The grass eating has stopped and she was able to transition to this food without any loose stools or other issues -- good signs #3 and 4. Needless to say, she absolutely loves the Blue Buffalo food and having hear eat her food in one sitting has greatly simplified my life as her bowel movements are now regular, greatly helping in the whole housebreaking process.  I haven't noticed much of a difference in her coat, but she's only been on the new food for a little over a week. Based on my positive exeprience with this food, I intend to switch her to the adult version of Blue Buffalo once she gets past the puppy stage.

column9: Generally positive, Got my dog through puppyhood, but take note...
column10: I believe this food worked for my goldendoodle puppy.  We Bought Blue Buffalo Chicken and Rice for my puppy after acquiring her at 8 weeks of age.  We switched her off Purina puppy because we wanted to go with a food containing no bi-products.  Blue Buffalo fit the bill.  Taste-wise, our pup did not discriminate.  She gobbled up her BB food and wanted more.  She grew up healthy without any problems.Once she hit around 8 months she would have occasional bouts with diarrhea.  I'm not sure if it was due to the food or her adjusting immune system but from that point forward she would have these bouts approximately once a month.  During these times we had to take her off BB and feed a bland diet of chicken, rice, and pumpkin to get her over the hump until resuming BB.  This would always work but the bouts would return occasionally.  We switched her to and adult blend - BB Wilderness (Chicken) at just over one year, hoping that grain free would alleviate this issue; however it still happened on and off.Our dog is now about 1 year and 3 months old.  We are switching her off BB Wilderness over to the Merrick duck and sweet potato recipe (grain free as well).  We never figured out the exact cause of these bouts and don't know if the food switch will fix things either.  The treats we give her were generally high quality consistent with her food and we never give table scraps. One thing we read was retrievers have been known to have food allergies and intolerances, and sometimes have sensitive stomachs.  Then again, young dogs' immune systems are constantly developing just as humans.  Dogs can't tell us what's bothering them so it's us to make our best judgment based on how their bodies react to things.My review is generally positive because I can't necessarily blame this food for my dog's occasional problems.  Every animal's body is different and these types of problems don't always reflect on the quality of the food.  For the most part she seemed to respond well and liked the taste as well.  I think it would be good just to take note if other people experience the same issue.
