I love Baby Brezza! I use it virtually every day-it is so convenient! If you ever do have a problem the customer service is great as well. I accidentally dropped the bowl and it cracked. I called Baby Brezza and they promptly shipped me a new one free of charge! So glad I bought this product.

I bought the Baby Brezza after alot of research and I'm happy to say I love it!  It steams and purees and is SO easy.  One thing to note is that after the food is steamed there is alot of water in the processor which is fine if your baby likes really runny purees.  My baby likes texture so I always drain the water before I puree and it comes out perfect.  Love it!  I dinged it one star because it is very small so I have to make several batches, but it's not a deal-breaker.  I would recommend this to anyone.

I LOVE my Brezza!  It's such a timesaver.  I just chop up whatever I'm making, fill the water tank, and let it do the rest.  Could I do the same thing with a steamer basket and a food processor?  Absolutely.  This is not a necessary item.  But I'm so happy that I don't have to deal with the extra steps and extra dishes.  It's wonderful!  I have to say, the customer service provided by the company is exceptional, also.  I used mine (the older model) regularly for 4 months before it stopped blending.  I contacted the company, and with absolutely no hassle whatsoever they shipped out a replacement unit.  Better yet, it was the newer model!  I'm thrilled with this appliance and would recommend it to anyone!

column9: Fresh baby food couldnt be easier
column10: We use this to make our daughter baby food and it could not be easier.  We've cooked all sorts of fruit and vegetable foods for her.

Just received this on Friday, have already made multiple batches of baby food with it and overall I love it. The only work required is to chop the veggies and add water, and this machine really does the rest. My only very minor complaints are 1) that the instructions are a big confusing (directions say to use 160ml of water, but the container is marked to measure 180ml, but after a few batches it was easy to eyeball how much you really needed) and 2) the blade is a bit hard to get out after it's finished to really get all of the food out (trial and error showed that you need to take the blade out while the cup is still attached to the base and then it's easy to get all of the puree out). Overall, however, the instructions are very easy to understand and the machine is easy to use and very efficient! I was able to make carrots, sweet potatoes and butternut squash purees over the course of a couple of hours while still getting other things done around the house. This will even be ideal for some single servings of adult foods like mashed potatoes. One butternut squash made multiple servings, so I think the savings do offset the cost of this machine over time.

column9: Quick and Easy Baby Food Processor
column10: This baby food processor is the BEST baby item I own!  It is really important to me to make my own baby food, but the thought of chopping, boiling/steaming, processing the veggies/fruits and then washing all these items is just another annoying item to add to the list of To Do's during the day. The Baby Brezza makes all that so simple and easy that I don't mind taking this extra step to give my baby the best nutrients AND save money! All you need to do is chop the food, stick it in the machine, and wait for it to be cooked and pureed. The clean up is simple and the machine is nice and compact for storage in my tiny kitchen. The food consistency is perfect and the recipe book gives some great suggestions for food varieties and quantities. Love this item and would highly suggest for you to buy one of your own.

I've just started making baby food for our baby--the Baby Brezza works like a charm!  It makes the whole process very easy.  You can literally chop up a vegetable, put it in the Baby Brezza, and hit the button.  It will steam and puree the food for you!  The instruction manual tells you how long to steam each vegetable.  It purees the food much better than my food processor.  If I used the food processor, I'd have to add an extra step of straining the food after it was pureed.  The only negative to the Baby Brezza is that it only makes limited quantities at a time.  But since the process is so easy, that doesn't bother me.  It's quick and easy to make multiple batches.  Not much to clean up when you're done either.  I pour the puree into ice cube trays to freeze.  In a couple of days, I quickly dip the bottom of the trays in warm water and then pop the cubes out into a zip lock bag to store in our deep freezer.  It's great!

Starting my baby on solids couldn t have been easier! This great size machine makes absolutely perfect baby food. Also there is a recipe book attached and specific instructions on how much time most fruits or veggies need to be vaporized for which is gret help. I strongly recommend it and as a first time  mom it has made my life very easy!
Great product. Super easy. I freeze food in ice tray then put in freezer bags. Just pop a few cubes in the Brezza and steam and you're ready to feed baby!

Love, love, love this product! Follow the cooking guide, just a press of a button & walk away! This product really helps save me on time & dishes! I was using a steamer & then the bullet, but this is all in one & I have the option to steam & blend or just blend. The cleaning is super easy & there was no assembly! The first time I used it I was so excited I wanted to keep making baby food all day & just experiment. If you are looking for huge portions you may want to stick to a blender, this is just the right size for me for cooking & for storage. I freeze my portions in a mini 12 muffin silicone tray & then place them in a freezer bag. I'm very happy with my investment!

column9: Far better than competitors and cheaper too!
column10: I love the Baby Brezza.It's by far the best baby food maker out there.I have tried the Beaba and the Kalorik. They were both awful.I am so glad i found the baby brezza. One step! Hooray! I put the food in the bowl and i press one button "steam and blend" and then it does just that. It steams the food in no time and the powerful blender makes everything perfectly smooth. It's simple to clean and works every time. You also have the choice to just steam or just blend. This product is head and shoulders above it's competitors....and cheaper too!

column9: LOVE the Brezza, makes my life so easy!
column10: I knew I wanted to feed my baby homemade nutritious meals and have a couple of great baby food cookbooks that I purchased. I know I could have used the items already in my kitchen to make baby food but I wanted one, easy, one-step machine that could do it all so I wasn't washing multiple pots/pans/steamers everytime I made baby food.The Brezza has made my life SOOOO easy!  I can cook squash, peaches, pears, apples, sweet potatoes etc. and blend and reheat with this fantastic appliance. And it's small and convenient!  I haven't had any mechanical issues with it (I've only had it for about a month) and it can get hot due to the steaming BUT this is like any pot or pan you'd use to steam.  It just takes some common sense when you're using it.I can spend one day making big batches and freeze them in individual ice cube trays (with lids) and then be done with cooking baby food for a couple of weeks!  This is an invaluable appliance to me, I highly recommend the Brezza.  It makes cooking your own baby food a breeze (and super cheap!) and easy to do so you're not feeding your baby processed baby foods.

I received this product on Saturday August 26th, and immediately starting using it to prepare my 5 month old her first baby food. I decided to start her off with carrots and I was a little apprehensive that the machine would not be able to puree them to the consistency I needed. Well let me just say I was wrong this machine is awesome I put the carrots on and they were steamed and blended in a matter of 25 minutes without me having to watch the machine. I was able to wash dishes and start a load of clothes while the Brezza did it's thing. Thank You Brezza for making my life a little easier! Oh by the way my daugther loved the carrots.

column9: Just get it, you won't regret it!
column10: So I've had this for a couple of weeks but tried it yesterday evening.  Wow!  It was soo easy!  Literally, I just rough chopped the apples, set the steamer and timer, decided to take a shower, came back, and VOILA!  I had fresh, delicious home-made apple sauce in 20 minutes!  I didn't have to stand over it and dump the water and transer the basket yadda yadda (who has time for that?!).  And it was so cheap.  I bought just 1 organic carrot and I ended up making 4 4 oz jars of carrot purees.  You can also add meats for when they get older.  I have also heard of moms using these to make purees to stick them in brownies or cakes.  This is the best purchase I have made in a LONG time.

column9: Quick, Easy and Healthy Baby Food
column10: A reluctant cook with no extra time, I never thought I'd be able to make homemade food. This machine changed my mind. I tried the basic recipes first and it was so easy to use - and clean up (yay!) - we're now trying all kinds of food combinations. I love that I can also make healthy purees that I "hide" in my older childrens' foods. After about 2 months, I've already recovered the cost of this appliance with all the homemade food I've made in my Baby Brezza.

I wanted a baby food maker and based on the reviews this was the best choice. My parents were the ones who purchased it and gave it to me as a gift. I am glad I chose this baby food maker. All you have to do is chop the fruits or vegetables, and about 20 minutes late: TA-DA! Baby food! I love the recipes and the specifications regarding time for each fruit or vegetable that the book has. My favorite thing: it makes everything in ONE container so it's easy to clean. Buy it, you won't regret it. It'll make your life easier.

Update - Feb 27, 2012The product worked fine for about 6 weeks.  In the last two weeks we have had issues where the device wouldn't steam intermittently.  Everything was done exactly the same way.  No user error.  Then finally last week it seems the bearings (I think they have bearing) in the center colum broke.  The underside of the Baby brezza is dark - presumably from the grease in the bearings.  The device would steam, but the blade would not spin.Then today, it stopped steaming as well.  About to send the product back.  Had nothing but problems with this since we got it.  $100 just wasted.  Wouldn't recommend it.  Extrememly frustrating when at the last minute you have to figure out some other way to feed your kid.  Products like this need to work, and work well.  They are after all for children and will be used everyday!  Not sure what kind of quality control this company has.(update after a couple of weeks of use)The product does work well.  Yes there are some lumps but if you manually hit the blend button for a bit longer you can get a very smooth puree for your child.The one other issue I have found is that the blade is a bit difficult to take off.  I have to pull it quite hard 40% of the time - hard enought that I though I was going to break the plastic.  My wife felt the same way.  So my rating of 3 stars don't change, however it is stable and good product and we do use it daily.Overall the product works.  However I did have one major problem.  The first time I tried to use the product, it would steam, and the motor would turn on but the blade wouldn't spin.  I called up Baby Brezza and it turns out they had a manufacturing issue where the belt had slipped off the cog for the blade.  They knew about the issue and immediately told me to remove the 5 screws from the bottom, remove the cover and slip the belt onto the cog.  All in all, it was easy to do and took all but 5 minutes.  However, the fact that you get a product that would not work right out the box was a huge dissapointment and my wife was really frustrated.On the plus side, the lady at Baby Brezza did know the issue and was able to get me going right away.  First time I have had success with customer service with any company.

I got this baby food maker after reading some of the reviews and comparing it to a couple of others. This is by far the best baby food maker out there and though I initially thought it to be a bit pricey it has been a total help in preparing babies foods. I love that you can just sit it and forget it. I also use it as a food warmer i just set it to steam for a couple of minutes.  I love that I can make wholesome food for my baby, and that I know exactly what is in the foods I am feeding her.  Very happy with this product.

column9: Makes homemade baby food do-able for a working mom
column10: I have seen so many bad reviews for the various baby food makers, I was skeptical about the Baby Brezza.  It had the best reviews so I registered for it and figured if I received it I'd give it a shot.  I'm so glad I did.  It is easily one of the best/most useful baby items we own.  Making sure I know exactly what is going into my little man's tummy is as easy as chopping up whatever meat/veggie/fruit I choose (usually what I am cooking for the rest of the family so it doesn't require extra prep), tossing it in, and pushing the "steam and blend" button.  I can continue with whatever I was doing and in 30 minutes or less, I have four servings that just need to be scooped into containers to store.  Much less expensive and much more nutritious than the pre-packaged store bought stuff.  As a mama who works 10 hours a day, the Baby Brezza is priceless!

I bought this product from Target after I had done what I thought was enough research on baby food makers.  I was originally going to get the baby bullet, but the reviews were not good at all so I went with the brezza instead.  Mistake.  I remember that a few people had written about the poor quality and bad customer service (of the company itself, not amazon).  When I opened it, the tape used to secure it within the plastic bag was melted so there was sticky stuff all over the bottom of the thing.  I had to scrub it as soon as I took it out of the box, after it had gotten sticky melted tape all over my kitchen counter.  That was annoying. The plastic covering over the buttons looked like it was lifting (as if it had been used or something...even though it was brand new).  I tried the motor and it worked, it wasn't terribly loud, I'd probably rate the noise a 4 on a 1-10 scale.  When I went to wash it (prior to first use of course), the directions said to remove the driveshaft prior to washing.  It said all you had to do was to turn the canister over, find the knob, and turn counter clock-wise.  That driveshaft must've been welded in there bc it took me and my husband over an hour to loosen it enough to get it out of there.  I was honestly scared to put it back in for fear that I'd never get it back out again!  I got over it and prepared to make my first meal (carrots).  I followed the directions and cut up the carrots to the appropriate size but when I went to put the water in, there was a discrepancy.  The directions said to put in "160ml of water" and that the canister had a premeasured line that could be used so the amount of water would be correct.  Normally that wouldn't be a problem...except that the measured line read 180ml.  Seriously?!?  So, I'm left trying to figure out which one is correct.  I ended up going with the premeasured canister...and I think that it was too much water bc the carrots came out ridiculously watery.  There were also still chunks of carrot in the mix.  It wasn't easy to get the food out around the blades, either.  I can see how people would say that it might be a time saver.  If it worked and was of decent quality then it WOULD save time.  You just set it and walk away.  But the end result leaves much to be desired.  And for the price, you'd expect to at least get your money's worth.  You're honestly better off just getting a really nice food processor and going the old fashioned way.

Bought this item to make baby food for my twins.  Within a month we started to notice a black liquid coming from the bottom.  We also found that it was not so easy to take out the blade out from the cup.  After 2 months of using the product the motor went out and it did not blend.  We ended up buying a kitchen aide chopper/puree machine for MUCH less and it workes sooo much better and has a bigger blender cup too! After using the Kitchen Aide product you can tell how cheaply made the baby breeza is.  Don't waste your money, you will end up having to get something else in the end!

I ordered this product in December 2011. I must have used it maybe 5-6 times with the steam-blend option. Following is what I observed1. Doesnt blend peas very well.2. The food does have a smell from the plastic of the tank.3. The water tank is extremely difficult to clean due to its narrow curved shape. Even after I ordered Brezza cleaning brush, it doesnt clean properly and now I have build up in the tank. So I cannot steam anymore as I dont want contaminated water in my babies food.4. So, I used just the blender option for maybe 5-6 more times. And now the blender doesnt work. Just broke.I will get in touch with the seller to see if I can get a full refund. I dont think I want to exchange.

This product makes it possible for ME (a working mom) to make my baby fresh food every morning before WORK!  Please remember this is a fine piece of equipment.  You must follow directions.  DO NOT STEAM with-OUT DRIVEshaft and DO NOT STEAM with blade in down position.  I think most of the poor reviews came from people who did not follow instructions.  THis product save me time which equates to saving me money.  It pays for itself.PS You can make fresh quinoa (or rice) with the additional grain basket.

column9: If you're going to make the baby food, use this....
column10: I knew I wanted to make the baby food, but I wasn't so sure about buying one of these machines since I already had a steamer and a food processor, then I received the Brezza as a gift.  Now I'm hooked. It's easy to use, clean, and store (tiny).The down side is that a piece broke on it and made it unusable, the upside was that we called the company and they immediately sent a replacement part without any hassle.  While it was out of commission, I used the steamer and food processor and was so annoyed with that process - double cleaning and transferring... ugh.My husband and I both work full time so every weekend we do a whole bunch of batches and freeze them to use during the week.  Even my husband finds it fun to find new foods and combinations and helps out.  Plus it comes with this little tiny guide of what foods to feed when and recipes, which is a great starter kit.If you're going to make the baby food it's worth the investment.

This is an excellent product!  It works so well and is so easy to use.  However, I did break a plastic piece off from the bottom when trying to get the drive shaft off, but the company replaced it no charge! :) Awesome customer service!

It didn't work properly out from the box...it didn't blend but it wasn't about the belt issue.  It seems like the lock system of the blade wasn't work properly.  It is a easy fix and then work beautiful for almost 2 months.  Then, it stop blending...again, based on other review, I check the belt but it is still not the case.  The driveshaft was stuck....I fixed it somehow and worked for a few times and goy stucked again.  I called the company...I agree with others that it is rather annoying to leave a message but I got a call back next day.  I didn't call them and they follow up with another call 2 days later.  I called back to the extension and left a message, same day the person call me back...and sending me the blade and bowl accessories for free to fix my issue!  I think customer service is quite good... I love the machine because it works beautifully when it works (steam and blend) but rather a pain when it is not....given I pay $100 for it...I wish it can work more consistently.

column9: Twin mom making baby food for the first time
column10: I've used the baby brezza about 4-5 times so far and love it! Very easy to use and clean and my twins are loving the purees I've made with it. I'd definitely recommend this product!

column9: Great customer service and great for lazy mom
column10: My first baby I was too busy and exhausted to make baby food from scratch. Fast forward three years later, baby number two more tired. But baby breeza so simple I couldn't come up with excuse not too.One morning I dropped the cannister filled with water and it cracked.I tried to buy a new one and the company fed exed me a new one for free.Great product makes three easy meals. Simple.

I have been using the brezza to make all of my daughter's baby food for about 2 months. I purchased mine several months ago from another site. Since day 1 I have been getting a "4 beep" alarm every time I start the steamer. It usually works after pressing the start button several times. It always blends the first time I press the button. Last night I got frustrated and steamed my veggies on the stove then used a food processor to blend...what a pain in the neck... I finally called customer service today and they said that I should have called 2 months ago, and they are sending me a new unit at no cost to me. I am keeping my fingers crossed that the new unit isn't as quirky as the last one because when it works it is very easy. Both the steam and blend functions work well and it is so nice to not have to transfer the food. Clean up is a breeze. It does have a small bowl but a batch still makes several portions. Babies don't eat that much ;-). After using the food processor, I would definetly recommend this or another appliance that steam and blend. In my experience this company stands behind their product.

column9: Great homemade benefits with little work!
column10: I wanted to give my baby the best food possible without the additives, hormones, and antibiotics.....This machine let's me do that.  I can buy organic and make my own foods a couple of times a week and freeze it.  There are a lot of things I can't control environmentally, but this I can.

column9: I bought this for my niece and she loves it!
column10: I bought Baby Brezza for my niece and she loves it.  It has made here life so much easier by being able to simply put in food and the water and press a button.  She loves it and her kids are eating healthier.  Thanks for a great product!

If you watch demonstrations of each of the two best selling machines on u tube, you will see for yourself that this is the one to get.  One less step (no transfer) makes this the choice for me.  I have had no problems at all with this machine but do watch out for the super sharp blades. The only drawback I would comment on is that it is hard to separate the blade from the drive shaft for placing the blade into the dishwasher but I still manage to do it, just wish the separation were easier.

I bought the Baby Brezza based on a recommendation from a friend.  This is the easiest baby food maker, I'm so glad I bought it.  Making food for my daughter is so easy.  I peel, cut and put it in the Brezza where it steams and blends all in a matter of minutes.  When it's finished I have enough food for her meals for the next 3-4 days.  My daughter is 5 months old so we are starting new foods every few days so it makes the perfect amount.  I would recommend this product to any mom or dad who wants to make their own baby food.  Clean-up is also a breeze.  The only thing I would tell people is that the belt for the motor can get displaced during shipping.  My husband fixed it within a matter of minutes but I think I should mention this so that you don't think your product is broken.  From what we read online, this happens frequently.  Overall this is a great product and I highly recommend it to any parent!

It's pretty self explanatory once you receive it. Very simple and so quick! I would recommend this to everyone! It didn't chop up my food at first, but I just took the blade off and put it back on and I never had that problem again. Also, make sure to clean it!

column9: frustrated but its a good product.
column10: A good product but I received one and the puree function didnt work sent it back and ordered another one. 2nd one had the same problem. I figured if two that I received had the same problem I must not be the only one.  I read reviews and saw that others were saying take the machine apart and put the black belt back on. We did that and now it works like a champ. Whatever the cause of the issue they need better quality control.

I haven't found a flaw with this product yet.  I had been making my own baby food using a steamer and blender and this is so much easier.  I add water, dump in the food, hit the steam + blend button and it does the rest for me!  I haven't tried meat yet but it's taken care of the fruits and veg I've tried with no problems.

I bought a Baby Brezza for my sister who got herself 3 girls.  The intended gift was for child #3, Mia is her name, but my sister is using it to make all sorts of yums for the kids.  I tried that piece out when I was over there the other day. We made me a vat of apple sauce. Seemed so easy and in 15 minutes we had some homemade Motts. She loves the gift and now I know what to buy as a gift for any of my friends and family that are about to pop one out.

column9: Love! Works great, sometimes hard to disassemble.
column10: The Brezza works great, very convenient to have the steamer and processor in one.  I'm able to make fresh organic baby food quickly and easily.  I've only done fruits so far, however, I have not tried meats or multi ingredient recipes.  My only complaints would be that it can be hard to pull out the drive shaft when you go to clean it and if I don't do Steam + blend I have to hold down the blend for the whole time.  It should have a timed setting for the blend too.  With that said, I have still recommended to others.

I have made 6 or so batches of food with this and have really enjoyed doing so.  It's taken just a few hours on two Saturdays to make weeks and weeks worth of food.  Overall very happy with this product.  There are a few small things that bother me, like it being a bit difficult to get the blade out when you're trying to scoop out the food, without losing any of the food.  But overall it works great and produces food at a smooth consistency.  Very happy with my purchase!  And seriously when you compare the color of the food you make to the color of the stuff they sell in jars, it just looks more appetizing.

I just used this for the first time to make my daughter's first few batches of baby food.  Absolutely love it!  It assembles and disassembles super easily, and cleans perfectly in the dishwasher.  It is so nice to set it and forget it....once the steam cycle is complete it purees on it's own!  You can also use it just to steam veggies and fruits for older babies.  I was actually told to look into some of the other baby food processors, but so glad I decided to go with my gut and get the Baby Brezza!

After doing loads of research I settled on this maker. I love the one button steam and blend feature. It saves a lot of time and stress about having to remember to switch from one feature to another. If you're looking for an easy, efficient baby food maker then purchase this one. The others are not worth the money.

column9: EXTREMELY HAPPY WITH MY DECISION TO BUY BREEZA OVER THE BABYCOOK
column10: I read review after review trying to decide which to buy...my son's nanny has used both now and she liked both but loves the baby breeza.  It is quite a bit cheaper and she says there's really no difference except for the plastic insert that comes with the other babycook device.  I have been extremely pleased with my purchase.  I use the Breeza pretty much daily.  It's fast & easy to make my son's organic baby food.  The fact that you can select steam & blend is great because it does all the work once you chop up your veggies or fruit or whatever... you walk off and 15-20-25 mins later you come back to the kitchen and the food is steamed & blended already.  And the instruction manual gives a great guide for how long to cook each fruit/veg and it also gives a guide on what foods baby can eat at 6 mos, 8 mos, 10mos, etc...i have it tacked on my frig and it's a quick & easy reference.  This machine has been easy to clean for the most part.. My sweet potatoes stain the clear container a bit but that's nothing i couldn't scrub off.  All in all a great purchase.

I love my Baby Brezza.  It really makes baby food making a breeze- if you don't mind all the peeling and chopping!  My only complaint is that the color of the bowl is already changing colors from the food.  I really do love this though and it is a great tool for a busy working mom to be able to find some time to cook for her little one.

This is an awsome machine!Our first one was damaged but we replaced it the next day and I am so happy we did! Crazy simple. I love giving my son new veggies and fruits! We've been to the farmers market and Whole Foods to get all the fresh produce we can! It's so simple. Chop it up, set the machine and store it!No worries about any preservatives/what could be in his food! I've even tried a few new produce items I'd never wanted to eat before.(I have to taste what it is I'm giving him) And I just can't bring myself to try some of the foods that sit in the store on the unrefrigerated shelf for months/years...

column9: Making baby food is a breeze
column10: I have had this product for a few weeks now. I love it. All I have to do is chop fruits/veggies, throw them in and turn this on. It's that easy!

I'm not a mother, just a person who enjoys steamed and pureed single portions of food. I just got this today and I immediately tried it with broccoli and carrots, steam + blend for 25 minutes. Turned out perfectly! Once it was done, I added some seasonings and blended some more for a delicious side dish! I love that the steaming and blending occurs in the same place! Hand cleaning was very easy afterwards. The water chamber for steaming is a little annoying to dump out after each use, but doesn't take away from the overall awesomeness. I hope this product lasts a long time!

column9: Easy way to make healthy food for baby
column10: I recently purchased this item and have made 4 different recipes in it. I have three pointers for you.1. Use distilled water if you can, it will save you the hassle of having scale build up later on.2. Add extra water, especially on longer cook times (25m+). It seems like mine runs out of water in the middle of some recipes and then messes me up on cook time because it shuts off, and if I wasn't watching it, I don't know how much time is left!3. If you want a smooth puree for a younger baby, add 5 minutes to the suggested steam time. My first batch of carrots came out textured, and my 6 month old was not crazy about them. Next time, I did longer, and they were much smoother.All in all, I am very satisfied. It doesn't take up too much counter space. I love that I can make something all natural and homemade. One batch is enough for 3 to 4 feedings, especially if you are feeding different items (cereal, veggies, fruit). I do buy some organic baby foods in pouches, but if I am out of something, I can whip it up in a jiff from fresh produce or frozen. I plan on not buying any more store baby food in the future, except maybe to keep in the diaper bag for trips. You can make things you will never find in the grocery store. My daughter ate broccoli and spinach last night, with a touch of parsley. Today, I made carrots and parsnips. Before that, peas one day, sweet potatoes another, and carrots mixed with zucchini.Lastly, it's pretty easy to clean. Soak it when you are done, so the food doesn't get stuck on, and wash it as soon as you can. There are 3 or 4 parts to clean.

column9: Compact machine for easy, healthy baby food
column10: I could use a steamer on the stove and a blender to make baby food but why go thru all the hassle when there is already plenty of work to do especially since I have twins.  This machine is really simple.  You cut up the fruits or veggies, choose how long you want to steam them based upon the included cookbook and then set it to steam/blend.  15-25 minutes later you have fresh, healthy baby food.  I will definitely recommend this to friends and give it as a gift.  I've only used it for a week but I think it is great and there is no reason to ever buy baby food when it is so easy to make yourself.

I bought this for my daughter last night.  She was so excited, she opened the box, washed it and cut up a pear.  Within 10mins, we had fresh pear for her little one.  My grandson loved it.  It was so easy.  One push of a button and it did all the work, and made one weeks worth of fresh pear for my grandson.  Our first try, and we love it!  We can't wait to make more.
This food maker is wonderful. made carrots as a trial run and it turned out perfect. easy to clean (dishwasher safe) and takes up little space which is perfect for my small kitchen.

I have been buying the plum baby organics food pouches (which I still love) and thought I could try making homemade baby food to give my baby different combos of food that the pouches and other store brands didn't offer. I have had every machine (Baby Beaba, Baby Bullet and Baby Chef) and they were all returned. Finally I found the Brezza! Super easy to use, has a great steam option (which was what I missed in the baby bullet) and easy to clean. Couldn't be happier with this product and now I can make fun food combos. Also, I usually buy products from Amazon however this time I bought from Babies R Us.  They were running a special where if you bought the food maker you got the spatula and cutting board attachment for free.
I really want to know who created this?!! OMG It's really amazing. It's sooooo eazy to make baby food. Every mammies must have this!

I love this baby food maker.  It's easy to use and easy to clean.  Love the one step aspect of the machine.  Warning - you do need to make your baby's food well in advance because the food is piping hot when finished and you can't serve boing hot food to a baby.  But this machine works really well for my little one and she loves all the things I make versus the jarred stuff.  Worth every penny.

column9: 5.5 Month Update-DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT!!!!!!
column10: NO MATTER HOW GREAT AN IDEA THIS ITEM SOUNDS LIKE, DO NOT BUY IT!!!!  After all the buttpain this product has already caused me (see below), a mere 6 days after receiving the replacement for the FIRST defective driveshaft, turns out THIS "NEW" driveshaft has the same problem!!!! It seized up, and will not allow the blade to turn. At least the first driveshaft had the decency to work for 3 months. Unbelievable that this product is still being sold on Amazon, I am positive I am not the only one this is happening to. Short of getting my money back, there's pretty much nothing Baby Brezza can do to make this right. Send me another driveshaft??? Yeah RIGHT!!!!>>ORIGINAL REVIEW>> Had no issues with the Baby Brezza until now (month 3). The mystery black stuff I read about in other reviews has started making regular appearances and the blade is starting to get stuck when blending for no apparent reason.  I really love what this product has allowed me to do (I make food in it to feed myself as well as my son!), but bummed that I'm encountering this problem which, from casual browsing of the other Amazon reviews, is not a rare manufacturing defect, but rather a design defect/quality control failure which causes a $100 piece of machinery to fail just a few months after purchase. Calling Baby Brezza customer service today to see how they can rectify this situation (thank god I saved the box).>>>UPDATE 25 April 2012>>> !!!!!IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR BREZZAS WITH LOT NUMBER MWI-001BRU!!!!!!!After a few days of phone tag, the Baby Brezza rep contacted me and let me know that the particular lot number (look for that on the bottom of the base) of my Brezza was indeed having the issues I described, due to a faulty driveshaft.  The rep said they would "exchange"  my faulty drive shaft for a new one, but UNFORTUNATELY, the "new driveshafts" are STILL BEING MADE. And wouldn't be available to ship for approximately 5 weeks.  Their "consolation prize" was a free accessory (of course, I had already purchased most of the accessories back when I bought the Brezza!). Pretty damn inconvenient when you have a REALLY hungry 7 1/2 month old baby.So if you have this lot number, even if it's working now, I would definitely lean forward in the foxhole and get Baby Brezza to send you a replacement driveshaft. The fact that they didn't offer to send a whole new unit instead of making me wait 5 weeks, AND that they don't even have these new driveshafts yet, means to me that it may not only be this lot, but any other lot manufactured from July 2011 on that has the defective driveshaft.  SO BUYER BEWARE on this product if you haven't already bought one.  It's a fantastic concept, just bad, bad, bad quality control for the $$$cha-ching$$$$ it costs.>>UPDATE 15 MAY 2012>>Received a replacement driveshaft, blade and container (with lid) today, along with the "Sorry For the Inconvenience" gift of a food storage unit. It's been about 3 weeks since I spoke with the Brezza rep. Not bad, given the estimate she gave me was 5 weeks. Originally I was told only the driveshaft would be sent to me, so I'm pleased that I now have a backup container and blade!  I am satisfied, and have changed my rating, because I really do love what this product does!

I bought this from a brick and mortar baby supply chain, and I was so excited to use it! I peeled, I chopped, I steamed and pureed. I was so happy! Then I realized it took me all day to make one regular sized batch of baby food. Still, it was so easy to just throw it in and walk away, so I kept making my baby food, one tiny batch at a time. Then, the fourth time I tried to use it, it would not steam. The start, stop, and steam buttons do not work. I'd had the machine less than a month. Then I noticed (as I was dumping out my unused water) that there was a bunch of metallic looking crap floating around in the water chamber. Unfortunatly the box had been thrown away otherwise I would have just taken it back to the store. I emailed customer service and about a week later received an email that said "please provide us with a number to reach you". By looking at some more recent reviews I can see I'm not the only one having a problem with their customer service. The idea behind this product is amazing, the product itself is garbage. I don't understand for the life of me why they couldn't make the blender cup bigger than a coffee cup. Even if this product had worked beautifully I would have eventually gotten tired of making tiny batches. I've been using my food processor and steaming on the stove in a pot. It's more to clean up but I can make a large batch of baby food in much less time. I wanted to love this thing, I really did. It's just not worth the money.

I was so excited to use this when my daughter started on vegetables. When I went to blend the food, the darn blade was broken! Needless to say I was not happy and had to return it for a refund. Rather than buying another one and trying again, I'm going with another product altogether. Very disappointing but glad Amazon gave me a full refund!

column9: I love this machine so much.
column10: I LOVE this machine so much! My mother- in- law purchased this machine and gave it to me.I am a working mom and too busy all the times to cook. But just right after first cooking baby food with this Baby Brezza, I got to get love it!This is super easy and simple to cook, i just toss the ingredients in the jar, press buttons, and feed my baby.Every aspect got me satisfied - easy cooking/cleaning method, good size to store on the counter top, cute design and etc.And plus, Asian moms(like me) feed baby grains such as rice, barley and beans, very often, cooking grains with grain basket in baby brezza machine is also SO easy and simple - literally ONE STEP BABY FOOD MAKER.

column9: Great baby food maker and more
column10: I really like using this product because it's very easy and convinient to use.  If you are serious about wanting to make your baby really good food this is the product for you. It may seem a little pricey but it's totally worth it. It's also great to make food for the rest of the family.  I've made veggie patties for the my family and they loved it. I would also reccomend that you purchase the flat spatula that is made for the Brezza so that you can easily get all the food out.  They cutting board would also make it easier to put the food in but it's not a must.  This would be a good product to put on your baby registry for sure.  You won't regret getting this product!

Although the machine I received initially did have a manufacturer's defect and would not blend, both Jolity (the seller of the product) and Baby Brezza responded with excellent customer service and a new one is being shipped to me as we speak. The little bit I played with the original one I received though, I can tell it's a great machine and I'm very excited to use it! I love the concept of one machine doing both the steaming and the blending without messing up a bunch of other machines. And I found that both my food processor and blender were too large to efficiently do a small batch of baby food. The size of the Baby Brezza is just right.

I was elated to receive this as a gift, always wanting to prepare my own baby food. Looking at the reviews, it seemed like a fantastic buy. Upon first use, the plastic base holding the blades produced hairline fractures where food can now get lodged. The piece holding the blades is also supposed to be easily removed for food removal and cleaning; it's become harder to remove with each use and now is near impossible to separate from the shaft. The gray plastic, stains very easily; and now, after only a handful of uses, the plastic, hinged cap to the water reservoir snapped off. Approx 20% of the time, the device will steam and fail to blend.

column9: Good product, but what is that plastic/metallic smell and taste on food?!
column10: I was really excited to buy this food maker and get started.  After steaming and pureeing just one thing I noticed a plastic/metallic smell.  I brushed it off to the product just having that new smell.  Washed it out again and pureed more food.  Then I happened to taste the food and it had a horrible plastic or metallic taste.  I tasted different batches of things I made with all having the same result.  So instead of the food having a natural taste as the product claims, it all tastes like plastic!  I have no idea what can be causing this problem.  Maybe it will go away with time, but I certainly don't want to waste a bunch of food to perform a trial and error test over and over again. Very disappointed in the end result.

So I've really liked this product -- basically using it almost every day. However, I'm noticing that whatever silver coating is used in the water tank is coming off. Has anyone else noticed this? It's a huge concern to me as I thought I was beginning to see silver particles in the food. Until I sort this out, I have to give 1 star for safety concerns.

column9: Defective Unit...zero support...Don't ignore bad reviews.
column10: I read many reviews saying people received defective units where the blade wouldn't spin, but chose to ignore them.  Sure enough my unit had the same problem out of the box.  I tried calling Baby Brezza and all I got was an answering machine, my message was never returned.Thankfully, I found a review posted on  December 29, 2011 by D. Mc. which provided a DIY fix to the problem....too bad Baby Brezza cost me a lot of time and aggravation.

I love, LOVE, LOVE my Baby Breeza!  And, I spell it "Breez" because it truly is a "breeze" to use.  (Corny, I know.)  Honestly, it's the easiest machine to use, and what mom doesn't want "easy" in their routine?  Making homemade baby food can be a hassle because it's cumbersome, time consuming and tedious, but not with the Baby Brezza.  They don't exaggerate when they say, clean, peel, chop and then let the machine do the work.  It completely saves time by steaming and blending at the same time...genius!  The only time consuming part is cutting up the veggies/fruit.  But, I find it relaxing!I've used my machine a handful of times now, each time a success.  My 5-1/2 month old loves her food, and my 3-year-old likes being able to "help" by turning the machine on (with my supervision..of course).  I highly recommend this product to moms.  I just wish I had known about it with my oldest!  Stop debating and buy it...now!

Joyva Chocolate covered Raspberry Jelly RingsIf you grew up in NYC you took these things for granted.  At the cash register of every deli are sold small packs of candy made by the Joyva company of Brooklyn.  Although they may be more famous for their Halvah (Joyva Marble Halva Bars 12 Bars) (an ancient Turkish confection, dating back 3000 years... according to the Joyva web site), I was always partial to their "Jell Rings".  Having long ago left New York I have found that these simple treats are scarcely found west of the Mississippi and certainly completely absent from my current home in the Pacific Northwest (this being attributed to the complete lack of any NY style delis in the Pacific Northwest).Having found these on Amazon was a pleasant surprise, but (as of the time of this writing) being only available from a 3rd party merchant with a somewhat steep shipping price put a damper on my enthusiasm.  The 5 pound quantity also gave me pause (that's a LOT of Jelly Rings!).  But my wife (possibly tired of my repeated search for and failure to find these anywhere) ordered this item anyway, and I am glad she did!  About 1 month now from the time they arrived, I am just finishing off the box (with some help from friends and co-workers with whom I have shared).These small (about 1-2" across) ring shaped candies consist of a firm purple "berry flavored" jelly covered in a dark chocolate shell.  The jelly is less tenacious than a gummy bear, but firmer than say jelly you would put on a PB&J.  I actually prefer to eat them on the cool side, which increases the firmness.  The dark chocolate pairs nicely with the jelly, giving a little bitter offset to the sweet jelly.  The chocolate itself is not the highest "quality" when simply considered against other chocolates.  The Kosher Parve rating means that these contain no dairy.... how does one make chocolate without any dairy :-).  But I put "quality" in quotes because ultimately it just tastes good, and that is what should matter.I've shared these with friends and co-workers and have received one of three responses:1. These are good/OK...thanks2. These are great!3. Ugh...tastes sort of like cough syrup coated in chocolateI am obviously of the response 2 camp, but maybe you need a little NY DNA in you to have such a reaction.  Reaction 3 was not prevalent (but who knows how many response 1's were just being polite).  So in summary, I LOVE these things -- if you've never had them before you might want to try to find a smaller quantity before diving in to the 5lb box.Shipping and storage:The box pictured on this page was packed inside a cardboard shipping box, with a single ice pack along side it.  When I received mine the ice pack had assumed ambient temperature, so I am not sure what good it did.  The rings in their original packaging box (pictured) are arranged in layers with cardboard between he layers... this is not a great travel arrangement and upon opening I found them somewhat jumbled and a bit damaged.  The damage was mostly flakes of chocolate that had been knocked off, but overall appearance was acceptable.  My take-away here is be wary of ordering these when the weather is hot as spending time in the warehouse/truck would not be good for them.So overall: 5 stars for the candy, -1 star for the shipping/price = 4 stars.  Enjoy!

OK, I had actually heard about these things through the local supermarket that I currently work at, had seen them on display before, but never really paid much attention to them, except for when they were gone. Apparently they're only sold around holiday seasons around here for some odd reason.Anyway, I had read reviews that gave them high marks all around, and as soon as I saw these, I knew I had to try a box. So, after clocking out, I went and snagged a box, paid and immediately went to my car and opened that box. Needless to say, I was hit with a nice aroma, and had a feeling I was in for a treat. After I popped one into my mouth, and tasted it, I was hooked.The "jell" held within has a nice consistancy, it's comparable to those jelly orange slices that one usually finds in those Sathers 2 for 1 dollar packs, though flavor wise, it's way tastier than those suckers could ever hope to be. It's not too sweet, it has just the right amount of raspberry flavor to harmonize with the dark chocolate coating outside. Needless to say, that box that I bought? It did not make it home. Not even half way, that's how addictive these things are. You gotta give Joyva credit for staying kosher, and creating such a tasty treat.Without a doubt I'll be keeping my eye out for these badboys alot more now, and might even end up buying a big box for family get togethers. These are awesome, and definitely worth giving a shot.

I was missing one of my favorite food items from NY around Christmas.  So I found them online with Amazon and ordered them.  They are truley savoring and lucious on your taste buds.  Will order them again in the future.  Very prompt shipping service.

My mother moved to Florida a year ago. She mentions these jellies every so often. I know she misses them. When she lived in New York City I would go to the bodega and buy some to bring to her. I sent her these Chocolate covered jellies in the big box we see in the bodega. She was so happy she must have gone through the whole box within a week with the help of her room mate. I've been eating these jellies since I was a kid. It was so great to see the whole box for sale and to be able to send her the box for the holidays.
The jell rings were packaged so they wouldn't be damaged and weren't melted from heat or anything. Make sure you refrigerate them when you get them though they are much better cold!
Great food and delivery. Wish they would have included the note sent, as this was a Valentine's Day gift, but otherwise - it was great.

We use to always buy these when we lived in NYC but now living in upstate NY you hardly ever see them. Been buying the past few years here on Amazon during the cool weather. They are addicting..beware:)
I got this for my husband as a present since we both love these Jellies for my.  Was amazed to see it in such a large quantity
Product was old. The chocolate was brittle, stale and easily sheared off from the jelly. Not the Jelly Rings I remember from childhood.
As always Joyva is the BEST! My ONLY reason for not giving this a higher rating is the bottom layer was stale.  The rest was incredibly delicious!
All Joyva products , Jelly Rings, Halva, are unmatched. I wish they were more availableup here in Canada, but no problem ordering with Amazon.com.
My mom introduced them to me as a kid. I love these things. I've been looking all over for them.
the chocolate which is my favorite came to me white, like when chocolate is old.  They were not fresh at all.  I was very disappointed

really awful! I got into my Passover candy early and am so glad, because if I bit into this during pessach, in eager anticipation of probably my only sugar/choclate fix for the week of Passover, I would cry upon tasting it. Manischevitz triple chocolate macaroons, on the other hand taste great.

I received the jelly rings upsidedown, so all of the rings were all over the place and alot of the chocolate was broken off!! I also thought that I would be getting 7 lbs. of rings, not 5 lbs. For that price, I could have paid a little more at my corner Ralph Rottens for fresh and unbroken rings!! What a disappointment!

column10: We bought this and figured out we got over 8 more servings than we did when we bought them already made up.This is a mighty tasty mixture  and makes a great tea smoothie;)I have tried several flavors and love them all.

column9: My cat won't eat anything else... that says it all! :)
column10: I received TWO (2) 24-pack boxes of this product; not the 12-pack as pictured. The price is better than I get at the grocery store (Amazon Prime member).I've tried other brands of cat food, even the more expensive "healthier" brands; I even try the regular Whiskas. But, the Tender Bites is kitty's favorite! I can't get him to eat any other kind anymore. If I try, he refuses and turns to his dry cat food until I clean the dish and refresh with Tender Bites!

I buy this products occasionally for my 5 cats, since they really like the taste.  I think it's a very good product, it's not filled with too many fillers, and it doesn't smell too strong. The biggest downfall with all of these Whiskas pouches is that they are messy to dispense, and it is very difficult to get all of the product out of the pouch.  I find I get the gravy all over my hands, not the biggest issue, but ewww.

We have six indoor cats, and they all have different likes.  Our siamese cat will only eat the Whiskas Tender Bites chicken.  That is the only flavor she likes, and it has to be the tenderbites.  She usually just likes the juice but will sometimes eat some of the food as well.  Why she only likes this one, I don't know.  Amazon is the only place I know to get the box of 24 in the chicken only.  I rated it five stars because she likes it!

My cat is not a huge fan. Sure, she'll lap up the gravy, but leaves the little meat-like bits as dry as a bone. It feels like saving money, but not if your cat is only gonna eat cornstarch gravy and turn her nose up at the meat by-products. It's probably fine for a grocery-store food, but a better quality food will make your cat happier and maybe healthier. Also I can't imagine gravy has got the nutritional content my cat needs.Pouches seem like a great idea compared to messy, annoying cans, until you can't figure out a way to get the stuff out of the package without getting gravy all over your hands.I switched to Merrick cat foods and my cat is happier--she doesn't leave lots of uneaten bits.

To all you cats out there,I love this food, my pet keepers feed it to me 4 times a day, I meow in protest if it's late. If asked I'll even sit on command so I can eat Whiskas morning, noon, and night!Thank you for keeping them well supplied.Stella(typed by the Keeper)

I purchased this as an option for my cat since he only eats chicken. This is a much drier and diced product (no juice) as compared to the other Whiskas products in a pouch. However, the pouch is quite stuff, so if you cat likes it, he will surely get enough to eat from this pouch. Also, the picture does not look like the product I was shipped.

Our older cat (14 years old) would only lick the juice from the bowl and let the chunks alone.  I've read since then that cats are carnivores and therefore should not be fed a grain-based diet.  So many cat foods on the market have grains as the main components, and so you have to look for products labeled "grain free".  We found some at our local feed store.  Maybe our first cat would have lived longer if we'd fed him better.

Even my most finicky cat LOVED this flavor.  The bowls are spotless after their meal!  I haven't been able to find this flavor by itself in the store, only in variety packs, and my cats don't like all the other flavors in the variety packs.  I'm willing to pay a little more to get a box of food I know they love!

This used to be my cat's favorite food.  But a couple of months ago, they changed the formula and now my cat won't touch it, and I know why.  Each of the four flavors says "in juices" after it.  But since the formula changed, there is absolutely no juice in this food.  The food comes out in one big dry clump.  The juice was my cat's favorite part.  I'll still by the other Whiska's flavors, but not this one.
Walmart.com has this for $4.88 for a box of 12 packs.  It was even cheaper at my local grocery store.  Amazon is ripping us off.
This is a Repeat Buy for me. My cats eat these and its cheaper and easier to buy in bulk.
I love being able to order this item online and have it delivered. The price is amazing and not having to worry about running out of food for the furry foster babies is much appreciated!

If you subscribe, you save and you don't have to trek to the store to buy these bulky boxes. I thought purchased enough for a 2 months supply but no, my cats must not be felines because they have appetites like pigs. ;) I have to change my subscription so that they deliver more frequently.

I sometimes get notes from my cat Steve regarding his food, litter, toys etc. and I post them here. - - I know, its weirdDear Grocery Lady,Please don't think because I am of the feline persuasion that I did not see and understand the "buy 1 get 1 free" coupon I saw for this terrible food. In case you didn't get the hint that I don't like this and you should never bring it again, I threw up in your shoe as gentle reminder.You know I have a delicate digestive system and a discerning palate.  Stick to the cuisine I like....don't go rogue again!Sincerely,Steve-the-cat  ,,,^. . ^,,,~

I am very pleased with my shipment of wiskas tender bits turkey with giblets. I have been unable to purchase the box of all one flavor. I have tried to special order this at my local store and been unsuccessful on several occations. purchasing this through amazon.com I am able to get my cats favorite food on a regular bases.  thank you amazon.com

Although I like the convenience of the food and my cats like the taste the 24/$15 is more than 50% over what I pay even at Petsmart. I was going for the convenience of monthly shipments, but the premium price is too high.

column9: Love the product - question the price
column10: I love the tender bites as do my senior cats (17 & 18 yrs old). But I do question the price, which is a unusual.  I get the 24 count variety pack for $9.49 at my local Food Lion grocery store.  I would expect a 48 count pack to be no more than double that price (18.98) so $28.11 would seem a bit high.  Unless of course  48 means 48 - 12 pack boxes.  Then the description needs  a little work.
Product worked great, but a friend had to tell me how to use it.  It doesn't come with any instructions.

Summary:Peanut butter, plain: A bit "rubbery". I cooked them a little longer in microwave and added chips. ;^)Peanut butter, choc. chip: Crispy, crunchy, crumbly, rich and VERY addictive! (Yes, they always arrive broken up somewhat, but you won't care.)(Like other chip one, only 5 oz. box)Swirl shortbread: Too heavy and buttery for me. Nice texture.Choc. Chip shortbread: If you like shortbread, this will taste decadent! Rich choc. chips. Crispy and yes, also addictive! (Note: only 5 oz instead of 7 oz. box)Butter shortbread: Couldn't really eat these. Too heavy and buttery. Least favorite.Haven't tried others yet.I have a wheat allergy and never tasted shortbread again until I found these wonderful delights at the store in the health-food section! The shortbread choc chip I tried first has not only the unique taste of shortbread, but has chocolate chunks also! They are crunchy and light.In comparison, they weigh less than some other Pamela products. They are not as "buttery" as the Butter Shortbread or Swirl (a good thing in my opinion). I love the pecans also!Recommend to any wheat-allergy sufferer, or gluten intolerant person. :^)

column9: Pamela's products are awesome - BusyMom in PA
column10: My children and I all have to eat gluten-free.  I do most of our baking, but once in a while we splurge.  EVERY Pamela's product I have tried has been great!  These and espresso chunk are my indulgences.  The baking mixes are wonderful if you are in a hurry.  Please note: Pamela's does use other things that might be allergens, so please read the ingredient list! :)

We eat mostly gluten free as one of my kids has a sensitivity to it. While I try to bake all the goods myself, these looked like a good thing to carry as a snack when we travel. My daughter didn't like the cookie part much. SHe kept trying to pick out just the chocolate chips.For myself, it was OK. Sometimes gluten free baked goods can have a grainy aftertaste and that was the case with these. The upshot was they make an excellent cookie crumb pie crust when you toss them in the food processor and grind them up.
Delicious, gluten free, 2 cookies individually wrapped for less than $1.00.Beats the vending machine hands-down.

Missing the flavor of shortbread because of gulten intolerance? Try the line of Pamela's cookies and products. This cookie is sweet, crunchy goodness with out the gluten, large chunks of dark chocolate round out a flavorful treat.

This is absolutely the best store-bought cookie I've ever had, with wheat or not.  And it's wheat-free! They are so addictive that I almost wish I had never tried them, as they're not calorie-free.  The chocolate within is absolutely divine and the cookie has just the right texture.  I just had to put them on my Amazon subscription list.

We bought these along with the Walnut Biscotti, as an Easter treat for our relatives with celiac disease. We decided we had to try them first to make sure they tasted all right. We loved them!! I had to stop my kids from eating them before we could give some to our relatives. You would never know that they were gluten free... they are excellent!

...the Organic Chocolate Chip Pecan Shortbread 2-Count Cookies (Pack of 12) were within 60 days of their expiration date upon arrival. They were tasty but crumbles, too many crumbs, NOT the nicely formed cookies depicted. I wouldn't buy theses again UNLESS I knew the expiration date was further out. Hopefully they would have an improved taste and form.So my first try with wheat and gluten free cookies was "just OK" :-s
These cookies are great!  Don 't really get alot of good stuff when going gluten free.

I've only been doing a gluten-free diet a  short time and when I was checking a local grocery store, I discovered Pamela's Chocolate Chip Hazel Nut Short Bread Cookies but I only bought one package.  When I got them home and tried them I was amazed how good they are.  Then I found them on Amazon, where I can get them cheaper and satisfy my sweet tooth.  They are delicious!  Thank you, Pamela.
I don't have to be on a gluten-free diet, I'm trying to make better choices. This was a great start! They are on the sweet side but absolutely delicious!

I am normally not a cookie person-- I usually find them too sweet and too oily-- but these are just perfect!! They have a texture that reminds me of those Chinese almond cookies (crispy and a bit crumbly rather than chewy). I don't have a wheat or gluten intolerance but these are definitely some of the best cookies I have ever tasted. Best of all, the ingredients are 95% organic.Note: There are 9 cookies in the box. I've eaten 7 in the last couple hours, they're that good!

I got sent a sample of these organic cookies from the manufacturer and really enjoyed them, so I signed up to get an ongoing monthly delivery of 6 boxes. The problem is, I eat them all within a week so I think I need a second delivery for two weeks later. :) The cookies are crumbly and taste a bit like Mexican Wedding cookies. One thing though, the cookies can come crumbled a bit at times from shipping and the size and amount of chocolate chunks vary greatly from one cookie to the next. I found that is okay though, because they are so tasty. I like dipping them in organic rice milk.

Love these cookies- I have a hard time opening the package, eating just one or two, and putting the rest away. Box is usually gone by the end of the day!! Melt in your mouth chocolate chunks balance out the rich buttery tasting shortbread with crunchy pecans. Too good not to buy!
These are my favorite wheat-free cookies out there, the pecan choc chip shortbread. Love these!

These are the best cookies!  Sort of like gourmet Lorna D cookies with chocolate chunks. Rich, not too sweet and no gritty GF aftertaste. The only bad thing about them is that you are tempted to eat the whole box. I will definitely buy them again, but not too often.

column9: Save your $ - buy these in the store.
column10: These cookies are pretty good for gluten free (but very high in calories). But do yourself a favor and don't buy them online. They arrived as a box of cookie crumble; every single cookie was broken.

(written by wittenburg's wife)Yum yum yum! You cannot tell these shortbread cookies are GF. Since being celiac, I really miss Pepperidge Farm Chesapeake cookies (Chocolate and Pecan chunks). These are similar but even better!!!

My husband LOVES these coookies. He is on a gluten-free diet and has commented that these cookies are the best he's ever tasted -- gluten-free or not!  Our local health food store doesn't carry this flavor, so I'm thrilled that I can order them by the case at Amazon.
I love these cookies. They are a great gluten-free treat. They are a smigeon dry, so you'll need to have some milk handy.

This is one of the most delicious cookies I have every had! The shortbread is indistinguishable in texture and taste from its regular gluten counterpart. The pecans add a nice crunch in the cookie and the chocolate keeps the whole thing from being too dry.My only wish is that the chocolate was not in there in such big chunks, maybe broken down more to a chip size. So that you get more chocolate through out the cookie and less chocolate in one bite. But that's just a matter of preference. As far as taste the chocolate is excellent, moist and high quality.I love the packaging just as much as the taste. The individual packages are just perfect to pop in my purse to have later as light snack.If you have celiacs, or even if you dont, I highly recommend getting this cookie. It makes a delicious treat.Pros: Taste. Handy packages of 2.Cons: Addictive.

Cookies a little too sweet for me.  The cookes came delivered in unbroken boxes, but found most cookies inside were broken and just crumbs.  I liked the chocolate chip ones better- they were not as broken as these pecan shortbread ones.

Pamela's Products Chocolate Chunk Pecan Shortbread Cookies are a pleasure to eat! These are the best packaged gluten free cookies I've found since I was diagnosed with Celiac disease.  Even my grandkids love them and think they're a special treat!  The 2-count cookie packs are so convenient, too.  I would highly recommend these delicious cookies!
these cookies are delicious, and in these individual packs, they seem to hold together better...when you purchase them in the boxes, they come in crumbles

Having tried Pamela's regular shortbread cookies, these are a vast improvement.  Why in the world she passes the plain ones off as shortbread, when they are at best a bland biscuit, and the base dough for these is as close to shortbread as I've ever had, gluten-free.  They have a great flavor, balance of sweet/savory that makes shortbread so good, nice crisp texture.  I would purchase these again.
These are superb. Light sweetness, deliocious nut flavor. Perfect. Only issue is they crumble a lot, so packaging them the way they did, is not recommended.

its nice to have them individually wrapped. the taste is ok but a little chemical taste in the parts without chocolate chunks. each individual would have to try for themselves. they will keep easily due to individual wrapping.

column9: So good, I will have to stop ordering them.

They are one of the few treats that I can't refuse.  I eat too many, in too short of a time.  Good for my taste buds, not so good for my tummy. Definite yum.

I was thoroughly disappointed in the condition of the cookies after they arrived. I receieved the Chocolate Chunk,Choc. Chip and Pecan Choc. Chip. They arrived in two shipments and all were broken. Only a few of the Choc. Chip cookies survived.Hey Amazon, I think that the packing wasn't sufficient and it might have helped to mark the outer boxes "fragile".

I bought this online for my husband.  I was going to order a moreexpensive brand from another online store, but this was fabulous.Not only did it lower his blood pressure, he felt lighter and energetic(the tea has detox properties) and he was "friskier".My husband takes the worst care of himself and if this can help him it will help anyone.

This is great tea, taste is good without adding anything. It seems to work or at least my pressure seems to be more stable now that I drink a couple of cups per day.  Might be the reduced coffee but I'll give credit to the tea.
My husband is very happy with this product to help control his high blood pressure.We will continue to re-order. We receive the product on a timely basis and invery good shape! Thanks again.
I have used these tea for a while now, not daily but when I feel my blood pressure is up, and every single time it has worked to lower my blood pressure! It is awesome!
The best tasting instant coffee that I have found is Jacobs Kronung. I have tried many others numbering in the dozens and this is the closest to brewed coffee taste. Give it a try and you will agree.
This product is really superior to most other instants.Pity it is not available here today. Quantity order.

column9: Can you say Wii are overrpriced?
column10: Another overpriced Wii product. Needs to be $1-$1.50 each not the 3.00 they cost me including shipping. Other than that, these are a great product. A bit too expensive for party favors which would be the proper target group.
